Core0水平速度估计更新
来源：core0_cyt4bb7/project/code/sensor/velocityEstimator.c，符号：velocityEstimatorUpdate，片段SHA-256：dc5ac7b35dccddca1ec381689ca2f770773e1ba66777a1d153bf9dec1eb70506。
代码（c）

void velocityEstimatorUpdate(uint8_t allowFrozenTofHeight)
{
    opticalFlowSampleStruct sample;
    float heightMm = 0.0f;
    float verticalVelocityMmS = 0.0f;
    float heightM;
    uint8_t tofFresh = tofGetHeight(&heightMm, &verticalVelocityMmS);
    uint8_t tofHealthy = altitudeTofIsHealthy();
    uint32_t primask;

    (void) verticalVelocityMmS; /* 垂直速度本阶段不入水平融合 */
    heightM = heightMm * 0.001f;

    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    velocityEstimatorState.heightM = heightM;
    velocityEstimatorState.tofFresh = tofFresh;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);

    if (!opticalFlowPoll(&sample))
    {
        return;
    }
    /* 收到任意完整帧 → 清链路帧年龄（含无效帧，表示链路活）。
     * 有效观测年龄 validAgeMs 仅在通过全部门控 + 校正后才清零（见下）。
     * 连续被拒计数：每收一帧先 +1（饱和不回卷），成功校正时在提交块归零。 */
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    velocityEstimatorState.frameAgeMs = 0u;
    velocityEstimatorState.lastRawFlowX = (float) sample.flowX;
    velocityEstimatorState.lastRawFlowY = (float) sample.flowY;
    if (velocityEstimatorState.consecutiveInvalidFrames < 0xFFFFu)
    {
        velocityEstimatorState.consecutiveInvalidFrames++;
    }
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);

    /* 帧无效 / dt 越界 / 无可用高度 / 高度越界 → 本帧不校正、不刷新有效年龄。
     * 已进入CRUISE后的ToF HOLD允许使用facade冻结的最后可信高度维持短窗光流尺度；
     * RAMP及其它调用场景仍要求实时健康，避免长期陈旧高度掩盖安全失效。 */
    if (!sample.valid ||
        sample.dtUs < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_DT_MIN_US ||
        sample.dtUs > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_DT_MAX_US ||
        (!tofHealthy && allowFrozenTofHeight == 0u) ||
        heightM < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_HEIGHT_MIN_M ||
        heightM > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_HEIGHT_MAX_M)
    {
        return;
    }

    {
        float q[4];
        float gyroX;
        float gyroY;
        float gyroZ;
        float physicalPitch;
        float physicalRoll;
        float invDtS;
        float flowAngularRateX;
        float flowAngularRateY;
        float flowBodyX;
        float flowBodyY;
        float flowSensorX;
        float flowSensorY;
        float flowLocal[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float measurementVariance;
        float snapVel[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float snapBias[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float snapP00[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float snapP01[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float snapP11[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float delayedVel[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float innovation[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        velocityEstimatorKalmanResultStruct result[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        uint16_t delaySlot;
        uint32_t snapPredictGeneration;
        uint8_t updateAccepted;
        uint8_t a;

        velocityEstimatorSnapshotImu(
            q, &gyroX, &gyroY, &gyroZ, &physicalPitch, &physicalRoll);

        /* 大倾角时 v=h×flowRate 近似失效；门限放宽至约 65° 以容忍机动平移大倾角（大倾角帧测速误差增大）。 */
        if (fabsf(physicalPitch) > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_TILT_LIMIT_RAD ||
            fabsf(physicalRoll) > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_TILT_LIMIT_RAD)
        {
            return;
        }

        invDtS = 1000000.0f / (float) sample.dtUs; /* 1/积分时长(秒) */
        flowAngularRateX = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_SCALE_X_RAD_PER_COUNT
            * (float) sample.flowX * invDtS;
        flowAngularRateY = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_SCALE_Y_RAD_PER_COUNT
            * (float) sample.flowY * invDtS;

        /* 倾摆去旋转：flowX 配 pitch(gyroX)、flowY 配 roll(gyroY)，板端"减负"=加回。 */
        flowAngularRateX -= VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_GYRO_COMP_X * gyroX;
        flowAngularRateY -= VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_GYRO_COMP_Y * gyroY;
        flowBodyX = heightM * flowAngularRateX;
        flowBodyY = heightM * flowAngularRateY;

        /* 杠杆臂切向解耦：光流偏离旋转中心 r=(LEVER_X,LEVER_Y)，yaw 转动时光流测到
         * 真实切向速度需扣除以还原质心速度。注意 gyroZ=imuData.gz 为 CCW 正，而 FRD
         * 右手系(Z 向下)的 ω_z = -gyroZ，故 v_tan=(gyroZ·dy, -gyroZ·dx)，
         * 质心 v = v_光流 - v_tan → forward -= gyroZ·dy；right += gyroZ·dx。确定性补偿，非标定。 */
        flowBodyX -= (gyroZ * VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_LEVER_Y_M);
        flowBodyY += (gyroZ * VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_LEVER_X_M);

        /* 已标定 B(FRD)→S 安装映射：sensorX=−bodyRight，sensorY=−bodyForward。 */
        flowSensorX = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BODY_TO_SENSOR_XX * flowBodyX
            + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BODY_TO_SENSOR_XY * flowBodyY;
        flowSensorY = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BODY_TO_SENSOR_YX * flowBodyX
            + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BODY_TO_SENSOR_YY * flowBodyY;
        velocityEstimatorRotateSensorToLocal(
            q[0], q[1], q[2], q[3],
            flowSensorX, flowSensorY, 0.0f,
            &flowLocal[0], &flowLocal[1]);

        /* 物理速度有限性守卫（高度/dt 异常组合可能产生 Inf/NaN）。 */
        if (!velocityEstimatorIsFinite(flowLocal[0]) ||
            !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(flowLocal[1]))
        {
            return;
        }

        /* 量测方差 R 随高度平方增长：同样角流噪声在更高处对应更大线速度噪声。
         * 首版不按 innovation 调 R（避免真实加速时残差变大而错误压低光流权重）。 */
        measurementVariance = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_R_BASE
            + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_R_HEIGHT_COEFF * heightM * heightM;
        measurementVariance = clampf(
            measurementVariance, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MIN, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MAX);

        /* 延迟补偿 + 缩短临界区：
         * P2 修复——关中断仅保护"快照"和"提交"两个短瞬间，中间 KF 计算（纯函数、
         * 基于局部快照）放临界区外，避免长时间关中断扰动 1ms 飞控环。
         * 延迟补偿——光流量测代表约 FLOW_DELAY_MS 前的状态，故 innovation 用"延迟时刻"
         * 的融合速度（环形历史）而非当前值，使量测与估计同时刻，消除时间错位。 */

        /* 临界区 1（短）：快照当前 v/bias/P + 取延迟时刻融合速度。 */
        primask = __get_PRIMASK();
        __disable_irq();
        snapPredictGeneration = velocityEstimatorState.predictGeneration;
        /* histWriteIdx 指向下一个待写槽，最近写入的是 idx-1；延迟 D 帧即 idx-1-D。 */
        delaySlot = (uint16_t) ((velocityEstimatorState.histWriteIdx
            + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VEL_HIST_LEN
            - 1u - VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_DELAY_MS) % VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VEL_HIST_LEN);
        for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
        {
            snapVel[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity;
            snapBias[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].bias;
            snapP00[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p00;
            snapP01[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p01;
            snapP11[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p11;
            delayedVel[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelHist[delaySlot];
        }
        __set_PRIMASK(primask);

        /* 临界区外：innovation 对齐延迟时刻估计（延迟补偿核心），KF 更新纯函数计算。
         * 两轴同拍：任一轴坏值（innovation 越限或更新失败）则整帧不提交。 */
        updateAccepted = 1u;
        for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
        {
            innovation[a] = flowLocal[a] - delayedVel[a];
            if (velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BIAS_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES ||
                fabsf(innovation[a]) > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_INNOVATION_LIMIT_MPS ||
                !velocityEstimatorKalmanUpdateAxis(
                    snapVel[a], snapBias[a], snapP00[a], snapP01[a], snapP11[a],
                    innovation[a], measurementVariance, &result[a]))
            {
                updateAccepted = 0u;
            }
        }

        /* 临界区 2（短）：提交结果 + 调试量。两轴同拍，单轴坏值则整帧不更新。 */
        primask = __get_PRIMASK();
        __disable_irq();
        for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
        {
            velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].flowVelocity = flowLocal[a];
            velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].innovation = innovation[a];
        }
        if (updateAccepted &&
            velocityEstimatorState.predictGeneration == snapPredictGeneration)
        {
            for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
            {
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity = result[a].velocity;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].bias = result[a].bias;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p00 = result[a].p00;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p01 = result[a].p01;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p11 = result[a].p11;
            }
            velocityEstimatorState.flowValid = 1u;
            velocityEstimatorState.validAgeMs = 0u; /* 有效观测年龄仅在更新成功时清零 */
            velocityEstimatorState.consecutiveInvalidFrames = 0u; /* 成功校正 → 连续被拒计数归零 */
        }
        __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    }
}

Core0飞行任务序列推进
来源：core0_cyt4bb7/project/code/flight/flightSequenceCoordinator.c，符号：flightSequenceStep，片段SHA-256：38b02fc51581a753ba123b7016af124276e6d1609b9f8d3e15b0d9fd8493765a。
代码（c）

void flightSequenceStep(const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts,
    flightSequenceOutputStruct *output)
{
    flightSequencePolicyContextStruct policyContext;
    flightSequencePolicyDecisionStruct decision;
    flightSequenceFactsStruct policyFacts;
    flightSequenceStageEnum renderStage;
    uint32_t dtMs;
    uint32_t landingTrigger = 0u;
    uint32_t policyActionMask;
    uint32_t policyTriggerSources = 0u;
    uint8_t policyPrimaryReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
    uint8_t landingReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
    uint8_t closedLoop;
    uint8_t mode3Event;
    uint8_t mode2Event;
    uint8_t landingTriggeredThisStep = 0u;
    uint8_t directDisarmActive = 0u;

    if (output == 0) return;
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(*output));
    if (facts == 0) return;

    dtMs = facts->nowMs - sequenceContext.lastNowMs;
    sequenceContext.lastNowMs = facts->nowMs;
    sequenceContext.cycleSeq++;
    policyFacts = *facts;
    policyFacts.dtMs = dtMs;
    policyFacts.coordinatorCycleSeq = sequenceContext.cycleSeq;
    policyFacts.coordinatorTransitionSeq = sequenceContext.transitionSeq;
    policyFacts.coordinatorEpisodeSeq = sequenceContext.episodeSeq;
    closedLoop = (facts->safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP) ? 1u : 0u;

    if (facts->systemMode != sequenceContext.lastSystemMode)
    {
        sequenceContext.lastSystemMode = facts->systemMode;
        sequenceContext.mode3Armed = 0u;
        sequenceContext.mode2Armed = 0u;
        sequenceContext.mode3LowTiming = 0u;
        sequenceContext.mode2LowTiming = 0u;
        if (sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING)
            sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm;
        flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_MODE);
    }
    if (facts->rejoinEdge != 0u)
    {
        sequenceContext.mode3Armed = 0u;
        sequenceContext.mode2Armed = 0u;
        if (sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING)
            sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm;
        flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_REJOIN);
    }

    if (facts->safety.disarmAcceptedSeq != sequenceContext.lastDisarmAcceptedSeq)
    {
        sequenceContext.lastDisarmAcceptedSeq = facts->safety.disarmAcceptedSeq;
        flightSequenceReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_DISARM);
    }
    if (facts->safety.protectAcceptedSeq != sequenceContext.lastProtectAcceptedSeq)
    {
        sequenceContext.lastProtectAcceptedSeq = facts->safety.protectAcceptedSeq;
        flightSequenceReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_PROTECT);
    }
    if (facts->safety.launchAcceptedSeq != sequenceContext.lastLaunchAcceptedSeq)
    {
        sequenceContext.lastLaunchAcceptedSeq = facts->safety.launchAcceptedSeq;
        sequenceContext.episodeSeq++;
        flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_INIT);
        if (sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff != 0u)
        {
            sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 0u;
            enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_WAIT,
                (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm);
        }
    }

    mode3Event = consumeLevelRequest(facts->mode3RequestValid,
        facts->mode3RequestLevel, (uint8_t) (facts->core2LinkLost == 0u),
        &sequenceContext.mode3Armed, &sequenceContext.mode3LowTiming,
        &sequenceContext.mode3LowStartMs, facts->nowMs);
    mode2Event = consumeLevelRequest(facts->mode2RequestValid,
        facts->mode2RequestLevel, (uint8_t) (facts->core2LinkLost == 0u),
        &sequenceContext.mode2Armed, &sequenceContext.mode2LowTiming,
        &sequenceContext.mode2LowStartMs, facts->nowMs);
    policyFacts.mode3RequestArmed = sequenceContext.mode3Armed;
    policyFacts.mode2RequestArmed = sequenceContext.mode2Armed;
    policyFacts.coordinatorTransitionSeq = sequenceContext.transitionSeq;
    policyFacts.coordinatorEpisodeSeq = sequenceContext.episodeSeq;

    memset(&policyContext, 0, sizeof(policyContext));
    policyContext.stage = sequenceContext.stage;
    policyContext.stageElapsedMs = sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs;
    policyContext.dtMs = dtMs;
    policyContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm;
    policyContext.cruiseAltitudeMm = sequenceContext.cruiseAltitudeMm;
    policyContext.mode3RequestEvent = (uint8_t) (mode3Event &&
        facts->systemMode == (uint8_t) UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_LORA_FWD);
    policyContext.mode2RequestEvent = (uint8_t) (mode2Event &&
        facts->systemMode == (uint8_t) UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO);
    memset(&decision, 0, sizeof(decision));
    flightSequencePolicySelectTriggers(&policyFacts, &policyContext, &decision);
    policyActionMask = decision.actionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ALL;
    if (policyActionMask != decision.actionMask)
    {
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_POLICY_INVALID;
        policyActionMask = 0u;
    }
    if (policyActionMask != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t triggerMetadataValid = (uint8_t)
            (decision.triggerEventValid == 1u && decision.triggerSources != 0u &&
             (decision.triggerSources & ~FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_POLICY_ALL) == 0u);
        uint8_t risingAction = (uint8_t)
            ((policyActionMask & ~sequenceContext.policyActionLevelMask) != 0u);
        uint8_t repeatedToken = (uint8_t)
            (sequenceContext.policyTriggerPrimed != 0u &&
             sequenceContext.lastPolicyTriggerEventSeq == decision.triggerEventSeq &&
             sequenceContext.lastPolicyTriggerSources == decision.triggerSources);
        if (triggerMetadataValid && risingAction && !repeatedToken)
        {
            policyTriggerSources = decision.triggerSources;
            policyPrimaryReason = decision.primaryReason;
            sequenceContext.policyTriggerPrimed = 1u;
            sequenceContext.lastPolicyTriggerEventSeq = decision.triggerEventSeq;
            sequenceContext.lastPolicyTriggerSources = decision.triggerSources;
        }
        else
        {
            if (!triggerMetadataValid)
                output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_POLICY_INVALID;
            policyActionMask = 0u;
        }
    }
    sequenceContext.policyActionLevelMask = decision.actionMask &
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ALL;

    if (facts->k5StandbyEdge != 0u)
    {
        output->requestDisarm = 1u;
        directDisarmActive = 1u;
        output->triggerSources |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_K5_STANDBY;
        sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 0u;
    }
    if (((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ARM) != 0u) &&
        (directDisarmActive == 0u))
    {
        output->triggerSources |= policyTriggerSources;
        sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources |= policyTriggerSources;
        if (policyPrimaryReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
            sequenceContext.primaryReason = policyPrimaryReason;
        if (facts->faultLatched != 0u) output->acknowledgeFault = 1u;
        else if ((facts->safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_DISARMED ||
                  facts->safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_PROTECTED) &&
            (facts->initialized != 0u) && (facts->controlReady != 0u) &&
            (requiredLinkLost(facts) == 0u))
        {
            output->requestLaunch = 1u;
            if ((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_TAKEOFF) != 0u)
                sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 1u;
        }
        else
        {
            sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 0u;
            output->safetyClampMask |= (requiredLinkLost(facts) != 0u) ?
                FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_REQUIRED_LINK : FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_SAFETY_STATE;
        }
    }
    if (((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_TAKEOFF) != 0u) &&
        ((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ARM) == 0u) && closedLoop &&
        (sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_IDLE))
    {
        if ((facts->systemPhase == CORE_UX_PHASE_HOME) && (facts->standalone == 0u) &&
            (requiredLinkLost(facts) == 0u))
        {
            output->triggerSources |= policyTriggerSources;
            sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources |= policyTriggerSources;
            if (policyPrimaryReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
                sequenceContext.primaryReason = policyPrimaryReason;
            enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_WAIT, (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm);
        }
    }

    if (sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs < FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_ELAPSED_CAP_MS)
    {
        uint32_t room = FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_ELAPSED_CAP_MS - sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs;
        sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs += (dtMs < room) ? dtMs : room;
    }
    renderStage = sequenceContext.stage;
    renderBaseStage(facts, output, renderStage);

    policyContext.stage = renderStage;
    policyContext.stageElapsedMs = sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs;
    policyContext.dtMs = dtMs;
    policyContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm;
    memset(&decision, 0, sizeof(decision));
    policyFacts.coordinatorTransitionSeq = sequenceContext.transitionSeq;
    policyFacts.coordinatorEpisodeSeq = sequenceContext.episodeSeq;
    flightSequencePolicyApplyStage(&policyFacts, &policyContext, &decision);
    mergePolicy(&decision, renderStage, output);
    if (output->rejectedOverrideMask != 0u)
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_POLICY_INVALID;

    if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_WAIT &&
        (((decision.overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u) ?
         (((output->rejectedOverrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) == 0u) &&
          decision.stageTransitionReady) :
         (sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs >= TAKEOFF_WAIT_MS)))
        enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_RAMP, sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm);
    else if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_RAMP &&
        (((decision.overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u) ?
         (((output->rejectedOverrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) == 0u) &&
          decision.stageTransitionReady) :
         (sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs >= TAKEOFF_RAMP_MS)))
        enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_CRUISE, sequenceContext.cruiseAltitudeMm);
    else if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING &&
        (decision.touchdown ||
         ((decision.overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u)))
    {
        uint8_t transitionOverrideValid = (uint8_t)
            ((decision.overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u &&
             (output->rejectedOverrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) == 0u);
        uint8_t landReady = (uint8_t) (decision.touchdown ||
            (transitionOverrideValid && decision.stageTransitionReady));
        if (landReady) enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED, output->altitudeTargetMm);
    }
    else if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED)
        output->requestDisarm = 1u;

    if (closedLoop && confirmedLandingLinkLost(facts, closedLoop,
        &landingReason, &landingTrigger))
    {
        if ((sequenceContext.stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING) &&
            (sequenceContext.stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED))
        {
            sequenceContext.primaryReason = landingReason;
            sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources |= landingTrigger;
            enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING,
                (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm);
            flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_ABORT);
            landingTriggeredThisStep = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (closedLoop &&
        ((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_LAND) != 0u) &&
        (sequenceContext.stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING) &&
        (sequenceContext.stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED))
    {
        landingReason = (policyPrimaryReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE) ?
            policyPrimaryReason : (policyContext.mode2RequestEvent ?
            CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_LORA_MODE2 : CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_LORA_MODE3);
        landingTrigger = policyTriggerSources;
        sequenceContext.primaryReason = landingReason;
        sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources |= landingTrigger;
        enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING,
            (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm);
        flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_ABORT);
        landingTriggeredThisStep = 1u;
    }
    if ((sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING) ||
        (sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED))
    {
        output->landingActive = 1u;
        output->altReached = 0u;
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_LANDING;
        output->triggerSources |= landingTrigger;
        output->primaryReason = sequenceContext.primaryReason;
        if (landingTriggeredThisStep != 0u)
        {
            /* 兼容既有语义：触发拍立即撤销运动资格，高度/RGB/蜂鸣从下一拍缓降输出接管。 */
            output->policyPositionActive = 1u;
        }
    }
    if (output->requestDisarm != 0u) directDisarmActive = 1u;

    if ((facts->safety.state != SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP) ||
        (facts->safety.valid == 0u) || (facts->paramsValid == 0u) ||
        (facts->initialized == 0u) || (facts->controlReady == 0u) ||
        (directDisarmActive != 0u))
    {
        output->altitudeControlEnable = 0u;
        output->idleThrottleMode = 0u;
        output->altReached = 0u;
        output->policyPositionActive = 1u;
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_SAFETY_STATE;
    }
    /* 唯一owner在目标/门设置后推进 altitudeHold，并以本拍fresh failsafe做最终钳制。 */
    pidFlightControllerSetIdleThrottleMode(output->idleThrottleMode);
    altitudeHoldSetControlEnabled(output->altitudeControlEnable);
    altitudeHoldSetTargetMm(output->altitudeTargetMm);
    altitudeHoldUpdate(facts->nowMs);
    altitudeHoldGetSnapshot(&output->altitude);
    if (output->altitude.failsafeStage != ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_NORMAL)
    {
        output->rgbIntent = UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN;
        output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_WARN;
    }
    if (output->altitude.failsafeStage == ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_RAMP)
    {
        output->altReached = 0u;
        output->policyPositionActive = 1u;
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_TOF_RAMP;
        output->triggerSources |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_TOF_FAILSAFE;
        if (output->primaryReason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
            output->primaryReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_TOF_FAILSAFE;
    }
    if (output->altitude.requestDisarm != 0u)
    {
        output->requestDisarm = 1u;
        output->altReached = 0u;
        output->policyPositionActive = 1u;
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_SAFETY_STATE;
    }
    if ((facts->readyBeepActive != 0u) && (output->landingActive == 0u) &&
        (output->altitude.failsafeStage == ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_NORMAL) &&
        ((output->buzzerPattern == UART_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT) ||
         (output->buzzerPattern == UART_LINK_BUZZER_3S)))
        output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_THREE_BEEPS;

    /* 最终水平引导仲裁：Policy本地 > 普通视觉/MOTION；安全钳制已将Policy源置零。 */
    if (output->policyPositionActive == 0u)
    {
        uint8_t externalAllowed = (uint8_t) (output->allowExternalMotion && facts->motionValid &&
            facts->motionFenceOpen && !facts->standalone &&
            facts->systemPhase == CORE_UX_PHASE_HOME && !output->landingActive &&
            output->altitude.failsafeStage != ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_RAMP);
        if (externalAllowed)
        {
            motionFeedforwardDiffUpdate(facts->motionVx, facts->motionVy,
                facts->motionSeq, facts->nowMs);
            if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_CRUISE)
            {
                output->bodyVelocityFwdMps = facts->motionVx *
                    sequenceParams.motionVelFfVxToFwd;
                output->bodyVelocityRightMps = facts->motionVy *
                    FLIGHT_MOTION_VEL_FF_VY_TO_RIGHT_SIGN *
                    sequenceParams.motionVelFfVyToRight;
                output->bodyVelocityFwdMps += facts->motionWz *
                    sequenceParams.motionYawOrbitOffsetRightM;
                output->bodyVelocityRightMps += facts->motionWz *
                    sequenceParams.motionYawOrbitOffsetFwdM;
            }
            output->pitchFeedforwardRad = motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvX() *
                sequenceParams.motionFfVxToPitch;
            output->rollFeedforwardRad = motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvY() *
                sequenceParams.motionFfVyToRoll;
            output->yawRateRadS = facts->motionWz * sequenceParams.motionFfWzToYaw;
        }
        else motionFeedforwardDiffReset();

        if (output->allowVisionPosition &&
            (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_CRUISE) &&
            sequenceParams.visionPosErrEnable && facts->visionFrameValid)
        {
            uint8_t visionFinite = (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(facts->visionErrX) &&
                finiteFloat(facts->visionErrY) && finiteFloat(facts->visionYawErr) &&
                facts->visionErrX >= -FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX &&
                facts->visionErrX <= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX &&
                facts->visionErrY >= -FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX &&
                facts->visionErrY <= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX &&
                facts->visionYawErr >= -FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_YAW_RAD &&
                facts->visionYawErr <= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_YAW_RAD);
            if (facts->visionTargetValid && visionFinite)
            {
                sequenceContext.lastVisionHadTarget = 1u;
                output->visionErrX = facts->visionErrX;
                output->visionErrY = facts->visionErrY;
                output->visionYawErr = facts->visionYawErr;
                output->visionValid = 1u;
            }
            else if (sequenceContext.lastVisionHadTarget && visionFinite &&
                facts->targetLostAgeMs < 3000u)
            {
                output->visionErrX = facts->visionErrX;
                output->visionErrY = facts->visionErrY;
                output->visionValid = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        if (output->landingActive != 0u)
        {
            /* 缓降保留Policy显式机体系命令，但撤销外部MOTION微分前馈及其历史。 */
            motionFeedforwardDiffReset();
            output->pitchFeedforwardRad = 0.0f;
            output->rollFeedforwardRad = 0.0f;
        }
        else
        {
            motionFeedforwardDiffUpdate(output->bodyVelocityFwdMps,
                output->bodyVelocityRightMps * FLIGHT_MOTION_VEL_FF_VY_TO_RIGHT_SIGN,
                sequenceContext.cycleSeq, facts->nowMs);
            output->pitchFeedforwardRad = motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvX() *
                sequenceParams.motionFfVxToPitch;
            output->rollFeedforwardRad = motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvY() *
                sequenceParams.motionFfVyToRoll;
        }
    }

    if ((output->safetyClampMask & (FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_SAFETY_STATE |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_TOF_RAMP)) != 0u)
    {
        output->visionValid = 0u;
        output->visionErrX = 0.0f;
        output->visionErrY = 0.0f;
        output->visionYawErr = 0.0f;
        output->bodyVelocityFwdMps = 0.0f;
        output->bodyVelocityRightMps = 0.0f;
        output->yawRateRadS = 0.0f;
        output->pitchFeedforwardRad = 0.0f;
        output->rollFeedforwardRad = 0.0f;
        motionFeedforwardDiffReset();
    }

    output->cycleSeq = sequenceContext.cycleSeq;
    output->episodeSeq = sequenceContext.episodeSeq;
    output->transitionSeq = sequenceContext.transitionSeq;
    output->triggerSources |= sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources;
    if (output->primaryReason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
        output->primaryReason = sequenceContext.primaryReason;
    output->valid = 1u;
}

Core1 MOTION重入零帧栅栏
来源：core1_cyt4bb7/project/code/app/core1MotionTxFence.c，符号：core1MotionTxFencePrepare，片段SHA-256：80ba2c89e4754f5e6f5fa44208f0e4ab8f5d12a82572fd5403bc0d25041d6f7c。
代码（c）

uint8_t core1MotionTxFencePrepare(core1MotionTxFenceState *state,
    uint32_t nowMs, float vx, float vy, float wz, uint8_t flags,
    core1MotionTxFenceFrame *frame)
{
    uint8_t nonzero;
    if ((state == 0) || (frame == 0)) return 0u;
    nonzero = (uint8_t) ((vx != 0.0f) || (vy != 0.0f) ||
        (wz != 0.0f) || (flags != 0u));
    if ((nonzero != 0u) &&
        ((state->primed == 0u) ||
         ((uint32_t) (nowMs - state->lastTxMs) >= CORE1_MOTION_TX_REARM_MS)))
    {
        frame->vx = 0.0f;
        frame->vy = 0.0f;
        frame->wz = 0.0f;
        frame->flags = 0u;
        state->primed = 1u;
        state->lastTxMs = nowMs;
        return 0u;
    }
    frame->vx = vx;
    frame->vy = vy;
    frame->wz = wz;
    frame->flags = flags;
    state->primed = 1u;
    state->lastTxMs = nowMs;
    return 1u;
}

Core1参数事务阶段推进
来源：core1_cyt4bb7/project/code/comm/paramSyncGateway.c，符号：advanceGlobal，片段SHA-256：233ee0ea6a7b7db4ceb36b2369172e1ddc658f24277238b68cc03781a920b635。
代码（c）

static void advanceGlobal(void)
{
    uint8_t next;
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_DECIDE)
    {
        persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH, globalTransactionId,
            globalTargetMask);
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT)
    {
        persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, globalTransactionId,
            globalTargetMask);
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
        return;
    }
    next = nextGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask, globalTarget);
    if (next < 5u)
    {
        globalTarget = next;
        /* Core1 owns the durable coordinator journal and is deliberately the
         * last cleanup participant.  If any earlier FINISH failed, do not let
         * Core1 clear that journal: retain the full FINISH decision and replay
         * every participant after recovery instead. */
        if ((globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH ||
             globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT) && (next == 1u) &&
            (globalFailedMask != 0u))
        {
            globalFailedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << 1);
            advanceGlobal();
            return;
        }
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK)
    {
        if (globalAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY)
            globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY;
        else if (globalAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME)
            globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_VERIFY_LOCK;
        else
            globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_VERIFY_LOCK)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT || globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_DECIDE;
        globalTarget = 1u;
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH)
    {
        if (globalFailedMask != 0u)
            rememberRecovery(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH, globalTransactionId,
                globalTargetMask);
        else
            clearRecovery();
        globalCommittedMask = globalFailedMask;
        globalTouchedMask = 0u;
        globalPreparedMask = 0u;
        globalFinishRequired = 0u;
        if (globalFailedMask == 0u &&
            globalConflictCleanupActive != 0u)
        {
            if (restartAfterConflictRecovery() == 0u)
                sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "RETRY_ROUTE");
            return;
        }
        sendGlobalFinal(globalFailedMask ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK,
            globalFailedMask ? "FINISH" : NULL);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT)
    {
        uint8_t abortFailed = (uint8_t) (globalFailedMask != 0u);
        uint8_t responseFailed;
        if (abortFailed)
            rememberRecovery(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, globalTransactionId,
                globalTargetMask);
        else
            clearRecovery();
        globalCommittedMask &= globalFailedMask;
        globalTouchedMask &= globalFailedMask;
        globalPreparedMask &= globalFailedMask;
        globalFinishRequired = 0u;
        if (abortFailed == 0u && globalConflictCleanupActive != 0u)
        {
            if (restartAfterConflictRecovery() == 0u)
                sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "RETRY_ROUTE");
            return;
        }
        /* A successful rollback does not turn the operation which triggered it
         * into success.  Board-originated transactions are intentionally
         * silent on UART, but still need a FAILED terminal state. */
        responseFailed = (uint8_t) (abortFailed || globalOperationFailed);
        sendGlobalFinal(responseFailed ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK,
            abortFailed ? "ROLLBACK" : (responseFailed ? "ABORTED" : NULL));
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
    {
        globalTransactionId = paramSyncGlobalPackSlotSummary(
            globalSlotValidMask, globalSlotEmptyMask, globalSlotInvalidMask);
        if (globalTransactionId == 0u)
        {
            globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INVALID;
            sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "INSPECT");
        }
        else
            sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL);
    }
    else
    {
        sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL);
    }
}

#include "core0Loop.h"

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core0 cm_7_0 飞控主循环（定高飞控）
 *   PIT_CH0 1ms   : IMU + 安全状态机（消费发车指令）
 *   PIT_CH1 1ms   : PID 级联控制 + 混控 + 电机输出
 *   主循环        : VL53L8CX 定高 + 读视觉误差 + 参数热重载 + 共享内存收发
 *
 * 取消急停：cm_7_0 不再读物理按键。发车/恢复/清空/调参全部由 cm_7_1 菜单经
 *   共享内存第三区 paramToFlight 下发：
 *     - cmdLaunchSeq/cmdStandbySeq 边沿 → Coordinator解释后向modeFlight发布轻量请求
 *     - paramSeq 变化       → 非 CLOSED_LOOP 态热重载 flightParams + applyParams
 *     - cmdClearSeq 边沿    → 同 paramSeq（参数已在 params 内回默认）
 *
 * 跨核初始化时序：cm_7_0 从 ESC arming 阶段开始发布 startupStateValid 启动快照，
 *   最终初始化完成后才置 cm70Ready 并发布健康汇总；必须等到 cm_7_1 视觉 cm71Ready 后才允许
 *   安全状态机运行（controlAllowed=1），确保两核就绪。
 */

#define VISION_STALE_TIMEOUT_MS (3000u) /* 视觉误差陈旧阈值：超过则弃用旧误差（相机/视觉核卡死降级） */
#define CHEVRON_FACT_STALE_TIMEOUT_MS (200u)
typedef struct
{
    volatile uint8_t initReady;
    volatile uint8_t controlAllowed;
    volatile uint16_t visionStaleMs;
    volatile uint16_t targetLostMs;
    volatile uint32_t startupInitMs;
    volatile uint32_t loopMs;
    uint32_t lastParamSeq;
    uint32_t lastCmdLaunchSeq;
    uint32_t lastCmdStandbySeq;
    uint32_t lastCmdClearSeq;
    uint32_t lastBootEpoch;
    uint8_t paramHandshakeDone;
    uint8_t paramApplyPending;
    uint32_t pendingParamSeq;
    uint32_t pendingBootEpoch;
    uint32_t lastVisionSeq;
    uint8_t systemPhase;
    uint8_t standalone;
    uint8_t motionFenceWaiting;
    uint8_t latchedFaultReason;
    uint8_t lastSafetyStateForFault;
    uint8_t faultAckSuppressActive;
    uint8_t previousSystemPhase;
    uint32_t lastChevronSeq;
    uint32_t lastChevronAgeTickMs;
    uint16_t chevronAgeMs;
    uint8_t chevronSeqPrimed;
    uint32_t readyStableStartMs;
    uint32_t motionFenceSeq;
    uint32_t readyBeepUntilMs;
    uint8_t imuReady;
    uint8_t initFailedMask;
    visionToFlightStruct visionRx;
    flightToVisionStruct flightTx;
    paramToFlightStruct paramRx;
    visionDebugToFlightStruct chevronFacts;
    flightParamsStruct params;
} core0RuntimeContextStruct;

static core0RuntimeContextStruct runtimeContext;

#define CORE0_INITIAL_LINK_WAIT_MS    (2000u)
#define CORE0_REJOIN_STABLE_MS         (2000u)

#define initReadyFlag          runtimeContext.initReady
#define controlAllowed         runtimeContext.controlAllowed
#define visionStaleMs          runtimeContext.visionStaleMs
#define targetLostMs           runtimeContext.targetLostMs
#define startupInitMs          runtimeContext.startupInitMs
#define loopMs                 runtimeContext.loopMs
#define lastParamSeq           runtimeContext.lastParamSeq
#define lastCmdLaunchSeq       runtimeContext.lastCmdLaunchSeq
#define lastCmdStandbySeq      runtimeContext.lastCmdStandbySeq
#define lastCmdClearSeq        runtimeContext.lastCmdClearSeq
#define lastBootEpoch          runtimeContext.lastBootEpoch
#define paramHandshakeDone     runtimeContext.paramHandshakeDone
#define paramApplyPending      runtimeContext.paramApplyPending
#define pendingParamSeq        runtimeContext.pendingParamSeq
#define pendingBootEpoch       runtimeContext.pendingBootEpoch
#define lastVisionSeq          runtimeContext.lastVisionSeq
#define visionRx               runtimeContext.visionRx
#define flightTx               runtimeContext.flightTx
#define paramRx                runtimeContext.paramRx
#define runtimeParams          runtimeContext.params
#define imuReady               runtimeContext.imuReady
#define faultReasonLatch       runtimeContext.latchedFaultReason
#define lastSafetyStateForFault runtimeContext.lastSafetyStateForFault
#define faultAckSuppressActive runtimeContext.faultAckSuppressActive

/* C1/C3/C4均为必需视觉；Core1自身断链由既有主链路保护独立覆盖，
 * 这里把远端通用source/class事实并入发车门和运行中缓降。 */
static uint8_t requiredVisionFault(uint8_t *source, uint8_t *faultClass)
{
    if (!crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive())
    {
        if (source != NULL) *source = 2u;
        if (faultClass != NULL) *faultClass = 2u;
        return 1u;
    }
    return crossCoreLinkGetRequiredVisionFault(source, faultClass);
}

static uint8_t anyRequiredLinkLost(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (!crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive() ||
        crossCoreLinkGetCore2LinkLost() || requiredVisionFault(NULL, NULL));
}

static void core0FaultLatch(uint8_t reason)
{
    if ((reason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE) &&
        (faultAckSuppressActive == 0u) &&
        (faultReasonLatch == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE))
    {
        if (reason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_REQUIRED_VISION)
        {
            uint8_t source = 0u;
            uint8_t faultClass = 0u;
            (void) crossCoreLinkGetRequiredVisionFault(&source, &faultClass);
            faultReasonLatch = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION(source, faultClass);
        }
        else faultReasonLatch = reason;
    }
}

static uint8_t sequenceNewer(uint32_t value, uint32_t baseline)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((value != baseline) && ((int32_t) (value - baseline) > 0));
}

/* LoRa组合键是电平传输、事件消费。只有连续新鲜的真实低电平才能重新武装；
 * 链路陈旧、Core2失联合成低值和模式切换均不得把同一次物理按压拆成两次事件。 */
static void core0RuntimeUpdateSystemPhase(void)
{
    uint8_t ready = (uint8_t) ((controlAllowed != 0u) &&
        (anyRequiredLinkLost() == 0u));
    if ((runtimeContext.systemPhase == CORE_UX_PHASE_REJOIN) &&
        (runtimeContext.standalone == 0u))
    {
        if (pidFlightControllerMotionBarrierPending() == 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.systemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_HOME;
            runtimeContext.readyBeepUntilMs = loopMs + 700u;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (runtimeContext.systemPhase == CORE_UX_PHASE_LINK_WAIT)
    {
        if (ready != 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.systemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_HOME;
            runtimeContext.standalone = 0u;
            runtimeContext.readyBeepUntilMs = loopMs + 700u;
        }
        else if (loopMs >= CORE0_INITIAL_LINK_WAIT_MS)
        {
            runtimeContext.systemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_STANDALONE;
            runtimeContext.standalone = 1u;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (runtimeContext.standalone == 0u)
    {
        if (ready == 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.systemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_STANDALONE;
            runtimeContext.standalone = 1u;
            runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = 0u;
            runtimeContext.motionFenceSeq = crossCoreLinkFenceMotion();
            runtimeContext.motionFenceWaiting = 1u;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ready == 0u)
    {
        runtimeContext.systemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_STANDALONE;
        runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs == 0u)
        runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = loopMs;
    runtimeContext.systemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_REJOIN;
    if ((uint32_t) (loopMs - runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs) >= CORE0_REJOIN_STABLE_MS)
    {
        runtimeContext.motionFenceSeq = crossCoreLinkFenceMotion();
        runtimeContext.motionFenceWaiting = 1u;
        pidFlightControllerRequestMotionBarrier(1u);
        runtimeContext.standalone = 0u;
        runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = 0u;
        runtimeContext.systemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_REJOIN;
    }
}

/* 相机模式是独立安全控制量：参数整包在 CLOSED_LOOP 延后时，它仍在合法 seq/epoch 边沿即时生效。 */
static uint8_t applyFlightParamsSnapshot(const paramToFlightStruct* src)
{
    if (!modeFlightTryBeginConfigUpdate()) return 0u;
    (void) flightParamsCommit(&src->params);
    flightParamsGetActive(&runtimeParams);
    pidFlightControllerApplyParams();
    altitudeHoldApplyParams();
    IMUApplyParams();
    modeFlightApplyParams();
    flightSequenceApplyParams();
    paramApplyPending = 0u;
    pendingParamSeq = src->paramSeq;
    pendingBootEpoch = src->cm71BootEpoch;
    modeFlightEndConfigUpdate();
    return 1u;
}

static void markFlightParamsPending(const paramToFlightStruct* src)
{
    paramApplyPending = 1u;
    pendingParamSeq = src->paramSeq;
    pendingBootEpoch = src->cm71BootEpoch;
}

/* ESC arming 进度回调：arming 阻塞期间持续把进度写共享内存，cm_7_1 据此画进度条。
 * 启动阶段 safetyState 约定值的单一真相源在 coreDataTransfer.h。 */
static void armProgressPublish(uint8_t progress)
{
    flightTx.safetyState = FLIGHT_SAFETY_ARMING;
    flightTx.armProgress = progress;
    flightTx.tofHealthy = 0u;
    flightTx.startupStateValid = 1u;
    coreDataWriteFlightToVision(&flightTx);
}

/* ESC arming完成后才进入ToF循环初始化。每轮完整初始化前发布启动阶段。 */
static void tofInitPublish(void)
{
    flightTx.safetyState = FLIGHT_SAFETY_TOF_INIT;
    flightTx.armProgress = 0u;
    flightTx.tofHealthy = 0u;
    flightTx.startupStateValid = 1u;
    coreDataWriteFlightToVision(&flightTx);
}

/* ============================================================
 * processInit
 * ============================================================ */
void processInit(void)
{
    runtimeContext.systemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_LINK_WAIT;
    runtimeContext.standalone = 0u;
    runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = 0u;
    runtimeContext.motionFenceWaiting = 0u;
    faultAckSuppressActive = 0u;
    runtimeContext.previousSystemPhase = CORE_UX_PHASE_LINK_WAIT;
    runtimeContext.lastChevronSeq = 0u;
    runtimeContext.lastChevronAgeTickMs = loopMs;
    runtimeContext.chevronAgeMs = 0xFFFFu;
    runtimeContext.chevronSeqPrimed = 0u;
    memset(&runtimeContext.chevronFacts, 0, sizeof(runtimeContext.chevronFacts));
    runtimeContext.initFailedMask = 0u;
    startupInitMs = 0u;
    imuReady = 0u;
    /* 飞控参数 RAM 镜像必须最先加载：IMUInit(gyroLpf)/pidFlightControllerInit/
     * altitudeHoldInit 均依赖 flightParams 默认值。Phase 5 后由 cm_7_1 经共享
     * 内存覆盖，但上电首帧先用 configFlightControlDefaults.h 默认值兜底。 */
    flightParamsLoadDefaults(&runtimeParams);
    flightParamsSetInitial(&runtimeParams);
    flightParamsGetActive(&runtimeParams);
    modeFlightApplyParams();

    memset(&flightTx, 0, sizeof(flightTx));

    /* PIT_CH0 在 initReady 前只提供启动毫秒计数，不运行飞控或外设周期逻辑。 */
    pit_ms_init(PIT_CH0, 1u);

    /* 电调优先：motorInit先把四路PWM驱动到950us确定停机态，
     * 再阻塞完成arming。ToF重试不得占用PWM引脚未初始化的上电窗口。 */
    motorInit(&armProgressPublish); /* 阻塞 ~5s arming，回调持续把进度写共享内存供 cm_7_1 画进度条 */

    {
        uint32_t tofInitStartMs = startupInitMs;
        uint8_t tofReady = 0u;

        do
        {
            /* altitudeHoldInit 每轮都会进入 tofL8cxInit，并通过LPN（代码沿用XSHUT宏名）完整复位。 */
            tofInitPublish();
            tofReady = altitudeHoldInit();
            if (tofReady != 0u) break;
        }
        while ((uint32_t) (startupInitMs - tofInitStartMs) < ALT_TOF_INIT_TIMEOUT_MS);

        if (tofReady == 0u) runtimeContext.initFailedMask |= CORE0_INIT_FAIL_TOF;
    }

    {
        uint8_t imuResult = IMUInit();
        if (imuResult)
        {
            /* IMU 失败：电机保持停机，但不中断前台链路/共享状态服务。 */
            motorStopAll();
            runtimeContext.initFailedMask |= CORE0_INIT_FAIL_IMU;
        }
        else imuReady = 1u;
    }

    pidFlightControllerApplyParams();
    pidFlightControllerInit();
    flightSequenceInit(0u);
    if (opticalFlowInit() == 0u) runtimeContext.initFailedMask |= CORE0_INIT_FAIL_OPTICAL_FLOW;
    velocityEstimatorInit();  /* IMU+光流双轴速度估计器（KF 反馈已接水平速度内环） */

    /* 核间链路(UART_2/P10 ↔ core1 P04): 发按键事件透传 core1 + 双向心跳。
     * 收发在前台 whileProcess, 心跳分频/存活计数在 pitProcess0(轻量), 不扰 400Hz 飞控。 */
    crossCoreLinkInit();

    /* 初始化共享内存发送区并标记 cm_7_0 就绪（握手） */
    memset(&flightTx, 0, sizeof(flightTx));
    flightTx.cm70Ready = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    flightTx.initFailedMask = runtimeContext.initFailedMask;
    coreDataWriteFlightToVision(&flightTx);

    pit_us_init(PIT_CH1, 1000u);

    initReadyFlag = 1u;
}

/* ============================================================
 * pitProcess0 — 1ms：IMU + 安全状态机
 * ============================================================ */
void pitProcess0(void)
{
    if (!initReadyFlag)
    {
        startupInitMs++;
        return;
    }

    if (imuReady != 0u)
    {
        IMUUpdate();
        velocityEstimatorPredictTick(); /* IMU 去重力+水平投影+双轴速度预测（1ms） */
    }
    altitudeHoldTickMs(); /* ToF 失活看门狗（运行期拔线降级） */
    loopMs++; /* 自由ms计时：Coordinator按无符号差值计算wrap-safe dt。 */

    /* 视觉新鲜度看门狗：1ms 累加，whileProcess 收到新 visionSeq 时清零 */
    if (visionStaleMs < 0xFFFFu) visionStaleMs++;

    /* 目标丢失保持窗口：1ms 累加，whileProcess 收到有效目标时清零 */
    if (targetLostMs < 0xFFFFu) targetLostMs++;

    /* 仅在跨核握手通过后运行硬安全状态机；前台Coordinator只发布轻量请求标志。 */
    if ((controlAllowed != 0u) && (imuReady != 0u))
    {
        modeFlightSafetyTick();
    }

    /* 核间链路心跳分频 + core1 存活超时计数(仅计数+置标志, 轻量, 不发送/不阻塞)。 */
    crossCoreLinkPit1ms();
}

/* ============================================================
 * pitProcess1 — 1ms：控制环
 * ============================================================ */
void pitProcess1(void)
{
    if (!initReadyFlag) return;

    if (imuReady != 0u) pidFlightControllerTick();
}

/* ============================================================
 * whileProcess — 主循环：定高 + 跨核握手 + 共享内存收发
 * ============================================================ */
void whileProcess(void)
{
    flightSequenceFactsStruct sequenceFacts;
    flightSequenceOutputStruct sequenceOutput;
    crossCoreFlightFactsSnapshotStruct linkFacts;
    visionDebugToFlightStruct chevronFacts;
    velocityEstimatorSnapshotStruct velocitySnapshot;
    pidFlightGuidanceCommandStruct guidance;
    uint8_t launchCommandEdge = 0u;
    uint8_t standbyCommandEdge = 0u;
    float motionVx = 0.0f;
    float motionVy = 0.0f;
    float motionWz = 0.0f;
    uint32_t motionSeq = 0u;
    uint32_t chevronElapsedMs;
    uint8_t motionFresh = 0u;
    flightSafetySnapshotStruct safety;
    pidFlightSnapshotStruct pidSnapshot;
    altitudeHoldSnapshotStruct altitudeSnapshot;
    if (!initReadyFlag) return;
    /* 先排空UART并更新存活事实，再解释任何远端请求或运动量。 */
    crossCoreLinkPoll();
    modeFlightGetSnapshot(&safety);
    pidFlightControllerGetSnapshot(&pidSnapshot);
    altitudeHoldGetSnapshot(&altitudeSnapshot);

    /* 跨核握手：等待 cm_7_1 视觉就绪后放行控制 */
    if (!controlAllowed)
    {
        coreDataReadVisionToFlight(&visionRx);
        if ((visionRx.cm71Ready == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) && (imuReady != 0u))
        {
            controlAllowed = 1u;
        }
    }

    /* 参数区轮询：热重载 + 发车/清空指令（cm_7_1 菜单下发） */
    if (coreDataReadParamToFlight(&paramRx) != 0u)
    {
        if (!paramHandshakeDone)
        {
            /* 首次握手：以 cm_7_1 持久化参数为准；闭环态只挂起参数 apply。 */
            paramHandshakeDone = 1u;
            lastParamSeq = paramRx.paramSeq;
            lastCmdClearSeq = paramRx.cmdClearSeq;
            lastCmdLaunchSeq = paramRx.cmdLaunchSeq; /* 忽略上电前的陈旧发车计数 */
            lastCmdStandbySeq = paramRx.cmdStandbySeq; /* 忽略上电前的陈旧回待机计数 */
            lastBootEpoch = paramRx.cm71BootEpoch;
            if (!applyFlightParamsSnapshot(&paramRx))
            {
                markFlightParamsPending(&paramRx);
            }
        }
        else if (paramRx.cm71BootEpoch != lastBootEpoch ||
                 paramRx.paramSeq < lastParamSeq ||
                 paramRx.cmdLaunchSeq < lastCmdLaunchSeq ||
                 paramRx.cmdStandbySeq < lastCmdStandbySeq ||
                 paramRx.cmdClearSeq < lastCmdClearSeq)
        {
            /* 对端(cm_7_1)复位检测——双判据，任一成立即视为复位：
             *   (1) cm71BootEpoch 变化（cm_7_1 由共享区上一帧 epoch+1 派生，单调递增）；
             *   (2) 任一 seq 相对 last 回退（确定性兜底：cm_7_1 复位后 seq 从 N 跌回 0，
             *       单调计数器永不正常回退，故 seq<last 必为复位）。
             * 复位时只重同步基线并挂起参数apply，绝不合成发车/回待机边沿，
             * 杜绝把计数器回退误判成"未操作的发车/回待机"。等真实 K5/菜单操作再增量。 */
            lastBootEpoch = paramRx.cm71BootEpoch;
            lastParamSeq = paramRx.paramSeq;
            lastCmdClearSeq = paramRx.cmdClearSeq;
            lastCmdLaunchSeq = paramRx.cmdLaunchSeq;
            lastCmdStandbySeq = paramRx.cmdStandbySeq;
            runtimeContext.chevronSeqPrimed = 0u;
            runtimeContext.chevronAgeMs = 0xFFFFu;
            markFlightParamsPending(&paramRx);
        }
        else
        {
            /* 参数热重载：闭环态只记录待应用，退出闭环后再套用最新快照。 */
            if (paramRx.paramSeq != lastParamSeq || paramRx.cmdClearSeq != lastCmdClearSeq)
            {
                lastParamSeq = paramRx.paramSeq;
                lastCmdClearSeq = paramRx.cmdClearSeq;
                if (!applyFlightParamsSnapshot(&paramRx))
                {
                    markFlightParamsPending(&paramRx);
                }
            }

            /* 发车指令边沿：置 pending，ISR 安全状态机消费 */
            if (paramRx.cmdLaunchSeq != lastCmdLaunchSeq)
            {
                lastCmdLaunchSeq = paramRx.cmdLaunchSeq;
                launchCommandEdge = 1u;
            }

            /* 回待机指令边沿：飞行中 K5 长按下发，置 disarm pending 让 ISR 安全状态机停机 */
            if (paramRx.cmdStandbySeq != lastCmdStandbySeq)
            {
                lastCmdStandbySeq = paramRx.cmdStandbySeq;
                standbyCommandEdge = 1u;
            }
        }

        if (paramApplyPending &&
            paramRx.paramSeq == pendingParamSeq &&
            paramRx.cm71BootEpoch == pendingBootEpoch)
        {
            (void) applyFlightParamsSnapshot(&paramRx);
        }

        /* KVM 路由与事件仅在前台快照给链路 owner；UART 重试/ACK 不进入 ISR。 */
        crossCoreLinkSetKvmRoute(paramRx.cm71BootEpoch,
            paramRx.kvmRouteEpoch,
            paramRx.kvmTarget,
            paramRx.kvmEventSeq,
            paramRx.kvmKeyId,
            paramRx.kvmKeyState,
            (uint8_t) (paramRx.kvmFlags & 1u));
    }

    /* 参数/命令处理可能跨过 PIT_CH0 状态转换；控制源与缓降决策使用就近安全快照。 */
    modeFlightGetSnapshot(&safety);
    if ((lastSafetyStateForFault == (uint8_t) SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP) &&
        (safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_PROTECTED))
    {
        core0FaultLatch(CORE0_FAULT_REASON_PROTECT_ATTITUDE);
    }
    if ((faultAckSuppressActive != 0u) &&
        (lastSafetyStateForFault != (uint8_t) SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP) &&
        (safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP))
    {
        /* 新的闭环飞行episode重新武装故障页；只抑制已ACK的上一事件。 */
        faultAckSuppressActive = 0u;
    }
    lastSafetyStateForFault = (uint8_t) safety.state;
    core0RuntimeUpdateSystemPhase();

    /* 先刷新视觉/MOTION/链路事实，再由唯一Coordinator解释触发、推进阶段并执行最终仲裁。 */
    coreDataReadVisionToFlight(&visionRx);
    if (visionRx.visionSeq != lastVisionSeq)
    {
        lastVisionSeq = visionRx.visionSeq;
        visionStaleMs = 0u;
    }
    if (visionRx.visionTargetValid != 0u) targetLostMs = 0u;
    chevronElapsedMs = loopMs - runtimeContext.lastChevronAgeTickMs;
    runtimeContext.lastChevronAgeTickMs = loopMs;
    runtimeContext.chevronAgeMs = factFreshnessAdvanceAgeU16(
        runtimeContext.chevronAgeMs, chevronElapsedMs);
    (void) coreDataTryReadVisionDebugToFlight(&runtimeContext.chevronFacts);
    chevronFacts = runtimeContext.chevronFacts;
    if ((chevronFacts.magic == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
        (factFreshnessAcceptSeq(&runtimeContext.chevronSeqPrimed,
            &runtimeContext.lastChevronSeq, chevronFacts.seq) != 0u))
    {
        runtimeContext.chevronAgeMs = 0u;
    }
    crossCoreLinkGetFlightFactsSnapshot(&linkFacts);
    motionFresh = crossCoreLinkGetMotionSnapshot(&motionVx, &motionVy, &motionWz, &motionSeq);
    if ((motionFresh != 0u) && (runtimeContext.motionFenceWaiting != 0u))
    {
        if (sequenceNewer(motionSeq, runtimeContext.motionFenceSeq) != 0u)
            runtimeContext.motionFenceWaiting = 0u;
        else motionFresh = 0u;
    }
    velocityEstimatorGetSnapshot(&velocitySnapshot);

    memset(&sequenceFacts, 0, sizeof(sequenceFacts));
    sequenceFacts.nowMs = loopMs;
    sequenceFacts.callerCycleSeq = loopMs;
    sequenceFacts.safety = safety;
    sequenceFacts.initialized = initReadyFlag;
    sequenceFacts.controlReady = (uint8_t) (controlAllowed && imuReady);
    sequenceFacts.systemMode = runtimeParams.systemMode;
    sequenceFacts.systemPhase = runtimeContext.systemPhase;
    sequenceFacts.standalone = runtimeContext.standalone;
    sequenceFacts.paramsValid = 1u;
    sequenceFacts.readyBeepActive = ((int32_t) (runtimeContext.readyBeepUntilMs - loopMs) > 0) ? 1u : 0u;
    sequenceFacts.k5LaunchEdge = launchCommandEdge;
    sequenceFacts.k5StandbyEdge = standbyCommandEdge;
    sequenceFacts.faultLatched = (faultReasonLatch != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE) ? 1u : 0u;
    sequenceFacts.rejoinEdge = (uint8_t) ((runtimeContext.previousSystemPhase != CORE_UX_PHASE_REJOIN) &&
        (runtimeContext.systemPhase == CORE_UX_PHASE_REJOIN));
    runtimeContext.previousSystemPhase = runtimeContext.systemPhase;
    sequenceFacts.mode3RequestValid = linkFacts.mode3RequestValid;
    sequenceFacts.mode3RequestLevel = linkFacts.mode3RequestLevel;
    sequenceFacts.mode3RequestAgeMs = linkFacts.motionAgeMs;
    sequenceFacts.mode3RequestSeq = linkFacts.motionSeq;
    sequenceFacts.mode2RequestValid = linkFacts.mode2RequestValid;
    sequenceFacts.mode2RequestLevel = linkFacts.mode2RequestLevel;
    sequenceFacts.mode2RequestAgeMs = linkFacts.statusAgeMs;
    sequenceFacts.mode2RequestSeq = linkFacts.statusSeq;
    sequenceFacts.core1Online = crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive();
    sequenceFacts.core1FactValid = initReadyFlag;
    sequenceFacts.core2FactValid = linkFacts.statusValid;
    sequenceFacts.requiredVisionFactValid = linkFacts.statusValid;
    sequenceFacts.core2LinkLost = crossCoreLinkGetCore2LinkLost();
    sequenceFacts.core2AttitudeFault = linkFacts.core2AttitudeFault;
    sequenceFacts.requiredVisionFault = crossCoreLinkGetRequiredVisionFault(
        &sequenceFacts.visionFaultSource, &sequenceFacts.visionFaultClass);
    sequenceFacts.core1AgeMs = linkFacts.core1AgeMs;
    sequenceFacts.core2AgeMs = linkFacts.statusAgeMs;
    sequenceFacts.requiredVisionAgeMs = linkFacts.statusAgeMs;
    sequenceFacts.linkSeq = linkFacts.statusSeq;
    sequenceFacts.core1Seq = linkFacts.core1Seq;
    sequenceFacts.core2Seq = linkFacts.statusSeq;
    sequenceFacts.requiredVisionSeq = linkFacts.statusSeq;
    sequenceFacts.altitude = altitudeSnapshot;
    sequenceFacts.visionErrX = visionRx.visionErrX;
    sequenceFacts.visionErrY = visionRx.visionErrY;
    sequenceFacts.visionYawErr = visionRx.visionYawErr;
    sequenceFacts.visionTargetValid = visionRx.visionTargetValid;
    sequenceFacts.visionFrameValid = (visionStaleMs < VISION_STALE_TIMEOUT_MS) ? 1u : 0u;
    sequenceFacts.visionAgeMs = visionStaleMs;
    sequenceFacts.targetLostAgeMs = targetLostMs;
    sequenceFacts.visionSeq = visionRx.visionSeq;
    sequenceFacts.chevronX = chevronFacts.filteredCenterX;
    sequenceFacts.chevronY = chevronFacts.filteredCenterY;
    sequenceFacts.chevronOrientationRad = chevronFacts.orientation;
    sequenceFacts.chevronOrientationConfidence = chevronFacts.orientationConfidence;
    sequenceFacts.chevronPositionValid = (uint8_t) (chevronFacts.magic == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC &&
        runtimeContext.chevronAgeMs < CHEVRON_FACT_STALE_TIMEOUT_MS &&
        chevronFacts.trackingState == 2u && chevronFacts.targetLost == 0u &&
        chevronFacts.filteredCenterX >= 0.0f &&
        chevronFacts.filteredCenterX <= (float) (MT9V03X_W - 1u) &&
        chevronFacts.filteredCenterY >= 0.0f &&
        chevronFacts.filteredCenterY <= (float) (MT9V03X_H - 1u));
    sequenceFacts.chevronOrientationValid = (uint8_t) (sequenceFacts.chevronPositionValid &&
        chevronFacts.orientProtectState == 0u &&
        chevronFacts.orientation >= -3.1415927f && chevronFacts.orientation <= 3.1415927f &&
        chevronFacts.orientationConfidence >= 0.0f && chevronFacts.orientationConfidence <= 1.0f);
    sequenceFacts.chevronAgeMs = runtimeContext.chevronAgeMs;
    sequenceFacts.chevronSeq = chevronFacts.seq;
    sequenceFacts.beaconCount = linkFacts.beaconCount;
    sequenceFacts.beaconAny = (linkFacts.beaconCount != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    sequenceFacts.beaconSearching = linkFacts.beaconSearching;
    sequenceFacts.beaconSearchTimedOut = linkFacts.beaconSearchTimedOut;
    sequenceFacts.beaconStateValid = linkFacts.beaconStateValid;
    sequenceFacts.beaconStateAgeMs = linkFacts.statusAgeMs;
    sequenceFacts.beaconStateSeq = linkFacts.beaconStateSeq;
    sequenceFacts.motionVx = motionVx;
    sequenceFacts.motionVy = motionVy;
    sequenceFacts.motionWz = motionWz;
    sequenceFacts.motionValid = motionFresh;
    sequenceFacts.motionFenceOpen = runtimeContext.motionFenceWaiting ? 0u : 1u;
    sequenceFacts.motionAgeMs = linkFacts.motionAgeMs;
    sequenceFacts.motionSeq = motionSeq;
    sequenceFacts.kfVelocityFwdMps = velocitySnapshot.velocityFwd;
    sequenceFacts.kfVelocityRightMps = velocitySnapshot.velocityRight;
    sequenceFacts.kfVelocityValid = velocitySnapshot.valid;

    flightSequenceStep(&sequenceFacts, &sequenceOutput);
    altitudeSnapshot = sequenceOutput.altitude;
    if (sequenceOutput.acknowledgeFault != 0u)
    {
        faultReasonLatch = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
        faultAckSuppressActive = 1u;
    }
    if (sequenceOutput.primaryReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
        core0FaultLatch(sequenceOutput.primaryReason);
    if (sequenceOutput.requestLaunch != 0u) modeFlightRequestLaunch();
    if (sequenceOutput.requestDisarm != 0u) modeFlightRequestDisarm();
    if ((faultAckSuppressActive != 0u) &&
        (safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_DISARMED) &&
        (sequenceOutput.landingActive == 0u) &&
        (altitudeSnapshot.failsafeStage == ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_NORMAL))
        faultAckSuppressActive = 0u;

    velocityEstimatorUpdate((uint8_t) (
        altitudeSnapshot.failsafeStage == ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_HOLD &&
        sequenceOutput.altReached != 0u && sequenceOutput.landingActive == 0u &&
        safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP));
    velocityEstimatorGetSnapshot(&velocitySnapshot);
    memset(&guidance, 0, sizeof(guidance));
    guidance.visionErrX = sequenceOutput.visionErrX;
    guidance.visionErrY = sequenceOutput.visionErrY;
    guidance.visionYawErr = sequenceOutput.visionYawErr;
    guidance.visionValid = sequenceOutput.visionValid;
    guidance.visionHeld = sequenceOutput.visionHeld;
    guidance.kfVelFwd = velocitySnapshot.velocityFwd;
    guidance.kfVelRight = velocitySnapshot.velocityRight;
    guidance.kfVelValid = velocitySnapshot.valid;
    guidance.ffVelFwd = sequenceOutput.bodyVelocityFwdMps;
    guidance.ffVelRight = sequenceOutput.bodyVelocityRightMps;
    guidance.ffPitch = sequenceOutput.pitchFeedforwardRad;
    guidance.ffRoll = sequenceOutput.rollFeedforwardRad;
    guidance.ffYawRate = sequenceOutput.yawRateRadS;
    pidFlightControllerSetGuidanceCommand(&guidance);
    flightTx.velX = velocitySnapshot.velocityFwd;
    flightTx.velY = velocitySnapshot.velocityRight;
    flightTx.velValid = velocitySnapshot.valid;

    /* 写飞控调试数据供 cm_7_1 显示 */
    pidFlightControllerGetSnapshot(&pidSnapshot);
    modeFlightGetSnapshot(&safety);
    altitudeHoldGetSnapshot(&altitudeSnapshot);
    {
        imuSnapshotStruct imu;
        IMUGetSnapshot(&imu);
        flightTx.pitch = imu.physicalPitch;
        flightTx.roll = imu.physicalRoll;
        flightTx.yaw = imu.yaw;
    }
    flightTx.altMm = (float) altitudeSnapshot.distanceMm;
    flightTx.baseThr = pidSnapshot.baseThrottlePct;
    flightTx.motorPct[0] = pidSnapshot.motorPct[0];
    flightTx.motorPct[1] = pidSnapshot.motorPct[1];
    flightTx.motorPct[2] = pidSnapshot.motorPct[2];
    flightTx.motorPct[3] = pidSnapshot.motorPct[3];
    flightTx.safetyState = (imuReady != 0u) ? (uint8_t) safety.state : FLIGHT_SAFETY_IMUFAIL;
    flightTx.armProgress = motorArmProgress;
    flightTx.tofHealthy = altitudeHoldIsHealthy();
    flightTx.cm70Ready = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    {
        uint8_t core1Alive = crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive();
        flightTx.core1LinkUp = core1Alive; /* 远程菜单: core1 链路存活回报 cm_7_1(断联保护/禁发车) */
        flightTx.core2LinkLost = core1Alive ? crossCoreLinkGetCore2LinkLost() : 1u;
        flightTx.requiredVisionFault = requiredVisionFault(NULL, NULL);
        flightTx.systemPhase = runtimeContext.systemPhase;
        flightTx.primaryReason = !core1Alive ? 1u :
            (flightTx.core2LinkLost ? 2u :
             (linkFacts.core2AttitudeFault ? 4u :
              (flightTx.requiredVisionFault ? 3u : 0u)));
        flightTx.initFailedMask = runtimeContext.initFailedMask;
        flightTx.latchedFaultReason = faultReasonLatch;
    }
    coreDataWriteFlightToVision(&flightTx);

    /* RGB 状态灯: 打包 core0 飞控状态经 CORE0_STATUS 帧发 core1(crossCoreLinkPoll 前台发送)。
     * safetyState/armProgress 直接用上面已填的 flightTx; statusFlags 按位汇总 4 个健康维度。
     * cm70Ready 恒置位(cm_7_0 运行到此即已就绪)。 */
    {
        uint8_t c0Flags = UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_CM70_READY;
        if (flightTx.velValid) c0Flags |= UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_VEL_VALID;
        if (visionRx.visionTargetValid) c0Flags |= UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_TARGET_VALID;
        if (flightTx.tofHealthy) c0Flags |= UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_TOF_HEALTHY;
        /* 飞控进入闭环=已发车：经 CORE0_STATUS 状态位传 core1，由 core1 中转为 RS-485 cmd LAUNCH 给 core2。
         * 电平语义：闭环期间持续置位，解除闭环(落地/急停回 DISARM)即清零，车随之停发车。 */
        if (safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP) c0Flags |= UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED;
        crossCoreLinkSetCore0Status(flightTx.safetyState, flightTx.armProgress, c0Flags);

        /* 空地系统下发 core1（CORE0_STATUS sysCtrl + buzzer）：
         *   sysCtrl bit0-1 = systemMode（core1 据此选 core2 控制源 485/LoRa）；
         *   sysCtrl bit2-4 = 起飞时序 rgbIntent（core1 rgbAnimator 自演动画）；
         *   sysCtrl bit5   = altReached（到顶；core1 据此放行车发车 LAUNCH）；
         *   sysCtrl bit6/7 = padding，恒为0；
         *   buzzer 字节    = 起飞时序蜂鸣模式码（core1 中转 core2 buzzer 库 pattern 层播放）。
         * 每拍填真值：core1 据此门控车发车(LAUNCH = launched && altReached)。altReached表示
         * 本架次已获得CRUISE资格且尚未进入RAMP/正式缓降，不等价于每拍ToF健康；WAIT/RAMP为0，
         * CRUISE后的短时ToF HOLD保持1。 */
        {
            uint8_t sysCtrl = (uint8_t) (runtimeParams.systemMode & UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_MASK);
            sysCtrl |= (uint8_t) ((sequenceOutput.rgbIntent & UART_LINK_SYS_RGB_MASK) <<
                UART_LINK_SYS_RGB_SHIFT);
            if (sequenceOutput.altReached) sysCtrl |= UART_LINK_SYS_ALT_REACHED;
            crossCoreLinkSetSysControl(sysCtrl, sequenceOutput.buzzerPattern);
        }
    }

}

#include "core1Loop.h"
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>

#include "zf_driver_pit.h"

#include "zf_device_mt9v03x.h"
#include "commonDef.h"
#include "coreDataTransfer.h"
#include "image.h"
#include "menu.h"
#include "paramSyncOwnerService.h"
#include "schmitt.h"

/* ============================================================
 * core0 cm_7_1 视觉核（调度层，UI/菜单在 menu 模块：menu/menuModel/menuPersistence/menuRender/menuInput）
 *   - 运行 ^ 灯板视觉管线（image.c）
 *   - 每帧计算图像误差写共享内存供 cm_7_0 飞控
 *   - 菜单 + IPS114 显示 + 按键 + flash 由 menu 模块封装
 *
 *   本文件只做：外设/视觉/菜单 init、PIT 节拍、whileProcess 调度。
 * ============================================================ */

volatile uint8_t initReadyFlag = 0u;
static uint8_t cameraReady = 0u;

#define MENU_PIT_TICK_MS           (10u)              /* PIT_CH2 菜单节拍周期 ms：pit_ms_init 与目标丢失冻结计时单一真相源 */
#define VISION_LOST_FREEZE_TICK_MS (MENU_PIT_TICK_MS) /* 目标丢失冻结每拍累加，恒等于 PIT_CH2 周期 */

/* 共享内存发送缓存（主循环使用，非 ISR） */
static visionToFlightStruct visionTx;

/* 外环误差施密特(滞回)死区：复用通用 schmitt 库（util/schmitt）。
 * 判据=质心到目标中点合成半径平方 r²；upper=大圆半径²(进入,转高)、lower=小圆半径²(退出,归零)。
 * outputState：0=低(已到位,误差归零)、1=高(跟踪中,正常输出)。BSS 初值 0=初始低状态
 * (刚锁定要求先越过大圆才驱动)；阈值随菜单 deadzone% 每帧刷新。 */
static SchmittTrigger visionDeadzone;

/* 目标丢失外推：持续维护最后一次有效目标质心与最后一次已发布 X/Y 误差（无论施密特高/低状态都记录）。
 * 丢失后先冻结输出一段可调时间，再按最后质心相对 exitR 分类为归零或沿最后视向外推。 */
static float lastValidCx = 0.0f;
static float lastValidCy = 0.0f;
static float lastOutputErrX = 0.0f;
static float lastOutputErrY = 0.0f;
static uint8_t lastValidHas = 0u; /* 是否已有有效质心历史（无则丢失时不外推） */
static volatile uint8_t visionLostActive = 0u;
static volatile uint16_t visionLostElapsedMs = 0u;

/* 计算图像误差并写共享内存（每帧调用，与显示解耦）。
 * 目标中点/极性取自菜单可调镜像 menuVisionTuning（运行时可改 + flash 持久化）。 */
static void publishVisionError(const imageObservationSnapshotStruct* observation)
{
    visionTuningStruct tuning;
    menuGetVisionTuning(&tuning);
    if (observation->valid)
    {
        /* 位置发布当前质心(OM_POSITION_ALPHA=1.0 默认不过滤)；速度发布“原始质心差分→低通”的结果。 */
        float cx = observation->filteredCenterX;
        float cy = observation->filteredCenterY;

        /* 持续维护最后有效质心（先于施密特门控，保证死区低状态也记录真实质心，供丢失外推用方向）。 */
        lastValidCx = cx;
        lastValidCy = cy;
        lastValidHas = 1u;
        visionLostActive = 0u;
        visionLostElapsedMs = 0u;

        /* 施密特死区：半径用原始像素偏差(与极性无关)；用 r² 比较省 sqrt。
         * 半径基准=图像高 H 的百分比直径(半径=0.5×pct/100×H)。阈值用半径²。 */
        float dx = cx - tuning.targetCenterX;
        float dy = cy - tuning.targetCenterY;
        float r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        float enterR = 0.5f * (tuning.deadzoneEnterPct * 0.01f) * (float) MT9V03X_H;
        float exitR = 0.5f * (tuning.deadzoneExitPct * 0.01f) * (float) MT9V03X_H;
        /* 依赖 menuModel 钳位保证 enter≥exit(故 enterR²≥exitR²)：upper≥lower 时库不交换阈值，
         * 施密特进入/退出语义正确；若该钳位被破坏致 upper<lower，库会交换→死区逻辑反转。 */
        schmittSetThresholds(&visionDeadzone, enterR * enterR, exitR * exitR);
        schmittUpdate(&visionDeadzone, r2);

        if (visionDeadzone.outputState)
        {
            visionTx.visionErrX = tuning.errXSign * dx;
            visionTx.visionErrY = tuning.errYSign * dy;
        }
        else
        {
            /* 死区内：位置误差归零(已到位)，valid 仍 1 → 位置外环速度目标归零、
             * 速度内环常驻把速度收向 0(悬停抗漂)，不触发失效降级。 */
            visionTx.visionErrX = 0.0f;
            visionTx.visionErrY = 0.0f;
        }
        lastOutputErrX = visionTx.visionErrX;
        lastOutputErrY = visionTx.visionErrY;
        visionTx.visionVelX = tuning.errXSign * observation->velocityX;
        visionTx.visionVelY = tuning.errYSign * observation->velocityY;
        /* yaw 朝向误差不受位置死区影响；朝向基线未确认时不做偏航修正。 */
        visionTx.visionYawErr = observation->orientBaselineValid
                                    ? (tuning.yawErrSign * wrapToPi(observation->orientation - tuning.targetAngleRad))
                                    : 0.0f;
        visionTx.visionTargetValid = 1u;
    }
    else
    {
        /* 目标丢失两阶段：
         *   1) 丢失后 lostFreezeMs 内冻结最后一次已发布 X/Y 误差，避免从真实误差阶跃到外推圆误差；
         *   2) 超时后，若最后质心在 exitR 内则归零；否则沿"目标中点 C → 最后有效质心 P"
         *      射线投影到外推圆周作虚拟靶点，驱动飞机朝最后视向找回。
         * 契约：丢失期 visionTargetValid=0，但 visionErrX/Y 可非零；偏航/速度丢失期归零。
         * 目标丢失安全上限仍由 cm_7_0 TARGET_LOST_HOLD_MS(3s) 兜底。 */
        float extrapErrX = 0.0f;
        float extrapErrY = 0.0f;

        visionDeadzone.outputState = 0u; /* 重捕从低状态开始(保留) */

        if (!visionLostActive)
        {
            visionLostActive = 1u;
            visionLostElapsedMs = 0u;
        }

        if (lastValidHas)
        {
            uint16_t lostElapsedMs = visionLostElapsedMs;
            if ((float) lostElapsedMs < tuning.lostFreezeMs)
            {
                extrapErrX = lastOutputErrX;
                extrapErrY = lastOutputErrY;
            }
            else
            {
                float dx = lastValidCx - tuning.targetCenterX;
                float dy = lastValidCy - tuning.targetCenterY;
                float dist = sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                float exitR = 0.5f * (tuning.deadzoneExitPct * 0.01f) * (float) MT9V03X_H;
                if (dist >= exitR && dist > 1e-3f)
                {
                    float R = 0.5f * tuning.lostExtrapDiameterPx; /* 外推圆半径 */
                    extrapErrX = tuning.errXSign * R * dx / dist; /* 虚拟靶点沿最后视向，距中点 R */
                    extrapErrY = tuning.errYSign * R * dy / dist;
                }
            }
        }

        visionTx.visionErrX = extrapErrX;
        visionTx.visionErrY = extrapErrY;
        visionTx.visionVelX = 0.0f;
        visionTx.visionVelY = 0.0f;
        visionTx.visionYawErr = 0.0f; /* 丢失期偏航不修正 */
        visionTx.visionTargetValid = 0u;
    }
    visionTx.cm71Ready = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    visionTx.visionSeq++; /* 每发布一帧自增，供 cm_7_0 判新鲜度 */
    coreDataWriteVisionToFlight(&visionTx);
}

/* 每帧把 ^ 灯板业务事实写入保留ABI名称的visionDebugRegion，供 cm_7_0 生成Policy事实
 * 与Core0 Pose。该共享区不再连接任何串口调试输出。与publishVisionError同源
 * (chevronDetector)、同拍(仅新帧调)，cm_7_0只接受一致快照。 */
static void publishVisionDebug(const imageObservationSnapshotStruct* observation)
{
    static uint32_t visionDebugSeq = 0u;
    visionDebugToFlightStruct dbg;

    dbg.magic = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    visionDebugSeq++;
    if (visionDebugSeq == 0u) visionDebugSeq = 1u;
    dbg.seq = visionDebugSeq;
    dbg.trackingState = observation->trackingState;
    dbg.contourCount = observation->contourCount;
    dbg.selectedIndex = observation->selectedIndex;
    dbg.targetLost = observation->targetLost;
    /* 无候选(contourCount==0)时 contourData[si] 的 center/size/Hu 是上帧残留(om_contour 每帧只清 contourSize，
     * 不清 center/Hu)，整组置 0 避免调试通道显示陈旧值，与 CH11=0/CH13=1 自洽。
     * contourCount>0(含 targetLost 但有真实轮廓)则照常显示选中轮廓观测量，保留诊断价值。 */
    if (observation->contourCount > 0u)
    {
        dbg.selectedCenterX = observation->selectedCenterX;
        dbg.selectedCenterY = observation->selectedCenterY;
        dbg.selectedSize = observation->selectedSize;
        dbg.selectedHuDistance = observation->selectedHuDistance;
    }
    else
    {
        dbg.selectedCenterX = 0u;
        dbg.selectedCenterY = 0u;
        dbg.selectedSize = 0u;
        dbg.selectedHuDistance = 0.0f;
    }
    dbg.filteredCenterX = observation->filteredCenterX;
    dbg.filteredCenterY = observation->filteredCenterY;
    dbg.orientationFresh = observation->orientationFresh;
    dbg.padding0 = 0u;
    dbg.orientation = observation->orientation;
    dbg.orientationConfidence = observation->orientationConfidence;
    dbg.orientProtectState = observation->orientProtectState;
    dbg.orientSpikeFrameCount = observation->orientSpikeFrameCount;
    dbg.lostFrameCount = observation->lostFrameCount;
    dbg.lockFrameCount = observation->lockFrameCount;
    coreDataWriteVisionDebugToFlight(&dbg);
}

/* ============================================================
 * processInit
 * ============================================================ */
void processInit(void)
{
    paramSyncOwnerServiceInit();
    cameraReady = imageInit();

    /* 菜单接管 IPS114 + 按键 + flash + 参数下发 + 握手 */
    menuInit();
    menuSetInitHealth(cameraReady ? 0u : CORE0_INIT_FAIL_CAMERA, 0u);

    /* 初始化共享内存发送区并标记 cm_7_1 就绪 */
    memset(&visionTx, 0, sizeof(visionTx));
    visionTx.cm71Ready = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    coreDataWriteVisionToFlight(&visionTx);

    /* 菜单节拍用 PIT_CH2：PIT_CH0/CH1 已被 cm_7_0 飞控占用（同一片 TCPWM0 硬件定时器
     * 跨双核共享），cm_7_1 若复用 PIT_CH1 会与 cm_7_0 的 1ms 控制环争用同一计数器，
     * 把按键扫描节拍拉快 ~10 倍 → 短按难触发且被误判长按。改用空闲的 PIT_CH2。 */
    pit_ms_init(PIT_CH2, MENU_PIT_TICK_MS);

    initReadyFlag = 1u;
}

/* ============================================================
 * pitProcess0 — 10ms (PIT_CH2)：菜单按键扫描 + 节拍（轻量）
 * ============================================================ */
void pitProcess0(void)
{
    if (!initReadyFlag) return;
    menuPitTick();
    if (visionLostActive)
    {
        if (visionLostElapsedMs <= (uint16_t) (0xFFFFu - VISION_LOST_FREEZE_TICK_MS))
        {
            visionLostElapsedMs = (uint16_t) (visionLostElapsedMs + VISION_LOST_FREEZE_TICK_MS);
        }
        else
        {
            visionLostElapsedMs = 0xFFFFu;
        }
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * whileProcess — 视觉处理 + 误差发布 + 菜单调度
 * ============================================================ */
void whileProcess(void)
{
    if (!initReadyFlag) return;

    paramSyncOwnerServicePoll();

    /* 先消费按键并热应用参数；IPS114、反馈与Flash仍统一留在循环尾。 */
    menuServiceInput();

    /* 视觉处理（无新帧直接进菜单调度，保证 UI 仍响应） */
    if ((cameraReady != 0u) && imageProcess())
    {
        imageObservationSnapshotStruct observation;
        imageGetObservationSnapshot(&observation);
        publishVisionError(&observation);
        publishVisionDebug(&observation); /* 保留ABI名称：同拍发布Policy灯板事实与Core0 Pose业务快照 */
    }

    /* 菜单尾服务（Flash/反馈/渲染），自身按刷新节拍限流。 */
    menuTick();
}
