/*
 * core0 cm_7_1 菜单 + 屏幕显示（core1Loop 仅调度）。本模块拆分为：
 *   menu.c        共享状态唯一定义 + 公共 API(menuInit/PitTick/Tick) + 状态机分发 + arming 门控
 *   menuModel.c   参数默认值/本地热重载/下发 cm_7_0 + 页表构建
 *   menuPersistence.c flash blob/CRC/版本迁移 + 读写/擦除
 *   menuRender.c  IPS114 绘制原语 + 各状态渲染
 *   menuInput.c   按键 handler + 反馈/清屏/滚动维护
 * 共享宏/类型在 menuInternal.h，跨文件状态与函数原型亦在该头集中声明。
 *
 *   参数三类：
 *     1) 视觉/相机参数（菜单本地应用，不下发 cm_7_0）：menuVisionTuning + DetectMode/BinaryCC/Canny + 曝光
 *     2) 飞控参数（编辑后经共享内存推给 cm_7_0 热重载）：menuFlightWork
 *     3) 指令：发车(cmdLaunch) / 回待机(cmdStandby) / 清空恢复默认(cmdClear)
 *
 *   屏幕：IPS114 240×135（横向），8×16 字体（30 列 × 8 行），飞行中持续刷新。
 *   开机：先显示约 5s ESC arming 进度，再显示 cm_7_0 ToF 初始化状态；
 *     两阶段均忽略按键，完成后才进入发车页（可交互）。
 */

/* 刷新：10ms tick → 100ms 刷新 */
#define LCD_REFRESH_DIV (10u)
#define FLIGHT_READ_FAIL_CLOSED_MS (600u)
#define KVM_READ_FAIL_CLOSED_MS (600u)
#define MENU_STORAGE_NONE    (0u)
#define MENU_STORAGE_SAVE    (1u)
#define MENU_STORAGE_RESTORE (2u)


/* ============================================================
 * 共享状态唯一定义点（跨文件量在 menuInternal.h extern 声明）
 * ============================================================ */
menuContextStruct menuContext;

static void discardAllMenuKeys(void)
{
    uint8_t keyIndex;
    for (keyIndex = 0u; keyIndex < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; keyIndex++)
    {
        menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease((menuKeyIndexEnum) keyIndex);
    }
}

static uint8_t faultReasonValid(uint8_t reason)
{
    if ((reason & CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_FLAG) != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t source = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_SOURCE(reason);
        uint8_t faultClass = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_CLASS(reason);
        return (uint8_t) ((source >= 1u) && (source <= 4u) &&
            (faultClass >= 1u) && (faultClass <= 7u));
    }
    return (uint8_t) ((reason >= CORE0_FAULT_REASON_PROTECT_ATTITUDE) &&
        (reason <= CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_C2_ATTITUDE));
}

/* ============================================================
 * 开机启动门控（ESC arming后进入ToF初始化，两个阶段均禁止按键）
 * ============================================================ */
static void updateArmingGate(void)
{
    /* cm_7_0 依次回报 ARMING 与 TOF_INIT；两个阶段均未完成启动。
     * 完成判据：cm_7_0 最终置 cm70Ready=MAGIC —— 说明启动
     *   已结束（无论 cm_7_1 是否亲眼见过 ARMING 窗口）。这样可覆盖 cm_7_1 启动慢、
     *   单独复位、错过 100% 帧等情形，避免永久卡在进度条。
     * cm_7_0 未最终就绪时保持当前启动页。 */
    if (!bootArmingDone)
    {
        if (flightRx.cm70Ready != CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC)
        {
            return;
        }
        /* cm_7_0 就绪且已离开启动阶段 */
        bootArmingDone = 1u;
        clearScreenForState(); /* arming 结束清屏进发车页 */
    }

}

/* ============================================================
 * 对外接口
 * ============================================================ */
void menuInit(void)
{
    menuState = MENU_HOME;
    pageIdx = 0;
    optIdx = 0;
    scrollTop = 0u;
    forceRedraw = 1u;
    bootArmingDone = 0u;
    bootRenderState = 0xFFu;
    armBarLast = 0xFFu;
    feedbackHoldTicks = 0u;
    feedbackWasActive = 0u;
    menuInitFailedMask = 0u;
    menuInitUnverifiedMask = 0u;
    menuInitSummaryTicks = 0u;
    menuInitSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFFFu;
    menuInitSummaryPresented = 0u;
    menuInputServiced = 0u;
    menuPendingScreenClear = 0u;
    menuPendingFeedback = 0u;
    menuPendingFeedbackColor = RGB565_BLACK;
    menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
    menuParamGlobalReset();
    menuFaultPageActive = 0u;
    menuFaultAckPending = 0u;
    menuFaultDisplayReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
    menuFaultRenderedReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
    menuFaultRenderedSafetyState = 0xFFu;
    remoteDeferredKeyValid = 0u;
    remoteDeferredKeyId = 0u;
    remoteDeferredKeyState = 0u;
    remoteDeferredKeyTickMs = 0u;
    memset(&flightRx, 0, sizeof(flightRx));
    flightLastGeneration = 0u;
    flightLastAdvanceMs = 0u;
    flightGenerationPrimed = 0u;
    flightSnapshotAvailable = 0u;
    mutationLockLast = 0u;
    menuTickMs = 0u;
    kvmReadFailureStartMs = 0u;
    kvmReadFailureActive = 0u;
    /* 取本启动唯一 epoch：读共享参数区上一帧 cm71BootEpoch + 1。共享区(0x28001200)
     * 不在 cm_7_1 SRAM 的 startup ECC 清零范围内，跨 cm_7_1 复位保留，故 epoch 单调递增，
     * 每次 cm_7_1 复位后必与上次不同。最高位置 1 保证非 0（cm_7_0 lastBootEpoch 初值 0，
     * 0 epoch 会漏判首次复位）。首帧(共享区未握手)用固定非 0 种子。 */
    {
        paramToFlightStruct priorFrame;
        if (coreDataReadParamToFlight(&priorFrame) != 0u)
        {
            bootEpoch = (priorFrame.cm71BootEpoch + 1u) | 0x80000000u;
        }
        else
        {
            bootEpoch = 0x80000001u;
        }
    }
    seqParam = 0u;
    seqLaunch = 0u;
    seqStandby = 0u;
    seqClear = 0u;
    menuKvmRouteEpoch = (bootEpoch ^ 0x4B564D31u) | 1u;
    remoteKeySeq = 0u;
    remoteKeyPending = 0u;
    remoteRouteRestartPending = 0u;
    remoteEnterThresholdPending = 0u;
    menuKeyTargetCore = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;

    menuLoadDefaults();
    menuBuildPages();

    /* IPS114 8×16 横屏 180，黑底绿字 */
    ips114_set_dir(IPS114_PORTAIT_180);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_init();
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_clear();
    menuRenderResetListSnapshot();

    menuKeyInit(10u);

    /* flash 载入：magic/version/CRC 校验，失败回退默认 → 本地应用 → 推 cm_7_0 */
    flash_init();
    menuFlashLoad();
    applyVisionLocal();
    menuPushParams();
}

void menuPitTick(void)
{
    menuTickMs += 10u;
    menuKeyScan();

    if (menuInitSummaryTicks > 0u) menuInitSummaryTicks--;


    /* 填充反馈倒计时（10ms 确定时长，不受前台帧率影响） */
    if (feedbackHoldTicks > 0u) feedbackHoldTicks--;

    lcdRefreshCount++;
    if (lcdRefreshCount >= LCD_REFRESH_DIV)
    {
        lcdRefreshCount = 0u;
        lcdRefreshFlag = 1u;
    }
}

    menuPendingScreenClear = 1u;
    forceRedraw = 1u;
}

    menuPendingFeedbackColor = color;
    menuPendingFeedbackAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
    menuPendingFeedbackSlot = 0u;
    menuPendingFeedback = 1u;
}

void menuRequestParamFeedback(uint16_t color, uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    menuPendingFeedbackColor = color;
    menuPendingFeedbackAction = action;
    menuPendingFeedbackSlot = slot;
    menuPendingFeedback = 1u;
}

void menuRequestSaveSettings(void)
{
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return;
    menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_SAVE;
}

void menuRequestRestoreDefaults(void)
{
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return;
    menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_RESTORE;
}

static void applyPendingTailEffects(void)
{
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
        (void) imageTakeCalibrationSaveRequest();
        return;
    }
    if (imageTakeCalibrationSaveRequest())
    {
        menuFlashSave();
    }
    if (menuPendingStorageAction == MENU_STORAGE_SAVE)
    {
        menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
        menuSaveSettings();
    }
    else if (menuPendingStorageAction == MENU_STORAGE_RESTORE)
    {
        menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
        menuRestoreDefaults();
    }

    if (menuPendingFeedback != 0u)
    {
        menuPendingFeedback = 0u;
        menuPendingScreenClear = 0u;
        ips114_full(menuPendingFeedbackColor);
        if (menuPendingFeedbackAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY ||
            menuPendingFeedbackAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME)
        {
            char slotText[16];
            ips114_set_color((menuPendingFeedbackColor == RGB565_GREEN) ?
                RGB565_BLACK : RGB565_WHITE, menuPendingFeedbackColor);
            ips114_show_string(80u, 42u,
                (menuPendingFeedbackAction ==
                    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ?
                    "SAVE OK" : "LOAD OK");
            (void) snprintf(slotText, sizeof(slotText), "SLOT %u",
                (unsigned) menuPendingFeedbackSlot);
            ips114_show_string(88u, 66u, slotText);
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
        menuPendingFeedbackAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
        menuPendingFeedbackSlot = 0u;
        menuRenderResetListSnapshot();
        feedbackHoldTicks = MENU_FEEDBACK_HOLD_TICKS;
        return;
    }
    if (menuPendingScreenClear != 0u)
    {
        menuPendingScreenClear = 0u;
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_clear();
        menuRenderResetListSnapshot();
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
}

void menuServiceInput(void)
{
    flightToVisionStruct nextFlight;
    uint32_t nextFlightGeneration;
    kvmStatusToMenuStruct nextKvm;
    uint32_t nowMs = menuTickMs;

    if (menuInputServiced != 0u) return;
    menuInputServiced = 1u;

    /* 读 cm_7_0 状态 → arming 门控。读写碰撞只保留last-good；
     * 已确认generation连续600ms未前进才按真实静默fail-closed。 */
    if (coreDataTryReadFlightToVision(&nextFlight,
            &nextFlightGeneration) != 0u)
    {
        if ((flightGenerationPrimed == 0u) ||
            (nextFlightGeneration != flightLastGeneration))
        {
            flightRx = nextFlight;
            flightLastGeneration = nextFlightGeneration;
            flightLastAdvanceMs = nowMs;
            flightGenerationPrimed = 1u;
            flightSnapshotAvailable = 1u;
        }
    }
    if ((flightGenerationPrimed == 0u) ||
        ((uint32_t) (nowMs - flightLastAdvanceMs) >=
            FLIGHT_READ_FAIL_CLOSED_MS))
    {
        flightSnapshotAvailable = 0u;
    }
    if (coreDataTryReadKvmStatusToMenu(&nextKvm) != 0u)
    {
        kvmRx = nextKvm;
        kvmReadFailureActive = 0u;
    }
    else if (kvmReadFailureActive == 0u)
    {
        kvmReadFailureActive = 1u;
        kvmReadFailureStartMs = nowMs;
    }
    else if ((uint32_t) (nowMs - kvmReadFailureStartMs) >= KVM_READ_FAIL_CLOSED_MS)
    {
        memset(&kvmRx, 0, sizeof(kvmRx));
    }
    updateArmingGate();
    if ((menuFaultAckPending == 0u) &&
        (menuFaultDisplayReason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE) &&
        (faultReasonValid(flightRx.latchedFaultReason) != 0u))
    {
        menuFaultDisplayReason = flightRx.latchedFaultReason;
    }

    /* 等 cm_7_0 完成初始化发布后再一次性汇总，避免本地相机结果先到而漏掉
     * IMU/ToF/光流等较晚到达的失败事实。 */
    if ((menuInitSummaryPresented == 0u) &&
        (flightRx.cm70Ready == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
        ((menuInitFailedMask | menuInitUnverifiedMask | flightRx.initFailedMask |
          flightRx.initUnverifiedMask) != 0u))
    {
        menuInitSummaryPresented = 1u;
        menuInitSummaryTicks = 300u;
        menuInitSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFFFu;
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }

    if (menuInitSummaryTicks > 0u)
    {
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        return;
    }
    if (menuInitSummaryLastSecond != 0xFFFFu)
    {
        menuInitSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFFFu;
        clearScreenForState();
    }

    if (!bootArmingDone)
    {
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        return;
    }

    if ((flightRx.cm70Ready == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
        (menuFaultDisplayReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE) &&
        (menuFaultAckPending == 0u))
    {
        menuState = MENU_HOME;
        if (menuFaultAckPending == 0u)
        {
            (void) handleFaultReasonAck();
        }
        else
        {
            discardAllMenuKeys();
        }
        return;
    }
    if (menuFaultAckPending != 0u)
    {
        if (flightRx.latchedFaultReason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
        {
            menuFaultAckPending = 0u;
            menuFaultDisplayReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
            menuFaultRenderedReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
            menuFaultRenderedSafetyState = 0xFFu;
        }
        else discardAllMenuKeys();
        return;
    }

    /* === 填充反馈保持期：屏幕维持填充色，吞掉按键；倒计时(10ms PIT 递减)结束后清屏重绘 === */
    if (feedbackHoldTicks > 0u)
    {
        feedbackWasActive = 1u;
        /* 吞掉保持期内的按键，避免反馈结束后误触发陈旧事件 */
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        return;
    }
    if (feedbackWasActive)
    {
        feedbackWasActive = 0u;
        clearScreenForState(); /* 保持期刚结束：清屏 + forceRedraw，下方按当前 menuState 重绘 */
    }

    /* === 按键 === */
    if (handleFlightStandbyKey())
    {
        return;
    }

    /* 远程操控模式: 按键转发给 core1, 不进本地菜单状态机。core0 屏保持发车页(红边框)。
     * 强制回发车页, 使切换瞬间本地不停留在子菜单。 */
    if (menuKeyTargetCore)
    {
        if (menuState != MENU_HOME)
        {
            menuState = MENU_HOME;
            clearScreenForState();
        }
        handleRemoteForward();
    }
    else
    {
        switch (menuState)
        {
            case MENU_HOME: handleHomeKeys(); break;
            case MENU_PAGE_LIST: handlePageListKeys(); break;
            case MENU_OPTION_LIST: handleOptionListKeys(); break;
            case MENU_EDIT: handleEditKeys(); break;
            case MENU_THRESH_EDIT: handleThreshEditKeys(); break;
            case MENU_PARAM_SLOTS: handleParamSlotKeys(); break;
            default: break;
        }
    }

}

void menuTick(void)
{
    uint8_t mutationLocked;
    menuParamGlobalPoll();
    if (menuPendingFeedback != 0u)
    {
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        menuInputServiced = 1u;
    }
    mutationLocked = paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked();
    if (mutationLocked != mutationLockLast)
    {
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
        (void) imageTakeCalibrationSaveRequest();
        mutationLockLast = mutationLocked;
    }
    if (menuInputServiced == 0u) menuServiceInput();
    menuInputServiced = 0u;
    applyPendingTailEffects();

    if (menuInitSummaryTicks > 0u)
    {
        uint16_t second = (uint16_t) ((menuInitSummaryTicks + 99u) / 100u);
        if ((second != menuInitSummaryLastSecond) || forceRedraw)
        {
            forceRedraw = 0u;
            renderInitFaultSummary((uint8_t) (menuInitFailedMask | flightRx.initFailedMask),
                (uint8_t) (menuInitUnverifiedMask | flightRx.initUnverifiedMask),
                (uint8_t) second);
            menuInitSummaryLastSecond = second;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (!bootArmingDone)
    {
        uint8_t bootState = (flightRx.startupStateValid != 0u) ?
            flightRx.safetyState : FLIGHT_SAFETY_ARMING;

        if (bootState == FLIGHT_SAFETY_TOF_INIT)
        {
            if ((bootRenderState != FLIGHT_SAFETY_TOF_INIT) || forceRedraw)
            {
                forceRedraw = 0u;
                renderTofInit();
                bootRenderState = FLIGHT_SAFETY_TOF_INIT;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            uint8_t prog = flightRx.armProgress;
            if (bootRenderState != FC_STATE_ARMING)
            {
                ips114_clear();
                menuRenderResetListSnapshot();
                armBarLast = 0xFFu;
                bootRenderState = FC_STATE_ARMING;
            }
            if ((prog != armBarLast) || forceRedraw)
            {
                forceRedraw = 0u;
                renderArming(prog);
                armBarLast = prog;
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if ((flightRx.cm70Ready == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
        (menuFaultDisplayReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE) &&
        (menuFaultAckPending == 0u))
    {
        uint8_t fullRedraw = (menuFaultPageActive == 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
        uint8_t reasonChanged = (menuFaultRenderedReason !=
            menuFaultDisplayReason) ? 1u : 0u;
        uint8_t stateChanged = (menuFaultRenderedSafetyState !=
            flightRx.safetyState) ? 1u : 0u;
        lcdRefreshFlag = 0u;
        if ((fullRedraw != 0u) || (reasonChanged != 0u) ||
            (stateChanged != 0u))
        {
            forceRedraw = 0u;
            menuFaultPageActive = 1u;
            renderFaultReasonPage(menuFaultDisplayReason,
                flightRx.safetyState, fullRedraw,
                reasonChanged, stateChanged);
            menuFaultRenderedReason = menuFaultDisplayReason;
            menuFaultRenderedSafetyState = flightRx.safetyState;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (menuFaultPageActive != 0u)
    {
        menuFaultPageActive = 0u;
        menuFaultRenderedReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
        menuFaultRenderedSafetyState = 0xFFu;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }
    if ((feedbackHoldTicks > 0u) || (menuPendingFeedback != 0u)) return;

    /* === 渲染（仅在刷新节拍或强制重绘时，限 SPI 流量） === */
    if (!lcdRefreshFlag && !forceRedraw) return;
    lcdRefreshFlag = 0u;
    forceRedraw = 0u;

    switch (menuState)
    {
        case MENU_HOME: renderHome(); break;
        case MENU_PAGE_LIST: renderPageList(); break;
        case MENU_OPTION_LIST: renderOptionList(0u); break;
        case MENU_EDIT: renderOptionList(1u); break;
        case MENU_THRESH_EDIT: renderThreshEdit(); break;
        case MENU_PARAM_SLOTS: renderParamSlots(); break;
        default: break;
    }
}

void menuSetInitHealth(uint8_t failedMaskValue, uint8_t unverifiedMaskValue)
{
    menuInitFailedMask = failedMaskValue;
    menuInitUnverifiedMask = unverifiedMaskValue;
}

void menuGetVisionTuning(visionTuningStruct* out)
{
    if (out == NULL) return;
    *out = menuVisionTuning;
}

#ifndef _MENU_H_
#define _MENU_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core0 cm_7_1 菜单 + 屏幕显示（独占 IPS114 + 5 按键 + flash）
 *
 *   职责拆分为五个 TU（共享状态/类型/原型见 menuInternal.h）：
 *     menu.c        共享状态定义 + 公共 API + 状态机分发 + 开机 arming 门控
 *     menuModel.c   参数默认/本地热重载/下发 cm_7_0 + 分页页表构建
 *     menuPersistence.c flash blob/CRC/版本迁移 + 读写/擦除
 *     menuRender.c  8×16 渲染（绘制原语 + 各状态画面）
 *     menuInput.c   按键状态机 handler + 清屏/填充反馈/滚动窗口维护
 *
 *   core1Loop.c 只做调度：
 *     processInit  → imageInit + menuInit
 *     pitProcess0  → menuPitTick（PIT_CH2 10ms ISR：key_scanner + 计数。
 *                    注意 PIT_CH0/CH1 是 cm_7_0 飞控独占的同片 TCPWM0 定时器，
 *                    cm_7_1 必须用 PIT_CH2，复用 CH1 会跨核争用导致按键节拍失准）
 *     whileProcess → menuServiceInput + imageProcess/publishVisionError + menuTick
 *
 *   按键映射：
 *     发车页短按: K1 进菜单 / K2 标定(成功后自动持久化) / K3 进阈值编辑器 /
 *              K4 短:手动保存全部参数(绿屏反馈) 长:清空恢复默认(红屏反馈) / K5 短:发车 长(飞行态):回待机
 *     发车页长按: K1 直达 Core1 / K2 直达 Core3 阈值页 / K3 直达 Core4 阈值页；远端 K1 长按返回 Core0
 *     页列表:  K1 进入选项 / K2 下 / K3 上 / K4 回发车页 / K5 保存回发车页
 *     选项列表:K1 进入编辑 / K2 下 / K3 上 / K4 回页列表 / K5 保存回发车页
 *     编辑:    K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大 / K5 保存回选项列表
 *     阈值编辑器: K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大 / K5 短:切项(Lo/Hi/Exp) 长:保存回发车页
 *   开机 ESC arming 期间显示进度条并忽略按键；当前调试配置在飞行中保持屏显。
 */

/* 视觉误差调参（菜单可调，供 core1Loop publishVisionError 计算误差读取）。
 * 与原 configVision.h 宏一一对应，运行时可改 + flash 持久化。
 * 仅在前台 whileProcess 上下文访问（菜单编辑 + 误差发布同线程），无需 volatile。 */
typedef struct
{
    float targetCenterX;  /* ^ 目标像素中点 X (0..MT9V03X_W-1) */
    float targetCenterY;  /* ^ 目标像素中点 Y (0..MT9V03X_H-1) */
    float targetAngleRad; /* ^ 期望朝向参考角 rad */
    float errXSign;       /* errX 极性 (±1) */
    float errYSign;       /* errY 极性 (±1) */
    float yawErrSign;     /* yawErr 极性 (±1) */
    float deadzoneEnterPct; /* 施密特大圆(进入,转高)直径占图像高%，须 > exit */
    float deadzoneExitPct;  /* 施密特小圆(退出,归零)直径占图像高% */
    float lostFreezeMs;     /* 目标丢失后冻结最后输出误差的时间 ms */
    float lostExtrapDiameterPx; /* 目标丢失外推圆直径 px（沿最后视向投影找回目标）*/
} visionTuningStruct;

#ifndef MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_INTERNAL_H
#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_INTERNAL_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "zf_device_ips114.h"

#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX (8u)
#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS        (15u)

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDigitsU64(uint64_t value)
{
    uint8_t digits = 1u;

    while (value >= 10u)
    {
        value /= 10u;
        digits++;
    }
    return digits;
}

static void menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(uint16_t x,
    uint16_t y,
    const char *literal)
{
    char buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS + 1u];
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t length = 0u;

    while ((literal[length] != '\0') && (length < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS))
    {
        length++;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS; i++)
    {
        buf[i] = ' ';
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < length; i++)
    {
        buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS - length + i] = literal[i];
    }
    buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS] = '\0';
    ips114_show_string(x, y, buf);
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForStep(float step)
{
    uint8_t decimals = 0u;
    double scaled = (step < 0.0f) ? -(double) step : (double) step;

    if (!(scaled > 0.0))
    {
        return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    }
    while (decimals < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX)
    {
        uint64_t rounded;
        double difference;

        if (!(scaled < (double) UINT64_MAX) ||
            !((scaled + 0.5) < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
        }
        rounded = (uint64_t) (scaled + 0.5);
        difference = scaled - (double) rounded;

        if (difference < 0.0)
        {
            difference = -difference;
        }
        if (difference <= 0.000001)
        {
            break;
        }
        scaled *= 10.0;
        decimals++;
    }
    return decimals;
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValue(double value)
{
    uint8_t decimals;
    double scale = 1.0;
    double tolerance = 0.0000001;

    if (value < 0.0)
    {
        value = -value;
    }
    if (!(value >= 0.0) || !(value < (double) UINT64_MAX))
    {
        return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    }
    for (decimals = 0u; decimals < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX; decimals++)
    {
        double scaled = value * scale;
        uint64_t rounded;
        double difference;

        if (!(scaled < (double) UINT64_MAX) ||
            !((scaled + 0.5) < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
        }
        rounded = (uint64_t) (scaled + 0.5);
        difference = value - ((double) rounded / scale);

        if (difference < 0.0)
        {
            difference = -difference;
        }
        if (difference <= tolerance)
        {
            return decimals;
        }
        scale *= 10.0;
    }
    return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(double value, float step)
{
    uint8_t stepDecimals = menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForStep(step);
    uint8_t valueDecimals = menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValue(value);

    return (stepDecimals > valueDecimals) ? stepDecimals : valueDecimals;
}

static void menuFloatDisplayShow(uint16_t x,
    uint16_t y,
    double value,
    uint8_t requestedDecimals)
{
    static const uint64_t scaleTable[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX + 1u] =
    {
        1u, 10u, 100u, 1000u, 10000u,
        100000u, 1000000u, 10000000u, 100000000u
    };
    char buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS + 1u];
    uint8_t decimals;
    uint8_t selectedDecimals = 0xFFu;
    uint8_t negative = 0u;
    uint8_t pos;
    uint8_t i;
    uint64_t scale = 1u;
    uint64_t scaled = 0u;
    uint64_t intPart;
    uint64_t fracPart;

    if (value != value)
    {
        menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(x, y, "NAN");
        return;
    }
    if (value < 0.0)
    {
        negative = 1u;
        value = -value;
    }

    decimals = (requestedDecimals <= MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX)
        ? requestedDecimals
        : MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    for (;; decimals--)
    {
        double scaledDouble;
        double roundedDouble;
        uint8_t required;

        scale = scaleTable[decimals];
        scaledDouble = value * (double) scale;
        roundedDouble = scaledDouble + 0.5;
        if ((scaledDouble < (double) UINT64_MAX) &&
            (roundedDouble < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            scaled = (uint64_t) roundedDouble;
            intPart = scaled / scale;
            required = (uint8_t) (negative + menuFloatDisplayDigitsU64(intPart));
            if (decimals != 0u)
            {
                required = (uint8_t) (required + 1u + decimals);
            }
            if (required <= MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS)
            {
                selectedDecimals = decimals;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (decimals == 0u)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    if (selectedDecimals == 0xFFu)
    {
        menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(x, y, "OVERFLOW");
        return;
    }

    for (i = 0u; i < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS; i++)
    {
        buf[i] = ' ';
    }
    buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS] = '\0';
    intPart = scaled / scale;
    fracPart = scaled % scale;
    pos = MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS;
    for (i = 0u; i < selectedDecimals; i++)
    {
        buf[--pos] = (char) ('0' + (fracPart % 10u));
        fracPart /= 10u;
    }
    if (selectedDecimals != 0u)
    {
        buf[--pos] = '.';
    }
    do
    {
        buf[--pos] = (char) ('0' + (intPart % 10u));
        intPart /= 10u;
    } while ((intPart != 0u) && (pos > 0u));
    if ((negative != 0u) && (pos > 0u))
    {
        buf[--pos] = '-';
    }

    ips114_show_string(x, y, buf);
}

/*

/* ============================================================
 * 滚动窗口维护
 * ============================================================ */
static void clampSelAndScroll(uint8_t count)
{
    if (count == 0u)
    {
        optIdx = 0;
        scrollTop = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (optIdx < 0) optIdx = (int8_t) (count - 1u);
    else if (optIdx >= (int8_t) count) optIdx = 0;

    if ((uint8_t) optIdx < scrollTop) scrollTop = (uint8_t) optIdx;
    else if ((uint8_t) optIdx >= scrollTop + VISIBLE_ROWS)
        scrollTop = (uint8_t) ((uint8_t) optIdx - VISIBLE_ROWS + 1u);
}

static void discardAllPhysicalKeysUntilRelease(void)
{
    uint8_t k;
    for (k = 0u; k < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; k++)
    {
        menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease((menuKeyIndexEnum) k);
    }
}

#define REMOTE_DEFERRED_KEY_MAX_AGE_MS (600u)

static void clearDeferredRemoteKey(void)
{
    remoteDeferredKeyValid = 0u;
    remoteDeferredKeyId = 0u;
    remoteDeferredKeyState = 0u;
    remoteDeferredKeyTickMs = 0u;
}

static void captureOneSafeRemoteKeyWhilePending(void)
{
    uint8_t k;

    /* 只允许一个同路由菜单短按跨ACK窗口。K5可能触发保存或发车，始终禁止
     * 排队；K4仅在非HOME页暂存，并在发送前再次核对页面仍未回HOME。 */
    if (remoteDeferredKeyValid == 0u)
    {
        for (k = 0u; k <= (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_4; k++)
        {
            if ((menuKeyGetState((menuKeyIndexEnum) k) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS) &&
                !((k == (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_4) &&
                  (remoteStatusLaunchHome() != 0u)))
            {
                remoteDeferredKeyValid = 1u;
                remoteDeferredKeyId = k;
                remoteDeferredKeyState = (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS;
                remoteDeferredKeyTickMs = menuTickMs;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    discardAllPhysicalKeysUntilRelease();
}

static void selectKvmTarget(uint8_t target, uint8_t enterThresholdAfterOwner)
{
    menuKeyTargetCore = target;
    menuKvmRouteEpoch++;
    if (menuKvmRouteEpoch == 0u) menuKvmRouteEpoch = 1u;
    remoteKeySeq = 0u;
    remoteKeyPending = 0u;
    remoteRouteRestartPending = 0u;
    remoteEnterThresholdPending = enterThresholdAfterOwner ? 1u : 0u;
    clearDeferredRemoteKey();
    menuState = MENU_HOME;
    discardAllPhysicalKeysUntilRelease();
    menuPushParams();
    clearScreenForState();
}

static void restartRemoteRoute(void)
{
    /* 目标核是操作员意图，协议重同步只能重建同一目标的租约，不能擅自改回 Core0。 */
    menuKvmRouteEpoch++;
    if (menuKvmRouteEpoch == 0u) menuKvmRouteEpoch = 1u;
    remoteKeySeq = 0u;
    remoteKeyPending = 0u;
    remoteRouteRestartPending = 0u;
    clearDeferredRemoteKey();
    discardAllPhysicalKeysUntilRelease();
    menuPushParams();
    forceRedraw = 1u;
}

static uint8_t remoteStatusFresh(void)
{
    uint8_t selectedValid;
    if ((kvmRx.magic != CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) ||
        (kvmRx.routeSession != bootEpoch) ||
        (kvmRx.routeEpoch != menuKvmRouteEpoch) ||
        (kvmRx.target != menuKeyTargetCore) ||
        (kvmRx.activeTarget != menuKeyTargetCore) ||
        ((kvmRx.flags & UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_PEER_RESTART) != 0u) ||
        ((kvmRx.flags & (UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ROUTE_ACCEPTED | UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_LEASE_VALID)) !=
         (UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ROUTE_ACCEPTED | UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_LEASE_VALID)))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    /* Core4 当前 STATUS 无独立菜单 VALID 位；route accepted + lease + activeTarget
     * 已构成 owner 建立事实，也是自动进入阈值页的触发边界。 */
    if (menuKeyTargetCore == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) return 1u;
    selectedValid = (menuKeyTargetCore == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1)
        ? UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE1_VALID : UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE3_VALID;
    return (uint8_t) ((kvmRx.flags & selectedValid) != 0u);
}

static uint8_t remoteStatusHome(void)
{
    uint8_t homeFlag = (menuKeyTargetCore == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1)
        ? UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE1_HOME : UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE3_HOME;
    return (uint8_t) ((kvmRx.flags & homeFlag) != 0u);
}

static uint8_t remoteStatusPeerRestarted(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((kvmRx.magic == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
        (kvmRx.routeSession == bootEpoch) &&
        (kvmRx.routeEpoch == menuKvmRouteEpoch) &&
        (kvmRx.target == menuKeyTargetCore) &&
        ((kvmRx.flags & UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_PEER_RESTART) != 0u));
}

static uint32_t paramGlobalRequestSequence;

static paramSyncGlobalRequest pendingParamGlobalRequest;
static menuParamGlobalUiSnapshot paramGlobalUi;
static uint8_t pendingParamGlobalRequestValid;

static void scheduleParamSlotInspect(void)
{
    pendingParamSlotInspect = 1u;
    paramGlobalUi.slotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
    forceRedraw = 1u;
}

void menuParamGlobalReset(void)
{
    memset(&pendingParamGlobalRequest, 0, sizeof(pendingParamGlobalRequest));
    memset(&paramGlobalUi, 0, sizeof(paramGlobalUi));
    paramGlobalUi.target = 0xFFu;
    pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    pendingParamSlotInspect = 0u;
    pendingParamGlobalCoordinatorBoot = 0u;
    paramGlobalUi.slotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNKNOWN;
}

void menuParamGlobalGetUi(menuParamGlobalUiSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    if (snapshot != 0) *snapshot = paramGlobalUi;
}

void menuParamGlobalPoll(void)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState state;
    uint8_t nextUi;
    if (pendingParamGlobalRequestValid == 0u)
    {
        if (pendingParamSlotInspect != 0u &&
            coreDataTryReadParamGlobalState(&state) != 0u &&
            paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&state) != 0u &&
            requestGlobalParamAction(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY,
                selectedParamSlot) != 0u)
            pendingParamSlotInspect = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (coreDataTryReadParamGlobalState(&state) == 0u) return;
    if (state.coordinatorBootGeneration != pendingParamGlobalCoordinatorBoot)
    {
        nextUi = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
        state.phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED;
        state.target = 0u;
        state.error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_PEER_RESTART;
        pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    }
    else if (paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(&state,
                 &pendingParamGlobalRequest) != 0u &&
             (state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t completedAction = pendingParamGlobalRequest.action;
        uint8_t completedSlot = pendingParamGlobalRequest.slot;
        nextUi = ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_OK) != 0u) ?
            MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS : MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
        paramGlobalUi.action = completedAction;
        paramGlobalUi.slot = completedSlot;
        if (completedAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        {
            if (completedSlot == selectedParamSlot)
                paramGlobalUi.slotUiState = (nextUi == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS) ?
                    paramSyncGlobalClassifySlotSummary(state.transactionId) :
                    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        }
        else if (nextUi == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS)
        {
            menuRequestParamFeedback((completedAction ==
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ? RGB565_GREEN :
                RGB565_RED, completedAction, completedSlot);
            pendingParamSlotInspect = 1u;
        }
        pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    }
    else if (paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(&state,
                 &pendingParamGlobalRequest) != 0u &&
             (state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u)
        nextUi = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS;
    else if (paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&state) == 0u)
    {
        nextUi = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
        state.phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED;
        state.target = 0u;
        state.error = ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY) != 0u) ?
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY :
            (((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u) ?
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY : PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
        pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    }
    else
        return;
    if (paramGlobalUi.state != nextUi || paramGlobalUi.phase != state.phase ||
        paramGlobalUi.target != state.target || paramGlobalUi.error != state.error)
    {
        paramGlobalUi.state = nextUi;
        paramGlobalUi.phase = state.phase;
        paramGlobalUi.target = state.target;
        paramGlobalUi.error = state.error;
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
}

static uint8_t requestGlobalParamAction(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState state;
    paramSyncGlobalRequest request;
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u ||
        pendingParamGlobalRequestValid != 0u ||
        coreDataTryReadParamGlobalState(&state) == 0u ||
        paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&state) == 0u) return 0u;
    paramGlobalRequestSequence++;
    if (paramGlobalRequestSequence == 0u) paramGlobalRequestSequence = 1u;
    request.producerBootGeneration = bootEpoch != 0u ? bootEpoch : 1u;
    request.sequence = paramGlobalRequestSequence;
    request.origin = 0u;
    request.action = action;
    request.slot = slot;
    request.reserved = 0u;
    if (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&request) == 0u) return 0u;
    coreDataWriteParamGlobalRequest(&request);
    pendingParamGlobalRequest = request;
    pendingParamGlobalCoordinatorBoot = state.coordinatorBootGeneration;
    pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 1u;
    paramGlobalUi.state = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED;
    paramGlobalUi.phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_REQUESTED;
    paramGlobalUi.target = 0xFFu;
    paramGlobalUi.error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    paramGlobalUi.action = action;
    paramGlobalUi.slot = slot;
    if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        paramGlobalUi.slotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
    forceRedraw = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

void handleParamSlotKeys(void)
{
    uint8_t ok;
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        enterPageList(0u);
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        selectedParamSlot = (selectedParamSlot <= 1u) ?
            MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT : (uint8_t) (selectedParamSlot - 1u);
        scheduleParamSlotInspect();
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        selectedParamSlot = (selectedParamSlot >= MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT) ?
            1u : (uint8_t) (selectedParamSlot + 1u);
        scheduleParamSlotInspect();
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u ||
            paramGlobalUi.slotUiState != PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL) return;
        ok = requestGlobalParamAction(
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME, selectedParamSlot);
        (void) ok;
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return;
        ok = requestGlobalParamAction(
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY, selectedParamSlot);
        (void) ok;
    }
}

/* 长按/保存操作请求循环尾整屏反馈，让操作员确认按键被成功触发。
 * menuTick 应用请求并设置 feedbackHoldTicks，在 10ms PIT 倒计时数百 ms 后清屏重绘。
 * color: 保存/确认用绿，清空/危险用红。MENU_FEEDBACK_HOLD_TICKS 见 menuInternal.h。 */
static void menuFlashFeedback(uint16_t color)
{
    menuRequestFeedback(color);
}

static void requestLaunchFromHome(void)
{
    if (flightSnapshotAvailable == 0u)
    {
        menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_RED);
        return;
    }
#if INTER_CORE_LINK_GUARD_ENABLE
    if ((flightRx.core1LinkUp == 0u) || (flightRx.core2LinkLost != 0u))
    {
        menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_RED);
        return;
    }
#endif
    seqLaunch++;
    menuPushParams();
}

uint8_t handleFlightStandbyKey(void)
{
    /* 远程路由时五键全部属于目标菜单；K5长按待机只在Core0本地目标生效。
     * 操作员仍可先K1长按切回Core0，再执行待机，避免吞掉远端菜单的保存键。 */
    if ((menuKeyTargetCore != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ||
        (flightRx.safetyState != FC_STATE_FLYING))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) != MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
    menuKeyTargetCore = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    menuKvmRouteEpoch++;
    if (menuKvmRouteEpoch == 0u) menuKvmRouteEpoch = 1u;
    remoteKeyPending = 0u;
    remoteRouteRestartPending = 0u;
    remoteEnterThresholdPending = 0u;
    menuState = MENU_HOME;
    seqStandby++;
    menuPushParams();
    menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_RED);
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t handleFaultReasonAck(void)
{
    menuKeyStateEnum k5State;
    if ((flightRx.cm70Ready != CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) ||
        (menuFaultDisplayReason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    k5State = menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5);
    if ((k5State == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS) || (k5State == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS))
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        menuKeyTargetCore = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
        menuKvmRouteEpoch++;
        if (menuKvmRouteEpoch == 0u) menuKvmRouteEpoch = 1u;
        remoteKeyPending = 0u;
        remoteRouteRestartPending = 0u;
        remoteEnterThresholdPending = 0u;
        menuState = MENU_HOME;
        seqLaunch++;
        menuFaultAckPending = 1u;
        menuFaultPageActive = 0u;
        menuPushParams();
        clearScreenForState();
        /* K5短按在物理释放时形成；ACK成功后再丢弃所有残留键，并要求各键经过
         * 真实释放才可在HOME重新计时，保证本次确认绝不穿透成发车/KVM动作。 */
        discardAllPhysicalKeysUntilRelease();
    }
    /* 未形成K5 SHORT/LONG时不得清扫描状态。短按依赖按下累计后在释放沿生成；
     * 长按达到1s即确认，避免LONG锁存后无法再形成SHORT。 */
    return 1u;
}

void handleHomeKeys(void)
{
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        requestLaunchFromHome();
        return;
    }
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t key;
        if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
        {
            menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
            enterPageList(1u);
            return;
        }
        for (key = 0u; key < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; key++)
        {
            if (menuKeyGetState((menuKeyIndexEnum) key) != MENU_KEY_RELEASE)
                menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease((menuKeyIndexEnum) key);
        }
        return;
    }
    /* HOME 长按直达：K1=Core1；K2=Core3阈值；K3=Core4阈值。 */
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        selectKvmTarget(UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        selectKvmTarget(UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3, 1u);
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        selectKvmTarget(UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4, 1u);
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        enterPageList(1u);
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        imageCalibTrigger();
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        /* K3 进入阈值编辑器 */
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        menuState = MENU_THRESH_EDIT;
        threshSel = 0u;
        clearScreenForState();
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        menuRequestSaveSettings();
        menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_GREEN); /* 保存确认：循环尾绿屏保持数帧后自动重绘 */
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        menuRequestRestoreDefaults();
        menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_RED); /* 清空恢复：红屏保持数帧后自动重绘 */
    }
}

/* 远端目标一次只允许一个在途事件；ACK 前禁止覆盖。 */
void handleRemoteForward(void)
{
    uint8_t fresh;
    uint8_t ackClosedThisPass = 0u;
    uint8_t restartRequired = remoteRouteRestartPending;

    /* 参数事务锁必须先于重绑、ACK等早退路径撤销旧菜单意图；
     * HOME发车仍在后续专用分支保持正交。 */
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        remoteEnterThresholdPending = 0u;
        clearDeferredRemoteKey();
    }

    if (remoteStatusPeerRestarted() != 0u)
    {
        remoteRouteRestartPending = 1u;
        restartRequired = 1u;
    }

    if ((remoteKeyPending != 0u) &&
        (kvmRx.routeSession == bootEpoch) &&
        (kvmRx.routeEpoch == menuKvmRouteEpoch) &&
        (kvmRx.ackEventSeq == remoteKeySeq) &&
        ((kvmRx.flags & UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ACK_TERMINAL) != 0u))
    {
        remoteKeyPending = 0u;
        ackClosedThisPass = 1u;
        menuPushParams();
        if ((kvmRx.ackResult == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_PEER_RESTART) ||
            (kvmRx.ackResult == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NO_LEASE) ||
            (kvmRx.ackResult == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_WRONG_TARGET) ||
            (kvmRx.ackResult == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_STALE_ROUTE) ||
            (kvmRx.ackResult == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_GLOBAL_EVENT_REJECTED) ||
            (kvmRx.ackResult == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_GAP) ||
            (kvmRx.ackResult == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_OLD_EVENT) ||
            (kvmRx.ackResult == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_BAD_PAYLOAD))
        {
            remoteRouteRestartPending = 1u;
            restartRequired = 1u;
        }
    }
    /* HOME 的 K1 长按是操作员退出远程路由的本地逃生动作。 */
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS &&
        remoteStatusHome())
    {
        selectKvmTarget(UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (restartRequired != 0u)
    {
        restartRemoteRoute();
        return;
    }
    fresh = remoteStatusFresh();
    if (fresh == 0u)
    {
        /* 资格失效时不保留尚未发送的第二事件，避免断链后陈旧菜单动作重放。 */
        clearDeferredRemoteKey();
        discardAllPhysicalKeysUntilRelease();
        return;
    }
    if (ackClosedThisPass != 0u)
    {
        /* ACK与实体事件同拍时无法证明事件发生在ACK之后，只截取一个允许
         * 延后的菜单短按；HOME发车与全部长按仍不穿透安全边界。 */
        captureOneSafeRemoteKeyWhilePending();
        return;
    }
    if (remoteKeyPending != 0u)
    {
        captureOneSafeRemoteKeyWhilePending();
        return;
    }
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        remoteEnterThresholdPending = 0u;
        clearDeferredRemoteKey();
        if ((menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS) &&
            remoteStatusLaunchHome())
        {
            menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
            requestLaunchFromHome();
            return;
        }
        discardAllPhysicalKeysUntilRelease();
        return;
    }
    if (remoteEnterThresholdPending != 0u)
    {
        /* 复用目标菜单既有 K3 短按入口，并沿用 eventSeq/在途锁/终态ACK。 */
        remoteEnterThresholdPending = 0u;
        remoteKeyId = (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_3;
        remoteKeyState = (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS;
        remoteKeySeq++;
        if (remoteKeySeq == 0u) remoteKeySeq = 1u;
        remoteKeyPending = 1u;
        discardAllPhysicalKeysUntilRelease();
        menuPushParams();
        return;
    }
    if ((menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS) &&
        remoteStatusLaunchHome())
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        requestLaunchFromHome();
        return;
    }
    if (remoteDeferredKeyValid != 0u)
    {
        if ((remoteDeferredKeyId == (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_4) &&
            (remoteStatusLaunchHome() != 0u))
        {
            clearDeferredRemoteKey();
        }
        if ((uint32_t) (menuTickMs - remoteDeferredKeyTickMs) <=
            REMOTE_DEFERRED_KEY_MAX_AGE_MS &&
            (remoteDeferredKeyValid != 0u))
        {
            remoteKeyId = remoteDeferredKeyId;
            remoteKeyState = remoteDeferredKeyState;
            clearDeferredRemoteKey();
            remoteKeySeq++;
            if (remoteKeySeq == 0u) remoteKeySeq = 1u;
            remoteKeyPending = 1u;
            menuPushParams();
            return;
        }
        clearDeferredRemoteKey();
    }

    for (uint8_t k = 0u; k < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; k++)
    {
        menuKeyStateEnum st = menuKeyGetState((menuKeyIndexEnum) k);
        if (st == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS || st == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
        {
            menuKeyClear((menuKeyIndexEnum) k);
            remoteKeyId = k;
            remoteKeyState = (uint8_t) st;
            remoteKeySeq++;
            if (remoteKeySeq == 0u) remoteKeySeq = 1u;
            remoteKeyPending = 1u;
            menuPushParams();
            break;
        }
    }
}

static void pageListMove(int8_t delta)
{
    if (menuPageCount == 0u)
    {
        pageIdx = 0;
        scrollTop = 0u;
        return;
    }
    pageIdx = (int8_t) (pageIdx + delta);
    if (pageIdx < 0) pageIdx = (int8_t) (menuPageCount - 1u);
    else if (pageIdx >= (int8_t) menuPageCount) pageIdx = 0;

    if ((uint8_t) pageIdx < scrollTop) scrollTop = (uint8_t) pageIdx;
    else if ((uint8_t) pageIdx >= scrollTop + VISIBLE_ROWS)
        scrollTop = (uint8_t) ((uint8_t) pageIdx - VISIBLE_ROWS + 1u);
    forceRedraw = 1u;
}

void handlePageListKeys(void)
{
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        enterOptionList();
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        pageListMove(+1);
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        pageListMove(-1);
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        menuState = MENU_HOME;
        clearScreenForState();
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u)
        {
            menuRequestSaveSettings();
            menuState = MENU_HOME;
            menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_GREEN); /* 保持数帧后自动清屏重绘发车页 */
        }
    }
}

void handleOptionListKeys(void)
{
    menuPageStruct* pg;

    if (pageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) pageIdx >= menuPageCount)
    {
        enterPageList(0u);
        return;
    }
    pg = &menuPages[pageIdx];

    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u &&
            pg->optionCount > 0u && optIdx >= 0 && optIdx < (int8_t) pg->optionCount
            && pg->opt[optIdx] != 0)
        {
            menuState = MENU_EDIT;
            forceRedraw = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        optIdx++;
        clampSelAndScroll(pg->optionCount);
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        optIdx--;
        clampSelAndScroll(pg->optionCount);
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        enterPageList(0u);
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u)
        {
            menuRequestSaveSettings();
            menuState = MENU_HOME;
            menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_GREEN); /* 保持数帧后自动清屏重绘发车页 */
        }
    }
}

void handleEditKeys(void)
{
    menuPageStruct* pg;
    float delta = 0.0f;
    uint8_t hasDelta = 0u;

    if (pageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) pageIdx >= menuPageCount)
    {
        enterPageList(0u);
        return;
    }
    pg = &menuPages[pageIdx];

    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        menuState = MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }

    if (optIdx < 0 || optIdx >= (int8_t) pg->optionCount || pg->opt[optIdx] == 0)
    {
        menuState = MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }

    /* K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大 */
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        delta = pg->stepL[optIdx];
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        delta = pg->stepS[optIdx];
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        delta = -pg->stepS[optIdx];
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        delta = -pg->stepL[optIdx];
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        menuState = MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }

    if (hasDelta)
    {
#if GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
        *pg->opt[optIdx] += delta;
        applyAfterEdit(pg->isVision[optIdx]);
        forceRedraw = 1u;
#else
        /* 持久化关闭：参数锁定，改值键已被消费但不改值、不下发。 */
        (void) delta;
#endif
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * 检测阈值编辑器按键（与编辑页加减逻辑一致）：
 *   K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大（作用于当前 threshSel 项 Lo/Hi/Exp）
 *   K5 短按 切项(Lo→Hi→Exp 循环) / K5 长按 保存回发车页
 *   每次调值即 applyVisionLocal() 热重载，下一帧两图即更新。
 *   步进：Lo/Hi 按 DetectMode 选择 BinaryCC 或 Legacy Canny；
 *         Exposure 大=VISION_EXPOSURE_STEP_LONG/小=VISION_EXPOSURE_STEP_SHORT。
 * ============================================================ */
void handleThreshEditKeys(void)
{
    float stepL;
    float stepS;
    float delta = 0.0f;

    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        menuState = MENU_HOME;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }

    /* K5 长按：保存回发车页（绿屏反馈）；短按：切项 */
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        menuRequestSaveSettings(); /* 循环尾写 flash（含当前 DetectMode 阈值/Exposure 字段） */
        menuState = MENU_HOME;
        menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_GREEN); /* 保持数帧后自动清屏重绘发车页 */
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        threshSel = (uint8_t) ((threshSel + 1u) % 3u);
        forceRedraw = 1u;
        return;
    }

    /* 当前项步进 */
    if (threshSel == 2u)
    {
        stepL = VISION_EXPOSURE_STEP_LONG;
        stepS = VISION_EXPOSURE_STEP_SHORT;
    } /* Exposure */
    else
    {
        if (detectModeF < 0.5f)
        {
            stepL = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_STEP_LONG;
            stepS = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_STEP_SHORT;
        }
        else
        {
            stepL = (float) VISION_CANNY_STEP_LONG;
            stepS = (float) VISION_CANNY_STEP_SHORT;
        }
    } /* Lo/Hi */

    /* 加减：K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大（同编辑页方向） */
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        delta = stepL;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        delta = stepS;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        delta = -stepS;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        delta = -stepL;
    }

    if (delta != 0.0f)
    {
#if GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
        if (threshSel == 0u)
        {
            if (detectModeF < 0.5f) binaryCcLowF += delta;
            else cannyLowF += delta;
        }
        else if (threshSel == 1u)
        {
            if (detectModeF < 0.5f) binaryCcHighF += delta;
            else cannyHighF += delta;
        }
        else exposureF += delta;
        applyVisionLocal(); /* 钳位 + 热重载，下一帧两图即更新 */
        forceRedraw = 1u;
#else

        (void) delta;

#include "menuKey.h"

#include "pinMap.h"
#include "zf_driver_gpio.h"

/*
 * 实现：5 路 GPI 上拉，按下 = GPIO_LOW。
 *   menuKeyScan 在 10ms PIT ISR 调用，按 zf_device_key 等价语义实现：
 *     - KEY_RELEASE_LEVEL = GPIO_HIGH（释放）
 *     - KEY_MAX_SHOCK_PERIOD = 10ms（消抖）
 *     - KEY_LONG_PRESS_PERIOD = 1000ms（短按/长按门限）
 *   对原逆飞库的功能扩展：
 *     - 短按状态锁存到 menuKeyClear 调用（防止短按事件被相邻 scan 周期覆盖）
 *     - 短按事件超时（达长按周期）自动清除，防陈旧事件误触发
 *     - 5 键全覆盖（原库 key_clear_all_state 仅清前 4 键，不在本封装提供 all_clear）
 */

#define MENU_KEY_RELEASE_LEVEL    (GPIO_HIGH)
#define MENU_KEY_SHOCK_PERIOD_MS  (10u)
#define MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS   (1000u)

static const gpio_pin_enum keyPins[MENU_KEY_COUNT] = {MENU_KEY1_PIN, MENU_KEY2_PIN, MENU_KEY3_PIN, MENU_KEY4_PIN, MENU_KEY5_PIN};

#include "menuKeyStateMachineImpl.h"

代码（c）
#ifndef _MENU_KEY_H_
#define _MENU_KEY_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core0 cm_7_1 菜单专用按键扫描封装
 *
 *   独立于逆飞 zf_device_key 库，避免修改逆飞原始代码以便后续库同步。
 *   实现：
 *     - 5 路 GPIO 直读（KEY_LIST 引脚）+ 周期消抖
 *     - 短按 / 长按 区分（释放时根据持续时长判定）
 *     - 短按锁存：短按事件保留至 menuKeyGetState 读取后由 menuKeyClear 清除
 *     - 短按长时间未消费时自动超时清除（防止误触发陈旧事件）
 *     - 长按消费(menuKeyClear)后置"等释放"：按住期间不再重复触发，必须物理释放
 *       后才允许下一次事件（防长按操作在按住期间反复触发）
 *
 *   线程模型：
 *     menuKeyScan() 在 PIT ISR 周期调用（10ms）；
 *     menuKeyGetState/Clear 在 whileProcess 前台消费；
 *     状态数组声明 volatile 跨 ISR/前台共享。
 */

typedef enum
{
    MENU_KEY_1 = 0u,
    MENU_KEY_2,
    MENU_KEY_3,
    MENU_KEY_4,
    MENU_KEY_5,
    MENU_KEY_COUNT
} menuKeyIndexEnum;

typedef enum
{
    MENU_KEY_RELEASE = 0u,
    MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS,
    MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS
} menuKeyStateEnum;

/* 初始化：配置 GPI 上拉 + 清状态。periodMs = 调用 menuKeyScan 的周期(毫秒) */
void menuKeyInit(uint32_t periodMs);

/* 扫描：在 PIT ISR 周期调用 */
void menuKeyScan(void);

/* 查询按键状态（短按事件保留至 menuKeyClear 调用） */
menuKeyStateEnum menuKeyGetState(menuKeyIndexEnum k);

/* 清除指定按键状态 */
void menuKeyClear(menuKeyIndexEnum k);

/* 丢弃当前事件并禁止重新计时，直到检测到一次物理释放。用于页面切换/安全ACK，
 * 防仍按住的键在新页面重新累计并穿透成菜单或发车动作。 */
void menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease(menuKeyIndexEnum k);

#endif /* _MENU_KEY_H_ */
core0_cyt4bb7/project/code/app/menuKeyStateMachineImpl.h
SHA-256：59535b1e043685925409616f368a3a31b77aec3c8e1a5054def43f33e20be6e5
代码（c）
#ifndef MENU_KEY_STATE_MACHINE_IMPL_H
#define MENU_KEY_STATE_MACHINE_IMPL_H

/* 单翻译单元实现片段：由 menuKey.c 在目标专用 keyPins 定义后包含一次。 */
static volatile uint32_t scanPeriodMs = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t pressTimeMs[MENU_KEY_COUNT];
static volatile uint32_t shortHoldMs[MENU_KEY_COUNT];
static volatile menuKeyStateEnum keyState[MENU_KEY_COUNT];
static volatile uint8_t waitRelease[MENU_KEY_COUNT]; /* 消费后等物理释放，防长按按住期间重复触发 */

void menuKeyInit(uint32_t periodMs)
{
    if (periodMs == 0u) periodMs = 1u;
    scanPeriodMs = periodMs;
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < MENU_KEY_COUNT; i++)
    {
        gpio_init(keyPins[i], GPI, GPIO_HIGH, GPI_PULL_UP);
        keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
        pressTimeMs[i] = 0u;
        shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
        waitRelease[i] = 0u;
    }
}

void menuKeyScan(void)
{
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < MENU_KEY_COUNT; i++)
    {
        uint8_t pressed = (gpio_get_level(keyPins[i]) != MENU_KEY_RELEASE_LEVEL) ? 1u : 0u;

        /* 等释放期间：忽略按键直到物理释放，期间不累计、不产状态 */
        if (waitRelease[i])
        {
            if (!pressed)
            {
                waitRelease[i] = 0u;
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
                pressTimeMs[i] = 0u;
                shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
            }
            continue;
        }

        /* 短按状态锁存超时清除 */
        if (keyState[i] == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
        {
            shortHoldMs[i] += scanPeriodMs;
            if (shortHoldMs[i] >= MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS)
            {
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
                shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
            }
        }

        if (pressed)
        {
            /* 按下：累计时长，达长按门限即升级为长按 */
            pressTimeMs[i] += scanPeriodMs;
            if (pressTimeMs[i] >= MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS)
            {
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* 释放：根据持续时长判定短按/释放 */
            if (keyState[i] != MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS &&
                pressTimeMs[i] >= MENU_KEY_SHOCK_PERIOD_MS &&
                pressTimeMs[i] < MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS)
            {
                if (keyState[i] != MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
                {
                    keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS;
                    shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
                }
            }
            else if ((keyState[i] != MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS) &&
                     (keyState[i] != MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS))
            {
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
            }
            pressTimeMs[i] = 0u;
        }
    }
}

menuKeyStateEnum menuKeyGetState(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (k >= MENU_KEY_COUNT) return MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
    return keyState[k];
}

void menuKeyClear(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (k >= MENU_KEY_COUNT) return;
    /* 长按消费后置等释放：防按住期间 scan 立刻再次升级为 LONG_PRESS 重复触发。
     * 短按消费正常清零即可（短按事件本就一次性锁存）。 */
    if (keyState[k] == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS) waitRelease[k] = 1u;
    keyState[k] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
    pressTimeMs[k] = 0u;
    shortHoldMs[k] = 0u;
}

void menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (k >= MENU_KEY_COUNT) return;
    waitRelease[k] = 1u;
    keyState[k] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
    pressTimeMs[k] = 0u;
    shortHoldMs[k] = 0u;
}

#include "menu.h"

/*
 * menuModel.c — 参数模型层：默认值加载、本地视觉热重载、向 cm_7_0 下发飞控参数/指令、
 *   分页菜单页表构建；Flash 布局/迁移/读写由 menuPersistence.c 负责。
 *   不触屏、不读按键；状态机/渲染/按键见 menu.c / menuRender.c / menuInput.c。
 */


/* 下发缓存（非 ISR，本 TU 私有） */
static paramToFlightStruct paramTx;

/* 视觉目标/极性/死区/外推默认值（configVision 宏单一真相源）：
 * menuLoadDefaults 与 menuFlashSave 的 PERSIST-off 占位共用，避免两处逐字段重复。 */
void menuFillVisionTuningDefaults(visionTuningStruct* v)
{
    v->targetCenterX = (float) VISION_TARGET_CENTER_X;
    v->targetCenterY = (float) VISION_TARGET_CENTER_Y;
    v->targetAngleRad = VISION_TARGET_ANGLE_RAD;
    v->errXSign = VISION_ERR_X_SIGN;
    v->errYSign = VISION_ERR_Y_SIGN;
    v->yawErrSign = VISION_YAW_ERR_SIGN;
    v->deadzoneEnterPct = VISION_DEADZONE_ENTER_PCT_DEFAULT;
    v->deadzoneExitPct = VISION_DEADZONE_EXIT_PCT_DEFAULT;
    v->lostFreezeMs = VISION_LOST_FREEZE_MS_DEFAULT;
    v->lostExtrapDiameterPx = VISION_LOST_EXTRAP_DIAMETER_PX_DEFAULT;
}

void menuFillBinaryCcDefaults(void)
{
    detectModeF = (float) VISION_DETECT_MODE_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcLowF = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_LOW_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcHighF = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_HIGH_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcAreaMinF = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_AREA_MIN_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcAreaMaxF = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_AREA_MAX_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcBrightnessMinF = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_BRIGHT_MIN_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcEccMaxF = VISION_BINARYCC_ECC_MAX_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcFillMinF = VISION_BINARYCC_FILL_MIN_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcHuMaxF = VISION_BINARYCC_HU_MAX_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcOrientBrightMinF = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_ORI_BRIGHT_MIN_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcOrientBorderMarginF = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_ORI_BORDER_MARGIN_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcOrientConfidenceMinF = VISION_BINARYCC_ORI_CONF_MIN_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcOrientHoldFramesF = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_ORI_HOLD_FRAMES_DEFAULT;
}


/* ============================================================
 * 默认值加载（视觉从 configVision 宏，飞控从 flightParamsLoadDefaults）
 * ============================================================ */
void menuLoadDefaults(void)
{
    imageOrientationProtectTuningStruct orientDefaults;
    menuFillVisionTuningDefaults(&menuVisionTuning);

    cannyLowF = (float) VISION_CANNY_LOW_DEFAULT;
    cannyHighF = (float) VISION_CANNY_HIGH_DEFAULT;
    exposureF = (float) VISION_EXPOSURE_DEFAULT;
    menuFillBinaryCcDefaults();

    imageGetOrientationProtectDefaults(&orientDefaults);
    orientJumpMaxF = orientDefaults.jumpMax;
    orientRecoverF = orientDefaults.recoverRad;
    orientConfirmFramesF = (float) orientDefaults.confirmFrames;
    /* 轮廓检测默认（image.h 宏） */
    contourSizeMinF = (float) VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MIN_DEFAULT;
    contourSizeMaxF = (float) VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MAX_DEFAULT;
    contourHuLostF = VISION_CONTOUR_HU_LOST_DEFAULT;
    contourBrightnessMaxF = (float) VISION_CONTOUR_BRIGHTNESS_MAX_DEF;

    flightParamsLoadDefaults(&menuFlightWork);
    visionPosErrEnableF = (float) menuFlightWork.visionPosErrEnable;
    systemModeF = (float) menuFlightWork.systemMode;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 本地热重载（视觉/相机参数即时生效）
 * ============================================================ */
void applyVisionLocal(void)
{
    /* Canny 钳位（与原 core1Loop 一致：MIN/MAX/GAP） */
    if (cannyLowF < (float) VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN) cannyLowF = (float) VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
    if (cannyHighF > (float) VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX) cannyHighF = (float) VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX;
    if (cannyLowF + (float) VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP > cannyHighF)
    {
        if (cannyHighF > (float) (VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP))
        {
            cannyLowF = cannyHighF - (float) VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP;
        }
        else
        {
            cannyLowF = (float) VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
            cannyHighF = (float) (VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP);
        }
    }
    imageApplyCannyThresholds((uint16_t) cannyLowF, (uint16_t) cannyHighF);

    detectModeF = (detectModeF >= 0.5f) ? (float) VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY : (float) VISION_DETECT_MODE_BINARYCC;

    binaryCcLowF = clampf(binaryCcLowF, (float) VISION_BINARYCC_THRESHOLD_MIN, (float) VISION_BINARYCC_THRESHOLD_MAX);
    binaryCcHighF = clampf(binaryCcHighF, (float) VISION_BINARYCC_THRESHOLD_MIN, (float) VISION_BINARYCC_THRESHOLD_MAX);
    if (binaryCcLowF > binaryCcHighF) binaryCcLowF = binaryCcHighF;
    binaryCcAreaMinF = clampf(binaryCcAreaMinF, 1.0f, 59999.0f);
    binaryCcAreaMaxF = clampf(binaryCcAreaMaxF, binaryCcAreaMinF + 1.0f, 60000.0f);
    binaryCcBrightnessMinF = clampf(binaryCcBrightnessMinF, 0.0f, 255.0f);
    binaryCcEccMaxF = clampf(binaryCcEccMaxF, 0.0f, 100.0f);
    binaryCcFillMinF = clampf(binaryCcFillMinF, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    binaryCcHuMaxF = clampf(binaryCcHuMaxF, 0.0f, 200.0f);
    binaryCcOrientBrightMinF = clampf(binaryCcOrientBrightMinF, 0.0f, 255.0f);
    binaryCcOrientBorderMarginF = clampf(binaryCcOrientBorderMarginF, 0.0f, 20.0f);
    binaryCcOrientConfidenceMinF = clampf(binaryCcOrientConfidenceMinF, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    binaryCcOrientHoldFramesF = clampf(binaryCcOrientHoldFramesF, 1.0f, 60.0f);
    {
        imageBinaryCcTuningStruct binaryCfg;
        binaryCfg.thresholdLow = (uint8_t) (binaryCcLowF + 0.5f);
        binaryCfg.thresholdHigh = (uint8_t) (binaryCcHighF + 0.5f);
        binaryCfg.areaMin = (uint16_t) binaryCcAreaMinF;
        binaryCfg.areaMax = (uint16_t) binaryCcAreaMaxF;
        binaryCfg.brightnessMin = (uint8_t) (binaryCcBrightnessMinF + 0.5f);
        binaryCfg.eccMax = binaryCcEccMaxF;
        binaryCfg.fillMin = binaryCcFillMinF;
        binaryCfg.huMax = binaryCcHuMaxF;
        binaryCfg.orientationBrightMin = (uint8_t) (binaryCcOrientBrightMinF + 0.5f);
        binaryCfg.orientationBorderMargin = (uint8_t) (binaryCcOrientBorderMarginF + 0.5f);
        binaryCfg.orientationConfidenceMin = binaryCcOrientConfidenceMinF;
        binaryCfg.orientationHoldFrames = (uint8_t) (binaryCcOrientHoldFramesF + 0.5f);
        binaryCfg.referenceCenterX = (uint16_t) clampf(menuVisionTuning.targetCenterX, 0.0f, (float) (MT9V03X_W - 1u));
        binaryCfg.referenceCenterY = (uint16_t) clampf(menuVisionTuning.targetCenterY, 0.0f, (float) (MT9V03X_H - 1u));
        imageApplyBinaryCcTuning(&binaryCfg);
        imageSetDetectMode((uint8_t) detectModeF);
    }

    /* 曝光钳位并下发相机 */
    exposureF = clampf(exposureF, (float) VISION_EXPOSURE_MIN, (float) VISION_EXPOSURE_MAX);
    mt9v03x_set_exposure_time((uint16_t) exposureF);

    /* 极性规整为 ±1 */
    menuVisionTuning.errXSign = (menuVisionTuning.errXSign >= 0.0f) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
    menuVisionTuning.errYSign = (menuVisionTuning.errYSign >= 0.0f) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
    menuVisionTuning.yawErrSign = (menuVisionTuning.yawErrSign >= 0.0f) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
    /* 死区百分比钳位：enter∈[1,100]，exit∈[0,enter-1]，保证大圆>小圆(回差非负) */
    menuVisionTuning.deadzoneEnterPct = clampf(menuVisionTuning.deadzoneEnterPct, 1.0f, 100.0f);
    menuVisionTuning.deadzoneExitPct = clampf(menuVisionTuning.deadzoneExitPct, 0.0f, menuVisionTuning.deadzoneEnterPct - 1.0f);
    menuVisionTuning.lostFreezeMs = clampf(menuVisionTuning.lostFreezeMs, 0.0f, 3000.0f);
    /* 外推圆直径钳位 [2,200]px：下限防退化为点（方向无意义），上限留余量（虚拟靶点可超图像）*/
    menuVisionTuning.lostExtrapDiameterPx = clampf(menuVisionTuning.lostExtrapDiameterPx, 2.0f, 200.0f);
    menuVisionTuning.targetCenterX = clampf(menuVisionTuning.targetCenterX, 0.0f, (float) (MT9V03X_W - 1u));
    menuVisionTuning.targetCenterY = clampf(menuVisionTuning.targetCenterY, 0.0f, (float) (MT9V03X_H - 1u));
    menuVisionTuning.targetAngleRad = wrapToPi(menuVisionTuning.targetAngleRad);

    /* 朝向跳变保护钳位 + 下发（jumpMax∈(0,PI]，recover∈(0,jumpMax)，confirm≥1） */
    orientJumpMaxF = clampf(orientJumpMaxF, 0.05f, PI);
    orientRecoverF = clampf(orientRecoverF, 0.01f, orientJumpMaxF);
    orientConfirmFramesF = clampf(orientConfirmFramesF, 1.0f, 60.0f);
    {
        imageOrientationProtectTuningStruct orientConfig;
        orientConfig.jumpMax = orientJumpMaxF;
        orientConfig.recoverRad = orientRecoverF;
        orientConfig.confirmFrames = (uint8_t) (orientConfirmFramesF + 0.5f);
        imageApplyOrientationProtect(&orientConfig);
    }

    /* 轮廓检测钳位 + 下发（经 image.c 封装，^ Hu 模板保持 image 私有）。
     * 先把 min 钳到 [1,59999]，再把 max 钳到 [min+1,60000]，保证 min<max 且二者
     * 都在 uint16 范围内，杜绝 sizeMin>sizeMax 或转 uint16_t 回绕（极端菜单/flash 值）。 */
    contourSizeMinF = clampf(contourSizeMinF, 1.0f, 59999.0f);
    contourSizeMaxF = clampf(contourSizeMaxF, contourSizeMinF + 1.0f, 60000.0f);
    if (contourHuLostF < 0.0f) contourHuLostF = 0.0f;
    contourBrightnessMaxF = clampf(contourBrightnessMaxF, 0.0f, 255.0f);
    imageApplyContourTuning((uint16_t) contourSizeMinF, (uint16_t) contourSizeMaxF,
        contourHuLostF, (uint8_t) (contourBrightnessMaxF + 0.5f));
}

/* ============================================================
 * 向 cm_7_0 推送飞控参数 / 指令
 * ============================================================ */
void menuPushParams(void)
{
    menuFlightWork.visionPosErrEnable = (visionPosErrEnableF >= 0.5f) ? 1u : 0u;

    /* 空地系统模式：影子 → 工作副本（钳 1..3）。顶层模式只下发给 core1/core2 决定车是否运动
     * 以及车控制源；不改写独立调试开关 VisPosErr。 */
    {
        uint8_t newSystemMode = (uint8_t) clampf(systemModeF, 1.0f, 3.0f);
        menuFlightWork.systemMode = newSystemMode;
    }
    /* 推送前硬校验：修正菜单可能调出的非法值（负增益/上下限反转等），
     * 修正结果回写工作副本，使屏幕显示与实际下发一致 */
    flightParamsSanitize(&menuFlightWork);
    visionPosErrEnableF = (float) menuFlightWork.visionPosErrEnable;
    systemModeF = (float) menuFlightWork.systemMode;

    memcpy(&paramTx.params, &menuFlightWork, sizeof(flightParamsStruct));
    paramTx.paramSeq = seqParam;
    paramTx.cmdLaunchSeq = seqLaunch;
    paramTx.cmdStandbySeq = seqStandby;
    paramTx.cmdClearSeq = seqClear;
    paramTx.cm71BootEpoch = bootEpoch;
    paramTx.cm71ParamReady = 0u; /* 事务token由coreDataTransfer owner填充 */
    paramTx.kvmRouteEpoch = menuKvmRouteEpoch;
    paramTx.kvmEventSeq = remoteKeySeq;
    paramTx.kvmTarget = menuKeyTargetCore;
    paramTx.kvmKeyId = remoteKeyId;
    paramTx.kvmKeyState = remoteKeyState;
    paramTx.kvmFlags = remoteKeyPending ? 1u : 0u;
    coreDataWriteParamToFlight(&paramTx);
}

/* ============================================================
 * 页表构建
 * ============================================================ */
static void addPage(const char* name)
{
    if (menuPageCount >= MENU_MAX_PAGES) return;
    menuPages[menuPageCount].name = name;
    menuPages[menuPageCount].optionCount = 0u;
}
static void addOpt(const char* nm, float* p, float s, float l, uint8_t vision)
{
    menuPageStruct* pg;
    uint8_t i;
    if (menuPageCount >= MENU_MAX_PAGES) return;
    pg = &menuPages[menuPageCount];
    i = pg->optionCount;
    if (i >= MENU_MAX_OPTIONS) return;
    pg->optName[i] = nm;
    pg->opt[i] = p;
    pg->stepS[i] = s;
    pg->stepL[i] = l;
    pg->isVision[i] = vision;
    pg->optionCount = (uint8_t) (i + 1u);
}
static void endPage(void)
{
    if (menuPageCount >= MENU_MAX_PAGES) return;
    menuPageCount++;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 编辑应用：本地视觉即时生效；飞控推 cm_7_0
 * ============================================================ */
void applyAfterEdit(uint8_t isVisionOpt)
{
    if (isVisionOpt)
    {
        applyVisionLocal();
    }
    else
    {
        seqParam++;
        menuPushParams();
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * 保存 / 清空恢复默认
 * ============================================================ */
void menuSaveSettings(void)
{
#if GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
    applyVisionLocal();
    seqParam++;
    menuPushParams();
    menuFlashSave();
#else
    /* 持久化关闭：人工保存键无效（可调参数不落盘）。
     * 标定自动落盘走 menuTick 直接调 menuFlashSave，不经本路径，不受影响。 */
#endif
}

void menuRestoreDefaults(void)
{
    menuLoadDefaults();
#if GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
    imageResetActiveTemplate(); /* 清两套 RAM 标定模板，回退各自出厂默认 */
#endif
    applyVisionLocal();
#if GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
    menuFlashErase();
#endif
    seqParam++;
#if GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
    seqClear++;
#endif
    /* seq 增量须在 menuPushParams 之前——它一次性快照 seqParam/seqClear/seqLaunch 下发 cm_7_0。
     * 持久化关闭时不擦 flash、不清标定模板、不动 seqClear（标定不受开关影响；
     * seqParam 边沿已足以触发 cm_7_0 整块回默认）。 */
    menuPushParams();
}
