/*
 * menuPersistence.c — core0 cm_7_1 菜单参数 Flash 持久化：
 *   blob 布局、CRC 及 load/save/erase。非当前版本统一回退默认值。
 *   公共菜单 API 不变，模型默认值仍由 menuModel.c 提供。
 */

/* ============================================================
 * flash 持久化布局（单页，magic+version+CRC）
 * ============================================================ */
#define MENU_FLASH_PAGE        (0u)
#define MENU_FLASH_MAGIC       (0x4D314B30u) /* "M1K0" core0 cm_7_1 菜单参数 */
#define MENU_FLASH_VERSION     (42u)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t version;
    uint32_t payloadBytes;     /* sizeof(载荷区)，用于一致性校验 */
    visionTuningStruct vision; /* 视觉目标中点/极性 */
    float cannyLow;
    float cannyHigh;
    float exposure;
    float detectMode;
    float binaryLow;
    float binaryHigh;
    float binaryAreaMin;
    float binaryAreaMax;
    float binaryBrightnessMin;
    float binaryEccMax;
    float binaryFillMin;
    float binaryHuMax;
    float binaryOrientBrightMin;
    float binaryOrientBorderMargin;
    float binaryOrientConfidenceMin;
    float binaryOrientHoldFrames;
    /* 朝向跳变保护 + Legacy 轮廓检测调参 */
    float orientJumpMax;
    float orientRecover;
    float orientConfirmFrames;
    float contourSizeMin;
    float contourSizeMax;
    float contourHuLost;
    float contourBrightnessMax;
    uint32_t legacyCalibValid;
    float legacyCalibHu[7];
    float legacyCalibSizeMin;
    float legacyCalibSizeMax;
    uint32_t binaryCalibValid;
    float binaryCalibHu[7];
    float binaryCalibSizeMin;
    float binaryCalibSizeMax;
    flightParamsStruct flight; /* 全量飞控参数 */
    uint32_t crc;              /* CRC32 over [magic..flight] */
} menuFlashBlobStruct;

typedef char menu_flash_blob_size_assert[(sizeof(menuFlashBlobStruct) == 648u) ? 1 : -1];

static uint8_t menuFlashBlobCrcValid(const void* blob, uint32_t blobBytes)
{
    uint32_t storedCrc;
    uint32_t crcLen;
    uint32_t crc;

    if (blobBytes <= sizeof(uint32_t)) return 0u;
    crcLen = blobBytes - (uint32_t) sizeof(uint32_t);
    memcpy(&storedCrc, ((const uint8_t*) blob) + crcLen, sizeof(storedCrc));
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t*) blob, crcLen);
    return (crc == storedCrc) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static uint8_t menuFlashBlobValid(const menuFlashBlobStruct* blob)
{
    if (blob->payloadBytes != (uint32_t) sizeof(menuFlashBlobStruct)) return 0u;

    return menuFlashBlobCrcValid(blob, (uint32_t) sizeof(menuFlashBlobStruct));
}

#if !GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
static void fillBinaryCcBlobDefaults(menuFlashBlobStruct* blob);
#endif

static paramSlotStore g_paramSlots;
static uint32_t g_localTransactionId = 1u;

static uint8_t menuFlashBlobSlotValid(const void *data, uint32_t bytes)
{
    const menuFlashBlobStruct *blob = (const menuFlashBlobStruct *) data;
    return (uint8_t) ((bytes == sizeof(*blob)) &&
        (blob->magic == MENU_FLASH_MAGIC) &&
        (blob->version == MENU_FLASH_VERSION) &&
        (menuFlashBlobValid(blob) != 0u));
}

static uint8_t menuFlashBlobExactValid(const menuFlashBlobStruct *blob)
{
    const uint32_t *words = (const uint32_t *) (const void *) blob;
    flightParamsStruct sanitized;
    uint32_t i;

    if (menuFlashBlobSlotValid(blob, sizeof(*blob)) == 0u) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < (uint32_t) (offsetof(menuFlashBlobStruct, crc) / 4u); i++)
    {
        float value;
        memcpy(&value, &words[i], sizeof(value));
        if (!isfinite(value)) return 0u;
    }
    if ((blob->legacyCalibValid > 1u) || (blob->binaryCalibValid > 1u)) return 0u;
    if ((blob->legacyCalibSizeMin < 0.0f) || (blob->legacyCalibSizeMin > 65535.0f) ||
        (blob->legacyCalibSizeMax < 0.0f) || (blob->legacyCalibSizeMax > 65535.0f) ||
        (blob->binaryCalibSizeMin < 0.0f) || (blob->binaryCalibSizeMin > 65535.0f) ||
        (blob->binaryCalibSizeMax < 0.0f) || (blob->binaryCalibSizeMax > 65535.0f))
        return 0u;
    sanitized = blob->flight;
    flightParamsSanitize(&sanitized);
    return (uint8_t) (memcmp(&sanitized, &blob->flight, sizeof(sanitized)) == 0);
}

static uint32_t nextLocalTransaction(void)
{
    g_localTransactionId++;
    if (g_localTransactionId == 0u) g_localTransactionId = 1u;
    return g_localTransactionId;
}

static void menuFlashBlobBuild(menuFlashBlobStruct *blob)
{
    uint32_t crcLen;

    memset(blob, 0, sizeof(*blob));
    blob->magic = MENU_FLASH_MAGIC;
    blob->version = MENU_FLASH_VERSION;
    blob->payloadBytes = (uint32_t) sizeof(*blob);
#if GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
    flightParamsStruct flight = menuFlightWork;
    flight.visionPosErrEnable = (visionPosErrEnableF >= 0.5f) ? 1u : 0u;
    flight.systemMode = (uint8_t) clampf(systemModeF, 1.0f, 3.0f);
    flightParamsSanitize(&flight);
    blob->vision = menuVisionTuning;
    blob->cannyLow = cannyLowF;
    blob->cannyHigh = cannyHighF;
    blob->exposure = exposureF;
    blob->detectMode = detectModeF;
    blob->binaryLow = binaryCcLowF;
    blob->binaryHigh = binaryCcHighF;
    blob->binaryAreaMin = binaryCcAreaMinF;
    blob->binaryAreaMax = binaryCcAreaMaxF;
    blob->binaryBrightnessMin = binaryCcBrightnessMinF;
    blob->binaryEccMax = binaryCcEccMaxF;
    blob->binaryFillMin = binaryCcFillMinF;
    blob->binaryHuMax = binaryCcHuMaxF;
    blob->binaryOrientBrightMin = binaryCcOrientBrightMinF;
    blob->binaryOrientBorderMargin = binaryCcOrientBorderMarginF;
    blob->binaryOrientConfidenceMin = binaryCcOrientConfidenceMinF;
    blob->binaryOrientHoldFrames = binaryCcOrientHoldFramesF;
    blob->orientJumpMax = orientJumpMaxF;
    blob->orientRecover = orientRecoverF;
    blob->orientConfirmFrames = orientConfirmFramesF;
    blob->contourSizeMin = contourSizeMinF;
    blob->contourSizeMax = contourSizeMaxF;
    blob->contourHuLost = contourHuLostF;
    blob->contourBrightnessMax = contourBrightnessMaxF;
    blob->flight = flight;
#else
    {
        flightParamsStruct defFlight;
        imageOrientationProtectTuningStruct orientDefaults;
        flightParamsLoadDefaults(&defFlight);
        imageGetOrientationProtectDefaults(&orientDefaults);
        menuFillVisionTuningDefaults(&blob->vision);
        blob->cannyLow = (float) VISION_CANNY_LOW_DEFAULT;
        blob->cannyHigh = (float) VISION_CANNY_HIGH_DEFAULT;
        blob->exposure = (float) VISION_EXPOSURE_DEFAULT;
        fillBinaryCcBlobDefaults(blob);
        blob->orientJumpMax = orientDefaults.jumpMax;
        blob->orientRecover = orientDefaults.recoverRad;
        blob->orientConfirmFrames = (float) orientDefaults.confirmFrames;
        blob->contourSizeMin = (float) VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MIN_DEFAULT;
        blob->contourSizeMax = (float) VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MAX_DEFAULT;
        blob->contourHuLost = VISION_CONTOUR_HU_LOST_DEFAULT;
        blob->contourBrightnessMax = (float) VISION_CONTOUR_BRIGHTNESS_MAX_DEF;
        blob->flight = defFlight;
    }
#endif
    {
        uint16_t sizeMin = 0u;
        uint16_t sizeMax = 0u;
        blob->legacyCalibValid = (uint32_t) imageGetActiveTemplateForMode(
            VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY, blob->legacyCalibHu, &sizeMin, &sizeMax);
        blob->legacyCalibSizeMin = (float) sizeMin;
        blob->legacyCalibSizeMax = (float) sizeMax;
        sizeMin = 0u;
        sizeMax = 0u;
        blob->binaryCalibValid = (uint32_t) imageGetActiveTemplateForMode(
            VISION_DETECT_MODE_BINARYCC, blob->binaryCalibHu, &sizeMin, &sizeMax);
        blob->binaryCalibSizeMin = (float) sizeMin;
        blob->binaryCalibSizeMax = (float) sizeMax;
    }
    crcLen = (uint32_t) (sizeof(*blob) - sizeof(uint32_t));
    blob->crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) blob, crcLen);
}

#if !GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
static void fillBinaryCcBlobDefaults(menuFlashBlobStruct* blob)
{
    blob->detectMode = (float) VISION_DETECT_MODE_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryLow = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_LOW_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryHigh = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_HIGH_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryAreaMin = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_AREA_MIN_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryAreaMax = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_AREA_MAX_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryBrightnessMin = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_BRIGHT_MIN_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryEccMax = VISION_BINARYCC_ECC_MAX_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryFillMin = VISION_BINARYCC_FILL_MIN_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryHuMax = VISION_BINARYCC_HU_MAX_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryOrientBrightMin = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_ORI_BRIGHT_MIN_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryOrientBorderMargin = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_ORI_BORDER_MARGIN_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryOrientConfidenceMin = VISION_BINARYCC_ORI_CONF_MIN_DEFAULT;
    blob->binaryOrientHoldFrames = (float) VISION_BINARYCC_ORI_HOLD_FRAMES_DEFAULT;
}
#endif

/* ============================================================
 * flash 持久化（magic+version+CRC，失败回退默认）
 *   FLASH_PAGE_LENGTH = 512 words (2KB)，blob 远小于一页。
 *   blob 经 flash_union_buffer 中转（库要求），按 word 对齐写入。
 * ============================================================ */
static void menuFlashApplyBlob(const menuFlashBlobStruct *blob)
{
#if GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE
    menuVisionTuning = blob->vision;
    cannyLowF = blob->cannyLow;
    cannyHighF = blob->cannyHigh;
    exposureF = blob->exposure;
    detectModeF = blob->detectMode;
    binaryCcLowF = blob->binaryLow;
    binaryCcHighF = blob->binaryHigh;
    binaryCcAreaMinF = blob->binaryAreaMin;
    binaryCcAreaMaxF = blob->binaryAreaMax;
    binaryCcBrightnessMinF = blob->binaryBrightnessMin;
    binaryCcEccMaxF = blob->binaryEccMax;
    binaryCcFillMinF = blob->binaryFillMin;
    binaryCcHuMaxF = blob->binaryHuMax;
    binaryCcOrientBrightMinF = blob->binaryOrientBrightMin;
    binaryCcOrientBorderMarginF = blob->binaryOrientBorderMargin;
    binaryCcOrientConfidenceMinF = blob->binaryOrientConfidenceMin;
    binaryCcOrientHoldFramesF = blob->binaryOrientHoldFrames;
    orientJumpMaxF = blob->orientJumpMax;
    orientRecoverF = blob->orientRecover;
    orientConfirmFramesF = blob->orientConfirmFrames;
    contourSizeMinF = blob->contourSizeMin;
    contourSizeMaxF = blob->contourSizeMax;
    contourHuLostF = blob->contourHuLost;
    contourBrightnessMaxF = blob->contourBrightnessMax;
    menuFlightWork = blob->flight;
#if (FLIGHT_SYSTEM_MODE_FORCE_DEFAULT_ON_BOOT != 0u)
    menuFlightWork.systemMode = FLIGHT_SYSTEM_MODE_DEFAULT;
#endif
    flightParamsSanitize(&menuFlightWork);
    visionPosErrEnableF = (float) menuFlightWork.visionPosErrEnable;
    systemModeF = (float) menuFlightWork.systemMode;
#endif
    if (blob->legacyCalibValid == 1u)
    {
        imageSetActiveTemplateForMode(VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY, blob->legacyCalibHu,
            (uint16_t) blob->legacyCalibSizeMin, (uint16_t) blob->legacyCalibSizeMax);
    }
    if (blob->binaryCalibValid == 1u)
    {
        imageSetActiveTemplateForMode(VISION_DETECT_MODE_BINARYCC, blob->binaryCalibHu,
            (uint16_t) blob->binaryCalibSizeMin, (uint16_t) blob->binaryCalibSizeMax);
    }
}

void menuFlashLoad(void)
{
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    menuFlashBlobStruct defaults;
    uint8_t valid = 0u;

    if (sizeof(menuFlashBlobStruct) > FLASH_PAGE_SIZE) return;
    menuFlashBlobBuild(&defaults);
    if (paramSlotStoreInit(&g_paramSlots, sizeof(menuFlashBlobStruct),
        menuFlashBlobSlotValid, &defaults) != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return;
    valid = (uint8_t) (paramSlotStoreReadRuntime(&g_paramSlots,
        &blob, sizeof(blob)) == PARAM_SLOT_OK);

    if (valid)
    {
        menuFlashApplyBlob(&blob);
        return;
    }

    /* Selector指向的数据损坏时保持调用方已加载的完整源码默认值。 */
}

void menuFlashSave(void)
{
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    menuFlashBlobBuild(&blob);
    (void) paramSlotStoreSaveRuntime(&g_paramSlots, &blob, sizeof(blob));
}

void menuFlashErase(void)
{
    /* menuRestoreDefaults已先恢复RAM默认和清空标定；只覆盖runtime。 */
    menuFlashSave();
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsGetActive(void)
{
    return paramSlotStoreGetActive(&g_paramSlots);
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsHasPending(void)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    paramSlotStatus status = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_paramSlots, &pending);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) ((status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) || (pending.valid != 0u));
}

uint32_t menuParamSlotsGetActiveBlobCrc(void)
{
    paramRuntimeMeta meta;
    return paramSlotStoreGetRuntimeMeta(&g_paramSlots, &meta) == PARAM_SLOT_OK ?
        meta.blobCrc : 0u;
}

uint32_t menuParamCurrentBlobCrc(void)
{
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    menuFlashBlobBuild(&blob);
    return crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &blob, sizeof(blob));
}

uint8_t menuParamRuntimeIsDirty(void)
{
    paramRuntimeMeta meta;
    if (paramSlotStoreGetRuntimeMeta(&g_paramSlots, &meta) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) (menuParamCurrentBlobCrc() != meta.blobCrc);
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsGetMeta(uint8_t slot, menuParamSlotMeta *meta)
{
    paramSlotMeta generic;
    paramSlotStatus status;
    if (meta == NULL) return 0u;
    status = paramSlotStoreGetMeta(&g_paramSlots, slot, &generic);
    memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
    meta->slot = slot;
    if ((status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) && (status != PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY)) return 0u;
    meta->valid = generic.valid;
    meta->active = generic.active;
    meta->bank = generic.bank;
    meta->generation = generic.generation;
    meta->blobCrc = generic.blobCrc;
    meta->transactionId = generic.transactionId;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsRead(uint8_t slot, uint8_t *blob, uint32_t blobBytes)
{
    return (uint8_t) (paramSlotStoreRead(&g_paramSlots, slot, blob, blobBytes) ==
        PARAM_SLOT_OK);
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsSaveCurrent(uint8_t slot)
{
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    menuFlashBlobBuild(&blob);
    return (uint8_t) (paramSlotStoreSave(&g_paramSlots, slot, &blob, sizeof(blob),
        nextLocalTransaction(), 0u) == PARAM_SLOT_OK);
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsActivate(uint8_t slot)
{
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    if (paramSlotStoreRead(&g_paramSlots, slot, &blob, sizeof(blob)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return 0u;
    if (paramSlotStoreSetActive(&g_paramSlots, slot) != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
    menuFlashApplyBlob(&blob);
    applyVisionLocal();
    seqParam++;
    menuPushParams();
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsActivatePrepared(uint8_t slot, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    if (paramSlotStoreRead(&g_paramSlots, slot, &blob, sizeof(blob)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return 0u;
    if (paramSlotStoreActivatePrepared(&g_paramSlots, slot, transactionId) !=
        PARAM_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
    menuFlashApplyBlob(&blob);
    applyVisionLocal();
    seqParam++;
    menuPushParams();
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsActivatePending(uint8_t slot)
{
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    if (paramSlotStoreRead(&g_paramSlots, slot, &blob, sizeof(blob)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return 0u;
    if (paramSlotStoreSetActivePending(&g_paramSlots, slot) != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
    menuFlashApplyBlob(&blob);
    applyVisionLocal();
    seqParam++;
    menuPushParams();
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsAbortPendingActivation(void)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    menuFlashBlobStruct rollback;
    paramSlotStatus status = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_paramSlots, &pending);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY) return 1u;
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK || (pending.valid == 0u) ||
        (pending.activationOnly == 0u)) return 0u;
    if (pending.active != 0u)
    {
        if (paramSlotStoreReadRuntime(&g_paramSlots, &rollback,
            sizeof(rollback)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
        menuFlashApplyBlob(&rollback);
        applyVisionLocal();
        seqParam++;
        menuPushParams();
    }
    if (paramSlotStoreAbortPendingActivation(&g_paramSlots) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsFinishPendingActivation(void)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    paramSlotStatus status = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_paramSlots, &pending);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY) return 1u;
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK || (pending.valid == 0u) ||
        (pending.active == 0u) ||
        (pending.activationOnly == 0u) ||
        (paramSlotStoreReadPreparedRuntime(&g_paramSlots, UINT32_MAX,
            &blob, sizeof(blob)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)) return 0u;
    menuFlashApplyBlob(&blob);
    applyVisionLocal();
    seqParam++;
    menuPushParams();
    if (paramSlotStoreFinishPendingActivation(&g_paramSlots) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsAbort(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    paramSlotStatus pendingStatus = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_paramSlots,
        &pending);
    menuFlashBlobStruct rollback;
    uint8_t runtimePending;

    if ((pendingStatus != PARAM_SLOT_OK) &&
        (pendingStatus != PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY)) return 0u;
    if ((pendingStatus == PARAM_SLOT_OK) && (pending.valid != 0u) &&
        (pending.active != 0u) &&
        ((pending.activationOnly != 0u) ||
         (pending.transactionId != transactionId))) return 0u;
    runtimePending = (uint8_t) ((pendingStatus == PARAM_SLOT_OK) &&
        (pending.valid != 0u) && (pending.active != 0u) &&
        (pending.activationOnly == 0u) &&
        (pending.transactionId == transactionId));
    if (runtimePending != 0u)
    {
        if (paramSlotStoreReadRuntime(&g_paramSlots, &rollback,
            sizeof(rollback)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
        menuFlashApplyBlob(&rollback);
        applyVisionLocal();
        seqParam++;
        menuPushParams();
    }
    if (paramSlotStoreAbort(&g_paramSlots, transactionId) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsFinish(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    paramSlotStatus pendingStatus = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_paramSlots,
        &pending);
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    uint8_t runtimePending;

    if ((pendingStatus != PARAM_SLOT_OK) &&
        (pendingStatus != PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY)) return 0u;
    runtimePending = (uint8_t) ((pendingStatus == PARAM_SLOT_OK) &&
        (pending.valid != 0u) && (pending.active != 0u));
    if (runtimePending != 0u)
    {
        if (paramSlotStoreReadPreparedRuntime(&g_paramSlots, transactionId,
            &blob, sizeof(blob)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
        menuFlashApplyBlob(&blob);
        applyVisionLocal();
        seqParam++;
        menuPushParams();
    }
    if (paramSlotStoreFinish(&g_paramSlots, transactionId) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuParamSlotsInspect(uint8_t slot, menuParamLibraryMeta *meta)
{
    paramSlotMeta raw;
    menuFlashBlobStruct blob;
    paramSlotStatus status;
    if (meta == NULL) return 0u;
    memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
    status = paramSlotStoreGetMeta(&g_paramSlots, slot, &raw);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY)
    {
        meta->state = MENU_PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
    meta->bank = raw.bank;
    meta->generation = raw.generation;
    meta->blobCrc = raw.blobCrc;
    meta->transactionId = raw.transactionId;
    status = paramSlotStoreRead(&g_paramSlots, slot, &blob, sizeof(blob));
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) meta->state = MENU_PARAM_SLOT_VALID;
    else if ((status == PARAM_SLOT_INVALID) ||
        (status == PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED))
        meta->state = MENU_PARAM_SLOT_INVALID;
    else return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

/*
 * menuRender.c — IPS114 8×16 渲染（绘制原语 + 各状态渲染），仅消费共享状态不修改。
 *   布局原则（消除闪烁/伪影）：任何分隔线都落在文字/图像的空白间隙，
 *   绝不与字模或图像矩形像素重叠。8×16 字体行高固定 16px。
 */

/* 相机图像坐标 → 发车页相机显示区坐标（显示区 116×72，左上偏移 (2,2)）。
 * 目标中点 / 轮廓质心叠加共用，消除重复魔数。 */
#define HOME_CAM_X (2u)
#define HOME_CAM_Y (17u)
#define HOME_CAM_W (130u)
#define HOME_CAM_H (67u)
#define HOME_VLINE_X (133u)
#define HOME_STATUS_X (135u)
#define HOME_SLOT_COUNT (13u)
#define HOME_SLOT_CHARS (39u)

static char homeSlotCache[HOME_SLOT_COUNT][HOME_SLOT_CHARS + 1u];
static uint8_t homeSlotValid[HOME_SLOT_COUNT];
static uint16_t homeSlotColor[HOME_SLOT_COUNT];
static uint16_t homeSlotBackground[HOME_SLOT_COUNT];
static uint16_t homeTitleColor = 0xFFFFu;
static uint16_t menuSolidFillBuffer[MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS];

static void fillSolidRect(uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t w, uint16_t h,
    uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t rowsPerTransfer;
    uint16_t rows;
    uint16_t i;

    if ((w == 0u) || (h == 0u) || (x >= LCD_W) || (y >= LCD_H)) return;
    if ((uint32_t) x + w > LCD_W) w = (uint16_t) (LCD_W - x);
    if ((uint32_t) y + h > LCD_H) h = (uint16_t) (LCD_H - y);
    if (w > MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS) return;
    rowsPerTransfer = (uint16_t) (MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS / w);
    for (i = 0u; i < MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS; i++) menuSolidFillBuffer[i] = color;
    while (h > 0u)
    {
        rows = (h < rowsPerTransfer) ? h : rowsPerTransfer;
        ips114_show_rgb565_image(x, y, menuSolidFillBuffer,
            w, rows, w, rows, 0u);
        y = (uint16_t) (y + rows);
        h = (uint16_t) (h - rows);
    }
}

static void drawHomeSlot(uint8_t slot, uint16_t x, uint16_t y,
    uint8_t width, uint16_t color, uint16_t background, const char *format, ...)
{
    char line[HOME_SLOT_CHARS + 1u];
    char formatted[48];
    size_t length;
    va_list args;
    if ((slot >= HOME_SLOT_COUNT) || (width > HOME_SLOT_CHARS)) return;
    va_start(args, format);
    (void) vsnprintf(formatted, sizeof(formatted), format, args);
    va_end(args);
    memset(line, 0, sizeof(line));
    memset(line, ' ', width);
    line[width] = '\0';
    length = strlen(formatted);
    if (length > width) length = width;
    memcpy(line, formatted, length);
    if ((homeSlotValid[slot] != 0u) &&
        (homeSlotColor[slot] == color) &&
        (homeSlotBackground[slot] == background) &&
        (memcmp(homeSlotCache[slot], line, sizeof(line)) == 0)) return;
    memcpy(homeSlotCache[slot], line, sizeof(line));
    homeSlotValid[slot] = 1u;
    homeSlotColor[slot] = color;
    homeSlotBackground[slot] = background;
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(color, background);
    ips114_show_string(x, y, line);
}

static inline uint16_t imgToDispX(uint32_t imgX)
{
    return (uint16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + imgX * HOME_CAM_W / (uint32_t) MT9V03X_W);
}
static inline uint16_t imgToDispY(uint32_t imgY)
{
    return (uint16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + imgY * HOME_CAM_H / (uint32_t) MT9V03X_H);
}

static void drawHomeBinaryCcEdgeFrame(void)
{
    uint32_t m;
    uint16_t x0;
    uint16_t y0;
    uint16_t x1;
    uint16_t y1;

    if (imageGetDetectMode() != VISION_DETECT_MODE_BINARYCC) return;

    m = (uint32_t) (binaryCcOrientBorderMarginF + 0.5f);
    if (m == 0u) return;
    if (m >= (uint32_t) (MT9V03X_W / 2u) || m >= (uint32_t) (MT9V03X_H / 2u)) return;

    x0 = imgToDispX(m);
    y0 = imgToDispY(m);
    x1 = imgToDispX((uint32_t) (MT9V03X_W - 1u) - m);
    y1 = imgToDispY((uint32_t) (MT9V03X_H - 1u) - m);

    if (x0 < HOME_CAM_X) x0 = HOME_CAM_X;
    if (y0 < HOME_CAM_Y) y0 = HOME_CAM_Y;
    if (x1 > HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u) x1 = HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u;
    if (y1 > HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u) y1 = HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u;
    if (x0 >= x1 || y0 >= y1) return;

    ips114_draw_line(x0, y0, x1, y0, RGB565_RED);
    ips114_draw_line(x0, y1, x1, y1, RGB565_RED);
    ips114_draw_line(x0, y0, x0, y1, RGB565_RED);
    ips114_draw_line(x1, y0, x1, y1, RGB565_RED);
}

static uint16_t menuOwnerColor(void)
{
    uint8_t owner = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    if ((flightSnapshotAvailable != 0u) &&
        (flightRx.cm70Ready == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
        (flightRx.core1LinkUp != 0u) &&
        (kvmRx.magic == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
        (kvmRx.routeSession == bootEpoch) &&
        (kvmRx.routeEpoch == menuKvmRouteEpoch) &&
        (kvmRx.target == menuKeyTargetCore) &&
        ((kvmRx.flags & (UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ROUTE_ACCEPTED | UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_LEASE_VALID)) ==
         (UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ROUTE_ACCEPTED | UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_LEASE_VALID)))
    {
        owner = kvmRx.activeTarget;
    }
    if (owner == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE) return RGB565_YELLOW;
    return (owner == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED;
}

}

/* 中点(Bresenham)画圆，逐点钳在发车页相机显示区 [x0,x1]×[y0,y1] 内。
 * 仅用于发车页死区圆标注；SDK 无 ips114_draw_circle，用 8 对称 draw_point 实现。 */
static void drawCircleClamped(int16_t cx, int16_t cy, int16_t r, uint16_t color,
    int16_t x0, int16_t y0, int16_t x1, int16_t y1)
{
    int16_t x = r;
    int16_t y = 0;
    int16_t err = 1 - r;
    if (r <= 0) return;

    while (x >= y)
    {
        int16_t px[8];
        int16_t py[8];
        uint8_t i;
        px[0] = cx + x; py[0] = cy + y;
        px[1] = cx + y; py[1] = cy + x;
        px[2] = cx - y; py[2] = cy + x;
        px[3] = cx - x; py[3] = cy + y;
        px[4] = cx - x; py[4] = cy - y;
        px[5] = cx - y; py[5] = cy - x;
        px[6] = cx + y; py[6] = cy - x;
        px[7] = cx + x; py[7] = cy - y;
        for (i = 0u; i < 8u; i++)
        {
            if (px[i] >= x0 && px[i] <= x1 && py[i] >= y0 && py[i] <= y1)
            {
                ips114_draw_point((uint16_t) px[i], (uint16_t) py[i], color);
            }
        }
        y++;
        if (err < 0)
        {
            err += 2 * y + 1;
        }
        else
        {
            x--;
            err += 2 * (y - x) + 1;
        }
    }
}

/* 反相标题条：标准页用黑字绿底，等待/报警等特殊页可传入异色背景。 */
static void drawTitleBar(const char* title, uint16_t fg, uint16_t bg)
{
    char bounded[40];
    size_t len = strlen(title);
    uint16_t x;

    if (len > 39u) len = 39u;
    memcpy(bounded, title, len);
    bounded[len] = '\0';
    x = (uint16_t) ((LCD_W - (uint16_t) (len * 6u)) / 2u);
    if (x < 2u) x = 2u;
    fillSolidRect(1u, 1u, (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), 15u, bg);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(fg, bg);
    ips114_show_string(x, 4u, bounded);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
}

static void fillRect(uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t w, uint16_t h, uint16_t color)

    fillSolidRect(x, y, w, h, color);
}

/* 列表右侧滚动滑块：轨道贴右内框，滑块高/位按 visible/total 比例。
 *   仅在 total>visible 时绘制。轨道 x 区间 [SCROLLBAR_X, LCD_W-2]，
 *   y 区间 [trackTop, trackBot]，与文字列不重叠（文字止于数值列）。 */
static void drawScrollbar(uint8_t total, uint8_t top)
{
    uint16_t trackTop = ROW_Y(1);
    uint16_t trackBot = (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 2u);
    uint16_t trackH;
    uint16_t thumbH;
    uint16_t thumbY;

    if (total <= VISIBLE_ROWS) return;
    trackH = (uint16_t) (trackBot - trackTop);

    /* 自清槽：先清整个槽区(轨道 + 旧滑块) → 消滚动时旧滑块横线残留。不触右外框(x=LCD_W-1)。 */
    for (uint16_t cy = trackTop; cy < trackBot; cy++)
    {
        ips114_draw_line(SCROLLBAR_X, cy, (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), cy, RGB565_BLACK);
    }

    /* 轨道竖线（左右两条勾勒细槽） */
    ips114_draw_line(SCROLLBAR_X, trackTop, SCROLLBAR_X, trackBot, RGB565_GREEN);
    ips114_draw_line((uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), trackTop, (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), trackBot, RGB565_GREEN);

    /* 滑块高度 = 轨道 × visible/total，位置 = 轨道 × top/total */
    thumbH = (uint16_t) ((uint32_t) trackH * VISIBLE_ROWS / total);
    if (thumbH < 6u) thumbH = 6u;
    thumbY = (uint16_t) (trackTop + (uint32_t) (trackH - thumbH) * top / (uint16_t) (total - VISIBLE_ROWS));

    /* 实心滑块：逐行横线填充槽内（x 留 1px 内缩，避免压槽壁） */
    for (uint16_t yy = thumbY; yy < thumbY + thumbH && yy < trackBot; yy++)
    {
        ips114_draw_line((uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X + 1u), yy, (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 3u), yy, RGB565_GREEN);
    }
}

static uint8_t homeFooterDirty = 1u;
static uint8_t homeLastKeyTarget = 0xFFu;

static void drawHomeFooter(void)
{
    uint8_t c1up = (flightRx.cm70Ready == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) ? flightRx.core1LinkUp : 0u;
    uint8_t c2up = (uint8_t) ((c1up != 0u) && (flightRx.core2LinkLost == 0u));

    uint8_t target = menuKeyTargetCore;
    const char *targetText = (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ? "C0" :
        ((target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) ? "C1" :
         ((target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ? "C3" : "C4"));
    const char *ownerText = (kvmRx.activeTarget == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ? "C0" :
        ((kvmRx.activeTarget == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) ? "C1" :
         ((kvmRx.activeTarget == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ? "C3" :
          ((kvmRx.activeTarget == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) ? "C4" : "NONE")));
    uint8_t statusChanged = (uint8_t) (homeFooterDirty
        || homeLastKeyTarget != target || homeLastC1Up != c1up || homeLastC2Up != c2up
        || homeLastVisionUp != visionUp || homeLastInputOwner != kvmRx.activeTarget);

    if (statusChanged)
    {
        drawHomeSlot(11u, 2u, 106u, 39u, menuOwnerColor(), RGB565_BLACK,
            "KEY:%s>%s C1:%s C2:%s VIS:%s", targetText, ownerText,
            c1up ? "OK" : "LOST", c2up ? "OK" : "LOST",
            visionUp ? "OK" : "LOST");

        homeFooterDirty = 0u;
        homeLastKeyTarget = target;
        homeLastC1Up = c1up;
        homeLastC2Up = c2up;
        homeLastVisionUp = visionUp;
        homeLastInputOwner = kvmRx.activeTarget;
    }

    {
        const char *phase = (flightRx.systemPhase == 2u) ? "LINK WAIT" :
            ((flightRx.systemPhase == 4u) ? "REJOIN" :
             ((flightRx.systemPhase == 5u) ? "STANDALONE" : "HOME"));
        const char *reason = (flightRx.primaryReason == 1u) ? "C1 LINK" :
            ((flightRx.primaryReason == 2u) ? "C2 LINK" :
             ((flightRx.primaryReason == 3u) ? "VISION" :
              ((flightRx.primaryReason == 4u) ? "C2 ATT" : "READY")));
        uint16_t color = (flightRx.primaryReason == 0u) ? RGB565_GRAY : RGB565_YELLOW;
        drawHomeSlot(12u, 2u, 121u, 39u, color, RGB565_BLACK,
            "%s  %s", phase, reason);
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * 渲染：ToF 上电复位与初始化重试。
 * ============================================================ */
void renderTofInit(void)
{
    ips114_clear();
    menuRenderResetListSnapshot();
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    drawTitleBar("TOF INIT", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_YELLOW);
    ips114_show_string(COL_X(8), ROW_Y(4), "Please wait...");
    drawFrameBorder();
}

/* ============================================================
 * 渲染：ESC arming 进度条（开机阻塞期间，cm_7_0 回报 0xFE+progress）
 *   居中标题 + 中部进度条 + 百分比。整屏布局，无图像。
 * ============================================================ */
void renderArming(uint8_t progress)
{
    /* 进度条几何：居中，宽 200，高 20 */
    const uint16_t barX = 20u;
    const uint16_t barY = 60u;
    const uint16_t barW = 200u;
    const uint16_t barH = 20u;
    uint16_t fillW = (uint16_t) ((uint32_t) (barW - 2u) * progress / 100u);

    /* 静态元素（标题/分隔线/提示/外框/边框）仅首帧绘制一次：armBarLast==0xFF 表示尚未画过。
     * 进度变化时只刷填充条与百分比，避免每帧重画标题导致闪烁。 */
    if (armBarLast == 0xFFu)
    {
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        drawTitleBar("ESC ARMING", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_YELLOW);
        ips114_show_string(COL_X(8), ROW_Y(2), "Please wait...");
        ips114_draw_line(barX, barY, (uint16_t) (barX + barW), barY, RGB565_GREEN);
        ips114_draw_line(barX, (uint16_t) (barY + barH), (uint16_t) (barX + barW), (uint16_t) (barY + barH), RGB565_GREEN);
        ips114_draw_line(barX, barY, barX, (uint16_t) (barY + barH), RGB565_GREEN);
        ips114_draw_line((uint16_t) (barX + barW), barY, (uint16_t) (barX + barW), (uint16_t) (barY + barH), RGB565_GREEN);
        ips114_show_string(COL_X(16), ROW_Y(6), "%");
        drawFrameBorder();
    }

    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);

    /* 填充（逐行横线，框内 barX+1..barX+barW-1） */
    for (uint16_t yy = (uint16_t) (barY + 2u); yy < (uint16_t) (barY + barH - 1u); yy++)
    {
        ips114_draw_line((uint16_t) (barX + 1u), yy, (uint16_t) (barX + 1u + fillW), yy, RGB565_GREEN);
    }

    /* 百分比（条下方居中，3 位定宽覆盖旧值） */
    ips114_show_int(COL_X(13), ROW_Y(6), (int32_t) progress, 3u);
}

/* ============================================================
 * 渲染：发车页（左灰度图 + 右数据 + 底部状态/按键）
 *   布局（240×135，无坐标重叠）：
 *     左图   x2..117  y2..73     (116×72)
 *     竖分隔 x120     y1..76
 *     右数据 x124..   y2,17,32,47,62(5 行：Tof/Vld/姿态P R/Y/速度V)
 *     横分隔 y78      x1..238
 *     底部   y80(状态) y96(键提示1) y112(键提示2)
 * ============================================================ */
void renderHome(void)
{
    imageObservationSnapshotStruct observation;
    imageFrameViewStruct originalView;
    const char *flightState;
    uint16_t titleColor;
    imageGetObservationSnapshot(&observation);

    switch (flightRx.safetyState)
    {
        case FC_STATE_DISARM: flightState = "DISARM"; break;
        case FC_STATE_FLYING: flightState = "FLYING"; break;
        case FC_STATE_PROTECT: flightState = "PROTECT"; break;
        case FC_STATE_IMUFAIL: flightState = "IMUFAIL"; break;
        case FC_STATE_ARMING: flightState = "ARMING"; break;
        default: flightState = "WAIT"; break;
    }
    titleColor = ((flightSnapshotAvailable != 0u) &&
        ((flightRx.safetyState == FC_STATE_PROTECT) ||
        (flightRx.safetyState == FC_STATE_IMUFAIL))) ? RGB565_RED :
        ((flightSnapshotAvailable == 0u) ||
         (flightRx.cm70Ready != CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) ||
         (flightRx.safetyState == FC_STATE_ARMING) ||
         (flightRx.systemPhase != CORE_UX_PHASE_HOME) ||
         (flightRx.core1LinkUp == 0u)) ? RGB565_YELLOW : RGB565_GREEN;
    if (homeTitleColor != titleColor)
    {
        drawTitleBar("CORE0 FLIGHT", RGB565_BLACK, titleColor);
        homeTitleColor = titleColor;
    }

    /* 左侧灰度图（内缩进框，避免与外框/竖分隔重叠；判空防相机未就绪/图像指针异常崩溃，仿 core1） */
    {
        const uint8_t* pixels = imageGetFrameView(IMAGE_FRAME_ORIGINAL, &originalView) ?
            originalView.pixels : 0;
        if (pixels != 0)
        {
            ips114_show_gray_image(HOME_CAM_X, HOME_CAM_Y, pixels,
                originalView.width, originalView.height, HOME_CAM_W, HOME_CAM_H, 0u);
        }
    }

    /* BinaryCC 朝向边缘门安全框：红框外侧区域不再采信新朝向，仅保持/失效旧朝向。 */
    drawHomeBinaryCcEdgeFrame();

    /* 叠加目标参考：目标中点青色十字 + 目标角度黄色短线。 */
    {
        uint16_t tx = imgToDispX((uint32_t) menuVisionTuning.targetCenterX);
        uint16_t ty = imgToDispY((uint32_t) menuVisionTuning.targetCenterY);
        if (tx < HOME_CAM_X) tx = HOME_CAM_X;
        else if (tx > HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u) tx = HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u;
        if (ty < HOME_CAM_Y) ty = HOME_CAM_Y;
        else if (ty > HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u) ty = HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u;

        {
            uint16_t x0 = (tx > HOME_CAM_X + 3u) ? (uint16_t) (tx - 3u) : HOME_CAM_X;
            uint16_t x1 = (tx + 3u < HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W) ?
                (uint16_t) (tx + 3u) : (uint16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u);
            uint16_t y0 = (ty > HOME_CAM_Y + 3u) ? (uint16_t) (ty - 3u) : HOME_CAM_Y;
            uint16_t y1 = (ty + 3u < HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H) ?
                (uint16_t) (ty + 3u) : (uint16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
            ips114_draw_line(x0, ty, x1, ty, RGB565_CYAN);
            ips114_draw_line(tx, y0, tx, y1, RGB565_CYAN);
        }

        /* 施密特死区双圆标注（圆心=目标中点）：大圆黄(进入阈值)、小圆品红(退出阈值)。
         * 半径按显示高 72 缩放(死区基准=图像高 H)：r_disp = 0.5×pct/100×72 = pct×0.36。 */
        {
            int16_t enterR = (int16_t) (menuVisionTuning.deadzoneEnterPct *
                (0.5f * (float) HOME_CAM_H / 100.0f) + 0.5f);
            int16_t exitR = (int16_t) (menuVisionTuning.deadzoneExitPct *
                (0.5f * (float) HOME_CAM_H / 100.0f) + 0.5f);
            drawCircleClamped((int16_t) tx, (int16_t) ty, enterR, RGB565_YELLOW,
                HOME_CAM_X, HOME_CAM_Y, HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u,
                HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
            drawCircleClamped((int16_t) tx, (int16_t) ty, exitR, RGB565_MAGENTA,
                HOME_CAM_X, HOME_CAM_Y, HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u,
                HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
        }

        {
            float ox = cosf(menuVisionTuning.targetAngleRad);
            float oy = sinf(menuVisionTuning.targetAngleRad);
            int16_t ex = (int16_t) ((float) tx + ox * 12.0f);
            int16_t ey = (int16_t) ((float) ty + oy * 12.0f);
            if (ex < (int16_t) HOME_CAM_X) ex = (int16_t) HOME_CAM_X;
            else if (ex > (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u)) ex =
                (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u);
            if (ey < (int16_t) HOME_CAM_Y) ey = (int16_t) HOME_CAM_Y;
            else if (ey > (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u)) ey =
                (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
            ips114_draw_line(tx, ty, (uint16_t) ex, (uint16_t) ey, RGB565_YELLOW);
        }
    }

    /* 叠加识别结果：^ 质心十字 + 朝向短线（图像坐标→显示坐标缩放，红色突出于灰度图）。
     * 显示区 (2,2)..(117,73)，116×72；相机 MT9V03X_W×H。 */
    if (observation.contourCount > 0u && !observation.targetLost)
    {
        uint16_t cxImg = observation.selectedCenterX;
        uint16_t cyImg = observation.selectedCenterY;
        uint16_t sx = imgToDispX(cxImg);
        uint16_t sy = imgToDispY(cyImg);
        if (sx < HOME_CAM_X) sx = HOME_CAM_X;
        else if (sx > HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u) sx = HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u;
        if (sy < HOME_CAM_Y) sy = HOME_CAM_Y;
        else if (sy > HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u) sy = HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u;

        /* 质心十字（±4px，钳在显示区内） */
        {
            uint16_t x0 = (sx > HOME_CAM_X + 4u) ? (uint16_t) (sx - 4u) : HOME_CAM_X;
            uint16_t x1 = (sx + 4u < HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W) ?
                (uint16_t) (sx + 4u) : (uint16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u);
            uint16_t y0 = (sy > HOME_CAM_Y + 4u) ? (uint16_t) (sy - 4u) : HOME_CAM_Y;
            uint16_t y1 = (sy + 4u < HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H) ?
                (uint16_t) (sy + 4u) : (uint16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
            ips114_draw_line(x0, sy, x1, sy, RGB565_RED);
            ips114_draw_line(sx, y0, sx, y1, RGB565_RED);
        }

        /* 朝向短线：从质心沿 orientation 方向延伸 ~14px（屏幕 y 向下，取 +sin） */
        {
            float ox = cosf(observation.orientation);
            float oy = sinf(observation.orientation);
            int16_t ex = (int16_t) ((float) sx + ox * 14.0f);
            int16_t ey = (int16_t) ((float) sy + oy * 14.0f);
            if (ex < (int16_t) HOME_CAM_X) ex = (int16_t) HOME_CAM_X;
            else if (ex > (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u)) ex =
                (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u);
            if (ey < (int16_t) HOME_CAM_Y) ey = (int16_t) HOME_CAM_Y;
            else if (ey > (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u)) ey =
                (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
            ips114_draw_line(sx, sy, (uint16_t) ex, (uint16_t) ey,
                observation.orientBaselineValid ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_GRAY);
        }
    }

    drawHomeSlot(0u, HOME_STATUS_X, 18u, 17u,
        flightRx.tofHealthy ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK,
        "ALT:%ldmm %s", (long) flightRx.altMm,
        flightRx.tofHealthy ? "OK" : "BAD");
    drawHomeSlot(1u, HOME_STATUS_X, 26u, 17u, RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK,
        "P:%ld R:%ld", (long) toDeg(flightRx.pitch), (long) toDeg(flightRx.roll));
    drawHomeSlot(2u, HOME_STATUS_X, 34u, 17u, RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK,
        "Y:%ld", (long) toDeg(flightRx.yaw));
    drawHomeSlot(3u, HOME_STATUS_X, 42u, 17u,
        flightRx.velValid ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK,
        flightRx.velValid ? "VX:%+.1f VY:%+.1f" : "VX:-- VY:--",
        (double) flightRx.velX, (double) flightRx.velY);
    drawHomeSlot(4u, HOME_STATUS_X, 50u, 17u,
        observation.valid ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK,
        "VISION:%s", observation.valid ? "TARGET" : "LOST");
    drawHomeSlot(5u, HOME_STATUS_X, 58u, 17u, RGB565_CYAN, RGB565_BLACK,
        "SYS:%u", menuFlightWork.systemMode);
    drawHomeSlot(6u, HOME_STATUS_X, 66u, 17u,
        (flightRx.safetyState == FC_STATE_PROTECT || flightRx.safetyState == FC_STATE_IMUFAIL) ?
            RGB565_RED : RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK, "FC:%s T:%u", flightState,
        (unsigned int) flightRx.baseThr);
    drawHomeSlot(7u, HOME_STATUS_X, 74u, 17u,
        (flightRx.tofHealthy && flightRx.core1LinkUp) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED,
        RGB565_BLACK, "GATE:%s",
        (flightRx.tofHealthy && flightRx.core1LinkUp) ? "READY" : "BLOCK");
    drawHomeSlot(8u, HOME_STATUS_X, 82u, 17u,
        flightRx.core1LinkUp ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK,
        "C1:%s C2:%s", flightRx.core1LinkUp ? "OK" : "LOST",
        (!flightRx.core2LinkLost && flightRx.core1LinkUp) ? "OK" : "LOST");
    drawHomeSlot(9u, HOME_STATUS_X, 90u, 17u,
        flightRx.requiredVisionFault ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_GREEN,
        RGB565_BLACK, "VIS:%s",
        flightRx.requiredVisionFault ? "FAULT" : "OK");
    /* 底部两行做局部刷新：第二行固定指南只在清屏后重画，避免 100ms 空刷闪烁。 */
    drawHomeFooter();

    /* 外框与发车页内部分隔线颜色按操控权:
     * 本地操控=绿，转发给远端目标时为红。 */
    {
        uint16_t bc = menuOwnerColor();
        ips114_draw_line(0, 0, LCD_W - 1u, 0, bc);
        ips114_draw_line(0, LCD_H - 1u, LCD_W - 1u, LCD_H - 1u, bc);
        ips114_draw_line(0, 0, 0, LCD_H - 1u, bc);
        ips114_draw_line(LCD_W - 1u, 0, LCD_W - 1u, LCD_H - 1u, bc);
        ips114_draw_line(HOME_VLINE_X, 17u, HOME_VLINE_X, 103u, bc);
        ips114_draw_line(1u, 104u, LCD_W - 2u, 104u, RGB565_GRAY);
        ips114_draw_line(1u, 119u, LCD_W - 2u, 119u, RGB565_GRAY);
    }
}

static const char* faultReasonText(uint8_t reason)
{
    if ((reason & CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_FLAG) != 0u)
    {
        switch (CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_CLASS(reason))
        {
            case 1u: return "VISION CAMERA";
            case 2u: return "VISION LINK";
            case 3u: return "VISION BRIDGE";
            case 4u: return "VISION PROTO";
            case 5u: return "VISION CONFIG";
            case 6u: return "VISION CALIB";
            case 7u: return "VISION POSE";
            default: return "VISION UNKNOWN";
        }
    }
    switch (reason)
    {
        case CORE0_FAULT_REASON_PROTECT_ATTITUDE: return "PROTECT ATT";
        case CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_C1_LINK: return "LAND C1 LINK";
        case CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_C2_LINK: return "LAND C2 LINK";
        case CORE0_FAULT_REASON_REQUIRED_VISION: return "LAND VISION";
        case CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_LORA_MODE3: return "LAND LORA M3";
        case CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_LORA_MODE2: return "LAND LORA M2";
        case CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_TOF_FAILSAFE: return "LAND TOF";
        case CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_C2_ATTITUDE: return "LAND C2 ATT";
        default: return "UNKNOWN";
    }
}

static const char* faultSourceText(uint8_t reason)
{
    if ((reason & CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_FLAG) == 0u) return "";
    switch (CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_SOURCE(reason))
    {
        case 1u: return "SRC:CORE0";
        case 2u: return "SRC:CORE1";
        case 3u: return "SRC:CORE3";
        case 4u: return "SRC:CORE4";
        default: return "SRC:?";
    }
}

static const char* safetyStateText(uint8_t state)
{
    switch (state)
    {
        case FC_STATE_DISARM: return "DISARM";
        case FC_STATE_FLYING: return "FLYING";
        case FC_STATE_PROTECT: return "PROTECT";
        case FC_STATE_IMUFAIL: return "IMUFAIL";
        case FC_STATE_ARMING: return "ARMING";
        default: return "WAIT";
    }
}

void renderFaultReasonPage(uint8_t reason, uint8_t state,
    uint8_t fullRedraw, uint8_t reasonChanged, uint8_t stateChanged)
{
    uint16_t titleColor = (reason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_PROTECT_ATTITUDE) ?
        RGB565_RED : RGB565_YELLOW;

    if (fullRedraw != 0u)
    {
        drawTitleBar("CORE0 FAULT", RGB565_BLACK, titleColor);
        fillRect(1u, 16u, (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u),
            (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 17u), RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(12u, 32u, "FAULT LATCHED");
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(12u, 56u, "RSN:");
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_CYAN, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(12u, 80u, "STATE:");
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(12u, 112u, "K5 ACK -> HOME");
        ips114_draw_line(0u, 0u, LCD_W - 1u, 0u, titleColor);
        ips114_draw_line(0u, LCD_H - 1u, LCD_W - 1u,
            LCD_H - 1u, titleColor);
        ips114_draw_line(0u, 0u, 0u, LCD_H - 1u, titleColor);
        ips114_draw_line(LCD_W - 1u, 0u, LCD_W - 1u,
            LCD_H - 1u, titleColor);
        reasonChanged = 1u;
        stateChanged = 1u;
    }
    else if (reasonChanged != 0u)
    {
        /* 原因类别改变时标题颜色也可能由红转黄；仅按事件重画标题与边框。 */
        drawTitleBar("CORE0 FAULT", RGB565_BLACK, titleColor);
        ips114_draw_line(0u, 0u, LCD_W - 1u, 0u, titleColor);
        ips114_draw_line(0u, LCD_H - 1u, LCD_W - 1u,
            LCD_H - 1u, titleColor);
        ips114_draw_line(0u, 0u, 0u, LCD_H - 1u, titleColor);
        ips114_draw_line(LCD_W - 1u, 0u, LCD_W - 1u,
            LCD_H - 1u, titleColor);
    }
    if (reasonChanged != 0u)
    {
        fillRect(52u, 56u, 144u, 16u, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(52u, 56u, faultReasonText(reason));
        fillRect(12u, 72u, 120u, 8u, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
        ips114_show_string(12u, 72u, faultSourceText(reason));
    }
    if (stateChanged != 0u)
    {
        fillRect(68u, 80u, 96u, 16u, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(68u, 80u, safetyStateText(state));
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * 渲染：检测阈值编辑器（原图 + 当前 DetectMode 预览 + Lo/Hi/Exp 热调）
 * ============================================================ */
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t originalFrameSeq;
    uint32_t previewFrameSeq;
    int32_t lowValue;
    int32_t highValue;
    int32_t exposureValue;
    uint16_t ownerColor;
    uint8_t detectMode;
    uint8_t selection;
    uint8_t originalValid;
    uint8_t previewValid;
    uint8_t valid;
} thresholdRenderSnapshotStruct;

static thresholdRenderSnapshotStruct thresholdRenderSnapshot;

static int32_t thresholdDisplayValue(float value, int32_t maximum)
{
    if (!(value == value) || (value <= 0.0f)) return 0;
    if (value >= (float) maximum) return maximum;
    return (int32_t) value;
}

static void drawThresholdValue(uint16_t slotX, uint16_t slotWidth,
    uint16_t nameX, uint16_t valueX, const char *name, uint8_t selected,
    int32_t value, uint8_t digits)
{
    char valueText[5];
    uint16_t background = selected ? MENU_SEL_BG : RGB565_BLACK;
    uint16_t nameForeground = selected ? MENU_SEL_NAME_FG : MENU_NORM_NAME_FG;
    uint16_t valueForeground = selected ? MENU_SEL_VAL_FG : MENU_NORM_VAL_FG;

    if (digits == 3u)
    {
        (void) snprintf(valueText, sizeof(valueText), "%3ld", (long) value);
    }
    else
    {
        (void) snprintf(valueText, sizeof(valueText), "%4ld", (long) value);
    }
    fillSolidRect(slotX, THR_TXT_Y, slotWidth, FONT_H, background);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(nameForeground, background);
    ips114_show_string(nameX, THR_TXT_Y, name);
    ips114_set_color(valueForeground, background);
    ips114_show_string(valueX, THR_TXT_Y, valueText);
}

void renderThreshEdit(void)
{
    imageFrameViewStruct originalView;
    imageFrameViewStruct previewView;
    uint8_t originalValid = imageGetFrameView(IMAGE_FRAME_ORIGINAL, &originalView) &&
        (originalView.pixels != 0);
    uint8_t previewValid = imageGetFrameView(IMAGE_FRAME_DETECT_PREVIEW, &previewView) &&
        (previewView.pixels != 0);
    uint8_t binaryMode = (detectModeF < 0.5f) ? 1u : 0u;
    float lowValue = binaryMode ? binaryCcLowF : cannyLowF;
    float highValue = binaryMode ? binaryCcHighF : cannyHighF;
    int32_t lowDisplay = thresholdDisplayValue(lowValue, 999);
    int32_t highDisplay = thresholdDisplayValue(highValue, 999);
    int32_t exposureDisplay = thresholdDisplayValue(exposureF, 9999);
    uint16_t ownerColor = menuOwnerColor();
    uint8_t first = (thresholdRenderSnapshot.valid == 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t selectionChanged = (uint8_t) (first ||
        (thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection != threshSel));

    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.detectMode != binaryMode))
    {
        drawTitleBar(binaryMode ? "BINARY THR" : "CANNY THR", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);
    }

    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.originalValid != originalValid) ||
        (originalValid && (thresholdRenderSnapshot.originalFrameSeq != originalView.frameSeq)))
    {
        if (originalValid)
        {
            ips114_show_gray_image(THR_IMG_L_X, THR_IMG_Y, originalView.pixels,
            originalView.width, originalView.height, THR_IMG_W, THR_IMG_H, 0u);
        }
        else
        {
            fillRect(THR_IMG_L_X, THR_IMG_Y, THR_IMG_W, THR_IMG_H, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
    }
    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.previewValid != previewValid) ||
        (previewValid && (thresholdRenderSnapshot.previewFrameSeq != previewView.frameSeq)))
    {
        if (previewValid)
        {
            ips114_show_gray_image(THR_IMG_R_X, THR_IMG_Y, previewView.pixels,
                previewView.width, previewView.height, THR_IMG_W, THR_IMG_H, 0u);
        }
        else
        {
            fillRect(THR_IMG_R_X, THR_IMG_Y, THR_IMG_W, THR_IMG_H, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
    }

    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.lowValue != lowDisplay) ||
        (selectionChanged && ((threshSel == 0u) ||
            (thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection == 0u))))
        drawThresholdValue(THRESH_SLOT_LOW_X, THRESH_SLOT_LOW_WIDTH,
            THRESH_NAME_LOW_X, THRESH_VALUE_LOW_X, "Lo:",
            (uint8_t) (threshSel == 0u), lowDisplay, 3u);
    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.highValue != highDisplay) ||
        (selectionChanged && ((threshSel == 1u) ||
            (thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection == 1u))))
        drawThresholdValue(THRESH_SLOT_HIGH_X, THRESH_SLOT_HIGH_WIDTH,
            THRESH_NAME_HIGH_X, THRESH_VALUE_HIGH_X, "Hi:",
            (uint8_t) (threshSel == 1u), highDisplay, 3u);
    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.exposureValue != exposureDisplay) ||
        (selectionChanged && ((threshSel == 2u) ||
            (thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection == 2u))))
        drawThresholdValue(THRESH_SLOT_EXPOSURE_X, THRESH_SLOT_EXPOSURE_WIDTH,
            THRESH_NAME_EXPOSURE_X, THRESH_VALUE_EXPOSURE_X, "Ex:",
            (uint8_t) (threshSel == 2u), exposureDisplay, 4u);

    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.ownerColor != ownerColor))
    {
        drawFrameBorder();
        ips114_draw_line(120u, ROW_Y(1), 120u, 96u, ownerColor);
        ips114_draw_line(1u, 96u, LCD_W - 2u, 96u, ownerColor);
    }

    thresholdRenderSnapshot.originalFrameSeq = originalValid ? originalView.frameSeq : 0u;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.previewFrameSeq = previewValid ? previewView.frameSeq : 0u;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.lowValue = lowDisplay;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.highValue = highDisplay;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.exposureValue = exposureDisplay;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.ownerColor = ownerColor;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.detectMode = binaryMode;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection = threshSel;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.originalValid = originalValid;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.previewValid = previewValid;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.valid = 1u;
}

/* 整行铺底右界：有滚动条→滚动条左(SCROLLBAR_X-1)；无→右内框(LCD_W-2)。渲染前按 total 设。 */
static uint16_t listFillRightX = (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);

static void fillBottomGutter(uint16_t y, uint16_t color)
{
    if (y != ROW_Y(VISIBLE_ROWS)) return;
    fillSolidRect(1u, (uint16_t) (y + FONT_H), listFillRightX,
        (uint16_t) ((LCD_H - 1u) - (y + FONT_H)), color);
}

/* 列表空行清理：铺黑到右界（含右侧空隙）。 */
static void clearListRow(uint16_t y)
{
    fillSolidRect(1u, y, listFillRightX, FONT_H, RGB565_BLACK);
    fillBottomGutter(y, RGB565_BLACK);
}

/* 整行铺底色，顶到右界，并为随后绘制的行标记和名称设置字色。 */
static void fillListRowBg(uint16_t y, uint16_t fg, uint16_t bg)
{
    ips114_set_color(fg, bg);
    fillSolidRect(1u, y, listFillRightX, FONT_H, bg);
    fillBottomGutter(y, bg);
}

/* 列表渲染快照（变化检测防闪烁，对齐 core2 chassisMenuRender）：仅结构变化(进/出编辑、换页、
 * 换选中项、滚动、切状态后)才整页重绘列表；EDIT 态值变只局部重绘当前值。
 * clearScreenForState(切状态/清屏)调 menuRenderResetListSnapshot 复位 → 下次列表渲染为结构性。 */
static menuStateEnum listLastState = (menuStateEnum) 0xFF;
static int16_t listLastPageIdx = -1;
static int16_t listLastOptIdx = -1;
static uint8_t listLastScrollTop = 0xFFu;
static uint16_t listLastBorderColor = 0xFFFFu;
static uint8_t paramSlotsSurfaceValid;
static uint8_t paramSlotsLastSelection = 0xFFu;
static menuParamGlobalUiSnapshot paramSlotsLastUi;

void menuRenderResetListSnapshot(void)
{
    listLastState = (menuStateEnum) 0xFF;
    listLastPageIdx = -1;
    listLastOptIdx = -1;
    listLastScrollTop = 0xFFu;
    listLastBorderColor = 0xFFFFu;
    paramSlotsSurfaceValid = 0u;
    paramSlotsLastSelection = 0xFFu;
    memset(&paramSlotsLastUi, 0xFF, sizeof(paramSlotsLastUi));
    homeFooterDirty = 1u;
    homeLastKeyTarget = 0xFFu;
    homeLastC1Up = 0xFFu;
    homeLastC2Up = 0xFFu;
    homeLastVisionUp = 0xFFu;
    homeLastInputOwner = 0xFFu;
    memset(homeSlotValid, 0, sizeof(homeSlotValid));
    memset(homeSlotColor, 0, sizeof(homeSlotColor));
    memset(homeSlotBackground, 0, sizeof(homeSlotBackground));
    homeTitleColor = 0xFFFFu;
    memset(&thresholdRenderSnapshot, 0, sizeof(thresholdRenderSnapshot));
}

void renderInitFaultSummary(uint8_t failedMask, uint8_t unverifiedMask, uint8_t secondsLeft)
{
    static const char *const names[4] = {"IMU", "TOF", "OPT FLOW", "CAMERA"};
    uint8_t row = 0u;
    uint8_t i;

    if (secondsLeft >= 3u)
    {
        ips114_clear();
        menuRenderResetListSnapshot();
        drawTitleBar((failedMask != 0u) ? "HW INIT FAIL" : "HW INIT CHECK",
            RGB565_BLACK, (failedMask != 0u) ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_YELLOW);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++)
        {
            uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << i);
            if ((failedMask & bit) != 0u)
            {
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK);
                ips114_show_string(8u, (uint16_t) (18u + row * 16u), names[i]);
                ips114_show_string(128u, (uint16_t) (18u + row * 16u), "FAIL ");
                row++;
            }
        }
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++)
        {
            uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << i);
            if (((unverifiedMask & bit) != 0u) && ((failedMask & bit) == 0u))
            {
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
                ips114_show_string(8u, (uint16_t) (18u + row * 16u), names[i]);
                ips114_show_string(128u, (uint16_t) (18u + row * 16u), "CHECK");
                row++;
            }
        }
        drawFrameBorder();
    }
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_show_string(8u, 114u, "CONTINUE 0s");
    ips114_show_uint(80u, 114u, secondsLeft, 1u);
}

/* ============================================================
 * 渲染：页列表（标题居中 + 滚动滑块）
 * ============================================================ */
void renderPageList(void)
{
    uint16_t borderColor = menuOwnerColor();
    /* 结构变化才整页重绘(防 100ms 空刷闪烁)：切入页列表 / 换选中页 / 滚动。 */
    uint8_t structural = (uint8_t) (listLastState != MENU_PAGE_LIST
        || listLastPageIdx != (int16_t) pageIdx || listLastScrollTop != scrollTop
        || listLastBorderColor != borderColor);
    uint8_t selectionOnly = (uint8_t) ((listLastState == MENU_PAGE_LIST) &&
        (listLastScrollTop == scrollTop) &&
        (listLastBorderColor == borderColor) &&
        (listLastPageIdx != (int16_t) pageIdx));
    if (!structural) return;

    listFillRightX = (menuPageCount > VISIBLE_ROWS) ? (uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X - 1u) : (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);
    if (selectionOnly == 0u)
        drawTitleBar("PAGES", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);

    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    uint8_t start = scrollTop;
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < VISIBLE_ROWS; i++)
    {
        uint8_t pi = (uint8_t) (start + i);
        uint16_t y = ROW_Y((uint8_t) (i + 1u));
        if ((selectionOnly != 0u) && (pi != (uint8_t) pageIdx) &&
            (pi != (uint8_t) listLastPageIdx)) continue;
        if (pi >= menuPageCount)
        {
            clearListRow(y);
            continue;
        }
        if (pi == (uint8_t) pageIdx)
        {
            fillListRowBg(y, MENU_SEL_NAME_FG, MENU_SEL_BG); /* 选中整行青底，名黑(页列表无数值) */
            ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, y, ">");
            ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, menuPages[pi].name);
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
        else
        {
            clearListRow(y);
            ips114_set_color(MENU_NORM_NAME_FG, RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, menuPages[pi].name);
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
    }

    if (selectionOnly == 0u)
    {
        drawFrameBorder();
        drawScrollbar(menuPageCount, scrollTop);
    }
    listLastState = MENU_PAGE_LIST;
    listLastPageIdx = (int16_t) pageIdx;
    listLastScrollTop = scrollTop;
    listLastOptIdx = -1;
    listLastBorderColor = borderColor;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 渲染：选项列表 / 编辑（共用，editing 改箭头 + 标题居中 + 滚动滑块）
 * ============================================================ */
void renderOptionList(uint8_t editing)
{
    menuPageStruct* pg = &menuPages[pageIdx];
    uint16_t borderColor = menuOwnerColor();
    uint8_t curIsEdit = (uint8_t) (editing != 0u);
    /* 结构变化判定(对齐 core2)：切入选项列表 / 进出编辑 / 换选中项 / 滚动 → 整页重绘；
     * EDIT 态值变(同态同项同滚动)只局部重绘当前值，消 100ms 全页重绘闪烁(用户重点:core0 调节页)。 */
    uint8_t enteringList = (uint8_t) (listLastState != MENU_OPTION_LIST && listLastState != MENU_EDIT);
    uint8_t editTransition = (uint8_t) ((listLastState == MENU_EDIT) != curIsEdit);
    uint8_t structural = (uint8_t) (enteringList || editTransition
        || listLastPageIdx != (int16_t) pageIdx
        || listLastOptIdx != (int16_t) optIdx || listLastScrollTop != scrollTop
        || listLastBorderColor != borderColor);
    uint8_t selectionOnly = (uint8_t) ((!enteringList) && (!editTransition) &&
        (listLastPageIdx == (int16_t) pageIdx) &&
        (listLastScrollTop == scrollTop) &&
        (listLastBorderColor == borderColor) &&
        (listLastOptIdx != (int16_t) optIdx));

    if (structural)
    {
        listFillRightX = (pg->optionCount > VISIBLE_ROWS) ? (uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X - 1u) : (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);
        if (selectionOnly == 0u)
            drawTitleBar(pg->name, RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);

        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        uint8_t start = scrollTop;
        for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < VISIBLE_ROWS; i++)
        {
            uint8_t oi = (uint8_t) (start + i);
            uint16_t y = ROW_Y((uint8_t) (i + 1u));
            if ((selectionOnly != 0u) && (oi != (uint8_t) optIdx) &&
                (oi != (uint8_t) listLastOptIdx)) continue;
            if (oi >= pg->optionCount)
            {
                clearListRow(y);
                continue;
            }
            if (oi == (uint8_t) optIdx && editing)
            {
                /* 编辑行：整行黄底强调，名黑/值红（非仅数值反相） */
                fillListRowBg(y, MENU_EDIT_NAME_FG, MENU_EDIT_BG);
                ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, y, "*");
                ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, pg->optName[oi]);
                ips114_set_color(MENU_EDIT_VAL_FG, MENU_EDIT_BG);
                menuFloatDisplayShow(MENU_PARAM_VALUE_X, y,
                    (double) (*pg->opt[oi]),
                    menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(
                        (double) (*pg->opt[oi]), pg->stepS[oi]));
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
            }
            else if (oi == (uint8_t) optIdx)
            {
                /* 选中行：整行青底，名黑/值蓝 */
                fillListRowBg(y, MENU_SEL_NAME_FG, MENU_SEL_BG);
                ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, y, ">");
                ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, pg->optName[oi]);
                ips114_set_color(MENU_SEL_VAL_FG, MENU_SEL_BG);
                menuFloatDisplayShow(MENU_PARAM_VALUE_X, y,
                    (double) (*pg->opt[oi]),
                    menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(
                        (double) (*pg->opt[oi]), pg->stepS[oi]));
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
            }
            else
            {
                /* 普通行：黑底，名绿/值白 */
                clearListRow(y);
                ips114_set_color(MENU_NORM_NAME_FG, RGB565_BLACK);
                ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, pg->optName[oi]);
                ips114_set_color(MENU_NORM_VAL_FG, RGB565_BLACK);
                menuFloatDisplayShow(MENU_PARAM_VALUE_X, y,
                    (double) (*pg->opt[oi]),
                    menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(
                        (double) (*pg->opt[oi]), pg->stepS[oi]));
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
            }
        }

        if (selectionOnly == 0u)
        {
            drawFrameBorder();
            /* 名称列/数值列竖分隔线已删除：名/值现用三态颜色区分，竖线多余且参与闪烁感（codex 点 6）。 */
            drawScrollbar(pg->optionCount, scrollTop);
        }
    }
    else if (editing)
    {
        /* 值局部刷新：仅当前选中项数值(黄底红字)，不动整行/名/边框/滚动条 → 消整页重绘闪烁 */
        uint16_t y = ROW_Y((uint8_t) ((uint8_t) optIdx - scrollTop + 1u));
        ips114_set_color(MENU_EDIT_VAL_FG, MENU_EDIT_BG);
        menuFloatDisplayShow(MENU_PARAM_VALUE_X, y,
            (double) (*pg->opt[optIdx]),
            menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(
                (double) (*pg->opt[optIdx]), pg->stepS[optIdx]));
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    }

    listLastState = curIsEdit ? MENU_EDIT : MENU_OPTION_LIST;
    listLastPageIdx = (int16_t) pageIdx;
    listLastOptIdx = (int16_t) optIdx;
    listLastScrollTop = scrollTop;
    listLastBorderColor = borderColor;
}

void renderParamSlots(void)
{
    char line[32];
    menuParamGlobalUiSnapshot globalUi;
    uint8_t fullRedraw;
    menuParamGlobalGetUi(&globalUi);

    fullRedraw = (uint8_t) (paramSlotsSurfaceValid == 0u);
    if (fullRedraw != 0u)
    {
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK);
        listFillRightX = (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);
        drawTitleBar("PARAM SLOTS", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(5u), "K2/K3 SLOT");
        ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(6u), "K1L SAVE K4 LOAD");
        ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(7u), "K5 BACK");
        drawFrameBorder();
        paramSlotsSurfaceValid = 1u;
    }
    if (fullRedraw != 0u || paramSlotsLastSelection != selectedParamSlot)
    {
        fillListRowBg(ROW_Y(1u), MENU_SEL_NAME_FG, MENU_SEL_BG);
        (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "> SELECT        SLOT %u",
            (unsigned) selectedParamSlot);
        ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, ROW_Y(1u), line);
        paramSlotsLastSelection = selectedParamSlot;
    }
    if (fullRedraw != 0u || paramSlotsLastUi.slotUiState != globalUi.slotUiState)
    {
        static const char *const slotText[] = {
            "UNKNOWN", "CHECKING", "FULL", "EMPTY", "PARTIAL",
            "INVALID", "UNAVAILABLE"};
        uint8_t state = globalUi.slotUiState;
        if (state > PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE)
            state = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNKNOWN;
        clearListRow(ROW_Y(2u));
        (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "SLOT: %s", slotText[state]);
        ips114_set_color((state == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL) ? RGB565_GREEN :
            ((state == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_EMPTY) ? RGB565_CYAN : RGB565_YELLOW),
            RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(24u, ROW_Y(2u), line);
    }
    if (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED)
        (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: QUEUED");
    else if (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS)
        (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "RUN: C%u PH%u",
            (unsigned) globalUi.target, (unsigned) globalUi.phase);
    else if (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS)
        (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: SUCCESS");
    else if (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED)
        (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "FAIL: C%u E%u",
            (unsigned) globalUi.target, (unsigned) globalUi.error);
    else
        (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: READY");
    if (fullRedraw != 0u || memcmp(&paramSlotsLastUi, &globalUi,
            sizeof(globalUi)) != 0)
    {
        clearListRow(ROW_Y(3u));
        ips114_set_color(globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS ? RGB565_GREEN :
            (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_CYAN),
            RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(24u, ROW_Y(3u), line);
    }
    paramSlotsLastUi = globalUi;
}
