static uint8_t activationContext(uint8_t *oldSlot, uint8_t *newSlot)
{
    uint32_t word = core0ParamSyncActivationRollbackRetained;
    if (core0ParamSyncActivationRollbackInverseRetained != ~word ||
        (word & 0xFFFF0000u) != CORE0_ACTIVATE_ROLLBACK_MAGIC)
        return 0u;
    *oldSlot = (uint8_t) word;
    *newSlot = (uint8_t) (word >> 8);
    return (uint8_t) (*oldSlot >= 1u && *oldSlot <= MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT &&
                      *newSlot >= 1u && *newSlot <= MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT);
}

static void setActivationContext(uint8_t oldSlot, uint8_t newSlot)
{
    uint32_t word = CORE0_ACTIVATE_ROLLBACK_MAGIC |
                    (uint32_t) oldSlot | ((uint32_t) newSlot << 8);
    core0ParamSyncActivationRollbackRetained = word;
    core0ParamSyncActivationRollbackInverseRetained = ~word;
}

static void clearActivationContext(void)
{
    core0ParamSyncActivationRollbackRetained = 0u;
    core0ParamSyncActivationRollbackInverseRetained = UINT32_MAX;
}

static uint8_t rollbackActivation(void)
{
    uint8_t oldSlot, newSlot;
    (void) activationContext(&oldSlot, &newSlot);
    if (menuParamSlotsAbortPendingActivation() == 0u) return 0u;
    clearActivationContext();
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t recoverActivationAfterOwnerBoot(void)
{
    if (g_activationRecoveryChecked != 0u) return 1u;
    g_activationRecoveryChecked = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint16_t readU16(const uint8_t *data)
{
    return (uint16_t) (data[0] | ((uint16_t) data[1] << 8));
}

static uint32_t readU32(const uint8_t *data)
{
    return (uint32_t) data[0] |
           ((uint32_t) data[1] << 8) |
           ((uint32_t) data[2] << 16) |
           ((uint32_t) data[3] << 24);
}

static void writeU16(uint8_t *data, uint16_t value)
{
    data[0] = (uint8_t) value;
    data[1] = (uint8_t) (value >> 8);
}

static void writeU32(uint8_t *data, uint32_t value)
{
    data[0] = (uint8_t) value;
    data[1] = (uint8_t) (value >> 8);
    data[2] = (uint8_t) (value >> 16);
    data[3] = (uint8_t) (value >> 24);
}

static uint32_t getOwnerBootGeneration(void)
{
    uint32_t previous;
    if (g_ownerBootGeneration != 0u) return g_ownerBootGeneration;
    previous = core0ParamSyncOwnerBootRetained;
    if ((previous == 0u) ||
        (core0ParamSyncOwnerBootInverseRetained != ~previous)) previous = 0u;
    previous++;
    if (previous == 0u) previous = 1u;
    core0ParamSyncOwnerBootRetained = previous;
    core0ParamSyncOwnerBootInverseRetained = ~previous;
    g_ownerBootGeneration = previous;
    return g_ownerBootGeneration;
}

static void clearMutationLock(void)
{
    g_syncMutationLocked = 0u;
    g_syncLockedSlot = 0u;
    g_syncLockedTransaction = 0u;
}

static uint8_t decodeGlobalTransaction(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request,
    uint8_t allowDefaultSlot, uint8_t *slot, uint32_t *transactionId)
{
    if (request->dataLength != 5u) return 0u;
    *slot = request->data[0];
    *transactionId = readU32(&request->data[1]);
    return (uint8_t) ((*transactionId != 0u) &&
        (*transactionId != UINT32_MAX) &&
        ((*slot >= 1u && *slot <= MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT) ||
         (allowDefaultSlot != 0u && *slot == 0u)));
}

static uint8_t transactionLocked(uint8_t slot, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    return (uint8_t) (g_syncMutationLocked != 0u &&
        g_syncLockedSlot == slot &&
        g_syncLockedTransaction == transactionId);
}

static uint8_t producerBootChangeAllowed(
    const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    menuParamRuntimeMeta runtimeMeta;
    uint8_t oldSlot, newSlot;
    uint8_t activationPending;
    uint8_t transactionPending;
    uint32_t transactionId;

    if (menuParamRuntimeGetMeta(&runtimeMeta) == 0u) return 0u;
    activationPending = (uint8_t) (activationContext(&oldSlot, &newSlot) ||
        (runtimeMeta.pending != 0u &&
         runtimeMeta.transactionId == UINT32_MAX));
    transactionPending = (uint8_t) (g_syncMutationLocked ||
        g_prepare.active || g_prepare.prepared || g_prepare.committed ||
        runtimeMeta.pending);
    if ((activationPending == 0u) && (transactionPending == 0u)) return 1u;
    if ((request->op != PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH &&
         request->op != PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT) ||
        (request->dataLength != 4u)) return 0u;

    transactionId = readU32(request->data);
    if (activationPending != 0u)
    {
        if ((transactionId != 0u) || g_prepare.active ||
            g_prepare.prepared || g_prepare.committed) return 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((g_syncMutationLocked != 0u) &&
        (transactionId != g_syncLockedTransaction)) return 0u;
    if ((g_prepare.active || g_prepare.prepared || g_prepare.committed) &&
        (transactionId != g_prepare.transactionId)) return 0u;
    if ((runtimeMeta.pending != 0u) &&
        (transactionId != runtimeMeta.transactionId)) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (g_syncMutationLocked || g_prepare.active ||
        g_prepare.prepared || g_prepare.committed ||
        menuParamSlotsHasPending());
}

static void publishResponse(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request,
    uint8_t status, const uint8_t *data, uint16_t length, uint32_t payloadCrc)
{
    paramSyncMailboxResponse response;

    memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
    g_responseSequence++;
    if (g_responseSequence == 0u) g_responseSequence = 1u;
    response.producerBootGeneration = getOwnerBootGeneration();
    response.sequence = g_responseSequence;
    response.transactionId = request->transactionId;
    response.offset = request->offset;
    response.payloadCrc32 = payloadCrc;
    response.dataLength = length;
    response.op = request->op;
    response.slot = request->slot;
    response.target = request->target;
    response.status = status;
    if ((data != NULL) && (length != 0u)) memcpy(response.data, data, length);
    g_lastResponse = response;
    g_lastResponseValid = 1u;
    (void) paramSyncMailboxPublishResponse(&response);
}

static uint8_t blobValid(const uint8_t *blob, uint32_t expectedBlobCrc)
{
    uint32_t internalStored = readU32(&blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_CRC_OFFSET]);
    uint32_t internalComputed = crc32IeeeCalc(blob,
        CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_CRC_OFFSET);

    return (uint8_t) ((readU32(&blob[0]) == CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_MAGIC) &&
                      (readU32(&blob[4]) == CORE0_PARAM_FLASH_VERSION) &&
                      (readU32(&blob[8]) == CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES) &&
                      (internalStored == internalComputed) &&
                      (internalStored == expectedBlobCrc));
}

static void handleReadMeta(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    menuParamLibraryMeta meta;
    uint8_t output[26u];
    uint8_t blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES];
    uint32_t blobCrc = 0u;
    uint8_t slot;

    if (request->dataLength != 1u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    slot = request->data[0];
    memset(&meta, 0, sizeof(meta));
    if ((slot < 1u) || (slot > MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT) ||
        (menuParamSlotsInspect(slot, &meta) == 0u))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (meta.state == MENU_PARAM_SLOT_VALID)
    {
        if (menuParamSlotsRead(slot, blob, sizeof(blob)) == 0u)
        {
            publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        blobCrc = readU32(&blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_CRC_OFFSET]);
    }
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(output));
    output[0] = CORE0_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET;
    output[1] = slot;
    output[2] = meta.state;
    output[3] = 0u;
    writeU32(&output[4], CORE0_PARAM_FLASH_VERSION);
    writeU32(&output[8], meta.generation);
    writeU32(&output[12], blobCrc);
    writeU32(&output[16], meta.transactionId);
    writeU32(&output[20], CORE0_PARAM_SCHEMA_HASH);
    writeU16(&output[24], CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES);
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, output, sizeof(output), 0u);
}

static void handleReadRuntimeMeta(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    menuParamRuntimeMeta meta;
    uint8_t output[32u];
    uint8_t blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES];

    if (request->dataLength != 0u || menuParamRuntimeGetMeta(&meta) == 0u ||
        menuParamRuntimeRead(blob, sizeof(blob)) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(output));
    output[0] = CORE0_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET;
    output[1] = meta.valid;
    output[2] = meta.bank;
    output[3] = meta.pending;
    output[4] = menuParamRuntimeIsDirty();
    output[5] = meta.sourceSlot;
    output[6] = meta.diagnosticFlags;
    writeU32(&output[8], CORE0_PARAM_FLASH_VERSION);
    writeU32(&output[12], meta.generation);
    writeU32(&output[16], readU32(&blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_CRC_OFFSET]));
    writeU32(&output[20], meta.transactionId);
    writeU32(&output[24], CORE0_PARAM_SCHEMA_HASH);
    writeU16(&output[28], CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES);
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, output, sizeof(output), 0u);
}

static void handleReadRuntimeChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES];
    uint8_t output[PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX];
    uint16_t offset;
    uint16_t length;

    if (request->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    offset = readU16(&request->data[0]);
    length = readU16(&request->data[2]);
    if (length == 0u || length > (PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX - 4u) ||
        (uint32_t) offset + length > sizeof(blob) ||
        menuParamRuntimeRead(blob, sizeof(blob)) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    writeU16(&output[0], offset);
    writeU16(&output[2], sizeof(blob));
    memcpy(&output[4], &blob[offset], length);
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, output,
        (uint16_t) (4u + length),
        readU32(&blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_CRC_OFFSET]));
}

static void handleReadChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES];
    uint8_t output[PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX];
    menuParamSlotMeta meta;
    uint16_t offset;
    uint16_t length;
    uint8_t slot;

    if (request->dataLength != 5u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    slot = request->data[0];
    offset = readU16(&request->data[1]);
    length = readU16(&request->data[3]);
    if ((slot < 1u) || (slot > MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT) || (length == 0u) ||
        (length > (PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX - 5u)) ||
        ((uint32_t) offset + length > CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES) ||
        (menuParamSlotsGetMeta(slot, &meta) == 0u) || (meta.valid == 0u) ||
        (menuParamSlotsRead(slot, blob, sizeof(blob)) == 0u))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    output[0] = slot;
    writeU16(&output[1], offset);
    writeU16(&output[3], CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES);
    memcpy(&output[5], &blob[offset], length);
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, output,
        (uint16_t) (length + 5u), readU32(&blob[CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES - 4u]));
}

static void clearPrepare(void)
{
    memset(&g_prepare, 0, sizeof(g_prepare));
}

static uint8_t abortPrepare(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    if (g_prepare.active == 0u) return 0u;
    if ((transactionId != 0u) &&
        (transactionId != g_prepare.transactionId)) return 0u;
    if ((g_prepare.prepared != 0u) &&
        (menuParamSlotsAbort(g_prepare.transactionId) == 0u)) return 0u;
    g_lastAbortedTransaction = g_prepare.transactionId;
    clearPrepare();
    return 1u;
}

static void handlePrepareLibraryFromLive(
    const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint32_t blobCrc;

    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_prepare.active != 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, (g_prepare.kind == PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY &&
            g_prepare.slot == slot &&
            g_prepare.transactionId == transactionId) ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK :
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, g_prepare.expectedBlobCrc);
        return;
    }
    blobCrc = menuParamCurrentBlobCrc();
    if (menuParamSlotsPrepareCurrent(slot, transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    clearPrepare();
    g_prepare.slot = slot;
    g_prepare.transactionId = transactionId;
    g_prepare.expectedBlobCrc = blobCrc;
    g_prepare.expectedBytes = CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES;
    g_prepare.receivedBytes = CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES;
    g_prepare.active = 1u;
    g_prepare.prepared = 1u;
    g_prepare.kind = PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, blobCrc);
}

static void handlePrepareRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint8_t ok;

    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u ||
        slot == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_prepare.active != 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, (g_prepare.kind == PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME &&
            g_prepare.slot == slot &&
            g_prepare.transactionId == transactionId) ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK :
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    ok = menuParamRuntimePrepareFromSlot(slot, transactionId);
    if (ok == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    clearPrepare();
    g_prepare.slot = slot;
    g_prepare.transactionId = transactionId;
    g_prepare.active = 1u;
    g_prepare.prepared = 1u;
    g_prepare.kind = PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleCommitRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;

    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u ||
        g_prepare.active == 0u || g_prepare.prepared == 0u ||
        g_prepare.kind != PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME || g_prepare.slot != slot ||
        g_prepare.transactionId != transactionId)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_prepare.committed == 0u &&
        menuParamRuntimeCommit(transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_prepare.committed = 1u;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleApplyRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;

    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u ||
        g_prepare.active == 0u || g_prepare.committed == 0u ||
        g_prepare.kind != PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME || g_prepare.slot != slot ||
        g_prepare.transactionId != transactionId)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_prepare.applied == 0u &&
        menuParamRuntimeApplyPrepared(transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_prepare.applied = 1u;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handlePrepareBegin(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;

    if (request->dataLength != 19u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    slot = request->data[0];
    transactionId = readU32(&request->data[1]);
    if ((slot < 1u) || (slot > MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT) ||
        (transactionId == 0u) || (transactionId == UINT32_MAX) ||
        (readU32(&request->data[5]) != CORE0_PARAM_FLASH_VERSION) ||
        (readU32(&request->data[9]) != CORE0_PARAM_SCHEMA_HASH) ||
        (readU16(&request->data[17]) != CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_prepare.active != 0u) && (slot == g_prepare.slot) &&
        (transactionId == g_prepare.transactionId) &&
        (readU32(&request->data[13]) == g_prepare.expectedBlobCrc) &&
        (readU16(&request->data[17]) == g_prepare.expectedBytes))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_prepare.active != 0u) && abortPrepare(g_prepare.transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    clearPrepare();
    g_prepare.slot = slot;
    g_prepare.transactionId = transactionId;
    g_prepare.expectedBlobCrc = readU32(&request->data[13]);
    g_prepare.expectedBytes = CORE0_PARAM_BLOB_BYTES;
    g_prepare.active = 1u;
    g_prepare.kind = PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handlePrepareChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint16_t offset;
    uint16_t length;

    if ((g_prepare.active == 0u) || (request->dataLength < 5u))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    offset = readU16(&request->data[1]);
    length = readU16(&request->data[3]);
    if ((request->data[0] == g_prepare.slot) &&
        ((uint32_t) offset + length <= g_prepare.receivedBytes) &&
        (length == (uint16_t) (request->dataLength - 5u)) &&
        (memcmp(&g_prepare.blob[offset], &request->data[5], length) == 0))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((request->data[0] != g_prepare.slot) ||
        (offset != g_prepare.receivedBytes) ||
        (length != (uint16_t) (request->dataLength - 5u)) ||
        ((uint32_t) offset + length > g_prepare.expectedBytes))
    {
        (void) abortPrepare(g_prepare.transactionId);
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(&g_prepare.blob[offset], &request->data[5], length);
    g_prepare.receivedBytes = (uint16_t) (g_prepare.receivedBytes + length);
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handlePrepareFinish(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint32_t crc;

    if ((g_prepare.prepared != 0u) && (request->dataLength == 1u) &&
        (request->data[0] == g_prepare.slot))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u,
            g_prepare.expectedBlobCrc);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_prepare.active == 0u) || (request->dataLength != 1u) ||
        (request->data[0] != g_prepare.slot) ||
        (g_prepare.receivedBytes != g_prepare.expectedBytes) ||
        (blobValid(g_prepare.blob, g_prepare.expectedBlobCrc) == 0u))
    {
        transactionId = g_prepare.transactionId;
        if (transactionId != 0u) (void) abortPrepare(transactionId);
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (menuParamSlotsPrepare(g_prepare.slot, g_prepare.blob,
            sizeof(g_prepare.blob), g_prepare.transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        transactionId = g_prepare.transactionId;
        (void) abortPrepare(transactionId);
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_prepare.prepared = 1u;
    crc = g_prepare.expectedBlobCrc;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, crc);
}

static uint8_t decodeSlotTransaction(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request,
    uint8_t *slot, uint32_t *transactionId)
{
    if (request->dataLength != 5u) return 0u;
    *slot = request->data[0];
    *transactionId = readU32(&request->data[1]);
    return (uint8_t) ((*slot >= 1u) && (*slot <= MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT));
}

static void handleCommit(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if ((decodeSlotTransaction(request, &slot, &transactionId) != 0u) &&
        (g_prepare.committed != 0u) && (slot == g_prepare.slot) &&
        (transactionId == g_prepare.transactionId))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((decodeSlotTransaction(request, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u) ||
        (g_prepare.kind != PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY) ||
        (g_prepare.prepared == 0u) || (slot != g_prepare.slot) ||
        (transactionId != g_prepare.transactionId))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (menuParamSlotsCommit(slot, transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_prepare.committed = 1u;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleActivate(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t oldSlot, pendingSlot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (decodeSlotTransaction(request, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((transactionId != 0u) && ((g_prepare.committed == 0u) ||
                                     (slot != g_prepare.slot) || (transactionId != g_prepare.transactionId)))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        if (!g_syncMutationLocked || g_syncLockedSlot != slot ||
            g_prepare.active || g_prepare.prepared ||
            g_prepare.committed)
        {
            publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        if (activationContext(&oldSlot, &pendingSlot))
        {
            publishResponse(request, pendingSlot == slot ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        oldSlot = menuParamSlotsGetActive();
        if (oldSlot < 1u || oldSlot > MENU_PARAM_SLOT_COUNT)
        {
            publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        setActivationContext(oldSlot, slot);
    }
    if ((transactionId == 0u ? menuParamSlotsActivatePending(slot) :
            menuParamSlotsActivatePrepared(slot, transactionId)) == 0u)
    {
        if (transactionId == 0u) (void) rollbackActivation();
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (transactionId != 0u) g_prepare.activated = 1u;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleAbort(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (request->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    transactionId = readU32(request->data);
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        uint8_t ok = rollbackActivation();
        if (ok) clearMutationLock();
        publishResponse(request, ok ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_prepare.active == 0u) &&
        (transactionId == g_lastAbortedTransaction))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (((g_prepare.active != 0u) && (abortPrepare(transactionId) == 0u)) ||
        ((g_prepare.active == 0u) && (menuParamSlotsAbort(transactionId) == 0u)))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    clearMutationLock();
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleFinish(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (request->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    transactionId = readU32(request->data);
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        if (menuParamSlotsFinishPendingActivation() == 0u)
        {
            publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        clearActivationContext();
        clearMutationLock();
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_prepare.active == 0u) &&
        (transactionId == g_lastFinishedTransaction))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_prepare.active != 0u) &&
        (((g_prepare.kind == PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY) &&
          (g_prepare.committed == 0u)) ||
         ((g_prepare.kind == PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME) &&
          ((g_prepare.committed == 0u) || (g_prepare.applied == 0u))) ||
         (transactionId != g_prepare.transactionId)))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (menuParamSlotsFinish(transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_lastFinishedTransaction = transactionId;
    clearPrepare();
    clearMutationLock();
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleLock(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t oldSlot, newSlot;
    uint32_t transactionId = (request->dataLength == 5u) ?
        readU32(&request->data[1]) : 0u;
    if (request->dataLength != 5u || request->data[0] > 5u ||
        transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX ||
        (g_syncMutationLocked && (g_syncLockedSlot != request->data[0] ||
         g_syncLockedTransaction != transactionId)) ||
        g_prepare.active || menuParamSlotsHasPending() ||
        activationContext(&oldSlot, &newSlot))
    {
        publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_syncMutationLocked = 1u;
    g_syncLockedSlot = request->data[0];
    g_syncLockedTransaction = transactionId;
    publishResponse(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static uint8_t retainedRequestMayResume(
    const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    if (request->target != CORE0_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_QUERY ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_CHUNK ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_META ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_RECOVERY ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH);
}

void paramSyncOwnerServiceInit(void)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest retainedRequest;
    g_lastRequestBoot = 0u;
    g_lastRequestSequence = 0u;
    g_responseSequence = 0u;
    g_lastResponseValid = 0u;
    (void) getOwnerBootGeneration();
    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&retainedRequest) != 0u &&
        retainedRequestMayResume(&retainedRequest) == 0u)
    {
        g_lastRequestBoot = retainedRequest.producerBootGeneration;
        g_lastRequestSequence = retainedRequest.sequence;
        if (retainedRequest.target == CORE0_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET)
            publishResponse(&retainedRequest, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY,
                NULL, 0u, 0u);
    }
}

void paramSyncOwnerServicePoll(void)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest request;

    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&request) == 0u) return;
    if ((request.producerBootGeneration == g_lastRequestBoot) &&
        (request.sequence == g_lastRequestSequence))
    {
        if (g_lastResponseValid != 0u)
            (void) paramSyncMailboxPublishResponse(&g_lastResponse);
        return;
    }
    if (request.producerBootGeneration == g_lastRequestBoot &&
        (int32_t) (request.sequence - g_lastRequestSequence) <= 0) return;
    if ((g_lastRequestBoot != 0u) &&
        (request.producerBootGeneration != g_lastRequestBoot))
    {
        if (producerBootChangeAllowed(&request) == 0u)
        {
            if (request.target == CORE0_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET)
                publishResponse(&request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
    }
    g_lastRequestBoot = request.producerBootGeneration;
    g_lastRequestSequence = request.sequence;
    if (request.target != CORE0_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET) return;
    if (recoverActivationAfterOwnerBoot() == 0u)
    {
        publishResponse(&request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    switch (request.op)
    {
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META: handleReadMeta(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_CHUNK: handleReadChunk(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_META:
            handleReadRuntimeMeta(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK:
            handleReadRuntimeChunk(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_LIBRARY_FROM_LIVE:
            handlePrepareLibraryFromLive(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_RUNTIME_FROM_SLOT:
            handlePrepareRuntime(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT_RUNTIME:
            handleCommitRuntime(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_APPLY_RUNTIME:
            handleApplyRuntime(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_BEGIN: handlePrepareBegin(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_CHUNK: handlePrepareChunk(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_VERIFY: handlePrepareFinish(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT: handleCommit(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_ACTIVATE: handleActivate(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT: handleAbort(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH: handleFinish(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_LOCK: handleLock(&request); break;
        default:
            publishResponse(&request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_REJECTED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            break;
    }
}

#include "coreDataTransfer.h"

#include "cy_device_headers.h"

#include <string.h>

#define CORE_DATA_CACHE_LINE_SIZE       (32u)
#define CORE_DATA_PARAM_TXN_TAG         (0xC03A0000u)
#define CORE_DATA_PARAM_TXN_TAG_MASK    (0xFFFF0001u)
#define CORE_DATA_PARAM_TXN_COUNTER_MASK (0x0000FFFEu)
#define CORE_DATA_VISDBG_BUSY_MAGIC      (0u)

/* 用 #pragma location 把两个结构体强制放在共享 RAM 区固定地址,
 * 让链接器为其保留空间 (沿用旧 sharedObject 的 __no_init 绝对放置机制)。
 * 两区相距 256 字节, 各自独立 cache line, 杜绝 false-sharing。 */
#pragma location = CORE_DATA_VISION_ADDR
__no_init volatile visionToFlightStruct visionRegion;

#pragma location = CORE_DATA_FLIGHT_ADDR
__no_init volatile flightToVisionStruct flightRegion;

#pragma location = CORE_DATA_KVM_STATUS_ADDR
__no_init volatile kvmStatusToMenuStruct kvmStatusRegion;

#pragma location = CORE_DATA_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_ADDR
__no_init volatile coreDataParamGlobalStateStruct paramGlobalStateRegion;

#pragma location = CORE_DATA_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_ADDR
__no_init volatile coreDataParamGlobalRequestStruct paramGlobalRequestRegion;

#pragma location = CORE_DATA_FLIGHT_MARKER_ADDR
__no_init volatile coreDataFlightMarkerStruct flightMarkerRegion;

#pragma location = CORE_DATA_PARAM_ADDR
__no_init volatile paramToFlightStruct paramRegion;

static uint32_t paramPublishCounter;
static uint32_t flightPublishGeneration;
static uint8_t flightPublishPrimed;

static uint32_t nextFlightPublishGeneration(void)
{
    coreDataFlightMarkerStruct marker;
    if (flightPublishPrimed == 0u)
    {
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &flightMarkerRegion,
            sizeof(flightMarkerRegion));
        __DSB();
        memcpy(&marker, (const void*) &flightMarkerRegion, sizeof(marker));
        if ((marker.magic == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
            (marker.generation != 0u))
            flightPublishGeneration = marker.generation;
        flightPublishPrimed = 1u;
    }
    if ((flightPublishGeneration & 1u) != 0u)
        flightPublishGeneration += 1u;
    else
        flightPublishGeneration += 2u;
    if (flightPublishGeneration == 0u) flightPublishGeneration = 2u;
    return flightPublishGeneration;
}

static void publishFlightMarker(uint32_t generation)
{
    coreDataFlightMarkerStruct marker;
    memset(&marker, 0, sizeof(marker));
    marker.magic = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    marker.generation = generation;
    memcpy((void*) &flightMarkerRegion, &marker, sizeof(marker));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &flightMarkerRegion,
        sizeof(flightMarkerRegion));
    __DSB();
}

static volatile void* paramMarkerCacheLine(void)
{
    uintptr_t marker = (uintptr_t) &paramRegion.cm71ParamReady;
    return (volatile void*) (marker & ~((uintptr_t) CORE_DATA_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u));
}

static void cleanParamMarker(void)
{
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr(paramMarkerCacheLine(), CORE_DATA_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
    __DSB();
}

static void invalidateParamMarker(void)
{
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr(paramMarkerCacheLine(), CORE_DATA_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
    __DSB();
}

static uint32_t nextParamCommitToken(void)
{
    paramPublishCounter = (paramPublishCounter + 2u) & CORE_DATA_PARAM_TXN_COUNTER_MASK;
    if (paramPublishCounter == 0u) paramPublishCounter = 2u;
    return CORE_DATA_PARAM_TXN_TAG | paramPublishCounter;
}

static uint8_t paramTokenIsCommitted(uint32_t token)
{
    return (uint8_t) (((token & CORE_DATA_PARAM_TXN_TAG_MASK) == CORE_DATA_PARAM_TXN_TAG) &&
                      ((token & CORE_DATA_PARAM_TXN_COUNTER_MASK) != 0u));
}

#pragma location = CORE_DATA_VISDBG_ADDR
__no_init volatile visionDebugToFlightStruct visionDebugRegion;

    __DSB();
}

void coreDataWriteVisionToFlight(const visionToFlightStruct* src)
{
    if (0 == src) return;
    memcpy((void*) &visionRegion, src, sizeof(visionToFlightStruct));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &visionRegion, sizeof(visionToFlightStruct));
}

void coreDataReadVisionToFlight(visionToFlightStruct* dst)
{
    if (0 == dst) return;
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &visionRegion, sizeof(visionToFlightStruct));
    memcpy(dst, (const void*) &visionRegion, sizeof(visionToFlightStruct));
}

void coreDataWriteFlightToVision(const flightToVisionStruct* src)
{
    uint32_t generation;
    if (0 == src) return;
    generation = nextFlightPublishGeneration();
    publishFlightMarker(generation - 1u);
    memcpy((void*) &flightRegion, src, sizeof(flightToVisionStruct));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &flightRegion, sizeof(flightToVisionStruct));
    __DSB();
    publishFlightMarker(generation);
}

uint8_t coreDataTryReadFlightToVision(flightToVisionStruct* dst,
    uint32_t* generation)
{
    coreDataFlightMarkerStruct before;
    coreDataFlightMarkerStruct after;
    flightToVisionStruct snapshot;

    if ((dst == 0) || (generation == 0)) return 0u;
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &flightMarkerRegion,
        sizeof(flightMarkerRegion));
    __DSB();
    memcpy(&before, (const void*) &flightMarkerRegion, sizeof(before));
    if ((before.magic != CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) ||
        (before.generation == 0u) || ((before.generation & 1u) != 0u))
        return 0u;

    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &flightRegion,
        sizeof(flightToVisionStruct));
    __DSB();
    memcpy(&snapshot, (const void*) &flightRegion, sizeof(snapshot));

    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &flightMarkerRegion,
        sizeof(flightMarkerRegion));
    __DSB();
    memcpy(&after, (const void*) &flightMarkerRegion, sizeof(after));
    if ((after.magic != before.magic) ||
        (after.generation != before.generation) ||
        ((after.generation & 1u) != 0u))
        return 0u;

    *dst = snapshot;
    *generation = after.generation;
    return 1u;
}

    if (0 == src) return;
    memcpy((void*) &kvmStatusRegion, src, sizeof(kvmStatusToMenuStruct));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &kvmStatusRegion, sizeof(kvmStatusToMenuStruct));
}

uint8_t coreDataTryReadKvmStatusToMenu(kvmStatusToMenuStruct* dst)
{
    kvmStatusToMenuStruct first;
    kvmStatusToMenuStruct second;
    uint8_t attempt;
    if (0 == dst) return 0u;
    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &kvmStatusRegion, sizeof(kvmStatusToMenuStruct));
        memcpy(&first, (const void*) &kvmStatusRegion, sizeof(first));
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &kvmStatusRegion, sizeof(kvmStatusToMenuStruct));
        memcpy(&second, (const void*) &kvmStatusRegion, sizeof(second));
        if (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0)
        {
            *dst = second;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

void coreDataWriteParamToFlight(const paramToFlightStruct* src)
{
    paramToFlightStruct frame;
    uint32_t committed;

    if (0 == src) return;

    frame = *src;
    committed = nextParamCommitToken();

    /* 先单独发布奇数marker，使跨多cache line的后续复制全程不可被接受。 */
    paramRegion.cm71ParamReady = committed | 1u;
    cleanParamMarker();

    frame.cm71ParamReady = committed | 1u;
    memcpy((void*) &paramRegion, &frame, sizeof(frame));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &paramRegion, sizeof(paramToFlightStruct));
    __DSB();

    /* payload全部可见后，最后把marker提交为对应偶数。 */
    paramRegion.cm71ParamReady = committed;
    cleanParamMarker();
}

uint8_t coreDataReadParamToFlight(paramToFlightStruct* dst)
{
    uint8_t attempt;

    if (0 == dst) return 0u;
    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        uint32_t before;
        uint32_t after;

        invalidateParamMarker();
        before = paramRegion.cm71ParamReady;
        if (paramTokenIsCommitted(before) == 0u) continue;

        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &paramRegion, sizeof(paramToFlightStruct));
        __DSB();
        memcpy(dst, (const void*) &paramRegion, sizeof(*dst));

        invalidateParamMarker();
        after = paramRegion.cm71ParamReady;
        if ((before == dst->cm71ParamReady) && (before == after) &&
            (paramTokenIsCommitted(after) != 0u))
        {
            return 1u;
        }
    }

    memset(dst, 0, sizeof(*dst));
    return 0u;
}

void coreDataWriteVisionDebugToFlight(const visionDebugToFlightStruct* src)
{
    visionDebugToFlightStruct frame;
    if (0 == src) return;

    frame = *src;
    if (frame.seq == 0u) return;

    /* 先发布BUSY，再写跨两条cache line的payload；最后单独提交READY。
     * payload阶段必须继续携带BUSY，避免第一条line先clean时提前公开半帧。 */
    visionDebugRegion.magic = CORE_DATA_VISDBG_BUSY_MAGIC;
    cleanVisionDebugMarker();
    frame.magic = CORE_DATA_VISDBG_BUSY_MAGIC;
    memcpy((void*) &visionDebugRegion, &frame, sizeof(frame));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &visionDebugRegion, sizeof(visionDebugToFlightStruct));
    __DSB();
    visionDebugRegion.magic = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    cleanVisionDebugMarker();
}

uint8_t coreDataTryReadVisionDebugToFlight(visionDebugToFlightStruct* dst)
{
    uint8_t attempt;
    if (0 == dst) return 0u;

    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        visionDebugToFlightStruct frame;
        uint32_t beforeMagic;
        uint32_t beforeSeq;
        uint32_t afterMagic;
        uint32_t afterSeq;

        invalidateVisionDebugMarker();
        beforeMagic = visionDebugRegion.magic;
        beforeSeq = visionDebugRegion.seq;
        if ((beforeMagic != CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) || (beforeSeq == 0u)) continue;

        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &visionDebugRegion,
            sizeof(visionDebugToFlightStruct));
        __DSB();
        memcpy(&frame, (const void*) &visionDebugRegion, sizeof(frame));

        invalidateVisionDebugMarker();
        afterMagic = visionDebugRegion.magic;
        afterSeq = visionDebugRegion.seq;
        if ((frame.magic == CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
            (beforeMagic == afterMagic) &&
            (beforeSeq == frame.seq) && (beforeSeq == afterSeq))
        {
            *dst = frame;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

/*
 * 核间共享内存 (cm_7_0 飞控 ↔ cm_7_1 视觉)
 *
 * 物理区域: section .global_ram_data
 *   startAddr = 0x28001000, size = 0x2000 (0x28001000 ~ 0x28002FFF)
 *   保留地址须避开: mt9v03x_h_num @ 0x28006BF0, mt9v03x_w_num @ 0x28006BF2
 *
 * 双核 D-Cache 一致性约定 (Cortex-M7, cache line = 32 字节):
 *   - 两个传输方向放在各自独立、32 字节对齐、互不共享 cache line 的区域,
 *     避免 false-sharing (一核 clean 把另一核刚写的字节冲掉)。
 *   - 写方: memcpy 进共享区 → SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr (把脏行刷回 RAM)。
 *   - 读方: SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr (丢弃过期缓存) → memcpy 出。
 *   - 握手用 32 位 magic (CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC), 防 __no_init 上电垃圾误判。
 *
 *   visionToFlight @ 0x28001000 (cm_7_1 写, cm_7_0 读)
 *   flightToVision @ 0x28001100 (cm_7_0 写, cm_7_1 读)   两区相距 256B, 绝不共享 line
 */
#ifndef CORE_DATA_TRANSFER_H
#define CORE_DATA_TRANSFER_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "flightParams.h"

#include "paramSyncGlobal.h"

/* 0x28001300 不可用: paramRegion(paramToFlightStruct≈448B)从 0x28001200 起跨过该 256B 边界,
 * 故 ^ 灯板视觉调试快照另起 0x28001400(paramRegion 止于 ~0x280013C0, 独立 cache line, 编译期断言守护)。 */

#define CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC (0x5A5AA5A6u)

#define CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE              (0u)

    ((uint8_t) (CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_FLAG | (((source) & 0x07u) << 3) | ((faultClass) & 0x07u)))
#define CORE0_FAULT_REASON_VISION_SOURCE(reason) ((uint8_t) (((reason) >> 3) & 0x07u))

/* cm_7_0 飞控 safetyState 跨核约定的非枚举值（区别于枚举 0=DISARM/1=CLOSED_LOOP/2=PROTECTED）：
 * cm_7_0 写、cm_7_1 菜单读，单一真相源（消除两 TU 各自硬编码 0xFE/0xFF）。 */
#define FLIGHT_SAFETY_TOF_INIT (0xFDu) /* ToF 上电复位与初始化重试中 */
#define FLIGHT_SAFETY_ARMING   (0xFEu) /* arming 进行中（ESC 上电阻塞期）*/
#define FLIGHT_SAFETY_IMUFAIL  (0xFFu) /* IMU 初始化失败挂起 */

/* flightToVision.systemPhase：运行owner裁决，菜单只读显示。 */
#define CORE_UX_PHASE_LINK_WAIT  (2u)
#define CORE_UX_PHASE_HOME       (3u)
#define CORE_UX_PHASE_REJOIN     (4u)
#define CORE_UX_PHASE_STANDALONE (5u)

/* 启动健康清单位。failedMask 只记录具有可靠返回值的初始化失败；void 型 SDK
 * 只能进入 unverifiedMask，禁止伪造成 FAIL。两核各自填本地位后由屏幕 owner 合并。 */
#define CORE0_INIT_FAIL_IMU          (0x01u)
#define CORE0_INIT_FAIL_TOF          (0x02u)
#define CORE0_INIT_FAIL_OPTICAL_FLOW (0x04u)

/* cm_7_1 视觉 → cm_7_0 飞控 (32 字节, 单 cache line) */
typedef struct
{
    float visionErrX;          /* 像素误差 X (目标中点可调), 已乘极性 */
    float visionErrY;          /* 像素误差 Y */
    float visionYawErr;        /* ^ 朝向误差 (rad, wrapToPi), 已乘极性 */
    uint8_t visionTargetValid; /* 1=锁定有效, 0=丢失 */
    uint8_t padding0[3];
    uint32_t cm71Ready; /* = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC 表示 cm_7_1 初始化完成 */
    uint32_t visionSeq; /* 每发布一帧 +1，cm_7_0 据此判新鲜度（陈旧则弃用误差） */
    float visionVelX;   /* 原始质心按实测帧间隔差分后的低通速度 X (px/s)，已乘极性 */
    float visionVelY;   /* 原始质心按实测帧间隔差分后的低通速度 Y (px/s)，已乘极性 */
} visionToFlightStruct;

/* cm_7_0 飞控 → cm_7_1 视觉 (64 字节, 2 cache line; 调试显示用) */
typedef struct
{
    float pitch;         /* rad */
    float roll;          /* rad */
    float yaw;           /* rad */
    float altMm;         /* 定高距离 mm */
    float baseThr;       /* 基准油门 % */
    float motorPct[4];   /* FL/FR/BL/BR 油门 % */
    uint8_t safetyState; /* 安全状态机枚举 */
    uint8_t armProgress; /* arming 进度 0~100 */
    uint8_t tofHealthy;  /* = altitudeHoldIsHealthy()：1=链路活&&测距可信&&突变保护未悬挂(可发车)；
                          * 0 覆盖 init 失败/无效 range_status/距离越界/突变悬挂/链路失活 */
    uint8_t startupStateValid; /* 1=ARMING/TOF_INIT 启动状态有效；不等价于最终初始化完成 */
    uint32_t cm70Ready; /* = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC 表示 cm_7_0 初始化完成 */
    /* 速度观测器状态（KF 机体水平航向系 m/s，发车页显示），保持64B/2 cache line。 */
    float velX;         /* KF 前向速度 m/s（axis[0]） */
    float velY;         /* KF 右向速度 m/s（axis[1]） */
    uint8_t velValid;   /* 1=KF 估计可信（velocityEstimatorIsValid） */
    uint8_t padding1[3];
    uint8_t core1LinkUp;   /* 远程菜单: 1=core1 核间链路在线(cm_7_0 crossCoreLink 心跳未超时)，供 cm_7_1 菜单断联保护/禁发车 */
    uint8_t core2LinkLost; /* 1=core1 已报告 RS-485↔core2 断联；供 cm_7_1 发车页显示/禁发车 */
    uint8_t requiredVisionFault; /* 1=Core1报告任一必需视觉故障 */
    uint8_t systemPhase;   /* 2=LINK_WAIT 3=HOME 4=REJOIN 5=STANDALONE */
    uint8_t primaryReason; /* 0=READY 1=C1 2=C2 3=VISION 4=C2 ATT */
    uint8_t initFailedMask;     /* CORE0_INIT_FAIL_*，cm_7_0 可观测失败 */
    uint8_t initUnverifiedMask; /* 无可靠自检的活动外设；只显示 CHECK */
    uint8_t latchedFaultReason; /* CORE0_FAULT_REASON_*；cm_7_0 首因锁存，K5 ACK 清除 */
} flightToVisionStruct;

/* cm_7_1 菜单 → cm_7_0 飞控 (参数热重载 + 指令通道) @ 0x28001200
 *   - params: 全量飞控参数，cm_7_0 在 paramSeq 变化时整块 apply 热重载
 *   - paramSeq: 参数 dirty 计数器，cm_7_1 每次下发参数 +1
 *   - cmdLaunchSeq: 发车指令边沿计数器，cm_7_0 检测增量触发起控
 *   - cmdStandbySeq: 回待机指令边沿计数器，cm_7_0 检测增量触发 CLOSED_LOOP→DISARMED
 *   - cmdClearSeq: 清空/恢复默认指令边沿计数器（参数已在 params 内回默认）
 *   - cm71BootEpoch: cm_7_1 每次启动由共享区上一帧 cm71BootEpoch+1 派生（共享区跨 cm_7_1
 *     复位保留，故单调递增，每次复位必不同）。cm_7_0 据"epoch 变化 或 任一 seq 相对 last
 *     回退"判定对端复位，只重同步 lastParamSeq/lastCmd*Seq，绝不产生发车/热重载，杜绝
 *     cm_7_1 重启把计数器回退(N→0)被误判成新边沿（会清突变悬挂 + 误恢复闭环）。
 *   - cm71ParamReady: 由共享区owner写入的奇偶事务token；调用方不得自行赋值或解释
 * 单向 (cm_7_1 写 / cm_7_0 读)，整块 clean/invalidate。注意这不是硬件原子事务：本结构
 * 跨多 cache line，cm_7_0 读到的是某次写之后的一致快照（写方整块 clean、读方整块
 * invalidate），靠 epoch/seq 边沿与回退判据防误触发，而非依赖单拍原子性。
 * 起始 0x28001200 与 flightToVision(0x28001100) 相距 256B，独立 cache line。 */
typedef struct
{
    flightParamsStruct params;
    uint32_t paramSeq;
    uint32_t cmdLaunchSeq;
    uint32_t cmdStandbySeq;
    uint32_t cmdClearSeq;
    uint32_t cm71BootEpoch;
    uint32_t cm71ParamReady;    /* 私有事务token；仅coreDataTransfer读写 */
    uint32_t kvmRouteEpoch;      /* 每次切目标递增；旧 route 的事件/ACK 自动失效 */
    uint32_t kvmEventSeq;        /* 当前 route 内事件序号，0=尚无事件 */
    uint8_t  kvmTarget;          /* 0=Core0, 1=Core1, 3=Core3 */
    uint8_t  kvmKeyId;           /* 0..4 = K1..K5 */
    uint8_t  kvmKeyState;        /* menuKeyStateEnum: 1=SHORT 2=LONG */
    uint8_t  kvmFlags;           /* bit0=本 route 有待确认事件 */
} paramToFlightStruct;

typedef char coreData_flight_params_size_assert[(sizeof(flightParamsStruct) == 420u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char coreData_param_to_flight_size_assert[(sizeof(paramToFlightStruct) == 456u) ? 1 : -1];

/* cm_7_1 视觉 → cm_7_0 (^ 灯板轮廓快照, 单向) @ 0x28001400
 *   cm_7_1 每帧从chevronDetector写本区；cm_7_0用于Policy事实与Core0 Pose，不连接串口调试输出。
 *   结构跨两条cache line，写方以magic BUSY→payload→READY两阶段提交；读方还校验前后seq，
 *   TryRead碰撞失败不得修改last-good。seq每个已提交帧+1并跳过0。
 *   与 paramRegion(0x28001200)独立 cache line, 无 false-sharing。字段布局按 4 字节对齐(padding0 补 selectedSize 后空隙)。 */
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t magic; /* = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC 表示 cm_7_1 已写过 */
    uint32_t seq;   /* 每个已提交帧+1并跳过0；同时参与事务一致性确认 */
    uint8_t  trackingState;  /* OM_TRACK_SEARCHING/ACQUIRING/LOCKED/LOST_HOLDING */
    uint8_t  contourCount;   /* 有效闭合轮廓数 */
    uint8_t  selectedIndex;  /* 选中轮廓索引 */
    uint8_t  targetLost;     /* 1=目标本体丢失(无候选/Hu超阈/触边) */
    uint16_t selectedCenterX; /* 选中轮廓原始质心 X */
    uint16_t selectedCenterY; /* 选中轮廓原始质心 Y */
    float    filteredCenterX; /* 发布质心 X（字段名保留；默认不过滤） */
    float    filteredCenterY; /* 发布质心 Y（字段名保留；默认不过滤） */
    uint16_t selectedSize;   /* 选中轮廓像素数 */
    uint8_t  orientationFresh; /* 1=本帧朝向样本被接受且已有可信基线 */
    uint8_t  padding0;       /* 对齐: 补 selectedSize 后到 selectedHuDistance 的 4 字节边界 */
    float    selectedHuDistance;   /* 选中轮廓 Hu 距离(0=未参与 Hu) */
    float    orientation;          /* 朝向 rad(-PI~PI) */
    float    orientationConfidence;/* 本帧朝向置信度 0~1(低置信只拒绝朝向更新) */
    uint8_t  orientProtectState;   /* OM_ORIENT_NORMAL/SUSPENDED */
    uint8_t  orientSpikeFrameCount;/* 朝向跳变保护确认帧计数 */
    uint8_t  lostFrameCount;
    uint8_t  lockFrameCount;
} visionDebugToFlightStruct;

/* 编译期断言(照搬 core1 typedef-char 负长度惯用法): 地址不与 paramRegion 重叠 + 32 字节对齐 + 不越共享段尾 + 结构不超 128B。 */
typedef char coreData_visdbg_after_param_assert[(CORE_DATA_PARAM_ADDR + sizeof(paramToFlightStruct) <= CORE_DATA_VISDBG_ADDR) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char coreData_visdbg_align_assert[((CORE_DATA_VISDBG_ADDR % 32u) == 0u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char coreData_visdbg_end_assert[(CORE_DATA_VISDBG_ADDR + sizeof(visionDebugToFlightStruct) <= 0x28003000u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char coreData_visdbg_exact_size_assert[(sizeof(visionDebugToFlightStruct) == 44u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char coreData_visdbg_size_assert[(sizeof(visionDebugToFlightStruct) <= 128u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char coreData_visdbg_before_param_sync_assert[
    ((CORE_DATA_VISDBG_ADDR + sizeof(visionDebugToFlightStruct)) <=
        PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_ADDR) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char coreData_param_sync_region_end_assert[
    ((PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_ADDR + PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_BYTES) <=
        0x28002000u) ? 1 : -1];

/* cm_7_1 调用: 写参数+指令 (Clean) */
void coreDataWriteParamToFlight(const paramToFlightStruct* src);
/* cm_7_0 调用: 读参数+指令 (Invalidate) */
uint8_t coreDataReadParamToFlight(paramToFlightStruct* dst);


/* cm_7_1 调用: 写视觉结果 (Clean) */
void coreDataWriteVisionToFlight(const visionToFlightStruct* src);
/* cm_7_0 调用: 读视觉结果 (Invalidate) */
void coreDataReadVisionToFlight(visionToFlightStruct* dst);

/* cm_7_0 调用: 写飞控调试数据 (Clean) */
void coreDataWriteFlightToVision(const flightToVisionStruct* src);
/* marker事务读：成功返回1并返回已确认的非零偶数generation；
 * 未提交/读写碰撞时返回0，且不修改dst或generation。 */
uint8_t coreDataTryReadFlightToVision(flightToVisionStruct* dst,
    uint32_t* generation);

void coreDataWriteKvmStatusToMenu(const kvmStatusToMenuStruct* src);
/* 事务读：成功返回1；连续三轮读碰撞时返回0且不修改dst。 */
uint8_t coreDataTryReadKvmStatusToMenu(kvmStatusToMenuStruct* dst);

/* cm_7_0链路核与cm_7_1菜单核之间的全局五槽事务状态/请求桥。 */
void coreDataWriteParamGlobalState(const paramSyncGlobalState *src);
void coreDataClearParamGlobalState(void);
uint8_t coreDataTryReadParamGlobalState(paramSyncGlobalState *dst);
void coreDataWriteParamGlobalRequest(const paramSyncGlobalRequest *src);
uint8_t coreDataTryReadParamGlobalRequest(paramSyncGlobalRequest *dst);

/* cm_7_1 调用: 写 ^ 灯板视觉调试快照 (Clean) */
void coreDataWriteVisionDebugToFlight(const visionDebugToFlightStruct* src);
/* cm_7_0调用：一致性事务读；成功返回1，碰撞/未提交返回0且不修改dst。 */
uint8_t coreDataTryReadVisionDebugToFlight(visionDebugToFlightStruct* dst);

#endif  // CORE_DATA_TRANSFER_H

#define CCL_KVM_STATUS_LOST_MS         (600u)
#define CCL_CORE0_POSE_MAX_X           ((float) (MT9V03X_W - 1u))
#define CCL_CORE0_POSE_MAX_Y           ((float) (MT9V03X_H - 1u))
#define CCL_POSE_PI                    (3.14159265358979323846f)
#define CCL_OM_TRACK_LOCKED            (2u) /* 与 openMorph.h OM_TRACK_LOCKED 同线值；避免 cm_7_0 引入视觉模块头 */
#define CCL_OM_ORIENT_NORMAL           (0u) /* 与 openMorph.h OM_ORIENT_NORMAL 同线值 */

typedef struct
{

    uartLinkFrameStruct rxQueue[CCL_RX_QUEUE_SIZE];

    volatile uint8_t rxTail;
    volatile uint8_t rxCount;
