    volatile uint8_t paramRxTail;
    volatile uint8_t paramRxCount;
    volatile uint8_t initReadyFlag;
    volatile uint8_t heartbeatSendFlag;
    volatile uint8_t kvmControlSendFlag;
    volatile uint8_t statusSendFlag;
    volatile uint8_t poseSendFlag;
    volatile uint16_t heartbeatTickCount;
    volatile uint16_t kvmControlTickCount;
    volatile uint16_t poseTickCount;
    volatile uint16_t core1QuietMs; /* 距上次收到 core1 合法帧 ms(ISR 累加, 收帧清零) */
    /* 运动前馈(MOTION 帧, core1 转发 core2 LoRa 遥控值): 前台 Poll 存值, Pit1ms 累加超时计时。 */
    float motionVx; /* 前台单写(Poll)/单读(GetMotion), 不进 ISR, 无需 volatile */
    float motionVy;
    float motionWz;
    uint8_t motionTakeoffReq;        /* MOTION 帧 flags bit0: 模式3 车 S3+S4 请求(前台 Poll 写/Get 读) */
    uint32_t motionRxSeq;            /* 本地 MOTION 接收序号：每收到一帧自增，供调用方区分新帧与旧值保持 */
    volatile uint16_t motionQuietMs; /* 距上次 MOTION 帧 ms(Pit1ms 累加, Poll 收帧清零); 超时判遥控失联 */
    volatile uint8_t motionWirePrimed;
    uint8_t motionSessionFenced;
    uint8_t motionWireSeq;
    volatile uint16_t statusQuietMs; /* 距上次前进STATUS帧ms；与整链路存活正交 */
    uint8_t statusWirePrimed;
    uint8_t statusWireSeq;
    uint32_t producerBootSession;
    uint8_t mode2LoraLandReqArmed;     /* 新鲜低电平建立基线后才允许下一次高电平 */
    uint8_t mode2RequestBaselineValid; /* 仅前进的真实低STATUS建立；stale后禁止伪低累计rearm */
    uint8_t core1ReportedCore2Lost;    /* STATUS 帧 linkFlags bit1: core1 报告 RS-485↔core2 断联(前台 Poll 写/Get 读)。
                                        * core1 自身死时此值陈旧, 由 IsCore1Alive() 在缓降/发车拦截中兜底。 */
    uint8_t core1ReportedCore2AttitudeFault;
    uint8_t core1ReportedRequiredVisionFault;
    uint8_t core1ReportedFaultSource;
    uint8_t core1ReportedFaultClass;
    uint8_t core1ReportedMode2LoraLandReq; /* STATUS 帧 linkFlags bit2: 模式2 LoRa 双肩键调试缓降请求(前台 Poll 写/Get 读)。 */
    uint16_t core1ReportedBeaconCount;
    uint32_t statusRxSeq;
    uint32_t beaconStateSeq;
    uint8_t core1ReportedBeaconSearching;
    uint8_t core1ReportedBeaconSearchTimedOut;
    uint8_t core1ReportedBeaconStateValid;
    uint8_t beaconStatePrimed;
    volatile uint8_t controlActive; /* 1=core0 远程模式(操控 core1), 心跳携带给 core1 画绿框 */
    /* CORE0_STATUS 帧内容(前台 SetCore0Status 写, 前台发送; 与心跳同周期发出供 core1 RGB 灯) */
    volatile uint8_t c0SafetyState;
    volatile uint8_t c0ArmProgress;
    volatile uint8_t c0StatusFlags;
    volatile uint8_t c0SysCtrl; /* 空地系统模式/RGB意图/到顶(crossCoreLinkSetSysControl 写) */
    volatile uint8_t c0Buzzer;  /* 蜂鸣模式码(中转 core2) */
    uint8_t statusTxSequence;
    uint8_t poseTxSequence;
    uint8_t poseEpoch;
    uint8_t posePrimed; /* 1=已记录本次 core0 启动后的 visionDebug 基线 seq */
    uint8_t heartbeatSequence;
    uint8_t kvmControlSequence;
    uint8_t kvmEventSequence;
    uint32_t poseLastSeq; /* 已处理的 visionDebugRegion.seq */
    uint32_t rxFrameCount;
    uint32_t rxErrorCount;
    uint32_t kvmRouteSession;
    uint32_t kvmRouteEpoch;
    uint32_t kvmEventSeq;
    uint32_t kvmTargetSession;
    volatile uint16_t kvmRetryTickMs;
    volatile uint16_t kvmStatusQuietMs;
    uint8_t kvmTarget;
    uint8_t kvmKeyId;
    uint8_t kvmKeyState;
    volatile uint8_t kvmEventPending;
    volatile uint8_t kvmEventSendFlag;
    uint8_t kvmPeerRestartLatched;
    kvmStatusToMenuStruct kvmStatus;
    paramSyncMailboxRequest paramAssembly;
    paramSyncMailboxResponse paramResponse;
    uint32_t paramRequestSequence;
    uint32_t paramWireRequestId;
    uint32_t paramOwnerBootGeneration;
    uint16_t paramExpectedBytes;
    uint16_t paramReceivedBytes;
    volatile uint16_t paramQuietMs;
    uint8_t paramAssemblyActive;
    uint8_t paramRequestPublished;
    uint8_t paramResponseValid;
    uint8_t paramTxSequence;
    paramSyncGlobalState paramGlobalState;
    paramSyncGlobalRequest paramGlobalRequest;
    uint32_t paramGlobalRequestBoot;
    uint32_t paramGlobalRequestSequence;
    volatile uint16_t paramGlobalStateQuietMs;
    volatile uint16_t paramGlobalRequestTxMs;
    uint8_t paramGlobalStateValid;
    uint8_t paramGlobalRequestAcked;
    uint8_t paramGlobalTxSequence;
} crossCoreLinkStateStruct;

static crossCoreLinkStateStruct cclState;
__no_init uint8_t cclPoseEpochRetained;
__no_init uint32_t cclParamBridgeBootRetained;
__no_init uint32_t cclParamMailboxRequestRetained;

static uint8_t cclStatusFrameSemanticValid(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame);
static uint8_t cclBindProducerSessionFromStatus(uint32_t session);
static uint8_t cclMotionSessionMatches(uint32_t session);

static uint8_t cclWireSeqAdvanced(uint8_t sequence, uint8_t previous)
{
    uint8_t delta = (uint8_t) (sequence - previous);
    return (uint8_t) ((delta != 0u) && (delta < 128u));
}

static uint8_t cclMotionFrameUsable(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    if ((frame == 0) ||
        ((frame->motionFlags & (uint8_t) ~UART_LINK_MOTION_FLAG_TAKEOFF_REQ) != 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    /* NaN使全部有序比较为false，Inf越界；无需在高频前台引入libm。 */
    return (uint8_t) ((frame->motionVx > -CCL_MOTION_ABS_MAX) &&
                      (frame->motionVx < CCL_MOTION_ABS_MAX) &&
                      (frame->motionVy > -CCL_MOTION_ABS_MAX) &&
                      (frame->motionVy < CCL_MOTION_ABS_MAX) &&
                      (frame->motionWz > -CCL_MOTION_ABS_MAX) &&
                      (frame->motionWz < CCL_MOTION_ABS_MAX));
}

static uint8_t cclMotionFrameIsZeroFence(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((frame != 0) &&
                      (frame->motionVx == 0.0f) && (frame->motionVy == 0.0f) &&
                      (frame->motionWz == 0.0f) && (frame->motionFlags == 0u));
}

static uint8_t cclStatusFrameSemanticValid(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    const uint8_t allowedFlags = UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_LINK_OK |
                                 UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_CORE2_LOST |
                                 UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ |
                                 UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT |
                                 UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCHING |
                                 UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCH_TIMEOUT |
                                 UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_VALID |
                                 UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_CORE2_ATTITUDE_FAULT;
    uint8_t faultActive;
    uint8_t beaconValid;
    uint8_t searchFlags;
    if ((frame == 0) || (frame->type != UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS) ||
        (frame->producerBootSession == 0u) ||
        ((frame->linkFlags & UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_LINK_OK) == 0u) ||
        ((frame->linkFlags & (uint8_t) ~allowedFlags) != 0u)) return 0u;
    faultActive = (frame->linkFlags &
                      UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT)
                      ? 1u
                      : 0u;
    if (((faultActive == 0u) &&
            ((frame->faultSource != 0u) || (frame->faultClass != 0u))) ||
        ((faultActive != 0u) &&
            (((frame->faultSource < 1u) || (frame->faultSource > 4u)) ||
                ((frame->faultClass < 1u) || (frame->faultClass > 7u))))) return 0u;
    beaconValid = (frame->linkFlags & UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_VALID) ? 1u : 0u;
    searchFlags = frame->linkFlags & (UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCHING |
                                         UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCH_TIMEOUT);
    if ((beaconValid == 0u) &&
        ((frame->beaconCount != 0u) || (searchFlags != 0u))) return 0u;
    if (searchFlags == (UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCHING |
                           UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCH_TIMEOUT)) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static void cclEnterStatusProtocolFault(void)
{
    cclState.statusQuietMs = CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS;
    cclState.core1ReportedCore2Lost = 1u;
    cclState.core1ReportedCore2AttitudeFault = 0u;
    cclState.core1ReportedRequiredVisionFault = 1u;
    cclState.core1ReportedFaultSource = 2u;
    cclState.core1ReportedFaultClass = 4u;
    cclState.core1ReportedMode2LoraLandReq = 0u;
    cclState.mode2LoraLandReqArmed = 0u;
    cclState.mode2RequestBaselineValid = 0u;
    cclState.motionWirePrimed = 0u;
    cclState.motionSessionFenced = 0u;
    cclState.motionVx = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionVy = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionWz = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionTakeoffReq = 0u;
    cclState.motionQuietMs = CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS;
    cclState.rxErrorCount++;
}

static void cclCommitBeaconState(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint16_t count = frame->beaconCount;
    uint8_t searching =
        (frame->linkFlags & UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCHING) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t timedOut =
        (frame->linkFlags & UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCH_TIMEOUT) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t valid =
        (frame->linkFlags & UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_VALID) ? 1u : 0u;

    if ((cclState.beaconStatePrimed == 0u) ||
        (count != cclState.core1ReportedBeaconCount) ||
        (searching != cclState.core1ReportedBeaconSearching) ||
        (timedOut != cclState.core1ReportedBeaconSearchTimedOut) ||
        (valid != cclState.core1ReportedBeaconStateValid))
    {
        cclState.core1ReportedBeaconCount = count;
        cclState.core1ReportedBeaconSearching = searching;
        cclState.core1ReportedBeaconSearchTimedOut = timedOut;
        cclState.core1ReportedBeaconStateValid = valid;
        cclState.beaconStatePrimed = 1u;
        cclState.beaconStateSeq++;
        if (cclState.beaconStateSeq == 0u) cclState.beaconStateSeq = 1u;
    }
}

static void cclHandleStatusFrame(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint8_t mode2High =
        (frame->linkFlags & UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t statusStale =
        (cclState.statusQuietMs >= CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t sequenceAdvanced = (cclState.statusWirePrimed == 0u) ? 1u : cclWireSeqAdvanced(frame->sequence, cclState.statusWireSeq);

    if (statusStale != 0u)
    {
        cclState.core1ReportedMode2LoraLandReq = 0u;
        cclState.mode2LoraLandReqArmed = 0u;
        cclState.mode2RequestBaselineValid = 0u;
    }
    if (sequenceAdvanced != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t faultActive = (frame->linkFlags &
                                  UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT)
                                  ? 1u
                                  : 0u;
        cclState.statusWirePrimed = 1u;
        cclState.statusWireSeq = frame->sequence;
        cclState.statusRxSeq++;
        if (cclState.statusRxSeq == 0u) cclState.statusRxSeq = 1u;
        cclState.statusQuietMs = 0u;
        cclCommitBeaconState(frame);
        cclState.core1ReportedCore2Lost =
            (frame->linkFlags & UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_CORE2_LOST) ? 1u : 0u;
        cclState.core1ReportedCore2AttitudeFault =
            (frame->linkFlags & UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_CORE2_ATTITUDE_FAULT) ? 1u : 0u;
        if (((faultActive == 0u) &&
                ((frame->faultSource != 0u) || (frame->faultClass != 0u))) ||
            ((faultActive != 0u) &&
                (((frame->faultSource < 1u) || (frame->faultSource > 4u)) ||
                    ((frame->faultClass < 1u) || (frame->faultClass > 7u)))))
        {
            cclState.core1ReportedRequiredVisionFault = 1u;
            cclState.core1ReportedFaultSource = 2u;
            cclState.core1ReportedFaultClass = 4u;
        }
        else
        {
            cclState.core1ReportedRequiredVisionFault = faultActive;
            cclState.core1ReportedFaultSource = frame->faultSource;
            cclState.core1ReportedFaultClass = frame->faultClass;
        }
        if (mode2High == 0u)
        {
            cclState.core1ReportedMode2LoraLandReq = 0u;
            cclState.mode2LoraLandReqArmed = 1u;
            cclState.mode2RequestBaselineValid = 1u;
        }
        else if (cclState.mode2LoraLandReqArmed != 0u)
        {
            cclState.core1ReportedMode2LoraLandReq = 1u;
            cclState.mode2LoraLandReqArmed = 0u;
        }
    }
    else if ((statusStale != 0u) && (mode2High == 0u))
    {
        /* 隔离重建帧只重锚wire身份，不刷新任何业务事实或本地业务序号。
         * 下一前进低帧才恢复STATUS，并重新开始Coordinator的400ms rearm。 */
        cclState.statusWirePrimed = 1u;
        cclState.statusWireSeq = frame->sequence;
    }
}

static uint8_t cclNextIndex(uint8_t index)
{
    index++;
    if (index >= CCL_RX_QUEUE_SIZE) index = 0u;
    return index;
}

static uint8_t cclNextParamIndex(uint8_t index)
{
    index++;
    if (index >= CCL_PARAM_RX_QUEUE_SIZE) index = 0u;
    return index;
}

/* ISR 上下文: 解析一字节, 成帧入队; 轻量, 不做共享内存/DCache。 */
static void cclHandleByte(uint8_t data)
{
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    uartLinkProtoStatusEnum status = uartLinkProtoInputByte(&cclState.parser, data, &frame);

    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_FRAME_READY != status)
    {
        if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_CHECK_ERROR == status || UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_TAIL_ERROR == status || UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_TYPE_ERROR == status)
        {
            cclState.rxErrorCount++;
        }
        return;
    }

    /* 参数同步不得挤占控制队列，也不得给控制/状态链路续鲜。参数队列满时
     * 丢弃本帧并依靠发送端重试，绝不淘汰既有控制帧。 */
    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_REQUEST == frame.type)
    {
        if (cclState.paramRxCount >= CCL_PARAM_RX_QUEUE_SIZE)
        {
            cclState.rxErrorCount++;
            return;
        }
        cclState.paramRxQueue[cclState.paramRxTail] = frame;
        cclState.paramRxTail = cclNextParamIndex(cclState.paramRxTail);
        cclState.paramRxCount++;
        cclState.rxFrameCount++;
        return;
    }
    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE == frame.type)
    {
        cclState.rxErrorCount++;
        return;
    }
    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE == frame.type)
    {
        if (cclState.rxCount >= CCL_RX_QUEUE_SIZE)
        {
            cclState.rxErrorCount++;
            return;
        }
        cclState.rxQueue[cclState.rxTail] = frame;
        cclState.rxTail = cclNextIndex(cclState.rxTail);
        cclState.rxCount++;
        return;
    }
    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST == frame.type)
    {
        cclState.rxErrorCount++;
        return;
    }
    cclState.core1QuietMs = 0u; /* 仅业务/控制合法帧证明 core1 控制链在线 */

    if (cclState.rxCount >= CCL_RX_QUEUE_SIZE)
    {
        cclState.rxHead = cclNextIndex(cclState.rxHead);
        cclState.rxCount--;
    }
    cclState.rxQueue[cclState.rxTail] = frame;
    cclState.rxTail = cclNextIndex(cclState.rxTail);
    cclState.rxCount++;
    cclState.rxFrameCount++;
}

static uint8_t cclPopFrame(uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint8_t got = 0u;
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 0u);
    if (cclState.rxCount > 0u)
    {
        *frame = cclState.rxQueue[cclState.rxHead];
        cclState.rxHead = cclNextIndex(cclState.rxHead);
        cclState.rxCount--;
        got = 1u;
    }
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 1u);
    return got;
}

static void cclSendHeartbeat(void)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_HEARTBEAT;
    frame.sequence = cclState.heartbeatSequence;
    /* value 携带操控态: 1=core0 远程模式正操控 core1, 0=本地模式。core1 据此画绿/红边框。 */
    frame.value = cclState.controlActive ? 1u : 0u;
    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK == uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, (uint8_t) sizeof(buffer)))
    {
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH);
        cclState.heartbeatSequence++;
    }
}

static uint8_t cclPopParamFrame(uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint8_t got = 0u;
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 0u);
    if (cclState.paramRxCount > 0u)
    {
        *frame = cclState.paramRxQueue[cclState.paramRxHead];
        cclState.paramRxHead = cclNextParamIndex(cclState.paramRxHead);
        cclState.paramRxCount--;
        got = 1u;
    }
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 1u);
    return got;
}

static void cclSendParamGlobalRequest(const paramSyncGlobalRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    if ((request == 0) || (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(request) == 0u)) return;
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST;
    frame.sequence = cclState.paramGlobalTxSequence++;
    frame.paramGlobalRequest = *request;
    if (uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) == UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK)
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
}

static void cclCancelPendingParamGlobalRequest(void)
{
    if ((cclState.paramGlobalRequestAcked == 0u) &&
        (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&cclState.paramGlobalRequest) != 0u))
        cclState.paramGlobalRequestAcked = 1u;
}

static void cclAcceptParamGlobalState(const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    uint8_t accept;
    if (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(state) == 0u)
    {
        cclState.paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
        cclState.paramGlobalStateQuietMs = CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS;
        coreDataClearParamGlobalState();
        cclCancelPendingParamGlobalRequest();
        cclState.rxErrorCount++;
        return;
    }
    accept = (uint8_t) ((cclState.paramGlobalStateValid == 0u) ||
        (state->coordinatorBootGeneration !=
            cclState.paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration) ||
        ((uint32_t) (state->sequence - cclState.paramGlobalState.sequence) <
            0x80000000u && state->sequence != cclState.paramGlobalState.sequence));
    if (accept == 0u) return;
    if ((paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&cclState.paramGlobalRequest) != 0u) &&
        (cclState.paramGlobalRequestAcked == 0u))
    {
        if ((cclState.paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration != 0u) &&
            (state->coordinatorBootGeneration !=
                cclState.paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration))
            cclState.paramGlobalRequestAcked = 1u;
        else if (paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(state,
                     &cclState.paramGlobalRequest) != 0u)
            cclState.paramGlobalRequestAcked = 1u;
    }
    cclState.paramGlobalState = *state;
    cclState.paramGlobalStateValid = 1u;
    cclState.paramGlobalStateQuietMs = 0u;
    coreDataWriteParamGlobalState(state);
}

static void cclSendParamResponse(const uartLinkFrameStruct *request,
    uint8_t status, const uint8_t *data, uint8_t length, uint16_t offset)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_PARAM];
    uartLinkFrameStruct response;
    uint8_t i;
    memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
    response.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE;
    response.sequence = cclState.paramTxSequence++;
    response.paramOp = (request->paramOp == UART_LINK_PARAM_OP_POLL &&
        cclState.paramResponseValid != 0u) ?
        cclState.paramAssembly.op : request->paramOp;
    response.paramReserved = request->paramReserved;
    response.paramTarget = request->paramTarget;
    response.paramStatus = status;
    response.paramRequestId = request->paramRequestId;
    response.paramOffset = offset;
    response.paramLength = length;
    for (i = 0u; i < length; i++) response.paramData[i] = data[i];
    if (uartLinkProtoEncode(&response, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) == UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK)
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
}

static void cclResetParamTransport(void)
{
    cclState.paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
    cclState.paramRequestPublished = 0u;
    cclState.paramResponseValid = 0u;
    cclState.paramExpectedBytes = 0u;
    cclState.paramReceivedBytes = 0u;
    cclState.paramWireRequestId = 0u;
    cclState.paramQuietMs = CCL_PARAM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS;
}

static uint8_t cclParamIdentityMatches(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((frame->paramRequestId ==
                          cclState.paramWireRequestId) &&
                      (frame->paramOp == cclState.paramAssembly.op) &&
                      (frame->paramReserved == 0u) &&
                      (frame->paramTarget == cclState.paramAssembly.target));
}

static uint8_t cclPublishParamAssembly(void)
{
    cclState.paramAssembly.dataLength = cclState.paramExpectedBytes;
    cclState.paramRequestSequence++;
    if (cclState.paramRequestSequence == 0u) cclState.paramRequestSequence = 1u;
    cclParamMailboxRequestRetained++;
    if (cclParamMailboxRequestRetained == 0u)
        cclParamMailboxRequestRetained = 1u;
    cclState.paramAssembly.producerBootGeneration = cclParamBridgeBootRetained;
    cclState.paramAssembly.sequence = cclState.paramRequestSequence;
    cclState.paramAssembly.transactionId = cclParamMailboxRequestRetained;
    cclState.paramAssembly.offset = cclState.paramRequestSequence;
    cclState.paramAssembly.slot = (cclState.paramExpectedBytes != 0u) ?
        cclState.paramAssembly.data[0] : 0u;
    if (paramSyncMailboxPublishRequest(&cclState.paramAssembly) == 0u)
    {
        cclResetParamTransport();
        return 0u;
    }
    cclState.paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
    cclState.paramRequestPublished = 1u;
    cclState.paramResponseValid = 0u;
    cclState.paramQuietMs = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static void cclHandleParamRequest(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxResponse response;
    uint8_t status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING;
    uint8_t length = 0u;
    uint8_t data[UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES];
    uint16_t offset = frame->paramOffset;
    if (frame->paramOp == UART_LINK_PARAM_OP_POLL)
    {
        uint16_t remaining;
        if ((frame->paramLength != 0u) || (frame->paramStatus != 0u) ||
            (cclState.paramRequestPublished == 0u) ||
            (frame->paramRequestId != cclState.paramWireRequestId) ||
            (frame->paramReserved != 0u) ||
            (frame->paramTarget != cclState.paramAssembly.target))
        {
            cclResetParamTransport();
            status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
        }
        else
        {
            cclState.paramQuietMs = 0u;
            if (!cclState.paramResponseValid &&
                paramSyncMailboxTryReadResponse(&response) &&
                response.transactionId == cclState.paramAssembly.transactionId &&
                response.offset == cclState.paramAssembly.offset &&
                response.op == cclState.paramAssembly.op &&
                response.slot == cclState.paramAssembly.slot &&
                response.target == cclState.paramAssembly.target)
            {
                if ((response.producerBootGeneration == 0u) ||
                    ((cclState.paramOwnerBootGeneration != 0u) &&
                     (response.producerBootGeneration !=
                        cclState.paramOwnerBootGeneration)))
                {
                    if (response.producerBootGeneration != 0u)
                        cclState.paramOwnerBootGeneration =
                            response.producerBootGeneration;
                    cclResetParamTransport();
                    status = UART_LINK_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART;
                }
                else
                {
                    cclState.paramOwnerBootGeneration =
                        response.producerBootGeneration;
                    cclState.paramResponse = response;
                    cclState.paramResponseValid = 1u;
                }
            }
            if (cclState.paramResponseValid)
            {
                status = (uint8_t) (cclState.paramResponse.status &
                                    UART_LINK_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
                if ((status > PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED) ||
                    (offset > cclState.paramResponse.dataLength))
                {
                    cclResetParamTransport();
                    status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
                }
                else
                {
                    remaining = (uint16_t) (cclState.paramResponse.dataLength - offset);
                    length = (remaining > UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) ? UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES : (uint8_t) remaining;
                    memcpy(data, &cclState.paramResponse.data[offset], length);
                    if (remaining > length) status |= UART_LINK_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else if ((frame->paramStatus & UART_LINK_PARAM_TRANSPORT_BEGIN) != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t sameRequest = (uint8_t) (cclParamIdentityMatches(frame) &&
                                         (frame->paramOffset == cclState.paramExpectedBytes) &&
                                         ((cclState.paramAssemblyActive != 0u) ||
                                             (cclState.paramRequestPublished != 0u)));
        if ((frame->paramStatus != UART_LINK_PARAM_TRANSPORT_BEGIN) ||
            (frame->paramLength != 0u) ||
            (frame->paramReserved != 0u) ||
            (frame->paramTarget != 0u) ||
            (frame->paramOffset > PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX))
        {
            cclResetParamTransport();
            status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
        }
        else if (sameRequest != 0u)
            cclState.paramQuietMs = 0u;
        else
        {
            cclResetParamTransport();
            memset(&cclState.paramAssembly, 0, sizeof(cclState.paramAssembly));
            cclState.paramExpectedBytes = frame->paramOffset;
            cclState.paramReceivedBytes = 0u;
            cclState.paramAssembly.op = frame->paramOp;
            cclState.paramAssembly.target = frame->paramTarget;
            cclState.paramWireRequestId = frame->paramRequestId;
            cclState.paramAssemblyActive = 1u;
            cclState.paramQuietMs = 0u;
            if (cclState.paramExpectedBytes == 0u && !cclPublishParamAssembly())
                status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
        }
    }
    else if ((frame->paramStatus == 0u) && (frame->paramLength != 0u) &&
             cclParamIdentityMatches(frame) &&
             ((cclState.paramAssemblyActive != 0u) ||
                 (cclState.paramRequestPublished != 0u)) &&
             ((uint32_t) frame->paramOffset + frame->paramLength <=
                 cclState.paramExpectedBytes))
    {
        if (frame->paramOffset < cclState.paramReceivedBytes)
        {
            if (((uint32_t) frame->paramOffset + frame->paramLength >
                    cclState.paramReceivedBytes) ||
                (memcmp(&cclState.paramAssembly.data[frame->paramOffset],
                     frame->paramData, frame->paramLength) != 0))
            {
                cclResetParamTransport();
                status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
            }
            else cclState.paramQuietMs = 0u;
        }
        else if ((cclState.paramAssemblyActive != 0u) &&
                 (frame->paramOffset == cclState.paramReceivedBytes))
        {
            memcpy(&cclState.paramAssembly.data[cclState.paramReceivedBytes],
                frame->paramData, frame->paramLength);
            cclState.paramReceivedBytes = (uint16_t) (cclState.paramReceivedBytes +
                                                      frame->paramLength);
            cclState.paramQuietMs = 0u;
            if (cclState.paramReceivedBytes == cclState.paramExpectedBytes &&
                !cclPublishParamAssembly()) status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
        }
        else
        {
            cclResetParamTransport();
            status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        cclResetParamTransport();
        status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    cclSendParamResponse(frame, status, data, length, offset);
}

static void cclSendKvmControl(void)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_CONTROL];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL;
    frame.sequence = cclState.kvmControlSequence;
    frame.kvmTargetSession = cclState.kvmTargetSession;
    frame.kvmRouteSession = cclState.kvmRouteSession;
    frame.kvmRouteEpoch = cclState.kvmRouteEpoch;
    frame.kvmTarget = cclState.kvmTarget;
    frame.kvmLeaseMs = CCL_KVM_LEASE_MS;
    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK == uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, (uint8_t) sizeof(buffer)))
    {
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, (uint8_t) sizeof(buffer));
        cclState.kvmControlSequence++;
    }
}

static void cclSendKvmEvent(void)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_EVENT];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    if ((cclState.kvmEventPending == 0u) || (cclState.kvmTargetSession == 0u)) return;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT;
    frame.sequence = cclState.kvmEventSequence;
    frame.kvmTargetSession = cclState.kvmTargetSession;
    frame.kvmRouteSession = cclState.kvmRouteSession;
    frame.kvmRouteEpoch = cclState.kvmRouteEpoch;
    frame.kvmEventSeq = cclState.kvmEventSeq;
    frame.kvmTarget = cclState.kvmTarget;
    frame.kvmKeyId = cclState.kvmKeyId;
    frame.kvmKeyState = cclState.kvmKeyState;
    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK == uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, (uint8_t) sizeof(buffer)))
    {
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, (uint8_t) sizeof(buffer));
        cclState.kvmEventSequence++;
    }
}

static void cclPublishKvmStatus(void)
{
    cclState.kvmStatus.magic = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    cclState.kvmStatus.statusSeq++;
    coreDataWriteKvmStatusToMenu(&cclState.kvmStatus);
}

static void cclHandleKvmStatus(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint32_t previousSession;
    if ((frame->kvmRouteSession != cclState.kvmRouteSession) ||
        (frame->kvmRouteEpoch != cclState.kvmRouteEpoch) ||
        (frame->kvmTarget != cclState.kvmTarget))
    {
        return;
    }
    previousSession = cclState.kvmTargetSession;
    cclState.kvmTargetSession = frame->kvmTargetSession;
    if ((previousSession == 0u) && (frame->kvmTargetSession != 0u))
    {
        /* 首帧只用于发现目标session；学到真实身份后同轮补发有效CONTROL。 */
        cclState.kvmControlSendFlag = 1u;
    }
    cclState.kvmStatusQuietMs = 0u;
    cclState.kvmStatus.targetSession = frame->kvmTargetSession;
    cclState.kvmStatus.routeSession = frame->kvmRouteSession;
    cclState.kvmStatus.routeEpoch = frame->kvmRouteEpoch;
    cclState.kvmStatus.ackEventSeq = frame->kvmEventSeq;
    cclState.kvmStatus.core3AgeMs = frame->kvmCore3AgeMs;
    cclState.kvmStatus.target = frame->kvmTarget;
    cclState.kvmStatus.activeTarget = frame->kvmActiveTarget;
    cclState.kvmStatus.menuStates = frame->kvmMenuStates;
    cclState.kvmStatus.flags = frame->kvmFlags;
    cclState.kvmStatus.ackResult = frame->kvmAckResult;
    if ((previousSession != 0u) && (previousSession != frame->kvmTargetSession))
    {
        cclState.kvmPeerRestartLatched = 1u;
        if (cclState.kvmEventPending != 0u)
        {
            cclState.kvmEventPending = 0u;
            cclState.kvmStatus.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ACK_TERMINAL;
            cclState.kvmStatus.ackEventSeq = cclState.kvmEventSeq;
            cclState.kvmStatus.ackResult = UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_PEER_RESTART;
        }
    }
    else if ((cclState.kvmEventPending != 0u) &&
             ((frame->kvmFlags & UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ACK_TERMINAL) != 0u) &&
             (frame->kvmEventSeq == cclState.kvmEventSeq))
    {
        cclState.kvmEventPending = 0u;
    }
    if (cclState.kvmPeerRestartLatched != 0u)
        cclState.kvmStatus.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_PEER_RESTART;
    cclPublishKvmStatus();
}

/* 发 CORE0_STATUS 帧(10 字节)给 core1: 飞控安全态 + arming 进度 + 状态位(供 RGB 状态灯)
 * + sysCtrl(空地系统模式/RGB意图/到顶) + buzzer(蜂鸣模式码)。与心跳同周期(前台), 绝不进飞控 ISR。 */
static void cclSendCore0Status(void)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0STATUS];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS;
    frame.sequence = cclState.statusTxSequence;
    frame.safetyState = cclState.c0SafetyState;
    frame.armProgress = cclState.c0ArmProgress;
    frame.statusFlags = cclState.c0StatusFlags;
    frame.sysCtrl = cclState.c0SysCtrl; /* 空地系统模式/RGB意图/到顶(crossCoreLinkSetSysControl 写, 默认 0) */
    frame.buzzer = cclState.c0Buzzer;   /* 蜂鸣模式码(默认 SILENT=0) */
    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK == uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, (uint8_t) sizeof(buffer)))
    {
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0STATUS);
        cclState.statusTxSequence++;
    }
}

static uint8_t cclPoseFinite(float v)
{
    return (v == v && v > -100000.0f && v < 100000.0f) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static float cclPoseClamp(float v, float lo, float hi)
{
    if (v < lo) return lo;
    if (v > hi) return hi;
    return v;
}

static uint16_t cclPoseQ8(float v)
{
    if (v < 0.0f) v = 0.0f;
    if (v > 255.996f) v = 255.996f;
    return (uint16_t) (v * 256.0f + 0.5f);
}

static uint8_t cclPoseConfidenceQ8(float conf)
{
    conf = cclPoseClamp(conf, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    return (uint8_t) (conf * 255.0f + 0.5f);
}

static void cclSendCore0PoseInvalid(void)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0POSE];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE;
    frame.sequence = cclState.poseTxSequence;
    frame.poseEpoch = cclState.poseEpoch;
    frame.poseXQ8 = 0u;
    frame.poseYQ8 = 0u;
    frame.poseOrientationRad = 0.0f;
    frame.poseConfidenceQ8 = 0u;
    frame.poseFlags = 0u;
    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK == uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, (uint8_t) sizeof(buffer)))
    {
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0POSE);
        cclState.poseTxSequence++;
    }
}

static void cclBuildCore0PoseFrame(const visionDebugToFlightStruct *dbg,
    uint8_t sequence, uint8_t epoch, uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint8_t flags = 0u;
    uint8_t trackLocked;
    uint8_t sourceOk;
    uint8_t positionOk;
    uint8_t headingOk;

    if (frame == 0) return;
    memset(frame, 0, sizeof(*frame));
    frame->type = UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE;
    frame->sequence = sequence;
    frame->poseEpoch = epoch;
    if (dbg == 0) return;

    trackLocked = (dbg->trackingState == CCL_OM_TRACK_LOCKED && dbg->contourCount > 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    sourceOk = (uint8_t) (trackLocked && (dbg->targetLost == 0u));
    positionOk = (uint8_t) (sourceOk &&
                            cclPoseFinite(dbg->filteredCenterX) &&
                            cclPoseFinite(dbg->filteredCenterY) &&
                            (dbg->filteredCenterX >= 0.0f) &&
                            (dbg->filteredCenterX <= CCL_CORE0_POSE_MAX_X) &&
                            (dbg->filteredCenterY >= 0.0f) &&
                            (dbg->filteredCenterY <= CCL_CORE0_POSE_MAX_Y));
    headingOk = (uint8_t) ((dbg->orientationFresh != 0u) &&
                           (dbg->orientProtectState == CCL_OM_ORIENT_NORMAL) &&
                           cclPoseFinite(dbg->orientation) &&
                           (dbg->orientation >= -CCL_POSE_PI) &&
                           (dbg->orientation <= CCL_POSE_PI) &&
                           cclPoseFinite(dbg->orientationConfidence) &&
                           (dbg->orientationConfidence >= 0.0f) &&
                           (dbg->orientationConfidence <= 1.0f));

    if (trackLocked) flags |= UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_TRACK_LOCKED;
    if (dbg->targetLost) flags |= UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_TARGET_LOST;
    if (positionOk != 0u)
    {
        frame->poseXQ8 = cclPoseQ8(dbg->filteredCenterX);
        frame->poseYQ8 = cclPoseQ8(dbg->filteredCenterY);
        flags |= UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_POSITION_NUMERIC_VALID;
        flags |= UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_POSITION_FRESH;
    }
    if (headingOk != 0u)
    {
        frame->poseOrientationRad = dbg->orientation;
        frame->poseConfidenceQ8 = cclPoseConfidenceQ8(
            dbg->orientationConfidence);
        flags |= UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_HEADING_FRESH;
    }
    frame->poseFlags = flags;
}

static void cclSendCore0PoseFromDebug(const visionDebugToFlightStruct *dbg)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0POSE];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;

    cclBuildCore0PoseFrame(dbg, cclState.poseTxSequence,
        cclState.poseEpoch, &frame);
    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK == uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, (uint8_t) sizeof(buffer)))
    {
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0POSE);
        cclState.poseTxSequence++;
    }
}

static void cclSendCore0PoseIfDue(void)
{
    visionDebugToFlightStruct dbg;
    if (!cclState.poseSendFlag) return;
    cclState.poseSendFlag = 0u;

    if (coreDataTryReadVisionDebugToFlight(&dbg) == 0u) return;
    if (dbg.magic != CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC)
    {
        cclState.posePrimed = 0u;
        cclSendCore0PoseInvalid();
        return;
    }

    if (!cclState.posePrimed)
    {
        cclState.posePrimed = 1u;
        cclState.poseLastSeq = dbg.seq;
        cclSendCore0PoseInvalid();
        return;
    }

    if (dbg.seq == cclState.poseLastSeq)
    {
        return;
    }
    cclState.poseLastSeq = dbg.seq;
    cclSendCore0PoseFromDebug(&dbg);
}

void crossCoreLinkInit(void)
{
    cclState.rxHead = 0u;
    cclState.rxTail = 0u;
    cclState.rxCount = 0u;
    cclState.paramRxHead = 0u;
    cclState.paramRxTail = 0u;
    cclState.paramRxCount = 0u;
    cclState.heartbeatSendFlag = 0u;
    cclState.kvmControlSendFlag = 0u;
    cclState.statusSendFlag = 0u;
    cclState.poseSendFlag = 0u;
    cclState.heartbeatTickCount = 0u;
    cclState.kvmControlTickCount = 0u;
    cclState.poseTickCount = 0u;
    cclState.core1QuietMs = CCL_LINK_LOST_MS; /* 上电默认断联 */
    cclState.motionVx = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionVy = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionWz = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionRxSeq = 0u;
    cclState.motionQuietMs = CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS; /* 上电默认无遥控前馈 */
    cclState.motionWirePrimed = 0u;
    cclState.motionSessionFenced = 0u;
    cclState.motionWireSeq = 0u;
    cclState.motionTakeoffReq = 0u;
    cclState.statusQuietMs = CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS;
    cclState.statusWirePrimed = 0u;
    cclState.statusWireSeq = 0u;
    cclState.producerBootSession = 0u;
    cclState.statusRxSeq = 0u;
    cclState.mode2RequestBaselineValid = 0u;
    cclState.beaconStateSeq = 0u;
    cclState.beaconStatePrimed = 0u;
    cclState.core1ReportedBeaconCount = 0u;
    cclState.core1ReportedBeaconSearching = 0u;
    cclState.core1ReportedBeaconSearchTimedOut = 0u;
    cclState.core1ReportedBeaconStateValid = 0u;
    cclState.mode2LoraLandReqArmed = 0u;
    cclState.core1ReportedCore2Lost = 1u; /* 上电默认 core2 未确认在线; 收到 core1 STATUS 后刷新 */
    cclState.core1ReportedCore2AttitudeFault = 0u;
    cclState.core1ReportedRequiredVisionFault = 1u;
    cclState.core1ReportedFaultSource = 2u;
    cclState.core1ReportedFaultClass = 2u;
    cclState.core1ReportedMode2LoraLandReq = 0u;
    cclState.controlActive = 0u;
    cclState.c0SafetyState = 0u;
    cclState.c0ArmProgress = 0u;
    cclState.c0StatusFlags = 0u;
    cclState.c0SysCtrl = 0u;
    cclState.c0Buzzer = 0u;
    cclState.statusTxSequence = 0u;
    cclState.poseTxSequence = 0u;
    cclState.heartbeatSequence = 0u;
    cclState.kvmControlSequence = 0u;
    cclState.kvmEventSequence = 0u;
    cclResetParamTransport();
    cclState.paramRequestSequence = 0u;
    cclState.paramOwnerBootGeneration = 0u;
    cclState.paramTxSequence = 0u;
    memset(&cclState.paramGlobalState, 0, sizeof(cclState.paramGlobalState));
    memset(&cclState.paramGlobalRequest, 0,
        sizeof(cclState.paramGlobalRequest));
    cclState.paramGlobalStateQuietMs = CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS;
    cclState.paramGlobalRequestTxMs = CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_TX_MS;
    cclState.paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
    cclState.paramGlobalRequestAcked = 0u;
    cclState.paramGlobalRequestBoot = 0u;
    cclState.paramGlobalRequestSequence = 0u;
    cclState.paramGlobalTxSequence = 0u;
    cclParamBridgeBootRetained++;
    if (cclParamBridgeBootRetained == 0u) cclParamBridgeBootRetained = 1u;
    cclPoseEpochRetained++;
    if (0u == cclPoseEpochRetained) cclPoseEpochRetained = 1u;
    cclState.poseEpoch = cclPoseEpochRetained;
    cclState.posePrimed = 0u;
    cclState.poseLastSeq = 0u;
    cclState.rxFrameCount = 0u;
    cclState.rxErrorCount = 0u;
    cclState.kvmRouteSession = 0u;
    cclState.kvmRouteEpoch = 0u;
    cclState.kvmEventSeq = 0u;
    cclState.kvmTargetSession = 0u;
    cclState.kvmRetryTickMs = 0u;
    cclState.kvmStatusQuietMs = CCL_KVM_STATUS_LOST_MS;
    cclState.kvmTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    cclState.kvmKeyId = 0u;
    cclState.kvmKeyState = 0u;
    cclState.kvmEventPending = 0u;
    cclState.kvmEventSendFlag = 0u;
    cclState.kvmPeerRestartLatched = 0u;
    memset(&cclState.kvmStatus, 0, sizeof(cclState.kvmStatus));
    cclState.kvmStatus.activeTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    cclPublishKvmStatus();
    coreDataClearParamGlobalState();
    uartLinkProtoInit(&cclState.parser);

    uart_init(CCL_UART_NUM, CCL_BAUDRATE, CROSS_CORE_UART_TX_PIN, CROSS_CORE_UART_RX_PIN);
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 1u);

    cclState.initReadyFlag = 1u;
}

void crossCoreLinkPit1ms(void)
{
    if (!cclState.initReadyFlag) return;

    cclState.heartbeatTickCount++;
    if (cclState.heartbeatTickCount >= CCL_HEARTBEAT_MS)
    {
        cclState.heartbeatTickCount = 0u;
        cclState.heartbeatSendFlag = 1u;
    }
    cclState.kvmControlTickCount++;
    if (cclState.kvmControlTickCount >= CCL_KVM_CONTROL_REFRESH_MS)
    {
        cclState.kvmControlTickCount = 0u;
        cclState.kvmControlSendFlag = 1u;
    }
    cclState.poseTickCount++;
    if (cclState.poseTickCount >= CCL_CORE0_POSE_TX_MS)
    {
        cclState.poseTickCount = 0u;
        cclState.poseSendFlag = 1u;
    }

    if (cclState.core1QuietMs < CCL_LINK_LOST_MS)
    {
        cclState.core1QuietMs++;
    }
    if (cclState.motionQuietMs < CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS)
    {
        cclState.motionQuietMs++;
    }
    if (cclState.statusQuietMs < CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS)
    {
        cclState.statusQuietMs++;
    }
    if (cclState.kvmEventPending != 0u)
    {
        cclState.kvmRetryTickMs++;
        if (cclState.kvmRetryTickMs >= CCL_KVM_EVENT_RETRY_MS)
        {
            cclState.kvmRetryTickMs = 0u;
            cclState.kvmEventSendFlag = 1u;
        }
    }
    if (cclState.kvmStatusQuietMs < CCL_KVM_STATUS_LOST_MS)
    {
        cclState.kvmStatusQuietMs++;
    }
    if (cclState.paramQuietMs < CCL_PARAM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS)
    {
        cclState.paramQuietMs++;
    }
    if (cclState.paramGlobalStateQuietMs < CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS)
        cclState.paramGlobalStateQuietMs++;
    if (cclState.paramGlobalRequestTxMs < CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_TX_MS)
        cclState.paramGlobalRequestTxMs++;
}

void crossCoreLinkPoll(void)
{
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    if (!cclState.initReadyFlag) return;

    /* STATUS身份进入离线栅栏即同步撤销MOTION，不等待独立300ms运动超时。
     * 后续只能由合法STATUS重绑并重新经过显式零MOTION fence。 */
    if ((cclState.statusQuietMs >= CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS) &&
        (cclState.motionSessionFenced != 0u))
    {
        cclState.motionWirePrimed = 0u;
        cclState.motionSessionFenced = 0u;
        cclState.motionWireSeq = 0u;
        cclState.motionVx = 0.0f;
        cclState.motionVy = 0.0f;
        cclState.motionWz = 0.0f;
        cclState.motionTakeoffReq = 0u;
        cclState.motionQuietMs = CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS;
    }
    while (cclPopFrame(&frame))
    {
        /* MOTION 帧: core1 转发的 core2 LoRa 遥控前馈 vx/vy/wz, 存最新值 + 清超时计时。
         * 其余(心跳/STATUS)收帧已在 ISR 刷新存活计时。 */
        if (UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION == frame.type)
        {
            uint8_t frameUsable = cclMotionFrameUsable(&frame);
            uint8_t sequenceAdvanced;
            uint8_t zeroFence = cclMotionFrameIsZeroFence(&frame);
            if (cclMotionSessionMatches(frame.producerBootSession) == 0u)
            {
                continue;
            }
            if ((zeroFence == 0u) && (cclState.motionSessionFenced == 0u)) continue;
            if (cclState.motionWirePrimed == 0u)
            {
                sequenceAdvanced = 1u;
            }
            else
            {
                sequenceAdvanced = cclWireSeqAdvanced(
                    frame.sequence, cclState.motionWireSeq);
            }
            if (sequenceAdvanced == 0u) continue;
            if (zeroFence != 0u)
            {
                cclState.motionSessionFenced = 1u;
                cclState.motionWirePrimed = 1u;
                cclState.motionWireSeq = frame.sequence;
                cclState.motionVx = 0.0f;
                cclState.motionVy = 0.0f;
                cclState.motionWz = 0.0f;
                cclState.motionTakeoffReq = 0u;
                cclState.motionQuietMs = 0u;
                cclState.motionRxSeq++;
                if (cclState.motionRxSeq == 0u) cclState.motionRxSeq = 1u;
                continue;
            }
            if ((sequenceAdvanced != 0u) && (frameUsable != 0u))
            {
                cclState.motionWirePrimed = 1u;
                cclState.motionWireSeq = frame.sequence;
                cclState.motionVx = frame.motionVx;
                cclState.motionVy = frame.motionVy;
                cclState.motionWz = frame.motionWz;
                cclState.motionTakeoffReq =
                    (frame.motionFlags & UART_LINK_MOTION_FLAG_TAKEOFF_REQ) ? 1u : 0u;
                cclState.motionQuietMs = 0u;
                cclState.motionRxSeq++;
                if (0u == cclState.motionRxSeq) cclState.motionRxSeq = 1u; /* 回绕跳过 0：初值/无帧态用 0，故有效序号恒非 0 */
            }
            else if ((sequenceAdvanced != 0u) && (frameUsable == 0u))
            {
                /* CRC通过但业务值非法：立即撤销前馈，不刷新新鲜度或接收序号。 */
                cclState.motionVx = 0.0f;
                cclState.motionVy = 0.0f;
                cclState.motionWz = 0.0f;
                cclState.motionTakeoffReq = 0u;
                cclState.motionQuietMs = CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS;
                cclState.rxErrorCount++;
            }
        }
        /* STATUS帧有独立wire序列与新鲜度。心跳/KVM/MOTION等其它合法帧只能证明物理链路，
         * 不得替STATUS业务事实续鲜。发送端重启/旧seq时，只允许显式M2低电平安全重建基线。 */
        else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS == frame.type)
        {
            if (cclStatusFrameSemanticValid(&frame) == 0u)
            {
                cclEnterStatusProtocolFault();
                continue;
            }
            if (cclBindProducerSessionFromStatus(
                    frame.producerBootSession) == 0u) continue;
            cclHandleStatusFrame(&frame);
        }
        else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_STATUS == frame.type)
        {
            cclHandleKvmStatus(&frame);
        }
        else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE == frame.type)
        {
            cclAcceptParamGlobalState(&frame.paramGlobalState);
        }
    }

    if ((cclState.paramGlobalStateValid != 0u) &&
        (cclState.paramGlobalStateQuietMs >= CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS))
    {
        cclState.paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
        coreDataClearParamGlobalState();
        cclCancelPendingParamGlobalRequest();
    }
    if (cclState.paramGlobalRequestTxMs >= CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_TX_MS)
    {
        paramSyncGlobalRequest request;
        cclState.paramGlobalRequestTxMs = 0u;
        if (coreDataTryReadParamGlobalRequest(&request) != 0u)
        {
            if ((request.producerBootGeneration != cclState.paramGlobalRequestBoot) ||
                (request.sequence != cclState.paramGlobalRequestSequence))
            {
                cclState.paramGlobalRequest = request;
                cclState.paramGlobalRequestBoot = request.producerBootGeneration;
                cclState.paramGlobalRequestSequence = request.sequence;
                cclState.paramGlobalRequestAcked = 0u;
            }
            if (cclState.paramGlobalRequestAcked == 0u)
                cclSendParamGlobalRequest(&request);
        }
    }

    cclSendCore0PoseIfDue();

    /* 路由边沿先立即发布CONTROL，再允许同路由EVENT发送。 */
    if (cclState.kvmControlSendFlag != 0u)
    {
        cclState.kvmControlSendFlag = 0u;
        cclSendKvmControl();
    }

    if (cclState.kvmEventSendFlag != 0u)
    {
        cclState.kvmEventSendFlag = 0u;
        cclSendKvmEvent();
    }

    if (cclState.heartbeatSendFlag)
    {
        cclState.heartbeatSendFlag = 0u;
        cclSendHeartbeat();
        cclSendCore0Status(); /* 与心跳同周期发 core0 状态(供 core1 RGB 灯) */
        cclState.statusSendFlag = 0u;
        cclSendKvmControl();
    }
    else if (cclState.statusSendFlag != 0u)
    {
        cclState.statusSendFlag = 0u;
        cclSendCore0Status();
    }

    if (!crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive())
    {
        if (cclState.kvmStatus.flags != 0u)
        {
            cclState.kvmStatus.flags = 0u;
            cclState.kvmStatus.activeTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
            cclPublishKvmStatus();
        }
    }
    else if ((cclState.kvmStatusQuietMs >= CCL_KVM_STATUS_LOST_MS) &&
             (cclState.kvmStatus.flags != 0u))
    {
        cclState.kvmStatus.flags = 0u;
        cclState.kvmStatus.activeTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
        cclPublishKvmStatus();
    }

    /* 参数桥接是最低优先级：控制队列和本拍全部安全/心跳发送完成后，
     * 每次Poll最多处理一帧。静默超时只撤销参数传输，不影响控制事实。 */
    if ((cclState.paramQuietMs >= CCL_PARAM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS) &&
        ((cclState.paramAssemblyActive != 0u) ||
            (cclState.paramRequestPublished != 0u) ||
            (cclState.paramResponseValid != 0u)))
    {
        cclResetParamTransport();
    }
    if (cclPopParamFrame(&frame)) cclHandleParamRequest(&frame);
}

uint8_t crossCoreLinkGetParamGlobalState(paramSyncGlobalState *out)
{
    uint32_t primask;
    uint8_t valid;
    if (out == 0) return 0u;
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    valid = (uint8_t) ((cclState.paramGlobalStateValid != 0u) &&
        (cclState.paramGlobalStateQuietMs < CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS) &&
        (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(&cclState.paramGlobalState) != 0u));
    if (valid != 0u) *out = cclState.paramGlobalState;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    return valid;
}

void crossCoreLinkRxIrqHandler(void)
{
    uint8_t data;
    if (uart_query_byte(CCL_UART_NUM, &data))
    {
        cclHandleByte(data);
    }
}

void crossCoreLinkSetKvmRoute(uint32_t routeSession, uint32_t routeEpoch,
    uint8_t target, uint32_t eventSeq, uint8_t keyId,
    uint8_t keyState, uint8_t eventPending)
{
    uint8_t routeChanged = (uint8_t) ((routeSession != cclState.kvmRouteSession) ||
                                      (routeEpoch != cclState.kvmRouteEpoch) || (target != cclState.kvmTarget));
    if (routeChanged != 0u)
    {
        cclState.kvmRouteSession = routeSession;
        cclState.kvmRouteEpoch = routeEpoch;
        cclState.kvmTarget = target;
        cclState.kvmTargetSession = 0u;
        cclState.kvmPeerRestartLatched = 0u;
        cclState.kvmStatusQuietMs = CCL_KVM_STATUS_LOST_MS;
        cclState.kvmEventPending = 0u;
        cclState.kvmControlSendFlag = 1u;
        /* 路由切换后的首个心跳必须携带新的controlActive，避免旧心跳令
         * Core1短暂推导出NONE并显示黄色。下一次前台poll立即发送。 */
        cclState.heartbeatSendFlag = 1u;
        memset(&cclState.kvmStatus, 0, sizeof(cclState.kvmStatus));
        cclState.kvmStatus.magic = CORE_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
        cclState.kvmStatus.routeSession = routeSession;
        cclState.kvmStatus.routeEpoch = routeEpoch;
        cclState.kvmStatus.target = target;
        cclState.kvmStatus.activeTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
        cclPublishKvmStatus();
    }
    cclState.controlActive = (target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ? 1u : 0u;
    if ((target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) && (eventPending != 0u) &&
        (eventSeq != 0u) &&
        ((cclState.kvmEventPending == 0u) || (eventSeq != cclState.kvmEventSeq)))
    {
        cclState.kvmEventSeq = eventSeq;
        cclState.kvmKeyId = keyId;
        cclState.kvmKeyState = keyState;
        cclState.kvmEventPending = 1u;
        cclState.kvmRetryTickMs = 0u;
        cclState.kvmEventSendFlag = 1u;
    }
    else if (eventPending == 0u)
    {
        cclState.kvmEventPending = 0u;
    }
}

void crossCoreLinkSetCore0Status(uint8_t safetyState, uint8_t armProgress, uint8_t statusFlags)
{
    cclState.c0SafetyState = safetyState;
    cclState.c0ArmProgress = armProgress;
    cclState.c0StatusFlags = statusFlags;
}

/* 设置 CORE0_STATUS 的 sysCtrl(空地系统模式/RGB意图/到顶, UART_LINK_SYS_* 打包) + buzzer(蜂鸣模式码)。
 * 前台每拍调；随心跳周期发给 core1。空地系统模式下发 + 起飞 RGB/蜂鸣编排 + 到顶车禁动门控用。 */
void crossCoreLinkSetSysControl(uint8_t sysCtrl, uint8_t buzzer)
{
    if ((cclState.c0SysCtrl != sysCtrl) || (cclState.c0Buzzer != buzzer))
    {
        cclState.c0SysCtrl = sysCtrl;
        cclState.c0Buzzer = buzzer;
        cclState.statusSendFlag = 1u;
    }
}

uint8_t crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive(void)
{
    return (cclState.core1QuietMs < CCL_LINK_LOST_MS) ? 1u : 0u;
}

uint8_t crossCoreLinkGetMotionSnapshot(float *vx, float *vy, float *wz, uint32_t *rxSeq)
{
    if (cclState.motionQuietMs >= CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS)
    {
        return 0u; /* 超时/无遥控前馈, 调用方喂零 */
    }
    if (vx != 0) *vx = cclState.motionVx;
    if (vy != 0) *vy = cclState.motionVy;
    if (wz != 0) *wz = cclState.motionWz;
    if (rxSeq != 0) *rxSeq = cclState.motionRxSeq;
    return 1u;
}

uint32_t crossCoreLinkFenceMotion(void)
{
    uint32_t baseline = cclState.motionRxSeq;
    /* 这些字段只由前台parser与本前台API写；UART ISR仅入字节FIFO，无需扩大为全局临界区。 */
    cclState.motionVx = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionVy = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionWz = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionTakeoffReq = 0u;
    cclState.motionQuietMs = CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS;
    return baseline;
}

/* core1 经 STATUS 帧报告的 RS-485↔core2 断联位（最近一帧的原值）。
 * 仅当 core1 在线时有意义；core1 死时此值可能陈旧，调用方(缓降/发车拦截)须用
 * crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive() 兜底：anyLinkLost = !IsCore1Alive() || GetCore2LinkLost()。 */
uint8_t crossCoreLinkGetCore2LinkLost(void)
{
    if (cclState.statusQuietMs >= CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS) return 1u;
    return cclState.core1ReportedCore2Lost;
}

/* Core1经固定14B STATUS bit3报告的通用必需视觉故障事实；plan缺失或停更都会
 * fail-closed置位。C1/C3/C4永久必需，Core1自身断联仍由
 * !crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive()独立兜底。 */
uint8_t crossCoreLinkGetRequiredVisionFault(uint8_t *source, uint8_t *faultClass)
{
    if (source != 0) *source = cclState.core1ReportedFaultSource;
    if (faultClass != 0) *faultClass = cclState.core1ReportedFaultClass;
    if (cclState.statusQuietMs >= CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS)
    {
        if (source != 0) *source = 2u;
        if (faultClass != 0) *faultClass = 3u;
        return 1u;
    }
    return cclState.core1ReportedRequiredVisionFault;
}

static void cclResetProducerSession(uint32_t session)
{
    cclResetParamTransport();
    cclState.producerBootSession = session;
    cclState.motionWirePrimed = 0u;
    cclState.motionSessionFenced = 0u;
    cclState.statusWirePrimed = 0u;
    cclState.motionVx = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionVy = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionWz = 0.0f;
    cclState.motionTakeoffReq = 0u;
    cclState.motionQuietMs = CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS;
    cclState.statusQuietMs = CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS;
    cclState.core1ReportedCore2AttitudeFault = 0u;
    cclState.core1ReportedRequiredVisionFault = 1u;
    cclState.core1ReportedFaultSource = 2u;
    cclState.core1ReportedFaultClass = 2u;
}

static uint8_t cclBindProducerSessionFromStatus(uint32_t session)
{
    uint8_t decision = uartLinkRxSessionClassify(
        (uint8_t) (cclState.statusQuietMs >= CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS),
        cclState.producerBootSession, session);
    if (decision == UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT) return 0u;
    if (decision == UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_REBIND)
        cclResetProducerSession(session);
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t cclMotionSessionMatches(uint32_t session)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((cclState.statusQuietMs < CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS) &&
                      (session != 0u) && (session == cclState.producerBootSession));
}

void crossCoreLinkGetFlightFactsSnapshot(crossCoreFlightFactsSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    uint32_t primask;
    if (out == 0) return;
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    out->motionSeq = cclState.motionRxSeq;
    out->statusSeq = cclState.statusRxSeq;
    out->beaconStateSeq = cclState.beaconStateSeq;
    out->core1Seq = cclState.rxFrameCount;
    out->motionAgeMs = cclState.motionQuietMs;
    out->statusAgeMs = cclState.statusQuietMs;
    out->core1AgeMs = cclState.core1QuietMs;
    out->beaconCount = cclState.core1ReportedBeaconCount;
    out->mode3RequestLevel = cclState.motionTakeoffReq;
    out->mode3RequestValid = (cclState.motionQuietMs < CCL_MOTION_LOST_MS) ? 1u : 0u;
    out->statusValid = (uint8_t) (crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive() &&
                                  cclState.statusQuietMs < CCL_STATUS_LOST_MS);
    out->core2AttitudeFault = out->statusValid ? cclState.core1ReportedCore2AttitudeFault : 0u;
    out->mode2RequestLevel = cclState.core1ReportedMode2LoraLandReq;
    out->mode2RequestValid = (uint8_t) (out->statusValid &&
                                        cclState.mode2RequestBaselineValid);
    out->beaconSearching = cclState.core1ReportedBeaconSearching;
    out->beaconSearchTimedOut = cclState.core1ReportedBeaconSearchTimedOut;
    out->beaconStateValid = (uint8_t) (out->statusValid &&
                                       cclState.core1ReportedBeaconStateValid);
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

#define _CROSS_CORE_LINK_H_

#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct
{

    uint32_t statusSeq;
    uint32_t beaconStateSeq;
    uint32_t core1Seq;
    uint16_t motionAgeMs;
    uint16_t statusAgeMs;
    uint16_t core1AgeMs;
    uint16_t beaconCount;

/*
 * crossCoreLink (core0 cm_7_0 端) - 核间单线双向链路 控制端
 *
 * 物理: UART_2 / P10 (group0) ↔ core1 P04 / UART_1，4 Mbps，全双工单线双向。
 *   - TX: 周期发 HEARTBEAT/状态/位姿，并通过事务KVM帧路由按键。
 *   - RX: 收 core1 心跳/状态 → 维护 core1 存活计时(断联检测)。
 *
 * 全部收发在前台 whileProcess(crossCoreLinkPoll), 绝不进 400Hz 飞控 PIT ISR。
 * crossCoreLinkPit1ms 仅做心跳分频 + 存活超时计数(轻量, 可入 1ms ISR)。
 * RX 在 UART_2 中断仅取一字节喂解析器(轻量)。
 *
 */

void crossCoreLinkInit(void);         /* 配 UART_2 + 开 RX 中断 + 复位状态 */
void crossCoreLinkPit1ms(void);       /* 1ms tick: 心跳分频 + core1 存活超时计数 */
void crossCoreLinkPoll(void);         /* 前台: 排空 RX → 维护存活; 发待发按键事件 + 心跳 */
void crossCoreLinkRxIrqHandler(void); /* UART_2 RX 中断: 仅取一字节喂解析器 */

/* cm_7_1 菜单前台快照路由意图；cm_7_0 负责周期 CONTROL 与单在途 EVENT 重试。 */
void crossCoreLinkSetKvmRoute(uint32_t routeSession, uint32_t routeEpoch,
    uint8_t target, uint32_t eventSeq, uint8_t keyId,
    uint8_t keyState, uint8_t eventPending);

/* 设置 core0 飞控状态(供 core1 RGB 状态灯): safetyState/armProgress/statusFlags(UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_*)。
 * 与心跳同周期经 CORE0_STATUS 帧发给 core1。前台调用。 */
void crossCoreLinkSetCore0Status(uint8_t safetyState, uint8_t armProgress, uint8_t statusFlags);

/* 设置 CORE0_STATUS 的 sysCtrl(空地系统模式/RGB意图/到顶, UART_LINK_SYS_* 打包) + buzzer(蜂鸣模式码,
 * UART_LINK_BUZZER_*)。空地系统模式下发 + 起飞 RGB/蜂鸣编排 + 到顶车禁动门控用。前台每拍调。 */
void crossCoreLinkSetSysControl(uint8_t sysCtrl, uint8_t buzzer);

uint8_t crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive(void); /* 1=core1 链路在线(心跳未超时) */

/* 取 core1 转发来的运动前馈 vx/vy/wz(MOTION 帧, 来自 core2 LoRa 遥控值)。
 * 返回 1=有效(近期收到且未超时), 0=超时/无(调用方应喂零, 防遥控失联失控)。 */
/* 取 MOTION 最新值与本地接收序号。
 * rxSeq 仅在 core0 本地每收一帧 MOTION 后自增，不改变线协议；调用方用它区分"新帧"与"旧值仍未超时"。 */
uint8_t crossCoreLinkGetMotionSnapshot(float *vx, float *vy, float *wz, uint32_t *rxSeq);

/* 热重连事务：前台owner清陈旧运动值/请求并返回当前接收序列基线；不重置UART、parser或session。 */
uint32_t crossCoreLinkFenceMotion(void);

/* 取模式3 车 LoRa S3+S4 请求电平(MOTION 帧 flags bit0; 超时返回 0)。
 * core0Loop 以低电平重装、每个高电平只消费一次，并按 TKO 阶段解释为起飞或缓降。 */
/* 取 core1 经 STATUS 帧上报的 RS-485↔core2 断联位(最近一帧原值; 200ms 周期刷新)。
 * 仅core1在线时有意义；Coordinator仍须以!crossCoreLinkIsCore1Alive()兜底core1自身断联。 */
uint8_t crossCoreLinkGetCore2LinkLost(void);

/* 取Core1经STATUS bit3上报的通用必需视觉故障事实（
 * plan缺失/停更均fail-closed）。C1/C3/C4永久必需，不再受相机数量模式门控。 */
uint8_t crossCoreLinkGetRequiredVisionFault(uint8_t *source, uint8_t *faultClass);

/* 起降Coordinator一次性读取的链路业务事实；各来源保留独立seq/age/valid。 */
void crossCoreLinkGetFlightFactsSnapshot(crossCoreFlightFactsSnapshotStruct *out);

/* Core1全核参数协调状态；独立于控制STATUS/linkFlags，新鲜度失效时返回0。 */
uint8_t crossCoreLinkGetParamGlobalState(paramSyncGlobalState *out);

#endif /* _CROSS_CORE_LINK_H_ */

    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t abiVersion;

    uint32_t sequence;

#pragma location = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_RESPONSE_ADDR

static uint8_t frameInputValid(uint32_t bootGeneration, uint32_t sequence,
    uint16_t dataLength)
{

        (dataLength <= PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX));
}

static void cleanRegion(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region)
{
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*region));
    __DSB();
}

static void invalidateRegion(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region)
{
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*region));
    __DSB();
}

static uint8_t publishFrame(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region,
    const paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame staged;

    staged = *frame;
    staged.endSequence = 0u;

    region->beginSequence = 0u;
    region->endSequence = 0u;
    cleanRegion(region);

    memcpy((void *) region, &staged, sizeof(staged));
    cleanRegion(region);

    region->endSequence = staged.sequence;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *)
        (((uintptr_t) &region->endSequence) & ~((uintptr_t) 31u)), 32u);
    __DSB();
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sharedFrameValid(const paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame,
    uint32_t magic)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((frame->beginSequence != 0u) &&
        (frame->beginSequence == frame->sequence) &&
        (frame->endSequence == frame->sequence) &&
        (frame->magic == magic) &&
        (frame->abiVersion == PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI) &&
        (frame->payloadBytes == frame->dataLength) &&
        frameInputValid(frame->producerBootGeneration, frame->sequence,
            frame->dataLength));
}

static uint8_t tryReadFrame(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region,
    uint32_t magic, paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame first;
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame second;
    uint8_t attempt;

    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        invalidateRegion(region);
        memcpy(&first, (const void *) region, sizeof(first));
        invalidateRegion(region);
        memcpy(&second, (const void *) region, sizeof(second));
        if (sharedFrameValid(&first, magic) &&
            sharedFrameValid(&second, magic) &&
            (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0))
        {
            *frame = second;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame frame;
    if ((request == 0) || !frameInputValid(request->producerBootGeneration,
        request->sequence, request->dataLength)) return 0u;
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.beginSequence = request->sequence;
    frame.magic = PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC;
    frame.abiVersion = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI;
    frame.payloadBytes = request->dataLength;
    frame.producerBootGeneration = request->producerBootGeneration;
    frame.sequence = request->sequence;
    frame.transactionId = request->transactionId;
    frame.offset = request->offset;
    frame.payloadCrc32 = request->payloadCrc32;
    frame.dataLength = request->dataLength;
    frame.op = request->op;
    frame.slot = request->slot;
    frame.target = request->target;
    frame.state = request->flags;
    memcpy(frame.data, request->data, request->dataLength);
    return publishFrame(&paramSyncRequestRegion, &frame);
}

#include "uartLinkProto.h"

/* float ↔ 4 字节小端互转（core0/core1 同为小端 ARM，按字节显式拼装传输）。 */
typedef union { float f; uint8_t b[4]; } uartLinkFloatBytes;

static uint8_t crc8AtmUpdate(uint8_t crc, uint8_t data)
{
    uint8_t bit;
    crc ^= data;
    for (bit = 0u; bit < 8u; bit++)
    {
        crc = (crc & 0x80u) ? (uint8_t)((crc << 1u) ^ 0x07u) : (uint8_t)(crc << 1u);
    }
    return crc;
}

static uint8_t xorU32Le(uint8_t value, uint32_t data)
{
    return (uint8_t)(value ^ (uint8_t)data ^ (uint8_t)(data >> 8)
        ^ (uint8_t)(data >> 16) ^ (uint8_t)(data >> 24));
}

static uint8_t xorU16Le(uint8_t value, uint16_t data)
{
    return (uint8_t)(value ^ (uint8_t)data ^ (uint8_t)(data >> 8));
}

static void putU32Le(uint8_t *buffer, uint8_t offset, uint32_t value)
{
    buffer[offset] = (uint8_t)value;
    buffer[offset + 1u] = (uint8_t)(value >> 8);
    buffer[offset + 2u] = (uint8_t)(value >> 16);
    buffer[offset + 3u] = (uint8_t)(value >> 24);
}

static uint32_t getU32Le(const uint8_t *buffer, uint8_t offset)
{
    return (uint32_t)buffer[offset]
        | ((uint32_t)buffer[offset + 1u] << 8)
        | ((uint32_t)buffer[offset + 2u] << 16)
        | ((uint32_t)buffer[offset + 3u] << 24);
}

/* 按 type 返回帧总长（含 HEAD/TAIL）；未知 type 返回 0。 */
static uint8_t uartLinkProtoFrameLen(uint8_t type)
{
    switch (type)
    {
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PING:
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_ACK:
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_HEARTBEAT:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_STATUS;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0STATUS;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0POSE;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_MOTION;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_CONTROL;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_EVENT;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_STATUS:
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_REQUEST:
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_STATUS;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE;
        default:
            return 0u;
    }
}

void uartLinkProtoInit(uartLinkParserStruct *parser)
{
    uint8_t i;

    if (0 == parser)
    {
        return;
    }

    parser->index = 0u;
    parser->expectLen = 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_MAX; ++i)
    {
        parser->buffer[i] = 0u;
    }
}

uint8_t uartLinkProtoChecksum(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    if (0 == frame)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t beaconLo = (uint8_t)(frame->beaconCount & 0xFFu);
        uint8_t beaconHi = (uint8_t)((frame->beaconCount >> 8) & 0xFFu);
        return (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence ^ beaconLo ^ beaconHi ^
            frame->linkFlags ^ frame->faultSource ^ frame->faultClass ^
            (uint8_t)frame->producerBootSession ^ (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 8) ^
            (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 16) ^ (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 24));
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t crc = 0u;
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->type);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sequence);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->safetyState);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->armProgress);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->statusFlags);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sysCtrl);
        return crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->buzzer);
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes vx, vy, wz;
        uint8_t i;
        uint8_t x = 0u;
        vx.f = frame->motionVx;
        vy.f = frame->motionVy;
        wz.f = frame->motionWz;
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, frame->type);
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, frame->sequence);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, vx.b[i]);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, vy.b[i]);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, wz.b[i]);
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, frame->motionFlags);
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, (uint8_t)frame->producerBootSession);
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 8));
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 16));
        return crc8AtmUpdate(x, (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 24));
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes yaw;
        uint8_t i;
        uint8_t x = (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence ^ frame->poseEpoch
            ^ (uint8_t)(frame->poseXQ8 & 0xFFu) ^ (uint8_t)((frame->poseXQ8 >> 8) & 0xFFu)
            ^ (uint8_t)(frame->poseYQ8 & 0xFFu) ^ (uint8_t)((frame->poseYQ8 >> 8) & 0xFFu));
        yaw.f = frame->poseOrientationRad;
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) x = (uint8_t)(x ^ yaw.b[i]);
        x = (uint8_t)(x ^ frame->poseConfidenceQ8 ^ frame->poseFlags);
        return x;
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t x = (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        x = (uint8_t)(x ^ frame->kvmTarget);
        return xorU16Le(x, frame->kvmLeaseMs);
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t x = (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmEventSeq);
        return (uint8_t)(x ^ frame->kvmTarget ^ frame->kvmKeyId ^ frame->kvmKeyState);
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t x = (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmEventSeq);
        x = (uint8_t)(x ^ frame->kvmTarget ^ frame->kvmActiveTarget
            ^ frame->kvmMenuStates ^ frame->kvmFlags ^ frame->kvmAckResult);
        return xorU16Le(x, frame->kvmCore3AgeMs);
    }

    if ((UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_REQUEST == frame->type) ||
        (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE == frame->type))
    {
        uint8_t crc = 0u;
        uint8_t i;
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->type);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sequence);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramOp);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramReserved);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramTarget);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramStatus);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
            (uint8_t)(frame->paramRequestId >> (8u * i)));
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, (uint8_t)frame->paramOffset);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, (uint8_t)(frame->paramOffset >> 8));
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramLength);
        for (i = 0u; i < UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES; i++)
            crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
                (i < frame->paramLength) ? frame->paramData[i] : 0u);
        return crc;
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t crc = 0u;
        uint8_t i;
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->type);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sequence);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
            (uint8_t)(frame->paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration >> (8u * i)));
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
            (uint8_t)(frame->paramGlobalRequest.sequence >> (8u * i)));
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramGlobalRequest.origin);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramGlobalRequest.action);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramGlobalRequest.slot);
        return crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramGlobalRequest.reserved);
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE == frame->type)
    {
        const uint32_t words[5] = {
            frame->paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration,
            frame->paramGlobalState.sequence,
            frame->paramGlobalState.requestBootGeneration,
            frame->paramGlobalState.requestSequence,
            frame->paramGlobalState.transactionId
        };
        const uint8_t bytes[8] = {
            frame->paramGlobalState.origin, frame->paramGlobalState.action,
            frame->paramGlobalState.slot, frame->paramGlobalState.phase,
            frame->paramGlobalState.target, frame->paramGlobalState.error,
            frame->paramGlobalState.readyMask, frame->paramGlobalState.flags
        };
        uint8_t crc = 0u;
        uint8_t i, j;
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->type);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sequence);
        for (i = 0u; i < 5u; i++)
            for (j = 0u; j < 4u; j++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
                (uint8_t)(words[i] >> (8u * j)));
        for (i = 0u; i < 8u; i++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, bytes[i]);
        return crc;
    }

    /* 基础帧：type ^ seq ^ value */
    return (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence ^ frame->value);
}

uartLinkProtoStatusEnum uartLinkProtoEncode(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame, uint8_t *buffer, uint8_t bufferSize)
{
    uint8_t frameLen;

    if (0 == frame || 0 == buffer)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    frameLen = uartLinkProtoFrameLen(frame->type);
    if (0u == frameLen)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_TYPE_ERROR;
    }
    if (bufferSize < frameLen)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    buffer[0] = UART_LINK_FRAME_HEAD;
    buffer[1] = frame->type;
    buffer[2] = frame->sequence;

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        buffer[3] = (uint8_t)(frame->beaconCount & 0xFFu);
        buffer[4] = (uint8_t)((frame->beaconCount >> 8) & 0xFFu);
        buffer[5] = frame->linkFlags;
        buffer[6] = frame->faultSource;
        buffer[7] = frame->faultClass;
        putU32Le(buffer, 8u, frame->producerBootSession);
        buffer[12] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[13] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        buffer[3] = frame->safetyState;
        buffer[4] = frame->armProgress;
        buffer[5] = frame->statusFlags;
        buffer[6] = frame->sysCtrl;
        buffer[7] = frame->buzzer;
        buffer[8] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[9] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes vx, vy, wz;
        uint8_t i;
        vx.f = frame->motionVx;
        vy.f = frame->motionVy;
        wz.f = frame->motionWz;
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) buffer[3u + i] = vx.b[i];
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) buffer[7u + i] = vy.b[i];
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) buffer[11u + i] = wz.b[i];
        buffer[15] = frame->motionFlags;
        putU32Le(buffer, 16u, frame->producerBootSession);
        buffer[20] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[21] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;

    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes yaw;
        uint8_t i;
        yaw.f = frame->poseOrientationRad;
        buffer[3] = frame->poseEpoch;
        buffer[4] = (uint8_t)(frame->poseXQ8 & 0xFFu);
        buffer[5] = (uint8_t)((frame->poseXQ8 >> 8) & 0xFFu);
        buffer[6] = (uint8_t)(frame->poseYQ8 & 0xFFu);
        buffer[7] = (uint8_t)((frame->poseYQ8 >> 8) & 0xFFu);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) buffer[8u + i] = yaw.b[i];
        buffer[12] = frame->poseConfidenceQ8;
        buffer[13] = frame->poseFlags;
        buffer[14] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[15] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL == frame->type)
    {
        putU32Le(buffer, 3u, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 7u, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 11u, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        buffer[15] = frame->kvmTarget;
        buffer[16] = (uint8_t)frame->kvmLeaseMs;
        buffer[17] = (uint8_t)(frame->kvmLeaseMs >> 8);
        buffer[18] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[19] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT == frame->type)
    {
        putU32Le(buffer, 3u, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 7u, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 11u, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);

        buffer[25] = (uint8_t)(frame->kvmCore3AgeMs >> 8);

        putU32Le(buffer, 19u, frame->paramGlobalState.transactionId);
        buffer[23] = frame->paramGlobalState.origin;
        buffer[24] = frame->paramGlobalState.action;
