#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_ELAPSED_CAP_MS (60000u)
#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_LORA_REARM_MS (400u)
#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_ALTITUDE_MM (4000.0f)
#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX (1000.0f)
#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_YAW_RAD (3.1415927f)
#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ALL (FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ARM | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_TAKEOFF | FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_LAND)
#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_ALL (FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_ALTITUDE | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_POSITION | FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_RGB | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_BUZZER | FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_REACHED | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_DISARM | FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_CONTROL | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION)
#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_BUILTIN_ALL (FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_K5_LAUNCH | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_K5_STANDBY | FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_LORA_MODE3 | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_LORA_MODE2 | FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_CORE1_LOST | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_CORE2_LOST | FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_TOF_FAILSAFE | FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_CORE2_ATTITUDE_FAULT)
#define FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_POLICY_ALL (FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_BUILTIN_ALL | \
    FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_POLICY_MASK)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t lastNowMs;
    uint32_t cycleSeq;
    uint32_t episodeSeq;
    uint32_t transitionSeq;
    uint32_t lastLaunchAcceptedSeq;
    uint32_t lastDisarmAcceptedSeq;
    uint32_t lastProtectAcceptedSeq;
    uint32_t stageElapsedMs;
    uint32_t mode3LowStartMs;
    uint32_t mode2LowStartMs;
    uint32_t latchedTriggerSources;
    uint32_t policyActionLevelMask;
    uint32_t lastPolicyTriggerEventSeq;
    uint32_t lastPolicyTriggerSources;
    float stageEntryAltitudeMm;
    float cruiseAltitudeMm;
    flightSequenceStageEnum stage;
    uint8_t primaryReason;
    uint8_t pendingAutoTakeoff;
    uint8_t mode3Armed;
    uint8_t mode2Armed;
    uint8_t mode3LowTiming;
    uint8_t mode2LowTiming;
    uint8_t lastVisionHadTarget;
    uint8_t lastSystemMode;
    uint8_t policyTriggerPrimed;
} flightSequenceContextStruct;

static flightSequenceContextStruct sequenceContext;
static flightParamsStruct sequenceParams;

static uint8_t finiteFloat(float value)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((value == value) &&
        (value <= 3.4028234e38f) && (value >= -3.4028234e38f));
}

static void enterStage(flightSequenceStageEnum stage, float entryAltitudeMm)
{
    sequenceContext.stage = stage;
    sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs = 0u;
    sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = entryAltitudeMm;
    sequenceContext.transitionSeq++;
}

static uint8_t consumeLevelRequest(uint8_t valid, uint8_t level,
    uint8_t rearmAllowed, uint8_t *armed, uint8_t *lowTiming,
    uint32_t *lowStartMs, uint32_t nowMs)
{
    if (valid == 0u)
    {
        *lowTiming = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    if (level == 0u)
    {
        if (rearmAllowed == 0u)
        {
            *lowTiming = 0u;
            return 0u;
        }
        if (*lowTiming == 0u)
        {
            *lowTiming = 1u;
            *lowStartMs = nowMs;
        }
        else if ((uint32_t) (nowMs - *lowStartMs) >= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_LORA_REARM_MS)
        {
            *armed = 1u;
        }
        return 0u;
    }
    *lowTiming = 0u;
    if (*armed == 0u) return 0u;
    *armed = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t requiredLinkLost(const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((facts->core1Online == 0u) ||
        (facts->core2LinkLost != 0u) ||
        (facts->core2AttitudeFault != 0u) ||
        (facts->requiredVisionFault != 0u));
}

static uint8_t confirmedLandingLinkLost(const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts,
    uint8_t closedLoop, uint8_t *reason, uint32_t *trigger)
{
    if (facts->core1Online == 0u)
    {
        *reason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_C1_LINK;
        *trigger = FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_CORE1_LOST;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (facts->core2LinkLost != 0u)
    {
        *reason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_C2_LINK;
        *trigger = FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_CORE2_LOST;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (facts->core2AttitudeFault != 0u)
    {
        *reason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_C2_ATTITUDE;
        *trigger = FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_CORE2_ATTITUDE_FAULT;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((closedLoop == 0u) || (facts->requiredVisionFault == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    *reason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_REQUIRED_VISION;
    *trigger = FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT;
    return 1u;
}

void flightSequenceReset(flightSequenceResetReasonEnum reason)
{
    sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 0u;
    sequenceContext.mode3Armed = 0u;
    sequenceContext.mode2Armed = 0u;
    sequenceContext.mode3LowTiming = 0u;
    sequenceContext.mode2LowTiming = 0u;
    sequenceContext.lastVisionHadTarget = 0u;
    sequenceContext.primaryReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
    sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources = 0u;
    sequenceContext.policyActionLevelMask = 0u;
    enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_IDLE, 0.0f);
    motionFeedforwardDiffReset();
    flightSequencePolicyReset(reason);
}

void flightSequenceInit(uint32_t nowMs)
{
    memset(&sequenceContext, 0, sizeof(sequenceContext));
    sequenceContext.lastNowMs = nowMs;
    sequenceContext.stage = FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_IDLE;
    sequenceContext.lastSystemMode = 0xFFu;
    motionFeedforwardDiffInit();
    flightSequenceApplyParams();
    flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_INIT);
}

void flightSequenceApplyParams(void)
{
    flightParamsGetActive(&sequenceParams);
    sequenceContext.cruiseAltitudeMm = sequenceParams.altTargetMm;
    motionFeedforwardDiffApplyParams();
}

static void renderBaseStage(const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts,
    flightSequenceOutputStruct *output, flightSequenceStageEnum renderStage)
{
    output->stage = renderStage;
    output->stageElapsedMs = sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs;
    output->altitudeTargetMm = (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm;
    output->rgbIntent = UART_LINK_RGB_NORMAL;
    output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT;
    output->altReached = 0u;
    output->altitudeControlEnable = 0u;
    output->allowExternalMotion = 1u; /* 保留现有非巡航角度前馈兼容语义。 */

    switch (renderStage)
    {
        case FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_WAIT:
            output->altitudeTargetMm = sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm;
            output->idleThrottleMode = 1u;
            output->rgbIntent = UART_LINK_RGB_TKO_WAIT;
            output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_1HZ;
            break;
        case FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_RAMP:
            output->altitudeControlEnable = 1u;
            break;
        case FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_CRUISE:
            output->altitudeControlEnable = 1u;
            output->allowVisionPosition = 1u;
            output->altitudeTargetMm = sequenceContext.cruiseAltitudeMm;
            output->altReached = 1u;
            if (sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs < TAKEOFF_APEX_BEEP_MS)
                output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_LONG;
            else if (sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs <
                (uint32_t) (TAKEOFF_APEX_BEEP_MS + TAKEOFF_CRUISE_BEEP_MS))
                output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_3S;
            break;
        case FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING:
            output->altitudeControlEnable = 1u;
            output->landingActive = 1u;
            break;
        case FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED:
            output->altitudeControlEnable = 1u;
            output->landingActive = 1u;
            output->altitudeTargetMm = LAND_FLOOR_MM;
            output->rgbIntent = UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN;
            output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_WARN;
            break;
        case FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_IDLE:
        default:
            if ((facts->systemMode == (uint8_t) UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_LORA_FWD) &&
                (facts->safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP))
            {
                output->idleThrottleMode = 1u;
                output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_ARMED_IDLE;
            }
            break;
    }
}

static void mergePolicy(const flightSequencePolicyDecisionStruct *decision,
    flightSequenceStageEnum renderStage,
    flightSequenceOutputStruct *output)
{
    output->rejectedOverrideMask |= decision->overrideMask &
        ~FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_ALL;
    if ((decision->overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_ALTITUDE) != 0u)
    {
        if (finiteFloat(decision->altitudeTargetMm) &&
            decision->altitudeTargetMm >= 0.0f &&
            decision->altitudeTargetMm <= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_ALTITUDE_MM)
            output->altitudeTargetMm = decision->altitudeTargetMm;
        else output->rejectedOverrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_ALTITUDE;
    }
    if ((decision->overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_RGB) != 0u)
    {
        if (decision->rgbIntent <= UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN)
            output->rgbIntent = decision->rgbIntent;
        else output->rejectedOverrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_RGB;
    }
    if ((decision->overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_BUZZER) != 0u)
    {
        if (decision->buzzerPattern <= UART_LINK_BUZZER_THREE_BEEPS)
            output->buzzerPattern = decision->buzzerPattern;
        else output->rejectedOverrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_BUZZER;
    }
    if ((decision->overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_REACHED) != 0u)
    {
        if (decision->altReached <= 1u)
            output->altReached = decision->altReached;
        else output->rejectedOverrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_REACHED;
    }

    if ((decision->overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_POSITION) != 0u)
    {
        if (finiteFloat(decision->bodyVelocityFwdMps) &&
            finiteFloat(decision->bodyVelocityRightMps) &&
            finiteFloat(decision->yawRateRadS) &&
            decision->bodyVelocityFwdMps >= -sequenceParams.posVelCmdLimit &&
            decision->bodyVelocityFwdMps <= sequenceParams.posVelCmdLimit &&
            decision->bodyVelocityRightMps >= -sequenceParams.posVelCmdLimit &&
            decision->bodyVelocityRightMps <= sequenceParams.posVelCmdLimit &&
            decision->yawRateRadS >= -sequenceParams.yawRateCmdLimit &&
            decision->yawRateRadS <= sequenceParams.yawRateCmdLimit &&
            decision->allowVisionPosition <= 1u &&
            decision->allowExternalMotion <= 1u &&
            decision->localPositionValid <= 1u)
        {
            output->policyPositionActive = decision->localPositionValid ? 1u : 0u;
            if (output->policyPositionActive != 0u)
            {
                output->bodyVelocityFwdMps = decision->bodyVelocityFwdMps;
                output->bodyVelocityRightMps = decision->bodyVelocityRightMps;
                output->yawRateRadS = decision->yawRateRadS;
            }
            else
            {
                output->bodyVelocityFwdMps = 0.0f;
                output->bodyVelocityRightMps = 0.0f;
                output->yawRateRadS = 0.0f;
            }
            output->allowVisionPosition = decision->allowVisionPosition ? 1u : 0u;
            output->allowExternalMotion = decision->allowExternalMotion ? 1u : 0u;
        }
        else output->rejectedOverrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_POSITION;
    }
    if (decision->requestDisarm != 0u) output->requestDisarm = 1u;
    if ((decision->overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_CONTROL) != 0u)
    {
        if (decision->altitudeControlEnable <= 1u &&
            decision->idleThrottleMode <= 1u &&
            !(decision->altitudeControlEnable && decision->idleThrottleMode))
        {
            output->altitudeControlEnable = decision->altitudeControlEnable;
            output->idleThrottleMode = decision->idleThrottleMode;
        }
        else output->rejectedOverrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_CONTROL;
    }
    if ((decision->overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u)
    {
        if (decision->stageTransitionReady > 1u ||
            (renderStage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_WAIT &&
             renderStage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_RAMP &&
             renderStage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING))
        {
            output->rejectedOverrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION;
        }
    }
}

void flightSequenceStep(const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts,
    flightSequenceOutputStruct *output)
{
    flightSequencePolicyContextStruct policyContext;
    flightSequencePolicyDecisionStruct decision;
    flightSequenceFactsStruct policyFacts;
    flightSequenceStageEnum renderStage;
    uint32_t dtMs;
    uint32_t landingTrigger = 0u;
    uint32_t policyActionMask;
    uint32_t policyTriggerSources = 0u;
    uint8_t policyPrimaryReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
    uint8_t landingReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE;
    uint8_t closedLoop;
    uint8_t mode3Event;
    uint8_t mode2Event;
    uint8_t landingTriggeredThisStep = 0u;
    uint8_t directDisarmActive = 0u;

    if (output == 0) return;
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(*output));
    if (facts == 0) return;

    dtMs = facts->nowMs - sequenceContext.lastNowMs;
    sequenceContext.lastNowMs = facts->nowMs;
    sequenceContext.cycleSeq++;
    policyFacts = *facts;
    policyFacts.dtMs = dtMs;
    policyFacts.coordinatorCycleSeq = sequenceContext.cycleSeq;
    policyFacts.coordinatorTransitionSeq = sequenceContext.transitionSeq;
    policyFacts.coordinatorEpisodeSeq = sequenceContext.episodeSeq;
    closedLoop = (facts->safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP) ? 1u : 0u;

    if (facts->systemMode != sequenceContext.lastSystemMode)
    {
        sequenceContext.lastSystemMode = facts->systemMode;
        sequenceContext.mode3Armed = 0u;
        sequenceContext.mode2Armed = 0u;
        sequenceContext.mode3LowTiming = 0u;
        sequenceContext.mode2LowTiming = 0u;
        if (sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING)
            sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm;
        flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_MODE);
    }
    if (facts->rejoinEdge != 0u)
    {
        sequenceContext.mode3Armed = 0u;
        sequenceContext.mode2Armed = 0u;
        if (sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING)
            sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm;
        flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_REJOIN);
    }

    if (facts->safety.disarmAcceptedSeq != sequenceContext.lastDisarmAcceptedSeq)
    {
        sequenceContext.lastDisarmAcceptedSeq = facts->safety.disarmAcceptedSeq;
        flightSequenceReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_DISARM);
    }
    if (facts->safety.protectAcceptedSeq != sequenceContext.lastProtectAcceptedSeq)
    {
        sequenceContext.lastProtectAcceptedSeq = facts->safety.protectAcceptedSeq;
        flightSequenceReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_PROTECT);
    }
    if (facts->safety.launchAcceptedSeq != sequenceContext.lastLaunchAcceptedSeq)
    {
        sequenceContext.lastLaunchAcceptedSeq = facts->safety.launchAcceptedSeq;
        sequenceContext.episodeSeq++;
        flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_INIT);
        if (sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff != 0u)
        {
            sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 0u;
            enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_WAIT,
                (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm);
        }
    }

    mode3Event = consumeLevelRequest(facts->mode3RequestValid,
        facts->mode3RequestLevel, (uint8_t) (facts->core2LinkLost == 0u),
        &sequenceContext.mode3Armed, &sequenceContext.mode3LowTiming,
        &sequenceContext.mode3LowStartMs, facts->nowMs);
    mode2Event = consumeLevelRequest(facts->mode2RequestValid,
        facts->mode2RequestLevel, (uint8_t) (facts->core2LinkLost == 0u),
        &sequenceContext.mode2Armed, &sequenceContext.mode2LowTiming,
        &sequenceContext.mode2LowStartMs, facts->nowMs);
    policyFacts.mode3RequestArmed = sequenceContext.mode3Armed;
    policyFacts.mode2RequestArmed = sequenceContext.mode2Armed;
    policyFacts.coordinatorTransitionSeq = sequenceContext.transitionSeq;
    policyFacts.coordinatorEpisodeSeq = sequenceContext.episodeSeq;

    memset(&policyContext, 0, sizeof(policyContext));
    policyContext.stage = sequenceContext.stage;
    policyContext.stageElapsedMs = sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs;
    policyContext.dtMs = dtMs;
    policyContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm;
    policyContext.cruiseAltitudeMm = sequenceContext.cruiseAltitudeMm;
    policyContext.mode3RequestEvent = (uint8_t) (mode3Event &&
        facts->systemMode == (uint8_t) UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_LORA_FWD);
    policyContext.mode2RequestEvent = (uint8_t) (mode2Event &&
        facts->systemMode == (uint8_t) UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO);
    memset(&decision, 0, sizeof(decision));
    flightSequencePolicySelectTriggers(&policyFacts, &policyContext, &decision);
    policyActionMask = decision.actionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ALL;
    if (policyActionMask != decision.actionMask)
    {
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_POLICY_INVALID;
        policyActionMask = 0u;
    }
    if (policyActionMask != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t triggerMetadataValid = (uint8_t)
            (decision.triggerEventValid == 1u && decision.triggerSources != 0u &&
             (decision.triggerSources & ~FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_POLICY_ALL) == 0u);
        uint8_t risingAction = (uint8_t)
            ((policyActionMask & ~sequenceContext.policyActionLevelMask) != 0u);
        uint8_t repeatedToken = (uint8_t)
            (sequenceContext.policyTriggerPrimed != 0u &&
             sequenceContext.lastPolicyTriggerEventSeq == decision.triggerEventSeq &&
             sequenceContext.lastPolicyTriggerSources == decision.triggerSources);
        if (triggerMetadataValid && risingAction && !repeatedToken)
        {
            policyTriggerSources = decision.triggerSources;
            policyPrimaryReason = decision.primaryReason;
            sequenceContext.policyTriggerPrimed = 1u;
            sequenceContext.lastPolicyTriggerEventSeq = decision.triggerEventSeq;
            sequenceContext.lastPolicyTriggerSources = decision.triggerSources;
        }
        else
        {
            if (!triggerMetadataValid)
                output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_POLICY_INVALID;
            policyActionMask = 0u;
        }
    }
    sequenceContext.policyActionLevelMask = decision.actionMask &
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ALL;

    if (facts->k5StandbyEdge != 0u)
    {
        output->requestDisarm = 1u;
        directDisarmActive = 1u;
        output->triggerSources |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_K5_STANDBY;
        sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 0u;
    }
    if (((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ARM) != 0u) &&
        (directDisarmActive == 0u))
    {
        output->triggerSources |= policyTriggerSources;
        sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources |= policyTriggerSources;
        if (policyPrimaryReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
            sequenceContext.primaryReason = policyPrimaryReason;
        if (facts->faultLatched != 0u) output->acknowledgeFault = 1u;
        else if ((facts->safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_DISARMED ||
                  facts->safety.state == SAFETY_STATE_PROTECTED) &&
            (facts->initialized != 0u) && (facts->controlReady != 0u) &&
            (requiredLinkLost(facts) == 0u))
        {
            output->requestLaunch = 1u;
            if ((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_TAKEOFF) != 0u)
                sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 1u;
        }
        else
        {
            sequenceContext.pendingAutoTakeoff = 0u;
            output->safetyClampMask |= (requiredLinkLost(facts) != 0u) ?
                FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_REQUIRED_LINK : FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_SAFETY_STATE;
        }
    }
    if (((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_TAKEOFF) != 0u) &&
        ((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ARM) == 0u) && closedLoop &&
        (sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_IDLE))
    {
        if ((facts->systemPhase == CORE_UX_PHASE_HOME) && (facts->standalone == 0u) &&
            (requiredLinkLost(facts) == 0u))
        {
            output->triggerSources |= policyTriggerSources;
            sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources |= policyTriggerSources;
            if (policyPrimaryReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
                sequenceContext.primaryReason = policyPrimaryReason;
            enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_WAIT, (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm);
        }
    }

    if (sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs < FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_ELAPSED_CAP_MS)
    {
        uint32_t room = FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_ELAPSED_CAP_MS - sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs;
        sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs += (dtMs < room) ? dtMs : room;
    }
    renderStage = sequenceContext.stage;
    renderBaseStage(facts, output, renderStage);

    policyContext.stage = renderStage;
    policyContext.stageElapsedMs = sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs;
    policyContext.dtMs = dtMs;
    policyContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm = sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm;
    memset(&decision, 0, sizeof(decision));
    policyFacts.coordinatorTransitionSeq = sequenceContext.transitionSeq;
    policyFacts.coordinatorEpisodeSeq = sequenceContext.episodeSeq;
    flightSequencePolicyApplyStage(&policyFacts, &policyContext, &decision);
    mergePolicy(&decision, renderStage, output);
    if (output->rejectedOverrideMask != 0u)
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_POLICY_INVALID;

    if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_WAIT &&
        (((decision.overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u) ?
         (((output->rejectedOverrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) == 0u) &&
          decision.stageTransitionReady) :
         (sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs >= TAKEOFF_WAIT_MS)))
        enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_RAMP, sequenceContext.stageEntryAltitudeMm);
    else if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_RAMP &&
        (((decision.overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u) ?
         (((output->rejectedOverrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) == 0u) &&
          decision.stageTransitionReady) :
         (sequenceContext.stageElapsedMs >= TAKEOFF_RAMP_MS)))
        enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_CRUISE, sequenceContext.cruiseAltitudeMm);
    else if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING &&
        (decision.touchdown ||
         ((decision.overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u)))
    {
        uint8_t transitionOverrideValid = (uint8_t)
            ((decision.overrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) != 0u &&
             (output->rejectedOverrideMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_TRANSITION) == 0u);
        uint8_t landReady = (uint8_t) (decision.touchdown ||
            (transitionOverrideValid && decision.stageTransitionReady));
        if (landReady) enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED, output->altitudeTargetMm);
    }
    else if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED)
        output->requestDisarm = 1u;

    if (closedLoop && confirmedLandingLinkLost(facts, closedLoop,
        &landingReason, &landingTrigger))
    {
        if ((sequenceContext.stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING) &&
            (sequenceContext.stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED))
        {
            sequenceContext.primaryReason = landingReason;
            sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources |= landingTrigger;
            enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING,
                (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm);
            flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_ABORT);
            landingTriggeredThisStep = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (closedLoop &&
        ((policyActionMask & FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_LAND) != 0u) &&
        (sequenceContext.stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING) &&
        (sequenceContext.stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED))
    {
        landingReason = (policyPrimaryReason != CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE) ?
            policyPrimaryReason : (policyContext.mode2RequestEvent ?
            CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_LORA_MODE2 : CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_LORA_MODE3);
        landingTrigger = policyTriggerSources;
        sequenceContext.primaryReason = landingReason;
        sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources |= landingTrigger;
        enterStage(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING,
            (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm);
        flightSequencePolicyReset(FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_RESET_ABORT);
        landingTriggeredThisStep = 1u;
    }
    if ((sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING) ||
        (sequenceContext.stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_LANDED))
    {
        output->landingActive = 1u;
        output->altReached = 0u;
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_LANDING;
        output->triggerSources |= landingTrigger;
        output->primaryReason = sequenceContext.primaryReason;
        if (landingTriggeredThisStep != 0u)
        {
            /* 兼容既有语义：触发拍立即撤销运动资格，高度/RGB/蜂鸣从下一拍缓降输出接管。 */
            output->policyPositionActive = 1u;
        }
    }
    if (output->requestDisarm != 0u) directDisarmActive = 1u;

    if ((facts->safety.state != SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP) ||
        (facts->safety.valid == 0u) || (facts->paramsValid == 0u) ||
        (facts->initialized == 0u) || (facts->controlReady == 0u) ||
        (directDisarmActive != 0u))
    {
        output->altitudeControlEnable = 0u;
        output->idleThrottleMode = 0u;
        output->altReached = 0u;
        output->policyPositionActive = 1u;
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_SAFETY_STATE;
    }
    /* 唯一owner在目标/门设置后推进 altitudeHold，并以本拍fresh failsafe做最终钳制。 */
    pidFlightControllerSetIdleThrottleMode(output->idleThrottleMode);
    altitudeHoldSetControlEnabled(output->altitudeControlEnable);
    altitudeHoldSetTargetMm(output->altitudeTargetMm);
    altitudeHoldUpdate(facts->nowMs);
    altitudeHoldGetSnapshot(&output->altitude);
    if (output->altitude.failsafeStage != ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_NORMAL)
    {
        output->rgbIntent = UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN;
        output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_WARN;
    }
    if (output->altitude.failsafeStage == ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_RAMP)
    {
        output->altReached = 0u;
        output->policyPositionActive = 1u;
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_TOF_RAMP;
        output->triggerSources |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_TOF_FAILSAFE;
        if (output->primaryReason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
            output->primaryReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_TOF_FAILSAFE;
    }
    if (output->altitude.requestDisarm != 0u)
    {
        output->requestDisarm = 1u;
        output->altReached = 0u;
        output->policyPositionActive = 1u;
        output->safetyClampMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_SAFETY_STATE;
    }
    if ((facts->readyBeepActive != 0u) && (output->landingActive == 0u) &&
        (output->altitude.failsafeStage == ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_NORMAL) &&
        ((output->buzzerPattern == UART_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT) ||
         (output->buzzerPattern == UART_LINK_BUZZER_3S)))
        output->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_THREE_BEEPS;

    /* 最终水平引导仲裁：Policy本地 > 普通视觉/MOTION；安全钳制已将Policy源置零。 */
    if (output->policyPositionActive == 0u)
    {
        uint8_t externalAllowed = (uint8_t) (output->allowExternalMotion && facts->motionValid &&
            facts->motionFenceOpen && !facts->standalone &&
            facts->systemPhase == CORE_UX_PHASE_HOME && !output->landingActive &&
            output->altitude.failsafeStage != ALTITUDE_FAILSAFE_RAMP);
        if (externalAllowed)
        {
            motionFeedforwardDiffUpdate(facts->motionVx, facts->motionVy,
                facts->motionSeq, facts->nowMs);
            if (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_CRUISE)
            {
                output->bodyVelocityFwdMps = facts->motionVx *
                    sequenceParams.motionVelFfVxToFwd;
                output->bodyVelocityRightMps = facts->motionVy *
                    FLIGHT_MOTION_VEL_FF_VY_TO_RIGHT_SIGN *
                    sequenceParams.motionVelFfVyToRight;
                output->bodyVelocityFwdMps += facts->motionWz *
                    sequenceParams.motionYawOrbitOffsetRightM;
                output->bodyVelocityRightMps += facts->motionWz *
                    sequenceParams.motionYawOrbitOffsetFwdM;
            }
            output->pitchFeedforwardRad = motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvX() *
                sequenceParams.motionFfVxToPitch;
            output->rollFeedforwardRad = motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvY() *
                sequenceParams.motionFfVyToRoll;
            output->yawRateRadS = facts->motionWz * sequenceParams.motionFfWzToYaw;
        }
        else motionFeedforwardDiffReset();

        if (output->allowVisionPosition &&
            (renderStage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_CRUISE) &&
            sequenceParams.visionPosErrEnable && facts->visionFrameValid)
        {
            uint8_t visionFinite = (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(facts->visionErrX) &&
                finiteFloat(facts->visionErrY) && finiteFloat(facts->visionYawErr) &&
                facts->visionErrX >= -FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX &&
                facts->visionErrX <= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX &&
                facts->visionErrY >= -FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX &&
                facts->visionErrY <= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_ERROR_PX &&
                facts->visionYawErr >= -FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_YAW_RAD &&
                facts->visionYawErr <= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_MAX_VISION_YAW_RAD);
            if (facts->visionTargetValid && visionFinite)
            {
                sequenceContext.lastVisionHadTarget = 1u;
                output->visionErrX = facts->visionErrX;
                output->visionErrY = facts->visionErrY;
                output->visionYawErr = facts->visionYawErr;
                output->visionValid = 1u;
            }
            else if (sequenceContext.lastVisionHadTarget && visionFinite &&
                facts->targetLostAgeMs < 3000u)
            {
                output->visionErrX = facts->visionErrX;
                output->visionErrY = facts->visionErrY;
                output->visionValid = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        if (output->landingActive != 0u)
        {
            /* 缓降保留Policy显式机体系命令，但撤销外部MOTION微分前馈及其历史。 */
            motionFeedforwardDiffReset();
            output->pitchFeedforwardRad = 0.0f;
            output->rollFeedforwardRad = 0.0f;
        }
        else
        {
            motionFeedforwardDiffUpdate(output->bodyVelocityFwdMps,
                output->bodyVelocityRightMps * FLIGHT_MOTION_VEL_FF_VY_TO_RIGHT_SIGN,
                sequenceContext.cycleSeq, facts->nowMs);
            output->pitchFeedforwardRad = motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvX() *
                sequenceParams.motionFfVxToPitch;
            output->rollFeedforwardRad = motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvY() *
                sequenceParams.motionFfVyToRoll;
        }
    }

    if ((output->safetyClampMask & (FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_SAFETY_STATE |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_CLAMP_TOF_RAMP)) != 0u)
    {
        output->visionValid = 0u;
        output->visionErrX = 0.0f;
        output->visionErrY = 0.0f;
        output->visionYawErr = 0.0f;
        output->bodyVelocityFwdMps = 0.0f;
        output->bodyVelocityRightMps = 0.0f;
        output->yawRateRadS = 0.0f;
        output->pitchFeedforwardRad = 0.0f;
        output->rollFeedforwardRad = 0.0f;
        motionFeedforwardDiffReset();
    }

    output->cycleSeq = sequenceContext.cycleSeq;
    output->episodeSeq = sequenceContext.episodeSeq;
    output->transitionSeq = sequenceContext.transitionSeq;
    output->triggerSources |= sequenceContext.latchedTriggerSources;
    if (output->primaryReason == CORE0_FAULT_REASON_NONE)
        output->primaryReason = sequenceContext.primaryReason;
    output->valid = 1u;
}

#include "flightSequencePolicyInternal.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "configFlightSequence.h"
#include "coreDataTransfer.h"
#include "uartLinkProto.h"

/*
 * 现场唯一编辑面：触发选择与阶段位置命令均集中在本文件。
 * 不注册回调、不使用 weak/动态内存，也不进入 ISR。
 */
typedef struct
{
    float descentTargetMm;
    uint8_t descentPrimed;
    uint8_t descentReanchorPending;
} flightSequencePolicyPrivateStruct;

static flightSequencePolicyPrivateStruct policyPrivate;

static inline void flightSequencePolicySlowRise(
    const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts,
    const flightSequencePolicyContextStruct *context,
    flightSequencePolicyDecisionStruct *decision)
{
    float fraction;
    (void) facts;
    fraction = (TAKEOFF_RAMP_MS > 0u) ?
        ((float) context->stageElapsedMs / (float) TAKEOFF_RAMP_MS) : 1.0f;
    if (fraction > 1.0f) fraction = 1.0f;
    decision->overrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_ALTITUDE |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_POSITION |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_RGB |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_BUZZER |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_REACHED;
    decision->altitudeTargetMm = context->stageEntryAltitudeMm + fraction *
        (context->cruiseAltitudeMm - context->stageEntryAltitudeMm);
    decision->bodyVelocityFwdMps = 0.0f;
    decision->bodyVelocityRightMps = 0.0f;
    decision->yawRateRadS = 0.0f;
    decision->allowVisionPosition = 0u;
    decision->allowExternalMotion = 1u;
    decision->localPositionValid = 0u; /* 默认保留HEAD的非巡航角度/yaw前馈；改为1即可启用本地命令并排他接管。 */
    decision->rgbIntent = UART_LINK_RGB_TKO_RAMP;
    decision->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_1HZ;
    decision->altReached = 0u;
    decision->overrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_CONTROL;
    decision->altitudeControlEnable = 1u;
    decision->idleThrottleMode = 0u;
}

static inline void flightSequencePolicySlowDescent(
    const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts,
    const flightSequencePolicyContextStruct *context,
    flightSequencePolicyDecisionStruct *decision)
{
    if (policyPrivate.descentPrimed == 0u)
    {
        policyPrivate.descentTargetMm = context->stageEntryAltitudeMm;
        policyPrivate.descentPrimed = 1u;
        policyPrivate.descentReanchorPending = facts->altitude.healthy ? 0u : 1u;
    }
    if (facts->altitude.healthy == 0u)
    {
        policyPrivate.descentReanchorPending = 1u;
    }
    else if (policyPrivate.descentReanchorPending != 0u)
    {
        policyPrivate.descentTargetMm = (float) facts->altitude.distanceMm;
        policyPrivate.descentReanchorPending = 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        policyPrivate.descentTargetMm -= LAND_DESCEND_RATE_MM_S *
            ((float) context->dtMs / 1000.0f);
        if (policyPrivate.descentTargetMm < LAND_FLOOR_MM)
            policyPrivate.descentTargetMm = LAND_FLOOR_MM;
    }

    decision->overrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_ALTITUDE |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_POSITION |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_RGB |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_BUZZER |
        FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_REACHED;
    decision->altitudeTargetMm = policyPrivate.descentTargetMm;
    decision->bodyVelocityFwdMps = 0.0f;
    decision->bodyVelocityRightMps = 0.0f;
    decision->yawRateRadS = 0.0f;
    decision->allowVisionPosition = 0u;
    decision->allowExternalMotion = 0u;
    decision->localPositionValid = 1u;
    decision->rgbIntent = UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN;
    decision->buzzerPattern = UART_LINK_BUZZER_WARN;
    decision->altReached = 0u;
    decision->overrideMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_OVERRIDE_CONTROL;
    decision->altitudeControlEnable = 1u;
    decision->idleThrottleMode = 0u;
    /* 目标到地板只表示继续保持最低高度，不能证明飞机已经触地。
     * 仅允许健康 ToF 的实测高度触发停桨，避免实际下降跟随滞后时高空 disarm。 */
    if (facts->altitude.healthy &&
        ((float) facts->altitude.distanceMm <= LAND_TOUCHDOWN_MM))
    {
        decision->touchdown = 1u;
    }
}

void flightSequencePolicyReset(flightSequenceResetReasonEnum reason)
{
    (void) reason;
    memset(&policyPrivate, 0, sizeof(policyPrivate));
}

void flightSequencePolicySelectTriggers(const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts,
    const flightSequencePolicyContextStruct *context,
    flightSequencePolicyDecisionStruct *decision)
{
    if ((facts == 0) || (context == 0) || (decision == 0)) return;

    if (facts->k5LaunchEdge != 0u)
    {
        decision->actionMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_ARM;
        decision->triggerSources |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_K5_LAUNCH;
        decision->triggerEventSeq = facts->coordinatorCycleSeq;
        decision->triggerEventValid = 1u;
        if (facts->systemMode != (uint8_t) UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_LORA_FWD)
            decision->actionMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_TAKEOFF;
    }
    if (context->mode3RequestEvent != 0u)
    {
        decision->triggerSources |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_LORA_MODE3;
        decision->triggerEventSeq = facts->mode3RequestSeq;
        decision->triggerEventValid = 1u;
        if (context->stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_IDLE)
            decision->actionMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_TAKEOFF;
        else
        {
            decision->actionMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_LAND;
            decision->primaryReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_LORA_MODE3;
        }
    }
    if ((context->mode2RequestEvent != 0u) &&
        (context->stage != FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_IDLE))
    {
        decision->actionMask |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_POLICY_ACTION_LAND;
        decision->triggerSources |= FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_TRIGGER_LORA_MODE2;
        decision->triggerEventSeq = facts->mode2RequestSeq;
        decision->triggerEventValid = 1u;
        decision->primaryReason = CORE0_FAULT_REASON_LAND_LORA_MODE2;
    }
}

void flightSequencePolicyApplyStage(const flightSequenceFactsStruct *facts,
    const flightSequencePolicyContextStruct *context,
    flightSequencePolicyDecisionStruct *decision)
{
    if ((facts == 0) || (context == 0) || (decision == 0)) return;
    if (context->stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_RAMP)
        flightSequencePolicySlowRise(facts, context, decision);
    else if (context->stage == FLIGHT_SEQUENCE_STAGE_DESCENDING)
        flightSequencePolicySlowDescent(facts, context, decision);
}

#include "IMU.h"

#include "zf_driver_delay.h"
#include "zf_common_interrupt.h"
#include "zf_device_imu660ra.h"

#include "commonDef.h"
#include "lowPassFilter.h"
#include "flightParams.h"
#include "mahony.h"

/* imu660ra: ±8G / ±2000DPS 默认配置（与驱动 IMU660RA_*_SAMPLE_DEFAULT 保持一致）
 * 加速度满量程 ±8g → 32768 LSB / 8g → 4096 LSB/g → 1g = 9.81 m/s^2
 *   增益 = 9.81 / 4096 ≈ 0.002395 m/s^2 / LSB
 * 陀螺仪满量程 ±2000DPS → 32768 LSB / 2000 → 16.384 LSB/(°/s)
 *   增益 = (1/16.384) * π/180 rad/s/LSB
 */
#define IMU660RA_ACC_GAIN_MPS2   (9.81f / 4096.0f)
#define IMU660RA_GYRO_GAIN_RADPS ((1.0f / 16.384f) * (PI / 180.0f))

#define IMUOffectCount   (2000)
#define IMUOffectDelayMs (2u)
#define IMU_FREEZE_TIMEOUT_MS       (100u)
#define IMU_FREEZE_RECOVERY_SAMPLES (20u)

typedef struct
{
    volatile _6IMUDATA data;
    volatile uint32_t snapshotSeq;
    volatile uint8_t snapshotValid;
    volatile uint8_t healthReason;
    volatile uint16_t unchangedMs;
    uint8_t recoverySamples;
    uint8_t rawPrimed;
    int16_t lastRaw[6];
    int16_t gyroXOffset;
    int16_t gyroYOffset;
    int16_t gyroZOffset;
    float gyroXRaw;
    float gyroYRaw;
    float gyroZRaw;
    volatile float gyroXFiltered;
    volatile float gyroYFiltered;
    volatile float gyroZFiltered;
    float accX;
    float accY;
    float accZ;
    LowPassFilterData gyroLpfX;
    LowPassFilterData gyroLpfY;
    LowPassFilterData gyroLpfZ;
} imuContextStruct;

static imuContextStruct imuContext;

#define imuData          imuContext.data
#define imuSnapshotSeq   imuContext.snapshotSeq
#define imuSnapshotValid imuContext.snapshotValid
#define imuHealthReason  imuContext.healthReason
#define imuUnchangedMs   imuContext.unchangedMs
#define gyroXOffset      imuContext.gyroXOffset
#define gyroYOffset      imuContext.gyroYOffset
#define gyroZOffset      imuContext.gyroZOffset
#define gyroXRaw         imuContext.gyroXRaw
#define gyroYRaw         imuContext.gyroYRaw
#define gyroZRaw         imuContext.gyroZRaw
#define gyroXFiltered    imuContext.gyroXFiltered
#define gyroYFiltered    imuContext.gyroYFiltered
#define gyroZFiltered    imuContext.gyroZFiltered
#define accX             imuContext.accX
#define accY             imuContext.accY
#define accZ             imuContext.accZ
#define gyroLpfX         imuContext.gyroLpfX
#define gyroLpfY         imuContext.gyroLpfY
#define gyroLpfZ         imuContext.gyroLpfZ

static void getOffset(void);

uint8_t IMUInit(void)
{
    uint8_t imuInitState = imu660ra_init();
    flightParamsStruct params;

    imuSnapshotValid = 0u;
    imuHealthReason = IMU_HEALTH_OK;
    imuUnchangedMs = 0u;
    imuContext.recoverySamples = 0u;
    imuContext.rawPrimed = 0u;
    imuSnapshotSeq = 0u;
    if (imuInitState) return imuInitState;

    getOffset();

    flightParamsGetActive(&params);
    lowPassFilterInit(&gyroLpfX, params.gyroLpfAlpha);
    lowPassFilterInit(&gyroLpfY, params.gyroLpfAlpha);
    lowPassFilterInit(&gyroLpfZ, params.gyroLpfAlpha);

    mahony6Init((_6IMUDATA *) &imuData, &gyroXRaw, &gyroYRaw, &gyroZRaw, &accX, &accY, &accZ);
    imuSnapshotValid = 1u;

    return imuInitState;
}

void IMUApplyParams(void)
{
    flightParamsStruct params;
    flightParamsGetActive(&params);
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    gyroLpfX.alpha = params.gyroLpfAlpha;
    gyroLpfY.alpha = params.gyroLpfAlpha;
    gyroLpfZ.alpha = params.gyroLpfAlpha;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

inline void IMUUpdate(void)
{
    uint8_t changed;
    imu660ra_get_gyro();
    imu660ra_get_acc();

    changed = (uint8_t)((imuContext.rawPrimed == 0u) ||
        (imu660ra_gyro_x != imuContext.lastRaw[0]) ||
        (imu660ra_gyro_y != imuContext.lastRaw[1]) ||
        (imu660ra_gyro_z != imuContext.lastRaw[2]) ||
        (imu660ra_acc_x != imuContext.lastRaw[3]) ||
        (imu660ra_acc_y != imuContext.lastRaw[4]) ||
        (imu660ra_acc_z != imuContext.lastRaw[5]));
    if (changed != 0u)
    {
        imuContext.lastRaw[0] = imu660ra_gyro_x;
        imuContext.lastRaw[1] = imu660ra_gyro_y;
        imuContext.lastRaw[2] = imu660ra_gyro_z;
        imuContext.lastRaw[3] = imu660ra_acc_x;
        imuContext.lastRaw[4] = imu660ra_acc_y;
        imuContext.lastRaw[5] = imu660ra_acc_z;
        imuContext.rawPrimed = 1u;
        imuUnchangedMs = 0u;
        if (imuHealthReason == IMU_HEALTH_FROZEN)
        {
            if (imuContext.recoverySamples < IMU_FREEZE_RECOVERY_SAMPLES)
                imuContext.recoverySamples++;
            if (imuContext.recoverySamples >= IMU_FREEZE_RECOVERY_SAMPLES)
            {
                imuHealthReason = IMU_HEALTH_OK;
                imuSnapshotValid = 1u;
                imuContext.recoverySamples = 0u;
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        if (imuUnchangedMs < IMU_FREEZE_TIMEOUT_MS) imuUnchangedMs++;
        if (imuUnchangedMs >= IMU_FREEZE_TIMEOUT_MS)
        {
            imuHealthReason = IMU_HEALTH_FROZEN;
            imuSnapshotValid = 0u;
            imuContext.recoverySamples = 0u;
        }
    }

    gyroXRaw = (float) (imu660ra_gyro_x - gyroXOffset) * IMU660RA_GYRO_GAIN_RADPS;
    gyroYRaw = (float) (imu660ra_gyro_y - gyroYOffset) * IMU660RA_GYRO_GAIN_RADPS;
    gyroZRaw = (float) (imu660ra_gyro_z - gyroZOffset) * IMU660RA_GYRO_GAIN_RADPS;

    lowPassFilter(&gyroLpfX, gyroXRaw);
    lowPassFilter(&gyroLpfY, gyroYRaw);
    lowPassFilter(&gyroLpfZ, gyroZRaw);

    gyroXFiltered = gyroLpfX.filteredValue;
    gyroYFiltered = gyroLpfY.filteredValue;
    gyroZFiltered = gyroLpfZ.filteredValue;

    accX = (float) imu660ra_acc_x * IMU660RA_ACC_GAIN_MPS2;
    accY = (float) imu660ra_acc_y * IMU660RA_ACC_GAIN_MPS2;
    accZ = (float) imu660ra_acc_z * IMU660RA_ACC_GAIN_MPS2;

    mahony6Update((_6IMUDATA *) &imuData);
    imuSnapshotSeq++;
}

void IMUGetSnapshot(imuSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    uint32_t primask;
    uint8_t i;
    if (out == 0) return;

    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    out->seq = imuSnapshotSeq;
    out->valid = imuSnapshotValid;
    out->healthReason = imuHealthReason;
    out->unchangedMs = imuUnchangedMs;
    for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) out->q[i] = imuData.q[i];
    out->physicalPitch = imuData.roll;
    out->physicalRoll = imuData.pitch;
    out->yaw = imuData.yaw;
    out->gyroPitchRaw = gyroXRaw;
    out->gyroRollRaw = gyroYRaw;
    out->gyroYawRaw = gyroZRaw;
    out->gyroPitchFiltered = gyroXFiltered;
    out->gyroRollFiltered = gyroYFiltered;
    out->gyroYawFiltered = gyroZFiltered;
    out->accelSensorX = accX;
    out->accelSensorY = accY;
    out->accelSensorZ = accZ;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

static void getOffset(void)
{
    system_delay_ms(500u);

    int xTemp = 0, yTemp = 0, zTemp = 0;

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < IMUOffectCount; i++)
    {
        imu660ra_get_gyro();

        xTemp += (int) imu660ra_gyro_x;
        yTemp += (int) imu660ra_gyro_y;
        zTemp += (int) imu660ra_gyro_z;

        system_delay_ms(IMUOffectDelayMs);
    }

    gyroXOffset = (int16_t) (xTemp / IMUOffectCount);
    gyroYOffset = (int16_t) (yTemp / IMUOffectCount);
    gyroZOffset = (int16_t) (zTemp / IMUOffectCount);
}

#ifndef _IMU_H_
#define _IMU_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core0 IMU（imu660ra）装配方向 → 物理姿态映射（机械零点均为 0°）
 *   物理 pitch（前倾正） ← imuData.roll  与  *imuData.gx
 *   物理 roll （左倾正） ← imuData.pitch 与  *imuData.gy
 *   物理 yaw  （CW 为负）← imuData.yaw   与  *imuData.gz
 *
 * Mahony 解算逻辑保持不变，只在使用层（pidFlightController / core0Loop）按上述映射重新绑定。
 *
 * Gyro 双路：
 *   - imuData.gx/gy/gz 指针指向 raw（未滤波）gyro，喂给 Mahony，避免低通带来的相位滞后。
 *   - imuGyroFilteredX/Y/Z 指针指向 1ms 一阶 LPF 滤波后的 gyro，专供角速度内环 PID 使用。
 *     LPF 系数由运行时 flightParams.gyroLpfAlpha 控制，可经 IMUApplyParams() 热重载。
 */
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t seq;
    uint8_t valid;
    uint8_t healthReason;
    uint16_t unchangedMs;
    float q[4];
    float physicalPitch;
    float physicalRoll;
    float yaw;
    float gyroPitchRaw;
    float gyroRollRaw;
    float gyroYawRaw;
    float gyroPitchFiltered;
    float gyroRollFiltered;
    float gyroYawFiltered;
    float accelSensorX;
    float accelSensorY;
    float accelSensorZ;
} imuSnapshotStruct;

#define IMU_HEALTH_OK     (0u)
#define IMU_HEALTH_FROZEN (1u)

/* 一次短临界区返回同拍姿态、角速度和加速度；调用方不再依赖 Mahony/厂商类型。 */
void IMUGetSnapshot(imuSnapshotStruct *out);

uint8_t IMUInit(void);
void IMUApplyParams(void);
void IMUUpdate(void);

#endif  // _IMU_H_

/*
 * mahony.c
 *
 *  Created: 20250116
 *  Author: Hecate
 */
#include "mahony.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <stddef.h>

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Definitions

#define sampleFreq 1000.0f  // sample frequency in Hz
#define twoKpDef   (1.0f)   // 2 * proportional gain
#define twoKiDef   (0.0f)   // 2 * integral gain

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Variable definitions

static volatile float twoKp = twoKpDef;                                            // 2 * proportional gain (Kp)
static volatile float twoKi = twoKiDef;                                            // 2 * integral gain (Ki)
static volatile float integralFBx = 0.0f, integralFBy = 0.0f, integralFBz = 0.0f;  // integral error terms scaled by Ki

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Function declarations

static inline float invSqrt(float x);

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846f
#endif

#ifndef M_2PI
#define M_2PI 6.28318530717958647692f
#endif

static void MahonyAHRSupdateIMU(float q[4], float gx, float gy, float gz, float ax, float ay, float az);

void mahony6Init(_6IMUDATA* obj, float* gx, float* gy, float* gz, float* ax, float* ay, float* az)
{
    obj->q[0] = 1.0f;
    obj->q[1] = 0.0f;
    obj->q[2] = 0.0f;
    obj->q[3] = 0.0f;
    obj->gx = gx;
    obj->gy = gy;
    obj->gz = gz;
    obj->ax = ax;
    obj->ay = ay;
    obj->az = az;

    obj->pitch = 0.0f;
    obj->roll = 0.0f;
    obj->yaw = 0.0f;
}

static inline void quaternionToEuler(const float q[4], float* pitch, float* roll, float* yaw);
static volatile const float yawfre = (1.0f / sampleFreq);
void mahony6Update(_6IMUDATA* obj)
{
    MahonyAHRSupdateIMU(obj->q, *(obj->gx), *(obj->gy), *(obj->gz), *(obj->ax), *(obj->ay), *(obj->az));

    quaternionToEuler(obj->q, &(obj->pitch), &(obj->roll), &(obj->yaw));
}

//====================================================================================================
// Functions

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// IMU algorithm update

static void MahonyAHRSupdateIMU(float q[4], float gx, float gy, float gz, float ax, float ay, float az)
{
    float recipNorm;
    float halfvx, halfvy, halfvz;
    float halfex, halfey, halfez;
    float qa, qb, qc;

    static float half_errorInv;
    static int count = 0;
    /********************************参数规划*********************************************************************************************************************/

    if (count < 3000)
    {
        count += 2;
        twoKp = 20;
    }
    else
    {
        if (half_errorInv < 20)
            twoKp = 0.1f;
        else
            twoKp = 4;
    }

    /*****************************************************************************************************************************************************/

    // Compute feedback only if accelerometer measurement valid (avoids NaN in accelerometer normalisation)
    if (!((ax == 0.0f) && (ay == 0.0f) && (az == 0.0f)))
    {
        // Normalise accelerometer measurement
        recipNorm = invSqrt(ax * ax + ay * ay + az * az);
        ax *= recipNorm;
        ay *= recipNorm;
        az *= recipNorm;

        // Estimated direction of gravity and vector perpendicular to magnetic flux
        halfvx = q[1] * q[3] - q[0] * q[2];
        halfvy = q[0] * q[1] + q[2] * q[3];
        halfvz = q[0] * q[0] - 0.5f + q[3] * q[3];

        // Error is sum of cross product between estimated and measured direction of gravity
        halfex = (ay * halfvz - az * halfvy);
        halfey = (az * halfvx - ax * halfvz);
        halfez = (ax * halfvy - ay * halfvx);
        half_errorInv = invSqrt(halfex * halfex + halfey * halfey + halfez * halfez);
        // Compute and apply integral feedback if enabled
        if (twoKi > 0.0f)
        {
            integralFBx += twoKi * halfex * (1.0f / sampleFreq);  // integral error scaled by Ki
            integralFBy += twoKi * halfey * (1.0f / sampleFreq);
            integralFBz += twoKi * halfez * (1.0f / sampleFreq);
            gx += integralFBx;  // apply integral feedback
            gy += integralFBy;
            gz += integralFBz;
        }
        else
        {
            integralFBx = 0.0f;  // prevent integral windup
            integralFBy = 0.0f;
            integralFBz = 0.0f;
        }

        // Apply proportional feedback
        gx += twoKp * halfex;
        gy += twoKp * halfey;
        gz += twoKp * halfez;
    }

    // Integrate rate of change of quaternion
    gx *= (0.5f * (1.0f / sampleFreq));  // pre-multiply common factors
    gy *= (0.5f * (1.0f / sampleFreq));
    gz *= (0.5f * (1.0f / sampleFreq));
    qa = q[0];
    qb = q[1];
    qc = q[2];
    q[0] += (-qb * gx - qc * gy - q[3] * gz);
    q[1] += (qa * gx + qc * gz - q[3] * gy);
    q[2] += (qa * gy - qb * gz + q[3] * gx);
    q[3] += (qa * gz + qb * gy - qc * gx);

    // Normalise quaternion
    recipNorm = invSqrt(q[0] * q[0] + q[1] * q[1] + q[2] * q[2] + q[3] * q[3]);
    q[0] *= recipNorm;
    q[1] *= recipNorm;
    q[2] *= recipNorm;
    q[3] *= recipNorm;
}

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fast inverse square-root
// See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fast_inverse_square_root

static inline float invSqrt(float x)
{
    float halfx = 0.5f * x;
    float y = x;
    long i = *(long*) &y;
    i = 0x5f3759df - (i >> 1);
    y = *(float*) &i;
    y = y * (1.5f - (halfx * y * y));
    return y;
}

static inline void quaternionToEuler(const float q[4], float* pitch, float* roll, float* yaw)
{
    if (q == NULL)
        return;

    const float q0 = q[0];  // w
    const float q1 = q[1];  // x
    const float q2 = q[2];  // y
    const float q3 = q[3];  // z

    const float sinr_cosp = 2.0f * (q0 * q1 + q2 * q3);
    const float cosr_cosp = 1.0f - 2.0f * (q1 * q1 + q2 * q2);
    *roll = atan2f(sinr_cosp, cosr_cosp);

    float sinp = 2.0f * (q0 * q2 - q1 * q3);
    if (sinp > 1.0f)
        sinp = 1.0f;
    else if (sinp < -1.0f)
        sinp = -1.0f;
    *pitch = asinf(sinp);

    const float siny_cosp = 2.0f * (q0 * q3 + q1 * q2);
    const float cosy_cosp = 1.0f - 2.0f * (q2 * q2 + q3 * q3);
    *yaw = atan2f(siny_cosp, cosy_cosp);
}

    volatile uint8_t launchPending;
    volatile uint8_t disarmPending;

    volatile uint32_t transitionSeq;
    volatile uint32_t launchAcceptedSeq;
    volatile uint32_t disarmAcceptedSeq;
    volatile uint32_t protectAcceptedSeq;
    volatile uint8_t lastPostureSafe;
    volatile uint8_t lastTofHealthy;
    volatile uint8_t configUpdateActive;
    modeFlightConfigStruct config;
} flightSafetyContextStruct;

static flightSafetyContextStruct safetyContext = {
    .safetyState = SAFETY_STATE_DISARMED
};

#define flightSafetyState       safetyContext.safetyState
#define launchRequestPending    safetyContext.launchPending
#define disarmRequestPending    safetyContext.disarmPending
#define protectionRequestPending safetyContext.protectionPending
#define flightSafetySeq         safetyContext.seq
#define flightTransitionSeq     safetyContext.transitionSeq
#define flightLaunchAcceptedSeq  safetyContext.launchAcceptedSeq
#define flightDisarmAcceptedSeq  safetyContext.disarmAcceptedSeq
#define flightProtectAcceptedSeq safetyContext.protectAcceptedSeq
#define lastPostureSafe         safetyContext.lastPostureSafe
#define lastTofHealthy          safetyContext.lastTofHealthy
#define modeConfig              safetyContext.config

static inline uint8_t postureSafeCheck(const imuSnapshotStruct* imu)
{
    float physicalPitch = imu->physicalPitch;
    float physicalRoll = imu->physicalRoll;
    if (!imu->valid) return 0u;
    if ((floatIsFinite(physicalPitch) == 0u) || (floatIsFinite(physicalRoll) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(modeConfig.pitchMin) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(modeConfig.pitchMax) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(modeConfig.rollMin) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(modeConfig.rollMax) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(modeConfig.gyroMax) == 0u)) return 0u;
    if (physicalPitch < modeConfig.pitchMin || physicalPitch > modeConfig.pitchMax ||
        physicalRoll < modeConfig.rollMin || physicalRoll > modeConfig.rollMax)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    float gx = imu->gyroPitchRaw;
    float gy = imu->gyroRollRaw;
    float gz = imu->gyroYawRaw;
    float gyroMax = modeConfig.gyroMax;
    if ((floatIsFinite(gx) == 0u) || (floatIsFinite(gy) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(gz) == 0u)) return 0u;
    if (gx > gyroMax || gx < -gyroMax ||
        gy > gyroMax || gy < -gyroMax ||
        gz > gyroMax || gz < -gyroMax)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    return 1u;
}
void modeFlightRequestLaunch(void)
{
    launchRequestPending = 1u;
}

void modeFlightRequestDisarm(void)
{
    disarmRequestPending = 1u;
}

void modeFlightRequestProtection(void)
{
    protectionRequestPending = 1u;
}

uint8_t modeFlightTryBeginConfigUpdate(void)
{
    uint8_t accepted = 0u;
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    if ((flightSafetyState != SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP) && !safetyContext.configUpdateActive)
    {
        safetyContext.configUpdateActive = 1u;
        accepted = 1u;
    }
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    return accepted;
}

void modeFlightEndConfigUpdate(void)
{
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    safetyContext.configUpdateActive = 0u;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

void modeFlightApplyParams(void)
{
    flightParamsStruct params;
    modeFlightConfigStruct next;
    uint32_t primask;
    flightParamsGetActive(&params);
    next.pitchMin = params.postureSafePitchMinRad;
    next.pitchMax = params.postureSafePitchMaxRad;
    next.rollMin = params.postureSafeRollMinRad;
    next.rollMax = params.postureSafeRollMaxRad;
    next.gyroMax = params.postureSafeGyroMaxRadS;
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    modeConfig = next;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

void modeFlightSafetyTick(void)
{
    imuSnapshotStruct imu;
    uint8_t launchRequested = 0u;
    uint8_t disarmRequested = disarmRequestPending;
    uint8_t safe;
    if (!safetyContext.configUpdateActive)
    {
        launchRequested = launchRequestPending;
        launchRequestPending = 0u;
    }
    disarmRequestPending = 0u;
    IMUGetSnapshot(&imu);
    safe = postureSafeCheck(&imu);
    /* 发车额外条件：ToF 健康。ToF 链路/测距/突变保护异常时禁止起飞，
     * 避免仅靠基准油门 + 姿态环进入无可靠高度反馈的飞行状态。 */
    uint8_t canLaunch = (uint8_t) (safe && altitudeHoldIsHealthy());
    lastPostureSafe = safe;
    lastTofHealthy = altitudeHoldIsHealthy();
    flightSafetySeq++;

    if (protectionRequestPending)
    {
        protectionRequestPending = 0u;
        if (flightSafetyState != SAFETY_STATE_PROTECTED)
        {
            pidFlightControllerStop();
            flightSafetyState = SAFETY_STATE_PROTECTED;
            flightTransitionSeq++;
            flightProtectAcceptedSeq++;
        }
        else pidFlightControllerStop();
        return;
    }

    /* 回待机/断联缓降落地请求（core0Loop disarm 标志）：优先于发车处理。
     * 仅闭环态接受（回待机或缓降只在 CLOSED_LOOP 触发，请求回 DISARMED，支持随后重新发车）。
     * pidFlightControllerStop 停机 + 清 PID/输出/电机（同姿态保护停机路径）；置 DISARMED；
     * 中止起飞时序回 IDLE（避免残留时序在下次发车前误编排）。本拍 disarm 后不再处理发车。 */
    if (disarmRequested && flightSafetyState == SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP)
    {
        pidFlightControllerStop();
        flightSafetyState = SAFETY_STATE_DISARMED;
        flightTransitionSeq++;
        flightDisarmAcceptedSeq++;
        return;
    }

    switch (flightSafetyState)
    {
        case SAFETY_STATE_DISARMED:
            /* 上电不自动起控；收到发车指令且姿态安全 + ToF 健康才进闭环 */
            if (launchRequested && canLaunch)
            {
                pidFlightControllerInit();
                flightSafetyState = SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP;
                pidFlightControllerSetEnabled(1u);
                flightTransitionSeq++;
                flightLaunchAcceptedSeq++;
            }
            break;

        case SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP:
            if (!safe)
            {
                pidFlightControllerStop();
                flightSafetyState = SAFETY_STATE_PROTECTED;
                flightTransitionSeq++;
                flightProtectAcceptedSeq++;
            }
            break;

        case SAFETY_STATE_PROTECTED:
            /* 扶正后再次发车重新 init 闭环起飞（支持多次发车）。 */
            if (launchRequested && canLaunch)
            {
                pidFlightControllerInit();
                flightSafetyState = SAFETY_STATE_CLOSED_LOOP;
                pidFlightControllerSetEnabled(1u);
                flightTransitionSeq++;
                flightLaunchAcceptedSeq++;
            }
            break;

        default:
            break;
    }
}

void modeFlightGetSnapshot(flightSafetySnapshotStruct *out)
{
    uint32_t primask;
    if (out == 0) return;
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    out->seq = flightSafetySeq;
    out->transitionSeq = flightTransitionSeq;
    out->launchAcceptedSeq = flightLaunchAcceptedSeq;
    out->disarmAcceptedSeq = flightDisarmAcceptedSeq;
    out->protectAcceptedSeq = flightProtectAcceptedSeq;
    out->state = flightSafetyState;
    out->postureSafe = lastPostureSafe;
    out->tofHealthy = lastTofHealthy;
    out->valid = 1u;
    out->configUpdateActive = safetyContext.configUpdateActive;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

#include "motionFeedforwardDiff.h"

#include "commonDef.h"
#include "configFlightControlDefaults.h"
#include "flightParams.h"
#include "lowPassFilter.h"

static float motionCmdDvX = 0.0f; /* MOTION vx 指令微分 m/s^2，经限幅+低通；首帧/超时为 0 */
static float motionCmdDvY = 0.0f; /* MOTION vy 指令微分 m/s^2，经限幅+低通；首帧/超时为 0 */
static LowPassFilterData motionDiffLpfVx;
static LowPassFilterData motionDiffLpfVy;
static uint8_t motionDiffPrimed = 0u;
static uint32_t motionDiffLastSeq = 0u;
static uint32_t motionDiffLastMs = 0u;
static uint32_t motionDiffLastFilterMs = 0u;
static float motionDiffLastVx = 0.0f;
static float motionDiffLastVy = 0.0f;
static float motionDiffLimitX;
static float motionDiffLimitY;
static float motionDiffAlphaX;
static float motionDiffAlphaY;

static float motionDiffFilterAxis(LowPassFilterData *lpf, float raw, float limit, float alpha)
{
    if (limit <= 0.0f)
    {
        lowPassFilterReset(lpf, 0.0f);
        return 0.0f;
    }
    lpf->alpha = clampf(alpha, FLIGHT_LPF_ALPHA_MIN, FLIGHT_LPF_ALPHA_MAX);
    raw = clampf(raw, -limit, limit);
    lowPassFilter(lpf, raw);
    return lpf->filteredValue;
}

void motionFeedforwardDiffReset(void)
{
    motionCmdDvX = 0.0f;
    motionCmdDvY = 0.0f;
    motionDiffPrimed = 0u;
    motionDiffLastSeq = 0u;
    motionDiffLastMs = 0u;
    motionDiffLastFilterMs = 0u;
    motionDiffLastVx = 0.0f;
    motionDiffLastVy = 0.0f;
    lowPassFilterReset(&motionDiffLpfVx, 0.0f);
    lowPassFilterReset(&motionDiffLpfVy, 0.0f);
}

void motionFeedforwardDiffInit(void)
{
    lowPassFilterInit(&motionDiffLpfVx, FLIGHT_MOTION_FF_VX_DIFF_LPF_ALPHA);
    lowPassFilterInit(&motionDiffLpfVy, FLIGHT_MOTION_FF_VY_DIFF_LPF_ALPHA);
    motionFeedforwardDiffReset();
    motionFeedforwardDiffApplyParams();
}

void motionFeedforwardDiffApplyParams(void)
{
    flightParamsStruct params;
    flightParamsGetActive(&params);
    motionDiffLimitX = params.motionFfVxDiffLimitMps2;
    motionDiffLimitY = params.motionFfVyDiffLimitMps2;
    motionDiffAlphaX = params.motionFfVxDiffLpfAlpha;
    motionDiffAlphaY = params.motionFfVyDiffLpfAlpha;
}

static void motionFeedforwardDiffDecay(uint32_t nowMs)
{
    if (!motionDiffPrimed) return;

    if ((nowMs - motionDiffLastFilterMs) >= (uint32_t) FLIGHT_MOTION_FF_DIFF_DT_MIN_MS)
    {
        motionCmdDvX = motionDiffFilterAxis(&motionDiffLpfVx, 0.0f,
            motionDiffLimitX, motionDiffAlphaX);
        motionCmdDvY = motionDiffFilterAxis(&motionDiffLpfVy, 0.0f,
            motionDiffLimitY, motionDiffAlphaY);
        motionDiffLastFilterMs = nowMs;
    }
}

void motionFeedforwardDiffUpdate(float vx, float vy, uint32_t rxSeq, uint32_t nowMs)
{
    if (!motionDiffPrimed)
    {
        motionDiffPrimed = 1u;
        motionDiffLastSeq = rxSeq;
        motionDiffLastMs = nowMs;
        motionDiffLastFilterMs = nowMs;
        motionDiffLastVx = vx;
        motionDiffLastVy = vy;
        motionCmdDvX = 0.0f;
        motionCmdDvY = 0.0f;
        lowPassFilterReset(&motionDiffLpfVx, 0.0f);
        lowPassFilterReset(&motionDiffLpfVy, 0.0f);
        return;
    }

    if (rxSeq != motionDiffLastSeq)
    {
        uint32_t dtMs = nowMs - motionDiffLastMs;
        float invDtS;
        float rawDx;
        float rawDy;
        if (dtMs < (uint32_t) FLIGHT_MOTION_FF_DIFF_DT_MIN_MS)
        {
            dtMs = (uint32_t) FLIGHT_MOTION_FF_DIFF_DT_MIN_MS;
        }
        invDtS = 1000.0f / (float) dtMs;
        rawDx = (vx - motionDiffLastVx) * invDtS;
        rawDy = (vy - motionDiffLastVy) * invDtS;

        motionCmdDvX = motionDiffFilterAxis(&motionDiffLpfVx, rawDx,
            motionDiffLimitX, motionDiffAlphaX);
        motionCmdDvY = motionDiffFilterAxis(&motionDiffLpfVy, rawDy,
            motionDiffLimitY, motionDiffAlphaY);

        motionDiffLastSeq = rxSeq;
        motionDiffLastMs = nowMs;
        motionDiffLastFilterMs = nowMs;
        motionDiffLastVx = vx;
        motionDiffLastVy = vy;
    }
    else
    {
        motionFeedforwardDiffDecay(nowMs);
    }
}

float motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvX(void)
{
    return motionCmdDvX;
}

float motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvY(void)
{
    return motionCmdDvY;
}

#ifndef _MOTION_FEEDFORWARD_DIFF_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * 运动前馈微分（core0 飞控）：对 MOTION 帧的 vx/vy 速度指令做指令微分（dt 下限保护 + 分轴限幅 +
 * 一阶低通），输出 m/s^2 量纲的 dvx/dvy，供 core0Loop 并入 pitch/roll 角度前馈。
 *
 * 状态机自包含（原内联于 core0Loop.c，前台 whileProcess 调用，非 ISR）：
 *   Init   —— processInit 一次性初始化低通并复位状态。

 *   Reset  —— 链路超时/无运动信号时复位（dvx/dvy 归零、状态清空）。
 *   GetDvX/GetDvY —— 前台读取最新微分值（生产消费同前台，无需 volatile）。
 * 参数（限幅/低通 alpha）取自 flightParams，运行时菜单可调；alpha 区间见 FLIGHT_LPF_ALPHA_MIN/MAX。
 */

void motionFeedforwardDiffApplyParams(void);
void motionFeedforwardDiffReset(void);
void motionFeedforwardDiffUpdate(float vx, float vy, uint32_t rxSeq, uint32_t nowMs);
float motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvX(void);
float motionFeedforwardDiffGetDvY(void);

#endif /* _MOTION_FEEDFORWARD_DIFF_H_ */

#include "motor.h"

#include "pinMap.h"
#include "zf_driver_pwm.h"
#include "zf_driver_delay.h"

/*
 * 400 Hz Servo PWM
 *   周期 2500µs；脉宽 950-2000µs 映射到 duty 寄存器 3800-8000
 *   (PWM_DUTY_MAX=10000 → 100% duty = 周期；950/2500*10000=3800)
 *
 * core0 移植说明：cm_7_0 不拥有 IPS114（屏幕归 cm_7_1），故 arming 全程
 *   不调用任何 ips114_*。进度通过 volatile motorArmProgress (0~100) 暴露，
 *   并经 motorInit(onProgress) 回调由 cm_7_0 写共享内存（safetyState=0xFE +
 *   armProgress），cm_7_1 据此在屏上画 ESC arming 进度条。 */
#define ESC_PWM_FREQ_HZ   (400u)
#define ESC_PWM_PERIOD_US (1000000u / ESC_PWM_FREQ_HZ)                               /* 2500 */
#define ESC_PWM_REG_MIN   ((MOTOR_STOP_PULSE_US * PWM_DUTY_MAX) / ESC_PWM_PERIOD_US) /* 3800 */
#define ESC_PWM_REG_MAX   ((MOTOR_FULL_PULSE_US * PWM_DUTY_MAX) / ESC_PWM_PERIOD_US) /* 8000 */
#define ESC_PWM_REG_SPAN  (ESC_PWM_REG_MAX - ESC_PWM_REG_MIN)                        /* 4200 */

/* 上电 arming：1050→950µs 扫描后保持 950µs 3s */
#define ESC_ARM_SWEEP_START_US (1050u)
#define ESC_ARM_SWEEP_STEPS    (101u)
#define ESC_ARM_SWEEP_STEP_MS  (20u)
#define ESC_ARM_HOLD_MS        (3000u)
#define ESC_ARM_TOTAL_MS       (ESC_ARM_SWEEP_STEPS * ESC_ARM_SWEEP_STEP_MS + ESC_ARM_HOLD_MS)

/* ESC 物理方位映射（P5.0/1/2/3 = BL/BR/FL/FR）见 pinMap.h */

/* arming 进度 0~100，供跨核调试显示读取 */
volatile uint8_t motorArmProgress = 0u;

/* ==========================================================
 * 内部 helper：duty→PWM 寄存器 / 寄存器→脉宽
 * ========================================================== */

static inline uint32_t rawDutyToReg(int16_t duty)
{
    if (duty <= 0) return (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN;
    return (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN + (uint32_t) ((duty * (int32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_SPAN) / (int32_t) MOTOR_DUTY_MAX);
}

/* ==========================================================
 * 百分比油门 API
 *   0~100%  ←→  MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MIN_US~MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MAX_US
 *   pct<=0  →  停机（950µs）
 *   pct>100 →  钳到上限
 * ========================================================== */

static int16_t motorPercentToDuty(float pct)
{
    /* NaN 唯一满足 x!=x 的浮点数；NaN 视为停机 */
    if (pct != pct) return 0;
    if (pct <= 0.0f) return 0;
    if (pct > 100.0f) pct = 100.0f;

    float span = (float) (MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MAX - MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MIN);
    float d = (float) MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MIN + (pct * 0.01f) * span;

    if (d < (float) MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MIN) d = (float) MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MIN;
    if (d > (float) MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MAX) d = (float) MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MAX;
    return (int16_t) (d + 0.5f);
}

void motorSetThrottlePercent(float flPct, float frPct, float blPct, float brPct)
{
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FL, rawDutyToReg(motorPercentToDuty(flPct)));
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FR, rawDutyToReg(motorPercentToDuty(frPct)));
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BL, rawDutyToReg(motorPercentToDuty(blPct)));
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BR, rawDutyToReg(motorPercentToDuty(brPct)));
}

/* ==========================================================
 * 生命周期
 * ========================================================== */

void motorInit(motorArmProgressCb onProgress)
{
    uint8_t i;
    uint32_t elapsedMs = 0u;

    motorArmProgress = 0u;

    /* 先让4路PWM进入确定的停机脉宽，再发布arming状态。
     * 避免共享状态写入期间ESC控制脚仍处于未初始化/悬空状态。 */
    pwm_init(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FL, ESC_PWM_FREQ_HZ, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_init(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FR, ESC_PWM_FREQ_HZ, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_init(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BL, ESC_PWM_FREQ_HZ, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_init(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BR, ESC_PWM_FREQ_HZ, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    if (onProgress != 0) onProgress(0u);

    /* 阶段 1：1050→950µs 扫描 */
    for (i = 0u; i < ESC_ARM_SWEEP_STEPS; i++)
    {
        uint32_t pulseUs = (uint32_t) ESC_ARM_SWEEP_START_US - (uint32_t) i;
        uint32_t reg = (pulseUs * (uint32_t) PWM_DUTY_MAX) / (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_PERIOD_US;
        pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FL, reg);
        pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FR, reg);
        pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BL, reg);
        pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BR, reg);
        system_delay_ms(ESC_ARM_SWEEP_STEP_MS);
        elapsedMs += ESC_ARM_SWEEP_STEP_MS;
        motorArmProgress = (uint8_t) ((elapsedMs * 100u) / ESC_ARM_TOTAL_MS);
        if (onProgress != 0) onProgress(motorArmProgress);
    }

    /* 阶段 2：保持 950µs 3s */
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FL, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FR, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BL, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BR, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    {
        uint32_t holdMs = 0u;
        uint32_t holdStep = 100u;
        while (holdMs < ESC_ARM_HOLD_MS)
        {
            system_delay_ms(holdStep);
            holdMs += holdStep;
            elapsedMs += holdStep;
            motorArmProgress = (uint8_t) ((elapsedMs * 100u) / ESC_ARM_TOTAL_MS);
            if (onProgress != 0) onProgress(motorArmProgress);
        }
    }

    motorArmProgress = 100u;
    if (onProgress != 0) onProgress(100u);
}

void motorStopAll(void)
{
    /* 全通道写停机脉宽 950µs */
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FL, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_FR, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BL, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
    pwm_set_duty(ESC_CH_PHYSICAL_BR, (uint32_t) ESC_PWM_REG_MIN);
}

#ifndef _MOTOR_H_
#define _MOTOR_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core0 ESC 驱动：4 路 400Hz Servo PWM（AM32 移植版自动识别为 servo 协议）
 *
 * 实际物理方位映射（用户硬件接线）：
 *   FL → TCPWM_CH11 / P5.2，顺时针
 *   FR → TCPWM_CH12 / P5.3，逆时针
 *   BL → TCPWM_CH09 / P5.0，逆时针
 *   BR → TCPWM_CH10 / P5.1，顺时针
 *
 * ===== 控制接口（百分比油门）=====
 *   闭环控制链路统一使用 motorSetThrottlePercent，输入为百分比（0~100）：
 *     pct <= 0            → 停机（950µs）
 *     0 < pct < 下限      → 抬到 1100µs
 *     下限..100           → 线性映射到 MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MIN~MAX
 *     pct > 100           → 钳到上限
 *
 * ===== 例外路径 =====
 *   motorInit 内部 arming 与 motorStopAll 直接写 950µs 脉宽，
 *   绕过百分比映射，是上电/急停安全的最后兜底。
 */

#define MOTOR_DUTY_MAX (10000)

#define MOTOR_STOP_PULSE_US       (950u)
#define MOTOR_FULL_PULSE_US       (2000u)
#define MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MIN_US (1100u)
/* PID 飞控正油门上限：1940µs */
#define MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MAX_US (1940u)
#define MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MIN     ((int16_t) (((MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MIN_US - MOTOR_STOP_PULSE_US) * (uint32_t) MOTOR_DUTY_MAX) / (MOTOR_FULL_PULSE_US - MOTOR_STOP_PULSE_US)))
#define MOTOR_ACTIVE_DUTY_MAX     ((int16_t) (((MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MAX_US - MOTOR_STOP_PULSE_US) * (uint32_t) MOTOR_DUTY_MAX) / (MOTOR_FULL_PULSE_US - MOTOR_STOP_PULSE_US)))

/* ===== 百分比油门接口 =====
 *   输入：0~100（%），对应脉宽线性映射到 MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MIN_US ~ MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MAX_US
 *   特殊值：
 *     pct <= 0            → 停机（950µs）
 *     0 < pct < 实际下限  → 抬到 MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MIN_US
 *     pct > 上限           → 钳到 MOTOR_ACTIVE_PULSE_MAX_US 等效百分比
 *   钳位逻辑在 motor.c 内部，上层不再重复钳位。
 */
void motorSetThrottlePercent(float flPct, float frPct, float blPct, float brPct);

/* arming 进度 0~100（cm_7_0 无 LCD，进度供跨核调试显示读取） */
extern volatile uint8_t motorArmProgress;

/* arming 进度回调：每步进度更新时调用，供 cm_7_0 把进度写共享内存给 cm_7_1 画进度条。
 * 解耦设计：motor.c 不依赖 coreDataTransfer，由调用方注入。NULL 表示不回调。 */
typedef void (*motorArmProgressCb)(uint8_t progress);

/* ===== 生命周期 ===== */
void motorInit(motorArmProgressCb onProgress); /* 阻塞 ~5s arming（1050→950 扫描 + 3s 保持），无 LCD */
void motorStopAll(void); /* 全部输出停机脉宽 (950µs) */

#endif /* _MOTOR_H_ */

代码（c）
#include "PID.h"

#include <math.h>

static void incrementalPidProcessHandler(PID *obj, float currentValue)
{
    float error = obj->expectedValue - currentValue;
    float deltaError = error - obj->lastError;

    obj->controlValue +=
        obj->kp * deltaError +
        obj->ki * error +
        obj->kd * (deltaError - (obj->lastError - obj->beforeLastError));

    obj->beforeLastError = obj->lastError;
    obj->lastError = error;
}

static void positionalPidHandler(PID *obj, float currentValue)
{
    float error = obj->expectedValue - currentValue;

    obj->integral += error;

    if (obj->integralMax)
    {
        if (obj->integral > obj->integralMax) obj->integral = obj->integralMax;
        else if (obj->integral < -obj->integralMax) obj->integral = -obj->integralMax;
    }

    obj->controlValue =
        obj->kp * error +
        obj->ki * obj->integral +
        obj->kd * (error - obj->lastError);

    obj->lastError = error;
}

/* 位置式 PID + D 项一阶低通：对 (error - lastError) 过 LPF 后乘 kd */
static void positionalPidWithDLpfHandler(PID *obj, float currentValue)
{
    float error = obj->expectedValue - currentValue;

    obj->integral += error;

    if (obj->integralMax)
    {
        if (obj->integral > obj->integralMax) obj->integral = obj->integralMax;
        else if (obj->integral < -obj->integralMax) obj->integral = -obj->integralMax;
    }

    lowPassFilter(&obj->dLpf, error - obj->lastError);

    obj->controlValue =
        obj->kp * error +
        obj->ki * obj->integral +
        obj->kd * obj->dLpf.filteredValue;

    obj->lastError = error;
}

void pidInit(PID *obj, float integralMax, float target, float kp, float ki, float kd, float derivativeLpfAlpha)
{
    obj->expectedValue = target;
    obj->kp = kp;
    obj->ki = ki;
    obj->kd = kd;

    if (ki != 0.0f && integralMax != 0.0f) obj->integralMax = fabsf(integralMax / ki);
    else obj->integralMax = 0.0f;

    obj->lastError = 0.0f;
    obj->beforeLastError = 0.0f;
    obj->integral = 0.0f;
    obj->controlValue = 0.0f;

    /* D 项 LPF：仅在位置式 + alpha∈(0,1) 时启用 */
    if (integralMax != 0.0f && derivativeLpfAlpha > 0.0f && derivativeLpfAlpha < 1.0f)
    {
        lowPassFilterInit(&obj->dLpf, derivativeLpfAlpha);
        obj->dLpfEnabled = 1u;
        obj->process = positionalPidWithDLpfHandler;
    }
    else
    {
        lowPassFilterInit(&obj->dLpf, 1.0f);
        obj->dLpfEnabled = 0u;
        if (integralMax == 0.0f) obj->process = incrementalPidProcessHandler;
        else obj->process = positionalPidHandler;
    }
}

inline void pidProcess(PID *obj, float currentValue)
{
    obj->process(obj, currentValue);
}

void pidReset(PID *obj)
{
    obj->expectedValue = 0.0f;
    obj->lastError = 0.0f;
    obj->beforeLastError = 0.0f;
    obj->integral = 0.0f;
    obj->controlValue = 0.0f;
    lowPassFilterInit(&obj->dLpf, obj->dLpf.alpha);
}

代码（c）
#ifndef _PID_H_
#define _PID_H_

#include <stdint.h>

#include "lowPassFilter.h"

/*
 * 通用 PID 控制器
 *   - integralMax == 0 → 增量式（用于电流/速度类无稳态的环；D 项 LPF 强制不启用）
 *   - integralMax > 0  → 位置式（积分限幅自动按 ki 折算）
 *
 * D 项低通：
 *   - derivativeLpfAlpha >= 1.0f             → 不启用（位置式直接乘 kd）
 *   - derivativeLpfAlpha ∈ (0,1) 且 位置式   → 启用，对 (error - lastError) 过一阶 LPF 后再乘 kd
 *   - 增量式无视 alpha
 *
 * 用法：
 *   PID pitchAnglePid;
 *   pidInit(&pitchAnglePid, 5.0f, 0.0f, 4.0f, 0.0f, 0.02f, 1.0f);    // 位置式无 D 项 LPF
 *   pidInit(&pitchRatePid, 5.0f, 0.0f, 17.1f, 0.0f, 17.0f, 0.3f);    // 位置式 + D 项 LPF
 *   pitchAnglePid.expectedValue = targetAngle;
 *   pidProcess(&pitchAnglePid, currentAngle);
 *   float out = pitchAnglePid.controlValue;
 */

typedef struct PID PID;
typedef void (*pidProcessHandlerFn)(PID *obj, float currentValue);

struct PID
{
    float expectedValue;
    float kp;
    float ki;
    float kd;

    float lastError;
    float beforeLastError;
    float integral;
    float integralMax;

    float controlValue;

    LowPassFilterData dLpf;
    uint8_t dLpfEnabled;

    pidProcessHandlerFn process;
};

/* 初始化：integralMax==0 选增量式，否则位置式。
 * integralMax 的含义：积分项在控制量单位下的最大贡献（内部换算为 |integral| ≤ integralMax/|ki|）
 * derivativeLpfAlpha：D 项一阶 LPF 系数；语义见文件头注释 */
void pidInit(PID *obj, float integralMax, float target, float kp, float ki, float kd, float derivativeLpfAlpha);
void pidProcess(PID *obj, float currentValue);
/* 清零 PID 运行状态（expectedValue/lastError/beforeLastError/integral/controlValue + 重置 D 项 LPF），
 * 保留 kp/ki/kd/integralMax/process 等配置；用于使能切换、急停、回放等需复位累加器的场景。 */
void pidReset(PID *obj);

#endif /* _PID_H_ */
