/* 速度环已与视觉位置环解耦：速度内环在 CLOSED_LOOP 下与姿态环同级常驻运行（velocityLoopUpdate），
 * 位置外环只负责生成/冻结/归零速度目标 posVelTarget（positionTargetUpdate），速度环再叠加 MOTION 速度前馈。 */

/* ===== 内部工具 ===== */

/* PID 单拍：写期望 → 处理反馈 → 输出钳幅 ±limit。 */
static inline float runPidClamped(PID *pid, float ref, float feedback, float limit)
{
    pid->expectedValue = ref;
    pidProcess(pid, feedback);
    return clampf(pid->controlValue, -limit, limit);
}

/* PID 单拍 + 角速度前馈：输出 = clampf(pidOut + ffCoeff*ref, ±limit)。
 * 仅角速度内环 pitch/roll 用（前馈量 = 目标角速度 = ref = expectedValue）。 */
static inline float runPidFF(PID *pid, float ref, float feedback, float ffCoeff, float limit)
{
    pid->expectedValue = ref;
    pidProcess(pid, feedback);
    return clampf(pid->controlValue + ffCoeff * ref, -limit, limit);
}

/* 定点串级复位：外环位置 PID + 内环速度 PID + 调度/保持状态。 */
/* 位置串级的非 PID 辅助状态清零（首测/重捕标记、保持修正、KF/视觉态、速度目标、分频计数）。
 * 重载增益版 resetPositionCascade 与仅清状态版 resetAllPidState 共用。 */
static void resetPositionCascadeState(void)
{
    posTargetPrimed = 0u;
    posVelPrimed = 0u;
    posHeldRollCorr = 0.0f;
    posHeldPitchCorr = 0.0f;
    posPrevKfValid = 0u;
    posKfInvalidTicks = 0u;
    posPrevVisionActive = 0u;
    posVelTargetX = 0.0f;
    posVelTargetY = 0.0f;
    posVelLoopCount = 0u;
    posLoopCount = 0u;
}

/* 定点串级复位（重载增益版）：4 个位置/速度 PID 从 flightParams 重载增益 + 清状态 + 辅助状态清零。 */
static void resetPositionCascade(void)
{
    pidInitFromParams(&posXPid, &pidConfig.posX, 0.0f); /* 目标误差为 0（^ 顶到目标中点） */
    pidInitFromParams(&posYPid, &pidConfig.posY, 0.0f);
    pidInitFromParams(&posVelXPid, &pidConfig.posVelX, 0.0f);
    pidInitFromParams(&posVelYPid, &pidConfig.posVelY, 0.0f);

    resetPositionCascadeState();
}

/* 全 PID 重载增益版（pidInitFromParams：从 flightParams 重载增益 + 清状态 + 设 expectedValue）。
 * 仅用于 Init / ApplyParams（增益可能变）。 */
static void resetAllPid(void)
{
    pidInitFromParams(&pitchAnglePid, &pidConfig.pitchAngle, pidConfig.pitchRefRad);
    pidInitFromParams(&rollAnglePid, &pidConfig.rollAngle, pidConfig.rollRefRad);
    pidInitFromParams(&pitchRatePid, &pidConfig.pitchRate, 0.0f);
    pidInitFromParams(&rollRatePid, &pidConfig.rollRate, 0.0f);
    pidInitFromParams(&yawRatePid, &pidConfig.yawRate, 0.0f);

    resetPositionCascade();

    pidInitFromParams(&yawAnglePid, &pidConfig.yawAngle, 0.0f); /* 目标 yawErr 为 0（机头对准 ^ 朝向） */
}

/* 全 PID 仅清状态版（pidReset：清累加器/lastError/controlValue/expectedValue + 重置 dLpf，保留增益）。
 * 用于 Stop（急停/disarm）+ idleThrottle 进/出边沿：增益不变只需清状态，各 PID expectedValue
 * 由下一控制拍 angle/rate/velocity/positionTarget 环重设，故清零无残留影响。 */
static void resetAllPidState(void)
{
    pidReset(&pitchAnglePid);
    pidReset(&rollAnglePid);
    pidReset(&pitchRatePid);
    pidReset(&rollRatePid);
    pidReset(&yawRatePid);

    pidReset(&posXPid);
    pidReset(&posYPid);
    pidReset(&posVelXPid);
    pidReset(&posVelYPid);

    resetPositionCascadeState();

    pidReset(&yawAnglePid);
}

/* 三个生命周期函数共有的参考值 + 循环计数器复位。 */
static void resetControlReferences(void)
{
    pidFlight.pitchRef = pidConfig.pitchRefRad;
    pidFlight.rollRef = pidConfig.rollRefRad;
    pidFlight.yawRateRef = pidConfig.yawRateRefRadS;
    angleLoopCount = 0u;
    yawAngleLoopCount = 0u;
}

/* Init/Stop 共有的控制输出清零（参考速率 + 控制量 + 电机 + 定高偏移）。 */
static void resetControlOutputs(void)
{
    pidFlight.pitchRateRef = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.rollRateRef = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.pitchCtrlPct = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.rollCtrlPct = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.yawCtrlPct = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.motorPct[0] = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.motorPct[1] = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.motorPct[2] = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.motorPct[3] = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.altitudeOffsetPct = 0.0f;
}

/* ===== 位置外环目标生成：27ms（速度内环 3 分频）=====
 * 把视觉像素误差换算为物理速度目标 posVelTargetX/Y（m/s, ZOH 供速度内环消费）。
 * 三态语义（速度环始终运行，仅目标来源不同）：
 *   ① 视觉有效(active=valid&&!held) → 跑位置 PID 更新目标 → 视觉指哪走哪
 *   ② 丢失保持期(held)             → 不跑 PID，冻结 posVelTarget 上次值（维持最后速度意图 ≤3s）
 *   ③ 无视觉/超时(!valid)          → posVelTarget 置 0（零速度位置保持/抗漂移）
 * errX↔roll(X 右向)、errY↔pitch(Y 前向)。 */
static void positionTargetUpdate(const imuSnapshotStruct* imu)
{
    uint8_t visionActive = (pidFlight.visionValid && !pidFlight.visionHeld) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t firstTarget = 0u;

    /* 态 ③：无视觉/超时 → 目标归零（区别于 held 的冻结）。位置 PID 状态待下次有效时重置。 */
    if (!pidFlight.visionValid)
    {
        posVelTargetX = 0.0f;
        posVelTargetY = 0.0f;
        posPrevVisionActive = 0u;
        return;
    }

    /* 态 ②：丢失保持期 → 冻结 posVelTarget 上次值，不跑 PID。 */
    if (!visionActive)
    {
        posPrevVisionActive = 0u;
        return;
    }

    /* 态 ①：视觉有效。首次识别 / 从无效或保持恢复 → 本拍立即跑一次位置外环并预置 lastError 防 D 冲击。 */
    if (!posTargetPrimed || !posPrevVisionActive)
    {
        firstTarget = 1u;
        posTargetPrimed = 1u;
        posLoopCount = 0u;
    }
    posPrevVisionActive = 1u;

    posLoopCount++;
    if (posLoopCount >= PID_FLIGHT_POS_LOOP_DIV || firstTarget)
    {
        float physicalPitch = imu->physicalPitch;
        float physicalRoll = imu->physicalRoll;
        float rawErrX = pidFlight.visionErrX;
        float rawErrY = pidFlight.visionErrY;
        float errCompX = rawErrX - pidConfig.posAttCompXGainPxPerRad * physicalRoll;  /* errX↔roll */
        float errCompY = rawErrY - pidConfig.posAttCompYGainPxPerRad * physicalPitch; /* errY↔pitch；增益默认 0 退化纯级联 */
        posLoopCount = 0u;

        if (firstTarget) posXPid.lastError = -errCompX;
        posVelTargetX = runPidClamped(&posXPid, 0.0f, errCompX, pidConfig.posVelCmdLimit);

        if (firstTarget) posYPid.lastError = -errCompY;
        posVelTargetY = runPidClamped(&posYPid, 0.0f, errCompY, pidConfig.posVelCmdLimit);
    }
}

/* ===== 速度内环：9ms，CLOSED_LOOP 下与姿态环同级常驻 =====
 * 期望=posVelTarget + ffVel(ZOH, m/s)，反馈=KF 物理速度 m/s → 角度修正（钳 ±posAngleLimitRad）。
 * 轴对齐：roll 环用 KF 右向、pitch 环用 KF 前向（KF 内部已去 yaw+倾摆，反馈不再做像素域姿态补偿）。
 * 轴极性：roll(左倾正) 与 右向速度(右正) 反号 → roll 输出取反才是负反馈；pitch(前倾正) 与 前向(前正) 同号 → 不取反。
 * 仅更新 posHeldRollCorr/PitchCorr；rollRef/pitchRef 由 positionReferenceUpdate 每 3ms 合成（含前馈）。
 * KF 失效(kfVelValid=0)：FREEZE_TICKS(≈150ms) 内冻结 posHeldRollCorr/PitchCorr 上次值（容忍光流瞬时丢帧），
 *   超时仍未恢复 → 角度修正归零（rollRef/pitchRef 退回纯基准姿态），保证长时间失效下姿态安全；恢复时预置 lastError 防 D 冲击。 */
static void velocityLoopUpdate(void)
{
    float velX = pidFlight.kfVelRight; /* roll 环反馈 m/s */
    float velY = pidFlight.kfVelFwd;   /* pitch 环反馈 m/s */
    float velCmdLimit = pidConfig.posVelCmdLimit;
    float velTargetX = clampf(posVelTargetX + pidFlight.ffVelRight, -velCmdLimit, velCmdLimit);
    float velTargetY = clampf(posVelTargetY + pidFlight.ffVelFwd, -velCmdLimit, velCmdLimit);

    /* KF 失效降级：短时(< FREEZE_TICKS)冻结上拍角度修正，保持 posVelTarget，不跑 PID；
     * 超时则归零角度修正，让姿态退回基准（纯姿态/定高仍在，水平不再依赖陈旧速度修正）。 */
    if (!pidFlight.kfVelValid)
    {
        posPrevKfValid = 0u;
        if (posKfInvalidTicks < PID_FLIGHT_KF_INVALID_FREEZE_TICKS)
        {
            posKfInvalidTicks++; /* 冻结期：posHeldRollCorr/PitchCorr 保持上次值不变 */
        }
        else
        {
            posHeldRollCorr = 0.0f;  /* 超时：归零角度修正，保姿态安全 */
            posHeldPitchCorr = 0.0f;
        }
        return;
    }

    posKfInvalidTicks = 0u; /* KF 有效：清失效计数 */

    /* 首测 / KF 恢复：预置 lastError 防微分冲击。 */
    if (!posVelPrimed || !posPrevKfValid)
    {
        posVelXPid.lastError = velTargetX - velX;
        posVelYPid.lastError = velTargetY - velY;
        posVelPrimed = 1u;
        posPrevKfValid = 1u;
    }

    /* 极性修正（roll 轴）：物理 roll 左倾正，而速度轴右向正——二者反号。
     * +rollRef(左倾) 使右向速度减小 ⇒ roll 环对地速度阻尼的回路增益为负，
     * 须对 PID 输出取反才构成负反馈（否则正反馈发散/跑飞）。
     * pitch 环"前倾正"与"前向正"同号、回路增益为正，故 velocityLoop 仅 roll 取反、pitch 不取反。 */
    posVelXPid.expectedValue = velTargetX;
    pidProcess(&posVelXPid, velX);
    posHeldRollCorr = clampf(-posVelXPid.controlValue,
        -pidConfig.posAngleLimitRad, pidConfig.posAngleLimitRad);

    posHeldPitchCorr = runPidClamped(&posVelYPid, velTargetY, velY, pidConfig.posAngleLimitRad);
}

/* ===== 位置/速度参考合成：3ms，与姿态角环同拍 =====
 * 速度内环在 CLOSED_LOOP 下常驻运行（不再被视觉有效性掐断），按 9ms 分频。
 * 位置外环（27ms）只在速度环拍内生成/冻结/归零速度目标。
 * rollRef/pitchRef 每 3ms 合成（基准 + 速度环角度修正 ZOH + 运动前馈），保证前馈 3ms 刷新。 */
static void positionReferenceUpdate(const imuSnapshotStruct* imu)
{
    posVelLoopCount++;
    if (posVelLoopCount >= PID_FLIGHT_POS_VEL_LOOP_DIV)
    {
        posVelLoopCount = 0u;
        positionTargetUpdate(imu); /* 27ms 分频在内部：生成/冻结/归零速度目标 */
        velocityLoopUpdate();   /* 9ms：更新 posHeldRollCorr/PitchCorr */
    }

    pidFlight.rollRef = pidConfig.rollRefRad + posHeldRollCorr + pidFlight.ffRoll;
    pidFlight.pitchRef = pidConfig.pitchRefRad + posHeldPitchCorr + pidFlight.ffPitch;
}

/* ===== 偏航角度环：3ms（视觉 yawErr → yawRateRef）=====
 * 目标丢失时仅用运动前馈；输出钳位到 ±YAW_RATE_CMD_LIMIT。 */
static void yawAngleLoopUpdate(void)
{
    float yawRateCmd;
    if (!pidFlight.visionValid)
    {
        pidReset(&yawAnglePid); /* 视觉失效仅清累加器(增益不变,expectedValue 恒0)，防重捕 windup/D 冲击；原每拍全量重载属冗余 */
        yawRateCmd = 0.0f;
    }
    else
    {
        yawRateCmd = runPidClamped(&yawAnglePid, 0.0f, pidFlight.visionYawErr,
            pidConfig.yawRateCmdLimit);
    }
    pidFlight.yawRateRef = yawRateCmd + pidFlight.ffYawRate;
}

/* ===== 外环：3ms 角度 PID（pitch/roll）=====
 * pitchRef/rollRef 由位置环写入（含基准 + 位置修正 + 前馈）。 */
static void angleLoopUpdate(const imuSnapshotStruct* imu)
{
    pidFlight.pitchRateRef = runPidClamped(&pitchAnglePid, pidFlight.pitchRef,
        imu->physicalPitch, pidConfig.rateCmdLimitPitch);
    pidFlight.rollRateRef = runPidClamped(&rollAnglePid, pidFlight.rollRef,
        imu->physicalRoll, pidConfig.rateCmdLimitRoll);
}

/* ===== 内环：1ms 角速度 PID（pitch/roll/yaw）===== */
static void rateLoopUpdate(const imuSnapshotStruct* imu)
{
    pidFlight.pitchCtrlPct = runPidFF(&pitchRatePid, pidFlight.pitchRateRef,
        imu->gyroPitchFiltered, pidConfig.pitchRateFF, pidConfig.ctrlLimitPctPitch);
    pidFlight.rollCtrlPct = runPidFF(&rollRatePid, pidFlight.rollRateRef,
        imu->gyroRollFiltered, pidConfig.rollRateFF, pidConfig.ctrlLimitPctRoll);
    pidFlight.yawCtrlPct = runPidClamped(&yawRatePid, pidFlight.yawRateRef,
        imu->gyroYawFiltered, pidConfig.ctrlLimitPctYaw);
}

/* ===== 混控：基准油门 + 控制量 → 4 电机百分比 =====
 * 混控符号严格对齐 LQR 历史 T_ALLOC 物理约束：
 *   FL = base - pitchCtrl - rollCtrl + yawCtrl    (CW)
 *   FR = base - pitchCtrl + rollCtrl - yawCtrl    (CCW)
 *   BL = base + pitchCtrl - rollCtrl - yawCtrl    (CCW)
 *   BR = base + pitchCtrl + rollCtrl + yawCtrl    (CW)
 * 约定：正 pitchCtrl → 前倾力矩；正 rollCtrl → 左倾力矩；正 yawCtrl → CCW
 */
static void applyMixerAndOutput(void)
{
    float base = pidFlight.baseThrottlePct + pidFlight.altitudeOffsetPct;

    float pitchCmd = pidFlight.pitchCtrlPct;
    float rollCmd = pidFlight.rollCtrlPct;
    float yawCmd = pidFlight.yawCtrlPct;

    if ((floatIsFinite(base) == 0u) || (floatIsFinite(pitchCmd) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(rollCmd) == 0u) || (floatIsFinite(yawCmd) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(pidConfig.throttleMinPct) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(pidConfig.throttleMaxPct) == 0u))
    {
        pidFlightControllerStop();
        modeFlightRequestProtection();
        return;
    }

    float flPct = base - pitchCmd - rollCmd + yawCmd;
    float frPct = base - pitchCmd + rollCmd - yawCmd;
    float blPct = base + pitchCmd - rollCmd - yawCmd;
    float brPct = base + pitchCmd + rollCmd + yawCmd;

    if ((floatIsFinite(flPct) == 0u) || (floatIsFinite(frPct) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(blPct) == 0u) || (floatIsFinite(brPct) == 0u))
    {
        pidFlightControllerStop();
        modeFlightRequestProtection();
        return;
    }

    flPct = clampf(flPct, pidConfig.throttleMinPct, pidConfig.throttleMaxPct);
    frPct = clampf(frPct, pidConfig.throttleMinPct, pidConfig.throttleMaxPct);
    blPct = clampf(blPct, pidConfig.throttleMinPct, pidConfig.throttleMaxPct);
    brPct = clampf(brPct, pidConfig.throttleMinPct, pidConfig.throttleMaxPct);

    pidFlight.motorPct[0] = flPct;
    pidFlight.motorPct[1] = frPct;
    pidFlight.motorPct[2] = blPct;
    pidFlight.motorPct[3] = brPct;

    motorSetThrottlePercent(flPct, frPct, blPct, brPct);
}

/* WAIT 期输出：四路固定 Thr Min，不叠加任何闭环控制量。 */
static void outputIdleThrottle(void)
{
    if ((floatIsFinite(pidConfig.throttleMinPct) == 0u) ||
        (floatIsFinite(pidConfig.throttleMaxPct) == 0u))
    {
        pidFlightControllerStop();
        modeFlightRequestProtection();
        return;
    }
    float idlePct = clampf(pidConfig.throttleMinPct, 0.0f, pidConfig.throttleMaxPct);

    pidFlight.pitchRateRef = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.rollRateRef = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.pitchCtrlPct = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.rollCtrlPct = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.yawCtrlPct = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.altitudeOffsetPct = 0.0f;

    pidFlight.motorPct[0] = idlePct;
    pidFlight.motorPct[1] = idlePct;
    pidFlight.motorPct[2] = idlePct;
    pidFlight.motorPct[3] = idlePct;

    motorSetThrottlePercent(idlePct, idlePct, idlePct, idlePct);
}

/* ===== 外部接口 ===== */

void pidFlightControllerInit(void)
{
    resetAllPid();
    resetControlReferences();
    resetControlOutputs();
    idleThrottleWasActive = 0u;
    motionBarrierTicks = 0u;

    pidFlight.baseThrottlePct = pidConfig.baseThrottlePct;
    pidFlight.visionErrX = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.visionErrY = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.visionYawErr = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.visionValid = 0u;
    pidFlight.visionHeld = 0u;
    pidFlight.kfVelFwd = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.kfVelRight = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.kfVelValid = 0u;
    pidFlight.ffVelFwd = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.ffVelRight = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.ffPitch = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.ffRoll = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.ffYawRate = 0.0f;
    pidFlight.enabled = 0u;
    idleThrottleMode = 0u;
    idleThrottleWasActive = 0u;
}

void pidFlightControllerStop(void)
{
    /* enabled 必须先置零，防止 pitProcess1 中 Tick() 在 Stop 中途重写电机输出 */
    pidFlight.enabled = 0u;
    idleThrottleMode = 0u;
    idleThrottleWasActive = 0u;

    resetAllPidState(); /* 急停/disarm 只需清累加器(增益不变)；下次发车 Init 重载增益 */
    resetControlReferences();
    resetControlOutputs();

    motorStopAll();
}

void pidFlightControllerSetEnabled(uint8_t enabled)
{
    if (!enabled)
    {
        pidFlightControllerStop();
        return;
    }
    pidFlight.enabled = 1u;
}

void pidFlightControllerSetIdleThrottleMode(uint8_t active)
{
    idleThrottleMode = active ? 1u : 0u;
}

void pidFlightControllerApplyParams(void)
{
    /* 热重载：用 flightParams 最新值重置所有 PID 与基准油门。
     * 仅在非 CLOSED_LOOP 态由前台调用（cm_7_0 按 safetyState 门控，飞行中不触发）。
     * enabled 不变（停机态保持停机），仅刷新增益/限幅/参考。 */
    loadConfig();
    resetAllPid();
    resetControlReferences();
    pidFlight.baseThrottlePct = pidConfig.baseThrottlePct;
}

void pidFlightControllerSetGuidanceCommand(
    const pidFlightGuidanceCommandStruct *command)
{
    uint32_t primask;
    if (command == 0) return;
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    pidFlight.visionErrX = command->visionErrX;
    pidFlight.visionErrY = command->visionErrY;
    pidFlight.visionYawErr = command->visionYawErr;
    pidFlight.visionValid = command->visionValid;
    pidFlight.visionHeld = command->visionHeld;
    pidFlight.kfVelFwd = command->kfVelFwd;
    pidFlight.kfVelRight = command->kfVelRight;
    pidFlight.kfVelValid = command->kfVelValid;
    pidFlight.ffVelFwd = command->ffVelFwd;
    pidFlight.ffVelRight = command->ffVelRight;
    pidFlight.ffPitch = command->ffPitch;
    pidFlight.ffRoll = command->ffRoll;
    pidFlight.ffYawRate = command->ffYawRate;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

void pidFlightControllerSetAltitudeOffset(float value)
{
    pidFlight.altitudeOffsetPct = value;
}

void pidFlightControllerGetSnapshot(pidFlightSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    uint32_t primask;
    if (out == 0) return;
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    *out = pidFlight;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

void pidFlightControllerRequestMotionBarrier(uint8_t ticks)
{
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    if (ticks > motionBarrierTicks) motionBarrierTicks = ticks;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

uint8_t pidFlightControllerMotionBarrierPending(void)
{
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    uint8_t pending;
    __disable_irq();
    pending = motionBarrierTicks;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    return pending;
}

void pidFlightControllerTick(void)
{
    imuSnapshotStruct imu;
    IMUGetSnapshot(&imu);
    pidFlight.seq++;
    if (motionBarrierTicks != 0u)
    {
        pidFlight.ffVelFwd = 0.0f;
        pidFlight.ffVelRight = 0.0f;
        pidFlight.ffPitch = 0.0f;
        pidFlight.ffRoll = 0.0f;
        pidFlight.ffYawRate = 0.0f;
        motionBarrierTicks--;
    }
    if (!pidFlight.enabled)
    {
        idleThrottleWasActive = 0u;
        motorStopAll();
        return;
    }

    if (idleThrottleMode)
    {
        if (!idleThrottleWasActive)
        {
            resetAllPidState(); /* 进起转旁路：清累加器(增益不变) */
            resetControlReferences();
            resetControlOutputs();
            idleThrottleWasActive = 1u;
        }
        outputIdleThrottle();
        return;
    }

    if (idleThrottleWasActive)
    {
        resetAllPidState(); /* 出起转旁路恢复闭环：清累加器(增益不变)，expectedValue 下一拍重设 */
        resetControlReferences();
        resetControlOutputs();
        idleThrottleWasActive = 0u;
    }

    /* 偏航角度环：每 3 拍 = 3ms（yawErr → yawRateRef） */
    yawAngleLoopCount++;
    if (yawAngleLoopCount >= PID_FLIGHT_YAW_ANGLE_LOOP_DIV)
    {
        yawAngleLoopCount = 0u;
        yawAngleLoopUpdate();
    }

    /* 姿态角环：每 3 拍 = 3ms。positionReferenceUpdate 内部再分频：
     * 速度内环 9ms（CLOSED_LOOP 下常驻，不被视觉掐断）、位置外环 27ms（仅生成/冻结/归零速度目标）。
     * 同一到期拍严格按 位置目标 → 速度内环（写 rollRef/pitchRef）→ 姿态角环 执行。 */
    angleLoopCount++;
    if (angleLoopCount >= PID_FLIGHT_ANGLE_LOOP_DIV)
    {
        angleLoopCount = 0u;
        positionReferenceUpdate(&imu);
        angleLoopUpdate(&imu);
    }

    rateLoopUpdate(&imu);
    applyMixerAndOutput();
}

#ifndef _PID_FLIGHT_CONTROLLER_H_
#define _PID_FLIGHT_CONTROLLER_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core0 定高飞控 PID（仅 FULL_ALT_HOLD，无调试模式）
 *   - 外环：角度 PID，3ms；位置式（pitch/roll）
 *   - 内环：角速度 PID，1ms；位置式（pitch/roll/yaw），反馈用 imuGyroFiltered*（1ms LPF）
 *   - 角速度前馈：PID 输出 + FF 系数 × 目标角速度，结果钳位
 *   - yaw 作为角速度差速闭环，yawRateRef 由偏航角度环（Phase 3）写入
 *   - 混控：基准油门 + 控制量（百分点）叠加到 FL/FR/BL/BR
 *   - 输出：motorSetThrottlePercent（油门行程 1100~1940µs 映射为 0~100%）
 *
 * ===== 物理轴映射（与 IMU.h 一致）=====
 *   物理 pitch（前倾正）← imuData.roll   & *imuGyroFilteredX
 *   物理 roll （左倾正）← imuData.pitch  & *imuGyroFilteredY
 *   物理 yaw  （CCW 正）← imuData.yaw    & *imuGyroFilteredZ
 *
 * ===== 混控符号（X 四旋翼，对齐 LQR 历史 T_ALLOC 物理约束）=====
 *   base 是 [0,100] 百分比；pitchCtrl / rollCtrl / yawCtrl 单位为"百分点"(pp)
 *   电机旋向: FL=CW, FR=CCW, BL=CCW, BR=CW
 *   本工程沿用 LQR 历史 T_ALLOC 的反号约定；若改用实际力矩方向为正，混控正负需全部翻转。
 *   正 pitchCtrl → 前倾力矩（T_ALLOC 反号）；正 rollCtrl → 左倾力矩；正 yawCtrl → CCW
 *   FL = base - pitchCtrl - rollCtrl + yawCtrl    (CW)
 *   FR = base - pitchCtrl + rollCtrl - yawCtrl    (CCW)
 *   BL = base + pitchCtrl - rollCtrl - yawCtrl    (CCW)
 *   BR = base + pitchCtrl + rollCtrl + yawCtrl    (CW)
 *
 * ===== 调参入口 =====
 *   所有 PID 参数 / 限幅 / 滤波系数默认值集中于 configFlightControlDefaults.h，
 *   本文件仅暴露状态机与生命周期。
 */

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t seq;
    float pitchRef; /* 目标角 rad（基准 + 位置环修正） */
    float rollRef;
    float pitchRateRef; /* 外环输出的目标角速度 rad/s */
    float rollRateRef;
    float yawRateRef; /* yaw 角速度目标 rad/s（偏航角度环输出 + 前馈） */

    float pitchCtrlPct; /* 内环 pitch 控制量（pp） */
    float rollCtrlPct;
    float yawCtrlPct; /* 内环 yaw 控制量（pp） */

    float baseThrottlePct;
    float motorPct[4];       /* FL/FR/BL/BR 混控后百分比 */
    float altitudeOffsetPct; /* 定高 PID 输出（pp，叠加到基准油门） */

    /* 视觉/遥控输入（由 core0Loop 在前台写入，ISR 内消费） */
    float visionErrX;    /* 像素误差 X（已含极性） */
    float visionErrY;    /* 像素误差 Y */
    float visionYawErr;  /* ^ 朝向误差 rad（已含极性） */
    uint8_t visionValid; /* 1=视觉目标有效（含丢失保持期：仍按上次误差/冻结输出闭环） */
    uint8_t visionHeld;  /* 1=目标丢失保持期：位置外环冻结速度目标，速度内环仍常驻运行 */
    /* KF 物理速度反馈（机体水平航向系 m/s，由 core0Loop 前台写入 velocityEstimatorGet/IsValid）。
     * 速度内环反馈用此替代像素速度：kfVelFwd=前向(对齐 pitch 环)、kfVelRight=右向(对齐 roll 环)。 */
    float kfVelFwd;      /* KF 前向速度 m/s（axis[0]） */
    float kfVelRight;    /* KF 右向速度 m/s（axis[1]） */
    uint8_t kfVelValid;  /* 1=KF 估计可信（velocityEstimatorIsValid）；0=失效→速度环冻结上次输出降级 */
    float ffVelFwd;      /* MOTION 速度目标前馈：前向速度 m/s，叠加到 pitch 速度环目标 */
    float ffVelRight;    /* MOTION 速度目标前馈：右向速度 m/s，叠加到 roll 速度环目标 */
    float ffPitch;       /* 运动前馈 pitch 角度增量 rad（core0Loop 由 vx 指令微分换算） */
    float ffRoll;        /* 运动前馈 roll 角度增量 rad（core0Loop 由 vy 指令微分换算） */
    float ffYawRate;     /* 运动前馈 yaw 角速度 rad/s（core0Loop 由 wz 直通换算） */

    uint8_t enabled;
    uint8_t padding[3];
} pidFlightSnapshotStruct;

typedef struct
{
    float visionErrX;
    float visionErrY;
    float visionYawErr;
    uint8_t visionValid;
    uint8_t visionHeld;
    float kfVelFwd;
    float kfVelRight;
    uint8_t kfVelValid;
    float ffVelFwd;
    float ffVelRight;
    float ffPitch;

void pidFlightControllerTick(void);

代码（c）
#include "altitudeTof.h"

#include <math.h>

#include "boardConfig.h" /* ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT 等编译期选择器 */
#include "configAltitudeTof.h"
#include "flightParams.h"
#include "lowPassFilter.h"
#include "IMU.h"

#if ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT == ALT_TOF_SENSOR_VL53L1X
#include "tofL1x.h"
#elif ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT == ALT_TOF_SENSOR_VL53L8CX
#include "tofL8cx.h"
#else
#error "Unsupported ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT"
#endif

/* 两款驱动统一暴露的契约：取帧 + 采样周期。init 时绑定其一，业务路径全走指针。
 * vtable 随 ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT 编译期只定义被选芯片一套（未选芯片头未 include、
 * 函数未声明，不能无条件取地址）。 */
typedef struct
{
    uint8_t (*init)(void);
    uint8_t (*poll)(uint16_t *distanceMm, uint8_t *valid);
    float (*samplePeriodS)(void);
} tofChipOps;

#if ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT == ALT_TOF_SENSOR_VL53L1X
static const tofChipOps opsSelected = {tofL1xInit, tofL1xPoll, tofL1xSamplePeriodS};
#else
static const tofChipOps opsSelected = {tofL8cxInit, tofL8cxPoll, tofL8cxSamplePeriodS};
#endif

typedef enum
{
    TOF_PROTECT_NORMAL = 0,
    TOF_PROTECT_SUSPENDED
} tofProtectStateEnum;

typedef struct
{
    float frozenHeightMm;       /* 访问器输出的高度（last-valid，冻结期保持） */
    float frozenVelMmS;         /* 访问器输出的速度低通（last-valid，冻结期保持） */
    float lastAcceptedHeightMm; /* 门控基线：上一可信高度 */
    float lastDiffHeightMm;     /* 速度差分基准 */
    LowPassFilterData velLpf;

    uint8_t hasAccepted;      /* 是否已有有效基线 */
    uint8_t hasDiffBaseline;  /* 速度差分基准是否就绪 */
    uint8_t resetVelBaseline; /* 恢复首帧标志：不跨冻结期做差分 */
    uint8_t linkAlive;        /* 链路活（init 成功 + 看门狗未超时） */
    uint8_t rangeHealthy;     /* 最近一次测距可信 */
    uint8_t freshHealthy;     /* 本拍是否产出新鲜健康帧 */
    tofProtectStateEnum protectState;

    float invalidAccumMs;          /* 无效累计，达 altTimeoutMs 后丢弃基线 */
    float sampleElapsedS;          /* 节流/丢帧合并后的真实帧间隔累计 */
    volatile uint16_t silentMs;    /* 距上次出测量的毫秒数（ISR 累加），超时判链路死 */
    volatile uint16_t pollAccumMs; /* 轮询节流计时（ISR 累加，update 消费） */
} tofStateStruct;

static const tofChipOps *ops;
static tofStateStruct tof;

typedef struct
{
    float maxSpeedMmS;
    float timeoutMs;
    float minMm;
    float maxMm;
    float velAlpha;
} altitudeTofConfigStruct;

static altitudeTofConfigStruct tofConfig;

static void loadConfig(void)
{
    flightParamsStruct params;
    flightParamsGetActive(&params);
    tofConfig.maxSpeedMmS = params.altTofMaxSpeedMmS;
    tofConfig.timeoutMs = params.altTimeoutMs;
    tofConfig.minMm = params.altDistMinMm;
    tofConfig.maxMm = params.altDistMaxMm;
    tofConfig.velAlpha = params.altVelLpfAlpha;
}

static void resetState(void)
{
    tof.frozenHeightMm = 0.0f;
    tof.frozenVelMmS = 0.0f;
    tof.lastAcceptedHeightMm = 0.0f;
    tof.lastDiffHeightMm = 0.0f;
    tof.hasAccepted = 0u;
    tof.hasDiffBaseline = 0u;
    tof.resetVelBaseline = 1u;
    tof.linkAlive = 0u;
    tof.rangeHealthy = 0u;
    tof.freshHealthy = 0u;
    tof.protectState = TOF_PROTECT_NORMAL;
    tof.invalidAccumMs = 0.0f;
    tof.sampleElapsedS = 0.0f;
    tof.silentMs = 0u;
    tof.pollAccumMs = ALT_TOF_POLL_PERIOD_MS; /* 允许上电后首个 update 立即轮询一次 */
    lowPassFilterInit(&tof.velLpf, tofConfig.velAlpha);
}

/* 姿态补偿：斜距 → 垂直高度 height = slant × cos(pitch) × cos(roll)。
 * 合成倾角 cos 低于阈值（激光易打斜侧、投影失真放大）则判无效。 */
static float compensateTilt(uint16_t slantMm, uint8_t *valid)
{
    imuSnapshotStruct imu;
    float tiltCos;
    IMUGetSnapshot(&imu);
    tiltCos = cosf(imu.physicalPitch) * cosf(imu.physicalRoll);
    if (tiltCos < ALT_TOF_MIN_TILT_COS)
    {
        *valid = 0u;
        return 0.0f;
    }
    *valid = 1u;
    return (float) slantMm * tiltCos;
}

/* 时间域创新门控（L1X/L8CX 共用）：单帧相对上一可信高度变化超过
 * 物理最大垂直速度 × 实测帧间隔 即判离群丢弃。离群帧一律拒绝(返回 0)、不再聚簇重建基线
 * （旧「连续 N 帧聚簇即采纳」会让 L8CX 野值簇被当新基线产生突发高度骤变，已彻底剔除）。
 * 持续离群由 altitudeTofUpdate 累加 invalidAccumMs，达 altTimeoutMs 后丢弃基线从头确认
 * （纯超时兜底，防真实大高度变化永久锁死）。返回 1=接受，0=丢弃。 */
static uint8_t temporalGate(float heightMm, float dtS)
{
    float maxStep;
    float diff;

    if (!tof.hasAccepted)
    {
        tof.protectState = TOF_PROTECT_NORMAL;
        tof.resetVelBaseline = 1u;
        return 1u;
    }

    maxStep = tofConfig.maxSpeedMmS * dtS;
    if (maxStep < (float) ALT_TOF_MIN_STEP_MM)
    {
        maxStep = (float) ALT_TOF_MIN_STEP_MM;
    }

    diff = fabsf(heightMm - tof.lastAcceptedHeightMm);
    if (diff <= maxStep)
    {
        tof.protectState = TOF_PROTECT_NORMAL;
        return 1u;
    }

    /* 离群帧：直接拒绝冻结，不重建基线；持续离群靠 update 累加 invalidAccumMs 超时兜底。 */
    tof.protectState = TOF_PROTECT_SUSPENDED;
    return 0u;
}

/* 接受有效帧：差分 + 低通求速度，更新冻结值与门控基线。
 * 恢复首帧（resetVelBaseline）不跨冻结期做差分，速度低通锚定到上一有效值。 */
static void acceptFrame(float heightMm, float dtS)
{
    if (tof.resetVelBaseline || !tof.hasDiffBaseline || dtS <= 0.0f)
    {
        tof.hasDiffBaseline = 1u;
        tof.resetVelBaseline = 0u;
        lowPassFilterReset(&tof.velLpf, tof.frozenVelMmS);
    }
    else
    {
        lowPassFilter(&tof.velLpf, (heightMm - tof.lastDiffHeightMm) / dtS);
    }

    tof.lastAcceptedHeightMm = heightMm;
    tof.lastDiffHeightMm = heightMm;
    tof.frozenHeightMm = heightMm;
    tof.frozenVelMmS = tof.velLpf.filteredValue;
    tof.hasAccepted = 1u;
    tof.rangeHealthy = 1u;
    tof.freshHealthy = 1u;
}

/* 无效帧：清测距健康态、冻结高度+速度（frozen* 不动），并标记恢复首帧重建速度基线、
 * 清本次累计时基——保证恢复帧不跨冻结 gap 做速度差分（决策 A：避免恢复速度尖峰）。
 * 累计达 altTimeoutMs 则进一步丢弃门控基线，使门控从头确认。 */
static void handleInvalid(float dtS)
{
    tof.rangeHealthy = 0u;
    tof.freshHealthy = 0u;
    tof.resetVelBaseline = 1u;
    tof.sampleElapsedS = 0.0f;
    tof.invalidAccumMs += dtS * 1000.0f;

    if (tof.invalidAccumMs >= tofConfig.timeoutMs)
    {
        tof.hasAccepted = 0u;
        tof.hasDiffBaseline = 0u;
        tof.protectState = TOF_PROTECT_NORMAL;
        tof.invalidAccumMs = 0.0f;
    }
}

uint8_t altitudeTofInit(void)
{
    ops = &opsSelected;
    loadConfig();
    resetState();
    tof.linkAlive = ops->init();
    return tof.linkAlive;
}

void altitudeTofTickMs(void)
{
    /* 轮询节流计时无条件累加（即使链路失活也要继续，否则节流后无法恢复轮询） */
    if (tof.pollAccumMs < 0xFFFFu) tof.pollAccumMs++;

    if (!tof.linkAlive && !tof.rangeHealthy) return; /* 已失效，无需再累计 */
    if (tof.silentMs < ALT_TOF_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS)
    {
        tof.silentMs++;
        if (tof.silentMs >= ALT_TOF_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS)
        {
            /* 链路失活：清健康态，冻结高度+速度（frozen* 不动），拒绝发车。
             * 标记恢复首帧重建速度基线，与 invalid 恢复路径一致（防 dead recovery 速度尖峰）。 */
            tof.linkAlive = 0u;
            tof.rangeHealthy = 0u;
            tof.freshHealthy = 0u;
            tof.resetVelBaseline = 1u;
        }
    }
}

void altitudeTofUpdate(void)
{
    uint16_t slantMm = 0u;
    uint8_t rawValid = 0u;
    uint8_t tiltValid = 0u;
    float heightMm;
    float dtS;

    tof.freshHealthy = 0u;

    /* 软件 IIC 轮询节流：每 ALT_TOF_POLL_PERIOD_MS 才放行一次取帧。 */
    if (tof.pollAccumMs < ALT_TOF_POLL_PERIOD_MS) return;
    tof.pollAccumMs = 0u;

    if (ops == 0 || !ops->poll(&slantMm, &rawValid)) return;

    tof.silentMs = 0u; /* 出测量即喂看门狗，与距离是否有效无关 */
    tof.linkAlive = 1u;
    dtS = ops->samplePeriodS();
    tof.sampleElapsedS += dtS;

    /* 姿态补偿在范围检查之前：量程判定针对真实垂直高度 */
    heightMm = compensateTilt(slantMm, &tiltValid);
    if (!rawValid || !tiltValid ||
        heightMm < tofConfig.minMm || heightMm > tofConfig.maxMm)
    {
        handleInvalid(dtS); /* 无效超时累计用单帧 dt（防累计值二次膨胀提前超时） */
        return;
    }

    if (!temporalGate(heightMm, tof.sampleElapsedS))
    {
        /* 离群拒绝期：冻结(frozen* 不动)，标记恢复首帧重建速度基线、清累计时基。
         * 纯超时兜底：累加 invalidAccumMs(单帧 dt)，持续离群达 altTimeoutMs 则丢弃基线，
         * 下一帧因 !hasAccepted 无条件接受真值，防真实大高度变化永久锁死。 */
        tof.rangeHealthy = 0u;
        tof.resetVelBaseline = 1u;
        tof.sampleElapsedS = 0.0f;
        tof.invalidAccumMs += dtS * 1000.0f;
        if (tof.invalidAccumMs >= tofConfig.timeoutMs)
        {
            tof.hasAccepted = 0u;
            tof.protectState = TOF_PROTECT_NORMAL;
            tof.invalidAccumMs = 0.0f;
        }
        return;
    }

    tof.invalidAccumMs = 0.0f;
    acceptFrame(heightMm, tof.sampleElapsedS);
    tof.sampleElapsedS = 0.0f;
}

uint8_t tofGetHeight(float *heightMm, float *velFiltered)
{
    if (heightMm != 0) *heightMm = tof.frozenHeightMm;
    if (velFiltered != 0) *velFiltered = tof.frozenVelMmS;
    return tof.freshHealthy;
}

uint8_t altitudeTofIsHealthy(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (tof.linkAlive && tof.rangeHealthy &&
                      tof.protectState == TOF_PROTECT_NORMAL && tof.hasAccepted);
}

void altitudeTofApplyParams(void)
{
    loadConfig();
    lowPassFilterInit(&tof.velLpf, tofConfig.velAlpha);
    lowPassFilterReset(&tof.velLpf, tof.frozenVelMmS);
    tof.invalidAccumMs = 0.0f;
    tof.protectState = TOF_PROTECT_NORMAL;
    tof.resetVelBaseline = 1u;

    /* 用新距离上下限保守复核缓存高度：若参数把合法区间收窄到当前冻结高度之外，
     * 立即清健康态，避免 altitudeTofIsHealthy() 在下一帧 ToF 到来前继续返回 OK
     * （旧边界下接受的 frozenHeightMm 可能已越界）。下一帧 acceptFrame 会重新置位。 */
    if (tof.hasAccepted &&
        (tof.frozenHeightMm < tofConfig.minMm ||
            tof.frozenHeightMm > tofConfig.maxMm))
    {
        tof.rangeHealthy = 0u;
        tof.freshHealthy = 0u;
    }
}

#ifndef _ALTITUDE_TOF_H_
#define _ALTITUDE_TOF_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * 定高 ToF facade：芯片分派 + 全部传感器数据加工。
 *   - init 时按 ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT 绑定 L1X/L8CX 函数表，运行期不切换
 *   - 姿态补偿（斜距→垂直高度）、范围检查、时间域创新门控、无效冻结、
 *     差分速度低通、链路看门狗、健康态全部在本层完成
 *   - 定高闭环只通过 tofGetHeight() 取"当前高度 + 速度低通"，不接触任一芯片细节

#endif /* _ALTITUDE_TOF_H_ */

#include "opticalFlow.h"

#include "pinMap.h"
#include "zf_driver_uart.h"

#define OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_NUM              (UART_1)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_BAUDRATE         (19200u)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_RX_TRIGGER_LEVEL (0u) /* 0 = 每收到 1 字节触发一次 RX 中断 */

#define OPTICAL_FLOW_FRAME_HEAD            (0xFEu)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_FRAME_TAIL            (0x55u)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_PAYLOAD_LENGTH        (0x0Au) /* 帧载荷长度字段固定值 = 10 */
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_VALID_MARKER          (0xF5u)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_SAMPLE_PERIOD_SEC     (0.02f) /* 名义 50Hz */

/* 流式解析状态机：帧头 -> 长度 -> 10 字节载荷 -> 校验 -> 帧尾 */
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD       (0u)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH     (1u)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_PAYLOAD         (2u)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_CHECKSUM        (3u)
#define OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_TAIL            (4u)

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t state;
    uint8_t payloadIndex;
    uint8_t checksum;
    uint8_t payload[OPTICAL_FLOW_PAYLOAD_LENGTH];
} opticalFlowParserStruct;

static opticalFlowParserStruct opticalFlowParser;

/* ISR 与主循环共享：最新样本 + 发布序号声明为私有 volatile（公共 struct 不加 volatile）。 */
static volatile opticalFlowSampleStruct opticalFlowLatestSample;
static volatile uint32_t opticalFlowPublishedSequence = 0u;
static uint32_t opticalFlowConsumedSequence = 0u;

static void opticalFlowParserReset(void)
{
    opticalFlowParser.state = OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD;
    opticalFlowParser.payloadIndex = 0u;
    opticalFlowParser.checksum = 0u;
}

/* 校验失败 / 帧尾错误时的重同步：若当前字节恰为帧头，直接作为下一帧头继续。 */
static void opticalFlowParserRestartFromByte(uint8_t byte)
{
    opticalFlowParser.payloadIndex = 0u;
    opticalFlowParser.checksum = 0u;
    opticalFlowParser.state = (OPTICAL_FLOW_FRAME_HEAD == byte)
                            ? OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH
                            : OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD;
}

static uint16_t opticalFlowDecodeU16(const uint8_t *data)
{
    return (uint16_t)((uint16_t)data[0] | ((uint16_t)data[1] << 8u));
}

static void opticalFlowPublishSample(void)
{
    uint16_t flowXRaw = opticalFlowDecodeU16(&opticalFlowParser.payload[0]);
    uint16_t flowYRaw = opticalFlowDecodeU16(&opticalFlowParser.payload[2]);
    uint32_t nextSequence = opticalFlowPublishedSequence + 1u;

    /* 显式小端拼成 uint16 再转 int16，不用 packed struct / 指针强转 / memcpy 解释整数。 */
    opticalFlowLatestSample.flowX = (int16_t)flowXRaw;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.flowY = (int16_t)flowYRaw;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.dtUs = opticalFlowDecodeU16(&opticalFlowParser.payload[4]);
    opticalFlowLatestSample.distanceMm = opticalFlowDecodeU16(&opticalFlowParser.payload[6]);
    opticalFlowLatestSample.valid =
        (OPTICAL_FLOW_VALID_MARKER == opticalFlowParser.payload[8]) ? 1u : 0u;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.version = opticalFlowParser.payload[9];
    opticalFlowLatestSample.sequence = nextSequence;

    /* 序号最后发布：主循环据此判断整帧快照是否已完整写入。 */
    opticalFlowPublishedSequence = nextSequence;
}

static void opticalFlowParserInputByte(uint8_t byte)
{
    switch (opticalFlowParser.state)
    {
        case OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD:
        {
            if (OPTICAL_FLOW_FRAME_HEAD == byte)
            {
                opticalFlowParser.state = OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH;
            }
            break;
        }

        case OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH:
        {
            if (OPTICAL_FLOW_PAYLOAD_LENGTH == byte)
            {
                opticalFlowParser.payloadIndex = 0u;
                opticalFlowParser.checksum = 0u;
                opticalFlowParser.state = OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_PAYLOAD;
            }
            else
            {
                opticalFlowParserRestartFromByte(byte);
            }
            break;
        }

        case OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_PAYLOAD:
        {
            opticalFlowParser.payload[opticalFlowParser.payloadIndex] = byte;
            opticalFlowParser.checksum ^= byte;
            opticalFlowParser.payloadIndex++;

            if (opticalFlowParser.payloadIndex >= OPTICAL_FLOW_PAYLOAD_LENGTH)
            {
                opticalFlowParser.state = OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_CHECKSUM;
            }
            break;
        }

        case OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_CHECKSUM:
        {
            if (opticalFlowParser.checksum == byte)
            {
                opticalFlowParser.state = OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_TAIL;
            }
            else
            {
                opticalFlowParserRestartFromByte(byte);
            }
            break;
        }

        case OPTICAL_FLOW_PARSE_TAIL:
        {
            if (OPTICAL_FLOW_FRAME_TAIL == byte)
            {
                opticalFlowPublishSample();
                opticalFlowParserReset();
            }
            else
            {
                opticalFlowParserRestartFromByte(byte);
            }
            break;
        }

        default:
        {
            opticalFlowParserRestartFromByte(byte);
            break;
        }
    }
}

uint8_t opticalFlowInit(void)
{
    opticalFlowParserReset();

    opticalFlowLatestSample.flowX = 0;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.flowY = 0;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.dtUs = 0u;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.distanceMm = 0u;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.sequence = 0u;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.valid = 0u;
    opticalFlowLatestSample.version = 0u;
    opticalFlowPublishedSequence = 0u;
    opticalFlowConsumedSequence = 0u;

    /* TX 脚仅占位（光流模块只发不收，可不接线）；RX=P04_0 收模块 TX。 */
    uart_init(
        OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_NUM,
        OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_BAUDRATE,
        OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_TX_PIN,
        OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_RX_PIN);
    uart_rx_trigger_interrupt(
        OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_NUM,
        OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_RX_TRIGGER_LEVEL);
    uart_rx_interrupt(OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_NUM, 1u);

    return 1u;
}

void opticalFlowRxIrqHandler(void)
{
    uint8_t byte;

    while (uart_query_byte(OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_NUM, &byte))
    {
        opticalFlowParserInputByte(byte);
    }
}

uint8_t opticalFlowPoll(opticalFlowSampleStruct *sample)
{
    uint8_t hasNewSample = 0u;

    if (0 == sample)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    /* 短暂屏蔽 UART_1 RX 中断做多字段一致性快照，不关全局中断。 */
    uart_rx_interrupt(OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_NUM, 0u);
    if (opticalFlowPublishedSequence != opticalFlowConsumedSequence)
    {
        sample->flowX = opticalFlowLatestSample.flowX;
        sample->flowY = opticalFlowLatestSample.flowY;
        sample->dtUs = opticalFlowLatestSample.dtUs;
        sample->distanceMm = opticalFlowLatestSample.distanceMm;
        sample->sequence = opticalFlowLatestSample.sequence;
        sample->valid = opticalFlowLatestSample.valid;
        sample->version = opticalFlowLatestSample.version;
        opticalFlowConsumedSequence = opticalFlowPublishedSequence;
        hasNewSample = 1u;
    }
    uart_rx_interrupt(OPTICAL_FLOW_UART_NUM, 1u);

    return hasNewSample;
}

#ifndef _OPTICAL_FLOW_H_
#define _OPTICAL_FLOW_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/* UPixels 光流模块驱动（UART_1/P04，19200 8N1，50Hz，上电即输出无需初始化命令）。
 * 14 字节定长小端帧，RX 中断内流式解析，发布单槽原子快照。
 * 驱动负责初始化与帧解析；数据由 velocityEstimator 前台独占消费，并作为水平速度内环的 KF 量测源。
 * 方向映射（已实测，依赖安装姿态）：flowX 前为正、flowY 右为正，已对齐机体 FRD。 */

typedef struct
{
    int16_t flowX;       /* X 方向光流积分（前为正） */
    int16_t flowY;       /* Y 方向光流积分（右为正） */
    uint16_t dtUs;       /* 积分时长（微秒），速度换算以此为准，不可用名义周期替代 */
    uint16_t distanceMm; /* 模块自带距离；无 ToF 时恒 999mm 占位，不可作真实高度 */
    uint32_t sequence;   /* 每个协议完整帧（含 valid=0）递增，用于漏帧 / 新鲜度检测 */
    uint8_t valid;       /* 测量有效性：1=有效(0xF5) / 0=无效(质量不足或静止) */
    uint8_t version;     /* 固件版本字段，原样上报 */
} opticalFlowSampleStruct;

/* 初始化 UART_1 接收链路；返回 1 表示本地外设配置完成，不代表链路已有数据。 */
uint8_t opticalFlowInit(void);

/* 仅由 uart1_isr() 调用：排空逐飞 UART 软件缓冲并喂入流式解析器。 */
void opticalFlowRxIrqHandler(void);

/* 返回 1 表示取得一帧尚未消费的新数据；sample->valid 表示测量有效性。 */
uint8_t opticalFlowPoll(opticalFlowSampleStruct *sample);

/* 返回传感器名义输出周期 0.02s；实际积分时长以 sample->dtUs 为准。 */

#endif /* _OPTICAL_FLOW_H_ */

#include "tofBus.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "boardConfig.h" /* ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT / ALT_TOF_L8CX_COMM_SELECT 等编译期选择器 */
#include "configAltitudeTof.h"
#include "pinMap.h"
#include "zf_driver_delay.h"
#include "zf_driver_gpio.h"

/* 后端选择：仅 VL53L8CX + 硬件 SPI 走 SPI，其余（含 VL53L1X）走软件 IIC */
#if (ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT == ALT_TOF_SENSOR_VL53L8CX) && \
    (ALT_TOF_L8CX_COMM_SELECT == ALT_TOF_L8CX_COMM_HARD_SPI)
#define TOF_BUS_BACKEND_SPI (1)
#else
#define TOF_BUS_BACKEND_SPI (0)
#endif

/* ==========================================================
 * 硬件 SPI 后端（WiFi SPI 引脚，NCS 软件管理）
 * ========================================================== */
#if TOF_BUS_BACKEND_SPI

#include "zf_driver_spi.h"

#define TOF_SPI_INDEX      (SPI_3)
/* SPI3 SCK/MOSI/MISO/NCS 引脚见 pinMap.h */
#define TOF_SPI_BAUD       (2000000u) /* 2MHz：低于手册 ≤3MHz 上限留裕量，避免分频取整超频/信号完整性问题 */
#define TOF_SPI_WRITE_FLAG (0x80u)    /* 地址高字节 MSB：写=1，读=0 */
#define TOF_SPI_SCRATCH    (64u)      /* 全双工分块缓冲：写时丢弃 RX / 读时发 0 哑数据 */

static uint8_t tofSpiScratch[TOF_SPI_SCRATCH];

/* 全双工写：发 tx，同步收到的 RX 丢进 scratch。spi_transfer_8bit 逐字节读 RX FIFO，
 * 避免"只写不读"导致全双工 RX FIFO 溢出/残留（L8CX 固件上传为大块写）。NCS 由调用方维持。 */
static void tofSpiWrite(const uint8_t *tx, uint32_t len)
{
    uint32_t off = 0u;

    while (off < len)
    {
        uint32_t n = (len - off > TOF_SPI_SCRATCH) ? TOF_SPI_SCRATCH : (len - off);
        spi_transfer_8bit(TOF_SPI_INDEX, &tx[off], tofSpiScratch, n);
        off += n;
    }
}

/* 全双工读：发 0 哑数据，收 RX 到 rx。 */
static void tofSpiRead(uint8_t *rx, uint32_t len)
{
    uint32_t off = 0u;

    while (off < len)
    {
        uint32_t n = (len - off > TOF_SPI_SCRATCH) ? TOF_SPI_SCRATCH : (len - off);
        memset(tofSpiScratch, 0, n);
        spi_transfer_8bit(TOF_SPI_INDEX, tofSpiScratch, &rx[off], n);
        off += n;
    }
}

void tofBusInit(void)
{
    /* CS 传 SPI_CS_NULL：禁用驱动自动 CS，改由 NCS GPIO 跨"地址+数据"事务手动保持低 */
    spi_init(TOF_SPI_INDEX, SPI_MODE3, TOF_SPI_BAUD,
        TOF_SPI_SCK_PIN, TOF_SPI_MOSI_PIN, TOF_SPI_MISO_PIN, SPI_CS_NULL);
    gpio_init(TOF_SPI_NCS_PIN, GPO, GPIO_HIGH, GPO_PUSH_PULL);
}

void tofBusSetAddress(uint8_t addr7)
{
    (void) addr7; /* SPI 经 NCS 选片，无从机地址 */
}

uint8_t tofBusWriteReg16(uint16_t reg, const uint8_t *buf, uint32_t size)
{
    uint8_t addr2[2];

    /* 非法 buffer：与软件 IIC 后端口径一致，返回错误而非伪装成功，
     * 避免平台层错误被 ST ULD 当成成功（防后续驱动扩展踩坑）。 */
    if (size != 0u && buf == NULL)
    {
        return 1u;
    }

    addr2[0] = (uint8_t) (((reg >> 8) & 0x7Fu) | TOF_SPI_WRITE_FLAG);
    addr2[1] = (uint8_t) reg;

    gpio_low(TOF_SPI_NCS_PIN);
    tofSpiWrite(addr2, 2u);
    if (size != 0u)
    {
        tofSpiWrite(buf, size);
    }
    gpio_high(TOF_SPI_NCS_PIN);
    return 0u;
}

uint8_t tofBusReadReg16(uint16_t reg, uint8_t *buf, uint32_t size)
{
    uint8_t addr2[2];

    /* 非法 buffer：与软件 IIC 后端口径一致，返回错误而非伪装成功。 */
    if (size != 0u && buf == NULL)
    {
        return 1u;
    }

    addr2[0] = (uint8_t) ((reg >> 8) & 0x7Fu);
    addr2[1] = (uint8_t) reg;

    gpio_low(TOF_SPI_NCS_PIN);
    tofSpiWrite(addr2, 2u);
    if (size != 0u)
    {
        tofSpiRead(buf, size);
    }
    gpio_high(TOF_SPI_NCS_PIN);
    return 0u;
}

/* ==========================================================
 * 软件 IIC 后端（P19_0/P19_1 位翻）
 * ========================================================== */
#else

#include "zf_driver_soft_iic.h"

/* 软件 IIC SDA/SCL 引脚（P19_0/1）见 pinMap.h */
#define TOF_IIC_DEFAULT_ADDR (0x52u >> 1u)
#define TOF_IIC_WRITE_CHUNK  (256u) /* ULD 固件上传大块写按此分块（与地址各 2 字节前缀） */

#if (ALT_TOF_SENSOR_SELECT == ALT_TOF_SENSOR_VL53L1X)
#define TOF_IIC_DELAY (ALT_TOF_L1X_IIC_DELAY)
#else
#define TOF_IIC_DELAY (ALT_TOF_L8CX_IIC_DELAY)
#endif

static soft_iic_info_struct tofIic;
static uint8_t tofIicTxBuf[TOF_IIC_WRITE_CHUNK + 2u];

void tofBusInit(void)
{
    soft_iic_init(&tofIic, TOF_IIC_DEFAULT_ADDR, TOF_IIC_DELAY,
        TOF_IIC_SCL_PIN, TOF_IIC_SDA_PIN);
}

void tofBusSetAddress(uint8_t addr7)
{
    tofIic.addr = addr7;
}

uint8_t tofBusWriteReg16(uint16_t reg, const uint8_t *buf, uint32_t size)
{
    uint32_t offset = 0u;

    /* 分块 ≤256，每块自带 16-bit 起始地址（地址随偏移递增）；size==0 时不发送 */
    if (size != 0u && buf == NULL)
    {
        return 1u;
    }
    while (offset < size)
    {
        uint32_t remaining = size - offset;
        uint32_t chunk = (remaining > TOF_IIC_WRITE_CHUNK) ? TOF_IIC_WRITE_CHUNK : remaining;
        uint16_t chunkReg = (uint16_t) (reg + offset);

        tofIicTxBuf[0] = (uint8_t) (chunkReg >> 8);
        tofIicTxBuf[1] = (uint8_t) chunkReg;
        memcpy(&tofIicTxBuf[2], &buf[offset], chunk);
        soft_iic_write_8bit_array(&tofIic, tofIicTxBuf, chunk + 2u);
        offset += chunk;
    }
    return 0u;
}

uint8_t tofBusReadReg16(uint16_t reg, uint8_t *buf, uint32_t size)
{
    uint8_t addr2[2];

    if (size == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (buf == NULL)
    {
        return 1u;
    }
    addr2[0] = (uint8_t) (reg >> 8);
    addr2[1] = (uint8_t) reg;
    soft_iic_transfer_8bit_array(&tofIic, addr2, 2u, buf, size);
    return 0u;
}

#endif /* TOF_BUS_BACKEND_SPI */

void tofBusDelayMs(uint32_t ms)
{
    system_delay_ms(ms);
}

#ifndef _TOF_BUS_H_
#define _TOF_BUS_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * ToF 统一通信传输层
 *   按 boardConfig.h / configAltitudeTof.h 宏在 [软件 IIC] / [硬件 SPI] 间编译期切换；
 *   VL53L1X / VL53L8CX 两款芯片共用同一组寄存器读写原语

 *   - 硬件 SPI：逐飞 zf_driver_spi（SPI_3，引脚 P03_x），NCS 软件管理(P03_3)
 *               L8CX SPI 协议：地址高字节 MSB=1 写 / =0 读；Mode3(CPOL=1,CPHA=1)；≤3MHz
 *
 *   仅 L8CX + HARD_SPI 使用 SPI 后端，其余（含 VL53L1X）使用软件 IIC。
 *   返回值 0 = 成功（与 ST ULD VL53LMZ_STATUS_OK 约定一致）。
 */

static float vl53l1xCountRateFixedToFloat(uint16 count_rate_fixed)
{
    return (float)count_rate_fixed / (float)(1u << 7);
}

static uint32 vl53l1xDecodeTimeout(uint16 reg_val)
{
    return ((uint32)(reg_val & 0x00FFu) << (reg_val >> 8)) + 1u;
}

static uint16 vl53l1xEncodeTimeout(uint32 timeout_mclks)
{
    uint32 ls_byte = 0u;
    uint16 ms_byte = 0u;

    if (0u == timeout_mclks)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    ls_byte = timeout_mclks - 1u;
    while ((ls_byte & 0xFFFFFF00u) > 0u)
    {
        ls_byte >>= 1;
        ms_byte++;
    }

    return (uint16)((ms_byte << 8) | (ls_byte & 0xFFu));
}

static uint32 vl53l1xTimeoutMclksToMicroseconds(uint32 timeout_mclks, uint32 macro_period_us)
{
    return (uint32)(((uint64)timeout_mclks * macro_period_us + 0x800u) >> 12);
}

static uint32 vl53l1xTimeoutMicrosecondsToMclks(uint32 timeout_us, uint32 macro_period_us)
{
    if (0u == macro_period_us)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    return (((uint32)timeout_us << 12) + (macro_period_us >> 1)) / macro_period_us;
}

static uint32 vl53l1xCalcMacroPeriod(uint8 vcsel_period)
{
    uint32 pll_period_us;
    uint8 vcsel_period_pclks;
    uint32 macro_period_us;

    if (0u == vl53l1xContext.fast_osc_frequency)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    pll_period_us = ((uint32)1u << 30) / vl53l1xContext.fast_osc_frequency;
    vcsel_period_pclks = (uint8)((vcsel_period + 1u) << 1);

    macro_period_us = 2304u * pll_period_us;
    macro_period_us >>= 6;
    macro_period_us *= vcsel_period_pclks;
    macro_period_us >>= 6;

    return macro_period_us;
}

static uint8 vl53l1xWaitForBootCompletion(void)
{
    uint16 elapsed_ms = 0u;

    while (0u == (vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_FIRMWARE__SYSTEM_STATUS) & 0x01u))
    {
        if ((vl53l1xData.io_timeout_ms > 0u) && (elapsed_ms >= vl53l1xData.io_timeout_ms))
        {
            vl53l1xData.did_timeout = ZF_TRUE;
            vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_TIMEOUT;
            return ZF_FALSE;
        }

        system_delay_ms(1u);
        elapsed_ms++;
    }

    return ZF_TRUE;
}

static uint8 vl53l1xWaitForDataReady(void)
{
    uint16 elapsed_ms = 0u;

    while (ZF_FALSE == VL53L1XDataReady())
    {
        if ((vl53l1xData.io_timeout_ms > 0u) && (elapsed_ms >= vl53l1xData.io_timeout_ms))
        {
            vl53l1xData.did_timeout = ZF_TRUE;
            vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_TIMEOUT;
            return ZF_FALSE;
        }

        system_delay_ms(1u);
        elapsed_ms++;
    }

    return ZF_TRUE;
}

static void vl53l1xSetupManualCalibration(void)
{
    vl53l1xContext.saved_vhv_init = vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_VHV_CONFIG__INIT);
    vl53l1xContext.saved_vhv_timeout = vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_VHV_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP_LOOP_BOUND);

    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_VHV_CONFIG__INIT, (uint8)(vl53l1xContext.saved_vhv_init & 0x7Fu));
    vl53l1xWriteReg(
        VL53L1_VHV_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP_LOOP_BOUND,
        (uint8)((vl53l1xContext.saved_vhv_timeout & 0x03u) + (3u << 2)));
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_PHASECAL_CONFIG__OVERRIDE, 0x01u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_CAL_CONFIG__VCSEL_START, vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_PHASECAL_RESULT__VCSEL_START));
}

static void vl53l1xReadResults(void)
{
    uint8 result_buffer[17];

    vl53l1xReadBlock(VL53L1_RESULT__RANGE_STATUS, result_buffer, 17u);
    vl53l1xContext.results.range_status = result_buffer[0];
    vl53l1xContext.results.stream_count = result_buffer[2];
    vl53l1xContext.results.dss_actual_effective_spads_sd0 = (uint16)(((uint16)result_buffer[3] << 8) | result_buffer[4]);
    vl53l1xContext.results.ambient_count_rate_mcps_sd0 = (uint16)(((uint16)result_buffer[7] << 8) | result_buffer[8]);
    vl53l1xContext.results.final_crosstalk_corrected_range_mm_sd0 = (uint16)(((uint16)result_buffer[13] << 8) | result_buffer[14]);
    vl53l1xContext.results.peak_signal_count_rate_crosstalk_corrected_mcps_sd0 = (uint16)(((uint16)result_buffer[15] << 8) | result_buffer[16]);
}

static void vl53l1xUpdateDss(void)
{
    uint16 spad_count = vl53l1xContext.results.dss_actual_effective_spads_sd0;

    if (0u != spad_count)
    {
        uint32 total_rate_per_spad = (uint32)vl53l1xContext.results.peak_signal_count_rate_crosstalk_corrected_mcps_sd0
                                   + vl53l1xContext.results.ambient_count_rate_mcps_sd0;

        if (total_rate_per_spad > 0xFFFFu)
        {
            total_rate_per_spad = 0xFFFFu;
        }

        total_rate_per_spad <<= 16;
        total_rate_per_spad /= spad_count;

        if (0u != total_rate_per_spad)
        {
            uint32 required_spads = ((uint32)VL53L1X_TARGET_RATE << 16) / total_rate_per_spad;

            if (required_spads > 0xFFFFu)
            {
                required_spads = 0xFFFFu;
            }

            vl53l1xWriteReg16(VL53L1_DSS_CONFIG__MANUAL_EFFECTIVE_SPADS_SELECT, (uint16)required_spads);
            return;
        }
    }

    vl53l1xWriteReg16(VL53L1_DSS_CONFIG__MANUAL_EFFECTIVE_SPADS_SELECT, 0x8000u);
}

static void vl53l1xGetRangingData(void)
{
    uint16 range = vl53l1xContext.results.final_crosstalk_corrected_range_mm_sd0;

    vl53l1xData.distance_mm = (uint16)(((uint32)range * 2011u + 0x0400u) / 0x0800u);

    switch (vl53l1xContext.results.range_status)
    {
        case 17:
        case 2:
        case 1:
        case 3:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_HARDWARE_FAIL;
            break;

        case 13:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_MIN_RANGE_FAIL;
            break;

        case 18:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_SYNCRONISATION_INT;
            break;

        case 5:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_OUTOFBOUNDS_FAIL;
            break;

        case 4:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_SIGNAL_FAIL;
            break;

        case 6:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_SIGMA_FAIL;
            break;

        case 7:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_WRAP_TARGET_FAIL;
            break;

        case 12:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_XTALK_SIGNAL_FAIL;
            break;

        case 8:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_RANGE_VALID_MIN_RANGE_CLIPPED;
            break;

        case 9:
            if (0u == vl53l1xContext.results.stream_count)
            {
                vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_RANGE_VALID_NO_WRAP_CHECK_FAIL;
            }
            else
            {
                vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_RANGE_VALID;
            }
            break;

        default:
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_NONE;
            break;
    }

    vl53l1xData.peak_signal_count_rate_mcps = vl53l1xCountRateFixedToFloat(
        vl53l1xContext.results.peak_signal_count_rate_crosstalk_corrected_mcps_sd0);
    vl53l1xData.ambient_count_rate_mcps = vl53l1xCountRateFixedToFloat(
        vl53l1xContext.results.ambient_count_rate_mcps_sd0);
}

static void vl53l1xResetState(void)
{
    memset(&vl53l1xContext, 0, sizeof(vl53l1xContext));
    memset(&vl53l1xData, 0, sizeof(vl53l1xData));
    vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_NONE;
    vl53l1xData.distance_mode = VL53L1X_DISTANCE_MODE_UNKNOWN;
    vl53l1xData.io_timeout_ms = VL53L1X_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS;
    vl53l1xData.intermeasurement_period_ms = VL53L1X_DEFAULT_INTERMEASUREMENT_PERIOD_MS;
    vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED;
}

uint8 VL53L1XInit(void)
{
    vl53l1xResetState();
    tofBusInit();
    tofBusSetAddress(VL53L1X_IIC_ADDR);
    gpio_init(VL53L1X_IIC_SHUT_PIN, GPO, GPIO_HIGH, GPO_PUSH_PULL);
    gpio_init(VL53L1X_IIC_INT_PIN, GPI, GPIO_HIGH, GPI_PULL_UP);

    gpio_low(VL53L1X_IIC_SHUT_PIN);
    system_delay_ms(2u);
    gpio_high(VL53L1X_IIC_SHUT_PIN);
    system_delay_ms(10u);

    if (0xEACCu != vl53l1xReadReg16(VL53L1_IDENTIFICATION__MODEL_ID))
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_NOT_DETECTED;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SOFT_RESET, 0x00u);
    system_delay_us(100u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SOFT_RESET, 0x01u);

    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xWaitForBootCompletion())
    {
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    vl53l1xWriteReg(
        VL53L1_PAD_I2C_HV__EXTSUP_CONFIG,
        (uint8)(vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_PAD_I2C_HV__EXTSUP_CONFIG) | 0x01u));

    vl53l1xContext.fast_osc_frequency = vl53l1xReadReg16(VL53L1_OSC_MEASURED__FAST_OSC__FREQUENCY);
    vl53l1xContext.osc_calibrate_val = vl53l1xReadReg16(VL53L1_RESULT__OSC_CALIBRATE_VAL);

    vl53l1xWriteReg16(VL53L1_DSS_CONFIG__TARGET_TOTAL_RATE_MCPS, VL53L1X_TARGET_RATE);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_GPIO__TIO_HV_STATUS, 0x02u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SIGMA_ESTIMATOR__EFFECTIVE_PULSE_WIDTH_NS, 8u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SIGMA_ESTIMATOR__EFFECTIVE_AMBIENT_WIDTH_NS, 16u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_ALGO__CROSSTALK_COMPENSATION_VALID_HEIGHT_MM, 0x01u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_ALGO__RANGE_IGNORE_VALID_HEIGHT_MM, 0xFFu);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_ALGO__RANGE_MIN_CLIP, 0u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_ALGO__CONSISTENCY_CHECK__TOLERANCE, 2u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg16(VL53L1_SYSTEM__THRESH_RATE_HIGH, 0x0000u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg16(VL53L1_SYSTEM__THRESH_RATE_LOW, 0x0000u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_DSS_CONFIG__APERTURE_ATTENUATION, 0x38u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg16(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__SIGMA_THRESH, 360u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg16(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__MIN_COUNT_RATE_RTN_LIMIT_MCPS, 192u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__GROUPED_PARAMETER_HOLD_0, 0x01u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__GROUPED_PARAMETER_HOLD_1, 0x01u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__QUANTIFIER, 2u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__GROUPED_PARAMETER_HOLD, 0x00u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__SEED_CONFIG, 1u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__SEQUENCE_CONFIG, 0x8Bu);
    vl53l1xWriteReg16(VL53L1_DSS_CONFIG__MANUAL_EFFECTIVE_SPADS_SELECT, (uint16)(200u << 8));
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_DSS_CONFIG__ROI_MODE_CONTROL, 2u);

    vl53l1xData.is_initialized = ZF_TRUE;

    if (ZF_FALSE == VL53L1XSetDistanceMode(VL53L1X_DISTANCE_MODE_LONG))
    {
        vl53l1xData.is_initialized = ZF_FALSE;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    if (ZF_FALSE == VL53L1XSetMeasurementTimingBudget(50000u))
    {
        vl53l1xData.is_initialized = ZF_FALSE;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    vl53l1xWriteReg16(
        VL53L1_ALGO__PART_TO_PART_RANGE_OFFSET_MM,
        (uint16)(vl53l1xReadReg16(VL53L1_MM_CONFIG__OUTER_OFFSET_MM) * 4u));

    vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_OK;
    return ZF_TRUE;
}

void VL53L1XSetTimeout(uint16 timeout_ms)
{
    vl53l1xData.io_timeout_ms = timeout_ms;
}

uint16 VL53L1XGetTimeout(void)
{
    return vl53l1xData.io_timeout_ms;
}

uint8 VL53L1XTimeoutOccurred(void)
{
    uint8 did_timeout = vl53l1xData.did_timeout;

    vl53l1xData.did_timeout = ZF_FALSE;
    return did_timeout;
}

uint8 VL53L1XSetDistanceMode(vl53l1x_distance_mode_enum mode)
{
    uint32 budget_us;

    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xData.is_initialized)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    budget_us = VL53L1XGetMeasurementTimingBudget();

    switch (mode)
    {
        case VL53L1X_DISTANCE_MODE_SHORT:
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_A, 0x07u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_B, 0x05u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VALID_PHASE_HIGH, 0x38u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__WOI_SD0, 0x07u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__WOI_SD1, 0x05u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__INITIAL_PHASE_SD0, 6u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__INITIAL_PHASE_SD1, 6u);
            break;

        case VL53L1X_DISTANCE_MODE_MEDIUM:
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_A, 0x0Bu);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_B, 0x09u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VALID_PHASE_HIGH, 0x78u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__WOI_SD0, 0x0Bu);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__WOI_SD1, 0x09u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__INITIAL_PHASE_SD0, 10u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__INITIAL_PHASE_SD1, 10u);
            break;

        case VL53L1X_DISTANCE_MODE_LONG:
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_A, 0x0Fu);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_B, 0x0Du);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VALID_PHASE_HIGH, 0xB8u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__WOI_SD0, 0x0Fu);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__WOI_SD1, 0x0Du);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__INITIAL_PHASE_SD0, 14u);
            vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SD_CONFIG__INITIAL_PHASE_SD1, 14u);
            break;

        default:
            vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
            return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    vl53l1xData.distance_mode = mode;

    if ((0u != budget_us) && (ZF_FALSE == VL53L1XSetMeasurementTimingBudget(budget_us)))
    {
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_OK;
    return ZF_TRUE;
}

vl53l1x_distance_mode_enum VL53L1XGetDistanceMode(void)
{
    return vl53l1xData.distance_mode;
}

uint8 VL53L1XSetMeasurementTimingBudget(uint32 budget_us)
{
    uint32 range_config_timeout_us;
    uint32 macro_period_us;
    uint32 phasecal_timeout_mclks;

    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xData.is_initialized)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    if (budget_us <= VL53L1X_TIMING_GUARD_US)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    range_config_timeout_us = budget_us - VL53L1X_TIMING_GUARD_US;
    if (range_config_timeout_us > 1100000u)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    range_config_timeout_us /= 2u;
    macro_period_us = vl53l1xCalcMacroPeriod(vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_A));
    if (0u == macro_period_us)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    phasecal_timeout_mclks = vl53l1xTimeoutMicrosecondsToMclks(1000u, macro_period_us);
    if (phasecal_timeout_mclks > 0xFFu)
    {
        phasecal_timeout_mclks = 0xFFu;
    }

    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_PHASECAL_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP, (uint8)phasecal_timeout_mclks);
    vl53l1xWriteReg16(
        VL53L1_MM_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP_A,
        vl53l1xEncodeTimeout(vl53l1xTimeoutMicrosecondsToMclks(1u, macro_period_us)));
    vl53l1xWriteReg16(
        VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP_A,
        vl53l1xEncodeTimeout(vl53l1xTimeoutMicrosecondsToMclks(range_config_timeout_us, macro_period_us)));

    macro_period_us = vl53l1xCalcMacroPeriod(vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_B));
    if (0u == macro_period_us)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    vl53l1xWriteReg16(
        VL53L1_MM_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP_B,
        vl53l1xEncodeTimeout(vl53l1xTimeoutMicrosecondsToMclks(1u, macro_period_us)));
    vl53l1xWriteReg16(
        VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP_B,
        vl53l1xEncodeTimeout(vl53l1xTimeoutMicrosecondsToMclks(range_config_timeout_us, macro_period_us)));

    vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_OK;
    return ZF_TRUE;
}

uint32 VL53L1XGetMeasurementTimingBudget(void)
{
    uint32 macro_period_us;
    uint32 range_config_timeout_us;

    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xData.is_initialized)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    macro_period_us = vl53l1xCalcMacroPeriod(vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__VCSEL_PERIOD_A));
    if (0u == macro_period_us)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    range_config_timeout_us = vl53l1xTimeoutMclksToMicroseconds(
        vl53l1xDecodeTimeout(vl53l1xReadReg16(VL53L1_RANGE_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP_A)),
        macro_period_us);

    return (2u * range_config_timeout_us) + VL53L1X_TIMING_GUARD_US;
}

uint8 VL53L1XDataReady(void)
{
    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xData.is_initialized)
    {
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    return (uint8)((vl53l1xReadReg(VL53L1_GPIO__TIO_HV_STATUS) & 0x01u) == 0u);
}

uint8 VL53L1XStartContinuous(uint32 period_ms)
{
    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xData.is_initialized)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    if (0u == period_ms)
    {
        period_ms = vl53l1xData.intermeasurement_period_ms;
    }

    if (0u == period_ms)
    {
        period_ms = VL53L1X_DEFAULT_INTERMEASUREMENT_PERIOD_MS;
    }

    if (0u == vl53l1xContext.osc_calibrate_val)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
        return ZF_FALSE;
    }

    vl53l1xData.intermeasurement_period_ms = period_ms;
    vl53l1xWriteReg32(
        VL53L1_SYSTEM__INTERMEASUREMENT_PERIOD,
        period_ms * (uint32)vl53l1xContext.osc_calibrate_val);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__INTERRUPT_CLEAR, 0x01u);
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__MODE_START, 0x40u);

    vl53l1xContext.is_started = ZF_TRUE;
    vl53l1xData.is_continuous_mode = ZF_TRUE;
    vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_OK;
    return ZF_TRUE;
}

void VL53L1XStopContinuous(void)
{
    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xData.is_initialized)
    {
        return;
    }

    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__MODE_START, 0x80u);
    vl53l1xContext.calibrated = ZF_FALSE;

    if (0u != vl53l1xContext.saved_vhv_init)
    {
        vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_VHV_CONFIG__INIT, vl53l1xContext.saved_vhv_init);
    }

    if (0u != vl53l1xContext.saved_vhv_timeout)
    {
        vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_VHV_CONFIG__TIMEOUT_MACROP_LOOP_BOUND, vl53l1xContext.saved_vhv_timeout);
    }

    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_PHASECAL_CONFIG__OVERRIDE, 0x00u);
    vl53l1xContext.is_started = ZF_FALSE;
    vl53l1xData.is_continuous_mode = ZF_FALSE;
    vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_OK;
}

uint16 VL53L1XRead(uint8 blocking)
{
    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xData.is_initialized)
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED;
        return 0u;
    }

    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xContext.is_started)
    {
        if (ZF_FALSE == VL53L1XStartContinuous(vl53l1xData.intermeasurement_period_ms))
        {
            return 0u;
        }
    }

    if (blocking)
    {
        if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xWaitForDataReady())
        {
            vl53l1xData.range_status = VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_NONE;
            vl53l1xData.distance_mm = 0u;
            vl53l1xData.peak_signal_count_rate_mcps = 0.0f;
            vl53l1xData.ambient_count_rate_mcps = 0.0f;
            return 0u;
        }
    }
    else if (ZF_FALSE == VL53L1XDataReady())
    {
        vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_DATA_NOT_READY;
        return vl53l1xData.distance_mm;
    }

    vl53l1xReadResults();

    if (ZF_FALSE == vl53l1xContext.calibrated)
    {
        vl53l1xSetupManualCalibration();
        vl53l1xContext.calibrated = ZF_TRUE;
    }

    vl53l1xUpdateDss();
    vl53l1xGetRangingData();
    vl53l1xWriteReg(VL53L1_SYSTEM__INTERRUPT_CLEAR, 0x01u);
    vl53l1xData.last_status = VL53L1X_STATUS_OK;
    return vl53l1xData.distance_mm;
}

const char *VL53L1XRangeStatusToString(uint8 status)
{
    switch (status)
    {
        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_RANGE_VALID:
            return "RANGE VALID";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_SIGMA_FAIL:
            return "SIGMA FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_SIGNAL_FAIL:
            return "SIGNAL FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_RANGE_VALID_MIN_RANGE_CLIPPED:
            return "RANGE VALID MIN RANGE CLIPPED";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_OUTOFBOUNDS_FAIL:
            return "OUTOFBOUNDS FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_HARDWARE_FAIL:
            return "HARDWARE FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_RANGE_VALID_NO_WRAP_CHECK_FAIL:
            return "RANGE VALID NO WRAP CHECK FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_WRAP_TARGET_FAIL:
            return "WRAP TARGET FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_PROCESSING_FAIL:
            return "PROCESSING FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_XTALK_SIGNAL_FAIL:
            return "XTALK SIGNAL FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_SYNCRONISATION_INT:
            return "SYNCRONISATION INT";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_RANGE_VALID_MERGED_PULSE:
            return "RANGE VALID MERGED PULSE";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_TARGET_PRESENT_LACK_OF_SIGNAL:
            return "TARGET PRESENT LACK OF SIGNAL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_MIN_RANGE_FAIL:
            return "MIN RANGE FAIL";

        case VL53L1_RANGESTATUS_RANGE_INVALID:
            return "RANGE INVALID";

代码（c）
#include "tofL8cx.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "configAltitudeTof.h"
#include "vl53lmz_api.h"

#define VL53L8CX_ZONE_COUNT               (16u)
#define VL53L8CX_STATUS_VALID             (5u)
#define VL53L8CX_STATUS_VALID_LARGE_PULSE (9u)

#if ALT_TOF_L8CX_FREQUENCY_HZ == 0u || ALT_TOF_L8CX_FREQUENCY_HZ > 60u
#error "VL53L8CX 4x4 ranging frequency must be in 1..60Hz"
#endif

#if ALT_TOF_L8CX_MIN_VALID_ZONES == 0u || ALT_TOF_L8CX_MIN_VALID_ZONES > VL53L8CX_ZONE_COUNT
#error "ALT_TOF_L8CX_MIN_VALID_ZONES must be in 1..16"
#endif

static VL53LMZ_Configuration device;
static VL53LMZ_ResultsData results;
static uint8_t lastStreamCount;
static uint8_t hasStreamCount;
static float samplePeriodS = 1.0f / (float) ALT_TOF_L8CX_FREQUENCY_HZ;

static void sortDistances(uint16_t *values, uint8_t count)
{
    uint8_t i;

    for (i = 1u; i < count; i++)
    {
        uint16_t value = values[i];
        uint8_t j = i;
        while (j > 0u && values[j - 1u] > value)
        {
            values[j] = values[j - 1u];
            j--;
        }
        values[j] = value;
    }
}

static uint16_t medianDistance(const uint16_t *values, uint8_t count)
{
    uint8_t middle = (uint8_t) (count / 2u);
    if ((count & 1u) != 0u)
    {
        return values[middle];
    }
    return (uint16_t) (((uint32_t) values[middle - 1u] + values[middle]) / 2u);
}

static uint8_t fuseHeight(uint16_t *distanceMm)
{
    uint16_t distances[VL53L8CX_ZONE_COUNT];
    uint8_t count = 0u;
    uint8_t zone;

    for (zone = 0u; zone < VL53L8CX_ZONE_COUNT; zone++)
    {
        uint8_t status = results.target_status[zone];
        int16_t distance = results.distance_mm[zone];
        if (results.nb_target_detected[zone] != 0u &&
            (status == VL53L8CX_STATUS_VALID || status == VL53L8CX_STATUS_VALID_LARGE_PULSE) &&
            distance >= (int16_t) ALT_TOF_L8CX_HARD_MIN_MM &&
            distance <= (int16_t) ALT_TOF_L8CX_HARD_MAX_MM)
        {
            distances[count++] = (uint16_t) distance;
        }
    }

    if (count < ALT_TOF_L8CX_MIN_VALID_ZONES)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    sortDistances(distances, count);
    uint16_t preliminary = medianDistance(distances, count);
    uint16_t relativeTolerance = (uint16_t) (((uint32_t) preliminary * ALT_TOF_L8CX_OUTLIER_REL_PERMILLE) / 1000u);
    uint16_t tolerance = relativeTolerance > ALT_TOF_L8CX_OUTLIER_ABS_MM
                             ? relativeTolerance
                             : ALT_TOF_L8CX_OUTLIER_ABS_MM;
    uint8_t first = 0u;
    uint8_t last = count;

    while (first < last &&
           ((uint32_t) distances[first] + tolerance < preliminary))
    {
        first++;
    }
    while (last > first &&
           distances[last - 1u] > (uint32_t) preliminary + tolerance)
    {
        last--;
    }

    uint8_t inlierCount = (uint8_t) (last - first);
    if (inlierCount < ALT_TOF_L8CX_MIN_VALID_ZONES)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    *distanceMm = medianDistance(&distances[first], inlierCount);
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t tofL8cxInit(void)
{
    uint8_t alive = 0u;
    uint8_t status;

    memset(&device, 0, sizeof(device));
    memset(&results, 0, sizeof(results));
    lastStreamCount = 0u;
    hasStreamCount = 0u;
    samplePeriodS = 1.0f / (float) ALT_TOF_L8CX_FREQUENCY_HZ;
    device.platform.address = VL53LMZ_DEFAULT_I2C_ADDRESS;

    status = vl53lmzPlatformInit();
    status |= vl53lmz_is_alive(&device, &alive);
    if (status != VL53LMZ_STATUS_OK || !alive)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    status = vl53lmz_init(&device);
    if (status != VL53LMZ_STATUS_OK || device.module_type != VL53LMZ_MODULE_TYPE_L8)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    status |= vl53lmz_set_resolution(&device, VL53LMZ_RESOLUTION_4X4);
    status |= vl53lmz_set_ranging_mode(&device, VL53LMZ_RANGING_MODE_CONTINUOUS);
    status |= vl53lmz_set_ranging_frequency_hz(&device, ALT_TOF_L8CX_FREQUENCY_HZ);
    status |= vl53lmz_start_ranging(&device);
    return (uint8_t) (status == VL53LMZ_STATUS_OK);
}

/* 时间域创新门控已统一上移到 altitudeTof facade（L1X/L8CX 共用）；
 * 本驱动只做 4x4 空间中值 + 离群融合，输出单帧候选高度。 */
uint8_t tofL8cxPoll(uint16_t *distanceMm, uint8_t *valid)
{
    uint8_t ready = 0u;
    uint8_t status = vl53lmz_check_data_ready(&device, &ready);

    if (status != VL53LMZ_STATUS_OK || !ready)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    status = vl53lmz_get_ranging_data(&device, &results);
    uint8_t streamCount = device.streamcount;
    if (hasStreamCount)
    {
        uint8_t frameDelta = streamCount >= lastStreamCount
                                 ? (uint8_t) (streamCount - lastStreamCount)
                                 : (uint8_t) ((256u - lastStreamCount) + streamCount);
        if (frameDelta == 0u) frameDelta = 1u;
        samplePeriodS = (float) frameDelta / (float) ALT_TOF_L8CX_FREQUENCY_HZ;
    }
    lastStreamCount = streamCount;
    hasStreamCount = 1u;

    *valid = 0u;
    if (status == VL53LMZ_STATUS_OK)
    {
        uint16_t fused;
        /* 仅做 4x4 空间中值融合；时间域门控由 altitudeTof facade 统一处理。 */
        if (fuseHeight(&fused))
        {
            *distanceMm = fused;
            *valid = 1u;
        }
    }
    return 1u;
}

float tofL8cxSamplePeriodS(void)
{
    return samplePeriodS;
}
