SHA-256：fd1af0193cf2b3dd6fcb32c901b7b9ecc2df514d1cca8672b82ec05562873734
代码（c）
#include "velocityEstimator.h"

#include <math.h>

#include "zf_common_interrupt.h"

#include "IMU.h"
#include "altitudeTof.h"
#include "commonDef.h"
#include "configVelocityEstimator.h"
#include "opticalFlow.h"

#define VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES 2u /* [0]=X 前向, [1]=Y 右向 */

/* 单轴融合状态：KF 状态 [v,b] + 对称协方差三项 P00/P01/P11 + 诊断量 + 延迟补偿历史。 */
typedef struct
{
    volatile float acceleration;    /* 机体水平航向系去重力加速度 m/s² */
    volatile float imuOnlyVelocity; /* 纯 IMU 积分参考（固定 bias，不被光流校正，影子对比漂移） */
    volatile float fusedVelocity;   /* KF 融合速度 m/s */
    volatile float bias;            /* 等效加速度 bias m/s² */
    volatile float p00;
    volatile float p01;
    volatile float p11;
    volatile float flowVelocity; /* 光流换算物理速度（诊断） */
    volatile float innovation;   /* 量测残差（诊断） */
    /* 融合速度环形历史（1ms 预测每拍写入），供光流帧延迟补偿取"延迟时刻"估计。 */
    volatile float fusedVelHist[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VEL_HIST_LEN];
} velocityEstimatorAxisStruct;

typedef struct
{
    velocityEstimatorAxisStruct axis[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
    volatile uint16_t histWriteIdx; /* X/Y 共享：两轴同拍写入后统一前进一格 */
    volatile float heightM;
    volatile uint16_t frameAgeMs; /* 最后一帧（含无效帧）年龄：链路活性 */
    volatile uint16_t validAgeMs; /* 最后一帧通过全部门控的有效观测年龄 */
    volatile uint16_t consecutiveInvalidFrames; /* 距上次成功 KF 校正以来连续被拒的光流帧数（每收一帧+1，成功校正归零）*/
    volatile uint32_t predictGeneration; /* 1ms 预测拍代数，拒绝提交基于旧预测的前台校正 */
    volatile float lastRawFlowX; /* 最近一帧原始光流计数 flowX（前正，未换算，常态调试用）*/
    volatile float lastRawFlowY; /* 最近一帧原始光流计数 flowY（右正，未换算）*/
    volatile uint8_t flowValid;
    volatile uint8_t tofFresh;
} velocityEstimatorStateStruct;

/* 单轴 KF 量测更新结果（纯函数式产出，校验通过后才提交到 state）。 */
typedef struct
{
    float velocity;
    float bias;
    float p00;
    float p01;
    float p11;
} velocityEstimatorKalmanResultStruct;

static volatile velocityEstimatorStateStruct velocityEstimatorState;
static volatile uint16_t velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount; /* X/Y 共享单计数 */
static float velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationSum[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
static float velocityEstimatorImuOnlyBias[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];

static float velocityEstimatorClamp(float value, float limit)
{
    return clampf(value, -limit, limit);
}

/* 有限性检查：NaN/Inf 返回 0（clampf 挡不住 NaN，需独立守卫防污染积分）。 */
static uint8_t velocityEstimatorIsFinite(float v)
{
    /* NaN != 自身；Inf 的差为 Inf。用乘 0 判断：有限数×0=0，NaN/Inf×0=NaN/Inf。 */
    float z = v * 0.0f;
    return (z == 0.0f) ? 1u : 0u;
}

/* 每轴状态 x=[v,b]^T，F=[[1,-dt],[0,1]]，P 仅存对称项 P00/P01/P11。 */
static void velocityEstimatorKalmanResetCovarianceAxis(
    volatile float *p00, volatile float *p01, volatile float *p11)
{
    *p00 = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_INIT_VEL;
    *p01 = 0.0f;
    *p11 = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_INIT_BIAS;
}

/* 对角项上下限保护；若浮点误差使 det(P)=P00*P11-P01^2<0，清交叉项恢复保守对角。 */
static uint8_t velocityEstimatorKalmanSanitizeCovariance(
    float *p00, float *p01, float *p11)
{
    float determinant;

    if (!velocityEstimatorIsFinite(*p00) ||
        !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(*p01) ||
        !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(*p11))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    *p00 = clampf(*p00, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MIN, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MAX);
    *p01 = clampf(*p01, -VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MAX, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MAX);
    *p11 = clampf(*p11, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MIN, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MAX);
    determinant = *p00 * *p11 - *p01 * *p01;
    if (!velocityEstimatorIsFinite(determinant))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (determinant < 0.0f)
    {
        *p01 = 0.0f;
    }
    return 1u;
}

/* P=F*P*F^T+Q 标量展开（F=[[1,-dt],[0,1]]）：
 *   P00' = P00 - 2*dt*P01 + dt^2*P11 + qv
 *   P01' = P01 - dt*P11
 *   P11' = P11 + qb
 * 无 sqrtf / 除法，适配 1ms ISR。 */
static void velocityEstimatorKalmanPredictCovarianceAxis(
    volatile float *p00State, volatile float *p01State, volatile float *p11State)
{
    float p00 = *p00State;
    float p01 = *p01State;
    float p11 = *p11State;
    float dt = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_PREDICT_DT_S;
    float nextP00;
    float nextP01;
    float nextP11;

    if (!velocityEstimatorKalmanSanitizeCovariance(&p00, &p01, &p11))
    {
        velocityEstimatorKalmanResetCovarianceAxis(p00State, p01State, p11State);
        return;
    }

    nextP00 = p00 - 2.0f * dt * p01 + dt * dt * p11 + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_Q_VEL;
    nextP01 = p01 - dt * p11;
    nextP11 = p11 + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_Q_BIAS;

    if (!velocityEstimatorKalmanSanitizeCovariance(&nextP00, &nextP01, &nextP11))
    {
        velocityEstimatorKalmanResetCovarianceAxis(p00State, p01State, p11State);
        return;
    }

    *p00State = nextP00;
    *p01State = nextP01;
    *p11State = nextP11;
}

/* H=[1,0]，S=P00+R，K=[P00/S,P01/S]^T。Joseph 协方差更新标量展开：
 *   P00' = (1-K0)^2*P00 + K0^2*R
 *   P01' = (1-K0)*(P01-K1*P00) + K0*K1*R
 *   P11' = P11 - 2*K1*P01 + K1^2*P00 + K1^2*R
 * 纯函数式：只写 result，校验失败返回 0（调用方不提交）。 */
static uint8_t velocityEstimatorKalmanUpdateAxis(
    float velocity, float bias,
    float p00, float p01, float p11,
    float innovation, float measurementVariance,
    velocityEstimatorKalmanResultStruct *result)
{
    float innovationVariance;
    float gainVelocity;
    float gainBias;
    float oneMinusGainVelocity;
    float nextP00;
    float nextP01;
    float nextP11;

    if (!velocityEstimatorIsFinite(velocity) ||
        !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(bias) ||
        !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(innovation) ||
        !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(measurementVariance) ||
        !velocityEstimatorKalmanSanitizeCovariance(&p00, &p01, &p11))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    innovationVariance = p00 + measurementVariance;
    if (innovationVariance <= VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MIN ||
        !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(innovationVariance))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    gainVelocity = clampf(
        p00 / innovationVariance, 0.0f, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_GAIN_VEL_MAX);
    gainBias = clampf(
        p01 / innovationVariance,
        -VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_GAIN_BIAS_MAX,
        VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_GAIN_BIAS_MAX);

    result->velocity = velocityEstimatorClamp(
        velocity + gainVelocity * innovation, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VELOCITY_LIMIT_MPS);
    result->bias = velocityEstimatorClamp(
        bias + gainBias * innovation, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BIAS_LIMIT_MPS2);

    oneMinusGainVelocity = 1.0f - gainVelocity;
    nextP00 = oneMinusGainVelocity * oneMinusGainVelocity * p00
        + gainVelocity * gainVelocity * measurementVariance;
    nextP01 = oneMinusGainVelocity * (p01 - gainBias * p00)
        + gainVelocity * gainBias * measurementVariance;
    nextP11 = p11 - 2.0f * gainBias * p01
        + gainBias * gainBias * p00
        + gainBias * gainBias * measurementVariance;

    if (!velocityEstimatorIsFinite(result->velocity) ||
        !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(result->bias) ||
        !velocityEstimatorKalmanSanitizeCovariance(&nextP00, &nextP01, &nextP11))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    result->p00 = nextP00;
    result->p01 = nextP01;
    result->p11 = nextP11;
    return 1u;
}

/* Mahony q 为传感器系 S 到本地系 L 的姿态。目标输出"机体水平航向系"速度
 * （前向/右向，跟随机头 yaw），因此须去掉 q 的 yaw 分量，只保留 pitch/roll 倾斜补偿。
 * 否则用完整 q（含 yaw）会把速度转到世界固定系，导致 xy 速度与 yaw 强耦合
 * （机体匀速前飞，yaw 转 90° 后输出却变成"向右飞"）；且 6 轴 yaw 不可观会漂移，
 * 双重污染。这里构造 R_tilt = R_yaw^T · R(q) 消 yaw：
 *   yaw 由 body-X 轴在世界水平面投影定，cosψ=r00/h, sinψ=r10/h, h=√(r00²+r10²)。
 * 输出端再做固定 L_S→L_FRD 重映射（前=X正/右=Y正）：newX=−tiltY、newY=−tiltX。
 * IMU(真实 S 去重力加速度) 与光流(经 BODY_TO_SENSOR 转成 S) 共用本 helper。 */
static void velocityEstimatorRotateSensorToLocal(
    float q0, float q1, float q2, float q3,
    float sensorX, float sensorY, float sensorZ,
    float *localX, float *localY)
{
    float r00 = 1.0f - 2.0f * (q2 * q2 + q3 * q3);
    float r01 = 2.0f * (q1 * q2 - q0 * q3);
    float r02 = 2.0f * (q1 * q3 + q0 * q2);
    float r10 = 2.0f * (q1 * q2 + q0 * q3);
    float r11 = 1.0f - 2.0f * (q1 * q1 + q3 * q3);
    float r12 = 2.0f * (q2 * q3 - q0 * q1);

    /* 去 yaw：R_tilt = R_yaw^T · R。yaw 由 body-X 世界水平投影定。 */
    float h = sqrtf(r00 * r00 + r10 * r10);
    float cosPsi;
    float sinPsi;
    float tilt00;
    float tilt01;
    float tilt02;
    float tilt10;
    float tilt11;
    float tilt12;
    float localSX;
    float localSY;

    if (h < 1.0e-6f)
    {
        /* 接近垂直（body-X 指天/地），yaw 无定义，退化为不去 yaw（极端姿态，已被倾角门控挡） */
        cosPsi = 1.0f;
        sinPsi = 0.0f;
    }
    else
    {
        cosPsi = r00 / h;
        sinPsi = r10 / h;
    }

    /* R_tilt 行0 = cosPsi·R[0] + sinPsi·R[1]；行1 = −sinPsi·R[0] + cosPsi·R[1] */
    tilt00 = cosPsi * r00 + sinPsi * r10; /* = h */
    tilt01 = cosPsi * r01 + sinPsi * r11;
    tilt02 = cosPsi * r02 + sinPsi * r12;
    tilt10 = -sinPsi * r00 + cosPsi * r10; /* = 0 */
    tilt11 = -sinPsi * r01 + cosPsi * r11;
    tilt12 = -sinPsi * r02 + cosPsi * r12;

    localSX = tilt00 * sensorX + tilt01 * sensorY + tilt02 * sensorZ;
    localSY = tilt10 * sensorX + tilt11 * sensorY + tilt12 * sensorZ;

    /* L_S → L_FRD：前向(X)=−L_S.Y，右向(Y)=−L_S.X。 */
    *localX = -localSY;
    *localY = -localSX;
}

/* 前台用：关中断快照 imuData（四元数/gyro/姿态），保证多字段一致。
 * physicalPitch/physicalRoll 出参允许 NULL（标定 store 路径不需要姿态角）。 */
static void velocityEstimatorSnapshotImu(
    float q[4], float *gyroX, float *gyroY, float *gyroZ,
    float *physicalPitch, float *physicalRoll)
{
    imuSnapshotStruct snapshot;
    IMUGetSnapshot(&snapshot);
    q[0] = snapshot.q[0];
    q[1] = snapshot.q[1];
    q[2] = snapshot.q[2];
    q[3] = snapshot.q[3];
    *gyroX = snapshot.gyroPitchRaw;
    *gyroY = snapshot.gyroRollRaw;
    *gyroZ = snapshot.gyroYawRaw;
    if (physicalPitch != 0)
    {
        *physicalPitch = snapshot.physicalPitch;
    }
    if (physicalRoll != 0)
    {
        *physicalRoll = snapshot.physicalRoll;
    }
}

void velocityEstimatorInit(void)
{
    uint8_t a;
    uint16_t histIdx;

    for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
    {
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].acceleration = 0.0f;
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].imuOnlyVelocity = 0.0f;
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity = 0.0f;
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].bias = 0.0f;
        velocityEstimatorKalmanResetCovarianceAxis(
            &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p00,
            &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p01,
            &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p11);
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].flowVelocity = 0.0f;
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].innovation = 0.0f;
        for (histIdx = 0u; histIdx < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VEL_HIST_LEN; histIdx++)
        {
            velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelHist[histIdx] = 0.0f;
        }
        velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationSum[a] = 0.0f;
        velocityEstimatorImuOnlyBias[a] = 0.0f;
    }
    velocityEstimatorState.histWriteIdx = 0u;
    velocityEstimatorState.heightM = 0.0f;
    velocityEstimatorState.frameAgeMs = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS;
    velocityEstimatorState.validAgeMs = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS;
    velocityEstimatorState.consecutiveInvalidFrames = 0u;
    velocityEstimatorState.predictGeneration = 0u;
    velocityEstimatorState.lastRawFlowX = 0.0f;
    velocityEstimatorState.lastRawFlowY = 0.0f;
    velocityEstimatorState.flowValid = 0u;
    velocityEstimatorState.tofFresh = 0u;

    velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount = 0u;
}

/* 1ms ISR 热路径：三轴去重力 + 四元数矩阵展开 + 双轴积分；
 * 无三角函数 / 除法（除标定结束一次）/ malloc / 递归。M7 硬件 FPU 可承受。 */
void velocityEstimatorPredictTick(void)
{
    float accelSensorX;
    float accelSensorY;
    float accelSensorZ;
    float linearSensorX;
    float linearSensorY;
    float linearSensorZ;
    float acceleration[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
    imuSnapshotStruct imuSnapshot;
    float q0;
    float q1;
    float q2;
    float q3;
    float gravitySensorX;
    float gravitySensorY;
    float gravitySensorZ;
    uint8_t a;

    velocityEstimatorState.predictGeneration++;
    IMUGetSnapshot(&imuSnapshot);
    q0 = imuSnapshot.q[0];
    q1 = imuSnapshot.q[1];
    q2 = imuSnapshot.q[2];
    q3 = imuSnapshot.q[3];
    accelSensorX = imuSnapshot.accelSensorX;
    accelSensorY = imuSnapshot.accelSensorY;
    accelSensorZ = imuSnapshot.accelSensorZ;

    if (velocityEstimatorState.frameAgeMs < 0xFFFFu)
    {
        velocityEstimatorState.frameAgeMs++;
    }
    if (velocityEstimatorState.validAgeMs < 0xFFFFu)
    {
        velocityEstimatorState.validAgeMs++;
    }
    if (velocityEstimatorState.validAgeMs >= VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS)
    {
        velocityEstimatorState.flowValid = 0u;
    }

    /* 机体系重力单位向量（与 Mahony halfv×2 同式），扣除得线加速度。 */
    gravitySensorX = 2.0f * (q1 * q3 - q0 * q2);
    gravitySensorY = 2.0f * (q0 * q1 + q2 * q3);
    gravitySensorZ = 2.0f * (q0 * q0 - 0.5f + q3 * q3);

    linearSensorX = accelSensorX - VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_GRAVITY_MPS2 * gravitySensorX;
    linearSensorY = accelSensorY - VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_GRAVITY_MPS2 * gravitySensorY;
    linearSensorZ = accelSensorZ - VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_GRAVITY_MPS2 * gravitySensorZ;

    velocityEstimatorRotateSensorToLocal(
        q0, q1, q2, q3,
        linearSensorX, linearSensorY, linearSensorZ,
        &acceleration[0], &acceleration[1]);

    /* NaN/Inf 守卫：四元数/加速度异常时冻结本拍预测并清有效标志，防 NaN 永久污染积分。 */
    if (!velocityEstimatorIsFinite(acceleration[0]) ||
        !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(acceleration[1]))
    {
        velocityEstimatorState.flowValid = 0u;
        return;
    }

    for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
    {
        acceleration[a] = velocityEstimatorClamp(
            acceleration[a], VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_ACCEL_LIMIT_MPS2);
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].acceleration = acceleration[a];
    }

    /* 上电静止 ~2s：平均去重力后的水平加速度作等效 bias 初值。
     * 标定期检测到运动（任一轴水平线加速度超阈值）即清零累计重新开始，
     * 避免把启动晃动 / Mahony 高增益收敛期误差写入 bias。双轴同时完成。 */
    if (velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BIAS_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES)
    {
        if (acceleration[0] > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_CALIB_MOTION_MPS2 ||
            acceleration[0] < -VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_CALIB_MOTION_MPS2 ||
            acceleration[1] > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_CALIB_MOTION_MPS2 ||
            acceleration[1] < -VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_CALIB_MOTION_MPS2)
        {
            velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationSum[0] = 0.0f;
            velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationSum[1] = 0.0f;
            velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount = 0u;
            return;
        }

        velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationSum[0] += acceleration[0];
        velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationSum[1] += acceleration[1];
        velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount++;

        if (velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount == VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BIAS_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES)
        {
            float invSamples = 1.0f / (float) VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BIAS_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES;
            for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
            {
                float bias = velocityEstimatorClamp(
                    velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationSum[a] * invSamples,
                    VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BIAS_LIMIT_MPS2);
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].bias = bias;
                velocityEstimatorImuOnlyBias[a] = bias;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].imuOnlyVelocity = 0.0f;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity = 0.0f;
                velocityEstimatorKalmanResetCovarianceAxis(
                    &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p00,
                    &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p01,
                    &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p11);
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
    {
        /* 纯 IMU 积分参考（固定 bias，不被光流校正，用于影子对比漂移）。 */
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].imuOnlyVelocity = velocityEstimatorClamp(
            velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].imuOnlyVelocity
                + (acceleration[a] - velocityEstimatorImuOnlyBias[a])
                    * VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_PREDICT_DT_S,
            VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VELOCITY_LIMIT_MPS);

        /* KF 状态预测：v += (a-b)*dt，b 为随机游走状态，本拍均值保持不变。 */
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity = velocityEstimatorClamp(
            velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity
                + (acceleration[a] - velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].bias)
                    * VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_PREDICT_DT_S,
            VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VELOCITY_LIMIT_MPS);

        /* 协方差预测：每轴约 10 次乘加，无除法/矩阵库；250MHz M7 FPU 1ms 预算充足。 */
        velocityEstimatorKalmanPredictCovarianceAxis(
            &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p00,
            &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p01,
            &velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p11);

        /* 写融合速度环形历史（供光流帧延迟补偿取延迟时刻估计）。本拍在 ISR 内，
         * 单写者，前台 Update 只读，无需额外保护。 */
        velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelHist[velocityEstimatorState.histWriteIdx] =
            velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity;
    }

    /* 两轴写入同一槽后统一前进（X/Y 共享单索引）。 */
    velocityEstimatorState.histWriteIdx =
        (uint16_t) ((velocityEstimatorState.histWriteIdx + 1u) % VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VEL_HIST_LEN);
}

void velocityEstimatorUpdate(uint8_t allowFrozenTofHeight)
{
    opticalFlowSampleStruct sample;
    float heightMm = 0.0f;
    float verticalVelocityMmS = 0.0f;
    float heightM;
    uint8_t tofFresh = tofGetHeight(&heightMm, &verticalVelocityMmS);
    uint8_t tofHealthy = altitudeTofIsHealthy();
    uint32_t primask;

    (void) verticalVelocityMmS; /* 垂直速度本阶段不入水平融合 */
    heightM = heightMm * 0.001f;

    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    velocityEstimatorState.heightM = heightM;
    velocityEstimatorState.tofFresh = tofFresh;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);

    if (!opticalFlowPoll(&sample))
    {
        return;
    }
    /* 收到任意完整帧 → 清链路帧年龄（含无效帧，表示链路活）。
     * 有效观测年龄 validAgeMs 仅在通过全部门控 + 校正后才清零（见下）。
     * 连续被拒计数：每收一帧先 +1（饱和不回卷），成功校正时在提交块归零。 */
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    velocityEstimatorState.frameAgeMs = 0u;
    velocityEstimatorState.lastRawFlowX = (float) sample.flowX;
    velocityEstimatorState.lastRawFlowY = (float) sample.flowY;
    if (velocityEstimatorState.consecutiveInvalidFrames < 0xFFFFu)
    {
        velocityEstimatorState.consecutiveInvalidFrames++;
    }
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);

    /* 帧无效 / dt 越界 / 无可用高度 / 高度越界 → 本帧不校正、不刷新有效年龄。
     * 已进入CRUISE后的ToF HOLD允许使用facade冻结的最后可信高度维持短窗光流尺度；
     * RAMP及其它调用场景仍要求实时健康，避免长期陈旧高度掩盖安全失效。 */
    if (!sample.valid ||
        sample.dtUs < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_DT_MIN_US ||
        sample.dtUs > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_DT_MAX_US ||
        (!tofHealthy && allowFrozenTofHeight == 0u) ||
        heightM < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_HEIGHT_MIN_M ||
        heightM > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_HEIGHT_MAX_M)
    {
        return;
    }

    {
        float q[4];
        float gyroX;
        float gyroY;
        float gyroZ;
        float physicalPitch;
        float physicalRoll;
        float invDtS;
        float flowAngularRateX;
        float flowAngularRateY;
        float flowBodyX;
        float flowBodyY;
        float flowSensorX;
        float flowSensorY;
        float flowLocal[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float measurementVariance;
        float snapVel[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float snapBias[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float snapP00[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float snapP01[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float snapP11[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float delayedVel[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        float innovation[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        velocityEstimatorKalmanResultStruct result[VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES];
        uint16_t delaySlot;
        uint32_t snapPredictGeneration;
        uint8_t updateAccepted;
        uint8_t a;

        velocityEstimatorSnapshotImu(
            q, &gyroX, &gyroY, &gyroZ, &physicalPitch, &physicalRoll);

        /* 大倾角时 v=h×flowRate 近似失效；门限放宽至约 65° 以容忍机动平移大倾角（大倾角帧测速误差增大）。 */
        if (fabsf(physicalPitch) > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_TILT_LIMIT_RAD ||
            fabsf(physicalRoll) > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_TILT_LIMIT_RAD)
        {
            return;
        }

        invDtS = 1000000.0f / (float) sample.dtUs; /* 1/积分时长(秒) */
        flowAngularRateX = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_SCALE_X_RAD_PER_COUNT
            * (float) sample.flowX * invDtS;
        flowAngularRateY = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_SCALE_Y_RAD_PER_COUNT
            * (float) sample.flowY * invDtS;

        /* 倾摆去旋转：flowX 配 pitch(gyroX)、flowY 配 roll(gyroY)，板端"减负"=加回。 */
        flowAngularRateX -= VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_GYRO_COMP_X * gyroX;
        flowAngularRateY -= VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_GYRO_COMP_Y * gyroY;
        flowBodyX = heightM * flowAngularRateX;
        flowBodyY = heightM * flowAngularRateY;

        /* 杠杆臂切向解耦：光流偏离旋转中心 r=(LEVER_X,LEVER_Y)，yaw 转动时光流测到
         * 真实切向速度需扣除以还原质心速度。注意 gyroZ=imuData.gz 为 CCW 正，而 FRD
         * 右手系(Z 向下)的 ω_z = -gyroZ，故 v_tan=(gyroZ·dy, -gyroZ·dx)，
         * 质心 v = v_光流 - v_tan → forward -= gyroZ·dy；right += gyroZ·dx。确定性补偿，非标定。 */
        flowBodyX -= (gyroZ * VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_LEVER_Y_M);
        flowBodyY += (gyroZ * VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_LEVER_X_M);

        /* 已标定 B(FRD)→S 安装映射：sensorX=−bodyRight，sensorY=−bodyForward。 */
        flowSensorX = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BODY_TO_SENSOR_XX * flowBodyX
            + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BODY_TO_SENSOR_XY * flowBodyY;
        flowSensorY = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BODY_TO_SENSOR_YX * flowBodyX
            + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BODY_TO_SENSOR_YY * flowBodyY;
        velocityEstimatorRotateSensorToLocal(
            q[0], q[1], q[2], q[3],
            flowSensorX, flowSensorY, 0.0f,
            &flowLocal[0], &flowLocal[1]);

        /* 物理速度有限性守卫（高度/dt 异常组合可能产生 Inf/NaN）。 */
        if (!velocityEstimatorIsFinite(flowLocal[0]) ||
            !velocityEstimatorIsFinite(flowLocal[1]))
        {
            return;
        }

        /* 量测方差 R 随高度平方增长：同样角流噪声在更高处对应更大线速度噪声。
         * 首版不按 innovation 调 R（避免真实加速时残差变大而错误压低光流权重）。 */
        measurementVariance = VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_R_BASE
            + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_R_HEIGHT_COEFF * heightM * heightM;
        measurementVariance = clampf(
            measurementVariance, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MIN, VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_KF_P_MAX);

        /* 延迟补偿 + 缩短临界区：
         * P2 修复——关中断仅保护"快照"和"提交"两个短瞬间，中间 KF 计算（纯函数、
         * 基于局部快照）放临界区外，避免长时间关中断扰动 1ms 飞控环。
         * 延迟补偿——光流量测代表约 FLOW_DELAY_MS 前的状态，故 innovation 用"延迟时刻"
         * 的融合速度（环形历史）而非当前值，使量测与估计同时刻，消除时间错位。 */

        /* 临界区 1（短）：快照当前 v/bias/P + 取延迟时刻融合速度。 */
        primask = __get_PRIMASK();
        __disable_irq();
        snapPredictGeneration = velocityEstimatorState.predictGeneration;
        /* histWriteIdx 指向下一个待写槽，最近写入的是 idx-1；延迟 D 帧即 idx-1-D。 */
        delaySlot = (uint16_t) ((velocityEstimatorState.histWriteIdx
            + VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VEL_HIST_LEN
            - 1u - VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_FLOW_DELAY_MS) % VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_VEL_HIST_LEN);
        for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
        {
            snapVel[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity;
            snapBias[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].bias;
            snapP00[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p00;
            snapP01[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p01;
            snapP11[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p11;
            delayedVel[a] = velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelHist[delaySlot];
        }
        __set_PRIMASK(primask);

        /* 临界区外：innovation 对齐延迟时刻估计（延迟补偿核心），KF 更新纯函数计算。
         * 两轴同拍：任一轴坏值（innovation 越限或更新失败）则整帧不提交。 */
        updateAccepted = 1u;
        for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
        {
            innovation[a] = flowLocal[a] - delayedVel[a];
            if (velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BIAS_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES ||
                fabsf(innovation[a]) > VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_INNOVATION_LIMIT_MPS ||
                !velocityEstimatorKalmanUpdateAxis(
                    snapVel[a], snapBias[a], snapP00[a], snapP01[a], snapP11[a],
                    innovation[a], measurementVariance, &result[a]))
            {
                updateAccepted = 0u;
            }
        }

        /* 临界区 2（短）：提交结果 + 调试量。两轴同拍，单轴坏值则整帧不更新。 */
        primask = __get_PRIMASK();
        __disable_irq();
        for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
        {
            velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].flowVelocity = flowLocal[a];
            velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].innovation = innovation[a];
        }
        if (updateAccepted &&
            velocityEstimatorState.predictGeneration == snapPredictGeneration)
        {
            for (a = 0u; a < VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_AXES; a++)
            {
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].fusedVelocity = result[a].velocity;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].bias = result[a].bias;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p00 = result[a].p00;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p01 = result[a].p01;
                velocityEstimatorState.axis[a].p11 = result[a].p11;
            }
            velocityEstimatorState.flowValid = 1u;
            velocityEstimatorState.validAgeMs = 0u; /* 有效观测年龄仅在更新成功时清零 */
            velocityEstimatorState.consecutiveInvalidFrames = 0u; /* 成功校正 → 连续被拒计数归零 */
        }
        __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    }
}

void velocityEstimatorGetSnapshot(velocityEstimatorSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();

    if (out == 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    __disable_irq();
    out->velocityFwd = velocityEstimatorState.axis[0].fusedVelocity;
    out->velocityRight = velocityEstimatorState.axis[1].fusedVelocity;
    out->validAgeMs = velocityEstimatorState.validAgeMs;
    out->valid =
        (velocityEstimatorBiasCalibrationCount >= VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_BIAS_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES &&
         velocityEstimatorState.flowValid) ? 1u : 0u;
    out->padding = 0u;
    out->predictGeneration = velocityEstimatorState.predictGeneration;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

uint16_t velocityEstimatorGetConsecutiveInvalidFrames(void)
{
    uint16_t count;
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    count = velocityEstimatorState.consecutiveInvalidFrames;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    return count;
}

void velocityEstimatorGetRawFlow(float *flowX, float *flowY)
{
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    if (flowX != 0)
    {
        *flowX = velocityEstimatorState.lastRawFlowX;
    }
    if (flowY != 0)
    {
        *flowY = velocityEstimatorState.lastRawFlowY;
    }
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

#ifndef _VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_H_
#define _VELOCITY_ESTIMATOR_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/* IMU + 光流水平速度估计器（双轴独立 2 状态线性 KF）。
 *   - 1ms IMU 预测：去重力 + 倾斜补偿(去 yaw, 保留 pitch/roll)转机体水平航向系 + 双轴状态/协方差预测
 *   - 光流帧异步校正：物理速度换算 + 标量量测更新（Joseph）+ bias 状态估计
 *   - 输出位于**机体水平航向系**（前向/右向，跟随机头 yaw），单位 m/s
 *     注意：非世界固定系——去 yaw 避免 xy 速度与航向耦合，正是光流定位所需的对地机体速度。
 * 输出经一次 snapshot 接入水平速度内环闭环；valid=0 时速度环冻结降级。 */

typedef struct
{
    float velocityFwd;
    float velocityRight;
    uint16_t validAgeMs;
    uint8_t valid;
    uint8_t padding;
    uint32_t predictGeneration;
} velocityEstimatorSnapshotStruct;

void velocityEstimatorInit(void);

/* 1ms PIT 调用（紧跟 IMUUpdate()）：仅四元数展开、去重力和双轴预测，
 * 无阻塞 / 动态内存 / UART / 三角函数。 */
void velocityEstimatorPredictTick(void);

/* 前台调用：消费光流新帧 + ToF 高度，物理速度换算 + 双轴 KF 量测更新。
 * allowFrozenTofHeight仅用于已进入CRUISE后的ToF HOLD：以最后可信高度维持短窗光流尺度；
 * RAMP/正式缓降必须传0，不能用冻结高度掩盖长期失效。 */
void velocityEstimatorUpdate(uint8_t allowFrozenTofHeight);

/* 一次短临界区返回同拍融合速度、有效性与预测代数。 */
void velocityEstimatorGetSnapshot(velocityEstimatorSnapshotStruct *out);

/* 距上次成功 KF 校正以来连续被拒的光流帧数（每收一帧+1 饱和于 0xFFFF，成功校正归零）。
 * 调试观测光流/KF 健康度：持续增大说明光流帧一直进不了融合（无效/门控拒/倾角越界等）。 */
uint16_t velocityEstimatorGetConsecutiveInvalidFrames(void);

/* 读取最近一帧原始光流计数（flowX 前正 / flowY 右正，未经 K_flow 换算）；允许任一指针为空。
 * 供调试通道观测光流是否在动；光流帧被 velocityEstimator 前台独占消费，外部不可再 poll。 */
void velocityEstimatorGetRawFlow(float *flowX, float *flowY);

代码（c）
#include "crc32Ieee.h"

uint32_t crc32IeeeCalc(const uint8_t* data, uint32_t len)
{
    uint32_t crc = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    uint32_t i;

    for (i = 0u; i < len; i++)
    {
        uint8_t b;
        crc ^= (uint32_t) data[i];
        for (b = 0u; b < 8u; b++)
        {
            uint32_t mask = (uint32_t) (-(int32_t) (crc & 1u));
            crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320u & mask);
        }
    }
    return ~crc;
}

#ifndef FACT_FRESHNESS_H_
#define FACT_FRESHNESS_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/* 调用方以相邻采样点的uint32模减传入elapsedMs；饱和后仅显式新事实可清零。 */
static inline uint16_t factFreshnessAdvanceAgeU16(uint16_t ageMs, uint32_t elapsedMs)
{
    if (elapsedMs >= (uint32_t) (0xFFFFu - ageMs)) return 0xFFFFu;
    return (uint16_t) (ageMs + elapsedMs);
}

/* 首次一致快照只建立当前会话基线，避免__no_init历史READY被当作新事实。 */
static inline uint8_t factFreshnessAcceptSeq(uint8_t *primed,
    uint32_t *baselineSeq, uint32_t candidateSeq)
{
    if (*primed == 0u)
    {
        *primed = 1u;
        *baselineSeq = candidateSeq;
        return 0u;
    }
    if (candidateSeq == *baselineSeq) return 0u;
    *baselineSeq = candidateSeq;
    return 1u;
}

#endif

/*
 * lowPassFilter.c
 *
 *  Created: 20250319
 *  Author: Hecate
 */
#include "lowPassFilter.h"

void lowPassFilterInit(LowPassFilterData *obj, float alpha)
{
    obj->alpha = alpha;

    obj->filteredValue = 0;
    obj->firstFlag = 1;
    obj->lastOutput = 0;
}

void lowPassFilterReset(LowPassFilterData *obj, float value)
{
    obj->firstFlag = 0u;
    obj->lastOutput = value;
    obj->filteredValue = value;
}

void lowPassFilter(LowPassFilterData *obj, const float value)
{
    if ((obj)->firstFlag == 1u)
    {
        (obj)->firstFlag = 0u;
        (obj)->lastOutput = value;
    }
    (obj)->filteredValue = (obj)->alpha * value + (1.0f - (obj)->alpha) * (obj)->lastOutput;
    (obj)->lastOutput = (obj)->filteredValue;
}

#define PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_MAGIC        (0x31534C50u) /* PLS1 */
#define PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_VERSION      (1u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_BYTES        (96u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A       (10u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B       (11u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS (PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_BYTES / 4u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE \
    (FLASH_PAGE_SIZE / PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_BYTES)
#define PARAM_SLOT_DATA_PAGE_FIRST        (0u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_DATA_PAGE_LAST         (PARAM_SLOT_COUNT * 2u - 1u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_COORDINATOR_PAGE_A     (12u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_COORDINATOR_PAGE_B     (13u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC       (0x50520000u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK  (0xFFFF0000u)
#define PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION  (1u << 10)
#define PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_FIELDS_MASK (0x000007FFu)
#define PARAM_SLOT_MASK                ((1u << PARAM_SLOT_COUNT) - 1u)

#define PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_MAGIC        (0x31544E52u) /* RNT1 */
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_VERSION      (1u)
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES        (64u)
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_DATA_PAGE_A           (14u)
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_DATA_PAGE_B           (15u)
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A       (16u)
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_B       (17u)
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS (PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES / 4u)
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE \
    (FLASH_PAGE_SIZE / PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES)
#define PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY    (UINT32_MAX)

static paramSlotSelector *selectorMutable(paramSlotStore *store)
{
    return (paramSlotSelector *) (void *) store->selectorBytes;
}

    return (const paramSlotSelector *) (const void *) store->selectorBytes;
}

    const paramSlotStore *store)

        store->runtimeSelectorBytes;
