static uint8_t slotValid(uint8_t slot)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((slot >= PARAM_SLOT_FIRST) && (slot <= PARAM_SLOT_LAST));
}

static uint32_t dataPage(uint8_t slot, uint8_t bank)
{
    return (uint32_t) ((slot - 1u) * 2u + (bank & 1u));
}

static uint8_t sequenceNewer(uint32_t candidate, uint32_t reference)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((int32_t) (candidate - reference) > 0);
}

static uint8_t selectorValid(const paramSlotSelector *selector)
{
    uint32_t crc;
    uint32_t packed;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t oldActive;
    uint8_t oldValid;
    uint8_t oldBank;
    uint8_t i;

    if ((selector->magic != PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_MAGIC) ||
        (selector->version != PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_VERSION) ||
        (selector->recordBytes != PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_BYTES) ||
        (selector->sequence == 0u) ||
        (selector->activeSlot > PARAM_SLOT_LAST) ||
        (selector->reserved0 != 0u) ||
        ((selector->validMask & (uint8_t) ~PARAM_SLOT_MASK) != 0u) ||
        ((selector->bankMask & (uint8_t) ~PARAM_SLOT_MASK) != 0u) ||
        ((selector->activeSlot != 0u) &&
         ((selector->validMask &
           (uint8_t) (1u << (selector->activeSlot - 1u))) == 0u)))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < PARAM_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
    {
        uint8_t valid = (uint8_t) ((selector->validMask >> i) & 1u);
        if (valid != 0u)
        {
            if (selector->generation[i] == 0u ||
                selector->transactionId[i] == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY)
                return 0u;
        }
        else if (((selector->bankMask >> i) & 1u) != 0u ||
                 selector->generation[i] != 0u ||
                 selector->blobCrc[i] != 0u ||
                 selector->transactionId[i] != 0u)
        {
            return 0u;
        }
    }
    packed = selector->reserved[2u];
    if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) != PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC)
    {
        if (selector->reserved[0u] != 0u || selector->reserved[1u] != 0u ||
            packed != 0u) return 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        if ((packed & ~(PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK |
                PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_FIELDS_MASK)) != 0u)
            return 0u;
        slot = (uint8_t) (packed & 0x0Fu);
        oldActive = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 4) & 0x0Fu);
        oldValid = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 8) & 1u);
        oldBank = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 9) & 1u);
        if (slotValid(slot) == 0u || slotValid(oldActive) == 0u ||
            (selector->activeSlot != slot &&
             selector->activeSlot != oldActive) ||
            ((selector->validMask >> (slot - 1u)) & 1u) == 0u ||
            ((oldActive != slot) &&
             (((selector->validMask >> (oldActive - 1u)) & 1u) == 0u)))
            return 0u;
        if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION) != 0u)
        {
            uint8_t index = (uint8_t) (slot - 1u);
            /* The former activation-only writer switched activeSlot while
             * retaining an exact snapshot of the target slot in reserved[].
             * Accept that durable shape so an upgrade can materialize the
             * rollback runtime; a zeroed pseudo-snapshot was never emitted by
             * production firmware and must not make a corrupt record valid. */
            if (selector->activeSlot != slot || oldValid == 0u ||
                oldBank != ((selector->bankMask >> index) & 1u) ||
                selector->reserved[0u] != selector->transactionId[index] ||
                selector->reserved[1u] != selector->generation[index])
                return 0u;
        }
        else
        {
            if (selector->transactionId[slot - 1u] == 0u ||
                selector->transactionId[slot - 1u] ==
                    PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY)
                return 0u;
            if (oldValid != 0u)
            {
                if (selector->reserved[1u] == 0u) return 0u;
            }
            else if (oldBank != 0u || selector->reserved[0u] != 0u ||
                     selector->reserved[1u] != 0u)
            {
                return 0u;
            }
        }
    }
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) selector,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(paramSlotSelector, crc));
    return (uint8_t) (crc == selector->crc);
}

static const uint32_t *flashWord(uint32_t page, uint32_t word)
{
    uintptr_t address = (uintptr_t) FLASH_BASE_ADDR +
        (uintptr_t) page * FLASH_PAGE_SIZE +
        (uintptr_t) word * sizeof(uint32_t);
    return (const uint32_t *) address;
}

static void cleanFlashSource(const void *source, uint32_t bytes)
{
#if CY_CORE_CM7_0 || CY_CORE_CM7_1
    uintptr_t start = ((uintptr_t) source) & ~(uintptr_t) 31u;
    uintptr_t end = ((uintptr_t) source + bytes + 31u) & ~(uintptr_t) 31u;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) start,
        (int32_t) (end - start));
#else
    (void) source;
    (void) bytes;
#endif
}

typedef enum
{
    PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_BLANK = 0,
    PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_PROGRAMMED,
    PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_IO_FAILED
} paramSlotFlashState;

static paramSlotFlashState blankCheckWords(uint32_t page,
    uint32_t firstWord,
    uint32_t wordCount)
{
    cy_stc_flash_blankcheck_config_t config = {0};
    cy_en_flashdrv_status_t status;

    if ((page >= FLASH_PAGE_NUM) || (wordCount == 0u) ||
        (firstWord >= FLASH_PAGE_LENGTH) ||
        (wordCount > (FLASH_PAGE_LENGTH - firstWord)))
    {
        return PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_IO_FAILED;
    }
    config.addrToBeChecked = flashWord(page, firstWord);
    config.numOfWordsToBeChecked = wordCount;
    status = Cy_Flash_BlankCheck(NULL, &config, CY_FLASH_DRIVER_BLOCKING);
    if (status == CY_FLASH_DRV_SUCCESS) return PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_BLANK;
    if (status == CY_FLASH_DRV_FLASH_NOT_ERASED) return PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_PROGRAMMED;
    return PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_IO_FAILED;
}

static uint8_t readFlashBytes(uint32_t page, uint32_t byteOffset,
    void *data, uint32_t bytes)
{
    uint32_t firstWord;
    uint32_t wordCount;
    uint32_t i;
    uint8_t *output = (uint8_t *) data;

    if ((data == NULL) || (bytes == 0u) || ((byteOffset & 3u) != 0u) ||
        (byteOffset + bytes > FLASH_PAGE_SIZE)) return 0u;
    firstWord = byteOffset / sizeof(uint32_t);
    wordCount = (bytes + 3u) / sizeof(uint32_t);
    if ((page >= FLASH_PAGE_NUM) || (firstWord >= FLASH_PAGE_LENGTH) ||
        (wordCount > (FLASH_PAGE_LENGTH - firstWord))) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < wordCount; i++)
    {
        const uint32_t *address;
        uint32_t value;
        uint32_t copyBytes;
        paramSlotFlashState state = blankCheckWords(page, firstWord + i, 1u);
        if (state == PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_BLANK)
        {
            value = UINT32_MAX;
            copyBytes = bytes - i * sizeof(uint32_t);
            if (copyBytes > sizeof(uint32_t)) copyBytes = sizeof(uint32_t);
            memcpy(&output[i * sizeof(uint32_t)], &value, copyBytes);
            continue;
        }
        if (state != PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_PROGRAMMED) return 0u;
        address = flashWord(page, firstWord + i);
#if CY_CORE_CM7_0 || CY_CORE_CM7_1
        {
            uintptr_t line = ((uintptr_t) address) & ~(uintptr_t) 31u;
            SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((uint32_t *) line, 32);
        }
#endif
        value = *((const volatile uint32_t *) address);
        copyBytes = bytes - i * sizeof(uint32_t);
        if (copyBytes > sizeof(uint32_t)) copyBytes = sizeof(uint32_t);
        memcpy(&output[i * sizeof(uint32_t)], &value, copyBytes);
    }
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t recordBlank(uint32_t page, uint32_t recordIndex)
{
    paramSlotFlashState state = blankCheckWords(page,
        recordIndex * PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS,
        PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS);
    if (state == PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_BLANK) return 1u;
    if (state == PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_PROGRAMMED) return 0u;
    return 2u;
}

static uint32_t firstBlankRecord(uint32_t page)
{
    uint32_t record;
    for (record = 0u; record < PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE; record++)
    {
        uint8_t state = recordBlank(page, record);
        if (state == 1u) return record;
        if (state == 2u) return PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE + 1u;
    }
    return PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE;
}

static uint8_t loadLatestSelector(paramSlotSelector *latest,
    uint32_t *latestPage, uint32_t *nextRecord)
{
    uint32_t pages[2u] = {PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B};
    uint8_t found = 0u;
    uint8_t ioFailed = 0u;
    uint8_t programmedInvalid = 0u;
    uint8_t committedInvalid = 0u;
    uint32_t p;

    *latestPage = PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
    *nextRecord = 0u;
    for (p = 0u; p < 2u; p++)
    {
        uint32_t record;
        for (record = 0u; record < PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE; record++)
        {
            paramSlotSelector candidate;
            uint8_t blank = recordBlank(pages[p], record);
            if (blank == 2u)
            {
                ioFailed = 1u;
                continue;
            }
            if (blank == 1u) continue;
            if (readFlashBytes(pages[p], record * PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_BYTES,
                &candidate, sizeof(candidate)) == 0u)
            {
                ioFailed = 1u;
                continue;
            }
            if (selectorValid(&candidate) == 0u)
            {
                programmedInvalid = 1u;
                if (candidate.magic == PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_MAGIC)
                    committedInvalid = 1u;
            }
            else if ((found == 0u) ||
                sequenceNewer(candidate.sequence, latest->sequence))
            {
                *latest = candidate;
                *latestPage = pages[p];
                *nextRecord = firstBlankRecord(pages[p]);
                if (*nextRecord > PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE)
                    ioFailed = 1u;
                found = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    if ((found == 0u) && (ioFailed == 0u) &&
        (programmedInvalid == 0u))
    {
        *latestPage = PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
        *nextRecord = firstBlankRecord(PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A);
        if (*nextRecord >= PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE)
        {
            *latestPage = PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B;
            *nextRecord = firstBlankRecord(PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B);
        }
        if (*nextRecord > PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE) ioFailed = 1u;
    }
    if (ioFailed != 0u) return 2u;
    if (committedInvalid != 0u) return (found != 0u) ? 3u : 4u;
    if ((found == 0u) && (programmedInvalid != 0u)) return 4u;
    return found;
}

static uint8_t programWord(uint32_t page, uint32_t wordIndex, uint32_t value)
{
    uint32_t readback;
    cleanFlashSource(&value, sizeof(value));
    Cy_FlashWriteWork((PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_ADDRESS_TYPE) (uintptr_t)
        flashWord(page, wordIndex),
        &value, CY_FLASH_DRIVER_BLOCKING);
    if (readFlashBytes(page, wordIndex * sizeof(uint32_t),
        &readback, sizeof(readback)) == 0u) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (readback == value);
}

static uint8_t resolveUncertainSelector(paramSlotStore *store)
{
    paramSlotSelector latest;
    uint32_t page;
    uint32_t record;
    uint8_t loadStatus;
    if (store->selectorUncertain == 0u) return 1u;
    memset(&latest, 0, sizeof(latest));
    loadStatus = loadLatestSelector(&latest, &page, &record);
    if (loadStatus >= 2u) return 0u;
    /* An initialized store had a durable selector before this write, so an
     * empty rescan cannot prove rollback and remains fail-closed.  During the
     * very first selector creation, however, empty is the expected durable
     * state when the magic word never committed; allow the caller to retry. */
    if (loadStatus == 0u)
    {
        if (store->initialized != 0u) return 0u;
        memset(store->selectorBytes, 0, sizeof(store->selectorBytes));
        store->selectorUncertain = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    memcpy(store->selectorBytes, &latest, sizeof(latest));
    store->selectorUncertain = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t reconcileSelectorWrite(paramSlotStore *store,
    const paramSlotSelector *expected)
{
    store->selectorUncertain = 1u;
    if (resolveUncertainSelector(store) == 0u) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (memcmp(store->selectorBytes, expected,
        sizeof(*expected)) == 0);
}

static uint8_t appendSelector(paramSlotStore *store,
    paramSlotSelector *next)
{
    paramSlotSelector latest;
    uint32_t page;
    uint32_t record;
    uint32_t baseWord;
    const uint32_t *words = (const uint32_t *) (const void *) next;
    uint32_t i;

    if (store->selectorUncertain != 0u)
    {
        if (resolveUncertainSelector(store) == 0u) return 0u;
        return 0u;
    }

    memset(&latest, 0, sizeof(latest));
    {
        uint8_t loadStatus = loadLatestSelector(&latest, &page, &record);
        if (loadStatus >= 2u) return 0u;
        if (loadStatus != 0u)
        {
            next->sequence = latest.sequence + 1u;
            if (next->sequence == 0u) next->sequence = 1u;
        }
        else
        {
            next->sequence = 1u;
        }
    }
    if (record >= PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE)
    {
        page = (page == PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A) ?
            PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B : PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
        if (flash_check(0u, page) != 0u) flash_erase_page(0u, page);
        record = 0u;
    }
    next->magic = PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_MAGIC;
    next->version = PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_VERSION;
    next->recordBytes = PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_BYTES;
    next->crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) next,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(paramSlotSelector, crc));
    baseWord = record * PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS;
    for (i = 1u; i < PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS; i++)
    {
        if (programWord(page, baseWord + i, words[i]) == 0u) return 0u;
    }
    if (programWord(page, baseWord, words[0]) == 0u)
        return reconcileSelectorWrite(store, next);
    {
        paramSlotSelector verified;
        if (readFlashBytes(page, record * PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_BYTES,
            &verified, sizeof(verified)) == 0u)
            return reconcileSelectorWrite(store, next);
        if ((selectorValid(&verified) == 0u) ||
            (memcmp(&verified, next, sizeof(verified)) != 0))
            return reconcileSelectorWrite(store, next);
    }
    memcpy(store->selectorBytes, next, sizeof(*next));
    store->selectorUncertain = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint32_t runtimeDataPage(uint8_t bank)
{
    return bank != 0u ? PARAM_RUNTIME_DATA_PAGE_B :
        PARAM_RUNTIME_DATA_PAGE_A;
}

static uint8_t runtimeSelectorValid(const paramRuntimeSelector *selector)
{
    uint32_t crc;
    if ((selector->magic != PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_MAGIC) ||
        (selector->version != PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_VERSION) ||
        (selector->recordBytes != PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES) ||
        (selector->sequence == 0u) ||
        (selector->bank > 1u) || (selector->valid > 1u) ||
        (selector->pending > 1u) ||
        ((selector->sourceSlot != 0u) &&
         (slotValid(selector->sourceSlot) == 0u)) ||
        (selector->rollbackBank > 1u) ||
        (selector->rollbackValid > 1u) ||
        ((selector->rollbackSourceSlot != 0u) &&
         (slotValid(selector->rollbackSourceSlot) == 0u)) ||
        (selector->reserved0 != 0u) || selector->reserved[0u] != 0u ||
        selector->reserved[1u] != 0u || selector->reserved[2u] != 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if ((selector->valid == 0u) || (selector->generation == 0u)) return 0u;
    if ((selector->pending != 0u) &&
        ((selector->transactionId == 0u) ||
         (selector->rollbackValid == 0u) ||
         (selector->rollbackGeneration == 0u) ||
         (selector->bank == selector->rollbackBank))) return 0u;
    if ((selector->pending == 0u) &&
        (selector->rollbackBank != 0u || selector->rollbackValid != 0u ||
         selector->rollbackSourceSlot != 0u ||
         selector->rollbackGeneration != 0u ||
         selector->rollbackBlobCrc != 0u ||
         selector->rollbackTransactionId != 0u)) return 0u;
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) selector,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(paramRuntimeSelector, crc));
    return (uint8_t) (crc == selector->crc);
}

static uint8_t runtimeRecordBlank(uint32_t page, uint32_t recordIndex)
{
    paramSlotFlashState state = blankCheckWords(page,
        recordIndex * PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS,
        PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS);
    if (state == PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_BLANK) return 1u;
    if (state == PARAM_SLOT_FLASH_PROGRAMMED) return 0u;
    return 2u;
}

static uint32_t firstBlankRuntimeRecord(uint32_t page)
{
    uint32_t record;
    for (record = 0u; record < PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE;
        record++)
    {
        uint8_t state = runtimeRecordBlank(page, record);
        if (state == 1u) return record;
        if (state == 2u) return PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE + 1u;
    }
    return PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE;
}

static uint8_t loadLatestRuntimeSelector(paramRuntimeSelector *latest,
    uint32_t *latestPage, uint32_t *nextRecord)
{
    const uint32_t pages[2u] = {PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A,
        PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_B};
    uint8_t found = 0u;
    uint8_t ioFailed = 0u;
    uint8_t programmedInvalid = 0u;
    uint8_t committedInvalid = 0u;
    uint32_t p;

    *latestPage = PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
    *nextRecord = 0u;
    for (p = 0u; p < 2u; p++)
    {
        uint32_t record;
        for (record = 0u; record < PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE;
            record++)
        {
            paramRuntimeSelector candidate;
            uint8_t blank = runtimeRecordBlank(pages[p], record);
            if (blank == 2u)
            {
                ioFailed = 1u;
                continue;
            }
            if (blank == 1u) continue;
            if (readFlashBytes(pages[p],
                record * PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES,
                &candidate, sizeof(candidate)) == 0u)
            {
                ioFailed = 1u;
                continue;
            }
            if (runtimeSelectorValid(&candidate) == 0u)
            {
                programmedInvalid = 1u;
                if (candidate.magic == PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_MAGIC)
                    committedInvalid = 1u;
            }
            else if ((found == 0u) ||
                sequenceNewer(candidate.sequence, latest->sequence))
            {
                *latest = candidate;
                *latestPage = pages[p];
                *nextRecord = firstBlankRuntimeRecord(pages[p]);
                if (*nextRecord > PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE)
                    ioFailed = 1u;
                found = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    if ((found == 0u) && (ioFailed == 0u) &&
        (programmedInvalid == 0u))
    {
        *latestPage = PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
        *nextRecord = firstBlankRuntimeRecord(PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A);
        if (*nextRecord >= PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE)
        {
            *latestPage = PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_B;
            *nextRecord = firstBlankRuntimeRecord(PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_B);
        }
        if (*nextRecord > PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE)
            ioFailed = 1u;
    }
    return (uint8_t) ((ioFailed != 0u) || (committedInvalid != 0u) ||
        ((found == 0u) && (programmedInvalid != 0u)) ? 2u : found);
}

static uint8_t resolveUncertainRuntimeSelector(paramSlotStore *store)
{
    paramRuntimeSelector latest;
    uint32_t page;
    uint32_t record;
    uint8_t loadStatus;
    if (store->runtimeSelectorUncertain == 0u) return 1u;
    memset(&latest, 0, sizeof(latest));
    loadStatus = loadLatestRuntimeSelector(&latest, &page, &record);
    if (loadStatus == 2u) return 0u;
    if (loadStatus == 0u)
    {
        if (store->runtimeInitialized != 0u) return 0u;
        memset(store->runtimeSelectorBytes, 0,
            sizeof(store->runtimeSelectorBytes));
        store->runtimeSelectorUncertain = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    memcpy(store->runtimeSelectorBytes, &latest, sizeof(latest));
    store->runtimeSelectorUncertain = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t reconcileRuntimeSelectorWrite(paramSlotStore *store,
    const paramRuntimeSelector *expected)
{
    store->runtimeSelectorUncertain = 1u;
    if (resolveUncertainRuntimeSelector(store) == 0u) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (memcmp(store->runtimeSelectorBytes, expected,
        sizeof(*expected)) == 0);
}

static uint8_t appendRuntimeSelector(paramSlotStore *store,
    paramRuntimeSelector *next)
{
    paramRuntimeSelector latest;
    uint32_t page;
    uint32_t record;
    uint32_t baseWord;
    const uint32_t *words = (const uint32_t *) (const void *) next;
    uint32_t i;

    if (store->runtimeSelectorUncertain != 0u)
    {
        if (resolveUncertainRuntimeSelector(store) == 0u) return 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(&latest, 0, sizeof(latest));
    {
        uint8_t loadStatus = loadLatestRuntimeSelector(&latest, &page, &record);
        if (loadStatus == 2u) return 0u;
        next->sequence = (loadStatus != 0u) ? latest.sequence + 1u : 1u;
        if (next->sequence == 0u) next->sequence = 1u;
    }
    if (record >= PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS_PER_PAGE)
    {
        page = (page == PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A) ?
            PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_B : PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
        if (flash_check(0u, page) != 0u) flash_erase_page(0u, page);
        record = 0u;
    }
    next->magic = PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_MAGIC;
    next->version = PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_VERSION;
    next->recordBytes = PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES;
    next->crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) next,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(paramRuntimeSelector, crc));
    baseWord = record * PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS;
    for (i = 1u; i < PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORD_WORDS; i++)
    {
        if (programWord(page, baseWord + i, words[i]) == 0u) return 0u;
    }
    if (programWord(page, baseWord, words[0]) == 0u)
        return reconcileRuntimeSelectorWrite(store, next);
    {
        paramRuntimeSelector verified;
        if (readFlashBytes(page, record * PARAM_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES,
            &verified, sizeof(verified)) == 0u)
            return reconcileRuntimeSelectorWrite(store, next);
        if ((runtimeSelectorValid(&verified) == 0u) ||
            (memcmp(&verified, next, sizeof(verified)) != 0))
            return reconcileRuntimeSelectorWrite(store, next);
    }
    memcpy(store->runtimeSelectorBytes, next, sizeof(*next));
    store->runtimeSelectorUncertain = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t readDataPage(const paramSlotStore *store,
    uint32_t page, void *blob)
{
    uint32_t paddedBytes = (store->blobBytes + 3u) & ~3u;
    uint8_t *scratch = (uint8_t *) (void *) flash_union_buffer;
    /* SeekFree's flash_buffer_clear() only clears FLASH_PAGE_LENGTH bytes,
     * although flash_union_buffer occupies FLASH_PAGE_SIZE bytes.  Fill the
     * complete source page here so a non-word-aligned blob cannot inherit
     * stale tail bytes. */
    memset((void *) flash_union_buffer, 0xFF, FLASH_PAGE_SIZE);
    if (readFlashBytes(page, 0u, scratch, paddedBytes) == 0u) return 0u;
    if (store->validate(scratch, store->blobBytes) == 0u) return 0u;
    if (blob != scratch) memcpy(blob, scratch, store->blobBytes);
    return 1u;
}

static paramSlotStatus verifyPendingLibraryCandidate(
    const paramSlotStore *store, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    const paramSlotSelector *selector = selectorConst(store);
    uint32_t packed = selector->reserved[2u];
    uint8_t *blob = (uint8_t *) (void *) flash_union_buffer;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t index;
    uint8_t bank;

    if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) != PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC)
        return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
    slot = (uint8_t) (packed & 0x0Fu);
    if (slotValid(slot) == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
    index = slot - 1u;
    if (transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY)
    {
        if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION) == 0u)
            return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    }
    else if (((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION) != 0u) ||
        (selector->transactionId[index] != transactionId))
    {
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    }
    if (((selector->validMask >> index) & 1u) == 0u ||
        selector->generation[index] == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
    bank = (uint8_t) ((selector->bankMask >> index) & 1u);
    if (readDataPage(store, dataPage(slot, bank), blob) == 0u ||
        crc32IeeeCalc(blob, store->blobBytes) != selector->blobCrc[index])
        return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

static uint8_t rollbackPendingSelector(paramSlotStore *store)
{
    const paramSlotSelector *current = selectorConst(store);
    paramSlotSelector rollback;
    uint32_t packed = current->reserved[2u];
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t oldActive;
    uint8_t oldValid;
    uint8_t oldBank;
    uint8_t *blob = (uint8_t *) (void *) flash_union_buffer;
    if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) != PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC) return 1u;
    slot = (uint8_t) (packed & 0x0Fu);
    oldActive = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 4) & 0x0Fu);
    oldValid = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 8) & 0x01u);
    oldBank = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 9) & 0x01u);
    if (!slotValid(slot) || !slotValid(oldActive)) return 0u;
    rollback = *current;
    rollback.activeSlot = (oldValid != 0u) ? oldActive : 0u;
    if (oldValid)
    {
        if (!readDataPage(store, dataPage(slot, oldBank), blob)) return 0u;
        if (oldBank) rollback.bankMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << (slot - 1u));
        else rollback.bankMask &= (uint8_t) ~(1u << (slot - 1u));
        rollback.validMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << (slot - 1u));
        rollback.generation[slot - 1u] = current->reserved[1u];
        rollback.blobCrc[slot - 1u] = crc32IeeeCalc(blob, store->blobBytes);
        rollback.transactionId[slot - 1u] = current->reserved[0u];
    }
    else
    {
        rollback.validMask &= (uint8_t) ~(1u << (slot - 1u));
        rollback.bankMask &= (uint8_t) ~(1u << (slot - 1u));
        rollback.generation[slot - 1u] = 0u;
        rollback.blobCrc[slot - 1u] = 0u;
        rollback.transactionId[slot - 1u] = 0u;
    }
    memset(rollback.reserved, 0, sizeof(rollback.reserved));
    return appendSelector(store, &rollback);
}

static uint8_t writeDataPage(const paramSlotStore *store,
    uint32_t page, const void *blob)
{
    uint32_t words = (store->blobBytes + 3u) / 4u;
    void *verify = (void *) flash_union_buffer;

    if ((store->blobBytes > FLASH_PAGE_SIZE) ||
        (store->validate(blob, store->blobBytes) == 0u)) return 0u;
    memset((void *) flash_union_buffer, 0xFF, FLASH_PAGE_SIZE);
    memcpy((void *) flash_union_buffer, blob, store->blobBytes);
    cleanFlashSource((const void *) flash_union_buffer, words * 4u);
    if (flash_check(0u, page) != 0u) flash_erase_page(0u, page);
    if (flash_write_page_from_buffer(0u, page, words) != 0u) return 0u;
    memset((void *) flash_union_buffer, 0xFF, FLASH_PAGE_SIZE);
    if (readDataPage(store, page, verify) == 0u) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (memcmp(verify, blob, store->blobBytes) == 0);
}

static void recoverSelectorFromDataPages(const paramSlotStore *store,
    paramSlotSelector *selector)
{
    uint8_t *blob = (uint8_t *) (void *) flash_union_buffer;
    uint8_t slot;

    memset(selector, 0, sizeof(*selector));
    for (slot = PARAM_SLOT_FIRST; slot <= PARAM_SLOT_LAST; slot++)
    {
        uint8_t bank;
        for (bank = 0u; bank < 2u; bank++)
        {
            if (readDataPage(store, dataPage(slot, bank), blob) != 0u)
            {
                uint8_t index = (uint8_t) (slot - 1u);
                uint8_t mask = (uint8_t) (1u << index);
                selector->validMask |= mask;
                if (bank != 0u) selector->bankMask |= mask;
                selector->generation[index] = 1u;
                selector->blobCrc[index] = crc32IeeeCalc(blob,
                    store->blobBytes);
                if (selector->activeSlot == 0u) selector->activeSlot = slot;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

static paramSlotStatus readRuntimeWithSelector(const paramSlotStore *store,
    const paramRuntimeSelector *selector, void *blob)
{
    uint32_t paddedBytes;
    uint8_t *scratch = (uint8_t *) (void *) flash_union_buffer;
    if ((selector->valid == 0u) || (selector->bank > 1u))
        return PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
    paddedBytes = (store->blobBytes + 3u) & ~3u;
    memset((void *) flash_union_buffer, 0xFF, FLASH_PAGE_SIZE);
    if (readFlashBytes(runtimeDataPage(selector->bank), 0u, scratch,
        paddedBytes) == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    if (store->validate(scratch, store->blobBytes) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_INVALID;
    if (crc32IeeeCalc(scratch, store->blobBytes) !=
        selector->blobCrc) return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
    if (blob != scratch) memcpy(blob, scratch, store->blobBytes);
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

static paramSlotStatus prepareRuntimeBlob(paramSlotStore *store,
    const void *blob, uint32_t transactionId, uint8_t sourceSlot)
{
    const paramRuntimeSelector *current;
    uint8_t bank;
    uint32_t generation;
    if ((store == NULL) || (blob == NULL) ||
        ((sourceSlot != 0u) && (slotValid(sourceSlot) == 0u)) ||
        (store->validate(blob, store->blobBytes) == 0u))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    if (resolveUncertainRuntimeSelector(store) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    current = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
    if ((store->runtimeStagedValid != 0u) ||
        ((store->runtimeInitialized != 0u) && (current->pending != 0u)))
        return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    bank = (store->runtimeInitialized != 0u && current->valid != 0u) ?
        (uint8_t) (current->bank ^ 1u) : 0u;
    generation = (store->runtimeInitialized != 0u && current->valid != 0u) ?
        current->generation + 1u : 1u;
    if (generation == 0u) generation = 1u;
    if (writeDataPage(store, runtimeDataPage(bank), blob) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
    store->runtimeStagedValid = 1u;
    store->runtimeStagedCommitted = 0u;
    store->runtimeStagedBank = bank;
    store->runtimeStagedSourceSlot = sourceSlot;
    store->runtimeStagedGeneration = generation;
    store->runtimeStagedBlobCrc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) blob,
        store->blobBytes);
    store->runtimeStagedTransactionId = transactionId;
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

static paramSlotStatus commitRuntimeBlob(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint32_t transactionId, uint8_t pending)
{
    paramRuntimeSelector next;
    const paramRuntimeSelector *current;
    if ((store == NULL) || (store->runtimeStagedValid == 0u))
        return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if (store->runtimeStagedTransactionId != transactionId)
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    if ((pending != 0u) && (transactionId == 0u))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    current = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
    memset(&next, 0, sizeof(next));
    if (store->runtimeInitialized != 0u) next = *current;
    if (pending != 0u)
    {
        if ((store->runtimeInitialized == 0u) || (current->valid == 0u))
            return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
        next.rollbackBank = current->bank;
        next.rollbackValid = current->valid;
        next.rollbackSourceSlot = current->sourceSlot;
        next.rollbackGeneration = current->generation;
        next.rollbackBlobCrc = current->blobCrc;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = current->transactionId;
    }
    else
    {
        next.rollbackBank = 0u;
        next.rollbackValid = 0u;
        next.rollbackSourceSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
        next.rollbackBlobCrc = 0u;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
    }
    next.bank = store->runtimeStagedBank;
    next.valid = 1u;
    next.pending = (uint8_t) (pending != 0u);
    next.sourceSlot = store->runtimeStagedSourceSlot;
    next.generation = store->runtimeStagedGeneration;
    next.blobCrc = store->runtimeStagedBlobCrc;
    next.transactionId = transactionId;
    memset(next.reserved, 0, sizeof(next.reserved));
    if (appendRuntimeSelector(store, &next) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    store->runtimeInitialized = 1u;
    store->runtimeStagedCommitted = 1u;
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

static void clearRuntimeStage(paramSlotStore *store)
{
    store->runtimeStagedValid = 0u;
    store->runtimeStagedCommitted = 0u;
    store->runtimeStagedBank = 0u;
    store->runtimeStagedSourceSlot = 0u;
    store->runtimeStagedGeneration = 0u;
    store->runtimeStagedBlobCrc = 0u;
    store->runtimeStagedTransactionId = 0u;
}

static paramSlotStatus abortRuntimeTransaction(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramRuntimeSelector next;
    const paramRuntimeSelector *current;
    if (resolveUncertainRuntimeSelector(store) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    current = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
    if ((store->runtimeInitialized != 0u) && (current->pending != 0u))
    {
        if (current->transactionId != transactionId)
            return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
        if (current->rollbackValid == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_INVALID;
        next = *current;
        next.bank = current->rollbackBank;
        next.valid = current->rollbackValid;
        next.pending = 0u;
        next.sourceSlot = current->rollbackSourceSlot;
        next.generation = current->rollbackGeneration;
        next.blobCrc = current->rollbackBlobCrc;
        next.transactionId = current->rollbackTransactionId;
        next.rollbackBank = 0u;
        next.rollbackValid = 0u;
        next.rollbackSourceSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
        next.rollbackBlobCrc = 0u;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
        memset(next.reserved, 0, sizeof(next.reserved));
        if (appendRuntimeSelector(store, &next) == 0u)
            return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    }
    else if ((store->runtimeStagedValid != 0u) &&
        (store->runtimeStagedTransactionId != transactionId))
    {
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    }
    clearRuntimeStage(store);
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

static paramSlotStatus finishRuntimeTransaction(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramRuntimeSelector next;
    const paramRuntimeSelector *current;
    uint8_t candidate[FLASH_PAGE_SIZE];
    if (resolveUncertainRuntimeSelector(store) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    current = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
    if ((store->runtimeInitialized != 0u) && (current->pending != 0u))
    {
        if (current->transactionId != transactionId)
            return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
        /* FINISH is the durable point of no return.  Re-read the candidate
         * before dropping rollback metadata so a damaged or unreadable bank
         * remains abortable after reboot. */
        if (readRuntimeWithSelector(store, current, candidate) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
            return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
        next = *current;
        next.pending = 0u;
        next.rollbackBank = 0u;
        next.rollbackValid = 0u;
        next.rollbackSourceSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
        next.rollbackBlobCrc = 0u;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
        memset(next.reserved, 0, sizeof(next.reserved));
        if (appendRuntimeSelector(store, &next) == 0u)
            return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    }
    else if ((store->runtimeStagedValid != 0u) &&
        (store->runtimeStagedTransactionId != transactionId))
    {
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    }
    clearRuntimeStage(store);
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

static paramSlotStatus initializeRuntime(paramSlotStore *store,
    const void *defaultBlob)
{
    paramRuntimeSelector selector;
    const paramSlotSelector *library;
    uint32_t page;
    uint32_t record;
    uint32_t packed;
    uint8_t blob[FLASH_PAGE_SIZE];
    uint8_t sourceSlot = 0u;
    uint8_t loadStatus;
    paramSlotStatus status;

    memset(&selector, 0, sizeof(selector));
    loadStatus = loadLatestRuntimeSelector(&selector, &page, &record);
    if (loadStatus == 2u) return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    if (loadStatus != 0u)
    {
        paramRuntimeSelector committed;
        memcpy(store->runtimeSelectorBytes, &selector, sizeof(selector));
        store->runtimeInitialized = 1u;
        status = readRuntimeWithSelector(store, &selector, blob);
        if (selector.pending != 0u)
        {
            if (selector.rollbackValid == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_INVALID;
            committed = selector;
            committed.bank = selector.rollbackBank;
            committed.valid = selector.rollbackValid;
            committed.pending = 0u;
            committed.sourceSlot = selector.rollbackSourceSlot;
            committed.generation = selector.rollbackGeneration;
            committed.blobCrc = selector.rollbackBlobCrc;
            committed.transactionId = selector.rollbackTransactionId;
            /* A pending candidate is not the startup source.  Even if its
             * bank is corrupt, preserve the selector and boot the rollback
             * bank so the coordinator can still issue ABORT. */
            return readRuntimeWithSelector(store, &committed, blob);
        }
        if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
        if (selector.pending != 0u) return status;
        if ((status == PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED) || (defaultBlob == NULL) ||
            (store->validate(defaultBlob, store->blobBytes) == 0u))
            return status;
        /* A structurally readable but invalid runtime is replaced by the
         * current compiled defaults.  The library pages remain untouched. */
        selector.pending = 0u;
        selector.rollbackValid = 0u;
        memcpy(store->runtimeSelectorBytes, &selector, sizeof(selector));
        clearRuntimeStage(store);
        status = prepareRuntimeBlob(store, defaultBlob, 0u, 0u);
        if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) status = commitRuntimeBlob(store, 0u, 0u);
        if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        {
            clearRuntimeStage(store);
            store->runtimeDefaultsRewritten = 1u;
        }
        return status;
    }

    library = selectorConst(store);
    sourceSlot = library->activeSlot;
    packed = library->reserved[2u];

    /* Migrate a transaction that had already switched the legacy active-slot
     * selector.  Materialize its previous startup source first, then recreate
     * the candidate as a pending runtime transaction.  This preserves the
     * coordinator's post-reboot ABORT/FINISH decision instead of silently
     * finalizing whichever slot happened to be active at upgrade time. */
    if (((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) == PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC) &&
        slotValid((uint8_t) (packed & 0x0Fu)) &&
        (sourceSlot == (uint8_t) (packed & 0x0Fu)))
    {
        uint8_t targetSlot = (uint8_t) (packed & 0x0Fu);
        uint8_t oldActive = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 4) & 0x0Fu);
        uint8_t oldValid = 0u;
        uint8_t oldBank = 0u;
        uint32_t transactionId;

        if (slotValid(oldActive))
        {
            if (oldActive == targetSlot)
            {
                oldValid = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 8) & 1u);
                oldBank = (uint8_t) ((packed >> 9) & 1u);
                status = (oldValid != 0u) &&
                    readDataPage(store, dataPage(oldActive, oldBank), blob) ?
                    PARAM_SLOT_OK : PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
            }
            else
            {
                status = paramSlotStoreRead(store, oldActive, blob,
                    store->blobBytes);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            status = PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
        }
        if ((status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) && (defaultBlob != NULL) &&
            (store->validate(defaultBlob, store->blobBytes) != 0u))
        {
            memcpy(blob, defaultBlob, store->blobBytes);
            oldActive = 0u;
            status = PARAM_SLOT_OK;
        }
        if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return status;
        status = prepareRuntimeBlob(store, blob, 0u, oldActive);
        if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) status = commitRuntimeBlob(store, 0u, 0u);
        if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return status;
        clearRuntimeStage(store);

        status = paramSlotStoreRead(store, targetSlot, blob, store->blobBytes);
        if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        {
            /* Keep the valid rollback runtime and the legacy pending marker;
             * the coordinator can still ABORT the damaged transaction. */
            return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
        }
        transactionId = ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION) != 0u) ?
            PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY :
            library->transactionId[targetSlot - 1u];
        if (transactionId == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
        status = prepareRuntimeBlob(store, blob, transactionId, targetSlot);
        if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK)
            status = commitRuntimeBlob(store, transactionId, 1u);
        return status;
    }

    if ((slotValid(sourceSlot) != 0u) &&
        (paramSlotStoreRead(store, sourceSlot, blob, store->blobBytes) ==
            PARAM_SLOT_OK))
    {
        status = prepareRuntimeBlob(store, blob, 0u, sourceSlot);
    }
    else if ((defaultBlob != NULL) &&
        (store->validate(defaultBlob, store->blobBytes) != 0u))
    {
        status = prepareRuntimeBlob(store, defaultBlob, 0u, 0u);
    }
    else
    {
        return PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
    }
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) status = commitRuntimeBlob(store, 0u, 0u);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) clearRuntimeStage(store);
    return status;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreInit(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint32_t blobBytes,
    paramSlotBlobValidator validate,
    const void *defaultBlob)
{
    paramSlotSelector selector;
    uint32_t page;
    uint32_t record;
    uint8_t legacy[FLASH_PAGE_SIZE];

    if ((store == NULL) || (validate == NULL) ||
        (blobBytes == 0u) ||
        (blobBytes > FLASH_PAGE_SIZE)) return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    memset(store, 0, sizeof(*store));
    store->blobBytes = blobBytes;
    store->validate = validate;
    flash_init();
    memset(&selector, 0, sizeof(selector));
    {
        uint8_t loadStatus = loadLatestSelector(&selector, &page, &record);
        if (loadStatus == 2u)
        {
            /* Runtime is the sole startup source.  A corrupt library journal
             * remains unavailable/fail-closed, but must not strand a valid
             * committed runtime or prevent a verified defaults repair. */
            memset(store->selectorBytes, 0, sizeof(store->selectorBytes));
            store->initialized = 0u;
            return initializeRuntime(store, defaultBlob);
        }
        if (loadStatus == 3u)
        {
            /* A durable malformed record must not poison an independently
             * valid last-good selector forever.  Rebuild only the selector
             * journal; library data pages and runtime pages are untouched. */
            if (flash_check(0u, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A) != 0u)
                flash_erase_page(0u, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A);
            if (flash_check(0u, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B) != 0u)
                flash_erase_page(0u, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B);
            memset(store->selectorBytes, 0, sizeof(store->selectorBytes));
            if (appendSelector(store, &selector) == 0u)
                return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
            loadStatus = 1u;
        }
        else if (loadStatus == 4u)
        {
            /* No selector record survived validation.  Reconstruct an
             * overwritable directory from independently valid data banks.
             * Generation/transaction identity cannot be trusted without a
             * selector and is restarted locally; the next five-board SAVE
             * assigns one common transaction identity.  Runtime remains the
             * independent startup source. */
            if (flash_check(0u, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A) != 0u)
                flash_erase_page(0u, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A);
            if (flash_check(0u, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B) != 0u)
                flash_erase_page(0u, PARAM_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B);
            recoverSelectorFromDataPages(store, &selector);
            memset(store->selectorBytes, 0, sizeof(store->selectorBytes));
            if (appendSelector(store, &selector) == 0u)
                return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
            loadStatus = 1u;
        }
        if (loadStatus != 0u)
        {
            uint32_t packed;
            uint8_t slot;
            memcpy(store->selectorBytes, &selector, sizeof(selector));
            store->initialized = 1u;
            packed = selector.reserved[2u];
            if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) == PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC &&
                (packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION) == 0u)
            {
                slot = (uint8_t) (packed & 0x0Fu);
                if (!slotValid(slot)) return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
                store->stagedValid = 1u;
                store->stagedCommitted = 1u;
                store->stagedSlot = slot;
                store->stagedBank = (uint8_t) ((selector.bankMask >>
                    (slot - 1u)) & 1u);
                store->stagedGeneration = selector.generation[slot - 1u];
                store->stagedBlobCrc = selector.blobCrc[slot - 1u];
                store->stagedTransactionId = selector.transactionId[slot - 1u];
            }
            return initializeRuntime(store, defaultBlob);
        }
    }
    memset(legacy, 0xFF, blobBytes);
    if (readFlashBytes(0u, 0u, legacy, (blobBytes + 3u) & ~3u) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    memset(&selector, 0, sizeof(selector));
    if (validate(legacy, blobBytes) != 0u)
    {
        selector.activeSlot = 1u;
        selector.validMask = 1u;
        selector.generation[0] = 1u;
        selector.blobCrc[0] = crc32IeeeCalc(legacy, blobBytes);
    }
    if (appendSelector(store, &selector) == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    store->initialized = 1u;
    return initializeRuntime(store, defaultBlob);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreGetMeta(const paramSlotStore *store,
    uint8_t slot, paramSlotMeta *meta)
{
    const paramSlotSelector *selector;
    uint8_t index;
    if ((store == NULL) || (meta == NULL) || (store->initialized == 0u) ||
        (slotValid(slot) == 0u)) return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    selector = selectorConst(store);
    index = slot - 1u;
    memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
    meta->slot = slot;
    meta->valid = (uint8_t) ((selector->validMask >> index) & 1u);
    meta->active = 0u;
    meta->bank = (uint8_t) ((selector->bankMask >> index) & 1u);
    meta->generation = selector->generation[index];
    meta->blobCrc = selector->blobCrc[index];
    meta->transactionId = selector->transactionId[index];
    return meta->valid ? PARAM_SLOT_OK : PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreRead(const paramSlotStore *store,
    uint8_t slot, void *blob, uint32_t blobBytes)
{
    paramSlotMeta meta;
    if ((blob == NULL) || (store == NULL) || (blobBytes != store->blobBytes))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    if (paramSlotStoreGetMeta(store, slot, &meta) != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
    if (readDataPage(store, dataPage(slot, meta.bank), blob) == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_INVALID;
    if (crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) blob, blobBytes) != meta.blobCrc)
        return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreReadRuntime(const paramSlotStore *store,
    void *blob, uint32_t blobBytes)
{
    paramRuntimeSelector committed;
    const paramRuntimeSelector *selector;
    if ((store == NULL) || (blob == NULL) ||
        (blobBytes != store->blobBytes) ||
        (store->runtimeInitialized == 0u)) return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    selector = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
    if (selector->pending == 0u)
        return readRuntimeWithSelector(store, selector, blob);
    if (selector->rollbackValid == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_INVALID;
    committed = *selector;
    committed.bank = selector->rollbackBank;
    committed.valid = selector->rollbackValid;
    committed.pending = 0u;
    committed.sourceSlot = selector->rollbackSourceSlot;
    committed.generation = selector->rollbackGeneration;
    committed.blobCrc = selector->rollbackBlobCrc;
    committed.transactionId = selector->rollbackTransactionId;
    return readRuntimeWithSelector(store, &committed, blob);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreReadPreparedRuntime(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint32_t transactionId, void *blob, uint32_t blobBytes)
{
    const paramRuntimeSelector *selector;
    if ((store == NULL) || (blob == NULL) ||
        (blobBytes != store->blobBytes) || (transactionId == 0u))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    if (resolveUncertainRuntimeSelector(store) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    selector = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
    if ((store->runtimeInitialized == 0u) || (selector->pending == 0u))
        return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if (selector->transactionId != transactionId)
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    return readRuntimeWithSelector(store, selector, blob);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreSaveRuntime(paramSlotStore *store,
    const void *blob, uint32_t blobBytes)
{
    paramSlotStatus status;
    if ((store == NULL) || (blob == NULL) ||
        (blobBytes != store->blobBytes)) return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    status = prepareRuntimeBlob(store, blob, 0u, 0u);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) status = commitRuntimeBlob(store, 0u, 0u);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) clearRuntimeStage(store);
    else if (store->runtimeStagedCommitted == 0u) clearRuntimeStage(store);
    return status;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStorePrepareRuntime(paramSlotStore *store,
    const void *blob, uint32_t blobBytes, uint32_t transactionId,
    uint8_t sourceSlot)
{
    if ((store == NULL) || (blob == NULL) ||
        (blobBytes != store->blobBytes) || (transactionId == 0u) ||
        (transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    return prepareRuntimeBlob(store, blob, transactionId, sourceSlot);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStorePrepareRuntimeFromSlot(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint8_t slot, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    uint8_t blob[FLASH_PAGE_SIZE];
    paramSlotStatus status;
    if ((store == NULL) || (transactionId == 0u) ||
        (transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY) ||
        (slotValid(slot) == 0u)) return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    status = paramSlotStoreRead(store, slot, blob, store->blobBytes);
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return status;
    return prepareRuntimeBlob(store, blob, transactionId, slot);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreCommitRuntime(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    if ((store == NULL) || (transactionId == 0u) ||
        (transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    return commitRuntimeBlob(store, transactionId, 1u);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreGetRuntimeMeta(const paramSlotStore *store,
    paramRuntimeMeta *meta)
{
    const paramRuntimeSelector *selector;
    if ((store == NULL) || (meta == NULL) ||
        (store->runtimeInitialized == 0u)) return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    selector = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
    memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
    meta->valid = selector->valid;
    meta->pending = selector->pending;
    if (selector->pending != 0u)
    {
        meta->valid = selector->rollbackValid;
        meta->bank = selector->rollbackBank;
        meta->sourceSlot = selector->rollbackSourceSlot;
        meta->generation = selector->rollbackGeneration;
        meta->blobCrc = selector->rollbackBlobCrc;
        meta->transactionId = selector->rollbackTransactionId;
    }
    else
    {
        meta->bank = selector->bank;
        meta->sourceSlot = selector->sourceSlot;
        meta->generation = selector->generation;
        meta->blobCrc = selector->blobCrc;
        meta->transactionId = selector->transactionId;
    }
    return selector->valid != 0u ? PARAM_SLOT_OK : PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
}

uint8_t paramSlotStoreRuntimeDefaultsRewritten(const paramSlotStore *store)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((store != NULL) &&
        (store->runtimeDefaultsRewritten != 0u));
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStorePrepare(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint8_t slot, const void *blob, uint32_t blobBytes, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSlotMeta meta;
    uint8_t bank = 0u;
    uint32_t generation = 1u;
    if ((store == NULL) || (store->initialized == 0u) || (blob == NULL) ||
        (blobBytes != store->blobBytes) ||
        (slotValid(slot) == 0u) || (transactionId == 0u) ||
        (transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    if (store->stagedValid != 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if ((selectorConst(store)->reserved[2u] & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) ==
        PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC) return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if (paramSlotStoreGetMeta(store, slot, &meta) == PARAM_SLOT_OK)
    {
        bank = (uint8_t) (meta.bank ^ 1u);
        generation = meta.generation + 1u;
        if (generation == 0u) generation = 1u;
    }
    if (writeDataPage(store, dataPage(slot, bank), blob) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
    store->stagedValid = 1u;
    store->stagedSlot = slot;
    store->stagedBank = bank;
    store->stagedGeneration = generation;
    store->stagedBlobCrc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) blob, blobBytes);
    store->stagedTransactionId = transactionId;
    store->stagedCommitted = 0u;
    memcpy(store->rollbackSelectorBytes, store->selectorBytes,
        sizeof(store->rollbackSelectorBytes));
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreCommit(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint8_t slot, uint32_t transactionId, uint8_t activate)
{
    paramSlotSelector next;
    uint8_t *candidate = (uint8_t *) (void *) flash_union_buffer;
    uint8_t mask;
    uint8_t index;
    (void) activate;
    if ((store == NULL) || (store->stagedValid == 0u)) return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if ((store->stagedSlot != slot) || (store->stagedTransactionId != transactionId))
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    if ((store->stagedBank > 1u) || (store->stagedGeneration == 0u) ||
        (readDataPage(store, dataPage(slot, store->stagedBank), candidate) == 0u) ||
        (crc32IeeeCalc(candidate, store->blobBytes) != store->stagedBlobCrc))
        return PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED;
    next = *selectorMutable(store);
    index = slot - 1u;
    mask = (uint8_t) (1u << index);
    next.validMask |= mask;
    if (store->stagedBank != 0u) next.bankMask |= mask;
    else next.bankMask &= (uint8_t) ~mask;
    next.generation[index] = store->stagedGeneration;
    next.blobCrc[index] = store->stagedBlobCrc;
    next.transactionId[index] = transactionId;
    if (next.activeSlot == 0u) next.activeSlot = slot;
    next.reserved[0u] = selectorConst(store)->transactionId[index];
    next.reserved[1u] = selectorConst(store)->generation[index];
    next.reserved[2u] = PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC | (uint32_t) slot |
        ((uint32_t) ((selectorConst(store)->activeSlot != 0u) ?
            selectorConst(store)->activeSlot : slot) << 4) |
        ((uint32_t) ((selectorConst(store)->validMask >> index) & 1u) << 8) |
        ((uint32_t) ((selectorConst(store)->bankMask >> index) & 1u) << 9);
    if (appendSelector(store, &next) == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    store->stagedCommitted = 1u;
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreSave(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint8_t slot, const void *blob, uint32_t blobBytes,
    uint32_t transactionId, uint8_t activate)
{
    paramSlotStatus status = paramSlotStorePrepare(store, slot, blob, blobBytes,
        transactionId);
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return status;
    status = paramSlotStoreCommit(store, slot, transactionId, activate);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        status = paramSlotStoreFinish(store, transactionId);
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK &&
        paramSlotStoreAbort(store, transactionId) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    return status;
}

static paramSlotStatus activateLibrarySlot(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint8_t slot, uint32_t transactionId, uint8_t pending)
{
    uint8_t blob[FLASH_PAGE_SIZE];
    paramSlotStatus status;
    const paramRuntimeSelector *runtime;
    if ((store == NULL) || (slotValid(slot) == 0u))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    runtime = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
    if ((store->runtimeInitialized != 0u) && (runtime->pending != 0u))
    {
        if ((runtime->transactionId == transactionId) &&
            (runtime->sourceSlot == slot)) return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
        return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    }
    status = paramSlotStoreRead(store, slot, blob, store->blobBytes);
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return status;
    status = prepareRuntimeBlob(store, blob, transactionId, slot);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        status = commitRuntimeBlob(store, transactionId, pending);
    if ((status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) && (pending == 0u)) clearRuntimeStage(store);
    else if ((status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) &&
        (store->runtimeStagedCommitted == 0u)) clearRuntimeStage(store);
    return status;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreSetActive(paramSlotStore *store, uint8_t slot)
{
    if (store == NULL || store->stagedValid != 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if ((selectorConst(store)->reserved[2u] & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) ==
        PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC) return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    return activateLibrarySlot(store, slot, 0u, 0u);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreActivatePrepared(paramSlotStore *store,
    uint8_t slot, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSlotMeta meta;
    if (store == NULL || transactionId == 0u ||
        transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY ||
        store->stagedValid == 0u || store->stagedCommitted == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if (store->stagedSlot != slot ||
        store->stagedTransactionId != transactionId)
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    if ((selectorConst(store)->reserved[2u] & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) !=
        PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC)
        return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if (paramSlotStoreGetMeta(store, slot, &meta) != PARAM_SLOT_OK ||
        meta.transactionId != transactionId)
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    return activateLibrarySlot(store, slot, transactionId, 1u);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreSetActivePending(paramSlotStore *store, uint8_t slot)
{
    if (store == NULL || store->stagedValid != 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    if ((selectorConst(store)->reserved[2u] & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) ==
        PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC) return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
    return activateLibrarySlot(store, slot, PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY, 1u);
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreAbortPendingActivation(paramSlotStore *store)
{
    uint32_t packed;
    paramSlotStatus runtimeStatus;
    if (store == NULL) return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    if (resolveUncertainSelector(store) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    packed = store->initialized != 0u ?
        selectorConst(store)->reserved[2u] : 0u;
    if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) == PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC)
    {
        if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION) == 0u)
            return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
        if (rollbackPendingSelector(store) == 0u)
            return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
        store->stagedValid = 0u;
        store->stagedCommitted = 0u;
    }
    runtimeStatus = abortRuntimeTransaction(store,
        PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY);
    return runtimeStatus;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreFinishPendingActivation(paramSlotStore *store)
{
    uint32_t packed;
    paramSlotStatus libraryStatus;
    paramSlotStatus runtimeStatus;
    if (store == NULL) return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    if (resolveUncertainSelector(store) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    libraryStatus = verifyPendingLibraryCandidate(store,
        PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY);
    if (libraryStatus != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return libraryStatus;
    packed = store->initialized != 0u ?
        selectorConst(store)->reserved[2u] : 0u;
    if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) == PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC)
    {
        paramSlotSelector next = *selectorMutable(store);
        const paramRuntimeSelector *runtime = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
        if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION) == 0u ||
            (store->runtimeInitialized == 0u) ||
            (runtime->pending == 0u) ||
            (runtime->transactionId != PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY))
            return PARAM_SLOT_NO_PREPARE;
        memset(next.reserved, 0, sizeof(next.reserved));
        if (appendSelector(store, &next) == 0u)
            return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
        store->stagedValid = 0u;
        store->stagedCommitted = 0u;
    }
    runtimeStatus = finishRuntimeTransaction(store,
        PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY);
    return runtimeStatus;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreAbort(paramSlotStore *store, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSlotStatus runtimeStatus;
    if ((store == NULL) ||
        (transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    runtimeStatus = abortRuntimeTransaction(store, transactionId);
    if (runtimeStatus != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return runtimeStatus;
    if (resolveUncertainSelector(store) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    if (store->stagedValid == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
    if ((transactionId != 0u) && (store->stagedTransactionId != transactionId))
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    if ((selectorConst(store)->reserved[2u] & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) ==
        PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC)
    {
        if (rollbackPendingSelector(store) == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    }
    store->stagedValid = 0u;
    store->stagedCommitted = 0u;
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreFinish(paramSlotStore *store, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSlotStatus runtimeStatus;
    paramSlotStatus libraryStatus;
    if ((store == NULL) ||
        (transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    if (resolveUncertainSelector(store) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
    if ((store->stagedValid != 0u) &&
        (store->stagedTransactionId != transactionId))
        return PARAM_SLOT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH;
    libraryStatus = verifyPendingLibraryCandidate(store, transactionId);
    if (libraryStatus != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return libraryStatus;
    {
        paramSlotSelector next = *selectorMutable(store);
        if ((next.reserved[2u] & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) ==
            PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC)
        {
            memset(next.reserved, 0, sizeof(next.reserved));
            if (appendSelector(store, &next) == 0u) return PARAM_SLOT_IO_FAILED;
        }
        store->stagedValid = 0u;
        store->stagedCommitted = 0u;
    }
    runtimeStatus = finishRuntimeTransaction(store, transactionId);
    return runtimeStatus;
}

uint8_t paramSlotStoreGetActive(const paramSlotStore *store)
{
    (void) store;
    return 0u;
}

paramSlotStatus paramSlotStoreGetPending(const paramSlotStore *store,
    paramSlotPendingInfo *pending)
{
    const paramSlotSelector *selector;
    uint32_t packed;
    uint8_t slot;
    if (store == NULL || pending == NULL ||
        ((store->initialized == 0u) && (store->runtimeInitialized == 0u)))
        return PARAM_SLOT_BAD_ARGUMENT;
    memset(pending, 0, sizeof(*pending));
    selector = selectorConst(store);
    packed = store->initialized != 0u ? selector->reserved[2u] : 0u;
    if ((packed & PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC_MASK) != PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_MAGIC)
    {
        const paramRuntimeSelector *runtime = runtimeSelectorConst(store);
        if ((store->runtimeInitialized == 0u) || (runtime->pending == 0u))
            return PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY;
        if ((runtime->sourceSlot != 0u) &&
            (slotValid(runtime->sourceSlot) == 0u)) return PARAM_SLOT_INVALID;
        pending->valid = 1u;
        pending->slot = runtime->sourceSlot;
        pending->active = 1u;
        pending->activationOnly = (uint8_t) (
            runtime->transactionId == PARAM_RUNTIME_TX_ACTIVATION_ONLY);
        pending->transactionId = pending->activationOnly ? 0u :
            runtime->transactionId;
        return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
    }
    slot = (uint8_t) (packed & 0x0Fu);
    if (!slotValid(slot)) return PARAM_SLOT_INVALID;
    pending->valid = 1u;
    pending->slot = slot;
    pending->active = (uint8_t) ((store->runtimeInitialized != 0u) &&
        (runtimeSelectorConst(store)->pending != 0u) &&
        (runtimeSelectorConst(store)->sourceSlot == slot));
    pending->activationOnly = (uint8_t) ((packed &
        PARAM_SLOT_PENDING_ACTIVATION) != 0u);
    pending->transactionId = pending->activationOnly ? 0u :
        selector->transactionId[slot - 1u];
    return PARAM_SLOT_OK;
}

/*
 * schmitt.c
 *
 *  Created: 20250718
 *  Author: Hecate
 */
#include "schmitt.h"

void schmittSetThresholds(SchmittTrigger *obj, float upperThresh, float lowerThresh)
{
    if (upperThresh < lowerThresh)
    {
        // 交换阈值
        obj->upperThreshold = lowerThresh;
        obj->lowerThreshold = upperThresh;
    }
    else
    {
        obj->upperThreshold = upperThresh;
        obj->lowerThreshold = lowerThresh;
    }
}

/* 去掉外部库原 inline 限定：C99 下 .c 内裸 inline 不保证产生外部符号，
 * 跨 TU 调用会链接期 undefined；普通函数 IAR 自会按需内联，无性能损失。 */
void schmittUpdate(SchmittTrigger *obj, float inputValue)
{
    const float val = (inputValue);
    (obj)->outputState = (obj)->outputState
                             ? ((val <= (obj)->lowerThreshold) ? 0u : 1u)
                             : ((val >= (obj)->upperThreshold) ? 1u : 0u);
}

#ifndef CODE_SCHMITT_H_
#define CODE_SCHMITT_H_

#include <stdint.h>

// 施密特触发器对象
typedef struct
{
    float upperThreshold;
    float lowerThreshold;
    uint8_t outputState;
} SchmittTrigger;

// 重新设置上下阈值
void schmittSetThresholds(SchmittTrigger *obj, float upperThresh, float lowerThresh);

// 输入新采样值并更新输出。迟滞语义（边界含等号）：
//   outputState=1（高）时，输入 <= lowerThreshold 才转 0；
//   outputState=0（低）时，输入 >= upperThreshold 才转 1。
void schmittUpdate(SchmittTrigger *obj, float inputValue);

#endif /* CODE_SCHMITT_H_ */

static void imageClampTemplateRange(uint16_t* sizeMin, uint16_t* sizeMax)
{
    if (*sizeMin < 1u) *sizeMin = 1u;
    else if (*sizeMin > 59999u) *sizeMin = 59999u;
    if (*sizeMax > 60000u) *sizeMax = 60000u;
    if (*sizeMax <= *sizeMin) *sizeMax = (uint16_t) (*sizeMin + 1u);
}

    contourDetectSetTemplate(legacyActiveHu, contourHuLost);
}

    if (binaryCcCalibrated)
    {
