        cfg.areaMax = binaryCcActiveSizeMax;
    }
    binaryCcSetConfig(&cfg);
    binaryCcSetTemplate(binaryCcActiveHu, cfg.huMax);
}

static uint8_t imageTakeFrameSnapshot(float* sampleDtS)
{
    volatile uint32_t* intControl;
    uint32_t savedIntControl;

    if (!mt9v03x_finish_flag) return 0u;

    /* CPUIntIdx3还承载UART，只屏蔽MT9V03X的TCPWM59系统中断源。 */
    intControl = imageCameraSystemIntControl();
    savedIntControl = *intControl;
    *intControl = savedIntControl & ~IMAGE_CAMERA_INT_VALID_MASK;
    (void) *intControl;
    __DSB();
    if (mt9v03x_finish_flag != 0u)
    {
        mt9v03x_finish_flag = 0u;
        /* 相机物理旋转 180°：整帧线性反转 = 水平+垂直翻转 = 180° 旋转。
         * 在快照处统一矫正朝向，下游检测/显示/闭环极性全部无需改动。 */
        const uint8_t* src = mt9v03x_image[0];
        for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < MT9V03X_IMAGE_SIZE; i++)
        {
            imageFrameBuffer[i] = src[MT9V03X_IMAGE_SIZE - 1u - i];
        }
    }
    else
    {
        if ((savedIntControl & IMAGE_CAMERA_INT_VALID_MASK) != 0u)
        {
            *intControl = savedIntControl;
            (void) *intControl;
            __DSB();
        }
        return 0u;
    }
    if ((savedIntControl & IMAGE_CAMERA_INT_VALID_MASK) != 0u)
    {
        *intControl = savedIntControl;
        (void) *intControl;
        __DSB();
    }

    uint32_t nowUs = timer_get(TC_TIME2_CH0);
    if (!frameTimestampPrimed)
    {
        *sampleDtS = 0.0f;
        frameTimestampPrimed = 1u;
    }
    else
    {
        uint32_t elapsedUs = (nowUs >= lastFrameTimestampUs)
                                 ? (nowUs - lastFrameTimestampUs)
                                 : ((IMAGE_TIMER_WRAP_US - lastFrameTimestampUs) + nowUs);
        *sampleDtS = (float) elapsedUs * 0.000001f;
    }
    lastFrameTimestampUs = nowUs;
    return 1u;
}

void imageApplyContourTuning(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax, float huLost, uint8_t brightnessMax)
{
    contourHuLost = huLost;
    /* 未标定时尺寸范围跟随菜单；已标定时保持标定收紧值（菜单不再覆盖尺寸） */
    if (!legacyCalibrated)
    {
        legacyActiveSizeMin = sizeMin;
        legacyActiveSizeMax = sizeMax;
    }
    contourDetectSetSizeRange(legacyActiveSizeMin, legacyActiveSizeMax);
    /* 始终用当前生效模板（默认或标定后），不回退硬编码默认 */
    contourDetectSetTemplate(legacyActiveHu, huLost);
    contourDetectSetBrightnessMax(brightnessMax);
}

void imageApplyBinaryCcTuning(const imageBinaryCcTuningStruct* config)
{
    BINARYCC_CONFIG_STRUCT next;
    if (config == 0) return;
    next.thresholdLow = config->thresholdLow;
    next.thresholdHigh = config->thresholdHigh;
    next.areaMin = config->areaMin;
    next.areaMax = config->areaMax;
    next.brightnessMin = config->brightnessMin;
    next.eccMax = config->eccMax;
    next.fillMin = config->fillMin;
    next.huMax = config->huMax;
    next.orientationBrightMin = config->orientationBrightMin;
    next.orientationBorderMargin = config->orientationBorderMargin;
    next.orientationConfidenceMin = config->orientationConfidenceMin;
    next.orientationHoldFrames = config->orientationHoldFrames;
    next.referenceCenterX = config->referenceCenterX;
    next.referenceCenterY = config->referenceCenterY;
    binaryCcActiveConfig = next;
    if (!binaryCcCalibrated)
    {
        binaryCcActiveSizeMin = config->areaMin;
        binaryCcActiveSizeMax = config->areaMax;
    }
    imageApplyBinaryTemplate();
}

void imageApplyCannyThresholds(uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    cannySetThreshold(thresholdLow, thresholdHigh);
}

void imageGetOrientationProtectDefaults(imageOrientationProtectTuningStruct* out)
{
    if (out == 0) return;
    out->jumpMax = OM_ORIENTATION_JUMP_MAX;
    out->recoverRad = OM_ORIENTATION_RECOVER_RAD;
    out->confirmFrames = OM_ORIENTATION_CONFIRM_FRAMES;
}

void imageApplyOrientationProtect(const imageOrientationProtectTuningStruct* config)
{
    if (config == 0) return;
    contourDetectSetOrientProtect(config->jumpMax, config->recoverRad, config->confirmFrames);
}

void imageSetDetectMode(uint8_t mode)
{
    imageDetectMode = imageNormalizeDetectMode(mode);
    if (imageDetectMode == VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY)
        imageApplyLegacyTemplate();
    else
        imageApplyBinaryTemplate();
}

uint8_t imageGetDetectMode(void)
{
    return imageDetectMode;
}

/* 标定/flash 恢复：写入实测 Hu 模板 + 收紧尺寸范围，并即时下发生效 */
void imageSetActiveTemplateForMode(uint8_t mode, const float hu[7], uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax)
{
    if (0 == hu) return;
    /* 入口钳位：防未来 blob 字段变更/手工刷写传入非法范围(min>=max 或 0)，
     * 与菜单侧 applyVisionLocal 同口径(min∈[1,59999], max∈[min+1,60000])。 */
    imageClampTemplateRange(&sizeMin, &sizeMax);
    if (imageNormalizeDetectMode(mode) == VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY)
    {
        for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++) legacyActiveHu[i] = hu[i];
        legacyActiveSizeMin = sizeMin;
        legacyActiveSizeMax = sizeMax;
        legacyCalibrated = 1u;
        if (imageDetectMode == VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY) imageApplyLegacyTemplate();
    }
    else
    {
        for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++) binaryCcActiveHu[i] = hu[i];
        binaryCcActiveSizeMin = sizeMin;
        binaryCcActiveSizeMax = sizeMax;
        binaryCcCalibrated = 1u;
        if (imageDetectMode == VISION_DETECT_MODE_BINARYCC) imageApplyBinaryTemplate();
    }
}

/* 供 flash 持久化读取当前模板（返回 1=已标定值，0=出厂默认） */
uint8_t imageGetActiveTemplateForMode(uint8_t mode, float huOut[7], uint16_t* sizeMinOut, uint16_t* sizeMaxOut)
{
    uint8_t legacy = (imageNormalizeDetectMode(mode) == VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY) ? 1u : 0u;
    if (huOut != 0)
    {
        for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++) huOut[i] = legacy ? legacyActiveHu[i] : binaryCcActiveHu[i];
    }
    if (sizeMinOut != 0) *sizeMinOut = legacy ? legacyActiveSizeMin : binaryCcActiveSizeMin;
    if (sizeMaxOut != 0) *sizeMaxOut = legacy ? legacyActiveSizeMax : binaryCcActiveSizeMax;
    return legacy ? legacyCalibrated : binaryCcCalibrated;
}

/* 清空恢复出厂默认：丢弃两套 RAM 标定模板，回退默认模板 + 默认尺寸范围，并即时下发生效。 */
void imageResetActiveTemplate(void)
{
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++)
    {
        legacyActiveHu[i] = legacyDefaultHu[i];
        binaryCcActiveHu[i] = binaryCcDefaultHu[i];
    }
    legacyActiveSizeMin = VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MIN_DEFAULT;
    legacyActiveSizeMax = VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MAX_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcActiveSizeMin = VISION_BINARYCC_AREA_MIN_DEFAULT;
    binaryCcActiveSizeMax = VISION_BINARYCC_AREA_MAX_DEFAULT;
    legacyCalibrated = 0u;
    binaryCcCalibrated = 0u;
    calibrationSavePending = 0u;
    imageApplyLegacyTemplate();
    imageApplyBinaryTemplate();
}

/* ---- 稳定性检测参数 ---- */
#define STABLE_WINDOW     15u   /* 连续稳定帧数 */
#define STABLE_POS_THRESH 3u    /* 坐标极差阈值（像素） */
#define STABLE_ANG_THRESH 0.15f /* 朝向角极差阈值（弧度 ≈ 8.6°） */

/* 环形缓冲区 */
static uint16_t stabBufX[STABLE_WINDOW];
static uint16_t stabBufY[STABLE_WINDOW];
static float stabBufAng[STABLE_WINDOW];
static uint8_t stabBufIdx = 0u;
static uint8_t stabBufFull = 0u;

/* 圆周角差（处理 -PI/PI 回绕） */
static inline float angleDiff(float a, float b)
{
    float d = a - b;
    if (d > PI) d -= 2.0f * PI;
    else if (d < -PI) d += 2.0f * PI;
    return fabsf(d);
}

/* 检查环形缓冲区内数据是否稳定 */
static uint8_t checkStability(void)
{
    uint16_t xMin = stabBufX[0], xMax = stabBufX[0];
    uint16_t yMin = stabBufY[0], yMax = stabBufY[0];
    for (uint8_t i = 1u; i < STABLE_WINDOW; i++)
    {
        if (stabBufX[i] < xMin) xMin = stabBufX[i];
        if (stabBufX[i] > xMax) xMax = stabBufX[i];
        if (stabBufY[i] < yMin) yMin = stabBufY[i];
        if (stabBufY[i] > yMax) yMax = stabBufY[i];
    }
    if ((xMax - xMin) > STABLE_POS_THRESH) return 0u;
    if ((yMax - yMin) > STABLE_POS_THRESH) return 0u;
    /* 角度用圆周角差：以第一个样本为参考，检查最大偏差 */
    float refAng = stabBufAng[0];
    for (uint8_t i = 1u; i < STABLE_WINDOW; i++)
    {
        if (angleDiff(stabBufAng[i], refAng) > STABLE_ANG_THRESH) return 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t imageInit(void)
{
    uint8_t initState = mt9v03x_init();

    /* mt9v03x_init() 返回 0 表示成功，非零表示失败 */
    if (initState) return 0u;

    timer_init(TC_TIME2_CH0, TIMER_US);
    timer_start(TC_TIME2_CH0);
    lastFrameTimestampUs = 0u;
    frameTimestampPrimed = 0u;

    cannyInit(&mt9v03xOriImg, 0.75f, 0u, 0u, mt9v03xOriImg.xLen - 1u, mt9v03xOriImg.yLen - 1u,
        VISION_CANNY_LOW_DEFAULT, VISION_CANNY_HIGH_DEFAULT);

    /* ^ 轮廓检测：先 init 固定项（质心特征/ROI/视觉中心），再用默认调参喂可调项。
     * sizeMin/sizeMax/huLost/brightnessMax 走 imageApplyContourTuning，
     * 与菜单热重载共用同一入口，保证默认值与运行时调参一致。 */
    contourDetectInit(
        VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MIN_DEFAULT, VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MAX_DEFAULT, 255u,
        mt9v03xOriImg.xLen / 2u, mt9v03xOriImg.yLen / 2u,
        0u, 0u, VISION_CONTOUR_BRIGHTNESS_MAX_DEF);
    imageApplyContourTuning(
        VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MIN_DEFAULT, VISION_CONTOUR_SIZE_MAX_DEFAULT,
        VISION_CONTOUR_HU_LOST_DEFAULT, VISION_CONTOUR_BRIGHTNESS_MAX_DEF);
    binaryCcInit(&binaryCcActiveConfig);
    imageApplyBinaryTemplate();
    imageSetDetectMode(VISION_DETECT_MODE_DEFAULT);

    return 1u;
}

uint8_t imageGetFrameView(imageFrameKindEnum kind, imageFrameViewStruct* out)
{
    const u8Image* selected;
    if (out == 0) return 0u;
    out->frameSeq = imageFrameSeq;
    switch (kind)
    {
        case IMAGE_FRAME_ORIGINAL:
            selected = &mt9v03xOriImg;
            break;
        case IMAGE_FRAME_DETECT_PREVIEW:
        case IMAGE_FRAME_CANNY:
            selected = &cannyEdgeImg;
            break;
        default:
            out->pixels = 0;
            out->width = 0u;
            out->height = 0u;
            return 0u;
    }
    out->pixels = selected->ptr;
    out->width = selected->xLen;
    out->height = selected->yLen;
    return (out->pixels != 0) ? 1u : 0u;
}

void imageGetObservationSnapshot(imageObservationSnapshotStruct* out)
{
    uint8_t selectedIndex;
    if (out == 0) return;

    selectedIndex = chevronDetector.selectedIndex;
    out->frameSeq = imageFrameSeq;
    out->trackingState = chevronDetector.trackingState;
    out->contourCount = chevronDetector.contourCount;
    out->selectedIndex = selectedIndex;
    out->targetLost = chevronDetector.targetLost;
    out->valid = (chevronDetector.trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOCKED &&
        chevronDetector.contourCount > 0u && selectedIndex < chevronDetector.contourCount &&
        !chevronDetector.targetLost) ? 1u : 0u;
    out->orientBaselineValid = chevronDetector.orientBaselineValid;
    out->orientProtectState = chevronDetector.orientProtectState;
    out->orientationFresh = (uint8_t) (
        (chevronDetector.orientBaselineValid != 0u) &&
        (chevronDetector.orientRejectFrameCount == 0u));
    if ((chevronDetector.contourCount > 0u) &&
        (selectedIndex < chevronDetector.contourCount))
    {
        out->selectedCenterX = chevronDetector.contourData[selectedIndex].centerX;
        out->selectedCenterY = chevronDetector.contourData[selectedIndex].centerY;
        out->selectedSize = chevronDetector.contourData[selectedIndex].contourSize;
        out->selectedHuDistance = chevronDetector.contourData[selectedIndex].huDistance;
    }
    else
    {
        out->selectedCenterX = 0u;
        out->selectedCenterY = 0u;
        out->selectedSize = 0u;
        out->selectedHuDistance = 0.0f;
    }
    out->lostFrameCount = chevronDetector.lostFrameCount;
    out->lockFrameCount = chevronDetector.lockFrameCount;
    out->orientSpikeFrameCount = chevronDetector.orientSpikeFrameCount;
    out->filteredCenterX = chevronDetector.centerXFilter.filteredValue;
    out->filteredCenterY = chevronDetector.centerYFilter.filteredValue;
    out->velocityX = chevronDetector.velocityXFilter.filteredValue;
    out->velocityY = chevronDetector.velocityYFilter.filteredValue;
    out->orientation = chevronDetector.orientation;
    out->orientationConfidence = chevronDetector.orientationConfidence;
}

uint8_t imageProcess(void)
{
    float sampleDtS;
    if (!imageTakeFrameSnapshot(&sampleDtS)) return 0u;
    imageFrameSeq++;

    if (imageDetectMode == VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY)
    {
        cannyEdgeDetection(&mt9v03xOriImg, &gaussianBlurImg, &cannyEdgeImg);
        contourDetect(&cannyEdgeImg, &mt9v03xOriImg, sampleDtS, &chevronDetector);
    }
    else
    {
        binaryCcDetect(&mt9v03xOriImg, &cannyEdgeImg, sampleDtS, &chevronDetector);
    }

    /* 标定状态机：等待稳定后提取实测 Hu 矩 */
    if (chevronCalibState == CALIB_DETECTING)
    {
        if (chevronDetector.contourCount > 0 && !chevronDetector.targetLost)
        {
            uint8_t si = chevronDetector.selectedIndex;
            stabBufX[stabBufIdx] = chevronDetector.contourData[si].centerX;
            stabBufY[stabBufIdx] = chevronDetector.contourData[si].centerY;
            stabBufAng[stabBufIdx] = chevronDetector.orientation;
            stabBufIdx++;
            if (stabBufIdx >= STABLE_WINDOW)
            {
                stabBufIdx = 0u;
                stabBufFull = 1u;
            }

            if (stabBufFull && checkStability())
            {
                float calibHu[7];
                uint8_t extracted = (imageDetectMode == VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY)
                                        ? contourExtractHuMoments(&chevronDetector, si, calibHu)
                                        : binaryCcExtractHuMoments(&chevronDetector, si, calibHu);
                if (extracted)
                {
                    /* 记录像素数并收紧尺寸范围 (允许 50%~200%) */
                    chevronCalibSize = chevronDetector.contourData[si].contourSize;
                    uint16_t sMin = (chevronCalibSize > 4u) ? (chevronCalibSize / 2u) : 2u;
                    uint16_t sMax = chevronCalibSize * 2u;
                    /* 写入生效模板：标定 Hu + 收紧尺寸，后续菜单热重载不再覆盖。
                     * HuLost 沿用当前菜单设定，供 flash 持久化读取。 */
                    imageSetActiveTemplateForMode(imageDetectMode, calibHu, sMin, sMax);

                    chevronCalibState = CALIB_DONE;
                    calibrationSavePending = 1u;
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* 目标丢失时重置稳定缓冲区 */
            stabBufIdx = 0u;
            stabBufFull = 0u;
        }
    }

    return 1u;
}

void imageCalibTrigger(void)
{
    stabBufIdx = 0u;
    stabBufFull = 0u;
    calibrationSavePending = 0u;
    chevronCalibState = CALIB_DETECTING;
}

uint8_t imageTakeCalibrationSaveRequest(void)
{
    uint8_t pending = calibrationSavePending;
    calibrationSavePending = 0u;
    return pending;
}

/*
 * om_binarycc.c - BinaryCC ^ 灯板检测
 *
 * 双阈值二值化 + 八连通候选 + 矩/Hu/朝向筛选，输出兼容 CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT。
 */

#include "om_binarycc.h"

#include "om_internal.h"
#include "om_tracking_internal.h"

#define BINARYCC_HU_TIE_THRESHOLD (1.0f)
#define BINARYCC_BRIGHT_MIN_COUNT (12u)

typedef struct
{
    uint16_t area;
    uint16_t bboxMinX;
    uint16_t bboxMinY;
    uint16_t bboxMaxX;
    uint16_t bboxMaxY;
    float centroidX;
    float centroidY;
    float meanBrightness;
    float m20;
    float m02;
    float m11;
    float m30;
    float m03;
    float m21;
    float m12;
    float hu[7];
    float huDistance;
    float ecc;
    float fillRatio;
    float orientation;
    float orientationConfidence;
    uint8_t orientationEdgeClipped;
} BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT;

static BINARYCC_CONFIG_STRUCT binaryCcConfig;
static uint8_t binaryCcTemplateReady = 0u;
static float binaryCcHuTemplate[7];
static BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT binaryCcCandidates[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];
static uint8_t binaryCcCandidateCount = 0u;

static void binaryCcComputeHu(float area, float mu20, float mu02, float mu11, float mu30, float mu03, float mu21, float mu12, float hu[7]);
static float binaryCcHuDistance(const float hu[7], const float templ[7]);
static void binaryCcThreshold(const u8Image* graySrc, u8Image* maskDst);
static uint8_t binaryCcVisited(uint32_t index);
static void binaryCcMarkVisited(uint32_t index);
static uint8_t binaryCcScanComponent(const u8Image* graySrc, const u8Image* maskDst, uint32_t startIndex, BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* out);
static void binaryCcFinishCandidate(const u8Image* graySrc, uint32_t queueCount, BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* c,
    float originX, float originY,
    float sumX, float sumY, float sumX2, float sumY2, float sumXY, float sumX3, float sumY3,
    float sumX2Y, float sumXY2, float sumGray);
static float binaryCcComputeOrientation(const u8Image* graySrc, uint32_t queueCount, float cx, float cy,
    float covXX, float covYY, float covXY, float* outConfidence);
static uint8_t binaryCcComputeBrightCoreOrientation(const u8Image* graySrc, uint32_t queueCount, float* outOrientation, float* outConfidence);
static float binaryCcSideSpreadScore(const u8Image* graySrc, uint32_t queueCount, float cx, float cy,
    float axisC, float axisS, float sign, float extent, uint8_t brightMin);
static uint8_t binaryCcTouchesOrientationBorder(const u8Image* graySrc, const BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* c);
static uint32_t binaryCcReferenceDistSq(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t idx);
static void binaryCcUpdateTracking(CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t detected, float sampleDtS);
static void binaryCcHandleLost(CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj);


void binaryCcInit(const BINARYCC_CONFIG_STRUCT* config)
{
    memset(&binaryCcConfig, 0, sizeof(binaryCcConfig));
    binaryCcCandidateCount = 0u;
    binaryCcTemplateReady = 0u;
    if (config != 0) binaryCcConfig = *config;
}

void binaryCcSetConfig(const BINARYCC_CONFIG_STRUCT* config)
{
    if (config != 0) binaryCcConfig = *config;
}

void binaryCcSetTemplate(const float hu[7], float huMax)
{
    if (hu == 0)
    {
        binaryCcTemplateReady = 0u;
        return;
    }
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++) binaryCcHuTemplate[i] = hu[i];
    binaryCcConfig.huMax = huMax;
    binaryCcTemplateReady = 1u;
}

uint16_t binaryCcDetect(const u8Image* graySrc, u8Image* maskDst, float sampleDtS, CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj)
{
    if (obj == 0 || graySrc == 0 || maskDst == 0 || graySrc->ptr == 0 || maskDst->ptr == 0 ||
        graySrc->size > OM_BUFFER_SIZE || maskDst->size < graySrc->size)
    {
        if (obj != 0) binaryCcHandleLost(obj);
        return 0u;
    }

    binaryCcThreshold(graySrc, maskDst);
    binaryCcCandidateCount = 0u;
    obj->selectedIndex = 0u;
    obj->contourCount = 0u;
    obj->targetLost = 1u;

    contourGeneration++;
    if (contourGeneration == 0u)
    {
        memset(inContourMap, 0, graySrc->size * sizeof(inContourMap[0]));
        contourGeneration = 1u;
    }

    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < graySrc->size; i++)
    {
        BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT c;
        if (maskDst->ptr[i] != WHITE || binaryCcVisited(i)) continue;
        memset(&c, 0, sizeof(c));
        if (!binaryCcScanComponent(graySrc, maskDst, i, &c))
        {
            continue;
        }

        if (c.area < binaryCcConfig.areaMin)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (binaryCcConfig.areaMax > 0u && c.area > binaryCcConfig.areaMax)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (binaryCcConfig.brightnessMin > 0u && c.meanBrightness < (float) binaryCcConfig.brightnessMin)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (binaryCcConfig.eccMax > 0.0f && c.ecc > binaryCcConfig.eccMax)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (binaryCcConfig.fillMin > 0.0f && c.fillRatio < binaryCcConfig.fillMin)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (binaryCcTemplateReady && binaryCcConfig.huMax > 0.0f && c.huDistance > binaryCcConfig.huMax)
        {
            continue;
        }

        if (binaryCcCandidateCount < OM_MAX_OBJECTS)
        {
            uint8_t dst = binaryCcCandidateCount;
            binaryCcCandidates[dst] = c;
            obj->contourData[dst].centerX = (uint16_t) (c.centroidX + 0.5f);
            obj->contourData[dst].centerY = (uint16_t) (c.centroidY + 0.5f);
            obj->contourData[dst].contourSize = c.area;
            obj->contourData[dst].huDistance = c.huDistance;
            binaryCcCandidateCount++;
        }
        else
        {
            continue;
        }
    }

    obj->contourCount = binaryCcCandidateCount;
    for (uint8_t i = binaryCcCandidateCount; i < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; i++) obj->contourData[i].contourSize = 0u;

    if (binaryCcCandidateCount == 0u)
    {
        binaryCcHandleLost(obj);
        return 0u;
    }

    if (binaryCcTemplateReady)
    {
        float huMin = binaryCcCandidates[0u].huDistance;
        for (uint8_t i = 1u; i < binaryCcCandidateCount; i++)
            if (binaryCcCandidates[i].huDistance < huMin) huMin = binaryCcCandidates[i].huDistance;

        uint32_t bestDist = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < binaryCcCandidateCount; i++)
        {
            if ((binaryCcCandidates[i].huDistance - huMin) < BINARYCC_HU_TIE_THRESHOLD)
            {
                uint32_t d = binaryCcReferenceDistSq(obj, i);
                if (d < bestDist)
                {
                    bestDist = d;
                    obj->selectedIndex = i;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        uint32_t bestDist = binaryCcReferenceDistSq(obj, 0u);
        obj->selectedIndex = 0u;
        for (uint8_t i = 1u; i < binaryCcCandidateCount; i++)
        {
            uint32_t d = binaryCcReferenceDistSq(obj, i);
            if (d < bestDist)
            {
                bestDist = d;
                obj->selectedIndex = i;
            }
        }
    }

    obj->targetLost = 0u;
    binaryCcUpdateTracking(obj, 1u, sampleDtS);
    return binaryCcCandidateCount;
}

uint8_t binaryCcExtractHuMoments(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t contourIndex, float huOut[7])
{
    if (obj == 0 || huOut == 0) return 0u;
    if (contourIndex >= obj->contourCount || contourIndex >= binaryCcCandidateCount) return 0u;
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++) huOut[i] = binaryCcCandidates[contourIndex].hu[i];
    return 1u;
}

static void binaryCcThreshold(const u8Image* graySrc, u8Image* maskDst)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < graySrc->size; i++)
    {
        uint8_t v = graySrc->ptr[i];
        maskDst->ptr[i] = (v >= binaryCcConfig.thresholdLow && v <= binaryCcConfig.thresholdHigh) ? WHITE : BLACK;
    }
}

static uint8_t binaryCcVisited(uint32_t index)
{
    return ((inContourMap[index] >> 16) == contourGeneration) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static void binaryCcMarkVisited(uint32_t index)
{
    inContourMap[index] = ((uint32_t) contourGeneration << 16) | 1u;
}

static uint8_t binaryCcScanComponent(const u8Image* graySrc, const u8Image* maskDst, uint32_t startIndex, BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* out)
{
    uint32_t head = 0u;
    uint32_t tail = 0u;
    float sumX = 0.0f, sumY = 0.0f, sumX2 = 0.0f, sumY2 = 0.0f, sumXY = 0.0f;
    float sumX3 = 0.0f, sumY3 = 0.0f, sumX2Y = 0.0f, sumXY2 = 0.0f, sumGray = 0.0f;
    // 以种子像素为原点累加相对坐标: 中心矩平移不变, 但幅值大幅减小, 避免 float 高阶矩灾难性抵消
    uint32_t originX = startIndex % graySrc->xLen;
    uint32_t originY = startIndex / graySrc->xLen;

    out->bboxMinX = graySrc->xLen;
    out->bboxMinY = graySrc->yLen;
    if (tail >= OM_BUFFER_SIZE) return 0u;
    contourQueue[tail++] = startIndex;
    binaryCcMarkVisited(startIndex);

    while (head < tail)
    {
        uint32_t cur = contourQueue[head++];
        uint32_t x = cur % graySrc->xLen;
        uint32_t y = cur / graySrc->xLen;
        float xf = (float) ((int32_t) x - (int32_t) originX);
        float yf = (float) ((int32_t) y - (int32_t) originY);
        float gray = (float) graySrc->ptr[cur];

        out->area++;
        if (x < out->bboxMinX) out->bboxMinX = (uint16_t) x;
        if (y < out->bboxMinY) out->bboxMinY = (uint16_t) y;
        if (x > out->bboxMaxX) out->bboxMaxX = (uint16_t) x;
        if (y > out->bboxMaxY) out->bboxMaxY = (uint16_t) y;

        sumX += xf;
        sumY += yf;
        sumX2 += xf * xf;
        sumY2 += yf * yf;
        sumXY += xf * yf;
        sumX3 += xf * xf * xf;
        sumY3 += yf * yf * yf;
        sumX2Y += xf * xf * yf;
        sumXY2 += xf * yf * yf;
        sumGray += gray;

        for (uint8_t ni = 0u; ni < 8u; ni++)
        {
            int32_t nx = (int32_t) x + contourDx[ni];
            int32_t ny = (int32_t) y + contourDy[ni];
            uint32_t next;
            if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || (uint32_t) nx >= graySrc->xLen || (uint32_t) ny >= graySrc->yLen) continue;
            next = (uint32_t) ny * graySrc->xLen + (uint32_t) nx;
            if (maskDst->ptr[next] == WHITE && !binaryCcVisited(next))
            {
                if (tail >= OM_BUFFER_SIZE) return 0u;
                binaryCcMarkVisited(next);
                contourQueue[tail++] = next;
            }
        }
    }

    if (out->area == 0u) return 0u;
    binaryCcFinishCandidate(graySrc, tail, out, (float) originX, (float) originY,
        sumX, sumY, sumX2, sumY2, sumXY, sumX3, sumY3, sumX2Y, sumXY2, sumGray);
    return 1u;
}

static void binaryCcFinishCandidate(const u8Image* graySrc, uint32_t queueCount, BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* c,
    float originX, float originY,
    float sumX, float sumY, float sumX2, float sumY2, float sumXY, float sumX3, float sumY3,
    float sumX2Y, float sumXY2, float sumGray)
{
    float area = (float) c->area;
    // cx/cy 为相对 seed 原点的质心, 供中心矩使用(平移不变); 绝对质心 = 原点 + 相对质心
    float cx = sumX / area;
    float cy = sumY / area;
    float centroidXAbs = originX + cx;
    float centroidYAbs = originY + cy;
    float mu20 = sumX2 - cx * sumX;
    float mu02 = sumY2 - cy * sumY;
    float mu11 = sumXY - cx * sumY;
    float mu30 = sumX3 - 3.0f * cx * sumX2 + 3.0f * cx * cx * sumX - cx * cx * cx * area;
    float mu03 = sumY3 - 3.0f * cy * sumY2 + 3.0f * cy * cy * sumY - cy * cy * cy * area;
    float mu21 = sumX2Y - cy * sumX2 - 2.0f * cx * sumXY + 2.0f * cx * cy * sumX + cx * cx * sumY - cx * cx * cy * area;
    float mu12 = sumXY2 - cx * sumY2 - 2.0f * cy * sumXY + 2.0f * cx * cy * sumY + cy * cy * sumX - cx * cy * cy * area;
    float covXX = mu20 / area;
    float covYY = mu02 / area;
    float covXY = mu11 / area;
    float trace = covXX + covYY;
    float delta = sqrtf((covXX - covYY) * (covXX - covYY) + 4.0f * covXY * covXY);
    float lambdaA = (trace + delta) * 0.5f;
    float lambdaB = (trace - delta) * 0.5f;
    float bboxArea = (float) ((c->bboxMaxX - c->bboxMinX + 1u) * (c->bboxMaxY - c->bboxMinY + 1u));

    if (lambdaA < lambdaB)
    {
        float t = lambdaA;
        lambdaA = lambdaB;
        lambdaB = t;
    }

    c->centroidX = centroidXAbs;
    c->centroidY = centroidYAbs;
    c->meanBrightness = sumGray / area;
    c->m20 = mu20;
    c->m02 = mu02;
    c->m11 = mu11;
    c->m30 = mu30;
    c->m03 = mu03;
    c->m21 = mu21;
    c->m12 = mu12;
    c->ecc = (lambdaB > 1.0e-6f) ? sqrtf(lambdaA / lambdaB) : 9999.0f;
    c->fillRatio = (bboxArea > 0.0f) ? (area / bboxArea) : 0.0f;
    binaryCcComputeHu(area, mu20, mu02, mu11, mu30, mu03, mu21, mu12, c->hu);
    c->huDistance = binaryCcTemplateReady ? binaryCcHuDistance(c->hu, binaryCcHuTemplate) : -1.0f;
    c->orientation = binaryCcComputeOrientation(graySrc, queueCount, centroidXAbs, centroidYAbs, covXX, covYY, covXY, &c->orientationConfidence);
    c->orientationEdgeClipped = binaryCcTouchesOrientationBorder(graySrc, c);
    if (c->orientationEdgeClipped) c->orientationConfidence = 0.0f;
}

static void binaryCcComputeHu(float area, float mu20, float mu02, float mu11, float mu30, float mu03, float mu21, float mu12, float hu[7])
{
    float invArea2 = 1.0f / (area * area);
    float invArea25 = invArea2 / sqrtf(area);
    float eta20 = mu20 * invArea2;
    float eta02 = mu02 * invArea2;
    float eta11 = mu11 * invArea2;
    float eta30 = mu30 * invArea25;
    float eta03 = mu03 * invArea25;
    float eta21 = mu21 * invArea25;
    float eta12 = mu12 * invArea25;
    float a = eta30 + eta12;
    float b = eta21 + eta03;
    float c = eta30 - 3.0f * eta12;
    float d = 3.0f * eta21 - eta03;

    hu[0] = eta20 + eta02;
    hu[1] = (eta20 - eta02) * (eta20 - eta02) + 4.0f * eta11 * eta11;
    hu[2] = c * c + d * d;
    hu[3] = a * a + b * b;
    hu[4] = c * a * (a * a - 3.0f * b * b) + d * b * (3.0f * a * a - b * b);
    hu[5] = (eta20 - eta02) * (a * a - b * b) + 4.0f * eta11 * a * b;
    hu[6] = d * a * (a * a - 3.0f * b * b) - c * b * (3.0f * a * a - b * b);
}

static float binaryCcHuDistance(const float hu[7], const float templ[7])
{
    static const float weights[7] = {2.0f, 2.0f, 1.5f, 1.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.02f};
    float distance = 0.0f;
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++)
    {
        float a = fabsf(hu[i]);
        float b = fabsf(templ[i]);
        if (a < 1.0e-12f) a = 1.0e-12f;
        if (b < 1.0e-12f) b = 1.0e-12f;
        distance += weights[i] * fabsf(logf(a) - logf(b));
    }
    return distance;
}

static float binaryCcComputeOrientation(const u8Image* graySrc, uint32_t queueCount, float cx, float cy,
    float covXX, float covYY, float covXY, float* outConfidence)
{
    float axis = wrapToPi(0.5f * atan2f(2.0f * covXY, covXX - covYY) + HALF_PI);
    if (binaryCcConfig.orientationBrightMin > 0u)
    {
        float brightOrient;
        if (binaryCcComputeBrightCoreOrientation(graySrc, queueCount, &brightOrient, outConfidence)) return brightOrient;
        *outConfidence = 0.0f;
        return axis;
    }

    float axisC = cosf(axis);
    float axisS = sinf(axis);
    float posExtent = 0.0f;
    float negExtent = 0.0f;
    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < queueCount; i++)
    {
        uint32_t index = contourQueue[i];
        float dx = (float) (index % graySrc->xLen) - cx;
        float dy = (float) (index / graySrc->xLen) - cy;
        float t = dx * axisC + dy * axisS;
        if (t > posExtent) posExtent = t;
        if (-t > negExtent) negExtent = -t;
    }
    if (posExtent <= 1.0f || negExtent <= 1.0f)
    {
        *outConfidence = 0.0f;
        return axis;
    }
    *outConfidence = 1.0f;
    return axis;
}

static uint8_t binaryCcComputeBrightCoreOrientation(const u8Image* graySrc, uint32_t queueCount, float* outOrientation, float* outConfidence)
{
    float count = 0.0f, sumX = 0.0f, sumY = 0.0f, sumX2 = 0.0f, sumY2 = 0.0f, sumXY = 0.0f;
    float cx, cy, covXX, covYY, covXY, axis, axisC, axisS, posExtent = 0.0f, negExtent = 0.0f;
    float posScore, negScore, denom;

    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < queueCount; i++)
    {
        uint32_t index = contourQueue[i];
        if (graySrc->ptr[index] < binaryCcConfig.orientationBrightMin) continue;
        float x = (float) (index % graySrc->xLen);
        float y = (float) (index / graySrc->xLen);
        count += 1.0f;
        sumX += x;
        sumY += y;
        sumX2 += x * x;
        sumY2 += y * y;
        sumXY += x * y;
    }
    if (count < (float) BINARYCC_BRIGHT_MIN_COUNT) return 0u;

    cx = sumX / count;
    cy = sumY / count;
    covXX = sumX2 / count - cx * cx;
    covYY = sumY2 / count - cy * cy;
    covXY = sumXY / count - cx * cy;
    axis = wrapToPi(0.5f * atan2f(2.0f * covXY, covXX - covYY) + HALF_PI);
    axisC = cosf(axis);
    axisS = sinf(axis);

    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < queueCount; i++)
    {
        uint32_t index = contourQueue[i];
        if (graySrc->ptr[index] < binaryCcConfig.orientationBrightMin) continue;
        float dx = (float) (index % graySrc->xLen) - cx;
        float dy = (float) (index / graySrc->xLen) - cy;
        float t = dx * axisC + dy * axisS;
        if (t > posExtent) posExtent = t;
        if (-t > negExtent) negExtent = -t;
    }
    if (posExtent <= 1.0f || negExtent <= 1.0f) return 0u;

    posScore = binaryCcSideSpreadScore(graySrc, queueCount, cx, cy, axisC, axisS, 1.0f, posExtent, binaryCcConfig.orientationBrightMin);
    negScore = binaryCcSideSpreadScore(graySrc, queueCount, cx, cy, axisC, axisS, -1.0f, negExtent, binaryCcConfig.orientationBrightMin);
    if (posScore >= 1.0e8f || negScore >= 1.0e8f) return 0u;
    *outOrientation = (posScore <= negScore) ? axis : wrapToPi(axis + PI);
    denom = fabsf(posScore) + fabsf(negScore) + 1.0e-6f;
    *outConfidence = fabsf(posScore - negScore) / denom;
    if (*outConfidence > 1.0f) *outConfidence = 1.0f;
    return 1u;
}

static float binaryCcSideSpreadScore(const u8Image* graySrc, uint32_t queueCount, float cx, float cy,
    float axisC, float axisS, float sign, float extent, uint8_t brightMin)
{
    float farStart = 0.45f * extent;
    float farEnd = 0.98f * extent;
    float absSum = 0.0f, squareSum = 0.0f, absMax = 0.0f, sampleCount = 0.0f;
    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < queueCount; i++)
    {
        uint32_t index = contourQueue[i];
        if (graySrc->ptr[index] < brightMin) continue;
        float dx = (float) (index % graySrc->xLen) - cx;
        float dy = (float) (index / graySrc->xLen) - cy;
        float t = dx * axisC + dy * axisS;
        float p = -dx * axisS + dy * axisC;
        float signedT = sign * t;
        if (signedT < farStart || signedT > farEnd) continue;
        float absP = fabsf(p);
        absSum += absP;
        squareSum += p * p;
        if (absP > absMax) absMax = absP;
        sampleCount += 1.0f;
    }
    if (sampleCount < 3.0f) return 1.0e9f;
    return (absSum / sampleCount) + 0.35f * sqrtf(squareSum / sampleCount) + 0.10f * absMax;
}

static uint8_t binaryCcTouchesOrientationBorder(const u8Image* graySrc, const BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* c)
{
    uint8_t m = binaryCcConfig.orientationBorderMargin;
    if (m == 0u) return 0u;
    if (c->bboxMinX <= m || c->bboxMinY <= m) return 1u;
    if ((uint16_t) (c->bboxMaxX + m) >= (graySrc->xLen - 1u)) return 1u;
    if ((uint16_t) (c->bboxMaxY + m) >= (graySrc->yLen - 1u)) return 1u;
    return 0u;
}

static uint32_t binaryCcReferenceDistSq(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t idx)
{
    uint16_t refX = (obj->lastValidSize != 0u && obj->trackingState != OM_TRACK_SEARCHING)
                        ? obj->lastValidCenterX
                        : binaryCcConfig.referenceCenterX;
    uint16_t refY = (obj->lastValidSize != 0u && obj->trackingState != OM_TRACK_SEARCHING)
                        ? obj->lastValidCenterY
                        : binaryCcConfig.referenceCenterY;
    int32_t dx = (int32_t) obj->contourData[idx].centerX - (int32_t) refX;
    int32_t dy = (int32_t) obj->contourData[idx].centerY - (int32_t) refY;
    return (uint32_t) (dx * dx + dy * dy);
}

static void binaryCcUpdateTracking(CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t detected, float sampleDtS)
{
    if (!detected)
    {
        binaryCcHandleLost(obj);
        return;
    }

    uint8_t si = obj->selectedIndex;
    BINARYCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* c = &binaryCcCandidates[si];
    uint16_t selCx = obj->contourData[si].centerX;
    uint16_t selCy = obj->contourData[si].centerY;
    uint16_t selSize = obj->contourData[si].contourSize;
    uint8_t acceptOrient = (c->orientationConfidence >= binaryCcConfig.orientationConfidenceMin) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t holdFrames = (binaryCcConfig.orientationHoldFrames == 0u) ? 1u : binaryCcConfig.orientationHoldFrames;

    obj->orientationConfidence = c->orientationConfidence;
    obj->lostFrameCount = 0u;
    obj->lockFrameCount = (obj->lockFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->lockFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
    if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_SEARCHING && obj->lockFrameCount >= OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD) obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING;
    else if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING && obj->lockFrameCount >= (OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD + OM_LOCK_CONFIRM)) obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOCKED;
    else if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING) obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOCKED;

    if (acceptOrient && obj->orientBaselineValid)
    {
        float dOri = fabsf(wrapToPi(c->orientation - obj->lastValidOrientation));
        if (contourDetectOrientationJumpAllowed(dOri) == 0u) acceptOrient = 0u;
    }

    omTrackingUpdateVelocity(obj, (float) selCx, (float) selCy, sampleDtS);
    obj->lastValidCenterX = selCx;
    obj->lastValidCenterY = selCy;
    obj->lastValidSize = selSize;

    if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOCKED)
    {
        omTrackingLowPass(&obj->centerXFilter, (float) selCx, OM_POSITION_ALPHA);
        omTrackingLowPass(&obj->centerYFilter, (float) selCy, OM_POSITION_ALPHA);
    }
    else
    {
        lowPassFilterReset(&obj->centerXFilter, (float) selCx);
        lowPassFilterReset(&obj->centerYFilter, (float) selCy);
    }

    if (!acceptOrient)
    {
        obj->orientAcquireFrameCount = 0u;
        obj->orientRejectFrameCount = (obj->orientRejectFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->orientRejectFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
        if (obj->orientRejectFrameCount >= holdFrames) obj->orientBaselineValid = 0u;
        if (obj->orientBaselineValid) obj->orientation = obj->orientFilter.filteredValue;
        return;
    }

    obj->orientRejectFrameCount = 0u;
    if (!obj->orientBaselineValid)
    {
        obj->orientAcquireFrameCount = (obj->orientAcquireFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->orientAcquireFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
        lowPassFilterReset(&obj->orientFilter, c->orientation);
        if (obj->orientAcquireFrameCount >= holdFrames)
        {
            obj->orientBaselineValid = 1u;
            obj->orientAcquireFrameCount = 0u;
            obj->lastValidOrientation = c->orientation;
            obj->orientation = obj->orientFilter.filteredValue;
        }
        return;
    }

    obj->lastValidOrientation = c->orientation;
    if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOCKED)
    {
        omTrackingAngleLowPass(&obj->orientFilter, c->orientation, OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA);
    }
    else
    {
        lowPassFilterReset(&obj->orientFilter, c->orientation);
    }
    obj->orientation = obj->orientFilter.filteredValue;
}

static void binaryCcHandleLost(CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj)
{
    obj->targetLost = 1u;
    obj->lockFrameCount = 0u;
    obj->lostFrameCount = (obj->lostFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->lostFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
    obj->orientationConfidence = 0.0f;
    obj->orientRejectFrameCount = (obj->orientRejectFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->orientRejectFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
    if (obj->orientRejectFrameCount >= ((binaryCcConfig.orientationHoldFrames == 0u) ? 1u : binaryCcConfig.orientationHoldFrames))
        obj->orientBaselineValid = 0u;
    omTrackingResetVelocity(obj);
    if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOCKED && obj->lostFrameCount >= OM_LOST_THRESHOLD) obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING;
    else if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING && obj->lostFrameCount >= OM_LOST_TIMEOUT) obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
    else if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING) obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
    if (obj->orientBaselineValid) obj->orientation = obj->orientFilter.filteredValue;
}

#ifndef OM_BINARYCC_H
#define OM_BINARYCC_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "openMorph.h"

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t thresholdLow;
    uint8_t thresholdHigh;
    uint16_t areaMin;
    uint16_t areaMax;
    uint8_t brightnessMin;
    float eccMax;
    float fillMin;
    float huMax;
    uint8_t orientationBrightMin;
    uint8_t orientationBorderMargin;
    float orientationConfidenceMin;
    uint8_t orientationHoldFrames;
    uint16_t referenceCenterX;
    uint16_t referenceCenterY;
} BINARYCC_CONFIG_STRUCT;

void binaryCcInit(const BINARYCC_CONFIG_STRUCT* config);
void binaryCcSetConfig(const BINARYCC_CONFIG_STRUCT* config);
void binaryCcSetTemplate(const float hu[7], float huMax);
uint16_t binaryCcDetect(const u8Image* graySrc, u8Image* maskDst, float sampleDtS, CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj);
uint8_t binaryCcExtractHuMoments(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t contourIndex, float huOut[7]);
#endif /* OM_BINARYCC_H */

/*
 * om_canny.c - [4] 高斯模糊及Canny边缘检测
 *
 * 3x3定点高斯核 / 逐行流水线 Sobel+NMS+滞后门限 边缘检测
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- define ----

#define CANNY_RING_WIDTH (OM_CANNY_RING_WIDTH)

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t width;
    uint32_t height;
    uint32_t pixelCount;
    uint32_t cropStartX;
    uint32_t cropStartY;
    uint32_t cropEndX;
    uint32_t cropEndY;
    uint32_t blurStartX;
    uint32_t blurStartY;
    uint32_t blurEndX;
    uint32_t blurEndY;
} gaussConfigStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t width;
    uint32_t height;
    uint32_t pixelCount;
    uint32_t sobelStartX;
    uint32_t sobelStartY;
    uint32_t sobelEndX;
    uint32_t sobelEndY;
    uint32_t nmsStartX;
    uint32_t nmsStartY;
    uint32_t nmsEndX;
    uint32_t nmsEndY;
    uint16_t thresholdLow;
    uint16_t thresholdHigh;
    uint32_t thresholdLowSq;
    uint32_t thresholdHighSq;
    int32_t trackOffsets[8];
} cannyConfigStruct;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt0[256];
static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt1[256];
static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt2[256];
static gaussConfigStruct gaussConfig = {0u};
static cannyConfigStruct cannyConfig = {0u};
static uint32_t sobelMapRing[3][CANNY_RING_WIDTH] = {0};
static uint8_t sobelDirMapRing[3][CANNY_RING_WIDTH] = {0};
static uint16_t cannyEdgeQueue[UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE] = {0};

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void gaussianInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY)
{
    // gaussianKernelTemp[0] : 四个角点对应的核值
    // gaussianKernelTemp[1] : 四个边点对应的核值
    // gaussianKernelTemp[2] : 中心点对应的核值
    float gaussianKernelTemp[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};

    memset(&gaussConfig, 0, sizeof(gaussConfig));

    if ((NULL == src) || (NULL == src->ptr) || (0u == src->xLen) || (0u == src->yLen) ||
        (src->xLen > CANNY_RING_WIDTH) || ((src->xLen * src->yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE))
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    gaussConfig.width = src->xLen;
    gaussConfig.height = src->yLen;
    gaussConfig.pixelCount = src->xLen * src->yLen;

    if (startX > endX)
    {
        uint32_t temp = startX;
        startX = endX;
        endX = temp;
    }
    if (startY > endY)
    {
        uint32_t temp = startY;
        startY = endY;
        endY = temp;
    }

    gaussConfig.cropStartX = unsignRange(startX, gaussConfig.width - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropStartY = unsignRange(startY, gaussConfig.height - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropEndX = range(endX, gaussConfig.cropStartX, gaussConfig.width - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropEndY = range(endY, gaussConfig.cropStartY, gaussConfig.height - 1u);

    gaussConfig.blurStartX = 1u;
    gaussConfig.blurStartY = 1u;
    gaussConfig.blurEndX = 0u;
    gaussConfig.blurEndY = 0u;

    if ((gaussConfig.width >= 3u) && (gaussConfig.height >= 3u) &&
        ((gaussConfig.cropEndX - gaussConfig.cropStartX) >= 2u) &&
        ((gaussConfig.cropEndY - gaussConfig.cropStartY) >= 2u))
    {
        gaussConfig.blurStartX = (0u == gaussConfig.cropStartX) ? 1u : (gaussConfig.cropStartX + 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurStartY = (0u == gaussConfig.cropStartY) ? 1u : (gaussConfig.cropStartY + 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurEndX = (gaussConfig.cropEndX >= (gaussConfig.width - 1u)) ? (gaussConfig.width - 2u) : (gaussConfig.cropEndX - 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurEndY = (gaussConfig.cropEndY >= (gaussConfig.height - 1u)) ? (gaussConfig.height - 2u) : (gaussConfig.cropEndY - 1u);
    }

    if (sigma <= 0.0f)
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    float sigma2 = sigma * sigma;
    float coeff = 1.0f / (TWO_PI * sigma2);
    float sum = 0.0f;

    // 生成 3x3 高斯核，并提取 3 个唯一值（角点/边点/中心）
    for (uint8_t y = 0u; y < 3; y++)
    {
        for (uint8_t x = 0u; x < 3; x++)
        {
            int16_t dx = (int16_t) x - 1;
            int16_t dy = (int16_t) y - 1;
            float exponent = -((float) (dx * dx + dy * dy)) / (2.0f * sigma2);
            float value = (float) exp((double) exponent) * coeff;

            if (0 == dx && 0 == dy) gaussianKernelTemp[2] = value;
            else if (0 == dx || 0 == dy) gaussianKernelTemp[1] = value;
            else gaussianKernelTemp[0] = value;

            sum += value;
        }
    }

    if (sum <= 0.0f)
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    // 归一化 3 个唯一核值
    gaussianKernelTemp[0] /= sum;
    gaussianKernelTemp[1] /= sum;
    gaussianKernelTemp[2] /= sum;

    // 预计算核值与 8bit 灰度值相乘的 定点数 (放缩256倍)，消除内层浮点开销
    for (uint16_t gray = 0u; gray < 256; gray++)
    {
        gaussKernelPreValueInt0[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[0] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
        gaussKernelPreValueInt1[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[1] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
        gaussKernelPreValueInt2[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[2] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
    }
}

void cannyInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY, uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    gaussianInit(src, sigma, startX, startY, endX, endY);

    memset(&cannyConfig, 0, sizeof(cannyConfig));

    if ((NULL == src) || (NULL == src->ptr) || (0u == src->xLen) || (0u == src->yLen) ||
        (src->xLen > CANNY_RING_WIDTH) || ((src->xLen * src->yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)) return;

    cannyConfig.width = src->xLen;
    cannyConfig.height = src->yLen;
    cannyConfig.pixelCount = src->xLen * src->yLen;

    if (thresholdLow > thresholdHigh)
    {
        uint16_t temp = thresholdLow;
        thresholdLow = thresholdHigh;
        thresholdHigh = temp;
    }

    cannyConfig.thresholdLow = thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHigh = thresholdHigh;

    // 提前计算平方
    cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq = (uint32_t) thresholdLow * thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq = (uint32_t) thresholdHigh * thresholdHigh;

    cannyConfig.sobelStartX = 1u;
    cannyConfig.sobelStartY = 1u;
    cannyConfig.sobelEndX = 0u;
    cannyConfig.sobelEndY = 0u;
    cannyConfig.nmsStartX = 1u;
    cannyConfig.nmsStartY = 1u;
    cannyConfig.nmsEndX = 0u;
    cannyConfig.nmsEndY = 0u;

    if ((gaussConfig.blurEndX > (gaussConfig.blurStartX + 1u)) &&
        (gaussConfig.blurEndY > (gaussConfig.blurStartY + 1u)))
    {
        cannyConfig.sobelStartX = gaussConfig.blurStartX + 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelStartY = gaussConfig.blurStartY + 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelEndX = gaussConfig.blurEndX - 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelEndY = gaussConfig.blurEndY - 1u;
    }

    if ((cannyConfig.sobelEndX > (cannyConfig.sobelStartX + 1u)) &&
        (cannyConfig.sobelEndY > (cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u)))
    {
        cannyConfig.nmsStartX = cannyConfig.sobelStartX + 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsStartY = cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsEndX = cannyConfig.sobelEndX - 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsEndY = cannyConfig.sobelEndY - 1u;
    }

    // 预先计算滞后门限追踪(连边)阶段需要的直接邻信偏移
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[0] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width - 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[1] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[2] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width + 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[3] = -1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[4] = 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[5] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width - 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[6] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[7] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width + 1;
}

/* 运行时仅更新 Canny 双阈值，不重算高斯核与 ROI，便于按键调参 */
void cannySetThreshold(uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    if (thresholdLow > thresholdHigh)
    {
        uint16_t temp = thresholdLow;
        thresholdLow = thresholdHigh;
        thresholdHigh = temp;
    }

    cannyConfig.thresholdLow = thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHigh = thresholdHigh;
    cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq = (uint32_t) thresholdLow * thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq = (uint32_t) thresholdHigh * thresholdHigh;
}

void cannyEdgeDetection(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dstGaussBlur, u8Image* dst)
{
    if (NULL == src || NULL == src->ptr || NULL == dstGaussBlur || NULL == dstGaussBlur->ptr ||
        NULL == dst || NULL == dst->ptr) return;
    if (0u == cannyConfig.pixelCount || 0u == gaussConfig.width) return;

    uint32_t queueHead = 0u;
    uint32_t queueTail = 0u;

    // 清零目标画布、ring buffer 残留、高斯模糊边界脏值
    memset(dst->ptr, BLACK, gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height);
    memset(dstGaussBlur->ptr, 0, gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height);
    memset(sobelMapRing, 0, sizeof(sobelMapRing));
    memset(sobelDirMapRing, 0, sizeof(sobelDirMapRing));

    for (uint32_t y = gaussConfig.blurStartY; y <= gaussConfig.blurEndY; y++)
    {
        // ================== 第1阶段: 高斯模糊 ==================
        const uint8_t* row0 = src->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row1 = src->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row2 = src->ptr + (y + 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        uint8_t* dstRow = dstGaussBlur->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

        for (uint32_t x = gaussConfig.blurStartX; x <= gaussConfig.blurEndX; x++)
        {
            uint32_t result = gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row0[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt2[row1[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row2[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x + 1u]];

            result = (result + 128) >> 8;
            dstRow[x] = (uint8_t) ((result > 255) ? 255 : result);
        }

        // ================== 第2阶段: Sobel计算 ==================
        if ((cannyConfig.sobelStartX <= cannyConfig.sobelEndX) &&
            (cannyConfig.sobelStartY <= cannyConfig.sobelEndY) &&
            (y >= (cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u)) &&
            ((y - 1u) <= cannyConfig.sobelEndY))
        {
            const uint8_t* s_row0 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + (y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width;
            const uint8_t* s_row1 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
            const uint8_t* s_row2 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

            uint32_t* sobelRow = sobelMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];
            uint8_t* dirRow = sobelDirMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];

            for (uint32_t x = cannyConfig.sobelStartX; x <= cannyConfig.sobelEndX; x++)
            {
                int32_t gx = (int32_t) s_row0[x + 1u] + ((int32_t) s_row1[x + 1u] << 1) + (int32_t) s_row2[x + 1u] - (int32_t) s_row0[x - 1u] - ((int32_t) s_row1[x - 1u] << 1) - (int32_t) s_row2[x - 1u];
                int32_t gy = (int32_t) s_row0[x - 1u] + ((int32_t) s_row0[x] << 1) + (int32_t) s_row0[x + 1u] - (int32_t) s_row2[x - 1u] - ((int32_t) s_row2[x] << 1) - (int32_t) s_row2[x + 1u];

                // 去除掉极其耗时的 sqrtf 运算
                uint32_t mag_sq = (uint32_t) (gx * gx) + (uint32_t) (gy * gy);
                sobelRow[x] = mag_sq;

                // 完全消除浮点除法，只用整数比较判定4大区面方向
                int32_t ax = (gx >= 0) ? gx : -gx;
                int32_t ay = (gy >= 0) ? gy : -gy;
                int32_t ay256 = ay << 8;

                if (ay256 <= ax * 106)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 0;  // 水平梯度主导（纵向边缘），沿水平方向抑制
                }
                else if (ay256 >= ax * 618)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 2;  // 垂直梯度主导（横向边缘），沿垂直方向抑制
                }
                else if ((gx ^ gy) >= 0)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 1;  // 45度梯度
                }
                else
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 3;  // 135度梯度
                }
            }
        }

        // ================== 第3阶段: 非极大值抑制 ==================
        if ((cannyConfig.nmsStartX <= cannyConfig.nmsEndX) &&
            (cannyConfig.nmsStartY <= cannyConfig.nmsEndY) &&
            (y >= (cannyConfig.nmsStartY + 2u)) &&
            ((y - 2u) <= cannyConfig.nmsEndY))
        {
            const uint32_t* n_row0 = sobelMapRing[(y - 3u) % 3];
            const uint32_t* n_row1 = sobelMapRing[(y - 2u) % 3];
            const uint32_t* n_row2 = sobelMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];
            const uint8_t* dirRow = sobelDirMapRing[(y - 2u) % 3];

            uint8_t* final_dstRow = dst->ptr + (y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width + cannyConfig.nmsStartX;

            for (uint32_t x = cannyConfig.nmsStartX; x <= cannyConfig.nmsEndX; x++)
            {
                uint32_t edge0, edge1;
                uint32_t magnitude = n_row1[x];
                uint8_t dir = dirRow[x];

                if (dir == 0)
                {
                    edge0 = n_row1[x - 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row1[x + 1u];
                }
                else if (dir == 2)
                {
                    edge0 = n_row0[x];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x];
                }
                else if (dir == 1)
                {
                    // gx, gy 同号 → 梯度方向 ↗ (亮度梯度指向右上) → NMS 比较 ↗ 与 ↙
                    edge0 = n_row0[x + 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x - 1u];
                }
                else
                {
                    // gx, gy 异号 → 梯度方向 ↘ (亮度梯度指向右下) → NMS 比较 ↘ 与 ↖
                    edge0 = n_row0[x - 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x + 1u];
                }

                if ((magnitude > edge0) && (magnitude >= edge1))
                {
                    if (magnitude >= cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq)
                    {
                        *final_dstRow = WHITE;  // 确信强边缘
                        if (queueTail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                        {
                            cannyEdgeQueue[queueTail++] = (uint16_t) ((y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width + x);
                        }
                    }
                    else if (magnitude >= cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq)
                    {
                        *final_dstRow = 127;  // 先标记为弱边缘，用于第四阶段追踪，避免大数组分配
                    }
                }

                final_dstRow++;
            }
        }
    }

    // ================== 第4阶段: 滞后门限追踪(连边) ==================
    while (queueHead < queueTail)
    {
        uint32_t index = cannyEdgeQueue[queueHead++];

        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            int32_t trackIndex = (int32_t) index + cannyConfig.trackOffsets[i];

            if (trackIndex >= 0 && trackIndex < (int32_t) cannyConfig.pixelCount)
            {
                if (dst->ptr[trackIndex] == 127)
                {
                    dst->ptr[trackIndex] = WHITE;  // 连通升级为强边缘

                    // 防溢出保护
                    if (queueTail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                    {
                        cannyEdgeQueue[queueTail++] = (uint16_t) trackIndex;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ================== 收尾: 清理死路 ==================
    uint32_t totalPixels = gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < totalPixels; i++)
    {
        if (dst->ptr[i] == 127) dst->ptr[i] = BLACK;  // 无法与强边缘连通被消除
    }
}

 * 使用位置距离 tiebreak; 收紧则更依赖 Hu */
#define CONTOUR_HU_TIE_THRESHOLD 1.0f

// ---- 内部函数声明 ----

static inline uint16_t eightNeighborhoodIterativeCall(const u8Image* obj, uint16_t startX, uint16_t startY, uint32_t genTag, CONTOUR_DATA_STRUCT* contour, float* outMxx, float* outMyy, float* outMxy, float* outM30, float* outM03, float* outM21, float* outM12, float* outOrientation, float* outOrientConfidence);
static float contourComputeRayBalanceOrientation(const u8Image* obj, uint32_t genTag, const uint32_t* queue, uint16_t count, float meanX, float meanY, float mxx, float myy, float mxy, float* outConfidence);
static float contourRayBalanceSideScore(const u8Image* obj, uint32_t genTag, const uint32_t* queue, uint16_t count, float meanX, float meanY, float axisC, float axisS, uint8_t positiveSide, float extent, float coneWidth, uint8_t rayRadius);
static uint8_t contourRayHasTaggedPixel(const u8Image* obj, uint32_t genTag, int32_t rx, int32_t ry, uint8_t radius);
static int32_t contourRoundToInt(float v);
static void computeHuMoments(float mxx, float myy, float mxy, float m30, float m03, float m21, float m12, uint16_t n, float hu[7]);
static float contourHuDistanceByIndex(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint16_t contourIdx);
static float huMatchDistance(const float huA[7], const float huB[7]);
static inline float fastLogPositive(float x);
static uint32_t contourCandidateReferenceDistSq(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint16_t contourIdx);
static void contourHandleLostSample(CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t resetOrientProtect);

/* 跟踪建立后优先保持上一目标连续性；搜索态才回退到固定图像中心。 */
static uint32_t contourCandidateReferenceDistSq(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint16_t contourIdx)
{
    if (obj->lastValidSize == 0u || obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_SEARCHING)
    {
        return contourDistSqBuf[contourIdx];
    }

    int32_t dx = (int32_t) obj->contourData[contourIdx].centerX - (int32_t) obj->lastValidCenterX;
    int32_t dy = (int32_t) obj->contourData[contourIdx].centerY - (int32_t) obj->lastValidCenterY;
    return (uint32_t) (dx * dx + dy * dy);
}

static void contourHandleLostSample(CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t resetOrientProtect)
{
    obj->lockFrameCount = 0u;
    obj->lostFrameCount = (obj->lostFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->lostFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
    if (resetOrientProtect)
    {
        obj->orientProtectState = OM_ORIENT_NORMAL;
        obj->orientSpikeFrameCount = 0u;
    }
    omTrackingResetVelocity(obj);
    obj->orientAcquireFrameCount = 0u;
    obj->orientRejectFrameCount = (obj->orientRejectFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->orientRejectFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
    if (obj->orientRejectFrameCount >= ((omOrientConfirmFrames == 0u) ? 1u : omOrientConfirmFrames))
    {
        obj->orientBaselineValid = 0u;
    }

    switch (obj->trackingState)
    {
        case OM_TRACK_SEARCHING:
            break;
        case OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING:
            obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
            break;
        case OM_TRACK_LOCKED:
            if (obj->lostFrameCount >= OM_LOST_THRESHOLD)
                obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING;
            break;
        case OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING:
            if (obj->lostFrameCount >= OM_LOST_TIMEOUT)
                obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
            break;
        default:
            obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
            break;
    }

    obj->orientation = obj->orientBaselineValid ? obj->orientFilter.filteredValue : 0.0f;
}

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void contourDetectInit(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax, uint8_t centroidFeature, uint16_t visionCenterX, uint16_t visionCenterY, uint16_t roiRadius, uint16_t earlyStopRadius, uint8_t brightnessMax)
{
    contourDataConfig.sizeMin = sizeMin;
    contourDataConfig.sizeMax = sizeMax;
    contourDataConfig.centroidFeature = centroidFeature;
    contourDataConfig.visionCenterX = visionCenterX;
    contourDataConfig.visionCenterY = visionCenterY;
    contourDataConfig.roiRadius = roiRadius;
    contourDataConfig.earlyStopRadius = earlyStopRadius;
    contourDataConfig.brightnessMax = brightnessMax;
    contourDataConfig.earlyStopRadiusSq = (uint32_t) earlyStopRadius * earlyStopRadius;
    contourDataConfig.huTemplateReady = 0u;
    contourDataConfig.huLostThreshold = 0.0f;
}

void contourDetectSetSizeRange(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax)
{
    contourDataConfig.sizeMin = sizeMin;
    contourDataConfig.sizeMax = sizeMax;
}

void contourDetectSetBrightnessMax(uint8_t brightnessMax)
{
    contourDataConfig.brightnessMax = brightnessMax;
}

void contourDetectSetOrientProtect(float jumpMax, float recoverRad, uint8_t confirmFrames)
{
    omOrientJumpMax = jumpMax;
    omOrientRecoverRad = recoverRad;
    omOrientConfirmFrames = confirmFrames;
}

uint8_t contourDetectOrientationJumpAllowed(float deltaRad)
{
    return (deltaRad <= omOrientJumpMax) ? 1u : 0u;
}

void contourDetectSetTemplate(const float* huMoments, float huLostThreshold)
{
    if (NULL == huMoments)
    {
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 7; i++) contourDataConfig.huTemplate[i] = 0.0f;
        contourDataConfig.huTemplateReady = 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 7; i++) contourDataConfig.huTemplate[i] = huMoments[i];
        contourDataConfig.huTemplateReady = 1u;
    }
    contourDataConfig.huLostThreshold = huLostThreshold;
}

uint16_t contourDetect(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* graySrc, float sampleDtS, CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj)
{
    if (src->size > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
    {
        obj->contourCount = 0;
        obj->selectedIndex = 0;
        obj->targetLost = 1;
        obj->orientation = 0.0f;
        obj->orientationConfidence = 0.0f;
        omTrackingResetVelocity(obj);
        return 0;
    }

    // generation 替代 memset: 每帧自增, 匹配当前 generation 才视为已访问
    contourGeneration++;
    if (contourGeneration == 0)
    {
        memset(inContourMap, 0, sizeof(inContourMap));
        contourGeneration = 1;
    }
    uint32_t genBase = (uint32_t) contourGeneration << 16;

    uint16_t contourCount = 0;
    uint32_t tagCounter = 0;
    obj->selectedIndex = 0;
    obj->orientation = 0.0f;
    obj->orientationConfidence = 0.0f; /* 每帧起底 0: 无候选/目标本体丢失时保持 0 */
    obj->targetLost = 1;

    /* huEnabled 仅以模板是否就绪为准 */
    uint8_t huEnabled = (contourDataConfig.huTemplateReady) ? 1u : 0u;

    // ROI 边界
    uint32_t roiStartX = 0, roiStartY = 0;
    uint32_t roiEndX = src->xLen - 1, roiEndY = src->yLen - 1;
    if (contourDataConfig.roiRadius > 0)
    {
        int32_t rs = (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterX - (int32_t) contourDataConfig.roiRadius;
        int32_t re = (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterX + (int32_t) contourDataConfig.roiRadius;
        int32_t ts = (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterY - (int32_t) contourDataConfig.roiRadius;
        int32_t te = (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterY + (int32_t) contourDataConfig.roiRadius;
        roiStartX = (rs < 0) ? 0 : (uint32_t) rs;
        roiStartY = (ts < 0) ? 0 : (uint32_t) ts;
        roiEndX = ((uint32_t) re >= src->xLen) ? src->xLen - 1 : (uint32_t) re;
        roiEndY = ((uint32_t) te >= src->yLen) ? src->yLen - 1 : (uint32_t) te;
    }

    // ========== 第一阶段: 扫描全部轮廓并收集特征 ==========
    for (uint32_t y = roiStartY; y <= roiEndY && contourCount < OM_MAX_OBJECTS - 1; y++)
    {
        uint32_t rowOff = y * src->xLen;
        for (uint32_t x = roiStartX; x <= roiEndX && contourCount < OM_MAX_OBJECTS - 1; x++)
        {
            uint32_t i = rowOff + x;
            if (src->ptr[i] != WHITE || (inContourMap[i] >> 16) == contourGeneration) continue;

            tagCounter++;
            if (tagCounter > 0xFFFFu) goto phaseTwoSelect;

            uint32_t genTag = genBase | (uint32_t) tagCounter;

            float curMxx = 0.0f, curMyy = 0.0f, curMxy = 0.0f;
            float curM30 = 0.0f, curM03 = 0.0f, curM21 = 0.0f, curM12 = 0.0f;
            uint16_t endpointCount = eightNeighborhoodIterativeCall(src, (uint16_t) x, (uint16_t) y, genTag, &obj->contourData[contourCount], &curMxx, &curMyy, &curMxy, &curM30, &curM03, &curM21, &curM12, &contourOrientBuf[contourCount], &contourOrientConfBuf[contourCount]);

            /* 闭合判定收紧: 真闭环=0 端点, ^=2 端点; 其余开放噪声曲线一律弃 */
            if (endpointCount != 0u && endpointCount != 2u) continue;

            /* BFS 内 abandon (触边/超尺寸/超端点) 时 contourSize 已被置 0, 下方 sizeMin 检查会拒绝 */

            // 尺寸过滤
            uint16_t sz = obj->contourData[contourCount].contourSize;
            if (sz < contourDataConfig.sizeMin || sz > contourDataConfig.sizeMax) continue;

            // ^形状几何预筛: 偏心率检查 (^主轴比/次轴比 在[1.5, 6])
            float eigSum = curMxx + curMyy;
            float eigDiff2 = (curMxx - curMyy) * (curMxx - curMyy) + 4.0f * curMxy * curMxy;
            if (eigSum > 0.0f && eigDiff2 > 0.0f)
            {
                // 免sqrt偏心率判定:
                // eigMax/eigMin < r  <=>  diff^2 < sum^2 * ((r-1)/(r+1))^2
                // eigMax/eigMin > r  <=>  diff^2 > sum^2 * ((r-1)/(r+1))^2
                const float ratioKMin = (CONTOUR_ECC_MIN - 1.0f) / (CONTOUR_ECC_MIN + 1.0f);
                const float ratioKMax = (CONTOUR_ECC_MAX - 1.0f) / (CONTOUR_ECC_MAX + 1.0f);
                float boundMin = eigSum * ratioKMin;
                float boundMax = eigSum * ratioKMax;
                if (eigDiff2 < boundMin * boundMin) continue;
                if (eigDiff2 > boundMax * boundMax) continue;
            }

            // 质心亮度上限过滤: ^笔画必处于暗背景上, 中心过亮必非^
            if (contourDataConfig.brightnessMax < 255)
            {
                uint16_t ccx = obj->contourData[contourCount].centerX;
                uint16_t ccy = obj->contourData[contourCount].centerY;
                uint8_t centroidBright = graySrc->ptr[(uint32_t) ccy * graySrc->xLen + (uint32_t) ccx];
                if (centroidBright > contourDataConfig.brightnessMax) continue;
            }

            // 质心内外特征 (射线法: 由质心向右发射水平射线, 统计与本轮廓边缘的交点奇偶)
            if (contourDataConfig.centroidFeature <= 1)
            {
                uint16_t crossings = 0;
                uint8_t prevEdge = 0;
                for (uint16_t cx = obj->contourData[contourCount].centerX + 1; cx < src->xLen; cx++)
                {
                    uint16_t idx = (uint16_t) (obj->contourData[contourCount].centerY * src->xLen + cx);
                    uint8_t isEdge = ((inContourMap[idx] & 0xFFFFu) == tagCounter && (inContourMap[idx] >> 16) == contourGeneration) ? 1u : 0u;
                    if (isEdge && !prevEdge) crossings++;
                    prevEdge = isEdge;
                }
                uint8_t centroidInside = crossings & 1u;
                if (contourDataConfig.centroidFeature == 0 && !centroidInside) continue;
                if (contourDataConfig.centroidFeature == 1 && centroidInside) continue;
            }

            // 存储距离平方
            int32_t dx = (int32_t) obj->contourData[contourCount].centerX - (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterX;
            int32_t dy = (int32_t) obj->contourData[contourCount].centerY - (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterY;
            contourDistSqBuf[contourCount] = (uint32_t) (dx * dx + dy * dy);

            // 存储中心矩 (第二阶段成败选择需要)
            uint32_t mBase = (uint32_t) contourCount * 7u;
            contourMomBuf[mBase] = curMxx;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 1] = curMyy;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 2] = curMxy;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 3] = curM30;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 4] = curM03;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 5] = curM21;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 6] = curM12;

            // Hu距离在第二阶段进入Top-K候选后才算, 第一阶段仅收集几何特征
            obj->contourData[contourCount].huDistance = 0.0f;

            contourCount++;

            // 非 Hu 模式下按当前选择参考 early-stop；跟踪态靠近上一目标，搜索态靠近画面中心。
            if (!huEnabled && contourDataConfig.earlyStopRadius > 0
                && contourCandidateReferenceDistSq(obj, contourCount - 1u) <= contourDataConfig.earlyStopRadiusSq)
                goto phaseTwoSelect;
        }
    }

phaseTwoSelect:
    obj->contourCount = contourCount;

    // ========== 第二阶段: 在已收集轮廓中选出最佳轮廓 ==========
    if (contourCount > 0)
    {
        if (huEnabled && contourCount > 1)
        {
            // Hu-first: 对所有候选计算 Hu 距离, 不做 Top-K 预筛
            float huMin = 3.402823466e+38f;
            for (uint16_t k = 0; k < contourCount; k++)
            {
                float dHu = contourHuDistanceByIndex(obj, k);
                contourHuBuf[k] = dHu;
                obj->contourData[k].huDistance = dHu;
                if (dHu < huMin) huMin = dHu;
            }

            /* Hu 优先选择: 最小 Hu; 同 Hu 带内 (差 < TIE_THRESHOLD) 按位置 tiebreak */
            uint32_t bestTieDist = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
            for (uint16_t k = 0; k < contourCount; k++)
            {
                if ((contourHuBuf[k] - huMin) < CONTOUR_HU_TIE_THRESHOLD)
                {
                    uint32_t referenceDist = contourCandidateReferenceDistSq(obj, k);
                    if (referenceDist < bestTieDist)
                    {
                        bestTieDist = referenceDist;
                        obj->selectedIndex = (uint8_t) k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else if (!huEnabled)
        {
            // 纯距离选择
            uint32_t bestDist = contourCandidateReferenceDistSq(obj, 0u);
            obj->selectedIndex = 0;
            for (uint16_t k = 1; k < contourCount; k++)
            {
                uint32_t referenceDist = contourCandidateReferenceDistSq(obj, k);
                if (referenceDist < bestDist)
                {
                    bestDist = referenceDist;
                    obj->selectedIndex = (uint8_t) k;
                }
            }
        }
        // contourCount==1 时 selectedIndex 已为 0

        // 目标丢失判定: Hu距离超阈值 → 形状不匹配模板
        if (huEnabled && contourDataConfig.huLostThreshold > 0.0f)
        {
            float selHu = contourHuDistanceByIndex(obj, obj->selectedIndex);
            contourHuBuf[obj->selectedIndex] = selHu;
            obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].huDistance = selHu;
            obj->targetLost = (selHu > contourDataConfig.huLostThreshold) ? 1u : 0u;
        }
        else
        {
            obj->targetLost = 0;
        }

        /* 选中轮廓朝向: BFS 末尾用 ^ 几何特征定向, 无跨帧状态 */
        obj->orientation = contourOrientBuf[obj->selectedIndex];
    }

    // 清空后段未使用位置
    for (uint16_t i = contourCount; i < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; i++) obj->contourData[i].contourSize = 0;

    // ========== 跟踪状态机 ==========
    {
        uint8_t detected = (obj->targetLost == 0u && contourCount > 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
        uint16_t selCx = obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].centerX;
        uint16_t selCy = obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].centerY;
        float selOrient = contourOrientBuf[obj->selectedIndex];
        float selOrientConf = contourOrientConfBuf[obj->selectedIndex];
        uint16_t selSize = obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].contourSize;

        // 画幅边缘接触检测: 质心过于靠近边缘视为丢失
        if (detected)
        {
            if (selCx <= OM_BORDER_MARGIN || selCx >= (src->xLen - 1u - OM_BORDER_MARGIN) ||
                selCy <= OM_BORDER_MARGIN || selCy >= (src->yLen - 1u - OM_BORDER_MARGIN))
            {
                detected = 0u;
                obj->targetLost = 1u;
            }
        }
        if (detected)
        {
            obj->orientationConfidence = selOrientConf;
            obj->lostFrameCount = 0u;
            obj->lockFrameCount = (obj->lockFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->lockFrameCount + 1u : 255u;

            switch (obj->trackingState)
            {
                case OM_TRACK_SEARCHING:
                    if (obj->lockFrameCount >= OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD)
                        obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING;
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING:
                    if (obj->lockFrameCount >= (OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD + OM_LOCK_CONFIRM))
                        obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOCKED;
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_LOCKED:
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING:
                    obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOCKED;
                    break;
                default:
                    obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
                    break;
            }

            // 主轴方向(PCA)实时跟随；低置信只拒绝朝向样本, 不影响目标位置有效性。
            // 小目标仍按上一帧对齐 180 度, 不冻结主轴角。
            float finalOrient = selOrient;
            if (obj->trackingState >= OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING && obj->orientBaselineValid)
            {
                if (selSize < OM_ORIENTATION_MIN_SIZE)
                {
                    float diff = selOrient - obj->lastValidOrientation;
                    diff = wrapToPi(diff);
                    // selOrient 与上一帧反向(尖端选反) -> 翻转 180 度对齐, 主轴角仍随实时
                    if (diff > HALF_PI)
                        finalOrient = selOrient - PI;
                    else if (diff < -HALF_PI)
                        finalOrient = selOrient + PI;
                    finalOrient = wrapToPi(finalOrient);
                }
            }

            // 朝向跳变保护 (逻辑同 ToF 定高跳变保护): 几何对齐后再判定 finalOrient
            // 相对上一基线的圆周跳变。仅 ACQUIRING/LOCKED 且已有可信基线时生效。
            // acceptSample=0 时拒绝当前朝向样本: 位置目标仍有效, 朝向沿用上一滤波值。
            uint8_t acceptSample = 1u;
            uint8_t hasOrientBaseline = obj->orientBaselineValid ? 1u : 0u;
            if (selOrientConf < OM_RAY_BALANCE_CONFIDENCE_MIN)
            {
                acceptSample = 0u;
            }

            if (acceptSample && obj->trackingState >= OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING && hasOrientBaseline)
            {
                float dOri = finalOrient - obj->lastValidOrientation;
                dOri = wrapToPi(dOri);
                if (dOri < 0.0f) dOri = -dOri;

                if (obj->orientProtectState == OM_ORIENT_NORMAL)
                {
                    if (dOri > omOrientJumpMax)
                    {
                        // 异常突跳 -> 挂起, 拒绝该样本
                        obj->orientProtectState = OM_ORIENT_SUSPENDED;
                        obj->orientSpikeFrameCount = 0u;
                        acceptSample = 0u;
                    }
                }
                else /* OM_ORIENT_SUSPENDED */
                {
                    if (dOri > omOrientJumpMax)
                    {
                        // 持续异常: 计数清零, 继续沿用基线
                        obj->orientSpikeFrameCount = 0u;
                        acceptSample = 0u;
                    }
                    else if (dOri < omOrientRecoverRad)
                    {
                        // 窄带恢复: 接受当前朝向
                        obj->orientProtectState = OM_ORIENT_NORMAL;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // 介于二者之间: 累计确认帧, 达阈值后接受新基线
                        obj->orientSpikeFrameCount = (obj->orientSpikeFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->orientSpikeFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
                        if (obj->orientSpikeFrameCount >= omOrientConfirmFrames)
                        {
                            obj->orientProtectState = OM_ORIENT_NORMAL;
                            obj->orientSpikeFrameCount = 0u;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            acceptSample = 0u;
                        }
                    }
                }

            }

            if (!acceptSample)
            {
                /* 朝向质量不足只冻结朝向基线; 目标质心/速度仍按本帧更新。 */
                omTrackingUpdateVelocity(obj, (float) selCx, (float) selCy, sampleDtS);

                obj->lastValidCenterX = selCx;
                obj->lastValidCenterY = selCy;
                obj->lastValidSize = selSize;
                obj->orientAcquireFrameCount = 0u;
                obj->orientRejectFrameCount = (obj->orientRejectFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->orientRejectFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
                if (obj->orientRejectFrameCount >= ((omOrientConfirmFrames == 0u) ? 1u : omOrientConfirmFrames))
                {
                    obj->orientBaselineValid = 0u;
                }

                if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOCKED)
                {
                    omTrackingLowPass(&obj->centerXFilter, (float) selCx, OM_POSITION_ALPHA);
                    omTrackingLowPass(&obj->centerYFilter, (float) selCy, OM_POSITION_ALPHA);
                }
                else
                {
                    lowPassFilterReset(&obj->centerXFilter, (float) selCx);
                    lowPassFilterReset(&obj->centerYFilter, (float) selCy);
                }

                obj->orientation = obj->orientBaselineValid ? obj->orientFilter.filteredValue : 0.0f;
            }
            else
            {
                /* 先用本帧原始整数质心更新速度；位置发布与速度低通相互独立。 */
                omTrackingUpdateVelocity(obj, (float) selCx, (float) selCy, sampleDtS);
                uint8_t hadOrientBaseline = obj->orientBaselineValid ? 1u : 0u;
                uint8_t baselineConfirmFrames = (omOrientConfirmFrames == 0u) ? 1u : omOrientConfirmFrames;

                obj->lastValidCenterX = selCx;
                obj->lastValidCenterY = selCy;
                obj->lastValidOrientation = finalOrient;
                obj->lastValidSize = selSize;
                obj->orientRejectFrameCount = 0u;
                if (hadOrientBaseline)
                {
                    obj->orientAcquireFrameCount = 0u;
                }
                else
                {
                    obj->orientAcquireFrameCount = (obj->orientAcquireFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->orientAcquireFrameCount + 1u : 255u;
                    if (obj->orientAcquireFrameCount >= baselineConfirmFrames)
                    {
                        obj->orientBaselineValid = 1u;
                        obj->orientAcquireFrameCount = 0u;
                    }
                }

                // 低通滤波 (仅 LOCKED 态), 系数由 OM_*_ALPHA 宏调节
                if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOCKED && hadOrientBaseline)
                {
                    omTrackingLowPass(&obj->centerXFilter, (float) selCx, OM_POSITION_ALPHA);
                    omTrackingLowPass(&obj->centerYFilter, (float) selCy, OM_POSITION_ALPHA);
                    omTrackingAngleLowPass(&obj->orientFilter, finalOrient, OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA);
                }
                else
                {
                    // 非 LOCKED 态直接跟随, 锚定滤波器状态防止入锁瞬间突跳
                    lowPassFilterReset(&obj->centerXFilter, (float) selCx);
                    lowPassFilterReset(&obj->centerYFilter, (float) selCy);
                    lowPassFilterReset(&obj->orientFilter, finalOrient);
                }

                obj->orientation = obj->orientBaselineValid ? obj->orientFilter.filteredValue : 0.0f;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            contourHandleLostSample(obj, 1u);
        }
    }

    return contourCount;
}

// ---- 提取 Hu 实现 ----

uint8_t contourExtractHuMoments(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t contourIndex, float huOut[7])
{
    if (obj == NULL || huOut == NULL) return 0u;
    if (contourIndex >= obj->contourCount || obj->contourData[contourIndex].contourSize == 0) return 0u;
    uint32_t mBase = (uint32_t) contourIndex * 7u;
    computeHuMoments(contourMomBuf[mBase], contourMomBuf[mBase + 1], contourMomBuf[mBase + 2],
        contourMomBuf[mBase + 3], contourMomBuf[mBase + 4], contourMomBuf[mBase + 5], contourMomBuf[mBase + 6],
        obj->contourData[contourIndex].contourSize, huOut);
    return 1u;
}

// 8邻域BFS: 统计连通区域大小、质心、二阶矩、三阶矩及端点数; 返回端点数
#include "om_contour_geometry_impl.h"

SHA-256：2297fbb13be4d89ebed81f7598f660462412069a60294526615368c2a394e61a
