#ifndef OM_CONTOUR_GEOMETRY_IMPL_H
#define OM_CONTOUR_GEOMETRY_IMPL_H

/*
 * om_contour.c 单翻译单元实现片段：BFS、ray-balance 朝向与 Hu 数学内核。
 * 依赖 om_contour.c 的私有类型、宏和状态，只允许在该文件原内部实现位置包含一次。
 */

static inline uint16_t eightNeighborhoodIterativeCall(const u8Image* obj, uint16_t startX, uint16_t startY, uint32_t genTag, CONTOUR_DATA_STRUCT* contour, float* outMxx, float* outMyy, float* outMxy, float* outM30, float* outM03, float* outM21, float* outM12, float* outOrientation, float* outOrientConfidence)
{
    uint32_t width = obj->xLen;
    uint32_t height = obj->yLen;

    contour->contourSize = 0;
    contour->centerX = 0;
    contour->centerY = 0;

    uint16_t head = 0;
    uint16_t tail = 0;

    // 起点入队并标记 (packed: high16=y, low16=x)
    inContourMap[startY * width + startX] = genTag;
    contourQueue[tail++] = ((uint32_t) startY << 16) | (uint32_t) startX;

    uint32_t sumX = 0;
    uint32_t sumY = 0;
    uint32_t sumXX = 0;
    uint32_t sumYY = 0;
    uint32_t sumXY = 0;
    uint64_t sumXXX = 0;
    uint64_t sumYYY = 0;
    uint64_t sumXXY = 0;
    uint64_t sumXYY = 0;
    uint16_t totalCount = 0;
    uint16_t endpointCount = 0;
    uint8_t abandon = 0;

    while (head < tail)
    {
        uint16_t cx = (uint16_t) (contourQueue[head] & 0xFFFFu);
        uint16_t cy = (uint16_t) (contourQueue[head] >> 16);
        head++;

        totalCount++;

        if (!abandon)
        {
            sumX += cx;
            sumY += cy;
            uint32_t cxx = (uint32_t) cx * cx;
            uint32_t cyy = (uint32_t) cy * cy;
            sumXX += cxx;
            sumYY += cyy;
            sumXY += (uint32_t) cx * cy;
            sumXXX += (uint64_t) cxx * cx;
            sumYYY += (uint64_t) cyy * cy;
            sumXXY += (uint64_t) cxx * cy;
            sumXYY += (uint64_t) cx * cyy;
        }

        // 统计原图中当前像素的白色8邻域数量 (用于端点检测)
        uint8_t whiteNeighborCount = 0;

        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            int32_t nx = (int32_t) cx + contourDx[i];
            int32_t ny = (int32_t) cy + contourDy[i];

            if (nx < 0 || (uint32_t) nx >= width || ny < 0 || (uint32_t) ny >= height) continue;

            uint16_t nIdx = (uint16_t) ((uint32_t) ny * width + (uint32_t) nx);

            if (obj->ptr[nIdx] == WHITE)
            {
                whiteNeighborCount++;

                // 未访问的白色像素入队
                if ((inContourMap[nIdx] >> 16) != contourGeneration)
                {
                    inContourMap[nIdx] = genTag;
                    if (tail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                        contourQueue[tail++] = ((uint32_t) ny << 16) | (uint32_t) nx;
                }
            }
        }

        // Canny后边缘上端点像素白色邻居数 < 2
        if (!abandon && whiteNeighborCount < 2) endpointCount++;

        /* 触图像边界即 abandon: 边缘截断的开放曲线刚好有 2 个端点会冒充闭合 ^ */
        if (!abandon && (cx == 0u || cy == 0u || (uint32_t) cx == width - 1u || (uint32_t) cy == height - 1u)) abandon = 1;

        if (!abandon && (totalCount > contourDataConfig.sizeMax || endpointCount > 2)) abandon = 1;
    }

    /* abandon 时 contourSize 置 0, 让 caller 的 sizeMin 检查直接拒绝该轮廓 */
    contour->contourSize = abandon ? 0u : totalCount;

    if (totalCount > 0 && !abandon)
    {
        float fN = (float) totalCount;
        float meanX = (float) sumX / fN;
        float meanY = (float) sumY / fN;
        contour->centerX = (uint16_t) (sumX / totalCount);
        contour->centerY = (uint16_t) (sumY / totalCount);

        *outMxx = (float) sumXX / fN - meanX * meanX;
        *outMyy = (float) sumYY / fN - meanY * meanY;
        *outMxy = (float) sumXY / fN - meanX * meanY;

        // 计算中心矩
        *outM30 = (float) sumXXX / fN - 3.0f * meanX * (float) sumXX / fN + 2.0f * meanX * meanX * meanX;
        *outM03 = (float) sumYYY / fN - 3.0f * meanY * (float) sumYY / fN + 2.0f * meanY * meanY * meanY;
        *outM21 = (float) sumXXY / fN - 2.0f * meanX * (float) sumXY / fN - meanY * (float) sumXX / fN + 2.0f * meanX * meanX * meanY;
        *outM12 = (float) sumXYY / fN - 2.0f * meanY * (float) sumXY / fN - meanX * (float) sumYY / fN + 2.0f * meanX * meanY * meanY;

        /* ^ 尖端朝向: 主轴由二阶矩给出, 尖端由质心射线两侧几何评分决定。
         * 尖端侧远端像素应沿主轴收敛, 反向开口侧远端像素离轴发散。
         */
        *outOrientation = contourComputeRayBalanceOrientation(obj, genTag, contourQueue, tail,
            meanX, meanY, *outMxx, *outMyy, *outMxy, outOrientConfidence);
    }
    else
    {
        *outMxx = 0.0f;
        *outMyy = 0.0f;
        *outMxy = 0.0f;
        *outM30 = 0.0f;
        *outM03 = 0.0f;
        *outM21 = 0.0f;
        *outM12 = 0.0f;
        *outOrientation = 0.0f;
        *outOrientConfidence = 0.0f;
    }

    return endpointCount;
}

static float contourComputeRayBalanceOrientation(const u8Image* obj, uint32_t genTag, const uint32_t* queue, uint16_t count, float meanX, float meanY, float mxx, float myy, float mxy, float* outConfidence)
{
    float theta = 0.5f * atan2f(2.0f * mxy, mxx - myy);
    float axis = wrapToPi(theta + HALF_PI);
    if (count == 0u)
    {
        *outConfidence = 0.0f;
        return axis;
    }

    float axisC = cosf(axis);
    float axisS = sinf(axis);
    float posExtent = 0.0f;
    float negExtent = 0.0f;

    for (uint16_t i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        uint16_t x = (uint16_t) (queue[i] & 0xFFFFu);
        uint16_t y = (uint16_t) (queue[i] >> 16);
        float dx = (float) x - meanX;
        float dy = (float) y - meanY;
        float t = dx * axisC + dy * axisS;
        if (t > posExtent) posExtent = t;
        if (-t > negExtent) negExtent = -t;
    }

    if (posExtent <= 1.0f || negExtent <= 1.0f)
    {
        *outConfidence = 0.0f;
        return axis;
    }

    float halfExtent = (posExtent > negExtent) ? posExtent : negExtent;
    float minExtent = (posExtent < negExtent) ? posExtent : negExtent;
    float coneWidth = CONTOUR_RAY_CONE_RATIO * minExtent;
    if (coneWidth < CONTOUR_RAY_CONE_MIN) coneWidth = CONTOUR_RAY_CONE_MIN;
    uint8_t rayRadius = (halfExtent < CONTOUR_RAY_RADIUS_SPLIT) ? 1u : 2u;

    float posScore = contourRayBalanceSideScore(obj, genTag, queue, count, meanX, meanY, axisC, axisS, 1u, posExtent, coneWidth, rayRadius);
    float negScore = contourRayBalanceSideScore(obj, genTag, queue, count, meanX, meanY, axisC, axisS, 0u, negExtent, coneWidth, rayRadius);
    float denom = fabsf(posScore) + fabsf(negScore) + 1e-6f;
    float confidence = fabsf(posScore - negScore) / denom;
    if (confidence > 1.0f) confidence = 1.0f;
    *outConfidence = confidence;

    return (posScore >= negScore) ? axis : wrapToPi(axis + PI);
}

static float contourRayBalanceSideScore(const u8Image* obj, uint32_t genTag, const uint32_t* queue, uint16_t count, float meanX, float meanY, float axisC, float axisS, uint8_t positiveSide, float extent, float coneWidth, uint8_t rayRadius)
{
    float farStart = CONTOUR_RAY_FAR_START_RATIO * extent;
    float farEnd = CONTOUR_RAY_FAR_END_RATIO * extent;
    float coneScore = 0.0f;
    uint16_t nearCount = 0u;
    uint16_t farTotal = 0u;
    float offAxisPenalty = 0.0f;
    float sign = positiveSide ? 1.0f : -1.0f;

    for (uint16_t i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        uint16_t x = (uint16_t) (queue[i] & 0xFFFFu);
        uint16_t y = (uint16_t) (queue[i] >> 16);
        float dx = (float) x - meanX;
        float dy = (float) y - meanY;
        float t = dx * axisC + dy * axisS;
        float p = -dx * axisS + dy * axisC;
        float signedT = sign * t;
        if (signedT < farStart) continue;

        farTotal++;
        float absP = fabsf(p);
        float farWeight = signedT / (extent + 1e-6f);
        if (farWeight > 1.0f) farWeight = 1.0f;
        if (absP <= coneWidth)
        {
            nearCount++;
            coneScore += (1.0f - absP / coneWidth) * (0.5f + 0.5f * farWeight);
        }
        else
        {
            float off = absP / coneWidth;
            if (off > 3.0f) off = 3.0f;
            offAxisPenalty += off * CONTOUR_RAY_OFF_PENALTY;
        }
    }

    float rayHits = 0.0f;
    int32_t steps = (int32_t) (farEnd - farStart) + 1;
    if (steps < 1) steps = 1;
    for (int32_t i = 0; i < steps; i++)
    {
        float ratio = (steps > 1) ? ((float) i / (float) (steps - 1)) : 0.0f;
        float d = farStart + (farEnd - farStart) * ratio;
        int32_t rx = contourRoundToInt(meanX + sign * axisC * d);
        int32_t ry = contourRoundToInt(meanY + sign * axisS * d);
        if (contourRayHasTaggedPixel(obj, genTag, rx, ry, rayRadius))
        {
            rayHits += 0.5f + 0.5f * (d / (extent + 1e-6f));
        }
    }

    float densityNorm = sqrtf((farTotal > 0u) ? (float) farTotal : 1.0f);
    return (CONTOUR_RAY_HIT_WEIGHT * rayHits) + (coneScore / densityNorm) +
           (CONTOUR_RAY_NEAR_WEIGHT * (float) nearCount) - offAxisPenalty;
}

static uint8_t contourRayHasTaggedPixel(const u8Image* obj, uint32_t genTag, int32_t rx, int32_t ry, uint8_t radius)
{
    int32_t r = (int32_t) radius;
    for (int32_t yy = ry - r; yy <= ry + r; yy++)
    {
        if (yy < 0 || (uint32_t) yy >= obj->yLen) continue;
        for (int32_t xx = rx - r; xx <= rx + r; xx++)
        {
            if (xx < 0 || (uint32_t) xx >= obj->xLen) continue;
            uint32_t idx = (uint32_t) yy * obj->xLen + (uint32_t) xx;
            if (inContourMap[idx] == genTag) return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

static int32_t contourRoundToInt(float v)
{
    return (v >= 0.0f) ? (int32_t) (v + 0.5f) : (int32_t) (v - 0.5f);
}

// 计算7个Hu不变矩 (输入为中心矩, n为像素数)
static void computeHuMoments(float mxx, float myy, float mxy, float m30, float m03, float m21, float m12, uint16_t n, float hu[7])
{
    float fN = (float) n;
    float sqrtN = sqrtf(fN);
    float invN = 1.0f / fN;
    float invN15 = invN / sqrtN;

    // 归一化中心矩
    float eta20 = mxx * invN;
    float eta02 = myy * invN;
    float eta11 = mxy * invN;
    float eta30 = m30 * invN15;
    float eta03 = m03 * invN15;
    float eta21 = m21 * invN15;
    float eta12 = m12 * invN15;

    // 7个Hu不变矩
    hu[0] = eta20 + eta02;
    hu[1] = (eta20 - eta02) * (eta20 - eta02) + 4.0f * eta11 * eta11;

    float t1 = eta30 - 3.0f * eta12;
    float t2 = 3.0f * eta21 - eta03;
    hu[2] = t1 * t1 + t2 * t2;

    float t3 = eta30 + eta12;
    float t4 = eta21 + eta03;
    hu[3] = t3 * t3 + t4 * t4;

    float t3sq = t3 * t3;
    float t4sq = t4 * t4;
    hu[4] = t1 * t3 * (t3sq - 3.0f * t4sq) + t2 * t4 * (3.0f * t3sq - t4sq);
    hu[5] = (eta20 - eta02) * (t3sq - t4sq) + 4.0f * eta11 * t3 * t4;
    hu[6] = t2 * t3 * (t3sq - 3.0f * t4sq) - t1 * t4 * (3.0f * t3sq - t4sq);
}

static float contourHuDistanceByIndex(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint16_t contourIdx)
{
    float hu[7];
    uint32_t mBase = (uint32_t) contourIdx * 7u;
    computeHuMoments(contourMomBuf[mBase], contourMomBuf[mBase + 1], contourMomBuf[mBase + 2],
        contourMomBuf[mBase + 3], contourMomBuf[mBase + 4], contourMomBuf[mBase + 5], contourMomBuf[mBase + 6],
        obj->contourData[contourIdx].contourSize, hu);
    return huMatchDistance(hu, contourDataConfig.huTemplate);
}

static inline float fastLogPositive(float x)
{
#if (CONTOUR_USE_FAST_LOG)
    union
    {
        float f;
        uint32_t u;
    } v;
    v.f = x;

    int32_t exp2 = (int32_t) ((v.u >> 23) & 0xFFu) - 127;
    uint32_t mant = (v.u & 0x7FFFFFu) | 0x3F800000u;  // 1.m
    union
    {
        float f;
        uint32_t u;
    } vm;
    vm.u = mant;
    float m = vm.f;

    float y = m - 1.0f;  // y in [0,1)
    // ln(1+y) 三阶截断
    float ln_m = y - 0.5f * y * y + (1.0f / 3.0f) * y * y * y;
    return ln_m + (float) exp2 * 0.69314718056f;
#else
    return logf(x);
#endif
}

// Hu矩加权匹配距离 (log空间加权L1, 低阶高权重, h6符号无意义)
static float huMatchDistance(const float huA[7], const float huB[7])
{
    float a0 = fabsf(huA[0]);
    if (a0 < 1e-12f) a0 = 1e-12f;
    float b0 = fabsf(huB[0]);
    if (b0 < 1e-12f) b0 = 1e-12f;
    float a1 = fabsf(huA[1]);
    if (a1 < 1e-12f) a1 = 1e-12f;
    float b1 = fabsf(huB[1]);
    if (b1 < 1e-12f) b1 = 1e-12f;
    float a2 = fabsf(huA[2]);
    if (a2 < 1e-12f) a2 = 1e-12f;
    float b2 = fabsf(huB[2]);
    if (b2 < 1e-12f) b2 = 1e-12f;
    float a3 = fabsf(huA[3]);
    if (a3 < 1e-12f) a3 = 1e-12f;
    float b3 = fabsf(huB[3]);
    if (b3 < 1e-12f) b3 = 1e-12f;
    float a4 = fabsf(huA[4]);
    if (a4 < 1e-12f) a4 = 1e-12f;
    float b4 = fabsf(huB[4]);
    if (b4 < 1e-12f) b4 = 1e-12f;
    float a5 = fabsf(huA[5]);
    if (a5 < 1e-12f) a5 = 1e-12f;
    float b5 = fabsf(huB[5]);
    if (b5 < 1e-12f) b5 = 1e-12f;

    float d0 = fastLogPositive(a0) - fastLogPositive(b0);
    float d1 = fastLogPositive(a1) - fastLogPositive(b1);
    float d2 = fastLogPositive(a2) - fastLogPositive(b2);
    float d3 = fastLogPositive(a3) - fastLogPositive(b3);
    float d4 = fastLogPositive(a4) - fastLogPositive(b4);
    float d5 = fastLogPositive(a5) - fastLogPositive(b5);

    float dist = 2.0f * fabsf(d0) + 2.0f * fabsf(d1) + 1.5f * fabsf(d2) + 1.5f * fabsf(d3) + 0.5f * fabsf(d4) + 0.5f * fabsf(d5);
    return dist;
}

#ifndef OM_TRACKING_INTERNAL_H
#define OM_TRACKING_INTERNAL_H

/*
 * openMorph 跟踪滤波内部助手。
 * 必须在 om_internal.h 之后包含；普通 static 保持各翻译单元原有本地链接与调用语义。
 */

static void omTrackingLowPass(LowPassFilterData* f, float sample, float alpha)
{
    f->alpha = alpha;
    lowPassFilter(f, sample);
}

static void omTrackingAngleLowPass(LowPassFilterData* f, float sample, float alpha)
{
    f->alpha = alpha;
    if (f->firstFlag == 1u)
    {
        lowPassFilterReset(f, sample);
        return;
    }
    float diff = sample - f->lastOutput;
    diff = wrapToPi(diff);
    lowPassFilter(f, f->lastOutput + diff);
    float out = f->filteredValue;
    out = wrapToPi(out);
    f->filteredValue = out;
    f->lastOutput = out;
}

static void omTrackingUpdateVelocity(CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, float rawX, float rawY, float sampleDtS)
{
    if (!obj->velocityPrimed)
    {
        obj->lastRawCenterX = rawX;
        obj->lastRawCenterY = rawY;
        lowPassFilterReset(&obj->velocityXFilter, 0.0f);
        lowPassFilterReset(&obj->velocityYFilter, 0.0f);
        obj->velocityPrimed = 1u;
        return;
    }

    if (sampleDtS >= OM_VELOCITY_DT_MIN_S && sampleDtS <= OM_VELOCITY_DT_MAX_S)
    {
        obj->velocityXFilter.alpha = OM_VELOCITY_ALPHA;
        obj->velocityYFilter.alpha = OM_VELOCITY_ALPHA;
        lowPassFilter(&obj->velocityXFilter, (rawX - obj->lastRawCenterX) / sampleDtS);
        lowPassFilter(&obj->velocityYFilter, (rawY - obj->lastRawCenterY) / sampleDtS);
    }
    else
    {
        lowPassFilterReset(&obj->velocityXFilter, 0.0f);
        lowPassFilterReset(&obj->velocityYFilter, 0.0f);
    }

    obj->lastRawCenterX = rawX;
    obj->lastRawCenterY = rawY;
}

static void omTrackingResetVelocity(CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj)
{
    obj->velocityPrimed = 0u;
    obj->lastRawCenterX = 0.0f;
    obj->lastRawCenterY = 0.0f;
    lowPassFilterReset(&obj->velocityXFilter, 0.0f);
    lowPassFilterReset(&obj->velocityYFilter, 0.0f);
}

/*
 * openMorph.h - 图像处理 头文件
 *
 *  Created: 20250804
 *  Author: Hecate
 *
 *  活跃模块: 高斯/Canny 与绿色灯板轮廓提取。
 */
#ifndef OPENMORPH_H
#define OPENMORPH_H

// ============================================================================
//  包含文件
// ============================================================================

#include <stdint.h>

#include "commonDef.h"
#include "openMorph_config.h"
#include "lowPassFilter.h"

// ============================================================================
//  [4] 高斯模糊与Canny边缘检测
// ============================================================================

// ---- 函数声明 ----

void gaussianInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY);
void cannyInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY, uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh);
void cannySetThreshold(uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh);
void cannyEdgeDetection(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dstGaussBlur, u8Image* dst);

// ============================================================================
//  [5] 轮廓提取
// ============================================================================

// ---- typedef ----

// 单个轮廓数据
typedef struct
{
    uint16_t centerX;      // 质心 X
    uint16_t centerY;      // 质心 Y
    uint16_t contourSize;  // 全部像素数
    float huDistance;      /* Hu 距离: 0 = 未参与 Hu (未进 Top-K); >0 = 实际匹配距离 */
} CONTOUR_DATA_STRUCT;

// 跟踪状态枚举
#define OM_TRACK_SEARCHING    (0u)
#define OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING    (1u)
#define OM_TRACK_LOCKED       (2u)
#define OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING (3u)

// 朝向跳变保护态 (逻辑同 ToF 定高跳变保护)
#define OM_ORIENT_NORMAL    (0u)
#define OM_ORIENT_SUSPENDED (1u)

// 轮廓检测器数据
typedef struct
{
    CONTOUR_DATA_STRUCT contourData[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];  // 轮廓数据缓存

    uint8_t selectedIndex;  // 当前选中轮廓索引
    uint8_t contourCount;   // 有效闭合轮廓数量
    uint8_t targetLost;     // 1=目标丢失(无候选/Hu超阈值/触边), 0=目标本体有效
    float orientation;      // 选中轮廓的几何朝向 (弧度, -PI ~ PI)
    float orientationConfidence;  // 选中轮廓本帧朝向置信度 (0~1, 低置信只拒绝朝向更新, 不代表目标丢失)

    /* 跨帧状态保持 */
    uint16_t lastValidCenterX;
    uint16_t lastValidCenterY;
    float lastValidOrientation;
    uint16_t lastValidSize;
    uint8_t lostFrameCount;
    uint8_t lockFrameCount;
    uint8_t trackingState;
    uint8_t orientProtectState;         // OM_ORIENT_NORMAL / OM_ORIENT_SUSPENDED
    uint8_t orientSpikeFrameCount;      // SUSPENDED 态累计帧数 (达确认帧数后接受新朝向)
    uint8_t orientBaselineValid;        // 已有可用于跳变保护/低通输出的可信朝向基线
    uint8_t orientAcquireFrameCount;    // 无基线时连续接受朝向样本计数
    uint8_t orientRejectFrameCount;     // 连续拒绝/丢失朝向样本计数
    LowPassFilterData orientFilter;     // 朝向低通 (角度域, 系数 OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA)
    LowPassFilterData centerXFilter;    // 发布质心 X 状态 (OM_POSITION_ALPHA=1.0 默认不过滤)
    LowPassFilterData centerYFilter;    // 发布质心 Y 状态 (OM_POSITION_ALPHA=1.0 默认不过滤)
    LowPassFilterData velocityXFilter;  // 原始质心 X 差分速度低通 (px/s)
    LowPassFilterData velocityYFilter;  // 原始质心 Y 差分速度低通 (px/s)
    float lastRawCenterX;               // 上一个有效原始质心 X
    float lastRawCenterY;               // 上一个有效原始质心 Y
    uint8_t velocityPrimed;             // 速度差分基线已建立
} CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT;

// ---- 函数声明 ----

void contourDetectInit(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax, uint8_t centroidFeature, uint16_t visionCenterX, uint16_t visionCenterY, uint16_t roiRadius, uint16_t earlyStopRadius, uint8_t brightnessMax);

// 运行时更新尺寸过滤范围 (标定后收紧)
void contourDetectSetSizeRange(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax);

// 运行时更新质心亮度过滤上限 (255=关闭过滤)
void contourDetectSetBrightnessMax(uint8_t brightnessMax);

/* 朝向跳变保护参数由 contour owner 私有持有，仅通过本命令热重载。 */
void contourDetectSetOrientProtect(float jumpMax, float recoverRad, uint8_t confirmFrames);
uint8_t contourDetectOrientationJumpAllowed(float deltaRad);

// 设置目标形状Hu矩模板
// huLostThreshold: 选中轮廓Hu距离超阈值则置targetLost=1, 建议20.0
// huMoments: 可传NULL以禁用Hu模板(此时退化为纯距离逻辑)
void contourDetectSetTemplate(const float* huMoments, float huLostThreshold);

// 检测: src=Canny边缘图, graySrc=灰度原图 (用于亮度筛除), sampleDtS=相邻处理帧实测间隔
// brightnessMax=255时跳过亮度筛除；返回检测到的闭合轮廓数量
uint16_t contourDetect(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* graySrc, float sampleDtS, CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj);

// 从最近一次 contourDetect() 结果中提取指定轮廓的 7 维 Hu 矩
// 返回 1=成功, 0=索引越界或无数据（必须在同一帧 contourDetect 之后调用）
uint8_t contourExtractHuMoments(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t contourIndex, float huOut[7]);

#endif  // OPENMORPH_H

代码（c）
/*
 * openMorph_config.h - openMorph 库可移植配置头
 *
 * 移植到新工程时只需修改本文件即可适配不同图像分辨率与对象数量上限。
 * openMorph 内部其他源文件不应再出现关于尺寸的字面量。
 */
#ifndef OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H
#define OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H

// ============================================================================
//  图像最大尺寸 (静态缓冲区按此分配)
// ============================================================================
//  当前默认 188 x 120 = 22560 像素 (与本工程实际相机分辨率匹配)
//  如需适配 320x240 等更高分辨率，按比例上调即可。
//  本配置与具体相机驱动解耦，不引入 SDK 头依赖。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH  (188u)
#define OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT (120u)
#define OM_BUFFER_SIZE      (OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH * OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT)

// ============================================================================
//  对象检测数量上限 (轮廓 / 信标 / 连通域共用)
// ============================================================================
//  contourData[] / beaconData[] / sbea[] 等数组的成员数量。
//  超过此上限的候选对象会被忽略 (只保留前 N 个有效结果)。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_MAX_OBJECTS (101u)

// ============================================================================
//  Canny 流水线环形缓冲宽度
// ============================================================================
//  Canny 边缘检测内部 sobel 环形缓冲的列宽，必须 >= OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_CANNY_RING_WIDTH (256u)

// ============================================================================
//  轮廓跟踪状态机参数
// ============================================================================
#define OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD       (2u)      // 连续检测到帧数: SEARCHING → ACQUIRING
#define OM_LOCK_CONFIRM         (1u)      // 继续确认帧数: ACQUIRING → LOCKED
#define OM_LOST_THRESHOLD       (5u)      // 连续丢失帧数: LOCKED → LOST_HOLDING
#define OM_LOST_TIMEOUT         (30u)     // 超时帧数: LOST_HOLDING → SEARCHING
#define OM_RAY_BALANCE_CONFIDENCE_MIN (0.50f) // ^尖端几何定向最低置信度: 低于此值拒绝更新朝向, 目标位置仍有效
#define OM_ORIENTATION_MIN_SIZE (8u)      // 朝向可靠的最小像素数；分辨率迁移不改变朝向冻结门
#define OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA    (1.0f)    // 朝向低通滤波系数 (1.0=不低通，直接跟随确认后的有效朝向)
#define OM_POSITION_ALPHA       (1.0f)    // 质心位置不过滤
#define OM_VELOCITY_ALPHA       (0.1f)    // 原始质心差分速度低通滤波系数
#define OM_VELOCITY_DT_MIN_S    (0.001f)  // 有效图像样本间隔下限
#define OM_VELOCITY_DT_MAX_S    (0.200f)  // 超过此间隔只重建速度基线
#define OM_BORDER_MARGIN        (1u)      // 画幅边缘安全边距

// ============================================================================
//  朝向跳变保护默认值 (运行时可由菜单热重载, 逻辑同 ToF 定高跳变保护)
//   NORMAL  态: |Δθ| > JUMP_MAX 视为异常突跳, 拒绝该样本进 SUSPENDED
//   SUSPEND 态: |Δθ| < RECOVER_RAD 即时恢复; 介于二者间累计 CONFIRM_FRAMES 帧后
//               接受新朝向为基线; 持续 > JUMP_MAX 则计数清零继续沿用旧朝向
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_ORIENTATION_JUMP_MAX       (0.785398f)  // PI/4, 朝向跳变阈值 (rad)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_RECOVER_RAD    (0.196349f)  // PI/16, 恢复窄带 (rad)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_CONFIRM_FRAMES (3u)         // 异常持续这么多帧后接受新朝向

#endif  // OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H

// 串口0默认作为调试串口
void uart0_isr(void)
{
    if (uart_isr_mask(UART_0))  // 串口0接收中断
    {
#if DEBUG_UART_USE_INTERRUPT        // 如果开启 debug 串口中断
        debug_interrupr_handler();  // 调用 debug 串口接收处理函数 数据会被 debug 环形缓冲区读取
#endif                              // 如果修改了 DEBUG_UART_INDEX 那这段代码需要放到对应的串口中断去
    }
    else  // 串口0发送中断
    {
    }
}

void uart1_isr(void)
{
    if (uart_isr_mask(UART_1))  // 串口1接收中断
    {
        opticalFlowRxIrqHandler();  // UPixels 光流：排空 UART 软缓冲喂流式解析器
    }
    else  // 串口1发送中断
    {
    }
}

void uart2_isr(void)
{
    if (uart_isr_mask(UART_2))  // 串口2接收中断
    {
        crossCoreLinkRxIrqHandler();  // 核间链路：排空 UART_2 软缓冲喂帧解析器
    }
    else  // 串口2发送中断
    {
    }
}

#include "core0Loop.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "zf_driver_pit.h"

#include "crossCoreLink.h"
#include "uartLinkProto.h"     /* UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_*(系统模式线值，决定下发 core2 控制源) */
#include "chassisLink.h"       /* RS-485 协议常量(MSG/cmd 位) + chassisLinkSendCommand(core1 作总线主发命令) */
#include "coreDataTransfer.h"  /* planToLinkStruct/coreDataReadPlan */
#include "core1MotionTxFence.h"
#include "core1TakeoffEpochIdentity.h"
#include "paramSyncGateway.h"
#include "paramSyncPlatformPolicy.h"

typedef char core1_buzzer_bridge_value_assert[(UART_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT && UART_LINK_BUZZER_1HZ == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_1HZ && UART_LINK_BUZZER_LONG == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_LONG && UART_LINK_BUZZER_3S == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_3S && UART_LINK_BUZZER_WARN == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_WARN && UART_LINK_BUZZER_ARMED_IDLE == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_ARMED_IDLE && UART_LINK_BUZZER_WAITING == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_WAITING && UART_LINK_BUZZER_THREE_BEEPS == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_THREE_BEEPS) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core1_takeoff_flag_bridge_value_assert[(UART_LINK_MOTION_FLAG_TAKEOFF_REQ == CHASSIS_LINK_LORA_FLAG_TAKEOFF_REQ) ? 1 : -1];

/* core1 作 RS-485 总线主：固定周期发 MSG_COMMAND 作"请求"，core2 收到后才回一帧应答
 * (半双工串行化, 避免碰撞)。周期取 10ms：命令(~1.56ms)+core2 应答(~1.56ms) 往返 <4ms，
 * 10ms 周期留足余量；core2 链路超时 500ms，10ms 远快于超时, 保活无忧。 */
#define RS485_COMMAND_PERIOD_MS (10u)

/* core2 链路断联判据(core1 测): RS-485 应答静默超此时长 → 判 core2 断联, 经 STATUS 帧上报 core0 缓降。
 * core1 每 10ms 轮询、core2 收到命令即应答, 500ms(50 次轮询无应答)足够稳健, 远快于飞行缓降时间尺度。
 * 注: core0 链路丢时 core1 仍发 ESTOP 命令(仍轮询), core2 仍应答 → 不会被误判为 core2 断联。 */
#define AG_CORE1_RS485_LOST_MS (500u)

/* core2 的 LoRa 双肩键请求保持约700ms。core1 仅在短时无 TELEMETRY 时保留最近置位，
 * 以覆盖 STATUS 200ms 周期；收到清零 TELEMETRY、模式切走或 core2 失链立即清零。 */
#define MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ_STALE_MS (300u)

typedef struct
{
    volatile uint32_t loopMs;
    uint32_t rs485LastCommandMs;
    uint32_t rs485LastReplyMs;
    uint32_t mode2LoraLandReqLastMs;
    uint32_t rs485CommandRequestMs;
    uint32_t planLastSeq;
    uint32_t planProducerBootGeneration;
    uint32_t planLastUpdateMs;
    planToLinkStruct lastGoodPlan;
    volatile uint8_t initReady;
    uint8_t rs485ReplyPrimed;
    uint8_t mode2LoraLandReqPrimed;
    uint8_t mode2LoraLandReqLevel;
    uint8_t mode2LoraLandReqPublished;
    uint8_t core2AttitudeFaultLevel;
    uint8_t rs485CommandReplyOutstanding;
    uint8_t planSeqPrimed;
    uint8_t lastGoodPlanValid;
    uint8_t mode2MotionNonzeroSent;
    uint8_t mode2MotionGateReady;
    core1MotionTxFenceState motionTxFence;
    core1TakeoffEpochIdentityState takeoffEpochIdentity;
    core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeCache observerParamBridge[2];
} core0RuntimeContextStruct;

static core0RuntimeContextStruct runtimeContext;

#define initReadyFlag                runtimeContext.initReady
#define rs485LastCommandMs           runtimeContext.rs485LastCommandMs
#define rs485LastReplyMs             runtimeContext.rs485LastReplyMs
#define mode2LoraLandReqLastMs       runtimeContext.mode2LoraLandReqLastMs
#define rs485ReplyPrimed             runtimeContext.rs485ReplyPrimed
#define mode2LoraLandReqPrimed       runtimeContext.mode2LoraLandReqPrimed
#define runtimeMode2LoraLandReqLevel runtimeContext.mode2LoraLandReqLevel
#define mode2LoraLandReqPublished    runtimeContext.mode2LoraLandReqPublished
#define planLastSeq                  runtimeContext.planLastSeq
#define planLastUpdateMs             runtimeContext.planLastUpdateMs
#define planSeqPrimed                runtimeContext.planSeqPrimed
#define loopMs                       runtimeContext.loopMs

static void core1ResetMotionTxFence(void)
{
    core1MotionTxFenceReset(&runtimeContext.motionTxFence);
    runtimeContext.mode2MotionNonzeroSent = 0u;
}

static uint8_t core1SendMotionWithZeroFence(float vx, float vy, float wz, uint8_t flags)
{
    core1MotionTxFenceFrame frame;
    uint8_t requestSent = core1MotionTxFencePrepare(
        &runtimeContext.motionTxFence, loopMs, vx, vy, wz, flags, &frame);
    crossCoreLinkSendMotion(frame.vx, frame.vy, frame.wz, frame.flags);
    return requestSent;
}
#define REQUIRED_VISION_PLAN_STALE_MS (600u) /* cm_7_1 plan 停更时无法证明必需视觉安全，fail-closed */

/* core2 是否在线(RS-485 应答未超时)。供经 crossCoreLink STATUS 帧上报 core0 断联聚合缓降。 */
static uint8_t core1Core2Alive(void)
{
    return (rs485ReplyPrimed &&
               (uint32_t) (loopMs - rs485LastReplyMs) < AG_CORE1_RS485_LOST_MS)
               ? 1u
               : 0u;
}

static uint16_t core1AgeMs(uint8_t primed, uint32_t lastMs, uint16_t limit)
{
    uint32_t age = primed ? (uint32_t) (loopMs - lastMs) : (uint32_t) limit;
    return (age < (uint32_t) limit) ? (uint16_t) age : limit;
}

void processInit(void)
{
    memset(runtimeContext.observerParamBridge, 0,
        sizeof(runtimeContext.observerParamBridge));
    paramSyncGatewayInit();
    /* 核间单线双向链路(UART_1/P04 ↔ core0 P10): 收 core0 透传按键→共享内存, 周期发心跳。
     * 替代原 uartLinkTest RESPONDER(已移除)。 */
    crossCoreLinkInit();
    /* RS-485(UART_4/P14, THVD1450): 收 core2 LoRa 遥控值, 中转给 core0 做无人机前馈。 */
    chassisLinkInit();
    pit_ms_init(PIT_CH0, 1u);
    initReadyFlag = 1u;
}

void pitProcess0(void)
{
    if (!initReadyFlag)
    {
        return;
    }

    crossCoreLinkPit1ms();

    loopMs++; /* 自由 ms 计时，供链路静默与请求年龄计算。 */

    /* 周期与静默年龄都由单调 loopMs 派生，ISR 不再与前台竞争清零标志。 */
}

void whileProcess(void)
{
    planToLinkStruct plan;
    planToLinkStruct sampledPlan;
    crossCoreLinkStatusStruct linkBeforePoll;
    crossCoreLinkStatusStruct linkAfterPoll;
    crossCoreLinkLocalFactsStruct localFacts;
    uint8_t requiredVisionFault = 0u;
    uint8_t visionFaultSource = REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_NONE;
    uint8_t visionFaultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_NONE;
    float loraReplyVx = 0.0f;
    float loraReplyVy = 0.0f;
    float loraReplyWz = 0.0f;
    uint8_t loraReplyValid = 0u;
    uint8_t remoteTakeoffReq = 0u;
    uint8_t mode2MotionGateReady = 0u;
    uint8_t takeoffIdentityReady;
    uint8_t rs485CommandSent = 0u;
    core1TakeoffEpochIdentityInput takeoffIdentityInput;

    if (!initReadyFlag)
    {
        paramSyncGatewayPoll(loopMs);
        return;
    }

    /* planRegion 本轮只读一次：既供 Core3 必需链路安全事实，也供 10ms RS-485 派发，避免同拍多次
     * invalidate/read 得到不同快照。读取碰撞与重复/旧seq保持last-good；只有wrap-aware新seq更新缓存和时间戳。 */
    if ((coreDataReadPlan(&sampledPlan) != 0u) &&
        (sampledPlan.magic == CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC) &&
        (sampledPlan.producerBootGeneration != 0u))
    {
        if ((planSeqPrimed == 0u) ||
            (sampledPlan.producerBootGeneration != runtimeContext.planProducerBootGeneration) ||
            ((int32_t) (sampledPlan.seq - planLastSeq) > 0))
        {
            if (sampledPlan.producerBootGeneration != runtimeContext.planProducerBootGeneration)
            {
                memset(&runtimeContext.lastGoodPlan, 0, sizeof(runtimeContext.lastGoodPlan));
                runtimeContext.lastGoodPlanValid = 0u;
                runtimeContext.mode2MotionGateReady = 0u;
                core1ResetMotionTxFence();
                runtimeContext.planProducerBootGeneration = sampledPlan.producerBootGeneration;
            }
            runtimeContext.lastGoodPlan = sampledPlan;
            runtimeContext.lastGoodPlanValid = 1u;
            planLastSeq = sampledPlan.seq;
            planLastUpdateMs = loopMs;
            planSeqPrimed = 1u;
        }
    }
    if (runtimeContext.lastGoodPlanValid != 0u)
    {
        plan = runtimeContext.lastGoodPlan;
    }
    else
    {
        memset(&plan, 0, sizeof(plan));
    }
    crossCoreLinkGetStatus(&linkBeforePoll);
    /* STATUS bit3始终携带通用必需视觉故障事实。plan身份无效或停更时本核无法证明安全，
     * fail-closed置1；有效plan持续刷新该事实。 */
    if ((plan.magic != CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC) ||
        (core1AgeMs(planSeqPrimed, planLastUpdateMs, REQUIRED_VISION_PLAN_STALE_MS) >=
            REQUIRED_VISION_PLAN_STALE_MS))
    {
        requiredVisionFault = 1u;
        visionFaultSource = REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE1;
        visionFaultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_BRIDGE;
    }
    else if (plan.requiredVisionFault != 0u)
    {
        requiredVisionFault = 1u;
        visionFaultSource = plan.faultSource;
        visionFaultClass = plan.faultClass;
    }

    /* 先排空上一条RS-485请求的Core2应答，再冻结并发布本拍本地事实。旧实现先发STATUS、
     * 后消费清零TELEMETRY，恰逢200ms发送点时会把上一拍M2高电平多发一帧。 */
    {
        uint8_t mode = linkBeforePoll.systemMode;
        chassisLinkReplyStruct decoded;
        while (chassisLinkPollReply(&decoded) != 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.rs485CommandReplyOutstanding = 0u;
            rs485LastReplyMs = loopMs;
            rs485ReplyPrimed = 1u;
            runtimeContext.core2AttitudeFaultLevel = decoded.attitudeFault;
            if (decoded.motionValid)
            {
                loraReplyVx = decoded.vx;
                loraReplyVy = decoded.vy;
                loraReplyWz = decoded.wz;
                loraReplyValid = 1u;
            }
            if (decoded.remoteTakeoffReq != 0u)
            {
                remoteTakeoffReq = 1u;
            }
            if (decoded.mode2LoraLandReqPresent != 0u)
            {
                if (decoded.mode2LoraLandReqLevel != 0u)
                {
                    runtimeMode2LoraLandReqLevel = 1u;
                    mode2LoraLandReqLastMs = loopMs;
                    mode2LoraLandReqPrimed = 1u;
                }
                else
                {
                    runtimeMode2LoraLandReqLevel = 0u;
                    mode2LoraLandReqPrimed = 0u;
                }
            }
        }
        {
            uint8_t core2Alive = core1Core2Alive();
            if ((mode != UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO) || !core2Alive ||
                (core1AgeMs(mode2LoraLandReqPrimed, mode2LoraLandReqLastMs,
                     MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ_STALE_MS) >= MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ_STALE_MS))
            {
                runtimeMode2LoraLandReqLevel = 0u;
                if ((mode != UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO) || !core2Alive)
                {
                    mode2LoraLandReqPrimed = 0u;
                }
            }
            mode2LoraLandReqPublished = (uint8_t) ((mode == UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO) && core2Alive &&
                                                   (runtimeMode2LoraLandReqLevel != 0u));
        }
    }

    /* 上报 core2 链路存活给 crossCoreLink：经 STATUS 帧(与心跳同周期 200ms 常发)转发 core0，
     * core0 landingSupervisor 聚合 (!core1Alive || core2Lost) → 任一断联缓降。每轮刷新，发由 Poll 节流。 */
    localFacts.core2LinkLost = core1Core2Alive() ? 0u : 1u;
    localFacts.core2AttitudeFault = localFacts.core2LinkLost ? 0u : runtimeContext.core2AttitudeFaultLevel;
    localFacts.requiredVisionFault = requiredVisionFault;
    localFacts.faultSource = visionFaultSource;
    localFacts.faultClass = visionFaultClass;
    localFacts.mode2LoraLandReq = mode2LoraLandReqPublished;
    localFacts.beaconStateValid = (uint8_t) ((plan.magic == CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC) &&
                                             planSeqPrimed && (plan.planTimeoutMs != 0u) &&
                                             (core1AgeMs(planSeqPrimed, planLastUpdateMs, 0xFFFFu) < plan.planTimeoutMs));
    localFacts.beaconCount = localFacts.beaconStateValid ? plan.beaconCount : 0u;
    localFacts.beaconSearching = localFacts.beaconStateValid ? plan.beaconSearching : 0u;
    localFacts.beaconSearchTimedOut = localFacts.beaconStateValid ? plan.beaconSearchTimedOut : 0u;
    crossCoreLinkPublishLocalFacts(&localFacts);

    crossCoreLinkPoll();
    if (crossCoreLinkTakeCore0PeerRearm() != 0u)
    {
        core1ResetMotionTxFence();
    }
    crossCoreLinkGetStatus(&linkAfterPoll);
    /* 本拍唯一一次plan采样和两条安全链路的RX排空均已完成。网关复用
     * 最新last-good与停车事实，避免读碰撞清桥或沿用上一拍状态接收请求。 */
    paramSyncGatewayPoll(loopMs);
    if (linkAfterPoll.core0Alive == 0u)
    {
        /* 物理失链期间不发送MOTION，并撤销发送身份。重连后的第一次真实请求
         * 必经core1SendMotionWithZeroFence先发零，闭合Core0超时后的rearm契约。 */
        core1ResetMotionTxFence();
    }

    /* 模式2每个飞行episode必须观察到cm_7_1发布的新
     * (producerBootGeneration,takeoffMotionEpoch)元组和新鲜解锁plan。
     * producer重启时即使epoch数值与旧代碰撞，新代身份仍可在自身安全门解锁后恢复；
     * STATUS空窗及飞行中altReached短暂撤销只归零，不重登记活动episode基线。 */
    memset(&takeoffIdentityInput, 0, sizeof(takeoffIdentityInput));
    takeoffIdentityInput.planIdentityValid = (uint8_t) (plan.magic == CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC &&
                                                        plan.producerBootGeneration != 0u);
    takeoffIdentityInput.planProducerGeneration =
        plan.producerBootGeneration;
    takeoffIdentityInput.planEpoch = plan.takeoffMotionEpoch;
    takeoffIdentityInput.core0StatusUsable = (uint8_t) (linkAfterPoll.core0Alive != 0u &&
                                                        linkAfterPoll.core0StatusValid != 0u);
    takeoffIdentityInput.mode2Active = (uint8_t) (linkAfterPoll.systemMode == UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO);
    takeoffIdentityInput.launched = linkAfterPoll.core0Launched;
    takeoffIdentityInput.altReached = linkAfterPoll.altReached;
    takeoffIdentityReady = core1TakeoffEpochIdentityStep(
        &runtimeContext.takeoffEpochIdentity, &takeoffIdentityInput);
    mode2MotionGateReady = (uint8_t) (takeoffIdentityReady != 0u &&
                                      plan.magic == CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC && plan.valid != 0u &&
                                      plan.dispatchEnable != 0u && plan.motionUnlocked != 0u &&
                                      plan.takeoffMotionEpoch != 0u &&
                                      core1AgeMs(planSeqPrimed, planLastUpdateMs, 0xFFFFu) < plan.planTimeoutMs &&
                                      chassisLinkMotionValid(plan.vx, plan.vy, plan.wz));
    runtimeContext.mode2MotionGateReady = mode2MotionGateReady;

    /* RS-485 总线主: 周期发 MSG_COMMAND(请求), 驱动 core2 回应答帧。命令携带发车门控位 + sysByte:
     *   core0 链路活 → ENABLE; core0 已发车(闭环) → LAUNCH; core0 链路丢 → ESTOP(车停)。
     *   sysByte: 控制源按 core0 系统模式(模式3→LoRa, 模式1/2/未设→485, 覆盖 core2 本地源) + 中转 core0 蜂鸣码。
     *   运动 vx/vy/wz: 模式2(RS485自主)且 cm_7_1 规划新鲜有效时取 planRegion；模式1/3/未设保持零速。
     * 先发命令再 Poll 收 core2 应答(本轮发完即切回收, 应答多在后续 whileProcess 轮次收到)。 */
    if ((uint32_t) (loopMs - rs485LastCommandMs) >= RS485_COMMAND_PERIOD_MS &&
        paramSyncGatewayCore2ReplyTurnaroundActive(loopMs) == 0u)
    {
        uint8_t cmd = 0u;
        uint8_t sysByte = 0u;
        uint8_t buzzer;
        uint8_t mode = linkAfterPoll.systemMode;
        float vx = 0.0f, vy = 0.0f, wz = 0.0f; /* 下发 core2 的运动量, 默认零速 */
        rs485LastCommandMs = loopMs;
        if (linkAfterPoll.core0Alive &&
            linkAfterPoll.core0StatusValid)
        {
            cmd |= CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_ENABLE;
            cmd |= CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_CORE0_ALIVE; /* 转告 core2：core0 核间链路活（供 core2 等待屏全链路门控 + 全通蜂鸣三声） */
            /* 车发车门控接飞机到顶信号：飞机已发车(闭环) 且 自动起飞时序已到巡航高(altReached)
             * 才置 LAUNCH。到顶前 altReached=0 → 车禁主动移动，避免起飞期(等待/爬高)车先动撞系留机。 */
            if (linkAfterPoll.core0Launched && linkAfterPoll.altReached &&
                (mode != UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO ||
                    mode2MotionGateReady != 0u))
            {
                cmd |= CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_LAUNCH;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            cmd |= CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_ESTOP; /* core0 链路丢 → 命令车急停/等待 */
        }
        /* 控制源: core0 系统模式 3(LoRa 转发) → LoRa, 其余(车不动/RS-485自主/未设) → RS-485。 */
        if (mode == UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_LORA_FWD)
        {
            sysByte |= CHASSIS_LINK_SYS_SOURCE_LORA;
        }
        /* 中转 core0 蜂鸣模式码(uartLinkProto 与 chassisLink BUZZER_* 同值)给 core2 代鸣。 */
        buzzer = (uint8_t) (linkAfterPoll.buzzer & CHASSIS_LINK_SYS_BUZZER_MASK);
        sysByte |= (uint8_t) (buzzer << CHASSIS_LINK_SYS_BUZZER_SHIFT);

        /* 运动来源: 仅"模式2(RS485自主) + 规划新鲜有效 + 派发开关开 + 三轴有效"才用 cm_7_1 规划值; 否则零速。
         * 派发总开关/超时改运行时(随 planToLinkStruct 跨核传来, 无编译期宏)。模式1(车不动)/模式3(LoRa转发)
         * 恒零速——模式3 车用本地 LoRa, 不消费此 vx/vy/wz。Core1 beaconNavigator 负责规划幅值/斜率/Min/TD;
         * Core2 仍按车体物理边界钳位并做麦轮归一化。非法(NaN/Inf/越界) plan fail-closed 归零。 */
        if (mode == UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO && mode2MotionGateReady != 0u && plan.magic == CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC && plan.valid != 0u && plan.dispatchEnable != 0u && core1AgeMs(planSeqPrimed, planLastUpdateMs, 0xFFFFu) < plan.planTimeoutMs && chassisLinkMotionValid(plan.vx, plan.vy, plan.wz))
        {
            vx = plan.vx;
            vy = plan.vy;
            wz = (plan.state == CORE1_PLAN_STATE_SEARCH) ? plan.wz : 0.0f;
        }
        chassisLinkSendCommand(vx, vy, wz, cmd, sysByte);
        runtimeContext.rs485CommandRequestMs = loopMs;
        runtimeContext.rs485CommandReplyOutstanding = 1u;
        rs485CommandSent = 1u;

        /* 抄送 core0 飞控前馈：模式2非零值实时发送；非零→零、规划失效或退出模式2时
         * 只发一次显式零边沿，稳态零不周期续鲜。首次/静默300ms后的真实值先经过零fence，
         * 下一拍再发送非零。模式3 LoRa→MOTION在下方应答块处理，与此按模式互斥。 */
        if (linkAfterPoll.core0Alive && mode == UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO &&
            (vx != 0.0f || vy != 0.0f || wz != 0.0f))
        {
            runtimeContext.mode2MotionNonzeroSent =
                core1SendMotionWithZeroFence(vx, vy, wz, 0u);
        }
        else if (runtimeContext.mode2MotionNonzeroSent != 0u)
        {
            (void) core1SendMotionWithZeroFence(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0u);
            runtimeContext.mode2MotionNonzeroSent = 0u;
        }
    }

    /* 参数事务只能占用本拍未发送控制命令的RS-485空隙；命令/心跳始终优先。 */
    paramSyncGatewayServiceExternal(loopMs, (uint8_t) (
        rs485CommandSent == 0u &&
        (runtimeContext.rs485CommandReplyOutstanding == 0u ||
         (uint32_t) (loopMs - runtimeContext.rs485CommandRequestMs) >=
            PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_RS485_REPLY_GUARD_MS) &&
        (uint32_t) (loopMs - rs485LastCommandMs) +
            PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_RS485_REPLY_GUARD_MS <
            RS485_COMMAND_PERIOD_MS));

    /* 仅在收到有效运动帧时发MOTION。应答已在本拍发布STATUS事实前排空；这里等待
     * crossCoreLinkPoll更新Core0链路身份后再决定是否转发，保持重连zero-fence契约。 */
    if ((loraReplyValid != 0u) &&
        (linkAfterPoll.core0Alive != 0u) &&
        (linkAfterPoll.systemMode == UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_LORA_FWD))
    {
        (void) core1SendMotionWithZeroFence(
            loraReplyVx, loraReplyVy, loraReplyWz, remoteTakeoffReq);
    }

}

uint8_t paramSyncGatewayPlatformTargetMask(void)
{
    crossCoreLinkStatusStruct link;
    uint8_t mask = 0u;
    crossCoreLinkGetStatus(&link);
    if (initReadyFlag != 0u) mask |= 0x02u;
    if (link.core0Alive && link.core0StatusValid) mask |= 0x01u;
    if (core1Core2Alive()) mask |= 0x04u;
    if (core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeReady(
            &runtimeContext.observerParamBridge[0], loopMs) != 0u)
        mask |= 0x08u;
    if (core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeReady(
            &runtimeContext.observerParamBridge[1], loopMs) != 0u)
        mask |= 0x10u;
    return mask;
}

void paramSyncGatewayPlatformPoll(uint32_t nowMs)
{
    core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct bridge;
    uint8_t i;
    for (i = 0u; i < 2u; i++)
    {
        core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeCache *cache =
            &runtimeContext.observerParamBridge[i];
        uint8_t source = (uint8_t) (i + 3u);
        uint8_t bridgeRead = 0u;
        bridgeRead = coreDataTryReadParamObserverBridge(source, &bridge);
        core1ParamSyncObserverBridgePoll(cache,
            bridgeRead != 0u ? &bridge : 0, nowMs);
    }
}

#include "core1ContinuityIdentity.h"

#include <string.h>

void core1ContinuityIdentityReset(core1ContinuityIdentityState *state)
{
    if (state != 0) memset(state, 0, sizeof(*state));
}

uint8_t core1ContinuityIdentityObserve(core1ContinuityIdentityState *state,
    const core1ContinuityIdentityInput *input)
{
    uint8_t changed;
    if ((state == 0) || (input == 0)) return 0u;
    if (state->primed == 0u)
    {
        state->last = *input;
        state->primed = 1u;
        return 0u;
    }
    changed = (uint8_t) (memcmp(&state->last, input, sizeof(*input)) != 0);
    state->last = *input;
    return changed;
}

uint8_t core1ContinuityIdentityApply(core1ContinuityIdentityState *state,
    const core1ContinuityIdentityInput *input,
    beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    uint8_t *barrierPending,
    uint8_t *planForceStep)
{
    if ((continuity == 0) || (barrierPending == 0) ||
        (planForceStep == 0)) return 0u;
    if (core1ContinuityIdentityObserve(state, input) == 0u) return 0u;
    beaconTargetContinuityInit(continuity);
    *barrierPending = 1u;
    *planForceStep = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

    CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_PACK(CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_CORE0, CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_NONE);

static uint8_t displayTarget(uint8_t target)
{
    if (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) return CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_CORE0;
    if (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) return CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_CORE1;
    if (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) return CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_CORE3;
    if (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) return CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_CORE4;

}

        displayTarget(inputOwner()));

static uint8_t deadlineReached(uint32_t nowMs, uint32_t deadlineMs)
{
    return (uint8_t) (((int32_t) (nowMs - deadlineMs)) >= 0);
}

static uint8_t observerTargetKvmEligible(uint8_t target,
    const core3LinkCore1Status *link, const core4LinkCore1Status *core4)
{
    const observerLinkCore1EndpointStatus *status;
    const uint32_t required = OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_KVM |
        OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_MENU_STATUS;

    if (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) status = link;
    else if (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) status = core4;
    else return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) ((status->online != 0u) &&
        (status->protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
        ((status->peerCapabilities & required) == required));
}

static uint8_t inputOwner(void)
{
    uint8_t requiredValid;

    if ((g_router.routeAccepted == 0u) || (g_router.leaseValid == 0u))
        return UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    if (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0)
    {
        return ((g_router.status.flags & UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE1_VALID) != 0u) &&
            (g_router.upstreamControlActive == 0u)
            ? UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0 : UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    }
    requiredValid = (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1)
        ? UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE1_VALID : UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE3_VALID;
    return ((g_router.upstreamControlActive != 0u) &&
        ((g_router.status.flags & requiredValid) != 0u))
        ? g_router.target : UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
}

static uint8_t mapCore3Result(uint8_t result, uint8_t flags)
{
    if ((flags & OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_ACK_FLAG_DUPLICATE) != 0u) return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_DUPLICATE;
    switch (result)
    {
        case OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_EXECUTED: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_EXECUTED;
        case OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_UNHANDLED: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_UNHANDLED;
        case OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_NO_LEASE: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NO_LEASE;
        case OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_WRONG_TARGET: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_WRONG_TARGET;
        case OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_STALE_EPOCH: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_STALE_ROUTE;
        case OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_GLOBAL_EVENT_REJECTED: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_GLOBAL_EVENT_REJECTED;
        case OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_GAP: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_GAP;
        case OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_OLD_SEQ: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_OLD_EVENT;
        default: return UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_BAD_PAYLOAD;
    }
}

static uint32_t nextEventSeq(uint32_t value)
{
    value++;
    return (value != 0u) ? value : 1u;
}

static uint8_t eventSeqNewer(uint32_t value, uint32_t reference)
{
    return (uint8_t)((value != reference) &&
        ((uint32_t)(value - reference) < 0x80000000u));
}

static uint8_t eventSeqReached(uint32_t value, uint32_t reference)
{
    if (reference == 0u) return 1u;
    if (value == 0u) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) ((value == reference) ||
        eventSeqNewer(value, reference));
}

static void setTerminalAck(uint32_t eventSeq, uint8_t result)
{
    g_router.status.ackEventSeq = eventSeq;
    g_router.status.ackResult = result;
    g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ACK_TERMINAL;
    g_router.completedSeq = eventSeq;
    g_router.completedResult = result;
}

static void completeCurrentEvent(uint32_t eventSeq, uint8_t result,
    uint8_t menuState, uint8_t homeReady)
{
    menuStatusSnapshotStruct menuStatus;
    menuGetStatus(&menuStatus);
    setTerminalAck(eventSeq, result);
    g_router.expectedSeq = nextEventSeq(g_router.expectedSeq);
    g_router.causalHomeValid = 1u;
    g_router.causalHome = homeReady;
    g_router.causalMenuState = menuState;
    g_router.causalMenuTick = menuStatus.tickSeq;
}

static void cancelPendingEvent(uint8_t result)
{
    uint32_t eventSeq = 0u;
    if (g_router.localEventPending != 0u) eventSeq = g_router.localEventSeq;
    else if (g_router.core3EventPending != 0u) eventSeq = g_router.expectedSeq;
    menuKeyRemoteRevoke();
    g_router.localEventPending = 0u;
    g_router.core3EventPending = 0u;
    g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
    g_router.causalHomeValid = 0u;
    if (eventSeq != 0u) setTerminalAck(eventSeq, result);
}

static void enforceActiveObserverEligibility(
    const core3LinkCore1Status *link, const core4LinkCore1Status *core4)
{
    if (((g_router.target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) &&
         (g_router.target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)) ||
        (observerTargetKvmEligible(g_router.target, link, core4) != 0u))
    {
        return;
    }
    if ((g_router.routeAccepted != 0u) || (g_router.leaseValid != 0u) ||
        (g_router.localEventPending != 0u) ||
        (g_router.core3EventPending != 0u) ||
        (g_router.core3ControlPending != 0u))
    {
        cancelPendingEvent(UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NO_LEASE);
    }
    g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
    g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
    g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
    g_router.causalHomeValid = 0u;
    g_router.status.activeTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    g_router.status.flags &= (uint8_t) ~(UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE3_VALID |
        UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE3_HOME |
        UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ROUTE_ACCEPTED |
        UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_LEASE_VALID);
    g_router.status.menuStates &= 0x0Fu;
    g_router.status.core3AgeMs = 0xFFFFu;
    publishDisplayState();
}

static void resetRoute(uint32_t routeSession, uint32_t routeEpoch, uint8_t target)
{
    menuKeyRemoteRevoke();
    g_router.status.routeSession = routeSession;
    g_router.status.routeEpoch = routeEpoch;
    g_router.status.ackEventSeq = 0u;
    g_router.status.ackResult = UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NONE;
    g_router.status.flags = 0u;
    g_router.expectedSeq = 1u;
    g_router.completedSeq = 0u;
    g_router.completedResult = UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NONE;
    g_router.localEventPending = 0u;
    g_router.core3EventPending = 0u;
    g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
    g_router.causalHomeValid = 0u;
    g_router.target = target;
    g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
    g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
    g_router.lastIngressEventSeq = 0u;
}

static uint32_t targetSession(uint8_t target, const core3LinkCore1Status *link,
    const core4LinkCore1Status *core4)
{
    if (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) return link->peerSession;
    if (target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) return core4->peerSession;
    return g_router.status.routerSession;
}

static void applyControl(const core1KvmIngressStruct *ingress,
    const core3LinkCore1Status *link, const core4LinkCore1Status *core4,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t session;
    uint8_t routeChanged = (uint8_t) ((ingress->routeSession != g_router.status.routeSession) ||
        (ingress->routeEpoch != g_router.status.routeEpoch) ||
        (ingress->target != g_router.target));
    if (routeChanged != 0u)
    {
        resetRoute(ingress->routeSession, ingress->routeEpoch, ingress->target);
    }
    g_router.status.target = ingress->target;
    session = targetSession(ingress->target, link, core4);
    g_router.status.targetSession = session;
    if ((ingress->leaseMs == 0u) || (ingress->leaseMs > CORE1_KVM_MAX_LEASE_MS) ||
        ((ingress->target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) &&
         (ingress->target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) &&
         (ingress->target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) &&
         (ingress->target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)) ||
        (session == 0u) ||
        ((ingress->target != UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) &&
         (ingress->targetSession != session)))
    {
        g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
        g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (observerTargetKvmEligible(ingress->target, link, core4) == 0u)
    {
        g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
        g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
        return;
    }
    g_router.leaseValid = 1u;
    g_router.leaseDeadlineMs = tickMs + ingress->leaseMs;
    if ((ingress->target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
        (ingress->target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4))
    {
        observerLinkKvmControl control;
        memset(&control, 0, sizeof(control));
        control.targetSession = session;
        control.routeSession = ingress->routeSession;
        control.routeEpoch = ingress->routeEpoch;
        control.leaseMs = ingress->leaseMs;
        control.target = ingress->target;
        g_router.core3ControlPending = (ingress->target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ?
            core3LinkCore1QueueKvmControl(&control) :
            core4LinkCore1QueueKvmControl(&control);
        if (g_router.core3ControlPending == 0u)
        {
            g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
            g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
        }
    }
    else g_router.routeAccepted = 1u;
}

static void rejectEvent(const core1KvmIngressStruct *ingress, uint8_t result)
{
    setTerminalAck(ingress->eventSeq, result);
}

static void applyEvent(const core1KvmIngressStruct *ingress,
    const core3LinkCore1Status *link, const core4LinkCore1Status *core4)
{
    menuStatusSnapshotStruct menuStatus;
    uint32_t session = targetSession(ingress->target, link, core4);
    menuGetStatus(&menuStatus);
    if ((ingress->routeSession != g_router.status.routeSession) ||
        (ingress->routeEpoch != g_router.status.routeEpoch))
    {
        rejectEvent(ingress, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_STALE_ROUTE);
        return;
    }
    if ((ingress->target != g_router.target) || (ingress->targetSession != session))
    {
        rejectEvent(ingress, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_WRONG_TARGET);
        return;
    }
    if (observerTargetKvmEligible(ingress->target, link, core4) == 0u)
    {
        rejectEvent(ingress, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NO_LEASE);
        return;
    }
    if ((ingress->keyId >= 5u) || (ingress->keyState < 1u) || (ingress->keyState > 2u))
    {
        rejectEvent(ingress, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_BAD_PAYLOAD);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_router.routeAccepted == 0u) || (g_router.leaseValid == 0u))
    {
        rejectEvent(ingress, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NO_LEASE);
        return;
    }
    if ((ingress->eventSeq == g_router.completedSeq) &&
        (g_router.completedSeq != 0u))
    {
        setTerminalAck(ingress->eventSeq, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_DUPLICATE);
        return;
    }
    if ((ingress->eventSeq == 0u) ||
        ((ingress->eventSeq != g_router.expectedSeq) &&
         (eventSeqNewer(ingress->eventSeq, g_router.expectedSeq) == 0u)))
    {
        rejectEvent(ingress, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_OLD_EVENT);
        return;
    }
    if (ingress->eventSeq != g_router.expectedSeq)
    {
        rejectEvent(ingress, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_GAP);
        return;
    }
    if (g_router.localEventPending != 0u) return;
    g_router.status.flags &= (uint8_t) ~UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ACK_TERMINAL;
    g_router.causalHomeValid = 0u;
    if (ingress->target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1)
    {
        if ((menuStatus.inputReady == 0u) ||
            (menuKeyRemoteInject(ingress->keyId, ingress->keyState) == 0u))
        {
            completeCurrentEvent(ingress->eventSeq, UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_BUSY,
                menuStatus.state, menuStatus.homeReady);
            return;
        }
        g_router.localEventPending = 1u;
        g_router.localEventSeq = ingress->eventSeq;
        g_router.localEventMenuTick = menuStatus.tickSeq;
        g_router.localKeyId = ingress->keyId;
    }
    else
    {
        observerLinkKvmEvent event;
        memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
        event.targetSession = session;
        event.routeSession = ingress->routeSession;
        event.routeEpoch = ingress->routeEpoch;
        event.eventSeq = ingress->eventSeq;
        event.target = ingress->target;
        event.keyId = ingress->keyId;
        event.keyState = (uint8_t) (ingress->keyState - 1u);
        if (ingress->target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3)
            (void) core3LinkCore1QueueKvmEvent(&event);
        else
            (void) core4LinkCore1QueueKvmEvent(&event);
        g_router.core3EventPending = 1u;
    }
}

static void finishEvents(void)
{
    observerLinkKvmAck ack;
    menuStatusSnapshotStruct menuStatus;
    menuGetStatus(&menuStatus);
    if (g_router.localEventPending != 0u)
    {
        if (menuStatus.tickSeq != g_router.localEventMenuTick)
        {
            uint8_t consumed = menuKeyRemoteTakeConsumed(g_router.localKeyId);
            if (consumed == 0u) menuKeyRemoteRevoke();
            completeCurrentEvent(g_router.localEventSeq,
                consumed ? UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_EXECUTED : UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_UNHANDLED,
                menuStatus.state, menuStatus.homeReady);
            g_router.localEventPending = 0u;
        }
    }
    while (((g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ?
        core3LinkCore1TakeKvmAck(&ack) : core4LinkCore1TakeKvmAck(&ack)) != 0u)
    {
        if ((ack.targetSession == g_router.status.targetSession) &&
            (ack.routeSession == g_router.status.routeSession) &&
            (ack.routeEpoch == g_router.status.routeEpoch) &&
            (ack.eventSeq == g_router.expectedSeq) &&
            (g_router.core3EventPending != 0u))
        {
            uint8_t result = mapCore3Result(ack.result, ack.flags);
            uint8_t ackValid = 1u;
            uint32_t requiredExpected = g_router.expectedSeq;
            if ((result == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_EXECUTED) ||
                (result == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_UNHANDLED) ||
                (result == UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_DUPLICATE))
                requiredExpected = nextEventSeq(requiredExpected);
            if (ack.expectedSeq != requiredExpected)
            {
                result = UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_BAD_PAYLOAD;
                requiredExpected = g_router.expectedSeq;
                ackValid = 0u;
            }
            setTerminalAck(ack.eventSeq, result);
            g_router.expectedSeq = requiredExpected;
            g_router.core3EventPending = 0u;
            g_router.causalHomeValid = ackValid;
            if (ackValid != 0u)
            {
                g_router.causalHome = (uint8_t) (
                    (ack.flags & OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_ACK_FLAG_HOME_READY) != 0u);
                g_router.causalMenuState = ack.menuState;
            }
        }
    }
}

static uint8_t updateBaseSnapshot(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    keyEventToMenuStruct next;

    if (coreDataTryReadKeyEvent(&next) != 0u)
    {
        g_router.baseSnapshot = next;
        g_router.baseLastGoodTickMs = tickMs;
        g_router.baseSnapshotAgeMs = 0u;
        g_router.baseSnapshotValid = 1u;
    }
    else if ((g_router.baseSnapshotValid == 0u) ||
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_router.baseLastGoodTickMs) >=
         CORE1_KVM_BASE_READ_TIMEOUT_MS))
    {
        memset(&g_router.baseSnapshot, 0, sizeof(g_router.baseSnapshot));
        g_router.baseSnapshotAgeMs = 0xFFFFu;
        g_router.baseSnapshotValid = 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        uint32_t age = (uint32_t) (tickMs - g_router.baseLastGoodTickMs);
        g_router.baseSnapshotAgeMs = (age > 0xFFFFu) ? 0xFFFFu :
            (uint16_t) age;
    }
    return g_router.baseSnapshotValid;
}

static void publishStatus(uint32_t tickMs, const core3LinkCore1Status *link,
    const core4LinkCore1Status *core4)
{
    observerLinkKvmMenuStatus core3Menu;
    uint32_t core3Age = UINT32_MAX;
    const keyEventToMenuStruct *base = &g_router.baseSnapshot;
    menuStatusSnapshotStruct menuStatus;
    uint8_t core1Home;
    uint8_t observerMenuAvailable = 0u;
    uint8_t observerEligible = observerTargetKvmEligible(
        g_router.target, link, core4);
    menuGetStatus(&menuStatus);
    core1Home = menuStatus.homeReady;
    uint8_t useCausal = (uint8_t) (
        ((g_router.status.flags & UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ACK_TERMINAL) != 0u) &&
        (g_router.causalHomeValid != 0u));

    if ((useCausal != 0u) &&
        (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) &&
        (menuStatus.tickSeq != g_router.causalMenuTick))
    {
        g_router.causalHomeValid = 0u;
        useCausal = 0u;
    }

    g_router.status.magic = CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    g_router.status.target = g_router.target;
    g_router.status.activeTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    g_router.status.targetSession = targetSession(g_router.target, link, core4);
    g_router.status.menuStates = (uint8_t) (menuStatus.state & 0x0Fu);
    g_router.status.paramTargetMask = 0x02u;
    if (link->online && link->protocolCompatible &&
        ((link->peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PARAM_SYNC) != 0u))
        g_router.status.paramTargetMask |= 0x08u;
    if (core4->online && core4->protocolCompatible &&
        ((core4->peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PARAM_SYNC) != 0u))
        g_router.status.paramTargetMask |= 0x10u;
    g_router.status.flags &= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ACK_TERMINAL | UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_PEER_RESTART;
    if ((g_router.baseSnapshotValid != 0u) &&
        (base->ready == CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC) && (base->linkUp != 0u))
    {
        g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE1_VALID;
        if (((useCausal != 0u) && (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1))
                ? g_router.causalHome : core1Home)
            g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE1_HOME;
    }
    if ((observerEligible != 0u) && (g_router.leaseValid != 0u) &&
        ((g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
         (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)))
    {
        observerMenuAvailable = (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) ?
            core4LinkCore1GetKvmMenuStatus(&core3Menu, tickMs, &core3Age) :
            core3LinkCore1GetKvmMenuStatus(&core3Menu, tickMs, &core3Age);
    }
    if ((observerMenuAvailable != 0u) &&
        (core3Age < CORE1_KVM_CORE3_FRESH_MS) &&
        (core3Menu.targetSession == ((g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) ?
            core4->peerSession : link->peerSession)) &&
        (core3Menu.routeSession == g_router.status.routeSession) &&
        (core3Menu.routeEpoch == g_router.status.routeEpoch) &&
        (core3Menu.target == g_router.target) &&
        ((core3Menu.flags & OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_LEASE_VALID) != 0u) &&
        (eventSeqReached(core3Menu.lastEventSeq, g_router.completedSeq) ||
         ((useCausal != 0u) && ((g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
                                (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)))))
    {
        uint8_t core3State;
        if (((g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
             (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)) &&
            (g_router.completedSeq != 0u) &&
            eventSeqReached(core3Menu.lastEventSeq,
                g_router.completedSeq))
        {
            g_router.causalHomeValid = 0u;
            useCausal = 0u;
        }
        if (((g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
             (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)) &&
            (g_router.leaseValid != 0u))
        {
            g_router.routeAccepted = 1u;
            g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
        }
        g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE3_VALID;
        if (((useCausal != 0u) && ((g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
                                  (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)))
                ? g_router.causalHome
                : ((core3Menu.flags & OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_HOME_READY) != 0u))
            g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE3_HOME;
        core3State = ((useCausal != 0u) &&
            ((g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
             (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)))
                ? g_router.causalMenuState : core3Menu.menuState;
        g_router.status.menuStates |= (uint8_t) ((core3State & 0x0Fu) << 4);
    }
    g_router.status.activeTarget = inputOwner();
    publishDisplayState();
    if (g_router.routeAccepted != 0u) g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_ROUTE_ACCEPTED;
    if (g_router.leaseValid != 0u) g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_LEASE_VALID;
    g_router.status.core3AgeMs = (core3Age > 0xFFFFu) ? 0xFFFFu : (uint16_t) core3Age;
    coreDataWriteKvmStatus(&g_router.status);
}

void core1KvmRouterInit(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    core3LinkCore1Status link;
    core4LinkCore1Status core4;
    (void) tickMs;
    memset(&g_router, 0, sizeof(g_router));
    core3LinkCore1GetStatus(&link);
    core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4);
    g_router.status.routerSession = (link.localSession ^ 0x4B564D31u) | 1u;
    g_router.status.targetSession = g_router.status.routerSession;
    g_router.status.target = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    g_router.status.activeTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    publishDisplayState();
    g_router.expectedSeq = 1u;
    g_router.target = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    g_router.lastPeerSession = link.peerSession;
    g_router.lastCore4PeerSession = core4.peerSession;
    g_router.status.magic = CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    coreDataWriteKvmStatus(&g_router.status);
}

void core1KvmRouterIngress(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    core1KvmIngressStruct ingress;
    core3LinkCore1Status link;
    core4LinkCore1Status core4;
    const keyEventToMenuStruct *base;
    uint8_t baseValid;

    core3LinkCore1GetStatus(&link);
    core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4);
    if (link.peerSession != g_router.lastPeerSession)
    {
        if ((g_router.lastPeerSession != 0u) &&
            (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3))
        {
            cancelPendingEvent(UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_PEER_RESTART);
            g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
            g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
            g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
            g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_PEER_RESTART;
        }
        g_router.lastPeerSession = link.peerSession;
    }
    if (core4.peerSession != g_router.lastCore4PeerSession)
    {
        if ((g_router.lastCore4PeerSession != 0u) &&
            (g_router.target == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4))
        {
            cancelPendingEvent(UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_PEER_RESTART);
            g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
            g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
            g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
            g_router.status.flags |= UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_PEER_RESTART;
        }
        g_router.lastCore4PeerSession = core4.peerSession;
    }
    baseValid = updateBaseSnapshot(tickMs);
    base = &g_router.baseSnapshot;
    if ((baseValid != 0u) && (base->ready == CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC))
    {
        g_router.upstreamControlActive = base->controlActive;
        if (base->linkUp == 0u)
        {
            cancelPendingEvent(UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NO_LEASE);
            g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
            g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
            g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
        }
    }
    else if (baseValid == 0u)
    {
        cancelPendingEvent(UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NO_LEASE);
        g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
        g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
        g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
    }
    if ((g_router.leaseValid != 0u) && deadlineReached(tickMs, g_router.leaseDeadlineMs))
    {
        cancelPendingEvent(UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NO_LEASE);
        g_router.leaseValid = 0u;
        g_router.routeAccepted = 0u;
        g_router.core3ControlPending = 0u;
    }
    enforceActiveObserverEligibility(&link, &core4);
    coreDataReadKvmIngress(&ingress);
    if ((ingress.magic == CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC) &&
        (ingress.updateSeq != g_router.lastIngressSeq))
    {
        g_router.lastIngressSeq = ingress.updateSeq;
        if ((ingress.flags & CORE1_KVM_INGRESS_CONTROL_VALID) != 0u)
            applyControl(&ingress, &link, &core4, tickMs);
        if (((ingress.flags & CORE1_KVM_INGRESS_EVENT_VALID) != 0u) &&
            ((ingress.eventSeq != g_router.lastIngressEventSeq) ||
             ((ingress.flags & CORE1_KVM_INGRESS_EVENT_EDGE) != 0u)))
        {
            g_router.lastIngressEventSeq = ingress.eventSeq;
            applyEvent(&ingress, &link, &core4);
        }
    }
    menuKeyRemoteSetLinkState(
        (uint8_t) ((baseValid != 0u) &&
            (base->ready == CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC) && (base->linkUp != 0u)),
        (uint8_t) (inputOwner() == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1),
        (baseValid != 0u) ? base->core2LinkLost : 1u);
}

void core1KvmRouterFinalize(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    core3LinkCore1Status link;
    core4LinkCore1Status core4;

    core3LinkCore1GetStatus(&link);
    core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4);
    enforceActiveObserverEligibility(&link, &core4);
    finishEvents();
    publishStatus(tickMs, &link, &core4);
    g_router.snapshotSeq++;
}

void core1KvmRouterGetSnapshot(core1KvmRouterSnapshot *out)
{
    if (out == 0) return;
    out->seq = g_router.snapshotSeq;
    out->routeSession = g_router.status.routeSession;
    out->routeEpoch = g_router.status.routeEpoch;
    out->targetSession = g_router.status.targetSession;
    out->core3AgeMs = g_router.status.core3AgeMs;
    out->desiredTarget = g_router.target;
    out->inputOwner = inputOwner();
    out->routeAccepted = g_router.routeAccepted;
    out->leaseValid = g_router.leaseValid;
    out->core1Valid = (uint8_t) ((g_router.status.flags & UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE1_VALID) != 0u);
    out->core3Valid = (uint8_t) ((g_router.status.flags & UART_LINK_KVM_FLAG_CORE3_VALID) != 0u);
    out->eventPending = (uint8_t) ((g_router.localEventPending != 0u) ||
        (g_router.core3EventPending != 0u) || (g_router.core3ControlPending != 0u));
    out->ackResult = g_router.status.ackResult;
    out->valid = 1u;
}

void core1KvmRouterGetSystemFacts(core1SystemFactsSnapshot *out)
{
    const keyEventToMenuStruct *base;
    if (out == 0) return;
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
    if (g_router.baseSnapshotValid == 0u) return;
    base = &g_router.baseSnapshot;
    out->ready = (uint8_t) (base->ready == CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC);
    out->linkUp = base->linkUp;
    out->core0StatusValid = base->core0StatusValid;
    out->core2LinkLost = base->core2LinkLost;
    out->core0SafetyState = base->core0SafetyState;
    out->core0StatusFlags = base->core0StatusFlags;
    out->core0RgbIntent = base->core0RgbIntent;
    out->core0SystemMode = base->core0SystemMode;
    out->core0AltReached = base->core0AltReached;
    out->baseAgeMs = g_router.baseSnapshotAgeMs;
}

uint8_t core1KvmRouterGetDisplayStateIsr(void)
{
    return g_displayState;
}

static uint16_t adaptObserverTracks(const observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *wire,
    uint8_t expectedSource,
    beaconConfirmedStruct *tracks)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if ((wire == NULL) || (tracks == NULL) || (wire->valid == 0u) ||
        (wire->sourceId != expectedSource) ||
        (wire->retainedCount > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS)) return 0u;
    memset(tracks, 0, sizeof(runtimeCore4Tracks));
    for (i = 0u; i < wire->retainedCount; i++)
    {
        tracks[i].centerX = wire->tracks[i].centerX;
        tracks[i].centerY = wire->tracks[i].centerY;
        tracks[i].predX = wire->tracks[i].predX;
        tracks[i].predY = wire->tracks[i].predY;
        tracks[i].size = wire->tracks[i].size;
        tracks[i].predSize = wire->tracks[i].predSize;
        tracks[i].trackId = wire->tracks[i].trackId;
        tracks[i].misses = wire->tracks[i].misses;
        tracks[i].fresh = (wire->tracks[i].flags &
                              OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_FRESH)
                              ? 1u
                              : 0u;
        tracks[i].flags = wire->tracks[i].flags;
        tracks[i].frameSeq = wire->trackerFrameSeq;
        tracks[i].velX = (float) wire->tracks[i].velXQ7 / 128.0f;
        tracks[i].velY = (float) wire->tracks[i].velYQ7 / 128.0f;
        tracks[i].areaVel = (float) wire->tracks[i].areaVelQ0;
    }
    return wire->retainedCount;
}
