static uint8_t signValid(int8_t value)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((value == 1) || (value == -1));
}

static uint8_t sourceCalibrationValid(const visionParamsStruct *params,
    uint8_t source)
{
    if (params == NULL) return 0u;
    if (source == REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE1)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (isfinite(params->c1Core0PoseOffsetX) &&
                          isfinite(params->c1Core0PoseOffsetY) &&
                          isfinite(params->planningKpVx) && isfinite(params->planningKpVy) &&
                          signValid(params->planningVxSign) &&
                          signValid(params->planningVySign) && signValid(params->planningWzSign));
    }
    if (source == REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE3)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (isfinite(params->core3CenterX) &&
                          isfinite(params->core3CenterY) &&
                          (params->core3CenterX >= 0.0f) && (params->core3CenterX < 188.0f) &&
                          (params->core3CenterY >= 0.0f) && (params->core3CenterY < 120.0f) &&
                          isfinite(params->core3Scale) &&
                          (params->core3Scale >= CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MIN) &&
                          (params->core3Scale <= CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MAX) &&
                          isfinite(params->core3MountYawRad) &&
                          (params->core3MountYawRad >= CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MIN) &&
                          (params->core3MountYawRad <= CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MAX) &&
                          (params->core3MirrorX <= 1u) &&
                          signValid(params->core3ErrorFwdSign) &&
                          signValid(params->core3ErrorRightSign) &&
                          isfinite(params->core3Core0PoseOffsetX) &&
                          isfinite(params->core3Core0PoseOffsetY) &&
                          isfinite(params->core3PlanningKpVx) &&
                          isfinite(params->core3PlanningKpVy) &&
                          signValid(params->core3PlanningVxSign) &&
                          signValid(params->core3PlanningVySign));
    }
    return (uint8_t) (isfinite(params->core4CenterX) &&
                      isfinite(params->core4CenterY) &&
                      (params->core4CenterX >= 0.0f) && (params->core4CenterX < 188.0f) &&
                      (params->core4CenterY >= 0.0f) && (params->core4CenterY < 120.0f) &&
                      isfinite(params->core4Scale) &&
                      (params->core4Scale >= CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MIN) &&
                      (params->core4Scale <= CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MAX) &&
                      isfinite(params->core4MountYawRad) &&
                      (params->core4MountYawRad >= CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MIN) &&
                      (params->core4MountYawRad <= CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MAX) &&
                      (params->core4MirrorX <= 1u) &&
                      signValid(params->core4ErrorFwdSign) &&
                      signValid(params->core4ErrorRightSign) &&
                      isfinite(params->core4Core0PoseOffsetX) &&
                      isfinite(params->core4Core0PoseOffsetY) &&
                      isfinite(params->core4PlanningKpVx) &&
                      isfinite(params->core4PlanningKpVy) &&
                      signValid(params->core4PlanningVxSign) &&
                      signValid(params->core4PlanningVySign));
}

static requiredVisionSnapshot observerRequiredFault(
    const observerLinkCore1EndpointStatus *link,
    observerConfigGrace *grace,
    uint8_t source)
{
    requiredVisionSnapshot fault = {0u, 0u, 0u, 0u};
    uint8_t configApplied;
    if (link->desiredRevision != grace->revision)
    {
        grace->revision = link->desiredRevision;
        grace->changedTickMs = runtimeTickMs;
    }
    fault.active = 1u;
    fault.source = source;
    if (link->online == 0u) fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_LINK;
    else if ((link->protocolCompatible == 0u) ||
             (link->planningCompatible == 0u) ||
             (link->algorithmsReady == 0u))
        fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_PROTOCOL;
    else if (link->configProviderValid == 0u)
        fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_CALIBRATION;
    else
    {
        configApplied = (uint8_t) ((link->configCompatible != 0u) &&
                                   (link->configAckStatus == OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED) &&
                                   (link->configAckRevision == link->desiredRevision) &&
                                   (link->configAckHash == link->desiredHash) &&
                                   (link->appliedMode == link->desiredMode));
        if (configApplied == 0u)
        {
            if ((uint32_t) (runtimeTickMs - grace->changedTickMs) < 600u)
            {
                fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_NONE;
                fault.inhibit = 1u;
            }
            else
                fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_CONFIG;
        }
        else if ((link->healthValid == 0u) ||
                 (link->health.ownerSession != link->localSession) ||
                 ((uint32_t) (runtimeTickMs - link->healthTickMs) >= 600u) ||
                 ((link->health.flags & OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_FLAG_BRIDGE_FRESH) == 0u) ||
                 (link->health.bridgeAgeMs >= 600u))
            fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_BRIDGE;
        else if ((link->health.cameraState != OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_RUNNING) ||
                 ((link->health.flags & OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_FLAG_FRAME_FRESH) == 0u) ||
                 (link->health.frameAgeMs >= 200u))
            fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_CAMERA;
        else
            fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_NONE;
    }
    if (fault.faultClass == REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_NONE) fault.active = 0u;
    return fault;
}

static requiredVisionSnapshot core1RequiredVisionFault(void)
{
    requiredVisionSnapshot fault = {0u, 0u, 0u, 0u};
    requiredVisionSnapshot core3Fault;
    requiredVisionSnapshot core4Fault;
    core3LinkCore1Status core3;
    core4LinkCore1Status core4;
    visionParamsStruct params;
    visionParamsGetActive(&params);
    if (sourceCalibrationValid(&params, REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE1) == 0u)
    {
        fault.active = 1u;
        fault.source = REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE1;
        fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_CALIBRATION;
        return fault;
    }
    if (sourceCalibrationValid(&params, REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE3) == 0u)
    {
        fault.active = 1u;
        fault.source = REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE3;
        fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_CALIBRATION;
        return fault;
    }
    if (sourceCalibrationValid(&params, REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE4) == 0u)
    {
        fault.active = 1u;
        fault.source = REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE4;
        fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_CALIBRATION;
        return fault;
    }
    if ((runtimeContext.cameraReady == 0u) ||
        ((uint32_t) (runtimeTickMs - runtimeLocalObservationTickMs) >= 200u))
    {
        fault.active = 1u;
        fault.source = REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE1;
        fault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_CAMERA;
        return fault;
    }
    core3LinkCore1GetStatus(&core3);
    core3Fault = observerRequiredFault(&core3, &g_core3ConfigGrace,
        REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE3);
    if (core3Fault.active != 0u) return core3Fault;
    core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4);
    core4Fault = observerRequiredFault(&core4, &g_core4ConfigGrace,
        REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE4);
    if (core4Fault.active != 0u) return core4Fault;
    if (core3Fault.inhibit != 0u) return core3Fault;
    return core4Fault;
}

static uint8_t core1RuntimeRequiredLinksReady(core1SystemFactsSnapshot *factsOut)
{
    core1SystemFactsSnapshot facts;
    requiredVisionSnapshot visionFault;
    uint8_t ready;
    core1KvmRouterGetSystemFacts(&facts);
    ready = (uint8_t) ((facts.ready != 0u) &&
                       (facts.linkUp != 0u) && (facts.core0StatusValid != 0u) &&
                       (facts.core2LinkLost == 0u));
    visionFault = core1RequiredVisionFault();
    if ((visionFault.active != 0u) || (visionFault.inhibit != 0u)) ready = 0u;
    if (factsOut != NULL) *factsOut = facts;
    return ready;
}

static void core1RuntimeUpdateSystemPhase(void)
{
    uint8_t ready = core1RuntimeRequiredLinksReady(NULL);
    if (runtimeContext.systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_LINK_WAIT)
    {
        if (ready != 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_HOME;
            runtimeContext.standalone = 0u;
        }
        else if (runtimeTickMs >= CORE1_INITIAL_LINK_WAIT_MS)
        {
            runtimeContext.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE;
            runtimeContext.standalone = 1u;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (runtimeContext.standalone == 0u)
    {
        if (ready == 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE;
            runtimeContext.standalone = 1u;
            runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = 0u;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ready == 0u)
    {
        runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = 0u;
        runtimeContext.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE;
        return;
    }
    if (runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs == 0u)
    {
        runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = runtimeTickMs;
    }
    runtimeContext.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN;
    if ((uint32_t) (runtimeTickMs - runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs) >=
        CORE1_REJOIN_STABLE_MS)
    {
        /* 只复位规划动态历史，不重初始化相机、UART、屏幕、参数或PIT。 */
        core3LinkCore1FencePlanningFacts();
        core4LinkCore1FencePlanningFacts();
        beaconNavigatorResetForRejoin();
        core1ContinuityReset();
        core1ContinuityIdentityReset(&runtimeContext.continuityIdentity);
        runtimeLocalObservationPending = 0u;
        runtimePlanForceStep = 1u;
        runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending = 1u;
        runtimeContext.standalone = 0u;
        runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = 0u;
        /* REJOIN保持到零输出屏障拍已实际发布；不能提前向UI宣称HOME。 */
        runtimeContext.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN;
    }
}

static uint8_t overlayPixel(float value, uint16_t limit, uint16_t *out)
{
    if ((out == NULL) || (!isfinite(value)) || (value < 0.0f) ||
        (value > (float) (limit - 1u))) return 0u;
    *out = (uint16_t) (value + 0.5f);
    return 1u;
}

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t sourceId;
    uint8_t mirrorX;
    uint8_t geometryMode;
    int8_t errorFwdSign;
    int8_t errorRightSign;
    float centerX;
    float centerY;
    float poseOffsetX;
    float poseOffsetY;
    float scale;
    float mountYawRad;
    float bodyHeadingRad;
} observerOverlayProfile;

static uint8_t observerOverlayProfileGet(const visionParamsStruct *params,
    uint8_t sourceId, observerOverlayProfile *profile)
{
    if ((params == NULL) || (profile == NULL) ||
        ((sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
            (sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4))) return 0u;
    memset(profile, 0, sizeof(*profile));
    profile->sourceId = sourceId;
    if (sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)
    {
        profile->geometryMode = BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_HEADING;
        profile->centerX = params->core4CenterX;
        profile->centerY = params->core4CenterY;
        profile->poseOffsetX = params->core4Core0PoseOffsetX;
        profile->poseOffsetY = params->core4Core0PoseOffsetY;
        profile->scale = params->core4Scale;
        profile->mountYawRad = params->core4MountYawRad;
        profile->mirrorX = params->core4MirrorX;
        profile->errorFwdSign = params->core4ErrorFwdSign;
        profile->errorRightSign = params->core4ErrorRightSign;
    }
    else
    {
        profile->geometryMode = BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_FIXED;
        profile->centerX = params->core3CenterX;
        profile->centerY = params->core3CenterY;
        profile->poseOffsetX = params->core3Core0PoseOffsetX;
        profile->poseOffsetY = params->core3Core0PoseOffsetY;
        profile->scale = params->core3Scale;
        profile->mountYawRad = params->core3MountYawRad;
        profile->mirrorX = params->core3MirrorX;
        profile->errorFwdSign = params->core3ErrorFwdSign;
        profile->errorRightSign = params->core3ErrorRightSign;
    }
    return (uint8_t) (isfinite(profile->centerX) && isfinite(profile->centerY) &&
                      isfinite(profile->poseOffsetX) && isfinite(profile->poseOffsetY) &&
                      isfinite(profile->scale) && isfinite(profile->mountYawRad) &&
                      (profile->centerX >= 0.0f) && (profile->centerX < 188.0f) &&
                      (profile->centerY >= 0.0f) && (profile->centerY < 120.0f) &&
                      (profile->scale >= CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MIN) &&
                      (profile->scale <= CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MAX) &&
                      (profile->mountYawRad >= CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MIN) &&
                      (profile->mountYawRad <= CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MAX) &&
                      (profile->mirrorX <= 1u) &&
                      ((profile->errorFwdSign == 1) || (profile->errorFwdSign == -1)) &&
                      ((profile->errorRightSign == 1) || (profile->errorRightSign == -1)));
}

static uint8_t bodyErrorToObserverVector(const observerOverlayProfile *profile,
    float errFwd, float errRight, float *u, float *v)
{
    beaconSourceProfile sourceProfile;
    if ((profile == NULL) || (u == NULL) || (v == NULL) ||
        (!isfinite(errFwd)) || (!isfinite(errRight))) return 0u;
    memset(&sourceProfile, 0, sizeof(sourceProfile));
    sourceProfile.centerX = profile->centerX;
    sourceProfile.centerY = profile->centerY;
    sourceProfile.scale = profile->scale;
    sourceProfile.mountYawRad = profile->mountYawRad;
    sourceProfile.bodyHeadingRad = profile->bodyHeadingRad;
    sourceProfile.mirrorX = profile->mirrorX;
    sourceProfile.errorFwdSign = profile->errorFwdSign;
    sourceProfile.errorRightSign = profile->errorRightSign;
    sourceProfile.geometryMode = profile->geometryMode;
    return beaconTargetContinuityBodyToObserver(&sourceProfile,
        errFwd, errRight, u, v);
}

static uint8_t bodyErrorToObserverPixel(const observerOverlayProfile *profile,
    float centerX, float centerY, float errFwd, float errRight,
    uint16_t *x, uint16_t *y)
{
    float u;
    float v;
    if (bodyErrorToObserverVector(profile, errFwd, errRight, &u, &v) == 0u)
        return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (overlayPixel(centerX + u / profile->scale, 188u, x) &&
                      overlayPixel(centerY + v / profile->scale, 120u, y));
}

static void publishObserverViewOverlay(uint8_t observerSource,
    const beaconNavigatorSnapshotStruct *nav)
{
    observerLinkCore1EndpointStatus link;
    observerLinkViewOverlay overlay;
    observerOverlayProfile profile;
    visionParamsStruct params;
    float centerX;
    float centerY;
    observerOverlayPoseMapping poseMapping;
    uint32_t sourceFrameSeq;
    uint32_t *overlaySeq;
    uint32_t *lastQueueMs;

    if (nav == NULL) return;
    if (observerSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)
    {
        overlaySeq = &runtimeContext.core4OverlaySeq;
        lastQueueMs = &runtimeContext.core4OverlayLastQueueMs;
        sourceFrameSeq = runtimeContext.core4TrackerFrameSeq;
        core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&link);
    }
    else
    {
        overlaySeq = &runtimeContext.core3OverlaySeq;
        lastQueueMs = &runtimeContext.core3OverlayLastQueueMs;
        sourceFrameSeq = runtimeContext.core3TrackerFrameSeq;
        core3LinkCore1GetStatus(&link);
    }
    if ((uint32_t) (runtimeTickMs - *lastQueueMs) < 100u) return;
    if ((link.online == 0u) || (link.protocolCompatible == 0u) ||
        (link.configAckStatus != OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED) ||
        (link.configAckRevision != link.desiredRevision) ||
        (link.configAckHash != link.desiredHash) ||
        (link.appliedMode != link.desiredMode)) return;
    visionParamsGetActive(&params);
    if (observerOverlayProfileGet(&params, observerSource, &profile) == 0u) return;
    if (profile.geometryMode == BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_HEADING)
        profile.bodyHeadingRad = nav->poseHeadingRad;
    centerX = (nav->poseValid != 0u) ? nav->poseRawX + profile.poseOffsetX : profile.centerX;
    centerY = (nav->poseValid != 0u) ? nav->poseRawY + profile.poseOffsetY : profile.centerY;
    if ((!isfinite(centerX)) || (!isfinite(centerY))) return;

    memset(&overlay, 0, sizeof(overlay));
    overlay.overlaySeq = ++(*overlaySeq);
    if (overlay.overlaySeq == 0u) overlay.overlaySeq = ++(*overlaySeq);
    overlay.sourceFrameSeq = sourceFrameSeq;
    overlay.ownerSession = link.localSession;
    overlay.configRevision = link.desiredRevision;
    overlay.configHash = link.desiredHash;
    overlay.detectMode = link.desiredMode;
    overlay.flags = OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_VALID;

    if (overlayPixel(centerX, 188u, &overlay.activeCenterX) &&
        overlayPixel(centerY, 120u, &overlay.activeCenterY))
    {
        overlay.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_CENTER;
        if (isfinite(params.planningDeadzoneEnterPx) &&
            isfinite(params.planningDeadzoneExitPx) &&
            (profile.scale > 0.0f))
        {
            float enterRadius = params.planningDeadzoneEnterPx / profile.scale;
            float exitRadius = params.planningDeadzoneExitPx / profile.scale;
            if ((enterRadius >= 0.0f) && (enterRadius <= 188.0f) &&
                (exitRadius >= 0.0f) && (exitRadius <= enterRadius))
            {
                overlay.deadzoneEnterRadius = (uint16_t) (enterRadius + 0.5f);
                overlay.deadzoneExitRadius = (uint16_t) (exitRadius + 0.5f);
                overlay.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_DEADZONE;
            }
        }
    }

    if ((sourceFrameSeq != 0u) &&
        (nav->targetValid != 0u) &&
        (nav->targetTrackId != 0u) && (nav->targetSize <= 22560u))
    {
        uint8_t selectedOk;
        if (nav->sourceId == observerSource)
        {
            selectedOk = (uint8_t) (overlayPixel((float) nav->controlX, 188u,
                                        &overlay.selectedX) &&
                                    overlayPixel((float) nav->controlY, 120u,
                                        &overlay.selectedY));
        }
        else
        {
            selectedOk = (uint8_t) (((profile.geometryMode !=
                                         BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_HEADING) ||
                                        ((nav->poseHeadingValid != 0u) && isfinite(profile.bodyHeadingRad))) &&
                                    bodyErrorToObserverPixel(&profile, centerX, centerY,
                                        nav->errFwd, nav->errRight, &overlay.selectedX, &overlay.selectedY));
        }
        if (selectedOk != 0u)
        {
            overlay.selectedTrackId = nav->targetTrackId;
            overlay.selectedSize = nav->targetSize;
            overlay.selectedFlags = (nav->targetHolding != 0u) ? OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_COAST : OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_FRESH;
            overlay.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_SELECTED;
        }
    }

    observerOverlayPoseMap(nav->poseRawX, nav->poseRawY,
        profile.poseOffsetX, profile.poseOffsetY, nav->poseValid,
        nav->poseHeadingRad, nav->poseHeadingValid, &poseMapping);
    if (poseMapping.poseMapped != 0u)
    {
        overlay.poseX = poseMapping.x;
        overlay.poseY = poseMapping.y;
        overlay.poseFlags = nav->poseHolding ? OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD : OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_FRESH;
        overlay.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_POSE;
        if (poseMapping.headingMapped != 0u)
        {
            overlay.poseHeadingQ8 = poseMapping.headingQ8;
            overlay.poseFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HEADING_VALID;
            if (nav->poseHeadingHolding != 0u)
            {
                overlay.poseFlags &= (uint8_t) ~OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_FRESH;
                overlay.poseFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD;
            }
        }
    }

    if (((observerSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4) ? core4LinkCore1QueueViewOverlay(&overlay, runtimeTickMs) : core3LinkCore1QueueViewOverlay(&overlay, runtimeTickMs)) != 0u)
        *lastQueueMs = runtimeTickMs;
}

void processInit(void)
{
    visionParamsStruct params;
    paramSyncOwnerServiceInit();
    /* PIT_CH2 10ms: 菜单按键扫描 + 刷新计数(对齐 core0 menuPitTick; PIT_CH1 留给图像/通用)。
     * cm_7_1 用 PIT_CH2, 不与飞控核(cm_7_0)的 CH0/CH1 跨核争用。 */
    pit_ms_init(PIT_CH2, 10u);

    /* 信标视觉管线初始化(mt9v03x + DetectMode 检测器 + 跟踪)。失败不阻塞主循环。 */
    runtimeContext.cameraReady = imageInit();

    /* 视觉参数: flash 加载(校验失败回退默认)→热重载到 DetectMode/track。
     * 须在 imageInit(已建两套检测默认配置)之后, 覆盖其默认阈值。 */
    flash_init();
    visionParamsLoad();
    visionParamsGetActive(&params);
    runtimeLastDetectMode = params.detectMode;

    /* 后/前观察板专线：两实例独立收发，协议状态机均在前台。 */
    core3LinkCore1Init(0u);
    core4LinkCore1Init(0u);
    core1KvmRouterInit(0u);
    paramSyncObserverRouterInit();

    /* 远程菜单(IPS114 占屏 cm_7_1): 上电先等 core0 链路在线才进发车页。 */
    menuInit();
    menuSetInitHealth(runtimeContext.cameraReady ? 0u : 1u, 0u);

    /* RGB 状态灯(P05 三路 PWM, 共阳极, 限亮 30%): 反映两核综合状态, 默认灭。 */
    rgbStatusLedInit();
    rgbStatusLedSetHardwareInitFault(runtimeContext.cameraReady ? 0u : 1u);

    /* 路径规划(beaconNavigator): 复位状态机 + 输出滤波器。须在 imageInit 之后(消费确认信标)。 */
    beaconNavigatorInit();
    beaconTargetContinuityInit(&runtimeTargetContinuity);
    beaconTargetContinuityInit(&runtimeDisplayContinuity);
    core0PoseSupervisorInit();
    takeoffMotionGateInit();
    takeoffMotionGateApplyParams(params.planningPostTakeoffDelayMs);

    runtimeContext.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_LINK_WAIT;
    runtimeContext.readyStableStartMs = 0u;
    runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending = 0u;
    runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive = 0u;
    core1ContinuityIdentityReset(&runtimeContext.continuityIdentity);
    runtimeContext.standalone = 0u;

    runtimeInitReady = 1u;
}

void pitProcess0(void)
{
    if (!runtimeInitReady) return;

    /* 菜单 10ms tick: 读核间透传按键(menuKeyScan) + 刷新分频。轻量, 渲染在前台。 */
    menuPitTick();

    /* RGB 状态灯 10ms 刷新(稳定节拍软生成闪烁/呼吸): 读本地 + 共享内存 core0 状态, 设三路 PWM。
     * 仅寄存器写 + 共享内存读(DCache invalidate 32B), 轻量, 与 menuKeyScan 同级开销。 */
    rgbStatusLedUpdate(runtimeInitReady, (uint8_t) 0u, runtimeBeaconCount);

    runtimeTickMs += 10u;
}

static void publishCore3ControlStatus(
    const beaconNavigatorSnapshotStruct *navSnapshot)
{
    core3LinkCore1Status linkStatus;
    core4LinkCore1Status core4LinkStatus;
    observerLinkControlStatus status;
    observerLinkControlStatus core4Status;
    core1KvmRouterSnapshot kvm;
    core1SystemFactsSnapshot facts;
    uint8_t core0Up;
    uint8_t core0Parked;
    uint8_t baseReason;
    uint8_t requiredLinksReady;

    memset(&status, 0, sizeof(status));
    core3LinkCore1GetStatus(&linkStatus);
    status.detectMode = runtimeLastDetectMode;
    status.protocolCompatible = linkStatus.protocolCompatible;
    status.algorithmsReady = linkStatus.algorithmsReady;
    status.configCompatible = linkStatus.configCompatible;
    core1KvmRouterGetSnapshot(&kvm);
    status.desiredTarget = kvm.desiredTarget;
    status.ownerTarget = (kvm.inputOwner == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE) ? OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE : kvm.inputOwner;
    core0Up = menuKeyRemoteLinkUp();
    status.systemPhase = runtimeContext.systemPhase;
    status.systemFlags = 0u;
    if (runtimeContext.systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE)
        status.systemFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_STANDALONE;
    else if (runtimeContext.systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN)
        status.systemFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_REJOIN;
    requiredLinksReady = core1RuntimeRequiredLinksReady(&facts);
    core0Parked = (uint8_t) ((facts.core0StatusValid != 0u) &&
        (facts.core0SafetyState == CORE1_CORE0_SAFETY_DISARMED) &&
        ((facts.core0StatusFlags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED) == 0u));
    if ((facts.core0StatusFlags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED) != 0u)
        status.systemFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_LAUNCHED;
    if ((facts.core0StatusFlags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_VEL_VALID) != 0u)
        status.systemFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_VEL_VALID;
    if ((requiredLinksReady != 0u) &&
        ((facts.core0StatusFlags & (UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_CM70_READY |
                                       UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_TOF_HEALTHY)) ==
            (UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_CM70_READY | UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_TOF_HEALTHY)))
        status.systemFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_LAUNCH_ELIGIBLE;
    if (core0Up == 0u)
    {
        baseReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CORE0_LINK;
    }
    else if (facts.core2LinkLost != 0u)
    {
        baseReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CORE2_LINK;
    }
    else if (runtimePlanTx.requiredVisionFault != 0u)
    {
        if (runtimePlanTx.faultClass == REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_LINK ||
            runtimePlanTx.faultClass == REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_BRIDGE)
            baseReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_OBSERVER_LINK;
        else if (runtimePlanTx.faultClass == REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_PROTOCOL)
            baseReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_PROTOCOL;
        else if (runtimePlanTx.faultClass == REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_CONFIG)
            baseReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CONFIG;
        else
            baseReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_SAFETY;
    }
    else
    {
        baseReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_NONE;
    }
    status.primaryReason = baseReason;

    /* 观察板本地参数安全门只接受这一份由Core0当前DISARMED事实生成的
     * canonical SAFE DTO。ARMING/TOF_INIT/CLOSED_LOOP及状态无效均发布RUN。 */
    if (core0Parked != 0u)
    {
        status.cameraControlState = OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_SAFE;
        core4Status = status;
        core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4LinkStatus);
        core4Status.protocolCompatible = core4LinkStatus.protocolCompatible;
        core4Status.algorithmsReady = core4LinkStatus.algorithmsReady;
        core4Status.configCompatible = core4LinkStatus.configCompatible;
        core3LinkCore1PublishControlStatus(&status, runtimeTickMs);
        core4LinkCore1PublishControlStatus(&core4Status, runtimeTickMs);
        return;
    }

    status.cameraControlState = OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN;
    status.flags = OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_STATUS_VALID |
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION;
    if (navSnapshot == NULL)
    {
        core4Status = status;
        core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4LinkStatus);
        core4Status.protocolCompatible = core4LinkStatus.protocolCompatible;
        core4Status.algorithmsReady = core4LinkStatus.algorithmsReady;
        core4Status.configCompatible = core4LinkStatus.configCompatible;
        core3LinkCore1PublishControlStatus(&status, runtimeTickMs);
        core4LinkCore1PublishControlStatus(&core4Status, runtimeTickMs);
        return;
    }
    if (runtimePlanTx.valid != 0u)
    {
        status.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_DECISION_VALID;
    }
    if (runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive != 0u)
    {
        status.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_BARRIER_REQUIRED;
    }
    if (runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable != 0u)
    {
        status.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_DISPATCH_ENABLED;
    }
    if (runtimePlanTx.requiredVisionFault == 0u)
    {
        status.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_REMOTE_ELIGIBLE;
    }
    if (core0Up != 0u)
    {
        status.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_CORE0_LINK_UP;
        if (menuKeyRemoteCore2LinkLost() == 0u)
        {
            status.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_CORE2_LINK_UP;
        }
    }
    if (navSnapshot->targetValid != 0u)
    {
        status.systemFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_TARGET_VALID;
    }
    if ((core0Up != 0u) && (menuKeyRemoteCore2LinkLost() != 0u))
    {
        status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CORE2_LINK;
    }
    else if (runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive != 0u)
    {
        status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_BARRIER;
    }
    else if ((runtimePlanTx.valid != 0u) &&
             (runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable == 0u))
    {
        status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_DISPATCH;
    }
    else if (navSnapshot->targetValid == 0u)
    {
        status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_TARGET;
    }

    status.activeSource = navSnapshot->sourceId;
    if (runtimePlanTx.beaconSearching != 0u)
    {
        status.activeSource = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE;
        status.controlClass = OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_SEARCH;
    }
    else if (navSnapshot->targetValid != 0u)
    {
        status.controlClass = (navSnapshot->sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1) ? OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_CORE1_TRACK : OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_OBSERVER_TRACK;
    }
    else
    {
        status.activeSource = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE;
        status.controlClass = OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE;
    }

    status.navState = navSnapshot->state;
    status.beaconCount = navSnapshot->beaconCount;
    status.targetX = navSnapshot->controlX;
    status.targetY = navSnapshot->controlY;
    status.targetSize = navSnapshot->targetSize;
    if ((observerLinkQuantizeSigned(navSnapshot->errX, 16.0f,
             -2048.0f, 2047.9375f, &status.errXQ4) == 0u) ||
        (observerLinkQuantizeSigned(navSnapshot->errY, 16.0f,
             -2048.0f, 2047.9375f, &status.errYQ4) == 0u))
    {
        status.cameraControlState = OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN;
        status.activeSource = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE;
        status.controlClass = OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE;
        status.flags = OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_STATUS_VALID |
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION;
        status.navState = 0u;
        status.beaconCount = 0u;
        status.targetX = 0u;
        status.targetY = 0u;
        status.targetSize = 0u;
        status.errXQ4 = 0;
        status.errYQ4 = 0;
        status.systemPhase = runtimeContext.systemPhase;
        status.primaryReason = baseReason;
        status.desiredTarget = kvm.desiredTarget;
        status.ownerTarget = (kvm.inputOwner == UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE) ? OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE : kvm.inputOwner;
    }
    core4Status = status;
    core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4LinkStatus);
    core4Status.protocolCompatible = core4LinkStatus.protocolCompatible;
    core4Status.algorithmsReady = core4LinkStatus.algorithmsReady;
    core4Status.configCompatible = core4LinkStatus.configCompatible;
    core3LinkCore1PublishControlStatus(&status, runtimeTickMs);
    core4LinkCore1PublishControlStatus(&core4Status, runtimeTickMs);
}

void whileProcess(void)
{
    if (!runtimeInitReady) return;

    core3LinkCore1Poll(runtimeTickMs);
    core4LinkCore1Poll(runtimeTickMs);
    paramSyncObserverRouterPoll(runtimeTickMs);
    core1KvmRouterIngress(runtimeTickMs);
    core3LinkCore1FlushControl(runtimeTickMs);
    core4LinkCore1FlushControl(runtimeTickMs);
    {
        core1SystemFactsSnapshot facts;
        core1KvmRouterGetSystemFacts(&facts);
        rgbStatusLedPublishCore0Facts(facts.ready, facts.linkUp,
            facts.core0StatusValid, facts.core0SafetyState,
            facts.core0StatusFlags, facts.core0RgbIntent);
    }
    /* KVM事实进入后立即消费按键；屏幕与Flash副作用仍留在循环尾。 */
    menuServiceInput();
    /* 菜单动作一旦提交即生成终态ACK，不等待视觉、规划或IPS114同步绘制。 */
    core1KvmRouterFinalize(runtimeTickMs);
    core3LinkCore1FlushControl(runtimeTickMs);
    /* 同一surface的选项/数值变化立即脏区绘制，避免等待本拍重视觉；不清屏、不写Flash。 */
    menuRenderInputFeedback();
    core1RuntimeUpdateSystemPhase();

    if (runtimeLastDetectMode != imageGetDetectMode())
    {
        runtimeLastDetectMode = imageGetDetectMode();
        runtimeBeaconCount = 0u;
        runtimeLocalObservationPending = 0u;
        beaconNavigatorInit();
        core1ContinuityReset();
        runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending = 1u;
        runtimePlanForceStep = 1u;
    }

    /* 前台跑信标视觉管线：取帧→BinaryCC→时间一致性跟踪。
     * 连通域/Hu 计算必须在前台，绝不进 PIT ISR。 */
    if ((runtimeContext.cameraReady != 0u) && imageProcess())
    {
        visionParamsStruct frameParams;
        imageGetObservationSnapshot(&runtimeContext.observation);
        visionParamsGetActive(&frameParams);
        runtimeBeaconCount = 0u;
        for (uint16_t i = 0u; i < runtimeContext.observation.count; i++)
        {
            if ((runtimeContext.observation.tracks[i].flags &
                    BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u)
                runtimeBeaconCount++;
        }
        runtimeLocalObservationPending = 1u;
        runtimeLocalObservationTickMs = runtimeTickMs;
        runtimeLocalObservationRevision = frameParams.sharedConfigRevision;
        runtimeLocalObservationHash = frameParams.sharedConfigHash;
        runtimeLocalObservationDetectMode = frameParams.detectMode;
    }

    /* 路径规划 10ms 节拍: 取最新确认信标 → beaconNavigator(选目标→误差→控制律→整形)
     * → 写跨核反向区(planRegion)供 cm_7_0 按空地系统模式派发。重计算全在前台。 */
    if (runtimePlanForceStep || runtimeTickMs != runtimePlanLastStepMs)
    {
        beaconNavigatorCommandStruct navCommand;
        beaconNavigatorOutputStruct navOutput;
        takeoffMotionGateInputStruct gateInput;
        takeoffMotionGateDecisionStruct gateDecision;
        core1SystemFactsSnapshot facts;
        uint8_t requiredLinksReady;
        uint8_t freshTargetAccepted;
        uint8_t continuityAdvanceAllowed;
        uint8_t searchOutputAllowed;
        uint8_t standbyDisplayAllowed;
        visionParamsStruct params;
        core0PoseSupervisorSnapshot poseSnapshot;
        beaconSourceObservationView sourceViews[BEACON_CONTINUITY_MAX_SOURCES];
        beaconTargetContinuityOutput continuityOutput;
        beaconTargetContinuityOutput displayContinuityOutput;
        core1NavigationDecisionInput navigationDecisionInput;
        core1NavigationDecisionKind navigationDecision;
        observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot core4Wire;
        observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot core3Wire;
        core3LinkCore1Status core3Status;
        core4LinkCore1Status core4Status;
        uint32_t core4Age = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        uint32_t core3Age = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        uint16_t core4Count = 0u;
        uint16_t core3Count = 0u;
        imageGetObservationSnapshot(&runtimeContext.observation);
        memset(&navCommand, 0, sizeof(navCommand));
        memset(&navOutput, 0, sizeof(navOutput));
        memset(&gateInput, 0, sizeof(gateInput));
        memset(&gateDecision, 0, sizeof(gateDecision));
        memset(sourceViews, 0, sizeof(sourceViews));
        memset(&continuityOutput, 0, sizeof(continuityOutput));
        memset(&displayContinuityOutput, 0, sizeof(displayContinuityOutput));
        memset(&navigationDecisionInput, 0, sizeof(navigationDecisionInput));
        memset(&core4Wire, 0, sizeof(core4Wire));
        memset(&core3Wire, 0, sizeof(core3Wire));
        navCommand.dtS = PLANNING_DT_S;
        visionParamsGetActive(&params);
        core0PoseSupervisorStep(runtimeTickMs,
            params.poseHoldMs,
            params.planningCore0PoseMinConfidence,
            params.planningCore0PoseHeadingSign,
            params.planningCore0PoseHeadingOffsetRad,
            &poseSnapshot);
        navCommand.pose = &poseSnapshot;
        runtimePlanForceStep = 0u;
        runtimePlanLastStepMs = runtimeTickMs;
        runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive = 0u;
        core3LinkCore1GetStatus(&core3Status);
        core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4Status);
        core1KvmRouterGetSystemFacts(&facts);
        core1ContinuityObserveIdentity(&core3Status, &core4Status,
            (uint8_t) ((facts.core0StatusFlags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED) != 0u));
        if (core3LinkCore1GetPlanningTrackSnapshot(&core3Wire,
                runtimeTickMs, params.core3ObservationTimeoutMs, &core3Age) != 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.core3TrackerFrameSeq = core3Wire.trackerFrameSeq;
            core3Count = adaptObserverTracks(&core3Wire,
                OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3, runtimeCore3Tracks);
        }
        if (core4LinkCore1GetPlanningTrackSnapshot(&core4Wire,
                runtimeTickMs, params.c4ObservationTimeoutMs, &core4Age) != 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.core4TrackerFrameSeq = core4Wire.trackerFrameSeq;
            core4Count = adaptObserverTracks(&core4Wire,
                OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4, runtimeCore4Tracks);
        }
        sourceViews[0].sourceId = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1;
        sourceViews[0].fresh = (uint8_t) (poseSnapshot.headingValid &&
                                          sourceCalibrationValid(&params, REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE1) &&
                                          (runtimeLocalObservationRevision == params.sharedConfigRevision) &&
                                          (runtimeLocalObservationHash == params.sharedConfigHash) &&
                                          (runtimeLocalObservationDetectMode == params.detectMode) &&
                                          ((uint32_t) (runtimeTickMs - runtimeLocalObservationTickMs) <=
                                              params.c1FreshGateMs));
        sourceViews[0].session = core3Status.localSession;
        sourceViews[0].observationSeq = runtimeContext.observation.frameSeq;
        sourceViews[0].tracks = runtimeContext.observation.tracks;
        sourceViews[0].count = runtimeContext.observation.count;
        sourceViews[0].profile.centerX = poseSnapshot.x + params.c1Core0PoseOffsetX;
        sourceViews[0].profile.centerY = poseSnapshot.y + params.c1Core0PoseOffsetY;
        sourceViews[0].profile.scale = 1.0f;
        sourceViews[0].profile.bodyHeadingRad = poseSnapshot.headingRad;
        sourceViews[0].profile.geometryMode =
            BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_DOWNWARD_HEADING;
        sourceViews[1].sourceId = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3;
        sourceViews[1].fresh = (uint8_t) (sourceCalibrationValid(&params, REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
                                          (core3Age <= params.c3FreshGateMs));
        sourceViews[1].session = core3Status.peerSession;
        sourceViews[1].observationSeq = core3Wire.trackerFrameSeq;
        sourceViews[1].tracks = runtimeCore3Tracks;
        sourceViews[1].count = core3Count;
        sourceViews[1].profile.centerX = poseSnapshot.x + params.core3Core0PoseOffsetX;
        sourceViews[1].profile.centerY = poseSnapshot.y + params.core3Core0PoseOffsetY;
        sourceViews[1].profile.scale = params.core3Scale;
        sourceViews[1].profile.mountYawRad = params.core3MountYawRad;
        sourceViews[1].profile.mirrorX = params.core3MirrorX;
        sourceViews[1].profile.errorFwdSign = params.core3ErrorFwdSign;
        sourceViews[1].profile.errorRightSign = params.core3ErrorRightSign;
        sourceViews[1].profile.geometryMode =
            BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_FIXED;
        sourceViews[2].sourceId = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4;
        sourceViews[2].fresh = (uint8_t) (sourceCalibrationValid(&params, REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE4) &&
                                          (core4Age <= params.c4FreshGateMs));
        sourceViews[2].session = core4Status.peerSession;
        sourceViews[2].observationSeq = core4Wire.trackerFrameSeq;
        sourceViews[2].tracks = runtimeCore4Tracks;
        sourceViews[2].count = core4Count;
        sourceViews[2].profile.centerX = poseSnapshot.x + params.core4Core0PoseOffsetX;
        sourceViews[2].profile.centerY = poseSnapshot.y + params.core4Core0PoseOffsetY;
        sourceViews[2].profile.scale = params.core4Scale;
        sourceViews[2].profile.mountYawRad = params.core4MountYawRad;
        sourceViews[2].profile.bodyHeadingRad = poseSnapshot.headingRad;
        sourceViews[2].profile.mirrorX = params.core4MirrorX;
        sourceViews[2].profile.errorFwdSign = params.core4ErrorFwdSign;
        sourceViews[2].profile.errorRightSign = params.core4ErrorRightSign;
        sourceViews[2].profile.geometryMode =
            BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_HEADING;
        requiredLinksReady = core1RuntimeRequiredLinksReady(&facts);
        takeoffMotionGateApplyParams(params.planningPostTakeoffDelayMs);
        gateInput.nowMs = runtimeTickMs;
        gateInput.systemMode = facts.core0SystemMode;
        gateInput.core0StatusValid = facts.core0StatusValid;
        gateInput.launched = (uint8_t) ((facts.core0StatusFlags &
                                            UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED) != 0u);
        gateInput.cruiseQualified = facts.core0AltReached;
        gateInput.runtimePermitted = (uint8_t) (requiredLinksReady != 0u && runtimeContext.cameraReady != 0u &&
                                                runtimeContext.standalone == 0u &&
                                                runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending == 0u &&
                                                runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive == 0u);
        takeoffMotionGatePrepare(&gateInput, &gateDecision);
        searchOutputAllowed = (uint8_t) (gateDecision.motionUnlocked != 0u &&
                                         poseSnapshot.motionPermitted != 0u);
        continuityAdvanceAllowed = (uint8_t) (searchOutputAllowed != 0u &&
                                              poseSnapshot.headingValid != 0u);
        if (poseSnapshot.stage == CORE0_POSE_STAGE_WAIT_FIRST)
        {
            core1ContinuityReset();
        }
        beaconTargetContinuityStep(&runtimeTargetContinuity, sourceViews,
            BEACON_CONTINUITY_MAX_SOURCES, runtimeTickMs,
            params.planningEdgePredictionHoldMs,
            params.planningSearchTimeoutMs, params.planningSearchEnable,
            continuityAdvanceAllowed, searchOutputAllowed, &continuityOutput);
        if (searchOutputAllowed == 0u) continuityOutput.searchActive = 0u;
        memset(&runtimeContext.displayTarget, 0,
            sizeof(runtimeContext.displayTarget));
        standbyDisplayAllowed = (uint8_t) ((gateInput.launched == 0u) &&
                                           (requiredLinksReady != 0u) &&
                                           (runtimeContext.cameraReady != 0u) &&
                                           (runtimeContext.standalone == 0u) &&
                                           (runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending == 0u) &&
                                           (runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive == 0u) &&
                                           (poseSnapshot.headingValid != 0u));
        if (standbyDisplayAllowed != 0u)
        {
            beaconTargetContinuityStep(&runtimeDisplayContinuity, sourceViews,
                BEACON_CONTINUITY_MAX_SOURCES, runtimeTickMs,
                params.planningEdgePredictionHoldMs,
                params.planningSearchTimeoutMs, params.planningSearchEnable,
                1u, 1u, &displayContinuityOutput);
            runtimeContext.displayTarget = displayContinuityOutput.candidate;
        }
        else
        {
            beaconTargetContinuityInit(&runtimeDisplayContinuity);
            if (continuityOutput.candidate.valid != 0u)
                runtimeContext.displayTarget = continuityOutput.candidate;
        }
        navCommand.qualifiedCount = continuityOutput.qualifiedCount;
        navCommand.searchActive = continuityOutput.searchActive;
        navCommand.searchDirection = continuityOutput.searchDirection;
        runtimeLocalObservationPending = 0u;

        if (runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending != 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive = 1u;
        }
        navigationDecisionInput.barrierRequired = (uint8_t) ((runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending != 0u) ||
                                                             (gateDecision.suppressNavigator != 0u));
        navigationDecisionInput.headingValid = poseSnapshot.headingValid;
        navigationDecisionInput.lastTargetValid =
            runtimeTargetContinuity.last.valid;
        navigationDecisionInput.startupForwardActive =
            gateDecision.startupForwardActive;
        navigationDecisionInput.candidateValid =
            continuityOutput.candidate.valid;
        navigationDecisionInput.searchActive = continuityOutput.searchActive;
        navigationDecision = core1NavigationDecisionSelect(
            &navigationDecisionInput);
        if (navigationDecision == CORE1_NAV_DECISION_BARRIER)
        {
            navCommand.kind = BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_BARRIER;
        }
        else if (navigationDecision == CORE1_NAV_DECISION_STARTUP_FORWARD)
        {
            navCommand.kind = BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_STARTUP_FORWARD;
        }
        else if (navigationDecision == CORE1_NAV_DECISION_CANDIDATE)
        {
            navCommand.kind = BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_CANDIDATE;
            navCommand.candidate = &continuityOutput.candidate;
        }
        else
        {
            navCommand.kind = BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_INVALID;
        }
        beaconNavigatorStep(&navCommand, &navOutput);
        freshTargetAccepted = (uint8_t) (navOutput.snapshot.state == (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_TRACK &&
                                         navOutput.snapshot.targetTrackId != 0u &&
                                         navOutput.snapshot.targetFresh != 0u &&
                                         navOutput.snapshot.targetValid != 0u);
        takeoffMotionGateFinalize(freshTargetAccepted, &gateDecision);
        runtimePlanTx = navOutput.plan;
        runtimePlanTx.planTimeoutMs = params.planningPlanTimeoutMs;
        runtimePlanTx.motionUnlocked = gateDecision.motionUnlocked;
        runtimePlanTx.startupPhase = gateDecision.phase;
        runtimePlanTx.takeoffMotionEpoch = gateDecision.epoch;
        runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable = (uint8_t) ((runtimePlanTx.valid != 0u) ? params.planningDispatchEnable : 0u);
        if (runtimeContext.standalone != 0u)
        {
            runtimePlanTx.valid = 0u;
            runtimePlanTx.vx = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.vy = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.wz = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable = 0u;
            runtimePlanTx.motionUnlocked = 0u;
        }
        if (runtimeContext.cameraReady == 0u)
        {
            runtimePlanTx.valid = 0u;
            runtimePlanTx.vx = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.vy = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.wz = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable = 0u;
            runtimePlanTx.motionUnlocked = 0u;
        }
        if (runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending != 0u)
        {
            runtimePlanTx.valid = 0u;
            runtimePlanTx.vx = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.vy = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.wz = 0.0f;
            runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable = 0u;
            runtimePlanTx.motionUnlocked = 0u;
            runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending = 0u;
        }
        {
            requiredVisionSnapshot visionFault = core1RequiredVisionFault();
            if ((visionFault.active == 0u) &&
                (poseSnapshot.stage == CORE0_POSE_STAGE_FAULT))
            {
                visionFault.active = 1u;
                visionFault.source = REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE0;
                visionFault.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_POSE;
            }
            runtimePlanTx.requiredVisionFault = visionFault.active;
            runtimePlanTx.faultSource = visionFault.source;
            runtimePlanTx.faultClass = visionFault.faultClass;
            runtimePlanTx.poseStage = poseSnapshot.stage;
            if (poseSnapshot.motionPermitted == 0u)
            {
                runtimePlanTx.valid = 0u;
                runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable = 0u;
                runtimePlanTx.vx = 0.0f;
                runtimePlanTx.vy = 0.0f;
                runtimePlanTx.wz = 0.0f;
            }
            if (visionFault.active != 0u)
            {
                runtimePlanTx.valid = 0u;
                runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable = 0u;
                runtimePlanTx.vx = 0.0f;
                runtimePlanTx.vy = 0.0f;
                runtimePlanTx.wz = 0.0f;
            }
        }
        runtimePlanTx.beaconSearching = continuityOutput.searchActive;
        runtimePlanTx.beaconSearchTimedOut = runtimeTargetContinuity.searchTimedOut;
        runtimePlanTx.seq = ++runtimePlanSeq;
        coreDataWritePlan(&runtimePlanTx);
        publishCore3ControlStatus(&navOutput.snapshot);
        publishObserverViewOverlay(OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3, &navOutput.snapshot);
        publishObserverViewOverlay(OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4, &navOutput.snapshot);
        if (runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive != 0u)
        {
            runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive = 0u;
            runtimeContext.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_HOME;
        }
    }

    /* 参数owner只读取已提交runtime，不参与停车或发车状态判定。 */
    paramSyncOwnerServicePoll();

    /* 重视觉链之后再排空一次RX，覆盖最多两个10ms epoch的规划突发。 */
    core3LinkCore1DrainRx(runtimeTickMs);
    core4LinkCore1DrainRx(runtimeTickMs);
    /* Core3回程ACK在渲染前闭合，缩短Core0单事件在途窗口。 */
    core1KvmRouterFinalize(runtimeTickMs);
    core3LinkCore1FlushControl(runtimeTickMs);
    core4LinkCore1FlushControl(runtimeTickMs);

    /* 菜单: 链路门控 + 按键状态机 + 渲染(发车页信标图 / 阈值双图 / 参数列表)。
     * HUD事实20ms，HOME整幅灰图+标注40ms，内部读 image.c 最新快照与确认信标。 */
    menuTick();
    core3LinkCore1FlushTx(runtimeTickMs);
    core4LinkCore1FlushTx(runtimeTickMs);
}

void core1RuntimeGetPlanSnapshot(core1RuntimePlanSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    if (out == NULL) return;
    out->seq = runtimePlanTx.seq;
    out->valid = runtimePlanTx.valid;
    out->dispatchEnable = runtimePlanTx.dispatchEnable;
    out->barrier = (uint8_t) ((runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierPending != 0u) ||
                              (runtimeContext.rejoinBarrierActive != 0u));
    out->standalone = runtimeContext.standalone;
    out->systemPhase = runtimeContext.systemPhase;
}

void core1RuntimeGetDisplayTargetSnapshot(
    core1RuntimeDisplayTargetSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    if (out == NULL) return;
    out->valid = runtimeContext.displayTarget.valid;
    out->fresh = runtimeContext.displayTarget.fresh;
    out->holding = runtimeContext.displayTarget.holding;
    out->sourceId = runtimeContext.displayTarget.sourceId;
    out->trackId = runtimeContext.displayTarget.trackId;
    out->size = runtimeContext.displayTarget.size;
    out->controlX = runtimeContext.displayTarget.fresh ? runtimeContext.displayTarget.centerX : runtimeContext.displayTarget.predictedX;
    out->controlY = runtimeContext.displayTarget.fresh ? runtimeContext.displayTarget.centerY : runtimeContext.displayTarget.predictedY;
}

uint32_t core1RuntimeGetTickMs(void)
{
    return runtimeTickMs;
}

#include "core1MotionTxFence.h"

#include <string.h>

void core1MotionTxFenceReset(core1MotionTxFenceState *state)
{
    if (state != 0) memset(state, 0, sizeof(*state));
}

uint8_t core1MotionTxFencePrepare(core1MotionTxFenceState *state,
    uint32_t nowMs, float vx, float vy, float wz, uint8_t flags,
    core1MotionTxFenceFrame *frame)
{
    uint8_t nonzero;
    if ((state == 0) || (frame == 0)) return 0u;
    nonzero = (uint8_t) ((vx != 0.0f) || (vy != 0.0f) ||
        (wz != 0.0f) || (flags != 0u));
    if ((nonzero != 0u) &&
        ((state->primed == 0u) ||
         ((uint32_t) (nowMs - state->lastTxMs) >= CORE1_MOTION_TX_REARM_MS)))
    {
        frame->vx = 0.0f;
        frame->vy = 0.0f;
        frame->wz = 0.0f;
        frame->flags = 0u;
        state->primed = 1u;
        state->lastTxMs = nowMs;
        return 0u;
    }
    frame->vx = vx;
    frame->vy = vy;
    frame->wz = wz;
    frame->flags = flags;
    state->primed = 1u;
    state->lastTxMs = nowMs;
    return 1u;
}

#include "core1NavigationDecision.h"

core1NavigationDecisionKind core1NavigationDecisionSelect(
    const core1NavigationDecisionInput *input)
{
    if (input == 0) return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_BARRIER;
    if (input->barrierRequired != 0u) return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_BARRIER;

    /* heading保持窗耗尽后，TRACK和首灯前直行都不能盖过已经成立的
     * 纯wz SEARCH；该规则同样适用于尚未建立历史owner的冷启动。 */
    if ((input->headingValid == 0u) && (input->searchActive != 0u))
        return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_CANDIDATE;
    if ((input->headingValid == 0u) && (input->lastTargetValid != 0u))
        return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_BARRIER;
    if ((input->startupForwardActive != 0u) &&
        (input->candidateValid == 0u))
        return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_STARTUP_FORWARD;
    if (input->searchActive != 0u) return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_CANDIDATE;
    if ((input->candidateValid != 0u) && (input->headingValid == 0u))
        return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_BARRIER;
    if (input->candidateValid != 0u) return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_CANDIDATE;
    if (input->startupForwardActive != 0u)
        return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_STARTUP_FORWARD;
    return CORE1_NAV_DECISION_INVALID;
}

#include "core1TakeoffEpochIdentity.h"

#include <string.h>

static void captureBaseline(core1TakeoffEpochIdentityState *state)
{
    state->baselineProducerGeneration = state->observedProducerGeneration;
    state->baselineEpoch = state->observedEpoch;
}

void core1TakeoffEpochIdentityReset(core1TakeoffEpochIdentityState *state)
{
    if (state != 0) memset(state, 0, sizeof(*state));
}

uint8_t core1TakeoffEpochIdentityStep(core1TakeoffEpochIdentityState *state,
    const core1TakeoffEpochIdentityInput *input)
{
    if ((state == 0) || (input == 0)) return 0u;
    if ((input->planIdentityValid != 0u) &&
        (input->planProducerGeneration != 0u))
    {
        state->observedProducerGeneration = input->planProducerGeneration;
        state->observedEpoch = input->planEpoch;
    }

    if (input->core0StatusUsable == 0u) return 0u;
    if ((input->mode2Active == 0u) || (input->launched == 0u))
    {
        state->episodeActive = 0u;
        captureBaseline(state);
        return 0u;
    }
    if (input->altReached == 0u)
    {
        /* 飞行中到顶事实短暂撤销时保留已建立episode；真正进入episode前
         * 则持续吸收当前producer+epoch作为旧身份基线。 */
        if (state->episodeActive == 0u) captureBaseline(state);
        return 0u;
    }
    if (state->episodeActive == 0u) state->episodeActive = 1u;
    if ((state->observedProducerGeneration == 0u) ||
        (state->observedEpoch == 0u)) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (
        (state->observedProducerGeneration !=
            state->baselineProducerGeneration) ||
        (state->observedEpoch != state->baselineEpoch));
}

#include "menu.h"
#include "menuInternal.h"
#include "../comm/paramSyncOwnerService.h"
#include "../comm/paramSyncGlobal.h"

#include "menuKeyRemote.h"
#include "core1KvmRouter.h"
#include "../vision/visionParams.h"
#include "zf_device_ips114.h"
#include "zf_common_font.h"

#include <stdio.h>

/*
 * core1 cm_7_1 菜单调度核心: 共享状态唯一定义 + 公共 API + 状态机分发 + 链路握手门控。
 * 移植自 core0 menu.c, 去掉 arming/飞控, 改为"等 core0 链路在线"门控(MENU_WAIT_LINK)。
 */

#define LCD_REFRESH_DIV (2u) /* 10ms tick → 20ms遥测；按键dirty仍同拍刷新 */
#define HOME_VISUAL_REFRESH_DIV (4u) /* 10ms tick → 40ms整幅灰图+标注，独立于按键dirty */
#define MENU_INITIAL_LINK_WAIT_TICKS (200u) /* 10ms × 200 = 2s */
#define MENU_STORAGE_NONE    (0u)
#define MENU_STORAGE_SAVE    (1u)
#define MENU_STORAGE_RESTORE (2u)

static volatile uint16_t initialLinkWaitTicks;

/* ============================================================
 * 共享状态唯一定义点
 * ============================================================ */
/* BinaryCC 阈值 + 相机曝光（menuModel applyVisionLocal 钳位后写回 visionParams，热重载）。 */
menuContextStruct menuContext;

static void discardAllMenuKeys(void)
{
    uint8_t keyIndex;
    for (keyIndex = 0u; keyIndex < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; keyIndex++)
    {
        menuKeyClear((menuKeyIndexEnum) keyIndex);
    }
}

static uint8_t isValidKvmTarget(uint8_t target)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((target == CORE1_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ||
        (target == CORE1_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) ||
        (target == CORE1_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
        (target == CORE1_KVM_TARGET_CORE4));
}

void menuObserveKvmDesiredTarget(uint8_t snapshotValid, uint8_t desiredTarget)
{
    if (snapshotValid == 0u) return;
    if (isValidKvmTarget(desiredTarget) == 0u) return;

    if ((kvmDesiredTargetPrimed != 0u) &&
        (lastValidKvmDesiredTarget == CORE1_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) &&
        (desiredTarget != CORE1_KVM_TARGET_CORE1))
    {
        menuCurrentState = MENU_HOME;
        pageIdx = 0;
        optIdx = 0;
        scrollTop = 0u;
        threshSel = THRESH_SEL_CANNY_LOW;
        feedbackHoldTicks = 0u;
        feedbackWasActive = 0u;
        menuPendingFeedback = 0u;
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        clearScreenForState();
    }
    lastValidKvmDesiredTarget = desiredTarget;
    kvmDesiredTargetPrimed = 1u;
}

uint16_t menuBorderColor(void)
{
    core1KvmRouterSnapshot kvm;
    core1KvmRouterGetSnapshot(&kvm);
    if ((kvm.valid == 0u) || (kvm.inputOwner == CORE1_KVM_TARGET_NONE))
        return RGB565_YELLOW;
    return (kvm.inputOwner == CORE1_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED;
}

void menuInit(void)
{
    menuCurrentState = MENU_WAIT_LINK;
    pageIdx = 0;
    optIdx = 0;
    scrollTop = 0u;
    forceRedraw = 1u;
    threshSel = THRESH_SEL_CANNY_LOW;
    controlOwned = 0u;
    feedbackHoldTicks = 0u;
    feedbackWasActive = 0u;
    lcdRefreshFlag = 0u;
    homeVisualRefreshFlag = 0u;
    lcdRefreshCount = 0u;
    homeVisualRefreshCount = 0u;
    waitLinkRendered = 0u;
    kvmTickSeq = 0u;
    initialLinkWaitTicks = 0u;
    initFailedMask = 0u;
    initUnverifiedMask = 0u;
    initSummaryTicks = 0u;
    initSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFFFu;
    menuInputServiced = 0u;
    menuPendingScreenClear = 0u;
    menuPendingFeedback = 0u;
    menuPendingFeedbackColor = RGB565_BLACK;
    menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
    mutationLockLast = paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked();
    menuParamGlobalReset();
    kvmDesiredTargetPrimed = 0u;
    lastValidKvmDesiredTarget = CORE1_KVM_TARGET_NONE;

    menuSyncFromParams(); /* 工作副本 ← 当前 visionParams(已由 visionParamsLoad 从 flash 载入) */
    menuContext.paramsRevision = visionParamsGetRevision();
    menuBuildPages();

    /* IPS114 8×16 横屏 180, 黑底绿字 */
    ips114_set_dir(IPS114_PORTAIT_180);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_init();
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_clear();
    menuRenderResetListSnapshot();

    menuKeyInit(10u);
}

void menuPitTick(void)
{
    menuKeyScan();

    if (initSummaryTicks > 0u) initSummaryTicks--;

    if (initialLinkWaitTicks < MENU_INITIAL_LINK_WAIT_TICKS)
        initialLinkWaitTicks++;

    if (feedbackHoldTicks > 0u) feedbackHoldTicks--;

    lcdRefreshCount++;
    if (lcdRefreshCount >= LCD_REFRESH_DIV)
    {
        lcdRefreshCount = 0u;
        lcdRefreshFlag = 1u;
    }

    homeVisualRefreshCount++;
    if (homeVisualRefreshCount >= HOME_VISUAL_REFRESH_DIV)
    {
        homeVisualRefreshCount = 0u;
        homeVisualRefreshFlag = 1u;
    }
}

void menuRequestScreenClear(void)
{
    menuPendingScreenClear = 1u;
    forceRedraw = 1u;
}

void menuRequestFeedback(uint16_t color)

    menuPendingFeedbackColor = color;
    menuPendingFeedbackAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
    menuPendingFeedbackSlot = 0u;
    menuPendingFeedback = 1u;
}

void menuRequestParamFeedback(uint16_t color, uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    menuPendingFeedbackColor = color;
    menuPendingFeedbackAction = action;
    menuPendingFeedbackSlot = slot;
    menuPendingFeedback = 1u;
}

void menuRequestSaveSettings(void)
{
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return;
    menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_SAVE;
}

void menuRequestRestoreDefaults(void)
{
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return;
    menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_RESTORE;
}

static void applyPendingTailEffects(void)
{
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        if (menuPendingStorageAction != MENU_STORAGE_NONE &&
            menuPendingFeedbackAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE)
            menuPendingFeedback = 0u;
        menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
        return;
    }
    if (menuPendingStorageAction == MENU_STORAGE_SAVE)
    {
        menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
        menuSaveSettings();
    }
    else if (menuPendingStorageAction == MENU_STORAGE_RESTORE)
    {
        menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
        menuRestoreDefaults();
    }

    if (menuPendingFeedback != 0u)
    {
        menuPendingFeedback = 0u;
        menuPendingScreenClear = 0u;
        ips114_full(menuPendingFeedbackColor);
        if (menuPendingFeedbackAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY ||
            menuPendingFeedbackAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME)
        {
            char slotText[16];
            ips114_set_color((menuPendingFeedbackColor == RGB565_GREEN) ?
                RGB565_BLACK : RGB565_WHITE, menuPendingFeedbackColor);
            ips114_show_string(80u, 42u,
                (menuPendingFeedbackAction ==
                    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ?
                    "SAVE OK" : "LOAD OK");
            (void) snprintf(slotText, sizeof(slotText), "SLOT %u",
                (unsigned) menuPendingFeedbackSlot);
            ips114_show_string(88u, 66u, slotText);
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
        menuPendingFeedbackAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
        menuPendingFeedbackSlot = 0u;
        menuRenderResetListSnapshot();
        feedbackHoldTicks = MENU_FEEDBACK_HOLD_TICKS;
        return;
    }
    if (menuPendingScreenClear != 0u)
    {
        menuPendingScreenClear = 0u;
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_clear();
        menuRenderResetListSnapshot();
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
}

void menuServiceInput(void)
{
    core1KvmRouterSnapshot kvm;
    uint8_t linkUp;

    if (menuInputServiced != 0u) return;
    menuInputServiced = 1u;
    kvmTickSeq++;
    /* 链路在线 = 可显示菜单(门控); 操控权(controlActive) = core0 远程模式正操控 core1
     * (决定边框 绿/红)。core0 本地模式时 linkUp=1 但 controlActive=0: 菜单可见但边框红。 */
    linkUp = menuKeyRemoteLinkUp();
    controlOwned = menuKeyRemoteControlActive();
    core1KvmRouterGetSnapshot(&kvm);
    menuObserveKvmDesiredTarget(kvm.valid, kvm.desiredTarget);

    if (initSummaryTicks > 0u)
    {
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        return;
    }
    if (initSummaryLastSecond != 0xFFFFu)
    {
        initSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFFFu;
        clearScreenForState();
    }

    /* === 上电链路握手门控: 等 core0 链路在线才进 HOME === */
    if (menuCurrentState == MENU_WAIT_LINK)
    {
        if (linkUp || (initialLinkWaitTicks >= MENU_INITIAL_LINK_WAIT_TICKS))
        {
            menuCurrentState = MENU_HOME;
            waitLinkRendered = 0u;
            clearScreenForState();
        }
        else
        {
            discardAllMenuKeys();
            return;
        }
    }

    /* 初始窗口结束后保持HOME连续观测；断链/重连由标题、链路槽和安全owner表达，
     * 禁止切整页WAIT造成图像消失和两次清屏黑闪。 */

    /* === 填充反馈保持期: 吞按键, 倒计时结束清屏重绘 === */
    if (feedbackHoldTicks > 0u)
    {
        feedbackWasActive = 1u;
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        return;
    }
    if (feedbackWasActive)
    {
        feedbackWasActive = 0u;
        clearScreenForState();
    }

    /* === 按键 === */
    switch (menuCurrentState)
    {
        case MENU_HOME: handleHomeKeys(); break;
        case MENU_PAGE_LIST: handlePageListKeys(); break;
        case MENU_OPTION_LIST: handleOptionListKeys(); break;
        case MENU_EDIT: handleEditKeys(); break;
        case MENU_THRESH_EDIT: handleThreshEditKeys(); break;
        default: break;
    }

}

void menuTick(void)
{
    uint8_t redrawRequested;
    uint8_t visualDue;
    uint8_t mutationLocked;
    uint32_t paramsRevision;

    menuParamGlobalPoll();
    if (menuPendingFeedback != 0u)
    {
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        menuInputServiced = 1u;
    }
    mutationLocked = paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked();
    if (mutationLocked != mutationLockLast)
    {
        discardAllMenuKeys();
        if (menuPendingStorageAction != MENU_STORAGE_NONE &&
            menuPendingFeedbackAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE)
            menuPendingFeedback = 0u;
        menuPendingStorageAction = MENU_STORAGE_NONE;
        mutationLockLast = mutationLocked;
    }
    if (mutationLocked == 0u)
    {
        paramsRevision = visionParamsGetRevision();
        if (paramsRevision != menuContext.paramsRevision)
        {
            menuSyncFromParams();
            menuContext.paramsRevision = paramsRevision;
            forceRedraw = 1u;
        }
    }
    if (menuInputServiced == 0u) menuServiceInput();
    menuInputServiced = 0u;
    applyPendingTailEffects();

    if (initSummaryTicks > 0u)
    {
        uint16_t second = (uint16_t) ((initSummaryTicks + 99u) / 100u);
        if ((second != initSummaryLastSecond) || forceRedraw)
        {
            forceRedraw = 0u;
            renderInitFaultSummary(initFailedMask, initUnverifiedMask, (uint8_t) second);
            initSummaryLastSecond = second;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (menuCurrentState == MENU_WAIT_LINK)
    {
        if (forceRedraw || !waitLinkRendered)
        {
            forceRedraw = 0u;
            renderWaitLink();
            waitLinkRendered = 1u;
        }
        return;
    }
    if ((feedbackHoldTicks > 0u) || (menuPendingFeedback != 0u)) return;

    /* === 渲染(仅刷新节拍或强制重绘) === */
    if (!lcdRefreshFlag && !forceRedraw) return;
    lcdRefreshFlag = 0u;
    redrawRequested = forceRedraw;
    forceRedraw = 0u;
    visualDue = (uint8_t) ((menuCurrentState == MENU_HOME) && redrawRequested);
    if (((menuCurrentState == MENU_HOME) ||
         (menuCurrentState == MENU_THRESH_EDIT)) &&
        (homeVisualRefreshFlag != 0u))
    {
        homeVisualRefreshFlag = 0u;
        visualDue = 1u;
    }

    switch (menuCurrentState)
    {
        case MENU_HOME: renderHome(visualDue); break;
        case MENU_PAGE_LIST: renderPageList(); break;
        case MENU_OPTION_LIST: renderOptionList(0u); break;
        case MENU_EDIT: renderOptionList(1u); break;
        case MENU_THRESH_EDIT: renderThreshEdit(visualDue); break;
        default: break;
    }
}

void menuRenderInputFeedback(void)
{
    if ((forceRedraw == 0u) ||
        (menuPendingScreenClear != 0u) ||
        (menuPendingFeedback != 0u) ||
        (menuPendingStorageAction != MENU_STORAGE_NONE) ||
        (feedbackHoldTicks != 0u) ||
        (initSummaryTicks != 0u) ||
        (menuCurrentState == MENU_WAIT_LINK) ||
        (menuCurrentState == MENU_HOME))
    {
        return;
    }

    /* 只绘制当前surface的dirty槽；页面切换清屏、反馈和Flash仍由尾段owner处理。 */
    forceRedraw = 0u;
    switch (menuCurrentState)
    {
        case MENU_PAGE_LIST: renderPageList(); break;
        case MENU_OPTION_LIST: renderOptionList(0u); break;
        case MENU_EDIT: renderOptionList(1u); break;
        case MENU_THRESH_EDIT: renderThreshEdit(0u); break;
        default: break;
    }
}

void menuSetInitHealth(uint8_t failedMaskValue, uint8_t unverifiedMaskValue)
{
    initFailedMask = failedMaskValue;
    initUnverifiedMask = unverifiedMaskValue;
    if ((failedMaskValue | unverifiedMaskValue) != 0u)
    {
        initSummaryTicks = 300u;
        initSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFFFu;
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
}

void menuGetStatus(menuStatusSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    uint8_t holdTicks;
    if (out == 0) return;
    holdTicks = feedbackHoldTicks;
    out->tickSeq = kvmTickSeq;
    out->state = (uint8_t) menuCurrentState;
    out->homeReady = (uint8_t) ((menuCurrentState == MENU_HOME) && (holdTicks == 0u));
    out->inputReady = (uint8_t) ((menuCurrentState != MENU_WAIT_LINK) && (holdTicks == 0u));
    out->valid = 1u;
}

#ifndef _MENU_H_
#define _MENU_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core1 cm_7_1 菜单 + 屏幕显示(独占 IPS114; 按键来自核间串口透传, core1 无物理按键)。
 *
 *   远程 KVM 模型: core0 发车页长按切换"按键操控目标"到 core1 后, core0 按键事件经核间
 *   串口透传到 core1, 驱动本菜单。core1 在自己的屏显示发车页/阈值编辑器/参数页, 交互/UI
 *   对齐 core0。UI 分割线/边框颜色表示操控权: 被 core0 操控=绿, 未操控=红。
 *
 *   职责拆分(共享状态/类型/原型见 menuInternal.h):
 *     menu.c        共享状态定义 + 公共 API + 状态机分发 + 链路握手门控
 *     menuModel.c   视觉/规划参数工作副本/默认/热重载到 visionParams + 页表 + flash
 *     menuRender.c  8×16 渲染(发车页全屏信标图 + 阈值双图 + 列表) + 绿/红边框
 *     menuKeyRemote 远程按键源(接口同 core0 menuKey)
 *
 *   core1Loop.c 调度:
 *     processInit  → imageInit + visionParamsLoad + menuInit
 *     pitProcess0  → menuPitTick(PIT_CH2 10ms ISR: menuKeyScan + 刷新计数)
 *     whileProcess → KVM Ingress + menuServiceInput + imageProcess/planning + menuTick + KVM Finalize
 *
 *   上电先 MENU_WAIT_LINK 等 core0 链路在线(menuKeyRemoteLinkUp), 确认后进 MENU_HOME。
 *
 *   按键映射(对齐 core0):
 *     发车页:  K1 进菜单 / K3 进阈值编辑器 / K4 短:保存 长:恢复默认 / (K2/K5 预留)
 *     页列表:  K1 进选项 / K2 下 / K3 上 / K4 回发车页 / K5 保存回发车页
 *     选项列表:K1 进编辑 / K2 下 / K3 上 / K4 回页列表 / K5 保存回发车页
 *     编辑:    K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大 / K5 回选项列表
 *     阈值编辑器: K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大 / K5 短:切项(Lo/Hi/Exp) 长:保存回发车页
 */

void menuInit(void);    /* ips114+按键源初始化, 同步 visionParams 工作副本, 建页表 */
void menuSetInitHealth(uint8_t failedMask, uint8_t unverifiedMask);
void menuPitTick(void); /* PIT_CH2 10ms ISR: menuKeyScan + 刷新计数(轻量) */
void menuServiceInput(void); /* 前台前段: 链路门控 + 按键状态机，不访问 IPS114/Flash */
void menuRenderInputFeedback(void); /* 同页选择/数值变化的轻量即时反馈，不处理Flash/清屏 */
void menuTick(void);    /* 前台尾段: Flash/反馈/渲染 */
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t tickSeq;
    uint8_t state;
    uint8_t homeReady;
    uint8_t inputReady;
    uint8_t valid;
} menuStatusSnapshotStruct;

void menuGetStatus(menuStatusSnapshotStruct *out);

#endif /* _MENU_H_ */

#ifndef MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_INTERNAL_H
#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_INTERNAL_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "zf_device_ips114.h"

#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX (8u)
#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS        (15u)

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDigitsU64(uint64_t value)
{
    uint8_t digits = 1u;

    while (value >= 10u)
    {
        value /= 10u;
        digits++;
    }
    return digits;
}

static void menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(uint16_t x,
    uint16_t y,
    const char *literal)
{
    char buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS + 1u];
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t length = 0u;

    while ((literal[length] != '\0') && (length < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS))
    {
        length++;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS; i++)
    {
        buf[i] = ' ';
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < length; i++)
    {
        buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS - length + i] = literal[i];
    }
    buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS] = '\0';
    ips114_show_string(x, y, buf);
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForStep(float step)
{
    uint8_t decimals = 0u;
    double scaled = (step < 0.0f) ? -(double) step : (double) step;

    if (!(scaled > 0.0))
    {
        return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    }
    while (decimals < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX)
    {
        uint64_t rounded;
        double difference;

        if (!(scaled < (double) UINT64_MAX) ||
            !((scaled + 0.5) < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
        }
        rounded = (uint64_t) (scaled + 0.5);
        difference = scaled - (double) rounded;

        if (difference < 0.0)
        {
            difference = -difference;
        }
        if (difference <= 0.000001)
        {
            break;
        }
        scaled *= 10.0;
        decimals++;
    }
    return decimals;
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValue(double value)
{
    uint8_t decimals;
    double scale = 1.0;
    double tolerance = 0.0000001;

    if (value < 0.0)
    {
        value = -value;
    }
    if (!(value >= 0.0) || !(value < (double) UINT64_MAX))
    {
        return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    }
    for (decimals = 0u; decimals < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX; decimals++)
    {
        double scaled = value * scale;
        uint64_t rounded;
        double difference;

        if (!(scaled < (double) UINT64_MAX) ||
            !((scaled + 0.5) < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
        }
        rounded = (uint64_t) (scaled + 0.5);
        difference = value - ((double) rounded / scale);

        if (difference < 0.0)
        {
            difference = -difference;
        }
        if (difference <= tolerance)
        {
            return decimals;
        }
        scale *= 10.0;
    }
    return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(double value, float step)
{
    uint8_t stepDecimals = menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForStep(step);
    uint8_t valueDecimals = menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValue(value);

    return (stepDecimals > valueDecimals) ? stepDecimals : valueDecimals;
}

static void menuFloatDisplayShow(uint16_t x,
    uint16_t y,
    double value,
    uint8_t requestedDecimals)
{
    static const uint64_t scaleTable[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX + 1u] =
    {
        1u, 10u, 100u, 1000u, 10000u,
        100000u, 1000000u, 10000000u, 100000000u
    };
    char buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS + 1u];
    uint8_t decimals;
    uint8_t selectedDecimals = 0xFFu;
    uint8_t negative = 0u;
    uint8_t pos;
    uint8_t i;
    uint64_t scale = 1u;
    uint64_t scaled = 0u;
    uint64_t intPart;
    uint64_t fracPart;

    if (value != value)
    {
        menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(x, y, "NAN");
        return;
    }
    if (value < 0.0)
    {
        negative = 1u;
        value = -value;
    }

    decimals = (requestedDecimals <= MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX)
        ? requestedDecimals
        : MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    for (;; decimals--)
    {
        double scaledDouble;
        double roundedDouble;
        uint8_t required;

        scale = scaleTable[decimals];
        scaledDouble = value * (double) scale;
        roundedDouble = scaledDouble + 0.5;
        if ((scaledDouble < (double) UINT64_MAX) &&
            (roundedDouble < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            scaled = (uint64_t) roundedDouble;
            intPart = scaled / scale;
            required = (uint8_t) (negative + menuFloatDisplayDigitsU64(intPart));
            if (decimals != 0u)
            {
                required = (uint8_t) (required + 1u + decimals);
            }
            if (required <= MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS)
            {
                selectedDecimals = decimals;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (decimals == 0u)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    if (selectedDecimals == 0xFFu)
    {
        menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(x, y, "OVERFLOW");
        return;
    }

    for (i = 0u; i < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS; i++)
    {
        buf[i] = ' ';
    }
    buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS] = '\0';
    intPart = scaled / scale;
    fracPart = scaled % scale;
    pos = MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS;
    for (i = 0u; i < selectedDecimals; i++)
    {
        buf[--pos] = (char) ('0' + (fracPart % 10u));
        fracPart /= 10u;
    }
    if (selectedDecimals != 0u)
    {
        buf[--pos] = '.';
    }
    do
    {
        buf[--pos] = (char) ('0' + (intPart % 10u));
        intPart /= 10u;
    } while ((intPart != 0u) && (pos > 0u));
    if ((negative != 0u) && (pos > 0u))
    {
        buf[--pos] = '-';
    }

    ips114_show_string(x, y, buf);
}

/*
 * core1 menuInput.c — 按键状态机 handler(按 menuState 分发) + 清屏/填充反馈/滚动维护。
 * 移植自 core0, 编辑即时生效调 applyVisionLocal()。按键经 menuKeyRemote(核间透传)。
