static void moveSelectionAndScroll(int8_t* index, uint8_t count, int8_t delta)
{
    if (count == 0u)
    {
        *index = 0;
        scrollTop = 0u;
        return;
    }
    *index = (int8_t) (*index + delta);
    if (*index < 0) *index = (int8_t) (count - 1u);
    else if (*index >= (int8_t) count) *index = 0;

    if ((uint8_t) *index < scrollTop) scrollTop = (uint8_t) *index;
    else if ((uint8_t) *index >= scrollTop + VISIBLE_ROWS)
        scrollTop = (uint8_t) ((uint8_t) *index - VISIBLE_ROWS + 1u);
}

static void pageListMove(int8_t delta);

static uint32_t paramGlobalRequestSequence;
static uint32_t pendingParamGlobalCoordinatorBoot;
static paramSyncGlobalRequest pendingParamGlobalRequest;
static menuParamGlobalUiSnapshot paramGlobalUi;
static uint8_t pendingParamGlobalRequestValid;
static paramSyncGlobalState latestParamGlobalState;
static uint32_t latestParamGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs;
static uint8_t latestParamGlobalStatePrimed;
static uint8_t latestParamGlobalStateValid;
static uint8_t pendingParamSlotInspect;
static uint8_t requestGlobalParamAction(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot);

static void scheduleParamSlotInspect(void)
{
    pendingParamSlotInspect = 1u;
    paramGlobalUi.slotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
    forceRedraw = 1u;
}

#define MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_FRESH_MS (300u)

static uint8_t tryReadFreshParamGlobalState(paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState sampled;
    uint32_t nowMs = core1RuntimeGetTickMs();
    if (state == 0) return 0u;
    if (coreDataTryReadParamGlobalState(&sampled) != 0u)
    {
        if (latestParamGlobalStatePrimed == 0u ||
            sampled.coordinatorBootGeneration !=
                latestParamGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration)
        {
            latestParamGlobalState = sampled;
            latestParamGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs = nowMs;
            latestParamGlobalStatePrimed = 1u;
            latestParamGlobalStateValid = 0u;
        }
        else if ((int32_t) (sampled.sequence -
                     latestParamGlobalState.sequence) > 0)
        {
            latestParamGlobalState = sampled;
            latestParamGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs = nowMs;
            latestParamGlobalStateValid = 1u;
        }
    }
    if (latestParamGlobalStatePrimed == 0u ||
        latestParamGlobalStateValid == 0u ||
        (uint32_t) (nowMs - latestParamGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs) >=
            MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_FRESH_MS)
    {
        latestParamGlobalStateValid = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    *state = latestParamGlobalState;
    return 1u;
}

void menuParamGlobalReset(void)
{
    memset(&pendingParamGlobalRequest, 0, sizeof(pendingParamGlobalRequest));
    memset(&paramGlobalUi, 0, sizeof(paramGlobalUi));
    paramGlobalUi.target = 0xFFu;
    pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    pendingParamGlobalCoordinatorBoot = 0u;
    memset(&latestParamGlobalState, 0, sizeof(latestParamGlobalState));
    latestParamGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs = 0u;
    latestParamGlobalStatePrimed = 0u;
    latestParamGlobalStateValid = 0u;
    pendingParamSlotInspect = 0u;
    paramGlobalUi.slotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNKNOWN;
}

void menuParamGlobalGetUi(menuParamGlobalUiSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    if (snapshot != 0) *snapshot = paramGlobalUi;
}

void menuParamGlobalPoll(void)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState state;
    uint8_t nextUi;
    uint32_t nextDiagnostic = 0u;
    if (pendingParamGlobalRequestValid == 0u)
    {
        if (pendingParamSlotInspect != 0u &&
            tryReadFreshParamGlobalState(&state) != 0u &&
            paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&state) != 0u &&
            requestGlobalParamAction(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY,
                (uint8_t) paramSlotSelection) != 0u)
            pendingParamSlotInspect = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (tryReadFreshParamGlobalState(&state) == 0u)
    {
        memset(&state, 0, sizeof(state));
        nextUi = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
        state.phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED;
        state.target = 1u;
        state.error = (latestParamGlobalStatePrimed != 0u &&
            latestParamGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration !=
                pendingParamGlobalCoordinatorBoot) ?
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_PEER_RESTART :
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE;
        pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    }
    else if (state.coordinatorBootGeneration != pendingParamGlobalCoordinatorBoot)
    {
        nextUi = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
        state.phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED;
        state.target = 1u;
        state.error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_PEER_RESTART;
        pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    }
    else if (paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(&state,
                 &pendingParamGlobalRequest) != 0u &&
             (state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t completedAction = pendingParamGlobalRequest.action;
        uint8_t completedSlot = pendingParamGlobalRequest.slot;
        nextUi = ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_OK) != 0u) ?
            MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS : MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
        nextDiagnostic = (nextUi == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED) ?
            state.transactionId : 0u;
        paramGlobalUi.action = completedAction;
        paramGlobalUi.slot = completedSlot;
        if (completedAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        {
            if (completedSlot == (uint8_t) paramSlotSelection)
                paramGlobalUi.slotUiState = (nextUi == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS) ?
                    paramSyncGlobalClassifySlotSummary(state.transactionId) :
                    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        }
        else if (nextUi == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS)
        {
            menuRequestParamFeedback((completedAction ==
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ? RGB565_GREEN :
                RGB565_RED, completedAction, completedSlot);
            pendingParamSlotInspect = 1u;
        }
        pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    }
    else if (paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(&state,
                 &pendingParamGlobalRequest) != 0u &&
             (state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u)
        nextUi = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS;
    else if (paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&state) == 0u)
    {
        nextUi = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
        state.phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED;
        state.target = 1u;
        state.error = ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY) != 0u) ?
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY :
            (((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u) ?
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY : PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
        pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 0u;
    }
    else
        return;
    if (paramGlobalUi.state != nextUi || paramGlobalUi.phase != state.phase ||
        paramGlobalUi.target != state.target || paramGlobalUi.error != state.error ||
        paramGlobalUi.diagnostic != nextDiagnostic)
    {
        paramGlobalUi.state = nextUi;
        paramGlobalUi.phase = state.phase;
        paramGlobalUi.target = state.target;
        paramGlobalUi.error = state.error;
        paramGlobalUi.diagnostic = nextDiagnostic;
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
}

static uint8_t requestGlobalParamAction(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState state;
    paramSyncGlobalRequest request;
    if (pendingParamGlobalRequestValid != 0u ||
        paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u ||
        tryReadFreshParamGlobalState(&state) == 0u ||
        paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&state) == 0u) return 0u;
    paramGlobalRequestSequence++;
    if (paramGlobalRequestSequence == 0u) paramGlobalRequestSequence = 1u;
    memset(&request, 0, sizeof(request));
    request.producerBootGeneration = coreDataGetPlanBootGeneration();
    request.sequence = paramGlobalRequestSequence;
    request.origin = 1u;
    request.action = action;
    request.slot = slot;
    if (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&request) == 0u) return 0u;
    coreDataWriteParamGlobalRequest(&request);
    pendingParamGlobalRequest = request;
    pendingParamGlobalCoordinatorBoot = state.coordinatorBootGeneration;
    pendingParamGlobalRequestValid = 1u;
    paramGlobalUi.state = MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED;
    paramGlobalUi.phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_REQUESTED;
    paramGlobalUi.target = 0xFFu;
    paramGlobalUi.error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    paramGlobalUi.diagnostic = 0u;
    paramGlobalUi.action = action;
    paramGlobalUi.slot = slot;
    if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        paramGlobalUi.slotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
    forceRedraw = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

static void enterPageList(uint8_t resetSelection)
{
    menuCurrentState = MENU_PAGE_LIST;
    if (resetSelection)
    {
        pageIdx = 0;
        scrollTop = 0u;

    else
    {
        scrollTop = 0u;
        pageListMove(0);
    }
    clearScreenForState();
}

static void enterOptionList(void)
{
    if (pageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) pageIdx >= menuPageCount
        || menuPages[pageIdx].optionCount == 0u)
    {
        forceRedraw = 1u;
        return;
    }
    menuCurrentState = MENU_OPTION_LIST;
    optIdx = 0;
    scrollTop = 0u;
    if ((uint8_t) pageIdx == paramSlotsPageIndex)
        scheduleParamSlotInspect();
    clearScreenForState();
}

static void pageListMove(int8_t delta)
{
    if (menuPageCount == 0u)
    {
        moveSelectionAndScroll(&pageIdx, menuPageCount, delta);
        return;
    }
    moveSelectionAndScroll(&pageIdx, menuPageCount, delta);
    forceRedraw = 1u;
}

/* 发车页: K1 进菜单 / K3 进阈值编辑器 / K4 短:保存 长:恢复默认。(K2/K5 预留) */
void handleHomeKeys(void)
{
    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return;

    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        enterPageList(1u);
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        menuCurrentState = MENU_THRESH_EDIT;
        threshSel = THRESH_SEL_CANNY_LOW;
        clearScreenForState();
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        menuRequestSaveSettings();
        menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_GREEN); /* 保存确认绿屏 */
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        menuRequestRestoreDefaults();
        menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_RED); /* 恢复默认红屏 */
    }
}

void handleOptionListKeys(void)
{
    menuPageStruct* pg;

    if (pageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) pageIdx >= menuPageCount)
    {
        enterPageList(0u);
        return;
    }
    pg = &menuPages[pageIdx];

    if ((uint8_t) pageIdx == paramSlotsPageIndex)
    {
        uint8_t slot = (uint8_t) paramSlotSelection;
        uint8_t ok = 0u;
        if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
        {
            menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
            if (paramGlobalUi.slotUiState == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL)
            {
                ok = requestGlobalParamAction(
                    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME, slot);
            }
            (void) ok;
        }
        else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
        {
            menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
            paramSlotSelection = (float) ((slot < 5u) ? slot + 1u : 1u);
            scheduleParamSlotInspect();
        }
        else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
        {
            menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
            paramSlotSelection = (float) ((slot > 1u) ? slot - 1u : 5u);
            scheduleParamSlotInspect();
        }
        else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
        {
            menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
            enterPageList(0u);
        }
        else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
        {
            menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
            ok = requestGlobalParamAction(
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY, slot);
            (void) ok;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u &&
            pg->optionCount > 0u && optIdx >= 0 && optIdx < (int8_t) pg->optionCount
            && pg->opt[optIdx] != 0)
        {
            menuCurrentState = MENU_EDIT;
            forceRedraw = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        moveSelectionAndScroll(&optIdx, pg->optionCount, +1);
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        moveSelectionAndScroll(&optIdx, pg->optionCount, -1);
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        enterPageList(0u);
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u)
        {
            menuRequestSaveSettings();
            menuCurrentState = MENU_HOME;
            menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_GREEN);
        }
    }
}

void handleEditKeys(void)
{
    menuPageStruct* pg;
    float delta = 0.0f;
    uint8_t hasDelta = 0u;

    if (pageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) pageIdx >= menuPageCount)
    {
        enterPageList(0u);
        return;
    }
    pg = &menuPages[pageIdx];

    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        menuCurrentState = MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }

    if (optIdx < 0 || optIdx >= (int8_t) pg->optionCount || pg->opt[optIdx] == 0)
    {
        menuCurrentState = MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }

    /* K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大 / K5 回选项列表 */
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        delta = pg->stepL[optIdx];
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        delta = pg->stepS[optIdx];
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        delta = -pg->stepS[optIdx];
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        delta = -pg->stepL[optIdx];
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        menuCurrentState = MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }

    if (hasDelta)
    {
        *pg->opt[optIdx] += delta;
        applyVisionLocal(); /* 钳位 + 热重载, 下一帧即生效 */
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
}

/* 阈值编辑器: K1 +大 / K2 +小 / K3 -小 / K4 -大(作用于当前 DetectMode 的 Lo/Hi/Exp);
 *   K5 短:切项(Lo→Hi→Exp) 长:保存回发车页。 */
void handleThreshEditKeys(void)
{
    float stepL;
    float stepS;
    float delta = 0.0f;
    uint8_t hasDelta = 0u;

    if (paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        menuCurrentState = MENU_HOME;
        clearScreenForState();
        return;
    }

    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        menuRequestSaveSettings();
        menuCurrentState = MENU_HOME;
        menuFlashFeedback(RGB565_GREEN);
        return;
    }
    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_5) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_5);
        threshSel = (threshSelEnum) ((threshSel + 1u) % THRESH_SEL_COUNT); /* Lo → Hi → Exp */
        forceRedraw = 1u;
        return;
    }

    if (threshSel == THRESH_SEL_EXPOSURE)
    {
        stepL = VISION_EXPOSURE_STEP_LONG;
        stepS = VISION_EXPOSURE_STEP_SHORT;
    }
    else
    {
        stepL = VISION_CANNY_STEP_LONG;
        stepS = VISION_CANNY_STEP_SHORT;
    }

    if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_1) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_1);
        delta = stepL;
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_2) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_2);
        delta = stepS;
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_3) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_3);
        delta = -stepS;
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }
    else if (menuKeyGetState(MENU_KEY_4) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(MENU_KEY_4);
        delta = -stepL;
        hasDelta = 1u;
    }

    if (hasDelta)
    {
        if (threshSel == THRESH_SEL_CANNY_LOW)
        {
            if (detectModeF >= 0.5f) legacyCannyLowF += delta;
            else cannyLowF += delta;
        }
        else if (threshSel == THRESH_SEL_CANNY_HIGH)
        {
            if (detectModeF >= 0.5f) legacyCannyHighF += delta;
            else cannyHighF += delta;
        }
        else
        {
            exposureF += delta;
        }
        applyVisionLocal(); /* 钳位 + 热重载, 下一帧两图即更新 */
        forceRedraw = 1u;
    }
}

#include "menuKeyRemote.h"

/*
 * core1 远程按键源实现。事务KVM router在前台通过menuKeyRemoteInject投递，
 * 本模块只拥有按键锁存与超时，供菜单handler用menuKeyGetState/Clear消费。
 *
 * 与 core0 menuKey 的差异: 不读 GPIO、不消抖(生产端已消抖识别), 只 seq 去重 + 锁存 + 超时。
 * 与 core0 一致: 短按锁存至 Clear; 长按消费后置等释放; 短按超时自动清除防陈旧。
 */

#define MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS (1000u) /* 短按锁存超时(与 core0 一致), 防陈旧事件 */

static volatile uint32_t scanPeriodMs = 0u;
static volatile menuKeyStateEnum keyState[MENU_KEY_COUNT];
static volatile uint8_t keyConsumed[MENU_KEY_COUNT]; /* menuKeyClear 显式消费证据 */
static volatile uint32_t shortHoldMs[MENU_KEY_COUNT]; /* 短按锁存已保持时长 */
static volatile uint8_t linkUpCache = 0u;             /* 最近读到的 core0 链路在线标志 */
static volatile uint8_t controlActiveCache = 0u;      /* core0 远程模式正操控 core1(决定绿/红边框) */
static volatile uint8_t core2LinkLostCache = 0u;      /* core1 cm_7_0 观测到的 core2 链路断联标志 */

void menuKeyInit(uint32_t periodMs)
{
    if (periodMs == 0u) periodMs = 1u;
    scanPeriodMs = periodMs;
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; i++)
    {
        keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
        shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
    }
    linkUpCache = 0u;
    controlActiveCache = 0u;
    core2LinkLostCache = 0u;
}

void menuKeyScan(void)
{
    /* 短按锁存超时清除(与 core0 menuKey 同语义): 短按事件长时间未被消费自动失效。 */
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; i++)
    {
        if (keyState[i] == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
        {
            shortHoldMs[i] += scanPeriodMs;
            if (shortHoldMs[i] >= MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS)
            {
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
                shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
            }
        }
    }

}

uint8_t menuKeyRemoteInject(uint8_t keyId, uint8_t state)
{
    if ((keyId >= (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT) ||
        ((state != (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS) &&
         (state != (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)) ||
        (keyState[keyId] != MENU_KEY_RELEASE))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    keyState[keyId] = (menuKeyStateEnum) state;
    shortHoldMs[keyId] = 0u;
    keyConsumed[keyId] = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t menuKeyRemoteTakeConsumed(uint8_t keyId)
{
    uint8_t consumed;
    if (keyId >= (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT) return 0u;
    consumed = keyConsumed[keyId];
    keyConsumed[keyId] = 0u;
    return consumed;
}

void menuKeyRemoteRevoke(void)
{
    uint8_t i;
    for (i = 0u; i < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; i++)
    {
        keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
        shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
        keyConsumed[i] = 0u;
    }
}

void menuKeyRemoteSetLinkState(uint8_t linkUp, uint8_t controlActive,
    uint8_t core2LinkLost)
{
    linkUpCache = linkUp ? 1u : 0u;
    controlActiveCache = controlActive ? 1u : 0u;
    core2LinkLostCache = core2LinkLost ? 1u : 0u;
}

menuKeyStateEnum menuKeyGetState(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (k >= MENU_KEY_COUNT) return MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
    return keyState[k];
}

void menuKeyClear(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (k >= MENU_KEY_COUNT) return;
    /* 远程事件无"按住"概念(每个事务事件单次投递)，消费即清。 */
    if (keyState[k] != MENU_KEY_RELEASE) keyConsumed[k] = 1u;
    keyState[k] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
    shortHoldMs[k] = 0u;
}

uint8_t menuKeyRemoteLinkUp(void)
{
    return linkUpCache;
}

uint8_t menuKeyRemoteControlActive(void)
{
    return controlActiveCache;
}

uint8_t menuKeyRemoteCore2LinkLost(void)
{
    return core2LinkLostCache;
}

#ifndef _MENU_KEY_REMOTE_H_
#define _MENU_KEY_REMOTE_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core1 cm_7_1 远程按键源 —— 接口与 core0 menuKey 完全一致(menuKeyGetState/Clear),
 * 但按键状态不读本地 GPIO(core1 无物理按键), 而来自事务KVM router:
 *   生产者: core1KvmRouter在前台校验session/epoch/lease后调用menuKeyRemoteInject
 *   消费者: 菜单 handler 调 menuKeyGetState/Clear(与 core0 同语义)
 *
 * 保留 core0 的锁存 + 超时清除语义: 短按事件锁存至 menuKeyClear; 长时间未消费自动清除
 * 防陈旧。生产者已是"消抖识别后的事件"(core0 menuKeyScan 产出), 故本端不再消抖, 只做
 * exactly-once由router负责；本模块只做锁存与超时。
 *
 * 线程模型: menuKeyScan在PIT_CH2 10ms ISR更新超时；Inject/Get/Clear在前台调用，
 * 状态数组volatile跨ISR/前台共享。
 */

typedef enum
{
    MENU_KEY_1 = 0u,
    MENU_KEY_2,
    MENU_KEY_3,
    MENU_KEY_4,
    MENU_KEY_5,
    MENU_KEY_COUNT
} menuKeyIndexEnum;

typedef enum
{
    MENU_KEY_RELEASE = 0u,
    MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS,
    MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS
} menuKeyStateEnum;

/* 初始化: 清状态。periodMs = 调用 menuKeyRemoteTick 的周期(毫秒) */
void menuKeyInit(uint32_t periodMs);

/* tick: PIT ISR 只做本地锁存超时，不读共享内存/DCache。 */
void menuKeyScan(void);

/* 仅由前台 KVM router 调用。 */
uint8_t menuKeyRemoteInject(uint8_t keyId, uint8_t keyState);
uint8_t menuKeyRemoteTakeConsumed(uint8_t keyId);
void menuKeyRemoteRevoke(void);
void menuKeyRemoteSetLinkState(uint8_t linkUp, uint8_t controlActive,
    uint8_t core2LinkLost);

/* 查询/清除按键状态(短按事件保留至 menuKeyClear) —— 与 core0 menuKey 同名同义 */
menuKeyStateEnum menuKeyGetState(menuKeyIndexEnum k);
void menuKeyClear(menuKeyIndexEnum k);

/* core0 链路是否在线(共享内存 linkUp)。菜单据此做断联门控/提示。 */
uint8_t menuKeyRemoteLinkUp(void);

/* core0 是否远程模式正操控 core1(共享内存 controlActive)。菜单据此画绿(被控)/红(未控)边框。 */
uint8_t menuKeyRemoteControlActive(void);

/* core1 cm_7_0 观测到 core2 RS-485 链路断联=1；供 HOME HUD 显示。 */
uint8_t menuKeyRemoteCore2LinkLost(void);

#endif /* _MENU_KEY_REMOTE_H_ */

/*

 *   热重载(写回 visionParams + visionParamsApply), flash 持久化(经 visionParams)。
 *   不触屏、不读按键。参数覆盖信标视觉(BinaryCC/beacon/track)与规划(planning), 无飞控参数。
 *
 * 工作副本用 float 是为复用 core0 菜单"float* opt[] 指针编辑 + 步进"的通用 EDIT 框架;
 * 应用时钳位 + 转回 visionParams 的定宽类型。
 */

/* BinaryCC 阈值编辑约束(MIN/MAX/GAP)已移至 config/configBeaconDetect.h(VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_*)。 */

static float sanitizeMenuFloat(float v, float def, float lo, float hi)
{
    if (v != v || v > 1.0e30f || v < -1.0e30f) v = def;
    return clampf(v, lo, hi);
}

static void clampBorderPairF(float *enter, float *exit, float maxValue)
{
    if ((enter == 0) || (exit == 0)) return;

    if (*enter < 0.5f)
    {
        *enter = 0.0f;
        *exit = 0.0f;
        return;
    }
    *enter = clampf(*enter, 1.0f, maxValue);
    *exit = clampf(*exit, 0.0f, *enter - 1.0f);
}

/* 工作副本钳位 → 写回 visionParams → 热重载到 BinaryCC/track 检测器(立即生效)。 */
void applyVisionLocal(void)
{
    visionParamsStruct candidate;
    visionParamsGetActive(&candidate);
    detectModeF = (detectModeF >= 0.5f) ? (float) VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY
                                        : (float) VISION_DETECT_MODE_BINARYCC;

    /* BinaryCC 阈值钳位: MIN/MAX/GAP(low+GAP<=high)。 */
    if (cannyLowF < VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN) cannyLowF = VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
    if (cannyHighF > VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX) cannyHighF = VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX;
    if (cannyLowF + VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP > cannyHighF)
    {
        if (cannyHighF > (VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP))
        {
            cannyLowF = cannyHighF - VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP;
        }
        else
        {
            cannyLowF = VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
            cannyHighF = VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP;
        }
    }
    if (legacyCannyLowF < VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN) legacyCannyLowF = VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
    if (legacyCannyHighF > VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX) legacyCannyHighF = VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX;
    if (legacyCannyLowF + VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP > legacyCannyHighF)
    {
        if (legacyCannyHighF > (VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP))
        {
            legacyCannyLowF = legacyCannyHighF - VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP;
        }
        else
        {
            legacyCannyLowF = VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
            legacyCannyHighF = VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP;
        }
    }
    exposureF = clampf(exposureF, (float) VISION_EXPOSURE_MIN, (float) VISION_EXPOSURE_MAX);

    /* beacon 钳位: sizeMin<sizeMax 且都在 uint16; ecc>=1; bright/endpoints 范围。 */
    beaconSizeMinF = clampf(beaconSizeMinF, 1.0f, 59999.0f);
    beaconSizeMaxF = clampf(beaconSizeMaxF, beaconSizeMinF + 1.0f, 60000.0f);
    beaconEccMaxF = clampf(beaconEccMaxF, 0.0f, 20.0f);
    beaconBrightMinF = clampf(beaconBrightMinF, 0.0f, 255.0f);
    beaconMaxEndpointsF = clampf(beaconMaxEndpointsF, 0.0f, 200.0f);
    beaconFillMinF = clampf(beaconFillMinF, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    beaconHuMaxF = clampf(beaconHuMaxF, VISION_BEACON_HU_MAX_MIN, VISION_BEACON_HU_MAX_MAX);
    beaconHuAreaMinF = clampf(beaconHuAreaMinF,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_AREA_MIN_MIN, VISION_BEACON_HU_AREA_MIN_MAX);

    /* track 钳位: assocDist>0; sizeRatio>1; confirm/drop/coast>=1; 关联 alpha 0.01..1。 */
    trackAssocDistF = clampf(trackAssocDistF, 1.0f, 100.0f);
    trackSizeRatioF = clampf(trackSizeRatioF, 1.1f, 10.0f);
    trackConfirmHitsF = clampf(trackConfirmHitsF, 1.0f, 60.0f);
    trackDropMissesF = clampf(trackDropMissesF, 1.0f, 60.0f);
    trackCoastMissesF = clampf(trackCoastMissesF, 1.0f, 60.0f);
    trackPositionAlphaF = clampf(trackPositionAlphaF, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MAX);
    trackSizeAlphaF = clampf(trackSizeAlphaF, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MAX);
    trackAreaVelAlphaF = clampf(trackAreaVelAlphaF, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MAX);
    trackAssocScoreMaxF = clampf(trackAssocScoreMaxF,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_SCORE_MAX_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_SCORE_MAX_MAX);
    trackAssocAreaWeightF = clampf(trackAssocAreaWeightF,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_WEIGHT_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_WEIGHT_MAX);
    trackAssocAreaVelWeightF = clampf(trackAssocAreaVelWeightF,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_WEIGHT_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_WEIGHT_MAX);
    planningEdgePredictionHoldMsF = clampf(planningEdgePredictionHoldMsF,
        VISION_TRACK_EDGE_PREDICTION_HOLD_MS_MIN,
        VISION_TRACK_EDGE_PREDICTION_HOLD_MS_MAX);
    c1EdgeBandLeftF = clampf(c1EdgeBandLeftF, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    c1EdgeBandRightF = clampf(c1EdgeBandRightF, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    c1EdgeBandTopF = clampf(c1EdgeBandTopF, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);
    c1EdgeBandBottomF = clampf(c1EdgeBandBottomF, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);
    observerEdgeBandLeftF = clampf(observerEdgeBandLeftF, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    observerEdgeBandRightF = clampf(observerEdgeBandRightF, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    observerEdgeBandTopF = clampf(observerEdgeBandTopF, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);
    observerEdgeBandBottomF = clampf(observerEdgeBandBottomF, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);

    clampBorderPairF(&c1BorderEnterRightF, &c1BorderExitRightF, (float) VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX);

    clampBorderPairF(&c1BorderEnterBottomF, &c1BorderExitBottomF, (float) VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX);

    clampBorderPairF(&observerBorderEnterRightF, &observerBorderExitRightF, (float) VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX);
    clampBorderPairF(&observerBorderEnterTopF, &observerBorderExitTopF, (float) VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX);
    clampBorderPairF(&observerBorderEnterBottomF, &observerBorderExitBottomF, (float) VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX);

    /* planning 钳位：中心/增益/限幅/Min/施密特死区/保持阈值/TD 均为运行时参数。 */

/* 保存: 钳位应用 + 落 flash。 */
void menuSaveSettings(void)
{
    applyVisionLocal();
    core3LinkCore1SyncDesiredIdentity();
    core4LinkCore1SyncDesiredIdentity();
    visionParamsSave();
}

/* 恢复默认: visionParams 次序(载默认→apply→擦盘, 擦后立即按默认运行) + 同步工作副本。 */
void menuRestoreDefaults(void)
{
    visionParamsRestoreDefaults();
    menuSyncFromParams();
}

/* ============================================================
 * 分页页表(信标视觉 + 规划参数)
 * ============================================================ */
static menuPageStruct* addPage(const char* name)
{
    menuPageStruct* pg;
    if (menuPageCount >= MENU_MAX_PAGES) return 0;
    pg = &menuPages[menuPageCount];
    pg->name = name;
    pg->optionCount = 0u;
    menuPageCount++;
    return pg;
}

static void addPageOption(menuPageStruct* pg, uint8_t* index, const char* name,
    float* value, float stepShort, float stepLong)
{
    uint8_t i = *index;
    pg->optName[i] = name;
    pg->opt[i] = value;
    pg->stepS[i] = stepShort;
    pg->stepL[i] = stepLong;
    pg->decimals[i] = 0u;
    *index = (uint8_t) (i + 1u);
}

static void addPageOptionDecimal(menuPageStruct* pg, uint8_t* index, const char* name,
    float* value, float stepShort, float stepLong, uint8_t decimals)
{
    uint8_t i = *index;
    pg->optName[i] = name;
    pg->opt[i] = value;
    pg->stepS[i] = stepShort;
    pg->stepL[i] = stepLong;
    pg->decimals[i] = decimals;
    *index = (uint8_t) (i + 1u);
}

            SOURCE_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_STEP_SHORT, SOURCE_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_STEP_LONG);
        addPageOption(pg, &i, "CenterX", &core4CenterXF,
            CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_STEP_SHORT, CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_STEP_LONG);

        addPageOption(pg, &i, "RSign", &core4ErrorRightSignF, 2.0f, 2.0f);
        pg->optionCount = i;
    }

    paramSlotsPageIndex = menuPageCount;
    paramSlotSelection = 1.0f;
    {
        menuPageStruct* pg = addPage("Param Slots");
        uint8_t i = 0u;
        if (pg == 0) return;

    }

/*
 * core1 menuRender.c — IPS114 8×16 渲染。移植自 core0, 适配:
 *   - 相机 188×120, 缩放宏按本核分辨率重算
 *   - 发车页显示信标灰度图视口 + 右侧 HUD + 左下来源/误差三行状态(非 core0 飞控数据)
 *   - 阈值编辑器双图: 原图 + BinaryCC mask(imageGetFrameView), Lo/Hi/Exp 热调
 *   - 分割线/边框颜色按操控权: 被控=绿 未控=红(menuBorderColor)
 * 仅消费状态不修改。8×16 字模占 y0..15, 横线避开字模行防闪烁。
 */

/* 发车页布局: 左图像块 + 右文字区。动态文字定宽覆盖，避免整块清黑闪烁。 */
#define HOME_IMG_X    (2u)
#define HOME_IMG_Y    (17u)
#define HOME_IMG_W    (130u)
#define HOME_CAM_X    (HOME_IMG_X)
#define HOME_CAM_Y    (HOME_IMG_Y)
#define HOME_CAM_W    (HOME_IMG_W)
#define HOME_CAM_H    (67u)
#define HOME_TXT_X    (135u)
#define HOME_VLINE_X  (133u)
#define HOME_SLOT_COUNT (13u)
#define HOME_SLOT_CHARS (39u)

static char homeSlotCache[HOME_SLOT_COUNT][HOME_SLOT_CHARS + 1u];
static uint8_t homeSlotValid[HOME_SLOT_COUNT];
static uint16_t homeSlotColor[HOME_SLOT_COUNT];
static uint16_t homeSlotBackground[HOME_SLOT_COUNT];
static uint16_t homeTitleColor = 0xFFFFu;
static uint16_t homeLayoutColor = 0xFFFFu;
#define MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS (240u)
static uint16_t menuSolidFillBuffer[MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS];

static void fillSolidRect(uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t w, uint16_t h,
    uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t rowsPerTransfer;
    uint16_t rows;
    uint16_t i;

    if ((w == 0u) || (h == 0u) || (x >= LCD_W) || (y >= LCD_H)) return;
    if ((uint32_t) x + w > LCD_W) w = (uint16_t) (LCD_W - x);
    if ((uint32_t) y + h > LCD_H) h = (uint16_t) (LCD_H - y);
    if (w > MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS) return;
    rowsPerTransfer = (uint16_t) (MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS / w);
    for (i = 0u; i < MENU_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS; i++) menuSolidFillBuffer[i] = color;
    while (h > 0u)
    {
        rows = (h < rowsPerTransfer) ? h : rowsPerTransfer;
        ips114_show_rgb565_image(x, y, menuSolidFillBuffer,
            w, rows, w, rows, 0u);
        y = (uint16_t) (y + rows);
        h = (uint16_t) (h - rows);
    }
}

static void drawHomeSlot(uint8_t slot, uint16_t x, uint16_t y,
    uint8_t width, uint16_t color, uint16_t background, const char *format, ...)
{
    char line[HOME_SLOT_CHARS + 1u];
    char formatted[48];
    size_t length;
    va_list args;
    if ((slot >= HOME_SLOT_COUNT) || (width > HOME_SLOT_CHARS)) return;
    va_start(args, format);
    (void) vsnprintf(formatted, sizeof(formatted), format, args);
    va_end(args);
    memset(line, 0, sizeof(line));
    memset(line, ' ', width);
    line[width] = '\0';
    length = strlen(formatted);
    if (length > width) length = width;
    memcpy(line, formatted, length);
    if ((homeSlotValid[slot] != 0u) &&
        (homeSlotColor[slot] == color) &&
        (homeSlotBackground[slot] == background) &&
        (memcmp(homeSlotCache[slot], line, sizeof(line)) == 0)) return;
    memcpy(homeSlotCache[slot], line, sizeof(line));
    homeSlotValid[slot] = 1u;
    homeSlotColor[slot] = color;
    homeSlotBackground[slot] = background;
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(color, background);
    ips114_show_string(x, y, line);
}

static inline uint16_t homeMapX(uint32_t imgX)
{
    uint32_t v = (uint32_t) HOME_CAM_X + imgX * HOME_CAM_W / (uint32_t) MT9V03X_W;
    uint32_t xMax = (uint32_t) HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u;
    if (v > xMax) v = xMax;
    return (uint16_t) v;
}
static inline uint16_t homeMapY(uint32_t imgY)
{
    uint32_t v = (uint32_t) HOME_CAM_Y + imgY * HOME_CAM_H / (uint32_t) MT9V03X_H;
    uint32_t yMax = (uint32_t) HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u;
    if (v > yMax) v = yMax;
    return (uint16_t) v;
}

static uint16_t homeMapFloatX(float imgX)
{
    if (imgX < 0.0f) imgX = 0.0f;
    else if (imgX > (float) (MT9V03X_W - 1u)) imgX = (float) (MT9V03X_W - 1u);
    return homeMapX((uint32_t) (imgX + 0.5f));
}

static uint16_t homeMapFloatY(float imgY)
{
    if (imgY < 0.0f) imgY = 0.0f;
    else if (imgY > (float) (MT9V03X_H - 1u)) imgY = (float) (MT9V03X_H - 1u);
    return homeMapY((uint32_t) (imgY + 0.5f));
}

static uint8_t homeImagePointVisible(float imgX, float imgY)
{
    return (uint8_t) (isfinite(imgX) && isfinite(imgY) &&
        (imgX >= 0.0f) && (imgX <= (float) (MT9V03X_W - 1u)) &&
        (imgY >= 0.0f) && (imgY <= (float) (MT9V03X_H - 1u)));
}

static int16_t homeRadiusToDisp(float radiusPx)
{
    if (radiusPx <= 0.0f) return 0;
    return (int16_t) (radiusPx * (float) HOME_CAM_H / (float) MT9V03X_H + 0.5f);
}

/* 外边框(四边), 颜色由操控权决定。坐标落屏内, 不与图像视口/HUD 冲突。 */
static void drawFrameBorder(uint16_t color)
{
    fillSolidRect(0u, 0u, LCD_W, 1u, color);
    fillSolidRect(0u, (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 1u), LCD_W, 1u, color);
    fillSolidRect(0u, 1u, 1u, (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 2u), color);
    fillSolidRect((uint16_t) (LCD_W - 1u), 1u, 1u,
        (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 2u), color);
}

static void fillRect(uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t w, uint16_t h, uint16_t color)
{
    fillSolidRect(x, y, w, h, color);
}

static void drawTitleBar(const char* title, uint16_t fg, uint16_t bg)
{
    char bounded[40];
    size_t len = strlen(title);
    uint16_t x;

    if (len > 39u) len = 39u;
    memcpy(bounded, title, len);
    bounded[len] = '\0';
    x = (uint16_t) ((LCD_W - (uint16_t) (len * 6u)) / 2u);
    if (x < 2u) x = 2u;
    fillSolidRect(1u, 1u, (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), 15u, bg);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(fg, bg);
    ips114_show_string(x, 4u, bounded);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
}

static void drawScrollbar(uint8_t total, uint8_t top, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t trackTop = ROW_Y(1);
    uint16_t trackBot = (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 2u);
    uint16_t trackH;
    uint16_t thumbH;
    uint16_t thumbY;

    if (total <= VISIBLE_ROWS) return;
    trackH = (uint16_t) (trackBot - trackTop);

    /* 自清槽：先清整个槽区(轨道 + 旧滑块) → 消滚动时旧滑块横线残留。不触右外框(x=LCD_W-1)。 */
    fillSolidRect(SCROLLBAR_X, trackTop,
        (uint16_t) ((LCD_W - 2u) - SCROLLBAR_X + 1u),
        (uint16_t) (trackBot - trackTop + 1u), RGB565_BLACK);
    fillSolidRect(SCROLLBAR_X, trackTop, 1u,
        (uint16_t) (trackBot - trackTop + 1u), color);
    fillSolidRect((uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), trackTop, 1u,
        (uint16_t) (trackBot - trackTop + 1u), color);

    thumbH = (uint16_t) ((uint32_t) trackH * VISIBLE_ROWS / total);
    if (thumbH < 6u) thumbH = 6u;
    thumbY = (uint16_t) (trackTop + (uint32_t) (trackH - thumbH) * top / (uint16_t) (total - VISIBLE_ROWS));

    if ((uint16_t) (thumbY + thumbH) > trackBot)
        thumbH = (uint16_t) (trackBot - thumbY);
    fillSolidRect((uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X + 1u), thumbY,
        (uint16_t) ((LCD_W - 3u) - (SCROLLBAR_X + 1u) + 1u), thumbH, color);
}

/* 在 (sx,sy) 画十字, 四端钳到 HOME camera viewport 内。 */
static void drawCross(uint16_t sx, uint16_t sy, uint16_t half, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t xMin = HOME_CAM_X;
    uint16_t yMin = HOME_CAM_Y;
    uint16_t xMax = (uint16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u);
    uint16_t yMax = (uint16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
    uint16_t x0 = (sx > (uint16_t) (xMin + half)) ? (uint16_t) (sx - half) : xMin;
    uint16_t x1 = (sx + half < xMax) ? (uint16_t) (sx + half) : xMax;
    uint16_t y0 = (sy > (uint16_t) (yMin + half)) ? (uint16_t) (sy - half) : yMin;
    uint16_t y1 = (sy + half < yMax) ? (uint16_t) (sy + half) : yMax;
    fillSolidRect(x0, sy, (uint16_t) (x1 - x0 + 1u), 1u, color);
    fillSolidRect(sx, y0, 1u, (uint16_t) (y1 - y0 + 1u), color);
}

static uint16_t clampHomeX(int16_t x)
{
    int16_t xMin = (int16_t) HOME_CAM_X;
    int16_t xMax = (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u);
    if (x < xMin) x = xMin;
    if (x > xMax) x = xMax;
    return (uint16_t) x;
}

static uint16_t clampHomeY(int16_t y)
{
    int16_t yMin = (int16_t) HOME_CAM_Y;
    int16_t yMax = (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
    if (y < yMin) y = yMin;
    if (y > yMax) y = yMax;
    return (uint16_t) y;
}

static void drawCircleClamped(int16_t cx, int16_t cy, int16_t r, uint16_t color)
{
    const int16_t xMin = (int16_t) HOME_CAM_X;
    const int16_t yMin = (int16_t) HOME_CAM_Y;
    const int16_t xMax = (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_X + HOME_CAM_W - 1u);
    const int16_t yMax = (int16_t) (HOME_CAM_Y + HOME_CAM_H - 1u);
    int16_t x = r;
    int16_t y = 0;
    int16_t err = 1 - r;

    if (r <= 0) return;

    while (x >= y)
    {
        int16_t px[8] = {
            (int16_t) (cx + x), (int16_t) (cx + y), (int16_t) (cx - y), (int16_t) (cx - x),
            (int16_t) (cx - x), (int16_t) (cx - y), (int16_t) (cx + y), (int16_t) (cx + x)
        };
        int16_t py[8] = {
            (int16_t) (cy + y), (int16_t) (cy + x), (int16_t) (cy + x), (int16_t) (cy + y),
            (int16_t) (cy - y), (int16_t) (cy - x), (int16_t) (cy - x), (int16_t) (cy - y)
        };
        for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 8u; i++)
        {
            if (px[i] >= xMin && px[i] <= xMax && py[i] >= yMin && py[i] <= yMax)
            {
                ips114_draw_point((uint16_t) px[i], (uint16_t) py[i], color);
            }
        }
        y++;
        if (err < 0)
        {
            err = (int16_t) (err + 2 * y + 1);
        }
        else
        {
            x--;
            err = (int16_t) (err + 2 * (y - x + 1));
        }
    }
}

/* 规划态 → 3 字符缩写(底行观测显示用)。 */

static void drawHomeImage(void)
{
    imageFrameViewStruct view;
    if (imageGetFrameView(IMAGE_FRAME_ORIGINAL, &view) && (view.pixels != 0))
    {
        ips114_show_gray_image(HOME_CAM_X, HOME_CAM_Y, view.pixels,
            view.width, view.height, HOME_CAM_W, HOME_CAM_H, 0u);
    }
    else
    {
        fillRect(HOME_CAM_X, HOME_CAM_Y, HOME_CAM_W, HOME_CAM_H, RGB565_BLACK);
    }
}

static void drawHomeTrackBorder(const beaconTrackBorderMarginsStruct *margin, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t left;
    uint16_t right;
    uint16_t top;
    uint16_t bottom;

    if (margin == 0) return;
    left = homeMapX(margin->left);
    right = homeMapX((uint32_t) (MT9V03X_W - 1u - margin->right));
    top = homeMapY(margin->top);
    bottom = homeMapY((uint32_t) (MT9V03X_H - 1u - margin->bottom));
    if (margin->top != 0u) ips114_draw_line(left, top, right, top, color);
    if (margin->bottom != 0u) ips114_draw_line(left, bottom, right, bottom, color);
    if (margin->left != 0u) ips114_draw_line(left, top, left, bottom, color);
    if (margin->right != 0u) ips114_draw_line(right, top, right, bottom, color);
}

static void drawHomeEdgePredictionBand(const beaconTrackEdgeBandsStruct *bands)
{
    uint16_t left = homeMapX(0u);
    uint16_t right = homeMapX(MT9V03X_W - 1u);
    uint16_t top = homeMapY(0u);
    uint16_t bottom = homeMapY(MT9V03X_H - 1u);
    if (bands == 0) return;
    if (bands->left != 0u)
        ips114_draw_line(homeMapX(bands->left), top, homeMapX(bands->left), bottom,
            RGB565_MAGENTA);
    if (bands->right != 0u)
        ips114_draw_line(homeMapX(MT9V03X_W - bands->right), top,
            homeMapX(MT9V03X_W - bands->right), bottom, RGB565_MAGENTA);
    if (bands->top != 0u)
        ips114_draw_line(left, homeMapY(bands->top), right, homeMapY(bands->top),
            RGB565_MAGENTA);
    if (bands->bottom != 0u)
        ips114_draw_line(left, homeMapY(MT9V03X_H - bands->bottom), right,
            homeMapY(MT9V03X_H - bands->bottom), RGB565_MAGENTA);
}

static void drawHomeTrackBorders(void)
{
    visionParamsStruct params;
    beaconTrackBorderConfigStruct border;
    beaconTrackEdgeBandsStruct bands;

    visionParamsGetActive(&params);
    border.enter.left = params.c1BorderEnterLeft;
    border.enter.right = params.c1BorderEnterRight;
    border.enter.top = params.c1BorderEnterTop;
    border.enter.bottom = params.c1BorderEnterBottom;
    border.exit.left = params.c1BorderExitLeft;
    border.exit.right = params.c1BorderExitRight;
    border.exit.top = params.c1BorderExitTop;
    border.exit.bottom = params.c1BorderExitBottom;
    drawHomeTrackBorder(&border.exit, RGB565_YELLOW);
    drawHomeTrackBorder(&border.enter, RGB565_CYAN);
    bands.left = params.c1EdgeBandLeft;
    bands.right = params.c1EdgeBandRight;
    bands.top = params.c1EdgeBandTop;
    bands.bottom = params.c1EdgeBandBottom;
    drawHomeEdgePredictionBand(&bands);
}

static int32_t homeErrorToInt(float value)
{
    int32_t out = (value >= 0.0f) ? (int32_t) (value + 0.5f) : (int32_t) (value - 0.5f);
    if (out > 999) out = 999;
    else if (out < -999) out = -999;
    return out;
}

void renderInitFaultSummary(uint8_t failedMask, uint8_t unverifiedMask, uint8_t secondsLeft)
{
    if (secondsLeft >= 3u)
    {
        ips114_clear();
        menuRenderResetListSnapshot();
        drawTitleBar((failedMask != 0u) ? "HW INIT FAIL" : "HW INIT CHECK",
            RGB565_BLACK, (failedMask != 0u) ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_YELLOW);
        ips114_set_color((failedMask != 0u) ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(8u, 34u, "CAMERA");
        ips114_show_string(128u, 34u,
            (failedMask != 0u) ? "FAIL " : ((unverifiedMask != 0u) ? "CHECK" : "OK   "));
        drawFrameBorder((failedMask != 0u) ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_YELLOW);
    }
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_show_string(8u, 114u, "CONTINUE 0s");
    ips114_show_uint(80u, 114u, secondsLeft, 1u);
}

static uint8_t beaconIsSelectedTrack(const beaconConfirmedStruct* bea,
    const core1RuntimeDisplayTargetSnapshotStruct* target)
{
    if ((bea == 0) || (target == 0) || (target->valid == 0u) ||
        (target->sourceId != BEACON_SOURCE_CORE1) ||
        (target->trackId == 0u)) return 0u;
    return (bea->trackId == target->trackId) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static void drawHomeBeacons(void)
{
    imageObservationSnapshotStruct observation;
    core1RuntimeDisplayTargetSnapshotStruct target;
    uint8_t skippedSelected = 0u;
    imageGetObservationSnapshot(&observation);
    core1RuntimeGetDisplayTargetSnapshot(&target);

    if (observation.valid != 0u)
    {
        for (uint16_t i = 0u; i < observation.count; i++)
        {
            if ((observation.tracks[i].flags &
                    BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u) continue;
            if (!skippedSelected && beaconIsSelectedTrack(&observation.tracks[i],
                    &target))
            {
                skippedSelected = 1u;
                continue;
            }
            drawCross(homeMapX(observation.tracks[i].centerX),
                homeMapY(observation.tracks[i].centerY), 4u, RGB565_YELLOW);
        }
    }

    /* HOME只显示Core1本地图像坐标；C3/C4目标不做伪像素投影。 */
    if ((target.valid == 0u) || (target.sourceId != BEACON_SOURCE_CORE1) ||
        (target.size == 0u)) return;
    drawCross(homeMapX(target.controlX), homeMapY(target.controlY), 5u,
        (target.holding != 0u) ? RGB565_MAGENTA : RGB565_RED);
}

static void drawHomePlanningDeadzone(const beaconNavigatorSnapshotStruct* snap)
{
    visionParamsStruct params;
    float centerX;
    float centerY;
    if (snap == 0) return;
    visionParamsGetActive(&params);
    centerX = snap->activeCenterX;
    centerY = snap->activeCenterY;
    if (homeImagePointVisible(centerX, centerY) == 0u) return;
    uint16_t cx = homeMapFloatX(centerX);
    uint16_t cy = homeMapFloatY(centerY);
    int16_t enterR = homeRadiusToDisp(params.planningDeadzoneEnterPx);
    int16_t exitR = homeRadiusToDisp(params.planningDeadzoneExitPx);

    drawCross(cx, cy, 4u, RGB565_CYAN);
    drawCircleClamped((int16_t) cx, (int16_t) cy, enterR, RGB565_YELLOW);
    drawCircleClamped((int16_t) cx, (int16_t) cy, exitR, RGB565_MAGENTA);
}

static void drawHomeCore0Pose(const beaconNavigatorSnapshotStruct* snap)
{
    visionParamsStruct params;
    float poseX;
    float poseY;
    uint16_t color;
    uint16_t headingColor;
    uint16_t sx;
    uint16_t sy;
    int16_t ex;
    int16_t ey;
    const float lineLen = 12.0f;
    if ((snap == 0) || (snap->poseValid == 0u)) return;

    visionParamsGetActive(&params);
    poseX = snap->poseRawX + params.c1Core0PoseOffsetX;
    poseY = snap->poseRawY + params.c1Core0PoseOffsetY;
    if (homeImagePointVisible(poseX, poseY) == 0u) return;

    color = snap->poseHolding ? RGB565_BLUE : RGB565_GREEN;
    sx = homeMapFloatX(poseX);
    sy = homeMapFloatY(poseY);
    drawCross(sx, sy, 6u, color);
    if (snap->poseHeadingValid)
    {
        headingColor = snap->poseHeadingHolding ? RGB565_BLUE : RGB565_GREEN;
        ex = (int16_t)((float) sx + cosf(snap->poseHeadingRad) * lineLen + 0.5f);
        ey = (int16_t)((float) sy + sinf(snap->poseHeadingRad) * lineLen + 0.5f);
        ips114_draw_line(sx, sy, clampHomeX(ex), clampHomeY(ey), headingColor);
    }
}

static void drawHomeHud(const beaconNavigatorSnapshotStruct* snap)
{
    core3LinkCore1Status core3;
    core4LinkCore1Status core4;
    core1KvmRouterSnapshot kvm;
    core1RuntimePlanSnapshotStruct plan;
    uint8_t c0Up = menuKeyRemoteLinkUp();
    uint8_t c2Lost = menuKeyRemoteCore2LinkLost();
    uint8_t state = (snap != 0) ? snap->state : (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
    const char *source;
    uint16_t title;
    uint8_t observersReady;
    const char *controlClass;

    core3LinkCore1GetStatus(&core3);
    core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&core4);
    core1KvmRouterGetSnapshot(&kvm);
    core1RuntimeGetPlanSnapshot(&plan);
    source = (snap != NULL && snap->sourceId == 4u) ? "C4" :
        ((snap != NULL && snap->sourceId == 3u) ? "C3" :
        ((snap != NULL && snap->sourceId == 1u) ? "C1" : "--"));
    observersReady = (uint8_t) (core3.online && core4.online &&
        core3.configCompatible && core4.configCompatible);
    controlClass = (state == (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_TRACK) ? "TRACK" :
        ((state == (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_SEARCH) ? "SEARCH" : "NONE");
    title = (!c0Up || c2Lost) ? RGB565_RED :
        ((plan.systemPhase != OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_HOME) ? RGB565_YELLOW :
        ((plan.barrier || !observersReady) ?
            RGB565_YELLOW : RGB565_GREEN));
    if (homeTitleColor != title)
    {
        drawTitleBar("CORE1 PLANNER", RGB565_BLACK, title);
        homeTitleColor = title;
    }

    drawHomeSlot(0u, HOME_TXT_X, 18u, 17u, RGB565_CYAN, RGB565_BLACK,
        "VISION:ALL SRC:%s", source);
    drawHomeSlot(1u, HOME_TXT_X, 26u, 17u,
        (c0Up && !c2Lost) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK,
        "C0:%s C2:%s", c0Up ? "OK" : "LOST", c2Lost ? "LOST" : "OK");
    drawHomeSlot(2u, HOME_TXT_X, 34u, 17u,
        (core3.online && core3.configCompatible) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_YELLOW,
        RGB565_BLACK, "C3:%s CFG:%s", core3.online ? "OK" : "LOST",
        core3.configCompatible ? "OK" : "SYNC");
    drawHomeSlot(3u, HOME_TXT_X, 42u, 17u, RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK,
        "NAV:%s CLS:%s", planStateStr(state),
        controlClass);
    drawHomeSlot(4u, HOME_TXT_X, 50u, 17u,
        plan.barrier ? RGB565_YELLOW : RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK,
        "BAR:%c DSP:%c", plan.barrier ? 'Y' : 'N',
        plan.dispatchEnable ? 'Y' : 'N');
    drawHomeSlot(5u, HOME_TXT_X, 58u, 17u,
        (core4.online && core4.configCompatible) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_YELLOW,
        RGB565_BLACK, "C4:%s CFG:%s", core4.online ? "OK" : "LOST",
        core4.configCompatible ? "OK" : "SYNC");
    drawHomeSlot(6u, HOME_TXT_X, 66u, 17u, RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK,
        "EX:%ld", (long) ((snap != 0) ? homeErrorToInt(snap->errX) : 0));
    drawHomeSlot(7u, HOME_TXT_X, 74u, 17u, RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK,
        "EY:%ld", (long) ((snap != 0) ? homeErrorToInt(snap->errY) : 0));
    drawHomeSlot(8u, HOME_TXT_X, 82u, 17u, RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK,
        "VX:%+.1f VY:%+.1f", (double) ((snap != 0) ? snap->vx : 0.0f),
        (double) ((snap != 0) ? snap->vy : 0.0f));
    drawHomeSlot(9u, HOME_TXT_X, 90u, 17u, RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK,
        "WZ:%+.1f", (double) ((snap != 0) ? snap->wz : 0.0f));
    drawHomeSlot(11u, 2u, 106u, 39u,
        (!plan.dispatchEnable && plan.valid) ? RGB565_YELLOW : RGB565_GREEN,
        RGB565_BLACK, "DSP:%s TARGET:%s KEY:%u>%u",
        plan.dispatchEnable ? "ON" : "LOCK",
        (snap != 0 && snap->valid) ? "VALID" : "LOST",
        kvm.desiredTarget, kvm.inputOwner);
    drawHomeSlot(12u, 2u, 121u, 39u,
        (!c0Up || c2Lost) ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_GRAY, RGB565_BLACK,
        (!c0Up) ? "BLOCK: CORE0 LINK" : (c2Lost ? "BLOCK: CORE2 LINK" :
            ((plan.systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN) ?
                "REJOIN: VERIFY + ZERO BARRIER" :
             (plan.standalone ? "STANDALONE: NO DISPATCH" : "K1/KVM MENU READY"))));
}

static void drawHomeLayoutLines(uint16_t color)
{
    if (homeLayoutColor == color) return;
    fillSolidRect(HOME_VLINE_X, 17u, 1u, 87u, color);
    fillSolidRect(1u, 104u, 238u, 1u, RGB565_GRAY);
    fillSolidRect(1u, 119u, 238u, 1u, RGB565_GRAY);
    drawFrameBorder(color);
    homeLayoutColor = color;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 发车页: 左图像视口 + 右文字区 + 操控权边框
 * ============================================================ */
void renderHome(uint8_t visualDue)
{
    beaconNavigatorSnapshotStruct snap;
    beaconNavigatorGetSnapshot(&snap);

    if (visualDue != 0u)
    {
        drawHomeImage();
        drawHomeTrackBorders();
        drawHomePlanningDeadzone(&snap);
        drawHomeBeacons();
        drawHomeCore0Pose(&snap);
    }
    drawHomeHud(&snap);
    drawHomeLayoutLines(menuBorderColor());

    /* 边框与静态分隔线仅在操控权颜色变化时重绘。 */
}

/* ============================================================
 * 阈值编辑器: 左原图 + 右检测预览(Binary mask 或 Canny edge) + 底部 Lo/Hi/Exp 参数行
 * ============================================================ */
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t originalFrameSeq;
    uint32_t previewFrameSeq;
    int32_t lowValue;
    int32_t highValue;
    int32_t exposureValue;
    uint16_t ownerColor;
    uint8_t detectMode;
    uint8_t selection;
    uint8_t originalValid;
    uint8_t previewValid;
    uint8_t valid;
} thresholdRenderSnapshotStruct;

static thresholdRenderSnapshotStruct thresholdRenderSnapshot;

static int32_t thresholdDisplayValue(float value, int32_t maximum)
{
    if (!(value == value) || (value <= 0.0f)) return 0;
    if (value >= (float) maximum) return maximum;
    return (int32_t) value;
}

static void drawThresholdValue(uint16_t slotX, uint16_t slotWidth,
    uint16_t nameX, uint16_t valueX, const char *name, uint8_t selected,
    int32_t value, uint8_t digits)
{
    char valueText[5];
    uint16_t background = selected ? MENU_SEL_BG : RGB565_BLACK;
    uint16_t nameForeground = selected ? MENU_SEL_NAME_FG : MENU_NORM_NAME_FG;
    uint16_t valueForeground = selected ? MENU_SEL_VAL_FG : MENU_NORM_VAL_FG;

    if (digits == 3u)
    {
        (void) snprintf(valueText, sizeof(valueText), "%3ld", (long) value);
    }
    else
    {
        (void) snprintf(valueText, sizeof(valueText), "%4ld", (long) value);
    }
    fillSolidRect(slotX, THR_TXT_Y, slotWidth, FONT_H, background);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(nameForeground, background);
    ips114_show_string(nameX, THR_TXT_Y, name);
    ips114_set_color(valueForeground, background);
    ips114_show_string(valueX, THR_TXT_Y, valueText);
}

void renderThreshEdit(uint8_t visualDue)
{
    uint16_t bc = menuBorderColor();
    uint8_t legacyMode = (detectModeF >= 0.5f) ? 1u : 0u;
    float lowValue = legacyMode ? legacyCannyLowF : cannyLowF;
    float highValue = legacyMode ? legacyCannyHighF : cannyHighF;
    int32_t lowDisplay = thresholdDisplayValue(lowValue, 999);
    int32_t highDisplay = thresholdDisplayValue(highValue, 999);
    int32_t exposureDisplay = thresholdDisplayValue(exposureF, 9999);

    imageFrameViewStruct ori;
    imageFrameViewStruct detectPreview;
    uint8_t oriValid = (uint8_t) (imageGetFrameView(IMAGE_FRAME_ORIGINAL, &ori) &&
        (ori.pixels != 0));
    uint8_t previewValid = (uint8_t) (imageGetFrameView(IMAGE_FRAME_DETECT_PREVIEW, &detectPreview) &&
        (detectPreview.pixels != 0));
    uint8_t first = (thresholdRenderSnapshot.valid == 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t selectionChanged = (uint8_t) (first ||
        (thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection != threshSel));

    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.detectMode != legacyMode))
    {
        drawTitleBar(legacyMode ? "CANNY EDIT" : "BINARY EDIT", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);
    }

    if ((visualDue != 0u) &&
        (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.originalValid != oriValid) ||
         (oriValid && (thresholdRenderSnapshot.originalFrameSeq != ori.frameSeq))))
    {
        if (oriValid)
        {
            ips114_show_gray_image(THR_IMG_L_X, THR_IMG_Y, ori.pixels,
                ori.width, ori.height, THR_IMG_W, THR_IMG_H, 0u);
        }
        else
        {
            fillRect(THR_IMG_L_X, THR_IMG_Y, THR_IMG_W, THR_IMG_H, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
    }
    if ((visualDue != 0u) &&
        (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.previewValid != previewValid) ||
         (previewValid && (thresholdRenderSnapshot.previewFrameSeq != detectPreview.frameSeq))))
    {
        if (previewValid)
        {
            ips114_show_gray_image(THR_IMG_R_X, THR_IMG_Y, detectPreview.pixels,
                detectPreview.width, detectPreview.height, THR_IMG_W, THR_IMG_H, 0u);
        }
        else
        {
            fillRect(THR_IMG_R_X, THR_IMG_Y, THR_IMG_W, THR_IMG_H, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
    }

    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.lowValue != lowDisplay) ||
        (selectionChanged && ((threshSel == THRESH_SEL_CANNY_LOW) ||
            (thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection == THRESH_SEL_CANNY_LOW))))
        drawThresholdValue(THRESH_SLOT_LOW_X, THRESH_SLOT_LOW_WIDTH,
            THRESH_NAME_LOW_X, THRESH_VALUE_LOW_X, "Lo:",
            (uint8_t) (threshSel == THRESH_SEL_CANNY_LOW), lowDisplay, 3u);
    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.highValue != highDisplay) ||
        (selectionChanged && ((threshSel == THRESH_SEL_CANNY_HIGH) ||
            (thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection == THRESH_SEL_CANNY_HIGH))))
        drawThresholdValue(THRESH_SLOT_HIGH_X, THRESH_SLOT_HIGH_WIDTH,
            THRESH_NAME_HIGH_X, THRESH_VALUE_HIGH_X, "Hi:",
            (uint8_t) (threshSel == THRESH_SEL_CANNY_HIGH), highDisplay, 3u);
    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.exposureValue != exposureDisplay) ||
        (selectionChanged && ((threshSel == THRESH_SEL_EXPOSURE) ||
            (thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection == THRESH_SEL_EXPOSURE))))
        drawThresholdValue(THRESH_SLOT_EXPOSURE_X, THRESH_SLOT_EXPOSURE_WIDTH,
            THRESH_NAME_EXPOSURE_X, THRESH_VALUE_EXPOSURE_X, "Ex:",
            (uint8_t) (threshSel == THRESH_SEL_EXPOSURE), exposureDisplay, 4u);

    if (first || (thresholdRenderSnapshot.ownerColor != bc))
    {
        /* 竖分隔 + 横分隔落在两图之间/下方空隙，与外框同步操控权色。 */
        fillSolidRect(120u, ROW_Y(1), 1u,
            (uint16_t) (THR_IMG_Y + THR_IMG_H - ROW_Y(1) + 1u), bc);
        fillSolidRect(1u, (uint16_t) (THR_IMG_Y + THR_IMG_H + 2u),
            (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), 1u, bc);
        drawFrameBorder(bc);
    }

    if (visualDue != 0u)
    {
        thresholdRenderSnapshot.originalFrameSeq = oriValid ? ori.frameSeq : 0u;
        thresholdRenderSnapshot.previewFrameSeq = previewValid ? detectPreview.frameSeq : 0u;
        thresholdRenderSnapshot.originalValid = oriValid;
        thresholdRenderSnapshot.previewValid = previewValid;
    }
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.lowValue = lowDisplay;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.highValue = highDisplay;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.exposureValue = exposureDisplay;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.ownerColor = bc;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.detectMode = legacyMode;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.selection = threshSel;
    thresholdRenderSnapshot.valid = 1u;
}

/* 列表空行清理使用内框RGB565块覆盖，既清旧内容又不触碰外框。
 * 替代每帧全屏 ips114_clear()——全屏清屏会在清→重绘间产生整屏黑闪。 */
/* 整行铺底右界：有滚动条→滚动条左(SCROLLBAR_X-1)；无→右内框(LCD_W-2)。渲染前按 total 设。 */
static uint16_t listFillRightX = (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);

static void fillBottomGutter(uint16_t y, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t top;
    if (y != ROW_Y(VISIBLE_ROWS)) return;
    top = (uint16_t) (y + FONT_H);
    if (top >= (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 1u)) return;
    fillSolidRect(1u, top, listFillRightX,
        (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 1u - top), color);
}

static void clearListRow(uint16_t y)
{
    fillSolidRect(1u, y, listFillRightX, FONT_H, RGB565_BLACK);
    fillBottomGutter(y, RGB565_BLACK);
}

/* 整行铺底色，顶到右界：选中/编辑整行强调，名/值由调用方另设色。
 * 修原选中态只反色字符、中间黑底不连成整行选中条的问题。 */
static void fillListRowBg(uint16_t y, uint16_t fg, uint16_t bg)
{
    ips114_set_color(fg, bg);
    fillSolidRect(1u, y, listFillRightX, FONT_H, bg);
    fillBottomGutter(y, bg);
}

/* 列表/HOME 局部渲染快照（变化检测防闪烁，对齐 core2/core0）：仅结构变化(进/出编辑、换页、换选中项、滚动、
 * 操控权边框色变、切状态后)才整页重绘；EDIT 态值变只局部重绘当前值。
 * clearScreenForState 调 menuRenderResetListSnapshot 复位 → 下次列表渲染为结构性，HOME 来源条强制重绘。 */
static menuStateEnum listLastState = (menuStateEnum) 0xFF;
static int16_t listLastPageIdx = -1;
static int16_t listLastOptIdx = -1;
static uint8_t listLastScrollTop = 0xFFu;
static uint16_t listLastBc = 0xFFFFu;
static uint8_t paramSlotsSurfaceValid;
static uint8_t paramSlotsLastSelection = 0xFFu;
static menuParamGlobalUiSnapshot paramSlotsLastUi;

void menuRenderResetListSnapshot(void)
{
    listLastState = (menuStateEnum) 0xFF;
    listLastPageIdx = -1;
    listLastOptIdx = -1;
    listLastScrollTop = 0xFFu;
    listLastBc = 0xFFFFu;
    paramSlotsSurfaceValid = 0u;
    paramSlotsLastSelection = 0xFFu;
    memset(&paramSlotsLastUi, 0xFF, sizeof(paramSlotsLastUi));
    homeLayoutColor = 0xFFFFu;
    memset(homeSlotValid, 0, sizeof(homeSlotValid));
    memset(homeSlotColor, 0, sizeof(homeSlotColor));
    memset(homeSlotBackground, 0, sizeof(homeSlotBackground));
    homeTitleColor = 0xFFFFu;
    memset(&thresholdRenderSnapshot, 0, sizeof(thresholdRenderSnapshot));
}

/* ============================================================
 * 页列表 / 选项列表(editing=1 时为编辑页, 高亮当前项显值)
 *   不全屏 clear(防黑闪): 进入页面时 clearScreenForState 已清屏一次,
 *   页内20ms事实刷新仅逐行脏区覆盖(clearListRow)。
 * ============================================================ */
void renderPageList(void)
{
    uint16_t bc = menuBorderColor();
    /* 结构变化才整页重绘(防周期空刷闪烁)：切入页列表 / 换选中页 / 滚动 / 边框色变。 */
    uint8_t structural = (uint8_t) (listLastState != MENU_PAGE_LIST
        || listLastPageIdx != (int16_t) pageIdx || listLastScrollTop != scrollTop
        || listLastBc != bc);
    uint8_t selectionOnly = (uint8_t) ((listLastState == MENU_PAGE_LIST) &&
        (listLastScrollTop == scrollTop) && (listLastBc == bc) &&
        (listLastPageIdx != (int16_t) pageIdx));
    if (!structural) return;

    listFillRightX = (menuPageCount > VISIBLE_ROWS) ? (uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X - 1u) : (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);
    if (selectionOnly == 0u)
        drawTitleBar("PAGES", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);

    uint8_t top = scrollTop;
    for (uint8_t r = 0u; r < VISIBLE_ROWS; r++)
    {
        uint8_t idx = (uint8_t) (top + r);
        uint16_t y = ROW_Y((uint16_t) (r + 1u));
        if ((selectionOnly != 0u) && (idx != (uint8_t) pageIdx) &&
            (idx != (uint8_t) listLastPageIdx)) continue;
        if (idx >= menuPageCount) { clearListRow(y); continue; }
        if (idx == (uint8_t) pageIdx)
        {
            fillListRowBg(y, MENU_SEL_NAME_FG, MENU_SEL_BG); /* 选中整行青底，名黑(页列表无数值) */
            ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, y, ">");
            ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, menuPages[idx].name);
        }
        else
        {
            clearListRow(y);
            ips114_set_color(MENU_NORM_NAME_FG, RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, menuPages[idx].name);
        }
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    }
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    if (selectionOnly == 0u)
    {
        drawScrollbar(menuPageCount, scrollTop, bc);
        drawFrameBorder(bc);
    }
    listLastState = MENU_PAGE_LIST;
    listLastPageIdx = (int16_t) pageIdx;
    listLastScrollTop = scrollTop;
    listLastOptIdx = -1;
    listLastBc = bc;
}

void renderOptionList(uint8_t editing)
{
    if ((editing == 0u) && (pageIdx >= 0) &&
        ((uint8_t) pageIdx == paramSlotsPageIndex))
    {
        char line[32];
        menuParamGlobalUiSnapshot globalUi;
        uint16_t bc = menuBorderColor();
        uint8_t fullRedraw;
        menuParamGlobalGetUi(&globalUi);
        listFillRightX = (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);
        fullRedraw = (uint8_t) (paramSlotsSurfaceValid == 0u);
        if (fullRedraw != 0u)
        {
            uint8_t row;
            drawTitleBar("PARAM SLOTS", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);
            for (row = 1u; row < 8u; row++) clearListRow(ROW_Y(row));
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(5u), "K2/K3 SLOT");
            ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(6u), "K1L SAVE K4 LOAD");
            ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(7u), "K5 BACK");
            drawFrameBorder(bc);
            paramSlotsSurfaceValid = 1u;
        }
        if (fullRedraw != 0u || paramSlotsLastSelection !=
            (uint8_t) paramSlotSelection)
        {
            fillListRowBg(ROW_Y(1u), MENU_SEL_NAME_FG, MENU_SEL_BG);
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "> SELECT        SLOT %u",
                (unsigned) ((uint8_t) paramSlotSelection));
            ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, ROW_Y(1u), line);
            paramSlotsLastSelection = (uint8_t) paramSlotSelection;
        }
        if (fullRedraw != 0u || paramSlotsLastUi.slotUiState !=
            globalUi.slotUiState)
        {
            static const char *const slotText[] = {
                "UNKNOWN", "CHECKING", "FULL", "EMPTY", "PARTIAL",
                "INVALID", "UNAVAILABLE"};
            uint8_t state = globalUi.slotUiState;
            if (state > PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE)
                state = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNKNOWN;
            clearListRow(ROW_Y(2u));
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "SLOT: %s", slotText[state]);
            ips114_set_color((state == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL) ? RGB565_GREEN :
                ((state == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_EMPTY) ? RGB565_CYAN : RGB565_YELLOW),
                RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(24u, ROW_Y(2u), line);
        }
        if (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED)
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: QUEUED");
        else if (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS)
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "RUN: C%u PH%u",
                (unsigned) globalUi.target, (unsigned) globalUi.phase);
        else if (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS)
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: SUCCESS");
        else if (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED)
        {
            uint32_t diagnostic = globalUi.diagnostic;
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
                "F:C%uE%u P%uO%uS%uD%u",
                (unsigned) globalUi.target, (unsigned) globalUi.error,
                (unsigned) ((diagnostic >> 16) & 0xFFu),
                (unsigned) (diagnostic & 0xFFu),
                (unsigned) ((diagnostic >> 8) & 0xFFu),
                (unsigned) ((diagnostic >> 24) & 0xFFu));
        }
        else
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: READY");
        if (fullRedraw != 0u || memcmp(&paramSlotsLastUi, &globalUi,
                sizeof(globalUi)) != 0)
        {
            clearListRow(ROW_Y(3u));
            ips114_set_color(globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS ? RGB565_GREEN :
                (globalUi.state == MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_CYAN),
                RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(24u, ROW_Y(3u), line);
        }
        paramSlotsLastUi = globalUi;
        listLastState = MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        listLastPageIdx = (int16_t) pageIdx;
        listLastOptIdx = (int16_t) optIdx;
        listLastScrollTop = scrollTop;
        listLastBc = bc;
        return;
    }
    uint16_t bc = menuBorderColor();
    menuPageStruct* pg = &menuPages[pageIdx];
    uint8_t curIsEdit = (uint8_t) (editing != 0u);
    /* 结构变化判定(对齐 core2/core0)：切入 / 进出编辑 / 换选中项 / 滚动 / 边框色变 → 整页重绘；
     * EDIT 态值变(同态同项同滚动同边框色)只局部重绘当前值，消周期全页重绘闪烁。 */
    uint8_t enteringList = (uint8_t) (listLastState != MENU_OPTION_LIST && listLastState != MENU_EDIT);
    uint8_t editTransition = (uint8_t) ((listLastState == MENU_EDIT) != curIsEdit);
    uint8_t structural = (uint8_t) (enteringList || editTransition
        || listLastPageIdx != (int16_t) pageIdx
        || listLastOptIdx != (int16_t) optIdx || listLastScrollTop != scrollTop
        || listLastBc != bc);
    uint8_t selectionOnly = (uint8_t) ((!enteringList) && (!editTransition) &&
        (listLastPageIdx == (int16_t) pageIdx) &&
        (listLastScrollTop == scrollTop) && (listLastBc == bc) &&
        (listLastOptIdx != (int16_t) optIdx));

    if (structural)
    {
        listFillRightX = (pg->optionCount > VISIBLE_ROWS) ? (uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X - 1u) : (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);
        if (selectionOnly == 0u)
            drawTitleBar(pg->name, RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);

        uint8_t top = scrollTop;
        for (uint8_t r = 0u; r < VISIBLE_ROWS; r++)
        {
            uint8_t idx = (uint8_t) (top + r);
            uint16_t y = ROW_Y((uint16_t) (r + 1u));
            uint8_t sel;
            if ((selectionOnly != 0u) && (idx != (uint8_t) optIdx) &&
                (idx != (uint8_t) listLastOptIdx)) continue;
            if (idx >= pg->optionCount) { clearListRow(y); continue; }
            sel = (idx == (uint8_t) optIdx);

            if (sel && editing)
            {
                /* 编辑行：整行黄底强调，名黑/值红（非仅数值反相） */
                fillListRowBg(y, MENU_EDIT_NAME_FG, MENU_EDIT_BG);
                ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, y, "*");
                ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, pg->optName[idx]);
                ips114_set_color(MENU_EDIT_VAL_FG, MENU_EDIT_BG);
                menuFloatDisplayShow(MENU_PARAM_VALUE_X, y,
                    (double) (*pg->opt[idx]),
                    (pg->decimals[idx] != 0u)
                        ? pg->decimals[idx]
                        : menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(
                            (double) (*pg->opt[idx]), pg->stepS[idx]));
            }
            else if (sel)
            {
                /* 选中行：整行青底，名黑/值蓝（整行铺底，修原只反色字符问题） */
                fillListRowBg(y, MENU_SEL_NAME_FG, MENU_SEL_BG);
                ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, y, ">");
                ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, pg->optName[idx]);
                ips114_set_color(MENU_SEL_VAL_FG, MENU_SEL_BG);
                menuFloatDisplayShow(MENU_PARAM_VALUE_X, y,
                    (double) (*pg->opt[idx]),
                    (pg->decimals[idx] != 0u)
                        ? pg->decimals[idx]
                        : menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(
                            (double) (*pg->opt[idx]), pg->stepS[idx]));
            }
            else
            {
                /* 普通行：黑底，名绿/值白 */
                clearListRow(y);
                ips114_set_color(MENU_NORM_NAME_FG, RGB565_BLACK);
                ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, pg->optName[idx]);
                ips114_set_color(MENU_NORM_VAL_FG, RGB565_BLACK);
                menuFloatDisplayShow(MENU_PARAM_VALUE_X, y,
                    (double) (*pg->opt[idx]),
                    (pg->decimals[idx] != 0u)
                        ? pg->decimals[idx]
                        : menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(
                            (double) (*pg->opt[idx]), pg->stepS[idx]));
            }
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        if (selectionOnly == 0u)
        {
            drawScrollbar(pg->optionCount, scrollTop, bc);
            drawFrameBorder(bc);
        }
    }
    else if (editing)
    {
        /* 值局部刷新：仅当前选中项数值(黄底红字)，不动整行/名/边框/滚动条 → 消整页重绘闪烁 */
        uint16_t y = ROW_Y((uint16_t) ((uint8_t) optIdx - scrollTop + 1u));
        ips114_set_color(MENU_EDIT_VAL_FG, MENU_EDIT_BG);
        menuFloatDisplayShow(MENU_PARAM_VALUE_X, y,
            (double) (*pg->opt[optIdx]),
            (pg->decimals[optIdx] != 0u)
                ? pg->decimals[optIdx]
                : menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(
                    (double) (*pg->opt[optIdx]), pg->stepS[optIdx]));
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    }

    listLastState = curIsEdit ? MENU_EDIT : MENU_OPTION_LIST;
    listLastPageIdx = (int16_t) pageIdx;
    listLastOptIdx = (int16_t) optIdx;
    listLastScrollTop = scrollTop;
    listLastBc = bc;
}

#ifndef OBSERVER_OVERLAY_POSE_MAPPING_H
#define OBSERVER_OVERLAY_POSE_MAPPING_H

#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct
{
    uint16_t x;
    uint16_t y;
    int16_t headingQ8;
    uint8_t poseMapped;
    uint8_t headingMapped;
} observerOverlayPoseMapping;

static inline uint8_t observerOverlayMapCoordinate(float value,
    uint16_t limit, uint16_t *pixel)
{
    if ((pixel == 0) || (!isfinite(value)) ||
        (value < 0.0f) || (value > (float) (limit - 1u))) return 0u;
    *pixel = (uint16_t) (value + 0.5f);
    return 1u;
}

static inline void observerOverlayPoseMap(float rawX, float rawY,
    float offsetX, float offsetY, uint8_t poseValid,
    float rawHeadingRad, uint8_t headingValid,
    observerOverlayPoseMapping *mapping)
{
    if (mapping == 0) return;
    mapping->x = 0u;
    mapping->y = 0u;
    mapping->headingQ8 = 0;
    mapping->poseMapped = 0u;
    mapping->headingMapped = 0u;
    if ((poseValid == 0u) ||
        (observerOverlayMapCoordinate(rawX + offsetX, 188u,
            &mapping->x) == 0u) ||
        (observerOverlayMapCoordinate(rawY + offsetY, 120u,
            &mapping->y) == 0u)) return;
    mapping->poseMapped = 1u;
    if ((headingValid == 0u) || (!isfinite(rawHeadingRad)) ||
        (rawHeadingRad < -3.1415927f) ||
        (rawHeadingRad > 3.1415927f)) return;
    mapping->headingQ8 = (int16_t) (rawHeadingRad * 256.0f);
    mapping->headingMapped = 1u;
}

#endif

代码（c）
#ifndef PARAM_SYNC_PLATFORM_POLICY_H
#define PARAM_SYNC_PLATFORM_POLICY_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "coreDataTransfer.h"

#define CORE1_PARAM_SYNC_OBSERVER_TARGET_FRESH_MS (600u)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration;
    uint32_t publishSequence;
    uint32_t peerSession;
    uint32_t lastAdvanceMs;
    uint8_t primed;
    uint8_t ready;
} core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeCache;

static inline void core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeReset(
    core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeCache *cache)
{
    if (cache != 0) memset(cache, 0, sizeof(*cache));
}

static inline uint8_t core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeAccept(
    core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeCache *cache,
    const core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct *bridge, uint32_t nowMs)
{
    if (cache == 0 || bridge == 0 ||
        coreDataParamObserverBridgeIsValid(bridge) == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (cache->primed != 0u &&
        cache->producerBootGeneration == bridge->producerBootGeneration &&
        cache->peerSession == bridge->peerSession &&
        (int32_t) (bridge->publishSequence - cache->publishSequence) <= 0)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (cache->primed == 0u ||
        cache->producerBootGeneration != bridge->producerBootGeneration ||
        cache->peerSession != bridge->peerSession)
    {
        core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeReset(cache);
    }
    cache->producerBootGeneration = bridge->producerBootGeneration;
    cache->publishSequence = bridge->publishSequence;
    cache->peerSession = bridge->peerSession;
    cache->lastAdvanceMs = nowMs;
    cache->primed = 1u;
    cache->ready = (uint8_t) ((bridge->flags &
        CORE1_PARAM_OBSERVER_FLAG_READY) != 0u);
    return 1u;
}

static inline void core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeExpire(
    core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeCache *cache, uint32_t nowMs)
{
    if (cache == 0 || cache->primed == 0u ||
        (uint32_t) (nowMs - cache->lastAdvanceMs) <
            CORE1_PARAM_SYNC_OBSERVER_TARGET_FRESH_MS)
    {
        return;
    }
    cache->ready = 0u;
}

static inline uint8_t core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeReady(
    const core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeCache *cache, uint32_t nowMs)
{
    return (uint8_t) (cache != 0 && cache->primed != 0u &&
        cache->ready != 0u &&
        (uint32_t) (nowMs - cache->lastAdvanceMs) <
            CORE1_PARAM_SYNC_OBSERVER_TARGET_FRESH_MS);
}

static inline void core1ParamSyncObserverBridgePoll(
    core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeCache *cache,
    const core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct *bridge, uint32_t nowMs)
{
    if (cache == 0) return;
    if (bridge != 0)
        (void) core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeAccept(cache, bridge, nowMs);
    core1ParamSyncObserverBridgeExpire(cache, nowMs);
}

#endif

#include "rgbAnimator.h"

#include "uartLinkProto.h" /* UART_LINK_RGB_x 意图码（与 core0 同源同值）*/

/*
 * RGB 起飞编排动画本体。详见 rgbAnimator.h 顶注。
 *   闪烁用 uint16 相位累加器：每 tick += step（自然回绕），on = (phase < 32768) → 50% 占空方波；
 *   step 越大频率越高。亮度档由 rgbStatusLed setRgb 内部钳 30%，本层用 0~100 相对值。
 */

/* 动画时长(ms)：对齐 core0 configFlight 的 TAKEOFF_WAIT_MS/RAMP_MS，仅控制本地动画形状(频率/亮度斜坡)。
 * 无需与 core0 字节级一致——意图码由 core0 真实相位驱动，相位切换时本层据新意图重置；时长只决定形状。 */
#define RGB_ANIM_TICK_MS    (10u)   /* rgbAnimTick 调用周期(PIT_CH2 10ms) */
#define RGB_ANIM_WAIT_MS    (5000u) /* ~对齐 TAKEOFF_WAIT_MS */
#define RGB_ANIM_RAMP_MS    (2000u) /* ~对齐 TAKEOFF_RAMP_MS */
#define RGB_ANIM_WAIT_SOLID_MS (700u) /* WAIT 末段强制常亮时长(频率封顶→常亮过渡，提示即将爬升) */
#define RGB_ANIM_BRIGHT_PCT (100u)  /* 满档相对亮度(setRgb 内部钳 30%) */

/* 闪烁相位步进：WAIT 期随 elapsed 线性增(慢闪→快闪)，WARN 固定高频。值越大频率越高。 */
#define RGB_ANIM_WAIT_STEP_SLOW (1000u)  /* 起始 ~1.5Hz */
#define RGB_ANIM_WAIT_STEP_FAST (6000u)  /* 末段 ~9Hz */
#define RGB_ANIM_WARN_STEP      (8000u)  /* 断联告警固定高频红闪 */

static uint8_t curIntent;
static uint32_t animElapsedMs;
static uint16_t animPhase;

void rgbAnimInit(void)
{
    curIntent = UART_LINK_RGB_NORMAL;
    animElapsedMs = 0u;
    animPhase = 0u;
}

void rgbAnimSet(uint8_t intent)
{
    if (intent != curIntent)
    {
        curIntent = intent;
        animElapsedMs = 0u;
        animPhase = 0u;
    }
}

void rgbAnimTick(void)
{
    uint16_t step = 0u;

    if (animElapsedMs < (0xFFFFFFFFu - RGB_ANIM_TICK_MS))
    {
        animElapsedMs += RGB_ANIM_TICK_MS;
    }

    switch (curIntent)
    {
        case UART_LINK_RGB_TKO_WAIT:
        {
            /* 步进随 elapsed 从 SLOW 线性升到 FAST（频率渐增），到时长封顶。 */
            uint32_t frac256 = (animElapsedMs >= RGB_ANIM_WAIT_MS)
                ? 256u : (animElapsedMs * 256u / RGB_ANIM_WAIT_MS);
            step = (uint16_t) (RGB_ANIM_WAIT_STEP_SLOW
                + (uint32_t) (RGB_ANIM_WAIT_STEP_FAST - RGB_ANIM_WAIT_STEP_SLOW) * frac256 / 256u);
            break;
        }
        case UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN:
            step = RGB_ANIM_WARN_STEP;
            break;
        default:
            step = 0u; /* RAMP/NORMAL 不用闪烁相位 */
            break;
    }

    animPhase = (uint16_t) (animPhase + step);
}

uint8_t rgbAnimActive(void)
{
    return (curIntent != UART_LINK_RGB_NORMAL) ? 1u : 0u;
}

void rgbAnimRender(uint8_t* rPct, uint8_t* gPct, uint8_t* bPct)
{
    uint8_t r = 0u;
    uint8_t g = 0u;
    uint8_t b = 0u;

    switch (curIntent)
    {
        case UART_LINK_RGB_TKO_WAIT:
        {
            /* 白色快闪(频率随 elapsed 渐增)；末 RGB_ANIM_WAIT_SOLID_MS 段强制常亮(过渡到爬升)。 */
            uint8_t on;
            if (animElapsedMs >= (RGB_ANIM_WAIT_MS - RGB_ANIM_WAIT_SOLID_MS))
            {
                on = 1u;
            }
            else
            {
                on = (animPhase < 32768u) ? 1u : 0u;
            }
            r = on ? RGB_ANIM_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u;
            g = r;
            b = r;
            break;
        }
        case UART_LINK_RGB_TKO_RAMP:
        {
            /* 白色常亮 → 线性渐灭(RAMP_MS)。 */
            uint32_t frac256 = (animElapsedMs >= RGB_ANIM_RAMP_MS)
                ? 256u : (animElapsedMs * 256u / RGB_ANIM_RAMP_MS);
            uint8_t bright = (uint8_t) ((uint32_t) RGB_ANIM_BRIGHT_PCT * (256u - frac256) / 256u);
            r = bright;
            g = bright;
            b = bright;
            break;
        }
        case UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN:
        {
            /* 红色高频快闪(断联告警)。 */
            uint8_t on = (animPhase < 32768u) ? 1u : 0u;
            r = on ? RGB_ANIM_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u;
            break;
        }
        default:
            break; /* NORMAL：全 0（rgbAnimActive=0，渲染不会被调用）*/
    }

    *rPct = r;
    *gPct = g;
    *bPct = b;
}

#ifndef _RGB_ANIMATOR_H_
#define _RGB_ANIMATOR_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core1 cm_7_1 RGB 起飞编排动画层（决策/渲染分离）。
 *   core0 takeoffSequencer 产"意图码"(UART_LINK_RGB_*) → CORE0_STATUS sysCtrl 下发 → 共享内存
 *   keyEventToMenuStruct.core0RgbIntent → 本层据意图本地自演动画(频率/亮度斜坡)，输出 RGB 期望
 *   亮度，由 rgbStatusLed 用其 setRgb 原语应用。意图=NORMAL 时本层 inactive，放行原状态灯优先级链。

 */
