void rgbAnimRender(uint8_t* rPct, uint8_t* gPct, uint8_t* bPct); /* 算当前 RGB 期望亮度 0~100 */

#endif /* _RGB_ANIMATOR_H_ */
core1_cyt4bb7/project/code/app/rgbStatusLed.c
SHA-256：26ae45665d1db373e0b84a7f003970a175b12df1ea7bae5974c4d98cd3d4c1f3
代码（c）
#include "rgbStatusLed.h"

#include "zf_driver_pwm.h"

#include "core1KvmRouter.h"
#include "uartLinkProto.h" /* UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_* 位定义 + UART_LINK_RGB_* 意图码 */
#include "rgbAnimator.h"   /* 起飞编排动画层（意图码→灯效）*/
#include "pinMap.h"        /* RGB 三路 TCPWM 通道令牌单一真相源 */

/*
 * core1 RGB 状态灯实现。共阳极低电平点亮 → 占空比反向(亮度% 越高 duty 越小)。
 * 最大亮度 30% 硬钳位。动效(闪烁/呼吸)由 PIT_CH2 10ms tick 每次 update 累加软生成。
 */

#define RGB_PWM_R   (RGB_LED_R_PWM)
#define RGB_PWM_G   (RGB_LED_G_PWM)
#define RGB_PWM_B   (RGB_LED_B_PWM)
#define RGB_PWM_FREQ_HZ (1000u)

#define RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT (30u)  /* 最大亮度上限(用户要求) */
#define RGB_DIM_PCT        (8u)   /* "暗"档亮度(明暗维的暗) */

/* PIT_CH2 10ms tick 每次 update 自增, 决定动效相位(闪烁方波/呼吸三角波)。10ms 节拍稳定,
 * 相位阈值以"调用次数"计(如 flashOn(40) ≈ 400ms 半周期), 肉眼可辨即可。 */
static uint32_t rgbTick = 0u;

/* core0 核间链路"曾连接"锁存：区分上电从未连接(等待 core0, 红慢闪) vs 曾连接后断开(断联告警, 红快闪 WARN)。
 * rgbStatusLedInit 清 0；一旦 linkUp 见过 1 即锁存, 不复位(断联后保持告警, 重连后清意图自然恢复)。 */
static uint8_t everLinkedCore0 = 0u;
static uint8_t hardwareInitFaultActive = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t core0FactsPacked = 0u;

/* 亮度% → 占空比(共阳极反向 + 30% 硬钳位)。pct: 期望亮度 0~100。 */
static uint32_t brightToDuty(uint8_t pct)
{
    if (pct > RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT) pct = RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT; /* 硬钳位, 任何状态不超 30% */
    /* 共阳极: 亮度 pct% → 低电平时间 pct% → duty = PWM_DUTY_MAX*(100-pct)/100。 */
    return (uint32_t)(PWM_DUTY_MAX - (uint32_t) pct * (PWM_DUTY_MAX / 100u));
}

/* 设三路颜色(各通道期望亮度 0~100, 内部钳 30%)。 */
static void setRgb(uint8_t rPct, uint8_t gPct, uint8_t bPct)
{
    pwm_set_duty(RGB_PWM_R, brightToDuty(rPct));
    pwm_set_duty(RGB_PWM_G, brightToDuty(gPct));
    pwm_set_duty(RGB_PWM_B, brightToDuty(bPct));
}

/* 动效相位: 方波(闪烁)。periodTicks=半周期调用次数; 返回 1=亮相 0=灭相。 */
static uint8_t flashOn(uint32_t periodTicks)
{
    if (periodTicks == 0u) return 1u;
    return ((rgbTick / periodTicks) & 1u) ? 0u : 1u;
}

/* 动效相位: 三角波(呼吸), 返回 0~100 亮度系数。periodTicks=半周期。 */
static uint8_t breathePct(uint32_t periodTicks)
{
    if (periodTicks == 0u) return 100u;
    uint32_t ph = rgbTick % (periodTicks * 2u);
    uint32_t up = (ph < periodTicks) ? ph : (periodTicks * 2u - ph); /* 0..periodTicks 三角 */
    return (uint8_t)(up * 100u / periodTicks);
}

void rgbStatusLedInit(void)
{
    rgbTick = 0u;
    everLinkedCore0 = 0u;
    hardwareInitFaultActive = 0u;
    core0FactsPacked = 0u;
    rgbAnimInit(); /* 起飞编排动画层复位 */
    /* 共阳极: 初始全灭(duty=满, 高电平) 防上电乱闪。 */
    pwm_init(RGB_PWM_R, RGB_PWM_FREQ_HZ, PWM_DUTY_MAX);
    pwm_init(RGB_PWM_G, RGB_PWM_FREQ_HZ, PWM_DUTY_MAX);
    pwm_init(RGB_PWM_B, RGB_PWM_FREQ_HZ, PWM_DUTY_MAX);
}

void rgbStatusLedUpdate(uint8_t core1Ready, uint8_t menuStateVal, uint16_t beaconCount)
{
    (void) menuStateVal;
    (void) beaconCount;
    rgbTick++;

    /* 前台发布窄原子事实；PIT ISR禁止做D-cache事务和共享结构双读。 */
    uint32_t facts = core0FactsPacked;
    uint8_t shmReady = (uint8_t) (facts & 1u);
    uint8_t linkUp = (uint8_t) ((shmReady != 0u) && (((facts >> 1) & 1u) != 0u));
    uint8_t c0Valid = (uint8_t) ((shmReady != 0u) && (((facts >> 2) & 1u) != 0u));
    uint8_t c0Safety = (uint8_t) (facts >> 8);
    uint8_t c0Flags = (uint8_t) (facts >> 16);
    uint8_t c0RgbIntent = (uint8_t) (facts >> 24);

    uint8_t cm70Ready = (c0Valid && (c0Flags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_CM70_READY)) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t velValid = (c0Valid && (c0Flags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_VEL_VALID)) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t targetValid = (c0Valid && (c0Flags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_TARGET_VALID)) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t kvmState = core1KvmRouterGetDisplayStateIsr();
    uint8_t desired = CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_DESIRED(kvmState);
    uint8_t owner = CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_OWNER(kvmState);

    /* 安全优先级先于起飞编排动画：本地硬故障/相机故障 > 飞控硬故障 >
     * 必需链路 > PROTECT > 初始化等待 > 起飞编排。 */
    if (!core1Ready)
    {
        setRgb(0u, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (linkUp && c0Valid && c0Safety == 0xFFu)
    {
        uint8_t on = flashOn(10u);
        setRgb(on ? RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (hardwareInitFaultActive != 0u)
    {
        uint32_t phase = rgbTick % 200u;
        uint8_t on = (uint8_t) ((phase < 10u) ||
            ((phase >= 25u) && (phase < 35u)));
        setRgb(on ? RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (linkUp) everLinkedCore0 = 1u;
    if (!linkUp)
    {
        uint8_t on = flashOn(everLinkedCore0 ? 10u : 40u);
        setRgb(on ? RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (c0Safety == 0x02u)
    {
        uint8_t on = flashOn(15u);
        setRgb(on ? RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u, 0u,
            on ? RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (!cm70Ready)
    {
        uint8_t b = breathePct(60u);
        setRgb((uint8_t)(RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT * b / 100u),
            (uint8_t)(RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT * b / 100u), 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (c0Safety == 0xFEu)
    {
        uint8_t on = flashOn(15u);
        setRgb(on ? RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u,
            on ? RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT : 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }

    /* ---- 起飞编排动画层(最高优先): core0 经 sysCtrl 下发 rgbIntent, 非 NORMAL 时本核自演动画 ----
     * 每拍喂意图(共享内存就绪才信, 否则 NORMAL)+推进相位; core1 就绪且意图有效时接管渲染并返回,
     * 否则放行下方原状态灯优先级链(NORMAL 时本层 inactive, 原灯照常)。 */
    {
        uint8_t intent;
        /* 链路上升沿已在安全优先级入口锁存。 */
        /* 意图选择(区分等待 vs 断联，并防陈旧意图残留)：
         *   共享内存未就绪 → NORMAL；
         *   链路在线 → 用 core0 下发意图(起飞编排 / core0 缓降下发的 DISCONNECT_WARN)；
         *   曾连接后断开 → 统一红快闪 DISCONNECT_WARN(断联告警；不沿用陈旧 core0 意图，防残留起飞动画)；
         *   上电从未连接 → NORMAL，放行下方优先级链 #3 红慢闪作"等待 core0 连接"指示。 */
        if (!shmReady)
        {
            intent = UART_LINK_RGB_NORMAL;
        }
        else if (linkUp)
        {
            intent = c0RgbIntent;
        }
        else
        {
            intent = everLinkedCore0 ? UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN : UART_LINK_RGB_NORMAL;
        }
        rgbAnimSet(intent);
        rgbAnimTick();
        if (core1Ready && rgbAnimActive())
        {
            uint8_t ar;
            uint8_t ag;
            uint8_t ab;
            rgbAnimRender(&ar, &ag, &ab);
            setRgb(ar, ag, ab);
            return;
        }
    }

    /* 正常职责：KVM 颜色只表征实际输入 owner：C0白、C1绿、C3蓝、NONE黄。
     * pending 呼吸；目标不可达时黄快闪。目标无效仅插入短红缺口，速度无效降亮。 */
    {
        uint8_t bright = velValid ? RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT : RGB_DIM_PCT;
        uint8_t r = 0u;
        uint8_t g = 0u;
        uint8_t b = 0u;
        uint8_t shown = owner;

        if (!targetValid && ((rgbTick % 100u) < 8u))
        {
            setRgb(bright, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        if ((owner == CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_NONE) &&
            (desired != CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_NONE))
        {
            uint8_t on = flashOn(10u);
            setRgb(on ? bright : 0u, on ? bright : 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        if (desired != owner)
        {
            shown = desired;
            bright = (uint8_t) ((uint16_t) bright * breathePct(60u) / 100u);
        }
        if (shown == CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_CORE0) r = g = b = bright;
        else if (shown == CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_CORE1) g = bright;
        else if (shown == CORE1_KVM_DISPLAY_TARGET_CORE3) b = bright;
        else r = g = bright;
        setRgb(r, g, b);
    }
}

void rgbStatusLedSetHardwareInitFault(uint8_t active)
{
    hardwareInitFaultActive = active ? 1u : 0u;
}
void rgbStatusLedPublishCore0Facts(uint8_t ready, uint8_t linkUp,
    uint8_t statusValid, uint8_t safetyState, uint8_t statusFlags,
    uint8_t rgbIntent)
{
    core0FactsPacked = ((uint32_t) (ready != 0u)) |
        ((uint32_t) (linkUp != 0u) << 1) |
        ((uint32_t) (statusValid != 0u) << 2) |
        ((uint32_t) safetyState << 8) |
        ((uint32_t) statusFlags << 16) |
        ((uint32_t) rgbIntent << 24);
}

#ifndef _RGB_STATUS_LED_H_
#define _RGB_STATUS_LED_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * rgbStatusLed - core1 cm_7_1 RGB 状态灯（两核共用状态标志硬件）
 *
 * 硬件: P05_0(B)/P05_1(R)/P05_2(G) → TCPWM CH09/CH10/CH11，共阳极低电平点亮。
 *   占空比越小越亮(duty 0=全亮, 10000=灭)。最大亮度限 30%(RGB_MAX_BRIGHT_PCT)。
 *
 * 状态来源(综合 core0+core1 整机):
 *   - 本地(cm_7_1 直接读): initReadyFlag / menuState / beaconCount
 *   - core0(由前台路由器发布一份打包事实): linkUp / core0SafetyState /
 *     core0StatusFlags(cm70Ready/velValid/targetValid/tofHealthy)
 *
 * 双维编码(用户要求): 飞行/待命档用 颜色(^灯板目标有效=绿/无=红) + 明暗(速度估计有效=亮/失效=暗)
 *   同时表达两个飞控健康维度。其余档用颜色+动效(常亮/闪烁/呼吸)区分。
 *
 * 全部经 core1 cm_7_1 的 PIT_CH2 10ms tick(pitProcess0)调用, 稳定节拍软生成动效。
 */

    uint8_t rgbIntent);

 * 不在ISR访问跨核共享区；软生成动效并设置三路占空比。

void rgbStatusLedUpdate(uint8_t core1Ready, uint8_t menuStateVal, uint16_t beaconCount);

代码（c）
#include "chassisLink.h"
#include "chassisLinkInternal.h"
#include "chassisLinkWireInternal.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "THVD1450.h"
#include "chassisParamProtocol.h"

/*
 * core1 端 RS-485 命令发送（core1→core2）。core1 作总线主，周期发 MSG_COMMAND。
 * 帧布局与 core2 chassisLink.c 解析侧逐字节对齐（SYNC）：
 *   payload[0]=0x02，[1:4]=vx，[5:8]=vy，[9:12]=wz（float32 小端），[13]=cmd 位，[14]=sysByte。
 */

#define CHASSIS_LINK_MOTION_ABS_MAX (200.0f)

static chassisParamFrame paramResponse;
static uint8_t paramResponsePending;
static uint8_t paramGlobalStateBytes[CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_BYTES];
static uint8_t paramGlobalRequestBytes[CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_BYTES];
static paramSyncGlobalRequest paramGlobalRequest;
static uint32_t paramGlobalStateSequence;
static uint8_t paramGlobalStateStreamSequence;
static uint8_t paramGlobalStateFragmentIndex;
static uint8_t paramGlobalStateCyclePending;
static uint8_t paramGlobalRequestStreamSequence;
static uint8_t paramGlobalRequestMask;
static uint8_t paramGlobalRequestPending;

uint8_t chassisLinkMotionValid(float vx, float vy, float wz)
{
    return (vx > -CHASSIS_LINK_MOTION_ABS_MAX && vx < CHASSIS_LINK_MOTION_ABS_MAX && vy > -CHASSIS_LINK_MOTION_ABS_MAX && vy < CHASSIS_LINK_MOTION_ABS_MAX && wz > -CHASSIS_LINK_MOTION_ABS_MAX && wz < CHASSIS_LINK_MOTION_ABS_MAX) ? 1u : 0u;
}

uint8_t chassisLinkDecodeReply(const thvd1450FrameStruct *frame,
    chassisLinkReplyStruct *decoded)
{
    uint8_t type;
    chassisLinkReplyStruct candidate;
    if ((frame == NULL) || (decoded == NULL)) return 0u;
    memset(decoded, 0, sizeof(*decoded));
    memset(&candidate, 0, sizeof(candidate));
    if (frame->length == 0u) return 0u;
    type = frame->payload[CHASSIS_LINK_TYPE_OFFSET];

    if (frame->length >= CHASSIS_LINK_LORA_BASE_LENGTH && type == CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_LORA_MOTION)
    {
        chassisLinkWireDecodeVector(frame->payload,
            &candidate.vx, &candidate.vy, &candidate.wz);
        candidate.motionValid = chassisLinkMotionValid(candidate.vx, candidate.vy, candidate.wz);
        if (candidate.motionValid == 0u) return 0u;
        if (frame->length >= CHASSIS_LINK_LORA_LENGTH)
        {
            uint8_t flags = frame->payload[CHASSIS_LINK_CONTROL_OFFSET];
            const uint8_t allowedFlags = CHASSIS_LINK_LORA_FLAG_TAKEOFF_REQ |
                                         CHASSIS_LINK_LORA_FLAG_ATTITUDE_FAULT;
            if ((flags & (uint8_t) ~allowedFlags) != 0u) return 0u;
            candidate.remoteTakeoffReq = (flags & CHASSIS_LINK_LORA_FLAG_TAKEOFF_REQ) ? 1u : 0u;
            candidate.attitudeFault =
                (flags & CHASSIS_LINK_LORA_FLAG_ATTITUDE_FAULT) ? 1u : 0u;
        }
        candidate.replyType = CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_LORA_MOTION;
        *decoded = candidate;
        return 1u;
    }
    else if (frame->length >= CHASSIS_LINK_TELEMETRY_LENGTH && type == CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_TELEMETRY)
    {
        uint8_t status = frame->payload[CHASSIS_LINK_CONTROL_OFFSET];
        chassisLinkWireDecodeVector(frame->payload,
            &candidate.vx, &candidate.vy, &candidate.wz);
        if (chassisLinkMotionValid(candidate.vx, candidate.vy, candidate.wz) == 0u) return 0u;
        if ((status & (uint8_t) ~(CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ENABLED |
                                  CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_LINK_OK | CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ESTOP |
                                  CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_LAUNCHED |
                                  CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ |
                                  CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ATTITUDE_FAULT)) != 0u) return 0u;
        candidate.mode2LoraLandReqPresent = 1u;
        candidate.mode2LoraLandReqLevel =
            (status & CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ) ? 1u : 0u;
        candidate.attitudeFault =
            (status & CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ATTITUDE_FAULT) ? 1u : 0u;
        candidate.replyType = CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_TELEMETRY;
        candidate.status = status;
        *decoded = candidate;
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

void chassisLinkInit(void)
{
    thvd1450Init();
    paramResponsePending = 0u;
    memset(paramGlobalStateBytes, 0, sizeof(paramGlobalStateBytes));
    memset(paramGlobalRequestBytes, 0, sizeof(paramGlobalRequestBytes));
    memset(&paramGlobalRequest, 0, sizeof(paramGlobalRequest));
    paramGlobalStateSequence = 0u;
    paramGlobalStateStreamSequence = 0u;
    paramGlobalStateFragmentIndex = 0u;
    paramGlobalStateCyclePending = 0u;
    paramGlobalRequestStreamSequence = 0u;
    paramGlobalRequestMask = 0u;
    paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
}

uint8_t chassisLinkPollReply(chassisLinkReplyStruct *out)
{
    thvd1450FrameStruct frame;
    if (out == NULL) return 0u;
    thvd1450Poll();
    while (thvd1450ReadFrame(&frame) == THVD1450_STATUS_OK)
    {
        chassisParamFrame decodedParam;
        chassisParamGlobalFragment globalFragment;
        if (chassisParamDecode(frame.payload, frame.length,
                CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_PARAM_RESPONSE, &decodedParam) != 0u)
        {
            paramResponse = decodedParam;
            paramResponsePending = 1u;
            continue;
        }
        if (chassisParamGlobalFragmentDecode(frame.payload, frame.length,
                CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST,
                &globalFragment) != 0u)
        {
            uint8_t expectedCount = (uint8_t)
                ((CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_BYTES +
                  CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_DATA_BYTES - 1u) /
                 CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_DATA_BYTES);
            uint8_t offset = (uint8_t) (globalFragment.fragmentIndex *
                CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_DATA_BYTES);
            if ((globalFragment.fragmentCount != expectedCount) ||
                ((uint16_t) offset + globalFragment.length >
                    CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_BYTES))
            {
                paramGlobalRequestMask = 0u;
                continue;
            }
            if (globalFragment.streamSequence !=
                paramGlobalRequestStreamSequence)
            {
                paramGlobalRequestStreamSequence =
                    globalFragment.streamSequence;
                paramGlobalRequestMask = 0u;
            }
            memcpy(&paramGlobalRequestBytes[offset], globalFragment.data,
                globalFragment.length);
            paramGlobalRequestMask |= (uint8_t)
                (1u << globalFragment.fragmentIndex);
            if (paramGlobalRequestMask ==
                (uint8_t) ((1u << expectedCount) - 1u))
            {
                if (paramSyncGlobalDecodeRequest(paramGlobalRequestBytes,
                        &paramGlobalRequest) != 0u)
                    paramGlobalRequestPending = 1u;
                paramGlobalRequestMask = 0u;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (chassisLinkDecodeReply(&frame, out) != 0u) return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

uint8_t chassisLinkSendParamGlobalState(const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    chassisParamGlobalFragment fragment;
    uint8_t payload[CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_FRAME_BYTES];
    uint8_t count = (uint8_t) ((CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_BYTES +
        CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_DATA_BYTES - 1u) /
        CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_DATA_BYTES);
    uint8_t offset;
    uint8_t remaining;
    if ((state == 0) || (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(state) == 0u)) return 0u;
    if (state->sequence != paramGlobalStateSequence)
    {
        paramSyncGlobalEncodeState(state, paramGlobalStateBytes);
        paramGlobalStateSequence = state->sequence;
        paramGlobalStateFragmentIndex = 0u;
        paramGlobalStateStreamSequence++;
        if (paramGlobalStateStreamSequence == 0u)
            paramGlobalStateStreamSequence = 1u;
        paramGlobalStateCyclePending = 1u;
    }
    if (paramGlobalStateCyclePending == 0u) return 0u;
    memset(&fragment, 0, sizeof(fragment));
    fragment.streamSequence = paramGlobalStateStreamSequence;
    fragment.fragmentIndex = paramGlobalStateFragmentIndex;
    fragment.fragmentCount = count;
    offset = (uint8_t) (fragment.fragmentIndex * CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_DATA_BYTES);
    remaining = (uint8_t) (CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_BYTES - offset);
    fragment.length = (remaining > CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_DATA_BYTES) ?
        CHASSIS_PARAM_GLOBAL_DATA_BYTES : remaining;
    memcpy(fragment.data, &paramGlobalStateBytes[offset], fragment.length);
    if ((chassisParamGlobalFragmentEncode(
             CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE, &fragment, payload) == 0u) ||
        (thvd1450SendBytes(payload, sizeof(payload)) != THVD1450_STATUS_OK))
        return 0u;
    paramGlobalStateFragmentIndex++;
    if (paramGlobalStateFragmentIndex >= count)
    {
        paramGlobalStateFragmentIndex = 0u;
        paramGlobalStateCyclePending = 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t chassisLinkTryReadParamGlobalRequest(paramSyncGlobalRequest *request)
{
    if ((request == 0) || (paramGlobalRequestPending == 0u)) return 0u;
    if (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&paramGlobalRequest) == 0u)
    {
        paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    *request = paramGlobalRequest;
    paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t chassisLinkSendParamRequest(const chassisParamFrame *request)
{
    uint8_t payload[CHASSIS_PARAM_FRAME_BYTES];
    if (chassisParamEncode(CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_PARAM_REQUEST, request, payload) == 0u)
        return 0u;
    return (thvd1450SendBytes(payload, CHASSIS_PARAM_FRAME_BYTES) ==
               THVD1450_STATUS_OK)
               ? 1u
               : 0u;
}

uint8_t chassisLinkTryReadParamResponse(chassisParamFrame *response)
{
    if ((response == 0) || (paramResponsePending == 0u)) return 0u;
    *response = paramResponse;
    paramResponsePending = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

void chassisLinkSendCommand(float vx, float vy, float wz, uint8_t cmd, uint8_t sysByte)
{
    uint8_t payload[CHASSIS_LINK_COMMAND_LENGTH];
    chassisLinkWireEncodeVector(payload, CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_COMMAND, vx, vy, wz);
    payload[CHASSIS_LINK_CONTROL_OFFSET] = cmd;
    payload[CHASSIS_LINK_SYSBYTE_OFFSET] = sysByte; /* bit0 控制源(0=485/1=LoRa) + bit1-3 蜂鸣模式码 */
    /* thvd1450SendBytes 内部封帧(7A|len|payload|xor|55) + 半双工 DE 自管理，阻塞至发完切回收。 */
    (void) thvd1450SendBytes(payload, CHASSIS_LINK_COMMAND_LENGTH);
}

SHA-256：b1f5deb07c4cbcfabb36b56f2e1944cb28f955bb400a6a5385c2cef06155eb96
代码（c）
#ifndef _CHASSIS_LINK_H_
#define _CHASSIS_LINK_H_

#include <stdint.h>

#include "chassisLinkProtocol.h"
#include "chassisParamProtocol.h"

typedef struct
{
    float vx;
    float vy;
    float wz;
    uint8_t motionValid;
    uint8_t remoteTakeoffReq;
    uint8_t mode2LoraLandReqPresent;
    uint8_t mode2LoraLandReqLevel;
    uint8_t attitudeFault;
    uint8_t replyType;
    uint8_t status;
} chassisLinkReplyStruct;

/*
 * core1 端 RS-485 链路层（core1 ↔ core2，基于 THVD1450 帧层）。core1 是总线主：
 *   发 MSG_COMMAND(core1→core2)：目标 vx/vy/wz + 指令字(ENABLE/ESTOP/LAUNCH)。
 *   收 MSG_TELEMETRY / MSG_LORA_MOTION(core2→core1)：chassisLinkInternal 单帧解码，core0Loop 前台聚合。
 *
 * 请求-应答：core1 周期发 MSG_COMMAND 作"轮询"，core2 收到有效命令后才回一帧
 *   (REMOTE_485→遥测 / REMOTE_LORA→LoRa 遥控值)，半双工总线串行化、避免碰撞。
 *
 * 协议常量与帧布局须与 core2 chassisLink.h 逐字节同源（SYNC：改一处必同步另一处）。
 * payload[0]=消息类型；其后小端 float32 + 指令/状态字节(手填，不用 PackFloats 以容纳类型字节)。
 */

/* 发送 MSG_COMMAND（15B payload：[0x02|vx(4)|vy(4)|wz(4)|cmd|sysByte]，float32 小端）。
 * sysByte = 控制源位(CHASSIS_LINK_SYS_SOURCE_LORA) | (蜂鸣码<<CHASSIS_LINK_SYS_BUZZER_SHIFT)。
 * 半双工阻塞发送，DE 由 THVD1450 自管理；发完自动切回收以接 core2 的应答帧。 */
void chassisLinkSendCommand(float vx, float vy, float wz, uint8_t cmd, uint8_t sysByte);

uint8_t chassisLinkTryReadParamResponse(chassisParamFrame *response);
uint8_t chassisLinkSendParamGlobalState(const paramSyncGlobalState *state);
uint8_t chassisLinkTryReadParamGlobalRequest(paramSyncGlobalRequest *request);

#ifndef CHASSIS_LINK_WIRE_INTERNAL_H
#define CHASSIS_LINK_WIRE_INTERNAL_H

#include <string.h>

#include "chassisLinkProtocol.h"

static void chassisLinkWireEncodeVector(uint8_t* payload, uint8_t type,
    float vx, float vy, float wz)
{
    payload[CHASSIS_LINK_TYPE_OFFSET] = type;
    memcpy(&payload[CHASSIS_LINK_VX_OFFSET], &vx, sizeof(vx));
    memcpy(&payload[CHASSIS_LINK_VY_OFFSET], &vy, sizeof(vy));
    memcpy(&payload[CHASSIS_LINK_WZ_OFFSET], &wz, sizeof(wz));
}

static void chassisLinkWireDecodeVector(const uint8_t* payload,
    float* vx, float* vy, float* wz)
{
    memcpy(vx, &payload[CHASSIS_LINK_VX_OFFSET], sizeof(*vx));
    memcpy(vy, &payload[CHASSIS_LINK_VY_OFFSET], sizeof(*vy));
    memcpy(wz, &payload[CHASSIS_LINK_WZ_OFFSET], sizeof(*wz));
}

#endif

#include "coreDataTransfer.h"

#include "cy_device_headers.h"

#include <string.h>

#define CORE1_PLAN_CACHE_LINE_SIZE (32u)

/* #pragma location 把共享结构强制放共享 RAM 固定地址(__no_init 绝对放置),
 * 让链接器保留空间。照搬 core0 coreDataTransfer 机制。 */
#pragma location = CORE1_DATA_KEY_ADDR
__no_init volatile keyEventToMenuStruct keyEventRegion;

void coreDataWriteKeyEvent(const keyEventToMenuStruct* src)
{
    if (0 == src) return;
    memcpy((void*) &keyEventRegion, src, sizeof(keyEventToMenuStruct));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &keyEventRegion, sizeof(keyEventToMenuStruct));
}
uint8_t coreDataTryReadKeyEvent(keyEventToMenuStruct* dst)
{
    keyEventToMenuStruct first;
    keyEventToMenuStruct second;
    uint8_t attempt;
    if (0 == dst) return 0u;
    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &keyEventRegion,
            sizeof(keyEventToMenuStruct));
        memcpy(&first, (const void*) &keyEventRegion, sizeof(first));
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &keyEventRegion,
            sizeof(keyEventToMenuStruct));
        memcpy(&second, (const void*) &keyEventRegion, sizeof(second));
        if (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0)
        {
            *dst = second;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

void coreDataReadKeyEvent(keyEventToMenuStruct* dst)
{
    if (0 == dst) return;
    if (coreDataTryReadKeyEvent(dst) == 0u)
    {
        /* 兼容旧consumer：未迁移调用仍保持原fail-closed语义。 */
        memset(dst, 0, sizeof(*dst));
    }
}

/* core0 位姿区: cm_7_0 链路核 → cm_7_1 规划/显示核。 */
#pragma location = CORE1_DATA_C0POSE_ADDR
__no_init volatile core0PoseToVisionStruct core0PoseRegion;

#pragma location = CORE1_DATA_KVM_STATUS_ADDR
__no_init volatile core1KvmStatusStruct kvmStatusRegion;

#pragma location = CORE1_DATA_KVM_INGRESS_ADDR

#pragma location = CORE1_DATA_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_ADDR

#pragma location = CORE1_DATA_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_ADDR

#pragma location = CORE1_DATA_PARAM_OBSERVER4_ADDR
__no_init volatile core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct paramObserver4Region;

void coreDataWriteCore0Pose(const core0PoseToVisionStruct* src)
{
    if (0 == src) return;
    memcpy((void*) &core0PoseRegion, src, sizeof(core0PoseToVisionStruct));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &core0PoseRegion, sizeof(core0PoseToVisionStruct));

}

    core0PoseToVisionStruct second;

    {

            sizeof(core0PoseToVisionStruct));
        memcpy(&first, (const void*) &core0PoseRegion, sizeof(first));
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &core0PoseRegion,
            sizeof(core0PoseToVisionStruct));
        memcpy(&second, (const void*) &core0PoseRegion, sizeof(second));
        if (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0)
        {
            *dst = second;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

{

    core1KvmIngressStruct second;
    uint8_t attempt;
    if (0 == dst) return;
    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &kvmIngressRegion, sizeof(core1KvmIngressStruct));
        memcpy(&first, (const void*) &kvmIngressRegion, sizeof(first));
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &kvmIngressRegion, sizeof(core1KvmIngressStruct));
        memcpy(&second, (const void*) &kvmIngressRegion, sizeof(second));
        if (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0)
        {
            *dst = second;
            return;
        }
    }
    memset(dst, 0, sizeof(*dst));
}

void coreDataWriteParamObserverBridge(
    const core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct *src)
{
    volatile core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct *region;
    if (coreDataParamObserverBridgeIsValid(src) == 0u) return;
    region = (src->source == 3u) ? &paramObserver3Region :
        &paramObserver4Region;
    memcpy((void *) region, src, sizeof(*src));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*src));
    __DSB();
}

uint8_t coreDataTryReadParamObserverBridge(uint8_t source,
    core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct *dst)
{
    volatile core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct *region;
    core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct first, second;
    uint8_t attempt;
    if (dst == 0 || (source != 3u && source != 4u)) return 0u;
    region = (source == 3u) ? &paramObserver3Region :
        &paramObserver4Region;
    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*dst));
        __DSB();
        memcpy(&first, (const void *) region, sizeof(first));
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*dst));
        __DSB();
        memcpy(&second, (const void *) region, sizeof(second));
        if (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0 &&
            second.source == source &&
            coreDataParamObserverBridgeIsValid(&second) != 0u)
        {
            *dst = second;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

/* 反向区: cm_7_1 规划核 → cm_7_0 链路核(运动意图)。另起一固定地址, 与 keyEventRegion 无重叠。 */
#pragma location = CORE1_DATA_PLAN_ADDR
__no_init volatile planToLinkStruct planRegion;

static uint32_t planPublishGeneration;
__no_init uint32_t planBootGenerationRetained;
__no_init uint32_t planBootGenerationInverseRetained;
static uint32_t planBootGeneration;

uint32_t coreDataGetPlanBootGeneration(void)
{
    if (planBootGeneration == 0u)
    {
        uint32_t previous = planBootGenerationRetained;
        if ((previous == 0u) ||
            (planBootGenerationInverseRetained != ~previous))
        {
            previous = 0u;
        }
        previous++;
        if (previous == 0u) previous = 1u;
        planBootGenerationRetained = previous;
        planBootGenerationInverseRetained = ~previous;
        planBootGeneration = previous;
    }
    return planBootGeneration;
}

static volatile void* planGenerationCacheLine(void)
{
    uintptr_t marker = (uintptr_t) &planRegion.publishGeneration;
    return (volatile void*) (marker & ~((uintptr_t) CORE1_PLAN_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u));
}

static void cleanPlanGeneration(void)
{
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr(planGenerationCacheLine(), CORE1_PLAN_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
    __DSB();
}

static void invalidatePlanGeneration(void)
{
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr(planGenerationCacheLine(), CORE1_PLAN_CACHE_LINE_SIZE);
    __DSB();
}

static uint32_t nextPlanGeneration(void)
{
    planPublishGeneration += 2u;
    if (planPublishGeneration == 0u) planPublishGeneration = 2u;
    return planPublishGeneration;
}

void coreDataWritePlan(const planToLinkStruct* src)
{
    planToLinkStruct frame;
    uint32_t committed;

    if (0 == src) return;

    frame = *src;
    frame.producerBootGeneration = coreDataGetPlanBootGeneration();
    committed = nextPlanGeneration();

    planRegion.publishGeneration = committed | 1u;
    cleanPlanGeneration();

    frame.publishGeneration = committed | 1u;
    memcpy((void*) &planRegion, &frame, sizeof(frame));
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &planRegion, sizeof(planToLinkStruct));
    __DSB();

    planRegion.publishGeneration = committed;
    cleanPlanGeneration();
}

uint8_t coreDataReadPlan(planToLinkStruct* dst)
{
    uint8_t attempt;

    if (0 == dst) return 0u;
    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        uint32_t before;
        uint32_t after;

        invalidatePlanGeneration();
        before = planRegion.publishGeneration;
        if ((before == 0u) || ((before & 1u) != 0u)) continue;

        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void*) &planRegion, sizeof(planToLinkStruct));
        __DSB();
        memcpy(dst, (const void*) &planRegion, sizeof(*dst));

        invalidatePlanGeneration();
        after = planRegion.publishGeneration;
        if ((before == dst->publishGeneration) && (before == after) &&
            ((after & 1u) == 0u) && (dst->magic == CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC))
        {
            return 1u;
        }
    }

    memset(dst, 0, sizeof(*dst));
    return 0u;
}

/*
 * core1 核间共享内存 (cm_7_0 链路核 ↔ cm_7_1 菜单/视觉核)
 *
 * 物理区域: section .global_ram_data
 *   startAddr = 0x28001000, size = 0x2000 (core1 此段经 .map 确认空闲)
 *   保留地址须避开: mt9v03x_h_num @ 0x28006BF0, mt9v03x_w_num @ 0x28006BF2 (远离, 无冲突)
 *
 * 用途:
 *   - status 区: core0 经核间 UART 把链路、飞控和系统状态发给 cm_7_0，cm_7_1按值读取。
 *   - pose 区: core0 经核间 UART 把灯板同坐标/方向发给 core1 cm_7_0, cm_7_1 规划核读出生成车坐标误差。
 *   key/pose 均同时携带链路在线语义或用于链路在线门控。core1 内 cm_7_0→cm_7_1 单向。
 *
 * 双核 D-Cache 一致性 (Cortex-M7, cache line=32B), 照搬 core0 coreDataTransfer:
 *   写方 memcpy→SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr；key/KVM安全快照读方最多三次双读一致校验，失败整帧清零。
 *   握手 32 位 magic 防 __no_init 上电垃圾。
 */
#ifndef _CORE_DATA_TRANSFER_H_
#define _CORE_DATA_TRANSFER_H_

#include <stdint.h>

#include "paramSyncMailbox.h"
#include "paramSyncGlobal.h"

#define CORE1_DATA_KEY_ADDR    (0x28001000u)
#define CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC (0x5A5AA5A6u)

/* cm_7_0 链路核 → cm_7_1 菜单核 (32 字节, 单 cache line)
 *   - linkUp: core0 链路在线(心跳未超时)=1; cm_7_1 据此判断远程操控可用 + 断联保护
 *   - core2LinkLost: core1 cm_7_0 观测到 RS-485↔core2 断联=1, 供 cm_7_1 HOME HUD 显示
 *   - ready: = MAGIC 表示 cm_7_0 链路核已初始化(防 __no_init 上电垃圾) */
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t ready;    /* = CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC */
    uint8_t linkUp;    /* 1=core0 链路在线(心跳未超时) */
    uint8_t controlActive; /* 1=core0 处于远程模式(正用按键操控 core1); 0=core0 本地模式 */
    /* core0 飞控状态(经 CORE0_STATUS 帧, 供 cm_7_1 RGB 状态灯)。cm_7_0 写 cm_7_1 读。 */
    uint8_t core0SafetyState; /* 0x00 DISARM/0x01 CLOSED_LOOP/0x02 PROTECT/0xFE ARMING/0xFF IMUFAIL */
    uint8_t core0ArmProgress; /* arming 进度 0~100 */
    uint8_t core0StatusFlags; /* UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_*: cm70Ready/velValid/targetValid/tofHealthy */
    uint8_t core0StatusValid; /* 1=已收到过 core0 CORE0_STATUS 帧(否则上面三字段无意义) */
    /* 空地系统模式 + RGB 意图(经 CORE0_STATUS sysCtrl, 供 cm_7_1 菜单显示 + rgbAnimator)。cm_7_0 写 cm_7_1 读。 */
    uint8_t core0SystemMode;  /* 空地系统模式 1/2/3(0=未设) */
    uint8_t core0RgbIntent;   /* RGB 意图码(UART_LINK_RGB_*, 供 cm_7_1 rgbAnimator) */
    uint8_t core2LinkLost;    /* 1=core1 RS-485↔core2 断联；0=在线/未判失联 */
    uint8_t core0AltReached;  /* CORE0_STATUS sysCtrl bit5；仅statusValid时有意义 */
    uint8_t padding[18];
} keyEventToMenuStruct;

static inline uint8_t coreDataParamObserverBridgeIsValid(
    const core1ParamObserverBridgeStruct *value)
{
    uint8_t requestValid;
    if (value == 0 || value->magic != CORE1_PARAM_OBSERVER_MAGIC ||
        value->producerBootGeneration == 0u || value->publishSequence == 0u ||
        (value->source != 3u && value->source != 4u) ||
        (value->flags & (uint8_t) ~CORE1_PARAM_OBSERVER_ALLOWED_FLAGS) != 0u ||
        value->reserved[0] != 0u || value->reserved[1] != 0u)
        return 0u;
    requestValid = (uint8_t) ((value->flags &
        CORE1_PARAM_OBSERVER_FLAG_REQUEST_VALID) != 0u);
    if ((value->flags & CORE1_PARAM_OBSERVER_FLAG_READY) != 0u)
    {
        if (value->peerSession == 0u) return 0u;
    }
    else if (value->peerSession != 0u || requestValid != 0u)
        return 0u;
    if (requestValid != 0u)
        return (uint8_t) (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&value->request) != 0u &&
            value->request.origin == value->source);
    return (uint8_t) (value->request.producerBootGeneration == 0u &&
        value->request.sequence == 0u && value->request.origin == 0u &&
        value->request.action == 0u && value->request.slot == 0u &&
        value->request.reserved == 0u);
}

#define REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE4 (4u)

/* cm_7_1 规划核 → cm_7_0 链路核 (64 字节, 2 cache line)
 *   - magic: = CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC 表示规划核已写过(防 __no_init 上电垃圾)
 *   - seq:   每次规划更新 +1, cm_7_0 据 seq 变化判数据新鲜(超时无变化→零速)
 *   - state: beaconNavigatorStateEnum (0 IDLE/2 TRACK/3 首灯前等待或直行/4 SEARCH)
 *   - valid: 1=vx/vy/wz 可下发; 0=应作零速处理
 *   - target / err 字段: 观测量(供 cm_7_1 上屏 + 调试), targetX/Y/Size 为continuity控制点/面积；
 *     EdgeHold时targetSize为最后目标面积，不一定来自当前fresh观测。
 *     cm_7_0 派发只读 valid/vx/vy/wz */
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t magic;       /* = CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC */
    uint32_t seq;         /* 规划更新边沿计数 */
    uint8_t  state;       /* 运动调度状态机当前态 */
    uint8_t  valid;       /* 1=运动意图有效可下发 */
    uint8_t  beaconCount; /* 当前确认信标数(观测) */
    uint8_t  padding0;
    uint16_t targetX;     /* continuity 控制点 X(实测或保持) */
    uint16_t targetY;     /* continuity 控制点 Y(实测或保持) */
    uint16_t targetSize;  /* continuity 目标面积 */
    uint16_t padding1;
    float    errX;        /* 像素误差 X(观测) */
    float    errY;        /* 像素误差 Y(观测) */
    float    vx;          /* 规划输出: 前向速度意图 */
    float    vy;          /* 规划输出: 横向速度意图 */
    float    wz;          /* 规划输出: 偏航角速度意图 */
    /* 运行时派发控制（cm_7_1 从 visionParams 填, cm_7_0 派发门控用；取代原编译期宏）。 */
    uint8_t  dispatchEnable;  /* 1=允许模式2下发运动(总开关) */
    uint8_t  motionUnlocked;  /* 模式2本次altReached episode已通过启动门 */
    uint16_t planTimeoutMs;   /* cm_7_0 判规划 seq 新鲜度超时(ms) */
    uint8_t  requiredVisionFault;
    uint8_t  startupPhase;    /* takeoffMotionPhaseEnum，仅Core1双核内部观测 */
    uint8_t  beaconSearching; /* 1=continuity正在寻灯 */
    uint8_t  beaconSearchTimedOut; /* 1=当前寻灯episode已超时 */
    uint32_t takeoffMotionEpoch;    /* 每次模式2 altReached新episode递增 */
    uint32_t publishGeneration;     /* 共享区奇偶事务代数；调用方不赋值 */
    uint8_t  faultSource;
    uint8_t  faultClass;
    uint8_t  poseStage;
    uint8_t  paddingTail;
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration; /* cm_7_1启动代次；先于seq判新鲜，0非法 */
} planToLinkStruct;

/* 跨核 ABI 固定 64 字节（两核 cm_7_0/cm_7_1 须同步烧录同一布局）。改字段务必守住 64B。 */
typedef char coreDataTransfer_planToLink_size_assert[(sizeof(planToLinkStruct) == 64u) ? 1 : -1];

/* cm_7_1 调用: 写规划运动意图 (Clean) */
uint32_t coreDataGetPlanBootGeneration(void);
void coreDataWritePlan(const planToLinkStruct* src);
/* cm_7_0 调用: 读规划运动意图 (Invalidate) */
uint8_t coreDataReadPlan(planToLinkStruct* dst);

typedef char coreData_plan_before_param_sync_assert[
    ((CORE1_DATA_PLAN_ADDR + sizeof(planToLinkStruct)) <=
        PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_ADDR) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char coreData_param_sync_region_end_assert[
    ((PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_ADDR + PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_BYTES) <=
        0x28002000u) ? 1 : -1];

#endif  /* _CORE_DATA_TRANSFER_H_ */

/*
 * crossCoreLink core1 cm_7_0 端实现。单线双向(UART_1/P04 ↔ core0 P10)。
 * 收状态/位姿/KVM帧并写共享内存；周期发心跳，维护core0存活超时。
 */

#define CCL_UART_NUM    (LINK_GROUP0_UART_NUM)
#define CCL_UART_TX_PIN (LINK_GROUP0_UART_TX_PIN)
#define CCL_UART_RX_PIN (LINK_GROUP0_UART_RX_PIN)
#define CCL_BAUDRATE    (UART_LINK_BAUDRATE)
#if UART_LINK_BAUDRATE != 4000000u
#error "Core0-Core1 link baud contract requires 4 Mbps"
#endif

#define CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_TX_MS (50u)

typedef struct

    volatile uint8_t core0SafetyState;   /* 最近 CORE0_STATUS 的 safetyState 字节, 供 cm_7_0 判 core0 地面态(断链视觉调试 gate) */

    uint8_t core2AttitudeFault; /* Core2姿态诊断故障；独立于链路和ESTOP */

static crossCoreLinkStateStruct cclState;
__no_init static uint32_t cclBootCounterRetained;
__no_init static uint32_t cclBootCounterInverseRetained;

static uint32_t cclNextBootSession(void)
{
    uint32_t value = cclBootCounterRetained;
    if ((value == 0u) || (cclBootCounterInverseRetained != ~value)) value = 0u;
    value++;
    if (value == 0u) value = 1u;
    cclBootCounterRetained = value;
    cclBootCounterInverseRetained = ~value;
    return value;
}

static uint8_t cclWireSeqAdvanced(uint8_t sequence, uint8_t previous)
{
    uint8_t delta = (uint8_t) (sequence - previous);
    return (uint8_t) ((delta != 0u) && (delta < 128u));
}

static uint8_t cclCore0StatusSemanticValid(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint8_t launched;
    uint8_t altReached;
    uint8_t mode;
    uint8_t rgb;
    if (frame == 0) return 0u;
    if (!((frame->safetyState <= 2u) || (frame->safetyState == 0xFEu) ||
            (frame->safetyState == 0xFFu))) return 0u;
    if (frame->armProgress > 100u) return 0u;
    if ((frame->statusFlags & (uint8_t) ~0x1Fu) != 0u) return 0u;
    if (frame->buzzer > UART_LINK_BUZZER_THREE_BEEPS) return 0u;
    mode = (uint8_t) (frame->sysCtrl & UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_MASK);
    rgb = (uint8_t) ((frame->sysCtrl >> UART_LINK_SYS_RGB_SHIFT) & UART_LINK_SYS_RGB_MASK);
    if ((mode > UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_LORA_FWD) || (rgb > UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN)) return 0u;
    launched = (frame->statusFlags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED) ? 1u : 0u;
    altReached = (frame->sysCtrl & UART_LINK_SYS_ALT_REACHED) ? 1u : 0u;
    if (launched != (uint8_t) (frame->safetyState == 1u)) return 0u;
    if ((altReached != 0u) && (launched == 0u)) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t cclCore0StatusIsSafeRearm(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((frame != 0) &&
                      (frame->safetyState != 1u) &&
                      ((frame->statusFlags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED) == 0u) &&
                      ((frame->sysCtrl & UART_LINK_SYS_ALT_REACHED) == 0u));
}

static void cclInvalidateCore0Status(uint8_t requireSafeRearm)
{
    keyEventToMenuStruct ev;
    cclState.core0StatusValid = 0u;
    cclState.core0StatusFlags = 0u;
    cclState.core0SysCtrl = 0u;
    cclState.core0Buzzer = 0u;
    cclState.core0SafetyState = CCL_CORE0_SAFETY_UNKNOWN;
    if (requireSafeRearm != 0u) cclState.core0StatusRearmRequired = 1u;
    coreDataReadKeyEvent(&ev);
    if (ev.ready == CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC)
    {
        ev.core0SafetyState = CCL_CORE0_SAFETY_UNKNOWN;
        ev.core0ArmProgress = 0u;
        ev.core0StatusFlags = 0u;
        ev.core0StatusValid = 0u;
        ev.core0SystemMode = 0u;
        ev.core0RgbIntent = 0u;
        ev.core0AltReached = 0u;
        coreDataWriteKeyEvent(&ev);
    }
}

static uint8_t cclNextIndex(uint8_t index)
{
    index++;
    if (index >= CCL_RX_QUEUE_SIZE) index = 0u;
    return index;
}

/* ISR 上下文: 解析一字节, 成帧则入队(丢弃溢出)。仅轻量, 不做 DCache/共享内存。 */
static void cclHandleByte(uint8_t data)
{
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    uartLinkProtoStatusEnum status = uartLinkProtoInputByte(&cclState.parser, data, &frame);

    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_FRAME_READY != status)
    {
        if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_CHECK_ERROR == status || UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_TAIL_ERROR == status || UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_TYPE_ERROR == status)
        {
            cclState.rxErrorCount++;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST == frame.type)
    {
        cclState.paramGlobalRequest = frame.paramGlobalRequest;
        cclState.paramGlobalRequestPending = 1u;
        return;
    }
    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE == frame.type)
    {
        cclState.rxErrorCount++;
        return;
    }

    /* 收到任意控制域合法帧才视为 core0 在线；参数域不为控制链续鲜。 */
    cclState.lastRxTickMs = cclState.tickMs;
    cclState.linkPrimed = 1u;

    /* 心跳帧 value 携带 core0 操控态(1=远程模式正操控 core1)。心跳不入队列,
     * 仅更新 controlActive(ISR 内单字节写, 原子); 队列放需前台处理的状态/位姿/KVM帧。 */
    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_HEARTBEAT == frame.type)
    {
        cclState.core0ControlActive = (frame.value != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
        return;
    }

    if (cclState.rxCount >= CCL_RX_QUEUE_SIZE)
    {
        /* 队列满: 丢最旧, 保最新(按键事件最新优先)。
         * 本函数在 UART ISR 上下文; rxCount-- 与下方 ++ 净零, 同核无同级中断抢占
         * (PIT ISR 不碰本队列), 故无需原子化。 */
        cclState.rxHead = cclNextIndex(cclState.rxHead);
        cclState.rxCount--;
    }
    cclState.rxQueue[cclState.rxTail] = frame;
    cclState.rxTail = cclNextIndex(cclState.rxTail);
    cclState.rxCount++;
    cclState.rxFrameCount++;
}

static uint8_t cclPopFrame(uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint8_t got = 0u;
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 0u);
    if (cclState.rxCount > 0u)
    {
        *frame = cclState.rxQueue[cclState.rxHead];
        cclState.rxHead = cclNextIndex(cclState.rxHead);
        cclState.rxCount--;
        got = 1u;
    }
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 1u);
    return got;
}

static void cclEncodeWriteAdvance(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame,
    uint8_t *buffer, uint8_t frameLength, uint8_t *sequence)
{
    if (UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK == uartLinkProtoEncode(frame, buffer, frameLength))
    {
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, frameLength);
        (*sequence)++;
    }
}

static void cclSendHeartbeat(void)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_HEARTBEAT;
    frame.sequence = cclState.heartbeatSequence;
    frame.value = (uint8_t) (cclState.heartbeatSequence ^ 0xA5u);
    cclEncodeWriteAdvance(&frame, buffer, UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH,
        &cclState.heartbeatSequence);
}

static void cclSendParamGlobalState(void)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    if (cclState.paramGlobalStateValid == 0u) return;
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE;
    frame.sequence = cclState.paramGlobalTxSequence++;
    frame.paramGlobalState = cclState.paramGlobalState;
    if (uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) == UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK)
        uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
    cclState.lastParamGlobalStateTickMs = cclState.tickMs;
    cclState.paramGlobalStateDirty = 0u;
}

/* 发 STATUS 帧(14 字节)给 core0: 上报 core2断联(bit1)、模式2调试缓降请求(bit2)及通用必需
 * 视觉故障事实(bit3，Core0始终消费)。与心跳同周期(前台 200ms)，
 * 常发不受MOTION帧gotMotion门控影响；beaconCount与寻灯状态来自cm_7_1现有plan共享快照。 */
static void cclSendStatus(void)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_STATUS];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS;
    frame.sequence = cclState.statusSequence;
    frame.beaconCount = cclState.beaconCount;
    frame.linkFlags = UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_LINK_OK; /* core1 在发即认为核间链路在线 */
    frame.faultSource = cclState.faultSource;
    frame.faultClass = cclState.faultClass;
    frame.producerBootSession = cclState.producerBootSession;
    if (cclState.core2LinkLost)
    {
        frame.linkFlags |= UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_CORE2_LOST;
    }
    if (cclState.core2AttitudeFault)
    {
        frame.linkFlags |= UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_CORE2_ATTITUDE_FAULT;
    }
    if (cclState.mode2LoraLandReq)
    {
        frame.linkFlags |= UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ;
    }
    if (cclState.requiredVisionFault)
    {
        frame.linkFlags |= UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT;
    }
    if (cclState.beaconSearching)
        frame.linkFlags |= UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCHING;
    if (cclState.beaconSearchTimedOut)
        frame.linkFlags |= UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_SEARCH_TIMEOUT;
    if (cclState.beaconStateValid)
        frame.linkFlags |= UART_LINK_STATUS_FLAG_BEACON_VALID;
    cclEncodeWriteAdvance(&frame, buffer, UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_STATUS,
        &cclState.statusSequence);
    cclState.statusDirty = 0u;
}

static void cclSendKvmStatus(const core1KvmStatusStruct *status)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_STATUS];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    if ((status == 0) || (status->magic != CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC)) return;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_STATUS;
    frame.sequence = cclState.kvmStatusSequence;
    frame.kvmTargetSession = status->targetSession;
    frame.kvmRouteSession = status->routeSession;
    frame.kvmRouteEpoch = status->routeEpoch;
    frame.kvmEventSeq = status->ackEventSeq;
    frame.kvmTarget = status->target;
    frame.kvmActiveTarget = status->activeTarget;
    frame.kvmMenuStates = status->menuStates;
    frame.kvmFlags = status->flags;
    frame.kvmAckResult = status->ackResult;
    frame.kvmCore3AgeMs = status->core3AgeMs;
    cclEncodeWriteAdvance(&frame, buffer, UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_STATUS,
        &cclState.kvmStatusSequence);
    cclState.lastSentKvmStatus = *status;
    cclState.lastSentKvmStatusValid = 1u;
}

static uint8_t cclKvmStatusSemanticChanged(const core1KvmStatusStruct *status)
{
    const core1KvmStatusStruct *last = &cclState.lastSentKvmStatus;
    if ((status == 0) || (status->magic != CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC)) return 0u;
    if (cclState.lastSentKvmStatusValid == 0u) return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) ((status->targetSession != last->targetSession) ||
                      (status->routeSession != last->routeSession) ||
                      (status->routeEpoch != last->routeEpoch) ||
                      (status->ackEventSeq != last->ackEventSeq) ||
                      (status->target != last->target) ||
                      (status->activeTarget != last->activeTarget) ||
                      (status->menuStates != last->menuStates) ||
                      (status->flags != last->flags) ||
                      (status->ackResult != last->ackResult));
}

static void cclHandleKvmIngress(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    core1KvmIngressStruct ingress;
    coreDataReadKvmIngress(&ingress);
    if (ingress.magic != CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC)
    {
        memset(&ingress, 0, sizeof(ingress));
        ingress.magic = CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    }
    if ((ingress.routeSession != frame->kvmRouteSession) ||
        (ingress.routeEpoch != frame->kvmRouteEpoch) ||
        (ingress.target != frame->kvmTarget))
    {
        ingress.flags = 0u;
        ingress.eventSeq = 0u;
        cclState.kvmIngressBatchFlags = 0u;
    }
    if (frame->type == UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL)
    {
        ingress.targetSession = frame->kvmTargetSession;
        ingress.routeSession = frame->kvmRouteSession;
        ingress.routeEpoch = frame->kvmRouteEpoch;
        ingress.leaseMs = frame->kvmLeaseMs;
        ingress.target = frame->kvmTarget;
        cclState.kvmIngressBatchFlags |= CORE1_KVM_INGRESS_CONTROL_VALID;
    }
    else
    {
        ingress.targetSession = frame->kvmTargetSession;
        ingress.routeSession = frame->kvmRouteSession;
        ingress.routeEpoch = frame->kvmRouteEpoch;
        ingress.eventSeq = frame->kvmEventSeq;
        ingress.target = frame->kvmTarget;
        ingress.keyId = frame->kvmKeyId;
        ingress.keyState = frame->kvmKeyState;
        cclState.kvmIngressBatchFlags |= (CORE1_KVM_INGRESS_EVENT_VALID |
                                          CORE1_KVM_INGRESS_EVENT_EDGE);
    }
    ingress.flags = (uint8_t) ((ingress.flags & CORE1_KVM_INGRESS_EVENT_VALID) |
                               cclState.kvmIngressBatchFlags);
    ingress.updateSeq = ++cclState.kvmIngressSeq;
    coreDataWriteKvmIngress(&ingress);
}

/* 处理一帧: CORE0_STATUS更新 core0 飞控状态(供 RGB 灯)。
 * 均 RMW(读出共享区→改本帧相关字段→写回), cm_7_0 单写, 保留其他字段不被互相清零。 */
static void cclHandleFrame(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    keyEventToMenuStruct ev;
    uint8_t statusWasRearming = 0u;
    if (frame->type == UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE)
    {
        cclState.paramResponse = *frame;
        cclState.paramResponsePending = 1u;
        return;
    }
    if ((frame->type == UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL) ||
        (frame->type == UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT))
    {
        cclHandleKvmIngress(frame);
        return;
    }
    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        statusWasRearming = cclState.core0StatusRearmRequired;
        if (cclCore0StatusSemanticValid(frame) == 0u)
        {
            /* 语义非法帧撤销业务事实，后续只能由安全非发车帧重建序列基线。 */
            if ((cclState.core0StatusValid != 0u) ||
                (cclState.core0SafetyState != CCL_CORE0_SAFETY_UNKNOWN))
            {
                cclInvalidateCore0Status(1u);
            }
            else
            {
                cclState.core0StatusRearmRequired = 1u;
            }
            cclState.rxErrorCount++;
            return;
        }
        if (cclState.core0StatusRearmRequired != 0u)
        {
            /* 单消息静默超时但wire序列仍连续时，允许前进的新帧在飞行中恢复。
             * 只有重复/旧seq或对端重启回退时，才要求安全未发车帧重建基线。 */
            uint8_t forward = (uint8_t) ((cclState.core0StatusWirePrimed != 0u) &&
                                         (cclWireSeqAdvanced(frame->sequence, cclState.core0StatusWireSeq) != 0u));
            if ((forward == 0u) && (cclCore0StatusIsSafeRearm(frame) == 0u)) return;
        }
        else if ((cclState.core0StatusWirePrimed != 0u) &&
                 (cclWireSeqAdvanced(frame->sequence, cclState.core0StatusWireSeq) == 0u))
        {
            return;
        }
    }
    coreDataReadKeyEvent(&ev);
    if (ev.ready != CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC)
    {
        /* 上电首帧前共享区可能未握手: 用零值起底 + 置 ready, 防 __no_init 垃圾。 */
        ev.linkUp = 1u;
        ev.controlActive = 0u;
        ev.core0SafetyState = 0u;
        ev.core0ArmProgress = 0u;
        ev.core0StatusFlags = 0u;
        ev.core0StatusValid = 0u;
        ev.core0SystemMode = 0u;
        ev.core0RgbIntent = 0u;
        ev.core2LinkLost = cclState.core2LinkLost;
        ev.core0AltReached = 0u;
        for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < sizeof(ev.padding); i++) ev.padding[i] = 0u;
        ev.ready = CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        ev.core0SafetyState = frame->safetyState;
        ev.core0ArmProgress = frame->armProgress;
        ev.core0StatusFlags = frame->statusFlags;
        ev.core0StatusValid = 1u;
        ev.core0SystemMode = (uint8_t) (frame->sysCtrl & UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_MASK);
        ev.core0RgbIntent = (uint8_t) ((frame->sysCtrl >> UART_LINK_SYS_RGB_SHIFT) & UART_LINK_SYS_RGB_MASK);
        ev.core0AltReached = ((frame->sysCtrl & UART_LINK_SYS_ALT_REACHED) != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
        ev.linkUp = 1u; /* 收到 core0 帧即在线 */
        coreDataWriteKeyEvent(&ev);
        /* 本地镜像供 cm_7_0 取: 发车态(LAUNCHED) / 系统模式 / 到顶 / 蜂鸣码 / 安全态 */
        cclState.core0StatusFlags = frame->statusFlags;
        cclState.core0SysCtrl = frame->sysCtrl;
        cclState.core0Buzzer = frame->buzzer;
        cclState.core0SafetyState = frame->safetyState;
        cclState.core0StatusValid = 1u; /* 收到有效 CORE0_STATUS: 地面态判据置有效(断链 Poll 会清回 0) */
        cclState.lastCore0StatusTickMs = cclState.tickMs;
        cclState.core0StatusWireSeq = frame->sequence;
        cclState.core0StatusWirePrimed = 1u;
        cclState.core0StatusRearmRequired = 0u;
        if (statusWasRearming != 0u)
            cclState.core0PeerRearmPending = 1u;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE == frame->type)
    {
        core0PoseToVisionStruct pose;
        coreDataReadCore0Pose(&pose);
        if (pose.magic != CORE1_C0POSE_READY_MAGIC)
        {
            pose.seq32 = 0u;
            pose.padding[0] = 0u;
            pose.padding[1] = 0u;
            pose.padding[2] = 0u;
        }
        cclState.poseSeq32++;
        pose.magic = CORE1_C0POSE_READY_MAGIC;
        pose.seq32 = cclState.poseSeq32;
        pose.poseEpoch = frame->poseEpoch;
        pose.confidenceQ8 = frame->poseConfidenceQ8;
        pose.flags = frame->poseFlags;
        pose.uartSeq = frame->sequence;
        pose.xQ8 = frame->poseXQ8;
        pose.yQ8 = frame->poseYQ8;
        pose.orientationRad = frame->poseOrientationRad;
        coreDataWriteCore0Pose(&pose);
    }
    /* 其他帧(心跳)在 cclHandleByte 已处理, 不入此函数 */
}

void crossCoreLinkInit(void)
{
    cclState.rxHead = 0u;
    cclState.rxTail = 0u;
    cclState.rxCount = 0u;
    cclState.tickMs = 0u;
    cclState.lastRxTickMs = 0u;
    cclState.lastHeartbeatTickMs = 0u;
    cclState.linkPrimed = 0u;
    cclState.heartbeatSequence = 0u;
    cclState.motionSequence = 0u;
    cclState.statusSequence = 0u;
    cclState.producerBootSession = cclNextBootSession();
    cclState.kvmStatusSequence = 0u;
    cclState.kvmIngressSeq = 0u;
    cclState.core2LinkLost = 0u; /* 上电默认未失联; core0Loop 每轮按 RS-485 存活刷新 */
    cclState.requiredVisionFault = 1u;
    cclState.faultSource = REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_CORE1;
    cclState.faultClass = REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_LINK;
    cclState.statusDirty = 1u;
    cclState.mode2LoraLandReq = 0u;
    cclState.beaconCount = 0u;
    cclState.beaconSearching = 0u;
    cclState.beaconSearchTimedOut = 0u;
    cclState.beaconStateValid = 0u;
    cclState.poseSeq32 = 0u;
    cclState.rxFrameCount = 0u;
    cclState.rxErrorCount = 0u;
    cclState.paramResponsePending = 0u;
    cclState.paramTxSequence = 0u;
    memset(&cclState.paramGlobalRequest, 0, sizeof(cclState.paramGlobalRequest));
    memset(&cclState.paramGlobalState, 0, sizeof(cclState.paramGlobalState));
    cclState.paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
    cclState.paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
    cclState.paramGlobalStateDirty = 0u;
    cclState.paramGlobalTxSequence = 0u;
    cclState.lastParamGlobalStateTickMs = 0u;
    cclState.core0ControlActive = 0u;
    cclState.core0StatusFlags = 0u;
    cclState.core0SysCtrl = 0u;
    cclState.core0Buzzer = 0u;
    cclState.core0SafetyState = CCL_CORE0_SAFETY_UNKNOWN; /* 未收 CORE0_STATUS 前非 DISARMED(fail-closed) */
    cclState.core0StatusValid = 0u;
    cclState.lastCore0StatusTickMs = 0u;
    cclState.core0StatusWirePrimed = 0u;
    cclState.core0StatusWireSeq = 0u;
    cclState.core0StatusRearmRequired = 1u;
    cclState.core0PeerRearmPending = 0u;
    uartLinkProtoInit(&cclState.parser);

    uart_init(CCL_UART_NUM, CCL_BAUDRATE, CCL_UART_TX_PIN, CCL_UART_RX_PIN);
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 1u);

    /* 上电先写一帧共享内存(linkUp=0)，让菜单核握手 ready 有效。 */
    {
        keyEventToMenuStruct ev;
        ev.linkUp = 0u;
        ev.controlActive = 0u;
        ev.ready = CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
        ev.core0SafetyState = 0u;
        ev.core0ArmProgress = 0u;
        ev.core0StatusFlags = 0u;
        ev.core0StatusValid = 0u;
        ev.core0SystemMode = 0u;
        ev.core0RgbIntent = 0u;
        ev.core2LinkLost = 0u;
        ev.core0AltReached = 0u;
        for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < sizeof(ev.padding); i++) ev.padding[i] = 0u;
        coreDataWriteKeyEvent(&ev);
    }

    {
        core0PoseToVisionStruct pose;
        pose.magic = CORE1_C0POSE_READY_MAGIC;
        pose.seq32 = 0u;
        pose.poseEpoch = 0u;
        pose.confidenceQ8 = 0u;
        pose.flags = 0u;
        pose.uartSeq = 0u;
        pose.xQ8 = 0u;
        pose.yQ8 = 0u;
        pose.orientationRad = 0.0f;
        pose.padding[0] = 0u;
        pose.padding[1] = 0u;
        pose.padding[2] = 0u;
        coreDataWriteCore0Pose(&pose);
    }

    {
        core1KvmIngressStruct ingress;
        memset(&ingress, 0, sizeof(ingress));
        ingress.magic = CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC;
        coreDataWriteKvmIngress(&ingress);
    }

    cclState.initReadyFlag = 1u;
}

void crossCoreLinkPit1ms(void)
{
    if (!cclState.initReadyFlag) return;

    cclState.tickMs++;
}

void crossCoreLinkPoll(void)
{
    core1KvmStatusStruct kvmStatus;
    uint8_t kvmStatusValid;
    uint8_t kvmStatusSent = 0u;
    if (!cclState.initReadyFlag) return;

    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    uint8_t linkAlive = crossCoreLinkIsCore0Alive();

    /* EVENT保持到cm7_1按事件身份消费；CONTROL仍只代表本次Poll的新租约事实。 */
    cclState.kvmIngressBatchFlags = 0u;
    while (cclPopFrame(&frame))
    {
        cclHandleFrame(&frame);
    }
    linkAlive = crossCoreLinkIsCore0Alive();

    /* fail-closed: core0 断链即作废 CORE0_STATUS 派生态。
     * 重连后 core0StatusValid 保持 0，直到新 CORE0_STATUS 帧到达才重新置 1，
     * 杜绝"刚重连未收状态帧却沿用断链前发车/模式/蜂鸣/安全态"。 */
    if ((!crossCoreLinkIsCore0Alive() ||
            ((cclState.core0StatusValid != 0u) &&
                ((uint32_t) (cclState.tickMs - cclState.lastCore0StatusTickMs) >= CCL_CORE0_STATUS_LOST_MS))) &&
        ((cclState.core0StatusValid != 0u) ||
            (cclState.core0SafetyState != CCL_CORE0_SAFETY_UNKNOWN)))
    {
        cclInvalidateCore0Status(1u);
    }

    /* 链路存活态/操控态变化时刷新共享内存(linkUp + controlActive), 让菜单核及时感知。
     * 断联时 controlActive 强制为 0；共享区 cm_7_0 单写/cm_7_1 单读。 */
    {
        uint8_t ctrl = (linkAlive && cclState.core0ControlActive) ? 1u : 0u;
        keyEventToMenuStruct ev;
        coreDataReadKeyEvent(&ev);
        if (ev.ready == CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC && (ev.linkUp != linkAlive || ev.controlActive != ctrl ||
                                                      ev.core2LinkLost != cclState.core2LinkLost))
        {
            ev.linkUp = linkAlive;
            ev.controlActive = ctrl;
            ev.core2LinkLost = cclState.core2LinkLost;
            coreDataWriteKeyEvent(&ev);
        }
    }

    kvmStatusValid = coreDataTryReadKvmStatus(&kvmStatus);
    if ((kvmStatusValid != 0u) && (cclKvmStatusSemanticChanged(&kvmStatus) != 0u))
    {
        cclSendKvmStatus(&kvmStatus);
        kvmStatusSent = 1u;
    }

    if (cclState.statusDirty != 0u) cclSendStatus();
    if ((uint32_t) (cclState.tickMs - cclState.lastHeartbeatTickMs) >= CCL_HEARTBEAT_MS)
    {
        cclState.lastHeartbeatTickMs = cclState.tickMs;
        cclSendHeartbeat();
        cclSendStatus(); /* 与心跳同周期上报 core2 断联位给 core0(常发, 不受 MOTION 门控) */
        if ((kvmStatusValid != 0u) && (kvmStatusSent == 0u))
        {
            cclSendKvmStatus(&kvmStatus);
        }
    }
    if ((cclState.paramGlobalStateValid != 0u) &&
        ((cclState.paramGlobalStateDirty != 0u) ||
         ((uint32_t) (cclState.tickMs - cclState.lastParamGlobalStateTickMs) >=
             CCL_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_TX_MS)))
        cclSendParamGlobalState();
}

void crossCoreLinkRxIrqHandler(void)
{
    uint8_t data;
    if (uart_query_byte(CCL_UART_NUM, &data))
    {
        cclHandleByte(data);
    }
}

uint8_t crossCoreLinkSendParamRequest(const uartLinkFrameStruct *request)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_STATUS];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    if (request == NULL || request->paramLength > UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES)
        return 0u;
    frame = *request;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_REQUEST;
    frame.sequence = cclState.paramTxSequence++;
    if (uartLinkProtoEncode(&frame, buffer, sizeof(buffer)) != UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK)
        return 0u;
    uart_write_buffer(CCL_UART_NUM, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t crossCoreLinkTakeParamResponse(uartLinkFrameStruct *response)
{
    if (response == NULL || !cclState.paramResponsePending) return 0u;
    *response = cclState.paramResponse;
    cclState.paramResponsePending = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

void crossCoreLinkPublishParamGlobalState(const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    if ((state == 0) || (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(state) == 0u)) return;
    cclState.paramGlobalState = *state;
    cclState.paramGlobalStateValid = 1u;
    cclState.paramGlobalStateDirty = 1u;
}

uint8_t crossCoreLinkTakeParamGlobalRequest(paramSyncGlobalRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t valid = 0u;
    if (request == 0) return 0u;
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 0u);
    if (cclState.paramGlobalRequestPending == 0u)
    {
        uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 1u);
        return 0u;
    }
    if (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&cclState.paramGlobalRequest) == 0u)
    {
        cclState.paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        *request = cclState.paramGlobalRequest;
        cclState.paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
        valid = 1u;
    }
    uart_rx_interrupt(CCL_UART_NUM, 1u);
    return valid;
}

void crossCoreLinkSendMotion(float vx, float vy, float wz, uint8_t remoteTakeoffReq)
{
    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_MOTION];
    uartLinkFrameStruct frame;
    if (!cclState.initReadyFlag) return;
    frame.type = UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION;
    frame.sequence = cclState.motionSequence;
    frame.motionVx = vx;
    frame.motionVy = vy;
    frame.motionWz = wz;
    /* flags bit0=remoteTakeoffReq：模式3 车 LoRa S3+S4 请求中转给 core0，由 core0 按阶段解释。 */
    frame.motionFlags = remoteTakeoffReq ? UART_LINK_MOTION_FLAG_TAKEOFF_REQ : 0u;
    frame.producerBootSession = cclState.producerBootSession;
    cclEncodeWriteAdvance(&frame, buffer, UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_MOTION,
        &cclState.motionSequence);
}

static uint8_t crossCoreLinkIsCore0Alive(void)
{
    return (cclState.linkPrimed &&
               (uint32_t) (cclState.tickMs - cclState.lastRxTickMs) < CCL_LINK_LOST_MS)
               ? 1u
               : 0u;
}

/* 设置模式2 LoRa 双肩键缓降请求位。该位与 MOTION flags bit0 解耦：
 * 模式2只经 STATUS bit2 转发给 core0 进入缓降，绝不触发起飞时序。 */
static void crossCoreLinkSetMode2LoraLandReq(uint8_t req)
{
    cclState.mode2LoraLandReq = req ? 1u : 0u;
}

/* 设置 RS-485↔core2 断联位(core0Loop 前台每轮按 core1Core2Alive() 调)。
 * cclSendStatus 与心跳同周期(200ms)把此位经 STATUS 帧 linkFlags bit1 上报 core0 供缓降聚合。 */
static void crossCoreLinkSetCore2LinkLost(uint8_t lost)
{
    uint8_t val = lost ? 1u : 0u;
    if (cclState.core2LinkLost != val)
    {
        keyEventToMenuStruct ev;
        cclState.core2LinkLost = val;
        coreDataReadKeyEvent(&ev);
        if (ev.ready == CORE1_DATA_READY_MAGIC)
        {
            ev.core2LinkLost = val;
            coreDataWriteKeyEvent(&ev);
        }
    }
}

/* 设置通用必需视觉故障事实。调用方合并物理链路、协议、相机、配置、标定与plan ready/新鲜度门；
 * 本owner只缓存并随固定14B STATUS bit3发送，Core0始终解释。 */
void crossCoreLinkGetStatus(crossCoreLinkStatusStruct *out)
{
    uint32_t now;
    uint32_t lastRx;
    uint8_t alive;
    uint8_t statusValid;
    uint8_t sysCtrl;
    if (out == NULL) return;

    /* 单次捕获存活时基与状态字，避免恰逢600ms边沿时由多个碎 getter
     * 拼出跨时刻组合。状态字段只由本前台 Poll 提交，tick/lastRx 为32位原子读。 */
    now = cclState.tickMs;
    lastRx = cclState.lastRxTickMs;
    alive = (uint8_t) ((cclState.linkPrimed != 0u) &&
                       ((uint32_t) (now - lastRx) < CCL_LINK_LOST_MS));
    statusValid = (uint8_t) ((alive != 0u) &&
                             (cclState.core0StatusValid != 0u) &&
                             ((uint32_t) (now - cclState.lastCore0StatusTickMs) < CCL_CORE0_STATUS_LOST_MS));
    sysCtrl = cclState.core0SysCtrl;

    out->core0Alive = alive;
    out->core0StatusValid = statusValid;
    out->core0SafetyState = (statusValid != 0u) ? cclState.core0SafetyState : CCL_CORE0_SAFETY_UNKNOWN;
    out->core0Launched = (uint8_t) ((statusValid != 0u) &&
                                    ((cclState.core0StatusFlags & UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED) != 0u));
    out->systemMode = (statusValid != 0u) ? (uint8_t) (sysCtrl & UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_MASK) : 0u;
    out->rgbIntent = (statusValid != 0u) ? (uint8_t) ((sysCtrl >> UART_LINK_SYS_RGB_SHIFT) & UART_LINK_SYS_RGB_MASK) : 0u;
    out->altReached = (uint8_t) ((statusValid != 0u) &&
                                 ((sysCtrl & UART_LINK_SYS_ALT_REACHED) != 0u));
    out->buzzer = (statusValid != 0u) ? cclState.core0Buzzer : 0u;
}

uint8_t crossCoreLinkTakeCore0PeerRearm(void)
{
    uint8_t pending = cclState.core0PeerRearmPending;
    cclState.core0PeerRearmPending = 0u;
    return pending;
}

void crossCoreLinkPublishLocalFacts(const crossCoreLinkLocalFactsStruct *facts)
{
    uint8_t active;
    uint8_t source;
    uint8_t faultClass;
    if (facts == NULL) return;
    crossCoreLinkSetCore2LinkLost(facts->core2LinkLost);
    active = facts->core2AttitudeFault ? 1u : 0u;
    if (cclState.core2AttitudeFault != active)
    {
        cclState.core2AttitudeFault = active;
        cclState.statusDirty = 1u;
    }
    active = facts->requiredVisionFault ? 1u : 0u;
    source = active ? facts->faultSource : REQUIRED_VISION_SOURCE_NONE;
    faultClass = active ? facts->faultClass : REQUIRED_VISION_FAULT_NONE;
    if ((cclState.requiredVisionFault != active) ||
        (cclState.faultSource != source) ||
        (cclState.faultClass != faultClass))
    {
        cclState.requiredVisionFault = active;
        cclState.faultSource = source;
        cclState.faultClass = faultClass;
        cclState.statusDirty = 1u;
    }
    crossCoreLinkSetMode2LoraLandReq(facts->mode2LoraLandReq);
    cclState.beaconCount = facts->beaconCount;
    cclState.beaconSearching = facts->beaconSearching ? 1u : 0u;
    cclState.beaconSearchTimedOut = facts->beaconSearchTimedOut ? 1u : 0u;
    cclState.beaconStateValid = facts->beaconStateValid ? 1u : 0u;
}

#ifndef _CROSS_CORE_LINK_H_
#define _CROSS_CORE_LINK_H_

#include <stdint.h>
#include "uartLinkProto.h"

/*
 * crossCoreLink (core1 cm_7_0 端) - 核间单线双向链路
 *
 * 物理: UART_1 / P04 (group0) ↔ core0 P10 / UART_2，4 Mbps，全双工单线双向。
 *   - RX: 收core0状态、位姿与事务KVM帧；合法帧刷新core0存活计时。
 *   - TX: 周期发 HEARTBEAT 帧(前台, 200ms) 给 core0 作存活信标。
 *
 * 替代原 uartLinkTest 的 RESPONDER 角色(已移除)。
 * RX 在 ISR 仅取字节喂解析器(轻量); 写共享内存(含 DCache)/发送均在前台 Poll, 绝不进 ISR。
 *
 * 链路状态由 crossCoreLinkGetStatus() 一次返回同拍快照，供调用方作断联保护(>600ms 无帧→断联)。
 */

void crossCoreLinkInit(void);         /* 配 UART_1 + 开 RX 中断 + 复位状态 */
void crossCoreLinkPit1ms(void);       /* 1ms tick: 心跳分频 + core0 存活超时计数(ISR 安全) */
void crossCoreLinkPoll(void);         /* 前台: 排空 RX 队列→写共享内存; 发心跳 */
void crossCoreLinkRxIrqHandler(void); /* UART_1 RX 中断: 仅取一字节喂解析器 */

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t core0Alive;
    uint8_t core0StatusValid;
    uint8_t core0SafetyState;
    uint8_t core0Launched;
    uint8_t systemMode;
    uint8_t rgbIntent;
    uint8_t altReached;
    uint8_t buzzer;
} crossCoreLinkStatusStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t core2LinkLost;
    uint8_t core2AttitudeFault;
    uint8_t requiredVisionFault;
    uint8_t faultSource;
    uint8_t faultClass;
    uint8_t mode2LoraLandReq;
    uint16_t beaconCount;
    uint8_t beaconSearching;
    uint8_t beaconSearchTimedOut;
    uint8_t beaconStateValid;
} crossCoreLinkLocalFactsStruct;

void crossCoreLinkGetStatus(crossCoreLinkStatusStruct *out);
/* CORE0_STATUS在初始化/超时/序号回退后重新建立时返回一次1；调用方据此撤销
 * MOTION发送priming，使下一次非零请求先发送显式零fence。 */
uint8_t crossCoreLinkTakeCore0PeerRearm(void);
void crossCoreLinkPublishLocalFacts(const crossCoreLinkLocalFactsStruct *facts);
uint8_t crossCoreLinkSendParamRequest(const uartLinkFrameStruct *request);
uint8_t crossCoreLinkTakeParamResponse(uartLinkFrameStruct *response);
void crossCoreLinkPublishParamGlobalState(const paramSyncGlobalState *state);
uint8_t crossCoreLinkTakeParamGlobalRequest(paramSyncGlobalRequest *request);

/* core0 飞控安全态字节(经 CORE0_STATUS 帧透传, 与 core0 pidFlightController.h safetyStateEnum 同值):
 *   0=DISARMED, 1=CLOSED_LOOP, 2=PROTECTED, 0xFE=ARMING, 0xFF=IMUFAIL。
 * UNKNOWN=0xFD(与任一真实值不同且≠DISARMED)，表示"尚未收到有效 CORE0_STATUS 或 core0 已断链"。 */
#define CCL_CORE0_SAFETY_DISARMED (0x00u)
#define CCL_CORE0_SAFETY_UNKNOWN  (0xFDu)

/* fail-closed 地面态判据(供 cm_7_0 断链信标视觉调试 gate):
 *   IsCore0StatusValid() = 已收到过 CORE0_STATUS 且 core0 链路在线(断链即失效; 重连未收新帧前不为真)。
 *   GetCore0SafetyState() = 最近 CORE0_STATUS 的 safetyState 字节; status invalid 时返回 UNKNOWN(≠DISARMED)，

/* 1=core0 飞控已发车(最近 CORE0_STATUS 的 LAUNCHED 位)。供 cm_7_0 中转为 RS-485 cmd LAUNCH 给 core2。
 * CORE0_STATUS invalid(断链/刚重连未收新状态帧)时返回 0，fail-closed 判未发车。 */

 * CORE0_STATUS invalid 时均返回 0(未设/不蜂鸣/未到顶)，避免复用断链前镜像。 */
/* 前台发送 MOTION 帧给 core0: vx/vy/wz(float 透传, 来自 core2 RS-485 LoRa 遥控值, 供无人机前馈)
 * + remoteTakeoffReq(模式3 车 LoRa S3+S4 请求, core0 按 TKO 阶段解释为起飞或缓降)。 */
void crossCoreLinkSendMotion(float vx, float vy, float wz, uint8_t remoteTakeoffReq);

static uint32_t nextRevision(uint32_t revision)
{
    return (revision == UINT32_MAX) ? 1u : (revision + 1u);
}

static uint32_t refreshCore3Identity(const visionParamsStruct *params,
    uint32_t hash)
{
    if (g_core3Identity.initialized == 0u)
    {
        g_core3Identity.revision = ((params->sharedConfigRevision != 0u) &&
            (params->sharedConfigHash == hash)) ?
            params->sharedConfigRevision : nextRevision(params->sharedConfigRevision);
        g_core3Identity.initialized = 1u;
    }
    else if (g_core3Identity.hash != hash)
    {
        g_core3Identity.revision = nextRevision(g_core3Identity.revision);
    }
    g_core3Identity.hash = hash;
    if ((params->sharedConfigRevision != g_core3Identity.revision) ||
        (params->sharedConfigHash != hash))
    {
        (void) visionParamsUpdateSharedIdentity(g_core3Identity.revision, hash);
    }
    return g_core3Identity.revision;
}

static uint32_t refreshCore4Identity(uint32_t session, uint32_t hash)
{
    if (session == 0u) return 0u;
    if ((g_core4Identity.initialized == 0u) ||
        (g_core4Identity.session != session))
    {
        /* Core4没有Flash身份槽；每个独立endpoint session建立自己的运行时seed。 */
        g_core4Identity.revision = session;
        g_core4Identity.session = session;
        g_core4Identity.initialized = 1u;
    }
    else if (g_core4Identity.hash != hash)
    {
        g_core4Identity.revision = nextRevision(g_core4Identity.revision);
    }
    g_core4Identity.hash = hash;
    return g_core4Identity.revision;
}

uint8_t observerLinkConfigCore1Provide(void *providerContext,
    uint8_t sourceId,
    observerLinkSharedConfig *config)
{
    visionParamsStruct params;
    observerLinkSharedConfig desired;
    uint32_t revision;
    uint32_t hash;
    (void) providerContext;
    if ((config == NULL) ||
        ((sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
         (sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4))) return 0u;
    visionParamsGetActive(&params);
    buildConfig(&params, sourceId, &desired);
    hash = observerLinkSharedConfigHash(&desired);
    if (sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3)
    {
        revision = refreshCore3Identity(&params, hash);
    }
    else
    {
        core4LinkCore1Status status;
        core4LinkCore1GetStatus(&status);
        revision = refreshCore4Identity(status.localSession, hash);
    }
    if (revision == 0u) return 0u;
    *config = desired;
    config->revision = revision;
    config->hash = hash;
    return observerLinkSharedConfigIsValid(config);
}

static uint8_t descriptorIsValid(
    const observerLinkCore1EndpointDescriptor *descriptor)
{
    if ((descriptor == NULL) || (descriptor->configProvider == NULL) ||
        ((descriptor->expectedRole != OBSERVER_LINK_ROLE_CORE3) &&
            (descriptor->expectedRole != OBSERVER_LINK_ROLE_CORE4)) ||
        ((descriptor->sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
            (descriptor->sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)) ||
        (descriptor->expectedRole != descriptor->sourceId) ||
        (descriptor->kvmTarget != descriptor->sourceId))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

#if defined(__ICCARM__)
__no_init uint32_t endpointBootCounterRetained;
__no_init uint32_t endpointBootCounterInverseRetained;
#else
static uint32_t endpointBootCounterRetained;
static uint32_t endpointBootCounterInverseRetained;
#endif
static uint32_t endpointBootGeneration;

static uint32_t getEndpointBootGeneration(void)
{
    if (endpointBootGeneration == 0u)
    {
        uint32_t value = endpointBootCounterRetained;
        if ((value == 0u) || (endpointBootCounterInverseRetained != ~value)) value = 0u;
        value++;
        if (value == 0u) value = 1u;
        endpointBootCounterRetained = value;
        endpointBootCounterInverseRetained = ~value;
        endpointBootGeneration = value;
    }
    return endpointBootGeneration;
}

static uint32_t makeBootSession(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    (void) tickMs;
    return getEndpointBootGeneration();
}

static uint8_t helloIdentifiesPeer(const endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    const observerLinkFrame *frame)
{
    uint8_t role;
    uint32_t capabilities;
    const uint32_t required = OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_BINARY_CC |
                              OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_LEGACY_CANNY |
                              OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_STAGING |
                              OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_APPLY |
                              OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS |
                              OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CAMERA_CONTROL |
                              OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONTROL_STATUS;
    return (uint8_t) ((frame->major == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR) &&
                      (frame->minor == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                      (observerLinkDecodeHello(frame->payload, frame->payloadLength,
                           &role, &capabilities) != 0u) &&
                      (role == endpoint->descriptor.expectedRole) &&
                      ((capabilities & required) == required));
}
