static uint8_t syncConfig(endpointPrivate *endpoint)
{
    observerLinkSharedConfig next;
    uint8_t identityChanged;

    memset(&next, 0, sizeof(next));
    if ((endpoint->descriptor.configProvider(
             endpoint->descriptor.configProviderContext,
             endpoint->descriptor.sourceId,
             &next) == 0u) ||
        (next.sourceId != endpoint->descriptor.sourceId) ||
        (next.revision == 0u) ||
        (next.hash != observerLinkSharedConfigHash(&next)) ||
        (observerLinkSharedConfigIsValid(&next) == 0u))
    {
        invalidateConfig(endpoint);
        return 0u;
    }

    identityChanged = (uint8_t) ((endpoint->status.configProviderValid == 0u) ||
                                 (next.revision != endpoint->desired.revision) ||
                                 (next.hash != endpoint->desired.hash) ||
                                 (next.detectMode != endpoint->desired.detectMode) ||
                                 (next.sourceId != endpoint->desired.sourceId));
    endpoint->desired = next;
    endpoint->status.configProviderValid = 1u;
    endpoint->status.desiredRevision = next.revision;
    endpoint->status.desiredHash = next.hash;
    endpoint->status.desiredMode = next.detectMode;
    if (identityChanged != 0u)
    {
        endpoint->status.configCompatible = 0u;
        endpoint->status.configAckStatus = OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_NONE;
        endpoint->status.configAckReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_NONE;
        endpoint->status.configAckDesiredMode = 0xFFu;
        endpoint->status.configAckRevision = 0u;
        endpoint->status.configAckHash = 0u;
        endpoint->status.configAckTickMs = 0u;
        clearPlanningState(endpoint);
    }
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sendMessageBudgeted(endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    uint8_t type,
    const uint8_t *payload,
    uint16_t payloadLength,
    uint32_t tickMs,
    uint8_t controlLane)
{
    observerLinkFrame frame;
    uint8_t wire[OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_FRAME_BYTES];
    uint16_t wireLength;
    uint8_t *credits = (controlLane != 0u) ? &endpoint->txControlCredits : &endpoint->txDataCredits;

    if ((payloadLength > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) ||
        ((payloadLength != 0u) && (payload == NULL)) || (*credits == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.major = OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR;
    frame.minor = OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR;
    frame.type = type;
    frame.payloadLength = payloadLength;
    frame.bootSession = endpoint->status.localSession;
    endpoint->packetSeq++;
    if (endpoint->packetSeq == 0u) endpoint->packetSeq = 1u;
    frame.packetSeq = endpoint->packetSeq;
    frame.tickMs = tickMs;
    if (payloadLength != 0u)
    {
        memcpy(frame.payload, payload, payloadLength);
    }
    wireLength = observerLinkEncodeFrame(&frame, wire, (uint16_t) sizeof(wire));
    if (wireLength == 0u)
    {
        endpoint->status.txFailures++;
        return 0u;
    }
    uart_write_buffer(ENDPOINT_UART(endpoint->descriptor.uart), wire, wireLength);
    (*credits)--;
    endpoint->status.txFrames++;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sendMessage(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint8_t type,
    const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    return sendMessageBudgeted(endpoint, type, payload, length, tickMs, 0u);
}

static uint8_t sendControlMessage(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint8_t type,
    const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    return sendMessageBudgeted(endpoint, type, payload, length, tickMs, 1u);
}

static void handleHello(endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    const observerLinkFrame *frame)
{
    uint8_t role;
    uint32_t capabilities;
    uint32_t requiredAlgorithms = OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_BINARY_CC |
                                  OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_LEGACY_CANNY |
                                  OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_APPLY;
    uint32_t configRelevantCapabilities = requiredAlgorithms |
                                          OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_STAGING |
                                          OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS |
                                          OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CAMERA_CONTROL |
                                          OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONTROL_STATUS;
    uint8_t protocolCompatible;
    uint8_t planningCompatible;
    uint8_t algorithmsReady;

    if ((observerLinkDecodeHello(frame->payload, frame->payloadLength,
             &role, &capabilities) == 0u) ||
        (role != endpoint->descriptor.expectedRole))
    {
        clearPeerState(endpoint);
        return;
    }
    protocolCompatible = (uint8_t) ((frame->minor == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                                    (frame->payload[2] == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                                    ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_STAGING) != 0u));
    algorithmsReady = (uint8_t) ((capabilities & requiredAlgorithms) == requiredAlgorithms);
    planningCompatible = (uint8_t) ((protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
                                    ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS) != 0u) &&
                                    ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CAMERA_CONTROL) != 0u) &&
                                    ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONTROL_STATUS) != 0u));
    if ((((capabilities ^ endpoint->status.peerCapabilities) &
             configRelevantCapabilities) != 0u) ||
        (protocolCompatible == 0u) || (algorithmsReady == 0u))
    {
        endpoint->status.configCompatible = 0u;
    }
    endpoint->status.peerCapabilities = capabilities;
    endpoint->status.protocolCompatible = protocolCompatible;
    endpoint->status.planningCompatible = planningCompatible;
    endpoint->status.algorithmsReady = algorithmsReady;
    if (planningCompatible == 0u) clearPlanningState(endpoint);
    if (kvmEligible(endpoint) == 0u) clearKvmState(endpoint);
    if (paramSyncEligible(endpoint) == 0u) clearParamPeerState(endpoint);
}

static void handleAck(endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    const observerLinkFrame *frame,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    observerLinkConfigAck ack;

    if ((observerLinkDecodeConfigAck(frame->payload, frame->payloadLength,
             &ack) == 0u) ||
        (ack.ownerSession != endpoint->status.localSession))
    {
        return;
    }
    endpoint->status.configAckStatus = ack.status;
    endpoint->status.configAckReason = ack.reason;
    endpoint->status.configAckDesiredMode = ack.desiredMode;
    endpoint->status.configAckRevision = ack.revision;
    endpoint->status.configAckHash = ack.hash;
    endpoint->status.appliedMode = ack.appliedMode;
    endpoint->status.configAckTickMs = tickMs;
    endpoint->status.configCompatible = (uint8_t) ((endpoint->status.configProviderValid != 0u) &&
                                                   (endpoint->status.online != 0u) &&
                                                   (endpoint->status.protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
                                                   (endpoint->status.algorithmsReady != 0u) &&
                                                   (ack.status == OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED) &&
                                                   (ack.reason == OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_NONE) &&
                                                   (ack.revision == endpoint->desired.revision) &&
                                                   (ack.hash == endpoint->desired.hash) &&
                                                   (ack.desiredMode == endpoint->desired.detectMode) &&
                                                   (ack.appliedMode == endpoint->desired.detectMode));
    if (endpoint->status.configCompatible == 0u) clearPlanningState(endpoint);
}

static uint8_t planningFragmentMatches(endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackFragment *fragment)
{
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *build = &endpoint->planningBuild;
    return (uint8_t) ((build->valid != 0u) &&
                      (fragment->sourceId == build->sourceId) &&
                      (fragment->detectMode == build->detectMode) &&
                      (fragment->truncated == build->truncated) &&
                      (fragment->ownerSession == build->ownerSession) &&
                      (fragment->revision == build->revision) &&
                      (fragment->hash == build->hash) &&
                      (fragment->appFrameSeq == build->appFrameSeq) &&
                      (fragment->captureTickMs == build->captureTickMs) &&
                      (fragment->trackerFrameSeq == build->trackerFrameSeq) &&
                      (fragment->confirmedTotal == build->confirmedTotal) &&
                      (fragment->freshTotal == build->freshTotal) &&
                      (fragment->freshLeft == build->freshLeft) &&
                      (fragment->freshRight == build->freshRight) &&
                      (fragment->retainedCount == build->retainedCount));
}

static void startPlanningBuild(endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackFragment *fragment)
{
    observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *build = &endpoint->planningBuild;
    memset(build, 0, sizeof(*build));
    build->valid = 1u;
    build->sourceId = fragment->sourceId;
    build->detectMode = fragment->detectMode;
    build->truncated = fragment->truncated;
    build->ownerSession = fragment->ownerSession;
    build->revision = fragment->revision;
    build->hash = fragment->hash;
    build->appFrameSeq = fragment->appFrameSeq;
    build->captureTickMs = fragment->captureTickMs;
    build->trackerFrameSeq = fragment->trackerFrameSeq;
    build->confirmedTotal = fragment->confirmedTotal;
    build->freshTotal = fragment->freshTotal;
    build->freshLeft = fragment->freshLeft;
    build->freshRight = fragment->freshRight;
    build->retainedCount = fragment->retainedCount;
    endpoint->planningBuildMask = 0u;
    endpoint->planningExpectedMask =
        (uint8_t) ((1u << fragment->fragmentCount) - 1u);
}

static uint8_t planningBuildIsValid(const endpointPrivate *endpoint)
{
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *build = &endpoint->planningBuild;
    uint8_t ordinaryRetained = 0u;
    uint8_t i;
    for (i = 0u; i < build->retainedCount; i++)
    {
        uint8_t j;
        if ((build->tracks[i].flags &
                OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u)
            ordinaryRetained++;
        for (j = 0u; j < i; j++)
        {
            if (build->tracks[j].trackId == build->tracks[i].trackId)
                return 0u;
        }
    }
    return (uint8_t) ((ordinaryRetained <= endpoint->desired.maxBeacons) &&
                      (ordinaryRetained <= build->confirmedTotal));
}

static void handlePlanningFragment(endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    const observerLinkFrame *frame,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    observerLinkPlanningTrackFragment fragment;
    uint8_t bit;
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t j;

    if ((frame->minor != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) ||
        (endpoint->status.planningCompatible == 0u) ||
        (endpoint->status.configCompatible == 0u) ||
        ((endpoint->status.peerCapabilities &
             OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS) == 0u) ||
        (observerLinkDecodePlanningTrackFragment(frame->payload,
             frame->payloadLength, &fragment) == 0u) ||
        (fragment.sourceId != endpoint->descriptor.sourceId) ||
        (fragment.ownerSession != endpoint->status.localSession) ||
        (fragment.revision != endpoint->desired.revision) ||
        (fragment.hash != endpoint->desired.hash) ||
        (fragment.detectMode != endpoint->desired.detectMode))
    {
        endpoint->status.planningReassemblyDrops++;
        return;
    }
    if ((endpoint->planningPublishedValid != 0u) &&
        (observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(fragment.trackerFrameSeq,
             endpoint->planningPublished.trackerFrameSeq) == 0u)) return;
    if (endpoint->planningBuild.valid == 0u)
    {
        startPlanningBuild(endpoint, &fragment);
    }
    else if (observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(fragment.trackerFrameSeq,
                 endpoint->planningBuild.trackerFrameSeq) != 0u)
    {
        startPlanningBuild(endpoint, &fragment);
    }
    else if (fragment.trackerFrameSeq !=
             endpoint->planningBuild.trackerFrameSeq)
    {
        return;
    }
    else if (planningFragmentMatches(endpoint, &fragment) == 0u)
    {
        endpoint->status.planningReassemblyDrops++;
        memset(&endpoint->planningBuild, 0, sizeof(endpoint->planningBuild));
        endpoint->planningBuildMask = 0u;
        return;
    }
    bit = (uint8_t) (1u << fragment.fragmentIndex);
    if ((endpoint->planningBuildMask & bit) != 0u)
    {
        for (i = 0u; i < fragment.trackCount; i++)
        {
            if (memcmp(
                    &endpoint->planningBuild.tracks[fragment.firstTrack + i],
                    &fragment.tracks[i], sizeof(fragment.tracks[i])) != 0)
            {
                endpoint->status.planningReassemblyDrops++;
                memset(&endpoint->planningBuild, 0,
                    sizeof(endpoint->planningBuild));
                endpoint->planningBuildMask = 0u;
                return;
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < fragment.trackCount; i++)
    {
        for (j = 0u; j < endpoint->planningBuild.retainedCount; j++)
        {
            uint8_t ownerFragment = (uint8_t) (j / OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT);
            if (((endpoint->planningBuildMask &
                     (uint8_t) (1u << ownerFragment)) != 0u) &&
                (endpoint->planningBuild.tracks[j].trackId ==
                    fragment.tracks[i].trackId))
            {
                endpoint->status.planningReassemblyDrops++;
                memset(&endpoint->planningBuild, 0,
                    sizeof(endpoint->planningBuild));
                endpoint->planningBuildMask = 0u;
                return;
            }
        }
        endpoint->planningBuild.tracks[fragment.firstTrack + i] =
            fragment.tracks[i];
    }
    endpoint->planningBuildMask |= bit;
    if (endpoint->planningBuildMask == endpoint->planningExpectedMask)
    {
        if (planningBuildIsValid(endpoint) == 0u)
        {
            endpoint->status.planningReassemblyDrops++;
            memset(&endpoint->planningBuild, 0,
                sizeof(endpoint->planningBuild));
            endpoint->planningBuildMask = 0u;
            return;
        }
        endpoint->planningPublished = endpoint->planningBuild;
        endpoint->planningPublishedValid = 1u;
        endpoint->planningPublishedTickMs = tickMs;
        endpoint->planningTransportAgeMs =
            frame->tickMs - fragment.captureTickMs;
        endpoint->status.planningSnapshots++;
        memset(&endpoint->planningBuild, 0,
            sizeof(endpoint->planningBuild));
        endpoint->planningBuildMask = 0u;
    }
}

static void handleFrame(endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    const observerLinkFrame *frame,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t qualifiedHello = (uint8_t) ((frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HELLO) &&
                                        (frame->major == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR) &&
                                        (frame->minor == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                                        (helloIdentifiesPeer(endpoint, frame) != 0u));
    uint8_t sessionDecision = observerLinkRxSessionClassify(
        endpoint->status.online, endpoint->status.peerSession,
        endpoint->rxPacketSeq, endpoint->rxPacketSeqPrimed,
        frame->bootSession, frame->packetSeq, qualifiedHello);
    if (sessionDecision == OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT) return;
    if (sessionDecision == OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REBIND)
    {
        endpoint->status.peerSession = frame->bootSession;
        endpoint->rxPacketSeqPrimed = 0u;
        clearPeerState(endpoint);
    }
    endpoint->rxPacketSeq = frame->packetSeq;
    endpoint->rxPacketSeqPrimed = 1u;
    endpoint->status.lastValidRxTickMs = tickMs;
    endpoint->status.online = 1u;
    endpoint->status.rxFrames++;

    if ((frame->major != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR) ||
        (frame->minor != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR))
    {
        clearPeerState(endpoint);
        return;
    }
    if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HELLO)
    {
        handleHello(endpoint, frame);
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_CONFIG_ACK)
    {
        handleAck(endpoint, frame, tickMs);
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_DIAGNOSTICS)
    {
        if (observerLinkDecodeDiagnostics(frame->payload, frame->payloadLength,
                &endpoint->status.peerDiagnostics) != 0u)
        {
            endpoint->status.peerDiagnosticsTickMs = tickMs;
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HEALTH)
    {
        observerLinkHealth health;
        if ((observerLinkDecodeHealth(frame->payload, frame->payloadLength,
                 &health) != 0u) &&
            (health.sourceId == endpoint->descriptor.sourceId) &&
            (health.ownerSession == endpoint->status.localSession))
        {
            endpoint->status.health = health;
            endpoint->status.healthValid = 1u;
            endpoint->status.healthTickMs = tickMs;
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_KVM_ACK)
    {
        observerLinkKvmAck ack;
        if ((kvmEligible(endpoint) != 0u) &&
            (endpoint->kvmControlArmed != 0u) &&
            (observerLinkDecodeKvmAck(frame->payload, frame->payloadLength,
                 &ack) != 0u) &&
            (ack.target == endpoint->descriptor.kvmTarget) &&
            (ack.targetSession == endpoint->status.peerSession))
        {
            endpoint->kvmAck = ack;
            endpoint->kvmAckReady = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_KVM_MENU_STATUS)
    {
        observerLinkKvmMenuStatus status;
        if ((kvmEligible(endpoint) != 0u) &&
            (endpoint->kvmControlArmed != 0u) &&
            (observerLinkDecodeKvmMenuStatus(frame->payload,
                 frame->payloadLength, &status) != 0u) &&
            (status.target == endpoint->descriptor.kvmTarget) &&
            (status.targetSession == endpoint->status.peerSession))
        {
            endpoint->kvmMenuStatus = status;
            endpoint->kvmMenuTickMs = tickMs;
            endpoint->kvmMenuValid = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT)
    {
        handlePlanningFragment(endpoint, frame, tickMs);
    }
    else if ((frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PARAM_RESPONSE) &&
             (paramSyncEligible(endpoint) != 0u) &&
             (frame->payloadLength <= OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES))
    {
        memcpy(endpoint->paramResponse, frame->payload, frame->payloadLength);
        endpoint->paramResponseLength = frame->payloadLength;
        endpoint->paramResponseReady = 1u;
    }
    else if ((frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST) &&
             (paramSyncEligible(endpoint) != 0u) &&
             (observerParamGlobalRequestDecode(frame->payload,
                  frame->payloadLength, &endpoint->paramGlobalRequest) != 0u) &&
             (endpoint->paramGlobalRequest.origin == endpoint->descriptor.sourceId))
    {
        endpoint->paramGlobalRequestReady = 1u;
    }
}

static void pollHardwareRxErrors(endpointPrivate *endpoint)
{
#if defined(__ICCARM__)
    volatile stc_SCB_t *base = (volatile stc_SCB_t *) endpoint->descriptor.scb;
    uint32_t status;
    uint32_t errors;
    if (base == NULL) return;
    status = Cy_SCB_UART_GetRxFifoStatus(base);
    errors = status & CY_SCB_UART_RECEIVE_ERR;
    if (errors == 0u) return;
    if ((errors & CY_SCB_RX_INTR_UART_FRAME_ERROR) != 0u)
    {
        endpoint->status.localDiagnostics.rxFrameErrors++;
    }
    if ((errors & CY_SCB_RX_INTR_UART_PARITY_ERROR) != 0u)
    {
        endpoint->status.localDiagnostics.rxParityErrors++;
    }
    Cy_SCB_UART_ClearRxFifoStatus(base, errors);
#else
    (void) endpoint;
#endif
}

static void receiveFrames(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    observerLinkFrame frame;
    uint16_t budget = OBSERVER_LINK_RX_BYTE_BUDGET;

    pollHardwareRxErrors(endpoint);
    while ((endpoint->rxTail != endpoint->rxHead) && (budget != 0u))
    {
        uint8_t byte = endpoint->rxRing[endpoint->rxTail];
        endpoint->rxTail =
            (uint16_t) ((endpoint->rxTail + 1u) & ENDPOINT_RX_RING_MASK);
        budget--;
        if (observerLinkParserFeed(&endpoint->parser, byte, &frame) != 0u)
        {
            handleFrame(endpoint, &frame, tickMs);
        }
    }
}

static uint8_t sendHello(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[8u];
    uint16_t length;
    uint32_t capabilities = OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_BINARY_CC |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_LEGACY_CANNY |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_STAGING |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_APPLY |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_KVM |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_MENU_STATUS |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CAMERA_CONTROL |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONTROL_STATUS |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_VIEW_OVERLAY |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PARAM_SYNC;
    if (observerLinkEncodeHello(OBSERVER_LINK_ROLE_CORE1,
            capabilities, payload, &length) == 0u) return 0u;
    return sendMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HELLO,
        payload, length, tickMs);
}

static void makeFailClosedControlStatus(observerLinkControlStatus *status)
{
    memset(status, 0, sizeof(*status));
    status->cameraControlState = OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN;
    status->flags = OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_STATUS_VALID |
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION;
    status->desiredTarget = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    status->ownerTarget = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
}

static uint8_t sendHeartbeat(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_CORE1_HEARTBEAT_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    observerLinkControlStatus status = endpoint->controlStatus;

    status.detectMode = endpoint->desired.detectMode;
    status.protocolCompatible = endpoint->status.protocolCompatible;
    status.algorithmsReady = endpoint->status.algorithmsReady;
    status.configCompatible = endpoint->status.configCompatible;
    if (observerLinkEncodeControlStatus(&status, payload, &length) == 0u)
    {
        makeFailClosedControlStatus(&status);
        status.detectMode = endpoint->desired.detectMode;
        status.protocolCompatible = endpoint->status.protocolCompatible;
        status.algorithmsReady = endpoint->status.algorithmsReady;
        status.configCompatible = endpoint->status.configCompatible;
        if (observerLinkEncodeControlStatus(&status, payload, &length) == 0u)
        {
            endpoint->status.txFailures++;
            return 0u;
        }
    }
    endpoint->status.controlStatus = status;
    endpoint->status.cameraControlState = status.cameraControlState;
    return sendMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HEARTBEAT,
        payload, length, tickMs);
}

static uint8_t sendConfig(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_SHARED_CONFIG_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    if ((endpoint->status.configProviderValid == 0u) ||
        (observerLinkEncodeSharedConfig(&endpoint->desired,
             payload, &length) == 0u)) return 0u;
    return sendMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_CONFIG_SNAPSHOT,
        payload, length, tickMs);
}

static uint8_t sendDiagnostics(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_DIAGNOSTICS_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    observerLinkDiagnostics diagnostics;
    endpoint->status.localDiagnostics.validFrames = endpoint->parser.validFrames;
    endpoint->status.localDiagnostics.crcErrors = endpoint->parser.crcErrors;
    endpoint->status.localDiagnostics.lengthErrors = endpoint->parser.lengthErrors;
    endpoint->status.localDiagnostics.versionErrors = endpoint->parser.versionErrors;
    endpoint->status.localDiagnostics.txDeferred = endpoint->status.txDeferred;
    diagnostics = endpoint->status.localDiagnostics;
    diagnostics.rxOverflowErrors += endpoint->rxRingOverflow;
    if (observerLinkEncodeDiagnostics(&diagnostics, payload, &length) == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return sendMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_DIAGNOSTICS,
        payload, length, tickMs);
}

static uint8_t sendViewOverlay(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_VIEW_OVERLAY_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    if (observerLinkEncodeViewOverlay(&endpoint->viewOverlay,
            payload, &length) == 0u) return 0u;
    return sendMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_VIEW_OVERLAY,
        payload, length, tickMs);
}

static uint8_t sendKvmControl(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_CONTROL_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    if (observerLinkEncodeKvmControl(&endpoint->kvmControl,
            payload, &length) == 0u) return 0u;
    return sendControlMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_KVM_CONTROL,
        payload, length, tickMs);
}

static uint8_t sendKvmEvent(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_EVENT_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    if (observerLinkEncodeKvmEvent(&endpoint->kvmEvent,
            payload, &length) == 0u) return 0u;
    return sendControlMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_KVM_EVENT,
        payload, length, tickMs);
}

static void refreshTxEpoch(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t elapsedEpochs =
        (uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->txEpochTickMs) /
        OBSERVER_LINK_TX_EPOCH_MS;
    uint32_t credits;
    if (elapsedEpochs == 0u) return;
    endpoint->txEpochTickMs += elapsedEpochs * OBSERVER_LINK_TX_EPOCH_MS;
    credits = (uint32_t) endpoint->txDataCredits +
              elapsedEpochs * OBSERVER_LINK_TX_FRAMES_PER_EPOCH;
    endpoint->txDataCredits = (uint8_t) ((credits > OBSERVER_LINK_TX_DATA_CREDIT_CAP) ? OBSERVER_LINK_TX_DATA_CREDIT_CAP : credits);
    credits = (uint32_t) endpoint->txControlCredits +
              elapsedEpochs * OBSERVER_LINK_TX_CONTROL_FRAMES_PER_EPOCH;
    endpoint->txControlCredits = (uint8_t) ((credits > OBSERVER_LINK_TX_CONTROL_CREDIT_CAP) ? OBSERVER_LINK_TX_CONTROL_CREDIT_CAP : credits);
}

static void serviceControlTransmit(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    if (kvmEligible(endpoint) == 0u)
    {
        clearKvmState(endpoint);
        return;
    }
    refreshTxEpoch(endpoint, tickMs);
    while (endpoint->txControlCredits != 0u)
    {
        if ((endpoint->kvmControlPending != 0u) &&
            (sendKvmControl(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u))
        {
            endpoint->kvmControlPending = 0u;
            continue;
        }
        if ((endpoint->kvmEventPending != 0u) &&
            (sendKvmEvent(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u))
        {
            endpoint->kvmEventPending = 0u;
            continue;
        }
        break;
    }
}

static uint8_t transmitOne(endpointPrivate *endpoint,
    uint32_t tickMs,
    uint32_t configPeriod)
{
    if (((endpoint->status.online == 0u) ||
            (endpoint->status.protocolCompatible == 0u)) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastHelloTickMs) >=
            ENDPOINT_HELLO_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendHello(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        endpoint->lastHelloTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastHeartbeatTickMs) >=
            ENDPOINT_HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendHeartbeat(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        endpoint->lastHeartbeatTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((endpoint->status.protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
        (endpoint->status.configProviderValid != 0u) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastConfigTickMs) >= configPeriod) &&
        (sendConfig(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        endpoint->lastConfigTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastHelloTickMs) >=
            ENDPOINT_HELLO_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendHello(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        endpoint->lastHelloTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastDiagTickMs) >=
            ENDPOINT_DIAG_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendDiagnostics(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        endpoint->lastDiagTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((endpoint->viewOverlayPending != 0u) &&
        ((endpoint->status.peerCapabilities &
             OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_VIEW_OVERLAY) != 0u) &&
        (sendViewOverlay(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        endpoint->viewOverlayPending = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    /* 参数同步严格位于心跳、配置、诊断和业务数据之后。 */
    if ((endpoint->paramRequestPending != 0u) &&
        (paramSyncEligible(endpoint) != 0u) &&
        (sendMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PARAM_REQUEST,
             endpoint->paramRequest, endpoint->paramRequestLength, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        endpoint->paramRequestPending = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((endpoint->paramGlobalStatePending != 0u) &&
        (paramSyncEligible(endpoint) != 0u))
    {
        uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_BYTES];
        uint16_t length;
        if ((observerParamGlobalStateEncode(&endpoint->paramGlobalState,
                  payload, &length) != 0u) &&
            (sendMessage(endpoint, OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE,
                  payload, length, tickMs) != 0u))
        {
            endpoint->paramGlobalStatePending = 0u;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t transmitWorkPending(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t configPeriod = (endpoint->status.configCompatible != 0u) ? ENDPOINT_CONFIG_REFRESH_MS : ENDPOINT_CONFIG_PERIOD_MS;
    return (uint8_t) ((endpoint->viewOverlayPending != 0u) ||
                      (endpoint->paramRequestPending != 0u) ||
                      (endpoint->paramGlobalStatePending != 0u) ||
                      ((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastHeartbeatTickMs) >=
                          ENDPOINT_HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_MS) ||
                      ((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastHelloTickMs) >=
                          ENDPOINT_HELLO_PERIOD_MS) ||
                      ((endpoint->status.protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
                          (endpoint->status.configProviderValid != 0u) &&
                          ((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastConfigTickMs) >= configPeriod)) ||
                      ((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->lastDiagTickMs) >=
                          ENDPOINT_DIAG_PERIOD_MS));
}

static void serviceTransmit(endpointPrivate *endpoint, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t configPeriod = (endpoint->status.configCompatible != 0u) ? ENDPOINT_CONFIG_REFRESH_MS : ENDPOINT_CONFIG_PERIOD_MS;
    refreshTxEpoch(endpoint, tickMs);
    while ((endpoint->txDataCredits != 0u) &&
           (transmitOne(endpoint, tickMs, configPeriod) != 0u))
    {
    }
    if ((transmitWorkPending(endpoint, tickMs) != 0u) &&
        (endpoint->txDataCredits == 0u) &&
        (endpoint->lastDeferredTickMs != tickMs))
    {
        endpoint->lastDeferredTickMs = tickMs;
        endpoint->status.txDeferred++;
    }
}

uint8_t observerLinkCore1EndpointInit(observerLinkCore1EndpointContext *context,
    const observerLinkCore1EndpointDescriptor *descriptor,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    endpointPrivate *endpoint;
    if ((context == NULL) || (descriptorIsValid(descriptor) == 0u)) return 0u;
    memset(context, 0, sizeof(*context));
    endpoint = privateFromContext(context);
    endpoint->magic = ENDPOINT_MAGIC;
    endpoint->descriptor = *descriptor;
    endpoint->status.sourceId = descriptor->sourceId;
    endpoint->status.localSession = makeBootSession(tickMs);
    endpoint->status.appliedMode = 0xFFu;
    endpoint->status.configAckDesiredMode = 0xFFu;
    endpoint->status.cameraControlState = OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN;
    observerLinkParserInit(&endpoint->parser);
    endpoint->lastHelloTickMs = tickMs - ENDPOINT_HELLO_PERIOD_MS;
    endpoint->lastHeartbeatTickMs = tickMs - ENDPOINT_HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_MS;
    endpoint->lastConfigTickMs = tickMs - ENDPOINT_CONFIG_PERIOD_MS;
    endpoint->lastDiagTickMs = tickMs - ENDPOINT_DIAG_PERIOD_MS;
    endpoint->lastDeferredTickMs = tickMs - 1u;
    endpoint->txEpochTickMs = tickMs;
    endpoint->txDataCredits = OBSERVER_LINK_TX_FRAMES_PER_EPOCH;
    endpoint->txControlCredits = OBSERVER_LINK_TX_CONTROL_FRAMES_PER_EPOCH;
    makeFailClosedControlStatus(&endpoint->controlStatus);
    endpoint->status.controlStatus = endpoint->controlStatus;
    (void) syncConfig(endpoint);
    uart_init(ENDPOINT_UART(descriptor->uart), OBSERVER_LINK_UART_BAUDRATE,
        ENDPOINT_TX_PIN(descriptor->txPin), ENDPOINT_RX_PIN(descriptor->rxPin));
    uart_rx_interrupt(ENDPOINT_UART(descriptor->uart), 1u);
    return 1u;
}

void observerLinkCore1EndpointRxIsr(observerLinkCore1EndpointContext *context)
{
    endpointPrivate *endpoint = initializedPrivate(context);
    uint8_t byte;
    if (endpoint == NULL) return;
    while (uart_query_byte(ENDPOINT_UART(endpoint->descriptor.uart),
               &byte) != 0u)
    {
        uint16_t next =
            (uint16_t) ((endpoint->rxHead + 1u) & ENDPOINT_RX_RING_MASK);
        if (next == endpoint->rxTail)
        {
            endpoint->rxRingOverflow++;
            continue;
        }
        endpoint->rxRing[endpoint->rxHead] = byte;
        publishBarrier();
        endpoint->rxHead = next;
    }
}

void observerLinkCore1EndpointPoll(observerLinkCore1EndpointContext *context,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    endpointPrivate *endpoint = initializedPrivate(context);
    if (endpoint == NULL) return;
    (void) syncConfig(endpoint);
    receiveFrames(endpoint, tickMs);
    if ((endpoint->status.online != 0u) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->status.lastValidRxTickMs) >=
            ENDPOINT_TIMEOUT_MS))
    {
        endpoint->status.online = 0u;
        endpoint->rxPacketSeqPrimed = 0u;
        clearPeerState(endpoint);
    }
    if ((endpoint->viewOverlayPending != 0u) &&
        (((uint32_t) (tickMs - endpoint->viewOverlayTickMs) >
             ENDPOINT_OVERLAY_MAX_AGE_MS) ||
            ((endpoint->status.online != 0u) &&
                (endpoint->status.protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
                ((endpoint->status.peerCapabilities &
                     OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_VIEW_OVERLAY) == 0u))))
    {
        endpoint->viewOverlayPending = 0u;
    }
    serviceControlTransmit(endpoint, tickMs);
    serviceTransmit(endpoint, tickMs);
}

#include "observerLinkProtocol.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "crc32Ieee.h"

static void putU16(uint8_t *dst, uint16_t value)
{
    dst[0] = (uint8_t) value;
    dst[1] = (uint8_t) (value >> 8);
}

static void putU32(uint8_t *dst, uint32_t value)
{
    dst[0] = (uint8_t) value;
    dst[1] = (uint8_t) (value >> 8);
    dst[2] = (uint8_t) (value >> 16);
    dst[3] = (uint8_t) (value >> 24);
}

static uint16_t getU16(const uint8_t *src)
{
    return (uint16_t) ((uint16_t) src[0] | ((uint16_t) src[1] << 8));
}

static uint32_t getU32(const uint8_t *src)
{
    return (uint32_t) src[0] |
           ((uint32_t) src[1] << 8) |
           ((uint32_t) src[2] << 16) |
           ((uint32_t) src[3] << 24);
}

static void putFloat(uint8_t *dst, float value)
{
    uint32_t bits;
    memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
    putU32(dst, bits);
}

static float getFloat(const uint8_t *src)
{
    uint32_t bits = getU32(src);
    float value;
    memcpy(&value, &bits, sizeof(value));
    return value;
}

static uint8_t finiteInRange(float value, float minimum, float maximum)
{
    if ((value != value) || (value > 1.0e30f) || (value < -1.0e30f))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return (uint8_t) ((value >= minimum) && (value <= maximum));
}

uint8_t observerLinkQuantizeSigned(float value, float scale,
    float minimum, float maximum, int16_t *quantized)
{
    float scaled;

    if ((quantized == NULL) ||
        (finiteInRange(value, minimum, maximum) == 0u) ||
        (finiteInRange(scale, 0.000001f, 1.0e30f) == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    scaled = value * scale;
    if (finiteInRange(scaled, -32768.0f, 32767.0f) == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    scaled += (scaled >= 0.0f) ? 0.5f : -0.5f;
    *quantized = (int16_t) scaled;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t updateExpected(observerLinkParser *parser)
{
    uint16_t payloadLength;

    parser->expected = 0u;
    if (parser->used < 8u)
    {
        return 1u;
    }
    payloadLength = getU16(&parser->bytes[6]);
    if (payloadLength > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    parser->expected = (uint16_t) (OBSERVER_LINK_HEADER_BYTES +
                                  payloadLength +
                                  OBSERVER_LINK_CRC_BYTES);
    return 1u;
}

static void recoverParser(observerLinkParser *parser)
{
    uint16_t i;
    uint8_t found;

    for (;;)
    {
        found = 0u;
        for (i = 1u; (uint16_t) (i + 1u) < parser->used; i++)
        {
            if ((parser->bytes[i] == OBSERVER_LINK_SOF0) &&
                (parser->bytes[i + 1u] == OBSERVER_LINK_SOF1))
            {
                memmove(parser->bytes, &parser->bytes[i], parser->used - i);
                parser->used = (uint16_t) (parser->used - i);
                if (updateExpected(parser) != 0u)
                {
                    return;
                }
                parser->lengthErrors++;
                found = 1u;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (found != 0u)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if ((parser->used != 0u) &&
            (parser->bytes[parser->used - 1u] == OBSERVER_LINK_SOF0))
        {
            parser->bytes[0] = OBSERVER_LINK_SOF0;
            parser->used = 1u;
        }
        else
        {
            parser->used = 0u;
        }
        parser->expected = 0u;
        return;
    }
}

void observerLinkParserInit(observerLinkParser *parser)
{
    if (parser != NULL)
    {
        memset(parser, 0, sizeof(*parser));
    }
}

uint16_t observerLinkEncodeFrame(const observerLinkFrame *frame, uint8_t *output, uint16_t capacity)
{
    uint16_t total;
    uint32_t crc;

    if ((frame == NULL) || (output == NULL) ||
        (frame->payloadLength > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    total = (uint16_t) (OBSERVER_LINK_HEADER_BYTES + frame->payloadLength +
                        OBSERVER_LINK_CRC_BYTES);
    if (capacity < total)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    output[0] = OBSERVER_LINK_SOF0;
    output[1] = OBSERVER_LINK_SOF1;
    output[2] = frame->major;
    output[3] = frame->minor;
    output[4] = frame->type;
    output[5] = frame->flags;
    putU16(&output[6], frame->payloadLength);
    putU32(&output[8], frame->bootSession);
    putU32(&output[12], frame->packetSeq);
    putU32(&output[16], frame->tickMs);
    if (frame->payloadLength != 0u)
    {
        memcpy(&output[OBSERVER_LINK_HEADER_BYTES],
            frame->payload,
            frame->payloadLength);
    }
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc(&output[2],
        (uint32_t) (OBSERVER_LINK_HEADER_BYTES - 2u + frame->payloadLength));
    putU32(&output[OBSERVER_LINK_HEADER_BYTES + frame->payloadLength], crc);
    return total;
}

uint8_t observerLinkParserFeed(observerLinkParser *parser, uint8_t byte, observerLinkFrame *frame)
{
    uint16_t payloadLength;
    uint32_t expectedCrc;
    uint32_t actualCrc;

    if ((parser == NULL) || (frame == NULL))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    if (parser->used == 0u)
    {
        if (byte == OBSERVER_LINK_SOF0)
        {
            parser->bytes[0] = byte;
            parser->used = 1u;
        }
        return 0u;
    }
    if (parser->used == 1u)
    {
        if (byte == OBSERVER_LINK_SOF1)
        {
            parser->bytes[1] = byte;
            parser->used = 2u;
        }
        else if (byte != OBSERVER_LINK_SOF0)
        {
            parser->used = 0u;
        }
        return 0u;
    }

    if (parser->used >= OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_FRAME_BYTES)
    {
        parser->lengthErrors++;
        parser->used = 0u;
        parser->expected = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    parser->bytes[parser->used++] = byte;

    if ((parser->used >= 8u) && (parser->expected == 0u))
    {
        if (updateExpected(parser) == 0u)
        {
            parser->lengthErrors++;
            recoverParser(parser);
            return 0u;
        }
    }
    if ((parser->expected == 0u) || (parser->used < parser->expected))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

validateFrame:
    payloadLength = getU16(&parser->bytes[6]);
    expectedCrc = getU32(&parser->bytes[OBSERVER_LINK_HEADER_BYTES + payloadLength]);
    actualCrc = crc32IeeeCalc(&parser->bytes[2],
        (uint32_t) (OBSERVER_LINK_HEADER_BYTES - 2u + payloadLength));
    if (expectedCrc != actualCrc)
    {
        parser->crcErrors++;
        recoverParser(parser);
        if ((parser->expected != 0u) && (parser->used >= parser->expected))
        {
            goto validateFrame;
        }
        return 0u;
    }

    frame->major = parser->bytes[2];
    frame->minor = parser->bytes[3];
    frame->type = parser->bytes[4];
    frame->flags = parser->bytes[5];
    frame->payloadLength = payloadLength;
    frame->bootSession = getU32(&parser->bytes[8]);
    frame->packetSeq = getU32(&parser->bytes[12]);
    frame->tickMs = getU32(&parser->bytes[16]);
    if (payloadLength != 0u)
    {
        memcpy(frame->payload,
            &parser->bytes[OBSERVER_LINK_HEADER_BYTES],
            payloadLength);
    }
    if (frame->major != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR)
    {
        parser->versionErrors++;
    }
    parser->validFrames++;
    if (parser->used > parser->expected)
    {
        uint16_t remaining = (uint16_t) (parser->used - parser->expected);
        memmove(parser->bytes, &parser->bytes[parser->expected], remaining);
        parser->used = remaining;
        if (updateExpected(parser) == 0u)
        {
            parser->lengthErrors++;
            recoverParser(parser);
        }
    }
    else
    {
        parser->used = 0u;
        parser->expected = 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodeHello(uint8_t role, uint32_t capabilities, uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (length == NULL))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    payload[0] = role;
    payload[1] = OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR;
    payload[2] = OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR;
    payload[3] = 0u;
    putU32(&payload[4], capabilities);
    *length = 8u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodeHello(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length, uint8_t *role, uint32_t *capabilities)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (role == NULL) || (capabilities == NULL) ||
        (length != 8u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if ((payload[1] != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR) ||
        (payload[2] != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    *role = payload[0];
    *capabilities = getU32(&payload[4]);
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodeSharedConfig(const observerLinkSharedConfig *config, uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if ((config == NULL) || (payload == NULL) || (length == NULL))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(payload, 0, OBSERVER_LINK_SHARED_CONFIG_BYTES);
    putU32(&payload[0], config->revision);
    putU32(&payload[4], config->hash);
    payload[8] = config->detectMode;
    payload[9] = config->maxBeacons;
    putU16(&payload[10], config->edgePredictionHoldMs);
    putU16(&payload[12], config->beaconSizeMin);
    putU16(&payload[14], config->beaconSizeMax);
    putFloat(&payload[16], config->beaconEccMax);
    payload[20] = config->beaconBrightnessMin;
    payload[21] = config->sourceId;
    putU16(&payload[22], config->beaconMaxEndpoints);
    putFloat(&payload[24], config->beaconFillMin);
    putFloat(&payload[28], config->beaconHuMax);
    putU16(&payload[32], config->beaconHuAreaMin);
    payload[34] = config->profileVersion;
    putFloat(&payload[36], config->trackMaxAssocDist);
    putFloat(&payload[40], config->trackSizeRatioMax);
    putU16(&payload[44], config->trackConfirmHits);
    putU16(&payload[46], config->trackDropMisses);
    putU16(&payload[48], config->trackCoastMisses);
    putFloat(&payload[52], config->trackPositionAlpha);
    putFloat(&payload[56], config->trackSizeAlpha);
    putFloat(&payload[60], config->trackAreaVelAlpha);
    putFloat(&payload[64], config->trackAssocScoreMax);
    putFloat(&payload[68], config->trackAssocAreaWeight);
    putFloat(&payload[72], config->trackAssocAreaVelWeight);
    for (i = 0u; i < 7u; i++)
    {
        putFloat(&payload[76u + (uint16_t) i * 4u], config->beaconHuTemplate[i]);
    }
    payload[104] = config->c1BorderEnterLeft;
    payload[105] = config->c1BorderEnterRight;
    payload[106] = config->c1BorderEnterTop;
    payload[107] = config->c1BorderEnterBottom;
    payload[108] = config->c1BorderExitLeft;
    payload[109] = config->c1BorderExitRight;
    payload[110] = config->c1BorderExitTop;
    payload[111] = config->c1BorderExitBottom;
    payload[112] = config->observerBorderEnterLeft;
    payload[113] = config->observerBorderEnterRight;
    payload[114] = config->observerBorderEnterTop;
    payload[115] = config->observerBorderEnterBottom;
    payload[116] = config->observerBorderExitLeft;
    payload[117] = config->observerBorderExitRight;
    payload[118] = config->observerBorderExitTop;
    payload[119] = config->observerBorderExitBottom;
    payload[120] = config->c1EdgeBandLeft;
    payload[121] = config->c1EdgeBandRight;
    payload[122] = config->c1EdgeBandTop;
    payload[123] = config->c1EdgeBandBottom;
    payload[124] = config->observerEdgeBandLeft;
    payload[125] = config->observerEdgeBandRight;
    payload[126] = config->observerEdgeBandTop;
    payload[127] = config->observerEdgeBandBottom;
    *length = OBSERVER_LINK_SHARED_CONFIG_BYTES;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodeSharedConfig(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length, observerLinkSharedConfig *config)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if ((payload == NULL) || (config == NULL) ||
        (length != OBSERVER_LINK_SHARED_CONFIG_BYTES))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(config, 0, sizeof(*config));
    config->revision = getU32(&payload[0]);
    config->hash = getU32(&payload[4]);
    config->detectMode = payload[8];
    config->maxBeacons = payload[9];
    config->edgePredictionHoldMs = getU16(&payload[10]);
    config->beaconSizeMin = getU16(&payload[12]);
    config->beaconSizeMax = getU16(&payload[14]);
    config->beaconEccMax = getFloat(&payload[16]);
    config->beaconBrightnessMin = payload[20];
    config->sourceId = payload[21];
    config->beaconMaxEndpoints = getU16(&payload[22]);
    config->beaconFillMin = getFloat(&payload[24]);
    config->beaconHuMax = getFloat(&payload[28]);
    config->beaconHuAreaMin = getU16(&payload[32]);
    config->profileVersion = payload[34];
    config->trackMaxAssocDist = getFloat(&payload[36]);
    config->trackSizeRatioMax = getFloat(&payload[40]);
    config->trackConfirmHits = getU16(&payload[44]);
    config->trackDropMisses = getU16(&payload[46]);
    config->trackCoastMisses = getU16(&payload[48]);
    config->trackPositionAlpha = getFloat(&payload[52]);
    config->trackSizeAlpha = getFloat(&payload[56]);
    config->trackAreaVelAlpha = getFloat(&payload[60]);
    config->trackAssocScoreMax = getFloat(&payload[64]);
    config->trackAssocAreaWeight = getFloat(&payload[68]);
    config->trackAssocAreaVelWeight = getFloat(&payload[72]);
    for (i = 0u; i < 7u; i++)
    {
        config->beaconHuTemplate[i] = getFloat(&payload[76u + (uint16_t) i * 4u]);
    }
    config->c1BorderEnterLeft = payload[104];
    config->c1BorderEnterRight = payload[105];
    config->c1BorderEnterTop = payload[106];
    config->c1BorderEnterBottom = payload[107];
    config->c1BorderExitLeft = payload[108];
    config->c1BorderExitRight = payload[109];
    config->c1BorderExitTop = payload[110];
    config->c1BorderExitBottom = payload[111];
    config->observerBorderEnterLeft = payload[112];
    config->observerBorderEnterRight = payload[113];
    config->observerBorderEnterTop = payload[114];
    config->observerBorderEnterBottom = payload[115];
    config->observerBorderExitLeft = payload[116];
    config->observerBorderExitRight = payload[117];
    config->observerBorderExitTop = payload[118];
    config->observerBorderExitBottom = payload[119];
    config->c1EdgeBandLeft = payload[120];
    config->c1EdgeBandRight = payload[121];
    config->c1EdgeBandTop = payload[122];
    config->c1EdgeBandBottom = payload[123];
    config->observerEdgeBandLeft = payload[124];
    config->observerEdgeBandRight = payload[125];
    config->observerEdgeBandTop = payload[126];
    config->observerEdgeBandBottom = payload[127];
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t borderSideValid(uint8_t enter, uint8_t exit, uint8_t maxValue)
{
    if ((enter == 0u) && (exit == 0u)) return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) ((enter >= 1u) && (enter <= maxValue) && (exit < enter));
}

static uint8_t sharedConfigBorderValid(const observerLinkSharedConfig *config)
{
    if (config == NULL) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (
        (config->edgePredictionHoldMs <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_HOLD_MS_MAX) &&
        ((config->sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) ||
         (config->sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)) &&
        (config->profileVersion == 1u) &&
        (config->c1EdgeBandLeft <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_BAND_X_MAX) &&
        (config->c1EdgeBandRight <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_BAND_X_MAX) &&
        (config->c1EdgeBandTop <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_BAND_Y_MAX) &&
        (config->c1EdgeBandBottom <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_BAND_Y_MAX) &&
        (config->observerEdgeBandLeft <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_BAND_X_MAX) &&
        (config->observerEdgeBandRight <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_BAND_X_MAX) &&
        (config->observerEdgeBandTop <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_BAND_Y_MAX) &&
        (config->observerEdgeBandBottom <= OBSERVER_LINK_EDGE_PREDICTION_BAND_Y_MAX) &&
        borderSideValid(config->c1BorderEnterLeft, config->c1BorderExitLeft, 93u) &&
        borderSideValid(config->c1BorderEnterRight, config->c1BorderExitRight, 93u) &&
        borderSideValid(config->c1BorderEnterTop, config->c1BorderExitTop, 59u) &&
        borderSideValid(config->c1BorderEnterBottom, config->c1BorderExitBottom, 59u) &&
        borderSideValid(config->observerBorderEnterLeft, config->observerBorderExitLeft, 93u) &&
        borderSideValid(config->observerBorderEnterRight, config->observerBorderExitRight, 93u) &&
        borderSideValid(config->observerBorderEnterTop, config->observerBorderExitTop, 59u) &&
        borderSideValid(config->observerBorderEnterBottom, config->observerBorderExitBottom, 59u));
}

uint32_t observerLinkSharedConfigHash(const observerLinkSharedConfig *config)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_SHARED_CONFIG_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;

    if ((config == NULL) ||
        (observerLinkEncodeSharedConfig(config, payload, &length) == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return crc32IeeeCalc(&payload[8], (uint32_t) (length - 8u));
}

uint8_t observerLinkSharedConfigIsValid(const observerLinkSharedConfig *config)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if ((config == NULL) || (config->revision == 0u) ||
        (config->hash != observerLinkSharedConfigHash(config)) ||
        (config->detectMode > 1u) ||
        (config->maxBeacons < 1u) || (config->maxBeacons > 32u) ||
        (sharedConfigBorderValid(config) == 0u) ||
        (config->beaconSizeMin < 1u) ||
        (config->beaconSizeMax <= config->beaconSizeMin) ||
        (config->beaconSizeMax > 60000u) ||
        (config->beaconMaxEndpoints > 200u) ||
        (config->beaconHuAreaMin < 1u) ||
        (config->beaconHuAreaMin > 100u) ||
        (config->trackConfirmHits < 1u) || (config->trackConfirmHits > 60u) ||
        (config->trackDropMisses < 1u) || (config->trackDropMisses > 60u) ||
        (config->trackCoastMisses < 1u) || (config->trackCoastMisses > 60u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < 7u; i++)
    {
        if (finiteInRange(config->beaconHuTemplate[i], -1000000.0f, 1000000.0f) == 0u)
        {
            return 0u;
        }
    }
    return (uint8_t) (
        finiteInRange(config->beaconEccMax, 0.0f, 20.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->beaconFillMin, 0.0f, 1.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->beaconHuMax, 0.0f, 200.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->trackMaxAssocDist, 1.0f, 100.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->trackSizeRatioMax, 1.1f, 10.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->trackPositionAlpha, 0.01f, 1.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->trackSizeAlpha, 0.01f, 1.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->trackAreaVelAlpha, 0.01f, 1.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->trackAssocScoreMax, 0.1f, 10.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->trackAssocAreaWeight, 0.0f, 3.0f) &&
        finiteInRange(config->trackAssocAreaVelWeight, 0.0f, 3.0f));
}

static uint8_t controlStatusIsValid(const observerLinkControlStatus *status)
{
    uint8_t statusValid;
    uint8_t decisionValid;
    uint8_t barrier;
    uint8_t dispatch;
    uint8_t core0LinkUp;
    uint8_t core2LinkUp;
    uint8_t requiredVision;

    if ((status == NULL) || (status->detectMode > 1u) ||
        (status->protocolCompatible > 1u) || (status->algorithmsReady > 1u) ||
        (status->configCompatible > 1u) ||
        (status->cameraControlState > OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN) ||
        ((status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)) ||
        (status->controlClass > OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_SEARCH) ||
        ((status->navState != 0u) && (status->navState != 2u) &&
         (status->navState != 3u) && (status->navState != 4u)) ||
        (status->systemPhase > OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_RUNNING) ||
        ((status->systemFlags & 0x80u) != 0u) ||
        (status->primaryReason > OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_LANDING) ||
        ((status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) &&
         (status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) &&
         (status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) &&
         (status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) &&
         (status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE)) ||
        ((status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) &&
         (status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) &&
         (status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) &&
         (status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) &&
         (status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE)) ||
        (status->targetX >= 188u) ||
        (status->targetY >= 120u) || (status->targetSize > 22560u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    statusValid = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_STATUS_VALID) != 0u);
    decisionValid = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_DECISION_VALID) != 0u);
    barrier = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_BARRIER_REQUIRED) != 0u);
    dispatch = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_DISPATCH_ENABLED) != 0u);
    core0LinkUp = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_CORE0_LINK_UP) != 0u);
    core2LinkUp = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_CORE2_LINK_UP) != 0u);
    requiredVision = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION) != 0u);

    if ((((status->systemFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_STANDALONE) != 0u) !=
          (status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE)) ||
        (((status->systemFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_REJOIN) != 0u) !=
          (status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN)) ||
        (((status->systemFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_LANDING) != 0u) &&
         ((status->systemFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_LAUNCH_ELIGIBLE) != 0u)))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    if (statusValid == 0u)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_SAFE) &&
            (status->activeSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE) &&
            (status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE) &&
            (status->navState == 0u) && (status->beaconCount == 0u) &&
            (status->targetX == 0u) && (status->targetY == 0u) &&
            (status->targetSize == 0u) && (status->errXQ4 == 0) &&
            (status->errYQ4 == 0) && (status->flags == 0u));
    }
    if ((status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_SAFE) ||
        ((status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN) !=
         (requiredVision != 0u)) ||
        ((core2LinkUp != 0u) && (core0LinkUp == 0u)) ||
        ((decisionValid != 0u) &&
         (status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE)) ||
        ((status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE)) ||
        ((status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_CORE1_TRACK) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1)) ||
        ((status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_OBSERVER_TRACK) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)) ||
        ((status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_SEARCH) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE)) ||
        ((dispatch != 0u) && ((decisionValid == 0u) || (barrier != 0u) ||
          (status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE))))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodeControlStatus(const observerLinkControlStatus *status,
    uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (length == NULL) ||
        (controlStatusIsValid(status) == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    payload[0] = status->detectMode;
    payload[1] = status->protocolCompatible;
    payload[2] = status->algorithmsReady;
    payload[3] = status->configCompatible;
    payload[4] = status->cameraControlState;
    payload[5] = status->activeSource;
    payload[6] = status->controlClass;
    payload[7] = status->flags;
    payload[8] = status->navState;
    payload[9] = status->beaconCount;
    putU16(&payload[10], status->targetX);
    putU16(&payload[12], status->targetY);
    putU16(&payload[14], status->targetSize);
    putU16(&payload[16], (uint16_t) status->errXQ4);
    putU16(&payload[18], (uint16_t) status->errYQ4);
    payload[20] = status->systemPhase;
    payload[21] = status->systemFlags;
    payload[22] = status->primaryReason;
    payload[23] = status->desiredTarget;
    payload[24] = status->ownerTarget;
    *length = OBSERVER_LINK_CORE1_HEARTBEAT_BYTES;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodeControlStatus(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length,
    observerLinkControlStatus *status)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (status == NULL) ||
        (length != OBSERVER_LINK_CORE1_HEARTBEAT_BYTES))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(status, 0, sizeof(*status));
    status->detectMode = payload[0];
    status->protocolCompatible = payload[1];
    status->algorithmsReady = payload[2];
    status->configCompatible = payload[3];
    status->cameraControlState = payload[4];
    status->activeSource = payload[5];
    status->controlClass = payload[6];
    status->flags = payload[7];
    status->navState = payload[8];
    status->beaconCount = payload[9];
    status->targetX = getU16(&payload[10]);
    status->targetY = getU16(&payload[12]);
    status->targetSize = getU16(&payload[14]);
    status->errXQ4 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[16]);
    status->errYQ4 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[18]);
    status->systemPhase = payload[20];
    status->systemFlags = payload[21];
    status->primaryReason = payload[22];
    status->desiredTarget = payload[23];
    status->ownerTarget = payload[24];
    return controlStatusIsValid(status);
}

static uint8_t observerSourceIsValid(uint8_t sourceId)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) ||
        (sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4));
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodeHealth(const observerLinkHealth *health,
    uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if ((health == NULL) || (payload == NULL) || (length == NULL) ||
        (observerSourceIsValid(health->sourceId) == 0u) ||
        (health->cameraState > 2u) ||
        (health->configState > OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    putU32(&payload[0], health->ownerSession);
    putU32(&payload[4], health->appFrameSeq);
    putU32(&payload[8], health->captureTickMs);
    putU32(&payload[12], health->bridgeSeq);
    putU16(&payload[16], health->frameAgeMs);
    putU16(&payload[18], health->bridgeAgeMs);
    payload[20] = health->sourceId;
    payload[21] = health->cameraState;
    payload[22] = health->configState;
    payload[23] = health->flags;
    *length = OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_BYTES;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodeHealth(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length,
    observerLinkHealth *health)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (health == NULL) ||
        (length != OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_BYTES))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    health->ownerSession = getU32(&payload[0]);
    health->appFrameSeq = getU32(&payload[4]);
    health->captureTickMs = getU32(&payload[8]);
    health->bridgeSeq = getU32(&payload[12]);
    health->frameAgeMs = getU16(&payload[16]);
    health->bridgeAgeMs = getU16(&payload[18]);
    health->sourceId = payload[20];
    health->cameraState = payload[21];
    health->configState = payload[22];
    health->flags = payload[23];
    return (uint8_t) ((observerSourceIsValid(health->sourceId) != 0u) &&
        (health->cameraState <= 2u) &&
        (health->configState <= OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED));
}

static uint8_t viewOverlayIsValid(const observerLinkViewOverlay *overlay)
{
    uint16_t knownFlags = OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_VALID |
        OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_CENTER | OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_DEADZONE |
        OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_SELECTED | OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_POSE;
    uint8_t selectedPresent;
    uint8_t posePresent;

    if ((overlay == NULL) || (overlay->overlaySeq == 0u) ||
        (overlay->ownerSession == 0u) || (overlay->configRevision == 0u) ||
        (overlay->detectMode > 1u) || ((overlay->flags & ~knownFlags) != 0u) ||
        ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_VALID) == 0u)) return 0u;
    selectedPresent = (uint8_t) ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_SELECTED) != 0u);
    posePresent = (uint8_t) ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_POSE) != 0u);
    if ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_CENTER) != 0u)
    {
        if ((overlay->activeCenterX >= 188u) || (overlay->activeCenterY >= 120u)) return 0u;
    }
    else if ((overlay->activeCenterX != 0u) || (overlay->activeCenterY != 0u)) return 0u;
    if ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_DEADZONE) != 0u)
    {
        if ((overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius > 188u) ||
            (overlay->deadzoneExitRadius > 188u) ||
            (overlay->deadzoneExitRadius > overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius)) return 0u;
    }
    else if ((overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius != 0u) ||
        (overlay->deadzoneExitRadius != 0u)) return 0u;
    if (selectedPresent != 0u)
    {
        if ((overlay->sourceFrameSeq == 0u) ||
            (overlay->selectedTrackId == 0u) || (overlay->selectedX >= 188u) ||
            (overlay->selectedY >= 120u) || (overlay->selectedSize > 22560u) ||
            ((overlay->selectedFlags & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_FRESH |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_COAST)) != 0u) ||
            (overlay->selectedFlags == 0u) ||
            (overlay->selectedFlags == (OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_FRESH |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_COAST))) return 0u;
    }
    else if ((overlay->selectedTrackId != 0u) || (overlay->selectedX != 0u) ||
        (overlay->selectedY != 0u) || (overlay->selectedSize != 0u) ||
        (overlay->selectedFlags != 0u)) return 0u;
    if (posePresent != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t poseAgeFlags = (uint8_t) (overlay->poseFlags &
            (OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_FRESH | OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD));
        if ((overlay->poseX >= 188u) || (overlay->poseY >= 120u) ||
            ((overlay->poseFlags & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_FRESH |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HEADING_VALID)) != 0u) ||
            (poseAgeFlags == 0u) ||
            (poseAgeFlags == (OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_FRESH |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD))) return 0u;
        if ((overlay->poseFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HEADING_VALID) != 0u)
        {
            if ((overlay->poseHeadingQ8 < -805) || (overlay->poseHeadingQ8 > 805)) return 0u;
        }
        else if (overlay->poseHeadingQ8 != 0) return 0u;
    }
    else if ((overlay->poseX != 0u) || (overlay->poseY != 0u) ||
        (overlay->poseHeadingQ8 != 0) || (overlay->poseFlags != 0u)) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodeViewOverlay(const observerLinkViewOverlay *overlay,
    uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (length == NULL) ||
        (viewOverlayIsValid(overlay) == 0u)) return 0u;
    putU32(&payload[0], overlay->overlaySeq);
    putU32(&payload[4], overlay->sourceFrameSeq);
    putU32(&payload[8], overlay->ownerSession);
    putU32(&payload[12], overlay->configRevision);
    putU32(&payload[16], overlay->configHash);
    putU16(&payload[20], overlay->flags);
    putU16(&payload[22], overlay->selectedTrackId);
    putU16(&payload[24], overlay->activeCenterX);
    putU16(&payload[26], overlay->activeCenterY);
    putU16(&payload[28], overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius);
    putU16(&payload[30], overlay->deadzoneExitRadius);
    putU16(&payload[32], overlay->selectedX);
    putU16(&payload[34], overlay->selectedY);
    putU16(&payload[36], overlay->selectedSize);
    putU16(&payload[38], overlay->poseX);
    putU16(&payload[40], overlay->poseY);
    putU16(&payload[42], (uint16_t) overlay->poseHeadingQ8);
    payload[44] = overlay->selectedFlags;
    payload[45] = overlay->poseFlags;
    payload[46] = overlay->detectMode;
    *length = OBSERVER_LINK_VIEW_OVERLAY_BYTES;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodeViewOverlay(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length,
    observerLinkViewOverlay *overlay)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (overlay == NULL) ||
        (length != OBSERVER_LINK_VIEW_OVERLAY_BYTES)) return 0u;
    memset(overlay, 0, sizeof(*overlay));
    overlay->overlaySeq = getU32(&payload[0]);
    overlay->sourceFrameSeq = getU32(&payload[4]);
    overlay->ownerSession = getU32(&payload[8]);
    overlay->configRevision = getU32(&payload[12]);
    overlay->configHash = getU32(&payload[16]);
    overlay->flags = getU16(&payload[20]);
    overlay->selectedTrackId = getU16(&payload[22]);
    overlay->activeCenterX = getU16(&payload[24]);
    overlay->activeCenterY = getU16(&payload[26]);
    overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius = getU16(&payload[28]);
    overlay->deadzoneExitRadius = getU16(&payload[30]);
    overlay->selectedX = getU16(&payload[32]);
    overlay->selectedY = getU16(&payload[34]);
    overlay->selectedSize = getU16(&payload[36]);
    overlay->poseX = getU16(&payload[38]);
    overlay->poseY = getU16(&payload[40]);
    overlay->poseHeadingQ8 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[42]);
    overlay->selectedFlags = payload[44];
    overlay->poseFlags = payload[45];
    overlay->detectMode = payload[46];
    return viewOverlayIsValid(overlay);
}

uint8_t observerLinkPlanningTrackFragmentCount(uint8_t retainedCount)
{
    if (retainedCount > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return (retainedCount == 0u) ? 1u :
        (uint8_t) ((retainedCount + OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT - 1u) /
                   OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT);
}

static uint8_t planningTrackIsValid(const observerLinkPlanningTrack *track)
{
    uint8_t fresh;
    uint8_t coast;
    uint8_t edgeGrace;
    uint8_t rejected;

    if ((track == NULL) || (track->centerX >= 188u) ||
        (track->centerY >= 120u) || (track->predX >= 188u) ||
        (track->predY >= 120u) || (track->size > 22560u) ||
        (track->predSize > 22560u) || (track->trackId == 0u) ||
        (track->misses > OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_MISSES_MAX) ||
        ((track->flags & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_FRESH |
                                     OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_COAST |
                                     OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_EDGE_GRACE |
                                     OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED)) != 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    fresh = (uint8_t) ((track->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_FRESH) != 0u);
    coast = (uint8_t) ((track->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_COAST) != 0u);
    edgeGrace = (uint8_t) ((track->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_EDGE_GRACE) != 0u);
    rejected = (uint8_t) ((track->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u);
    if (rejected != 0u)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((track->flags ==
            OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) &&
            (track->centerX == 0u) && (track->centerY == 0u) &&
            (track->predX == 0u) && (track->predY == 0u) &&
            (track->size == 0u) && (track->predSize == 0u) &&
            (track->misses == 0u) && (track->velXQ7 == 0) &&
            (track->velYQ7 == 0) && (track->areaVelQ0 == 0));
    }
    if ((edgeGrace != 0u) && ((fresh != 0u) || (coast == 0u))) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (((fresh != 0u) && (track->misses == 0u) && (coast == 0u)) ||
                      ((fresh == 0u) && (track->misses != 0u) && (coast != 0u)));
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodePlanningTrackFragment(
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *snapshot,
    uint8_t fragmentIndex, uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    uint8_t fragmentCount;
    uint8_t first;
    uint8_t count;
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t ordinaryRetained = 0u;
    uint16_t offset;

    if ((snapshot == NULL) || (payload == NULL) || (length == NULL) ||
        (snapshot->valid == 0u) || (observerSourceIsValid(snapshot->sourceId) == 0u) ||
        (snapshot->detectMode > 1u) ||
        (snapshot->retainedCount > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS) ||
        (snapshot->freshTotal > snapshot->confirmedTotal) ||
        ((uint16_t) snapshot->freshLeft + snapshot->freshRight != snapshot->freshTotal))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < snapshot->retainedCount; i++)
    {
        uint8_t j;
        if (planningTrackIsValid(&snapshot->tracks[i]) == 0u) return 0u;
        if ((snapshot->tracks[i].flags &
                OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u)
            ordinaryRetained++;
        for (j = 0u; j < i; j++)
        {
            if (snapshot->tracks[j].trackId == snapshot->tracks[i].trackId)
                return 0u;
        }
    }
    if (ordinaryRetained > snapshot->confirmedTotal) return 0u;
    fragmentCount = observerLinkPlanningTrackFragmentCount(snapshot->retainedCount);
    if (fragmentIndex >= fragmentCount)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    first = (uint8_t) (fragmentIndex * OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT);
    count = (uint8_t) (snapshot->retainedCount - first);
    if (count > OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT)
    {
        count = OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT;
    }
    memset(payload, 0, OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_MAX_BYTES);
    payload[0] = snapshot->sourceId;
    payload[1] = snapshot->detectMode;
    payload[2] = (uint8_t) (OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_VALID |
        ((snapshot->truncated != 0u) ? OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_TRUNCATED : 0u));
    payload[3] = fragmentIndex;
    payload[4] = fragmentCount;
    payload[5] = first;
    payload[6] = count;
    payload[7] = snapshot->retainedCount;
    putU32(&payload[8], snapshot->ownerSession);
    putU32(&payload[12], snapshot->revision);
    putU32(&payload[16], snapshot->hash);
    putU32(&payload[20], snapshot->appFrameSeq);
    putU32(&payload[24], snapshot->captureTickMs);
    payload[28] = snapshot->confirmedTotal;
    payload[29] = snapshot->freshTotal;
    payload[30] = snapshot->freshLeft;
    payload[31] = snapshot->freshRight;
    putU32(&payload[32], snapshot->trackerFrameSeq);
    offset = OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BYTES;
    for (i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        const observerLinkPlanningTrack *track = &snapshot->tracks[first + i];
        uint8_t j;
        if (planningTrackIsValid(track) == 0u)
        {
            return 0u;
        }
        for (j = 0u; j < (uint8_t) (first + i); j++)
        {
            if (snapshot->tracks[j].trackId == track->trackId)
            {
                return 0u;
            }
        }
        payload[offset + 0u] = track->centerX;
        payload[offset + 1u] = track->centerY;
        payload[offset + 2u] = track->predX;
        payload[offset + 3u] = track->predY;
        putU16(&payload[offset + 4u], track->size);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 6u], track->predSize);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 8u], track->trackId);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 10u], (uint16_t) (track->misses |
            ((uint16_t) track->flags << 9u)));
        putU16(&payload[offset + 12u], (uint16_t) track->velXQ7);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 14u], (uint16_t) track->velYQ7);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 16u], (uint16_t) track->areaVelQ0);
        offset = (uint16_t) (offset + OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_BYTES);
    }
    *length = offset;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodePlanningTrackFragment(const uint8_t *payload,
    uint16_t length, observerLinkPlanningTrackFragment *fragment)
{
    uint8_t expectedFragments;
    uint8_t expectedFirst;
    uint8_t expectedCount;
    uint8_t i;
    uint16_t offset;

    if ((payload == NULL) || (fragment == NULL) ||
        (length < OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BYTES) ||
        (observerSourceIsValid(payload[0]) == 0u) || (payload[1] > 1u) ||
        ((payload[2] & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_VALID) == 0u) ||
        ((payload[2] & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_VALID |
                                   OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_TRUNCATED)) != 0u) ||
        (payload[7] > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS) ||
        (payload[29] > payload[28]) ||
        ((uint16_t) payload[30] + payload[31] != payload[29]))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    expectedFragments = observerLinkPlanningTrackFragmentCount(payload[7]);
    if ((payload[4] != expectedFragments) || (payload[3] >= expectedFragments))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    expectedFirst = (uint8_t) (payload[3] * OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT);
    expectedCount = (uint8_t) (payload[7] - expectedFirst);
    if (expectedCount > OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT)
    {
        expectedCount = OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT;
    }
    if ((payload[5] != expectedFirst) || (payload[6] != expectedCount) ||
        (length != (uint16_t) (OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BYTES +
                               expectedCount * OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_BYTES)))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(fragment, 0, sizeof(*fragment));
    fragment->sourceId = payload[0];
    fragment->detectMode = payload[1];
    fragment->truncated = (uint8_t) ((payload[2] & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_TRUNCATED) != 0u);
    fragment->fragmentIndex = payload[3];
    fragment->fragmentCount = payload[4];
    fragment->firstTrack = payload[5];
    fragment->trackCount = payload[6];
    fragment->retainedCount = payload[7];
    fragment->ownerSession = getU32(&payload[8]);
    fragment->revision = getU32(&payload[12]);
    fragment->hash = getU32(&payload[16]);
    fragment->appFrameSeq = getU32(&payload[20]);
    fragment->captureTickMs = getU32(&payload[24]);
    fragment->confirmedTotal = payload[28];
    fragment->freshTotal = payload[29];
    fragment->freshLeft = payload[30];
    fragment->freshRight = payload[31];
    fragment->trackerFrameSeq = getU32(&payload[32]);
    offset = OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BYTES;
    for (i = 0u; i < expectedCount; i++)
    {
        observerLinkPlanningTrack *track = &fragment->tracks[i];
        uint8_t j;
        track->centerX = payload[offset + 0u];
        track->centerY = payload[offset + 1u];
        track->predX = payload[offset + 2u];
        track->predY = payload[offset + 3u];
        track->size = getU16(&payload[offset + 4u]);
        track->predSize = getU16(&payload[offset + 6u]);
        track->trackId = getU16(&payload[offset + 8u]);
        {
            uint16_t state = getU16(&payload[offset + 10u]);
            if ((state & 0xe000u) != 0u)
            {
                return 0u;
            }
            track->misses = (uint16_t) (state & 0x01ffu);
            track->flags = (uint8_t) ((state >> 9u) & 0x0fu);
        }
        track->velXQ7 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[offset + 12u]);
        track->velYQ7 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[offset + 14u]);
        track->areaVelQ0 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[offset + 16u]);
        if (planningTrackIsValid(track) == 0u)
        {
            return 0u;
        }
        for (j = 0u; j < i; j++)
        {
            if (fragment->tracks[j].trackId == track->trackId)
            {
                return 0u;
            }
        }
        offset = (uint16_t) (offset + OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_BYTES);
    }
    return 1u;
}

/* RFC1982式32位序号比较：0保留给未初始化态，跨UINT32_MAX时仍保持半窗单调。 */
static inline uint8_t observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(
    uint32_t value, uint32_t reference)
{
    uint32_t delta = value - reference;
    return (uint8_t) ((value != 0u) && (delta != 0u) &&
                      (delta < 0x80000000u));
}

#define OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT (0u)
#define OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_ACCEPT (1u)
#define OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REBIND (2u)

/* 在线时身份不可被其它session抢占；只有接收端已进入离线栅栏后，合格HELLO
 * 才能用任意非零session（含冷启动回退/同值）重建packet序号基线。 */
static inline uint8_t observerLinkRxSessionClassify(uint8_t online,
    uint32_t currentSession, uint32_t currentPacketSeq,
    uint8_t packetSeqPrimed, uint32_t incomingSession,
    uint32_t incomingPacketSeq, uint8_t qualifiedHello)
{
    if ((incomingSession == 0u) || (incomingPacketSeq == 0u))
        return OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    if (online == 0u)
        return (qualifiedHello != 0u) ? OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REBIND : OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    if (incomingSession != currentSession)
        return OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    if ((packetSeqPrimed != 0u) &&
        (observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(incomingPacketSeq,
             currentPacketSeq) == 0u))
        return OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    return OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_ACCEPT;
}
