typedef struct
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint32_t payloadCrc32;
    uint16_t offset;
    uint16_t totalLength;
    uint8_t op;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t target;
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t length;
    uint8_t data[OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES];
} observerParamFrame;

static inline uint8_t observerParamEncode(const observerParamFrame *frame,
    uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if (frame == NULL || payload == NULL || length == NULL ||
        frame->length > OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) return 0u;
    payload[0] = frame->op;
    payload[1] = frame->slot;
    payload[2] = frame->target;
    payload[3] = frame->status;
    payload[4] = (uint8_t) frame->transactionId;
    payload[5] = (uint8_t) (frame->transactionId >> 8);
    payload[6] = (uint8_t) (frame->transactionId >> 16);
    payload[7] = (uint8_t) (frame->transactionId >> 24);
    payload[8] = (uint8_t) frame->offset;
    payload[9] = (uint8_t) (frame->offset >> 8);
    payload[10] = (uint8_t) frame->totalLength;
    payload[11] = (uint8_t) (frame->totalLength >> 8);
    payload[12] = (uint8_t) frame->payloadCrc32;
    payload[13] = (uint8_t) (frame->payloadCrc32 >> 8);
    payload[14] = (uint8_t) (frame->payloadCrc32 >> 16);
    payload[15] = (uint8_t) (frame->payloadCrc32 >> 24);
    payload[16] = frame->length;
    if (frame->length != 0u) memcpy(&payload[17], frame->data, frame->length);
    *length = (uint16_t) (OBSERVER_PARAM_HEADER_BYTES + frame->length);
    return 1u;
}

static inline uint8_t observerParamDecode(const uint8_t *payload,
    uint16_t length, observerParamFrame *frame)
{
    observerParamFrame candidate;
    if (payload == NULL || frame == NULL || length < OBSERVER_PARAM_HEADER_BYTES ||
        payload[16] > OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES ||
        length != (uint16_t) (OBSERVER_PARAM_HEADER_BYTES + payload[16])) return 0u;
    memset(&candidate, 0, sizeof(candidate));
    candidate.op = payload[0];
    candidate.slot = payload[1];
    candidate.target = payload[2];
    candidate.status = payload[3];
    candidate.transactionId = (uint32_t) payload[4] | ((uint32_t) payload[5] << 8) |
                              ((uint32_t) payload[6] << 16) | ((uint32_t) payload[7] << 24);
    candidate.offset = (uint16_t) (payload[8] | ((uint16_t) payload[9] << 8));
    candidate.totalLength = (uint16_t) (payload[10] | ((uint16_t) payload[11] << 8));
    candidate.payloadCrc32 = (uint32_t) payload[12] |
        ((uint32_t) payload[13] << 8) | ((uint32_t) payload[14] << 16) |
        ((uint32_t) payload[15] << 24);
    candidate.length = payload[16];
    if (candidate.length != 0u) memcpy(candidate.data, &payload[17], candidate.length);
    *frame = candidate;
    return 1u;
}

#include "paramSyncCoordinatorJournal.h"

#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "crc32Ieee.h"
#include "paramSyncMailbox.h"
#include "zf_driver_flash.h"

#define PARAM_COORD_MAGIC          (0x314A4350u) /* PCJ1 */
#define PARAM_COORD_VERSION        (1u)
#define PARAM_COORD_RECORD_BYTES   (32u)
#define PARAM_COORD_PAGE_A         (12u)
#define PARAM_COORD_PAGE_B         (13u)
#define PARAM_COORD_RECORD_WORDS   (PARAM_COORD_RECORD_BYTES / 4u)
#define PARAM_COORD_RECORDS_PER_PAGE (FLASH_PAGE_SIZE / PARAM_COORD_RECORD_BYTES)
#define PARAM_COORD_TARGET_MASK    (0x1Fu)

#ifndef PARAM_COORD_FLASH_ADDRESS_TYPE
#define PARAM_COORD_FLASH_ADDRESS_TYPE uint32_t
#endif

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t version;
    uint32_t recordBytes;
    uint32_t sequence;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint8_t decision;
    uint8_t targetMask;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t reserved0;
    uint32_t reserved1;
    uint32_t crc;
} paramCoordinatorRecord;

typedef char paramCoordinatorRecordSizeAssert[
    (sizeof(paramCoordinatorRecord) == PARAM_COORD_RECORD_BYTES) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char paramCoordinatorPagesExistAssert[(FLASH_PAGE_NUM >= 14u) ? 1 : -1];

static paramCoordinatorRecord g_latest;
static uint8_t g_ready;
static uint8_t g_uncertain;
static uint8_t g_committedInvalid;

static const uint32_t *flashWord(uint32_t page, uint32_t word)
{
    uintptr_t address = (uintptr_t) FLASH_BASE_ADDR +
        (uintptr_t) page * FLASH_PAGE_SIZE +
        (uintptr_t) word * sizeof(uint32_t);
    return (const uint32_t *) address;
}

static uint8_t readWord(uint32_t page, uint32_t word, uint32_t *value)
{
    cy_stc_flash_blankcheck_config_t config = {0};
    cy_en_flashdrv_status_t status;
    const uint32_t *address;
    if (page >= FLASH_PAGE_NUM || word >= FLASH_PAGE_LENGTH || value == NULL)
        return 0u;
    address = flashWord(page, word);
    config.addrToBeChecked = address;
    config.numOfWordsToBeChecked = 1u;
    status = Cy_Flash_BlankCheck(NULL, &config, CY_FLASH_DRIVER_BLOCKING);
    if (status == CY_FLASH_DRV_SUCCESS)
    {
        *value = UINT32_MAX;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (status != CY_FLASH_DRV_FLASH_NOT_ERASED) return 0u;
#if CY_CORE_CM7_0 || CY_CORE_CM7_1
    {
        uintptr_t line = ((uintptr_t) address) & ~(uintptr_t) 31u;
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((uint32_t *) line, 32);
    }
#endif
    *value = *((const volatile uint32_t *) address);
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t readRecord(uint32_t page, uint32_t index,
    paramCoordinatorRecord *record)
{
    uint32_t *words = (uint32_t *) (void *) record;
    uint32_t i;
    if (record == NULL || index >= PARAM_COORD_RECORDS_PER_PAGE) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < PARAM_COORD_RECORD_WORDS; i++)
        if (!readWord(page, index * PARAM_COORD_RECORD_WORDS + i, &words[i]))
            return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t recordValid(const paramCoordinatorRecord *record)
{
    uint32_t crc;
    if (record->magic != PARAM_COORD_MAGIC ||
        record->version != PARAM_COORD_VERSION ||
        record->recordBytes != PARAM_COORD_RECORD_BYTES ||
        record->sequence == 0u || record->reserved0 != 0u ||
        record->reserved1 != 0u ||
        (record->targetMask & (uint8_t) ~PARAM_COORD_TARGET_MASK) != 0u)
        return 0u;
    if (record->decision != PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE &&
        record->decision != PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT &&
        record->decision != PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH) return 0u;
    if (record->decision == PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE)
    {
        if (record->transactionId != 0u || record->targetMask != 0u ||
            record->slot != 0u) return 0u;
    }
    else if (record->transactionId == UINT32_MAX ||
             record->targetMask == 0u || record->slot > 5u ||
             (record->decision == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH &&
              record->targetMask != PARAM_COORD_TARGET_MASK))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) record,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(paramCoordinatorRecord, crc));
    return (uint8_t) (crc == record->crc);
}

static uint8_t recordBlank(uint32_t page, uint32_t index)
{
    uint32_t i;
    if (index >= PARAM_COORD_RECORDS_PER_PAGE) return 2u;
    for (i = 0u; i < PARAM_COORD_RECORD_WORDS; i++)
    {
        uint32_t value;
        if (!readWord(page, index * PARAM_COORD_RECORD_WORDS + i, &value))
            return 2u;
        if (value != UINT32_MAX) return 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sequenceNewer(uint32_t candidate, uint32_t reference)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((int32_t) (candidate - reference) > 0);
}

static uint8_t loadLatest(uint32_t *pageOut, uint32_t *indexOut)
{
    const uint32_t pages[2] = {PARAM_COORD_PAGE_A, PARAM_COORD_PAGE_B};
    uint8_t found = 0u;
    uint8_t committedInvalid = 0u;
    uint32_t p;
    g_committedInvalid = 0u;
    memset(&g_latest, 0, sizeof(g_latest));
    *pageOut = PARAM_COORD_PAGE_A;
    *indexOut = 0u;
    for (p = 0u; p < 2u; p++)
    {
        uint32_t index;
        for (index = 0u; index < PARAM_COORD_RECORDS_PER_PAGE; index++)
        {
            paramCoordinatorRecord candidate;
            if (!readRecord(pages[p], index, &candidate)) return 0u;
            {
                uint8_t blank = recordBlank(pages[p], index);
                if (blank == 2u) return 0u;
                if (blank == 1u) continue;
            }
            if (!recordValid(&candidate))
            {
                if (candidate.magic == PARAM_COORD_MAGIC)
                    committedInvalid = 1u;
            }
            else if (!found ||
                sequenceNewer(candidate.sequence, g_latest.sequence))
            {
                g_latest = candidate;
                *pageOut = pages[p];
                found = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    if (committedInvalid != 0u)
    {
        g_committedInvalid = 1u;
        return 0u;
    }
    {
        uint32_t index;
        for (index = 0u; index < PARAM_COORD_RECORDS_PER_PAGE; index++)
        {
            uint8_t blank = recordBlank(*pageOut, index);
            if (blank == 2u) return 0u;
            if (blank == 1u)
            {
                *indexOut = index;
                return 1u;
            }
        }
        *indexOut = PARAM_COORD_RECORDS_PER_PAGE;
    }
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t programWord(uint32_t page, uint32_t word, uint32_t value)
{
    uint32_t readback;
#if CY_CORE_CM7_0 || CY_CORE_CM7_1
    {
        uintptr_t start = ((uintptr_t) &value) & ~(uintptr_t) 31u;
        uintptr_t end = ((uintptr_t) &value + sizeof(value) + 31u) &
            ~(uintptr_t) 31u;
        SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) start,
            (int32_t) (end - start));
    }
#endif
    Cy_FlashWriteWork((PARAM_COORD_FLASH_ADDRESS_TYPE) (uintptr_t)
        flashWord(page, word), &value, CY_FLASH_DRIVER_BLOCKING);
    return (uint8_t) (readWord(page, word, &readback) && readback == value);
}

static uint8_t reloadLatest(void)
{
    uint32_t page;
    uint32_t index;
    if (!loadLatest(&page, &index))
    {
        g_ready = 0u;
        g_uncertain = 1u;
        return 0u;
    }
    g_ready = 1u;
    g_uncertain = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t reconcileRecordWrite(const paramCoordinatorRecord *expected)
{
    g_ready = 0u;
    g_uncertain = 1u;
    if (!reloadLatest()) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (recordValid(&g_latest) &&
        memcmp(&g_latest, expected, sizeof(*expected)) == 0);
}

static uint8_t appendRecord(paramCoordinatorRecord *record)
{
    uint32_t page, index, i, base;
    paramCoordinatorRecord verified;
    const uint32_t *words = (const uint32_t *) (const void *) record;
    if (g_uncertain != 0u)
    {
        if (!reloadLatest()) return 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    if (!loadLatest(&page, &index))
    {
        g_ready = 0u;
        g_uncertain = 1u;
        return 0u;
    }
    g_ready = 1u;
    if (index >= PARAM_COORD_RECORDS_PER_PAGE)
    {
        page = (page == PARAM_COORD_PAGE_A) ? PARAM_COORD_PAGE_B :
            PARAM_COORD_PAGE_A;
        if (flash_check(0u, page) != 0u) flash_erase_page(0u, page);
        index = 0u;
    }
    record->magic = PARAM_COORD_MAGIC;
    record->version = PARAM_COORD_VERSION;
    record->recordBytes = PARAM_COORD_RECORD_BYTES;
    record->sequence = g_latest.sequence + 1u;
    if (record->sequence == 0u) record->sequence = 1u;
    record->crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) record,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(paramCoordinatorRecord, crc));
    base = index * PARAM_COORD_RECORD_WORDS;
    for (i = 1u; i < PARAM_COORD_RECORD_WORDS; i++)
        if (!programWord(page, base + i, words[i]))
            return reconcileRecordWrite(record);
    if (!programWord(page, base, words[0]))
        return reconcileRecordWrite(record);
    if (!readRecord(page, index, &verified) || !recordValid(&verified) ||
        memcmp(&verified, record, sizeof(*record)) != 0)
        return reconcileRecordWrite(record);
    g_latest = verified;
    g_ready = 1u;
    g_uncertain = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t paramSyncCoordinatorJournalInit(void)
{
    paramCoordinatorRecord recovered;
    uint8_t recoveredValid;
    flash_init();
    if (reloadLatest()) return 1u;
    if (g_committedInvalid == 0u) return 0u;

    /* Magic is programmed last, so this branch is reserved for a durable but
     * internally inconsistent journal record, not a transient read failure.
     * Rebuild both coordinator-only pages from the newest independently valid
     * decision when one exists.  If none survived, use a verified NONE record;
     * library/runtime pending state remains in its own selector, so recovery
     * observes that identity and chooses ABORT.  This restores SAVE-overwrite
     * without ever treating an INVALID slot as loadable. */
    recovered = g_latest;
    recoveredValid = recordValid(&recovered);
    flash_erase_page(0u, PARAM_COORD_PAGE_A);
    flash_erase_page(0u, PARAM_COORD_PAGE_B);
    memset(&g_latest, 0, sizeof(g_latest));
    g_ready = 1u;
    g_uncertain = 0u;
    g_committedInvalid = 0u;
    if (recoveredValid == 0u) memset(&recovered, 0, sizeof(recovered));
    return appendRecord(&recovered);
}

uint8_t paramSyncCoordinatorJournalGet(paramSyncCoordinatorDecision *decision)
{
    if ((g_uncertain != 0u || g_ready == 0u) &&
        !paramSyncCoordinatorJournalInit()) return 0u;
    if (decision == NULL) return 0u;
    memset(decision, 0, sizeof(*decision));
    if (!recordValid(&g_latest) || g_latest.decision == PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE)
        return 1u;
    decision->valid = 1u;
    decision->decision = g_latest.decision;
    decision->transactionId = g_latest.transactionId;
    decision->targetMask = g_latest.targetMask;
    decision->slot = g_latest.slot;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t paramSyncCoordinatorJournalWrite(uint8_t decision,
    uint32_t transactionId, uint8_t targetMask, uint8_t slot)
{
    paramCoordinatorRecord record;
    if ((decision != PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH && decision != PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT) ||
        transactionId == UINT32_MAX ||
        targetMask == 0u ||
        (targetMask & (uint8_t) ~PARAM_COORD_TARGET_MASK) != 0u ||
        (decision == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH &&
         targetMask != PARAM_COORD_TARGET_MASK) ||
        slot > 5u) return 0u;
    memset(&record, 0, sizeof(record));
    record.decision = decision;
    record.transactionId = transactionId;
    record.targetMask = targetMask;
    record.slot = slot;
    return appendRecord(&record);
}

uint8_t paramSyncCoordinatorJournalClear(void)
{
    paramCoordinatorRecord record;
    memset(&record, 0, sizeof(record));
    return appendRecord(&record);
}

static uint32_t nextGatewayBootGeneration(void)
{
    uint32_t previous = paramSyncGatewayBootRetained;
    if ((previous == 0u) ||
        (paramSyncGatewayBootInverseRetained != ~previous)) previous = 0u;
    previous++;
    if (previous == 0u) previous = 1u;
    paramSyncGatewayBootRetained = previous;
    paramSyncGatewayBootInverseRetained = ~previous;
    return previous;
}

    if (previous == 0u ||
        paramSyncGatewayWireTransactionInverseRetained != ~previous)
        previous = 0u;
    previous++;
    if (previous == 0u || previous == UINT32_MAX) previous = 1u;
    paramSyncGatewayWireTransactionRetained = previous;
    paramSyncGatewayWireTransactionInverseRetained = ~previous;
    return previous;
}

static uint8_t externalReplayFenceActive(uint32_t now)
{
    if (externalReplayFencePrimed == 0u)
    {
        externalReplayFenceStartMs = now;
        externalReplayFencePrimed = 1u;
    }
    return (uint8_t) ((uint32_t) (now - externalReplayFenceStartMs) <
        PARAM_GATEWAY_EXTERNAL_REPLAY_FENCE_MS);
}

static void discardExternalReplayResidue(void)
{
    chassisParamFrame staleCore2;
    uartLinkFrameStruct staleCore0;
    /* 首发隔离期间尚未发送本会话请求，因此此处能读到的应答只可能
     * 属于重启前会话。每拍各消费一个，防止本地接收快照在隔离结束后
     * 与重新从 1 开始的线级事务号碰撞。 */
    (void) chassisLinkTryReadParamResponse(&staleCore2);
    (void) crossCoreLinkTakeParamResponse(&staleCore0);
}

static void putU16(uint8_t* p, uint16_t v)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t) v;
    p[1] = (uint8_t) (v >> 8);
}
static void putU32(uint8_t* p, uint32_t v)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t) v;
    p[1] = (uint8_t) (v >> 8);
    p[2] = (uint8_t) (v >> 16);
    p[3] = (uint8_t) (v >> 24);
}
static uint16_t getU16(const uint8_t* p)
{
    return (uint16_t) (p[0] | ((uint16_t) p[1] << 8));
}
static uint32_t getU32(const uint8_t* p)
{
    return (uint32_t) p[0] | ((uint32_t) p[1] << 8) | ((uint32_t) p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t) p[3] << 24);
}

static uint8_t sequenceAdvances(uint32_t candidate, uint32_t current)
{
    return (uint8_t) (candidate != 0u &&
        (current == 0u || (int32_t) (candidate - current) > 0));
}

static uint8_t requestShapeValid(const paramSyncGatewayFrame *frame)
{
    if (frame == NULL || frame->session == 0u || frame->sequence == 0u ||
        frame->flags != 0u) return 0u;
    switch (frame->messageType)
    {
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_HELLO:
            return (uint8_t) (frame->target == 0xFFu &&
                frame->payloadLength == 4u &&
                getU32(frame->payload) == frame->session);
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_ENUM_TARGETS:
            return (uint8_t) (frame->target == 0xFFu &&
                frame->payloadLength == 0u);
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_META:
            return (uint8_t) (frame->target < 5u &&
                frame->payloadLength == 1u && frame->payload[0] >= 1u &&
                frame->payload[0] <= 5u);
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_CHUNK:
            return (uint8_t) (frame->target < 5u &&
                frame->payloadLength == 5u && frame->payload[0] >= 1u &&
                frame->payload[0] <= 5u && getU16(&frame->payload[3]) != 0u);
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_RUNTIME_META:
            return (uint8_t) (frame->target < 5u &&
                frame->payloadLength == 0u);
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK:
            return (uint8_t) (frame->target < 5u &&
                frame->payloadLength == 4u && getU16(&frame->payload[2]) != 0u);
        default:
            return 0u;
    }
}

static uint8_t mailboxResponseFresh(const paramSyncMailboxResponse *response)
{
    uint8_t target;
    if (response == NULL || response->target >= 5u ||
        (response->target != 1u && response->target != 3u &&
         response->target != 4u) || response->producerBootGeneration == 0u ||
        response->sequence == 0u) return 0u;
    target = response->target;
    if (mailboxResponseBoot[target] == response->producerBootGeneration)
    {
        if (sequenceAdvances(response->sequence,
                mailboxResponseSequence[target]) == 0u) return 0u;
    }
    mailboxResponseBoot[target] = response->producerBootGeneration;
    mailboxResponseSequence[target] = response->sequence;
    return 1u;
}

static uint32_t runtimeLoadTransactionId(
    const paramSyncGatewayFrame *request, uint8_t slot)
{
    uint32_t transactionId = gatewayBoot ^ request->session ^
        request->sequence ^ ((uint32_t) slot << 24) ^ 0x52554E54u;
    if (transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX)
        transactionId = 1u;
    return transactionId;
}

uint32_t paramSyncGatewayCrc32(const uint8_t* d, uint16_t n)
{
    uint32_t c = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    uint16_t i;
    uint8_t b;
    if (!d) return 0u;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
    {
        c ^= d[i];
        for (b = 0; b < 8; b++) c = (c & 1u) ? ((c >> 1) ^ 0xEDB88320u) : (c >> 1);
    }
    return ~c;
}

static uint16_t cobsEncode(const uint8_t* i, uint16_t n, uint8_t* o, uint16_t cap)
{
    uint16_t r = 0, w = 1, ci = 0;
    uint8_t c = 1;
    if (!i || !o || cap < 2) return 0;
    while (r < n)
    {
        if (i[r] == 0)
        {
            o[ci] = c;
            c = 1;
            ci = w++;
            r++;
            if (w > cap) return 0;
        }
        else
        {
            if (w >= cap) return 0;
            o[w++] = i[r++];
            c++;
            if (c == 0xFF)
            {
                o[ci] = c;
                c = 1;
                ci = w++;
                if (w > cap) return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    o[ci] = c;
    return w;
}
static uint16_t cobsDecode(const uint8_t* i, uint16_t n, uint8_t* o, uint16_t cap)
{
    uint16_t r = 0, w = 0;
    while (r < n)
    {
        uint8_t c = i[r++], j;
        if (!c) return 0;
        for (j = 1; j < c; j++)
        {
            if (r >= n || w >= cap) return 0;
            o[w++] = i[r++];
        }
        if (c != 0xFF && r < n)
        {
            if (w >= cap) return 0;
            o[w++] = 0;
        }
    }
    return w;
}

uint16_t paramSyncGatewayEncode(const paramSyncGatewayFrame* f, uint8_t* out, uint16_t cap)
{
    uint8_t raw[PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_WIRE_MAX];
    uint16_t rn, en;
    if (!f || !out || cap < 2 || f->payloadLength > PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_PAYLOAD_MAX) return 0;
    rn = (uint16_t) (PARAM_GATEWAY_HEADER_BYTES + f->payloadLength + 4u);
    putU32(raw, PARAM_GATEWAY_MAGIC);
    raw[4] = PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_MAJOR;
    raw[5] = PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_MINOR;
    raw[6] = f->messageType;
    raw[7] = f->target;
    putU32(&raw[8], f->session);
    putU32(&raw[12], f->sequence);
    putU32(&raw[16], f->flags);
    putU16(&raw[20], f->payloadLength);
    memcpy(&raw[22], f->payload, f->payloadLength);
    putU32(&raw[22u + f->payloadLength], paramSyncGatewayCrc32(raw, (uint16_t) (22u + f->payloadLength)));
    en = cobsEncode(raw, rn, out, (uint16_t) (cap - 1u));
    if (!en || en >= cap) return 0;
    out[en++] = 0;
    return en;
}

uint8_t paramSyncGatewayDecode(const uint8_t* in, uint16_t n, paramSyncGatewayFrame* f)
{
    uint8_t raw[PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_WIRE_MAX];
    paramSyncGatewayFrame x;
    uint16_t rn, pn;
    if (!in || !f || !n) return 0;
    rn = cobsDecode(in, n, raw, sizeof(raw));
    if (rn < 26u) return 0;
    pn = getU16(&raw[20]);
    if (getU32(raw) != PARAM_GATEWAY_MAGIC || raw[4] != PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_MAJOR || raw[5] > PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_MINOR ||
        pn > PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_PAYLOAD_MAX || rn != (uint16_t) (22u + pn + 4u) ||
        getU32(&raw[22u + pn]) != paramSyncGatewayCrc32(raw, (uint16_t) (22u + pn))) return 0;
    memset(&x, 0, sizeof(x));
    x.messageType = raw[6];
    x.target = raw[7];
    x.session = getU32(&raw[8]);
    x.sequence = getU32(&raw[12]);
    x.flags = getU32(&raw[16]);
    x.payloadLength = pn;
    memcpy(x.payload, &raw[22], pn);
    *f = x;
    return 1;
}
