static void sendFrame(paramSyncGatewayFrame* f)
{
    uint16_t n = paramSyncGatewayEncode(f, txEncodedFrame,
        sizeof(txEncodedFrame));
    if (n) uart_write_buffer(UART_0, txEncodedFrame, n);
}
static void sendError(const paramSyncGatewayFrame* r, const char* msg)
{
    paramSyncGatewayFrame x = *r;
    uint16_t n = 0;
    x.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_ERROR;
    while (msg[n] && n < PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_PAYLOAD_MAX)
    {
        x.payload[n] = (uint8_t) msg[n];
        n++;
    }
    x.payloadLength = n;
    sendFrame(&x);
}
static uint8_t responseType(uint8_t request)
{
    if (request == PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_META) return PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_META;
    if (request == PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_CHUNK) return PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_CHUNK;
    if (request == PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_RUNTIME_META)
        return PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_RUNTIME_META;
    if (request == PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK)
        return PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_RUNTIME_CHUNK;
    if (request == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_READ_TRANSACTION_STATUS)
        return PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_TRANSACTION_STATUS;
    return PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACK;
}

/* This predicate is consumed by the normal control path.  It deliberately
 * describes only whether the coordinator can guarantee that no parameter
 * mutation/recovery is in flight.  Flight/drive state and the current online
 * target mask are mutation-entry preconditions, not reasons to suppress the
 * normal Core1 control bridge. */
static uint8_t mutationStagingEmpty(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (globalTouchedMask == 0u &&
        globalPreparedMask == 0u && globalCommittedMask == 0u &&
        globalFinishRequired == 0u && prepareIntentPending == 0u);
}

static uint8_t runtimeCoordinatorReady(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE &&
        recoveryDiscoveryDone != 0u && recoveryTargetMask == 0u &&
        gatewayCleanupFailed == 0u && mutationStagingEmpty() != 0u);
}

static uint8_t mutationMenuReady(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (runtimeCoordinatorReady() != 0u &&
        globalTerminal == 0u && activeSession == 0u &&
        requestPending == 0u &&
        paramSyncGatewayPlatformTargetMask() == PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK);
}

uint8_t paramSyncGatewayGlobalReady(void)
{
    return runtimeCoordinatorReady();
}

uint8_t paramSyncGatewayGetGlobalState(paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    if (state == NULL ||
        paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(&publishedGlobalState) == 0u)
        return 0u;
    *state = publishedGlobalState;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t publicGlobalPhase(void)
{
    if (globalPhase != PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE &&
        globalAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE)
        return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_RECOVERING;
    switch (globalPhase)
    {
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_REQUESTED;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_LOCKING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_VERIFY_LOCK: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_PREPARING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_INSPECT_LIBRARY: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_PREPARING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY:
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_PREPARING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT:
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_COMMITTING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_APPLYING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_DECIDE: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_DECIDING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FINISHING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_ABORTING;
        case PARAM_GLOBAL_RECOVERY: return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_RECOVERING;
        default:
            if (globalTerminal != 0u)
                return globalTerminalOk != 0u ? PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_SUCCEEDED :
                    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED;
            return mutationMenuReady() != 0u ? PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_READY :
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_UNINITIALIZED;
    }
}

static uint32_t packFailureDiagnostic(uint8_t phase, uint8_t op,
    uint8_t status, uint8_t detail)
{
    return (uint32_t) op | ((uint32_t) status << 8) |
        ((uint32_t) phase << 16) | ((uint32_t) detail << 24);
}

static void publishGlobalState(uint32_t nowMs, uint8_t force)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState next;
    memset(&next, 0, sizeof(next));
    next.coordinatorBootGeneration = gatewayBoot;
    next.requestBootGeneration = globalRequest.session;
    next.requestSequence = globalRequest.sequence;
    next.transactionId = globalTransactionId;
    next.origin = globalOrigin;
    next.action = globalAction;
    next.slot = globalSlot;
    next.phase = publicGlobalPhase();
    next.target = 0xFFu;
    next.error = globalStateError;
    next.readyMask = paramSyncGatewayPlatformTargetMask();
    if (next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_UNINITIALIZED ||
        next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_READY)
    {
        next.requestBootGeneration = 0u;
        next.requestSequence = 0u;
        next.transactionId = 0u;
        next.origin = 0xFFu;
        next.action = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
        next.slot = 0u;
        next.target = 0xFFu;
        next.error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    }
    else if (next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_RECOVERING)
    {
        next.requestBootGeneration = 0u;
        next.requestSequence = 0u;
        next.origin = 0xFFu;
        next.action = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
        next.slot = 0u;
        next.target = 0xFFu;
        next.error = (globalStateError == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE) ?
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE : PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY;
    }
    else if (next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED)
    {
        next.target = globalStateFailedTarget;
        next.transactionId = globalFailureDiagnostic;
    }
    else if (next.phase >= PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_REQUESTED &&
        next.phase <= PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_ABORTING)
        next.target = (globalTarget <= 4u) ? globalTarget : 0xFFu;
    if (next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_READY)
        next.flags = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_READY;
    else if (next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_RECOVERING)
        next.flags = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY |
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY;
    else if (next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_SUCCEEDED)
        next.flags = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL |
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_OK;
    else if (next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED)
        next.flags = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL;
    else if (next.phase != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_UNINITIALIZED)
        next.flags = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY;
    if (runtimeCoordinatorReady() != 0u)
        next.flags |= PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY;
    next.sequence = publishedGlobalState.sequence;
    if (force == 0u && memcmp(&next, &publishedGlobalState, sizeof(next)) == 0 &&
        (uint32_t) (nowMs - globalStateLastPublishMs) < 50u) return;
    globalStateSequence++;
    if (globalStateSequence == 0u) globalStateSequence = 1u;
    next.sequence = globalStateSequence;
    publishedGlobalState = next;
    globalStateLastPublishMs = nowMs;
    if (next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_SUCCEEDED ||
        next.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED)
    {
        if (globalTerminalPublished == 0u)
        {
            globalTerminalPublished = 1u;
            globalTerminalPublishedMs = nowMs;
        }
    }
    else
        globalTerminalPublished = 0u;
    coreDataWriteParamGlobalState(&next);
    crossCoreLinkPublishParamGlobalState(&next);
}

static uint8_t requestOp(uint8_t messageType)
{
    switch (messageType)
    {
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_META: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_CHUNK: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_CHUNK;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_RUNTIME_META:
            return PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_META;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK:
            return PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PREPARE_BEGIN: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_BEGIN;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PREPARE_CHUNK: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_CHUNK;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PREPARE_FINISH: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_VERIFY;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_COMMIT: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACTIVATE: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_ACTIVATE;
        case PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT;
        default: return PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE;
    }
}

static uint8_t routeMailbox(const paramSyncGatewayFrame* f)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest r;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof(r));
    mailboxSequence++;
    if (!mailboxSequence) mailboxSequence = 1;
    r.producerBootGeneration = gatewayBoot;
    r.sequence = mailboxSequence;
    r.transactionId = f->session;
    /* offset is an internal request nonce echoed verbatim by every owner.
     * It must not reuse the PC sequence, because a reconnect may repeat the
     * same public session/sequence tuple while a retained response remains. */
    r.offset = mailboxSequence;
    r.payloadCrc32 = f->flags;
    r.dataLength = f->payloadLength;
    r.op = currentInternalOp;
    r.slot = f->payloadLength ? f->payload[0] : 0u;
    r.target = f->target;
    memcpy(r.data, f->payload, f->payloadLength);
    if (paramSyncMailboxPublishRequest(&r) == 0u) return 0u;
    pendingMailboxSequence = r.sequence;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t startCore2Request(const paramSyncGatewayFrame* f)
{
    uint8_t op = currentInternalOp;
    if (op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE) return 0u;
    memset(&externalWire, 0, sizeof(externalWire));
    externalWire.requestId = nextGatewayWireTransactionId();
    externalWire.offset = f->payloadLength;
    externalWire.op = op;
    externalWire.reserved = 0u;
    externalWire.target = PARAM_GATEWAY_CORE2_TARGET;
    externalWire.status = CHASSIS_PARAM_TRANSPORT_BEGIN;
    externalRequestOffset = 0u;
    externalResponseLength = 0u;
    externalRetryCount = 0u;
    externalSendPending = 1u;
    externalState = PARAM_EXT_WAIT_BEGIN;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t startCore0Request(const paramSyncGatewayFrame* f)
{
    uint8_t op = currentInternalOp;
    if (op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE) return 0u;
    memset(&core0Wire, 0, sizeof(core0Wire));
    core0Wire.paramRequestId = nextGatewayWireTransactionId();
    core0Wire.paramOffset = f->payloadLength;
    core0Wire.paramOp = op;
    core0Wire.paramReserved = 0u;
    core0Wire.paramTarget = 0u;
    core0Wire.paramStatus = UART_LINK_PARAM_TRANSPORT_BEGIN;
    core0RequestOffset = 0u;
    core0ResponseLength = 0u;
    core0RetryCount = 0u;
    core0SendPending = 1u;
    core0State = PARAM_EXT_WAIT_BEGIN;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t core2ReplyStatusValid(uint8_t rawStatus)
{
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t transport;
    if (rawStatus == CHASSIS_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART) return 1u;
    status = (uint8_t) (rawStatus & CHASSIS_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    transport = (uint8_t) (rawStatus &
        (uint8_t) ~CHASSIS_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    return (uint8_t) (status <= PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED &&
        (transport == 0u || transport == CHASSIS_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE));
}

static uint8_t core2ReplyMatchesCurrentPhase(
    const chassisParamFrame *reply)
{
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t more;
    if (reply == 0 || reply->requestId != externalWire.requestId ||
        reply->reserved != 0u ||
        reply->target != PARAM_GATEWAY_CORE2_TARGET ||
        core2ReplyStatusValid(reply->status) == 0u) return 0u;
    status = (uint8_t) (reply->status & CHASSIS_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    more = (uint8_t) (reply->status & CHASSIS_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE);
    if (externalState == PARAM_EXT_WAIT_BEGIN ||
        externalState == PARAM_EXT_WAIT_DATA)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (reply->status != CHASSIS_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART &&
            status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK && more == 0u &&
            reply->op == currentInternalOp &&
            reply->offset == externalWire.offset && reply->length == 0u);
    }
    if (externalState != PARAM_EXT_WAIT_POLL ||
        reply->offset != externalResponseLength) return 0u;
    if (reply->status == CHASSIS_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (reply->op == CHASSIS_PARAM_OP_POLL &&
            reply->length == 0u);
    }
    if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (reply->status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING &&
            reply->op == CHASSIS_PARAM_OP_POLL && reply->length == 0u);
    }
    if (reply->op == CHASSIS_PARAM_OP_POLL)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((reply->status == CHASSIS_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART ||
            (status >= PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_REJECTED &&
             status <= PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED)) &&
            more == 0u && reply->length == 0u);
    }
    if (reply->op != currentInternalOp ||
        (uint32_t) externalResponseLength + reply->length >
            sizeof(externalResponse)) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) ((more != 0u) ?
        (reply->length == CHASSIS_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) :
        (reply->length <= CHASSIS_PARAM_DATA_BYTES));
}

static uint8_t core0ReplyStatusValid(uint8_t rawStatus)
{
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t transport;
    if (rawStatus == UART_LINK_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART) return 1u;
    status = (uint8_t) (rawStatus & UART_LINK_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    transport = (uint8_t) (rawStatus &
        (uint8_t) ~UART_LINK_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    return (uint8_t) (status <= PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED &&
        (transport == 0u || transport == UART_LINK_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE));
}

static uint8_t core0ReplyMatchesCurrentPhase(
    const uartLinkFrameStruct *reply)
{
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t more;
    if (reply == 0 ||
        reply->paramRequestId != core0Wire.paramRequestId ||
        reply->paramReserved != 0u || reply->paramTarget != 0u ||
        core0ReplyStatusValid(reply->paramStatus) == 0u) return 0u;
    status = (uint8_t) (reply->paramStatus & UART_LINK_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    more = (uint8_t) (reply->paramStatus & UART_LINK_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE);
    if (core0State == PARAM_EXT_WAIT_BEGIN ||
        core0State == PARAM_EXT_WAIT_DATA)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (reply->paramStatus !=
                UART_LINK_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART &&
            status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK && more == 0u &&
            reply->paramOp == currentInternalOp &&
            reply->paramOffset == core0Wire.paramOffset &&
            reply->paramLength == 0u);
    }
    if (core0State != PARAM_EXT_WAIT_POLL ||
        reply->paramOffset != core0ResponseLength) return 0u;
    if (reply->paramStatus == UART_LINK_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (reply->paramOp == UART_LINK_PARAM_OP_POLL &&
            reply->paramLength == 0u);
    }
    if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (reply->paramStatus == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING &&
            reply->paramOp == UART_LINK_PARAM_OP_POLL &&
            reply->paramLength == 0u);
    }
    if (reply->paramOp == UART_LINK_PARAM_OP_POLL)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((reply->paramStatus ==
                UART_LINK_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART ||
            (status >= PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_REJECTED &&
             status <= PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED)) &&
            more == 0u && reply->paramLength == 0u);
    }
    if (reply->paramOp != currentInternalOp ||
        (uint32_t) core0ResponseLength + reply->paramLength >
            sizeof(core0Response)) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) ((more != 0u) ?
        (reply->paramLength == UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) :
        (reply->paramLength <= UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES));
}

static void completeExternal(uint8_t status)
{
    externalState = PARAM_EXT_IDLE;
    externalSendPending = 0u;
    core0State = PARAM_EXT_IDLE;
    core0SendPending = 0u;
    finishRequest(status, 0u, externalResponse, externalResponseLength);
}

static uint8_t dispatchPendingRequest(void)
{
    if (pendingRequest.target == 0u)
        return startCore0Request(&pendingRequest);
    if (pendingRequest.target == PARAM_GATEWAY_CORE2_TARGET)
        return startCore2Request(&pendingRequest);
    if (pendingRequest.target == 1u || pendingRequest.target == 3u ||
        pendingRequest.target == 4u)
        return routeMailbox(&pendingRequest);
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t startPrepareIntent(const paramSyncGatewayFrame *request)
{
    uint8_t targetMask = (uint8_t) (globalTouchedMask |
        (uint8_t) (1u << request->target));
    uint32_t transactionId = getU32(&request->payload[1]);
    deferredPrepareRequest = *request;
    pendingRequest = *request;
    pendingRequest.target = 1u;
    pendingRequest.payloadLength = 7u;
    pendingRequest.payload[0] = PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT;
    pendingRequest.payload[1] = request->payload[0];
    putU32(&pendingRequest.payload[2], transactionId);
    pendingRequest.payload[6] = targetMask;
    currentInternalOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_DECIDE;
    if (!routeMailbox(&pendingRequest)) return 0u;
    prepareIntentPending = 1u;
    requestPending = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t dispatchGlobalCurrent(void)
{
    pendingRequest = globalRequest;
    pendingRequest.target = globalTarget;
    pendingRequest.flags = 0u;
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT || globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK ||
        globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY ||
        globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME ||
        globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME ||
        globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE)
    {
        pendingRequest.messageType =
            (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT) ? PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_COMMIT :
            PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACTIVATE;
        pendingRequest.payloadLength = 5u;
        pendingRequest.payload[0] = globalSlot;
        putU32(&pendingRequest.payload[1], globalTransactionId);
        currentInternalOp =
            (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT) ? PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT :
            (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK) ? PARAM_SYNC_OP_LOCK :
            (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY) ?
                PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_LIBRARY_FROM_LIVE :
            (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME) ?
                PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_RUNTIME_FROM_SLOT :
            (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME) ?
                PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT_RUNTIME : PARAM_SYNC_OP_APPLY_RUNTIME;
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT)
    {
        pendingRequest.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT;
        pendingRequest.payloadLength = 7u;
        pendingRequest.payload[0] = PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT;
        pendingRequest.payload[1] = globalSlot;
        putU32(&pendingRequest.payload[2], globalTransactionId);
        pendingRequest.payload[6] = globalTargetMask;
        currentInternalOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_DECIDE;
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_VERIFY_LOCK)
    {
        pendingRequest.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_META;
        pendingRequest.payloadLength = 1u;
        pendingRequest.payload[0] = globalSlot;
        currentInternalOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META;
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
    {
        pendingRequest.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_READ_META;
        pendingRequest.payloadLength = 1u;
        pendingRequest.payload[0] = globalSlot;
        currentInternalOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META;
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_DECIDE)
    {
        pendingRequest.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_COMMIT;
        pendingRequest.payloadLength = 7u;
        pendingRequest.payload[0] = PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH;
        pendingRequest.payload[1] = globalSlot;
        putU32(&pendingRequest.payload[2], globalTransactionId);
        pendingRequest.payload[6] = globalTargetMask;
        currentInternalOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_DECIDE;
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_RECOVERY)
    {
        pendingRequest.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT;
        pendingRequest.payloadLength = 0u;
        currentInternalOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_RECOVERY;
    }
    else
    {
        pendingRequest.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT;
        pendingRequest.payloadLength = 4u;
        putU32(pendingRequest.payload, globalTransactionId);
        currentInternalOp = (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH) ? PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH : PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT;
    }
    if (!dispatchPendingRequest()) return 0u;
    requestPending = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

static void sendGlobalFinal(uint8_t status, const char* error)
{
    paramSyncGatewayFrame response = globalRequest;
    uint16_t length = 0u;
    if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK)
    {
        response.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACK;
        response.payloadLength = 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        response.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_ERROR;
        while (error != NULL && error[length] != '\0' &&
               length < PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_PAYLOAD_MAX)
        {
            response.payload[length] = (uint8_t) error[length];
            length++;
        }
        response.payloadLength = length;
    }
    if (globalSilent != 0u)
    {
        if (globalBoardInitiated == 0u)
            gatewayCleanupFailed = (uint8_t) (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK);
        globalSilent = 0u;
    }
    else
        sendFrame(&response);
    if (globalAction != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE &&
        globalRequest.session != 0u && globalRequest.sequence != 0u)
    {
        globalTerminal = 1u;
        globalTerminalOk = (uint8_t) (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK);
        globalTerminalObservedByPc = 0u;
        if (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK &&
            globalStateError == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE)
            globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_STORAGE;
    }
    else
    {
        globalTerminal = 0u;
        globalTerminalOk = 0u;
        globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
        globalStateFailedTarget = 0xFFu;
        globalTransactionId = 0u;
        globalSlot = 0u;
        globalOrigin = 0xFFu;
        globalAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
        globalRequest.session = 0u;
        globalRequest.sequence = 0u;
    }
    requestPending = 0u;
    globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE;
    globalBoardInitiated = 0u;
}

static uint8_t recoveryDecisionValid(uint8_t op, uint32_t transactionId,
    uint8_t targetMask)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT ||
        op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH) && transactionId != UINT32_MAX &&
        targetMask != 0u &&
        (targetMask & (uint8_t) ~PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK) == 0u &&
        (op != PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH ||
         targetMask == PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK));
}

static void persistRecoveryDecision(uint8_t op, uint32_t transactionId,
    uint8_t targetMask)
{
    uint32_t word;
    if (op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE)
    {
        paramSyncGatewayRecoveryRetained = 0u;
        paramSyncGatewayRecoveryInverseRetained = UINT32_MAX;
        paramSyncGatewayRecoveryTransactionRetained = 0u;
        paramSyncGatewayRecoveryTransactionInverseRetained = UINT32_MAX;
        return;
    }
    if (recoveryDecisionValid(op, transactionId, targetMask) == 0u)
        return;
    word = PARAM_GATEWAY_RECOVERY_MAGIC | ((uint32_t) op << 8) | targetMask;
    paramSyncGatewayRecoveryRetained = 0u;
    paramSyncGatewayRecoveryInverseRetained = UINT32_MAX;
    paramSyncGatewayRecoveryTransactionRetained = transactionId;
    paramSyncGatewayRecoveryTransactionInverseRetained = ~transactionId;
    paramSyncGatewayRecoveryRetained = word;
    paramSyncGatewayRecoveryInverseRetained = ~word;
}

static uint8_t loadRecoveryDecision(uint8_t *op, uint32_t *transactionId,
    uint8_t *targetMask)
{
    uint32_t word = paramSyncGatewayRecoveryRetained;
    uint8_t storedOp;
    uint8_t storedMask;
    if (paramSyncGatewayRecoveryInverseRetained != ~word ||
        paramSyncGatewayRecoveryTransactionInverseRetained !=
            ~paramSyncGatewayRecoveryTransactionRetained ||
        (word & 0xFFFF0000u) != PARAM_GATEWAY_RECOVERY_MAGIC)
        return 0u;
    storedOp = (uint8_t) (word >> 8);
    storedMask = (uint8_t) word;
    if (recoveryDecisionValid(storedOp,
        paramSyncGatewayRecoveryTransactionRetained, storedMask) == 0u)
        return 0u;
    *op = storedOp;
    *transactionId = paramSyncGatewayRecoveryTransactionRetained;
    *targetMask = storedMask;
    return 1u;
}

static void rememberRecovery(uint8_t op, uint32_t transactionId,
    uint8_t targetMask)
{
    if (recoveryDecisionValid(op, transactionId, targetMask) == 0u)
    {
        gatewayCleanupFailed = 1u;
        return;
    }
    recoveryOp = op;
    recoveryTransactionId = transactionId;
    recoveryTargetMask = targetMask;
    gatewayCleanupFailed = 1u;
    persistRecoveryDecision(op, transactionId, targetMask);
}

static void clearRecovery(void)
{
    recoveryOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE;
    recoveryTransactionId = 0u;
    recoveryTargetMask = 0u;
    gatewayCleanupFailed = 0u;
    persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE, 0u, 0u);
}

static uint8_t firstGlobalTarget(paramGlobalPhase phase, uint8_t mask)
{
    static const uint8_t forwardOrder[5] = {1u, 0u, 2u, 3u, 4u};
    static const uint8_t cleanupOrder[5] = {0u, 2u, 3u, 4u, 1u};
    const uint8_t *order = (phase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH ||
        phase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT) ? cleanupOrder : forwardOrder;
    uint8_t i;
    for (i = 0u; i < 5u; i++)
        if ((mask & (uint8_t) (1u << order[i])) != 0u) return order[i];
    return 5u;
}

static uint8_t nextGlobalTarget(paramGlobalPhase phase, uint8_t mask,
    uint8_t current)
{
    static const uint8_t forwardOrder[5] = {1u, 0u, 2u, 3u, 4u};
    static const uint8_t cleanupOrder[5] = {0u, 2u, 3u, 4u, 1u};
    const uint8_t *order = (phase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH ||
        phase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT) ? cleanupOrder : forwardOrder;
    uint8_t i, seen = 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < 5u; i++)
    {
        if (seen && (mask & (uint8_t) (1u << order[i])) != 0u)
            return order[i];
        if (order[i] == current) seen = 1u;
    }
    return 5u;
}

static uint8_t restartAfterConflictRecovery(void)
{
    clearRecovery();
    globalConflictCleanupActive = 0u;
    globalTransactionId = globalConflictRetryTransactionId;
    globalSlot = globalRequest.payload[0];
    globalTargetMask = PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK;
    globalTouchedMask = 0u;
    globalPreparedMask = 0u;
    globalCommittedMask = 0u;
    globalFailedMask = 0u;
    globalOperationFailed = 0u;
    globalFinishRequired = 1u;
    globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    globalStateFailedTarget = 0xFFu;
    globalFailureDiagnostic = 0u;
    globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT;
    persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, globalTransactionId,
        globalTargetMask);
    globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
    return dispatchGlobalCurrent();
}

static void advanceGlobal(void)
{
    uint8_t next;
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_DECIDE)
    {
        persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH, globalTransactionId,
            globalTargetMask);
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT)
    {
        persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, globalTransactionId,
            globalTargetMask);
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
        return;
    }
    next = nextGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask, globalTarget);
    if (next < 5u)
    {
        globalTarget = next;
        /* Core1 owns the durable coordinator journal and is deliberately the
         * last cleanup participant.  If any earlier FINISH failed, do not let
         * Core1 clear that journal: retain the full FINISH decision and replay
         * every participant after recovery instead. */
        if ((globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH ||
             globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT) && (next == 1u) &&
            (globalFailedMask != 0u))
        {
            globalFailedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << 1);
            advanceGlobal();
            return;
        }
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK)
    {
        if (globalAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY)
            globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY;
        else if (globalAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME)
            globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_VERIFY_LOCK;
        else
            globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_VERIFY_LOCK)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE;
        globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT || globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_DECIDE;
        globalTarget = 1u;
        if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
            finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH)
    {
        if (globalFailedMask != 0u)
            rememberRecovery(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH, globalTransactionId,
                globalTargetMask);
        else
            clearRecovery();
        globalCommittedMask = globalFailedMask;
        globalTouchedMask = 0u;
        globalPreparedMask = 0u;
        globalFinishRequired = 0u;
        if (globalFailedMask == 0u &&
            globalConflictCleanupActive != 0u)
        {
            if (restartAfterConflictRecovery() == 0u)
                sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "RETRY_ROUTE");
            return;
        }
        sendGlobalFinal(globalFailedMask ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK,
            globalFailedMask ? "FINISH" : NULL);
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT)
    {
        uint8_t abortFailed = (uint8_t) (globalFailedMask != 0u);
        uint8_t responseFailed;
        if (abortFailed)
            rememberRecovery(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, globalTransactionId,
                globalTargetMask);
        else
            clearRecovery();
        globalCommittedMask &= globalFailedMask;
        globalTouchedMask &= globalFailedMask;
        globalPreparedMask &= globalFailedMask;
        globalFinishRequired = 0u;
        if (abortFailed == 0u && globalConflictCleanupActive != 0u)
        {
            if (restartAfterConflictRecovery() == 0u)
                sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "RETRY_ROUTE");
            return;
        }
        /* A successful rollback does not turn the operation which triggered it
         * into success.  Board-originated transactions are intentionally
         * silent on UART, but still need a FAILED terminal state. */
        responseFailed = (uint8_t) (abortFailed || globalOperationFailed);
        sendGlobalFinal(responseFailed ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK,
            abortFailed ? "ROLLBACK" : (responseFailed ? "ABORTED" : NULL));
    }
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
    {
        globalTransactionId = paramSyncGlobalPackSlotSummary(
            globalSlotValidMask, globalSlotEmptyMask, globalSlotInvalidMask);
        if (globalTransactionId == 0u)
        {
            globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INVALID;
            sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "INSPECT");
        }
        else
            sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL);
    }
    else
    {
        sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL);
    }
}

static void finishRequest(uint8_t status, uint32_t crc,
    const uint8_t* data, uint16_t length)
{
    if (prepareIntentPending != 0u)
    {
        paramSyncGatewayFrame original = deferredPrepareRequest;
        uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << original.target);
        uint32_t transactionId = getU32(&original.payload[1]);
        prepareIntentPending = 0u;
        requestPending = 0u;
        if (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK)
        {
            sendError(&original, "INTENT");
            return;
        }
        globalTouchedMask |= bit;
        targetPreparedSlot[original.target] = original.payload[0];
        targetTransactionId[original.target] = transactionId;
        persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, transactionId,
            globalTouchedMask);
        pendingRequest = original;
        currentInternalOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_BEGIN;
        if (!dispatchPendingRequest())
        {
            sendError(&original, "ROUTE");
            return;
        }
        requestPending = 1u;
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE)
    {
        paramSyncGatewayFrame response = pendingRequest;
        response.messageType = (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK) ? responseType(pendingRequest.messageType) : PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_ERROR;
        response.flags = crc;
        response.payloadLength = length;
        if (data != NULL && length != 0u) memcpy(response.payload, data, length);
        if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK && pendingRequest.target < 5u)
        {
            uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << pendingRequest.target);
            if (pendingRequest.messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PREPARE_BEGIN &&
                pendingRequest.payloadLength == 19u)
            {
                globalTouchedMask |= bit;
                targetPreparedSlot[pendingRequest.target] = pendingRequest.payload[0];
                targetTransactionId[pendingRequest.target] =
                    getU32(&pendingRequest.payload[1]);
            }
            else if (pendingRequest.messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PREPARE_FINISH)
                globalPreparedMask |= bit;
            else if (pendingRequest.messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT)
            {
                globalTouchedMask &= (uint8_t) ~bit;
                globalPreparedMask &= (uint8_t) ~bit;
                globalCommittedMask &= (uint8_t) ~bit;
                if ((globalTouchedMask | globalPreparedMask |
                     globalCommittedMask) == 0u) clearRecovery();
            }
        }
        sendFrame(&response);
        requestPending = 0u;
        return;
    }

    if (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK && globalPhase != PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE &&
        globalFailureDiagnostic == 0u)
    {
        uint8_t detail = (uint8_t) ((data != NULL && length >= 1u) ?
            data[0] : 0u);
        globalFailureDiagnostic = packFailureDiagnostic((uint8_t) globalPhase,
            currentInternalOp, status, detail);
    }
    if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED &&
        globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT && globalTarget == 1u &&
        currentInternalOp == PARAM_SYNC_OP_DECIDE && data != NULL &&
        length == 8u && data[0] == 2u &&
        globalConflictRecoveryAttempted == 0u)
    {
        uint8_t recoveryDecision = data[1];
        uint32_t recoveryTransaction = getU32(&data[2]);
        uint8_t recoveryMask = data[6];
        uint8_t recoverySlot = data[7];
        if (recoveryDecisionValid(recoveryDecision, recoveryTransaction,
                recoveryMask) != 0u && recoverySlot <= 5u)
        {
            globalConflictRetryTransactionId = globalTransactionId;
            globalConflictRecoveryAttempted = 1u;
            globalConflictCleanupActive = 1u;
            globalOperationFailed = 1u;
            globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY;
            globalStateFailedTarget = 1u;
            globalTransactionId = recoveryTransaction;
            globalSlot = recoverySlot;
            /* The durable decision is owned by Core1.  An ABORT decision may
             * legitimately describe only the participants touched before the
             * original failure, so its stored mask need not include bit 1.
             * Recovery must still visit Core1 last to consume that journal;
             * otherwise cleanup appears successful and the retry encounters
             * the same decision forever. */
            globalTargetMask = (uint8_t) (recoveryMask | (1u << 1));
            globalTouchedMask = 0u;
            globalPreparedMask = 0u;
            globalCommittedMask = 0u;
            globalFailedMask = 0u;
            requestPending = 0u;
            rememberRecovery(recoveryDecision, recoveryTransaction,
                globalTargetMask);
            globalPhase = (recoveryDecision == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH) ?
                PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH : PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT;
            globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
            if (dispatchGlobalCurrent() == 0u)
                sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "RECOVERY_ROUTE");
            return;
        }
    }
    requestPending = 0u;
    if (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK)
    {
        globalStateFailedTarget = globalTarget;
        globalStateError = (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_REJECTED) ?
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_REJECTED : PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_STORAGE;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_RECOVERY)
    {
        if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK && data != NULL && length == 7u &&
            (data[0] == PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE || data[0] == PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT ||
             data[0] == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH) &&
            (data[0] == PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE ||
             (data[5] != 0u &&
              (data[5] & ~PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK) == 0u &&
              data[6] <= 5u &&
              (data[0] != PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH ||
               data[5] == PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK))))
        {
            if (data[0] != PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE)
            {
                globalSlot = data[6];
                rememberRecovery(data[0], getU32(&data[1]), data[5]);
            }
            else if (recoveryTargetMask == 0u)
                clearRecovery();
            recoveryDiscoveryDone = 1u;
        }
        else
            gatewayCleanupFailed = 1u;
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE;
        globalSilent = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INSPECT_LIBRARY &&
        status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK)
    {
        uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
        uint32_t slotTransactionId;
        if (data == NULL || length != 26u || data[0] != globalTarget ||
            data[1] != globalSlot || data[2] > 2u || data[3] != 0u)
        {
            status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
            globalStateFailedTarget = globalTarget;
            globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INVALID;
        }
        else if (data[2] == 0u)
            globalSlotEmptyMask |= bit;
        else if (data[2] == 2u)
            globalSlotInvalidMask |= bit;
        else
        {
            slotTransactionId = getU32(&data[16]);
            if (slotTransactionId == 0u || slotTransactionId == UINT32_MAX)
                globalSlotInvalidMask |= bit;
            else if (globalSlotTransactionValid == 0u)
            {
                globalSlotTransactionId = slotTransactionId;
                globalSlotTransactionValid = 1u;
                globalSlotValidMask |= bit;
            }
            else if (slotTransactionId == globalSlotTransactionId)
                globalSlotValidMask |= bit;
            else
                globalSlotInvalidMask |= bit;
        }
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_VERIFY_LOCK && status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK)
    {
        uint32_t libraryTransactionId;
        if (data == NULL || length != 26u || data[0] != globalTarget ||
            data[1] != globalSlot || data[2] != 1u || data[3] != 0u ||
            (globalOrigin == 0xFFu &&
             getU32(&data[12]) != globalExpectedCrc[globalTarget]))
        {
            status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
            globalStateFailedTarget = globalTarget;
            globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INCOMPLETE;
        }
        else
        {
            libraryTransactionId = getU32(&data[16]);
            if (libraryTransactionId == 0u ||
                libraryTransactionId == UINT32_MAX)
            {
                status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
                globalStateFailedTarget = globalTarget;
                globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INCOMPLETE;
            }
            else if (globalLibraryIdentitySet == 0u)
            {
                globalLibraryTransactionId = libraryTransactionId;
                globalLibraryIdentitySet = 1u;
            }
            else if (libraryTransactionId != globalLibraryTransactionId)
            {
                status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
                globalStateFailedTarget = globalTarget;
                globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INCOMPLETE;
            }
        }
    }
    if (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK && globalFailureDiagnostic == 0u)
    {
        globalFailureDiagnostic = packFailureDiagnostic(
            (uint8_t) globalPhase, currentInternalOp, status,
            globalStateError);
    }
    if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK)
    {
        if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT ||
            globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME ||
            globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE)
            globalCommittedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
        else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK)
            globalTouchedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
        else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY ||
                 globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME)
            globalPreparedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
        else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH)
            globalCommittedMask &= (uint8_t) ~(1u << globalTarget);
        else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT)
        {
            uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
            globalTouchedMask &= (uint8_t) ~bit;
            globalPreparedMask &= (uint8_t) ~bit;
            globalCommittedMask &= (uint8_t) ~bit;
        }
        advanceGlobal();
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
    {
        if (globalFailureDiagnostic == 0u)
        {
            globalFailureDiagnostic = packFailureDiagnostic(
                (uint8_t) globalPhase, currentInternalOp, status,
                globalStateError);
        }
        globalOperationFailed = 1u;
        sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "INSPECT");
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_DECIDE)
    {
        recoveryDiscoveryDone = 0u;
        clearRecovery();
        globalOperationFailed = 1u;
        sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "DECISION");
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT)
    {
        globalFailedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
        advanceGlobal();
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH)
    {
        globalOperationFailed = 1u;
        globalFailedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
        advanceGlobal();
        return;
    }
    globalOperationFailed = 1u;
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE ||
        globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME ||
        globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT)
        globalCommittedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK ||
             globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY ||
             globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME)
        globalTouchedMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << globalTarget);
    globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT;
    globalTargetMask = (uint8_t) (globalTouchedMask | globalPreparedMask |
                                  globalCommittedMask);
    if (globalTargetMask == 0u) globalTargetMask = 0x1Fu;
    persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, globalTransactionId,
        globalTargetMask);
    globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
    if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
        finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
}

static uint8_t startGlobal(const paramSyncGatewayFrame* request)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint8_t requestedSlot;
    if (globalTerminal != 0u) return 0u;
    if (request->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT)
    {
        uint8_t i;
        if (request->payloadLength != 4u) return 0u;
        transactionId = getU32(request->payload);
        if (recoveryTargetMask != 0u)
        {
            if (recoveryOp != PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT ||
                transactionId != recoveryTransactionId) return 0u;
            globalTargetMask = recoveryTargetMask;
        }
        else
        {
            globalTargetMask = (uint8_t) (globalTouchedMask | globalPreparedMask |
                                          globalCommittedMask);
            for (i = 0u; transactionId != 0u && i < 5u; i++)
            {
                if ((globalTargetMask & (uint8_t) (1u << i)) != 0u &&
                    targetTransactionId[i] != transactionId) return 0u;
            }
        }
        if (transactionId == 0u &&
            ((globalFinishRequired && globalTransactionId != 0u) ||
             ((globalTouchedMask != 0u || globalPreparedMask != 0u ||
               globalCommittedMask != 0u) && globalTransactionId != 0u) ||
             (recoveryTargetMask != 0u && recoveryOp == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH)))
            return 0u;
        globalSlot = 0u;
        globalAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
        globalOrigin = 0xFFu;
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT;
        globalOperationFailed = 0u;
        if (transactionId == 0u) globalTargetMask = 0x1Fu;
        if (globalTargetMask == 0u)
        {
            globalRequest = *request;
            globalTransactionId = transactionId;
            sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL);
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        if ((request->payloadLength != 5u && request->payloadLength != 25u) ||
            request->payload[0] < 1u ||
            request->payload[0] > 5u) return 0u;
        requestedSlot = request->payload[0];
        transactionId = getU32(&request->payload[1]);
        if (recoveryTargetMask != 0u) return 0u;
        if (request->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_COMMIT)
        {
            uint8_t i;
            if (transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX)
                return 0u;
            if (globalPreparedMask != 0x1Fu) return 0u;
            for (i = 0u; i < 5u; i++)
            {
                if (targetPreparedSlot[i] != requestedSlot ||
                    targetTransactionId[i] != transactionId) return 0u;
            }
            globalCommittedMask = 0u;
            globalFinishRequired = 0u;
            globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT;
            globalAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY;
            globalOrigin = 0xFFu;
            globalSlot = requestedSlot;
            globalTargetMask = 0x1Fu;
        }
        else if (request->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACTIVATE)
        {
            uint8_t i;
            if (transactionId != 0u || request->payloadLength != 25u ||
                globalFinishRequired || globalTouchedMask != 0u ||
                globalPreparedMask != 0u || globalCommittedMask != 0u)
                return 0u;
            transactionId = runtimeLoadTransactionId(request, requestedSlot);
            globalCommittedMask = 0u;
            globalFinishRequired = 1u;
            globalSlot = requestedSlot;
            globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT;
            globalAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME;
            globalOrigin = 0xFFu;
            globalLibraryIdentitySet = 0u;
            globalLibraryTransactionId = 0u;
            for (i = 0u; i < 5u; i++)
                globalExpectedCrc[i] = getU32(&request->payload[5u + i * 4u]);
            globalTargetMask = 0x1Fu;
        }
        else return 0u;
        globalOperationFailed = 0u;
    }
    globalRequest = *request;
    globalTransactionId = transactionId;
    globalTerminal = 0u;
    globalTerminalOk = 0u;
    globalTerminalObservedByPc = 0u;
    globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    globalStateFailedTarget = 0xFFu;
    globalFailureDiagnostic = 0u;
    globalConflictRetryTransactionId = 0u;
    globalConflictRecoveryAttempted = 0u;
    globalConflictCleanupActive = 0u;
    globalFailedMask = 0u;
    globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT)
        persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, globalTransactionId,
            globalTargetMask);
    else if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK ||
             globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT)
        persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, globalTransactionId,
            globalTargetMask);
    return dispatchGlobalCurrent();
}

static uint8_t startBoardGlobal(const paramSyncGlobalRequest *request)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(request) == 0u ||
        globalTerminal != 0u ||
        mutationMenuReady() == 0u ||
        requestPending != 0u || globalPhase != PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE)
        return 0u;
    transactionId = gatewayBoot ^ request->producerBootGeneration ^
        request->sequence ^ ((uint32_t) request->origin << 28) ^
        ((uint32_t) request->action << 20) ^ 0x42524454u;
    if (transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX)
        transactionId = 1u;
    memset(&globalRequest, 0, sizeof(globalRequest));
    globalRequest.messageType = (request->action ==
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ? PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_COMMIT :
        PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACTIVATE;
    globalRequest.target = 0xFFu;
    globalRequest.session = request->producerBootGeneration;
    globalRequest.sequence = request->sequence;
    globalRequest.payloadLength = 5u;
    globalRequest.payload[0] = request->slot;
    putU32(&globalRequest.payload[1], transactionId);
    globalTransactionId = transactionId;
    globalSlot = request->slot;
    globalOrigin = request->origin;
    globalAction = request->action;
    globalTargetMask = PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK;
    globalTouchedMask = 0u;
    globalPreparedMask = 0u;
    globalCommittedMask = 0u;
    globalFailedMask = 0u;
    globalOperationFailed = 0u;
    globalFinishRequired = (uint8_t) (request->action !=
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY);
    globalLibraryIdentitySet = 0u;
    globalLibraryTransactionId = 0u;
    globalSlotValidMask = 0u;
    globalSlotEmptyMask = 0u;
    globalSlotInvalidMask = 0u;
    globalSlotTransactionId = 0u;
    globalSlotTransactionValid = 0u;
    globalTerminal = 0u;
    globalTerminalOk = 0u;
    globalTerminalObservedByPc = 0u;
    globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    globalStateFailedTarget = 0xFFu;
    globalFailureDiagnostic = 0u;
    globalConflictRetryTransactionId = 0u;
    globalConflictRecoveryAttempted = 0u;
    globalConflictCleanupActive = 0u;
    globalBoardInitiated = 1u;
    globalSilent = 1u;
    globalPhase = (request->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY) ?
        PARAM_GLOBAL_INSPECT_LIBRARY : PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT;
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INTENT)
        persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, transactionId,
            globalTargetMask);
    globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
    return dispatchGlobalCurrent();
}

static uint8_t considerBoardRequest(const paramSyncGlobalRequest *request,
    uint8_t expectedOrigin)
{
    if (request == NULL || request->origin != expectedOrigin ||
        paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(request) == 0u) return 0u;
    if (boardRequestBoot[expectedOrigin] == request->producerBootGeneration &&
        (int32_t) (request->sequence -
            boardRequestSequence[expectedOrigin]) <= 0) return 0u;
    /* READY 边沿与各板按键不是同一总线原子事件：另一请求可能已经让协调器
     * 进入 BUSY，但并发按键仍在共享区/桥内排队。此类请求必须在当前事务期间
     * 消费并记入去重身份；发起端看到同 coordinator 的非 READY 状态后本地形成
     * BUSY 终态。若保留到当前事务结束，它会在无人再次按键时自动执行。 */
    if (globalTerminal != 0u || globalPhase != PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE ||
        requestPending != 0u)
    {
        boardRequestBoot[expectedOrigin] = request->producerBootGeneration;
        boardRequestSequence[expectedOrigin] = request->sequence;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (startBoardGlobal(request) != 0u)
    {
        boardRequestBoot[expectedOrigin] = request->producerBootGeneration;
        boardRequestSequence[expectedOrigin] = request->sequence;
    }
    else
    {
        boardRequestBoot[expectedOrigin] = request->producerBootGeneration;
        boardRequestSequence[expectedOrigin] = request->sequence;
        globalRequest.session = request->producerBootGeneration;
        globalRequest.sequence = request->sequence;
        globalOrigin = request->origin;
        globalAction = request->action;
        globalSlot = request->slot;
        globalTransactionId = 0u;
        globalTerminal = 1u;
        globalTerminalOk = 0u;
        globalTerminalObservedByPc = 0u;
        globalStateError = (paramSyncGatewayPlatformTargetMask() !=
              PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK) ? PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INCOMPLETE :
             ((recoveryDiscoveryDone == 0u || recoveryTargetMask != 0u ||
               gatewayCleanupFailed != 0u) ?
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY :
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY);
        globalStateFailedTarget = request->origin;
    }
    return 1u;
}

static void pollBoardRequests(void)
{
    paramSyncGlobalRequest request;
    if (crossCoreLinkTakeParamGlobalRequest(&request) != 0u)
        if (considerBoardRequest(&request, 0u) != 0u) return;
    if (coreDataTryReadParamGlobalRequest(&request) != 0u)
        if (considerBoardRequest(&request, 1u) != 0u) return;
    if (chassisLinkTryReadParamGlobalRequest(&request) != 0u)
        if (considerBoardRequest(&request, 2u) != 0u) return;
    if (paramSyncGatewayPlatformTakeObserverRequest(3u, &request) != 0u)
        if (considerBoardRequest(&request, 3u) != 0u) return;
    if (paramSyncGatewayPlatformTakeObserverRequest(4u, &request) != 0u)
        (void) considerBoardRequest(&request, 4u);
}

static void invalidateSession(void)
{
    uint32_t transactionId =
        (globalPhase != PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE) ? globalTransactionId : 0u;
    uint32_t invalidatedSession = activeSession;
    uint8_t targetMask = (uint8_t) (globalTouchedMask | globalPreparedMask |
                                    globalCommittedMask);
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t zeroActivationRollback = (uint8_t) ((globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK ||
                                                    globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_VERIFY_LOCK ||
                                                    globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE ||
                                                    globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH) &&
                                                globalTransactionId == 0u);
    if (requestPending && pendingRequest.target < 5u &&
        (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_LOCK ||
         globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_LIBRARY ||
         globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_PREPARE_RUNTIME ||
         globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT ||
         globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_COMMIT_RUNTIME ||
         globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_ACTIVATE))
    {
        targetMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << pendingRequest.target);
    }
    if (requestPending && pendingRequest.target < 5u &&
        pendingRequest.messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PREPARE_BEGIN &&
        pendingRequest.payloadLength == 19u)
    {
        uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << pendingRequest.target);
        targetMask |= bit;
        globalTouchedMask |= bit;
        targetPreparedSlot[pendingRequest.target] = pendingRequest.payload[0];
        targetTransactionId[pendingRequest.target] =
            getU32(&pendingRequest.payload[1]);
    }
    if (requestPending && pendingRequest.target < 5u &&
        pendingRequest.messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACTIVATE &&
        pendingRequest.payloadLength == 5u &&
        getU32(&pendingRequest.payload[1]) == 0u &&
        (currentInternalOp == PARAM_SYNC_OP_LOCK ||
         currentInternalOp == PARAM_SYNC_OP_ACTIVATE))
    {
        targetMask |= (uint8_t) (1u << pendingRequest.target);
        zeroActivationRollback = 1u;
    }
    if (transactionId == 0u && zeroActivationRollback == 0u)
    {
        for (i = 0u; i < 5u; i++)
        {
            if ((targetMask & (uint8_t) (1u << i)) != 0u &&
                targetTransactionId[i] != 0u)
            {
                transactionId = targetTransactionId[i];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    activeSession = 0u;
    lastPcSequence = 0u;
    rxEncodedLength = 0u;
    requestPending = 0u;
    prepareIntentPending = 0u;
    externalState = PARAM_EXT_IDLE;
    externalSendPending = 0u;
    core0State = PARAM_EXT_IDLE;
    core0SendPending = 0u;
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
    {
        globalStateFailedTarget = globalTarget;
        globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_PEER_RESTART;
        globalFailureDiagnostic = packFailureDiagnostic(
            (uint8_t) globalPhase, currentInternalOp,
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, globalStateError);
        globalOperationFailed = 1u;
        sendGlobalFinal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, "INSPECT");
        return;
    }
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_DECIDE ||
        currentInternalOp == PARAM_SYNC_OP_DECIDE)
    {
        recoveryDiscoveryDone = 0u;
        clearRecovery();
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE;
        return;
    }
    if (recoveryTargetMask != 0u)
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE;
        gatewayCleanupFailed = 1u;
        return;
    }
    if (targetMask == 0u ||
        (transactionId == 0u && zeroActivationRollback == 0u))
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE;
        return;
    }
    /* Core1 has already persisted FINISH before cleanup starts.  From this
     * point the decision is irreversible: a session timeout, owner reboot or
     * other invalidation may defer cleanup, but must never downgrade the
     * remaining participants to ABORT.  Replaying FINISH for the full mask is
     * idempotent and also covers a response that was lost after completion. */
    if (globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH)
    {
        rememberRecovery(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH, transactionId, targetMask);
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE;
        return;
    }
    memset(&globalRequest, 0, sizeof(globalRequest));
    globalRequest.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT;
    globalRequest.target = 0xFFu;
    globalRequest.session = invalidatedSession;
    globalRequest.payloadLength = 4u;
    putU32(globalRequest.payload, transactionId);
    globalTransactionId = transactionId;
    globalTargetMask = targetMask;
    globalOperationFailed = 1u;
    globalFailedMask = 0u;
    globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT;
    persistRecoveryDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, transactionId, targetMask);
    globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
    if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
        finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
}

static void startSilentCleanup(const paramSyncGatewayFrame* hello)
{
    globalRequest = *hello;
    globalRequest.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT;
    globalRequest.target = 0xFFu;
    globalRequest.payloadLength = 4u;
    putU32(globalRequest.payload, recoveryTargetMask ? recoveryTransactionId : 0u);
    globalTransactionId = recoveryTargetMask ? recoveryTransactionId : 0u;
    globalTargetMask = recoveryTargetMask ? recoveryTargetMask : 0x1Fu;
    globalCommittedMask = 0u;
    globalOperationFailed = 0u;
    globalFailedMask = 0u;
    globalFinishRequired = 0u;
    globalPhase = (recoveryTargetMask && recoveryOp == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH) ?
        PARAM_GLOBAL_FINISH : PARAM_GLOBAL_ABORT;
    globalSilent = 1u;
    globalTarget = firstGlobalTarget(globalPhase, globalTargetMask);
    if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
        finishRequest(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0u, NULL, 0u);
}

static void startRecoveryDiscovery(const paramSyncGatewayFrame *hello)
{
    globalRequest = *hello;
    globalTargetMask = (uint8_t) (1u << 1);
    globalTarget = 1u;
    globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_RECOVERY;
    globalSilent = 1u;
    if (!dispatchGlobalCurrent())
    {
        globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE;
        globalSilent = 0u;
        gatewayCleanupFailed = 1u;
    }
}

static void handleFrame(const paramSyncGatewayFrame* f, uint32_t now)
{
    paramSyncGatewayFrame x = *f;
    if (requestShapeValid(f) == 0u)
    {
        sendError(f, "FRAME");
        return;
    }
    if (f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_HELLO)
    {
        uint8_t mask = paramSyncGatewayPlatformTargetMask();
        uint8_t safe = (uint8_t) (f->session != 0u &&
            mask == PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK);
        uint8_t startCleanup = 0u;
        uint8_t startDiscovery = 0u;
        if (activeSession == f->session &&
            sequenceAdvances(f->sequence, lastPcSequence) == 0u)
        {
            sendError(f, "SEQUENCE");
            return;
        }
        if (safe)
        {
            uint8_t newSession = (uint8_t) (activeSession != f->session);
            if (newSession && globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE &&
                !requestPending && globalTerminal == 0u &&
                mutationStagingEmpty() != 0u)
            {
                activeSession = f->session;
                requestPending = 0u;
            }
            else if (newSession)
                safe = 0u;
            if (!newSession || activeSession == f->session) lastActivityMs = now;
            if (activeSession == f->session && globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE &&
                !requestPending && globalTerminal == 0u &&
                mutationStagingEmpty() != 0u)
            {
                if (!recoveryDiscoveryDone)
                {
                    safe = 0u;
                    startDiscovery = 1u;
                }
                else if (recoveryTargetMask != 0u || gatewayCleanupFailed != 0u)
                {
                    safe = 0u;
                    startCleanup = 1u;
                }
            }
            else if (globalPhase != PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE || requestPending ||
                     globalTerminal != 0u || mutationStagingEmpty() == 0u)
                safe = 0u;
        }
        if (activeSession == f->session) lastPcSequence = f->sequence;
        x.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_HELLO_ACK;
        x.payloadLength = 10u;
        putU32(&x.payload[0], gatewayBoot);
        putU32(&x.payload[4], PARAM_GATEWAY_CAP_READ |
            PARAM_GATEWAY_CAP_LIBRARY_RUNTIME_SPLIT);
        x.payload[8] = safe;
        x.payload[9] = mask;
        sendFrame(&x);
        if (startDiscovery)
            startRecoveryDiscovery(f);
        else if (startCleanup)
            startSilentCleanup(f);
        return;
    }
    if (!activeSession || f->session != activeSession)
    {
        sendError(f, "SESSION");
        return;
    }
    if (sequenceAdvances(f->sequence, lastPcSequence) == 0u)
    {
        sendError(f, "SEQUENCE");
        return;
    }
    lastPcSequence = f->sequence;
    lastActivityMs = now;
    if (!recoveryDiscoveryDone)
    {
        sendError(f, "RECOVERY");
        return;
    }
    if (requestPending)
    {
        sendError(f, "BUSY");
        return;
    }
    if (gatewayCleanupFailed != 0u &&
        !(f->target == 0xFFu && f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT))
    {
        sendError(f, "RECOVERY");
        return;
    }
    if (f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_ENUM_TARGETS)
    {
        x.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_MSG_TARGETS;
        x.payloadLength = 1u;
        x.payload[0] = paramSyncGatewayPlatformTargetMask();
        sendFrame(&x);
        return;
    }
    if (f->target == 0xFFu &&
        f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_READ_TRANSACTION_STATUS)
    {
        x.messageType = PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_TRANSACTION_STATUS;
        x.payloadLength = sizeof(paramSyncGlobalState);
        memcpy(x.payload, &publishedGlobalState, sizeof(paramSyncGlobalState));
        sendFrame(&x);
        if (globalTerminal != 0u && globalOrigin == 0xFFu)
        {
            globalTerminalObservedByPc = 1u;
            globalTerminalPublishedMs = now -
                PARAM_GATEWAY_GLOBAL_TERMINAL_HOLD_MS;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (globalTerminal != 0u &&
        f->messageType >= PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PREPARE_BEGIN &&
        f->messageType <= PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT)
    {
        sendError(f, "BUSY");
        return;
    }
    if (f->target != 0xFFu &&
        (f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_COMMIT ||
         f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACTIVATE))
    {
        sendError(f, "GLOBAL_ONLY");
        return;
    }
    if (f->target == 0xFFu &&
        (f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_COMMIT ||
            f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ACTIVATE ||
            f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_ABORT))
    {
        if (!startGlobal(f)) sendError(f, "GLOBAL");
        return;
    }
    if (requestOp(f->messageType) == PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE)
    {
        sendError(f, "OP");
        return;
    }
    if (f->messageType == PARAM_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_PREPARE_BEGIN &&
        f->payloadLength == 19u)
    {
        uint32_t transactionId = getU32(&f->payload[1]);
        uint8_t i;
        if (transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX ||
            f->target >= 5u)
        {
            sendError(f, "TRANSACTION");
            return;
        }
        for (i = 0u; i < 5u; i++)
        {
            if ((globalTouchedMask & (uint8_t) (1u << i)) != 0u &&
                targetTransactionId[i] != transactionId)
            {
                sendError(f, "TRANSACTION");
                return;
            }
        }
        if (!startPrepareIntent(f)) sendError(f, "INTENT");
        return;
    }
    currentInternalOp = requestOp(f->messageType);
    if (f->target == 0u)
    {
        if (!startCore0Request(f))
        {
            sendError(f, "CORE0");
            return;
        }
    }
    else if (f->target == PARAM_GATEWAY_CORE2_TARGET)
    {
        if (!startCore2Request(f))
        {
            sendError(f, "CORE2");
            return;
        }
    }
    else if (f->target == 1u || f->target == 3u || f->target == 4u)
    {
        if (!routeMailbox(f))
        {
            sendError(f, "MAILBOX");
            return;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        sendError(f, "ROUTE");
        return;
    }
    pendingRequest = *f;
    requestPending = 1u;
}

void paramSyncGatewayInit(void)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest retainedRequest;
    paramSyncMailboxResponse retainedResponse;
    rxHead = rxTail = rxEncodedLength = 0;
    rxOverflowSequence = 0u;
    rxOverflowAcknowledged = 0u;
    rxDiscardUntilDelimiter = 0u;
    activeSession = requestPending = mailboxSequence = 0;
    lastPcSequence = 0u;
    pendingMailboxSequence = 0u;
    externalState = PARAM_EXT_IDLE;
    externalSendPending = 0u;
    core0State = PARAM_EXT_IDLE;
    core0SendPending = 0u;
    globalPhase = PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE;
    globalTransactionId = 0u;
    globalSlot = 0u;
    globalTarget = 0u;
    globalCommittedMask = 0u;
    globalOperationFailed = 0u;
    globalFinishRequired = 0u;
    globalTouchedMask = 0u;
    globalPreparedMask = 0u;
    globalTargetMask = 0u;
    globalSilent = 0u;
    gatewayCleanupFailed = 0u;
    globalFailedMask = 0u;
    currentInternalOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE;
    recoveryTargetMask = 0u;
    recoveryOp = PARAM_SYNC_OP_NONE;
    recoveryTransactionId = 0u;
    prepareIntentPending = 0u;
    recoveryDiscoveryDone = 0u;
    if (loadRecoveryDecision(&recoveryOp, &recoveryTransactionId,
            &recoveryTargetMask))
    {
        gatewayCleanupFailed = 1u;
    }
    memset(ownerBootGeneration, 0, sizeof(ownerBootGeneration));
    memset(mailboxResponseBoot, 0, sizeof(mailboxResponseBoot));
    memset(mailboxResponseSequence, 0, sizeof(mailboxResponseSequence));
    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&retainedRequest) != 0u &&
        retainedRequest.sequence != 0u)
        mailboxSequence = retainedRequest.sequence;
    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadResponse(&retainedResponse) != 0u &&
        retainedResponse.target < 5u &&
        retainedResponse.producerBootGeneration != 0u &&
        retainedResponse.sequence != 0u)
    {
        mailboxResponseBoot[retainedResponse.target] =
            retainedResponse.producerBootGeneration;
        mailboxResponseSequence[retainedResponse.target] =
            retainedResponse.sequence;
    }
    memset(targetPreparedSlot, 0, sizeof(targetPreparedSlot));
    memset(targetTransactionId, 0, sizeof(targetTransactionId));
    memset(globalExpectedCrc, 0, sizeof(globalExpectedCrc));
    globalLibraryTransactionId = 0u;
    globalLibraryIdentitySet = 0u;
    globalSlotValidMask = 0u;
    globalSlotEmptyMask = 0u;
    globalSlotInvalidMask = 0u;
    globalSlotTransactionId = 0u;
    globalSlotTransactionValid = 0u;
    memset(boardRequestBoot, 0, sizeof(boardRequestBoot));
    memset(boardRequestSequence, 0, sizeof(boardRequestSequence));
    memset(&publishedGlobalState, 0, sizeof(publishedGlobalState));
    memset(&globalRequest, 0, sizeof(globalRequest));
    globalStateSequence = 0u;
    globalStateLastPublishMs = 0u;
    rs485GatewayTxMs = 0u;
    rs485GatewayTxPrimed = 0u;
    globalAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
    globalOrigin = 0xFFu;
    globalTerminal = globalTerminalOk = globalStateError = 0u;
    globalStateFailedTarget = 0xFFu;
    globalFailureDiagnostic = 0u;
    globalConflictRetryTransactionId = 0u;
    globalConflictRecoveryAttempted = 0u;
    globalConflictCleanupActive = 0u;
    globalBoardInitiated = 0u;
    globalTerminalPublished = 0u;
    globalTerminalObservedByPc = 0u;
    globalTerminalPublishedMs = 0u;
    externalReplayFenceStartMs = 0u;
    externalReplayFencePrimed = 0u;
    gatewayBoot = nextGatewayBootGeneration();
}
void paramSyncGatewayRxIrqHandler(void)
{
    uint8_t batch[16u];
    uint8_t count = uart_query_buffer(UART_0, batch);
    uint8_t i;
    for (i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        uint16_t next;
        if (rxOverflowSequence != rxOverflowAcknowledged) continue;
        next = (uint16_t) ((rxHead + 1u) &
            (PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_RING_BYTES - 1u));
        if (next == rxTail)
        {
            uint32_t sequence = rxOverflowSequence + 1u;
            if (sequence == 0u) sequence = 1u;
            rxOverflowSequence = sequence;
            continue;
        }
        rxRing[rxHead] = batch[i];
        rxHead = next;
    }
}
void paramSyncGatewayPoll(uint32_t now)
{
    paramSyncMailboxResponse m;
    paramSyncGatewayFrame automatic;
    (void) externalReplayFenceActive(now);
    paramSyncGatewayPlatformPoll(now);
    if (rxOverflowAcknowledged != rxOverflowSequence)
    {
        uint32_t observed = rxOverflowSequence;
        rxTail = rxHead;
        rxEncodedLength = 0u;
        rxDiscardUntilDelimiter = 1u;
        rxOverflowAcknowledged = observed;
    }
    while (rxTail != rxHead)
    {
        uint8_t b = rxRing[rxTail];
        rxTail = (uint16_t) ((rxTail + 1u) & (PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_RING_BYTES - 1u));
        if (rxDiscardUntilDelimiter != 0u)
        {
            if (b == 0u) rxDiscardUntilDelimiter = 0u;
            continue;
        }
        if (!b)
        {
            paramSyncGatewayFrame f;
            if (rxEncodedLength && paramSyncGatewayDecode(rxEncodedFrame,
                    rxEncodedLength, &f)) handleFrame(&f, now);
            rxEncodedLength = 0;
        }
        else if (rxEncodedLength < sizeof(rxEncodedFrame))
            rxEncodedFrame[rxEncodedLength++] = b;
        else
        {
            rxEncodedLength = 0u;
            rxDiscardUntilDelimiter = 1u;
        }
    }
    if (activeSession &&
             (uint32_t) (now - lastActivityMs) >= PARAM_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_MS)
    {
        invalidateSession();
    }
    if (globalTerminal != 0u && globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE &&
        globalTerminalPublished != 0u &&
        (globalOrigin != 0xFFu || globalTerminalObservedByPc != 0u ||
         activeSession == 0u) &&
        (uint32_t) (now - globalTerminalPublishedMs) >=
            PARAM_GATEWAY_GLOBAL_TERMINAL_HOLD_MS)
    {
        globalTerminal = 0u;
        globalTerminalOk = 0u;
        globalStateError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
        globalStateFailedTarget = 0xFFu;
        globalFailureDiagnostic = 0u;
        globalConflictRetryTransactionId = 0u;
        globalConflictRecoveryAttempted = 0u;
        globalConflictCleanupActive = 0u;
        globalAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
        globalOrigin = 0xFFu;
        globalSlot = 0u;
        globalTransactionId = 0u;
        globalTerminalObservedByPc = 0u;
        memset(&globalRequest, 0, sizeof(globalRequest));
    }
    /* 在任何协调状态下都排空板端入口。忙时 considerBoardRequest 只消费并
     * 去重，不改写当前公开事务；避免队列中的旧按键在终态保持结束后重放。 */
    pollBoardRequests();
    memset(&automatic, 0, sizeof(automatic));
    automatic.target = 0xFFu;
    automatic.session = gatewayBoot;
    automatic.sequence = globalStateSequence + 1u;
    if (globalTerminal == 0u && globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE &&
        requestPending == 0u)
    {
        if (recoveryDiscoveryDone == 0u || recoveryTargetMask != 0u ||
            gatewayCleanupFailed != 0u)
        {
            /* Requests left in a bridge/shared mailbox across coordinator
             * restart or recovery are stale by definition.  Consume them while
             * the public state is not READY so they receive a matched failure
             * instead of executing automatically after recovery. */
            if (globalTerminal == 0u && globalPhase == PARAM_GLOBAL_NONE &&
                requestPending == 0u &&
                paramSyncGatewayPlatformTargetMask() ==
                    PARAM_GATEWAY_TARGET_MASK)
            {
                if (recoveryDiscoveryDone == 0u)
                    startRecoveryDiscovery(&automatic);
                else
                    startSilentCleanup(&automatic);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* READY 且入口已在本拍统一轮询；无额外动作。 */
        }
    }
    publishGlobalState(now, 0u);
    if (!requestPending || (pendingRequest.target != 1u &&
        pendingRequest.target != 3u && pendingRequest.target != 4u) ||
        !paramSyncMailboxTryReadResponse(&m)) return;
    if (mailboxResponseFresh(&m) == 0u ||
        m.target != pendingRequest.target ||
        m.op != currentInternalOp ||
        m.slot != (pendingRequest.payloadLength ? pendingRequest.payload[0] : 0u) ||
        m.transactionId != pendingRequest.session ||
        m.offset != pendingMailboxSequence) return;
    if (m.producerBootGeneration == 0u)
    {
        sendError(&pendingRequest, "OWNER_BOOT");
        invalidateSession();
        return;
    }
    if (ownerBootGeneration[pendingRequest.target] != 0u &&
        ownerBootGeneration[pendingRequest.target] != m.producerBootGeneration)
    {
        /* 本次会话仍fail-closed，但采纳新owner代际供下一会话恢复。 */
        ownerBootGeneration[pendingRequest.target] =
            m.producerBootGeneration;
        sendError(&pendingRequest, "OWNER_BOOT");
        invalidateSession();
        return;
    }
    ownerBootGeneration[pendingRequest.target] = m.producerBootGeneration;
    finishRequest(m.status, m.payloadCrc32, m.data, m.dataLength);
}

void paramSyncGatewayServiceExternal(uint32_t now, uint8_t rs485Allowed)
{
    chassisParamFrame reply;
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t replayFenceActive = externalReplayFenceActive(now);
    if (paramSyncGatewayCore2ReplyTurnaroundActive(now) != 0u) return;
    if (replayFenceActive != 0u) discardExternalReplayResidue();
    if ((!requestPending || pendingRequest.target != PARAM_GATEWAY_CORE2_TARGET ||
         replayFenceActive != 0u) &&
        rs485Allowed != 0u && publishedGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration != 0u &&
        chassisLinkSendParamGlobalState(&publishedGlobalState) != 0u)
    {
        rs485GatewayTxMs = now;
        rs485GatewayTxPrimed = 1u;
        return;
    }
    if (!requestPending) return;
    if ((pendingRequest.target == 0u ||
         pendingRequest.target == PARAM_GATEWAY_CORE2_TARGET) &&
        replayFenceActive != 0u) return;
    if (pendingRequest.target == 0u)
    {
        uartLinkFrameStruct reply0;
        uint8_t status0;

        {

                return;

            {
                completeExternal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID);
                return;
            }
            if (reply0.paramStatus == UART_LINK_PARAM_OWNER_RESTART)

                invalidateSession();
                return;

                    return;

                        core0Wire.paramLength);
                    core0Wire.paramStatus = 0u;
                    core0State = PARAM_EXT_WAIT_DATA;
                }
            }
            else if (core0State == PARAM_EXT_WAIT_DATA)

                completeExternal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED);
                return;

            core0SendPending = 1u;

            core0SendPending = 0u;

        {
            completeExternal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID);
            return;

            return;

            {
                completeExternal(status);
                return;
            }
