            {
                externalWire.op = CHASSIS_PARAM_OP_POLL;
                externalWire.offset = 0u;
                externalWire.length = 0u;
                externalWire.status = 0u;
                externalState = PARAM_EXT_WAIT_POLL;
            }
            else
            {
                uint16_t remaining = (uint16_t) (pendingRequest.payloadLength - externalRequestOffset);
                externalWire.offset = externalRequestOffset;
                externalWire.length = (remaining > CHASSIS_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) ? CHASSIS_PARAM_DATA_BYTES : (uint8_t) remaining;
                memcpy(externalWire.data, &pendingRequest.payload[externalRequestOffset],
                    externalWire.length);
                externalWire.status = 0u;
                externalState = PARAM_EXT_WAIT_DATA;
            }
        }
        else if (externalState == PARAM_EXT_WAIT_DATA)
        {
            if (status != CHASSIS_PARAM_STATUS_PENDING)
            {
                completeExternal(status);
                return;
            }
            externalRequestOffset = (uint16_t) (externalRequestOffset + externalWire.length);
            if (externalRequestOffset >= pendingRequest.payloadLength)
            {
                externalWire.op = CHASSIS_PARAM_OP_POLL;
                externalWire.offset = 0u;
                externalWire.length = 0u;
                externalWire.status = 0u;
                externalState = PARAM_EXT_WAIT_POLL;
            }
            else
            {
                uint16_t remaining = (uint16_t) (pendingRequest.payloadLength - externalRequestOffset);
                externalWire.offset = externalRequestOffset;
                externalWire.length = (remaining > CHASSIS_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) ? CHASSIS_PARAM_DATA_BYTES : (uint8_t) remaining;
                memcpy(externalWire.data, &pendingRequest.payload[externalRequestOffset],
                    externalWire.length);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (status == CHASSIS_PARAM_STATUS_PENDING)
            {
                externalWire.offset = externalResponseLength;
            }
            else if ((reply.offset != externalResponseLength) ||
                     ((uint32_t) externalResponseLength + reply.length > sizeof(externalResponse)))
            {
                completeExternal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID);
                return;
            }
            else
            {
                memcpy(&externalResponse[externalResponseLength], reply.data, reply.length);
                externalResponseLength = (uint16_t) (externalResponseLength + reply.length);
                if ((reply.status & CHASSIS_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE) == 0u)
                {
                    completeExternal(status);
                    return;
                }
                externalWire.offset = externalResponseLength;
            }
        }
        externalRetryCount = 0u;
        externalSendPending = 1u;
    }

    if ((!externalSendPending) &&
        ((uint32_t) (now - externalLastSendMs) >= PARAM_GATEWAY_RETRY_MS))
    {
        if (externalRetryCount >= PARAM_GATEWAY_RETRY_MAX)
        {
            completeExternal(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED);
            return;
        }
        externalRetryCount++;
        externalSendPending = 1u;
    }
    if (externalSendPending && rs485Allowed &&
        chassisLinkSendParamRequest(&externalWire))
    {
        externalLastSendMs = now;
        externalSendPending = 0u;
        rs485GatewayTxMs = now;
        rs485GatewayTxPrimed = 1u;
    }
}

        (uint32_t) (nowMs - rs485GatewayTxMs) <
            PARAM_SYNC_GATEWAY_RS485_REPLY_GUARD_MS);
}

    return activeSession ? 1u : 0u;

#include "paramSyncMailbox.h"

#include "cy_device_headers.h"

#include <string.h>

#define PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC  (0x50535251u) /* PSRQ */
#define PARAM_SYNC_RESPONSE_MAGIC (0x50535253u) /* PSRS */
#define PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI    (1u)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t beginSequence;
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t abiVersion;
    uint32_t payloadBytes;
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration;
    uint32_t sequence;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint32_t offset;
    uint32_t payloadCrc32;
    uint16_t dataLength;
    uint8_t op;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t target;
    uint8_t state;
    uint8_t reservedHeader[6];
    uint8_t data[PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX];
    uint8_t reservedTail[12];
    uint32_t endSequence;
} paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame;

typedef char paramSyncMailbox_frame_size_assert[
    (sizeof(paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame) == PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_FRAME_BYTES) ? 1 : -1];

#pragma location = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REQUEST_ADDR
__no_init static volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame paramSyncRequestRegion;
#pragma location = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_RESPONSE_ADDR
__no_init static volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame paramSyncResponseRegion;

static uint8_t frameInputValid(uint32_t bootGeneration, uint32_t sequence,
    uint16_t dataLength)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((bootGeneration != 0u) && (sequence != 0u) &&
        (dataLength <= PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX));
}
static void cleanRegion(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region)
{
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*region));
    __DSB();
}

static void invalidateRegion(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region)
{
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*region));
    __DSB();
}

static uint8_t publishFrame(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region,
    const paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame staged;

    staged = *frame;
    staged.endSequence = 0u;

    region->beginSequence = 0u;
    region->endSequence = 0u;
    cleanRegion(region);

    memcpy((void *) region, &staged, sizeof(staged));
    cleanRegion(region);

    region->endSequence = staged.sequence;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *)
        (((uintptr_t) &region->endSequence) & ~((uintptr_t) 31u)), 32u);
    __DSB();
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sharedFrameValid(const paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame,
    uint32_t magic)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((frame->beginSequence != 0u) &&
        (frame->beginSequence == frame->sequence) &&
        (frame->endSequence == frame->sequence) &&
        (frame->magic == magic) &&
        (frame->abiVersion == PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI) &&
        (frame->payloadBytes == frame->dataLength) &&
        frameInputValid(frame->producerBootGeneration, frame->sequence,
            frame->dataLength));
}

static uint8_t tryReadFrame(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region,
    uint32_t magic, paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame first;
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame second;
    uint8_t attempt;

    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        invalidateRegion(region);
        memcpy(&first, (const void *) region, sizeof(first));
        invalidateRegion(region);
        memcpy(&second, (const void *) region, sizeof(second));
        if (sharedFrameValid(&first, magic) &&
            sharedFrameValid(&second, magic) &&
            (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0))
        {
            *frame = second;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

uint8_t paramSyncMailboxPublishRequest(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame frame;
    if ((request == 0) || !frameInputValid(request->producerBootGeneration,
        request->sequence, request->dataLength)) return 0u;
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.beginSequence = request->sequence;
    frame.magic = PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC;
    frame.abiVersion = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI;
    frame.payloadBytes = request->dataLength;
    frame.producerBootGeneration = request->producerBootGeneration;
    frame.sequence = request->sequence;
    frame.transactionId = request->transactionId;
    frame.offset = request->offset;
    frame.payloadCrc32 = request->payloadCrc32;
    frame.dataLength = request->dataLength;
    frame.op = request->op;
    frame.slot = request->slot;
    frame.target = request->target;
    frame.state = request->flags;
    memcpy(frame.data, request->data, request->dataLength);
    return publishFrame(&paramSyncRequestRegion, &frame);
}

{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame frame;
    paramSyncMailboxRequest candidate;
    if ((request == 0) || !tryReadFrame(&paramSyncRequestRegion,
        PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC, &frame)) return 0u;
    memset(&candidate, 0, sizeof(candidate));
    candidate.producerBootGeneration = frame.producerBootGeneration;
    candidate.sequence = frame.sequence;
    candidate.transactionId = frame.transactionId;
    candidate.offset = frame.offset;
    candidate.payloadCrc32 = frame.payloadCrc32;
    candidate.dataLength = frame.dataLength;
    candidate.op = frame.op;
    candidate.slot = frame.slot;
    candidate.target = frame.target;
    candidate.flags = frame.state;
    memcpy(candidate.data, frame.data, frame.dataLength);
    *request = candidate;
    return 1u;
}

static void acceptLatestGlobalState(uint32_t tickMs)
{

    uint8_t i;

        state.coordinatorBootGeneration !=
            g_latestGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration)
    {

                clearGlobalRequest(&g_globalRoutes[i]);
        }
        g_latestGlobalState = state;
        g_latestGlobalStateValid = 0u;
        g_latestGlobalStatePrimed = 1u;
        g_latestGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs = tickMs;
        for (i = 0u; i < 2u; i++)

            g_globalRoutes[i].queuedStateBoot = 0u;
            g_globalRoutes[i].queuedStateSequence = 0u;
        }
        return;

        return;
    g_latestGlobalState = state;
    g_latestGlobalStateValid = 1u;
    g_latestGlobalStatePrimed = 1u;
    g_latestGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs = tickMs;
    for (i = 0u; i < 2u; i++)
    {
        g_globalRoutes[i].queuedStateBoot = 0u;
        g_globalRoutes[i].queuedStateSequence = 0u;
    }

static void pollGlobalRoute(observerGlobalRoute *route, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    observerLinkCore1EndpointStatus status;
    paramSyncGlobalRequest request;
    uint8_t ready;
    getObserverStatus(route->source, &status);
    ready = (uint8_t) (observerReady(&status) != 0u &&
        g_latestGlobalStateValid != 0u);
    if (ready == 0u || route->ready == 0u ||
        route->peerSession != status.peerSession)
    {
        if (ready == 0u || route->peerSession != status.peerSession)
            clearGlobalRequest(route);
        route->queuedStateBoot = 0u;
        route->queuedStateSequence = 0u;
    }
    if (route->ready != ready ||
        route->peerSession != (ready != 0u ? status.peerSession : 0u))
        route->bridgeDirty = 1u;
    route->ready = ready;
    route->peerSession = (ready != 0u) ? status.peerSession : 0u;

    if (ready != 0u && g_latestGlobalStateValid != 0u &&
        (route->queuedStateBoot !=
             g_latestGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration ||
         route->queuedStateSequence != g_latestGlobalState.sequence) &&
        queueGlobalState(route->source, &g_latestGlobalState) != 0u)
    {
        route->queuedStateBoot =
            g_latestGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration;
        route->queuedStateSequence = g_latestGlobalState.sequence;
    }

    if (takeGlobalRequest(route->source, &request) != 0u &&
        ready != 0u && request.origin == route->source &&
        paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&request) != 0u &&
        g_latestGlobalStateValid != 0u &&
        paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&g_latestGlobalState) != 0u)
    {
        if (route->requestPending == 0u ||
            (route->request.producerBootGeneration ==
                 request.producerBootGeneration &&
             route->request.sequence == request.sequence))
        {
            route->request = request;
            route->requestCoordinatorBoot =
                g_latestGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration;
            route->requestPending = 1u;
            route->bridgeDirty = 1u;
        }
    }

    if (route->requestPending != 0u &&
        (ready == 0u || g_latestGlobalStateValid == 0u ||
         route->requestCoordinatorBoot !=
             g_latestGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration ||
         paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(&g_latestGlobalState,
             &route->request) != 0u ||
         paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&g_latestGlobalState) == 0u))
        clearGlobalRequest(route);
    publishGlobalBridge(route, tickMs, 0u);
}

static void pollGlobalRoutes(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t i;
    acceptLatestGlobalState(tickMs);
    if (g_latestGlobalStateValid != 0u &&
        (uint32_t) (tickMs - g_latestGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs) >=
            OBSERVER_GLOBAL_STATE_FRESH_MS)
    {
        g_latestGlobalStateValid = 0u;
        for (i = 0u; i < 2u; i++)
            clearGlobalRequest(&g_globalRoutes[i]);
    }
    pollGlobalRoute(&g_globalRoutes[0], tickMs);
    pollGlobalRoute(&g_globalRoutes[1], tickMs);
}

static uint8_t queueRequest(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length)
{
    return (g_request.target == 3u) ? core3LinkCore1QueueParamRequest(payload, length) : core4LinkCore1QueueParamRequest(payload, length);
}

static uint8_t takeResponse(uint8_t *payload, uint16_t capacity, uint16_t *length)
{
    return (g_request.target == 3u) ? core3LinkCore1TakeParamResponse(payload, capacity, length) : core4LinkCore1TakeParamResponse(payload, capacity, length);
}

static void publish(uint8_t status)
{
    paramSyncMailboxResponse response;
    memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
    g_responseSequence++;
    if (g_responseSequence == 0u) g_responseSequence = 1u;
    if (g_routerBootGeneration == 0u) return;
    response.producerBootGeneration = g_routerBootGeneration;
    response.sequence = g_responseSequence;
    response.transactionId = g_request.transactionId;
    response.offset = g_request.offset;
    response.payloadCrc32 = g_responseIdentityPrimed != 0u ?
        g_responsePayloadCrc32 : 0u;
    response.dataLength = g_responseLength;
    response.op = g_request.op;
    response.slot = g_request.slot;
    response.target = g_request.target;
    response.status = status;
    memcpy(response.data, g_responseData, g_responseLength);
    (void) paramSyncMailboxPublishResponse(&response);
    g_state = ROUTER_IDLE;
    g_sendPending = 0u;
}

static void setPoll(void)
{
    g_wire.op = OBSERVER_PARAM_OP_POLL;
    g_wire.offset = g_responseLength;
    g_wire.totalLength = 0u;
    g_wire.payloadCrc32 = 0u;
    g_wire.length = 0u;
    g_wire.status = 0u;
    g_state = ROUTER_WAIT_POLL;
    g_sendPending = 1u;
}

static void setData(void)
{
    uint16_t remaining = (uint16_t) (g_request.dataLength - g_requestOffset);
    g_wire.offset = g_requestOffset;
    g_wire.totalLength = g_request.dataLength;
    g_wire.payloadCrc32 = g_request.payloadCrc32;
    g_wire.length = (remaining > OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) ? OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES : (uint8_t) remaining;
    g_wire.status = 0u;
    memcpy(g_wire.data, &g_request.data[g_requestOffset], g_wire.length);
    g_state = ROUTER_WAIT_DATA;
    g_sendPending = 1u;
}

static uint32_t nextWireTransactionId(void)
{
    g_wireTransactionSequence++;
    if (g_wireTransactionSequence == 0u ||
        g_wireTransactionSequence == 0xFFFFFFFFu)
        g_wireTransactionSequence = 1u;
    return g_wireTransactionSequence;
}

static uint8_t replyStatusValid(const observerParamFrame *reply)
{
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t transport;
    if (reply == 0) return 0u;
    status = (uint8_t) (reply->status & OBSERVER_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    transport = (uint8_t) (reply->status &
        (uint8_t) ~OBSERVER_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    return (uint8_t) (status <= PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED &&
        (transport == 0u || transport == OBSERVER_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE));
}

static uint8_t replyMatchesCurrentPhase(const observerParamFrame *reply)
{
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t more;
    uint16_t remaining;
    uint8_t expectedLength;
    if (reply == 0 || reply->transactionId != g_wireTransactionId ||
        reply->slot != g_request.slot || reply->target != g_request.target ||
        replyStatusValid(reply) == 0u) return 0u;
    status = (uint8_t) (reply->status & OBSERVER_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
    more = (uint8_t) (reply->status & OBSERVER_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE);
    if (g_state == ROUTER_WAIT_BEGIN || g_state == ROUTER_WAIT_DATA)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK &&
            reply->op == g_request.op &&
            reply->offset == g_wire.offset &&
            reply->totalLength == g_request.dataLength &&
            reply->payloadCrc32 == 0u && reply->length == 0u && more == 0u);
    }
    if (g_state != ROUTER_WAIT_POLL ||
        reply->offset != g_responseLength) return 0u;
    if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (reply->op == OBSERVER_PARAM_OP_POLL &&
            reply->totalLength == 0u && reply->payloadCrc32 == 0u &&
            reply->length == 0u && more == 0u);
    }
    if (reply->op == OBSERVER_PARAM_OP_POLL)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK &&
            reply->totalLength == 0u && reply->payloadCrc32 == 0u &&
            reply->length == 0u && more == 0u);
    }
    if (reply->op != g_request.op ||
        reply->totalLength > sizeof(g_responseData) ||
        reply->offset > reply->totalLength ||
        (g_responseIdentityPrimed != 0u &&
         (reply->totalLength != g_responseExpectedLength ||
          reply->payloadCrc32 != g_responsePayloadCrc32))) return 0u;
    remaining = (uint16_t) (reply->totalLength - reply->offset);
    expectedLength = (remaining > OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) ?
        OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES : (uint8_t) remaining;
    return (uint8_t) (reply->length == expectedLength &&
        ((remaining > expectedLength) ?
            (more != 0u) : (more == 0u)));
}

static void startRequest(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    observerLinkCore1EndpointStatus status;
    g_request = *request;
    memset(&g_wire, 0, sizeof(g_wire));
    g_wireTransactionId = nextWireTransactionId();
    g_wire.transactionId = g_wireTransactionId;
    g_wire.op = request->op;
    g_wire.slot = request->slot;
    g_wire.target = request->target;
    g_wire.status = OBSERVER_PARAM_TRANSPORT_BEGIN;
    g_wire.totalLength = request->dataLength;
    g_wire.payloadCrc32 = request->payloadCrc32;
    g_requestOffset = 0u;
    g_responseLength = 0u;
    g_responseExpectedLength = 0u;
    g_responsePayloadCrc32 = 0u;
    g_responseIdentityPrimed = 0u;
    g_deadlineMs = tickMs + OBSERVER_ROUTER_TIMEOUT_MS;
    g_state = ROUTER_WAIT_BEGIN;
    g_sendPending = 1u;
    getObserverStatus(request->target, &status);
    if (observerReady(&status) == 0u)
    {
        publish(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED);
        return;
    }
    g_requestPeerSession = status.peerSession;
}

void paramSyncObserverRouterInit(void)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest retainedRequest;
    g_state = ROUTER_IDLE;
    g_sendPending = 0u;
    g_lastBoot = g_lastSequence = g_responseSequence = 0u;
    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&retainedRequest) != 0u)
    {
        /* 共享邮箱是保留快照；重启只建立基线，不能重放旧请求。 */
        g_lastBoot = retainedRequest.producerBootGeneration;
        g_lastSequence = retainedRequest.sequence;
    }
    g_routerBootGeneration = coreDataGetPlanBootGeneration();
    g_requestPeerSession = 0u;
    g_wireTransactionSequence = 0u;
    g_wireTransactionId = 0u;
    memset(g_globalRoutes, 0, sizeof(g_globalRoutes));
    memset(&g_latestGlobalState, 0, sizeof(g_latestGlobalState));
    g_latestGlobalStateValid = 0u;
    g_latestGlobalStatePrimed = 0u;
    g_latestGlobalStateLastAdvanceMs = 0u;
    g_globalRoutes[0].source = 3u;
    g_globalRoutes[1].source = 4u;
    g_globalRoutes[0].bridgeDirty = 1u;
    g_globalRoutes[1].bridgeDirty = 1u;
    publishGlobalBridge(&g_globalRoutes[0], 0u, 1u);
    publishGlobalBridge(&g_globalRoutes[1], 0u, 1u);
}

void paramSyncObserverRouterPoll(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest request;
    observerParamFrame reply;
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    uint8_t status;
    observerLinkCore1EndpointStatus ownerStatus;

    pollGlobalRoutes(tickMs);

    if (g_state == ROUTER_IDLE && paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&request) &&
        (request.producerBootGeneration != g_lastBoot ||
         sequenceNewer(request.sequence, g_lastSequence) != 0u))
    {
        g_lastBoot = request.producerBootGeneration;
        g_lastSequence = request.sequence;
        if (request.target == 3u || request.target == 4u) startRequest(&request, tickMs);
    }
    if (g_state == ROUTER_IDLE) return;
    getObserverStatus(g_request.target, &ownerStatus);
    if (observerReady(&ownerStatus) == 0u ||
        ownerStatus.peerSession != g_requestPeerSession)
    {
        publish(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED);
        return;
    }
    if ((int32_t) (tickMs - g_deadlineMs) >= 0)
    {
        publish(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED);
        return;
    }
    if (takeResponse(payload, sizeof(payload), &length) &&
        observerParamDecode(payload, length, &reply) &&
        reply.transactionId == g_wireTransactionId)
    {
        if (replyMatchesCurrentPhase(&reply) == 0u)
        {
            publish(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID);
            return;
        }
        status = (uint8_t) (reply.status & OBSERVER_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
        if (g_state == ROUTER_WAIT_BEGIN)
        {
            if (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING)
            {
                publish(status);
                return;
            }
            if (g_request.dataLength == 0u) setPoll();
            else setData();
        }
        else if (g_state == ROUTER_WAIT_DATA)
        {
            if (status != PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING)
            {
                publish(status);
                return;
            }
            g_requestOffset = (uint16_t) (g_requestOffset + g_wire.length);
            if (g_requestOffset >= g_request.dataLength) setPoll();
            else setData();
        }
        else if (status == PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING)
        {
            setPoll();
        }
        else if (reply.offset != g_responseLength ||
                 (uint32_t) g_responseLength + reply.length > sizeof(g_responseData))
        {
            publish(PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID);
            return;
        }
        else
        {
            if (g_responseIdentityPrimed == 0u)
            {
                g_responseExpectedLength = reply.totalLength;
                g_responsePayloadCrc32 = reply.payloadCrc32;
                g_responseIdentityPrimed = 1u;
            }
            memcpy(&g_responseData[g_responseLength], reply.data, reply.length);
            g_responseLength = (uint16_t) (g_responseLength + reply.length);
            if ((reply.status & OBSERVER_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE) != 0u) setPoll();
            else
            {
                publish(status);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    if (g_sendPending && observerParamEncode(&g_wire, payload, &length) &&
        queueRequest(payload, length))
        g_sendPending = 0u;
}

static uint8_t activationContext(uint8_t *oldSlot, uint8_t *newSlot)
{
    uint32_t word = paramSyncActivationRollbackRetained;
    if (paramSyncActivationRollbackInverseRetained != ~word ||
        (word & 0xFFFF0000u) != CORE1_ACTIVATE_ROLLBACK_MAGIC)
        return 0u;
    *oldSlot = (uint8_t) word;
    *newSlot = (uint8_t) (word >> 8);
    return (uint8_t) (*oldSlot >= 1u && *oldSlot <= 5u &&
                      *newSlot >= 1u && *newSlot <= 5u);
}

static void setActivationContext(uint8_t oldSlot, uint8_t newSlot)
{
    uint32_t word = CORE1_ACTIVATE_ROLLBACK_MAGIC |
                    (uint32_t) oldSlot | ((uint32_t) newSlot << 8);
    paramSyncActivationRollbackRetained = word;
    paramSyncActivationRollbackInverseRetained = ~word;
}

static void clearActivationContext(void)
{
    paramSyncActivationRollbackRetained = 0u;
    paramSyncActivationRollbackInverseRetained = UINT32_MAX;
}

static uint8_t rollbackActivation(void)
{
    uint8_t oldSlot, newSlot;
    (void) activationContext(&oldSlot, &newSlot);
    if (visionParamsAbortPendingActivation() != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
    clearActivationContext();
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t recoverActivationAfterOwnerBoot(void)
{
    if (activationRecoveryChecked) return 1u;
    activationRecoveryChecked = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

static void putU16(uint8_t *p, uint16_t v)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t) v;
    p[1] = (uint8_t) (v >> 8);
}
static void putU32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t v)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t) v;
    p[1] = (uint8_t) (v >> 8);
    p[2] = (uint8_t) (v >> 16);
    p[3] = (uint8_t) (v >> 24);
}
static uint16_t getU16(const uint8_t *p)
{
    return (uint16_t) (p[0] | ((uint16_t) p[1] << 8));
}
static uint32_t getU32(const uint8_t *p)
{
    return (uint32_t) p[0] | ((uint32_t) p[1] << 8) | ((uint32_t) p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t) p[3] << 24);
}

static uint32_t getOwnerBootGeneration(void)
{
    uint32_t previous;
    if (ownerBootGeneration != 0u) return ownerBootGeneration;
    previous = paramSyncOwnerBootRetained;
    if ((previous == 0u) ||
        (paramSyncOwnerBootInverseRetained != ~previous)) previous = 0u;
    previous++;
    if (previous == 0u) previous = 1u;
    paramSyncOwnerBootRetained = previous;
    paramSyncOwnerBootInverseRetained = ~previous;
    ownerBootGeneration = previous;
    return ownerBootGeneration;
}

static void encodeBlob(const visionParamsStruct *params, visionFlashBlobStruct *blob)
{
    memset(blob, 0, sizeof(*blob));
    blob->magic = VISION_FLASH_MAGIC;
    blob->version = VISION_FLASH_VERSION;
    blob->payloadBytes = sizeof(*blob);
    blob->param = *params;
    blob->crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) blob, (uint32_t) offsetof(visionFlashBlobStruct, crc));
}

static uint8_t finishCoordinatorDecision(uint8_t operation,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSyncCoordinatorDecision decision;
    if (!paramSyncCoordinatorJournalGet(&decision)) return 0u;
    if (!decision.valid) return 1u;
    if (decision.decision != operation ||
        decision.transactionId != transactionId) return 0u;
    return paramSyncCoordinatorJournalClear();
}

static uint8_t coordinatorAllowsFinish(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSyncCoordinatorDecision decision;
    return (uint8_t) (paramSyncCoordinatorJournalGet(&decision) &&
        decision.valid && decision.decision == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH &&
        decision.transactionId == transactionId);
}

static uint8_t coordinatorAllowsAbort(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSyncCoordinatorDecision decision;
    return (uint8_t) (paramSyncCoordinatorJournalGet(&decision) &&
        (!decision.valid ||
         (decision.decision == PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT &&
          decision.transactionId == transactionId)));
}

static uint8_t producerBootChangeAllowed(
    const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    paramSyncCoordinatorDecision decision;
    visionParamsPendingInfo pending;
    uint8_t oldSlot, newSlot;
    uint8_t activationPending;
    uint8_t transactionPending;
    uint32_t transactionId;

    if (!paramSyncCoordinatorJournalGet(&decision) ||
        visionParamsGetPending(&pending) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
    activationPending = (uint8_t) (activationContext(&oldSlot, &newSlot) ||
        (pending.valid != 0u && pending.activationOnly != 0u));
    transactionPending = (uint8_t) (syncMutationLocked || stagedActive ||
        stagedPrepared || stagedCommitted || pending.valid || decision.valid);
    if ((activationPending == 0u) && (transactionPending == 0u)) return 1u;
    if ((request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_RECOVERY) &&
        (request->dataLength == 0u)) return 1u;
    if ((request->op != PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH &&
         request->op != PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT) ||
        (request->dataLength != 4u)) return 0u;

    transactionId = getU32(request->data);
    if (activationPending != 0u)
    {
        if ((transactionId != 0u) || stagedActive || stagedPrepared ||
            stagedCommitted) return 0u;
        if ((decision.valid != 0u) &&
            (request->op != decision.decision ||
             decision.transactionId != 0u)) return 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((pending.valid != 0u) &&
        (transactionId != pending.transactionId)) return 0u;
    if ((syncMutationLocked != 0u) &&
        (transactionId != syncLockedTransaction)) return 0u;
    if ((stagedActive || stagedPrepared || stagedCommitted) &&
        (transactionId != stagedTransaction)) return 0u;
    if ((decision.valid != 0u) &&
        (request->op != decision.decision ||
         transactionId != decision.transactionId)) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t persistentMutationPending(void)
{
    visionParamsPendingInfo pending;
    visionParamsSlotStatus pendingStatus;
    uint8_t persistentPending = 1u;
    pendingStatus = visionParamsGetPending(&pending);
    /* GetPending 将 EMPTY 映射为 OK + valid=0；真实读取错误保持 fail-closed。 */
    if (pendingStatus == VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        persistentPending = pending.valid;
    return persistentPending;
}

uint8_t paramSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (syncMutationLocked || stagedActive || stagedPrepared ||
        stagedCommitted || persistentMutationPending());
}

static uint8_t decodeGlobalTransaction(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request,
    uint8_t allowDefaultSlot, uint8_t *slot, uint32_t *transactionId)
{
    if (request->dataLength != 5u) return 0u;
    *slot = request->data[0];
    *transactionId = getU32(&request->data[1]);
    return (uint8_t) ((*transactionId != 0u) &&
        (*transactionId != UINT32_MAX) &&
        ((*slot >= 1u && *slot <= 5u) ||
         (allowDefaultSlot != 0u && *slot == 0u)));
}

static uint8_t transactionLocked(uint8_t slot, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    return (uint8_t) (syncMutationLocked != 0u &&
        syncLockedSlot == slot && syncLockedTransaction == transactionId);
}

static void publish(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request, uint8_t status,
    const uint8_t *data, uint16_t length, uint32_t crc)
{
    paramSyncMailboxResponse r;
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof(r));
    responseSequence++;
    if (!responseSequence) responseSequence = 1;
    r.producerBootGeneration = getOwnerBootGeneration();
    r.sequence = responseSequence;
    r.transactionId = request->transactionId;
    r.offset = request->offset;
    r.payloadCrc32 = crc;
    r.dataLength = length;
    r.op = request->op;
    r.slot = request->slot;
    r.target = request->target;
    r.status = status;
    if (data && length) memcpy(r.data, data, length);
    (void) paramSyncMailboxPublishResponse(&r);
}

static void publishDiagnostic(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request,
    uint8_t status, uint8_t detail)
{
    publish(request, status, &detail, 1u, 0u);
}

static void publishCoordinatorConflict(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request,
    const paramSyncCoordinatorDecision *current)
{
    uint8_t out[8u];
    out[0] = PARAM_DIAG_JOURNAL_CONFLICT;
    out[1] = current->decision;
    putU32(&out[2], current->transactionId);
    out[6] = current->targetMask;
    out[7] = current->slot;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, out, sizeof(out), 0u);
}

static void handleReadMeta(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t out[26];
    visionParamsLibraryMeta meta;
    visionParamsStruct params;
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    uint32_t blobCrc = 0u;
    memset(&meta, 0, sizeof(meta));
    if (request->dataLength != 1u || request->data[0] < 1u || request->data[0] > 5u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (visionParamsInspectSlot(request->data[0], &meta) !=
        VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (meta.state == VISION_PARAMS_LIBRARY_VALID)
    {
        if (visionParamsReadSlot(request->data[0], &params, NULL) !=
            VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        {
            publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        encodeBlob(&params, &blob);
        blobCrc = blob.crc;
    }
    out[0] = 1u;
    out[1] = request->data[0];
    out[2] = meta.state;
    out[3] = 0u;
    putU32(&out[4], VISION_FLASH_VERSION);
    putU32(&out[8], meta.generation);
    putU32(&out[12], blobCrc);
    putU32(&out[16], meta.transactionId);
    putU32(&out[20], CORE1_SCHEMA_HASH);
    putU16(&out[24], sizeof(visionFlashBlobStruct));
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, out, sizeof(out), 0u);
}

static void handleReadRuntimeMeta(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t out[32];
    visionParamsStruct runtime, active;
    visionParamsRuntimeMeta meta;
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;

    if (request->dataLength != 0u ||
        visionParamsReadRuntime(&runtime, &meta) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    encodeBlob(&runtime, &blob);
    visionParamsGetActive(&active);
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(out));
    out[0] = 1u;
    out[1] = meta.valid;
    out[2] = meta.bank;
    out[3] = meta.pending;
    out[4] = (uint8_t) (memcmp(&runtime, &active, sizeof(runtime)) != 0);
    out[5] = meta.sourceSlot;
    out[6] = meta.diagnosticFlags;
    putU32(&out[8], VISION_FLASH_VERSION);
    putU32(&out[12], meta.generation);
    putU32(&out[16], blob.crc);
    putU32(&out[20], meta.transactionId);
    putU32(&out[24], CORE1_SCHEMA_HASH);
    putU16(&out[28], sizeof(blob));
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, out, sizeof(out), 0u);
}

static void handleReadRuntimeChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    visionParamsStruct params;
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    uint8_t out[PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX];
    uint16_t offset, length;

    if (request->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    offset = getU16(&request->data[0]);
    length = getU16(&request->data[2]);
    if (length == 0u || length > (PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX - 4u) ||
        (uint32_t) offset + length > sizeof(blob) ||
        visionParamsReadRuntime(&params, NULL) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    encodeBlob(&params, &blob);
    putU16(&out[0], offset);
    putU16(&out[2], sizeof(blob));
    memcpy(&out[4], ((const uint8_t *) &blob) + offset, length);
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, out, (uint16_t) (4u + length),
        blob.crc);
}

static void handleReadChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    visionParamsStruct params;
    visionParamsSlotMeta meta;
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    uint8_t out[PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX];
    uint8_t slot;
    uint16_t offset, length;
    if (request->dataLength != 5u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    slot = request->data[0];
    offset = getU16(&request->data[1]);
    length = getU16(&request->data[3]);
    if (slot < 1u || slot > 5u || length == 0u || length > (PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX - 5u) ||
        offset >= sizeof(blob) || ((uint32_t) offset + length) > sizeof(blob) ||
        visionParamsReadSlot(slot, &params, &meta) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    encodeBlob(&params, &blob);
    out[0] = slot;
    putU16(&out[1], offset);
    putU16(&out[3], sizeof(blob));
    memcpy(&out[5], ((const uint8_t *) &blob) + offset, length);
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, out, (uint16_t) (5u + length), blob.crc);
}

static void handlePrepareLibraryFromLive(
    const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    visionParamsStruct active;
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;

    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (stagedPrepared != 0u || stagedCommitted != 0u)
    {
        publish(request, (stagedKind == PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY &&
            stagedSlot == slot && stagedTransaction == transactionId) ?
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u,
            stagedExpectedCrc);
        return;
    }
    visionParamsGetActive(&active);
    encodeBlob(&active, &blob);
    if (visionParamsPrepareSlot(slot, &active, transactionId) !=
        VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publishDiagnostic(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED,
            PARAM_DIAG_PREPARE_SLOT);
        return;
    }
    clearStaging();
    stagedBlob = blob;
    stagedSlot = slot;
    stagedTransaction = transactionId;
    stagedExpectedCrc = blob.crc;
    stagedBytes = sizeof(blob);
    stagedReceived = sizeof(blob);
    stagedPrepared = 1u;
    stagedKind = PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, blob.crc);
}

static void handlePrepareRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    visionParamsSlotStatus status;

    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u ||
        slot == 0u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (stagedPrepared != 0u || stagedCommitted != 0u)
    {
        publish(request, (stagedKind == PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME &&
            stagedSlot == slot && stagedTransaction == transactionId) ?
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    status = visionParamsPrepareRuntimeFromSlot(slot, transactionId);
    if (status != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    clearStaging();
    stagedSlot = slot;
    stagedTransaction = transactionId;
    stagedPrepared = 1u;
    stagedKind = PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleCommitRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u ||
        stagedKind != PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME || stagedPrepared == 0u ||
        stagedSlot != slot || stagedTransaction != transactionId)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (stagedCommitted == 0u &&
        visionParamsCommitRuntime(transactionId) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    stagedCommitted = 1u;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleApplyRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u ||
        stagedKind != PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME || stagedCommitted == 0u ||
        stagedSlot != slot || stagedTransaction != transactionId)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (stagedApplied == 0u &&
        visionParamsApplyPreparedRuntime(transactionId) !=
            VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    stagedApplied = 1u;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handlePrepareBegin(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint32_t transactionId = r->dataLength == 19u ?
        getU32(&r->data[1]) : 0u;
    if (r->dataLength != 19u || r->data[0] < 1u || r->data[0] > 5u ||
        transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX ||
        getU32(&r->data[5]) != VISION_FLASH_VERSION ||
        getU32(&r->data[9]) != CORE1_SCHEMA_HASH ||
        getU16(&r->data[17]) != sizeof(stagedBlob))
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (stagedPrepared || stagedCommitted)
    {
        if (visionParamsAbortPreparedSlot(stagedTransaction) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        {
            publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
    }
    clearStaging();
    memset(&stagedBlob, 0, sizeof(stagedBlob));
    stagedSlot = r->data[0];
    stagedTransaction = transactionId;
    stagedExpectedCrc = getU32(&r->data[13]);
    stagedBytes = getU16(&r->data[17]);
    stagedReceived = 0u;
    stagedActive = 1u;
    stagedPrepared = 0u;
    stagedCommitted = 0u;
    stagedKind = PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY;
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static void handlePrepareChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint16_t offset, length;
    if (!stagedActive || r->dataLength < 5u)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    slot = r->data[0];
    offset = getU16(&r->data[1]);
    length = getU16(&r->data[3]);
    if (slot != stagedSlot || offset != stagedReceived || length != (uint16_t) (r->dataLength - 5u) ||
        ((uint32_t) offset + length) > stagedBytes)
    {
        stagedActive = 0u;
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(((uint8_t *) &stagedBlob) + offset, &r->data[5], length);
    stagedReceived = (uint16_t) (stagedReceived + length);
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static void handlePrepareFinish(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint32_t computed;
    if (!stagedActive || r->dataLength != 1u || r->data[0] != stagedSlot || stagedReceived != stagedBytes ||
        stagedBlob.magic != VISION_FLASH_MAGIC || stagedBlob.version != VISION_FLASH_VERSION ||
        stagedBlob.payloadBytes != sizeof(stagedBlob))
    {
        stagedActive = 0u;
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    computed = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &stagedBlob, (uint32_t) offsetof(visionFlashBlobStruct, crc));
    if (computed != stagedBlob.crc || computed != stagedExpectedCrc ||
        visionParamsPrepareSlot(stagedSlot, &stagedBlob.param, stagedTransaction) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        stagedActive = 0u;
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    stagedActive = 0u;
    stagedPrepared = 1u;
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, computed);
}

static void handleCommit(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (r->dataLength != 5u || r->data[0] < 1u || r->data[0] > 5u)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    slot = r->data[0];
    transactionId = getU32(&r->data[1]);
    if (stagedKind != PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY || !stagedPrepared ||
        slot != stagedSlot || transactionId != stagedTransaction)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (!stagedCommitted &&
        visionParamsCommitPreparedSlot(slot, transactionId, 0u) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publishDiagnostic(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED,
            PARAM_DIAG_COMMIT_SLOT);
        return;
    }
    stagedCommitted = 1u;
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static void handleActivate(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t oldSlot, pendingSlot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (r->dataLength != 5u || r->data[0] < 1u || r->data[0] > 5u)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    slot = r->data[0];
    transactionId = getU32(&r->data[1]);
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        if (!syncMutationLocked || syncLockedSlot != slot || stagedActive ||
            stagedPrepared || stagedCommitted)
        {
            publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        if (activationContext(&oldSlot, &pendingSlot))
        {
            publish(r, pendingSlot == slot ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        oldSlot = visionParamsGetActiveSlot();
        if (oldSlot < 1u || oldSlot > 5u)
        {
            publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        setActivationContext(oldSlot, slot);
    }
    if ((transactionId != 0u &&
            (!stagedCommitted || transactionId != stagedTransaction || slot != stagedSlot)) ||
        (transactionId == 0u ? visionParamsActivateSlotPending(slot) :
            visionParamsActivatePreparedSlot(slot, transactionId)) !=
                VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        if (transactionId == 0u) (void) rollbackActivation();
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static void handleAbort(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (r->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    transactionId = getU32(r->data);
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        uint8_t ok = (uint8_t) (
            finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, 0u) &&
            rollbackActivation());
        if (ok) clearMutationLock();
        publish(r, ok ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (!stagedActive && !stagedPrepared && !stagedCommitted &&
        transactionId == lastAbortedTransaction)
    {
        publish(r, finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT,
            transactionId) ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK :
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (!stagedActive && !stagedPrepared && !stagedCommitted)
    {
        visionParamsPendingInfo pending;
        if (visionParamsGetPending(&pending) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        {
            publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        if (!pending.valid)
        {
            lastAbortedTransaction = transactionId;
            clearStaging();
            clearMutationLock();
            publish(r, finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT,
                transactionId) ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK :
                PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
    }
    if ((stagedActive || stagedPrepared || stagedCommitted) &&
        transactionId != stagedTransaction)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (!coordinatorAllowsAbort(transactionId))
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (visionParamsAbortPreparedSlot(transactionId) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    lastAbortedTransaction = transactionId;
    clearStaging();
    clearMutationLock();
    if (!finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT, transactionId))
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static void handleFinish(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (r->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    transactionId = getU32(r->data);
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        visionParamsPendingInfo pending;
        if (visionParamsGetPending(&pending) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        {
            publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        if (!pending.valid)
        {
            clearActivationContext();
            clearMutationLock();
            publish(r, finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH, 0u) ?
                PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        if (!pending.activationOnly || !coordinatorAllowsFinish(0u) ||
            visionParamsFinishPendingActivation() != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        {
            publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        clearActivationContext();
        clearMutationLock();
        publish(r, finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH, 0u) ?
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (!stagedActive && !stagedPrepared && !stagedCommitted &&
        transactionId == lastFinishedTransaction)
    {
        publish(r, finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH,
            transactionId) ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK :
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if ((stagedActive || stagedPrepared || stagedCommitted) &&
        transactionId != stagedTransaction)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    {
        visionParamsPendingInfo pending;
        if (visionParamsGetPending(&pending) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK ||
            (pending.valid && !coordinatorAllowsFinish(transactionId)))
        {
            publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
        if (!pending.valid && !stagedActive && !stagedPrepared && !stagedCommitted)
        {
            lastFinishedTransaction = transactionId;
            clearStaging();
            clearMutationLock();
            publish(r, finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH,
                transactionId) ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK :
                PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
    }
    if ((stagedKind == PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY && stagedCommitted == 0u) ||
        (stagedKind == PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME &&
         (stagedCommitted == 0u || stagedApplied == 0u)) ||
        visionParamsFinishPreparedSlot(transactionId) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    lastFinishedTransaction = transactionId;
    clearStaging();
    clearMutationLock();
    if (!finishCoordinatorDecision(PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH, transactionId))
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static void handleDecide(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint8_t operation, slot, targetMask;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    visionParamsPendingInfo pending;
    paramSyncCoordinatorDecision current;
    if (r->dataLength != 7u)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    operation = r->data[0];
    slot = r->data[1];
    transactionId = getU32(&r->data[2]);
    targetMask = r->data[6];
    if (slot > 5u || targetMask == 0u ||
        (targetMask & ~0x1Fu) != 0u)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (!paramSyncCoordinatorJournalGet(&current))
    {
        publishDiagnostic(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED,
            PARAM_DIAG_JOURNAL_GET);
        return;
    }
    if (operation == PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT)
    {
        if (current.valid &&
            (current.decision != PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT ||
             current.transactionId != transactionId || current.slot != slot))
        {
            publishCoordinatorConflict(r, &current);
            return;
        }
        if (!paramSyncCoordinatorJournalWrite(operation, transactionId,
                targetMask, slot))
        {
            publishDiagnostic(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED,
                PARAM_DIAG_JOURNAL_WRITE);
            return;
        }
    }
    else if (operation == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH)
    {
        if (targetMask != 0x1Fu ||
            visionParamsGetPending(&pending) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK ||
            !pending.valid || pending.slot != slot ||
            ((transactionId == 0u) ? (!pending.activationOnly) :
                (pending.activationOnly || pending.transactionId != transactionId)) ||
            (current.valid && current.transactionId != transactionId))
        {
            publishDiagnostic(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED,
                PARAM_DIAG_FINISH_PREREQUISITE);
            return;
        }
        if (!paramSyncCoordinatorJournalWrite(operation, transactionId,
                targetMask, slot))
        {
            publishDiagnostic(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED,
                PARAM_DIAG_JOURNAL_WRITE);
            return;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static void handleRecovery(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint8_t out[7];
    paramSyncCoordinatorDecision decision;
    visionParamsPendingInfo pending;
    if (r->dataLength != 0u ||
        !paramSyncCoordinatorJournalGet(&decision) ||
        visionParamsGetPending(&pending) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
    {
        publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(out));
    if (decision.valid)
    {
        out[0] = decision.decision;
        putU32(&out[1], decision.transactionId);
        out[5] = decision.targetMask;
        out[6] = decision.slot;
    }
    else if (pending.valid)
    {
        out[0] = PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT;
        putU32(&out[1], pending.activationOnly ? 0u : pending.transactionId);
        out[5] = 0x1Fu;
        out[6] = pending.slot;
    }
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, out, sizeof(out), 0u);
}

static void handleLock(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *r)
{
    uint8_t oldSlot, newSlot;
    uint32_t transactionId = (r->dataLength == 5u) ?
        getU32(&r->data[1]) : 0u;
    if (r->dataLength != 5u || r->data[0] > 5u ||
        transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX ||
        (syncMutationLocked && (syncLockedSlot != r->data[0] ||
         syncLockedTransaction != transactionId)) ||
        stagedActive || stagedPrepared || stagedCommitted ||
        persistentMutationPending() ||
        activationContext(&oldSlot, &newSlot))
    {
        publishDiagnostic(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY,
            PARAM_DIAG_LOCK_CONFLICT);
        return;
    }
    syncMutationLocked = 1u;
    syncLockedSlot = r->data[0];
    syncLockedTransaction = transactionId;
    publish(r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, 0, 0, 0);
}

static uint8_t retainedRequestMayResume(
    const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    if (request->target != 1u) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_QUERY ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_CHUNK ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_META ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_RECOVERY ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_DECIDE);
}

void paramSyncOwnerServiceInit(void)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest retainedRequest;
    lastBoot = 0u;
    lastSequence = 0u;
    responseSequence = 0u;
    (void) getOwnerBootGeneration();
    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&retainedRequest) != 0u &&
        retainedRequestMayResume(&retainedRequest) == 0u)
    {
        lastBoot = retainedRequest.producerBootGeneration;
        lastSequence = retainedRequest.sequence;
        if (retainedRequest.target == 1u)
            publish(&retainedRequest, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, 0, 0, 0);
    }
}

void paramSyncOwnerServicePoll(void)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest r;
    if (!paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&r)) return;
    if (r.producerBootGeneration == lastBoot && r.sequence == lastSequence) return;
    if (r.producerBootGeneration == lastBoot &&
        (int32_t) (r.sequence - lastSequence) <= 0) return;
    if (lastBoot != 0u && r.producerBootGeneration != lastBoot)
    {
        if (producerBootChangeAllowed(&r) == 0u)
        {
            if (r.target == 1u) publish(&r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, 0, 0, 0);
            return;
        }
    }
    lastBoot = r.producerBootGeneration;
    lastSequence = r.sequence;
    if (r.target != 1u) return;
    if (!recoverActivationAfterOwnerBoot())
    {
        publish(&r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, 0, 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    switch (r.op)
    {
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META: handleReadMeta(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_CHUNK: handleReadChunk(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_META: handleReadRuntimeMeta(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK: handleReadRuntimeChunk(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_LIBRARY_FROM_LIVE:
            handlePrepareLibraryFromLive(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_RUNTIME_FROM_SLOT:
            handlePrepareRuntime(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT_RUNTIME: handleCommitRuntime(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_APPLY_RUNTIME: handleApplyRuntime(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_BEGIN: handlePrepareBegin(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_CHUNK: handlePrepareChunk(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_VERIFY: handlePrepareFinish(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT: handleCommit(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_ACTIVATE: handleActivate(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT: handleAbort(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH: handleFinish(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_LOCK: handleLock(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_DECIDE: handleDecide(&r); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_RECOVERY: handleRecovery(&r); break;
        default: publish(&r, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_REJECTED, 0, 0, 0); break;
    }
}

SHA-256：f32b00f61dd9fabb1dd83da5f0ad656a4ee1d1c85208b1240c32ce28c67804ee
代码（c）
#include "THVD1450.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "zf_device_type.h"

#include "zf_driver_gpio.h"
#include "zf_driver_uart.h"

#include "pinMap.h" /* RS-485 UART 编号/引脚/方向脚单一真相源 */

#define THVD1450_UART_NUM      (RS485_UART_NUM)
#define THVD1450_UART_TX_PIN   (RS485_UART_TX_PIN)
#define THVD1450_UART_RX_PIN   (RS485_UART_RX_PIN)

#define THVD1450_DIR_PIN             (RS485_DIR_PIN)
#define THVD1450_RX_FRAME_QUEUE_SIZE (4u)
/* 单次 Poll 排空字节预算: RS-485 未接/悬空/噪声时 RX FIFO 可能持续有字节, 无界 while drain
 * 会拖住前台(饿死 10ms RS-485 命令节拍 / 200ms 核间心跳)。限 64 字节/轮, 余下留下一轮。
 * 帧队列满仍由 thvd1450PushFrame 丢最旧策略兜底。 */
#define THVD1450_POLL_BYTE_BUDGET    (64u)
#if THVD1450_UART_BAUDRATE != 1000000u
#error "Core1-Core2 RS-485 baud contract requires 1 Mbps"
#endif

static uint8_t thvd1450TxBuffer[THVD1450_FRAME_LENGTH_MAX];

static thvd1450ParserStruct thvd1450Parser;
static thvd1450FrameStruct thvd1450RxQueue[THVD1450_RX_FRAME_QUEUE_SIZE];

static volatile uint8_t thvd1450RxHead = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t thvd1450RxTail = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t thvd1450RxCount = 0u;

static uint8_t thvd1450NextIndex(uint8_t index)
{
    index++;
    if (index >= THVD1450_RX_FRAME_QUEUE_SIZE)
    {
        index = 0u;
    }

    return index;
}

static void thvd1450PushFrame(const thvd1450FrameStruct *frame)
{
    if (NULL == frame)
    {
        return;
    }

    if (thvd1450RxCount >= THVD1450_RX_FRAME_QUEUE_SIZE)
    {
        thvd1450RxHead = thvd1450NextIndex(thvd1450RxHead);
        thvd1450RxCount--;
    }

    thvd1450RxQueue[thvd1450RxTail] = *frame;
    thvd1450RxTail = thvd1450NextIndex(thvd1450RxTail);
    thvd1450RxCount++;
}

static void thvd1450HandleByte(uint8_t data)
{
    thvd1450FrameStruct rxFrame;
    thvd1450StatusEnum status;

    status = thvd1450ProtocolInputByte(&thvd1450Parser, data, &rxFrame);
    if (THVD1450_STATUS_FRAME_READY == status)
    {
        thvd1450PushFrame(&rxFrame);
    }
}

void thvd1450Init(void)
{
    thvd1450ProtocolInit(&thvd1450Parser);
    memset(thvd1450RxQueue, 0, sizeof(thvd1450RxQueue));
    thvd1450RxHead = 0u;
    thvd1450RxTail = 0u;
    thvd1450RxCount = 0u;

    uart_init(THVD1450_UART_NUM, THVD1450_UART_BAUDRATE, THVD1450_UART_TX_PIN, THVD1450_UART_RX_PIN);
    gpio_init(THVD1450_DIR_PIN, GPO, GPIO_LOW, GPO_PUSH_PULL);

    thvd1450SetMode(THVD1450_MODE_RECEIVE);

    set_wireless_type(RECEIVER_UART, thvd1450RxIrqHandler);
    uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 1u);
}

void thvd1450SetMode(thvd1450ModeEnum mode)
{
    if (THVD1450_MODE_TRANSMIT == mode)
    {
        gpio_high(THVD1450_DIR_PIN);
    }
    else
    {
        gpio_low(THVD1450_DIR_PIN);
    }
}

void thvd1450Poll(void)
{
    uint8_t data;
    uint8_t budget = THVD1450_POLL_BYTE_BUDGET;

    uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 0u);
    /* 限预算排空: 达 THVD1450_POLL_BYTE_BUDGET 即退出本轮, 剩余字节留下一轮 Poll 处理。 */
    while (budget > 0u && uart_query_byte(THVD1450_UART_NUM, &data))
    {
        thvd1450HandleByte(data);
        budget--;
    }
    uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 1u);
}

thvd1450StatusEnum thvd1450SendBytes(const uint8_t *payload, uint8_t length)
{
    uint8_t frameLength = 0u;
    thvd1450StatusEnum status;

    status = thvd1450ProtocolEncode(
        payload,
        length,
        thvd1450TxBuffer,
        (uint8_t)sizeof(thvd1450TxBuffer),
        &frameLength);
    if (THVD1450_STATUS_OK != status)
    {
        return status;
    }

    thvd1450SetMode(THVD1450_MODE_TRANSMIT);
    uart_write_buffer(THVD1450_UART_NUM, thvd1450TxBuffer, frameLength);
    thvd1450SetMode(THVD1450_MODE_RECEIVE);

    return THVD1450_STATUS_OK;
}

void thvd1450RxIrqHandler(void)
{
    uint8_t data;

    if (uart_query_byte(THVD1450_UART_NUM, &data))
    {
        thvd1450HandleByte(data);
    }
}

thvd1450StatusEnum thvd1450ReadFrame(thvd1450FrameStruct *frame)
{
    if (NULL == frame)
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 0u);
    if (0u == thvd1450RxCount)
    {
        uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 1u);
        return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
    }

    *frame = thvd1450RxQueue[thvd1450RxHead];
    thvd1450RxHead = thvd1450NextIndex(thvd1450RxHead);
    thvd1450RxCount--;
    uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 1u);
    return THVD1450_STATUS_OK;
}

SHA-256：634e0a17539c065b6fda54bd997e2dfbe871fe8480c45d41630e20389016056f
代码（c）
#include "THVD1450_protocol.h"

#include <string.h>

#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD     (0u)
#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH   (1u)
#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_PAYLOAD  (2u)
#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_CHECKSUM (3u)
#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_TAIL     (4u)

static void thvd1450ProtocolRestartFromHead(thvd1450ParserStruct *parser)
{
    thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
    parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH;
}

void thvd1450ProtocolInit(thvd1450ParserStruct *parser)
{
    thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
}

void thvd1450ProtocolReset(thvd1450ParserStruct *parser)
{
    if (NULL == parser)
    {
        return;
    }

    memset(parser, 0, sizeof(*parser));
    parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD;
}

uint8_t thvd1450ProtocolChecksum(const uint8_t *payload, uint8_t length)
{
    uint8_t checksum = length;
    uint8_t i;

    for (i = 0u; i < length; i++)
    {
        checksum ^= payload[i];
    }

    return checksum;
}

thvd1450StatusEnum thvd1450ProtocolEncode(
    const uint8_t *payload,
    uint8_t length,
    uint8_t *frameBuffer,
    uint8_t frameBufferSize,
    uint8_t *frameLength)
{
    if ((NULL == frameBuffer) || (NULL == frameLength) || ((0u != length) && (NULL == payload)))
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (length > THVD1450_PAYLOAD_LENGTH_MAX)
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_LENGTH_ERROR;
    }

    if (frameBufferSize < (uint8_t)(length + THVD1450_FRAME_OVERHEAD))
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_LENGTH_ERROR;
    }

    frameBuffer[0] = THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD;
    frameBuffer[1] = length;

    if (0u != length)
    {
        memcpy(&frameBuffer[2], payload, length);
    }

    frameBuffer[2u + length] = thvd1450ProtocolChecksum(payload, length);
    frameBuffer[3u + length] = THVD1450_FRAME_TAIL;
    *frameLength = (uint8_t)(length + THVD1450_FRAME_OVERHEAD);

    return THVD1450_STATUS_OK;
}

thvd1450StatusEnum thvd1450ProtocolInputByte(
    thvd1450ParserStruct *parser,
    uint8_t byte,
    thvd1450FrameStruct *outFrame)
{
    if (NULL == parser)
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    switch (parser->state)
    {
        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD:
        {
            if (THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD == byte)
            {
                parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH;
            }
            return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
        }

        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH:
        {
            if (byte > THVD1450_PAYLOAD_LENGTH_MAX)
            {
                thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
                return THVD1450_STATUS_LENGTH_ERROR;
            }

            parser->expectedLength = byte;
            parser->frame.length = byte;
            parser->checksum = byte;
            parser->index = 0u;
            parser->state = (0u == byte) ? THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_CHECKSUM : THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_PAYLOAD;
            return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
        }

        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_PAYLOAD:
        {
            parser->frame.payload[parser->index] = byte;
            parser->checksum ^= byte;
            parser->index++;

            if (parser->index >= parser->expectedLength)
            {
                parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_CHECKSUM;
            }
            return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
        }

        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_CHECKSUM:
        {
            if (byte != parser->checksum)
            {
                if (THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD == byte)
                {
                    thvd1450ProtocolRestartFromHead(parser);
                }
                else
                {
                    thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
                }
                return THVD1450_STATUS_CHECKSUM_ERROR;
            }

            parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_TAIL;
            return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
        }

        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_TAIL:
        {
            if (THVD1450_FRAME_TAIL == byte)
            {
                if (NULL != outFrame)
                {
                    *outFrame = parser->frame;
                }
                thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
                return THVD1450_STATUS_FRAME_READY;
            }

            if (THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD == byte)
            {
                thvd1450ProtocolRestartFromHead(parser);
            }
            else
            {
                thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
            }
            return THVD1450_STATUS_TAIL_ERROR;
        }

        default:
        {
            thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
            break;
        }
    }

    return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
}

#ifndef _THVD1450_PROTOCOL_H_
#define _THVD1450_PROTOCOL_H_

#include <stdint.h>

#define THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD         (0x7Au)
#define THVD1450_UART_BAUDRATE      (1000000u)
#define THVD1450_FRAME_TAIL         (0x55u)
#define THVD1450_DATA_LENGTH_MAX    (16u)
#define THVD1450_PAYLOAD_LENGTH_MAX (THVD1450_DATA_LENGTH_MAX)
#define THVD1450_FRAME_OVERHEAD     (4u)
#define THVD1450_FRAME_LENGTH_MAX   (THVD1450_PAYLOAD_LENGTH_MAX + THVD1450_FRAME_OVERHEAD)

typedef enum
{
    THVD1450_STATUS_OK = 0u,
    THVD1450_STATUS_FRAME_READY,
    THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME,
    THVD1450_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM,
    THVD1450_STATUS_LENGTH_ERROR,
    THVD1450_STATUS_CHECKSUM_ERROR,
    THVD1450_STATUS_TAIL_ERROR,
} thvd1450StatusEnum;

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t length;
    uint8_t payload[THVD1450_PAYLOAD_LENGTH_MAX];
} thvd1450FrameStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t state;
    uint8_t index;
    uint8_t expectedLength;
    uint8_t checksum;
    thvd1450FrameStruct frame;
} thvd1450ParserStruct;

void thvd1450ProtocolReset(thvd1450ParserStruct *parser);

    uint8_t *frameBuffer,
    uint8_t frameBufferSize,
    uint8_t *frameLength);

    thvd1450ParserStruct *parser,
    uint8_t byte,
    thvd1450FrameStruct *outFrame);

#endif // _THVD1450_PROTOCOL_H_
