#include "uartLinkProto.h"

/* float ↔ 4 字节小端互转（core0/core1 同为小端 ARM，按字节显式拼装传输）。 */
typedef union { float f; uint8_t b[4]; } uartLinkFloatBytes;

static uint8_t crc8AtmUpdate(uint8_t crc, uint8_t data)
{
    uint8_t bit;
    crc ^= data;
    for (bit = 0u; bit < 8u; bit++)
    {
        crc = (crc & 0x80u) ? (uint8_t)((crc << 1u) ^ 0x07u) : (uint8_t)(crc << 1u);
    }
    return crc;
}

static uint8_t xorU32Le(uint8_t value, uint32_t data)
{
    return (uint8_t)(value ^ (uint8_t)data ^ (uint8_t)(data >> 8)
        ^ (uint8_t)(data >> 16) ^ (uint8_t)(data >> 24));
}

static uint8_t xorU16Le(uint8_t value, uint16_t data)
{
    return (uint8_t)(value ^ (uint8_t)data ^ (uint8_t)(data >> 8));
}

static void putU32Le(uint8_t *buffer, uint8_t offset, uint32_t value)
{
    buffer[offset] = (uint8_t)value;
    buffer[offset + 1u] = (uint8_t)(value >> 8);
    buffer[offset + 2u] = (uint8_t)(value >> 16);
    buffer[offset + 3u] = (uint8_t)(value >> 24);
}

static uint32_t getU32Le(const uint8_t *buffer, uint8_t offset)
{
    return (uint32_t)buffer[offset]
        | ((uint32_t)buffer[offset + 1u] << 8)
        | ((uint32_t)buffer[offset + 2u] << 16)
        | ((uint32_t)buffer[offset + 3u] << 24);
}

/* 按 type 返回帧总长（含 HEAD/TAIL）；未知 type 返回 0。 */
static uint8_t uartLinkProtoFrameLen(uint8_t type)
{
    switch (type)
    {
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PING:
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_ACK:
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_HEARTBEAT:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_STATUS;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0STATUS;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0POSE;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_MOTION;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_CONTROL;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_EVENT;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_STATUS:
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_REQUEST:
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_KVM_STATUS;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST;
        case UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE:
            return UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE;
        default:
            return 0u;
    }
}

void uartLinkProtoInit(uartLinkParserStruct *parser)
{
    uint8_t i;

    if (0 == parser)
    {
        return;
    }

    parser->index = 0u;
    parser->expectLen = 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_MAX; ++i)
    {
        parser->buffer[i] = 0u;
    }
}

uint8_t uartLinkProtoChecksum(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    if (0 == frame)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t beaconLo = (uint8_t)(frame->beaconCount & 0xFFu);
        uint8_t beaconHi = (uint8_t)((frame->beaconCount >> 8) & 0xFFu);
        return (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence ^ beaconLo ^ beaconHi ^
            frame->linkFlags ^ frame->faultSource ^ frame->faultClass ^
            (uint8_t)frame->producerBootSession ^ (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 8) ^
            (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 16) ^ (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 24));
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t crc = 0u;
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->type);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sequence);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->safetyState);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->armProgress);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->statusFlags);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sysCtrl);
        return crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->buzzer);
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes vx, vy, wz;
        uint8_t i;
        uint8_t x = 0u;
        vx.f = frame->motionVx;
        vy.f = frame->motionVy;
        wz.f = frame->motionWz;
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, frame->type);
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, frame->sequence);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, vx.b[i]);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, vy.b[i]);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, wz.b[i]);
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, frame->motionFlags);
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, (uint8_t)frame->producerBootSession);
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 8));
        x = crc8AtmUpdate(x, (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 16));
        return crc8AtmUpdate(x, (uint8_t)(frame->producerBootSession >> 24));
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes yaw;
        uint8_t i;
        uint8_t x = (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence ^ frame->poseEpoch
            ^ (uint8_t)(frame->poseXQ8 & 0xFFu) ^ (uint8_t)((frame->poseXQ8 >> 8) & 0xFFu)
            ^ (uint8_t)(frame->poseYQ8 & 0xFFu) ^ (uint8_t)((frame->poseYQ8 >> 8) & 0xFFu));
        yaw.f = frame->poseOrientationRad;
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) x = (uint8_t)(x ^ yaw.b[i]);
        x = (uint8_t)(x ^ frame->poseConfidenceQ8 ^ frame->poseFlags);
        return x;
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t x = (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        x = (uint8_t)(x ^ frame->kvmTarget);
        return xorU16Le(x, frame->kvmLeaseMs);
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t x = (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmEventSeq);
        return (uint8_t)(x ^ frame->kvmTarget ^ frame->kvmKeyId ^ frame->kvmKeyState);
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t x = (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        x = xorU32Le(x, frame->kvmEventSeq);
        x = (uint8_t)(x ^ frame->kvmTarget ^ frame->kvmActiveTarget
            ^ frame->kvmMenuStates ^ frame->kvmFlags ^ frame->kvmAckResult);
        return xorU16Le(x, frame->kvmCore3AgeMs);
    }

    if ((UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_REQUEST == frame->type) ||
        (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE == frame->type))
    {
        uint8_t crc = 0u;
        uint8_t i;
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->type);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sequence);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramOp);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramReserved);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramTarget);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramStatus);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
            (uint8_t)(frame->paramRequestId >> (8u * i)));
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, (uint8_t)frame->paramOffset);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, (uint8_t)(frame->paramOffset >> 8));
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramLength);
        for (i = 0u; i < UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES; i++)
            crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
                (i < frame->paramLength) ? frame->paramData[i] : 0u);
        return crc;
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST == frame->type)
    {
        uint8_t crc = 0u;
        uint8_t i;
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->type);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sequence);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
            (uint8_t)(frame->paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration >> (8u * i)));
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
            (uint8_t)(frame->paramGlobalRequest.sequence >> (8u * i)));
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramGlobalRequest.origin);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramGlobalRequest.action);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramGlobalRequest.slot);
        return crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->paramGlobalRequest.reserved);
    }

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE == frame->type)
    {
        const uint32_t words[5] = {
            frame->paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration,
            frame->paramGlobalState.sequence,
            frame->paramGlobalState.requestBootGeneration,
            frame->paramGlobalState.requestSequence,
            frame->paramGlobalState.transactionId
        };
        const uint8_t bytes[8] = {
            frame->paramGlobalState.origin, frame->paramGlobalState.action,
            frame->paramGlobalState.slot, frame->paramGlobalState.phase,
            frame->paramGlobalState.target, frame->paramGlobalState.error,
            frame->paramGlobalState.readyMask, frame->paramGlobalState.flags
        };
        uint8_t crc = 0u;
        uint8_t i, j;
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->type);
        crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, frame->sequence);
        for (i = 0u; i < 5u; i++)
            for (j = 0u; j < 4u; j++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc,
                (uint8_t)(words[i] >> (8u * j)));
        for (i = 0u; i < 8u; i++) crc = crc8AtmUpdate(crc, bytes[i]);
        return crc;
    }

    /* 基础帧：type ^ seq ^ value */
    return (uint8_t)(frame->type ^ frame->sequence ^ frame->value);
}

uartLinkProtoStatusEnum uartLinkProtoEncode(const uartLinkFrameStruct *frame, uint8_t *buffer, uint8_t bufferSize)
{
    uint8_t frameLen;

    if (0 == frame || 0 == buffer)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    frameLen = uartLinkProtoFrameLen(frame->type);
    if (0u == frameLen)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_TYPE_ERROR;
    }
    if (bufferSize < frameLen)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    buffer[0] = UART_LINK_FRAME_HEAD;
    buffer[1] = frame->type;
    buffer[2] = frame->sequence;

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        buffer[3] = (uint8_t)(frame->beaconCount & 0xFFu);
        buffer[4] = (uint8_t)((frame->beaconCount >> 8) & 0xFFu);
        buffer[5] = frame->linkFlags;
        buffer[6] = frame->faultSource;
        buffer[7] = frame->faultClass;
        putU32Le(buffer, 8u, frame->producerBootSession);
        buffer[12] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[13] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        buffer[3] = frame->safetyState;
        buffer[4] = frame->armProgress;
        buffer[5] = frame->statusFlags;
        buffer[6] = frame->sysCtrl;
        buffer[7] = frame->buzzer;
        buffer[8] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[9] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes vx, vy, wz;
        uint8_t i;
        vx.f = frame->motionVx;
        vy.f = frame->motionVy;
        wz.f = frame->motionWz;
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) buffer[3u + i] = vx.b[i];
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) buffer[7u + i] = vy.b[i];
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) buffer[11u + i] = wz.b[i];
        buffer[15] = frame->motionFlags;
        putU32Le(buffer, 16u, frame->producerBootSession);
        buffer[20] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[21] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes yaw;
        uint8_t i;
        yaw.f = frame->poseOrientationRad;
        buffer[3] = frame->poseEpoch;
        buffer[4] = (uint8_t)(frame->poseXQ8 & 0xFFu);
        buffer[5] = (uint8_t)((frame->poseXQ8 >> 8) & 0xFFu);
        buffer[6] = (uint8_t)(frame->poseYQ8 & 0xFFu);
        buffer[7] = (uint8_t)((frame->poseYQ8 >> 8) & 0xFFu);
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) buffer[8u + i] = yaw.b[i];
        buffer[12] = frame->poseConfidenceQ8;
        buffer[13] = frame->poseFlags;
        buffer[14] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[15] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL == frame->type)
    {
        putU32Le(buffer, 3u, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 7u, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 11u, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        buffer[15] = frame->kvmTarget;
        buffer[16] = (uint8_t)frame->kvmLeaseMs;
        buffer[17] = (uint8_t)(frame->kvmLeaseMs >> 8);
        buffer[18] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[19] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT == frame->type)
    {
        putU32Le(buffer, 3u, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 7u, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 11u, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        putU32Le(buffer, 15u, frame->kvmEventSeq);
        buffer[19] = frame->kvmTarget;
        buffer[20] = frame->kvmKeyId;
        buffer[21] = frame->kvmKeyState;
        buffer[22] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[23] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        putU32Le(buffer, 3u, frame->kvmTargetSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 7u, frame->kvmRouteSession);
        putU32Le(buffer, 11u, frame->kvmRouteEpoch);
        putU32Le(buffer, 15u, frame->kvmEventSeq);
        buffer[19] = frame->kvmTarget;
        buffer[20] = frame->kvmActiveTarget;
        buffer[21] = frame->kvmMenuStates;
        buffer[22] = frame->kvmFlags;
        buffer[23] = frame->kvmAckResult;
        buffer[24] = (uint8_t)frame->kvmCore3AgeMs;
        buffer[25] = (uint8_t)(frame->kvmCore3AgeMs >> 8);
        buffer[26] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[27] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if ((UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_REQUEST == frame->type) ||
        (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE == frame->type))
    {
        uint8_t i;
        if (frame->paramLength > UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES)
            return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
        buffer[3] = frame->paramOp;
        buffer[4] = frame->paramReserved;
        buffer[5] = frame->paramTarget;
        buffer[6] = frame->paramStatus;
        putU32Le(buffer, 7u, frame->paramRequestId);
        buffer[11] = (uint8_t)frame->paramOffset;
        buffer[12] = (uint8_t)(frame->paramOffset >> 8);
        buffer[13] = frame->paramLength;
        for (i = 0u; i < UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES; i++)
            buffer[14u + i] = (i < frame->paramLength) ? frame->paramData[i] : 0u;
        buffer[26] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[27] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST == frame->type)
    {
        putU32Le(buffer, 3u, frame->paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration);
        putU32Le(buffer, 7u, frame->paramGlobalRequest.sequence);
        buffer[11] = frame->paramGlobalRequest.origin;
        buffer[12] = frame->paramGlobalRequest.action;
        buffer[13] = frame->paramGlobalRequest.slot;
        buffer[14] = frame->paramGlobalRequest.reserved;
        buffer[15] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[16] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE == frame->type)
    {
        putU32Le(buffer, 3u, frame->paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration);
        putU32Le(buffer, 7u, frame->paramGlobalState.sequence);
        putU32Le(buffer, 11u, frame->paramGlobalState.requestBootGeneration);
        putU32Le(buffer, 15u, frame->paramGlobalState.requestSequence);
        putU32Le(buffer, 19u, frame->paramGlobalState.transactionId);
        buffer[23] = frame->paramGlobalState.origin;
        buffer[24] = frame->paramGlobalState.action;
        buffer[25] = frame->paramGlobalState.slot;
        buffer[26] = frame->paramGlobalState.phase;
        buffer[27] = frame->paramGlobalState.target;
        buffer[28] = frame->paramGlobalState.error;
        buffer[29] = frame->paramGlobalState.readyMask;
        buffer[30] = frame->paramGlobalState.flags;
        buffer[31] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[32] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }
    else
    {
        buffer[3] = frame->value;
        buffer[4] = uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame);
        buffer[5] = UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL;
    }

    return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK;
}

uartLinkProtoStatusEnum uartLinkProtoInputByte(uartLinkParserStruct *parser, uint8_t data, uartLinkFrameStruct *frame)
{
    uint8_t frameLen;

    if (0 == parser || 0 == frame)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    /* 等待帧头：index==0 时只接受 HEAD，其余字节丢弃。 */
    if (0u == parser->index && UART_LINK_FRAME_HEAD != data)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK;
    }

    parser->buffer[parser->index] = data;
    parser->index++;

    /* 读到 type（index==2 即第 2 字节落位后）确定期望帧长。 */
    if (2u == parser->index)
    {
        parser->expectLen = uartLinkProtoFrameLen(parser->buffer[1]);
        if (0u == parser->expectLen)
        {
            /* 未知 type：复位重新找帧头，报类型错。 */
            parser->index = 0u;
            return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_TYPE_ERROR;
        }
    }

    /* expectLen 未定或未集满，继续收。 */
    if (parser->index < 2u || parser->index < parser->expectLen)
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_OK;
    }

    /* 集满一帧，解析。 */
    frameLen = parser->expectLen;
    parser->index = 0u;
    parser->expectLen = 0u;

    frame->type = parser->buffer[1];
    frame->sequence = parser->buffer[2];
    frame->value = 0u;
    frame->beaconCount = 0u;
    frame->linkFlags = 0u;
    frame->faultSource = 0u;
    frame->faultClass = 0u;
    frame->producerBootSession = 0u;
    frame->safetyState = 0u;
    frame->armProgress = 0u;
    frame->statusFlags = 0u;
    frame->sysCtrl = 0u;
    frame->buzzer = 0u;
    frame->poseEpoch = 0u;
    frame->poseXQ8 = 0u;
    frame->poseYQ8 = 0u;
    frame->poseOrientationRad = 0.0f;
    frame->poseConfidenceQ8 = 0u;
    frame->poseFlags = 0u;
    frame->motionVx = 0.0f;
    frame->motionVy = 0.0f;
    frame->motionWz = 0.0f;
    frame->motionFlags = 0u;
    frame->kvmTargetSession = 0u;
    frame->kvmRouteSession = 0u;
    frame->kvmRouteEpoch = 0u;
    frame->kvmEventSeq = 0u;
    frame->kvmLeaseMs = 0u;
    frame->kvmCore3AgeMs = 0u;
    frame->kvmTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    frame->kvmActiveTarget = UART_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    frame->kvmKeyId = 0u;
    frame->kvmKeyState = 0u;
    frame->kvmMenuStates = 0xFFu;
    frame->kvmFlags = 0u;
    frame->kvmAckResult = UART_LINK_KVM_ACK_NONE;
    frame->paramRequestId = 0u;
    frame->paramOffset = 0u;
    frame->paramOp = 0u;
    frame->paramReserved = 0u;
    frame->paramTarget = 0u;
    frame->paramStatus = 0u;
    frame->paramLength = 0u;
    { uint8_t i; for (i = 0u; i < UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES; i++) frame->paramData[i] = 0u; }
    frame->paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalRequest.sequence = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalRequest.origin = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalRequest.action = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalRequest.slot = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalRequest.reserved = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.sequence = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.requestBootGeneration = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.requestSequence = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.transactionId = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.origin = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.action = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.slot = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.phase = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.target = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.error = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.readyMask = 0u;
    frame->paramGlobalState.flags = 0u;

    if (UART_LINK_TYPE_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        frame->beaconCount = (uint16_t)(parser->buffer[3] | ((uint16_t)parser->buffer[4] << 8));
        frame->linkFlags = parser->buffer[5];
        frame->faultSource = parser->buffer[6];
        frame->faultClass = parser->buffer[7];
        frame->producerBootSession = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 8u);
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        frame->safetyState = parser->buffer[3];
        frame->armProgress = parser->buffer[4];
        frame->statusFlags = parser->buffer[5];
        frame->sysCtrl = parser->buffer[6];
        frame->buzzer = parser->buffer[7];
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_MOTION == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes vx, vy, wz;
        uint8_t i;
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) vx.b[i] = parser->buffer[3u + i];
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) vy.b[i] = parser->buffer[7u + i];
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) wz.b[i] = parser->buffer[11u + i];
        frame->motionVx = vx.f;
        frame->motionVy = vy.f;
        frame->motionWz = wz.f;
        frame->motionFlags = parser->buffer[15];
        frame->producerBootSession = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 16u);
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_CORE0_POSE == frame->type)
    {
        uartLinkFloatBytes yaw;
        uint8_t i;
        frame->poseEpoch = parser->buffer[3];
        frame->poseXQ8 = (uint16_t)(parser->buffer[4] | ((uint16_t)parser->buffer[5] << 8));
        frame->poseYQ8 = (uint16_t)(parser->buffer[6] | ((uint16_t)parser->buffer[7] << 8));
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) yaw.b[i] = parser->buffer[8u + i];
        frame->poseOrientationRad = yaw.f;
        frame->poseConfidenceQ8 = parser->buffer[12];
        frame->poseFlags = parser->buffer[13];
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_CONTROL == frame->type)
    {
        frame->kvmTargetSession = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 3u);
        frame->kvmRouteSession = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 7u);
        frame->kvmRouteEpoch = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 11u);
        frame->kvmTarget = parser->buffer[15];
        frame->kvmLeaseMs = (uint16_t)(parser->buffer[16] | ((uint16_t)parser->buffer[17] << 8));
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_EVENT == frame->type)
    {
        frame->kvmTargetSession = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 3u);
        frame->kvmRouteSession = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 7u);
        frame->kvmRouteEpoch = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 11u);
        frame->kvmEventSeq = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 15u);
        frame->kvmTarget = parser->buffer[19];
        frame->kvmKeyId = parser->buffer[20];
        frame->kvmKeyState = parser->buffer[21];
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_KVM_STATUS == frame->type)
    {
        frame->kvmTargetSession = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 3u);
        frame->kvmRouteSession = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 7u);
        frame->kvmRouteEpoch = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 11u);
        frame->kvmEventSeq = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 15u);
        frame->kvmTarget = parser->buffer[19];
        frame->kvmActiveTarget = parser->buffer[20];
        frame->kvmMenuStates = parser->buffer[21];
        frame->kvmFlags = parser->buffer[22];
        frame->kvmAckResult = parser->buffer[23];
        frame->kvmCore3AgeMs = (uint16_t)(parser->buffer[24] | ((uint16_t)parser->buffer[25] << 8));
    }
    else if ((UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_REQUEST == frame->type) ||
        (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_RESPONSE == frame->type))
    {
        uint8_t i;
        frame->paramOp = parser->buffer[3];
        frame->paramReserved = parser->buffer[4];
        frame->paramTarget = parser->buffer[5];
        frame->paramStatus = parser->buffer[6];
        frame->paramRequestId = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 7u);
        frame->paramOffset = (uint16_t)(parser->buffer[11] | ((uint16_t)parser->buffer[12] << 8));
        frame->paramLength = parser->buffer[13];
        if (frame->paramLength > UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES)
            return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
        for (i = 0u; i < UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES; i++)
            frame->paramData[i] = parser->buffer[14u + i];
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST == frame->type)
    {
        frame->paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 3u);
        frame->paramGlobalRequest.sequence = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 7u);
        frame->paramGlobalRequest.origin = parser->buffer[11];
        frame->paramGlobalRequest.action = parser->buffer[12];
        frame->paramGlobalRequest.slot = parser->buffer[13];
        frame->paramGlobalRequest.reserved = parser->buffer[14];
        if (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&frame->paramGlobalRequest) == 0u)
            return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }
    else if (UART_LINK_TYPE_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE == frame->type)
    {
        frame->paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 3u);
        frame->paramGlobalState.sequence = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 7u);
        frame->paramGlobalState.requestBootGeneration = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 11u);
        frame->paramGlobalState.requestSequence = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 15u);
        frame->paramGlobalState.transactionId = getU32Le(parser->buffer, 19u);
        frame->paramGlobalState.origin = parser->buffer[23];
        frame->paramGlobalState.action = parser->buffer[24];
        frame->paramGlobalState.slot = parser->buffer[25];
        frame->paramGlobalState.phase = parser->buffer[26];
        frame->paramGlobalState.target = parser->buffer[27];
        frame->paramGlobalState.error = parser->buffer[28];
        frame->paramGlobalState.readyMask = parser->buffer[29];
        frame->paramGlobalState.flags = parser->buffer[30];
    }
    else
    {
        frame->value = parser->buffer[3];
    }

    if (uartLinkProtoChecksum(frame) != parser->buffer[frameLen - 2u])
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_CHECK_ERROR;
    }
    if (UART_LINK_FRAME_TAIL != parser->buffer[frameLen - 1u])
    {
        return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_TAIL_ERROR;
    }

    return UART_LINK_PROTO_STATUS_FRAME_READY;
}

#ifndef _UART_LINK_PROTO_H_
#define _UART_LINK_PROTO_H_

/*
 * SYNC: core0 ↔ core1 两份 uartLinkProto.c/.h 必须逐字节同源。改任一份后 diff 校验另一份。
 *
 * 帧族（按 type 定长解析，HEAD/TAIL 不变）：
 *   基础帧 6 字节  [HEAD|type|seq|value|xor|TAIL]
 *     - PING/ACK/HEARTBEAT：原有，value 留白
 *   状态帧 14 字节 [HEAD|type|seq|beaconLo|beaconHi|linkFlags|faultSource|faultClass|producerBootSession(4)|xor|TAIL]
 *     - STATUS(0x40)：core1→core0 回传信标数、链路标志和通用必需视觉故障来源/类别
 *       linkFlags bit1=core2LinkLost(core1 测 RS-485↔core2 断联，core0 据此聚合缓降并禁 K5 发车)；
 *       linkFlags bit2=mode2LoraLandReq(模式2调试 LoRa 双肩键缓降请求，仅转 manualLand，不请求起飞)；
 *       linkFlags bit3=requiredVisionFault(任一必需视觉故障；plan缺失/停更或必需视觉链路、相机、配置、标定故障均fail-closed，由core0聚合缓降并禁K5发车)；
 *       与心跳同周期(200ms)常发，不受 MOTION 帧 gotMotion 门控影响(故 core2 断联上报走此帧而非 MOTION flags)
 *   core0 状态帧 10 字节 [HEAD|0x44|seq|safetyState|armProgress|statusFlags|sysCtrl|buzzer|crc8|TAIL]
 *     - CORE0_STATUS(0x44)：core0→core1 回传 飞控安全态 + arming 进度 + 状态位(供 RGB 状态灯)
 *       + sysCtrl(空地系统模式/RGB意图/到顶标志) + buzzer(蜂鸣模式码，core1 中转 RS-485 给 core2 buzzer 库 pattern 层播放)
 *   core0 位姿帧 16 字节 [HEAD|0x42|seq|epoch|xQ8(2)|yQ8(2)|yaw(4)|confQ8|flags|xor|TAIL]
 *     - CORE0_POSE(0x42)：core0→core1 回传 core0 视觉灯板同坐标/方向，供 core1 车坐标误差生成和屏幕叠加
 *   运动帧 22 字节 [HEAD|0x51|seq|vx(4)|vy(4)|wz(4)|flags|producerBootSession(4)|crc8|TAIL]
 *     - MOTION(0x51)：core1→core0 运动前馈 vx/vy/wz（3×float 小端，来源=core1 规划(beaconNavigator) 或 LoRa 遥控转发）
 *       + flags(bit0=remoteTakeoffReq：模式3 车 LoRa S3+S4 请求，core0 按 TKO 阶段解释为起飞或缓降)
 *   CORE0_STATUS/MOTION 使用 CRC-8/ATM(poly=0x07, init=0)，覆盖 type+seq+payload；
 *   其余帧保持 xor = type ^ seq ^ 其余 payload 各字节。
 *   字节序：多字节字段显式按字节小端拼装，不依赖结构体布局。
 */

#include <stdint.h>
#include "paramSyncGlobal.h"

#define UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT (0u)
#define UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_ACCEPT (1u)
#define UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_REBIND (2u)

/* Core0只在STATUS已进入离线栅栏时允许任意非零producer session重绑。
 * 在线期间其它session一律拒绝，避免延迟旧帧抢占当前producer。 */
static inline uint8_t uartLinkRxSessionClassify(uint8_t statusFenced,
    uint32_t currentSession, uint32_t incomingSession)
{
    if (incomingSession == 0u) return UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    if (statusFenced != 0u) return UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_REBIND;
    return (incomingSession == currentSession) ? UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_ACCEPT : UART_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
}

#define UART_LINK_FRAME_HEAD (0xA5u)

#define UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_C0STATUS    (10u) /* core0 状态帧（CORE0_STATUS 0x44，含 sysCtrl+buzzer） */

 *   bit0-1 = systemMode；bit2-4 = rgbIntent；bit5 = altReached；

 *   1=车不动 2=RS-485 自主(车随视觉误差) 3=LoRa 转发(车 LoRa 遥控)。0=未设。 */
#define UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_CAR_STILL  (1u)
#define UART_LINK_SYS_MODE_RS485_AUTO (2u)

#define UART_LINK_RGB_NORMAL          (0u) /* 无动画，走 core1 原状态灯优先级链 */

#define UART_LINK_RGB_TKO_RAMP        (2u) /* 起飞 2s 爬高：常亮→线性渐灭 */
#define UART_LINK_RGB_DISCONNECT_WARN (3u) /* 断联告警：加速闪烁 */

#define UART_LINK_MOTION_FLAG_TAKEOFF_REQ (0x01u) /* 模式3 车 LoRa S3+S4 请求：TKO_IDLE 起飞，WAIT/RAMP/CRUISE 缓降 */

#define UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_TRACK_LOCKED           (0x01u) /* bit0：core0 视觉跟踪锁定 */

#define UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_HEADING_FRESH          (0x10u) /* bit4：本帧方向样本独立有效 */

/* buzzer 蜂鸣模式码（core0 产生 → core1 中转 RS-485 → core2 buzzer 库 pattern 层播放；与 chassisLink CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_* 同值 SYNC） */
#define UART_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT      (0u)

#define UART_LINK_BUZZER_WARN        (4u) /* 断联告警：急促鸣 */

#define UART_LINK_BUZZER_THREE_BEEPS (7u) /* 完整系统资格上升沿：三声一次 */

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t type;
    uint8_t sequence;
    uint8_t value;                /* 基础帧 payload */
    uint16_t beaconCount;         /* STATUS 帧：信标数 */
    uint8_t linkFlags;            /* STATUS 帧：链路标志 */
    uint8_t faultSource;          /* STATUS：必需视觉故障来源，0=无 */
    uint8_t faultClass;           /* STATUS：必需视觉故障类别，0=无 */
    uint32_t producerBootSession; /* STATUS/MOTION：Core1 cm7_0启动身份，0非法 */
    uint8_t safetyState;          /* CORE0_STATUS 帧：飞控安全态 */
    uint8_t armProgress;          /* CORE0_STATUS 帧：arming 进度 0~100 */
    uint8_t statusFlags;          /* CORE0_STATUS 帧：状态位(UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_*) */
    uint8_t sysCtrl;              /* CORE0_STATUS 帧：空地系统模式/RGB意图/到顶标志(UART_LINK_SYS_*) */
    uint8_t buzzer;               /* CORE0_STATUS 帧：蜂鸣模式码(UART_LINK_BUZZER_*，中转 core2 buzzer 库 pattern 层播放) */
    uint8_t poseEpoch;            /* CORE0_POSE 帧：core0 链路初始化 epoch，变更表示 core0 重启/共享区需重新锁存 */
    uint16_t poseXQ8;             /* CORE0_POSE 帧：core0 灯板 X，同坐标 Q8.8 */
    uint16_t poseYQ8;             /* CORE0_POSE 帧：core0 灯板 Y，同坐标 Q8.8 */
    float poseOrientationRad;     /* CORE0_POSE 帧：灯板方向 rad，范围约 [-pi, pi] */
    uint8_t poseConfidenceQ8;     /* CORE0_POSE 帧：方向置信度 Q0.8（0..255） */
    uint8_t poseFlags;            /* CORE0_POSE 帧：flags(UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_*) */
    float motionVx;               /* MOTION 帧：速度指令 vx；core0 速度前馈直用，pitch 前馈用其指令微分 */
    float motionVy;               /* MOTION 帧：速度指令 vy；core0 速度前馈直用，roll 前馈用其指令微分 */
    float motionWz;               /* MOTION 帧：角速度指令 wz；core0 yaw 前馈直通 */
    uint8_t motionFlags;          /* MOTION 帧：flags(UART_LINK_MOTION_FLAG_*，bit0=remoteTakeoffReq) */
    /* KVM_CONTROL/EVENT/STATUS：显式字段按帧类型编码，禁止裸结构体传输。 */
    uint32_t kvmTargetSession; /* 目标路由 owner boot session echo，重启后旧事件拒绝 */
    uint32_t kvmRouteSession;  /* Core0 cm7_1 菜单 boot epoch */
    uint32_t kvmRouteEpoch;    /* 每次切目标递增 */
    uint32_t kvmEventSeq;      /* 每 route epoch 从 1 起；STATUS 中为最后终态 ACK seq */
    uint16_t kvmLeaseMs;       /* CONTROL 租约上限 */
    uint16_t kvmCore3AgeMs;    /* STATUS：Core3 菜单状态年龄 */
    uint8_t kvmTarget;
    uint8_t kvmActiveTarget;
    uint8_t kvmKeyId;
    uint8_t kvmKeyState;
    uint8_t kvmMenuStates; /* STATUS：低4位 Core1、高4位 Core3 原始菜单态 */
    uint8_t kvmFlags;
    uint8_t kvmAckResult;
    uint32_t paramRequestId;
    uint16_t paramOffset;
    uint8_t paramOp;
    uint8_t paramReserved;
    uint8_t paramTarget;
    uint8_t paramStatus;
    uint8_t paramLength;
    uint8_t paramData[UART_LINK_PARAM_DATA_BYTES];
    paramSyncGlobalRequest paramGlobalRequest;
    paramSyncGlobalState paramGlobalState;
} uartLinkFrameStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t index;

    uint8_t buffer[UART_LINK_FRAME_LENGTH_MAX];
} uartLinkParserStruct;

#ifndef COMMON_DEF_H
#define COMMON_DEF_H

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * 跨模块公共定义：纯常量 / 数学工具 / 图像类型。
 * 本文件不含编译期硬件选择器（在 boardConfig.h，需要者直接包含）、也不含运行时可调参数。
 * 这里全是无副作用、可安全包含的常量与工具。
 */

/* ============================================================
 * 1. 数学宏（钳位 / 角度换算 / 圆周率）
 * ============================================================ */
#define range(x, min, max)  (((x) < (min)) ? (min) : (((x) > (max)) ? (max) : (x)))
#define unsignRange(x, max) (((x) > (max)) ? (max) : (x))

#define toRad(x) ((x) * 3.14159265358979323846f / 180.0f) /* 储备：当前无消费者，与在用的 toDeg 对称保留 */
#define toDeg(x) ((x) * 180.0f / 3.14159265358979323846f)

/* PI 可能已由 CMSIS DSP 的 arm_math.h 定义（值在 float 精度下等价），
 * 用 #ifndef 守卫避免 Pa181 宏重定义警告 */
#ifndef PI
#define PI      (3.14159265358979323846f)
#endif
#define TWO_PI  (2.0f * PI)
#define HALF_PI (0.5f * PI)

/* ============================================================
 * 2. 二值图像颜色
 * ============================================================ */
#define BLACK 0          /* 二值背景色 */
#define WHITE 255        /* 二值前景色 */
#define cReverse(x) ((x) ? BLACK : WHITE) /* 颜色翻转 */

/* ============================================================
 * 3. 跨模块 inline 工具（钳位 / 角度归一化）
 * ============================================================ */
static inline float clampf(float v, float lo, float hi)
{
    if (v < lo) return lo;
    if (v > hi) return hi;
    return v;
}

static inline float wrapToPi(float a)
{
    while (a > PI)  a -= TWO_PI;
    while (a < -PI) a += TWO_PI;
    return a;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 4. 通用图像 typedef
 *   u8Image 为视觉管线主力类型。
 * ============================================================ */
typedef struct
{
    uint8_t* ptr;

    uint32_t xLen;
    uint32_t yLen;

    uint32_t size;
} u8Image;

#endif

#ifndef _CONFIG_BEACON_DETECT_H_
#define _CONFIG_BEACON_DETECT_H_

/*
 * core1 cm_7_1 信标"检测层"调参中心：BinaryCC 与 Legacy Canny/om_beacon 热切换 + 相机曝光。
 * 默认值由 visionParamsLoadDefaults / menuLoadDefaults 加载，运行时菜单可改 + flash 持久化
 * （见 vision/visionParams.c + app/menuModel.c）。
 *
 * 三层配置头拆分（2026-07 重构，原 configVision.h 拆为 detect/track）：
 *   configBeaconDetect.h  — 本文件：DetectMode/BinaryCC/Legacy Canny/曝光/信标检测
 *   configBeaconTrack.h   — 时间一致性跟踪（关联/确认/丢弃/coast/位置·面积 alpha）
 *   configBeaconPlanning.h— 路径规划（中心/目标选择/增益/sign/限幅/Min/slew/施密特/TD/派发）
 * 底层 openMorph 缓冲尺寸（OM_*）在 vision/openMorph_config.h，不在此。
 *
 * 图像坐标系：core1 相机 MT9V03X 188×120 灰度。默认值调整后需重新实拍复核；
 * 菜单运行时可调并由 flash 持久化，换硬件或接线后同样必须复核。
 */

/* ============================================================
 * 1. DetectMode + 阈值 + 相机曝光（默认值 + 菜单编辑约束）
 *   规则为 low <= gray <= high；high=255 等价于关闭过曝拒绝。
 *   当前默认使用 Legacy Canny；BinaryCC 保留为菜单热切换回滚/对比。
 *   旧字段名 cannyLow/cannyHigh 仅为兼容 flash 前缀；当前语义为 BinaryCC low/high。
 * ============================================================ */
#define VISION_CANNY_SIGMA          (0.75f)  /* Legacy Canny 保留项；BinaryCC 不使用 */
#define VISION_DETECT_MODE_BINARYCC      (0u)
#define VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY  (1u)
#define VISION_DETECT_MODE_DEFAULT       VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY
#define VISION_BINARY_LOW_DEFAULT   (40u)

#ifndef _CONFIG_BEACON_TRACK_H_
#define _CONFIG_BEACON_TRACK_H_

/*
 * core1 cm_7_1 信标"跟踪层"调参中心：时间一致性跟踪（抗光关键层）。
 * 连续 confirmHits 帧关联才确认输出、连续 dropMisses 帧丢失才删除、coastMisses 帧内丢失仍滑行。
 * 关联更新用一阶低通平滑（位置/面积各一 alpha，越小越平滑）；新轨迹直贴测量值。
 * 轨迹内部用坐标速度(px/frame)与面积速度(area pixels/frame)预测下一帧关联残差；
 * 这些速度只作为轨迹事实，不负责 active target 选择。
 * 详见 vision/beaconTrack.c。默认值运行时菜单可调 + flash 持久化。
 *
 * 三层配置头拆分见 config/configBeaconDetect.h 顶注。
 */

#define VISION_TRACK_MAX_ASSOC_DIST_DEFAULT  (14.0f) /* 帧间质心最大关联距离(px) */
#define VISION_TRACK_SIZE_RATIO_MAX_DEFAULT  (3.0f)  /* 面积连续性: 检测面积/预测面积 比值上限 */

#ifndef _PIN_MAP_H_
#define _PIN_MAP_H_

/*
 * core1 飞机副控 / 视觉决策中枢 MCU 引脚集中管理（纯编译期 #define，零依赖）。
 *   右值为逐飞 GPIO/外设复用枚举（UART/TCPWM 通道名或裸 Pxx_y），
 *   仅在各消费 .c 的预处理期展开；本头不 include 任何驱动头，
 *   token 的实际定义由消费方自带的 zf_driver_* 头提供。
 *
 * 硬件事实详见 PROJECT.md §3.5 / §5；引脚汇总见 docs/PINOUT.md。
 */

/* ============================================================
 * 核间双 UART（core0 ↔ core1 同板，两条独立链路，分组交叉相连）
 *   分组 0：core1 P04 ↔ core0 P10
 *   分组 1：core1 P10 ↔ core0 P14
 *   引脚号跨核不同，靠同板线缆相连。建议一条专传算法/遥测、
 *   一条专传人机交互（仅 core0 有按键，交互信息汇于 core0）。
 *   *_NUM 为 UART 外设编号（外设复用选择，与引脚同属映射范畴）。
 * ============================================================ */
#define LINK_GROUP0_UART_NUM    (UART_1)
#define LINK_GROUP0_UART_RX_PIN (UART1_RX_P04_0)
#define LINK_GROUP0_UART_TX_PIN (UART1_TX_P04_1)

/* ============================================================
 * core3 后向观察板正式业务专线：
 *   core1 P02_1 TX -> core3 P02_0 RX，
 *   core3 P02_1 TX -> core1 P02_0 RX。
 * ============================================================ */
#define OBSERVER_CORE3_UART_NUM    (UART_5)
#define OBSERVER_CORE3_UART_RX_PIN (UART5_RX_P02_0)
#define OBSERVER_CORE3_UART_TX_PIN (UART5_TX_P02_1)
#define OBSERVER_CORE3_UART_SCB    (SCB7)

/* core4 前向观察板正式业务专线：core1 UART6/P03。 */
#define OBSERVER_CORE4_UART_NUM    (UART_6)
#define OBSERVER_CORE4_UART_RX_PIN (UART6_RX_P03_0)
#define OBSERVER_CORE4_UART_TX_PIN (UART6_TX_P03_1)
#define OBSERVER_CORE4_UART_SCB    (SCB6)

/* ============================================================
 * RS-485 收发器 THVD1450（UART_4，core1 ↔ core2 飞机-车模链路）
 *   RE#/DE 单引脚控制方向：高=发送 / 低=接收；外部下拉默认接收。
 * ============================================================ */
#define RS485_UART_NUM    (UART_4)
#define RS485_UART_RX_PIN (UART4_RX_P14_0) /* THVD1450 RO -> MCU RX */
#define RS485_UART_TX_PIN (UART4_TX_P14_1) /* MCU TX -> THVD1450 DI */
#define RS485_DIR_PIN     (P14_4)          /* RE#/DE 方向控制 */

/* ============================================================
 * RGB LED 灯珠（三路 TCPWM，共阳极：控制脚接阴极，低电平点亮）
 *   右值为 TCPWM 通道令牌（通道+引脚一体，对标 core2 MOTOR_*_EN_PWM），
 *   消费方 pwm_init/pwm_set_duty 直接取用。
 * ============================================================ */
#define RGB_LED_R_PWM (TCPWM_CH10_P05_1)
#define RGB_LED_G_PWM (TCPWM_CH11_P05_2)
#define RGB_LED_B_PWM (TCPWM_CH09_P05_0)

#endif /* _PIN_MAP_H_ */

SHA-256：41dfb8c71ac2097c94e88051aabf3dc4a09c930866556ed3bf56dceebf497f7a
代码（c）
#include "beaconNavigator.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "commonDef.h"
#include "configBeaconPlanning.h"
#include "schmitt.h"
#include "trackingDifferentiator.h"

typedef struct
{
    beaconNavigatorSnapshotStruct snapshot;
    beaconNavigatorParamViewStruct params;
    SchmittTrigger deadzone;
    trackingDifferentiatorStruct tdVx;
    trackingDifferentiatorStruct tdVy;
    trackingDifferentiatorStruct tdWz;
    float slewVx;
    float slewVy;
    float slewWz;
    uint8_t tdVxEnabled;
    uint8_t tdVyEnabled;
    uint8_t tdWzEnabled;
} beaconNavigatorContextStruct;

static beaconNavigatorContextStruct navigatorContext;
#define nav navigatorContext.snapshot
#define params navigatorContext.params

static uint8_t finiteFloat(float value)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((value == value) && (value > -1.0e30f) &&
        (value < 1.0e30f));
}

static float positiveLimit(float value)
{
    return (finiteFloat(value) && value > 0.0f) ? value : 0.0f;
}

static float slewToward(float current, float target, float step)
{
    float delta = target - current;
    if (delta > step) delta = step;
    if (delta < -step) delta = -step;
    return current + delta;
}

static float applyMinimum(float value, float minimum, float maximum)
{
    if (!finiteFloat(value) || !finiteFloat(minimum) || minimum < 0.0f ||
        maximum <= 0.0f) return 0.0f;
    value = clampf(value, -maximum, maximum);
    if (value == 0.0f || minimum == 0.0f) return value;
    minimum = (minimum > maximum) ? maximum : minimum;
    return (value < 0.0f) ? ((value > -minimum) ? -minimum : value) :
        ((value < minimum) ? minimum : value);
}

static void applyPlanarMinimum(float *vx, float *vy, float vxMinimum,
    float vyMinimum, float vxMaximum, float vyMaximum)
{
    float normalizedX;
    float normalizedY;
    float normalizedMagnitude;
    if ((vx == 0) || (vy == 0) || !finiteFloat(*vx) || !finiteFloat(*vy) ||
        !finiteFloat(vxMinimum) || !finiteFloat(vyMinimum) ||
        vxMinimum < 0.0f || vyMinimum < 0.0f)
    {
        if (vx != 0) *vx = 0.0f;
        if (vy != 0) *vy = 0.0f;
        return;
    }
    *vx = clampf(*vx, -vxMaximum, vxMaximum);
    *vy = clampf(*vy, -vyMaximum, vyMaximum);
    vxMinimum = (vxMinimum > vxMaximum) ? vxMaximum : vxMinimum;
    vyMinimum = (vyMinimum > vyMaximum) ? vyMaximum : vyMinimum;
    if ((*vx == 0.0f) && (*vy == 0.0f)) return;
    if ((vxMinimum == 0.0f) || (vyMinimum == 0.0f))
    {
        *vx = applyMinimum(*vx, vxMinimum, vxMaximum);
        *vy = applyMinimum(*vy, vyMinimum, vyMaximum);
        return;
    }
    if ((fabsf(*vx) >= vxMinimum) || (fabsf(*vy) >= vyMinimum)) return;
    normalizedX = *vx / vxMinimum;
    normalizedY = *vy / vyMinimum;
    normalizedMagnitude = hypotf(normalizedX, normalizedY);
    if (normalizedMagnitude >= 1.0f) return;
    if (!finiteFloat(normalizedMagnitude) || normalizedMagnitude <= 0.0f)
    {
        *vx = *vy = 0.0f;
        return;
    }
    *vx = clampf(*vx / normalizedMagnitude, -vxMaximum, vxMaximum);
    *vy = clampf(*vy / normalizedMagnitude, -vyMaximum, vyMaximum);
}

static void hardZero(void)
{
    nav.cmdVx = nav.cmdVy = nav.cmdWz = 0.0f;
    nav.vx = nav.vy = nav.wz = 0.0f;
    navigatorContext.slewVx = navigatorContext.slewVy = navigatorContext.slewWz = 0.0f;
    trackingDifferentiatorReset(&navigatorContext.tdVx, 0.0f);
    trackingDifferentiatorReset(&navigatorContext.tdVy, 0.0f);
    trackingDifferentiatorReset(&navigatorContext.tdWz, 0.0f);
}

static void clearCandidate(void)
{
    nav.targetValid = 0u;
    nav.targetFresh = 0u;
    nav.targetHolding = 0u;
    nav.sourceId = BEACON_SOURCE_NONE;
    nav.controlX = nav.controlY = nav.targetSize = nav.targetTrackId = 0u;
    nav.errX = nav.errY = nav.errFwd = nav.errRight = 0.0f;
}

static void copyPose(const core0PoseSupervisorSnapshot *pose)
{
    nav.poseValid = 0u;
    nav.poseHolding = 0u;
    nav.poseHeadingValid = 0u;
    nav.poseHeadingHolding = 0u;
    nav.poseLinkAlive = 0u;
    nav.poseFlags = 0u;
    nav.poseEpoch = 0u;
    nav.poseConfidenceQ8 = 0u;
    nav.poseHoldMs = 0u;
    nav.poseHeadingHoldMs = 0u;
    nav.poseRawX = 0.0f;
    nav.poseRawY = 0.0f;
    nav.poseHeadingRad = 0.0f;
    if (pose == 0) return;
    nav.poseValid = pose->positionValid;
    nav.poseHolding = pose->positionHolding;
    nav.poseHeadingValid = pose->headingValid;
    nav.poseHeadingHolding = pose->headingHolding;
    nav.poseLinkAlive = pose->linkAlive;
    nav.poseFlags = pose->flags;
    nav.poseEpoch = pose->poseEpoch;
    nav.poseConfidenceQ8 = pose->confidenceQ8;
    nav.poseHoldMs = pose->positionAgeMs;
    nav.poseHeadingHoldMs = pose->headingAgeMs;
    nav.poseRawX = pose->x;
    nav.poseRawY = pose->y;
    nav.poseHeadingRad = pose->headingRad;
}

static void syncTd(uint8_t desired, uint8_t *active, float *slew,
    float output, trackingDifferentiatorStruct *td)
{
    desired = (desired != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    if (*active == desired) return;
    *slew = output;
    trackingDifferentiatorReset(td, output);
    *active = desired;
}

static void applyOutput(float vx, float vy, float wz, float dtS,
    float intentScale, uint8_t applyMinimumOutput)
{
    float vxMax = positiveLimit(params.planningVxMax);
    float vyMax = positiveLimit(params.planningVyMax);
    float wzMax = positiveLimit(params.planningWzMax);
    if (!finiteFloat(intentScale))
    {
        hardZero();
        return;
    }
    intentScale = clampf(intentScale, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    syncTd(params.planningTdVxEnable, &navigatorContext.tdVxEnabled,
        &navigatorContext.slewVx, nav.vx, &navigatorContext.tdVx);
    syncTd(params.planningTdVyEnable, &navigatorContext.tdVyEnabled,
        &navigatorContext.slewVy, nav.vy, &navigatorContext.tdVy);
    syncTd(params.planningTdWzEnable, &navigatorContext.tdWzEnabled,
        &navigatorContext.slewWz, nav.wz, &navigatorContext.tdWz);
    navigatorContext.slewVx = slewToward(navigatorContext.slewVx,
        clampf(vx * intentScale, -vxMax, vxMax), params.planningVxSlewPerS * dtS);
    navigatorContext.slewVy = slewToward(navigatorContext.slewVy,
        clampf(vy * intentScale, -vyMax, vyMax), params.planningVySlewPerS * dtS);
    navigatorContext.slewWz = slewToward(navigatorContext.slewWz,
        clampf(wz * intentScale, -wzMax, wzMax), params.planningWzSlewPerS * dtS);
    nav.cmdVx = clampf(navigatorContext.slewVx, -vxMax, vxMax);
    nav.cmdVy = clampf(navigatorContext.slewVy, -vyMax, vyMax);
    nav.cmdWz = clampf(navigatorContext.slewWz, -wzMax, wzMax);
    trackingDifferentiatorSetParams(&navigatorContext.tdVx, params.planningTdRvx, dtS, params.planningTdN);
    trackingDifferentiatorSetParams(&navigatorContext.tdVy, params.planningTdRvy, dtS, params.planningTdN);
    trackingDifferentiatorSetParams(&navigatorContext.tdWz, params.planningTdRwz, dtS, params.planningTdN);
    nav.vx = navigatorContext.tdVxEnabled ? trackingDifferentiatorUpdate(&navigatorContext.tdVx, nav.cmdVx) : nav.cmdVx;
    nav.vy = navigatorContext.tdVyEnabled ? trackingDifferentiatorUpdate(&navigatorContext.tdVy, nav.cmdVy) : nav.cmdVy;
    nav.wz = navigatorContext.tdWzEnabled ? trackingDifferentiatorUpdate(&navigatorContext.tdWz, nav.cmdWz) : nav.cmdWz;
    if (!finiteFloat(nav.vx) || !finiteFloat(nav.vy) || !finiteFloat(nav.wz))
    {
        hardZero();
        return;
    }
    nav.vx = clampf(nav.vx, -vxMax, vxMax);
    nav.vy = clampf(nav.vy, -vyMax, vyMax);
    nav.wz = clampf(nav.wz, -wzMax, wzMax);
    if (applyMinimumOutput != 0u)
    {
        applyPlanarMinimum(&nav.vx, &nav.vy, params.planningVxMin,
            params.planningVyMin, vxMax, vyMax);
        nav.wz = applyMinimum(nav.wz, params.planningWzMin, wzMax);
    }
}

static void applyCandidate(const beaconControlCandidate *candidate, float dtS)
{
    float r2;
    float ex;
    float ey;
    int8_t vxSign;
    int8_t vySign;
    float kpVx;
    float kpVy;
    if ((candidate == 0) || (candidate->valid == 0u) ||
        !finiteFloat(candidate->errFwd) || !finiteFloat(candidate->errRight) ||
        !finiteFloat(candidate->centerX) || !finiteFloat(candidate->centerY))
    {
        nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
        nav.valid = 0u;
        clearCandidate();
        hardZero();
        return;
    }
    nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_TRACK;
    nav.valid = 1u;
    nav.sourceId = candidate->sourceId;
    nav.targetValid = 1u;
    nav.targetFresh = candidate->fresh;
    nav.targetHolding = candidate->holding;
    nav.targetTrackId = candidate->trackId;
    nav.targetSize = candidate->size;
    nav.controlX = candidate->fresh ? candidate->centerX : candidate->predictedX;
    nav.controlY = candidate->fresh ? candidate->centerY : candidate->predictedY;
    nav.activeCenterX = candidate->sourceCenterX;
    nav.activeCenterY = candidate->sourceCenterY;
    nav.errFwd = nav.errX = candidate->errFwd;
    nav.errRight = nav.errY = candidate->errRight;
    r2 = nav.errFwd * nav.errFwd + nav.errRight * nav.errRight;
    schmittSetThresholds(&navigatorContext.deadzone,
        params.planningDeadzoneEnterPx * params.planningDeadzoneEnterPx,
        params.planningDeadzoneExitPx * params.planningDeadzoneExitPx);
    schmittUpdate(&navigatorContext.deadzone, r2);
    ex = navigatorContext.deadzone.outputState ? nav.errFwd : 0.0f;
    ey = navigatorContext.deadzone.outputState ? nav.errRight : 0.0f;
    vxSign = params.planningVxSign;
    vySign = params.planningVySign;
    kpVx = params.planningKpVx;
    kpVy = params.planningKpVy;
    if (candidate->sourceId == BEACON_SOURCE_CORE3)
    {
        vxSign = params.core3PlanningVxSign;
        vySign = params.core3PlanningVySign;
        kpVx = params.core3PlanningKpVx;
        kpVy = params.core3PlanningKpVy;
    }
    else if (candidate->sourceId == BEACON_SOURCE_CORE4)
    {
        vxSign = params.core4PlanningVxSign;
        vySign = params.core4PlanningVySign;
        kpVx = params.core4PlanningKpVx;
        kpVy = params.core4PlanningKpVy;
    }
    applyOutput((float) vxSign * kpVx * ex, (float) vySign * kpVy * ey,
        0.0f, dtS, candidate->intentScale, 1u);
}

static void applySearch(float dtS, int8_t direction)
{
    float wz;
    if ((params.planningSearchEnable == 0u) ||
        (positiveLimit(params.planningSearchWz) <= 0.0f) ||
        (direction != -1 && direction != 1))
    {
        nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
        nav.valid = 0u;
        hardZero();
        return;
    }
    clearCandidate();
    nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_SEARCH;
    nav.valid = 1u;
    wz = (float) params.planningWzSign * (float) direction * params.planningSearchWz;
    applyOutput(0.0f, 0.0f, wz, dtS, 1.0f, 1u);
    /* SEARCH 只允许 yaw 使用最终Min；零线速度必须保持精确零。 */
    nav.vx = nav.vy = 0.0f;
}

static void applyStartup(float dtS)
{
    clearCandidate();
    nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_STARTUP_FORWARD;
    if (params.planningFirstBeaconForwardEnable == 0u)
    {
        nav.valid = 0u;
        hardZero();
        return;
    }
    nav.valid = 1u;
    applyOutput(params.planningFirstBeaconForwardSpeed, 0.0f, 0.0f, dtS, 1.0f,
        1u);
}

void beaconNavigatorApplyParams(const beaconNavigatorParamViewStruct *view)
{
    if (view != 0) params = *view;
}

void beaconNavigatorInit(void)
{
    beaconNavigatorParamViewStruct retainedParams = params;
    memset(&navigatorContext, 0, sizeof(navigatorContext));
    params = retainedParams;
    nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
    trackingDifferentiatorInit(&navigatorContext.tdVx, params.planningTdRvx,
        PLANNING_DT_S, params.planningTdN, 0.0f);
    trackingDifferentiatorInit(&navigatorContext.tdVy, params.planningTdRvy,
        PLANNING_DT_S, params.planningTdN, 0.0f);
    trackingDifferentiatorInit(&navigatorContext.tdWz, params.planningTdRwz,
        PLANNING_DT_S, params.planningTdN, 0.0f);
    schmittInit(&navigatorContext.deadzone, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0u);
}

void beaconNavigatorResetForRejoin(void)
{
    memset(&nav, 0, sizeof(nav));
    nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
    hardZero();
    schmittReset(&navigatorContext.deadzone, 0u);
}

void beaconNavigatorGetSnapshot(beaconNavigatorSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    if (out != 0) *out = nav;
}

static void fillPlan(planToLinkStruct *out)
{
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
    out->magic = CORE1_PLAN_READY_MAGIC;
    out->state = nav.state;
    out->valid = nav.valid;
    out->beaconCount = nav.beaconCount;
    out->targetX = nav.controlX;
    out->targetY = nav.controlY;
    out->targetSize = nav.targetSize;
    out->errX = nav.errX;
    out->errY = nav.errY;
    out->vx = nav.vx;
    out->vy = nav.vy;
    out->wz = (nav.state == (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_SEARCH) ? nav.wz : 0.0f;
}

void beaconNavigatorStep(const beaconNavigatorCommandStruct *command,
    beaconNavigatorOutputStruct *output)
{
    if ((command == 0) || (output == 0)) return;
    copyPose(command->pose);
    nav.beaconCount = command->qualifiedCount;
    if ((command->kind != BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_BARRIER) &&
        ((command->pose == 0) || (command->pose->motionPermitted == 0u)))
    {
        nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
        nav.valid = 0u;
        clearCandidate();
        hardZero();
        output->snapshot = nav;
        fillPlan(&output->plan);
        return;
    }
    switch (command->kind)
    {
    case BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_BARRIER:
        nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
        nav.valid = 0u;
        clearCandidate();
        hardZero();
        break;
    case BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_STARTUP_FORWARD:
        applyStartup(command->dtS);
        break;
    case BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_CANDIDATE:
        if ((command->candidate != 0) && (command->candidate->valid != 0u))
        {
            applyCandidate(command->candidate, command->dtS);
        }
        else if (command->searchActive != 0u)
        {
            applySearch(command->dtS, command->searchDirection);
        }
        else
        {
            nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
            nav.valid = 0u;
            clearCandidate();
            hardZero();
        }
        break;
    case BEACON_NAV_COMMAND_INVALID:
    default:
        nav.state = (uint8_t) BEACON_NAV_IDLE;
        nav.valid = 0u;
        clearCandidate();
        hardZero();
        break;
    }
    output->snapshot = nav;
    fillPlan(&output->plan);
}

#include "beaconTargetContinuity.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "observerLinkProtocol.h"

#define DYNAMIC_CENTER_X_MIN (-188.0f)
#define DYNAMIC_CENTER_X_MAX (375.0f)
#define DYNAMIC_CENTER_Y_MIN (-120.0f)
#define DYNAMIC_CENTER_Y_MAX (239.0f)
#define PI_F (3.1415927f)

static uint8_t finiteFloat(float value)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((value == value) && (value > -3.4028234e38f) &&
        (value < 3.4028234e38f));
}

static uint8_t profileValid(const beaconSourceProfile *profile)
{
    uint8_t commonValid;
    uint8_t headingValid;
    if (profile == 0) return 0u;
    commonValid = (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(profile->centerX) &&
        finiteFloat(profile->centerY) && finiteFloat(profile->scale) &&
        (profile->centerX >= DYNAMIC_CENTER_X_MIN) &&
        (profile->centerX <= DYNAMIC_CENTER_X_MAX) &&
        (profile->centerY >= DYNAMIC_CENTER_Y_MIN) &&
        (profile->centerY <= DYNAMIC_CENTER_Y_MAX) &&
        (profile->scale > 0.0f) && (profile->scale <= 10.0f));
    if (commonValid == 0u) return 0u;
    if (profile->geometryMode == BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_DOWNWARD_HEADING)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(profile->bodyHeadingRad) &&
            (profile->bodyHeadingRad >= -PI_F) &&
            (profile->bodyHeadingRad <= PI_F));
    }
    if ((profile->geometryMode != BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_FIXED) &&
        (profile->geometryMode != BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_HEADING)) return 0u;
    headingValid = (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(profile->bodyHeadingRad) &&
        (profile->bodyHeadingRad >= -PI_F) &&
        (profile->bodyHeadingRad <= PI_F));
    return (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(profile->mountYawRad) &&
        (profile->mountYawRad >= -PI_F) && (profile->mountYawRad <= PI_F) &&
        (profile->mirrorX <= 1u) &&
        ((profile->errorFwdSign == 1) || (profile->errorFwdSign == -1)) &&
        ((profile->errorRightSign == 1) || (profile->errorRightSign == -1)) &&
        ((profile->geometryMode == BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_FIXED) ||
         (headingValid != 0u)));
}

static uint8_t convertPoint(const beaconSourceProfile *profile,
    uint16_t x, uint16_t y, float *errFwd, float *errRight)
{
    float u;
    float v;
    float c;
    float s;
    float fixedFwd;
    float fixedRight;
    if ((profileValid(profile) == 0u) || (errFwd == 0) || (errRight == 0))
        return 0u;
    u = ((float) x - profile->centerX) * profile->scale;
    v = ((float) y - profile->centerY) * profile->scale;
    if (profile->geometryMode == BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_DOWNWARD_HEADING)
    {
        c = cosf(profile->bodyHeadingRad);
        s = sinf(profile->bodyHeadingRad);
        *errFwd = c * u + s * v;
        *errRight = -s * u + c * v;
    }
    else
    {
        if (profile->mirrorX != 0u) u = -u;
        c = cosf(profile->mountYawRad);
        s = sinf(profile->mountYawRad);
        fixedRight = (float) profile->errorRightSign * (c * u - s * v);
        fixedFwd = (float) profile->errorFwdSign * (s * u + c * v);
        if (profile->geometryMode == BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_HEADING)
        {
            c = cosf(profile->bodyHeadingRad);
            s = sinf(profile->bodyHeadingRad);
            *errFwd = c * fixedFwd + s * fixedRight;
            *errRight = -s * fixedFwd + c * fixedRight;
        }
        else
        {
            *errFwd = fixedFwd;
            *errRight = fixedRight;
        }
    }
    return (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(*errFwd) && finiteFloat(*errRight));
}

uint8_t beaconTargetContinuityBodyToObserver(const beaconSourceProfile *profile,
    float errFwd, float errRight, float *u, float *v)
{
    float c;
    float s;
    float fixedFwd = errFwd;
    float fixedRight = errRight;
    if ((profileValid(profile) == 0u) || (u == 0) || (v == 0) ||
        (finiteFloat(errFwd) == 0u) || (finiteFloat(errRight) == 0u)) return 0u;
    if (profile->geometryMode == BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_DOWNWARD_HEADING)
    {
        c = cosf(profile->bodyHeadingRad);
        s = sinf(profile->bodyHeadingRad);
        *u = c * errFwd - s * errRight;
        *v = s * errFwd + c * errRight;
    }
    else
    {
        if (profile->geometryMode == BEACON_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_OBSERVER_HEADING)
        {
            c = cosf(profile->bodyHeadingRad);
            s = sinf(profile->bodyHeadingRad);
            fixedFwd = c * errFwd - s * errRight;
            fixedRight = s * errFwd + c * errRight;
        }
        fixedFwd /= (float) profile->errorFwdSign;
        fixedRight /= (float) profile->errorRightSign;
        c = cosf(profile->mountYawRad);
        s = sinf(profile->mountYawRad);
        *u = c * fixedRight + s * fixedFwd;
        *v = -s * fixedRight + c * fixedFwd;
        if (profile->mirrorX != 0u) *u = -*u;
    }
    return (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(*u) && finiteFloat(*v));
}

static uint8_t convertCandidate(const beaconSourceObservationView *view,
    const beaconConfirmedStruct *track,
    beaconControlCandidate *candidate)
{
    if ((view == 0) || (track == 0) || (candidate == 0) ||
        (profileValid(&view->profile) == 0u) || (track->fresh == 0u) ||
        (track->trackId == 0u) ||
        ((track->flags & BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u)) return 0u;
    memset(candidate, 0, sizeof(*candidate));
    candidate->valid = 1u;
    candidate->fresh = 1u;
    candidate->sourceId = view->sourceId;
    candidate->trackId = track->trackId;
    candidate->size = track->size;
    candidate->centerX = track->centerX;
    candidate->centerY = track->centerY;
    candidate->predictedX = track->predX;
    candidate->predictedY = track->predY;
    candidate->session = view->session;
    candidate->observationSeq = view->observationSeq;
    candidate->intentScale = 1.0f;
    candidate->sourceCenterX = view->profile.centerX;
    candidate->sourceCenterY = view->profile.centerY;
    if ((convertPoint(&view->profile, track->centerX, track->centerY,
            &candidate->errFwd, &candidate->errRight) == 0u) ||
        (convertPoint(&view->profile, track->predX, track->predY,
            &candidate->predictedFwd, &candidate->predictedRight) == 0u))
        return 0u;
    candidate->velocityRight = candidate->predictedRight - candidate->errRight;
    candidate->velocityFwd = candidate->predictedFwd - candidate->errFwd;
    return (uint8_t) (finiteFloat(candidate->errRight) &&
        finiteFloat(candidate->errFwd) && finiteFloat(candidate->predictedRight) &&
        finiteFloat(candidate->predictedFwd));
}

static const beaconSourceObservationView *findCurrentView(
    const beaconSourceObservationView *views, uint8_t viewCount,
    const beaconControlCandidate *last)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if ((views == 0) || (last == 0)) return 0;
    for (i = 0u; i < viewCount; i++)
    {
        if ((views[i].sourceId == last->sourceId) &&
            (views[i].session == last->session) &&
            (profileValid(&views[i].profile) != 0u)) return &views[i];
    }
    return 0;
}

static uint8_t buildEdgeHoldCandidate(
    const beaconSourceObservationView *views, uint8_t viewCount,
    const beaconControlCandidate *last, float intentScale,
    beaconControlCandidate *candidate)
{
    const beaconSourceObservationView *view = findCurrentView(views, viewCount, last);
    if ((view == 0) || (candidate == 0)) return 0u;
    *candidate = *last;
    candidate->fresh = 0u;
    candidate->holding = 1u;
    candidate->intentScale = intentScale;
    candidate->observationSeq = view->observationSeq;
    if (convertPoint(&view->profile, last->predictedX, last->predictedY,
            &candidate->errFwd, &candidate->errRight) == 0u) return 0u;
    candidate->predictedFwd = candidate->errFwd;
    candidate->predictedRight = candidate->errRight;
    candidate->velocityFwd = 0.0f;
    candidate->velocityRight = 0.0f;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t buildScoringReference(
    const beaconSourceObservationView *views, uint8_t viewCount,
    const beaconTargetContinuity *continuity, float *refFwd, float *refRight)
{
    const beaconSourceObservationView *view;
    uint16_t x;
    uint16_t y;
    if ((continuity == 0) || (continuity->last.valid == 0u) ||
        (refFwd == 0) || (refRight == 0)) return 0u;
    view = findCurrentView(views, viewCount, &continuity->last);
    if (view == 0) return 0u;
    x = continuity->trendValid ? continuity->last.predictedX :
        continuity->last.centerX;
    y = continuity->trendValid ? continuity->last.predictedY :
        continuity->last.centerY;
    return convertPoint(&view->profile, x, y, refFwd, refRight);
}

static uint32_t updateClock(beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t elapsedMs;
    if (continuity->clockPrimed == 0u)
    {
        continuity->clockPrimed = 1u;
        continuity->clockTickMs = tickMs;
        return 0u;
    }
    elapsedMs = (uint32_t) (tickMs - continuity->clockTickMs);
    continuity->clockTickMs = tickMs;
    return elapsedMs;
}

static void pauseTargetTimer(beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    uint32_t elapsedMs)
{
    if (continuity->last.valid != 0u)
        continuity->lastTickMs += elapsedMs;
}

static void pauseSearchTimer(beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    uint32_t elapsedMs)
{
    if (continuity->searchRunning != 0u)
        continuity->searchStartTickMs += elapsedMs;
}

static void advanceSearch(beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    uint32_t tickMs, uint16_t searchTimeoutMs, uint8_t searchEnabled,
    uint8_t allowStart)
{
    if (searchEnabled == 0u)
    {
        continuity->searchRunning = 0u;
        continuity->searchTimedOut = 0u;
    }
    else if (continuity->searchTimedOut == 0u)
    {
        if ((continuity->searchRunning == 0u) && (allowStart != 0u))
        {
            continuity->searchRunning = 1u;
            continuity->searchStartTickMs = tickMs;
        }
        if ((continuity->searchRunning != 0u) && (searchTimeoutMs != 0u) &&
            ((uint32_t) (tickMs - continuity->searchStartTickMs) >=
                searchTimeoutMs))
        {
            continuity->searchRunning = 0u;
            continuity->searchTimedOut = 1u;
        }
    }
}

static float edgeHoldIntentScale(uint32_t elapsedMs, uint16_t edgeHoldMs)
{
    if ((edgeHoldMs == 0u) || (elapsedMs >= edgeHoldMs)) return 0.0f;
    return 1.0f - (float) elapsedMs / (float) edgeHoldMs;
}

static uint8_t sequenceAdvanced(uint32_t previous, uint32_t current)
{
    uint32_t delta = (uint32_t) (current - previous);
    return (uint8_t) ((delta != 0u) && (delta < 0x80000000u));
}

static uint8_t consumeBorderRejection(beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    const beaconSourceObservationView *views, uint8_t viewCount)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if ((continuity->last.valid == 0u) || (views == 0)) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < viewCount; i++)
    {
        uint16_t j;
        if ((views[i].tracks == 0) ||
            (views[i].sourceId != continuity->last.sourceId) ||
            (views[i].session != continuity->last.session) ||
            (sequenceAdvanced(continuity->last.observationSeq,
                views[i].observationSeq) == 0u)) continue;
        for (j = 0u; j < views[i].count; j++)
        {
            const beaconConfirmedStruct *track = &views[i].tracks[j];
            if ((track->trackId == continuity->last.trackId) &&
                (track->flags == BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED))
            {
                memset(&continuity->last, 0, sizeof(continuity->last));
                continuity->trendValid = 0u;
                continuity->edgeHoldActive = 0u;
                return 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t sourceRank(uint8_t source, uint8_t current)
{
    if ((current != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE) && (source == current)) return 0u;
    if (source == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1) return 1u;
    if (source == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) return 2u;
    return 3u;
}

static uint8_t tieBefore(const beaconControlCandidate *left,
    const beaconControlCandidate *right,
    uint8_t current)
{
    uint8_t lr = sourceRank(left->sourceId, current);
    uint8_t rr = sourceRank(right->sourceId, current);
    if (lr != rr) return (uint8_t) (lr < rr);
    if (left->session != right->session) return (uint8_t) (left->session < right->session);
    return (uint8_t) (left->trackId < right->trackId);
}

static uint8_t selectExactCurrentCandidate(
    const beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    const beaconSourceObservationView *views,
    uint8_t viewCount,
    beaconControlCandidate *candidate)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if ((continuity == 0) || (continuity->last.valid == 0u) ||
        (views == 0) || (candidate == 0)) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < viewCount; i++)
    {
        uint16_t j;
        if ((views[i].fresh == 0u) || (views[i].tracks == 0) ||
            (views[i].sourceId != continuity->last.sourceId) ||
            (views[i].session != continuity->last.session)) continue;
        for (j = 0u; j < views[i].count; j++)
        {
            if ((views[i].tracks[j].trackId == continuity->last.trackId) &&
                (convertCandidate(&views[i], &views[i].tracks[j], candidate) != 0u))
                return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t selectBestCandidate(
    const beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    const beaconSourceObservationView *views,
    uint8_t viewCount,
    beaconControlCandidate *best)
{
    float bestScore = 3.4028234e38f;
    float referenceFwd = 0.0f;
    float referenceRight = 0.0f;
    uint8_t haveBest = 0u;
    uint8_t referenceValid = 0u;
    uint8_t currentOwner = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE;
    uint8_t i;
    if (best == 0) return 0u;
    memset(best, 0, sizeof(*best));
    if ((continuity == 0) || (views == 0)) return 0u;
    if (continuity->last.valid != 0u)
    {
        referenceValid = buildScoringReference(views, viewCount, continuity,
            &referenceFwd, &referenceRight);
        if (referenceValid != 0u) currentOwner = continuity->last.sourceId;
    }
    /* 三来源统一评分。历史仍有效时，使用上一目标车体系预测位置
     * 同拍完成跨视野连续交接。 */
    for (i = 0u; i < viewCount; i++)
    {
        uint16_t j;
        if ((views[i].fresh == 0u) || (views[i].tracks == 0)) continue;
        for (j = 0u; j < views[i].count; j++)
        {
            beaconControlCandidate next;
            float df;
            float dr;
            float score;
            if (convertCandidate(&views[i], &views[i].tracks[j], &next) == 0u)
                continue;
            if (referenceValid != 0u)
            {
                df = next.errFwd - referenceFwd;
                dr = next.errRight - referenceRight;
            }
            else
            {
                df = next.errFwd;
                dr = next.errRight;
            }
            score = df * df + dr * dr;
            if ((haveBest == 0u) || (score < bestScore) ||
                ((score == bestScore) && tieBefore(&next, best, currentOwner)))
            {
                *best = next;
                bestScore = score;
                haveBest = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    return haveBest;
}

void beaconTargetContinuityInit(beaconTargetContinuity *continuity)
{
    if (continuity != 0) memset(continuity, 0, sizeof(*continuity));
}

void beaconTargetContinuityStep(beaconTargetContinuity *continuity,
    const beaconSourceObservationView *views,
    uint8_t viewCount,
    uint32_t tickMs,
    uint16_t edgeHoldMs,
    uint16_t searchTimeoutMs,
    uint8_t searchEnabled,
    uint8_t targetAdvanceAllowed,
    uint8_t searchAdvanceAllowed,
    beaconTargetContinuityOutput *output)
{
    beaconControlCandidate best;
    float referenceFwd = 0.0f;
    float referenceRight = 0.0f;
    uint32_t clockElapsedMs;
    uint8_t haveBest = 0u;
    uint8_t referenceValid = 1u;
    uint8_t i;
    if ((continuity == 0) || (views == 0) || (output == 0)) return;
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(*output));
    clockElapsedMs = updateClock(continuity, tickMs);
    (void) consumeBorderRejection(continuity, views, viewCount);
    for (i = 0u; i < viewCount; i++)
    {
        uint16_t j;
        if ((views[i].fresh == 0u) || (views[i].tracks == 0)) continue;
        for (j = 0u; j < views[i].count; j++)
        {
            beaconControlCandidate qualified;
            if (convertCandidate(&views[i], &views[i].tracks[j],
                &qualified) == 0u) continue;
            if (output->qualifiedCount < 255u) output->qualifiedCount++;
        }
    }
    if (continuity->last.valid != 0u)
    {
        referenceValid = buildScoringReference(views, viewCount, continuity,
            &referenceFwd, &referenceRight);
    }
    if (targetAdvanceAllowed == 0u)
    {
        if (searchAdvanceAllowed != 0u)
        {
            uint8_t edgeHoldExpired = (uint8_t) ((continuity->last.valid == 0u) ||
                (edgeHoldMs == 0u) ||
                ((uint32_t) (tickMs - continuity->lastTickMs) > edgeHoldMs));
            if (edgeHoldExpired != 0u)
            {
                continuity->edgeHoldActive = 0u;
            }
            advanceSearch(continuity, tickMs, searchTimeoutMs, searchEnabled,
                edgeHoldExpired);
        }
        else
        {
            pauseTargetTimer(continuity, clockElapsedMs);
            pauseSearchTimer(continuity, clockElapsedMs);
        }
        output->searchActive = (uint8_t) (searchEnabled &&
            continuity->searchRunning &&
            !continuity->searchTimedOut);
        output->searchDirection = (continuity->searchDirection == 0) ? 1 :
            continuity->searchDirection;
        return;
    }
    if (referenceValid == 0u)
    {
        continuity->last.valid = 0u;
        continuity->trendValid = 0u;
    }
    haveBest = selectExactCurrentCandidate(continuity, views, viewCount, &best);
    if (haveBest == 0u)
        haveBest = selectBestCandidate(continuity, views, viewCount, &best);
    if (haveBest != 0u)
    {
        continuity->searchRunning = 0u;
        continuity->searchTimedOut = 0u;
        continuity->trendValid = continuity->last.valid;
        continuity->last = best;
        continuity->lastTickMs = tickMs;
        continuity->edgeHoldActive = 0u;
        continuity->searchDirection = (best.errRight < 0.0f) ? -1 : 1;
        output->candidate = best;
    }
    else if ((continuity->last.valid != 0u) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - continuity->lastTickMs) <= edgeHoldMs) &&
        (edgeHoldMs != 0u) &&
        (findCurrentView(views, viewCount, &continuity->last) != 0))
    {
        uint32_t elapsedMs = (uint32_t) (tickMs - continuity->lastTickMs);
        float intentScale = edgeHoldIntentScale(elapsedMs, edgeHoldMs);
        continuity->searchRunning = 0u;
        continuity->edgeHoldActive = 1u;
        if (buildEdgeHoldCandidate(views, viewCount, &continuity->last,
                intentScale, &output->candidate) == 0u)
        {
            memset(&output->candidate, 0, sizeof(output->candidate));
            continuity->edgeHoldActive = 0u;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        continuity->edgeHoldActive = 0u;
        advanceSearch(continuity, tickMs, searchTimeoutMs, searchEnabled, 1u);
        output->searchActive = (uint8_t) (searchEnabled &&
            continuity->searchRunning && !continuity->searchTimedOut);
    }
    output->searchDirection = (continuity->searchDirection == 0) ? 1 :
        continuity->searchDirection;
}

#include <string.h>

#include "core1KvmRouter.h"
#include "coreDataTransfer.h"
#include "uartLinkProto.h"

#define POSE_ZERO_WAIT_MS (3000u)
#define POSE_MAX_X_Q8 (187u * 256u)
#define POSE_MAX_Y_Q8 (119u * 256u)

typedef struct
{
    core0PoseSupervisorSnapshot snapshot;
    uint32_t lastPositionTickMs;
    uint32_t lastHeadingTickMs;
    uint32_t lastSeq;
    uint8_t havePosition;
    uint8_t haveHeading;
    uint8_t poseSeqPrimed;
    uint8_t poseEpochPrimed;
    uint8_t trustedLaunchKnown;
    uint8_t lastTrustedLaunched;
    uint8_t episodePositionQualified;
    uint8_t episodeFencePrimed;
} poseSupervisorContext;

static poseSupervisorContext g_pose;

static float wrapPi(float value)
{
    while (value > 3.14159265358979323846f) value -= 6.28318530717958647692f;
    while (value < -3.14159265358979323846f) value += 6.28318530717958647692f;
    return value;
}

static uint16_t ageU16(uint32_t now, uint32_t then)
{
    uint32_t age = now - then;
    return (age > 0xFFFFu) ? 0xFFFFu : (uint16_t) age;
}

static uint8_t finiteFloat(float value)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((value == value) &&
        (value > -3.4028234e38f) && (value < 3.4028234e38f));
}

static uint8_t seq32Advanced(uint32_t sequence, uint32_t previous)
{
    uint32_t delta = sequence - previous;
    return (uint8_t) ((delta != 0u) && (delta < 0x80000000u));
}

static void beginPositionEpisode(void)
{
    g_pose.episodePositionQualified = 0u;
    g_pose.episodeFencePrimed = (uint8_t) (
        (g_pose.poseEpochPrimed != 0u) &&
        (g_pose.poseSeqPrimed != 0u));
}

void core0PoseSupervisorInit(void)
{
    memset(&g_pose, 0, sizeof(g_pose));
    g_pose.snapshot.stage = CORE0_POSE_STAGE_WAIT_FIRST;
}

void core0PoseSupervisorStep(uint32_t tickMs,
    uint16_t holdMs,
    float minHeadingConfidence,
    int8_t headingSign,
    float headingOffsetRad,
    core0PoseSupervisorSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    core1SystemFactsSnapshot facts;
    core0PoseToVisionStruct pose;
    uint8_t transportAlive;
    uint8_t statusUsable;
    uint8_t launched = 0u;
    uint8_t poseAdvanced = 0u;
    uint8_t positionAccepted = 0u;
    uint8_t epochChanged = 0u;
    uint8_t episodeStarted = 0u;
    core1KvmRouterGetSystemFacts(&facts);
    transportAlive = (uint8_t) ((facts.ready != 0u) &&
        (facts.linkUp != 0u));
    statusUsable = (uint8_t) (transportAlive &&
        (facts.core0StatusValid != 0u));
    g_pose.snapshot.linkAlive = transportAlive;
    if ((transportAlive != 0u) &&
        (coreDataTryReadCore0Pose(&pose) != 0u) &&
        (pose.magic == CORE1_C0POSE_READY_MAGIC))
    {
        if ((g_pose.poseEpochPrimed != 0u) &&
            (pose.poseEpoch != g_pose.snapshot.poseEpoch))
        {
            epochChanged = 1u;
        }
        if (epochChanged != 0u)
        {
            g_pose.poseSeqPrimed = 0u;
        }
        if ((g_pose.poseEpochPrimed == 0u) || (epochChanged != 0u))
        {
            g_pose.poseEpochPrimed = 1u;
            g_pose.snapshot.poseEpoch = pose.poseEpoch;
        }
        if ((g_pose.poseSeqPrimed == 0u) ||
            (seq32Advanced(pose.seq32, g_pose.lastSeq) != 0u))
        {
            uint8_t sourceOk;
            uint8_t positionOk;
            uint8_t headingOk;
            poseAdvanced = 1u;
            g_pose.poseSeqPrimed = 1u;
            g_pose.lastSeq = pose.seq32;
            g_pose.snapshot.confidenceQ8 = pose.confidenceQ8;
            g_pose.snapshot.flags = pose.flags;
            sourceOk = (uint8_t) (
                ((pose.flags & UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_TRACK_LOCKED) != 0u) &&
                ((pose.flags & UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_TARGET_LOST) == 0u));
            positionOk = (uint8_t) (sourceOk &&
                ((pose.flags & UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_POSITION_NUMERIC_VALID) != 0u) &&
                ((pose.flags & UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_POSITION_FRESH) != 0u) &&
                (pose.xQ8 <= POSE_MAX_X_Q8) &&
                (pose.yQ8 <= POSE_MAX_Y_Q8));
            headingOk = (uint8_t) (
                ((pose.flags & UART_LINK_POSE_FLAG_HEADING_FRESH) != 0u) &&
                ((float) pose.confidenceQ8 / 255.0f >= minHeadingConfidence) &&
                (finiteFloat(pose.orientationRad) != 0u) &&
                (pose.orientationRad >= -3.1415927f) && (pose.orientationRad <= 3.1415927f));
            if (positionOk != 0u)
            {
                g_pose.snapshot.x = (float) pose.xQ8 / 256.0f;
                g_pose.snapshot.y = (float) pose.yQ8 / 256.0f;
                g_pose.lastPositionTickMs = tickMs;
                g_pose.havePosition = 1u;
                positionAccepted = 1u;
            }
            if (headingOk != 0u)
            {
                g_pose.snapshot.headingRad = wrapPi((float) headingSign *
                    pose.orientationRad + headingOffsetRad);
                g_pose.lastHeadingTickMs = tickMs;
                g_pose.haveHeading = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    if ((epochChanged != 0u) && (g_pose.trustedLaunchKnown != 0u) &&
        (g_pose.lastTrustedLaunched != 0u))
    {
        beginPositionEpisode();
        episodeStarted = 1u;
    }
    if (statusUsable != 0u)
    {
        launched = (uint8_t) ((facts.core0StatusFlags &
            UART_LINK_C0_FLAG_LAUNCHED) != 0u);
        if (g_pose.trustedLaunchKnown == 0u)
        {
            g_pose.trustedLaunchKnown = 1u;
            g_pose.lastTrustedLaunched = launched;
            if (launched != 0u)
            {
                beginPositionEpisode();
                episodeStarted = 1u;
            }
        }
        else if (launched != g_pose.lastTrustedLaunched)
        {
            g_pose.lastTrustedLaunched = launched;
            if (launched != 0u)
            {
                beginPositionEpisode();
                episodeStarted = 1u;
            }
            else
            {
                g_pose.episodePositionQualified = 0u;
                g_pose.episodeFencePrimed = 0u;
            }
        }
        if ((launched != 0u) && (episodeStarted == 0u) &&
            (poseAdvanced != 0u))
        {
            if (g_pose.episodeFencePrimed == 0u)
            {
                g_pose.episodeFencePrimed = 1u;
            }
            else if (positionAccepted != 0u)
            {
                g_pose.episodePositionQualified = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    g_pose.snapshot.positionAgeMs = g_pose.havePosition ?
        ageU16(tickMs, g_pose.lastPositionTickMs) : 0xFFFFu;
    g_pose.snapshot.headingAgeMs = g_pose.haveHeading ?
        ageU16(tickMs, g_pose.lastHeadingTickMs) : 0xFFFFu;
    g_pose.snapshot.positionValid = (uint8_t) (g_pose.havePosition &&
        g_pose.snapshot.positionAgeMs <= holdMs);
    g_pose.snapshot.headingValid = (uint8_t) (g_pose.haveHeading &&
        g_pose.snapshot.headingAgeMs <= holdMs);
    if (g_pose.snapshot.headingValid == 0u)
    {
        g_pose.haveHeading = 0u;
        g_pose.snapshot.headingRad = 0.0f;
    }
    g_pose.snapshot.positionHolding = (uint8_t) (g_pose.snapshot.positionValid &&
        g_pose.snapshot.positionAgeMs != 0u);
    g_pose.snapshot.headingHolding = (uint8_t) (g_pose.snapshot.headingValid &&
        g_pose.snapshot.headingAgeMs != 0u);
    if (statusUsable == 0u)
    {
        g_pose.snapshot.stage = CORE0_POSE_STAGE_LINK_BYPASS;
        g_pose.snapshot.motionPermitted = 0u;
        if (snapshot != 0) *snapshot = g_pose.snapshot;
        return;
    }
    if (launched == 0u)
    {
        g_pose.snapshot.stage = g_pose.snapshot.positionValid ? CORE0_POSE_STAGE_FRESH :
            CORE0_POSE_STAGE_WAIT_FIRST;
    }
    else if (g_pose.episodePositionQualified == 0u)
    {
        g_pose.snapshot.stage = CORE0_POSE_STAGE_WAIT_FIRST;
    }
    else
    {
        if (g_pose.snapshot.positionAgeMs == 0u) g_pose.snapshot.stage = CORE0_POSE_STAGE_FRESH;
        else if (g_pose.snapshot.positionAgeMs <= holdMs) g_pose.snapshot.stage = CORE0_POSE_STAGE_HOLD;
        else if (g_pose.snapshot.positionAgeMs < (uint32_t) holdMs + POSE_ZERO_WAIT_MS)
            g_pose.snapshot.stage = CORE0_POSE_STAGE_ZERO_WAIT;
        else g_pose.snapshot.stage = CORE0_POSE_STAGE_FAULT;
    }
    g_pose.snapshot.motionPermitted = (uint8_t) ((g_pose.snapshot.stage == CORE0_POSE_STAGE_FRESH) ||
        (g_pose.snapshot.stage == CORE0_POSE_STAGE_HOLD));
    if (snapshot != 0) *snapshot = g_pose.snapshot;
}
