/*
 * om_canny.c - [4] 高斯模糊及Canny边缘检测
 *
 * 3x3定点高斯核 / 逐行流水线 Sobel+NMS+滞后门限 边缘检测
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- define ----

#define CANNY_RING_WIDTH (OM_CANNY_RING_WIDTH)

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t width;
    uint32_t height;
    uint32_t pixelCount;
    uint32_t cropStartX;
    uint32_t cropStartY;
    uint32_t cropEndX;
    uint32_t cropEndY;
    uint32_t blurStartX;
    uint32_t blurStartY;
    uint32_t blurEndX;
    uint32_t blurEndY;
} gaussConfigStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t width;
    uint32_t height;
    uint32_t pixelCount;
    uint32_t sobelStartX;
    uint32_t sobelStartY;
    uint32_t sobelEndX;
    uint32_t sobelEndY;
    uint32_t nmsStartX;
    uint32_t nmsStartY;
    uint32_t nmsEndX;
    uint32_t nmsEndY;
    uint16_t thresholdLow;
    uint16_t thresholdHigh;
    uint32_t thresholdLowSq;
    uint32_t thresholdHighSq;
    int32_t trackOffsets[8];
} cannyConfigStruct;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt0[256];
static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt1[256];
static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt2[256];
static gaussConfigStruct gaussConfig = {0u};
static cannyConfigStruct cannyConfig = {0u};
static uint32_t sobelMapRing[3][CANNY_RING_WIDTH] = {0};
static uint8_t sobelDirMapRing[3][CANNY_RING_WIDTH] = {0};
static uint16_t cannyEdgeQueue[UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE] = {0};

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void gaussianInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY)
{
    // gaussianKernelTemp[0] : 四个角点对应的核值
    // gaussianKernelTemp[1] : 四个边点对应的核值
    // gaussianKernelTemp[2] : 中心点对应的核值
    float gaussianKernelTemp[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};

    memset(&gaussConfig, 0, sizeof(gaussConfig));

    if ((NULL == src) || (NULL == src->ptr) || (0u == src->xLen) || (0u == src->yLen) ||
        (src->xLen > CANNY_RING_WIDTH) || ((src->xLen * src->yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE))
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    gaussConfig.width = src->xLen;
    gaussConfig.height = src->yLen;
    gaussConfig.pixelCount = src->xLen * src->yLen;

    if (startX > endX)
    {
        uint32_t temp = startX;
        startX = endX;
        endX = temp;
    }
    if (startY > endY)
    {
        uint32_t temp = startY;
        startY = endY;
        endY = temp;
    }

    gaussConfig.cropStartX = unsignRange(startX, gaussConfig.width - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropStartY = unsignRange(startY, gaussConfig.height - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropEndX = range(endX, gaussConfig.cropStartX, gaussConfig.width - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropEndY = range(endY, gaussConfig.cropStartY, gaussConfig.height - 1u);

    gaussConfig.blurStartX = 1u;
    gaussConfig.blurStartY = 1u;
    gaussConfig.blurEndX = 0u;
    gaussConfig.blurEndY = 0u;

    if ((gaussConfig.width >= 3u) && (gaussConfig.height >= 3u) &&
        ((gaussConfig.cropEndX - gaussConfig.cropStartX) >= 2u) &&
        ((gaussConfig.cropEndY - gaussConfig.cropStartY) >= 2u))
    {
        gaussConfig.blurStartX = (0u == gaussConfig.cropStartX) ? 1u : (gaussConfig.cropStartX + 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurStartY = (0u == gaussConfig.cropStartY) ? 1u : (gaussConfig.cropStartY + 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurEndX = (gaussConfig.cropEndX >= (gaussConfig.width - 1u)) ? (gaussConfig.width - 2u) : (gaussConfig.cropEndX - 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurEndY = (gaussConfig.cropEndY >= (gaussConfig.height - 1u)) ? (gaussConfig.height - 2u) : (gaussConfig.cropEndY - 1u);
    }

    if (sigma <= 0.0f)
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    float sigma2 = sigma * sigma;
    float coeff = 1.0f / (TWO_PI * sigma2);
    float sum = 0.0f;

    // 生成 3x3 高斯核，并提取 3 个唯一值（角点/边点/中心）
    for (uint8_t y = 0u; y < 3; y++)
    {
        for (uint8_t x = 0u; x < 3; x++)
        {
            int16_t dx = (int16_t) x - 1;
            int16_t dy = (int16_t) y - 1;
            float exponent = -((float) (dx * dx + dy * dy)) / (2.0f * sigma2);
            float value = (float) exp((double) exponent) * coeff;

            if (0 == dx && 0 == dy) gaussianKernelTemp[2] = value;
            else if (0 == dx || 0 == dy) gaussianKernelTemp[1] = value;
            else gaussianKernelTemp[0] = value;

            sum += value;
        }
    }

    if (sum <= 0.0f)
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    // 归一化 3 个唯一核值
    gaussianKernelTemp[0] /= sum;
    gaussianKernelTemp[1] /= sum;
    gaussianKernelTemp[2] /= sum;

    // 预计算核值与 8bit 灰度值相乘的 定点数 (放缩256倍)，消除内层浮点开销
    for (uint16_t gray = 0u; gray < 256; gray++)
    {
        gaussKernelPreValueInt0[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[0] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
        gaussKernelPreValueInt1[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[1] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
        gaussKernelPreValueInt2[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[2] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
    }
}

void cannyInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY, uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    gaussianInit(src, sigma, startX, startY, endX, endY);

    memset(&cannyConfig, 0, sizeof(cannyConfig));

    if ((NULL == src) || (NULL == src->ptr) || (0u == src->xLen) || (0u == src->yLen) ||
        (src->xLen > CANNY_RING_WIDTH) || ((src->xLen * src->yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)) return;

    cannyConfig.width = src->xLen;
    cannyConfig.height = src->yLen;
    cannyConfig.pixelCount = src->xLen * src->yLen;

    if (thresholdLow > thresholdHigh)
    {
        uint16_t temp = thresholdLow;
        thresholdLow = thresholdHigh;
        thresholdHigh = temp;
    }

    cannyConfig.thresholdLow = thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHigh = thresholdHigh;

    // 提前计算平方
    cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq = (uint32_t) thresholdLow * thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq = (uint32_t) thresholdHigh * thresholdHigh;

    cannyConfig.sobelStartX = 1u;
    cannyConfig.sobelStartY = 1u;
    cannyConfig.sobelEndX = 0u;
    cannyConfig.sobelEndY = 0u;
    cannyConfig.nmsStartX = 1u;
    cannyConfig.nmsStartY = 1u;
    cannyConfig.nmsEndX = 0u;
    cannyConfig.nmsEndY = 0u;

    if ((gaussConfig.blurEndX > (gaussConfig.blurStartX + 1u)) &&
        (gaussConfig.blurEndY > (gaussConfig.blurStartY + 1u)))
    {
        cannyConfig.sobelStartX = gaussConfig.blurStartX + 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelStartY = gaussConfig.blurStartY + 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelEndX = gaussConfig.blurEndX - 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelEndY = gaussConfig.blurEndY - 1u;
    }

    if ((cannyConfig.sobelEndX > (cannyConfig.sobelStartX + 1u)) &&
        (cannyConfig.sobelEndY > (cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u)))
    {
        cannyConfig.nmsStartX = cannyConfig.sobelStartX + 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsStartY = cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsEndX = cannyConfig.sobelEndX - 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsEndY = cannyConfig.sobelEndY - 1u;
    }

    // 预先计算滞后门限追踪(连边)阶段需要的直接邻信偏移
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[0] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width - 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[1] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[2] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width + 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[3] = -1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[4] = 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[5] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width - 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[6] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[7] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width + 1;
}

/* 运行时仅更新 Canny 双阈值，不重算高斯核与 ROI，便于按键调参 */
void cannySetThreshold(uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    if (thresholdLow > thresholdHigh)
    {
        uint16_t temp = thresholdLow;
        thresholdLow = thresholdHigh;
        thresholdHigh = temp;
    }

    cannyConfig.thresholdLow = thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHigh = thresholdHigh;
    cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq = (uint32_t) thresholdLow * thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq = (uint32_t) thresholdHigh * thresholdHigh;
}

void cannyEdgeDetection(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dstGaussBlur, u8Image* dst)
{
    if (NULL == src || NULL == src->ptr || NULL == dstGaussBlur || NULL == dstGaussBlur->ptr ||
        NULL == dst || NULL == dst->ptr) return;
    if (0u == cannyConfig.pixelCount || 0u == gaussConfig.width) return;

    uint32_t queueHead = 0u;
    uint32_t queueTail = 0u;

    // 清零目标画布、ring buffer 残留、高斯模糊边界脏值
    memset(dst->ptr, BLACK, gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height);
    memset(dstGaussBlur->ptr, 0, gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height);
    memset(sobelMapRing, 0, sizeof(sobelMapRing));
    memset(sobelDirMapRing, 0, sizeof(sobelDirMapRing));

    for (uint32_t y = gaussConfig.blurStartY; y <= gaussConfig.blurEndY; y++)
    {
        // ================== 第1阶段: 高斯模糊 ==================
        const uint8_t* row0 = src->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row1 = src->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row2 = src->ptr + (y + 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        uint8_t* dstRow = dstGaussBlur->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

        for (uint32_t x = gaussConfig.blurStartX; x <= gaussConfig.blurEndX; x++)
        {
            uint32_t result = gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row0[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt2[row1[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row2[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x + 1u]];

            result = (result + 128) >> 8;
            dstRow[x] = (uint8_t) ((result > 255) ? 255 : result);
        }

        // ================== 第2阶段: Sobel计算 ==================
        if ((cannyConfig.sobelStartX <= cannyConfig.sobelEndX) &&
            (cannyConfig.sobelStartY <= cannyConfig.sobelEndY) &&
            (y >= (cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u)) &&
            ((y - 1u) <= cannyConfig.sobelEndY))
        {
            const uint8_t* s_row0 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + (y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width;
            const uint8_t* s_row1 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
            const uint8_t* s_row2 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

            uint32_t* sobelRow = sobelMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];
            uint8_t* dirRow = sobelDirMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];

            for (uint32_t x = cannyConfig.sobelStartX; x <= cannyConfig.sobelEndX; x++)
            {
                int32_t gx = (int32_t) s_row0[x + 1u] + ((int32_t) s_row1[x + 1u] << 1) + (int32_t) s_row2[x + 1u] - (int32_t) s_row0[x - 1u] - ((int32_t) s_row1[x - 1u] << 1) - (int32_t) s_row2[x - 1u];
                int32_t gy = (int32_t) s_row0[x - 1u] + ((int32_t) s_row0[x] << 1) + (int32_t) s_row0[x + 1u] - (int32_t) s_row2[x - 1u] - ((int32_t) s_row2[x] << 1) - (int32_t) s_row2[x + 1u];

                // 去除掉极其耗时的 sqrtf 运算
                uint32_t mag_sq = (uint32_t) (gx * gx) + (uint32_t) (gy * gy);
                sobelRow[x] = mag_sq;

                // 完全消除浮点除法，只用整数比较判定4大区面方向
                int32_t ax = (gx >= 0) ? gx : -gx;
                int32_t ay = (gy >= 0) ? gy : -gy;
                int32_t ay256 = ay << 8;

                if (ay256 <= ax * 106)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 0;  // 水平梯度主导（纵向边缘），沿水平方向抑制
                }
                else if (ay256 >= ax * 618)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 2;  // 垂直梯度主导（横向边缘），沿垂直方向抑制
                }
                else if ((gx ^ gy) >= 0)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 1;  // 45度梯度
                }
                else
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 3;  // 135度梯度
                }
            }
        }

        // ================== 第3阶段: 非极大值抑制 ==================
        if ((cannyConfig.nmsStartX <= cannyConfig.nmsEndX) &&
            (cannyConfig.nmsStartY <= cannyConfig.nmsEndY) &&
            (y >= (cannyConfig.nmsStartY + 2u)) &&
            ((y - 2u) <= cannyConfig.nmsEndY))
        {
            const uint32_t* n_row0 = sobelMapRing[(y - 3u) % 3];
            const uint32_t* n_row1 = sobelMapRing[(y - 2u) % 3];
            const uint32_t* n_row2 = sobelMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];
            const uint8_t* dirRow = sobelDirMapRing[(y - 2u) % 3];

            uint8_t* final_dstRow = dst->ptr + (y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width + cannyConfig.nmsStartX;

            for (uint32_t x = cannyConfig.nmsStartX; x <= cannyConfig.nmsEndX; x++)
            {
                uint32_t edge0, edge1;
                uint32_t magnitude = n_row1[x];
                uint8_t dir = dirRow[x];

                if (dir == 0)
                {
                    edge0 = n_row1[x - 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row1[x + 1u];
                }
                else if (dir == 2)
                {
                    edge0 = n_row0[x];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x];
                }
                else if (dir == 1)
                {
                    // gx, gy 同号 → 梯度方向 ↗ (亮度梯度指向右上) → NMS 比较 ↗ 与 ↙
                    edge0 = n_row0[x + 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x - 1u];
                }
                else
                {
                    // gx, gy 异号 → 梯度方向 ↘ (亮度梯度指向右下) → NMS 比较 ↘ 与 ↖
                    edge0 = n_row0[x - 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x + 1u];
                }

                if ((magnitude > edge0) && (magnitude >= edge1))
                {
                    if (magnitude >= cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq)
                    {
                        *final_dstRow = WHITE;  // 确信强边缘
                        if (queueTail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                        {
                            cannyEdgeQueue[queueTail++] = (uint16_t) ((y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width + x);
                        }
                    }
                    else if (magnitude >= cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq)
                    {
                        *final_dstRow = 127;  // 先标记为弱边缘，用于第四阶段追踪，避免大数组分配
                    }
                }

                final_dstRow++;
            }
        }
    }

    // ================== 第4阶段: 滞后门限追踪(连边) ==================
    while (queueHead < queueTail)
    {
        uint32_t index = cannyEdgeQueue[queueHead++];

        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            int32_t trackIndex = (int32_t) index + cannyConfig.trackOffsets[i];

            if (trackIndex >= 0 && trackIndex < (int32_t) cannyConfig.pixelCount)
            {
                if (dst->ptr[trackIndex] == 127)
                {
                    dst->ptr[trackIndex] = WHITE;  // 连通升级为强边缘

                    // 防溢出保护
                    if (queueTail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                    {
                        cannyEdgeQueue[queueTail++] = (uint16_t) trackIndex;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ================== 收尾: 清理死路 ==================
    uint32_t totalPixels = gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < totalPixels; i++)
    {
        if (dst->ptr[i] == 127) dst->ptr[i] = BLACK;  // 无法与强边缘连通被消除
    }
}

/*
 * openMorph_config.h - openMorph 库可移植配置头
 *
 * 移植到新工程时只需修改本文件即可适配不同图像分辨率与对象数量上限。
 * openMorph 内部其他源文件不应再出现关于尺寸的字面量。
 */
#ifndef OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H
#define OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H

// ============================================================================
//  图像最大尺寸 (静态缓冲区按此分配)
// ============================================================================
//  core1 实际相机 MT9V03X 为 188 x 120 = 22560 像素 (与 image.c 的 MT9V03X_IMAGE_SIZE 一致)。
//  必须与相机分辨率匹配: 若小于真实分辨率, om_canny/cannyInit 入口保护
//  ((xLen*yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) 会拒绝处理 → canny 图纯黑、信标失效。
//  注意: core0/core1 当前均为 188x120；openMorph_config.h 仍按各核相机独立维护。
//  像素索引以 uint16 存储 (om_beacon/om_canny), 故 W*H 须 <= 65535; 22560 在范围内。
//  本配置与具体相机驱动解耦，不引入 SDK 头依赖。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH  (188u)
#define OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT (120u)
#define OM_BUFFER_SIZE      (OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH * OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT)

// ============================================================================
//  对象检测数量上限 (轮廓 / 信标 / 连通域共用)
// ============================================================================
//  contourData[] / beaconData[] / sbea[] 等数组的成员数量。
//  超过此上限的候选对象会被忽略 (只保留前 N 个有效结果)。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_MAX_OBJECTS (101u)

// ============================================================================
//  Canny 流水线环形缓冲宽度
// ============================================================================
//  Canny 边缘检测内部 sobel 环形缓冲的列宽，必须 >= OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_CANNY_RING_WIDTH (256u)

// ============================================================================
//  轮廓跟踪状态机参数
// ============================================================================
#define OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD       (2u)      // 连续检测到帧数: SEARCHING → ACQUIRING
#define OM_LOCK_CONFIRM         (1u)      // 继续确认帧数: ACQUIRING → LOCKED
#define OM_LOST_THRESHOLD       (5u)      // 连续丢失帧数: LOCKED → LOST_HOLDING
#define OM_LOST_TIMEOUT         (30u)     // 超时帧数: LOST_HOLDING → SEARCHING
#define OM_RAY_BALANCE_CONFIDENCE_MIN (0.50f) // ^尖端几何定向最低置信度: 低于此值拒绝更新朝向, 目标位置仍有效
#define OM_ORIENTATION_MIN_SIZE (8u)      // 朝向可靠的最小像素数 (与 core0 openMorph 算法同源)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA    (0.4f)    // 朝向低通滤波系数 (喂给 lowPassFilter, 越大越跟随/越小越平滑)
#define OM_POSITION_ALPHA       (1.0f)    // 质心位置不过滤
#define OM_VELOCITY_ALPHA       (0.1f)    // 原始质心差分速度低通滤波系数
#define OM_VELOCITY_DT_MIN_S    (0.001f)  // 有效图像样本间隔下限
#define OM_VELOCITY_DT_MAX_S    (0.200f)  // 超过此间隔只重建速度基线
#define OM_BORDER_MARGIN        (1u)      // 画幅边缘安全边距

// ============================================================================
//  朝向跳变保护默认值 (运行时可由菜单热重载, 逻辑同 ToF 定高跳变保护)
//   NORMAL  态: |Δθ| > JUMP_MAX 视为异常突跳, 拒绝该样本进 SUSPENDED
//   SUSPEND 态: |Δθ| < RECOVER_RAD 即时恢复; 介于二者间累计 CONFIRM_FRAMES 帧后
//               接受新朝向为基线; 持续 > JUMP_MAX 则计数清零继续沿用旧朝向
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_ORIENTATION_JUMP_MAX       (0.785398f)  // PI/4, 朝向跳变阈值 (rad)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_RECOVER_RAD    (0.196349f)  // PI/16, 恢复窄带 (rad)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_CONFIRM_FRAMES (3u)         // 异常持续这么多帧后接受新朝向

#endif  // OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H

#include "visionParams.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "visionParamsInternal.h"

/*
 * visionParams.c — core1 视觉参数运行时模型。
 *   持有参数实体、默认加载、sanitize/clamp 与运行时 Apply。
 *   不触屏/不读按键; 全部前台调用。
 */

typedef struct
{
    visionParamsStruct active;
    uint32_t revision;
    uint8_t initialized;
} visionParamsRepositoryStruct;

static visionParamsRepositoryStruct visionParamsRepository;

visionParamsStruct *visionParamsRepositoryMutable(void)
{
    return &visionParamsRepository.active;
}

void visionParamsGetActive(visionParamsStruct *out)
{
    if (out == 0) return;
    *out = visionParamsRepository.active;
}

uint32_t visionParamsGetRevision(void)
{
    return visionParamsRepository.revision;
}

uint8_t visionParamsCommit(const visionParamsStruct *candidate)
{
    if (candidate == 0) return 0u;
    visionParamsRepository.active = *candidate;
    visionParamsApply();
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t visionParamsUpdateSharedIdentity(uint32_t revision, uint32_t hash)
{
    if (revision == 0u) return 0u;
    if ((visionParams.sharedConfigRevision == revision) &&
        (visionParams.sharedConfigHash == hash))
    {
        return 1u;
    }
    visionParams.sharedConfigRevision = revision;
    visionParams.sharedConfigHash = hash;
    visionParamsRepository.revision++;
    if (visionParamsRepository.revision == 0u) visionParamsRepository.revision = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

/* NaN/Inf 回默认再 clamp（clampf 对 NaN 返回 NaN，需先剔除；不引入 math.h）。 */
static float sanitizeFloat(float v, float def, float lo, float hi)
{
    if (v != v || v > 1.0e30f || v < -1.0e30f) v = def;
    return clampf(v, lo, hi);
}

static void sanitizeBorderPair(uint8_t *enter, uint8_t *exit, uint8_t maxValue,
    uint8_t defaultEnter, uint8_t defaultExit)
{
    if ((enter == 0) || (exit == 0)) return;

    if ((*enter == 0u) && (*exit == 0u))
    {
        return;
    }
    if ((*enter < 1u) || (*enter > maxValue) || (*exit >= *enter))
    {
        *enter = defaultEnter;
        *exit = defaultExit;
    }
}

void visionParamsClamp(void)
{
    visionParams.detectMode = (visionParams.detectMode == VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY)
                                  ? VISION_DETECT_MODE_LEGACY_CANNY
                                  : VISION_DETECT_MODE_BINARYCC;

    if (visionParams.cannyLow < VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN) visionParams.cannyLow = VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
    if (visionParams.cannyHigh > VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX) visionParams.cannyHigh = VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX;
    if ((uint16_t) (visionParams.cannyLow + VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP) > visionParams.cannyHigh)
    {
        if (visionParams.cannyHigh > (uint16_t) (VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP))
        {
            visionParams.cannyLow = (uint16_t) (visionParams.cannyHigh - VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP);
        }
        else
        {
            visionParams.cannyLow = VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
            visionParams.cannyHigh = (uint16_t) (VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP);
        }
    }
    if (visionParams.exposure < VISION_EXPOSURE_MIN) visionParams.exposure = VISION_EXPOSURE_MIN;
    if (visionParams.exposure > VISION_EXPOSURE_MAX) visionParams.exposure = VISION_EXPOSURE_MAX;
    if (visionParams.legacyCannyLow < VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN)
        visionParams.legacyCannyLow = VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
    if (visionParams.legacyCannyHigh > VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX)
        visionParams.legacyCannyHigh = VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MAX;
    if ((uint16_t) (visionParams.legacyCannyLow + VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP) > visionParams.legacyCannyHigh)
    {
        if (visionParams.legacyCannyHigh > (uint16_t) (VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP))
        {
            visionParams.legacyCannyLow = (uint16_t) (visionParams.legacyCannyHigh - VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP);
        }
        else
        {
            visionParams.legacyCannyLow = VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN;
            visionParams.legacyCannyHigh = (uint16_t) (VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_MIN + VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_THRESHOLD_GAP);
        }
    }

    if (visionParams.beaconSizeMin < 1u) visionParams.beaconSizeMin = 1u;
    if (visionParams.beaconSizeMin > 59999u) visionParams.beaconSizeMin = 59999u;
    if (visionParams.beaconSizeMax <= visionParams.beaconSizeMin)
        visionParams.beaconSizeMax = (uint16_t) (visionParams.beaconSizeMin + 1u);
    if (visionParams.beaconSizeMax > 60000u) visionParams.beaconSizeMax = 60000u;
    visionParams.beaconEccMax = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.beaconEccMax,
        VISION_BEACON_ECC_MAX_DEFAULT, 0.0f, 20.0f);
    if (visionParams.beaconMaxEndpoints > 200u) visionParams.beaconMaxEndpoints = 200u;
    visionParams.beaconFillMin = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.beaconFillMin,
        VISION_BEACON_FILL_MIN_DEFAULT, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    visionParams.beaconHuMax = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.beaconHuMax,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_MAX_DEFAULT, VISION_BEACON_HU_MAX_MIN, VISION_BEACON_HU_MAX_MAX);
    visionParams.beaconHuAreaMin = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.beaconHuAreaMin,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_AREA_MIN_MIN, VISION_BEACON_HU_AREA_MIN_MAX);

    visionParams.trackMaxAssocDist = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.trackMaxAssocDist,
        VISION_TRACK_MAX_ASSOC_DIST_DEFAULT, 1.0f, 100.0f);
    visionParams.trackSizeRatioMax = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.trackSizeRatioMax,
        VISION_TRACK_SIZE_RATIO_MAX_DEFAULT, 1.1f, 10.0f);
    visionParams.trackConfirmHits = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.trackConfirmHits, 1.0f, 60.0f);
    visionParams.trackDropMisses = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.trackDropMisses, 1.0f, 60.0f);
    visionParams.trackCoastMisses = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.trackCoastMisses, 1.0f, 60.0f);
    visionParams.trackPositionAlpha = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.trackPositionAlpha,
        VISION_TRACK_POSITION_ALPHA_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MAX);
    visionParams.trackSizeAlpha = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.trackSizeAlpha,
        VISION_TRACK_SIZE_ALPHA_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MAX);
    visionParams.planningEdgePredictionHoldMs = (uint16_t) clampf(
        (float) visionParams.planningEdgePredictionHoldMs,
        VISION_TRACK_EDGE_PREDICTION_HOLD_MS_MIN,
        VISION_TRACK_EDGE_PREDICTION_HOLD_MS_MAX);
    visionParams.c1EdgeBandLeft = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c1EdgeBandLeft, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    visionParams.c1EdgeBandRight = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c1EdgeBandRight, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    visionParams.c1EdgeBandTop = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c1EdgeBandTop, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.c1EdgeBandBottom = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c1EdgeBandBottom, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.observerEdgeBandLeft = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.observerEdgeBandLeft, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    visionParams.observerEdgeBandRight = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.observerEdgeBandRight, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    visionParams.observerEdgeBandTop = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.observerEdgeBandTop, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.observerEdgeBandBottom = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.observerEdgeBandBottom, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.c4EdgeBandLeft = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c4EdgeBandLeft, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    visionParams.c4EdgeBandRight = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c4EdgeBandRight, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX);
    visionParams.c4EdgeBandTop = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c4EdgeBandTop, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.c4EdgeBandBottom = (uint8_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c4EdgeBandBottom, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX);

    visionParams.planningKpVy = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningKpVy,
        PLANNING_KP_VY_DEFAULT, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MIN, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MAX);

        CORE3_PLANNING_KP_VX_DEFAULT, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MIN, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MAX);
    visionParams.core3PlanningKpVy = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core3PlanningKpVy,
        CORE3_PLANNING_KP_VY_DEFAULT, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MIN, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MAX);
    visionParams.core4PlanningKpVx = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core4PlanningKpVx,
        CORE4_PLANNING_KP_VX_DEFAULT, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MIN, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MAX);
    visionParams.core4PlanningKpVy = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core4PlanningKpVy,
        CORE4_PLANNING_KP_VY_DEFAULT, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MIN, PLANNING_KP_LINEAR_MAX);
    visionParams.planningVxMax = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningVxMax,
        PLANNING_VX_MAX_DEFAULT, PLANNING_V_LINEAR_LIMIT_MIN, PLANNING_V_LINEAR_LIMIT_MAX);
    visionParams.planningVyMax = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningVyMax,
        PLANNING_VY_MAX_DEFAULT, PLANNING_V_LINEAR_LIMIT_MIN, PLANNING_V_LINEAR_LIMIT_MAX);
    visionParams.planningWzMax = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningWzMax,
        PLANNING_WZ_MAX_DEFAULT, PLANNING_WZ_LIMIT_MIN, PLANNING_WZ_LIMIT_MAX);
    visionParams.planningVxSlewPerS = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningVxSlewPerS,
        PLANNING_VX_SLEW_DEFAULT, PLANNING_SLEW_MIN, PLANNING_SLEW_MAX);
    visionParams.planningVySlewPerS = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningVySlewPerS,
        PLANNING_VY_SLEW_DEFAULT, PLANNING_SLEW_MIN, PLANNING_SLEW_MAX);
    visionParams.planningWzSlewPerS = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningWzSlewPerS,
        PLANNING_WZ_SLEW_DEFAULT, PLANNING_SLEW_MIN, PLANNING_SLEW_MAX);
    visionParams.planningVxMin = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningVxMin,
        PLANNING_VX_MIN_DEFAULT, 0.0f, visionParams.planningVxMax);
    visionParams.planningVyMin = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningVyMin,
        PLANNING_VY_MIN_DEFAULT, 0.0f, visionParams.planningVyMax);
    visionParams.planningWzMin = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningWzMin,
        PLANNING_WZ_MIN_DEFAULT, 0.0f, visionParams.planningWzMax);
    visionParams.planningFirstBeaconForwardSpeed = sanitizeFloat(
        visionParams.planningFirstBeaconForwardSpeed,
        PLANNING_FIRST_BEACON_FORWARD_SPEED_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_FIRST_BEACON_FORWARD_SPEED_MIN,
        visionParams.planningVxMax);
    visionParams.planningPostTakeoffDelayMs = (uint16_t) clampf(
        (float) visionParams.planningPostTakeoffDelayMs,
        PLANNING_POST_TAKEOFF_DELAY_MS_MIN,
        PLANNING_POST_TAKEOFF_DELAY_MS_MAX);
    visionParams.planningFirstBeaconForwardEnable =
        (visionParams.planningFirstBeaconForwardEnable != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    /* deadzone：先钳 enter、后钳 exit（exit 上界依赖已钳位的 enter，保证 exit <= enter - GAP_MIN），顺序不可换。 */
    visionParams.planningDeadzoneEnterPx = sanitizeFloat(
        visionParams.planningDeadzoneEnterPx, PLANNING_DEADZONE_ENTER_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_DEADZONE_ENTER_MIN, PLANNING_DEADZONE_ENTER_MAX);
    visionParams.planningDeadzoneExitPx = sanitizeFloat(
        visionParams.planningDeadzoneExitPx, PLANNING_DEADZONE_EXIT_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_DEADZONE_EXIT_MIN,
        visionParams.planningDeadzoneEnterPx - PLANNING_DEADZONE_GAP_MIN);
    visionParams.planningCore0PoseMinConfidence = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningCore0PoseMinConfidence,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_MIN_CONF_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_MIN_CONF_MIN,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_MIN_CONF_MAX);
    visionParams.c1Core0PoseOffsetX = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.c1Core0PoseOffsetX,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_X_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_X_MIN,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_X_MAX);
    visionParams.c1Core0PoseOffsetY = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.c1Core0PoseOffsetY,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_MIN,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.planningCore0PoseHeadingOffsetRad = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningCore0PoseHeadingOffsetRad,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_HEADING_OFFSET_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_HEADING_OFFSET_MIN,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_HEADING_OFFSET_MAX);
    visionParams.planningCore0PoseHeadingSign =
        (visionParams.planningCore0PoseHeadingSign >= 0) ? (int8_t) 1 : (int8_t) -1;
    visionParams.poseHoldMs = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.poseHoldMs,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_HOLD_MS_MIN, PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_HOLD_MS_MAX);

    /* 离散极性 sign：仅 -1/+1（>=0 归 +1）。 */
    visionParams.planningVxSign = (visionParams.planningVxSign >= 0) ? (int8_t) 1 : (int8_t) -1;
    visionParams.planningVySign = (visionParams.planningVySign >= 0) ? (int8_t) 1 : (int8_t) -1;
    visionParams.planningWzSign = (visionParams.planningWzSign >= 0) ? (int8_t) 1 : (int8_t) -1;

    /* 派发开关归一化 0/1；派发超时钳到范围。 */
    visionParams.planningDispatchEnable = (visionParams.planningDispatchEnable != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    visionParams.planningSearchEnable = (visionParams.planningSearchEnable != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    visionParams.planningPlanTimeoutMs = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.planningPlanTimeoutMs,
        PLANNING_PLAN_TIMEOUT_MS_MIN, PLANNING_PLAN_TIMEOUT_MS_MAX);
    visionParams.planningSearchWz = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningSearchWz,
        PLANNING_SEARCH_WZ_DEFAULT, PLANNING_SEARCH_WZ_MIN, PLANNING_SEARCH_WZ_MAX);
    visionParams.planningSearchTimeoutMs = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.planningSearchTimeoutMs,
        PLANNING_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS_MIN, PLANNING_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS_MAX);

    /* 输出 TD：NaN/Inf 回默认再 clamp。 */
    visionParams.planningTdRvx = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningTdRvx,
        PLANNING_TD_RVX_DEFAULT, PLANNING_TD_R_MIN, PLANNING_TD_R_MAX);
    visionParams.planningTdRvy = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningTdRvy,
        PLANNING_TD_RVY_DEFAULT, PLANNING_TD_R_MIN, PLANNING_TD_R_MAX);
    visionParams.planningTdRwz = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningTdRwz,
        PLANNING_TD_RWZ_DEFAULT, PLANNING_TD_R_MIN, PLANNING_TD_R_MAX);
    visionParams.planningTdN = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.planningTdN,
        PLANNING_TD_N_DEFAULT, PLANNING_TD_N_MIN, PLANNING_TD_N_MAX);
    visionParams.planningTdVxEnable = (visionParams.planningTdVxEnable != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    visionParams.planningTdVyEnable = (visionParams.planningTdVyEnable != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    visionParams.planningTdWzEnable = (visionParams.planningTdWzEnable != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;

    visionParams.trackAreaVelAlpha = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.trackAreaVelAlpha,
        VISION_TRACK_AREA_VEL_ALPHA_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MIN, VISION_TRACK_ALPHA_MAX);
    visionParams.trackAssocScoreMax = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.trackAssocScoreMax,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_SCORE_MAX_DEFAULT,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_SCORE_MAX_MIN,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_SCORE_MAX_MAX);
    visionParams.trackAssocAreaWeight = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.trackAssocAreaWeight,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_WEIGHT_DEFAULT,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_WEIGHT_MIN,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_WEIGHT_MAX);
    visionParams.trackAssocAreaVelWeight = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.trackAssocAreaVelWeight,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_VEL_WEIGHT_DEFAULT,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_WEIGHT_MIN,
        VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_WEIGHT_MAX);
    if (visionParams.sharedConfigRevision == 0u) visionParams.sharedConfigRevision = 1u;
    visionParams.core3CenterX = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core3CenterX,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_X_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_X_MIN, CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_X_MAX);
    visionParams.core3CenterY = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core3CenterY,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_Y_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_Y_MIN, CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.core3Scale = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core3Scale,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MIN, CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MAX);
    visionParams.core3MountYawRad = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core3MountYawRad,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MIN, CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MAX);
    visionParams.core3ObservationTimeoutMs = (uint16_t) clampf(
        (float) visionParams.core3ObservationTimeoutMs,
        (float) CORE3_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS_MIN,
        (float) CORE3_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS_MAX);
    if (visionParams.maxBeacons < BEACON_MAX_BEACONS_MIN)
        visionParams.maxBeacons = BEACON_MAX_BEACONS_MIN;
    if (visionParams.maxBeacons > BEACON_MAX_BEACONS_MAX)
        visionParams.maxBeacons = BEACON_MAX_BEACONS_MAX;
    visionParams.core3MirrorX = (visionParams.core3MirrorX != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    visionParams.core3ErrorFwdSign = (visionParams.core3ErrorFwdSign >= 0) ? 1 : -1;
    visionParams.core3ErrorRightSign = (visionParams.core3ErrorRightSign >= 0) ? 1 : -1;
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.c1BorderEnterLeft, &visionParams.c1BorderExitLeft,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_ENTER_LEFT_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_LEFT_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.c1BorderEnterRight, &visionParams.c1BorderExitRight,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_ENTER_RIGHT_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_RIGHT_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.c1BorderEnterTop, &visionParams.c1BorderExitTop,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_ENTER_TOP_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_TOP_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.c1BorderEnterBottom, &visionParams.c1BorderExitBottom,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_ENTER_BOTTOM_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_BOTTOM_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.observerBorderEnterLeft, &visionParams.observerBorderExitLeft,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_CORE3_BORDER_ENTER_LEFT_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_CORE3_BORDER_EXIT_LEFT_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.observerBorderEnterRight, &visionParams.observerBorderExitRight,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_CORE3_BORDER_ENTER_RIGHT_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_CORE3_BORDER_EXIT_RIGHT_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.observerBorderEnterTop, &visionParams.observerBorderExitTop,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_CORE3_BORDER_ENTER_TOP_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_CORE3_BORDER_EXIT_TOP_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.observerBorderEnterBottom, &visionParams.observerBorderExitBottom,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_CORE3_BORDER_ENTER_BOTTOM_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_CORE3_BORDER_EXIT_BOTTOM_DEFAULT);
    visionParams.core3Core0PoseOffsetX = sanitizeFloat(
        visionParams.core3Core0PoseOffsetX,
        CORE3_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_X_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_X_MIN,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_X_MAX);
    visionParams.core3Core0PoseOffsetY = sanitizeFloat(
        visionParams.core3Core0PoseOffsetY,
        CORE3_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_MIN,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.core3PlanningVxSign =
        (visionParams.core3PlanningVxSign >= 0) ? (int8_t) 1 : (int8_t) -1;
    visionParams.core3PlanningVySign =
        (visionParams.core3PlanningVySign >= 0) ? (int8_t) 1 : (int8_t) -1;

    visionParams.c1FreshGateMs = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c1FreshGateMs,
        (float) SOURCE_FRESH_GATE_MS_MIN, (float) SOURCE_FRESH_GATE_MS_MAX);
    visionParams.c3FreshGateMs = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c3FreshGateMs,
        (float) SOURCE_FRESH_GATE_MS_MIN, (float) SOURCE_FRESH_GATE_MS_MAX);
    visionParams.c4FreshGateMs = (uint16_t) clampf((float) visionParams.c4FreshGateMs,
        (float) SOURCE_FRESH_GATE_MS_MIN, (float) SOURCE_FRESH_GATE_MS_MAX);
    visionParams.c4ObservationTimeoutMs = (uint16_t) clampf(
        (float) visionParams.c4ObservationTimeoutMs,
        (float) CORE4_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS_MIN,
        (float) CORE4_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS_MAX);
    visionParams.core4CenterX = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core4CenterX,
        CORE4_CALIBRATION_CENTER_X_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_X_MIN, CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_X_MAX);
    visionParams.core4CenterY = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core4CenterY,
        CORE4_CALIBRATION_CENTER_Y_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_Y_MIN, CORE3_CALIBRATION_CENTER_Y_MAX);
    visionParams.core4Scale = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core4Scale,
        CORE4_CALIBRATION_SCALE_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MIN, CORE3_CALIBRATION_SCALE_MAX);
    visionParams.core4MountYawRad = sanitizeFloat(visionParams.core4MountYawRad,
        CORE4_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MIN, CORE3_CALIBRATION_YAW_RAD_MAX);
    visionParams.core4MirrorX = (visionParams.core4MirrorX != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    visionParams.core4ErrorFwdSign = (visionParams.core4ErrorFwdSign >= 0) ? 1 : -1;
    visionParams.core4ErrorRightSign = (visionParams.core4ErrorRightSign >= 0) ? 1 : -1;
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.c4BorderEnterLeft, &visionParams.c4BorderExitLeft,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_CORE4_BORDER_ENTER_LEFT_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_CORE4_BORDER_EXIT_LEFT_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.c4BorderEnterRight, &visionParams.c4BorderExitRight,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_CORE4_BORDER_ENTER_RIGHT_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_CORE4_BORDER_EXIT_RIGHT_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.c4BorderEnterTop, &visionParams.c4BorderExitTop,

        VISION_TRACK_CORE4_BORDER_ENTER_TOP_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_CORE4_BORDER_EXIT_TOP_DEFAULT);
    sanitizeBorderPair(&visionParams.c4BorderEnterBottom, &visionParams.c4BorderExitBottom,
        VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX,
        VISION_TRACK_CORE4_BORDER_ENTER_BOTTOM_DEFAULT, VISION_TRACK_CORE4_BORDER_EXIT_BOTTOM_DEFAULT);

        visionParams.core4Core0PoseOffsetY, CORE4_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_DEFAULT,
        PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_MIN, PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_OFFSET_Y_MAX);

        (visionParams.core4PlanningVxSign >= 0) ? (int8_t) 1 : (int8_t) -1;
    visionParams.core4PlanningVySign =
        (visionParams.core4PlanningVySign >= 0) ? (int8_t) 1 : (int8_t) -1;

void visionParamsLoadDefaults(void)
{
    memset(&visionParams, 0, sizeof(visionParams));
    visionParams.detectMode = VISION_DETECT_MODE_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.cannyLow = VISION_CANNY_LOW_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.cannyHigh = VISION_CANNY_HIGH_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.exposure = VISION_EXPOSURE_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.beaconSizeMin = VISION_BEACON_SIZE_MIN_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.beaconSizeMax = VISION_BEACON_SIZE_MAX_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.beaconEccMax = VISION_BEACON_ECC_MAX_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.beaconBrightnessMin = VISION_BEACON_BRIGHTNESS_MIN_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.beaconMaxEndpoints = VISION_BEACON_MAX_ENDPOINTS_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.trackMaxAssocDist = VISION_TRACK_MAX_ASSOC_DIST_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.trackSizeRatioMax = VISION_TRACK_SIZE_RATIO_MAX_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.trackConfirmHits = VISION_TRACK_CONFIRM_HITS_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.trackDropMisses = VISION_TRACK_DROP_MISSES_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.trackCoastMisses = VISION_TRACK_COAST_MISSES_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.trackPositionAlpha = VISION_TRACK_POSITION_ALPHA_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.trackSizeAlpha = VISION_TRACK_SIZE_ALPHA_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningEdgePredictionHoldMs = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_PREDICTION_HOLD_MS_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.c1EdgeBandLeft = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_C1_LEFT_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.c1EdgeBandRight = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_C1_RIGHT_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.c1EdgeBandTop = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_C1_TOP_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.c1EdgeBandBottom = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_C1_BOTTOM_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.observerEdgeBandLeft = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_C3_LEFT_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.observerEdgeBandRight = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_C3_RIGHT_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.observerEdgeBandTop = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_C3_TOP_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.observerEdgeBandBottom = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_C3_BOTTOM_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningKpVx = PLANNING_KP_VX_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningKpVy = PLANNING_KP_VY_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.core3PlanningKpVx = CORE3_PLANNING_KP_VX_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.core3PlanningKpVy = CORE3_PLANNING_KP_VY_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningVxMax = PLANNING_VX_MAX_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningVyMax = PLANNING_VY_MAX_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningWzMax = PLANNING_WZ_MAX_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningVxSlewPerS = PLANNING_VX_SLEW_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningVySlewPerS = PLANNING_VY_SLEW_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningWzSlewPerS = PLANNING_WZ_SLEW_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningVxMin = PLANNING_VX_MIN_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningVyMin = PLANNING_VY_MIN_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningWzMin = PLANNING_WZ_MIN_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningDeadzoneEnterPx = PLANNING_DEADZONE_ENTER_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningDeadzoneExitPx = PLANNING_DEADZONE_EXIT_DEFAULT;
    visionParams.planningCore0PoseMinConfidence = PLANNING_CORE0_POSE_MIN_CONF_DEFAULT;

void visionParamsApply(void)
{
    static const float beaconHuTemplate[7] = {
        VISION_BEACON_HU_TEMPLATE_0,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_TEMPLATE_1,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_TEMPLATE_2,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_TEMPLATE_3,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_TEMPLATE_4,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_TEMPLATE_5,
        VISION_BEACON_HU_TEMPLATE_6};
    BEACONCC_CONFIG_STRUCT beaconCcConfig;
    beaconNavigatorParamViewStruct navigator;
    beaconTrackBorderConfigStruct c1Border;
    beaconTrackEdgePredictionConfigStruct c1Edge;

    visionParamsClamp();

    beaconCcConfig.thresholdLow = (uint8_t) visionParams.cannyLow;
    beaconCcConfig.thresholdHigh = (uint8_t) visionParams.cannyHigh;
    beaconCcConfig.areaMin = visionParams.beaconSizeMin;
    beaconCcConfig.areaMax = visionParams.beaconSizeMax;
    beaconCcConfig.brightnessMin = visionParams.beaconBrightnessMin;
    beaconCcConfig.eccMax = visionParams.beaconEccMax;
    beaconCcConfig.fillMin = visionParams.beaconFillMin;
    beaconCcConfig.huMax = visionParams.beaconHuMax;
    beaconCcConfig.huAreaMin = visionParams.beaconHuAreaMin;
    beaconCcSetConfig(&beaconCcConfig);
    beaconCcSetTemplate(beaconHuTemplate, visionParams.beaconHuMax);
    cannySetThreshold(visionParams.legacyCannyLow, visionParams.legacyCannyHigh);
    beaconDetectInit(visionParams.beaconSizeMin, visionParams.beaconSizeMax,
        visionParams.beaconEccMax, visionParams.beaconBrightnessMin,
        visionParams.beaconMaxEndpoints);
    imageSetDetectMode(visionParams.detectMode);

    /* track: 热重载跟踪门控参数 + 关联平滑 alpha。 */
    beaconTrackSetParams(visionParams.trackMaxAssocDist, visionParams.trackSizeRatioMax,
        visionParams.trackConfirmHits, visionParams.trackDropMisses,
        visionParams.trackCoastMisses,
        visionParams.trackPositionAlpha, visionParams.trackSizeAlpha,
        visionParams.trackAreaVelAlpha, visionParams.trackAssocScoreMax,
        visionParams.trackAssocAreaWeight, visionParams.trackAssocAreaVelWeight);
    c1Border.enter.left = visionParams.c1BorderEnterLeft;
    c1Border.enter.right = visionParams.c1BorderEnterRight;
    c1Border.enter.top = visionParams.c1BorderEnterTop;
    c1Border.enter.bottom = visionParams.c1BorderEnterBottom;
    c1Border.exit.left = visionParams.c1BorderExitLeft;
    c1Border.exit.right = visionParams.c1BorderExitRight;
    c1Border.exit.top = visionParams.c1BorderExitTop;
    c1Border.exit.bottom = visionParams.c1BorderExitBottom;
    beaconTrackSetBorderMargins(&c1Border);
    c1Edge.holdMs = visionParams.planningEdgePredictionHoldMs;
    c1Edge.bands.left = visionParams.c1EdgeBandLeft;
    c1Edge.bands.right = visionParams.c1EdgeBandRight;
    c1Edge.bands.top = visionParams.c1EdgeBandTop;
    c1Edge.bands.bottom = visionParams.c1EdgeBandBottom;
    beaconTrackSetEdgePredictionConfig(&c1Edge);

    navigator.planningKpVx = visionParams.planningKpVx;
    navigator.planningKpVy = visionParams.planningKpVy;
    navigator.core3PlanningKpVx = visionParams.core3PlanningKpVx;
    navigator.core3PlanningKpVy = visionParams.core3PlanningKpVy;
    navigator.core4PlanningKpVx = visionParams.core4PlanningKpVx;
    navigator.core4PlanningKpVy = visionParams.core4PlanningKpVy;
    navigator.planningVxMax = visionParams.planningVxMax;
    navigator.planningVyMax = visionParams.planningVyMax;
    navigator.planningWzMax = visionParams.planningWzMax;
    navigator.planningVxMin = visionParams.planningVxMin;
    navigator.planningVyMin = visionParams.planningVyMin;
    navigator.planningWzMin = visionParams.planningWzMin;
    navigator.planningVxSlewPerS = visionParams.planningVxSlewPerS;
    navigator.planningVySlewPerS = visionParams.planningVySlewPerS;
    navigator.planningWzSlewPerS = visionParams.planningWzSlewPerS;
    navigator.planningDeadzoneEnterPx = visionParams.planningDeadzoneEnterPx;
    navigator.planningDeadzoneExitPx = visionParams.planningDeadzoneExitPx;
    navigator.planningTdRvx = visionParams.planningTdRvx;
    navigator.planningTdRvy = visionParams.planningTdRvy;
    navigator.planningTdRwz = visionParams.planningTdRwz;
    navigator.planningTdN = visionParams.planningTdN;
    navigator.planningSearchWz = visionParams.planningSearchWz;
    navigator.planningFirstBeaconForwardSpeed = visionParams.planningFirstBeaconForwardSpeed;
    navigator.planningVxSign = visionParams.planningVxSign;
    navigator.planningVySign = visionParams.planningVySign;
    navigator.planningWzSign = visionParams.planningWzSign;
    navigator.core3PlanningVxSign = visionParams.core3PlanningVxSign;
    navigator.core3PlanningVySign = visionParams.core3PlanningVySign;
    navigator.core4PlanningVxSign = visionParams.core4PlanningVxSign;
    navigator.core4PlanningVySign = visionParams.core4PlanningVySign;
    navigator.planningSearchEnable = visionParams.planningSearchEnable;
    navigator.planningTdVxEnable = visionParams.planningTdVxEnable;
    navigator.planningTdVyEnable = visionParams.planningTdVyEnable;
    navigator.planningTdWzEnable = visionParams.planningTdWzEnable;
    navigator.planningFirstBeaconForwardEnable = visionParams.planningFirstBeaconForwardEnable;
    beaconNavigatorApplyParams(&navigator);

    imageSetExposure(visionParams.exposure);

    visionParamsRepository.initialized = 1u;
    visionParamsRepository.revision++;
    if (visionParamsRepository.revision == 0u) visionParamsRepository.revision = 1u;
}

#ifndef _VISION_PARAMS_H_
#define _VISION_PARAMS_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * visionParams - core1 cm_7_1 视觉参数运行时模型 + flash 持久化
 *
 * 把原本编译期 #define 的 DetectMode / BinaryCC / Legacy Canny / beacon / track 参数集中为运行时可调结构，提供:
 *   - 默认值加载(visionParamsLoadDefaults, 取自 configBeacon*.h 的 #define)
 *   - 热重载到检测器/相机(visionParamsApply: imageSetDetectMode + beaconCcSetConfig + cannySetThreshold + beaconTrackSetParams + imageSetExposure)
 *   - 保存 core1 规划运行时参数，含三来源动态中心/外参/增益/极性/边界/fresh门/观察超时与共享限幅/slew/TD整形参数
 *   - flash 持久化(load/save/erase, magic+version+CRC, 失败回退默认), 照搬 core0 menuModel 方案
 *   - 恢复默认(visionParamsRestoreDefaults: 载默认→应用→擦盘, 擦盘后视觉立即按默认运行)
 *
 * 全部前台调用(cm_7_1 whileProcess / 菜单), 非 ISR, 无 volatile 需求。
 * 远程菜单(core0 透传)与本地开机加载都经本模块改参→apply 生效。
 *
 * 字段名 cannyLow/cannyHigh 为兼容旧 flash 前缀；当前语义是 BinaryCC low/high。
 * Legacy Canny 使用 legacyCannyLow/legacyCannyHigh。
 */

/* 活动参数由 visionParams.c 私有仓库独占；调用方按值取快照或一次提交候选 DTO。 */
void visionParamsGetActive(visionParamsStruct *out);

uint8_t visionParamsUpdateSharedIdentity(uint32_t revision, uint32_t hash);

/* 用 configBeacon*.h 的 #define 默认值填充 visionParams(不应用到检测器)。 */
void visionParamsLoadDefaults(void);

void visionParamsApply(void);

/* 开机加载: flash 校验通过则载入并 apply; 失败回退默认并 apply。须先 flash_init()。 */
void visionParamsLoad(void);

/* 保存当前 visionParams 到 flash(magic+version+CRC)。仅菜单保存边沿调用，稀疏写防损耗。 */
void visionParamsSave(void);

/* 恢复默认: 载默认→apply(立即按默认运行)→擦 flash。绝不只擦盘留旧值。 */
void visionParamsRestoreDefaults(void);

#define VISION_FLASH_PAGE    (0u)

#define VISION_FLASH_VERSION (46u)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t version;
    uint32_t payloadBytes;
    visionParamsStruct param;
    uint32_t crc;
} visionFlashBlobStruct;

SHA-256：fe9d6ad7573c5c210573510182becfd309ad40b874970a807d60d3f3d8bfd237
代码（c）
#include "visionParams.h"

#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "../../../../core0_cyt4bb7/project/code/util/paramSlotStore.h"
#include "crc32Ieee.h"
#include "visionParamsFlashSchemaInternal.h"
#include "visionParamsInternal.h"

static paramSlotStore g_slotStore;
static uint8_t g_slotReady;

static uint8_t visionFlashBlobIsValidRaw(const void *data, uint32_t bytes)
{
    const visionFlashBlobStruct *stored = (const visionFlashBlobStruct *) data;
    return (uint8_t) ((bytes == sizeof(*stored)) &&
        (stored->magic == VISION_FLASH_MAGIC) &&
        (stored->version == VISION_FLASH_VERSION) &&
        (stored->payloadBytes == sizeof(*stored)) &&
        (crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) stored,
            (uint32_t) offsetof(visionFlashBlobStruct, crc)) == stored->crc));
}

static void encodeBlob(const visionParamsStruct *params,
    visionFlashBlobStruct *blob)
{
    memset(blob, 0, sizeof(*blob));
    blob->magic = VISION_FLASH_MAGIC;
    blob->version = VISION_FLASH_VERSION;
    blob->payloadBytes = sizeof(*blob);
    blob->param = *params;
    blob->crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) blob,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(visionFlashBlobStruct, crc));
}

static void sanitizeCopy(const visionParamsStruct *source,
    visionParamsStruct *sanitized)
{
    visionParamsStruct old = visionParams;
    visionParams = *source;
    visionParamsClamp();
    *sanitized = visionParams;
    visionParams = old;
}

static visionParamsSlotStatus mapStatus(paramSlotStatus status)
{
    return (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) ? VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK :
        VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
}

void visionParamsLoad(void)
{
    visionFlashBlobStruct defaults;
    visionFlashBlobStruct stored;

    visionParamsLoadDefaults();
    visionParamsClamp();
    encodeBlob(&visionParams, &defaults);
    g_slotReady = (uint8_t) (paramSlotStoreInit(&g_slotStore,
        sizeof(defaults), visionFlashBlobIsValidRaw, &defaults) == PARAM_SLOT_OK);
    if (g_slotReady != 0u)
    {
        if (paramSlotStoreReadRuntime(&g_slotStore, &stored,
                sizeof(stored)) == PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        {
            visionParams = stored.param;
            visionParamsClamp();
        }
    }
    visionParamsApply();
}

void visionParamsSave(void)
{
    visionParamsClamp();
    (void) visionParamsSaveRuntime(&visionParams);
}

void visionParamsRestoreDefaults(void)
{
    (void) visionParamsRestoreActiveSlotDefaults();
}

uint8_t visionParamsGetActiveSlot(void)
{
    return (g_slotReady != 0u) ? paramSlotStoreGetActive(&g_slotStore) : 0u;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsReadSlot(uint8_t slot,
    visionParamsStruct *params, visionParamsSlotMeta *meta)
{
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    paramSlotMeta raw;
    if ((g_slotReady == 0u) || (params == NULL) ||
        (paramSlotStoreRead(&g_slotStore, slot, &blob, sizeof(blob)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK))
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    sanitizeCopy(&blob.param, params);
    if (meta != NULL)
    {
        if (paramSlotStoreGetMeta(&g_slotStore, slot, &raw) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
            return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
        memcpy(meta, &raw, sizeof(*meta));
    }
    return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsPrepareSlot(uint8_t slot,
    const visionParamsStruct *params, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    visionParamsStruct sanitized;
    if ((g_slotReady == 0u) || (params == NULL)) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    sanitizeCopy(params, &sanitized);
    encodeBlob(&sanitized, &blob);
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStorePrepare(&g_slotStore, slot, &blob,
        sizeof(blob), transactionId));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsCommitPreparedSlot(uint8_t slot,
    uint32_t transactionId, uint8_t activate)
{
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStoreCommit(&g_slotStore, slot,
        transactionId, activate));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsAbortPreparedSlot(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    paramSlotStatus pendingStatus = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_slotStore,
        &pending);
    visionParamsStruct candidate;

    if ((pendingStatus != PARAM_SLOT_OK) &&
        (pendingStatus != PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY)) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    if ((pendingStatus == PARAM_SLOT_OK) && (pending.valid != 0u) &&
        (pending.active != 0u) &&
        ((pending.activationOnly != 0u) ||
         (pending.transactionId != transactionId)))
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    if ((pendingStatus == PARAM_SLOT_OK) && (pending.valid != 0u) &&
        (pending.active != 0u) && (pending.activationOnly == 0u) &&
        (pending.transactionId == transactionId))
    {
        if (visionParamsReadRuntime(&candidate, NULL) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK ||
            !visionParamsCommit(&candidate)) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    }
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStoreAbort(&g_slotStore, transactionId));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsFinishPreparedSlot(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    paramSlotStatus pendingStatus = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_slotStore,
        &pending);

    if ((pendingStatus != PARAM_SLOT_OK) &&
        (pendingStatus != PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY)) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    if ((pendingStatus == PARAM_SLOT_OK) && (pending.valid != 0u) &&
        (pending.active != 0u) &&
        visionParamsApplyPreparedRuntime(transactionId) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStoreFinish(&g_slotStore, transactionId));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsSaveSlot(uint8_t slot,
    const visionParamsStruct *params, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    visionParamsStruct sanitized;
    if ((g_slotReady == 0u) || (params == NULL)) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    sanitizeCopy(params, &sanitized);
    encodeBlob(&sanitized, &blob);
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStoreSave(&g_slotStore, slot, &blob,
        sizeof(blob), transactionId, 0u));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsActivateSlot(uint8_t slot)
{
    visionParamsStruct candidate;
    if (visionParamsReadSlot(slot, &candidate, NULL) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    if (paramSlotStoreSetActive(&g_slotStore, slot) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    if (visionParamsCommit(&candidate) == 0u) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsActivatePreparedSlot(uint8_t slot,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    visionParamsStruct candidate;
    if (visionParamsReadSlot(slot, &candidate, NULL) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    if (paramSlotStoreActivatePrepared(&g_slotStore, slot, transactionId) !=
        PARAM_SLOT_OK) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    return visionParamsCommit(&candidate) ? VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK :
        VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsActivateSlotPending(uint8_t slot)
{
    visionParamsStruct candidate;
    if (visionParamsReadSlot(slot, &candidate, NULL) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    if (paramSlotStoreSetActivePending(&g_slotStore, slot) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    return visionParamsCommit(&candidate) ? VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK : VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsAbortPendingActivation(void)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    visionParamsStruct candidate;
    paramSlotStatus status = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_slotStore, &pending);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK || !pending.valid || !pending.activationOnly)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    if (pending.active &&
        (visionParamsReadRuntime(&candidate, NULL) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK ||
         !visionParamsCommit(&candidate))) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStoreAbortPendingActivation(&g_slotStore));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsFinishPendingActivation(void)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo pending;
    if (paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_slotStore, &pending) != PARAM_SLOT_OK ||
        !pending.valid || !pending.active || !pending.activationOnly ||
        visionParamsApplyPreparedRuntime(UINT32_MAX) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStoreFinishPendingActivation(&g_slotStore));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsGetPending(visionParamsPendingInfo *pending)
{
    paramSlotPendingInfo raw;
    paramSlotStatus status;
    if (pending == NULL) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    memset(pending, 0, sizeof(*pending));
    status = paramSlotStoreGetPending(&g_slotStore, &raw);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    pending->transactionId = raw.transactionId;
    pending->slot = raw.slot;
    pending->valid = raw.valid;
    pending->activationOnly = raw.activationOnly;
    pending->active = raw.active;
    return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsRestoreActiveSlotDefaults(void)
{
    visionParamsStruct old = visionParams;
    visionParamsStruct defaults;
    visionParamsLoadDefaults();
    defaults = visionParams;
    visionParams = old;
    if (visionParamsSaveRuntime(&defaults) != VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    return visionParamsCommit(&defaults) ? VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK :
        VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsReadRuntime(visionParamsStruct *params,
    visionParamsRuntimeMeta *meta)
{
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    paramRuntimeMeta raw;
    if ((g_slotReady == 0u) || (params == NULL) ||
        (paramSlotStoreReadRuntime(&g_slotStore, &blob, sizeof(blob)) !=
            PARAM_SLOT_OK)) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    sanitizeCopy(&blob.param, params);
    if (meta != NULL)
    {
        if (paramSlotStoreGetRuntimeMeta(&g_slotStore, &raw) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
            return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
        memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
        meta->valid = raw.valid;
        meta->bank = raw.bank;
        meta->pending = raw.pending;
        meta->sourceSlot = raw.sourceSlot;
        meta->diagnosticFlags = paramSlotStoreRuntimeDefaultsRewritten(&g_slotStore) ?
            VISION_PARAMS_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTIC_DEFAULTS_REWRITTEN : 0u;
        meta->generation = raw.generation;
        meta->blobCrc = raw.blobCrc;
        meta->transactionId = raw.transactionId;
    }
    return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsInspectSlot(uint8_t slot,
    visionParamsLibraryMeta *meta)
{
    paramSlotMeta raw;
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    paramSlotStatus status;
    if ((g_slotReady == 0u) || (meta == NULL))
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
    status = paramSlotStoreGetMeta(&g_slotStore, slot, &raw);
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_EMPTY)
    {
        meta->state = VISION_PARAMS_LIBRARY_EMPTY;
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
    }
    if (status != PARAM_SLOT_OK) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    meta->bank = raw.bank;
    meta->generation = raw.generation;
    meta->blobCrc = raw.blobCrc;
    meta->transactionId = raw.transactionId;
    status = paramSlotStoreRead(&g_slotStore, slot, &blob, sizeof(blob));
    if (status == PARAM_SLOT_OK) meta->state = VISION_PARAMS_LIBRARY_VALID;
    else if ((status == PARAM_SLOT_INVALID) ||
        (status == PARAM_SLOT_VERIFY_FAILED))
        meta->state = VISION_PARAMS_LIBRARY_INVALID;
    else return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsGetRuntimeMeta(
    visionParamsRuntimeMeta *meta)
{
    paramRuntimeMeta raw;
    if ((meta == NULL) ||
        (paramSlotStoreGetRuntimeMeta(&g_slotStore, &raw) != PARAM_SLOT_OK))
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
    meta->valid = raw.valid;
    meta->bank = raw.bank;
    meta->pending = raw.pending;
    meta->sourceSlot = raw.sourceSlot;
    meta->diagnosticFlags = paramSlotStoreRuntimeDefaultsRewritten(&g_slotStore) ?
        VISION_PARAMS_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTIC_DEFAULTS_REWRITTEN : 0u;
    meta->generation = raw.generation;
    meta->blobCrc = raw.blobCrc;
    meta->transactionId = raw.transactionId;
    return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsSaveRuntime(
    const visionParamsStruct *params)
{
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    visionParamsStruct sanitized;
    if ((g_slotReady == 0u) || (params == NULL)) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    sanitizeCopy(params, &sanitized);
    encodeBlob(&sanitized, &blob);
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStoreSaveRuntime(&g_slotStore, &blob,
        sizeof(blob)));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsPrepareRuntime(
    const visionParamsStruct *params, uint32_t transactionId,
    uint8_t sourceSlot)
{
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    visionParamsStruct sanitized;
    if ((g_slotReady == 0u) || (params == NULL)) return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    sanitizeCopy(params, &sanitized);
    encodeBlob(&sanitized, &blob);
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStorePrepareRuntime(&g_slotStore, &blob,
        sizeof(blob), transactionId, sourceSlot));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsPrepareRuntimeFromSlot(uint8_t slot,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStorePrepareRuntimeFromSlot(&g_slotStore,
        slot, transactionId));
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsApplyPreparedRuntime(
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    visionFlashBlobStruct blob;
    visionParamsStruct candidate;
    if (paramSlotStoreReadPreparedRuntime(&g_slotStore, transactionId,
        &blob, sizeof(blob)) != PARAM_SLOT_OK)
        return VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
    sanitizeCopy(&blob.param, &candidate);
    return visionParamsCommit(&candidate) ? VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_OK :
        VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_ERROR;
}

visionParamsSlotStatus visionParamsCommitRuntime(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    return mapStatus(paramSlotStoreCommitRuntime(&g_slotStore,
        transactionId));
}

// 串口0默认作为调试串口
void uart0_isr(void)
{
    if (uart_isr_mask(UART_0))  // 串口0接收中断
    {
#if DEBUG_UART_USE_INTERRUPT        // 如果开启 debug 串口中断
        debug_interrupr_handler();  // 调用 debug 串口接收处理函数 数据会被 debug 环形缓冲区读取
#endif                              // 如果修改了 DEBUG_UART_INDEX 那这段代码需要放到对应的串口中断去
    }
    else  // 串口0发送中断
    {
    }
}

#include "chassisLink.h"    /* CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_* 码值 */
#include "zf_driver_gpio.h"

/*
 * 蜂鸣器单一所有者本体。详见 buzzer.h 顶注。
 *   BEEP_PIN 唯一写者：仅本文件 gpio_*。仲裁优先级为
 *   runaway > WARN > hardware-init-fault > event > ordinary pattern。
 *   节奏相位 rhythmTick 每 buzzerTick(500µs) 自增；短鸣脉宽复用 BEEP_TICKS_SHORT(100ms=200tick)。
 *   纯 cm_7_0 PIT 上下文（buzzerInit 在 ISR 启动前 processInit 调），状态单上下文，无需 volatile。
 *   解耦：不 include motorControl/loraNavControl——失控/事件态经 setter 注入，无反向依赖。
 */

/* 节奏周期（500µs/tick）。 */
#define BUZ_PERIOD_1HZ_TICKS   (2000u) /* 1Hz：每 1000ms 一次短鸣（起飞等待/爬高）*/
#define BUZ_PERIOD_3S_TICKS    (6000u) /* 3s：每 3000ms 一次短鸣（巡航）*/
#define BUZ_PERIOD_WARN_TICKS  (400u)  /* WARN：200ms 周期 50% 占空急促鸣（断联告警）*/
#define BUZ_PERIOD_ARMED_TICKS (4000u) /* armed-idle：每 2000ms 一次短鸣（模式3 已 arm 待 S3+S4 请求，桨在转警示）*/
#define BUZ_PERIOD_WAITING_TICKS (6000u) /* 等待连接：每 3000ms 一次短鸣（core2 WAIT_LINK 等 RS-485；与 3S 同节奏但上下文互斥）*/
#define BUZ_PERIOD_LORA_IDLE_TICKS (4000u) /* MODE4 本地 LoRa 兜底：每 2000ms 一声（0.5Hz，人耳可辨别） */
#define BUZ_LORA_IDLE_ON_TICKS   (300u)  /* LoRa 兜底响 150ms（比 SHORT 略长，舒缓提示而非急促告警）*/
#define BUZ_PERIOD_HW_FAIL_TICKS (10000u) /* 5s */
#define BUZ_HW_FAIL_GAP_TICKS    (400u)   /* 每声起点相隔200ms */

static uint8_t curCode;           /* 当前模式/命令码 */
static uint32_t rhythmTick;       /* 节奏相位（每拍自增）*/
static uint16_t eventRemainTicks; /* 一次性事件确认音剩余拍数（>0 覆盖 pattern）*/
static uint8_t runawayActive;     /* 失控锁定态（常鸣，最高优先）*/
static uint8_t hardwareInitFaultActive;

void buzzerInit(void)
{
    gpio_init(BEEP_PIN, GPO, GPIO_LOW, GPO_PUSH_PULL);
    curCode = CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT;
    rhythmTick = 0u;
    eventRemainTicks = 0u;
    runawayActive = 0u;
    hardwareInitFaultActive = 0u;
}

void buzzerSetPattern(uint8_t code)
{
    if (code != curCode)
    {
        curCode = code;
        rhythmTick = 0u; /* 码变化重置节奏相位，新模式从脉冲起点播放（短鸣即时触发）*/
    }
}

void buzzerBeepEvent(uint16_t durationTicks)
{
    /* 一次性事件确认音：置剩余拍数，buzzerTick 在 pattern 之上、runaway 之下播满时长。
     * 后到事件覆盖前一事件剩余（取新时长，与原 beepRemainTicks 直接赋值语义一致）。 */
    eventRemainTicks = durationTicks;
}

void buzzerSetRunaway(uint8_t active)
{
    runawayActive = active ? 1u : 0u;
}

void buzzerSetHardwareInitFault(uint8_t active)
{
    hardwareInitFaultActive = active ? 1u : 0u;
}

static uint8_t buzzerComputeHardwareFailOn(void)
{
    uint32_t phase = rhythmTick % BUZ_PERIOD_HW_FAIL_TICKS;
    if (phase >= 4u * BUZ_HW_FAIL_GAP_TICKS) return 0u;
    return ((phase % BUZ_HW_FAIL_GAP_TICKS) < BEEP_TICKS_SHORT) ? 1u : 0u;
}

/* 按当前码与节奏相位算"本拍是否鸣"（pattern 层）。 */
static uint8_t buzzerComputePatternOn(void)
{
    switch (curCode)
    {
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_1HZ:
            return ((rhythmTick % BUZ_PERIOD_1HZ_TICKS) < BEEP_TICKS_SHORT) ? 1u : 0u;
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_LONG:
            return 1u; /* 长鸣：码持续期间常鸣（sequencer 保持 LONG ~800ms 后转 3S）*/
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_3S:
            return ((rhythmTick % BUZ_PERIOD_3S_TICKS) < BEEP_TICKS_SHORT) ? 1u : 0u;
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_WARN:
            return ((rhythmTick % BUZ_PERIOD_WARN_TICKS) < (BUZ_PERIOD_WARN_TICKS / 2u)) ? 1u : 0u;
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_ARMED_IDLE:
            return ((rhythmTick % BUZ_PERIOD_ARMED_TICKS) < BEEP_TICKS_SHORT) ? 1u : 0u;
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_WAITING:
            return ((rhythmTick % BUZ_PERIOD_WAITING_TICKS) < BEEP_TICKS_SHORT) ? 1u : 0u;
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_LORA_IDLE:
            return ((rhythmTick % BUZ_PERIOD_LORA_IDLE_TICKS) < BUZ_LORA_IDLE_ON_TICKS) ? 1u : 0u;
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_HW_INIT_FAIL:
        {
            uint32_t phase = rhythmTick % BUZ_PERIOD_HW_FAIL_TICKS;
            if (phase >= 4u * BUZ_HW_FAIL_GAP_TICKS) return 0u;
            return ((phase % BUZ_HW_FAIL_GAP_TICKS) < BEEP_TICKS_SHORT) ? 1u : 0u;
        }
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_THREE_BEEPS:
            /* 三连短鸣(一次性)：码变化时 buzzerSetPattern 重置 rhythmTick=0，按绝对相位播 3 声后恒静默
             * （不取模）。每声 BEEP_TICKS_SHORT(100ms)，声起点间距 250ms（500 tick @500µs；即鸣 100ms + 静默 150ms）。
             * 码保持不变 rhythmTick续增但恒静默，不重播；Core0完整系统资格owner经链路下发
             * 约700ms码7窗口覆盖全程，Core2不从局部链路边沿猜测READY。 */
            if (rhythmTick < BEEP_TICKS_SHORT) return 1u;
            if (rhythmTick >= 500u && rhythmTick < (500u + BEEP_TICKS_SHORT)) return 1u;
            if (rhythmTick >= 1000u && rhythmTick < (1000u + BEEP_TICKS_SHORT)) return 1u;
            return 0u;
        case CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT:
        default:
            return 0u;
    }
}

void buzzerTick(void)
{
    uint8_t on;

    /* 节奏相位无条件推进，保时间准（即便本拍被 runaway/event 覆盖，恢复时相位不漂移）。 */
    rhythmTick++;

    /* 1. 失控锁定最高优先：常鸣（取代原 motorControlOutput 直写 gpio_high；仅复位经 buzzerInit 解锁）。 */
    if (runawayActive)
    {
        gpio_high(BEEP_PIN);
        return;
    }

    /* 2. 安全WARN高于本机故障和操作事件。 */
    if (curCode == CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_WARN)
    {
        on = buzzerComputePatternOn();
        if (on) gpio_high(BEEP_PIN); else gpio_low(BEEP_PIN);
        return;
    }

    /* 3. 本机初始化故障是独立请求，不能被普通pattern覆盖。 */
    if (hardwareInitFaultActive != 0u)
    {
        on = buzzerComputeHardwareFailOn();
        if (on) gpio_high(BEEP_PIN); else gpio_low(BEEP_PIN);
        return;
    }

    /* 4. 一次性事件确认音：高电平播满剩余时长，覆盖普通pattern。 */
    if (eventRemainTicks > 0u)
    {
        eventRemainTicks--;
        gpio_high(BEEP_PIN);
        return;
    }

    /* 5. 普通模式/命令码节奏。 */
    on = buzzerComputePatternOn();
    if (on)
    {
        gpio_high(BEEP_PIN);
    }
    else
    {
        gpio_low(BEEP_PIN);
    }
}

#ifndef _BUZZER_H_
#define _BUZZER_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core2 蜂鸣器单一所有者库（代飞机鸣叫——无人机无蜂鸣器，借车载 BEEP_PIN=P07_2）。
 *   本模块是 BEEP_PIN 的唯一写者：仅此处 gpio_init/gpio_high/gpio_low。其余模块（loraNavControl
 *   事件确认音、motorControl 失控锁定、core0Loop 模式/命令码）只经下方 API 提交"请求"，绝不直写 BEEP，
 *   消除原先三模块各自直写 + 依赖调用顺序的隐式仲裁与冗余双写竞态。
 *
 *   显式优先级仲裁器（buzzerTick 内单点判定，每拍恰写一次）：
 *     1. runaway（失控锁定，buzzerSetRunaway）：常鸣，最高优先（覆盖一切）。
 *     2. WARN：必需链路/缓降急促告警，不能被操作确认音覆盖。
 *     3. HW_INIT_FAIL：Core2本地显示初始化故障节奏。
 *     4. event：被高优先级覆盖时暂停剩余时长，解除后续播。
 *     5. 其它pattern。
 *   无 runaway/event 且 pattern=SILENT → gpio_low（静默）。
 *
 *   pattern 码值 = CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_*（SILENT/1HZ/LONG/3S/WARN/ARMED_IDLE/WAITING/THREE_BEEPS，
 *   core0 takeoffSequencer 产 → core1 中转 RS-485 sysByte → core2 播放）+ core2 本地扩展码
 *   LORA_IDLE(=8，超 sysByte 3-bit，仅 MODE4 本地置、不经传输)。
 *
 *   调用约定（不变量）：所有 API 仅在 cm_7_0 PIT 上下文（pitProcess0 / loraNavControlPit500us）调用，
 *   单上下文 → 内部状态无需 volatile。buzzerInit 在 processInit（ISR 启动前）调，恰一次。
 *   buzzerTick 每 500µs 调恰一次（PRODUCTION 与 TUNE 均调，使失控常鸣两态都生效）。
 */

void buzzerInit(void);                     /* 初始化 BEEP GPIO（唯一所有者）并复位仲裁状态 */
void buzzerSetPattern(uint8_t code);       /* 设模式/命令码(CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_*)；码变化即重置节奏相位 */
void buzzerBeepEvent(uint16_t durationTicks); /* 请求一次性事件确认音 N 拍（覆盖 pattern；500µs/拍）*/
void buzzerSetRunaway(uint8_t active);     /* 设失控锁定态（传 motorControlIsRunawayLatched()）：常鸣最高优先 */
void buzzerSetHardwareInitFault(uint8_t active); /* 独立本机故障请求，不与WARN共用pattern码 */
void buzzerTick(void);                     /* 500µs：优先级仲裁后写 BEEP_PIN 恰一次（唯一写者）*/

#define CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_HW_INIT_FAIL (9u)

#endif /* _BUZZER_H_ */

#include "chassisMenu.h"
#include "chassisMenuInternal.h"

#include "chassisLink.h"  /* chassisLinkIsAlive：WAIT_RS485 门控(A8) */
#include "core0Loop.h"    /* runtime snapshot：模式4结束等待(A8) */
#include "configCore2Build.h"
#include "motorControl.h" /* 失控锁定查询/人工解锁（HOME K5 长按）*/
#include "paramSyncOwnerService.h"
#include "menuKey.h"
#include "lightStrip.h"  /* 待发车页亮度快调 lightStripSetBrightness + 步长/钳位宏 */
#include "commonDef.h"   /* range 钳位 */
#include "zf_device_ips114.h"

/* ============================================================
 * 共享状态唯一定义点（chassisMenuInternal.h 中 extern）
 * ============================================================ */
chassisMenuContextStruct chassisMenuContext = {.state = CHASSIS_MENU_HOME};
static uint8_t paramLockWasActive;
static void localFlashFeedback(uint8_t action, uint8_t success);

/* ============================================================
 * 生命周期
 * ============================================================ */
void chassisMenuInit(void)
{
    chassisMenuBuildPages();

    ips114_set_dir(CORE2_IPS114_DISPLAY_DIR);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_init();
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_clear();

    /* 上电先进等待 RS-485 态：未连 core1 且未进模式4 时停在等待屏，不进菜单(A8，仿 core1 WAIT_LINK)。 */
    chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_WAIT_RS485;
    chassisPageIdx = 0;
    chassisOptIdx = 0;
    chassisScrollTop = 0u;
    chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
