    chassisFeedbackHoldTicks = 0u;
    feedbackWasActive = 0u;
    chassisSurfaceResetPending = 0u;
    chassisFeedbackRenderPending = 0u;
    chassisFeedbackColor = RGB565_BLACK;
    chassisFeedbackAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
    chassisFeedbackSlot = 0u;
    chassisParamSlotInspectPending = 0u;
    chassisParamGlobalLastEvent = 0u;
    chassisBrightnessSaveDelayMs = 0u;
    chassisBrightnessSavePending = 0u;
    chassisFlashActionPending = CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_NONE;
    chassisInitFailedMask = 0u;
    chassisInitUnverifiedMask = 0u;
    chassisInitSummaryMs = 0u;
    chassisInitSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFu;
    chassisParamSlotSelection = 1.0f;
    paramLockWasActive = 0u;
}

/* ISR 1ms：按键扫描 + 填充反馈倒计时（轻量，不触屏） */
void chassisMenuPitTick(void)
{
    menuKeyScan();
    if (chassisFeedbackHoldTicks > 0u) chassisFeedbackHoldTicks--;
    if (chassisInitSummaryMs > 0u) chassisInitSummaryMs--;
    if (chassisBrightnessSaveDelayMs > 0u) chassisBrightnessSaveDelayMs--;
}

/* 输入阶段只请求surface切换，实际清屏统一留给渲染阶段。 */
static void requestSurfaceReset(void)
{
    chassisSurfaceResetPending = 1u;
    chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
    chassisDirtyMask |= CHASSIS_MENU_DIRTY_SURFACE;
}

static void cancelPendingBrightnessSave(void)
{
    chassisBrightnessSavePending = 0u;
    chassisBrightnessSaveDelayMs = 0u;
}

static void requestSettingsSave(void)
{
    cancelPendingBrightnessSave();
    chassisFlashActionPending = CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_SAVE;
}

static void requestSettingsClear(void)
{
    cancelPendingBrightnessSave();
    chassisFlashActionPending = CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_CLEAR;
}

static void serviceBrightnessSave(void)
{
    if (core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return;
    if ((chassisBrightnessSavePending != 0u) &&
        (chassisBrightnessSaveDelayMs == 0u))
    {
        chassisBrightnessSavePending = 0u;
        if (core2RuntimeRequestSave() == 0u)
        {
            chassisBrightnessSavePending = 1u;
            chassisBrightnessSaveDelayMs = 100u;
        }
    }
}

static void serviceFlashAction(void)
{
    uint8_t action = chassisFlashActionPending;
    uint8_t success;
    if (core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return;
    if (action == CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_CLEAR_WAIT)
    {
        if (core2RuntimeParamsApplied() != 0u)
        {
            chassisFlashActionPending = CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_NONE;
            localFlashFeedback(CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_CLEAR, 1u);
        }
        return;
    }
    chassisFlashActionPending = CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_NONE;
    if (action == CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_SAVE)
    {
        success = chassisMenuSaveSettings();
        localFlashFeedback(action, success);
    }
    else if (action == CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_CLEAR)
    {
        success = chassisMenuClearFlash();
        if (success == 0u)
            localFlashFeedback(action, 0u);
        else if (core2RuntimeParamsApplied() != 0u)
            localFlashFeedback(action, 1u);
        else
            chassisFlashActionPending = CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_CLEAR_WAIT;
    }
}

/* ============================================================
 * 按键消费 + 滚动维护（仿 core0 menuInput）
 * ============================================================ */
static uint8_t keyHit(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (menuKeyGetState(k) == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(k);
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t keyLong(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (menuKeyGetState(k) == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS)
    {
        menuKeyClear(k);
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

/* 环形循环 + 滚动窗口维护，使选中项始终可见（仿 core0 clampSelAndScroll） */
static void clampSelAndScroll(int8_t* sel, uint8_t count)
{
    if (count == 0u) { *sel = 0; chassisScrollTop = 0u; return; }
    if (*sel < 0) *sel = (int8_t) (count - 1u);
    else if (*sel >= (int8_t) count) *sel = 0;

    if ((uint8_t) *sel < chassisScrollTop)
        chassisScrollTop = (uint8_t) *sel;
    else if ((uint8_t) *sel >= (uint8_t) (chassisScrollTop + VISIBLE_ROWS))
        chassisScrollTop = (uint8_t) ((uint8_t) *sel - VISIBLE_ROWS + 1u);
}

static void enterChassisPageList(uint8_t resetSelection)
{
    chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_PAGE_LIST;
    if (resetSelection)
    {
        chassisPageIdx = 0;
        chassisScrollTop = 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        chassisScrollTop = 0u;
        clampSelAndScroll(&chassisPageIdx, chassisMenuPageCount);
    }
    requestSurfaceReset();
}

static void enterChassisOptionList(void)
{
    if (chassisPageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) chassisPageIdx >= chassisMenuPageCount
        || chassisMenuPages[chassisPageIdx].optionCount == 0u)
    {
        chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
        return;
    }
    chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST;
    chassisOptIdx = 0;
    chassisScrollTop = 0u;
    if ((uint8_t) chassisPageIdx == chassisParamSlotsPageIndex)
        chassisParamSlotInspectPending = 1u;
    requestSurfaceReset();
}

static uint8_t currentOptionIsValid(const chassisMenuPageStruct* page)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if (page == 0 || chassisOptIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) chassisOptIdx >= page->optionCount) return 0u;
    i = (uint8_t) chassisOptIdx;
    return (uint8_t) (page->opt[i] != 0);
}

/* 填充反馈：整屏色 + 倒计时（保存绿/恢复红） */
static void flashFeedback(uint16_t color)
{
    chassisFeedbackColor = color;
    chassisFeedbackAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
    chassisFeedbackSlot = 0u;
    chassisFeedbackRenderPending = 1u;
    chassisFeedbackHoldTicks = CHASSIS_MENU_FEEDBACK_HOLD_TICKS;
    chassisDirtyMask |= CHASSIS_MENU_DIRTY_FEEDBACK;
}

static void localFlashFeedback(uint8_t action, uint8_t success)
{
    chassisFeedbackColor = success ?
        ((action == CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_SAVE) ?
            RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED) : RGB565_YELLOW;
    chassisFeedbackAction = (action == CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_SAVE) ?
        CHASSIS_MENU_FEEDBACK_LOCAL_SAVE :
        CHASSIS_MENU_FEEDBACK_LOCAL_RESET;
    chassisFeedbackSlot = success;
    chassisFeedbackRenderPending = 1u;
    chassisFeedbackHoldTicks = CHASSIS_MENU_FEEDBACK_HOLD_TICKS;
    chassisDirtyMask |= CHASSIS_MENU_DIRTY_FEEDBACK;
}

static void paramFeedback(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    chassisFeedbackColor = (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ?
        RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED;
    chassisFeedbackAction = action;
    chassisFeedbackSlot = slot;
    chassisFeedbackRenderPending = 1u;
    chassisFeedbackHoldTicks = CHASSIS_MENU_FEEDBACK_HOLD_TICKS;
    chassisDirtyMask |= CHASSIS_MENU_DIRTY_FEEDBACK;
}

/* 待发车页(WAIT/HOME)快调灯条亮度：立即热应用，最后一次变化500ms后合并落盘。 */
static void chassisMenuAdjustBrightness(int8_t deltaPct)
{
    float prev = chassisMenuWorkingParams.lightStripBrightness;
    float b = range(prev + (float) deltaPct,
                    (float) LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MIN, (float) LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MAX);
    if (b == prev) return; /* 已在上/下限、值未变 → 不重复写 flash（限位处连按防磨损；值为 10 的整数倍，浮点等值比较安全）*/
    chassisMenuWorkingParams.lightStripBrightness = b;
    (void) core2RuntimeSubmitParams(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    chassisParamsGetActive(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    chassisBrightnessSavePending = 1u;
    chassisBrightnessSaveDelayMs = LIGHT_STRIP_SAVE_DELAY_MS;
    chassisDirtyMask |= CHASSIS_MENU_DIRTY_HOME_BRIGHTNESS;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 各状态按键 handler
 * ============================================================ */
static void handleHomeKeys(void)
{
    if (core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t key;
        if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_4)) enterChassisPageList(1u);
        for (key = 0u; key < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; key++)
            menuKeyClear((menuKeyIndexEnum) key);
        return;
    }
    /* 新键位(codex 复核点1)：K4 进菜单(对齐页列表/选项列表 K4=进入)；K1 短=保存 / 长=擦flash+热重载默认。
     * K2−/K3+ 灯条亮度；K5 短保存、长按人工清失控锁定。 */
    if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_4))
    {
        enterChassisPageList(1u);
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_2)) { chassisMenuAdjustBrightness(-(int8_t) LIGHT_STRIP_STEP_COARSE); } /* 亮度 −10% */
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_3)) { chassisMenuAdjustBrightness(+(int8_t) LIGHT_STRIP_STEP_COARSE); } /* 亮度 +10% */
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_1)) { requestSettingsSave(); }  /* K1 短=保存 */
    else if (keyLong(MENU_KEY_1))
    {
        requestSettingsClear();
    } /* K1 长=擦flash+热重载默认 */
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_5)) { requestSettingsSave(); }  /* K5 短=保存(冗余) */
    else if (keyLong(MENU_KEY_5))
    {
        /* K5 长=失控锁定时人工解锁（免断电恢复重新发车）；未锁定则无操作。解锁后由发车门控正常受控。 */
        if (motorControlIsRunawayLatched())
        {
            motorControlClearRunaway();
            flashFeedback(RGB565_YELLOW);
        }
    }
}

static void handlePageListKeys(void)
{
    if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_4))
    {
        enterChassisOptionList();
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_2))
    {
        chassisPageIdx--;
        clampSelAndScroll(&chassisPageIdx, chassisMenuPageCount);
        chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_3))
    {
        chassisPageIdx++;
        clampSelAndScroll(&chassisPageIdx, chassisMenuPageCount);
        chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_1))
    {
        chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_HOME;
        requestSurfaceReset();
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_5))
    {
        if (core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u)
        {
            requestSettingsSave();
            chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_HOME;
        }
    }
}

static void handleOptionListKeys(void)
{
    const chassisMenuPageStruct* page;
    if (chassisPageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) chassisPageIdx >= chassisMenuPageCount)
    {
        enterChassisPageList(0u);
        return;
    }
    page = &chassisMenuPages[chassisPageIdx];

    if ((uint8_t) chassisPageIdx == chassisParamSlotsPageIndex)
    {
        uint8_t slot = (uint8_t) chassisParamSlotSelection;
        if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_5))
        {
            enterChassisPageList(0u);
        }
        else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_2))
        {
            chassisParamSlotSelection = (float) ((slot > 1u) ? slot - 1u : 5u);
            chassisParamSlotInspectPending = 1u;
            chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
        }
        else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_3))
        {
            chassisParamSlotSelection = (float) ((slot < 5u) ? slot + 1u : 1u);
            chassisParamSlotInspectPending = 1u;
            chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
        }
        else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_4))
        {
            core2ParamGlobalUiSnapshot ui;
            uint8_t ok = 0u;
            core2RuntimeGetParamGlobalUi(&ui);
            if (chassisParamSlotInspectPending == 0u &&
                ui.state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS &&
                ui.action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY &&
                ui.slot == slot &&
                ui.slotUiState == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL)
            {
                ok = core2RuntimeRequestGlobalParamAction(
                    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME, slot);
            }
            (void) ok;
            chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
        }
        else if (keyLong(MENU_KEY_1))
        {
            uint8_t ok = core2RuntimeRequestGlobalParamAction(
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY, slot);
            (void) ok;
            chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_4))
    {
        if (core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u &&
            currentOptionIsValid(page))
        {
            chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_EDIT;
            chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_2))
    {
        chassisOptIdx--;
        clampSelAndScroll(&chassisOptIdx, page->optionCount);
        chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_3))
    {
        chassisOptIdx++;
        clampSelAndScroll(&chassisOptIdx, page->optionCount);
        chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_1))
    {
        enterChassisPageList(0u);
    }
    else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_5))
    {
        if (core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u)
        {
            requestSettingsSave();
            chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_HOME;
        }
    }
}

static void handleEditKeys(void)
{
    const chassisMenuPageStruct* page;
    uint8_t i;
    if (chassisPageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) chassisPageIdx >= chassisMenuPageCount)
    {
        enterChassisPageList(0u);
        return;
    }
    page = &chassisMenuPages[chassisPageIdx];
    if (chassisOptIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) chassisOptIdx >= page->optionCount)
    {
        chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        requestSurfaceReset();
        return;
    }
    i = (uint8_t) chassisOptIdx;
    if (!currentOptionIsValid(page))
    {
        chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        requestSurfaceReset();
        return;
    }

    if (core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        requestSurfaceReset();
        return;
    }

    if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_5))
    {
        chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        requestSurfaceReset();
        return;
    }

    /* 浮点项：core2 菜单按物理方向镜像，K4 +大 K3 +小 K2 -小 K1 -大。 */
    {
        float delta = 0.0f;
        uint8_t hasDelta = 0u;
        if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_4)) { delta = page->stepL[i]; hasDelta = 1u; }
        else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_3)) { delta = page->stepS[i]; hasDelta = 1u; }
        else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_2)) { delta = -page->stepS[i]; hasDelta = 1u; }
        else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_1)) { delta = -page->stepL[i]; hasDelta = 1u; }

        if (hasDelta && page->opt[i] != 0)
        {
            *page->opt[i] += delta;
            chassisMenuApplyAfterEdit();
            chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
        }
    }
}

/* 前台输入阶段只消费按键和推进页面状态，不触碰IPS114或Flash。 */
void chassisMenuInputTick(void)
{
    uint8_t k;
    uint8_t paramLocked;
    core2RuntimeSnapshotStruct runtimeSnapshot;
    core2ParamGlobalUiSnapshot paramUi;

    core2RuntimeGetSnapshot(&runtimeSnapshot);
    core2RuntimeGetParamGlobalUi(&paramUi);

    if (paramUi.eventSequence != 0u &&
        paramUi.eventSequence != chassisParamGlobalLastEvent)
    {
        chassisParamGlobalLastEvent = paramUi.eventSequence;
        if (paramUi.state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS &&
            (paramUi.action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY ||
             paramUi.action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME))
        {
            paramFeedback(paramUi.action, paramUi.slot);
            chassisParamSlotInspectPending = 1u;
        }
        chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
    }

    paramLocked = core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked();
    if (paramLocked != paramLockWasActive)
    {
        for (k = 0u; k < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; k++)
            menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease((menuKeyIndexEnum) k);
        if (paramLocked != 0u)
        {
            uint8_t cancelledAction = chassisFlashActionPending;
            cancelPendingBrightnessSave();
            if (chassisFlashActionPending !=
                CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_CLEAR_WAIT)
                chassisFlashActionPending = CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_NONE;
            if (cancelledAction == CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_SAVE ||
                cancelledAction == CHASSIS_MENU_FLASH_ACTION_CLEAR)
                localFlashFeedback(cancelledAction, 0u);
        }
        paramLockWasActive = paramLocked;
    }
    if (paramLocked == 0u && chassisMenuSyncWorkingCopy() != 0u)
        chassisForceRedraw = 1u;

    if (chassisInitSummaryMs > 0u)
    {
        goto input_done;
    }
    if (chassisInitSummaryLastSecond != 0xFFu)
    {
        chassisInitSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFu;
        requestSurfaceReset();
    }

    /* 上电等待 RS-485 门控（A8，仿 core1 WAIT_LINK→HOME）：RS-485 未活且未进模式4 → 停在等待屏、
     * 吞按键不进菜单；链路活(core1 已连) 或 进模式4(失链兜底, 车本地可用) → 迁 HOME。 */
    if (chassisMenuState == CHASSIS_MENU_WAIT_RS485)
    {
        /* 放行亮度键(K2−/K3+，500ms合并存flash)，其余键吞掉(不进调参菜单) */
        if (paramLocked == 0u)
        {
            if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_2)) chassisMenuAdjustBrightness(-(int8_t) LIGHT_STRIP_STEP_COARSE);
            else if (keyHit(MENU_KEY_3)) chassisMenuAdjustBrightness(+(int8_t) LIGHT_STRIP_STEP_COARSE);
        }
        for (k = 0u; k < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; k++) menuKeyClear((menuKeyIndexEnum) k);
        /* 阻塞等 core0+core1 全链路：core1(RS-485 活) && core0(经 core1 转告 cmd bit4) 都活 → 进 HOME；
         * 或 MODE4 兜底(RS-485 失链>2s 进本地 LoRa 独立)。否则停等待屏、显示等待对象(仿 core1)。 */
        if ((chassisLinkIsAlive() && chassisLinkGetCore0Alive()) || runtimeSnapshot.standalone)
        {
            chassisMenuState = CHASSIS_MENU_HOME;
            requestSurfaceReset();
        }
        goto input_done;
    }

    /* 填充反馈保持期：吞按键 + 维持填充，不渲染 */
    if (chassisFeedbackHoldTicks > 0u)
    {
        feedbackWasActive = 1u;
        for (k = 0u; k < (uint8_t) MENU_KEY_COUNT; k++)
            menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease((menuKeyIndexEnum) k);
        goto input_done;
    }
    if (feedbackWasActive)
    {
        feedbackWasActive = 0u;
        chassisFeedbackRenderPending = 0u;
        requestSurfaceReset();
    }

    if (chassisParamSlotInspectPending != 0u &&
        chassisFeedbackHoldTicks == 0u &&
        core2RuntimeRequestGlobalParamAction(
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY,
            (uint8_t) chassisParamSlotSelection) != 0u)
        chassisParamSlotInspectPending = 0u;

    /* 按键状态机（每轮跑，响应及时） */
    switch (chassisMenuState)
    {
        case CHASSIS_MENU_HOME:        handleHomeKeys(); break;
        case CHASSIS_MENU_PAGE_LIST:   handlePageListKeys(); break;
        case CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST: handleOptionListKeys(); break;
        case CHASSIS_MENU_EDIT:        handleEditKeys(); break;
        default: break;
    }

    if (chassisFeedbackHoldTicks > 0u)
    {
        feedbackWasActive = 1u;
        goto input_done;
    }

input_done:
    return;
}

void chassisMenuServiceDeferred(void)
{
    serviceFlashAction();
    serviceBrightnessSave();
}

/* 前台渲染阶段：集中执行清屏/整屏反馈和dirty渲染。 */
void chassisMenuRenderTick(uint8_t displayDue)
{
    if (displayDue != 0u) chassisDirtyMask |= CHASSIS_MENU_DIRTY_HOME_FACTS;
    if (chassisInitSummaryMs > 0u)
    {
        uint8_t second = (uint8_t) ((chassisInitSummaryMs + 999u) / 1000u);
        if ((second != chassisInitSummaryLastSecond) || chassisForceRedraw)
        {
            chassisRenderInitFaultSummary(chassisInitFailedMask,
                chassisInitUnverifiedMask, second);
            chassisInitSummaryLastSecond = second;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (chassisFeedbackHoldTicks > 0u)
    {
        if (chassisFeedbackRenderPending != 0u)
        {
            ips114_full(chassisFeedbackColor);
            if (chassisFeedbackAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY ||
                chassisFeedbackAction == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME)
            {
                char slotText[16];
                ips114_set_color((chassisFeedbackColor == RGB565_GREEN) ?
                    RGB565_BLACK : RGB565_WHITE, chassisFeedbackColor);
                ips114_show_string(80u, 42u,
                    (chassisFeedbackAction ==
                        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ?
                        "SAVE OK" : "LOAD OK");
                (void) snprintf(slotText, sizeof(slotText), "SLOT %u",
                    (unsigned) chassisFeedbackSlot);
                ips114_show_string(88u, 66u, slotText);
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
            }
            else if (chassisFeedbackAction == CHASSIS_MENU_FEEDBACK_LOCAL_SAVE ||
                     chassisFeedbackAction == CHASSIS_MENU_FEEDBACK_LOCAL_RESET)
            {
                const char *text = (chassisFeedbackAction ==
                    CHASSIS_MENU_FEEDBACK_LOCAL_SAVE) ?
                    (chassisFeedbackSlot ? "SAVE OK" : "SAVE FAIL") :
                    (chassisFeedbackSlot ? "RESET OK" : "RESET FAIL");
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_BLACK, chassisFeedbackColor);
                ips114_show_string(72u, 50u, text);
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
            }
            chassisFeedbackAction = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE;
            chassisFeedbackSlot = 0u;
            chassisFeedbackRenderPending = 0u;
        }
        return;
    }

    if (chassisSurfaceResetPending != 0u)
    {
        chassisSurfaceResetPending = 0u;
        chassisMenuClearScreen();
    }

    if (chassisMenuState == CHASSIS_MENU_WAIT_RS485)
    {
        if (displayDue || chassisForceRedraw) chassisRenderWaitRs485();
        chassisDirtyMask = 0u;
        return;
    }

    /* 渲染节流：仅 20ms 到点、事件dirty或强制重绘才画（防闪烁机制②）。
     * HOME 态实时刷新底盘速度，故 displayDue 即画；其余态靠 forceRedraw + 内部变化检测。 */
    if (!displayDue && !chassisForceRedraw && (chassisDirtyMask == 0u)) return;

    switch (chassisMenuState)
    {
        case CHASSIS_MENU_HOME:        chassisRenderHome(); break;
        case CHASSIS_MENU_PAGE_LIST:   chassisRenderPageList(); break;
        case CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST: chassisRenderOptionList(0u); break;
        case CHASSIS_MENU_EDIT:        chassisRenderOptionList(1u); break;
        default: break;
    }
    chassisDirtyMask = 0u;
}

void chassisMenuSetInitHealth(uint8_t failedMask, uint8_t unverifiedMask)
{
    chassisInitFailedMask = failedMask;
    chassisInitUnverifiedMask = unverifiedMask;
    if ((failedMask | unverifiedMask) != 0u)
    {
        chassisInitSummaryMs = 3000u;
        chassisInitSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFu;
        chassisForceRedraw = 1u;
    }
}

#include "chassisMenuInternal.h"

#include "chassisParams.h"

/* ---- 页表构建 helpers ---- */
static chassisMenuPageStruct* curPage = 0;

static void addPage(const char* name)
{
    if (chassisMenuPageCount >= CHASSIS_MENU_MAX_PAGES) { curPage = 0; return; }
    curPage = &chassisMenuPages[chassisMenuPageCount];
    chassisMenuPageCount++;
    curPage->name = name;
    curPage->optionCount = 0u;
}

/* 浮点项：working copy 值指针 + 小/大步长。重建分类由 runtime 对参数差异自行判定。 */
static void addFloat(const char* name, float* val, float stepS, float stepL)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if (curPage == 0) return;
    i = curPage->optionCount;
    if (i >= CHASSIS_MENU_MAX_OPTIONS) return;
    curPage->optName[i] = name;
    curPage->opt[i] = val;
    curPage->stepS[i] = stepS;
    curPage->stepL[i] = stepL;
    curPage->optionCount++;
}

static void addWheelPidPage(
    const char* name,
    chassisPidGainStruct* speedGain,
    chassisPidGainStruct* currentGain)
{
    addPage(name);
    addFloat("Spd Kp", &speedGain->kp, 0.5f, 5.0f);
    addFloat("Spd Ki", &speedGain->ki, 0.002f, 0.01f);
    addFloat("Spd Kd", &speedGain->kd, 0.05f, 0.5f);
    addFloat("Cur Kp", &currentGain->kp, 0.0001f, 0.001f);
    addFloat("Cur Ki", &currentGain->ki, 0.00005f, 0.0005f);
    addFloat("Cur Kd", &currentGain->kd, 0.0001f, 0.001f);
}

void chassisMenuBuildPages(void)
{
    chassisParamsGetActive(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    chassisMenuWorkingRevision = chassisParamsGetRevision();
    chassisMenuPageCount = 0u;
    curPage = 0;

    /* 按轮分页：每页一个轮的全部 PID（速度 kp/ki/kd + 电流 kp/ki/kd）。runtime 自动判定需安全重建。
     * 速度/电流环现均四轮独立（chassisParams 的 speedXx 与 currentXx 各四组）；四轮共享积分钳位归 Common 页。 */
    addWheelPidPage("FL Wheel", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.speedFl, &chassisMenuWorkingParams.currentFl);
    addWheelPidPage("FR Wheel", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.speedFr, &chassisMenuWorkingParams.currentFr);
    addWheelPidPage("BL Wheel", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.speedBl, &chassisMenuWorkingParams.currentBl);
    addWheelPidPage("BR Wheel", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.speedBr, &chassisMenuWorkingParams.currentBr);

    /* 公共页：四轮共享的积分钳位；runtime 自动在安全态重建 PID 应用新钳位。 */
    addPage("Common");
    addFloat("Spd Imax", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.speedIntegralMax, 10.0f, 100.0f);
    addFloat("Cur Imax", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.currentIntegralMax, 10.0f, 100.0f);

    /* 角速度环 PID */
    addPage("Yaw Rate");
    addFloat("Yaw Kp", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.yawRate.kp, 0.1f, 1.0f);
    addFloat("Yaw Ki", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.yawRate.ki, 0.01f, 0.1f);
    addFloat("Yaw Kd", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.yawRate.kd, 0.01f, 0.1f);
    addFloat("Yaw Imax", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.yawRateIntegralMax, 0.5f, 5.0f);
    addFloat("Yaw OutLim", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.yawRateOutputLimit, 1.0f, 5.0f);

    addPage("Heading");
    addFloat("Heading Kp", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.headingKp, 0.1f, 1.0f);
    addFloat("Heading Wlim", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.headingRateLimit, 0.1f, 0.5f);

    /* LoRa 映射（runtime 同次提交热生效；V Max 单位 m/s，同时是摇杆满量程和 LoRa 模式限速） */
    addPage("LoRa Map");
    addFloat("V Max", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.loraVMaxMps, 0.05f, 0.2f);
    addFloat("Wz Max", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.loraWzMaxRadps, 0.1f, 0.5f);
    addFloat("Deadzone", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.loraStickDeadzone, 5.0f, 20.0f);

    /* 导航 */
    addPage("Navigation");
    addFloat("NavCorrKp", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.navCorrectionKp, 0.01f, 0.1f);
    addFloat("NavCorrLim", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.navCorrectionLimit, 0.5f, 2.0f);
    addFloat("NavErrLim", &chassisMenuWorkingParams.navErrorLimitPulses, 50.0f, 200.0f);

    chassisParamSlotsPageIndex = chassisMenuPageCount;
    chassisParamSlotSelection = 1.0f;
    addPage("Param Slots");
    addFloat("Slot", &chassisParamSlotSelection, 1.0f, 1.0f);

}

uint8_t chassisMenuSyncWorkingCopy(void)
{
    uint32_t revision = chassisParamsGetRevision();
    if (revision == 0u || revision == chassisMenuWorkingRevision) return 0u;
    chassisParamsGetActive(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    chassisMenuWorkingRevision = revision;
    return 1u;
}

/* 编辑后只提交一次完整 working copy；runtime 自行判定动态热生效或安全态重建。 */
void chassisMenuApplyAfterEdit(void)
{
    chassisParamsSanitize(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    (void) core2RuntimeSubmitParams(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    chassisParamsGetActive(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    chassisMenuWorkingRevision = chassisParamsGetRevision();
}

uint8_t chassisMenuSaveSettings(void)
{
    chassisParamsGetActive(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    chassisMenuWorkingRevision = chassisParamsGetRevision();
    return core2RuntimeRequestSave();
}

/* runtime 写入源码默认值并热应用（HOME K1 长按）；库槽保持不变。 */
uint8_t chassisMenuClearFlash(void)
{
    uint8_t ok = core2RuntimeRequestFactoryReset();
    chassisParamsGetActive(&chassisMenuWorkingParams);
    chassisMenuWorkingRevision = chassisParamsGetRevision();
    return ok;
}

/* ============================================================
 * 防闪烁机制（仿 core0 menuRender，硬要求）：
 *   ① 静态元素首帧绘制 + 变化检测（lastXxx 标记，不变跳过重绘）
 *   ② 刷新节流（chassisMenuRenderTick 用 displayDue gate）
 *   ③ 局部刷新 + 定宽覆盖（行清只覆盖内框内容区，不擦滚动条/外框；EDIT 值变只重绘当前值）
 *   ④ 切状态才 ips114_clear（chassisMenuClearScreen）
 * ============================================================ */

/* 上次渲染快照（变化检测，避免无变化重绘 → 防闪烁核心） */
static chassisMenuStateEnum lastState = (chassisMenuStateEnum) 0xFF;

#define HOME_TEXT_COLUMNS (13u)
#define HOME_LEFT_VALUE_X (38u)
#define HOME_RIGHT_VALUE_X (158u)
#define HOME_TILE_MAX_WIDTH (96u)
#define HOME_TILE_MAX_HEIGHT (12u)
#define SOLID_FILL_BUFFER_PIXELS (240u)
static uint16_t homeTileBuffer[HOME_TILE_MAX_WIDTH * HOME_TILE_MAX_HEIGHT];
static uint16_t solidFillBuffer[SOLID_FILL_BUFFER_PIXELS];

static void fillSolidRect(uint16_t left, uint16_t top,
    uint16_t width, uint16_t height, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t rowsPerTransfer;
    uint16_t rows;
    uint16_t y = top;
    uint16_t i;

    if ((width == 0u) || (height == 0u) || (width > SOLID_FILL_BUFFER_PIXELS)) return;
    rowsPerTransfer = (uint16_t) (SOLID_FILL_BUFFER_PIXELS / width);
    if (rowsPerTransfer == 0u) rowsPerTransfer = 1u;
    for (i = 0u; i < SOLID_FILL_BUFFER_PIXELS; i++) solidFillBuffer[i] = color;
    while (height > 0u)
    {
        rows = (height < rowsPerTransfer) ? height : rowsPerTransfer;
        ips114_show_rgb565_image(left, y, solidFillBuffer,
            width, rows, width, rows, 0u);
        y = (uint16_t) (y + rows);
        height = (uint16_t) (height - rows);
    }
}

static void clearPixelRect(uint16_t left, uint16_t top,
    uint16_t right, uint16_t bottom, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t width = (uint16_t) (right - left + 1u);
    uint16_t height = (uint16_t) (bottom - top + 1u);
    uint32_t count = (uint32_t) width * height;
    uint32_t i;

    if ((width > HOME_TILE_MAX_WIDTH) || (height > HOME_TILE_MAX_HEIGHT)) return;
    for (i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        homeTileBuffer[i] = color;
    }
    ips114_show_rgb565_image(left, top, homeTileBuffer,
        width, height, width, height, 0u);
}

static void drawHomeTextSlot(uint8_t slot, uint16_t x, uint16_t y,
    const char *value, uint16_t color)
{
    char padded[HOME_TEXT_COLUMNS + 1u];
    uint8_t i = 0u;

    if ((slot >= 8u) || (value == 0)) return;
    if ((strcmp(homeTextCache[slot], value) == 0) &&
        (homeTextColor[slot] == color)) return;

    memset(padded, ' ', HOME_TEXT_COLUMNS);
    while ((i < HOME_TEXT_COLUMNS) && (value[i] != '\0'))
    {
        padded[i] = value[i];
        i++;
    }
    padded[HOME_TEXT_COLUMNS] = '\0';
    ips114_set_color(color, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_show_string(x, y, padded);
    strncpy(homeTextCache[slot], value, HOME_TEXT_COLUMNS);
    homeTextCache[slot][HOME_TEXT_COLUMNS] = '\0';
    homeTextColor[slot] = color;
}

static int32_t quantizeTenth(float value)
{
    float scaled = value * 10.0f;
    return (int32_t) ((scaled >= 0.0f) ? (scaled + 0.5f) : (scaled - 0.5f));
}

static void drawHomeNumberSlot(uint8_t slot, uint16_t x, uint16_t y,
    float value, uint8_t valid, uint16_t color)
{
    int32_t quantized;
    if (slot >= 6u) return;
    quantized = (valid != 0u) ? quantizeTenth(value) : INT32_MIN;
    if ((homeNumberCache[slot] == quantized) &&
        (homeNumberColor[slot] == color)) return;

    clearPixelRect(x, y, (uint16_t) (x + 77u), (uint16_t) (y + 7u), RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_set_color(color, RGB565_BLACK);
    if (valid != 0u)
    {
        ips114_show_float(x, y, (double) value, 4u, 1u);
    }
    else
    {
        ips114_show_string(x, y, "--");
    }
    homeNumberCache[slot] = quantized;
    homeNumberColor[slot] = color;
}

static void drawHomeFooter(const char *text, uint16_t color)
{
    char padded[40];
    uint8_t i = 0u;
    if (text == 0) return;
    if ((strcmp(homeFooterCache, text) == 0) && (homeFooterColor == color)) return;
    memset(padded, ' ', 39u);
    while ((i < 39u) && (text[i] != '\0'))
    {
        padded[i] = text[i];
        i++;
    }
    padded[39] = '\0';
    ips114_set_color(color, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_show_string(2u, 122u, padded);
    strncpy(homeFooterCache, text, 39u);
    homeFooterCache[39] = '\0';
    homeFooterColor = color;
}

static void drawBrightnessBar(uint8_t brightness)
{
    uint8_t filled;
    uint8_t cell;
    uint16_t x;
    uint16_t y;
    const uint16_t x0 = 32u;
    const uint16_t y0 = 106u;
    if (brightness > 100u) brightness = 100u;
    if (lastBrightness == brightness) return;
    filled = (uint8_t) (((uint16_t) brightness * 12u + 50u) / 100u);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_show_string(2u, y0, "LIT");
    for (y = 0u; y < HOME_TILE_MAX_HEIGHT; y++)
    {
        for (x = 0u; x < HOME_TILE_MAX_WIDTH; x++)
        {
            cell = (uint8_t) (x / 8u);
            homeTileBuffer[(uint32_t) y * HOME_TILE_MAX_WIDTH + x] =
                ((x % 8u) < 7u) ?
                    ((cell < filled) ? RGB565_CYAN : RGB565_GRAY) : RGB565_BLACK;
        }
    }
    ips114_show_rgb565_image(x0, y0, homeTileBuffer,
        HOME_TILE_MAX_WIDTH, HOME_TILE_MAX_HEIGHT,
        HOME_TILE_MAX_WIDTH, HOME_TILE_MAX_HEIGHT, 0u);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_show_string(132u, y0, "K2- K3+");
    lastBrightness = brightness;
}

static void drawTitleEx(const char* title, uint16_t fg, uint16_t bg)
{
    char bounded[40];
    size_t len = strlen(title);
    uint16_t x;

    if (len > 39u) len = 39u;
    memcpy(bounded, title, len);
    bounded[len] = '\0';
    x = (uint16_t) ((LCD_W - (uint16_t) (len * 6u)) / 2u);
    if (x < 2u) x = 2u;

    fillSolidRect(1u, 1u, (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), 15u, bg);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(fg, bg);
    ips114_show_string(x, 4u, bounded);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
}

/* 标题栏（静态：仅状态/页变化时重绘） */
static void drawTitle(const char* title)
{
    drawTitleEx(title, RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);
}

/* 列表右侧滚动滑块：自清槽（先清 SCROLLBAR_X..LCD_W-2 槽区，消旧滑块残留），再画轨道 + 滑块。
 * 不触右外框(x=LCD_W-1)。仅在 total>visible 时绘制。 */
static void drawScrollbar(uint8_t total, uint8_t top)
{
    uint16_t trackTop = ROW_Y(1u);
    uint16_t trackBot = (uint16_t) (LCD_H - 2u);
    uint16_t trackH;
    uint16_t thumbH;
    uint16_t thumbY;

    if (total <= VISIBLE_ROWS) return;
    trackH = (uint16_t) (trackBot - trackTop);

    /* 自清槽：清整个槽区(轨道 + 旧滑块) → 消滚动时旧滑块横线残留 */
    fillSolidRect(SCROLLBAR_X, trackTop,
        (uint16_t) ((LCD_W - 2u) - SCROLLBAR_X + 1u), trackH, RGB565_BLACK);
    fillSolidRect(SCROLLBAR_X, trackTop, 1u, trackH, RGB565_GREEN);
    fillSolidRect((uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u), trackTop, 1u, trackH, RGB565_GREEN);

    thumbH = (uint16_t) ((uint32_t) trackH * VISIBLE_ROWS / total);
    if (thumbH < 6u) thumbH = 6u;
    thumbY = (uint16_t) (trackTop + (uint32_t) (trackH - thumbH) * top / (uint16_t) (total - VISIBLE_ROWS));

    if ((uint16_t) (thumbY + thumbH) > trackBot)
        thumbH = (uint16_t) (trackBot - thumbY);
    fillSolidRect((uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X + 1u), thumbY,
        (uint16_t) ((LCD_W - 3u) - (SCROLLBAR_X + 1u) + 1u), thumbH, RGB565_GREEN);
}

/* ---- 发车页（HOME）：底盘状态总览（仿 core0 renderHome，换底盘量）---- */
void chassisRenderHome(void)
{
    chassisApplicationSnapshotStruct chassisSnapshot;
    motorControlSnapshotStruct motorSnapshot;
    loraRemoteSnapshotStruct loraSnapshot;
    loraNavControlSnapshotStruct navSnapshot;
    core2RuntimeSnapshotStruct runtimeSnapshot;
    uint16_t titleColor;
    uint16_t frameColor;
    const char *modeText;
    const char *gateText;
    const char *causeText;
    const char *navText;
    const char *wheelText;
    uint8_t motionValid;
    uint8_t yawValid;
    uint8_t runaway;
    uint8_t redrawStatic = (uint8_t) (chassisForceRedraw || lastState != CHASSIS_MENU_HOME);

    chassisApplicationGetSnapshot(&chassisSnapshot);
    motorControlGetSnapshot(&motorSnapshot);
    loraRemoteGetSnapshot(&loraSnapshot);
    loraNavControlGetSnapshot(&navSnapshot);
    core2RuntimeGetSnapshot(&runtimeSnapshot);
    runaway = motorSnapshot.runawayLatched;
    motionValid = (uint8_t) ((chassisSnapshot.valid != 0u) &&
        (runtimeSnapshot.valid != 0u));
    yawValid = (uint8_t) ((chassisSnapshot.valid != 0u) &&
        (chassisSnapshot.attitudeHealthy != 0u) &&
        (chassisSnapshot.attitudeDataFresh != 0u));
    titleColor = (runtimeSnapshot.estop || runaway) ? RGB565_RED :
        ((runtimeSnapshot.runState == 0u) || runtimeSnapshot.standalone || runtimeSnapshot.rejoin ||
         (runtimeSnapshot.commandFresh == 0u)) ? RGB565_YELLOW : RGB565_GREEN;
    frameColor = titleColor;

    if (redrawStatic || (lastHomeTitleColor != titleColor))
    {
        drawTitleEx("  CORE2 CHASSIS  ", RGB565_BLACK, titleColor);
        lastHomeTitleColor = titleColor;
    }
    if (redrawStatic)
    {
        static const char *const leftLabels[7] =
            {"MODE", "CMDX", "CMDY", "CMDW", "ACTX", "ACTY", "YAWrad"};
        static const char *const rightLabels[7] =
            {"LINK", "GATE", "LORA", "NAV", "WHEEL", "STATE", "CAUSE"};
        uint8_t row;
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GRAY, RGB565_BLACK);
        for (row = 0u; row < 7u; row++)
        {
            uint16_t y = (uint16_t) (18u + (uint16_t) row * 12u);
            ips114_show_string(2u, y, leftLabels[row]);
            ips114_show_string(122u, y, rightLabels[row]);
        }
        ips114_draw_line(119u, 17u, 119u, 103u, RGB565_GRAY);
        drawSectionDivider(104u, RGB565_GRAY);
        drawSectionDivider(119u, RGB565_GRAY);
    }

    modeText = (runtimeSnapshot.runState < 4u) ?
        chassisRunStateNames[runtimeSnapshot.runState] : "?";
    gateText = runtimeSnapshot.estop ? "ESTOP" :
        (!runtimeSnapshot.enabled ? "BLOCK" :
         (runtimeSnapshot.launched ? "GO" : "ARM WAIT"));
    causeText = runaway ? "RUNAWAY" :
        (runtimeSnapshot.estop ? "ESTOP" :
         (runtimeSnapshot.rejoin ? "REJOIN" :
          ((runtimeSnapshot.commandFresh == 0u) ? "CMD STALE" : "--")));
    switch (navSnapshot.state)
    {
        case LORA_NAV_RECORDING: navText = "RECORD"; break;
        case LORA_NAV_READY: navText = "READY"; break;
        case LORA_NAV_REPLAYING: navText = "REPLAY"; break;
        case LORA_NAV_DONE: navText = "DONE"; break;
        case LORA_NAV_ERROR: navText = "ERROR"; break;
        default: navText = "IDLE"; break;
    }
    wheelText = runaway ? "SAT LOCK" : "NORMAL";

    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    drawHomeTextSlot(0u, HOME_LEFT_VALUE_X, 18u, modeText,
        runtimeSnapshot.standalone ? RGB565_YELLOW : RGB565_WHITE);
    drawHomeTextSlot(1u, HOME_RIGHT_VALUE_X, 18u,
        (runtimeSnapshot.core1LinkReady && runtimeSnapshot.core0ViaCore1Ready) ?
            "C1 OK C0 OK" :
            (runtimeSnapshot.core1LinkReady ? "C1 OK C0 WAIT" : "C1 LOST C0 --"),
        (runtimeSnapshot.core1LinkReady && runtimeSnapshot.core0ViaCore1Ready) ?
            RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED);
    drawHomeTextSlot(2u, HOME_RIGHT_VALUE_X, 30u, gateText,
        (runtimeSnapshot.estop || !runtimeSnapshot.enabled) ? RGB565_RED :
            (runtimeSnapshot.launched ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_YELLOW));
    drawHomeTextSlot(3u, HOME_RIGHT_VALUE_X, 42u,
        !loraSnapshot.linkAlive ? "LOST" :
            (loraSnapshot.unlocked ? "OK UNLOCK" : "OK LOCK"),
        !loraSnapshot.linkAlive ? RGB565_RED :
            (loraSnapshot.unlocked ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_YELLOW));
    drawHomeTextSlot(4u, HOME_RIGHT_VALUE_X, 54u, navText,
        (navSnapshot.state == LORA_NAV_ERROR) ? RGB565_RED :
            ((navSnapshot.state == LORA_NAV_REPLAYING) ? RGB565_CYAN : RGB565_WHITE));
    drawHomeTextSlot(5u, HOME_RIGHT_VALUE_X, 66u, wheelText,
        runaway ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_WHITE);
    drawHomeTextSlot(6u, HOME_RIGHT_VALUE_X, 78u,
        runaway ? "LOCKED" : "CONTROL OK", runaway ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_GREEN);
    drawHomeTextSlot(7u, HOME_RIGHT_VALUE_X, 90u, causeText,
        (strcmp(causeText, "--") == 0) ? RGB565_WHITE : RGB565_RED);

    drawHomeNumberSlot(0u, HOME_LEFT_VALUE_X, 30u,
        chassisSnapshot.targetCommand.vx, motionValid, RGB565_WHITE);
    drawHomeNumberSlot(1u, HOME_LEFT_VALUE_X, 42u,
        chassisSnapshot.targetCommand.vy, motionValid, RGB565_WHITE);
    drawHomeNumberSlot(2u, HOME_LEFT_VALUE_X, 54u,
        chassisSnapshot.targetCommand.wz, motionValid, RGB565_WHITE);
    drawHomeNumberSlot(3u, HOME_LEFT_VALUE_X, 66u,
        chassisSnapshot.actualSpeed.vx, motionValid, RGB565_GREEN);
    drawHomeNumberSlot(4u, HOME_LEFT_VALUE_X, 78u,
        chassisSnapshot.actualSpeed.vy, motionValid, RGB565_GREEN);
    drawHomeNumberSlot(5u, HOME_LEFT_VALUE_X, 90u,
        chassisSnapshot.imu.yawAngle, yawValid, RGB565_GREEN);
    drawBrightnessBar((uint8_t) chassisMenuWorkingParams.lightStripBrightness);

    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    if (motorControlIsRunawayLatched())
    {
        drawHomeFooter("RUNAWAY  K5 LONG: UNLOCK", RGB565_RED);
    }
    else
    {
        drawHomeFooter((strcmp(causeText, "--") == 0) ?
            "K4 MENU  K1 SAVE  K1L CLEAR" : causeText,
            (strcmp(causeText, "--") == 0) ? RGB565_GRAY : RGB565_RED);
    }
    if (lastHomeFrameColor != frameColor)
    {
        drawFrameBorder(frameColor);
        lastHomeFrameColor = frameColor;
    }
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);

    lastState = CHASSIS_MENU_HOME;
    chassisForceRedraw = 0u;
    chassisDirtyMask = 0u;
}

/* ---- 等待 RS-485 连接（WAIT_RS485）：上电未连 core1 且未进模式4 时的等待屏（仿 core1 renderWaitLink）----
 * 红字告警 + 提示；链路活或进模式4 后由 chassisMenuInputTick 状态机迁 HOME。静态屏，变化检测防闪烁。 */
void chassisRenderWaitRs485(void)
{
    uint8_t redrawStatic = (uint8_t) (chassisForceRedraw || lastState != CHASSIS_MENU_WAIT_RS485);
    uint8_t c1 = chassisLinkIsAlive();          /* core1 RS-485 链路活 */
    uint8_t c0 = chassisLinkGetCore0Alive();    /* core0 链路活(经 core1 转告)；RS-485 断则 0 */
    uint8_t c0Display = c0 ? 2u : (c1 ? 1u : 0u); /* 0=-- 1=WAIT 2=OK */

    if (redrawStatic)
    {
        drawTitleEx("  WAIT LINK  ", RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_RED);
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(MENU_TEXT_X, ROW_Y(1u), "core1(485) :");
        ips114_show_string(MENU_TEXT_X, ROW_Y(3u), "core0(c1)  :");
        drawSectionDivider(104u, RGB565_RED);
        drawSectionDivider(119u, RGB565_RED);
    }

    /* 动态：两链路状态(绿=OK/红=WAIT，定宽覆盖) + 亮度。RS-485 断时 core0 未知显 "--"。 */
    if ((redrawStatic != 0u) || (lastWaitC1 != c1))
    {
        ips114_set_color(c1 ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(COL_X(13u), ROW_Y(1u), c1 ? "OK  " : "WAIT");
        lastWaitC1 = c1;
    }
    if ((redrawStatic != 0u) || (lastWaitC0Display != c0Display))
    {
        ips114_set_color(c0 ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_show_string(COL_X(13u), ROW_Y(3u), c0 ? "OK  " : (c1 ? "WAIT" : "--  "));
        lastWaitC0Display = c0Display;
    }
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    drawBrightnessBar((uint8_t) chassisMenuWorkingParams.lightStripBrightness);
    if (redrawStatic != 0u)
    {
        ips114_show_string(MENU_TEXT_X, 121u, "WAIT: local LoRa fallback");
        drawFrameBorder(RGB565_YELLOW);
    }

    lastState = CHASSIS_MENU_WAIT_RS485;
    chassisForceRedraw = 0u;
}

void chassisRenderInitFaultSummary(uint8_t failedMask, uint8_t unverifiedMask, uint8_t secondsLeft)
{
    static const char *const names[2] = {"IMU", "CHASSIS ALG"};
    uint8_t row = 0u;
    uint8_t i;
    if (secondsLeft >= 3u)
    {
        chassisMenuClearScreen();
        drawTitleEx((failedMask != 0u) ? "HW INIT FAIL" : "HW INIT CHECK",
            RGB565_BLACK, (failedMask != 0u) ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_YELLOW);
        for (i = 0u; i < 2u; i++)
        {
            uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << i);
            if ((failedMask & bit) != 0u)
            {
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK);
                ips114_show_string(8u, (uint16_t) (34u + row * 16u), names[i]);
                ips114_show_string(128u, (uint16_t) (34u + row * 16u), "FAIL ");
                row++;
            }
        }
        for (i = 0u; i < 2u; i++)
        {
            uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << i);
            if (((unverifiedMask & bit) != 0u) && ((failedMask & bit) == 0u))
            {
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
                ips114_show_string(8u, (uint16_t) (34u + row * 16u), names[i]);
                ips114_show_string(128u, (uint16_t) (34u + row * 16u), "CHECK");
                row++;
            }
        }
        drawFrameBorder((failedMask != 0u) ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_YELLOW);
    }
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_show_string(8u, 114u, "CONTINUE 0s");
    ips114_show_uint(80u, 114u, secondsLeft, 1u);
    chassisForceRedraw = 0u;
}

/* ---- 页列表（PAGE_LIST）---- */
void chassisRenderPageList(void)
{
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t redrawStatic = (uint8_t) (lastState != CHASSIS_MENU_PAGE_LIST);
    uint8_t changed = (uint8_t) (redrawStatic
        || lastPageIdx != chassisPageIdx || lastScrollTop != chassisScrollTop);
    uint8_t selectionOnly = (uint8_t) ((!redrawStatic) &&
        (lastScrollTop == chassisScrollTop) && (lastPageIdx != chassisPageIdx));

    /* 无结构变化(displayDue 无变化)直接跳过，避免空刷滚动条/边框造成抖动 */
    if (!changed) return;

    listFillRightX = (chassisMenuPageCount > VISIBLE_ROWS) ? (uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X - 1u) : (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);

    if (redrawStatic)
    {
        drawTitle("  SELECT PAGE  ");
    }

    for (i = 0u; i < VISIBLE_ROWS; i++)
    {
        uint8_t idx = (uint8_t) (chassisScrollTop + i);
        uint8_t row = (uint8_t) (i + 1u);
        if ((selectionOnly != 0u) && ((int8_t) idx != chassisPageIdx) &&
            ((int8_t) idx != lastPageIdx)) continue;
        if (idx >= chassisMenuPageCount)
        {
            clearListRow(row);
            continue;
        }
        if ((int8_t) idx == chassisPageIdx)
        {
            fillListRowBg(row, MENU_SEL_NAME_FG, MENU_SEL_BG); /* 选中整行青底 */
            ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, ROW_Y(row), ">");
            ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, ROW_Y(row), chassisMenuPages[idx].name);
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        }
        else
        {
            clearListRow(row); /* 普通行：黑底绿名（页列表无数值） */
            ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, ROW_Y(row), chassisMenuPages[idx].name);
        }
    }

    if (selectionOnly == 0u)
    {
        drawScrollbar(chassisMenuPageCount, chassisScrollTop);
        drawFrameBorder(RGB565_GREEN);
    }
    lastState = CHASSIS_MENU_PAGE_LIST;
    lastPageIdx = chassisPageIdx;
    lastScrollTop = chassisScrollTop;
    chassisForceRedraw = 0u;
}

/* 把某项的当前浮点值格式化显示，x 起、定宽覆盖。
 * 颜色由调用方(行样式 helper)预设；本函数只在当前前景/背景下清+画，不隐式假设颜色。 */
static void drawOptValue(const chassisMenuPageStruct* page, uint8_t i, uint16_t x, uint16_t y)
{
    float val = (page->opt[i] != 0) ? *page->opt[i] : 0.0f;
    menuFloatDisplayShow(x, y,
        (double) val,
        menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep((double) val, page->stepS[i]));
}

/* 三态行样式表：底色/名色/值色/行首标记。 */
static void optRowStyle(optRowStyleEnum style, uint16_t* bg, uint16_t* nameFg, uint16_t* valFg, const char** mark)
{
    switch (style)
    {
        case OPT_ROW_SELECTED:
            *bg = MENU_SEL_BG;  *nameFg = MENU_SEL_NAME_FG;  *valFg = MENU_SEL_VAL_FG;  *mark = ">"; break;
        case OPT_ROW_EDITING:
            *bg = MENU_EDIT_BG; *nameFg = MENU_EDIT_NAME_FG; *valFg = MENU_EDIT_VAL_FG; *mark = "*"; break;
        case OPT_ROW_NORMAL:
        default:
            *bg = RGB565_BLACK; *nameFg = MENU_NORM_NAME_FG; *valFg = MENU_NORM_VAL_FG; *mark = " "; break;
    }
}

/* 画整行选项（铺底色 + 标记 + 名 + 值，名/值不同前景色）。结构性重绘用。 */
static void drawOptionRow(uint8_t row, const chassisMenuPageStruct* page, uint8_t idx, optRowStyleEnum style)
{
    uint16_t y = ROW_Y(row);
    uint16_t bg;
    uint16_t nameFg;
    uint16_t valFg;
    const char* mark;
    optRowStyle(style, &bg, &nameFg, &valFg, &mark);

    /* 整行铺底色（只写内框）+ 标记 + 名(名色) */
    ips114_set_color(nameFg, bg);
    fillSolidRect(1u, y, listFillRightX, FONT_H, bg);
    fillBottomGutter(row, bg);
    ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, y, mark);
    ips114_show_string(MENU_ITEM_X, y, page->optName[idx]);

    /* 值(值色，与名不同) */
    ips114_set_color(valFg, bg);
    drawOptValue(page, idx, MENU_VAL_X, y);

    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK); /* 复原默认 */
}

/* EDIT 态值变局部刷新：仅重绘当前选中项数值(黄底红字)，不动整行/名/边框/滚动条 → 消整页清屏闪烁。 */
static void drawEditValueOnly(const chassisMenuPageStruct* page, uint8_t idx, uint8_t row)
{
    ips114_set_color(MENU_EDIT_VAL_FG, MENU_EDIT_BG);
    drawOptValue(page, idx, MENU_VAL_X, ROW_Y(row));
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
}

/* ---- 选项列表（OPTION_LIST）/ 编辑（EDIT，editing=1 编辑选中项）---- */
void chassisRenderOptionList(uint8_t editing)
{
    const chassisMenuPageStruct* page;
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t enteringList;
    uint8_t editTransition;
    uint8_t structural;
    uint8_t selectionOnly;

    if (chassisPageIdx < 0 || (uint8_t) chassisPageIdx >= chassisMenuPageCount) return;
    page = &chassisMenuPages[chassisPageIdx];
    if ((editing == 0u) &&
        ((uint8_t) chassisPageIdx == chassisParamSlotsPageIndex))
    {
        char line[32];
        core2ParamGlobalUiSnapshot globalUi;
        uint8_t slotUiState;
        uint8_t fullRedraw;
        core2RuntimeGetParamGlobalUi(&globalUi);
        slotUiState = globalUi.slotUiState;
        if (chassisParamSlotInspectPending != 0u ||
            globalUi.action != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY ||
            globalUi.slot != (uint8_t) chassisParamSlotSelection)
            slotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
        listFillRightX = (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);
        fullRedraw = (uint8_t) (paramSlotsSurfaceValid == 0u);
        if (fullRedraw != 0u)
        {
            drawTitle("PARAM SLOTS");
            for (i = 1u; i < 8u; i++) clearListRow(i);
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(5u), "K2/K3 SLOT");
            ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(6u), "K1L SAVE K4 LOAD");
            ips114_show_string(8u, ROW_Y(7u), "K5 BACK");
            drawFrameBorder(RGB565_GREEN);
            paramSlotsSurfaceValid = 1u;
        }
        if (fullRedraw != 0u || paramSlotsLastSelection !=
            (uint8_t) chassisParamSlotSelection)
        {
            fillListRowBg(1u, MENU_SEL_NAME_FG, MENU_SEL_BG);
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "> SELECT        SLOT %u",
                (unsigned) ((uint8_t) chassisParamSlotSelection));
            ips114_show_string(MENU_MARK_X, ROW_Y(1u), line);
            paramSlotsLastSelection = (uint8_t) chassisParamSlotSelection;
        }
        if (fullRedraw != 0u || paramSlotsLastUi.slotUiState != slotUiState)
        {
            static const char *const slotText[] = {
                "UNKNOWN", "CHECKING", "FULL", "EMPTY", "PARTIAL",
                "INVALID", "UNAVAILABLE"};
            uint8_t state = slotUiState;
            if (state > PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE)
                state = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNKNOWN;
            clearListRow(2u);
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "SLOT: %s", slotText[state]);
            ips114_set_color((state == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL) ? RGB565_GREEN :
                ((state == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_EMPTY) ? RGB565_CYAN : RGB565_YELLOW),
                RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(24u, ROW_Y(2u), line);
        }
        globalUi.slotUiState = slotUiState;
        if (globalUi.state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED)
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: QUEUED");
        else if (globalUi.state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS)
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "RUN: C%u PH%u",
                (unsigned) globalUi.target, (unsigned) globalUi.phase);
        else if (globalUi.state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS)
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: SUCCESS");
        else if (globalUi.state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED)
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "FAIL: C%u E%u",
                (unsigned) globalUi.target, (unsigned) globalUi.error);
        else
            (void) snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "TASK: READY");
        if (fullRedraw != 0u || memcmp(&paramSlotsLastUi, &globalUi,
                sizeof(globalUi)) != 0)
        {
            clearListRow(3u);
            ips114_set_color(globalUi.state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS ? RGB565_GREEN :
                (globalUi.state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_CYAN),
                RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(24u, ROW_Y(3u), line);
        }
        paramSlotsLastUi = globalUi;
        lastState = CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        lastOptIdx = chassisOptIdx;
        lastScrollTop = chassisScrollTop;
        chassisForceRedraw = 0u;
        return;
    }

    /* 结构变化判定(不依赖 forceRedraw)：从别态进入 / 进出编辑 / 换选中项 / 滚动 → 整页重绘。
     * 编辑态值变(同态同项同滚动)不算结构变化 → 走值局部刷新(drawEditValueOnly)，
     * 消除原 `|| editing` 每帧清整页 7 行造成的闪烁(forceRedraw 仅 gate 是否被调，不再决定整页重绘)。 */
    enteringList = (uint8_t) (lastState == CHASSIS_MENU_HOME
        || lastState == CHASSIS_MENU_PAGE_LIST
        || lastState == (chassisMenuStateEnum) 0xFF);
    editTransition = (uint8_t) ((lastState == CHASSIS_MENU_EDIT) != (editing != 0u));
    structural = (uint8_t) (enteringList || editTransition
        || lastOptIdx != chassisOptIdx || lastScrollTop != chassisScrollTop);
    selectionOnly = (uint8_t) ((!enteringList) && (!editTransition) &&
        (lastScrollTop == chassisScrollTop) && (lastOptIdx != chassisOptIdx));

    if (structural)
    {
        listFillRightX = (page->optionCount > VISIBLE_ROWS) ? (uint16_t) (SCROLLBAR_X - 1u) : (uint16_t) (LCD_W - 2u);
        if (enteringList)
        {
            drawTitle(page->name);
        }
        for (i = 0u; i < VISIBLE_ROWS; i++)
        {
            uint8_t idx = (uint8_t) (chassisScrollTop + i);
            uint8_t row = (uint8_t) (i + 1u);
            if ((selectionOnly != 0u) && ((int8_t) idx != chassisOptIdx) &&
                ((int8_t) idx != lastOptIdx)) continue;
            if (idx >= page->optionCount)
            {
                clearListRow(row);
                continue;
            }
            {
                uint8_t selected = (uint8_t) ((int8_t) idx == chassisOptIdx);
                optRowStyleEnum style = (!selected) ? OPT_ROW_NORMAL
                    : (editing ? OPT_ROW_EDITING : OPT_ROW_SELECTED);
                drawOptionRow(row, page, idx, style);
            }
        }
        if (selectionOnly == 0u)
        {
            drawScrollbar(page->optionCount, chassisScrollTop);
            drawFrameBorder(RGB565_GREEN);
        }
    }
    else if (editing)
    {
        /* 值局部刷新：仅当前选中项数值（选中项在屏行 = optIdx - scrollTop + 1） */
        uint8_t selRow = (uint8_t) ((uint8_t) chassisOptIdx - chassisScrollTop + 1u);
        drawEditValueOnly(page, (uint8_t) chassisOptIdx, selRow);
    }
    /* else：OPTION_LIST 非结构变化(displayDue 无变化) → 跳过 */

    lastState = editing ? CHASSIS_MENU_EDIT : CHASSIS_MENU_OPTION_LIST;
    lastOptIdx = chassisOptIdx;
    lastScrollTop = chassisScrollTop;
    chassisForceRedraw = 0u;
}

/*
 * ============================================================
 * core2 工程配置宏 — 操作指南
 * ============================================================
 *
 * [1] 时序参数（通常不需修改，除非换电机/编码器）
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SAMPLE_PERIOD_US        (50)    PIT_CH1 触发周期 (µs)
 *                                 电流 ADC 过采样：每 50µs 采一次样
 *                                 PIT_CH1/CH0 共用 CPUIntIdx2，同优先级顺序执行
 *
 * CONTROL_PERIOD_US       (500)   PIT_CH0 触发周期 (µs) — 系统"心跳"
 *                                 每拍执行：电流反馈更新 + 电流 PID + PWM 输出
 *
 * SPEED_LOOP_DIVIDER      (4)     速度环分频：500µs × 4 = 2ms
 *                                 每 4 拍执行：编码器采样 + 速度 PID + 运动学更新
 *                                 改此值后需重新整定速度 PID 增益
 *
 *
 * IPS114_DISPLAY_PERIOD_MS(20)    LCD HOME遥测刷新周期 (ms)
 *                                 不进 ISR，由 whileProcess 消费标志位
 *
 * IPS114_LINE_HEIGHT      (16)    LCD 行距 (像素)，配合 8×16 横屏字体
 *
 * MOTOR_TUNE_STEP_HIGH/LOW/INTERVAL_S   CASCADE/CURRENT 目标阶跃测试：目标每 INTERVAL_S 秒
 *                                 在高/低值间切换(INTERVAL_S=0 → 恒高值)，单位随模式(速度/电流)，
 *                                 便于上位机看闭环阶跃响应；低值可为负→双向阶跃
 *
 * [2] 工作模式选择 — 两级体系（详见 configCore2Build.h 与 PROJECT.md §6）
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * 第一级（编译期）CORE2_BUILD_MODE：
 *   CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION 生产固件——空地系统运行态机 carRunState 单点决策(据 RS-485 链路
 *     活否 + core1 下发的 sysByte 源位 + 失链时长，每拍重算)，替代原静态 controlSource 选源：
 *     FOLLOW_485 (链路活+源=485, 模式1/2)：消费 core1 经 RS-485 下发的 vx/vy/wz + 发车门控 + yaw 闭环驱动底盘。
 *     LORA_LINKED(链路活+源=LoRa, 模式3) / MODE4(RS-485 失链 >2s 兜底)：本地 LoRa3A22 双摇杆遥控
 *                  + NAV 轨迹录制/回放（loraNavControl）。左摇杆前后=vx/左右=vy，右摇杆左右=wz；
 *                  S3+S4 chord 解锁⇄锁定（锁定即急停），S4 单按=录制，S3 单按=回放；链路丢失 >500ms
 *                  软急停；蜂鸣器 P07_2 提示。
 *     WAIT_LINK  (RS-485 失链未超时)：软急停等待 core1（与原失链急停同语义）。
 *   CORE2_BUILD_TUNE 调参固件——编译期选 MOTOR_TUNE_MODE 子模式：
 *
 *   0  MOTOR_TUNE_CASCADE     级联 PID 调试模式
 *      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 *      │ 单轮选中调试：编码器 → 速度PID → 电流PID → PWM。   │
 *      │ IPS114 显示选中轮子的 6 项数据 (tgt/fbk/spdOut/     │
 *      │ curFbk/curOut)。用途：4 轮逐一标定 PID 参数。      │
 *      └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 *
 *   1  MOTOR_TUNE_LORA_TEST   LoRa 遥控器原始数据监视模式
 *      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 *      │ 仅接收 LoRa 帧，IPS114 显示 4 摇杆 + 4 按键 +      │
 *      │ 4 拨码开关 + state_flag 原始值。                    │
 *      │ 不控制电机、不跑 PID。                              │
 *      │ 用途：验证 LoRa 链路, 标定摇杆中位/极性/范围。     │
 *      └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 *
 *   2  MOTOR_TUNE_CURRENT     电流环单环调参
 *   3  MOTOR_TUNE_OPEN_LOOP   开环 PWM 测试
 *
 * 切换模式：改 configCore2Build.h 的 CORE2_BUILD_MODE / MOTOR_TUNE_MODE，重新编译刷写。
 * ============================================================
 */

/* 空地系统运行态机（单点决策，替代原静态 controlSource 分支）：每拍 pitProcess0 据
 * RS-485 链路活否 + cmd.sysByte 源位 + 失链时长重算，无锁存——RS-485 恢复自动退出模式4。
 *   WAIT_LINK  : RS-485 失链但未超时——软急停等待 core1
 *   FOLLOW_485 : RS-485 活 + 源=485(模式1/2)——跟随 core1 指令(发车门控)
 *   LORA_LINKED: RS-485 活 + 源=LoRa(模式3)——本地 LoRa 双摇杆遥控
 *   MODE4      : RS-485 失链 >AG_CAR_RS485_WAIT_MS——本地兜底, LoRa 独立(车单独可用)
 * controlSource 静态镜像已删：源不再由本地 flash 决定，改由 RS-485 链路 + core0 下发的
 * sysByte 源位主导；Core2 不再保留第二套控制源参数。 */
typedef enum
{
    CAR_RUN_WAIT_LINK = 0,
    CAR_RUN_FOLLOW_485 = 1,
    CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED = 2,
    CAR_RUN_MODE4 = 3
} carRunStateEnum;

static void cancelPendingParamGlobalRequest(uint8_t error)
{
    core2ParamGlobalUiSnapshot ui;
    ui.state = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiState;
    ui.phase = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiPhase;
    ui.target = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiTarget;
    ui.error = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiError;
    ui.action = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiAction;
    ui.slot = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiSlot;
    ui.slotUiState = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalSlotUiState;
    ui.eventSequence = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiEventSequence;
    if (core2ParamGlobalUiCancel(
            &core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestValid, &ui, error) == 0u)
        return;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestCoordinatorBoot = 0u;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiState = ui.state;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiPhase = ui.phase;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiTarget = ui.target;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiError = ui.error;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiAction = ui.action;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiSlot = ui.slot;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalSlotUiState = ui.slotUiState;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiEventSequence++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiEventSequence == 0u)
        core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiEventSequence = 1u;
}

/* FOLLOW_485 控制态（pitProcess0 控制分支写，whileProcess 遥测读）：
 * bit 语义供遥测 status 上报 core1——使能态 / 急停态 / 已发车态。 */
static void rs485ControlStop(void)
{
    chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(0u);
    core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider = 0u;
    core2ControlRuntime.rs485YawDivider = 0u;
    chassisApplicationStop();
    motorControlStopAll();
    chassisApplicationUpdateFeedback();
    /* 遥测态：急停/等待——使能关、急停置位、未发车（原两调用点各自重复，收口于此）。 */
    core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEnabled = 0u;
    core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEstop = 1u;
    core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlLaunched = 0u;
}

static void rs485ControlRunSpeedLoop(const chassisLinkCommandStruct *cmd)
{
    chassisMotionCommandStruct motion;

    motion.vx = cmd->vx;
    motion.vy = cmd->vy;
    motion.wz = cmd->wz;

    /* 与 LoRa/NAV 保持相同顺序：先刷新本拍反馈，再开启 yaw owner 并应用命令。
     * 姿态不健康时只撤销yaw闭环修正并上报独立故障，合法底盘命令仍继续执行。 */
    chassisApplicationUpdateFeedback();
    chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(1u);
    chassisApplicationApplyCommandWithLimit(
        motion,
        CHASSIS_RS485_MAX_LINEAR_SPEED_MPS,
        CHASSIS_RS485_MAX_YAW_RATE_RADPS);

    /* 先下发一次限幅后的目标, 让 yaw PID 读取同一 targetCommand;
     * 6ms tick 产生新 yawCorrection 后, 本拍再重算一次轮速。 */
    core2ControlRuntime.rs485YawDivider++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.rs485YawDivider >= YAW_RATE_LOOP_DIVIDER)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.rs485YawDivider = 0u;
        chassisApplicationYawRateTick();
        chassisApplicationApplyCommandWithLimit(
            motion,
            CHASSIS_RS485_MAX_LINEAR_SPEED_MPS,
            CHASSIS_RS485_MAX_YAW_RATE_RADPS);
    }

    motorControlSpeedTick();
}
