void processInit(void)
{
    chassisParamStruct activeParams;
    uint8_t chassisInitResult;
    uint8_t imuInitResult;

    core2ControlRuntime.runState = CAR_RUN_WAIT_LINK;
    core2ControlRuntime.runStateSeq = 1u;
    core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEstop = 1u;
    core2ControlRuntime.ownerValidPrev = 0u;
    core2ControlRuntime.loraLinkPrev = 0u;
    core2ControlRuntime.loraRearmRequired = 1u;
    core2ControlRuntime.loraLaunchLowSeen = 0u;
    core2ControlRuntime.effectiveLoraLaunchGate = 0u;

    /* 控制环参数 RAM 镜像：所有控制 init 前先填宏默认值，再从 flash 载入覆盖（校验通过 +
     * GLOBAL_PARAM_PERSIST_ENABLE），使 motorControlInit/chassisApplicationInit 读到持久化值。
     * 菜单(D-4)运行时改镜像 + 热生效 + 保存。 */
    chassisParamsInit();
    core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceInit();
    chassisParamsGetActive(&activeParams);

    chassisInitResult = chassisApplicationInit();
    imuInitResult = IMUInit();
    if (imuInitResult != 0u) core2ControlRuntime.initFailedMask |= 0x01u;
    else core2ControlRuntime.imuReady = 1u;
    if (chassisInitResult != 0u) core2ControlRuntime.initFailedMask |= 0x02u;
    core2ControlRuntime.criticalInitFailed =
        (core2ControlRuntime.initFailedMask != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    motorInit();
    motorControlInit();
    core2RuntimeApplyControllerParams(&activeParams);
    currentSenseInit();
    currentSenseClearOffset(16u);
    encoderInit();
    menuKeyInit(1u); /* menuKeyScan 由 PIT_CH0÷KEY_TICK_DIVIDER 以 1ms 周期调用 */
    lightStripInit();
#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
    lightStripSetBrightness((uint8_t) activeParams.lightStripBrightness); /* 生产态：恢复持久化/默认亮度（WAIT/HOME 可热调）*/
#else
    lightStripSetBrightness(0u); /* TUNE 调参态 ^ 定位灯条不亮（PWM 占 P08_0 但 0 占空比）；按键改作选轮 */
#endif
    /* RS-485 链路初始化。PRODUCTION：comm 已搬到 cm_7_1 通信核，本调用是镜像实现的零初始化(不碰 UART4)；
     * TUNE：真实 thvd1450Init(UART_4 + DE=P13_7，comm 仍在本核)。 */
    chassisLinkInit();
    buzzerInit(); /* 蜂鸣器单一所有者：BEEP_PIN gpio_init + 复位仲裁。PRODUCTION/TUNE 都 init(TUNE 失控也鸣) */
    buzzerSetHardwareInitFault(core2ControlRuntime.criticalInitFailed);

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
    /* 空地系统：LoRa 路径需常驻可用——模式3(源=LoRa)与模式4(失链兜底)都在运行时切入 LoRa。
     * PRODUCTION：LoRa 收发已搬到 cm_7_1，loraNavControlInit 内的 loraRemoteInit 为镜像零初始化(不碰 UART1)；
     * loraNavControl 仅保留 NAV 录制/回放/落地状态机(电机驱动在本核 500µs ISR)，运动/解锁/边沿读 cm_7_1 共享内存镜像。 */
    loraNavControlInit();
    core2RuntimeApplyDynamicParams(&activeParams);
#elif (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_LORA_TEST)
    lora3a22_init();
#endif

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_TUNE) && ((MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_CASCADE) || (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_CURRENT) || (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_OPEN_LOOP))
    updateTuneTarget();
#endif

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
    chassisMenuInit(); /* 生产态：板载菜单（发车/调参页）接管 IPS114 + 5 键，替代 tuneDisplay 与灯条键扫描 */
    chassisMenuSetInitHealth(core2ControlRuntime.initFailedMask, 0u);
#else
    tuneDisplayInit();
#endif
    pit_us_init(PIT_CH0, CONTROL_PERIOD_US);
    pit_us_init(PIT_CH1, SAMPLE_PERIOD_US);
    core2ControlRuntime.initReady = 1u;
}

uint8_t core2RuntimeSubmitParams(const chassisParamStruct *candidate)
{
    chassisParamStruct previous;
    chassisParamStruct prepared;
    chassisParamStruct active;
    chassisApplicationParamViewStruct chassisView;
    loraRemoteParamViewStruct remoteView;
    loraNavControlParamViewStruct navView;
    uint32_t irqWasEnabled;
    uint8_t controllerReinitRequired;

    if (candidate == 0) return 0u;

    prepared = *candidate;
    chassisParamsSanitize(&prepared);
    chassisParamsGetActive(&previous);

    /* 活动仓库只在前台访问，完整DTO的sanitize/复制在IRQ开启时完成。 */
    if (!chassisParamsCommit(&prepared)) return 0u;
    chassisParamsGetActive(&active);
    controllerReinitRequired = (memcmp(
                                    &previous,
                                    &active,
                                    offsetof(chassisParamStruct, yawRateOutputLimit)) != 0)
                                   ? 1u
                                   : 0u;
    core2RuntimeBuildParamViews(&active, 0, &chassisView, &remoteView, &navView);

    /* 仅各ISR owner的9个动态标量与pending标志在共享IRQ临界区交换；完整DTO工作已在上方完成。
     * CH0/CH1共用CPUIntIdx2，只保存并屏蔽该IRQ，禁止逐飞 interrupt_global_* 坏计数器。 */
    irqWasEnabled = NVIC_GetEnableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);
    NVIC_DisableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);
    loraRemoteApplyParams(&remoteView);
    loraNavControlApplyParams(&navView);
    chassisApplicationApplyYawOutputLimit(chassisView.yawRateOutputLimit);
    if (controllerReinitRequired) core2ControlRuntime.paramApplyPending = 1u;
    if (irqWasEnabled != 0u) NVIC_EnableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);

    lightStripSetBrightness((uint8_t) active.lightStripBrightness);
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core2RuntimeRequestSave(void)
{
    chassisParamStruct active;
    if (core2RuntimeParamsApplyReady() == 0u) return 0u;
    chassisParamsGetActive(&active);
    return (uint8_t) (chassisParamsSaveRuntime(&active) ==
        CHASSIS_PARAMS_SLOT_OK);
}

uint8_t core2RuntimeRequestFactoryReset(void)
{
    chassisParamStruct defaults;
    if (core2RuntimeParamsApplyReady() == 0u) return 0u;
    chassisParamsLoadDefaults(&defaults);
    chassisParamsSanitize(&defaults);
    if (chassisParamsSaveRuntime(&defaults) !=
        CHASSIS_PARAMS_SLOT_OK) return 0u;
    return core2RuntimeSubmitParams(&defaults);
}

uint8_t core2RuntimeParamsApplyReady(void)
{
#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
    motorControlSnapshotStruct motor;
    motorControlGetSnapshot(&motor);
    if (core2ParamSyncMotorSnapshotIsStopped(&motor) == 0u) return 0u;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_WAIT_LINK)
    {
        return 1u;
    }
    if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_FOLLOW_485 &&
        (!core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEnabled || core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEstop ||
            !core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlLaunched))
    {
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
#else
    return 1u;
#endif
}

uint8_t core2RuntimeParamsApplied(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (core2ControlRuntime.paramApplyPending == 0u);
}

uint8_t core2RuntimeRequestGlobalParamAction(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    paramSyncGlobalRequest request;
    if (core2ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u ||
        core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestValid != 0u ||
        core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalStateValid == 0u ||
        paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalState) == 0u)
        return 0u;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestSequence++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestSequence == 0u)
        core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestSequence = 1u;
    request.producerBootGeneration = core2ParamSyncOwnerBootGeneration();
    request.sequence = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestSequence;
    request.origin = 2u;
    request.action = action;
    request.slot = slot;
    request.reserved = 0u;
    if (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(&request) == 0u) return 0u;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequest = request;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestCoordinatorBoot =
        core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestValid = 1u;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiState = CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiPhase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_REQUESTED;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiTarget = 0xFFu;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiError = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiAction = action;
    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiSlot = slot;
    if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
    return 1u;
}

void core2RuntimeGetParamGlobalUi(core2ParamGlobalUiSnapshot *out)
{
    if (out == 0) return;
    out->state = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiState;
    out->phase = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiPhase;
    out->target = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiTarget;
    out->error = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiError;
    out->action = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiAction;
    out->slot = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiSlot;
    out->slotUiState = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalSlotUiState;
    out->reserved = 0u;
    out->eventSequence = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiEventSequence;
}

static void core2RuntimeServiceParamApply(void)
{
    if (!core2ControlRuntime.paramApplyPending || !core2RuntimeParamsApplyReady())
    {
        return;
    }

    /* CH0/CH1 共用 CPUIntIdx2：极短保存并屏蔽该 IRQ 后只停/清 CH0 源，再恢复原使能状态。
     * 不清 NVIC pending，不停 CH1；随后 CH0 已停表，CH1 可继续电流采样而不会触碰控制器状态。 */
    {
        uint32_t irqWasEnabled = NVIC_GetEnableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);
        NVIC_DisableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);
        pit_disable(PIT_CH0);
        pit_isr_flag_clear(PIT_CH0);
        if (irqWasEnabled != 0u) NVIC_EnableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);
    }
    if (core2RuntimeParamsApplyReady())
    {
        chassisParamStruct active;
        chassisParamsGetActive(&active);
        core2RuntimeApplyControllerParams(&active);
        core2ControlRuntime.paramApplyPending = 0u;
    }
    pit_enable(PIT_CH0);
}

static void core2RuntimeBuildParamViews(
    const chassisParamStruct *params,
    motorControlParamViewStruct *motor,
    chassisApplicationParamViewStruct *chassis,
    loraRemoteParamViewStruct *remote,
    loraNavControlParamViewStruct *nav)
{
    const chassisPidGainStruct *speed[4] = {
        &params->speedFl, &params->speedFr, &params->speedBl, &params->speedBr};
    const chassisPidGainStruct *current[4] = {
        &params->currentFl, &params->currentFr, &params->currentBl, &params->currentBr};
    uint8_t i;

    if (motor != 0)
    {
        for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++)
        {
            motor->speedKp[i] = speed[i]->kp;
            motor->speedKi[i] = speed[i]->ki;
            motor->speedKd[i] = speed[i]->kd;
            motor->currentKp[i] = current[i]->kp;
            motor->currentKi[i] = current[i]->ki;
            motor->currentKd[i] = current[i]->kd;
        }
        motor->speedIntegralMax = params->speedIntegralMax;
        motor->currentIntegralMax = params->currentIntegralMax;
    }

    if (chassis != 0)
    {
        chassis->yawRateKp = params->yawRate.kp;
        chassis->yawRateKi = params->yawRate.ki;
        chassis->yawRateKd = params->yawRate.kd;
        chassis->yawRateIntegralMax = params->yawRateIntegralMax;
        chassis->headingKp = params->headingKp;
        chassis->headingRateLimit = params->headingRateLimit;
        chassis->yawRateOutputLimit = params->yawRateOutputLimit;
    }

    if (remote != 0)
    {
        remote->vMaxMps = params->loraVMaxMps;
        remote->wzMaxRadps = params->loraWzMaxRadps;
        remote->stickDeadzone = params->loraStickDeadzone;
    }

    if (nav != 0)
    {
        nav->correctionKp = params->navCorrectionKp;
        nav->correctionLimit = params->navCorrectionLimit;
        nav->errorLimitPulses = params->navErrorLimitPulses;
        nav->loraVMaxMps = params->loraVMaxMps;
        nav->loraWzMaxRadps = params->loraWzMaxRadps;
    }
}

static void core2RuntimeApplyControllerParams(const chassisParamStruct *params)
{
    motorControlParamViewStruct motor;
    chassisApplicationParamViewStruct chassis;
    core2RuntimeBuildParamViews(params, &motor, &chassis, 0, 0);
    motorControlApplyParams(&motor);
    (void) chassisApplicationApplyParams(&chassis);
}

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
static void core2RuntimeApplyDynamicParams(const chassisParamStruct *params)
{
    chassisApplicationParamViewStruct chassis;
    loraRemoteParamViewStruct remote;
    loraNavControlParamViewStruct nav;

    core2RuntimeBuildParamViews(params, 0, &chassis, &remote, &nav);
    loraRemoteApplyParams(&remote);
    loraNavControlApplyParams(&nav);
    chassisApplicationApplyYawOutputLimit(chassis.yawRateOutputLimit);
}
#endif

void pitProcess1(void)
{
    if (!core2ControlRuntime.initReady) return;
    currentSenseSample();
}

void pitProcess0(void)
{
    if (!core2ControlRuntime.initReady) return;

    motorControlUpdateCurrentFeedback();

    core2ControlRuntime.imuTickDivider++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.imuTickDivider >= IMU_TICK_DIVIDER)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.imuTickDivider = 0u;
        if (core2ControlRuntime.imuReady != 0u)
            IMUUpdate();     /* 1ms（500µs×IMU_TICK_DIVIDER）；仅采样、映射并压入前台姿态队列 */
        chassisLinkTickMs(); /* 1ms RS-485 链路年龄计时（与 IMU 同节拍） */
#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
        /* 空地系统：RS-485 连续失链时长累加(活则清零、饱和于等待阈值)，供模式4超时兜底决策。
         * 紧随 chassisLinkTickMs 后读 isAlive，两者同拍一致(age 本拍已更新)。ISR 内单字节/字操作，安全。 */
        if (chassisLinkIsAlive())
        {
            core2ControlRuntime.rs485DeadMs = 0u;
            if ((core2ControlRuntime.rejoinActive != 0u) &&
                (core2ControlRuntime.rejoinReadyMs < 2000u))
                core2ControlRuntime.rejoinReadyMs++;
        }
        else
        {
            if (core2ControlRuntime.rs485DeadMs < AG_CAR_RS485_WAIT_MS)
                core2ControlRuntime.rs485DeadMs++;
            core2ControlRuntime.rejoinReadyMs = 0u;
            core2ControlRuntime.rejoinActive = 0u;
        }
#endif
    }

    core2ControlRuntime.keyTickDivider++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.keyTickDivider >= KEY_TICK_DIVIDER)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.keyTickDivider = 0u;
#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
        chassisMenuPitTick(); /* 扫键 + 菜单填充反馈倒计时（内部含 menuKeyScan，1ms 节拍）*/
#else
        menuKeyScan();
#endif
    }

    /* 即使控制硬件初始化失败，UI刷新和前台通信年龄仍必须继续推进。 */
    core2ControlRuntime.loopMsAccumUs += (uint16_t) CONTROL_PERIOD_US;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.loopMsAccumUs >= 1000u)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.loopMsAccumUs -= 1000u;
        core2ControlRuntime.loopMs++;
    }
    core2ControlRuntime.displayCountUs += CONTROL_PERIOD_US;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.displayCountUs >= IPS114_DISPLAY_PERIOD_MS * 1000u)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.displayCountUs = 0u;
        core2ControlRuntime.displayDue = 1u;
    }

    if (core2ControlRuntime.criticalInitFailed != 0u)
    {
#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
        rs485ControlStop();
        buzzerSetPattern(CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_SILENT);
        buzzerSetRunaway(0u);
        buzzerTick();
#else
        motorControlStopAll();
#endif
        return;
    }

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
    /* 空地系统：单点决策 carRunState（据 RS-485 链路活否 + cmd.sysByte 源位 + 失链时长），
     * 替代原静态 controlSource 分支。每拍 500µs 重算，无锁存——RS-485 恢复自动退出模式4。
     * 取最新命令快照(整块、含 sysByte)：既供源位决策、又供 FOLLOW_485 发车门控消费。 */
    {
        chassisLinkCommandStruct cmd;
        uint8_t linkAlive = chassisLinkIsAlive();
        carRunStateEnum previousRunState = core2ControlRuntime.runState;
        uint8_t ownerEdge = 0u;

        /* 仅链路活时才在 500µs PIT 内整块读命令快照（chassisLinkGetCommand 含
         * PRIMASK 关中断临界区）：WAIT_LINK/MODE4 失链态的决策只看 rs485DeadMs、
         * 不需要 cmd。未连通时每拍调用会与 RS-485/PIT 时序耦合 → 整机卡在 waiting（板上实测，
         * 屏蔽该调用或仅 isAlive 时读即不卡死）。失链态 cmd 置零：MODE4 launchGate=0、蜂鸣 isAlive
         * 为假不读 cmd 蜂鸣位、SOURCE_IS_LORA 仅在 alive 分支引用，均不受影响。 */
        cmd.vx = 0.0f;
        cmd.vy = 0.0f;
        cmd.wz = 0.0f;
        cmd.cmd = 0u;
        cmd.sysByte = 0u;

        if (linkAlive)
        {
            chassisLinkGetCommand(&cmd);
            if ((previousRunState == CAR_RUN_MODE4) &&
                (core2ControlRuntime.rejoinActive == 0u))
            {
                core2ControlRuntime.rejoinActive = 1u;
                core2ControlRuntime.rejoinReadyMs = 0u;
                core2ControlRuntime.rejoinFenceSeq = core2ControlRuntime.lastCommSeq;
            }
            if (core2ControlRuntime.rejoinActive != 0u)
            {
                if ((core2ControlRuntime.rejoinReadyMs >= 2000u) &&
                    (core2ControlRuntime.commFresh != 0u) &&
                    (core2ControlRuntime.lastCommSeq != core2ControlRuntime.rejoinFenceSeq))
                {
                    core2ControlRuntime.rejoinActive = 0u;
                    core2ControlRuntime.rejoinReadyMs = 0u;
                    core2ControlRuntime.rejoinBarrierTicks = 1u;
                    core2ControlRuntime.runState = CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_SOURCE_IS_LORA(cmd) ? CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED : CAR_RUN_FOLLOW_485;
                }
                else
                {
                    core2ControlRuntime.runState = CAR_RUN_WAIT_LINK;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                core2ControlRuntime.runState = CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_SOURCE_IS_LORA(cmd) ? CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED : CAR_RUN_FOLLOW_485;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            core2ControlRuntime.runState =
                (core2ControlRuntime.rs485DeadMs >= AG_CAR_RS485_WAIT_MS) ? CAR_RUN_MODE4 : CAR_RUN_WAIT_LINK;
        }
        if (core2ControlRuntime.runState != previousRunState)
        {
            core2ControlRuntime.runStateSeq++;
            if (core2ControlRuntime.runStateSeq == 0u) core2ControlRuntime.runStateSeq = 1u;
            ownerEdge = 1u;
        }
        {
            uint8_t ownerValid = 0u;
            uint8_t loraAlive = loraRemoteIsLinkAlive();
            uint8_t launchGate = (cmd.cmd & CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_LAUNCH) ? 1u : 0u;
            if ((core2ControlRuntime.loraLinkPrev != 0u) && (loraAlive == 0u))
            {
                core2ControlRuntime.loraRearmRequired = 1u;
                core2ControlRuntime.loraLaunchLowSeen = 0u;
            }
            core2ControlRuntime.loraLinkPrev = loraAlive;
            if ((loraAlive != 0u) && (launchGate == 0u))
                core2ControlRuntime.loraLaunchLowSeen = 1u;
            if ((core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED) &&
                (loraAlive != 0u) && (launchGate != 0u) &&
                (core2ControlRuntime.loraLaunchLowSeen != 0u))
            {
                core2ControlRuntime.loraRearmRequired = 0u;
            }
            core2ControlRuntime.effectiveLoraLaunchGate = (uint8_t) ((loraAlive != 0u) && (launchGate != 0u) &&
                                                                     (core2ControlRuntime.loraRearmRequired == 0u));
            if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_FOLLOW_485)
            {
                ownerValid = (uint8_t) (linkAlive &&
                                        ((cmd.cmd & CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_ENABLE) != 0u) &&
                                        ((cmd.cmd & CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_ESTOP) == 0u) &&
                                        ((cmd.cmd & CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_LAUNCH) != 0u));
            }
            else if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED)
            {
                ownerValid = (uint8_t) (linkAlive &&
                                        core2ControlRuntime.effectiveLoraLaunchGate);
            }
            else if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_MODE4)
            {
                ownerValid = (uint8_t) (loraRemoteIsLinkAlive() &&
                                        loraRemoteIsUnlocked());
            }
            if (ownerValid != core2ControlRuntime.ownerValidPrev)
            {
                core2ControlRuntime.ownerValidPrev = ownerValid;
                ownerEdge = 1u;
            }
        }
        if (ownerEdge != 0u)
        {
            core2ControlRuntime.rejoinBarrierTicks = 1u;
            loraNavControlAbortSession();
        }

        if (core2ControlRuntime.rejoinBarrierTicks != 0u)
        {
            /* 热回归只清动态控制历史；恰好一个500us拍强制目标与电机输出全零。 */
            core2ControlRuntime.rejoinBarrierTicks--;
            rs485ControlStop();
        }
        else if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_FOLLOW_485)
        {
            /* RS-485 跟随 core1（源=485, 链路活已由上面决策保证）：消费下发运动指令 + 发车门控。
             * 发车门控（每拍 500µs 都查，不分频）：禁止发车的任一条件成立 → 软急停/等待。
             * 条件：收到急停位 / 未收到使能位 / **未收到发车信号(LAUNCH)**（链路失活已在 carRunState
             * 决策中分流到 WAIT_LINK/MODE4，不进本分支）。发车信号来自 core0(经 core1 中转 RS-485
             * cmd LAUNCH 位)——仿 core1 等待上位机发车，上位机未发车则即使有运动指令也禁止发车。
             * 与 LoRa/NAV 急停同语义——等待/急停态跳过本拍 CurrentTick/Output（不再产生 PWM）：
             * 电流环是增量式 PID，StopAll 已清状态，但若同拍再跑 CurrentTick，
             * error=0-feedbackCurrent(非零电流反馈) 会算出非零 motorOutput，形成残余 PWM 脉冲。
             * 故等待/急停态硬停且不输出。 */
            if ((cmd.cmd & CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_ESTOP) || !(cmd.cmd & CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_ENABLE) || !(cmd.cmd & CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_LAUNCH))
            {
                rs485ControlStop(); /* 含遥测态复位（使能关/急停/未发车） */
            }
            else
            {
                /* 使能 + 链路活 + 已发车：按 core1 指令跑级联控制。速度环 2ms 分频，电流环/输出每拍。 */
                core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEnabled = 1u;
                core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEstop = 0u;
                core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlLaunched = 1u;
                core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider++;
                if (core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider >= SPEED_LOOP_DIVIDER)
                {
                    core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider = 0u;
                    rs485ControlRunSpeedLoop(&cmd);
                }
                motorControlCurrentTick();
                motorControlOutput();
            }
        }
        else if ((core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED) ||
                 (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_MODE4))
        {
            /* 源=LoRa(模式3) 或 失链兜底(模式4)：本地 LoRa 双摇杆遥控 + NAV 录制/回放。
             * chord 语义按 standalone 分流(B6)：模式4 脱机 S3+S4 切换本地解锁；模式2/3 联机 S3+S4 发请求，上层按系统模式解释。
             * 驱动门控：模式4=本地解锁；模式3=飞机到顶门控 launchGate(core1 下发 LAUNCH 位)，车禁动直到飞机到顶。 */
            {
                uint8_t standalone = (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_MODE4) ? 1u : 0u;
                uint8_t launchGate = standalone ? 0u : core2ControlRuntime.effectiveLoraLaunchGate;
                core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider = 0u;
                core2ControlRuntime.rs485YawDivider = 0u;
                loraNavControlPit500us(standalone, launchGate);
            }
        }
        else /* CAR_RUN_WAIT_LINK：RS-485 失链但未超时——软急停等待 core1(与原失链急停同语义) */
        {
            rs485ControlStop(); /* 含遥测态复位（使能关/急停/未发车） */
        }

        /* 蜂鸣（单点，恰每拍一次，在上方分支 motorControlOutput 之后）：码源 = RS-485 命令的蜂鸣位
         * （链路活才信，否则 SILENT，避免播放陈旧命令码）。BEEP_PIN 由 buzzer 单一所有者库唯一写：
         * 此处只提交 pattern 码 + runaway 态，事件确认音由 loraNavControl 经 buzzerBeepEvent 提交，
         * 仲裁优先级 runaway > WARN > hardware fault > event > pattern 全在 buzzerTick 内。 */
        {
            /* 蜂鸣码源：链路活 → core0 经 RS-485 中转的码(起飞/巡航/断联WARN/armed-idle)；
             * 链路失 → 本核本地：模式4(脱离飞机系统 >2s，已切本地 LoRa 兜底) = LORA_IDLE 0.5Hz 可辨别提示
             *          (用户要求：每 2s 响 150ms，人耳可辨别的一声声，非 WARN 急促告警；LoRa 锁/解锁确认音仍可穿插)；
             *          WAIT_LINK(等待 RS-485 未超时，尚未进 LoRa) = WAITING 等待连接提示音。 */
            uint8_t buzCode;
            if (chassisLinkIsAlive())
            {
                buzCode = CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_BUZZER(cmd);
            }
            else if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_MODE4)
            {
                buzCode = (uint8_t) CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_LORA_IDLE; /* 本地 LoRa 兜底：0.5Hz 可辨别提示(非急促告警) */
            }
            else
            {
                buzCode = (uint8_t) CHASSIS_LINK_BUZZER_WAITING; /* WAIT_LINK：等待连接提示音 */
            }
            /* 完整资格三声只接受Core0系统资格owner下发的码7；本核不再用局部C0/C1链路猜测。 */
            /* 单一所有者：仅 buzzerTick 写 BEEP。失控态注入仲裁器(最高优先常鸣)；LoRa 事件确认音由
             * loraNavControl 经 buzzerBeepEvent 提交(仲裁器 event>pattern 覆盖)，此处不再分 exclusive。 */
            buzzerSetPattern(buzCode);
            buzzerSetRunaway(motorControlIsRunawayLatched());
            buzzerTick();
        }
    }
#elif (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_CASCADE)
    core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider >= SPEED_LOOP_DIVIDER)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider = 0u;
        chassisApplicationUpdateFeedback();
        updateTuneTarget();
        motorControlSpeedTick();
    }
    motorControlCurrentTick();
    motorControlStopWheelExcept(tuneModeGetSelectedWheel()); /* 仅驱动选中轮，非选中轮空闲 */
    motorControlOutput();
#elif (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_LORA_TEST)
    core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider >= SPEED_LOOP_DIVIDER)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider = 0u;
        chassisApplicationUpdateFeedback();
    }
#elif (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_CURRENT)
    core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider >= SPEED_LOOP_DIVIDER)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider = 0u;
        chassisApplicationUpdateFeedback();
        updateTuneTarget();
    }
    motorControlCurrentTick();
    motorControlStopWheelExcept(tuneModeGetSelectedWheel()); /* 仅驱动选中轮，非选中轮空闲 */
    motorControlOutput();
#elif (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_OPEN_LOOP)
    core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider++;
    if (core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider >= SPEED_LOOP_DIVIDER)
    {
        core2ControlRuntime.speedLoopDivider = 0u;
        chassisApplicationUpdateFeedback();
        updateTuneTarget();
    }
    motorControlOutput();
#endif

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_TUNE)
    /* TUNE：pattern 恒 SILENT(未 setPattern)，仅失控时由 buzzer 仲裁器常鸣。每拍 setRunaway+tick 恰一次。
     * 本块仅 TUNE 编译，与 PRODUCTION 在其 carRunState 分支内 tick 互斥；修复 TUNE 原 BEEP 未 init/失控无鸣缺口。 */
    buzzerSetRunaway(motorControlIsRunawayLatched());
    buzzerTick();
#endif
}

void whileProcess(void)
{
    if (!core2ControlRuntime.initReady) return;

    core2ParamSyncOwnerServicePoll();

    if (core2ControlRuntime.imuReady != 0u) IMUProcess();

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
    /* 先消费交互：参数提交可在同一轮立即进入下方Apply，也不被共享镜像/串口处理拖延。 */
    chassisMenuInputTick();
#endif
    core2RuntimeServiceParamApply();

    /* 标志读-清在关中断临界区内完成，消除 ISR 置位与前台"读-判-清"间的竞态(防丢边沿)。
     * 临界区仅含单字节读+清零，极短；耗时的发送/刷屏在临界区外执行。
     * 用 PRIMASK 存-恢复，绝不用 SDK interrupt_global_disable/enable（坏计数器，与 ISR 高频临界区
     * 竞争会上漂致中断永久关闭整机卡死；详见 chassisLink.c 镜像段注释）。 */
    {
        uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
        uint8_t doDisplay;
        __disable_irq();
        doDisplay = core2ControlRuntime.displayDue;
        core2ControlRuntime.displayDue = 0u;
        __set_PRIMASK(primask);

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
        /* 核间共享内存桥接（RS-485/LoRa 收发已搬到 cm_7_1 通信核）：
         *   (1) 读 cm_7_1 发布的 commToControl（RS-485 命令 + LoRa 解码），刷新本地镜像——
         *       chassisLink/loraRemote 的 getter 经此镜像供 500µs ISR 读（SCB cache 操作只在此前台执行）。
         *   (2) 发布 controlToComm 应答快照：应答类型按 carRunState（LORA_LINKED→LoRa 运动 / 其它→遥测实速）+
         *       遥测实速 + 状态位。cm_7_1 收到 core1 MSG_COMMAND 请求后照发（请求-应答，半双工串行化）。
         * magic 门控防 __no_init 上电垃圾：cm_7_1 未就绪前镜像保持上电默认(IsAlive=0→WAIT_LINK，安全)。 */
        {
            commToControlStruct commSnap;
            controlToCommStruct ctrlSnap;
            chassisMotionCommandStruct loraCmd;
            chassisApplicationSnapshotStruct chassisSnapshot;
            uint8_t status = 0u;

            chassisApplicationGetSnapshot(&chassisSnapshot);
            loraCmd.vx = 0.0f;
            loraCmd.vy = 0.0f;
            loraCmd.wz = 0.0f;

            if (coreDataReadCommToControl(&commSnap) != 0u &&
                ((core2ControlRuntime.commSeen == 0u) ||
                    (commSnap.seq != core2ControlRuntime.lastCommSeq)))
            {
                core2ControlRuntime.lastCommSeq = commSnap.seq;
                core2ControlRuntime.lastCommTickMs = core2ControlRuntime.loopMs;
                core2ControlRuntime.commSeen = 1u;
                core2ControlRuntime.commFresh = 1u;
                chassisLinkMirrorApply(&commSnap);
                loraRemoteMirrorApply(&commSnap);
                core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalStateValid = (uint8_t) (
                    commSnap.paramGlobalStateValid != 0u &&
                    paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(&commSnap.paramGlobalState) != 0u);
                if (core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestValid != 0u)
                {
                    uint8_t cancelReason =
                        core2ParamGlobalRequestCancellationReason(
                            &commSnap.paramGlobalState,
                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalStateValid,
                            &core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequest,
                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestCoordinatorBoot);
                    if (cancelReason != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE)
                        cancelPendingParamGlobalRequest(cancelReason);
                }
                if (core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalStateValid != 0u)
                {

                        commSnap.paramGlobalState;

                        ui.state = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiState;
                        ui.phase = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiPhase;
                        ui.target = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiTarget;
                        ui.error = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiError;
                        ui.action = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiAction;
                        ui.slot = core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiSlot;

                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiState = ui.state;
                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiPhase = ui.phase;
                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiTarget = ui.target;
                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiError = ui.error;
                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiAction = ui.action;
                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiSlot = ui.slot;
                            core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalSlotUiState = ui.slotUiState;

                            {
                                core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestCoordinatorBoot = 0u;
                                core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiEventSequence++;
                                if (core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiEventSequence == 0u)
                                    core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalUiEventSequence = 1u;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if ((core2ControlRuntime.commFresh != 0u) &&
                ((uint32_t) (core2ControlRuntime.loopMs - core2ControlRuntime.lastCommTickMs) >=
                    LORA_LINK_TIMEOUT_MS))
            {
                chassisLinkMirrorInvalidate();
                loraRemoteMirrorInvalidate();
                core2ControlRuntime.commFresh = 0u;
                core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
                cancelPendingParamGlobalRequest(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
            }

            /* 授权位只反映基础运行门；姿态故障通过独立位上报，不撤销底盘授权。 */
            if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_FOLLOW_485)
            {
                if (core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEnabled &&
                    core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlLaunched &&
                    !core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEstop)
                {
                    status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ENABLED;
                    status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_LAUNCHED;
                }
                else if (core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEstop ||
                         core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEnabled ||
                         core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlLaunched)
                {
                    status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ESTOP;
                }
                if (loraRemoteGetRemoteTakeoffReq()) status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_MODE2_LORA_LAND_REQ;
            }
            else if (chassisSnapshot.yawRateEnabled)
            {
                status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ENABLED;
            }
            if (chassisSnapshot.attitudeFaultActive)
                status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ATTITUDE_FAULT;
            if (chassisLinkIsAlive()) status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_LINK_OK;
            if ((core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED) ||
                (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_MODE4))
            {
                uint8_t driveGate = 0u;
                if (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_MODE4)
                {
                    driveGate = loraRemoteIsUnlocked();
                }
                else
                {
                    driveGate = core2ControlRuntime.effectiveLoraLaunchGate;
                }
                loraCmd = loraRemoteGetMotionForGate(driveGate);
            }

            memset(&ctrlSnap, 0, sizeof(ctrlSnap));
            ctrlSnap.magic = CORE2_CTRL_READY_MAGIC;
            ctrlSnap.seq = ++core2ControlRuntime.controlPublishSeq;
            ctrlSnap.replyType = (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED)
                                     ? (uint8_t) CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_LORA_MOTION
                                     : (uint8_t) CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_TELEMETRY;
            ctrlSnap.status = status;
            ctrlSnap.takeoffReq = loraRemoteGetRemoteTakeoffReq(); /* 后备：cm_7_1 通常用本地新鲜值 */
            ctrlSnap.padding0 = 0u;
            ctrlSnap.teleVx = chassisSnapshot.actualSpeed.vx;
            ctrlSnap.teleVy = chassisSnapshot.actualSpeed.vy;
            ctrlSnap.teleWz = chassisSnapshot.actualSpeed.wz;
            ctrlSnap.loraCmdVx = loraCmd.vx;
            ctrlSnap.loraCmdVy = loraCmd.vy;
            ctrlSnap.loraCmdWz = loraCmd.wz;
            ctrlSnap.paramGlobalRequest =
                core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequest;
            ctrlSnap.paramGlobalRequestSeq =
                core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestSequence;
            ctrlSnap.paramGlobalRequestValid =
                core2ControlRuntime.paramGlobalRequestValid;
            coreDataWriteControlToComm(&ctrlSnap);
        }
#else
        /* TUNE 调参固件：comm 仍在 cm_7_0 本地（chassisLink 真实实现）。原请求-应答遥测保留。 */
#if (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_LORA_TEST)
        loraRemotePoll(); /* 前台 owner 接收 SDK 已解析的完整 LoRa 帧并发布业务快照 */
#endif
        chassisLinkPoll();
        if (chassisLinkCommandReceived())
        {
            chassisApplicationSnapshotStruct chassisSnapshot;
            uint8_t status = 0u;
            chassisApplicationGetSnapshot(&chassisSnapshot);
            if (chassisSnapshot.yawRateEnabled)
            {
                status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ENABLED;
            }
            if (chassisSnapshot.attitudeFaultActive)
                status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ATTITUDE_FAULT;
            if (chassisLinkIsAlive()) status |= CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_LINK_OK;
            chassisLinkSendTelemetry(
                chassisSnapshot.actualSpeed.vx,
                chassisSnapshot.actualSpeed.vy,
                chassisSnapshot.actualSpeed.wz,
                status);
        }
#endif

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
        chassisMenuRenderTick(doDisplay);
#endif
#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_TUNE)
        if (doDisplay)
        {
            tuneDisplayUpdate();
        }
#endif
    }

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
    /* 生产态 5 键已由 chassisMenuInputTick 接管（菜单导航 + HOME亮度快调）；lightStripKeyScan 不再挂载。
     * LoRa 前台处理(状态机/导航/显示)仅在 LoRa 激活态(模式3 源=LoRa 或 失链兜底模式4)运行，
     * 与 pitProcess0 的 loraNavControlPit500us 门控一致(FOLLOW_485/WAIT_LINK 不服务 LoRa)。 */
    if ((core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_LORA_LINKED) ||
        (core2ControlRuntime.runState == CAR_RUN_MODE4))
    {
        loraNavControlWhile();
    }
    /* 合并Flash保存放到本轮通信、渲染和业务处理之后，避免阻塞新按键反馈。 */
    chassisMenuServiceDeferred();
#elif (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_CASCADE) || (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_CURRENT) || (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_OPEN_LOOP)
    tuneWheelKeyScan(); /* 调参选轮态：KEY_2..5 直选 FL/FR/BL/BR，KEY_1 复位默认轮（灯条已灭）*/
#endif
}

void core2RuntimeGetSnapshot(core2RuntimeSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    if (out == 0) return;
#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)
    uint32_t irqWasEnabled = NVIC_GetEnableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);
    carRunStateEnum state;
    NVIC_DisableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);
    __DMB();
    state = core2ControlRuntime.runState;
    out->seq = core2ControlRuntime.runStateSeq;
    out->valid = core2ControlRuntime.initReady;
    out->runState = (uint8_t) state;
    out->standalone = (state == CAR_RUN_MODE4) ? 1u : 0u;
    out->core1LinkReady = chassisLinkIsAlive();
    out->core0ViaCore1Ready = chassisLinkGetCore0Alive();
    out->commandFresh = core2ControlRuntime.commFresh;
    out->enabled = core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEnabled;
    out->estop = core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlEstop;
    out->launched = core2ControlRuntime.rs485ControlLaunched;
    out->rejoin = core2ControlRuntime.rejoinActive;
    __DMB();
    if (irqWasEnabled != 0u) NVIC_EnableIRQ(CPUIntIdx2_IRQn);
#else
    out->seq = 0u;
    out->valid = 0u;
    out->runState = 0u;
    out->standalone = 0u;
    out->core1LinkReady = 0u;
    out->core0ViaCore1Ready = 0u;
    out->commandFresh = 0u;
    out->enabled = 0u;
    out->estop = 0u;
    out->launched = 0u;
    out->rejoin = 0u;
#endif
}

typedef enum
{
    CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_IDLE = 0u,
    CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED,
    CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS,
    CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS,
    CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED
} core2ParamGlobalUiState;

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t state;
    uint8_t phase;
    uint8_t target;
    uint8_t error;
    uint8_t action;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t slotUiState;
    uint8_t reserved;
    uint32_t eventSequence;
} core2ParamGlobalUiSnapshot;

static inline uint8_t core2ParamGlobalUiObserve(
    const paramSyncGlobalState *state,
    const paramSyncGlobalRequest *request,
    uint8_t *requestPending,
    core2ParamGlobalUiSnapshot *ui)
{
    if (state == 0 || request == 0 || requestPending == 0 || ui == 0 ||
        *requestPending == 0u ||
        paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(state) == 0u ||
        paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(state, request) == 0u) return 0u;
    ui->phase = state->phase;
    ui->target = state->target;
    ui->error = state->error;
    ui->action = request->action;
    ui->slot = request->slot;
    if ((state->flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) != 0u)
    {
        ui->state = ((state->flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_OK) != 0u) ?
            CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS : CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
        if (request->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            ui->slotUiState = (ui->state == CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS) ?
                paramSyncGlobalClassifySlotSummary(state->transactionId) :
                PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        *requestPending = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((state->flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u)
    {
        ui->state = CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS;
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static inline uint8_t core2ParamGlobalUiCancel(uint8_t *requestPending,
    core2ParamGlobalUiSnapshot *ui, uint8_t error)
{
    if (requestPending == 0 || ui == 0 || *requestPending == 0u) return 0u;
    *requestPending = 0u;
    ui->state = CORE2_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED;
    ui->phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED;
    ui->target = 2u;
    ui->error = error;
    return 1u;
}

static inline uint8_t core2ParamGlobalRequestCancellationReason(
    const paramSyncGlobalState *state, uint8_t stateValid,
    const paramSyncGlobalRequest *request, uint32_t coordinatorBootGeneration)
{
    if (state == 0 || request == 0 || stateValid == 0u ||
        paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(state) == 0u)
        return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE;
    if (coordinatorBootGeneration == 0u ||
        state->coordinatorBootGeneration != coordinatorBootGeneration)
        return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_PEER_RESTART;
    if (paramSyncGlobalStateReady(state) != 0u ||
        paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(state, request) != 0u)
        return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    if ((state->flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY) != 0u)
        return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY;
    return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY;
}

#include "core1Loop.h"

#include "configCore2Build.h" /* CORE2_BUILD_MODE / AG_CAR_RS485_WAIT_MS */
#include "configChassisRemote.h"

#include "zf_driver_pit.h"

/*
 * core2 cm_7_1 = 通信核（生产固件）。
 *
 * 把 RS-485(THVD1450/UART4) 与 LoRa(loraRemote/UART1) 的收发整体放到本空闲核：
 *   - 中断驱动 RX：UART4随ISR搬入THVD本地ring，UART1保留逐飞缓冲，前台 Poll 解析；
 *   - RS-485/LoRa 的 RX 中断风暴只拖慢本核，cm_7_0 的 500µs 控制 PIT 被彻底隔离（历史卡死根因消除）。
 * 经 coreDataTransfer 共享内存与 cm_7_0 控制核桥接：
 *   - 发布 commToControl：RS-485 命令快照 + LoRa 解码运动/解锁/单按边沿(seq)；
 *   - 读取 controlToComm：应答类型 + 遥测实速，收到 core1 MSG_COMMAND 请求后照发（请求-应答）。
 *
 * 调参固件(CORE2_BUILD_TUNE) 下本核保持空占位（comm 仍在 cm_7_0，调参不联机）。
 */

#if (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)

#include <string.h>

#include "chassisLink.h"
#include "loraRemote.h"
#include "coreDataTransfer.h"

#define COMM_TICK_PERIOD_US (1000u) /* PIT_CH2：1ms tick 驱动链路年龄 + LoRa 超时/chord/edge 状态机 */

typedef struct
{
    volatile uint8_t initReady;
    volatile uint32_t rs485DeadMs;
    volatile uint32_t recordSeq;
    volatile uint32_t replaySeq;
    uint32_t publishSeq;
    volatile uint32_t tickMs;
    controlToCommStruct controlSnapshot;
    uint32_t lastControlSeq;
    uint32_t lastControlTickMs;
    uint8_t controlSeen;
} core2CommRuntimeContextStruct;

static core2CommRuntimeContextStruct core2CommRuntime = {0};

void processInit(void)
{
    chassisLinkInit();  /* 真实实现：thvd1450Init（cm_7_1 内已开 UART4 RX 中断 + DE=P13_7） */
    loraRemoteInit();   /* 真实实现：lora3a22_init + 开 UART1 RX 中断 + 状态复位 */

    pit_us_init(PIT_CH2, COMM_TICK_PERIOD_US); /* 1ms tick → pit0_ch2_isr → pitProcess0 */
    core2CommRuntime.initReady = 1u;
}

void pitProcess0(void)
{
    uint8_t standalone;

    if (!core2CommRuntime.initReady) return;

    chassisLinkTickMs(); /* RS-485 链路年龄 +1ms */

    /* 本核失链计时（与 cm_7_0 同语义）：用于 standalone(模式4 脱机) 判定。 */
    if (chassisLinkIsAlive())
    {
        core2CommRuntime.rs485DeadMs = 0u;
    }
    else if (core2CommRuntime.rs485DeadMs < AG_CAR_RS485_WAIT_MS)
    {
        core2CommRuntime.rs485DeadMs++;
    }

    /* standalone=1（模式4 脱机）：S3+S4 chord 切换本地解锁；=0（模式2/3 联机）：chord 置双肩键请求。
     * 与 cm_7_0 carRunState 的模式4 判据一致（RS-485 失链 >AG_CAR_RS485_WAIT_MS），具体语义由上层系统模式解释。 */
    standalone = (core2CommRuntime.rs485DeadMs >= AG_CAR_RS485_WAIT_MS) ? 1u : 0u;
    loraRemoteTickMs(standalone); /* 超时维护 + chord/edge 状态机 */
    core2CommRuntime.tickMs++;

    /* 单按边沿（read-and-clear）转单调 seq，跨核交付给 cm_7_0（防 read-and-clear 跨核竞态）。 */
    if (loraRemoteRecordEdge()) core2CommRuntime.recordSeq++;
    if (loraRemoteReplayEdge()) core2CommRuntime.replaySeq++;
}

void whileProcess(void)
{
    commToControlStruct out;
    controlToCommStruct reply;
    chassisLinkCommandStruct cmd;
    loraRemoteSnapshotStruct loraSnapshot;
    paramSyncGlobalState paramGlobalState;
    uint8_t controlFresh;

    if (!core2CommRuntime.initReady) return;

    /* 1. 前台排空 RX（UART4本地ring/UART1逐飞缓冲），解析帧/LoRa 摇杆。 */
    loraRemotePoll();
    chassisLinkPoll();

    /* 2. 构建并发布 commToControl（cm_7_1 → cm_7_0）。 */
    chassisLinkGetCommand(&cmd);
    loraRemoteGetSnapshot(&loraSnapshot);
    memset(&out, 0, sizeof(out));
    out.magic = CORE2_COMM_READY_MAGIC;
    out.seq = ++core2CommRuntime.publishSeq;
    out.cmdVx = cmd.vx;
    out.cmdVy = cmd.vy;
    out.cmdWz = cmd.wz;
    out.cmd = cmd.cmd;
    out.sysByte = cmd.sysByte;
    out.linkAlive = chassisLinkIsAlive();
    out.loraVxRaw = loraSnapshot.joystick[1];
    out.loraVyRaw = loraSnapshot.joystick[0];
    out.loraWzRaw = loraSnapshot.joystick[2];
    out.loraUnlocked = loraSnapshot.unlocked;
    out.loraLinkAlive = loraSnapshot.linkAlive;
    out.takeoffReq = loraSnapshot.takeoffReq;
    out.recordSeq = core2CommRuntime.recordSeq;
    out.replaySeq = core2CommRuntime.replaySeq;
    if (chassisLinkGetParamGlobalState(&paramGlobalState) != 0u)
    {
        out.paramGlobalState = paramGlobalState;
        out.paramGlobalStateSeq = paramGlobalState.sequence;
        out.paramGlobalStateValid = 1u;
    }
    coreDataWriteCommToControl(&out);

    /* 前台持续刷新控制核应答缓存；事务失败或停更超过500ms时统一按无效处理。 */
    if (coreDataReadControlToComm(&reply) != 0u &&
        ((core2CommRuntime.controlSeen == 0u) || (reply.seq != core2CommRuntime.lastControlSeq)))
    {
        core2CommRuntime.controlSnapshot = reply;
        core2CommRuntime.lastControlSeq = reply.seq;
        core2CommRuntime.lastControlTickMs = core2CommRuntime.tickMs;
        core2CommRuntime.controlSeen = 1u;
    }
    controlFresh = (uint8_t) (core2CommRuntime.controlSeen != 0u &&
        (uint32_t) (core2CommRuntime.tickMs -
                    core2CommRuntime.lastControlTickMs) < LORA_LINK_TIMEOUT_MS);
    if (core2CommRuntime.controlSeen != 0u)
    {
        chassisLinkSetParamGlobalRequest(
            &core2CommRuntime.controlSnapshot.paramGlobalRequest,
            (uint8_t) (controlFresh != 0u &&
                core2CommRuntime.controlSnapshot.paramGlobalRequestValid != 0u));
    }
    /* 3. RS-485 请求-应答：收到 core1 的 MSG_COMMAND 才回一帧应答（半双工总线由 core1 命令串行化）。
     * 应答类型/遥测由 cm_7_0 经 controlToComm 决定；LoRa 运动使用 cm_7_0 按本地参数映射后的命令，
     * 避免通信核编译期默认值与控制核菜单/flash 参数不一致。
     * controlToComm magic 未就绪（cm_7_0 还没发布）时回遥测零值，保持 core1 视为链路在。 */
    if (chassisLinkCommandReceived())
    {
        uint8_t replyValid;
        replyValid = controlFresh;
        if (replyValid != 0u) reply = core2CommRuntime.controlSnapshot;
        else memset(&reply, 0, sizeof(reply));

        if (replyValid && reply.replyType == CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_LORA_MOTION)
        {
            chassisMotionCommandStruct fallback = loraRemoteGetMotion();
            float vx = reply.loraCmdVx;
            float vy = reply.loraCmdVy;
            float wz = reply.loraCmdWz;
            if (reply.seq == 0u)
            {
                vx = fallback.vx;
                vy = fallback.vy;
                wz = fallback.wz;
            }
            chassisLinkSendLoraMotion(vx, vy, wz, loraSnapshot.takeoffReq,
                (uint8_t) ((reply.status & CHASSIS_LINK_STATUS_ATTITUDE_FAULT) != 0u));
        }
        else
        {
            float vx = replyValid ? reply.teleVx : 0.0f;
            float vy = replyValid ? reply.teleVy : 0.0f;
            float wz = replyValid ? reply.teleWz : 0.0f;
            uint8_t status = replyValid ? reply.status : 0u;
            chassisLinkSendTelemetry(vx, vy, wz, status);
        }
    }
}

#else  /* CORE2_BUILD_TUNE：cm_7_1 空占位（comm 仍在 cm_7_0） */

}

{
    if (!core2CommRuntimeInitReady) return;
}

{
    if (!core2CommRuntimeInitReady) return;
}

#endif

#include "lightStrip.h"

#include "menuKey.h"
#include "pinMap.h"

static volatile uint8_t lightStripBrightness = LIGHT_STRIP_DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS;

static uint32_t brightnessToDuty(uint8_t pct)
{
    /* PWM_DUTY_MAX = 10000，pct 0..100 → 0..10000 */
    return (uint32_t) pct * (PWM_DUTY_MAX / 100u);
}

static uint8_t clampBrightness(int16_t value)
{
    if (value < (int16_t) LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MIN)
    {
        return LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MIN;
    }
    if (value > (int16_t) LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MAX)
    {
        return LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MAX;
    }
    return (uint8_t) value;
}

void lightStripInit(void)
{
    lightStripBrightness = LIGHT_STRIP_DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS;
    pwm_init(LIGHT_STRIP_PWM_CHANNEL, LIGHT_STRIP_PWM_FREQ_HZ,
             brightnessToDuty(lightStripBrightness));
}

void lightStripSetBrightness(uint8_t pct)
{
    uint8_t clamped = clampBrightness((int16_t) pct);
    lightStripBrightness = clamped;
    pwm_set_duty(LIGHT_STRIP_PWM_CHANNEL, brightnessToDuty(clamped));
}

/* 消费一次按键事件（短按或长按均算一次，等价原边沿"按一下调一次"，不连发）。
 * 读到非 RELEASE 即 Clear 并返回 1；长按经 Clear 后进入等释放，不会重复触发。 */
static uint8_t keyConsumed(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (menuKeyGetState(k) != MENU_KEY_RELEASE)
    {
        menuKeyClear(k);
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

void lightStripKeyScan(void)
{
    int16_t next = (int16_t) lightStripBrightness;
    uint8_t changed = 0u;

    if (keyConsumed(MENU_KEY_1))
    {
        next = (int16_t) LIGHT_STRIP_DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS;
        changed = 1u;
    }
    if (keyConsumed(MENU_KEY_2))
    {
        next -= (int16_t) LIGHT_STRIP_STEP_COARSE;
        changed = 1u;
    }
    if (keyConsumed(MENU_KEY_3))
    {
        next -= (int16_t) LIGHT_STRIP_STEP_FINE;
        changed = 1u;
    }
    if (keyConsumed(MENU_KEY_4))
    {
        next += (int16_t) LIGHT_STRIP_STEP_FINE;
        changed = 1u;
    }
    if (keyConsumed(MENU_KEY_5))
    {
        next += (int16_t) LIGHT_STRIP_STEP_COARSE;
        changed = 1u;
    }

    if (changed)
    {
        lightStripSetBrightness(clampBrightness(next));
    }
}

#ifndef MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_INTERNAL_H
#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_INTERNAL_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "zf_device_ips114.h"

#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX (8u)
#define MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS        (15u)

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDigitsU64(uint64_t value)
{
    uint8_t digits = 1u;

    while (value >= 10u)
    {
        value /= 10u;
        digits++;
    }
    return digits;
}

static void menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(uint16_t x,
    uint16_t y,
    const char *literal)
{
    char buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS + 1u];
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t length = 0u;

    while ((literal[length] != '\0') && (length < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS))
    {
        length++;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS; i++)
    {
        buf[i] = ' ';
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < length; i++)
    {
        buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS - length + i] = literal[i];
    }
    buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS] = '\0';
    ips114_show_string(x, y, buf);
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForStep(float step)
{
    uint8_t decimals = 0u;
    double scaled = (step < 0.0f) ? -(double) step : (double) step;

    if (!(scaled > 0.0))
    {
        return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    }
    while (decimals < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX)
    {
        uint64_t rounded;
        double difference;

        if (!(scaled < (double) UINT64_MAX) ||
            !((scaled + 0.5) < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
        }
        rounded = (uint64_t) (scaled + 0.5);
        difference = scaled - (double) rounded;

        if (difference < 0.0)
        {
            difference = -difference;
        }
        if (difference <= 0.000001)
        {
            break;
        }
        scaled *= 10.0;
        decimals++;
    }
    return decimals;
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValue(double value)
{
    uint8_t decimals;
    double scale = 1.0;
    double tolerance = 0.0000001;

    if (value < 0.0)
    {
        value = -value;
    }
    if (!(value >= 0.0) || !(value < (double) UINT64_MAX))
    {
        return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    }
    for (decimals = 0u; decimals < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX; decimals++)
    {
        double scaled = value * scale;
        uint64_t rounded;
        double difference;

        if (!(scaled < (double) UINT64_MAX) ||
            !((scaled + 0.5) < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
        }
        rounded = (uint64_t) (scaled + 0.5);
        difference = value - ((double) rounded / scale);

        if (difference < 0.0)
        {
            difference = -difference;
        }
        if (difference <= tolerance)
        {
            return decimals;
        }
        scale *= 10.0;
    }
    return MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
}

static uint8_t menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValueAndStep(double value, float step)
{
    uint8_t stepDecimals = menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForStep(step);
    uint8_t valueDecimals = menuFloatDisplayDecimalsForValue(value);

    return (stepDecimals > valueDecimals) ? stepDecimals : valueDecimals;
}

static void menuFloatDisplayShow(uint16_t x,
    uint16_t y,
    double value,
    uint8_t requestedDecimals)
{
    static const uint64_t scaleTable[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX + 1u] =
    {
        1u, 10u, 100u, 1000u, 10000u,
        100000u, 1000000u, 10000000u, 100000000u
    };
    char buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS + 1u];
    uint8_t decimals;
    uint8_t selectedDecimals = 0xFFu;
    uint8_t negative = 0u;
    uint8_t pos;
    uint8_t i;
    uint64_t scale = 1u;
    uint64_t scaled = 0u;
    uint64_t intPart;
    uint64_t fracPart;

    if (value != value)
    {
        menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(x, y, "NAN");
        return;
    }
    if (value < 0.0)
    {
        negative = 1u;
        value = -value;
    }

    decimals = (requestedDecimals <= MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX)
        ? requestedDecimals
        : MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_DECIMALS_MAX;
    for (;; decimals--)
    {
        double scaledDouble;
        double roundedDouble;
        uint8_t required;

        scale = scaleTable[decimals];
        scaledDouble = value * (double) scale;
        roundedDouble = scaledDouble + 0.5;
        if ((scaledDouble < (double) UINT64_MAX) &&
            (roundedDouble < (double) UINT64_MAX))
        {
            scaled = (uint64_t) roundedDouble;
            intPart = scaled / scale;
            required = (uint8_t) (negative + menuFloatDisplayDigitsU64(intPart));
            if (decimals != 0u)
            {
                required = (uint8_t) (required + 1u + decimals);
            }
            if (required <= MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS)
            {
                selectedDecimals = decimals;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (decimals == 0u)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    if (selectedDecimals == 0xFFu)
    {
        menuFloatDisplayShowLiteral(x, y, "OVERFLOW");
        return;
    }

    for (i = 0u; i < MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS; i++)
    {
        buf[i] = ' ';
    }
    buf[MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS] = '\0';
    intPart = scaled / scale;
    fracPart = scaled % scale;
    pos = MENU_FLOAT_DISPLAY_CHARS;
    for (i = 0u; i < selectedDecimals; i++)
    {
        buf[--pos] = (char) ('0' + (fracPart % 10u));
        fracPart /= 10u;
    }
    if (selectedDecimals != 0u)
    {
        buf[--pos] = '.';
    }
    do
    {
        buf[--pos] = (char) ('0' + (intPart % 10u));
        intPart /= 10u;
    } while ((intPart != 0u) && (pos > 0u));
    if ((negative != 0u) && (pos > 0u))
    {
        buf[--pos] = '-';
    }

    ips114_show_string(x, y, buf);
}

/*
 * 实现：5 路 GPI 上拉，按下 = GPIO_LOW（移植自 core0 menuKey，逻辑等价）。
 *   menuKeyScan 在 PIT ISR 周期调用，按 zf_device_key 等价语义实现：
 *     - KEY_RELEASE_LEVEL  = GPIO_HIGH（释放）
 *     - SHOCK_PERIOD_MS    = 10ms（消抖）
 *     - LONG_PERIOD_MS     = 1000ms（短按/长按门限）
 *   时间门限按 scanPeriodMs 累计（与调用周期解耦）：core2 以 1ms 调用即 10/1000 拍。
 *   功能：短按锁存到 menuKeyClear；短按超时自动清；长按消费后等物理释放防重复触发。
 *   引脚 core2 顺序：KEY_1=P19_4 ... KEY_5=P20_3（pinMap.h KEY_INPUT_KEYx_PIN）。
 */

#define MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS   (1000u)

{
    KEY_INPUT_KEY1_PIN, /* KEY_1 = P19_4 */
    KEY_INPUT_KEY2_PIN, /* KEY_2 = P20_0 */
    KEY_INPUT_KEY3_PIN, /* KEY_3 = P20_1 */
    KEY_INPUT_KEY4_PIN, /* KEY_4 = P20_2 */
    KEY_INPUT_KEY5_PIN, /* KEY_5 = P20_3 */
};

#ifndef _MENU_KEY_H_
#define _MENU_KEY_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core2 板载按键扫描封装（移植自 core0 cm_7_1 menuKey，状态机版）
 *
 *   替代原 keyInput 边沿驱动：提供 短按 / 长按 区分 + 锁存 + 超时清 + 等释放。
 *   实现：
 *     - 5 路 GPIO 直读（pinMap.h KEY_INPUT_KEYx_PIN）+ 周期消抖
 *     - 短按 / 长按 区分（释放时根据持续时长判定）
 *     - 短按锁存：短按事件保留至 menuKeyGetState 读取后由 menuKeyClear 清除
 *     - 短按长时间未消费时自动超时清除（防陈旧事件误触发）
 *     - 长按消费(menuKeyClear)后置"等释放"：按住期间不再重复触发，必须物理释放后才允许下一次事件
 *
 *   引脚顺序：core2 主板 KEY_1=P19_4，KEY_2..5=P20_0..P20_3（与 coreT1/coreT2 反向，
 *   也与 core0 menuKey 的 KEY_1=P20_3 反向）。索引语义见 pinMap.h。
 *
 *   线程模型：
 *     menuKeyScan() 在 PIT ISR 周期调用（core2：500µs PIT ÷KEY_TICK_DIVIDER = 1ms）；
 *     menuKeyGetState/Clear 在前台消费；状态数组 volatile 跨 ISR/前台共享。
 */

typedef enum
{
    MENU_KEY_1 = 0u,
    MENU_KEY_2,
    MENU_KEY_3,
    MENU_KEY_4,
    MENU_KEY_5,
    MENU_KEY_COUNT
} menuKeyIndexEnum;

typedef enum
{
    MENU_KEY_RELEASE = 0u,
    MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS,
    MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS
} menuKeyStateEnum;

/* 初始化：配置 GPI 上拉 + 清状态。periodMs = 调用 menuKeyScan 的周期(毫秒) */
void menuKeyInit(uint32_t periodMs);

/* 扫描：在 PIT ISR 周期调用 */
void menuKeyScan(void);

/* 查询按键状态（短按事件保留至 menuKeyClear 调用） */
menuKeyStateEnum menuKeyGetState(menuKeyIndexEnum k);

/* 清除指定按键状态（消费事件） */
void menuKeyClear(menuKeyIndexEnum k);
void menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease(menuKeyIndexEnum k);

#endif /* _MENU_KEY_H_ */

SHA-256：59535b1e043685925409616f368a3a31b77aec3c8e1a5054def43f33e20be6e5
代码（c）
#ifndef MENU_KEY_STATE_MACHINE_IMPL_H
#define MENU_KEY_STATE_MACHINE_IMPL_H

/* 单翻译单元实现片段：由 menuKey.c 在目标专用 keyPins 定义后包含一次。 */
static volatile uint32_t scanPeriodMs = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t pressTimeMs[MENU_KEY_COUNT];
static volatile uint32_t shortHoldMs[MENU_KEY_COUNT];
static volatile menuKeyStateEnum keyState[MENU_KEY_COUNT];
static volatile uint8_t waitRelease[MENU_KEY_COUNT]; /* 消费后等物理释放，防长按按住期间重复触发 */

void menuKeyInit(uint32_t periodMs)
{
    if (periodMs == 0u) periodMs = 1u;
    scanPeriodMs = periodMs;
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < MENU_KEY_COUNT; i++)
    {
        gpio_init(keyPins[i], GPI, GPIO_HIGH, GPI_PULL_UP);
        keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
        pressTimeMs[i] = 0u;
        shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
        waitRelease[i] = 0u;
    }
}

void menuKeyScan(void)
{
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < MENU_KEY_COUNT; i++)
    {
        uint8_t pressed = (gpio_get_level(keyPins[i]) != MENU_KEY_RELEASE_LEVEL) ? 1u : 0u;

        /* 等释放期间：忽略按键直到物理释放，期间不累计、不产状态 */
        if (waitRelease[i])
        {
            if (!pressed)
            {
                waitRelease[i] = 0u;
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
                pressTimeMs[i] = 0u;
                shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
            }
            continue;
        }

        /* 短按状态锁存超时清除 */
        if (keyState[i] == MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
        {
            shortHoldMs[i] += scanPeriodMs;
            if (shortHoldMs[i] >= MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS)
            {
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
                shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
            }
        }

        if (pressed)
        {
            /* 按下：累计时长，达长按门限即升级为长按 */
            pressTimeMs[i] += scanPeriodMs;
            if (pressTimeMs[i] >= MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS)
            {
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* 释放：根据持续时长判定短按/释放 */
            if (keyState[i] != MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS &&
                pressTimeMs[i] >= MENU_KEY_SHOCK_PERIOD_MS &&
                pressTimeMs[i] < MENU_KEY_LONG_PERIOD_MS)
            {
                if (keyState[i] != MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS)
                {
                    keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS;
                    shortHoldMs[i] = 0u;
                }
            }
            else if ((keyState[i] != MENU_KEY_SHORT_PRESS) &&
                     (keyState[i] != MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS))
            {
                keyState[i] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
            }
            pressTimeMs[i] = 0u;
        }
    }
}

menuKeyStateEnum menuKeyGetState(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (k >= MENU_KEY_COUNT) return MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
    return keyState[k];
}

void menuKeyClear(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (k >= MENU_KEY_COUNT) return;
    /* 长按消费后置等释放：防按住期间 scan 立刻再次升级为 LONG_PRESS 重复触发。
     * 短按消费正常清零即可（短按事件本就一次性锁存）。 */
    if (keyState[k] == MENU_KEY_LONG_PRESS) waitRelease[k] = 1u;
    keyState[k] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
    pressTimeMs[k] = 0u;
    shortHoldMs[k] = 0u;
}

void menuKeyDiscardUntilRelease(menuKeyIndexEnum k)
{
    if (k >= MENU_KEY_COUNT) return;
    waitRelease[k] = 1u;
    keyState[k] = MENU_KEY_RELEASE;
    pressTimeMs[k] = 0u;
    shortHoldMs[k] = 0u;
}

#endif

static inline uint8_t core2ParamSyncMotorSnapshotIsStopped(
    const motorControlSnapshotStruct *motor)
{

        !isfinite(motor->fl.feedbackSpeed) ||
        !isfinite(motor->fr.feedbackSpeed) ||
        !isfinite(motor->bl.feedbackSpeed) ||
        !isfinite(motor->br.feedbackSpeed) ||
        !isfinite(motor->fl.motorOutput) ||
        !isfinite(motor->fr.motorOutput) ||
        !isfinite(motor->bl.motorOutput) ||
        !isfinite(motor->br.motorOutput) ||
        motor->fl.feedbackSpeed != 0.0f ||
        motor->fr.feedbackSpeed != 0.0f ||
        motor->bl.feedbackSpeed != 0.0f ||
        motor->br.feedbackSpeed != 0.0f ||
        motor->fl.motorOutput != 0.0f ||
        motor->fr.motorOutput != 0.0f ||
        motor->bl.motorOutput != 0.0f ||
        motor->br.motorOutput != 0.0f) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}
