SHA-256：92ccd93183850cd48e9fab8717e18034da3a2de8fab9b1528c327c566c431c51
代码（c）
/*
 * core2 核间共享内存 (cm_7_1 通信核 ↔ cm_7_0 控制核)
 *
 * 物理区域: section .global_ram_data
 *   startAddr = 0x28001000, size = 0x2000（core2 .icf 已定义，与 core0/core1 同源空闲段）
 *
 * 背景: RS-485(THVD1450/UART4) 与 LoRa(loraRemote/UART1) 的收发整体搬到空闲的 cm_7_1（通信核），
 *   cm_7_1 重新启用中断驱动 RX（库 uart_query_byte 依赖 RX ISR 填软件缓冲），其 UART 中断风暴只会
 *   拖慢空闲的 cm_7_1，cm_7_0 的 500µs 控制环被彻底隔离。两核经本共享内存桥接高层状态。
 *
 * 方向:
 *   commToControl  (cm_7_1 → cm_7_0): RS-485 解码命令 + LoRa 原始摇杆/解锁/边沿，控制核按本地参数映射后驱动电机。
 *   controlToComm  (cm_7_0 → cm_7_1): 应答快照（应答类型 + 遥测实速 + 已应用 LoRa 运动命令），通信核收到 core1 请求后照发。
 *
 * 双核 D-Cache 一致性 (Cortex-M7, cache line=32B), 照搬 core0/core1 coreDataTransfer:
 *   写方 memcpy→SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr; 读方 SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr→memcpy。
 *   握手 32 位 magic 防 __no_init 上电垃圾; recordSeq/replaySeq 单调计数跨核交付单按边沿（不可 read-and-clear）。
 *   两区相隔 256B(0x100) 各占独立 cache line，无伪共享。
 */
#ifndef _CORE2_DATA_TRANSFER_H_
#define _CORE2_DATA_TRANSFER_H_

#include <stdint.h>

#include "paramSyncMailbox.h"
#include "paramSyncGlobal.h"

/* ============================================================
 * 区 A: cm_7_1 通信核 → cm_7_0 控制核 (commToControl)
 * ============================================================ */
#define CORE2_COMM_TO_CTRL_ADDR (0x28001000u)
#define CORE2_COMM_READY_MAGIC  (0x5A5AA5A4u)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t magic;       /* = CORE2_COMM_READY_MAGIC，cm_7_1 初始化完成后置位（防 __no_init 上电垃圾） */
    uint32_t seq;         /* 事务开始代数，由coreDataTransfer owner填写 */

    /* ---- RS-485 命令快照（由 core1 MSG_COMMAND 解码）---- */
    float    cmdVx;       /* core1 目标 vx */
    float    cmdVy;       /* core1 目标 vy */
    float    cmdWz;       /* core1 目标 wz */
    uint8_t  cmd;         /* CHASSIS_LINK_CMD_*（ESTOP/ENABLE/LAUNCH/CORE0_ALIVE） */
    uint8_t  sysByte;     /* CHASSIS_LINK_SYS_*（控制源位 + 蜂鸣码） */
    uint8_t  linkAlive;   /* 1=RS-485 链路活（cm_7_1 侧 age 未超时） */
    uint8_t  padding0;

    /* ---- LoRa 解码快照（cm_7_1 本地解码 + chord/边沿状态机）----
     * 只跨核传原始摇杆，cm_7_0 的 loraRemote owner 用 runtime 下发的窄配置映射，避免双核参数不一致。 */
    int16_t  loraVxRaw;   /* joystick[1]：左摇杆上下 */
    int16_t  loraVyRaw;   /* joystick[0]：左摇杆左右，右推为 +vy */
    int16_t  loraWzRaw;   /* joystick[2]：右摇杆左右 */
    int16_t  loraRawPad;  /* 对齐填充：3×int16 摇杆后补到 8 字节边界 */
    uint8_t  loraUnlocked;   /* loraRemoteIsUnlocked() */
    uint8_t  loraLinkAlive;  /* loraRemoteIsLinkAlive() */
    uint8_t  takeoffReq;     /* loraRemoteGetRemoteTakeoffReq()（联机 S3+S4 请求；模式2/3 由上层链路分流） */
    uint8_t  padding1;

    /* ---- 单按边沿以单调 seq 计数交付（不可跨核 read-and-clear）----
     * cm_7_1 每检测到一次单按上升沿 +1；cm_7_0 保留各自 last-consumed，正增量触发一次。
     * 容忍发布(~1ms)与消费(~500µs ISR)节拍差，无丢/无重；boot 首见基线同步防伪边沿。 */
    uint32_t recordSeq;   /* S4 单按边沿计数 */
    uint32_t replaySeq;   /* S3 单按边沿计数 */

    uint32_t paramGlobalStateSeq;
    paramSyncGlobalState paramGlobalState;
    uint8_t  paramGlobalStateValid;
    uint8_t  padding2[15];
    uint32_t publishConfirm; /* 事务结束代数，必须与seq相等且为偶数 */
} commToControlStruct;

typedef char core2_comm_to_control_size_assert[(sizeof(commToControlStruct) == 96u) ? 1 : -1];

/* cm_7_1 调用：发布通信→控制快照 (Clean) */
void coreDataWriteCommToControl(const commToControlStruct* src);
/* cm_7_0 调用：读取通信→控制快照 (Invalidate) */
uint8_t coreDataReadCommToControl(commToControlStruct* dst);

/* ============================================================
 * 区 B: cm_7_0 控制核 → cm_7_1 通信核 (controlToComm)
 *   另起 cache line，与 64B 的 commToControl(0x28001000) 无重叠。
 * ============================================================ */
#define CORE2_CTRL_TO_COMM_ADDR (0x28001100u)
#define CORE2_CTRL_READY_MAGIC  (0xA5A55A5Bu)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t magic;       /* = CORE2_CTRL_READY_MAGIC */
    uint32_t seq;         /* 事务开始代数，由coreDataTransfer owner填写 */

    uint8_t  replyType;   /* 应答类型 = CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_TELEMETRY | CHASSIS_LINK_MSG_LORA_MOTION */
    uint8_t  status;      /* 遥测状态位（ENABLED/LINK_OK/ESTOP/LAUNCHED），TELEMETRY 用 */
    uint8_t  takeoffReq;  /* LORA_MOTION payload[13] bit0（cm_7_1 通常用本地新鲜值，此为后备） */
    uint8_t  padding0;

    float    teleVx;      /* TELEMETRY: 编码器正解算实速 vx */
    float    teleVy;      /* TELEMETRY: 实速 vy */
    float    teleWz;      /* TELEMETRY: 陀螺 yawRate */

    float    loraCmdVx;   /* LORA_MOTION: cm_7_0 按本地参数映射并实际应用的 LoRa vx(m/s) */
    float    loraCmdVy;
    float    loraCmdWz;

    paramSyncGlobalRequest paramGlobalRequest;
    uint32_t paramGlobalRequestSeq;
    uint8_t  paramGlobalRequestValid;
    uint8_t  padding1[7];
    uint32_t publishConfirm; /* 事务结束代数，必须与seq相等且为偶数 */
} controlToCommStruct;

typedef char core2_control_to_comm_size_assert[(sizeof(controlToCommStruct) == 64u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core2_comm_to_control_alignment_assert[((CORE2_COMM_TO_CTRL_ADDR & 31u) == 0u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core2_control_to_comm_alignment_assert[((CORE2_CTRL_TO_COMM_ADDR & 31u) == 0u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core2_shared_regions_nonoverlap_assert[
    ((CORE2_COMM_TO_CTRL_ADDR + sizeof(commToControlStruct)) <= CORE2_CTRL_TO_COMM_ADDR) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core2_control_before_param_sync_assert[
    ((CORE2_CTRL_TO_COMM_ADDR + sizeof(controlToCommStruct)) <=
        PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_ADDR) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core2_param_sync_region_end_assert[
    ((PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_ADDR + PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REGION_BYTES) <=
        0x28002000u) ? 1 : -1];

/* cm_7_0 调用：发布应答快照 (Clean) */
void coreDataWriteControlToComm(const controlToCommStruct* src);
/* cm_7_1 调用：读取应答快照 (Invalidate) */
uint8_t coreDataReadControlToComm(controlToCommStruct* dst);

#endif  /* _CORE2_DATA_TRANSFER_H_ */

#include "loraNavControl.h"

#include "buzzer.h"          /* buzzerBeepEvent：事件确认音改经单一所有者蜂鸣器库提交，不再直写 BEEP */

#include "pinMap.h"
#include "zf_driver_gpio.h"
#include "zf_common_interrupt.h" /* snapshot 发布代数内存屏障 */

typedef struct
{
    wheelSpeedStruct baseTargetSpeed;
    float wz;
    int32_t flAccum;
    int32_t frAccum;
    int32_t blAccum;
    int32_t brAccum;
} loraNavControlFrameStruct;

typedef struct
{
    loraNavControlFrameStruct frames[LORA_NAV_MAX_FRAMES];
    loraNavControlSnapshotStruct status;
    uint8_t speedLoopDividerCount;
    uint8_t yawRateLoopDividerCount;
    uint8_t loraTickDividerCount;
    uint8_t lockPrevUnlocked;
    uint8_t linkInitReady;
    uint16_t linkAliveTickCount;
    uint16_t linkLostTickCount;
    float correctionKp;
    float correctionLimit;
    float errorLimitPulses;
    float loraVMaxMps;
    float loraWzMaxRadps;
} loraNavControlContextStruct;

static loraNavControlContextStruct loraNavContext = {0};
static volatile loraNavControlSnapshotStruct loraNavPublished = {.state = LORA_NAV_IDLE};
static volatile uint32_t loraNavPublishGeneration = 0u;

static const chassisMotionCommandStruct NAV_ZERO_COMMAND = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};

static void loraNavControlPublish(void);

/* 对称限幅薄包装：复用 commonDef.h::clampSym（消除重复实现）。
 * 保留为函数而非内联宏，保证调用点只求值一次。 */
static float navClampFloat(float value, float limit)
{
    return clampSym(value, limit);
}

static float navRampScale(uint16_t index, uint16_t count)
{
    uint16_t remaining;
    float startScale = 1.0f;
    float endScale = 1.0f;

    if (NAV_RAMP_FRAMES == 0u)
    {
        return 1.0f;
    }

    if (index < NAV_RAMP_FRAMES)
    {
        startScale = (float) (index + 1u) / (float) NAV_RAMP_FRAMES;
    }

    remaining = count - index;
    if (remaining < NAV_RAMP_FRAMES)
    {
        endScale = (float) remaining / (float) NAV_RAMP_FRAMES;
    }

    return (startScale < endScale) ? startScale : endScale;
}

static void navResetActualAccum(void)
{
    loraNavContext.status.flActualAccum = 0;
    loraNavContext.status.frActualAccum = 0;
    loraNavContext.status.blActualAccum = 0;
    loraNavContext.status.brActualAccum = 0;
    loraNavContext.status.flError = 0.0f;
    loraNavContext.status.frError = 0.0f;
    loraNavContext.status.blError = 0.0f;
    loraNavContext.status.brError = 0.0f;
}

static void navStopMotion(loraNavControlStateEnum nextState)
{
    loraNavContext.speedLoopDividerCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount = 0u;
    chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(0u);
    chassisApplicationStop();
    motorControlStopAll();
    loraNavContext.status.state = nextState;
}

static uint8_t navIsManualDriveState(loraNavControlStateEnum state)
{
    return (state == LORA_NAV_IDLE || state == LORA_NAV_READY || state == LORA_NAV_DONE) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static uint8_t navShouldRunOutput(loraNavControlStateEnum state)
{
    return (navIsManualDriveState(state) || state == LORA_NAV_RECORDING || state == LORA_NAV_REPLAYING) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static void navStartRecording(void)
{
    loraNavContext.status.frameCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.status.frameIndex = 0u;
    navResetActualAccum();
    motorControlStopAll();
    loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount = 0u;
    chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(1u);
    loraNavContext.status.state = LORA_NAV_RECORDING;
    buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_SHORT);
}

static void navFinishRecording(void)
{
    if (loraNavContext.status.frameCount == 0u)
    {
        navStopMotion(LORA_NAV_IDLE);
    }
    else
    {
        navStopMotion(LORA_NAV_READY);
        buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_LONG);
    }
}

static void navStartReplay(void)
{
    if (loraNavContext.status.frameCount == 0u)
    {
        navStopMotion(LORA_NAV_ERROR);
        buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_LONG);
        return;
    }

    loraNavContext.status.frameIndex = 0u;
    navResetActualAccum();
    motorControlStopAll();
    /* 回放保留录制基准轮速/编码器纠偏，并由当前姿态环独占旋转修正。 */
    chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(1u);
    loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.status.state = LORA_NAV_REPLAYING;
    buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_SHORT);
}

static void navAccumulateEncoder(encoderDataStruct encoderData)
{
    loraNavContext.status.flActualAccum += encoderData.flCount;
    loraNavContext.status.frActualAccum += encoderData.frCount;
    loraNavContext.status.blActualAccum += encoderData.blCount;
    loraNavContext.status.brActualAccum += encoderData.brCount;
}

static void navRecordFrame(void)
{
    uint16_t frameIndex = loraNavContext.status.frameCount;
    chassisApplicationSnapshotStruct snapshot;

    if (frameIndex >= LORA_NAV_MAX_FRAMES)
    {
        navFinishRecording();
        return;
    }

    chassisApplicationGetSnapshot(&snapshot);
    loraNavContext.frames[frameIndex].baseTargetSpeed = snapshot.baseWheelSpeed;
    loraNavContext.frames[frameIndex].wz = snapshot.targetCommand.wz;
    loraNavContext.frames[frameIndex].flAccum = loraNavContext.status.flActualAccum;
    loraNavContext.frames[frameIndex].frAccum = loraNavContext.status.frActualAccum;
    loraNavContext.frames[frameIndex].blAccum = loraNavContext.status.blActualAccum;
    loraNavContext.frames[frameIndex].brAccum = loraNavContext.status.brActualAccum;
    loraNavContext.status.frameCount = frameIndex + 1u;
}

static void navApplyReplayFrame(void)
{
    uint16_t frameIndex = loraNavContext.status.frameIndex;
    const loraNavControlFrameStruct* frame;
    wheelSpeedStruct baseTargetSpeed;
    wheelSpeedStruct encoderCorrection;
    chassisMotionCommandStruct replayCommand;
    float rampScale;
    float errorLimit = loraNavContext.errorLimitPulses;
    float correctionKp = loraNavContext.correctionKp;
    float correctionLimit = loraNavContext.correctionLimit;
    float rotationProjection;

    if (frameIndex >= loraNavContext.status.frameCount)
    {
        navStopMotion(LORA_NAV_DONE);
        buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_LONG);
        return;
    }

    frame = &loraNavContext.frames[frameIndex];
    loraNavContext.status.flError = (float) (frame->flAccum - loraNavContext.status.flActualAccum);
    loraNavContext.status.frError = (float) (frame->frAccum - loraNavContext.status.frActualAccum);
    loraNavContext.status.blError = (float) (frame->blAccum - loraNavContext.status.blActualAccum);
    loraNavContext.status.brError = (float) (frame->brAccum - loraNavContext.status.brActualAccum);

    /* 历史yaw修正属于旋转owner：先从累计误差中剔除旋转模态，再判错和纠偏。 */
    rotationProjection = (-loraNavContext.status.flError +
        loraNavContext.status.frError - loraNavContext.status.blError +
        loraNavContext.status.brError) * 0.25f;
    loraNavContext.status.flError += rotationProjection;
    loraNavContext.status.frError -= rotationProjection;
    loraNavContext.status.blError += rotationProjection;
    loraNavContext.status.brError -= rotationProjection;

    if (absf(loraNavContext.status.flError) > errorLimit ||
        absf(loraNavContext.status.frError) > errorLimit ||
        absf(loraNavContext.status.blError) > errorLimit ||
        absf(loraNavContext.status.brError) > errorLimit)
    {
        navStopMotion(LORA_NAV_ERROR);
        buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_LONG);
        return;
    }

    rampScale = navRampScale(frameIndex, loraNavContext.status.frameCount);
    baseTargetSpeed.fl = frame->baseTargetSpeed.fl * rampScale;
    baseTargetSpeed.fr = frame->baseTargetSpeed.fr * rampScale;
    baseTargetSpeed.bl = frame->baseTargetSpeed.bl * rampScale;
    baseTargetSpeed.br = frame->baseTargetSpeed.br * rampScale;
    encoderCorrection.fl = navClampFloat(
        correctionKp * loraNavContext.status.flError, correctionLimit);
    encoderCorrection.fr = navClampFloat(
        correctionKp * loraNavContext.status.frError, correctionLimit);
    encoderCorrection.bl = navClampFloat(
        correctionKp * loraNavContext.status.blError, correctionLimit);
    encoderCorrection.br = navClampFloat(
        correctionKp * loraNavContext.status.brError, correctionLimit);

    replayCommand.vx = 0.0f;
    replayCommand.vy = 0.0f;
    replayCommand.wz = frame->wz * rampScale;
    chassisApplicationSetMotionCommand(replayCommand);
    loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount++;
    if (loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount >= YAW_RATE_LOOP_DIVIDER)
    {
        loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount = 0u;
        chassisApplicationYawRateTick();
    }
    chassisApplicationApplyReplayWheelTarget(
        baseTargetSpeed,
        encoderCorrection,
        replayCommand.wz);
    loraNavContext.status.frameIndex = frameIndex + 1u;
}

static void navApplyRemoteCommand(void)
{
    chassisMotionCommandStruct cmd;
    /* 上层已完成模式3/模式4 driveGate；这里按 loraRemote owner 缓存的窄配置映射 raw 摇杆。 */
    cmd = loraRemoteGetMotionForGate(1u);
    chassisApplicationSetMotionCommand(cmd);

    /* 角速度环 6ms 节拍（YAW_RATE_LOOP_DIVIDER） */
    loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount++;
    if (loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount >= YAW_RATE_LOOP_DIVIDER)
    {
        loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount = 0u;
        chassisApplicationYawRateTick();
    }

    chassisApplicationApplyCommandWithLimit(
        cmd,
        loraNavContext.loraVMaxMps,
        loraNavContext.loraWzMaxRadps);
}

static void navDrainPendingEdges(void)
{
    /* 链路未就绪 / 锁定 / 链路丢失 期间, 把残留的单按事件丢弃, 防止恢复后误触发 */
    (void) loraRemoteRecordEdge();
    (void) loraRemoteReplayEdge();
}

void loraNavControlInit(void)
{
    const loraRemoteParamViewStruct remoteParams = {
        LORA_V_MAX_MPS, LORA_WZ_MAX_RADPS, (float) LORA_STICK_DEADZONE};
    const loraNavControlParamViewStruct navParams = {
        NAV_CORRECTION_KP, NAV_CORRECTION_LIMIT, NAV_ERROR_LIMIT_PULSES,
        LORA_V_MAX_MPS, LORA_WZ_MAX_RADPS};

    loraRemoteInit();
    loraRemoteApplyParams(&remoteParams);
    loraNavControlApplyParams(&navParams);

    loraNavContext.speedLoopDividerCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.yawRateLoopDividerCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.loraTickDividerCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.lockPrevUnlocked = 0u;
    loraNavContext.linkInitReady = 0u;
    loraNavContext.linkAliveTickCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.linkLostTickCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.status.frameCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.status.frameIndex = 0u;
    navResetActualAccum();
    chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(0u);
    loraNavContext.status.state = LORA_NAV_IDLE;
    loraNavContext.status.seq = 0u;
    loraNavContext.status.valid = 1u;
    loraNavControlPublish();
}

void loraNavControlAbortSession(void)
{
    loraNavContext.status.frameCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.status.frameIndex = 0u;
    loraNavContext.linkAliveTickCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.linkLostTickCount = 0u;
    loraNavContext.lockPrevUnlocked = 0u;
    navResetActualAccum();
    navDrainPendingEdges();
    loraNavContext.status.state = LORA_NAV_IDLE;
    loraNavControlPublish();
}

void loraNavControlApplyParams(const loraNavControlParamViewStruct *params)
{
    if (params == 0) return;
    loraNavContext.correctionKp = params->correctionKp;
    loraNavContext.correctionLimit = params->correctionLimit;
    loraNavContext.errorLimitPulses = params->errorLimitPulses;
    loraNavContext.loraVMaxMps = params->loraVMaxMps;
    loraNavContext.loraWzMaxRadps = params->loraWzMaxRadps;
}

void loraNavControlPit500us(uint8_t standalone, uint8_t launchGate)
{
    uint8_t isUnlocked;
    uint8_t linkAlive;

    /* 1ms LoRa tick: 消费帧 + chord/edge 状态机。standalone 传给 chord 分流(模式4 解锁 / 模式3 阶段请求)。 */
    loraNavContext.loraTickDividerCount++;
    if (loraNavContext.loraTickDividerCount >= LORA_TICK_DIVIDER)
    {
        loraNavContext.loraTickDividerCount = 0u;
        loraRemoteTickMs(standalone);
    }

    linkAlive = loraRemoteIsLinkAlive();

    /* 启动初始过滤: 链路连续保持 ~1s 才允许进入正常工作流;
     * 必须先于锁定检查执行 -- 上电默认锁定, 若 gated 在 isUnlocked 之后,
     * linkAliveTickCount 会一直停在 0, 用户解锁后才开始计 1s,
     * 期间首次 S3/S4 单按会被 navDrainPendingEdges 静默吞掉
     */
    if (!loraNavContext.linkInitReady)
    {
        if (linkAlive)
        {
            if (loraNavContext.linkAliveTickCount < LORA_INIT_VALID_TICKS)
            {
                loraNavContext.linkAliveTickCount++;
                if (loraNavContext.linkAliveTickCount >= LORA_INIT_VALID_TICKS)
                {
                    loraNavContext.linkInitReady = 1u;
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            loraNavContext.linkAliveTickCount = 0u;
        }
        loraNavContext.speedLoopDividerCount = 0u;
        chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(0u);
        motorControlStopAll();
        navDrainPendingEdges();
        loraNavControlPublish();
        return;
    }

    /* 驱动门控（"unlocked"=允许跑）按模式分流(B6)：
     *   模式4(脱机 standalone)：本地 S3+S4 解锁状态(原义)；
     *   模式3(联机非 standalone)：飞机到顶门控 launchGate(=core1 下发 LAUNCH 位=飞机已发车&&到顶)——
     *     飞机起飞爬高期 launchGate=0 → 车锁定不动，到巡航高后 =1 → 车可驾驶(车禁动直到飞机到顶)。
     * 边沿切换均触发长鸣; 锁定 = 急停。 */
    isUnlocked = standalone ? loraRemoteIsUnlocked() : launchGate;
    if (isUnlocked != loraNavContext.lockPrevUnlocked)
    {
        buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_LONG);
        if (!isUnlocked)
        {
            navStopMotion(LORA_NAV_IDLE);
        }
        loraNavContext.lockPrevUnlocked = isUnlocked;
    }

    if (!isUnlocked)
    {
        loraNavContext.speedLoopDividerCount = 0u;
        chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(0u);
        motorControlStopAll();
        navDrainPendingEdges();
        loraNavControlPublish();
        return;
    }

    /* 链路丢失: 强制零速, 保留录制 / 回放进度; 录制中连续断 >2s 后丢弃缓冲 */
    if (!linkAlive)
    {
        if (loraNavContext.linkLostTickCount < LORA_LINK_LOST_DISCARD_TICKS)
        {
            loraNavContext.linkLostTickCount++;
            if (loraNavContext.linkLostTickCount >= LORA_LINK_LOST_DISCARD_TICKS &&
                loraNavContext.status.state == LORA_NAV_RECORDING)
            {
                navStopMotion(LORA_NAV_IDLE);
                loraNavContext.status.frameCount = 0u;
                buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_LONG);
            }
        }
        chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(0u);
        chassisApplicationApplyCommandWithLimit(
            NAV_ZERO_COMMAND,
            loraNavContext.loraVMaxMps,
            loraNavContext.loraWzMaxRadps);
        loraNavContext.speedLoopDividerCount = 0u;
        motorControlStopAll();
        navDrainPendingEdges();
        loraNavControlPublish();
        return;
    }
    loraNavContext.linkLostTickCount = 0u;

    /* S4 单按上升沿: 录制开关 (chord 抑制后才会到达此处) */
    if (loraRemoteRecordEdge())
    {
        if (loraNavContext.status.state == LORA_NAV_RECORDING)
        {
            navFinishRecording();
        }
        else if (loraNavContext.status.state != LORA_NAV_ERROR)
        {
            navStartRecording();
        }
        /* ERROR为故障闭锁态：消费按键但保持停车，只有新的owner/授权流程可退出。 */
    }

    /* S3 单按上升沿: 回放开关 */
    if (loraRemoteReplayEdge())
    {
        if (loraNavContext.status.state == LORA_NAV_REPLAYING)
        {
            navStopMotion(LORA_NAV_DONE);
            buzzerBeepEvent(BEEP_TICKS_LONG);
        }
        else if (loraNavContext.status.state == LORA_NAV_READY ||
                 loraNavContext.status.state == LORA_NAV_DONE)
        {
            navStartReplay();
        }
    }

    /* 速度环 @ 2ms */
    loraNavContext.speedLoopDividerCount++;
    if (loraNavContext.speedLoopDividerCount >= SPEED_LOOP_DIVIDER)
    {
        chassisApplicationSnapshotStruct snapshot;

        loraNavContext.speedLoopDividerCount = 0u;
        chassisApplicationUpdateFeedback();
        chassisApplicationGetSnapshot(&snapshot);
        navAccumulateEncoder(snapshot.encoderData);

        if (loraNavContext.status.state == LORA_NAV_RECORDING)
        {
            chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(1u);
            navApplyRemoteCommand();
            navRecordFrame();
            motorControlSpeedTick();
        }
        else if (loraNavContext.status.state == LORA_NAV_REPLAYING)
        {
            navApplyReplayFrame();
            if (loraNavContext.status.state == LORA_NAV_REPLAYING)
            {
                motorControlSpeedTick();
            }
        }
        else if (navIsManualDriveState(loraNavContext.status.state))
        {
            chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(1u);
            navApplyRemoteCommand();
            motorControlSpeedTick();
        }
        else
        {
            chassisApplicationSetYawRateEnable(0u);
            motorControlStopAll();
        }
    }

    if (navShouldRunOutput(loraNavContext.status.state))
    {
        motorControlCurrentTick();
        motorControlOutput();
    }
    loraNavControlPublish();
}

void loraNavControlWhile(void)
{
    /* LoRa 帧消费与 chord/edge 状态机由 PIT 内部 loraRemoteTickMs 完成,
     * 调试与 LCD 刷新由 core0Loop 顶层标志位驱动, 此处无周期前台任务
     */
}

void loraNavControlGetSnapshot(loraNavControlSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    uint8_t retry;

    if (out == 0)
    {
        return;
    }

    for (retry = 0u; retry < 3u; retry++)
    {
        uint32_t before = loraNavPublishGeneration;
        loraNavControlSnapshotStruct snapshot;

        __DMB();
        snapshot = loraNavPublished;
        __DMB();
        if (((before & 1u) == 0u) && (before == loraNavPublishGeneration))
        {
            *out = snapshot;
            return;
        }
    }

    {
        const loraNavControlSnapshotStruct empty = {.state = LORA_NAV_IDLE};
        *out = empty;
    }
}

static void loraNavControlPublish(void)
{
    loraNavControlSnapshotStruct snapshot = loraNavContext.status;

    snapshot.seq++;
    snapshot.valid = 1u;
    loraNavContext.status.seq = snapshot.seq;
    loraNavContext.status.valid = snapshot.valid;
    loraNavPublishGeneration++;
    __DMB();
    loraNavPublished = snapshot;
    __DMB();
    loraNavPublishGeneration++;
}

#include "loraRemote.h"

#include "configChassisRemote.h"
#include "configCore2Build.h" /* CORE2_BUILD_MODE */

/*
 * LoRa3A22 双摇杆遥控适配层。双实现按「核 + 固件」选择（IAR 预定义 CY_CORE_CM7_0/CM7_1）：
 *
 *   [cm_7_0 控制核 + 生产固件] → 镜像实现：不拥有 UART1。LoRa 收发/解码/chord 状态机已搬到
 *       cm_7_1 通信核，本核仅通过 coreDataTransfer 读 cm_7_1 发布的 LoRa 解码快照。getter API 不变，
 *       由 whileProcess 调 loraRemoteMirrorApply 刷新；单按边沿经 recordSeq/replaySeq 单调计数交付。
 *
 *   [cm_7_1 通信核（任何固件） / cm_7_0 调参固件] → 真实 UART1 实现：cm_7_1 中断驱动 RX
 *       （ISR 填 SeekFree 软件缓冲）+ 前台 loraRemotePoll 排空解析 + 1ms tick 维护超时/chord/edge。
 */

/* 摇杆原始值 -> 物理量。
 * 死区内强制 0; 死区外把 [DEADZONE, RANGE] 线性映射到 [0, MAX]; 超出 RANGE 钳位。 */
static float loraRemoteStickToFloat(int16_t raw, float maxOutput, float deadzone)
{
    float magnitude;
    float direction;
    float scale;
    float result;

    if (maxOutput <= 0.0f) return 0.0f;
    if (deadzone < 0.0f) deadzone = 0.0f;
    if (deadzone >= (float) LORA_STICK_RANGE) return 0.0f;

    if (raw >= 0)
    {
        direction = 1.0f;
        magnitude = (float) raw;
    }
    else
    {
        direction = -1.0f;
        magnitude = (float) (-(int32_t) raw);
    }

    if (magnitude <= deadzone)
        return 0.0f;
    if (magnitude >= (float) LORA_STICK_RANGE)
        return (direction > 0.0f) ? maxOutput : -maxOutput;

    scale = (magnitude - deadzone) / ((float) LORA_STICK_RANGE - deadzone);
    result = scale * maxOutput;
    return (direction > 0.0f) ? result : -result;
}

chassisMotionCommandStruct loraRemoteMapRawMotion(
    loraRemoteRawMotionStruct raw,
    float vMaxMps,
    float wzMaxRadps,
    float deadzone)
{
    chassisMotionCommandStruct command;
    command.vx = LORA_VX_INPUT_DIR * loraRemoteStickToFloat(raw.vxRaw, vMaxMps, deadzone);
    command.vy = LORA_VY_INPUT_DIR * loraRemoteStickToFloat(raw.vyRaw, vMaxMps, deadzone);
    command.wz = LORA_WZ_INPUT_DIR * loraRemoteStickToFloat(raw.wzRaw, wzMaxRadps, deadzone);
    return command;
}

#if defined(CY_CORE_CM7_0) && (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_PRODUCTION)

/* ===================== cm_7_0 生产态：共享内存镜像实现 ===================== */
#include "coreDataTransfer.h"
#include "zf_common_interrupt.h"

/* volatile：whileProcess 临界区写、500µs ISR(loraRemoteGetMotion) 临界区读。临界区已是编译屏障，
 * volatile 再保证逐字段真实内存访问（60A 电机安全裕度，与 chassisLink linkMirror 同处理）。 */
static volatile loraRemoteRawMotionStruct loraRawMirror = {0, 0, 0};
static volatile uint8_t loraUnlockedMirror = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraLinkAliveMirror = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraTakeoffReqMirror = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 0u; /* 前台 apply 置，500µs ISR 读-清 */
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 0u;
static uint32_t loraLastRecordSeq = 0u; /* 仅前台 apply 访问 */
static uint32_t loraLastReplaySeq = 0u;
static uint8_t loraMirrorInited = 0u; /* 首次 apply 同步 seq 基线，防 boot 伪边沿 */
static float loraVMaxMps = LORA_V_MAX_MPS;
static float loraWzMaxRadps = LORA_WZ_MAX_RADPS;
static float loraStickDeadzone = (float) LORA_STICK_DEADZONE;

static void loraRemoteMirrorClearUnsafe(void)
{
    loraRawMirror.vxRaw = 0;
    loraRawMirror.vyRaw = 0;
    loraRawMirror.wzRaw = 0;
    loraUnlockedMirror = 0u;
    loraLinkAliveMirror = 0u;
    loraTakeoffReqMirror = 0u;
    loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 0u;
    loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 0u;
}

void loraRemoteInit(void)
{
    loraRemoteMirrorClearUnsafe();
    loraLastRecordSeq = 0u;
    loraLastReplaySeq = 0u;
    loraMirrorInited = 0u;
}

void loraRemoteApplyParams(const loraRemoteParamViewStruct *params)
{
    if (params == 0) return;
    loraVMaxMps = params->vMaxMps;
    loraWzMaxRadps = params->wzMaxRadps;
    loraStickDeadzone = params->stickDeadzone;
}

void loraRemoteMirrorInvalidate(void)
{
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    loraRemoteMirrorClearUnsafe();
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    loraMirrorInited = 0u;
}

/* whileProcess 调：把 cm_7_1 发布的 LoRa 解码快照刷新到本地镜像。仅 magic 有效时调用。 */
void loraRemoteMirrorApply(const commToControlStruct* s)
{
    uint32_t primask;
    if (0 == s) return;

    /* PRIMASK 存-恢复，绝不用 SDK interrupt_global_disable/enable（坏计数器，ISR 高频用会上漂致中断
     * 永久关闭整机卡死；详见 chassisLink.c 镜像段注释）。 */
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    loraRawMirror.vxRaw = s->loraVxRaw;
    loraRawMirror.vyRaw = s->loraVyRaw;
    loraRawMirror.wzRaw = s->loraWzRaw;
    loraUnlockedMirror = s->loraUnlocked;
    loraLinkAliveMirror = s->loraLinkAlive;
    loraTakeoffReqMirror = s->takeoffReq;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);

    /* 单按边沿：seq 正增量触发一次。首次 apply 同步基线（不触发），防 cm_7_1 早启时 boot 伪边沿。 */
    if (!loraMirrorInited)
    {
        loraLastRecordSeq = s->recordSeq;
        loraLastReplaySeq = s->replaySeq;
        loraMirrorInited = 1u;
    }
    else
    {
        if (s->recordSeq != loraLastRecordSeq)
        {
            loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 1u;
            loraLastRecordSeq = s->recordSeq;
        }
        if (s->replaySeq != loraLastReplaySeq)
        {
            loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 1u;
            loraLastReplaySeq = s->replaySeq;
        }
    }
}

chassisMotionCommandStruct loraRemoteGetMotion(void)
{
    return loraRemoteGetMotionForGate(loraUnlockedMirror);
}

chassisMotionCommandStruct loraRemoteGetMotionForGate(uint8_t driveGate)
{
    chassisMotionCommandStruct c;
    loraRemoteRawMotionStruct raw;
    c.vx = 0.0f;
    c.vy = 0.0f;
    c.wz = 0.0f;
    if (!driveGate || !loraLinkAliveMirror) return c;
    raw = loraRemoteGetRawMotion();
    c = loraRemoteMapRawMotion(
        raw,
        loraVMaxMps,
        loraWzMaxRadps,
        loraStickDeadzone);
    return c;
}

uint8_t loraRemoteIsLinkAlive(void)
{
    return loraLinkAliveMirror;
}
uint8_t loraRemoteIsUnlocked(void)
{
    return loraUnlockedMirror;
}
uint8_t loraRemoteGetRemoteTakeoffReq(void)
{
    return loraTakeoffReqMirror;
}

loraRemoteRawMotionStruct loraRemoteGetRawMotion(void)
{
    loraRemoteRawMotionStruct raw;
    uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK(); /* 绝不用 SDK interrupt_global_*（坏计数器，ISR 高频致卡死）*/
    __disable_irq();
    raw.vxRaw = loraRawMirror.vxRaw;
    raw.vyRaw = loraRawMirror.vyRaw;
    raw.wzRaw = loraRawMirror.wzRaw;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    return raw;
}

}

void loraRemoteGetSnapshot(loraRemoteSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    uint8_t i;
    uint32_t primask;

    if (0 == out) return;
    for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++)
    {
        out->joystick[i] = 0;
        out->key[i] = 0u;
        out->switchKey[i] = 0u;
    }

    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    out->joystick[0] = loraRawMirror.vyRaw;
    out->joystick[1] = loraRawMirror.vxRaw;
    out->joystick[2] = loraRawMirror.wzRaw;
    out->frameSeq = 0u;
    out->linkAlive = loraLinkAliveMirror;
    out->unlocked = loraUnlockedMirror;
    out->takeoffReq = loraTakeoffReqMirror;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
}

#else /* defined(CY_CORE_CM7_1) || (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_TUNE) */

/* ===================== 真实 UART1 实现 ===================== */

#include <string.h>

#include "zf_device_lora3a22.h"

#include "zf_common_interrupt.h"

static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteIsUnlockedFlag = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 0u;

static volatile uint8_t loraRemotePrevS3 = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemotePrevS4 = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteChordArmed = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteKeyFramePrimed = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteModePrimed = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteLastStandalone = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteChordFrameCount = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t loraRemoteLastKeyFrameSeq = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t loraRemoteKeyTickMs = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t loraRemoteChordStartMs = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t loraRemoteReleaseStartMs = 0u;

static volatile uint16_t loraRemoteSilentMs = 0u;

/* 联机双肩键请求保持倒计时(1ms/tick)：覆盖至少三个200ms STATUS发布机会，降低单帧
 * 丢失/调度相位导致模式2人工缓降未送达的概率；归零后由低电平重新武装下一次请求。 */
#define LORA_TAKEOFF_REQ_HOLD_TICKS (700u)
static volatile uint16_t loraRemoteTakeoffReqTicks = 0u;

/* 前台轮询接收快照（cm_7_1 中断驱动 RX 填 SeekFree 软件缓冲，loraRemotePoll 前台逐字节解析后
 * 整块发布到 loraSnapshot；PIT 侧 Tick/GetMotion 临界区整块读，消除「前台写 18 字节 vs PIT 读」撕裂）。
 * loraParseBuf/Len 为前台解析状态，仅 loraRemotePoll 单上下文访问。 */
static volatile lora3a22_uart_transfer_dat_struct loraSnapshot;
static volatile uint32_t loraRemoteFrameSeq = 0u;
#if !(defined(CY_CORE_CM7_0) && (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_TUNE) \
    && (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_LORA_TEST))
static uint8_t loraParseBuf[LORA3A22_DATA_LEN];
static uint8_t loraParseLen = 0u;
#endif

void loraRemoteInit(void)
{
    lora3a22_init();

    /* 驱动静态初始化把 state_flag 置 1, 这里强制为 0
     * 避免上电瞬间还未收到第一帧就被当作链路存活
     */
    lora3a22_state_flag = 0u;
    lora3a22_finsh_flag = 0u;
    lora3a22_response_time = 0u;

    loraRemoteIsUnlockedFlag = 0u;
    loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 0u;
    loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 0u;
    loraRemotePrevS3 = 0u;
    loraRemotePrevS4 = 0u;
    loraRemoteChordArmed = 0u;
    loraRemoteKeyFramePrimed = 0u;
    loraRemoteModePrimed = 0u;
    loraRemoteLastStandalone = 0u;
    loraRemoteChordFrameCount = 0u;
    loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount = 0u;
    loraRemoteLastKeyFrameSeq = 0u;
    loraRemoteKeyTickMs = 0u;
    loraRemoteChordStartMs = 0u;
    loraRemoteReleaseStartMs = 0u;
    loraRemoteSilentMs = 0u;
    loraRemoteTakeoffReqTicks = 0u;
    loraRemoteFrameSeq = 0u;

    /* 中断驱动 RX：本实现运行在 cm_7_1 通信核（控制环在 cm_7_0，与此 UART 中断完全隔离），
     * 故重新启用 UART1 RX 中断——SeekFree uart_query_byte 依赖 RX ISR 填软件缓冲，否则
     * loraRemotePoll 永远排空不到字节。lora3a22_init 已注册轻量缓冲填充 ISR；前台 loraRemotePoll
     * 排空 + 解析，重活不在 ISR 内。RX 悬空/噪声的中断风暴只拖慢空闲的 cm_7_1，不影响 cm_7_0 500µs PIT。 */
    uart_rx_interrupt(LORA3A22_UART_INDEX, 1u);
#if !(defined(CY_CORE_CM7_0) && (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_TUNE) \
    && (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_LORA_TEST))
    loraParseLen = 0u;
#endif
    memset((void *) &loraSnapshot, 0, sizeof(loraSnapshot));
}

void loraRemoteApplyParams(const loraRemoteParamViewStruct *params)
{
    (void) params;
}

/* 前台轮询排空 UART1 LoRa FIFO + 逐字节解析（复刻 lora3a22_uart_callback 的起始位/长度/和校验，
 * 但在前台执行、用 uart_query_byte 返回值控制 byte budget）。解析成功整块发布到 loraSnapshot
 * （关中断临界区）+ 置 state/finsh 标志（驱动全局 vuint8，供 loraRemoteTickMs 维护超时）。 */
void loraRemotePoll(void)
{
#if defined(CY_CORE_CM7_0) && (CORE2_BUILD_MODE == CORE2_BUILD_TUNE) \
    && (MOTOR_TUNE_MODE == MOTOR_TUNE_LORA_TEST)
    uint32_t primask;

    /* cm_7_0 LoRa 调试固件沿用既有 SDK ISR 解析路径；前台 owner 只接收完整帧快照，
     * 不改变 ISR、UART FIFO 或驱动回调所有权。 */
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    if (lora3a22_finsh_flag != 0u)
    {
        lora3a22_finsh_flag = 0u;
        memcpy((void *) &loraSnapshot, &lora3a22_uart_transfer, sizeof(loraSnapshot));
        loraRemoteFrameSeq++;
    }
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);
#else
    uint8_t budget = LORA_POLL_BYTE_BUDGET;
    uint8_t byte;

    while ((budget > 0u) && uart_query_byte(LORA3A22_UART_INDEX, &byte))
    {
        budget--;
        loraParseBuf[loraParseLen] = byte;
        loraParseLen++;

        if ((loraParseLen == 1u) && (loraParseBuf[0] != LORA3A22_FRAME_STAR))
        {
            loraParseLen = 0u; /* 起始位不符，丢弃重新对齐 */
            continue;
        }
        if (loraParseLen >= (uint8_t) LORA3A22_DATA_LEN)
        {
            uint8_t parity = loraParseBuf[1];
            uint8_t sum = 0u;
            uint8_t i;
            loraParseBuf[1] = 0u; /* 校验位本身不计入和（与驱动 callback 一致）*/
            for (i = 0u; i < (uint8_t) LORA3A22_DATA_LEN; i++)
            {
                sum = (uint8_t) (sum + loraParseBuf[i]);
            }
            if (sum == parity)
            {
                /* PRIMASK 存-恢复，绝不用 SDK interrupt_global_disable/enable（坏计数器：前台 Poll 与
                 * PIT 读高频交错令 interrupt_global_flag 上漂致中断永久关闭整机卡死；详见 chassisLink.c 注释）。 */
                uint32_t primask;
                loraParseBuf[1] = parity;
                primask = __get_PRIMASK();
                __disable_irq();
                memcpy((void *) &loraSnapshot, loraParseBuf, sizeof(loraSnapshot));
                loraRemoteFrameSeq++;
                __set_PRIMASK(primask);
                lora3a22_finsh_flag = 1u;
                lora3a22_state_flag = 1u;
            }
            loraParseLen = 0u;
        }
    }
#endif
}

void loraRemoteTickMs(uint8_t standalone)
{
    uint8_t curS3;
    uint8_t curS4;
    uint32_t frameSeq;
    lora3a22_uart_transfer_dat_struct snap;

    loraRemoteKeyTickMs++;

    /* 双肩键请求保持倒计时逐拍递减(链路丢失时也衰减，自然落沿)。 */
    if (loraRemoteTakeoffReqTicks > 0u)
    {
        loraRemoteTakeoffReqTicks--;
    }

    /* (1) 链路超时维护: 每收到一帧合法数据, 驱动会把 finsh_flag 与 state_flag
     * 同时置 1, 我们消费 finsh_flag 来重置静默计时;
     * 静默 >= 500ms 则强制 state_flag = 0
     */
    if (lora3a22_finsh_flag != 0u)
    {
        lora3a22_finsh_flag = 0u;
        loraRemoteSilentMs = 0u;
    }
    else if (loraRemoteSilentMs < LORA_LINK_TIMEOUT_MS)
    {
        loraRemoteSilentMs++;
        if (loraRemoteSilentMs >= LORA_LINK_TIMEOUT_MS)
        {
            lora3a22_state_flag = 0u;
        }
    }

    /* (2) 链路丢失: 强制 chord 抑制 + 清待消费边沿
     * 防止用户在断链时按住的键在恢复链路时产生伪边沿
     */
    if (lora3a22_state_flag == 0u)
    {
        loraRemoteIsUnlockedFlag = 0u;
        loraRemoteTakeoffReqTicks = 0u;
        loraRemotePrevS3 = 0u;
        loraRemotePrevS4 = 0u;
        loraRemoteChordArmed = 0u;
        loraRemoteKeyFramePrimed = 0u;
        loraRemoteModePrimed = 0u;
        loraRemoteChordFrameCount = 0u;
        loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount = 0u;
        loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 0u;
        loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 0u;
        return;
    }

    /* (3) chord / 单按边沿状态机：快照与发布序号同一临界区读取。只有真实新LoRa帧
     * 才能推进按键状态，禁止1ms PIT把一帧异常key值放大成数十个“连续样本”。 */
    {
        uint32_t primask = __get_PRIMASK(); /* 绝不用 SDK interrupt_global_*（坏计数器，详见 chassisLink.c 注释）*/
        __disable_irq();
        memcpy(&snap, (const void *) &loraSnapshot, sizeof(snap));
        frameSeq = loraRemoteFrameSeq;
        __set_PRIMASK(primask);
    }
    if ((loraRemoteKeyFramePrimed != 0u) &&
        (frameSeq == loraRemoteLastKeyFrameSeq)) return;
    loraRemoteLastKeyFrameSeq = frameSeq;
    loraRemoteKeyFramePrimed = 1u;

    curS3 = (snap.key[LORA_KEY_S3_INDEX] != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    curS4 = (snap.key[LORA_KEY_S4_INDEX] != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;

    /* standalone改变会改变组合键业务含义。模式边沿必须撤销旧候选，并重新经过全松武装。 */
    if ((loraRemoteModePrimed == 0u) ||
        (loraRemoteLastStandalone != (standalone ? 1u : 0u)))
    {
        loraRemoteModePrimed = 1u;
        loraRemoteLastStandalone = standalone ? 1u : 0u;
        loraRemoteChordArmed = 0u;
        loraRemoteChordFrameCount = 0u;
        loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount = 0u;
        loraRemotePrevS3 = curS3;
        loraRemotePrevS4 = curS4;
    }

    if (curS3 && curS4)
    {
        uint32_t confirmMs = standalone ?
            (uint32_t) LORA_CHORD_DEBOUNCE_MS :
            (uint32_t) LORA_LINKED_CHORD_CONFIRM_MS;
        loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount = 0u;
        if (loraRemoteChordArmed != 0u)
        {
            if (loraRemoteChordFrameCount == 0u)
            {
                loraRemoteChordStartMs = loraRemoteKeyTickMs;
                loraRemoteChordFrameCount = 1u;
            }
            else if (loraRemoteChordFrameCount < 0xFFu)
            {
                loraRemoteChordFrameCount++;
            }
            if ((loraRemoteChordFrameCount >= LORA_CHORD_MIN_FRESH_FRAMES) &&
                ((uint32_t) (loraRemoteKeyTickMs - loraRemoteChordStartMs) >= confirmMs))
            {
                if (standalone)
                {
                    loraRemoteIsUnlockedFlag ^= 1u;
                }
                else
                {
                    loraRemoteTakeoffReqTicks = LORA_TAKEOFF_REQ_HOLD_TICKS;
                }
                loraRemoteChordArmed = 0u;
                loraRemoteChordFrameCount = 0u;
                loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 0u;
                loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 0u;
            }
        }
    }
    else if (!curS3 && !curS4)
    {
        /* 上电、重连、模式边沿或一次组合键之后，必须由真实新帧证明全松，
         * 才重装下一次组合键资格。 */
        loraRemoteChordFrameCount = 0u;
        if (loraRemoteChordArmed == 0u)
        {
            if (loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount == 0u)
            {
                loraRemoteReleaseStartMs = loraRemoteKeyTickMs;
                loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount = 1u;
            }
            else if (loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount < 0xFFu)
            {
                loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount++;
            }
            if ((loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount >= LORA_CHORD_MIN_FRESH_FRAMES) &&
                ((uint32_t) (loraRemoteKeyTickMs - loraRemoteReleaseStartMs) >=
                    (uint32_t) LORA_CHORD_RELEASE_ARM_MS))
            {
                loraRemoteChordArmed = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        /* 任一单键打断双键候选；只有已完成全松武装时才产生单按边沿。 */
        loraRemoteChordFrameCount = 0u;
        loraRemoteReleaseFrameCount = 0u;
        if ((loraRemoteChordArmed != 0u) && curS4 && !loraRemotePrevS4 && !curS3)
        {
            loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 1u;
        }
        if ((loraRemoteChordArmed != 0u) && curS3 && !loraRemotePrevS3 && !curS4)
        {
            loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 1u;
        }
    }

    loraRemotePrevS3 = curS3;
    loraRemotePrevS4 = curS4;
}

uint8_t loraRemoteIsLinkAlive(void)
{
    return (lora3a22_state_flag != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
}

uint8_t loraRemoteIsUnlocked(void)
{
    return loraRemoteIsUnlockedFlag;
}

/* 联机双肩键请求电平(保持倒计时未归零即 1)。
 * 模式2由 TELEMETRY status bit4 上报为调试缓降；模式3由 MSG_LORA_MOTION flags bit0 上报。 */
uint8_t loraRemoteGetRemoteTakeoffReq(void)
{
    return (loraRemoteTakeoffReqTicks > 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
}

loraRemoteRawMotionStruct loraRemoteGetRawMotion(void)
{
    loraRemoteRawMotionStruct raw = {0, 0, 0};
    lora3a22_uart_transfer_dat_struct snap;
    uint32_t primask;

    /* loraSnapshot 临界区整块快照（前台 poll 写，本 PIT 读，防撕裂）。
     * PRIMASK 存-恢复，绝不用 SDK interrupt_global_*（坏计数器，详见 chassisLink.c 注释）。 */
    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    memcpy(&snap, (const void *) &loraSnapshot, sizeof(snap));
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);

    raw.vxRaw = snap.joystick[1];
    raw.vyRaw = snap.joystick[0];
    raw.wzRaw = snap.joystick[2];
    return raw;
}

chassisMotionCommandStruct loraRemoteGetMotionForGate(uint8_t driveGate)
{
    chassisMotionCommandStruct command = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
    loraRemoteRawMotionStruct raw;

    if (lora3a22_state_flag == 0u || driveGate == 0u)
        return command;

    raw = loraRemoteGetRawMotion();
    return loraRemoteMapRawMotion(raw, LORA_V_MAX_MPS, LORA_WZ_MAX_RADPS, (float) LORA_STICK_DEADZONE);
}

chassisMotionCommandStruct loraRemoteGetMotion(void)
{
    return loraRemoteGetMotionForGate(loraRemoteIsUnlockedFlag);
}

void loraRemoteGetSnapshot(loraRemoteSnapshotStruct *out)
{
    lora3a22_uart_transfer_dat_struct snap;
    uint32_t frameSeq;
    uint8_t linkAlive;
    uint8_t unlocked;
    uint8_t takeoffReq;
    uint32_t primask;
    uint8_t i;

    if (0 == out) return;

    primask = __get_PRIMASK();
    __disable_irq();
    memcpy(&snap, (const void *) &loraSnapshot, sizeof(snap));
    frameSeq = loraRemoteFrameSeq;
    linkAlive = (lora3a22_state_flag != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    unlocked = loraRemoteIsUnlockedFlag;
    takeoffReq = (loraRemoteTakeoffReqTicks > 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    __set_PRIMASK(primask);

    for (i = 0u; i < 4u; i++)
    {
        out->joystick[i] = snap.joystick[i];
        out->key[i] = snap.key[i];
        out->switchKey[i] = snap.switch_key[i];
    }
    out->frameSeq = frameSeq;
    out->linkAlive = linkAlive;
    out->unlocked = unlocked;
    out->takeoffReq = takeoffReq;
}

/* 两种编译分支各自拥有 volatile pending 状态；消费语义统一为单次读清。 */
uint8_t loraRemoteRecordEdge(void)
{
    uint8_t edge = loraRemoteRecordEdgePending;
    loraRemoteRecordEdgePending = 0u;
    return edge;
}

uint8_t loraRemoteReplayEdge(void)
{
    uint8_t edge = loraRemoteReplayEdgePending;
    loraRemoteReplayEdgePending = 0u;
    return edge;
}

#ifndef _LORA_REMOTE_H_
#define _LORA_REMOTE_H_

#include <stdint.h>

#include "chassisApplication.h"

/* LoRa3A22 双摇杆遥控适配层
 *
 * 摇杆映射(原始 int16, 中位 0):
 *   joystick[1] (左摇杆上下) -> vx (前后)
 *   joystick[0] (左摇杆左右) -> vy (左右)
 *   joystick[2] (右摇杆左右) -> wz (CCW+/CW-)
 *
 * 按键语义:
 *   key[2] = S4 (左肩)  单按 -> 录制开关
 *   key[3] = S3 (右肩)  单按 -> 回放开关
 *   S3 + S4 同时按下    -> 按 standalone 分流(B6)：脱机(模式4)=切换 解锁<->锁定；
 *                          联机(模式2/3)=发送双肩键请求，上层按系统模式解释
 *
 * 安全约束:
 *   - 链路丢失 (>500ms 无新帧): GetMotion 强制 (0,0,0)，并清除解锁与起飞请求
 *   - 锁定: GetMotion 强制 (0,0,0), 由调用方负责清 PID 状态与停车
 *   - chord 抑制: S3+S4 触发 chord 后, 必须先松开两键才能再产生单按事件
 */
typedef struct
{
    int16_t vxRaw; /* joystick[1]：左摇杆上下 */
    int16_t vyRaw; /* joystick[0]：左摇杆左右，右推为 +vy */
    int16_t wzRaw; /* joystick[2]：右摇杆左右 */
} loraRemoteRawMotionStruct;

/* 按值发布的业务快照，不暴露逐飞驱动类型或 owner 内部对象地址。
 * frameSeq 仅统计本核真实 UART 实现成功接收的帧；cm_7_0 生产镜像不传输该事实，保持 0。 */
typedef struct
{
    int16_t joystick[4];
    uint8_t key[4];
    uint8_t switchKey[4];
    uint32_t frameSeq;
    uint8_t linkAlive;
    uint8_t unlocked;
    uint8_t takeoffReq;
} loraRemoteSnapshotStruct;

#include "paramSyncMailbox.h"

#include "cy_device_headers.h"

#include <string.h>

#define PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC  (0x50535251u) /* PSRQ */
#define PARAM_SYNC_RESPONSE_MAGIC (0x50535253u) /* PSRS */
#define PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI    (1u)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t beginSequence;
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t abiVersion;
    uint32_t payloadBytes;
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration;
    uint32_t sequence;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint32_t offset;
    uint32_t payloadCrc32;
    uint16_t dataLength;
    uint8_t op;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t target;
    uint8_t state;
    uint8_t reservedHeader[6];
    uint8_t data[PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX];
    uint8_t reservedTail[12];
    uint32_t endSequence;
} paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame;

typedef char paramSyncMailbox_frame_size_assert[
    (sizeof(paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame) == PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_FRAME_BYTES) ? 1 : -1];

#pragma location = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REQUEST_ADDR
__no_init static volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame paramSyncRequestRegion;
#pragma location = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_RESPONSE_ADDR
__no_init static volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame paramSyncResponseRegion;

static uint8_t frameInputValid(uint32_t bootGeneration, uint32_t sequence,
    uint16_t dataLength)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((bootGeneration != 0u) && (sequence != 0u) &&
        (dataLength <= PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX));
}
static void cleanRegion(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region)
{
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*region));
    __DSB();
}

static void invalidateRegion(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region)
{
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*region));
    __DSB();
}

static uint8_t publishFrame(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region,
    const paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame staged;

    staged = *frame;
    staged.endSequence = 0u;

    region->beginSequence = 0u;
    region->endSequence = 0u;
    cleanRegion(region);

    memcpy((void *) region, &staged, sizeof(staged));
    cleanRegion(region);

    region->endSequence = staged.sequence;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *)
        (((uintptr_t) &region->endSequence) & ~((uintptr_t) 31u)), 32u);
    __DSB();
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sharedFrameValid(const paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame,
    uint32_t magic)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((frame->beginSequence != 0u) &&
        (frame->beginSequence == frame->sequence) &&
        (frame->endSequence == frame->sequence) &&
        (frame->magic == magic) &&
        (frame->abiVersion == PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI) &&
        (frame->payloadBytes == frame->dataLength) &&
        frameInputValid(frame->producerBootGeneration, frame->sequence,
            frame->dataLength));
}

static uint8_t tryReadFrame(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region,
    uint32_t magic, paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame first;
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame second;
    uint8_t attempt;

    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        invalidateRegion(region);
        memcpy(&first, (const void *) region, sizeof(first));
        invalidateRegion(region);
        memcpy(&second, (const void *) region, sizeof(second));
        if (sharedFrameValid(&first, magic) &&
            sharedFrameValid(&second, magic) &&
            (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0))
        {
            *frame = second;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

uint8_t paramSyncMailboxPublishRequest(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame frame;
    if ((request == 0) || !frameInputValid(request->producerBootGeneration,
        request->sequence, request->dataLength)) return 0u;
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.beginSequence = request->sequence;
    frame.magic = PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC;
    frame.abiVersion = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI;
    frame.payloadBytes = request->dataLength;
    frame.producerBootGeneration = request->producerBootGeneration;
    frame.sequence = request->sequence;
    frame.transactionId = request->transactionId;
    frame.offset = request->offset;
    frame.payloadCrc32 = request->payloadCrc32;
    frame.dataLength = request->dataLength;
    frame.op = request->op;
    frame.slot = request->slot;
    frame.target = request->target;
    frame.state = request->flags;
    memcpy(frame.data, request->data, request->dataLength);
    return publishFrame(&paramSyncRequestRegion, &frame);
}

uint8_t paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame frame;
    paramSyncMailboxRequest candidate;
    if ((request == 0) || !tryReadFrame(&paramSyncRequestRegion,
        PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC, &frame)) return 0u;
    memset(&candidate, 0, sizeof(candidate));
    candidate.producerBootGeneration = frame.producerBootGeneration;
    candidate.sequence = frame.sequence;
    candidate.transactionId = frame.transactionId;
    candidate.offset = frame.offset;
    candidate.payloadCrc32 = frame.payloadCrc32;
    candidate.dataLength = frame.dataLength;
    candidate.op = frame.op;
    candidate.slot = frame.slot;
    candidate.target = frame.target;
    candidate.flags = frame.state;
    memcpy(candidate.data, frame.data, frame.dataLength);
    *request = candidate;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t paramSyncMailboxPublishResponse(const paramSyncMailboxResponse *response)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame frame;
    if ((response == 0) || !frameInputValid(response->producerBootGeneration,
        response->sequence, response->dataLength)) return 0u;
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.beginSequence = response->sequence;
    frame.magic = PARAM_SYNC_RESPONSE_MAGIC;
    frame.abiVersion = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI;
    frame.payloadBytes = response->dataLength;
    frame.producerBootGeneration = response->producerBootGeneration;
    frame.sequence = response->sequence;
    frame.transactionId = response->transactionId;
    frame.offset = response->offset;
    frame.payloadCrc32 = response->payloadCrc32;
    frame.dataLength = response->dataLength;
    frame.op = response->op;
    frame.slot = response->slot;
    frame.target = response->target;
    frame.state = response->status;
    memcpy(frame.data, response->data, response->dataLength);
    return publishFrame(&paramSyncResponseRegion, &frame);
}

uint8_t paramSyncMailboxTryReadResponse(paramSyncMailboxResponse *response)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame frame;
    paramSyncMailboxResponse candidate;
    if ((response == 0) || !tryReadFrame(&paramSyncResponseRegion,
        PARAM_SYNC_RESPONSE_MAGIC, &frame)) return 0u;
    memset(&candidate, 0, sizeof(candidate));
    candidate.producerBootGeneration = frame.producerBootGeneration;
    candidate.sequence = frame.sequence;
    candidate.transactionId = frame.transactionId;
    candidate.offset = frame.offset;
    candidate.payloadCrc32 = frame.payloadCrc32;
    candidate.dataLength = frame.dataLength;
    candidate.op = frame.op;
    candidate.slot = frame.slot;
    candidate.target = frame.target;
    candidate.status = frame.state;
    memcpy(candidate.data, frame.data, frame.dataLength);
    *response = candidate;
    return 1u;
}

#include "THVD1450.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "zf_device_type.h"

#include "zf_driver_gpio.h"
#include "zf_driver_uart.h"

#define THVD1450_UART_NUM      (UART_4)
#define THVD1450_UART_TX_PIN   (UART4_TX_P14_1)
#define THVD1450_UART_RX_PIN   (UART4_RX_P14_0)

#define THVD1450_DIR_PIN             (P13_7) /* core2: RE#/DE 接 P13_7；与 core1 的驱动并发模型亦有意不同 */
#define THVD1450_RX_FRAME_QUEUE_SIZE (4u)
#define THVD1450_POLL_BYTE_BUDGET    (64u)   /* 未接 485 时 RX 悬空可能持续进噪声，前台轮询必须有上限 */
#define THVD1450_RX_BYTE_RING_SIZE   (128u)
#define THVD1450_ISR_BATCH_MAX       (16u)
#if THVD1450_UART_BAUDRATE != 1000000u
#error "Core1-Core2 RS-485 baud contract requires 1 Mbps"
#endif

static uint8_t thvd1450TxBuffer[THVD1450_FRAME_LENGTH_MAX];

static thvd1450ParserStruct thvd1450Parser;
static thvd1450FrameStruct thvd1450RxQueue[THVD1450_RX_FRAME_QUEUE_SIZE];

static volatile uint8_t thvd1450RxHead = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t thvd1450RxTail = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t thvd1450RxCount = 0u;

#if defined(CY_CORE_CM7_1)
/* UART ISR单写、前台单读。逐飞UART暂存不是ring，ISR必须立即搬走本批字节。 */
static uint8_t thvd1450RxByteRing[THVD1450_RX_BYTE_RING_SIZE];
static volatile uint8_t thvd1450RxByteHead = 0u;
static volatile uint8_t thvd1450RxByteTail = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t thvd1450RxOverflowSequence = 0u;
static volatile uint32_t thvd1450RxOverflowAcknowledged = 0u;
static uint8_t thvd1450RxDiscardState = 0u;
#endif

static uint8_t thvd1450NextIndex(uint8_t index)
{
    index++;
    if (index >= THVD1450_RX_FRAME_QUEUE_SIZE)
    {
        index = 0u;
    }

    return index;
}

#if defined(CY_CORE_CM7_1)
static uint8_t thvd1450NextByteIndex(uint8_t index)
{
    index++;
    if (index >= THVD1450_RX_BYTE_RING_SIZE)
    {
        index = 0u;
    }
    return index;
}

static void thvd1450PushByteFromIsr(uint8_t data)
{
    uint8_t next;

    if (thvd1450RxOverflowSequence != thvd1450RxOverflowAcknowledged)
    {
        return;
    }

    next = thvd1450NextByteIndex(thvd1450RxByteTail);
    if (next == thvd1450RxByteHead)
    {
        thvd1450RxOverflowSequence++;
        return;
    }

    thvd1450RxByteRing[thvd1450RxByteTail] = data;
    __DMB();
    thvd1450RxByteTail = next;
}
#endif

static void thvd1450PushFrame(const thvd1450FrameStruct *frame)
{
    if (NULL == frame)
    {
        return;
    }

    if (thvd1450RxCount >= THVD1450_RX_FRAME_QUEUE_SIZE)
    {
        thvd1450RxHead = thvd1450NextIndex(thvd1450RxHead);
        thvd1450RxCount--;
    }

    thvd1450RxQueue[thvd1450RxTail] = *frame;
    thvd1450RxTail = thvd1450NextIndex(thvd1450RxTail);
    thvd1450RxCount++;
}

static void thvd1450HandleByte(uint8_t data)
{
    thvd1450FrameStruct rxFrame;
    thvd1450StatusEnum status;

    status = thvd1450ProtocolInputByte(&thvd1450Parser, data, &rxFrame);
    if (THVD1450_STATUS_FRAME_READY == status)
    {
        thvd1450PushFrame(&rxFrame);
    }
}

void thvd1450Init(void)
{
    thvd1450ProtocolInit(&thvd1450Parser);
    memset(thvd1450RxQueue, 0, sizeof(thvd1450RxQueue));
    thvd1450RxHead = 0u;
    thvd1450RxTail = 0u;
    thvd1450RxCount = 0u;
#if defined(CY_CORE_CM7_1)
    memset(thvd1450RxByteRing, 0, sizeof(thvd1450RxByteRing));
    thvd1450RxByteHead = 0u;
    thvd1450RxByteTail = 0u;
    thvd1450RxOverflowSequence = 0u;
    thvd1450RxOverflowAcknowledged = 0u;
    thvd1450RxDiscardState = 0u;
#endif

    uart_init(THVD1450_UART_NUM, THVD1450_UART_BAUDRATE, THVD1450_UART_TX_PIN, THVD1450_UART_RX_PIN);
    gpio_init(THVD1450_DIR_PIN, GPO, GPIO_LOW, GPO_PUSH_PULL);

    thvd1450SetMode(THVD1450_MODE_RECEIVE);

#if defined(CY_CORE_CM7_1)
    /* cm_7_1 通信核：uart4_isr在uart_isr_mask后立即把驱动暂存搬入本地SPSC ring，
     * 前台thvd1450Poll只消费ring并解析。控制环在cm_7_0，与本UART中断完全隔离：
     * RS-485 悬空/噪声的 RX 中断风暴只拖慢空闲的 cm_7_1，不影响 cm_7_0 的 500µs 控制 PIT。
     * ISR只做最多16字节的有界搬运，不解析协议、不发送。 */
    uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 1u);
#else
    /* cm_7_0 调参固件：保持 RX 中断关闭（原前台轮询范式，避免 485 悬空风暴饿死本核控制 PIT）。
     * 注：cm_7_0 生产固件用镜像实现，根本不编译本 thvd1450Init。 */
    uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 0u);
#endif
}

void thvd1450SetMode(thvd1450ModeEnum mode)
{
    if (THVD1450_MODE_TRANSMIT == mode)
    {
        gpio_high(THVD1450_DIR_PIN);
    }
    else
    {
        gpio_low(THVD1450_DIR_PIN);
    }
}

void thvd1450Poll(void)
{
    uint8_t data;
    uint8_t budget = THVD1450_POLL_BYTE_BUDGET;

#if defined(CY_CORE_CM7_1)
    if (thvd1450RxOverflowSequence != thvd1450RxOverflowAcknowledged)
    {
        uint32_t overflowSequence;

        uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 0u);
        overflowSequence = thvd1450RxOverflowSequence;
        thvd1450RxByteHead = thvd1450RxByteTail;
        thvd1450ProtocolReset(&thvd1450Parser);
        thvd1450RxDiscardState = 1u;
        thvd1450RxOverflowAcknowledged = overflowSequence;
        uart_rx_interrupt(THVD1450_UART_NUM, 1u);
    }

    while ((budget > 0u) &&
           (thvd1450RxByteHead != thvd1450RxByteTail))
    {
        data = thvd1450RxByteRing[thvd1450RxByteHead];
        __DMB();
        thvd1450RxByteHead = thvd1450NextByteIndex(thvd1450RxByteHead);
        budget--;
        if (thvd1450RxDiscardState != 0u)
        {
            if (thvd1450RxDiscardState == 1u)
            {
                if (data == THVD1450_FRAME_TAIL)
                    thvd1450RxDiscardState = 2u;
            }
            else if (data == THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD)
            {
                thvd1450ProtocolReset(&thvd1450Parser);
                thvd1450HandleByte(data);
                thvd1450RxDiscardState = 0u;
            }
            continue;
        }
        thvd1450HandleByte(data);
    }
#else
    while ((budget > 0u) && uart_query_byte(THVD1450_UART_NUM, &data))
    {
        budget--;
        thvd1450HandleByte(data);
    }
#endif
}

void thvd1450RxIrqHandler(void)
{
#if defined(CY_CORE_CM7_1)
    uint8_t batch[THVD1450_ISR_BATCH_MAX];
    uint8_t count;
    uint8_t i;

    count = uart_query_buffer(THVD1450_UART_NUM, batch);
    if (count > THVD1450_ISR_BATCH_MAX)
    {
        count = THVD1450_ISR_BATCH_MAX;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        thvd1450PushByteFromIsr(batch[i]);
    }
#endif
}

thvd1450StatusEnum thvd1450SendBytes(const uint8_t *payload, uint8_t length)
{
    uint8_t frameLength = 0u;
    thvd1450StatusEnum status;

    status = thvd1450ProtocolEncode(
        payload,
        length,
        thvd1450TxBuffer,
        (uint8_t)sizeof(thvd1450TxBuffer),
        &frameLength);
    if (THVD1450_STATUS_OK != status)
    {
        return status;
    }

    thvd1450SetMode(THVD1450_MODE_TRANSMIT);
    uart_write_buffer(THVD1450_UART_NUM, thvd1450TxBuffer, frameLength);
    thvd1450SetMode(THVD1450_MODE_RECEIVE);

    return THVD1450_STATUS_OK;
}

thvd1450StatusEnum thvd1450ReadFrame(thvd1450FrameStruct *frame)
{
    if (NULL == frame)
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (0u == thvd1450RxCount)
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
    }

    *frame = thvd1450RxQueue[thvd1450RxHead];
    thvd1450RxHead = thvd1450NextIndex(thvd1450RxHead);
    thvd1450RxCount--;
    return THVD1450_STATUS_OK;
}

SHA-256：634e0a17539c065b6fda54bd997e2dfbe871fe8480c45d41630e20389016056f
代码（c）
#include "THVD1450_protocol.h"

#include <string.h>

#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD     (0u)
#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH   (1u)
#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_PAYLOAD  (2u)
#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_CHECKSUM (3u)
#define THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_TAIL     (4u)

static void thvd1450ProtocolRestartFromHead(thvd1450ParserStruct *parser)
{
    thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
    parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH;
}

void thvd1450ProtocolInit(thvd1450ParserStruct *parser)
{
    thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
}

void thvd1450ProtocolReset(thvd1450ParserStruct *parser)
{
    if (NULL == parser)
    {
        return;
    }

    memset(parser, 0, sizeof(*parser));
    parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD;
}

uint8_t thvd1450ProtocolChecksum(const uint8_t *payload, uint8_t length)
{
    uint8_t checksum = length;
    uint8_t i;

    for (i = 0u; i < length; i++)
    {
        checksum ^= payload[i];
    }

    return checksum;
}

thvd1450StatusEnum thvd1450ProtocolEncode(
    const uint8_t *payload,
    uint8_t length,
    uint8_t *frameBuffer,
    uint8_t frameBufferSize,
    uint8_t *frameLength)
{
    if ((NULL == frameBuffer) || (NULL == frameLength) || ((0u != length) && (NULL == payload)))
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    if (length > THVD1450_PAYLOAD_LENGTH_MAX)
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_LENGTH_ERROR;
    }

    if (frameBufferSize < (uint8_t)(length + THVD1450_FRAME_OVERHEAD))
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_LENGTH_ERROR;
    }

    frameBuffer[0] = THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD;
    frameBuffer[1] = length;

    if (0u != length)
    {
        memcpy(&frameBuffer[2], payload, length);
    }

    frameBuffer[2u + length] = thvd1450ProtocolChecksum(payload, length);
    frameBuffer[3u + length] = THVD1450_FRAME_TAIL;
    *frameLength = (uint8_t)(length + THVD1450_FRAME_OVERHEAD);

    return THVD1450_STATUS_OK;
}

thvd1450StatusEnum thvd1450ProtocolInputByte(
    thvd1450ParserStruct *parser,
    uint8_t byte,
    thvd1450FrameStruct *outFrame)
{
    if (NULL == parser)
    {
        return THVD1450_STATUS_INVALID_PARAM;
    }

    switch (parser->state)
    {
        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_HEAD:
        {
            if (THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD == byte)
            {
                parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH;
            }
            return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
        }

        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_LENGTH:
        {
            if (byte > THVD1450_PAYLOAD_LENGTH_MAX)
            {
                thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
                return THVD1450_STATUS_LENGTH_ERROR;
            }

            parser->expectedLength = byte;
            parser->frame.length = byte;
            parser->checksum = byte;
            parser->index = 0u;
            parser->state = (0u == byte) ? THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_CHECKSUM : THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_PAYLOAD;
            return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
        }

        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_PAYLOAD:
        {
            parser->frame.payload[parser->index] = byte;
            parser->checksum ^= byte;
            parser->index++;

            if (parser->index >= parser->expectedLength)
            {
                parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_CHECKSUM;
            }
            return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
        }

        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_CHECKSUM:
        {
            if (byte != parser->checksum)
            {
                if (THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD == byte)
                {
                    thvd1450ProtocolRestartFromHead(parser);
                }
                else
                {
                    thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
                }
                return THVD1450_STATUS_CHECKSUM_ERROR;
            }

            parser->state = THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_TAIL;
            return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
        }

        case THVD1450_PARSE_WAIT_TAIL:
        {
            if (THVD1450_FRAME_TAIL == byte)
            {
                if (NULL != outFrame)
                {
                    *outFrame = parser->frame;
                }
                thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
                return THVD1450_STATUS_FRAME_READY;
            }

            if (THVD1450_FRAME_HEAD == byte)
            {
                thvd1450ProtocolRestartFromHead(parser);
            }
            else
            {
                thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
            }
            return THVD1450_STATUS_TAIL_ERROR;
        }

        default:
        {
            thvd1450ProtocolReset(parser);
            break;
        }
    }

    return THVD1450_STATUS_NO_FRAME;
}

#include "chassisParams.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "configChassisPidDefaults.h"
#include "configChassisRemote.h"
#include "lightStrip.h"        /* LIGHT_STRIP_DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS / _MIN / _MAX（亮度默认与钳位单一真相源） */
#include "commonDef.h"

typedef struct
{
    chassisParamStruct active;
    uint32_t revision;
    uint8_t initialized;
} chassisParamsRepositoryStruct;

static chassisParamsRepositoryStruct chassisParamsRepository = {0};

void chassisParamsInit(void)
{
    chassisParamStruct initial;

    chassisParamsLoadDefaults(&initial);
    chassisParamsFlashLoad(&initial);
    chassisParamsSanitize(&initial);
    chassisParamsRepository.active = initial;
    chassisParamsRepository.revision = 1u;
    chassisParamsRepository.initialized = 1u;
}

void chassisParamsLoadDefaults(chassisParamStruct* p)
{
    if (p == 0) return;

    /* 速度环四轮增益 + 积分钳位 */
    p->speedFl.kp = MOTOR_CONTROL_FL_SPEED_KP;
    p->speedFl.ki = MOTOR_CONTROL_FL_SPEED_KI;
    p->speedFl.kd = MOTOR_CONTROL_FL_SPEED_KD;
    p->speedFr.kp = MOTOR_CONTROL_FR_SPEED_KP;
    p->speedFr.ki = MOTOR_CONTROL_FR_SPEED_KI;
    p->speedFr.kd = MOTOR_CONTROL_FR_SPEED_KD;
    p->speedBl.kp = MOTOR_CONTROL_BL_SPEED_KP;
    p->speedBl.ki = MOTOR_CONTROL_BL_SPEED_KI;
    p->speedBl.kd = MOTOR_CONTROL_BL_SPEED_KD;
    p->speedBr.kp = MOTOR_CONTROL_BR_SPEED_KP;
    p->speedBr.ki = MOTOR_CONTROL_BR_SPEED_KI;
    p->speedBr.kd = MOTOR_CONTROL_BR_SPEED_KD;
    p->speedIntegralMax = MOTOR_CONTROL_SPEED_PID_INTEGRAL_MAX;

    /* 电流环（四轮独立，各读自己一组宏；所有 *_CURRENT_* 宏均有意义） */
    p->currentFl.kp = MOTOR_CONTROL_FL_CURRENT_KP;
    p->currentFl.ki = MOTOR_CONTROL_FL_CURRENT_KI;
    p->currentFl.kd = MOTOR_CONTROL_FL_CURRENT_KD;
    p->currentFr.kp = MOTOR_CONTROL_FR_CURRENT_KP;
    p->currentFr.ki = MOTOR_CONTROL_FR_CURRENT_KI;
    p->currentFr.kd = MOTOR_CONTROL_FR_CURRENT_KD;
    p->currentBl.kp = MOTOR_CONTROL_BL_CURRENT_KP;
    p->currentBl.ki = MOTOR_CONTROL_BL_CURRENT_KI;
    p->currentBl.kd = MOTOR_CONTROL_BL_CURRENT_KD;
    p->currentBr.kp = MOTOR_CONTROL_BR_CURRENT_KP;
    p->currentBr.ki = MOTOR_CONTROL_BR_CURRENT_KI;
    p->currentBr.kd = MOTOR_CONTROL_BR_CURRENT_KD;
    p->currentIntegralMax = MOTOR_CONTROL_CURRENT_PID_INTEGRAL_MAX;

    /* 角速度环 */
    p->yawRate.kp = CHASSIS_YAW_RATE_KP;
    p->yawRate.ki = CHASSIS_YAW_RATE_KI;
    p->yawRate.kd = CHASSIS_YAW_RATE_KD;
    p->yawRateIntegralMax = CHASSIS_YAW_RATE_INTEGRAL_MAX;
    p->headingKp = CHASSIS_HEADING_KP;
    p->headingRateLimit = CHASSIS_HEADING_RATE_LIMIT_RADPS;
    p->yawRateOutputLimit = CHASSIS_YAW_RATE_OUTPUT_LIMIT;

    /* LoRa 映射（真实物理单位） */
    p->loraVMaxMps = LORA_V_MAX_MPS;
    p->loraWzMaxRadps = LORA_WZ_MAX_RADPS;
    p->loraStickDeadzone = (float) LORA_STICK_DEADZONE;

    /* 导航 */
    p->navCorrectionKp = NAV_CORRECTION_KP;
    p->navCorrectionLimit = NAV_CORRECTION_LIMIT;
    p->navErrorLimitPulses = NAV_ERROR_LIMIT_PULSES;

    /* ^ 定位灯条亮度默认（lightStrip.h 单一真相源） */
    p->lightStripBrightness = (float) LIGHT_STRIP_DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS;

}

/* 钳位单个 PID 增益组：kp/ki/kd 必须非负（极性靠电机方向系数，增益恒非负，负增益=正反馈危险） */
static void sanitizeGain(chassisPidGainStruct* g)
{
    if (g->kp < 0.0f) g->kp = 0.0f;
    if (g->ki < 0.0f) g->ki = 0.0f;
    if (g->kd < 0.0f) g->kd = 0.0f;
}

static uint8_t chassisParamsAllFinite(const chassisParamStruct* p)
{
    const float* values = &p->speedFl.kp;
    uint32_t count = (uint32_t) (sizeof(chassisParamStruct) / sizeof(float));
    uint32_t i;

    for (i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        if (floatIsFinite(values[i]) == 0u) return 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

void chassisParamsSanitize(chassisParamStruct* p)
{
    if (p == 0) return;

    if (chassisParamsAllFinite(p) == 0u)
    {
        chassisParamsLoadDefaults(p);
    }

    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->speedFl);
    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->speedFr);
    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->speedBl);
    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->speedBr);
    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->currentFl);
    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->currentFr);
    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->currentBl);
    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->currentBr);
    sanitizeGain((chassisPidGainStruct*) &p->yawRate);

    if (p->speedIntegralMax < 0.0f) p->speedIntegralMax = 0.0f;
    if (p->currentIntegralMax < 0.0f) p->currentIntegralMax = 0.0f;
    if (p->yawRateIntegralMax < 0.0f) p->yawRateIntegralMax = 0.0f;
    if (p->headingKp < 0.0f) p->headingKp = 0.0f;
    if (p->headingKp > CHASSIS_HEADING_KP_MAX) p->headingKp = CHASSIS_HEADING_KP_MAX;
    if (p->headingRateLimit < 0.0f) p->headingRateLimit = 0.0f;
    if (p->headingRateLimit > CHASSIS_HEADING_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_RADPS)
    {
        p->headingRateLimit = CHASSIS_HEADING_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_RADPS;
    }
    if (p->yawRateOutputLimit < 0.0f) p->yawRateOutputLimit = 0.0f;

    /* LoRa 速度上限非负；死区须 < 量程（防 loraRemote 除零/负标度） */
    if (p->loraVMaxMps < 0.0f) p->loraVMaxMps = 0.0f;
    if (p->loraWzMaxRadps < 0.0f) p->loraWzMaxRadps = 0.0f;
    if (p->loraStickDeadzone < 0.0f) p->loraStickDeadzone = 0.0f;
    if (p->loraStickDeadzone >= (float) LORA_STICK_RANGE)
    {
        p->loraStickDeadzone = (float) (LORA_STICK_RANGE - 1);
    }

    /* 导航纠正非负 */
    if (p->navCorrectionKp < 0.0f) p->navCorrectionKp = 0.0f;
    if (p->navCorrectionLimit < 0.0f) p->navCorrectionLimit = 0.0f;
    if (p->navErrorLimitPulses < 0.0f) p->navErrorLimitPulses = 0.0f;

    /* 灯条亮度钳到 [MIN,MAX]（防菜单/flash 注入越界；lightStripSetBrightness 收 uint8_t pct） */
    if (p->lightStripBrightness < (float) LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MIN) p->lightStripBrightness = (float) LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MIN;
    if (p->lightStripBrightness > (float) LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MAX) p->lightStripBrightness = (float) LIGHT_STRIP_BRIGHTNESS_MAX;

}

void chassisParamsGetActive(chassisParamStruct* out)
{
    if (out == 0) return;
    if (!chassisParamsRepository.initialized)
    {
        chassisParamsLoadDefaults(out);
        chassisParamsSanitize(out);
        return;
    }
    *out = chassisParamsRepository.active;
}

uint32_t chassisParamsGetRevision(void)
{
    return chassisParamsRepository.initialized ?
        chassisParamsRepository.revision : 0u;
}

uint8_t chassisParamsCommit(const chassisParamStruct* candidate)
{
    chassisParamStruct sanitized;

    if (candidate == 0) return 0u;
    sanitized = *candidate;
    chassisParamsSanitize(&sanitized);
    chassisParamsRepository.active = sanitized;
    chassisParamsRepository.revision++;
    if (chassisParamsRepository.revision == 0u) chassisParamsRepository.revision = 1u;
    chassisParamsRepository.initialized = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

#ifndef _CHASSIS_PARAMS_H_

#include <stdint.h>

/*
 * core2 底盘可调参数 RAM 镜像（仿 core0 flightParams）。
 *
 * 目的：菜单热重载 + flash 持久化的运行时参数载体。控制环从读编译期默认宏
 *       改为读本镜像；默认值仍以 configChassisPidDefaults.h / configChassisRemote.h
 *       宏为单一真相源（chassisParamsLoadDefaults 加载）。
 *
 * 安全只读项不进镜像、保持宏：MOTOR_*_OUTPUT_DIR(极性)、MOTOR_RUNAWAY_*(失控保护)、
 *   *_DIVIDER(时序)、*_LPF*(滤波)、LORA_LINK_TIMEOUT_MS、CHASSIS_*几何/编码器换算、
 *   CHASSIS_RS485_* 物理上限。
 *
 * 当前：本结构只作 DTO；活动副本由 chassisParams.c 私有仓库持有。菜单编辑 working copy，
 * runtime 提交后各 owner 缓存所需窄配置，ISR 不直接依赖仓库布局。
 */

{
    float kp;
    float ki;
    float kd;
} chassisPidGainStruct;

{

    chassisPidGainStruct speedBl;

    chassisPidGainStruct currentFl;

    chassisPidGainStruct currentBl;
    chassisPidGainStruct currentBr;
    float currentIntegralMax; /* MOTOR_CONTROL_CURRENT_PID_INTEGRAL_MAX（四轮共享） */

    /* §D 角速度（yaw）环（位置式） */
    chassisPidGainStruct yawRate;
    float yawRateIntegralMax; /* CHASSIS_YAW_RATE_INTEGRAL_MAX */
    float headingKp;          /* CHASSIS_HEADING_KP */
    float headingRateLimit;   /* CHASSIS_HEADING_RATE_LIMIT_RADPS */
    float yawRateOutputLimit; /* CHASSIS_YAW_RATE_OUTPUT_LIMIT */

    float lightStripBrightness;

    uint32_t version;
