static void markDirty(void)
{
    if (g_view.screenRevision < UINT32_MAX)
    {
        g_view.screenRevision++;
    }
}

static uint32_t floatToU32(float value)
{
    if (value <= 0.0f)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (value >= (float) UINT32_MAX)
    {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    return (uint32_t) (value + 0.5f);
}

static void syncFromActive(void)
{
    const core3VisionParamsStruct *params = core3VisionParamsGetActive();

    g_workValues[0] = (float) params->exposure;
    g_workValues[1] = (float) params->binaryLow;
    g_workValues[2] = (float) params->binaryHigh;
    g_workValues[3] = (float) params->legacyCannyLow;
    g_workValues[4] = (float) params->legacyCannyHigh;
    g_workValuesRevision = core3VisionParamsGetRevision();
}

static uint32_t g_paramGlobalRequestSequence;
static paramSyncGlobalState g_paramGlobalState;
static uint8_t g_paramGlobalStateValid;
static paramSyncGlobalRequest g_paramGlobalPendingRequest;
static uint8_t g_paramGlobalRequestPending;
static uint8_t g_paramSlotInspectPending;
static uint8_t g_externalParamTransactionActive;
static uint32_t g_lastTerminalCoordinatorBoot;
static uint32_t g_lastTerminalRequestBoot;
static uint32_t g_lastTerminalRequestSequence;

static void scheduleParamSlotInspect(void)
{
    g_paramSlotInspectPending = 1u;
    if (g_view.paramSlotUiState != PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING)
    {
        g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
        markDirty();
    }
}

static void setParamGlobalUi(core3MenuParamGlobalUiState uiState,
    uint8_t phase, uint8_t target, uint8_t error)
{
    if ((g_view.paramGlobalUiState != uiState) ||
        (g_view.paramGlobalPhase != phase) ||
        (g_view.paramGlobalTarget != target) ||
        (g_view.paramGlobalError != error))
    {
        g_view.paramGlobalUiState = uiState;
        g_view.paramGlobalPhase = phase;
        g_view.paramGlobalTarget = target;
        g_view.paramGlobalError = error;
        markDirty();
    }
}

static void setParamGlobalContext(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    if ((g_view.paramGlobalAction != action) ||
        (g_view.paramGlobalSlot != slot))
    {
        g_view.paramGlobalAction = action;
        g_view.paramGlobalSlot = slot;
        markDirty();
    }
}

static void setParamGlobalExternal(uint8_t external)
{
    if (g_view.paramGlobalExternal != external)
    {
        g_view.paramGlobalExternal = external;
        markDirty();
    }
}

static uint8_t observeNewTerminal(const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    if (((state->flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) == 0u) ||
        (state->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY))
        return 0u;
    if ((g_lastTerminalCoordinatorBoot == state->coordinatorBootGeneration) &&
        (g_lastTerminalRequestBoot == state->requestBootGeneration) &&
        (g_lastTerminalRequestSequence == state->requestSequence))
        return 0u;
    g_lastTerminalCoordinatorBoot = state->coordinatorBootGeneration;
    g_lastTerminalRequestBoot = state->requestBootGeneration;
    g_lastTerminalRequestSequence = state->requestSequence;
    return 1u;
}

static void invalidateGlobalParamRoute(void)
{
    g_paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
    memset(&g_paramGlobalState, 0, sizeof(g_paramGlobalState));
    if (g_externalParamTransactionActive != 0u)
    {
        g_externalParamTransactionActive = 0u;
        setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
        setParamGlobalContext(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE, 0u);
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED, 3u,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
    }
    if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u)
    {
        if (g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action ==
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED, 3u,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
        g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
    }
}

static void pollGlobalParamState(void)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState state;
    uint8_t matchesPending;

    if (core3LinkCore3TakeParamGlobalState(&state) == 0u)
    {
        invalidateGlobalParamRoute();
        return;
    }
    g_paramGlobalState = state;
    g_paramGlobalStateValid = 1u;
    matchesPending = (uint8_t) ((g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u) &&
        (paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(&state,
            &g_paramGlobalPendingRequest) != 0u));
    if (observeNewTerminal(&state) != 0u) scheduleParamSlotInspect();
    if (matchesPending == 0u)
    {
        if ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u)
        {
            g_externalParamTransactionActive = 1u;
            setParamGlobalExternal(1u);
            setParamGlobalContext(state.action, state.slot);
            setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS, state.phase,
                state.target, state.error);
        }
        else if ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) != 0u)
        {
            g_externalParamTransactionActive = 0u;
            setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
            setParamGlobalContext(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE, 0u);
            setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_IDLE, state.phase,
                state.target, state.error);
        }
        else if ((g_externalParamTransactionActive != 0u) &&
                 (paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&state) != 0u))
        {
            g_externalParamTransactionActive = 0u;
            setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
            setParamGlobalContext(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE, 0u);
            setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_IDLE, state.phase,
                state.target, state.error);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (state.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_SUCCEEDED)
    {
        setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
        g_view.paramGlobalAction = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action;
        g_view.paramGlobalSlot = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.slot;
        if (g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action ==
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        {
            g_view.paramSlotUiState =
                paramSyncGlobalClassifySlotSummary(state.transactionId);
        }
        else
        {
            g_view.lastAction = (g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action ==
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ?
                CORE3_MENU_ACTION_LIBRARY_SAVE : CORE3_MENU_ACTION_RUNTIME_LOAD;
            g_view.lastActionOk = 1u;
            g_view.lastActionSlot = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.slot;
            g_feedbackStartMs = g_tickMs;
            g_paramSlotInspectPending = 1u;
        }
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS, state.phase,
            0xFFu, PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE);
        g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (state.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED)
    {
        setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
        g_view.paramGlobalAction = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action;
        g_view.paramGlobalSlot = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.slot;
        if (g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action ==
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED, state.phase,
            state.target, state.error);
        g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u)
    {
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS, state.phase,
            state.target, state.error);
    }
}

static uint8_t requestGlobalParamAction(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    paramSyncGlobalRequest request;
    uint8_t error;
    if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u)
        error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY;
    else if (g_paramGlobalStateValid == 0u)
        error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE;
    else if (paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&g_paramGlobalState) == 0u)
    {
        if ((g_paramGlobalState.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY) != 0u)
            error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY;
        else if (g_paramGlobalState.readyMask != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK)
            error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INCOMPLETE;
        else
            error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY;
    }
    else
        error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    if (error != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE)
    {
        if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED, 3u, error);
        return 0u;
    }
    g_paramGlobalRequestSequence++;
    if (g_paramGlobalRequestSequence == 0u) g_paramGlobalRequestSequence = 1u;
    request.producerBootGeneration = core3LinkCore3GetLocalBootGeneration();
    request.sequence = g_paramGlobalRequestSequence;
    request.origin = 3u;
    request.action = action;
    request.slot = slot;
    request.reserved = 0u;
    if (core3LinkCore3QueueParamGlobalRequest(&request) == 0u)
    {
        if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED, 3u,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
        return 0u;
    }
    g_paramGlobalPendingRequest = request;
    g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 1u;
    setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
    setParamGlobalUi(CORE3_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED,
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_REQUESTED, 0xFFu,
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE);
    g_view.paramGlobalAction = action;
    g_view.paramGlobalSlot = slot;
    if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t isValidKvmTarget(uint8_t target)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((target == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ||
        (target == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) ||
        (target == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
        (target == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4));
}

    g_view.state = CORE3_MENU_HOME;

static void applyWorkValues(void)
{
    core3VisionParamsStruct candidate = *core3VisionParamsGetActive();

    candidate.exposure = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[0]);
    candidate.binaryLow = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[1]);
    candidate.binaryHigh = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[2]);
    candidate.legacyCannyLow = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[3]);
    candidate.legacyCannyHigh = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[4]);
    core3VisionParamsCommit(&candidate);
    syncFromActive();
}

    g_view.state = CORE3_MENU_HOME;
    markDirty();

static uint8_t handleHome(core3MenuKey key, core3MenuPress press)
{
    if ((key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_3) && (press == CORE3_MENU_PRESS_SHORT))
    {
        g_view.state = CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT;
        g_view.thresholdItem = CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_LOW;
        markDirty();
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_4) && (press == CORE3_MENU_PRESS_SHORT))
    {
        g_view.state = CORE3_MENU_PAGE_LIST;
        g_view.pageIndex = 0;
        g_view.pageScrollTop = 0u;
        markDirty();
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t handlePageList(core3MenuKey key, core3MenuPress press)
{
    if (press != CORE3_MENU_PRESS_SHORT) return 0u;
    if (key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_1)
    {
        enterHome();
        return 1u;
    }
    if (key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_4)
    {
        g_view.state = CORE3_MENU_OPTION_LIST;
        g_view.optionIndex = 0;
        g_view.optionScrollTop = 0u;
        markDirty();
        scheduleParamSlotInspect();
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t handleSlotPage(core3MenuKey key, core3MenuPress press)
{
    if ((key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_5) && (press == CORE3_MENU_PRESS_SHORT))
    {
        enterHome();
        return 1u;
    }
    if (press == CORE3_MENU_PRESS_SHORT)
    {
        if ((key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_2) && (g_view.selectedParamSlot > 0u))
        {
            g_view.selectedParamSlot--;
            scheduleParamSlotInspect();
            return 1u;
        }
        if ((key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_3) &&
            (g_view.selectedParamSlot + 1u < CORE3_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT))
        {
            g_view.selectedParamSlot++;
            scheduleParamSlotInspect();
            return 1u;
        }
        if (key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_4)
        {
            if (core3ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return 1u;
            if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending == 0u &&
                g_paramSlotInspectPending == 0u &&
                g_view.paramGlobalAction ==
                    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY &&
                g_view.paramGlobalSlot ==
                    (uint8_t) (g_view.selectedParamSlot + 1u) &&
                g_view.paramSlotUiState == PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL)
            {
                (void) requestGlobalParamAction(
                    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME,
                    (uint8_t) (g_view.selectedParamSlot + 1u));
            }
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    if ((key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_1) && (press == CORE3_MENU_PRESS_LONG))
    {
        if (core3ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u) return 1u;
        (void) requestGlobalParamAction(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY,
            (uint8_t) (g_view.selectedParamSlot + 1u));
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t handleThresholdEdit(core3MenuKey key, core3MenuPress press)
{
    uint8_t lowIndex = (g_view.detectMode == 1u) ? 3u : 1u;
    uint8_t highIndex = (g_view.detectMode == 1u) ? 4u : 2u;
    uint8_t valueIndex;
    float stepShort;
    float stepLong;
    if (core3ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() != 0u)
    {
        enterHome();
        return 1u;
    }
    float delta;

    if ((key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_5) && (press == CORE3_MENU_PRESS_LONG))
    {
        saveSettings();
        enterHome();
        return 1u;
    }
    if (press != CORE3_MENU_PRESS_SHORT)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_5)
    {
        g_view.thresholdItem = (core3MenuThresholdItem)
            (((uint8_t) g_view.thresholdItem + 1u) % CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_COUNT);
        markDirty();
        return 1u;
    }

    if (g_view.thresholdItem == CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_EXPOSURE)
    {
        valueIndex = 0u;
        stepShort = CORE3_VISION_EXPOSURE_STEP_S;
        stepLong = CORE3_VISION_EXPOSURE_STEP_L;
    }
    else
    {
        valueIndex = (g_view.thresholdItem == CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_LOW)
                         ? lowIndex
                         : highIndex;
        stepShort = (g_view.detectMode == 1u)
                        ? CORE3_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_STEP_S
                        : CORE3_VISION_BINARY_STEP_S;
        stepLong = (g_view.detectMode == 1u)
                       ? CORE3_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_STEP_L
                       : CORE3_VISION_BINARY_STEP_L;
    }

    if (key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_1)
    {
        delta = stepLong;
    }
    else if (key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_2)
    {
        delta = stepShort;
    }
    else if (key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_3)
    {
        delta = -stepShort;
    }
    else if (key == CORE3_MENU_KEY_4)
    {
        delta = -stepLong;
    }
    else
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    *g_options[valueIndex].value += delta;
    applyWorkValues();
    markDirty();
    return 1u;
}

void core3MenuInit(void)
{
    memset(&g_view, 0, sizeof(g_view));
    g_view.state = CORE3_MENU_HOME;
    g_view.pageIndex = 0;
    g_view.optionIndex = 0;
    g_view.screenRevision = 1u;
    g_view.kvmDesiredTarget = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    g_view.kvmInputOwner = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    g_tickMs = 0u;
    g_feedbackStartMs = 0u;
    g_lastValidDesiredTarget = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    g_lastValidDesiredTargetPrimed = 1u;
    g_view.selectedParamSlot = 0u;
    g_view.paramGlobalTarget = 0xFFu;
    g_paramGlobalRequestSequence = 0u;
    g_paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
    g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
    g_paramSlotInspectPending = 0u;
    g_externalParamTransactionActive = 0u;
    g_lastTerminalCoordinatorBoot = 0u;
    g_lastTerminalRequestBoot = 0u;
    g_lastTerminalRequestSequence = 0u;
    memset(&g_paramGlobalState, 0, sizeof(g_paramGlobalState));
    memset(&g_paramGlobalPendingRequest, 0, sizeof(g_paramGlobalPendingRequest));
    g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNKNOWN;
    syncFromActive();
}

void core3MenuTick(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    g_tickMs = tickMs;
    pollGlobalParamState();
    if ((core3ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked() == 0u) &&
        (g_workValuesRevision != core3VisionParamsGetRevision()))
    {
        syncFromActive();
        markDirty();
    }
    if ((g_view.lastAction != CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_feedbackStartMs) >= CORE3_MENU_FEEDBACK_MS))
    {
        g_view.lastAction = CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE;
        markDirty();
    }
    if ((g_paramSlotInspectPending != 0u) &&
        (g_view.lastAction == CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE) &&
        (g_paramGlobalRequestPending == 0u) &&
        (g_paramGlobalStateValid != 0u) &&
        (paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&g_paramGlobalState) != 0u) &&
        requestGlobalParamAction(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY,
            (uint8_t) (g_view.selectedParamSlot + 1u)) != 0u)
    {
        g_paramSlotInspectPending = 0u;
    }
}

void core3MenuSetDetectMode(uint8_t detectMode)
{
    uint8_t normalized = (detectMode == 1u) ? 1u : 0u;

    if (g_view.detectMode != normalized)
    {
        g_view.detectMode = normalized;
        markDirty();
    }
}

void core3MenuSetLinkState(uint8_t linkReady, uint8_t lastCameraControlState)
{
    uint8_t ready = (linkReady != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
    uint8_t controlState = (lastCameraControlState <= 2u) ?
        lastCameraControlState : 0u;
    uint8_t changed = (uint8_t) ((g_view.linkReady != ready) ||
        (g_view.lastCameraControlState != controlState));

    if (ready == 0u)
    {
        invalidateGlobalParamRoute();
        if ((g_view.linkReady != 0u) ||
            (g_view.state != CORE3_MENU_HOME) ||
            (g_view.lastAction != CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE))
        {
            changed = 1u;
            /* 断链中止编辑且不触发保存；固定回HOME继续单板视觉调试。 */
            syncFromActive();
            g_view.state = CORE3_MENU_HOME;
            g_view.thresholdItem = CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_LOW;
            g_view.lastAction = CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE;
            g_view.lastActionOk = 0u;
            g_feedbackStartMs = 0u;
        }
    }
    g_view.linkReady = ready;
    g_view.lastCameraControlState = controlState;
    if (changed != 0u)
    {
        markDirty();
    }
}

void core3MenuSetControlOwned(uint8_t controlOwned)
{
    uint8_t owned = ((g_view.linkReady != 0u) && (controlOwned != 0u)) ? 1u : 0u;

    if (g_view.controlOwned != owned)
    {
        g_view.controlOwned = owned;
        markDirty();
    }
}

void core3MenuSetKvmRoute(uint8_t desiredTarget, uint8_t inputOwner)
{
    if ((isValidKvmTarget(desiredTarget) != 0u) &&
        (g_lastValidDesiredTargetPrimed != 0u) &&
        (g_lastValidDesiredTarget == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) &&
        (desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3))
    {
        returnHomeForKvmSwitch();
    }
    if (isValidKvmTarget(desiredTarget) != 0u)
    {
        g_lastValidDesiredTarget = desiredTarget;
        g_lastValidDesiredTargetPrimed = 1u;
    }
    if ((g_view.kvmDesiredTarget != desiredTarget) ||
        (g_view.kvmInputOwner != inputOwner))
    {
        g_view.kvmDesiredTarget = desiredTarget;
        g_view.kvmInputOwner = inputOwner;
        markDirty();
    }
}

uint8_t core3MenuSubmitKey(core3MenuKey key, core3MenuPress press)
{
    if ((key > CORE3_MENU_KEY_5) || (press > CORE3_MENU_PRESS_LONG))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (g_view.lastAction != CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE)
    {
        /* 成功提示期间确认并吞掉已送达事件，禁止上游把旧按键重放。 */
        return 1u;
    }
    if (g_view.linkReady == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if ((g_lastValidDesiredTargetPrimed == 0u) ||
        (g_lastValidDesiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    switch (g_view.state)
    {
        case CORE3_MENU_HOME:
            return handleHome(key, press);
        case CORE3_MENU_PAGE_LIST:
            return handlePageList(key, press);
        case CORE3_MENU_OPTION_LIST:
            return handleSlotPage(key, press);
        case CORE3_MENU_EDIT:
            enterHome();
            return 0u;
        case CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT:
            return handleThresholdEdit(key, press);
        case CORE3_MENU_WAIT_LINK:
            return 0u;
        default:
            return 0u;
    }
}

    if (view != NULL)
    {
        *view = g_view;
    }
}

    return ((pageIndex == 0u) && (optionIndex == 0u)) ? "Slot" : "";
}

double core3MenuGetOptionValue(uint8_t pageIndex, uint8_t optionIndex)

    return ((pageIndex == 0u) && (optionIndex == 0u))
        ? (double) (g_view.selectedParamSlot + 1u) : 0.0;
}

void core3MenuFormatValue(double value,
    char output[CORE3_MENU_VALUE_CHARS + 1u])
{
    uint8_t position;
    uint8_t negative = 0u;
    uint32_t integerPart;

    if (output == NULL)
    {
        return;
    }
    memset(output, ' ', CORE3_MENU_VALUE_CHARS);
    output[CORE3_MENU_VALUE_CHARS] = '\0';

    if (value < 0.0)
    {
        negative = 1u;
        value = -value;
    }
    integerPart = (uint32_t) (value + 0.5);

    position = CORE3_MENU_VALUE_CHARS;
    do
    {
        output[--position] = (char) ('0' + (integerPart % 10u));
        integerPart /= 10u;
    } while ((integerPart != 0u) && (position > 0u));
    if ((negative != 0u) && (position > 0u))
    {
        output[--position] = '-';
    }
}

static void core3RuntimeUpdateLocalPhase(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    if (g_status.core1LinkReady == 0u)
    {
        g_linkReadyStableStartMs = 0u;
        if ((g_localStandalone != 0u) || (tickMs >= CORE3_INITIAL_LINK_WAIT_MS))
        {
            g_localStandalone = 1u;
            g_status.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE;
            g_status.systemFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_STANDALONE;
            g_status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CORE1_LINK;
        }
        else
        {
            g_status.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_LINK_WAIT;
            g_status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CORE1_LINK;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (g_localStandalone != 0u)
    {
        if (g_linkReadyStableStartMs == 0u) g_linkReadyStableStartMs = tickMs;
        g_status.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN;
        g_status.systemFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_REJOIN;
        g_status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CORE1_LINK;
        if ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_linkReadyStableStartMs) >= CORE3_REJOIN_STABLE_MS)
        {
            /* 规划重入只建立规划屏障，不得撤销正交的KVM租约或在途ACK。 */
            g_localStandalone = 0u;
            g_linkReadyStableStartMs = 0u;
            g_rejoinBarrierUntilMs = tickMs + CORE3_RUNTIME_PIT_MS;
        }
        return;
    }
    if ((g_rejoinBarrierUntilMs != 0u) &&
        ((int32_t) (g_rejoinBarrierUntilMs - tickMs) > 0))
    {
        g_status.controlFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_BARRIER_REQUIRED;
        g_status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_BARRIER;
    }
    else
    {
        g_rejoinBarrierUntilMs = 0u;
    }
}

    config->trackSizeRatioMax = 2.0f;

    config->trackDropMisses = 4u;
    config->trackCoastMisses = 2u;
    config->trackPositionAlpha = 1.0f;
    config->trackSizeAlpha = 1.0f;
    config->trackAreaVelAlpha = 0.35f;
    config->trackAssocScoreMax = 1.75f;
    config->trackAssocAreaWeight = 0.45f;
    config->trackAssocAreaVelWeight = 0.35f;
    config->beaconHuTemplate[0] = 0.180488205803f;
    config->beaconHuTemplate[1] = 0.0079012345679f;
    config->beaconHuTemplate[2] = 0.000123277089059f;
    config->beaconHuTemplate[3] = 0.00000801787369286f;
    config->hash = observerLinkSharedConfigHash(config);
}

static void core3RuntimeProcessKvm(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    core3LinkCore3Status linkStatus;
    observerLinkKvmControl control;
    observerLinkKvmEvent event;
    core3KvmCore3Status kvmStatus;
    core3MenuView view;
    observerKvmBindingAction bindingAction;
    uint8_t handled;

    core3LinkCore3GetStatus(&linkStatus);
    bindingAction = observerKvmBindingGuardObserve(&g_kvmBindingGuard,
        linkStatus.ownerSession, linkStatus.bindingEpoch);
    if (bindingAction != OBSERVER_KVM_BINDING_UNCHANGED)
    {
        if (bindingAction == OBSERVER_KVM_BINDING_REBOUND)
            core3KvmCore3Revoke();
        core3RuntimeClearKvmPending();
    }
    if (g_status.kvmLinkReady == 0u)
    {
        core3KvmCore3Revoke();
        core3RuntimeClearKvmPending();
    }
    core3KvmCore3Poll(tickMs);
    while (core3LinkCore3TakeKvmControl(&control) != 0u)
    {
        if (g_status.kvmLinkReady != 0u)
        {
            (void) core3KvmCore3ApplyControl(&control, tickMs);
        }
    }
    if (g_pendingKvmEventValid == 0u)
    {
        g_pendingKvmEventValid = core3LinkCore3TakeKvmEvent(
            &g_pendingKvmEvent);
    }
    if ((g_pendingKvmEventValid != 0u) &&
        (core3KvmCore3ApplyEvent(&g_pendingKvmEvent, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_pendingKvmEventValid = 0u;
    }
    if (core3KvmCore3TakeEvent(&event) != 0u)
    {
        handled = core3MenuSubmitKey((core3MenuKey) event.keyId,
            (core3MenuPress) event.keyState);
        core3MenuGetView(&view);
        (void) core3KvmCore3CompleteEvent(
            handled ? OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_EXECUTED : OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_UNHANDLED,
            (uint8_t) view.state,
            (uint8_t) ((g_status.kvmLinkReady != 0u) &&
                (view.state == CORE3_MENU_HOME) &&
                (view.lastAction == CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE)),
            (uint8_t) view.lastAction,
            view.lastActionOk,
            view.screenRevision);
    }
    if (g_pendingKvmAckValid == 0u)
    {
        g_pendingKvmAckValid = core3KvmCore3TakeAck(&g_pendingKvmAck);
    }
    if ((g_pendingKvmAckValid != 0u) &&
        (core3LinkCore3QueueKvmAck(&g_pendingKvmAck) != 0u))
    {
        g_pendingKvmAckValid = 0u;
    }
    core3MenuGetView(&view);
    core3KvmCore3UpdateMenu((uint8_t) view.state,
        (uint8_t) ((g_status.kvmLinkReady != 0u) &&
            (view.state == CORE3_MENU_HOME) &&
            (view.lastAction == CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE)),
        (uint8_t) view.lastAction,
        view.lastActionOk,
        (uint8_t) (view.lastAction != CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE),
        view.screenRevision);
    if ((view.screenRevision != g_lastKvmMenuRevision) ||
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastKvmMenuTickMs) >= 50u))
    {
        core3KvmCore3GetMenuStatus(&g_pendingKvmMenu);
        g_pendingKvmMenuValid = 1u;
    }
    if ((g_pendingKvmMenuValid != 0u) &&
        (core3LinkCore3QueueKvmMenuStatus(&g_pendingKvmMenu) != 0u))
    {
        g_lastKvmMenuRevision = g_pendingKvmMenu.screenRevision;
        g_lastKvmMenuTickMs = tickMs;
        g_pendingKvmMenuValid = 0u;
    }
    core3KvmCore3GetStatus(&kvmStatus);
    g_status.kvmControlOwned = (uint8_t) ((g_status.kvmLinkReady != 0u) &&
        (kvmStatus.leaseValid != 0u));
    /* KVM租约与规划控制状态正交。CONTROL_STATUS暂时过期时，仍以直接租约
     * 作为本机按键owner事实，避免有效操控期间框线被误判为黄色。 */
    core3RuntimePublishMenuKvmRoute();
}

static void core3RuntimeApplyCameraConfig(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t revision;

    if (g_cameraInitialized == 0u)
    {
        return;
    }
    revision = core3VisionParamsGetRevision();
    if (revision == g_lastAppliedCameraConfigRevision)
    {
        return;
    }
    if ((revision == g_lastCameraConfigAttemptRevision) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastCameraConfigAttemptTickMs) <
            CORE3_CAMERA_CONFIG_RETRY_MS))
    {
        return;
    }
    g_lastCameraConfigAttemptRevision = revision;
    g_lastCameraConfigAttemptTickMs = tickMs;
    if (core3CameraServiceSetExposure(
            core3VisionParamsGetActive()->exposure) != 0u)
    {
        if (g_status.configApplyFailures < UINT32_MAX)
        {
            g_status.configApplyFailures++;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        g_lastAppliedCameraConfigRevision = revision;
    }
}

static void core3RuntimeRecordMaxUs(uint32_t elapsedUs, uint32_t *maximumUs)
{
    if ((elapsedUs != CORE3_TIMING_INVALID_US) && (elapsedUs > *maximumUs))
    {
        *maximumUs = elapsedUs;
    }
}

static void core3RuntimeAttemptCameraInit(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t result;

    g_lastInitAttemptTickMs = tickMs;
    g_status.cameraInitAttempts++;
    result = core3CameraServiceInit();
    if (result == 0u)
    {
        g_cameraInitialized = 1u;
        g_status.initFailedMask &= (uint8_t) ~CORE3_INIT_FAIL_CAMERA;
        g_status.state = CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_STARTING;
        g_lastFrameTickMs = tickMs;
        g_recoveryFrameStreak = 0u;
        core3RuntimeApplyCameraConfig(tickMs);
    }
    else
    {
        g_cameraInitialized = 0u;
        g_status.initFailedMask |= CORE3_INIT_FAIL_CAMERA;
        g_status.cameraInitFailures++;
        g_status.state = CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_FAULT;
    }
}

static void core3RuntimeConsumeFrame(const core3CameraSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    uint32_t frameIntervalMs = 0u;

    if (g_status.frameValid != 0u)
    {
        uint32_t expectedFrames;

        frameIntervalMs = snapshot->tickMs - g_lastFrameTickMs;
        expectedFrames =
            (frameIntervalMs + (CORE3_CAMERA_EXPECTED_FRAME_MS / 2u)) /
            CORE3_CAMERA_EXPECTED_FRAME_MS;
        if (expectedFrames > 1u)
        {
            g_status.estimatedMissedFrames += expectedFrames - 1u;
        }
    }

    g_latestSnapshot = *snapshot;
    g_lastFrameTickMs = snapshot->tickMs;
    g_status.frameValid = 1u;
    g_status.appFrameSeq = snapshot->appFrameSeq;
    g_statsWindowFrames++;

    if (g_status.state == CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_STARTING)
    {
        g_status.state = CORE3_RUNTIME_RUNNING;
        g_recoveryFrameStreak = 0u;
    }
    else if (g_status.state == CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_FAULT)
    {
        if ((g_recoveryFrameStreak == 0u) ||
            (frameIntervalMs < CORE3_CAMERA_FRAME_TIMEOUT_MS))
        {
            g_recoveryFrameStreak++;
        }
        else
        {
            g_recoveryFrameStreak = 1u;
        }

        if (g_recoveryFrameStreak >= CORE3_CAMERA_RECOVERY_FRAMES)
        {
            g_status.state = CORE3_RUNTIME_RUNNING;
            g_recoveryFrameStreak = 0u;
        }
    }
}

static void core3RuntimeUpdateStats(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t windowMs = tickMs - g_statsWindowStartTickMs;

    if (windowMs >= core3VisionParamsGetActive()->statsPeriodMs)
    {
        g_status.appFps = (g_statsWindowFrames * 1000u) / windowMs;
        g_statsWindowFrames = 0u;
        g_statsWindowStartTickMs = tickMs;
    }

    if (g_status.frameValid != 0u)
    {
        g_status.frameAgeMs = tickMs - g_lastFrameTickMs;
    }
}

static void core3RuntimeUpdateParamStatus(void)
{
    core3VisionParamsPersistenceStatus persistenceStatus;

    core3VisionParamsPersistenceGetStatus(&persistenceStatus);
    g_status.paramsLoadStatus = (uint8_t) persistenceStatus.lastLoad;
    g_status.flashWriteFailures = persistenceStatus.writeVerifyFailures;
    g_status.configRevision = core3VisionParamsGetRevision();
}
static void core3RuntimeUpdateLinkStatus(void)
{
    core3LinkCore3Status linkStatus;
    observerLinkViewOverlay overlay;
    uint32_t overlayAge = UINT32_MAX;
    uint8_t statusValid;

    core3LinkCore3GetStatus(&linkStatus);
    g_status.core1LinkOnline = linkStatus.online;
    g_status.core1ProtocolCompatible = linkStatus.protocolCompatible;
    g_status.sharedConfigStatus = linkStatus.configStatus;
    g_status.sharedConfigMode = linkStatus.stagedMode;
    g_status.core1LinkReady = (uint8_t) (
        (linkStatus.online != 0u) && (linkStatus.protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
        (linkStatus.planningCompatible != 0u) &&
        (linkStatus.configStatus == OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED));
    g_status.kvmLinkReady = (uint8_t) ((linkStatus.online != 0u) &&
        (linkStatus.protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
        ((linkStatus.peerCapabilities &
            (OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_KVM | OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_MENU_STATUS)) ==
            (OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_KVM | OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_MENU_STATUS)));
    statusValid = (uint8_t) ((g_status.core1LinkReady != 0u) &&
        (linkStatus.controlStatusValid != 0u) &&
        (linkStatus.cameraControlValid != 0u));
    g_status.controlStatusValid = linkStatus.controlStatusValid;
    g_status.lastCameraControlState = linkStatus.lastKnownCameraControlState;
    g_status.cameraControlState = statusValid ?
        linkStatus.cameraControlState : OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_SAFE;
    g_status.cameraControlReady = statusValid;
    g_status.cameraControlLocked = 1u;
    g_status.activeSource = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE;
    g_status.controlClass = OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE;
    g_status.controlFlags = 0u;
    g_status.navState = 0u;
    g_status.systemPhase = OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_LINK_WAIT;
    g_status.systemFlags = 0u;
    g_status.primaryReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CORE1_LINK;
    g_status.kvmDesiredTarget = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0;
    g_status.kvmInputOwner = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE;
    g_status.controlBeaconCount = 0u;
    g_status.core0LinkUp = 0u;
    g_status.core2LinkUp = 0u;
    g_status.targetX = 0u;
    g_status.targetY = 0u;
    g_status.targetSize = 0u;
    g_status.errXQ4 = 0;
    g_status.errYQ4 = 0;
    g_status.viewOverlayValid = 0u;
    g_status.viewOverlayAgeMs = UINT32_MAX;
    memset(&g_status.viewOverlay, 0, sizeof(g_status.viewOverlay));
    if (g_status.controlStatusValid != 0u)
    {
        const observerLinkControlStatus *control = &linkStatus.controlStatus;

        g_status.kvmDesiredTarget = control->desiredTarget;
        g_status.kvmInputOwner = control->ownerTarget;
        g_status.core0LinkUp = (uint8_t) ((control->flags &
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_CORE0_LINK_UP) != 0u);
        g_status.core2LinkUp = (uint8_t) ((control->flags &
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_CORE2_LINK_UP) != 0u);
    }
    if (statusValid != 0u)
    {
        const observerLinkControlStatus *control = &linkStatus.controlStatus;

        g_status.activeSource = control->activeSource;
        g_status.controlClass = control->controlClass;
        g_status.controlFlags = control->flags;
        g_status.navState = control->navState;
        g_status.systemPhase = control->systemPhase;
        g_status.systemFlags = control->systemFlags;
        g_status.primaryReason = control->primaryReason;
        g_status.controlBeaconCount = control->beaconCount;
        g_status.cameraControlLocked = (uint8_t) ((control->flags &
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_REMOTE_ELIGIBLE) == 0u);
        g_status.targetX = control->targetX;
        g_status.targetY = control->targetY;
        g_status.targetSize = control->targetSize;
        g_status.errXQ4 = control->errXQ4;
        g_status.errYQ4 = control->errYQ4;
    }
    if (core3LinkCore3GetViewOverlay(&overlay, g_status.tickMs,
            200u, &overlayAge) != 0u)
    {
        g_status.viewOverlay = overlay;
        g_status.viewOverlayValid = 1u;
        g_status.viewOverlayAgeMs = overlayAge;
    }
    g_status.core1Session = linkStatus.ownerSession;
    g_status.sharedConfigRevision = linkStatus.stagedRevision;
    g_status.sharedConfigHash = linkStatus.stagedHash;
    g_status.linkCrcErrors = linkStatus.localDiagnostics.crcErrors;
    g_status.linkLengthErrors = linkStatus.localDiagnostics.lengthErrors;
    g_status.linkRxOverflowErrors = linkStatus.localDiagnostics.rxOverflowErrors;
    g_status.peerRxOverflowErrors = linkStatus.peerDiagnostics.rxOverflowErrors;
    g_status.linkTxDeferred = linkStatus.txDeferred;
}

static void core3RuntimeUpdateVisionStatus(void)
{
    core3VisionPipelineStatus pipelineStatus;
    core3VisionObservation observation;

    core3VisionPipelineGetStatus(&pipelineStatus);
    core3VisionPipelineGetObservation(&observation);
    g_status.visionApplied = pipelineStatus.applied;
    g_status.visionDetectMode = pipelineStatus.detectMode;
    if (observation.valid != 0u)
    {
        uint16_t i;
        uint16_t ordinaryRetained = 0u;
        g_latestObservation = observation;
        g_status.visionOverflow = observation.truncated;
        g_status.visionMaxBeacons = observation.maxBeacons;
        g_status.confirmedBeacons = observation.confirmedTotal;
        g_status.freshBeacons = observation.freshTotal;
        for (i = 0u; i < observation.retainedCount; i++)
        {
            if ((observation.tracks[i].flags &
                    BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u)
                ordinaryRetained++;
        }
        g_status.retainedBeacons = ordinaryRetained;
    }
    else
    {
        memset(&g_latestObservation, 0, sizeof(g_latestObservation));
        g_status.visionOverflow = 0u;
        g_status.visionMaxBeacons = 0u;
        g_status.confirmedBeacons = 0u;
        g_status.freshBeacons = 0u;
        g_status.retainedBeacons = 0u;
    }
}

static void core3RuntimePublishHealth(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    core3LinkCore3Status linkStatus;
    observerLinkHealth health;
    uint32_t frameAge = (g_status.appFrameSeq != 0u) ?
        (tickMs - g_lastFrameTickMs) : UINT32_MAX;

    core3LinkCore3GetStatus(&linkStatus);
    memset(&health, 0, sizeof(health));
    health.ownerSession = linkStatus.ownerSession;
    health.appFrameSeq = g_status.appFrameSeq;
    health.captureTickMs = g_lastFrameTickMs;
    health.frameAgeMs = (frameAge > UINT16_MAX) ? UINT16_MAX : (uint16_t) frameAge;
    health.bridgeAgeMs = UINT16_MAX;
    health.sourceId = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3;
    health.configState = linkStatus.configStatus;
    if ((g_cameraInitialized != 0u) &&
        (g_status.state == CORE3_RUNTIME_RUNNING))
    {
        health.cameraState = OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_RUNNING;
    }
    else if ((g_status.state == CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_FAULT) ||
        (g_status.cameraInitFailures != 0u))
    {
        health.cameraState = OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_FAULT;
    }
    else
    {
        health.cameraState = OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_UNKNOWN;
    }
    if (frameAge < CORE3_CAMERA_FRAME_TIMEOUT_MS)
    {
        health.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_FLAG_FRAME_FRESH;
    }
    (void) core3LinkCore3PublishHealth(&health);
}

static uint8_t core3RuntimeBuildPlanningSnapshot(
    const core3VisionObservation *observation,
    observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    uint16_t i;
    uint16_t ordinaryRetained = 0u;

    if ((observation == NULL) || (snapshot == NULL) ||
        (observation->valid == 0u) ||
        (observation->sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) ||
        (observation->detectMode > 1u) ||
        (observation->ownerSession == 0u) ||
        (observation->retainedCount > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS) ||
        (observation->confirmedTotal > UINT8_MAX) ||
        (observation->freshTotal > UINT8_MAX) ||
        (observation->freshLeft > UINT8_MAX) ||
        (observation->freshRight > UINT8_MAX) ||
        (observation->freshTotal > observation->confirmedTotal) ||
        ((uint32_t) observation->freshLeft + observation->freshRight !=
            observation->freshTotal))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    memset(snapshot, 0, sizeof(*snapshot));
    snapshot->valid = 1u;
    snapshot->sourceId = observation->sourceId;
    snapshot->detectMode = observation->detectMode;
    snapshot->truncated = observation->truncated;
    snapshot->ownerSession = observation->ownerSession;
    snapshot->revision = observation->configRevision;
    snapshot->hash = observation->configHash;
    snapshot->appFrameSeq = observation->appFrameSeq;
    snapshot->captureTickMs = observation->tickMs;
    snapshot->trackerFrameSeq = observation->trackerFrameSeq;
    snapshot->confirmedTotal = (uint8_t) observation->confirmedTotal;
    snapshot->freshTotal = (uint8_t) observation->freshTotal;
    snapshot->freshLeft = (uint8_t) observation->freshLeft;
    snapshot->freshRight = (uint8_t) observation->freshRight;
    snapshot->retainedCount = (uint8_t) observation->retainedCount;

    for (i = 0u; i < observation->retainedCount; i++)
    {
        const core3VisionTrack *source = &observation->tracks[i];
        observerLinkPlanningTrack *destination = &snapshot->tracks[i];
        uint8_t rejected = (uint8_t) ((source->flags &
            OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u);
        uint16_t j;

        if ((source->centerX >= 188u) || (source->centerY >= 120u) ||
            (source->predX >= 188u) || (source->predY >= 120u) ||
            (source->size > 22560u) || (source->predSize > 22560u) ||
            (source->trackId == 0u) ||
            (source->misses > OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_MISSES_MAX) ||
            ((source->flags & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_FRESH |
                                          OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_COAST |
                                          OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_EDGE_GRACE |
                                          OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED)) != 0u) ||
            (((source->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_FRESH) != 0u) !=
                (source->fresh != 0u)))
        {
            return 0u;
        }
        for (j = 0u; j < i; j++)
        {
            if (observation->tracks[j].trackId == source->trackId)
            {
                return 0u;
            }
        }
        if (rejected != 0u)
        {
            if ((source->flags != OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) ||
                (source->centerX != 0u) || (source->centerY != 0u) ||
                (source->predX != 0u) || (source->predY != 0u) ||
                (source->size != 0u) || (source->predSize != 0u) ||
                (source->misses != 0u) || (source->fresh != 0u) ||
                (source->velX != 0.0f) || (source->velY != 0.0f) ||
                (source->areaVel != 0.0f)) return 0u;
        }
        else
        {
            ordinaryRetained++;
        }
        destination->centerX = (uint8_t) source->centerX;
        destination->centerY = (uint8_t) source->centerY;
        destination->predX = (uint8_t) source->predX;
        destination->predY = (uint8_t) source->predY;
        destination->size = source->size;
        destination->predSize = source->predSize;
        destination->trackId = source->trackId;
        destination->misses = source->misses;
        destination->flags = source->flags;
        if ((observerLinkQuantizeSigned(source->velX, 128.0f,
                -256.0f, 255.9921875f, &destination->velXQ7) == 0u) ||
            (observerLinkQuantizeSigned(source->velY, 128.0f,
                -256.0f, 255.9921875f, &destination->velYQ7) == 0u) ||
            (observerLinkQuantizeSigned(source->areaVel, 1.0f,
                -32768.0f, 32767.0f, &destination->areaVelQ0) == 0u))
        {
            return 0u;
        }
    }
    return (uint8_t) (ordinaryRetained <= observation->confirmedTotal);
}

static void core3RuntimeProcessVisionFrame(const core3CameraSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    core3LinkCore3Status linkStatus;
    observerLinkSharedConfig staged;
    core3VisionObservation observation;
    observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot wireSnapshot;
    core3VisionPipelineStatus pipelineStatus;
    uint8_t remoteQualified;

    core3LinkCore3GetStatus(&linkStatus);
    remoteQualified = (uint8_t) ((linkStatus.online != 0u) &&
        (linkStatus.protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
        (linkStatus.ownerSession != 0u) &&
        (core3LinkCore3GetStagedConfig(&staged) != 0u));
    core3VisionPipelineGetStatus(&pipelineStatus);
    if ((remoteQualified == 0u) && (pipelineStatus.applied == 0u))
    {
        core3LinkCore3GetStatus(&linkStatus);
        core3RuntimeBuildStandaloneConfig(&staged);
        if (core3VisionPipelineApplyAtFrameBoundary(
                core3VisionParamsGetActive(),
                core3VisionParamsGetRevision(),
                &staged,
                linkStatus.localSession,
                linkStatus.localSession) == 0u)
        {
            core3RuntimeUpdateVisionStatus();
            return;
        }
    }
    if ((remoteQualified != 0u) &&
        (core3VisionPipelineApplyAtFrameBoundary(
            core3VisionParamsGetActive(),
            core3VisionParamsGetRevision(),
            &staged,
            linkStatus.localSession,
            linkStatus.ownerSession) == 0u))
    {
        if (g_status.configApplyFailures < UINT32_MAX)
        {
            g_status.configApplyFailures++;
        }
        core3VisionPipelineInvalidate();
        core3RuntimeUpdateVisionStatus();
        return;
    }
    if ((remoteQualified != 0u) &&
        ((linkStatus.configStatus != OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED) ||
            (linkStatus.appliedRevision != staged.revision) ||
            (linkStatus.appliedHash != staged.hash) ||
            (linkStatus.appliedMode != staged.detectMode)) &&
        (core3LinkCore3MarkConfigApplied(linkStatus.ownerSession,
             staged.revision,
             staged.hash,
             staged.detectMode) == 0u))
    {
        if (g_status.configApplyFailures < UINT32_MAX)
        {
            g_status.configApplyFailures++;
        }
        core3RuntimeUpdateVisionStatus();
        return;
    }
    core3VisionPipelineSetSelectedTrackId(
        ((g_status.viewOverlayValid != 0u) &&
         (g_status.activeSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
         ((g_status.viewOverlay.flags &
            OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_SELECTED) != 0u)) ?
            g_status.viewOverlay.selectedTrackId : 0u);
    if (core3VisionPipelineProcess(snapshot) == 0u)
    {
        if (g_status.configApplyFailures < UINT32_MAX)
        {
            g_status.configApplyFailures++;
        }
        core3VisionPipelineInvalidate();
    }
    else
    {
        core3VisionPipelineGetObservation(&observation);
        if ((remoteQualified != 0u) &&
            (observation.ownerSession == linkStatus.ownerSession) &&
            (core3RuntimeBuildPlanningSnapshot(&observation,
                &wireSnapshot) != 0u)
            )
        {
            (void) core3LinkCore3QueuePlanningTrackSnapshot(&wireSnapshot);
        }
    }
    core3RuntimeUpdateVisionStatus();
}

static void core3RuntimeRenderView(const core3MenuView *view, uint32_t tickMs,
    uint8_t updateThresholdImages)
{
    uint32_t displayUs;

    if (view == NULL)
    {
        return;
    }
    if ((view->state != CORE3_MENU_HOME) ||
        (view->lastAction != CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE))
    {
        g_lastMenuRenderTickMs = tickMs;
        if (view->state == CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT)
        {
            displayUs = core3DiagnosticsRenderThresholdEditor(view,
                ((g_status.frameValid != 0u) &&
                 (g_status.state != CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_FAULT)) ?
                    &g_latestSnapshot : NULL,
                ((g_status.frameValid != 0u) &&
                 (g_status.state != CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_FAULT)) ?
                    core3VisionPipelineGetPreview() : NULL,
                updateThresholdImages);
        }
        else
        {
            displayUs = core3DiagnosticsRenderMenu(view);
        }
    }
    else
    {
        g_lastHudTickMs = tickMs;
        displayUs = core3DiagnosticsRenderHud(&g_status);
    }
    g_lastRenderedMenuRevision = view->screenRevision;
    if (g_status.timingInvalid == 0u)
    {
        core3RuntimeRecordMaxUs(displayUs, &g_status.displayMaxUs);
    }
}

void core3RuntimeInit(void)
{
    core3VisionParamsStruct initialParams;
    core3VisionParamsLoadStatus loadStatus;
    uint32_t displayUs;

    g_tickMs = 0u;
    g_tickDue = 0u;
    g_cameraInitialized = 0u;
    g_recoveryFrameStreak = 0u;
    g_lastInitAttemptTickMs = 0u;
    g_lastFrameTickMs = 0u;
    g_statsWindowStartTickMs = 0u;
    g_statsWindowFrames = 0u;
    g_lastHudTickMs = 0u;
    g_lastPreviewTickMs = 0u;
    g_lastMenuRenderTickMs = 0u;
    g_lastRenderedMenuRevision = 0u;
    g_lastCameraConfigAttemptTickMs = 0u;
    g_lastCameraConfigAttemptRevision = 0u;
    g_lastAppliedCameraConfigRevision = 0u;
    observerKvmBindingGuardInit(&g_kvmBindingGuard);
    g_lastKvmLocalSession = 0u;
    g_lastKvmMenuTickMs = 0u;
    g_lastKvmMenuRevision = 0u;
    core3RuntimeClearKvmPending();
    g_linkReadyStableStartMs = 0u;
    g_rejoinBarrierUntilMs = 0u;
    g_localStandalone = 0u;
    g_initSummaryUntilMs = 0u;
    g_initSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFu;
    memset(&g_status, 0, sizeof(g_status));
    g_menuConfirmedSwitchedAway = 0u;
    memset(&g_latestSnapshot, 0, sizeof(g_latestSnapshot));

    g_status.state = CORE3_RUNTIME_BOOT;
    core3DiagnosticsDisplayInitEarly();
    core3VisionParamsLoadDefaults(&initialParams);
    loadStatus = core3VisionParamsFlashLoad(&initialParams);
    g_status.paramsLoadStatus = (uint8_t) loadStatus;
    if (core3RuntimeFlashLoadFailed(loadStatus) != 0u)
        g_status.initFailedMask |= CORE3_INIT_FAIL_FLASH;
    core3VisionParamsSanitize(&initialParams);
    core3VisionParamsSetInitial(&initialParams);
    core3MenuInit();
    core3DiagnosticsRuntimeInit();
    g_status.timingInvalid = (uint8_t) (core3DiagnosticsTimingValid() == 0u);
    if (g_status.timingInvalid != 0u)
    {
        g_status.snapshotMaxUs = CORE3_TIMING_INVALID_US;
        g_status.foregroundMaxUs = CORE3_TIMING_INVALID_US;
        g_status.displayMaxUs = CORE3_TIMING_INVALID_US;
    }

    if (core3VisionPipelineInit() == 0u)
        g_status.initFailedMask |= CORE3_INIT_FAIL_PIPELINE;
    core3LinkCore3Init(0u);
    {
        core3VisionPipelineStatus pipelineStatus;
        core3VisionPipelineGetStatus(&pipelineStatus);
        core3LinkCore3SetVisionReady(pipelineStatus.ready);
    }
    {
        core3LinkCore3Status linkStatus;
        core3LinkCore3GetStatus(&linkStatus);
        core3KvmCore3Init(linkStatus.localSession);
        g_lastKvmLocalSession = linkStatus.localSession;
    }
    core3RuntimeUpdateParamStatus();
    core3RuntimeUpdateLinkStatus();
    core3RuntimeUpdateLocalPhase(0u);
    core3MenuSetLinkState(g_status.kvmLinkReady,
        g_status.lastCameraControlState);
    core3RuntimePublishMenuKvmRoute();
    core3RuntimeUpdateVisionStatus();

    core3RuntimeAttemptCameraInit(0u);
    if (g_cameraInitialized == 0u)
        g_status.initFailedMask |= CORE3_INIT_FAIL_CAMERA;
    if (g_status.timingInvalid != 0u)
        g_status.initUnverifiedMask |= CORE3_INIT_CHECK_DWT;
    if ((g_status.initFailedMask | g_status.initUnverifiedMask) != 0u)
    {
        g_initSummaryUntilMs = 3000u;
        g_initSummaryLastSecond = 3u;
    }
    core3DiagnosticsUpdateRgb(&g_status, 0u);

    {
        core3MenuView menuView;

        core3MenuGetView(&menuView);
        displayUs = core3RuntimeInitSummaryActive(0u) ?
            core3DiagnosticsRenderInitFaultSummary(g_status.initFailedMask,
                g_status.initUnverifiedMask, 3u) :
            core3DiagnosticsRenderMenu(&menuView);
        g_lastRenderedMenuRevision = menuView.screenRevision;
        if (g_status.timingInvalid == 0u)
        {
            core3RuntimeRecordMaxUs(displayUs, &g_status.displayMaxUs);
        }
    }

    /* PIT 最后启动，确保 ISR 首次到来前全部 owner 状态已就绪。 */
    pit_ms_init(PIT_CH2, CORE3_RUNTIME_PIT_MS);
}

void core3RuntimeTick10msIsr(void)
{
    g_tickMs += CORE3_RUNTIME_PIT_MS;
    g_tickDue = 1u;
}

void core3RuntimeProcess(void)
{
    core3CameraSnapshot snapshot;
    uint32_t copyCycles = 0u;
    uint32_t foregroundStartCycles;
    uint32_t foregroundUs;
    uint32_t displayUs;
    uint32_t tickMs = g_tickMs;
    uint8_t captured = 0u;
    core3MenuView menuView;

    foregroundStartCycles = core3DiagnosticsCycleNow();
    /* 到期位只作观测提示，调度真相是单写者 tick 的无符号差值，因此清零竞态不会丢时间。 */
    g_tickDue = 0u;
    g_status.tickMs = tickMs;
    core3LinkCore3Poll(tickMs);
    {
        core3LinkCore3Status linkStatus;
        core3LinkCore3GetStatus(&linkStatus);
        if ((linkStatus.localSession != 0u) &&
            (linkStatus.localSession != g_lastKvmLocalSession))
        {
            core3KvmCore3Init(linkStatus.localSession);
            g_lastKvmLocalSession = linkStatus.localSession;
            core3RuntimeClearKvmPending();
        }
    }
    core3RuntimeUpdateLinkStatus();
    core3RuntimeUpdateLocalPhase(tickMs);
    core3MenuSetLinkState(g_status.kvmLinkReady,
        g_status.lastCameraControlState);
    core3RuntimePublishMenuKvmRoute();
    core3MenuSetDetectMode((g_status.sharedConfigMode <= 1u)
                               ? g_status.sharedConfigMode
                               : g_status.visionDetectMode);
    core3MenuTick(tickMs);
    core3RuntimeProcessKvm(tickMs);
    /* ACK/MENU_STATUS在逻辑提交后同拍发送，不等待相机复制或视觉算法。 */
    core3LinkCore3FlushControl(tickMs);
    core3MenuSetControlOwned(g_status.kvmControlOwned);
    core3MenuGetView(&menuView);

    if (g_cameraInitialized != 0u)
    {
        captured = core3CameraServiceTryCapture(tickMs,
            (uint8_t) (g_status.timingInvalid == 0u),
            &snapshot,
            &copyCycles);
        if (captured != 0u)
        {
            uint32_t copyUs = core3DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(copyCycles);

            core3RuntimeConsumeFrame(&snapshot);
            if (g_status.timingInvalid == 0u)
            {
                core3RuntimeRecordMaxUs(copyUs, &g_status.snapshotMaxUs);
            }
        }

        /* 快照仍严格早于显示；菜单状态变更在大块视觉算法前优先脏区绘制，
         * 不再叠加100ms周期门和一整拍算法耗时。 */
        if ((core3RuntimeInitSummaryActive(tickMs) == 0u) &&
            (menuView.screenRevision != g_lastRenderedMenuRevision))
        {
            core3RuntimeRenderView(&menuView, tickMs, 0u);
        }
        if (captured != 0u)
        {
            core3RuntimeProcessVisionFrame(&snapshot);
            /* 新规划快照产生后立即使用本epoch剩余发送预算；UART仍由前台单owner串行访问。 */
            core3LinkCore3FlushTx(tickMs);
        }

        if (((g_status.state == CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_STARTING) ||
                (g_status.state == CORE3_RUNTIME_RUNNING)) &&
            ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastFrameTickMs) >= CORE3_CAMERA_FRAME_TIMEOUT_MS))
        {
            g_status.state = CORE3_RUNTIME_CAMERA_FAULT;
            g_recoveryFrameStreak = 0u;
        }
    }
    else if ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastInitAttemptTickMs) >= CORE3_CAMERA_INIT_RETRY_MS)
    {
        core3RuntimeAttemptCameraInit(tickMs);
    }

    core3RuntimeUpdateStats(tickMs);
    core3RuntimeUpdateParamStatus();
    core3RuntimeApplyCameraConfig(tickMs);
    core3RuntimePublishHealth(tickMs);
    core3DiagnosticsUpdateRgb(&g_status, tickMs);

    foregroundUs = core3DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core3DiagnosticsCycleNow() - foregroundStartCycles);
    if (g_status.timingInvalid == 0u)
    {
        core3RuntimeRecordMaxUs(foregroundUs, &g_status.foregroundMaxUs);
    }

    if (core3RuntimeInitSummaryActive(tickMs) != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t second = (uint8_t) ((g_initSummaryUntilMs - tickMs + 999u) / 1000u);
        if (second != g_initSummaryLastSecond)
        {
            g_initSummaryLastSecond = second;
            displayUs = core3DiagnosticsRenderInitFaultSummary(g_status.initFailedMask,
                g_status.initUnverifiedMask, second);
            if (g_status.timingInvalid == 0u)
                core3RuntimeRecordMaxUs(displayUs, &g_status.displayMaxUs);
        }
        return;
    }
    g_initSummaryUntilMs = 0u;
    g_initSummaryLastSecond = 0xFFu;

    if ((menuView.state == CORE3_MENU_HOME) &&
        (menuView.lastAction == CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE) &&
        (g_status.frameValid != 0u) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastPreviewTickMs) >=
            core3VisionParamsGetActive()->previewPeriodMs))
    {
        g_lastPreviewTickMs = tickMs;
        displayUs = core3DiagnosticsRenderPreview(&g_latestSnapshot, &g_status,
            &g_latestObservation);
        if (g_status.timingInvalid == 0u)
        {
            core3RuntimeRecordMaxUs(displayUs, &g_status.displayMaxUs);
        }
    }

    if ((menuView.state != CORE3_MENU_HOME) ||
        (menuView.lastAction != CORE3_MENU_ACTION_NONE))
    {
        if (!((menuView.state == CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT) &&
              (menuView.screenRevision != g_lastRenderedMenuRevision) &&
              (captured == 0u) &&
              (g_cameraInitialized != 0u) &&
              (g_status.state == CORE3_RUNTIME_RUNNING) &&
              (g_status.frameValid != 0u)) &&
            ((menuView.screenRevision != g_lastRenderedMenuRevision) ||
            ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastMenuRenderTickMs) >=
                CORE3_MENU_RENDER_PERIOD_MS)))
        {
            uint8_t updateThresholdImages = 0u;
            if ((menuView.state == CORE3_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT) &&
                ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastPreviewTickMs) >=
                    core3VisionParamsGetActive()->previewPeriodMs))
            {
                g_lastPreviewTickMs = tickMs;
                updateThresholdImages = 1u;
            }
            core3RuntimeRenderView(&menuView, tickMs, updateThresholdImages);
        }
    }
    else if ((g_lastRenderedMenuRevision != menuView.screenRevision) ||
             ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastHudTickMs) >=
                 core3VisionParamsGetActive()->hudPeriodMs))
    {
        core3RuntimeRenderView(&menuView, tickMs, 0u);
    }
}

#include "core3VisionPipeline.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "beaconTrack.h"
#include "core3VisionWorkspace.h"
#include "om_beaconcc.h"
#include "openMorph.h"

#define CORE3_VISION_WIDTH  (188u)
#define CORE3_VISION_HEIGHT (120u)
#define CORE3_VISION_PIXELS (CORE3_VISION_WIDTH * CORE3_VISION_HEIGHT)
#define CORE3_VISION_CANNY_SIGMA (0.75f)

static uint8_t g_preview[CORE3_VISION_PIXELS];
static BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT g_detector;
static beaconTrackerStruct g_tracker;
static observerLinkSharedConfig g_activeShared;
static core3VisionObservation g_observation;
static core3VisionPipelineStatus g_status;
static uint32_t g_ownerSession;
static uint32_t g_sourceBootSession;
static uint32_t g_localRevision;
static uint16_t g_selectedTrackId;

_Static_assert(CORE3_VISION_PIXELS == OM_BUFFER_SIZE,
    "Core3 pipeline and OpenMorph image sizes differ");

static void clearTracking(void)
{
    memset(&g_detector, 0, sizeof(g_detector));
    beaconTrackInit(&g_tracker);
    memset(&g_observation, 0, sizeof(g_observation));
    memset(g_preview, 0, sizeof(g_preview));
}

static void applyDetectorConfig(const core3VisionParamsStruct *localParams,
    const observerLinkSharedConfig *sharedConfig)
{
    BEACONCC_CONFIG_STRUCT binaryConfig;
    beaconTrackBorderConfigStruct border;
    beaconTrackEdgePredictionConfigStruct edge;

    memset(&binaryConfig, 0, sizeof(binaryConfig));
    binaryConfig.thresholdLow = (uint8_t) localParams->binaryLow;
    binaryConfig.thresholdHigh = (uint8_t) localParams->binaryHigh;
    binaryConfig.areaMin = sharedConfig->beaconSizeMin;
    binaryConfig.areaMax = sharedConfig->beaconSizeMax;
    binaryConfig.brightnessMin = sharedConfig->beaconBrightnessMin;
    binaryConfig.eccMax = sharedConfig->beaconEccMax;
    binaryConfig.fillMin = sharedConfig->beaconFillMin;
    binaryConfig.huMax = sharedConfig->beaconHuMax;
    binaryConfig.huAreaMin = sharedConfig->beaconHuAreaMin;
    beaconCcSetConfig(&binaryConfig);
    beaconCcSetTemplate(sharedConfig->beaconHuTemplate,
        sharedConfig->beaconHuMax);
    cannySetThreshold(localParams->legacyCannyLow,
        localParams->legacyCannyHigh);
    beaconDetectInit(sharedConfig->beaconSizeMin,
        sharedConfig->beaconSizeMax,
        sharedConfig->beaconEccMax,
        sharedConfig->beaconBrightnessMin,
        sharedConfig->beaconMaxEndpoints);
    beaconTrackSetParams(sharedConfig->trackMaxAssocDist,
        sharedConfig->trackSizeRatioMax,
        sharedConfig->trackConfirmHits,
        sharedConfig->trackDropMisses,
        sharedConfig->trackCoastMisses,
        sharedConfig->trackPositionAlpha,
        sharedConfig->trackSizeAlpha,
        sharedConfig->trackAreaVelAlpha,
        sharedConfig->trackAssocScoreMax,
        sharedConfig->trackAssocAreaWeight,
        sharedConfig->trackAssocAreaVelWeight);
    border.enter.left = sharedConfig->observerBorderEnterLeft;
    border.enter.right = sharedConfig->observerBorderEnterRight;
    border.enter.top = sharedConfig->observerBorderEnterTop;
    border.enter.bottom = sharedConfig->observerBorderEnterBottom;
    border.exit.left = sharedConfig->observerBorderExitLeft;
    border.exit.right = sharedConfig->observerBorderExitRight;
    border.exit.top = sharedConfig->observerBorderExitTop;
    border.exit.bottom = sharedConfig->observerBorderExitBottom;
    beaconTrackSetBorderMargins(&border);
    edge.holdMs = sharedConfig->edgePredictionHoldMs;
    edge.bands.left = sharedConfig->observerEdgeBandLeft;
    edge.bands.right = sharedConfig->observerEdgeBandRight;
    edge.bands.top = sharedConfig->observerEdgeBandTop;
    edge.bands.bottom = sharedConfig->observerEdgeBandBottom;
    beaconTrackSetEdgePredictionConfig(&edge);
}

static uint8_t trackComesFirst(const beaconConfirmedStruct *left,
    const beaconConfirmedStruct *right)
{
    uint8_t leftRejected = (uint8_t) ((left->flags &
        BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u);
    uint8_t rightRejected = (uint8_t) ((right->flags &
        BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u);
    uint16_t leftSize;
    uint16_t rightSize;

    if (leftRejected != rightRejected) return leftRejected;
    if ((leftRejected != 0u) &&
        ((left->trackId == g_selectedTrackId) !=
         (right->trackId == g_selectedTrackId)))
        return (uint8_t) (left->trackId == g_selectedTrackId);
    if (left->fresh != right->fresh)
    {
        return left->fresh;
    }
    if (left->misses != right->misses)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (left->misses < right->misses);
    }
    leftSize = (left->fresh != 0u) ? left->size : left->predSize;
    rightSize = (right->fresh != 0u) ? right->size : right->predSize;
    if (leftSize != rightSize)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (leftSize > rightSize);
    }
    return (uint8_t) (left->trackId < right->trackId);
}

static void copyTrack(core3VisionTrack *destination,
    const beaconConfirmedStruct *source)
{
    destination->centerX = source->centerX;
    destination->centerY = source->centerY;
    destination->size = source->size;
    destination->trackId = source->trackId;
    destination->predX = source->predX;
    destination->predY = source->predY;
    destination->predSize = source->predSize;
    destination->misses = source->misses;
    destination->fresh = source->fresh;
    destination->flags = source->flags;
    destination->velX = source->velX;
    destination->velY = source->velY;
    destination->areaVel = source->areaVel;
}

static void publishObservation(const core3CameraSnapshot *frame)
{
    uint16_t order[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];
    uint16_t count = g_tracker.confirmedCount;
    uint16_t retained = 0u;
    uint16_t ordinaryRetained = 0u;
    uint16_t i;

    memset(&g_observation, 0, sizeof(g_observation));
    g_observation.detectMode = g_activeShared.detectMode;
    g_observation.sourceId = 3u;
    g_observation.maxBeacons = g_activeShared.maxBeacons;
    g_observation.edgeBands.left = g_activeShared.observerEdgeBandLeft;
    g_observation.edgeBands.right = g_activeShared.observerEdgeBandRight;
    g_observation.edgeBands.top = g_activeShared.observerEdgeBandTop;
    g_observation.edgeBands.bottom = g_activeShared.observerEdgeBandBottom;
    g_observation.border.enter.left = g_activeShared.observerBorderEnterLeft;
    g_observation.border.enter.right = g_activeShared.observerBorderEnterRight;
    g_observation.border.enter.top = g_activeShared.observerBorderEnterTop;
    g_observation.border.enter.bottom = g_activeShared.observerBorderEnterBottom;
    g_observation.border.exit.left = g_activeShared.observerBorderExitLeft;
    g_observation.border.exit.right = g_activeShared.observerBorderExitRight;
    g_observation.border.exit.top = g_activeShared.observerBorderExitTop;
    g_observation.border.exit.bottom = g_activeShared.observerBorderExitBottom;
    g_observation.sourceBootSession = g_sourceBootSession;
    g_observation.ownerSession = g_ownerSession;
    g_observation.configRevision = g_activeShared.revision;
    g_observation.configHash = g_activeShared.hash;
    g_observation.appFrameSeq = frame->appFrameSeq;
    g_observation.trackerFrameSeq = g_tracker.frameSeq;
    g_observation.tickMs = frame->tickMs;
    for (i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        uint16_t position = i;

        order[i] = i;
        if ((g_tracker.confirmed[i].flags &
                BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u)
        {
            g_observation.confirmedTotal++;
            if (g_tracker.confirmed[i].fresh != 0u)
            {
                g_observation.freshTotal++;
                if (g_tracker.confirmed[i].centerX < (CORE3_VISION_WIDTH / 2u))
                    g_observation.freshLeft++;
                else
                    g_observation.freshRight++;
            }
        }
        while ((position > 0u) &&
               (trackComesFirst(&g_tracker.confirmed[order[position]],
                    &g_tracker.confirmed[order[position - 1u]]) != 0u))
        {
            uint16_t swap = order[position - 1u];
            order[position - 1u] = order[position];
            order[position] = swap;
            position--;
        }
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        const beaconConfirmedStruct *source = &g_tracker.confirmed[order[i]];
        uint8_t rejected = (uint8_t) ((source->flags &
            BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u);
        if ((retained >= CORE3_VISION_MAX_PUBLISHED_TRACKS) ||
            ((rejected == 0u) &&
             (ordinaryRetained >= g_activeShared.maxBeacons)))
        {
            g_observation.truncated = 1u;
            continue;
        }
        copyTrack(&g_observation.tracks[retained], source);
        retained++;
        if (rejected == 0u)
        {
            ordinaryRetained++;
            beaconTrackMarkPublished(&g_tracker, source->trackId);
        }
    }
    g_observation.retainedCount = retained;
    g_observation.valid = 1u;
}

uint8_t core3VisionPipelineInit(void)
{
    u8Image source;
    BEACONCC_CONFIG_STRUCT binaryConfig;

    memset(&g_status, 0, sizeof(g_status));
    memset(&g_activeShared, 0, sizeof(g_activeShared));
    memset(g_preview, 0, sizeof(g_preview));
    g_ownerSession = 0u;
    g_sourceBootSession = 0u;
    g_localRevision = 0u;
    source.ptr = g_preview;
    source.xLen = CORE3_VISION_WIDTH;
    source.yLen = CORE3_VISION_HEIGHT;
    source.size = CORE3_VISION_PIXELS;
    memset(&binaryConfig, 0, sizeof(binaryConfig));
    beaconCcInit(&binaryConfig);

        CORE3_VISION_CANNY_SIGMA,
        0u,
        0u,

        CORE3_VISION_HEIGHT - 1u,
        CORE3_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_LOW_DEFAULT,
        CORE3_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_HIGH_DEFAULT);

    return 1u;
}

    g_selectedTrackId = trackId;

uint8_t core3VisionPipelineApplyAtFrameBoundary(
    const core3VisionParamsStruct *localParams,
    uint32_t localRevision,
    const observerLinkSharedConfig *sharedConfig,
    uint32_t sourceBootSession,
    uint32_t ownerSession)
{
    uint8_t sharedChanged;
    uint8_t modeChanged;
    uint8_t ownerChanged;

    if ((g_status.ready == 0u) || (localParams == NULL) ||
        (sharedConfig == NULL) || (sourceBootSession == 0u) ||
        (ownerSession == 0u) ||
        (observerLinkSharedConfigIsValid(sharedConfig) == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    sharedChanged = (uint8_t) ((g_status.applied == 0u) ||
                               (g_activeShared.revision != sharedConfig->revision) ||
                               (g_activeShared.hash != sharedConfig->hash));
    modeChanged = (uint8_t) ((g_status.applied != 0u) &&
                             (g_activeShared.detectMode != sharedConfig->detectMode));
    ownerChanged = (uint8_t) ((g_status.applied != 0u) &&
                              (g_ownerSession != ownerSession));
    if ((sharedChanged != 0u) || (g_localRevision != localRevision) ||
        (ownerChanged != 0u))
    {
        applyDetectorConfig(localParams, sharedConfig);
    }
    if ((modeChanged != 0u) || (ownerChanged != 0u))
    {
        clearTracking();
        if (modeChanged != 0u)
        {
        }
    }
    else if (sharedChanged != 0u)
    {
        g_observation.valid = 0u;
    }
    g_activeShared = *sharedConfig;
    g_sourceBootSession = sourceBootSession;
    g_ownerSession = ownerSession;
    g_localRevision = localRevision;
    g_status.applied = 1u;
    g_status.detectMode = sharedConfig->detectMode;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3VisionPipelineProcess(const core3CameraSnapshot *frame)
{
    u8Image source;
    u8Image preview;
    u8Image gaussian;

    if ((g_status.applied == 0u) || (frame == NULL) ||
        (frame->data == NULL) || (frame->width != CORE3_VISION_WIDTH) ||
        (frame->height != CORE3_VISION_HEIGHT))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    source.ptr = (uint8_t *) frame->data;
    source.xLen = frame->width;
    source.yLen = frame->height;
    source.size = CORE3_VISION_PIXELS;
    preview.ptr = g_preview;
    preview.xLen = frame->width;
    preview.yLen = frame->height;
    preview.size = CORE3_VISION_PIXELS;
    if (g_activeShared.detectMode == 1u)
    {
        gaussian.ptr = g_core3VisionWorkspace.scratch.canny.gaussian;
        gaussian.xLen = frame->width;
        gaussian.yLen = frame->height;
        gaussian.size = CORE3_VISION_PIXELS;
        cannyEdgeDetection(&source, &gaussian, &preview);
        (void) beaconDetect(&preview, &source, &g_detector);
    }
    else
    {
        (void) beaconCcDetect(&source, &preview, &g_detector);
    }
    beaconTrackUpdate(&g_tracker, &g_detector);
    publishObservation(frame);
    return 1u;
}

void core3VisionPipelineInvalidate(void)
{
    if (g_status.applied != 0u)
    {
        clearTracking();
    }
    g_status.applied = 0u;
    g_status.detectMode = 0u;
    memset(&g_activeShared, 0, sizeof(g_activeShared));
    g_sourceBootSession = 0u;
    g_ownerSession = 0u;
}

void core3VisionPipelineGetObservation(core3VisionObservation *observation)
{
    if (observation != NULL)
    {
        *observation = g_observation;
    }
}

void core3VisionPipelineGetStatus(core3VisionPipelineStatus *status)
{
    if (status != NULL)
    {
        *status = g_status;
    }
}

{
    return g_preview;
}

observerKvmBindingAction observerKvmBindingGuardObserve(
    observerKvmBindingGuard *guard,
    uint32_t ownerSession,
    uint32_t bindingEpoch)
{
    if (guard == 0) return OBSERVER_KVM_BINDING_REBOUND;
    if (guard->primed == 0u)
    {
        guard->ownerSession = ownerSession;
        guard->bindingEpoch = bindingEpoch;
        guard->primed = 1u;
        return OBSERVER_KVM_BINDING_INITIAL;
    }
    if ((guard->ownerSession == ownerSession) &&
        (guard->bindingEpoch == bindingEpoch))
        return OBSERVER_KVM_BINDING_UNCHANGED;
    guard->ownerSession = ownerSession;
    guard->bindingEpoch = bindingEpoch;
    return OBSERVER_KVM_BINDING_REBOUND;
}

#include "core3CoreDataTransfer.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "cy_device_headers.h"

/* Core-local live snapshot. It is deliberately not placed in shared RAM and
 * is only exposed to business code through the copy-out getter. */
static core3CoreDataDiagnostics g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive;

static uint8_t core3CoreSequenceIsNewer(uint32_t candidate,
    uint32_t reference)
{
    uint32_t delta = candidate - reference;
    return (uint8_t) ((delta != 0u) && (delta < 0x80000000u));
}

static void saturatingIncrement(uint32_t *value)
{
    if (*value != UINT32_MAX) (*value)++;
}

static void saturatingAdd(uint32_t *value, uint32_t amount)
{
    if ((UINT32_MAX - *value) < amount) *value = UINT32_MAX;
    else *value += amount;
}

static void saturatingAdd64(uint64_t *value, uint32_t amount)
{
    if ((UINT64_MAX - *value) < amount) *value = UINT64_MAX;
    else *value += amount;
}

void core3CoreDataTimingInit(void)
{
    uint32_t before;

    if ((g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingInitialized != 0u) &&
        (g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingValid != 0u)) return;
    g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingInitialized = 1u;
    g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingValid = 0u;
    if ((DWT->CTRL & DWT_CTRL_NOCYCCNT_Msk) != 0u) return;

    CoreDebug->DEMCR |= CoreDebug_DEMCR_TRCENA_Msk;
    if ((DWT->CTRL & DWT_CTRL_CYCCNTENA_Msk) == 0u)
    {
        DWT->CYCCNT = 0u;
        DWT->CTRL |= DWT_CTRL_CYCCNTENA_Msk;
    }
    __DSB();
    __ISB();
    before = DWT->CYCCNT;
    __NOP();
    __NOP();
    __NOP();
    __NOP();
    if (((DWT->CTRL & DWT_CTRL_CYCCNTENA_Msk) != 0u) &&
        (DWT->CYCCNT != before))
    {
        g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingValid = 1u;
    }
}

static uint8_t timingBegin(uint32_t *startCycles)
{
    if ((startCycles == NULL) ||
        (g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingValid == 0u)) return 0u;
    if ((DWT->CTRL & DWT_CTRL_CYCCNTENA_Msk) == 0u)
    {
        g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingValid = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    *startCycles = DWT->CYCCNT;
    return 1u;
}

static void timingEnd(uint8_t valid, uint32_t startCycles)
{
    uint32_t elapsed;

    if (valid == 0u)
    {
        saturatingIncrement(
            &g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingInvalidSampleCount);
        return;
    }
    elapsed = DWT->CYCCNT - startCycles;
    if (((DWT->CTRL & DWT_CTRL_CYCCNTENA_Msk) == 0u) || (elapsed == 0u))
    {
        g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingValid = 0u;
        saturatingIncrement(
            &g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingInvalidSampleCount);
        return;
    }
    saturatingIncrement(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingSampleCount);
    saturatingAdd64(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingTotalCycles, elapsed);
    if (g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingMaxCycles < elapsed)
    {
        g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.timingMaxCycles = elapsed;
    }
}

/* Each image owns a cache-line-isolated retained pair in core-local RAM. */
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t counter;
    uint32_t counterInverse;
    uint8_t padding[24];
} core3CoreBootState;

#pragma data_alignment = 32
__no_init static core3CoreBootState core3CoreBootStateRetained;

#pragma location = CORE3_CORE_LINK_REGION_ADDR
__no_init volatile core3CoreLinkSnapshot core3CoreLinkRegion;

#pragma location = CORE3_CORE_VISION_REGION_ADDR
__no_init volatile core3CoreVisionSnapshot core3CoreVisionRegion;

#define CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_DEPTH (4u)
#define CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_MASK  (CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_DEPTH - 1u)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration;
    uint32_t sequence;
    uint32_t payloadBytes;
    uint32_t commit;
    uint8_t payload[112];
} core3CoreCommittedSlot;

typedef struct
{
    volatile uint32_t producerBootGeneration;
    volatile uint32_t head;
    uint8_t producerPadding[24];
    volatile uint32_t consumerBootGeneration;
    volatile uint32_t tail;
    uint8_t consumerPadding[24];
    core3CoreCommittedSlot slots[CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_DEPTH];
} core3CoreQueueRegion;

#define CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_COMMIT (0xC35A0000u)

typedef char core3Core_queue_depth_assert[
    ((CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_DEPTH & CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_MASK) == 0u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core3Core_queue_region_size_assert[
    (sizeof(core3CoreQueueRegion) == 0x240u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core3Core_queue_slot_size_assert[
    (sizeof(core3CoreCommittedSlot) == 128u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core3Core_ingress_slot_size_assert[
    (sizeof(core3CoreIngressEvent) <= 112u) ? 1 : -1];
typedef char core3Core_egress_slot_size_assert[
    (sizeof(core3CoreEgressEvent) <= 112u) ? 1 : -1];

#pragma location = CORE3_CORE_INGRESS_QUEUE_ADDR
__no_init volatile core3CoreQueueRegion core3CoreIngressQueue;

#pragma location = CORE3_CORE_EGRESS_QUEUE_ADDR
__no_init volatile core3CoreQueueRegion core3CoreEgressQueue;

static uint8_t snapshotStable(const void *first, const void *second,
    uint32_t size, uint32_t magic, uint32_t begin, uint32_t end)
{
    const core3CoreLinkSnapshot *header = (const core3CoreLinkSnapshot *) second;
    return (uint8_t) ((memcmp(first, second, size) == 0) &&
        (header->magic == magic) &&
        (header->abiVersion == CORE3_CORE_ABI_VERSION) &&
        (header->payloadBytes == size) &&
        (begin != 0u) && (begin == end));
}

static uint8_t probeSnapshot(volatile core3CoreLinkSnapshot *region,
    uint32_t magic, uint32_t payloadBytes, uint32_t *bootGeneration,
    uint32_t *publishSeq, uint32_t *probeCount)
{
    uint32_t begin;
    uint32_t observedMagic;
    uint32_t abiVersion;
    uint32_t observedBytes;
    uint32_t boot;
    uint32_t seq;

    if ((bootGeneration == NULL) || (publishSeq == NULL)) return 0u;
    saturatingIncrement(probeCount);
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, 32u);
    begin = region->beginGeneration;
    observedMagic = region->magic;
    abiVersion = region->abiVersion;
    observedBytes = region->payloadBytes;
    boot = region->bootGeneration;
    seq = region->publishSeq;
    if ((begin == 0u) || (observedMagic != magic) ||
        (abiVersion != CORE3_CORE_ABI_VERSION) ||
        (observedBytes != payloadBytes) || (boot == 0u) || (seq == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    *bootGeneration = boot;
    *publishSeq = seq;
    return 1u;
}

uint32_t core3CoreDataMakeBootGeneration(uint32_t salt)
{
    uint32_t startCycles;
    uint8_t timingValid = timingBegin(&startCycles);
    uint32_t generation;

    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &core3CoreBootStateRetained,
        sizeof(core3CoreBootStateRetained));
    if (core3CoreBootStateRetained.counterInverse !=
        ~core3CoreBootStateRetained.counter)
    {
        core3CoreBootStateRetained.counter =
            DWT->CYCCNT ^ salt ^ 0x6D2B79F5u;
    }
    core3CoreBootStateRetained.counter++;
    if (core3CoreBootStateRetained.counter == 0u)
    {
        core3CoreBootStateRetained.counter = 1u;
    }
    core3CoreBootStateRetained.counterInverse =
        ~core3CoreBootStateRetained.counter;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &core3CoreBootStateRetained,
        sizeof(core3CoreBootStateRetained));
    __DSB();
    generation = core3CoreBootStateRetained.counter;
    timingEnd(timingValid, startCycles);
    return generation;
}

uint8_t core3CoreDataProbeLink(uint32_t *bootGeneration, uint32_t *publishSeq)
{
    uint32_t startCycles;
    uint8_t timingValid = timingBegin(&startCycles);
    uint8_t result = probeSnapshot(&core3CoreLinkRegion, CORE3_CORE_LINK_MAGIC,
        sizeof(core3CoreLinkRegion), bootGeneration, publishSeq,
        &g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.linkProbeCount);
    timingEnd(timingValid, startCycles);
    return result;
}

uint8_t core3CoreDataProbeVision(uint32_t *bootGeneration, uint32_t *publishSeq)

    uint8_t result = probeSnapshot(

        CORE3_CORE_VISION_MAGIC, sizeof(core3CoreVisionRegion), bootGeneration,
        publishSeq, &g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.visionProbeCount);
