}

void core3CoreDataWriteLink(const core3CoreLinkSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    uint32_t startCycles;
    uint8_t timingValid = timingBegin(&startCycles);
    if (snapshot == NULL)
    {
        timingEnd(timingValid, startCycles);
        return;
    }
    memcpy((void *) &core3CoreLinkRegion, snapshot, sizeof(*snapshot));
    __DMB();
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) &core3CoreLinkRegion,
        sizeof(core3CoreLinkRegion));
    __DSB();
    saturatingIncrement(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.linkPublishCount);
    saturatingAdd(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.linkPublishBytes,
        sizeof(core3CoreLinkRegion));
    timingEnd(timingValid, startCycles);
}

uint8_t core3CoreDataTryReadLink(core3CoreLinkSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    core3CoreLinkSnapshot first;
    core3CoreLinkSnapshot second;
    uint8_t attempt;
    uint8_t result = 0u;
    uint32_t startCycles;
    uint8_t timingValid = timingBegin(&startCycles);
    if (snapshot == NULL)
    {
        timingEnd(timingValid, startCycles);
        return 0u;
    }
    saturatingIncrement(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.linkReadAttempts);
    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) &core3CoreLinkRegion,
            sizeof(core3CoreLinkRegion));
        memcpy(&first, (const void *) &core3CoreLinkRegion, sizeof(first));
        SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) &core3CoreLinkRegion,
            sizeof(core3CoreLinkRegion));
        memcpy(&second, (const void *) &core3CoreLinkRegion, sizeof(second));
        if (snapshotStable(&first, &second, sizeof(second), CORE3_CORE_LINK_MAGIC,
            second.beginGeneration, second.endGeneration))
        {
            *snapshot = second;
            result = 1u;
            break;
        }
        saturatingIncrement(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.linkReadRetries);
    }
    if (result == 0u)
    {
        saturatingIncrement(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.linkReadFailures);
    }
    timingEnd(timingValid, startCycles);
    return result;
}

static uint8_t queuePush(volatile core3CoreQueueRegion *queue,
    const void *event, uint32_t eventSize, uint32_t *fullCount,
    uint32_t *highWater)
{
    uint32_t head;
    uint32_t tail;
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration;
    volatile core3CoreCommittedSlot *slot;
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &queue->consumerBootGeneration, 32u);
    producerBootGeneration = queue->producerBootGeneration;
    if (producerBootGeneration == 0u) return 0u;
    head = queue->head;
    tail = (queue->consumerBootGeneration == producerBootGeneration) ?
        queue->tail : head;
    if ((uint32_t) (head - tail) >= CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_DEPTH)
    {
        saturatingIncrement(fullCount);
        return 0u;
    }
    slot = &queue->slots[head & CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_MASK];
    memset((void *) slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
    slot->producerBootGeneration = producerBootGeneration;
    slot->sequence = head + 1u;
    slot->payloadBytes = eventSize;
    memcpy((void *) slot->payload, event, eventSize);
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) slot, sizeof(*slot));
    __DSB();
    slot->commit = CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_COMMIT ^ producerBootGeneration ^ (head + 1u);
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) slot, 32u);
    __DSB();
    queue->head = head + 1u;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &queue->producerBootGeneration, 32u);
    __DSB();
    if (*highWater < ((uint32_t) (head - tail) + 1u))
    {
        *highWater = (uint32_t) (head - tail) + 1u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

static void queueReset(volatile core3CoreQueueRegion *queue,
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration)
{
    queue->head = 0u;
    queue->producerBootGeneration = producerBootGeneration;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &queue->producerBootGeneration, 32u);
    __DSB();
}

static void queueSyncConsumer(volatile core3CoreQueueRegion *queue,
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration)
{
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &queue->producerBootGeneration, 32u);
    if (queue->producerBootGeneration != producerBootGeneration) return;
    queue->tail = queue->head;
    queue->consumerBootGeneration = producerBootGeneration;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &queue->consumerBootGeneration, 32u);
    __DSB();
}

{
    uint32_t startCycles;
    uint8_t timingValid = timingBegin(&startCycles);
    queueReset(&core3CoreIngressQueue, producerBootGeneration);
    timingEnd(timingValid, startCycles);
}

static uint8_t queuePop(volatile core3CoreQueueRegion *queue,
    void *event, uint32_t eventSize, uint32_t producerBootGeneration)
{
    uint32_t head;
    uint32_t tail;
    uint32_t expectedCommit;
    volatile core3CoreCommittedSlot *slot;
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &queue->producerBootGeneration, 32u);
    if ((queue->producerBootGeneration != producerBootGeneration) ||
        (queue->consumerBootGeneration != producerBootGeneration)) return 0u;
    head = queue->head;
    tail = queue->tail;
    if (tail == head) return 0u;
    if ((uint32_t) (head - tail) > CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_DEPTH) return 0u;
    slot = &queue->slots[tail & CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_MASK];
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) slot, sizeof(*slot));
    expectedCommit = CORE3_CORE_QUEUE_COMMIT ^ producerBootGeneration ^
        (tail + 1u);
    if ((slot->producerBootGeneration != producerBootGeneration) ||
        (slot->sequence != (tail + 1u)) ||
        (slot->payloadBytes != eventSize) ||
        (slot->commit != expectedCommit)) return 0u;
    memcpy(event, (const void *) slot->payload, eventSize);
    __DMB();
    queue->tail = tail + 1u;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr(
        (volatile void *) &queue->consumerBootGeneration, 32u);
    __DSB();
    return 1u;
}

            &g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.ingressQueueHighWater);

}

uint8_t core3CoreBorderRejectionMerge(
    const core3CoreBorderRejection *pending,
    observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    uint8_t delivered = 0u;
    uint8_t i;
    if ((pending == NULL) || (snapshot == NULL) ||
        (pending->rejectedCount == 0u) ||
        (snapshot->ownerSession != pending->ownerSession) ||
        (snapshot->revision != pending->revision) ||
        (snapshot->hash != pending->hash) ||
        ((snapshot->trackerFrameSeq != pending->trackerFrameSeq) &&
         (core3CoreSequenceIsNewer(snapshot->trackerFrameSeq,
            pending->trackerFrameSeq) == 0u))) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < pending->rejectedCount; i++)
    {
        uint16_t rejectedId = pending->rejectedTrackIds[i];
        uint8_t j;
        uint8_t replacement = OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS;
        for (j = 0u; j < snapshot->retainedCount; j++)
        {
            if (snapshot->tracks[j].trackId == rejectedId)
            {
                memset(&snapshot->tracks[j], 0,
                    sizeof(snapshot->tracks[j]));
                snapshot->tracks[j].trackId = rejectedId;
                snapshot->tracks[j].flags =
                    OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED;
                break;
            }
            if ((snapshot->tracks[j].flags &
                    OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u)
                replacement = j;
        }
        if (j == snapshot->retainedCount)
        {
            if (snapshot->retainedCount < OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS)
            {
                j = snapshot->retainedCount++;
            }
            else if (replacement < OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS)
            {
                j = replacement;
                snapshot->truncated = 1u;
            }
            else
            {
                break;
            }
            memset(&snapshot->tracks[j], 0, sizeof(snapshot->tracks[j]));
            snapshot->tracks[j].trackId = rejectedId;
            snapshot->tracks[j].flags =
                OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED;
        }
        delivered++;
    }
    return delivered;
}

uint8_t core3CoreBorderRejectionAppend(core3CoreBorderRejection *pending,
    uint8_t *pendingValid, const core3CoreBorderRejection *event)
{
    uint8_t uniqueAdded = 0u;
    uint8_t i;
    if ((pending == NULL) || (pendingValid == NULL) || (event == NULL) ||
        (event->ownerSession == 0u) || (event->rejectedCount == 0u) ||
        (event->rejectedCount > CORE3_CORE_REJECTION_TRACK_MAX)) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < event->rejectedCount; i++)
    {
        uint8_t j;
        if (event->rejectedTrackIds[i] == 0u) return 0u;
        for (j = 0u; j < i; j++)
            if (event->rejectedTrackIds[j] ==
                event->rejectedTrackIds[i]) return 0u;
    }
    if ((*pendingValid == 0u) ||
        (pending->ownerSession != event->ownerSession) ||
        (pending->revision != event->revision) ||
        (pending->hash != event->hash))
    {
        *pending = *event;
        *pendingValid = 1u;
        return 1u;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < event->rejectedCount; i++)
    {
        uint8_t j;
        for (j = 0u; j < pending->rejectedCount; j++)
            if (pending->rejectedTrackIds[j] ==
                event->rejectedTrackIds[i]) break;
        if (j == pending->rejectedCount) uniqueAdded++;
    }
    if ((uint16_t) pending->rejectedCount + uniqueAdded >
        CORE3_CORE_REJECTION_TRACK_MAX) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < event->rejectedCount; i++)
    {
        uint8_t j;
        for (j = 0u; j < pending->rejectedCount; j++)
            if (pending->rejectedTrackIds[j] ==
                event->rejectedTrackIds[i]) break;
        if (j == pending->rejectedCount)
            pending->rejectedTrackIds[pending->rejectedCount++] =
                event->rejectedTrackIds[i];
    }
    if (core3CoreSequenceIsNewer(event->trackerFrameSeq,
            pending->trackerFrameSeq) != 0u)
        pending->trackerFrameSeq = event->trackerFrameSeq;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3CorePlanningPreserveRejections(
    observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *destination,
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *pending)
{
    uint8_t i;
    if ((destination == NULL) || (pending == NULL)) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < pending->retainedCount; i++)
    {
        const observerLinkPlanningTrack *rejected = &pending->tracks[i];
        uint8_t j;
        uint8_t replacement = OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS;
        if ((rejected->flags &
                OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u) continue;
        for (j = 0u; j < destination->retainedCount; j++)
        {
            if (destination->tracks[j].trackId == rejected->trackId)
            {
                destination->tracks[j] = *rejected;
                replacement = j;
                break;
            }
            if ((destination->tracks[j].flags &
                    OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u)
                replacement = j;
        }
        if (j < destination->retainedCount) continue;
        if (destination->retainedCount < OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS)
            destination->tracks[destination->retainedCount++] = *rejected;
        else if (replacement < OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS)
        {
            destination->tracks[replacement] = *rejected;
            destination->truncated = 1u;
        }
        else return 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

    saturatingIncrement(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.sharedStaleCount);
}

void core3CoreDataNoteSessionReset(void)
{
    saturatingIncrement(&g_core3CoreDataDiagnosticsLive.sessionResetCount);
}

#include "core3KvmCore3.h"

#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

#define CORE3_KVM_KEY_COUNT       (5u)
#define CORE3_KVM_KEY_STATE_COUNT (2u)
#define CORE3_KVM_KEY1            (0u)
#define CORE3_KVM_LONG_PRESS      (1u)
#define CORE3_KVM_ACTION_SAVE     (1u)

typedef struct
{
    core3KvmCore3Status publicStatus;
    observerLinkKvmEvent event;
    observerLinkKvmAck ack;
    observerLinkKvmAck completedAck;
    uint32_t lastEventSeq;
    uint32_t screenRevision;
    uint8_t ackReady;
    uint8_t completedAckValid;
    uint8_t menuState;
    uint8_t menuFlags;
    uint8_t lastAckResult;
} core3KvmState;

static core3KvmState g_kvm;

static uint8_t deadlineReached(uint32_t nowMs, uint32_t deadlineMs)
{
    return (uint8_t) (((int32_t) (nowMs - deadlineMs)) >= 0);
}

static uint32_t nextEventSeq(uint32_t value)
{
    value++;
    return (value != 0u) ? value : 1u;
}

static uint8_t eventSeqNewer(uint32_t value, uint32_t reference)
{
    return (uint8_t)((value != reference) &&
        ((uint32_t)(value - reference) < 0x80000000u));
}

static uint8_t routeMatchesEvent(const observerLinkKvmEvent *event)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((event->routeSession == g_kvm.publicStatus.routeSession) &&
        (event->routeEpoch == g_kvm.publicStatus.routeEpoch));
}

static uint8_t sameCompletedEvent(const observerLinkKvmEvent *event)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((g_kvm.completedAckValid != 0u) &&
        (event->targetSession == g_kvm.completedAck.targetSession) &&
        (event->routeSession == g_kvm.completedAck.routeSession) &&
        (event->routeEpoch == g_kvm.completedAck.routeEpoch) &&
        (event->eventSeq == g_kvm.completedAck.eventSeq) &&
        (event->target == g_kvm.completedAck.target));
}

static void updatePublicPending(void)
{
    g_kvm.publicStatus.ackPending = g_kvm.ackReady;
}

static void prepareAck(const observerLinkKvmEvent *event, uint8_t result)
{
    memset(&g_kvm.ack, 0, sizeof(g_kvm.ack));
    g_kvm.ack.targetSession = g_kvm.publicStatus.localSession;
    g_kvm.ack.routeSession = event->routeSession;
    g_kvm.ack.routeEpoch = event->routeEpoch;
    g_kvm.ack.eventSeq = event->eventSeq;
    g_kvm.ack.expectedSeq = g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq;
    g_kvm.ack.target = event->target;
    g_kvm.ack.result = result;
    g_kvm.ack.menuState = g_kvm.menuState;
    g_kvm.ackReady = 1u;
    updatePublicPending();
}

static void clearRouteState(void)
{
    g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq = 1u;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.eventPending = 0u;
    g_kvm.ackReady = 0u;
    g_kvm.completedAckValid = 0u;
    g_kvm.lastEventSeq = 0u;
    g_kvm.lastAckResult = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_NONE;
    updatePublicPending();
}

void core3KvmCore3Init(uint32_t localSession)
{
    memset(&g_kvm, 0, sizeof(g_kvm));
    g_kvm.publicStatus.localSession = localSession;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq = 1u;
}

void core3KvmCore3Poll(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    if ((g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseValid != 0u) &&
        (deadlineReached(tickMs, g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseDeadlineMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseValid = 0u;
        g_kvm.menuFlags &= (uint8_t) ~OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_LEASE_VALID;
    }
}

void core3KvmCore3Revoke(void)
{
    g_kvm.publicStatus.routeSession = 0u;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.routeEpoch = 0u;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseDeadlineMs = 0u;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseValid = 0u;
    g_kvm.menuFlags &= (uint8_t) ~OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_LEASE_VALID;
    clearRouteState();
}

uint8_t core3KvmCore3ApplyControl(const observerLinkKvmControl *control, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t routeChanged;
    if ((control == NULL) ||
        (control->targetSession != g_kvm.publicStatus.localSession) ||
        (control->target != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
        (control->leaseMs == 0u) ||
        (control->leaseMs > CORE3_KVM_MAX_LEASE_MS))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    routeChanged = (uint8_t) ((control->routeSession != g_kvm.publicStatus.routeSession) ||
        (control->routeEpoch != g_kvm.publicStatus.routeEpoch));
    g_kvm.publicStatus.routeSession = control->routeSession;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.routeEpoch = control->routeEpoch;
    if (routeChanged != 0u)
    {
        clearRouteState();
    }
    g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseDeadlineMs = tickMs + control->leaseMs;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseValid = 1u;
    g_kvm.menuFlags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_LEASE_VALID;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3KvmCore3ApplyEvent(const observerLinkKvmEvent *event, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    if (event == NULL)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    core3KvmCore3Poll(tickMs);
    if ((g_kvm.publicStatus.eventPending != 0u) || (g_kvm.ackReady != 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (event->targetSession != g_kvm.publicStatus.localSession)
    {
        prepareAck(event, OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_BAD_PAYLOAD);
        return 1u;
    }
    if (event->target != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3)
    {
        prepareAck(event, OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_WRONG_TARGET);
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((g_kvm.publicStatus.routeSession != 0u) && (routeMatchesEvent(event) == 0u))
    {
        prepareAck(event, OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_STALE_EPOCH);
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((event->keyId >= CORE3_KVM_KEY_COUNT) ||
        (event->keyState >= CORE3_KVM_KEY_STATE_COUNT) ||
        (event->flags != 0u))
    {
        prepareAck(event, OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_BAD_PAYLOAD);
        return 1u;
    }
    if (sameCompletedEvent(event) != 0u)
    {
        g_kvm.ack = g_kvm.completedAck;
        g_kvm.ack.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_ACK_FLAG_DUPLICATE;
        g_kvm.ackReady = 1u;
        updatePublicPending();
        return 1u;
    }
    if (g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseValid == 0u)
    {
        prepareAck(event, OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_NO_LEASE);
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((event->eventSeq == 0u) ||
        ((event->eventSeq != g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq) &&
         (eventSeqNewer(event->eventSeq, g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq) == 0u)))
    {
        prepareAck(event, OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_OLD_SEQ);
        return 1u;
    }
    if (event->eventSeq != g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq)
    {
        prepareAck(event, OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_RESULT_GAP);
        return 1u;
    }
    g_kvm.event = *event;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.eventPending = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3KvmCore3TakeEvent(observerLinkKvmEvent *event)
{
    if ((event == NULL) || (g_kvm.publicStatus.eventPending == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    *event = g_kvm.event;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3KvmCore3CompleteEvent(uint8_t result, uint8_t menuState,
    uint8_t homeReady, uint8_t action, uint8_t actionOk,
    uint32_t screenRevision)
{
    if (g_kvm.publicStatus.eventPending == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    g_kvm.menuState = menuState;
    g_kvm.screenRevision = screenRevision;
    prepareAck(&g_kvm.event, result);
    if (homeReady != 0u)
    {
        g_kvm.ack.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_ACK_FLAG_HOME_READY;
    }
    if (actionOk != 0u)
    {
        g_kvm.ack.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_ACK_FLAG_ACTION_OK;
    }
    if (action == CORE3_KVM_ACTION_SAVE)
    {
        g_kvm.ack.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_ACK_FLAG_ACTION_SAVE;
    }
    g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq = nextEventSeq(g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq);
    g_kvm.ack.expectedSeq = g_kvm.publicStatus.expectedSeq;
    g_kvm.publicStatus.eventPending = 0u;
    g_kvm.completedAck = g_kvm.ack;
    g_kvm.completedAckValid = 1u;
    g_kvm.lastEventSeq = g_kvm.event.eventSeq;
    g_kvm.lastAckResult = result;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3KvmCore3TakeAck(observerLinkKvmAck *ack)
{
    if ((ack == NULL) || (g_kvm.ackReady == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    *ack = g_kvm.ack;
    g_kvm.ackReady = 0u;
    updatePublicPending();
    return 1u;
}

void core3KvmCore3UpdateMenu(uint8_t menuState, uint8_t homeReady,
    uint8_t action, uint8_t actionOk, uint8_t feedbackActive,
    uint32_t screenRevision)
{
    uint8_t flags = 0u;
    g_kvm.menuState = menuState;
    g_kvm.screenRevision = screenRevision;
    if (homeReady != 0u)
    {
        flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_HOME_READY;
    }
    if (feedbackActive != 0u)
    {
        flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_FEEDBACK_ACTIVE;
    }
    if (g_kvm.publicStatus.leaseValid != 0u)
    {
        flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_LEASE_VALID;
    }
    if (actionOk != 0u)
    {
        flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_ACTION_OK;
    }
    if (action == CORE3_KVM_ACTION_SAVE)
    {
        flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_FLAG_ACTION_SAVE;
    }
    g_kvm.menuFlags = flags;
}

void core3KvmCore3GetMenuStatus(observerLinkKvmMenuStatus *status)
{
    if (status == NULL)
    {
        return;
    }
    memset(status, 0, sizeof(*status));
    status->targetSession = g_kvm.publicStatus.localSession;
    status->routeSession = g_kvm.publicStatus.routeSession;
    status->routeEpoch = g_kvm.publicStatus.routeEpoch;
    status->lastEventSeq = g_kvm.lastEventSeq;
    status->screenRevision = g_kvm.screenRevision;
    status->target = OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3;
    status->menuState = g_kvm.menuState;
    status->flags = g_kvm.menuFlags;
    status->lastAckResult = g_kvm.lastAckResult;
}

void core3KvmCore3GetStatus(core3KvmCore3Status *status)
{
    if (status != NULL)
    {
        *status = g_kvm.publicStatus;
    }
}

static void failPendingParamGlobalRequest(uint8_t error)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState failure;
    uint32_t sequence;
    if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending == 0u) return;
    memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
    failure.coordinatorBootGeneration =
        (g_paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration != 0u) ?
            g_paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration :
            g_paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration;
    sequence = g_paramGlobalState.sequence + 1u;
    if (sequence == 0u) sequence = 1u;
    failure.sequence = sequence;
    failure.requestBootGeneration =
        g_paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration;
    failure.requestSequence = g_paramGlobalRequest.sequence;
    failure.origin = g_paramGlobalRequest.origin;
    failure.action = g_paramGlobalRequest.action;
    failure.slot = g_paramGlobalRequest.slot;
    failure.phase = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED;
    failure.target = OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3;
    failure.error = error;
    failure.flags = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL;
    if (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(&failure) != 0u)
    {
        g_paramGlobalRouteFailure = failure;
        g_paramGlobalRouteFailureReady = 1u;
    }
    g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
}

static void invalidateParamGlobalRoute(void)
{
    failPendingParamGlobalRequest(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
    g_paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
    g_paramGlobalStateReady = 0u;
}

static uint8_t paramGlobalRouteReady(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    return (uint8_t) (g_status.online != 0u &&
        g_status.protocolCompatible != 0u &&
        (g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PARAM_SYNC) != 0u &&
        g_paramGlobalStateValid != 0u &&
        (uint32_t) (tickMs - g_paramGlobalStateLastRxMs) <
            CORE3_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS);
}

static uint8_t paramGlobalBusyError(const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    if ((state->flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY) != 0u)
        return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY;
    if (state->readyMask != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK)
        return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INCOMPLETE;
    if ((state->flags & (PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY |
                         PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL)) != 0u)
        return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY;
    return PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE;
}

                              OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_LEGACY_CANNY |

                      (role == OBSERVER_LINK_ROLE_CORE1) &&
                      ((capabilities & required) == required));
}

static uint32_t makeBootSession(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t session;
    (void) tickMs;
    if (g_bootCounterInverse != ~g_bootCounter)
    {
        g_bootCounter = 0u;
    }
    g_bootCounter++;
    if (g_bootCounter == 0u) g_bootCounter = 1u;
    g_bootCounterInverse = ~g_bootCounter;
    session = g_bootCounter;
    return session;
}

static uint8_t sendMessageBudgeted(uint8_t type,
    const uint8_t *payload,
    uint16_t payloadLength,
    uint32_t tickMs,
    uint8_t controlLane)
{
    observerLinkFrame frame;
    uint8_t wire[OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_FRAME_BYTES];
    uint16_t wireLength;

    if (controlLane != 0u)
    {
        if (g_txControlCredits == 0u) return 0u;
    }
    else if (g_txDataCredits == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    if ((payloadLength > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) ||
        ((payloadLength != 0u) && (payload == NULL)))
    {
        g_status.txFailures++;
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.major = OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR;
    frame.minor = OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR;
    frame.type = type;
    frame.payloadLength = payloadLength;
    frame.bootSession = g_status.localSession;
    g_packetSeq++;
    if (g_packetSeq == 0u) g_packetSeq = 1u;
    frame.packetSeq = g_packetSeq;
    frame.tickMs = tickMs;
    if (payloadLength != 0u)
    {
        memcpy(frame.payload, payload, payloadLength);
    }
    wireLength = observerLinkEncodeFrame(&frame, wire, (uint16_t) sizeof(wire));
    if (wireLength == 0u)
    {
        g_status.txFailures++;
        return 0u;
    }
    uart_write_buffer(CORE3_CORE1_UART_NUM, wire, wireLength);
    if (controlLane != 0u) g_txControlCredits--;
    else g_txDataCredits--;
    g_status.txFrames++;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sendMessage(uint8_t type,
    const uint8_t *payload,
    uint16_t payloadLength,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    return sendMessageBudgeted(type, payload, payloadLength, tickMs, 0u);
}

static uint8_t sendControlMessage(uint8_t type,
    const uint8_t *payload,
    uint16_t payloadLength,
    uint32_t tickMs)
{
    return sendMessageBudgeted(type, payload, payloadLength, tickMs, 1u);
}

static void publishParamAssembly(void)
{
    g_paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
    g_paramAssembly.dataLength = g_paramExpectedBytes;
    g_paramRequestSequence++;
    if (g_paramRequestSequence == 0u) g_paramRequestSequence = 1u;
    g_paramAssembly.producerBootGeneration = g_status.localSession;
    g_paramAssembly.sequence = g_paramRequestSequence;
    g_paramAssembly.offset = g_paramRequestSequence;
    if (!paramSyncMailboxPublishRequest(&g_paramAssembly))
        g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
    else
    {
        g_paramWaitingOwner = 1u;
        g_paramOwnerDeadlineMs = g_paramLastTickMs + 500u;
    }
}

static void handleParamRequest(const observerLinkFrame *frame, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    observerParamFrame wire;
    paramSyncMailboxResponse response;
    uint16_t remaining;
    g_paramLastTickMs = tickMs;
    if (!observerParamDecode(frame->payload, frame->payloadLength, &wire)) return;
    g_paramReply = wire;
    g_paramReply.payloadCrc32 = 0u;
    g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_PENDING;
    g_paramReply.length = 0u;
    if (wire.op == OBSERVER_PARAM_OP_POLL)
    {
        if (!g_paramResponseValid && paramSyncMailboxTryReadResponse(&response) &&
            response.transactionId == wire.transactionId &&
            response.offset == g_paramAssembly.offset &&
            response.op == g_paramAssembly.op && response.slot == g_paramAssembly.slot &&
            response.target == g_paramAssembly.target)
        {
            if (g_paramOwnerBootPrimed && response.producerBootGeneration != g_paramOwnerBoot)
            {
                g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
                g_paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
                g_paramResponseValid = 0u;
                g_paramWaitingOwner = 0u;
                g_paramOwnerBoot = response.producerBootGeneration;
                g_paramOwnerResponseSequence = response.sequence;
                g_paramOwnerBootPrimed = 1u;
            }
            else if (g_paramOwnerBootPrimed &&
                observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(response.sequence,
                    g_paramOwnerResponseSequence) == 0u)
            {
                /* 保留邮箱旧应答只作基线，不能完成新的线端事务。 */
            }
            else
            {
                g_paramOwnerBoot = response.producerBootGeneration;
                g_paramOwnerResponseSequence = response.sequence;
                g_paramOwnerBootPrimed = 1u;
                g_paramResponse = response;
                g_paramResponseValid = 1u;
                g_paramWaitingOwner = 0u;
            }
        }
        if (g_paramWaitingOwner &&
            (int32_t) (tickMs - g_paramOwnerDeadlineMs) >= 0)
        {
            g_paramWaitingOwner = 0u;
            g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED;
        }
        if (g_paramResponseValid && g_paramResponse.transactionId == wire.transactionId)
        {
            g_paramReply.op = g_paramResponse.op;
            g_paramReply.slot = g_paramResponse.slot;
            g_paramReply.target = g_paramResponse.target;
            g_paramReply.status = (uint8_t) (g_paramResponse.status & OBSERVER_PARAM_STATUS_MASK);
            g_paramReply.payloadCrc32 = g_paramResponse.payloadCrc32;
            g_paramReply.offset = wire.offset;
            g_paramReply.totalLength = g_paramResponse.dataLength;
            if (wire.offset > g_paramResponse.dataLength)
                g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
            else
            {
                remaining = (uint16_t) (g_paramResponse.dataLength - wire.offset);
                g_paramReply.length = (remaining > OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) ? OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES : (uint8_t) remaining;
                memcpy(g_paramReply.data, &g_paramResponse.data[wire.offset], g_paramReply.length);
                if (remaining > g_paramReply.length)
                    g_paramReply.status |= OBSERVER_PARAM_TRANSPORT_MORE;
            }
        }
    }
    else if ((wire.status & OBSERVER_PARAM_TRANSPORT_BEGIN) != 0u)
    {
        if (wire.target != 3u || wire.totalLength > PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX)
        {
            g_paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
            g_paramResponseValid = 0u;
            g_paramWaitingOwner = 0u;
            g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
            memset(&g_paramAssembly, 0, sizeof(g_paramAssembly));
        }
        else if (wire.transactionId == g_paramAssembly.transactionId &&
                 wire.op == g_paramAssembly.op && wire.slot == g_paramAssembly.slot &&
                 wire.target == g_paramAssembly.target &&
                 wire.payloadCrc32 == g_paramAssembly.payloadCrc32 &&
                 wire.totalLength == g_paramExpectedBytes)
        {
            /* 丢失应答后的 BEGIN 重传保留分片进度及 owner 应答。 */
        }
        else
        {
            g_paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
            g_paramResponseValid = 0u;
            g_paramWaitingOwner = 0u;
            memset(&g_paramAssembly, 0, sizeof(g_paramAssembly));
            g_paramExpectedBytes = wire.totalLength;
            g_paramReceivedBytes = 0u;
            g_paramAssembly.op = wire.op;
            g_paramAssembly.slot = wire.slot;
            g_paramAssembly.target = wire.target;
            g_paramAssembly.transactionId = wire.transactionId;
            g_paramAssembly.payloadCrc32 = wire.payloadCrc32;
            g_paramAssemblyActive = 1u;
            if (g_paramExpectedBytes == 0u) publishParamAssembly();
        }
    }
    else if (wire.transactionId == g_paramAssembly.transactionId &&
             wire.op == g_paramAssembly.op && wire.slot == g_paramAssembly.slot &&
             wire.target == g_paramAssembly.target &&
             wire.payloadCrc32 == g_paramAssembly.payloadCrc32 &&
             ((uint32_t) wire.offset + wire.length <= g_paramExpectedBytes))
    {
        if (wire.offset < g_paramReceivedBytes)
        {
            if (((uint32_t) wire.offset + wire.length > g_paramReceivedBytes) ||
                memcmp(&g_paramAssembly.data[wire.offset], wire.data,
                    wire.length) != 0)
            {
                g_paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
                g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
            }
        }
        else if (g_paramAssemblyActive && wire.offset == g_paramReceivedBytes)
        {
            memcpy(&g_paramAssembly.data[g_paramReceivedBytes], wire.data, wire.length);
            g_paramReceivedBytes = (uint16_t) (g_paramReceivedBytes + wire.length);
            if (g_paramReceivedBytes == g_paramExpectedBytes) publishParamAssembly();
        }
        else
        {
            g_paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
            g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        g_paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
        g_paramReply.status = PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID;
    }
    g_paramReplyPending = 1u;
}

static uint8_t sendParamReply(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    if (!g_paramReplyPending || !observerParamEncode(&g_paramReply, payload, &length)) return 0u;
    if (!sendMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PARAM_RESPONSE, payload, length, tickMs)) return 0u;
    g_paramReplyPending = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sendParamGlobalRequest(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u &&
        paramGlobalRouteReady(tickMs) == 0u)
        failPendingParamGlobalRequest(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
    if ((g_paramGlobalRequestPending == 0u) ||
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_paramGlobalRequestLastSendMs) <
            OBSERVER_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_RETRY_MS) ||
        (observerParamGlobalRequestEncode(&g_paramGlobalRequest,
             payload, &length) == 0u) ||
        (sendMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PARAM_GLOBAL_REQUEST,
             payload, length, tickMs) == 0u)) return 0u;
    g_paramGlobalRequestLastSendMs = tickMs;
    return 1u;
}

static void queueAck(uint32_t ownerSession,
    const observerLinkSharedConfig *config,
    uint8_t status,
    uint8_t reason)
{
    if ((g_ackPending != 0u) &&
        (g_pendingAck.status == OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED) &&
        (status != OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED))
    {
        return;
    }
    memset(&g_pendingAck, 0, sizeof(g_pendingAck));
    g_pendingAck.ownerSession = ownerSession;
    if (config != NULL)
    {
        g_pendingAck.revision = config->revision;
        g_pendingAck.hash = config->hash;
        g_pendingAck.desiredMode = config->detectMode;
    }
    g_pendingAck.appliedMode = g_status.appliedMode;
    g_pendingAck.status = status;
    g_pendingAck.reason = reason;
    g_ackPending = 1u;
}

static void handleHello(const observerLinkFrame *frame)
{
    uint8_t role;
    uint32_t capabilities;

    g_status.peerCapabilities = 0u;
    g_status.protocolCompatible = 0u;
    g_status.planningCompatible = 0u;

    if (observerLinkDecodeHello(frame->payload,
            frame->payloadLength,
            &role,
            &capabilities) == 0u ||
        (role != OBSERVER_LINK_ROLE_CORE1))
    {
        g_status.protocolCompatible = 0u;
        return;
    }
    g_status.peerCapabilities = capabilities;
    g_status.protocolCompatible = (uint8_t) ((frame->minor == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                                             (frame->payload[2] == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                                             ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_BINARY_CC) != 0u) &&
                                             ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_LEGACY_CANNY) != 0u) &&
                                             ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_STAGING) != 0u));
    g_status.planningCompatible = (uint8_t) ((frame->minor == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                                             (frame->payload[2] == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                                             ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS) != 0u) &&
                                             ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CAMERA_CONTROL) != 0u) &&
                                             ((capabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONTROL_STATUS) != 0u));
    if (g_status.planningCompatible == 0u)
    {
        clearControlStatus();
        g_planningActiveValid = 0u;
        g_planningLatestValid = 0u;
        g_planningFragmentIndex = 0u;
    }
}

static void handleConfig(const observerLinkFrame *frame)
{
    observerLinkSharedConfig incoming;

    if ((frame->minor != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) ||
        (g_status.planningCompatible == 0u))
    {
        queueAck(frame->bootSession,
            NULL,
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED,
            OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_UNSUPPORTED);
        return;
    }

    if (observerLinkDecodeSharedConfig(frame->payload,
            frame->payloadLength,
            &incoming) == 0u)
    {
        queueAck(frame->bootSession,
            NULL,
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED,
            OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_BAD_PAYLOAD);
        return;
    }
    if (incoming.hash != observerLinkSharedConfigHash(&incoming))
    {
        queueAck(frame->bootSession,
            &incoming,
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED,
            OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_BAD_HASH);
        return;
    }
    if ((incoming.sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) ||
        (incoming.profileVersion != 1u) ||
        (g_status.protocolCompatible == 0u) ||
        (observerLinkSharedConfigIsValid(&incoming) == 0u))
    {
        queueAck(frame->bootSession,
            &incoming,
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED,
            (g_status.protocolCompatible == 0u)
                ? OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_UNSUPPORTED
                : OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_BAD_PAYLOAD);
        return;
    }

    if ((g_stagedValid != 0u) && (incoming.revision != g_staged.revision) &&
        (observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(incoming.revision,
             g_staged.revision) == 0u))
    {
        queueAck(frame->bootSession,
            &g_staged,
            OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED,
            OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_OLD_REVISION);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_stagedValid != 0u) && (incoming.revision == g_staged.revision))
    {
        if (incoming.hash != g_staged.hash)
        {
            queueAck(frame->bootSession,
                &g_staged,
                OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED,
                OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_REVISION_CONFLICT);
        }
        else
        {
            queueAck(frame->bootSession,
                &g_staged,
                g_status.configStatus,
                g_status.configReason);
        }
        return;
    }

    g_staged = incoming;
    g_stagedValid = 1u;
    g_status.stagedRevision = incoming.revision;
    g_status.stagedHash = incoming.hash;
    g_status.stagedMode = incoming.detectMode;
    g_status.configStatus = OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_STAGED;
    g_status.configReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_NONE;
    queueAck(frame->bootSession,
        &g_staged,
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_STAGED,
        OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_NONE);
}

static void handleFrame(const observerLinkFrame *frame, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t qualifiedHello = (uint8_t) ((frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HELLO) &&
                                        (frame->major == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR) &&
                                        (frame->minor == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
                                        (helloIdentifiesCore1(frame) != 0u));
    uint8_t sessionDecision = observerLinkRxSessionClassify(
        g_status.online, g_status.ownerSession, g_rxPacketSeq,
        g_rxPacketSeqPrimed, frame->bootSession, frame->packetSeq,
        qualifiedHello);
    if (sessionDecision == OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT) return;
    if (sessionDecision == OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REBIND)
    {
        g_status.bindingEpoch++;
        if (g_status.bindingEpoch == 0u) g_status.bindingEpoch = 1u;
        clearOwnerState(frame->bootSession);
        g_rxPacketSeqPrimed = 0u;
        g_status.protocolCompatible = 0u;
        g_status.peerCapabilities = 0u;
    }
    g_rxPacketSeq = frame->packetSeq;
    g_rxPacketSeqPrimed = 1u;
    g_status.lastValidRxTickMs = tickMs;
    g_status.online = 1u;
    g_status.rxFrames++;

    if ((frame->major != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MAJOR) ||
        (frame->minor != OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR))
    {
        invalidateParamGlobalRoute();
        g_status.protocolCompatible = 0u;
        g_status.planningCompatible = 0u;
        g_planningActiveValid = 0u;
        g_planningLatestValid = 0u;
        g_planningFragmentIndex = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HELLO)
    {
        handleHello(frame);
        if (g_status.protocolCompatible == 0u ||
            (g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PARAM_SYNC) == 0u)
            invalidateParamGlobalRoute();
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_CONFIG_SNAPSHOT)
    {
        handleConfig(frame);
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HEARTBEAT)
    {
        observerLinkControlStatus controlStatus;
        if ((frame->minor == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
            ((g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CAMERA_CONTROL) != 0u) &&
            ((g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONTROL_STATUS) != 0u) &&
            (observerLinkDecodeControlStatus(frame->payload,
                 frame->payloadLength, &controlStatus) != 0u))
        {
            g_status.controlStatus = controlStatus;
            g_status.controlStatusValid = 1u;
            g_status.cameraControlState = controlStatus.cameraControlState;
            g_status.cameraControlValid = (uint8_t) ((controlStatus.flags & OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_STATUS_VALID) != 0u);
            if (controlStatus.cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN)
            {
                g_status.lastKnownCameraControlState =
                    controlStatus.cameraControlState;
            }
            g_status.cameraControlTickMs = tickMs;
        }
        else
        {
            clearControlStatus();
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_DIAGNOSTICS)
    {
        if (observerLinkDecodeDiagnostics(frame->payload,
                frame->payloadLength,
                &g_status.peerDiagnostics) != 0u)
        {
            g_status.peerDiagnosticsTickMs = tickMs;
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_VIEW_OVERLAY)
    {
        observerLinkViewOverlay overlay;
        uint8_t sameIdentity;
        sameIdentity = 0u;
        if ((frame->minor == OBSERVER_LINK_PROTOCOL_MINOR) &&
            ((g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_VIEW_OVERLAY) != 0u) &&
            (observerLinkDecodeViewOverlay(frame->payload,
                 frame->payloadLength, &overlay) != 0u) &&
            (overlay.ownerSession == frame->bootSession) &&
            (overlay.ownerSession == g_status.ownerSession) &&
            (overlay.configRevision == g_status.appliedRevision) &&
            (overlay.configHash == g_status.appliedHash) &&
            (overlay.detectMode == g_status.appliedMode))
        {
            sameIdentity = (uint8_t) ((g_status.viewOverlayValid != 0u) &&
                                      (g_status.viewOverlay.ownerSession == overlay.ownerSession) &&
                                      (g_status.viewOverlay.configRevision == overlay.configRevision) &&
                                      (g_status.viewOverlay.configHash == overlay.configHash) &&
                                      (g_status.viewOverlay.detectMode == overlay.detectMode));
            if ((sameIdentity == 0u) ||
                (observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(overlay.overlaySeq,
                     g_status.viewOverlay.overlaySeq) != 0u))
            {
                g_status.viewOverlay = overlay;
                g_status.viewOverlayValid = 1u;
                g_status.viewOverlayTickMs = tickMs;
            }
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_KVM_CONTROL)
    {
        if (observerLinkDecodeKvmControl(frame->payload,
                frame->payloadLength, &g_kvmControl) != 0u)
        {
            g_kvmControlReady = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_KVM_EVENT)
    {
        if (observerLinkDecodeKvmEvent(frame->payload,
                frame->payloadLength, &g_kvmEvent) != 0u)
        {
            g_kvmEventReady = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if (frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PARAM_REQUEST &&
             (g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PARAM_SYNC) != 0u)
    {
        handleParamRequest(frame, tickMs);
    }
    else if ((frame->type == OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE) &&
             ((g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PARAM_SYNC) != 0u))
    {
        paramSyncGlobalState next;
        if (observerParamGlobalStateDecode(frame->payload,
                frame->payloadLength, &next) == 0u)
        {
            invalidateParamGlobalRoute();
        }
        else
        {
            if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u &&
                g_paramGlobalStateValid != 0u &&
                next.coordinatorBootGeneration !=
                    g_paramGlobalState.coordinatorBootGeneration)
                failPendingParamGlobalRequest(
                    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_PEER_RESTART);
            else if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u &&
                paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(&next,
                    &g_paramGlobalRequest) == 0u &&
                paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&next) == 0u)
                failPendingParamGlobalRequest(paramGlobalBusyError(&next));
            g_paramGlobalState = next;
            g_paramGlobalStateReady = 1u;
            g_paramGlobalStateValid = 1u;
            g_paramGlobalStateLastRxMs = tickMs;
            if (((next.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) != 0u) &&
                (next.requestBootGeneration ==
                    g_paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration) &&
                (next.requestSequence == g_paramGlobalRequest.sequence))
                g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
        }
    }
}

static void pollHardwareRxErrors(void)
{
#if defined(__ICCARM__)
    uint32_t status = Cy_SCB_UART_GetRxFifoStatus(CORE3_CORE1_UART_SCB);
    uint32_t errors = status & CY_SCB_UART_RECEIVE_ERR;

    if ((errors & CY_SCB_RX_INTR_OVERFLOW) != 0u)
    {
        g_status.localDiagnostics.rxOverflowErrors++;
    }
    if ((errors & CY_SCB_RX_INTR_UART_FRAME_ERROR) != 0u)
    {
        g_status.localDiagnostics.rxFrameErrors++;
    }
    if ((errors & CY_SCB_RX_INTR_UART_PARITY_ERROR) != 0u)
    {
        g_status.localDiagnostics.rxParityErrors++;
    }
    if (errors != 0u)
    {
        Cy_SCB_UART_ClearRxFifoStatus(CORE3_CORE1_UART_SCB, errors);
    }
#endif
}

static void receiveFrames(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    observerLinkFrame frame;
    uint8_t byte;
    uint16_t budget = OBSERVER_LINK_RX_BUDGET;

    pollHardwareRxErrors();
    while ((budget != 0u) && (g_rxTail != g_rxHead))
    {
        __DMB();
        byte = g_rxRing[g_rxTail];
        g_rxTail = (uint16_t) ((g_rxTail + 1u) & OBSERVER_LINK_RX_RING_MASK);
        budget--;
        if (observerLinkParserFeed(&g_parser, byte, &frame) != 0u)
        {
            handleFrame(&frame, tickMs);
        }
    }
}

static uint8_t sendHello(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[8u];
    uint16_t length;
    uint32_t capabilities = OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_STAGING |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_KVM |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_MENU_STATUS |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CAMERA_CONTROL |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONTROL_STATUS |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_VIEW_OVERLAY |
                            OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PARAM_SYNC;

    if (g_visionReady != 0u)
    {
        capabilities |= OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_BINARY_CC |
                        OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_LEGACY_CANNY |
                        OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_CONFIG_APPLY;
    }
    if (observerLinkEncodeHello(OBSERVER_LINK_ROLE_CORE3,
            capabilities,
            payload,
            &length) != 0u)
    {
        return sendMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HELLO, payload, length, tickMs);
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t sendHeartbeat(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[4u];
    payload[0] = g_status.protocolCompatible;
    payload[1] = g_status.configStatus;
    payload[2] = g_status.stagedMode;
    payload[3] = g_status.appliedMode;
    return sendMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HEARTBEAT,
        payload,
        (uint16_t) sizeof(payload),
        tickMs);
}

static uint8_t sendDiagnostics(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_DIAGNOSTICS_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    observerLinkDiagnostics diagnostics;

    g_status.localDiagnostics.validFrames = g_parser.validFrames;
    g_status.localDiagnostics.crcErrors = g_parser.crcErrors;
    g_status.localDiagnostics.lengthErrors = g_parser.lengthErrors;
    g_status.localDiagnostics.versionErrors = g_parser.versionErrors;
    g_status.localDiagnostics.txDeferred = g_status.txDeferred;
    diagnostics = g_status.localDiagnostics;
    diagnostics.rxOverflowErrors += g_rxRingOverflow;
    if (observerLinkEncodeDiagnostics(&diagnostics,
            payload,
            &length) == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return sendMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_DIAGNOSTICS,
        payload,
        length,
        tickMs);
}

static uint8_t sendHealth(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    observerLinkHealth health;

    if (g_healthPending == 0u) return 0u;
    health = g_health;
    health.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_FLAG_BRIDGE_FRESH;
    health.bridgeAgeMs = 0u;
    if ((observerLinkEncodeHealth(&health, payload, &length) != 0u) &&
        (sendMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_HEALTH, payload, length, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_healthPending = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t sendPendingAck(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_ACK_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;

    if ((g_ackPending != 0u) &&
        (observerLinkEncodeConfigAck(&g_pendingAck, payload, &length) != 0u) &&
        (sendMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_CONFIG_ACK, payload, length, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_ackPending = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t sendKvmAck(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_ACK_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    if ((g_kvmAckPending != 0u) &&
        (observerLinkEncodeKvmAck(&g_kvmAck, payload, &length) != 0u) &&
        (sendControlMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_KVM_ACK, payload, length, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_kvmAckPending = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t sendKvmMenuStatus(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_MENU_STATUS_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    if ((g_kvmMenuPending != 0u) &&
        (observerLinkEncodeKvmMenuStatus(&g_kvmMenuStatus, payload, &length) != 0u) &&
        (sendControlMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_KVM_MENU_STATUS, payload, length, tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_kvmMenuPending = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t sendPlanningTrackFragment(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t payload[OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_MAX_BYTES];
    uint16_t length;
    uint8_t fragmentCount;

    if (g_planningActiveValid == 0u)
    {
        if (g_planningLatestValid == 0u)
        {
            return 0u;
        }
        g_planningActive = g_planningLatest;
        g_planningActiveValid = 1u;
        g_planningLatestValid = 0u;
        g_planningFragmentIndex = 0u;
    }
    if ((g_status.online == 0u) || (g_status.protocolCompatible == 0u) ||
        (g_status.planningCompatible == 0u) ||
        (g_status.configStatus != OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED) ||
        ((g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS) == 0u) ||
        (g_planningActive.ownerSession != g_status.ownerSession) ||
        (g_planningActive.revision != g_status.appliedRevision) ||
        (g_planningActive.hash != g_status.appliedHash) ||
        (g_planningActive.detectMode != g_status.appliedMode))
    {
        g_planningActiveValid = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    fragmentCount = observerLinkPlanningTrackFragmentCount(
        g_planningActive.retainedCount);
    if (observerLinkEncodePlanningTrackFragment(&g_planningActive,
            g_planningFragmentIndex, payload, &length) == 0u)
    {
        g_status.txFailures++;
        g_planningActiveValid = 0u;
        g_planningFragmentIndex = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    if (sendMessage(OBSERVER_LINK_MSG_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT,
            payload, length, tickMs) == 0u)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    g_planningFragmentIndex++;
    if (g_planningFragmentIndex >= fragmentCount)
    {
        g_planningActiveValid = 0u;
        g_planningFragmentIndex = 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

void core3LinkCore3Init(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest retainedRequest;
    paramSyncMailboxResponse retainedResponse;
    if (g_uartInitialized != 0u) uart_rx_interrupt(CORE3_CORE1_UART_NUM, 0u);
    memset(&g_status, 0, sizeof(g_status));
    observerLinkParserInit(&g_parser);
    clearOwnerState(0u);
    g_packetSeq = 0u;

    g_lastHelloTickMs = tickMs - OBSERVER_LINK_HELLO_PERIOD_MS;
    g_lastHeartbeatTickMs = tickMs - OBSERVER_LINK_HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_MS;
    g_lastDiagTickMs = tickMs - OBSERVER_LINK_DIAG_PERIOD_MS;
    g_lastDeferredTickMs = tickMs - 1u;
    g_txEpochTickMs = tickMs;
    g_txDataCredits = OBSERVER_LINK_TX_FRAMES_PER_EPOCH;
    g_txControlCredits = OBSERVER_LINK_TX_CONTROL_FRAMES_PER_EPOCH;
    g_planningBurstCount = 0u;
    memset(&g_kvmControl, 0, sizeof(g_kvmControl));
    memset(&g_kvmEvent, 0, sizeof(g_kvmEvent));
    memset(&g_kvmAck, 0, sizeof(g_kvmAck));
    memset(&g_kvmMenuStatus, 0, sizeof(g_kvmMenuStatus));

    g_kvmMenuPending = 0u;
    memset(&g_planningActive, 0, sizeof(g_planningActive));
    memset(&g_planningLatest, 0, sizeof(g_planningLatest));
    g_planningActiveValid = 0u;
    g_planningLatestValid = 0u;
    g_planningFragmentIndex = 0u;
    g_rxHead = 0u;
    g_rxTail = 0u;
    g_rxRingOverflow = 0u;
    g_paramAssemblyActive = 0u;
    g_paramResponseValid = 0u;
    g_paramReplyPending = 0u;
    g_paramRequestSequence = 0u;
    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&retainedRequest) != 0u)
        g_paramRequestSequence = retainedRequest.sequence;
    g_paramOwnerBoot = 0u;
    g_paramOwnerResponseSequence = 0u;
    g_paramOwnerBootPrimed = 0u;

void core3LinkCore3RxIsr(void)
{
    uint8_t byte;
    while (uart_query_byte(CORE3_CORE1_UART_NUM, &byte) != 0u)
    {
        uint16_t next = (uint16_t) ((g_rxHead + 1u) & OBSERVER_LINK_RX_RING_MASK);
        if (next == g_rxTail)
        {
            g_rxRingOverflow++;
            continue;
        }
        g_rxRing[g_rxHead] = byte;
        __DMB();
        g_rxHead = next;
    }
}

void core3LinkCore3SetVisionReady(uint8_t ready)
{
    g_visionReady = (ready != 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static uint8_t transmitWorkPending(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *planning =
        (g_planningActiveValid != 0u) ? &g_planningActive : ((g_planningLatestValid != 0u) ? &g_planningLatest : NULL);
    uint8_t planningSendable = (uint8_t) ((planning != NULL) &&
                                          (g_status.online != 0u) && (g_status.protocolCompatible != 0u) &&
                                          (g_status.planningCompatible != 0u) &&
                                          (g_status.configStatus == OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED) &&
                                          ((g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_PLANNING_TRACKS) != 0u) &&
                                          (planning->ownerSession == g_status.ownerSession) &&
                                          (planning->revision == g_status.appliedRevision) &&
                                          (planning->hash == g_status.appliedHash) &&
                                          (planning->detectMode == g_status.appliedMode));

    return (uint8_t) ((g_ackPending != 0u) ||
                      (g_paramReplyPending != 0u) ||
                      ((g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u) &&
                       ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_paramGlobalRequestLastSendMs) >=
                        OBSERVER_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_RETRY_MS)) ||
                      (planningSendable != 0u) ||
                      (g_healthPending != 0u) ||
                      ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastHeartbeatTickMs) >=
                          OBSERVER_LINK_HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_MS) ||
                      ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastHelloTickMs) >=
                          OBSERVER_LINK_HELLO_PERIOD_MS) ||
                      ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastDiagTickMs) >=
                          OBSERVER_LINK_DIAG_PERIOD_MS));
}

static uint8_t transmitOne(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    if (sendPendingAck(tickMs) != 0u) return 1u;
    if (((g_status.online == 0u) || (g_status.protocolCompatible == 0u)) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastHelloTickMs) >= OBSERVER_LINK_HELLO_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendHello(tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_lastHelloTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastHeartbeatTickMs) >= OBSERVER_LINK_HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendHeartbeat(tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_lastHeartbeatTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (sendHealth(tickMs) != 0u) return 1u;
    if ((g_planningBurstCount >= OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_BURST_MAX) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastHelloTickMs) >= OBSERVER_LINK_HELLO_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendHello(tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_lastHelloTickMs = tickMs;
        g_planningBurstCount = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((g_planningBurstCount >= OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_BURST_MAX) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastDiagTickMs) >= OBSERVER_LINK_DIAG_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendDiagnostics(tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_lastDiagTickMs = tickMs;
        g_planningBurstCount = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (sendPlanningTrackFragment(tickMs) != 0u)
    {
        if (g_planningBurstCount < 0xFFu) g_planningBurstCount++;
        return 1u;
    }
    g_planningBurstCount = 0u;
    if (((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastHelloTickMs) >= OBSERVER_LINK_HELLO_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendHello(tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_lastHelloTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastDiagTickMs) >= OBSERVER_LINK_DIAG_PERIOD_MS) &&
        (sendDiagnostics(tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        g_lastDiagTickMs = tickMs;
        return 1u;
    }
    if (sendParamReply(tickMs) != 0u) return 1u;
    if (sendParamGlobalRequest(tickMs) != 0u) return 1u;
    return 0u;
}

uint8_t core3LinkCore3QueueParamGlobalRequest(
    const paramSyncGlobalRequest *request)
{
    if ((request == NULL) || (paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(request) == 0u) ||
        (request->origin != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3)) return 0u;
    if ((g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u) &&
        ((g_paramGlobalRequest.producerBootGeneration !=
             request->producerBootGeneration) ||
         (g_paramGlobalRequest.sequence != request->sequence))) return 0u;
    g_paramGlobalRequest = *request;
    g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 1u;
    if (paramGlobalRouteReady(g_paramLastTickMs) == 0u)
    {
        failPendingParamGlobalRequest(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
        return 1u;
    }
    g_paramGlobalRequestLastSendMs -= OBSERVER_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_RETRY_MS;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3LinkCore3TakeParamGlobalState(paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    if (state != NULL && g_paramGlobalRouteFailureReady != 0u)
    {
        *state = g_paramGlobalRouteFailure;
        g_paramGlobalRouteFailureReady = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((state == NULL) || (g_paramGlobalStateReady == 0u)) return 0u;
    if (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(&g_paramGlobalState) == 0u)
    {
        g_paramGlobalStateReady = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }
    *state = g_paramGlobalState;
    g_paramGlobalStateReady = 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3LinkCore3IsParamGlobalStateValid(void)

    return paramGlobalRouteReady(g_paramLastTickMs);
}

static void refreshTxEpoch(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t elapsedEpochs;
    uint32_t credits;

    elapsedEpochs = (uint32_t) (tickMs - g_txEpochTickMs) /
                    OBSERVER_LINK_TX_EPOCH_MS;
    if (elapsedEpochs != 0u)
    {
        g_txEpochTickMs += elapsedEpochs * OBSERVER_LINK_TX_EPOCH_MS;
        credits = (uint32_t) g_txDataCredits +
                  elapsedEpochs * OBSERVER_LINK_TX_FRAMES_PER_EPOCH;
        g_txDataCredits = (uint8_t) ((credits > OBSERVER_LINK_TX_DATA_CREDIT_CAP) ? OBSERVER_LINK_TX_DATA_CREDIT_CAP : credits);
        credits = (uint32_t) g_txControlCredits +
                  elapsedEpochs * OBSERVER_LINK_TX_CONTROL_FRAMES_PER_EPOCH;
        g_txControlCredits = (uint8_t) ((credits > OBSERVER_LINK_TX_CONTROL_CREDIT_CAP) ? OBSERVER_LINK_TX_CONTROL_CREDIT_CAP : credits);
    }
}

static void serviceControlTransmit(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    refreshTxEpoch(tickMs);
    while (g_txControlCredits != 0u)
    {
        if (sendKvmAck(tickMs) != 0u) continue;
        if (sendKvmMenuStatus(tickMs) != 0u) continue;
        break;
    }
}

static void serviceTransmit(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    refreshTxEpoch(tickMs);
    while ((g_txDataCredits != 0u) &&
           (transmitOne(tickMs) != 0u))
    {
        /* 有界串行发送；完整快照的active分片在latest之前保持冻结。 */
    }
    if ((transmitWorkPending(tickMs) != 0u) &&
        (g_txDataCredits == 0u) &&
        (g_lastDeferredTickMs != tickMs))
    {
        g_lastDeferredTickMs = tickMs;
        g_status.txDeferred++;
    }
}

void core3LinkCore3Poll(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    g_paramLastTickMs = tickMs;
    receiveFrames(tickMs);
    if (g_paramGlobalStateValid != 0u &&
        (uint32_t) (tickMs - g_paramGlobalStateLastRxMs) >=
            CORE3_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS)
        invalidateParamGlobalRoute();
    if ((g_status.online != 0u) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_status.lastValidRxTickMs) >= OBSERVER_LINK_TIMEOUT_MS))
    {
        uint32_t ownerSession = g_status.ownerSession;
        g_status.online = 0u;
        g_rxPacketSeqPrimed = 0u;
        g_status.protocolCompatible = 0u;
        g_status.peerCapabilities = 0u;
        clearOwnerState(ownerSession);
    }
    if ((g_status.controlStatusValid != 0u) &&
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_status.cameraControlTickMs) >= OBSERVER_LINK_TIMEOUT_MS))
    {
        clearControlStatus();
    }
    serviceControlTransmit(tickMs);
    serviceTransmit(tickMs);
}

void core3LinkCore3FlushControl(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    serviceControlTransmit(tickMs);
}

void core3LinkCore3FlushTx(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    serviceTransmit(tickMs);
}

void core3LinkCore3GetStatus(core3LinkCore3Status *status)
{
    if (status != NULL)
    {
        g_status.localDiagnostics.validFrames = g_parser.validFrames;
        g_status.localDiagnostics.crcErrors = g_parser.crcErrors;
        g_status.localDiagnostics.lengthErrors = g_parser.lengthErrors;
        g_status.localDiagnostics.versionErrors = g_parser.versionErrors;
        g_status.localDiagnostics.txDeferred = g_status.txDeferred;
        *status = g_status;
        status->localDiagnostics.rxOverflowErrors += g_rxRingOverflow;
    }
}

uint8_t core3LinkCore3MarkConfigApplied(uint32_t ownerSession,
    uint32_t revision,
    uint32_t hash,
    uint8_t appliedMode)
{
    if ((g_stagedValid == 0u) ||
        (g_status.online == 0u) ||
        (g_status.protocolCompatible == 0u) ||
        (ownerSession != g_status.ownerSession) ||
        (revision != g_staged.revision) ||
        (hash != g_staged.hash) ||
        (appliedMode != g_staged.detectMode))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if ((g_status.appliedRevision != revision) ||
        (g_status.appliedHash != hash) ||
        (g_status.appliedMode != appliedMode))
    {
        clearViewOverlay();
    }
    g_status.appliedRevision = revision;
    g_status.appliedHash = hash;
    g_status.appliedMode = appliedMode;
    g_status.configStatus = OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED;
    g_status.configReason = OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_NONE;
    queueAck(ownerSession,
        &g_staged,
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_APPLIED,
        OBSERVER_LINK_REJECT_NONE);
    return 1u;
}

    }
    return 1u;
}

{
    uint32_t bridgeSeq;
    if ((health == NULL) ||
        (health->sourceId != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3)) return 0u;
    bridgeSeq = g_health.bridgeSeq + 1u;
    if (bridgeSeq == 0u) bridgeSeq = 1u;
    g_health = *health;
    g_health.bridgeSeq = bridgeSeq;
    g_health.bridgeAgeMs = 0u;
    g_health.flags |= OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_FLAG_BRIDGE_FRESH;
    g_healthPending = 1u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core3LinkCore3GetViewOverlay(observerLinkViewOverlay *overlay,
    uint32_t tickMs, uint32_t timeoutMs, uint32_t *ageMs)
{
    uint32_t age;

    if ((overlay == NULL) || (g_status.viewOverlayValid == 0u)) return 0u;
    age = tickMs - g_status.viewOverlayTickMs;
    if (ageMs != NULL) *ageMs = age;
    if ((age > timeoutMs) || (g_status.online == 0u) ||
        (g_status.protocolCompatible == 0u) ||
        ((g_status.peerCapabilities & OBSERVER_LINK_CAP_VIEW_OVERLAY) == 0u) ||
        (g_status.viewOverlay.ownerSession != g_status.ownerSession) ||
        (g_status.viewOverlay.configRevision != g_status.appliedRevision) ||
        (g_status.viewOverlay.configHash != g_status.appliedHash) ||
        (g_status.viewOverlay.detectMode != g_status.appliedMode)) return 0u;
    *overlay = g_status.viewOverlay;
    return 1u;
}

static void flushPendingBorderRejections(void)
{
    while ((g_pendingBorderRejectionValid != 0u) &&
        (g_pendingBorderRejection.count != 0u))
    {
        core3CoreEgressEvent event;
        core3CoreBorderRejection *payload;
        uint16_t sent;
        memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
        event.kind = CORE3_CORE_EGRESS_BORDER_REJECTION;
        payload = &event.payload.borderRejection;
        payload->ownerSession = g_pendingBorderRejection.ownerSession;
        payload->revision = g_pendingBorderRejection.revision;
        payload->hash = g_pendingBorderRejection.hash;
        payload->trackerFrameSeq = g_pendingBorderRejection.trackerFrameSeq;
        sent = g_pendingBorderRejection.count;
        if (sent > CORE3_CORE_REJECTION_TRACK_MAX)
            sent = CORE3_CORE_REJECTION_TRACK_MAX;
        payload->rejectedCount = (uint8_t) sent;
        memcpy(payload->rejectedTrackIds, g_pendingBorderRejection.trackIds,
            (size_t) sent * sizeof(uint16_t));
        if (core3CoreDataPushEgress(&event) == 0u) break;
        g_pendingBorderRejection.count = (uint16_t)
            (g_pendingBorderRejection.count - sent);
        if (g_pendingBorderRejection.count != 0u)
            memmove(g_pendingBorderRejection.trackIds,
                &g_pendingBorderRejection.trackIds[sent],
                (size_t) g_pendingBorderRejection.count * sizeof(uint16_t));
    }
    if ((g_pendingBorderRejectionValid != 0u) &&
        (g_pendingBorderRejection.count == 0u))
        clearPendingBorderRejections();
}

static void flushVision(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    g_tickMs = tickMs;
    if ((g_visionDirty != 0u) ||
        ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_lastVisionPublishTickMs) >=
            CORE3_CORE_SHARED_HEARTBEAT_MS))
    {
        publishVision();
    }
}

static void refreshLink(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    core3CoreLinkSnapshot incoming;
    uint32_t bootGeneration;
    uint32_t publishSeq;
    uint8_t bindingChanged;
    uint8_t rebaseline;

    if (g_lastLinkProbeTickMs == tickMs) return;
    g_lastLinkProbeTickMs = tickMs;
    if (core3CoreDataProbeLink(&bootGeneration, &publishSeq) == 0u) return;
    if ((bootGeneration == g_link.bootGeneration) &&
        (publishSeq == g_lastLinkPublishSeq)) return;
    if (core3CoreDataTryReadLink(&incoming) == 0u) return;
    rebaseline = (uint8_t) ((g_linkBaselinePending != 0u) ||
        ((g_link.magic == CORE3_CORE_LINK_MAGIC) &&
         (incoming.bootGeneration != g_link.bootGeneration)));
    bindingChanged = (uint8_t) (
        (g_link.magic == CORE3_CORE_LINK_MAGIC) &&
        ((incoming.status.ownerSession != g_link.status.ownerSession) ||
         (incoming.status.bindingEpoch != g_link.status.bindingEpoch)));
    if ((g_link.magic != CORE3_CORE_LINK_MAGIC) ||
        (incoming.bootGeneration != g_link.bootGeneration))
    {
        if (g_link.magic == CORE3_CORE_LINK_MAGIC)
        {
            core3CoreDataNoteSessionReset();
        }
        core3CoreDataSyncIngressConsumer(incoming.bootGeneration);
        if (g_vision.appliedSeq != 0u)
        {
            g_vision.appliedSeq++;
            if (g_vision.appliedSeq == 0u) g_vision.appliedSeq = 1u;
            markVisionDirty();
        }
        clearKvmQueues();
        clearPendingBorderRejections();
        g_linkWasFresh = 0u;
        g_lastRemoteRxTick = 0u;
        g_lastRemoteControlTick = 0u;
        g_lastRemoteDiagTick = 0u;
        g_lastRemoteOverlaySeq = 0u;
    }
    else if (bindingChanged != 0u)
    {
        core3CoreDataSyncIngressConsumer(incoming.bootGeneration);
        g_vision.appliedOwnerSession = 0u;
        clearKvmQueues();
        clearPendingBorderRejections();
        g_lastRemoteRxTick = 0u;
        g_lastRemoteControlTick = 0u;
        g_lastRemoteDiagTick = 0u;
        g_lastRemoteOverlaySeq = 0u;
        g_lastParamGlobalStateSeq = incoming.paramGlobalStateSeq;
        g_lastParamGlobalStateTickMs =
            tickMs - CORE3_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS;
    }
    if (rebaseline != 0u)
    {
        /* Shared RAM is __no_init.  The first coherent sample establishes only
         * producer identity and sequence; an advancing outer publication must
         * follow before it can become fresh.  READY additionally requires an
         * advancing parameter-state sequence. */
        g_lastLinkPublishSeq = incoming.publishSeq;
        g_lastLinkPublishTickMs = tickMs - CORE3_CORE_SHARED_STALE_MS;
        g_lastParamGlobalStateSeq = incoming.paramGlobalStateSeq;
        g_lastParamGlobalStateTickMs =
            tickMs - CORE3_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS;
        g_lastRemoteRxTick = incoming.status.lastValidRxTickMs;
        g_lastRemoteControlTick = incoming.status.cameraControlTickMs;
        g_lastRemoteDiagTick = incoming.status.peerDiagnosticsTickMs;
        g_lastRemoteOverlaySeq = (incoming.status.viewOverlayValid != 0u) ?
            incoming.status.viewOverlay.overlaySeq : 0u;
        g_localRxTick = tickMs;
        g_localControlTick = tickMs;
        g_localDiagTick = tickMs;
        g_localOverlayTick = tickMs;
        incoming.status.lastValidRxTickMs = g_localRxTick;
        incoming.status.cameraControlTickMs = g_localControlTick;
        incoming.status.peerDiagnosticsTickMs = g_localDiagTick;
        incoming.status.viewOverlayTickMs = g_localOverlayTick;
        g_link = incoming;
        g_linkBaselinePending = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (incoming.publishSeq != g_lastLinkPublishSeq)
    {
        g_lastLinkPublishSeq = incoming.publishSeq;
        g_lastLinkPublishTickMs = tickMs;
        if (incoming.paramGlobalStateSeq == 0u)
        {
            g_lastParamGlobalStateSeq = 0u;
            g_lastParamGlobalStateTickMs =
                tickMs - CORE3_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS;
        }
        else if ((incoming.paramGlobalStateSeq !=
                     g_lastParamGlobalStateSeq) ||
                 ((g_linkWasFresh == 0u) &&
                  (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(
                       &incoming.paramGlobalState) != 0u) &&
                  ((incoming.paramGlobalState.flags &
                       PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) != 0u)))
        {
            g_lastParamGlobalStateSeq = incoming.paramGlobalStateSeq;
            g_lastParamGlobalStateTickMs = tickMs;
        }
    }
    if (incoming.status.lastValidRxTickMs != g_lastRemoteRxTick)
    {
        g_lastRemoteRxTick = incoming.status.lastValidRxTickMs;
        g_localRxTick = tickMs;
    }
    if (incoming.status.cameraControlTickMs != g_lastRemoteControlTick)
    {
        g_lastRemoteControlTick = incoming.status.cameraControlTickMs;
        g_localControlTick = tickMs;
    }
    if (incoming.status.peerDiagnosticsTickMs != g_lastRemoteDiagTick)
    {
        g_lastRemoteDiagTick = incoming.status.peerDiagnosticsTickMs;
        g_localDiagTick = tickMs;
    }
    if ((incoming.status.viewOverlayValid != 0u) &&
        (incoming.status.viewOverlay.overlaySeq != g_lastRemoteOverlaySeq))
    {
        g_lastRemoteOverlaySeq = incoming.status.viewOverlay.overlaySeq;
        g_localOverlayTick = tickMs;
    }
    incoming.status.lastValidRxTickMs = g_localRxTick;
    incoming.status.cameraControlTickMs = g_localControlTick;
    incoming.status.peerDiagnosticsTickMs = g_localDiagTick;
    incoming.status.viewOverlayTickMs = g_localOverlayTick;
    g_link = incoming;
}

static uint8_t linkFresh(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((g_link.magic == CORE3_CORE_LINK_MAGIC) &&
        ((uint32_t) (g_tickMs - g_lastLinkPublishTickMs) <
            CORE3_CORE_SHARED_STALE_MS));
}

static uint8_t paramGlobalStateFresh(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((linkFresh() != 0u) &&
        (g_link.paramGlobalStateSeq != 0u) &&
        (g_link.paramGlobalStateSeq == g_lastParamGlobalStateSeq) &&
        ((uint32_t) (g_tickMs - g_lastParamGlobalStateTickMs) <
            CORE3_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS) &&
        (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(&g_link.paramGlobalState) != 0u));
}

void core3LinkCore3Init(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    core3CoreDataTimingInit();
    memset(&g_link, 0, sizeof(g_link));
    memset(&g_vision, 0, sizeof(g_vision));
    g_tickMs = tickMs;
    g_lastLinkProbeTickMs = UINT32_MAX;
    g_lastVisionPublishTickMs = tickMs;
    g_lastParamGlobalStateSeq = 0u;
    g_lastParamGlobalStateTickMs =
        tickMs - CORE3_LINK_PARAM_GLOBAL_STATE_LOST_MS;
    g_visionDirty = 0u;
    clearPendingBorderRejections();
    g_linkWasFresh = 0u;
    g_linkBaselinePending = 1u;
    clearKvmQueues();
    g_vision.magic = CORE3_CORE_VISION_MAGIC;
    g_vision.abiVersion = CORE3_CORE_ABI_VERSION;
    g_vision.payloadBytes = sizeof(g_vision);
    g_vision.bootGeneration = core3CoreDataMakeBootGeneration(0xC3710001u);
    core3CoreDataResetEgress(g_vision.bootGeneration);
    g_vision.beginGeneration = 2u;
    g_vision.endGeneration = 2u;
    publishVision();
    refreshLink(tickMs);
}

void core3LinkCore3SetVisionReady(uint8_t ready)
{
    ready = (uint8_t) (ready != 0u);
    if ((g_vision.visionReadySeq == 0u) || (g_vision.visionReady != ready))
    {
        g_vision.visionReady = ready;
        g_vision.visionReadySeq++;
        markVisionDirty();
    }
}

void core3LinkCore3Poll(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    core3CoreIngressEvent event;
    g_tickMs = tickMs;
    refreshLink(tickMs);
    if (linkFresh() == 0u)
    {
        if (g_linkWasFresh != 0u)
        {
            core3CoreDataNoteSharedStale();
            core3CoreDataSyncIngressConsumer(g_link.bootGeneration);
            clearKvmQueues();
            clearPendingBorderRejections();
        }
        g_linkWasFresh = 0u;
        return;
    }
    g_linkWasFresh = 1u;
    flushPendingBorderRejections();
    while ((g_controlCount < CORE3_CORE_LOCAL_KVM_DEPTH) &&
        (g_eventCount < CORE3_CORE_LOCAL_KVM_DEPTH) &&
        (core3CoreDataPopIngress(&event, g_link.bootGeneration) != 0u))
    {
        if (event.kind == CORE3_CORE_INGRESS_KVM_CONTROL)
        {
            g_controlQueue[g_controlHead] = event.payload.control;
            g_controlHead = (uint8_t) ((g_controlHead + 1u) %
                CORE3_CORE_LOCAL_KVM_DEPTH);
            g_controlCount++;
        }
        else if (event.kind == CORE3_CORE_INGRESS_KVM_EVENT)
        {
            g_eventQueue[g_eventHead] = event.payload.event;
            g_eventHead = (uint8_t) ((g_eventHead + 1u) %
                CORE3_CORE_LOCAL_KVM_DEPTH);
            g_eventCount++;
        }
    }
}

uint8_t core3LinkCore3QueuePlanningTrackSnapshot(
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    core3CoreEgressEvent rejection;
    core3CoreBorderRejection *event;
    uint8_t i;
    if (snapshot == NULL) return 0u;

    flushPendingBorderRejections();
    if (g_pendingBorderRejectionValid != 0u)
    {
        if ((g_pendingBorderRejection.ownerSession != snapshot->ownerSession) ||
            (g_pendingBorderRejection.revision != snapshot->revision) ||
            (g_pendingBorderRejection.hash != snapshot->hash))
        {
            clearPendingBorderRejections();
        }
    }

    memset(&rejection, 0, sizeof(rejection));
    rejection.kind = CORE3_CORE_EGRESS_BORDER_REJECTION;
    event = &rejection.payload.borderRejection;
    event->ownerSession = snapshot->ownerSession;
    event->revision = snapshot->revision;
    event->hash = snapshot->hash;
    event->trackerFrameSeq = snapshot->trackerFrameSeq;
    for (i = 0u; i < snapshot->retainedCount; i++)
    {
        const observerLinkPlanningTrack *track = &snapshot->tracks[i];
        if ((track->flags &
                OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u) continue;
        if ((track->trackId == 0u) ||
            (event->rejectedCount >= CORE3_CORE_REJECTION_TRACK_MAX))
            return 0u;
        event->rejectedTrackIds[event->rejectedCount++] = track->trackId;
    }
    if (event->rejectedCount != 0u)
    {
        uint16_t uniqueAdded = 0u;
        if (g_pendingBorderRejectionValid == 0u)
        {
            g_pendingBorderRejection.ownerSession = event->ownerSession;
            g_pendingBorderRejection.revision = event->revision;
            g_pendingBorderRejection.hash = event->hash;
            g_pendingBorderRejection.trackerFrameSeq = event->trackerFrameSeq;
            g_pendingBorderRejectionValid = 1u;
        }
        for (i = 0u; i < event->rejectedCount; i++)
        {
            uint16_t j;
            for (j = 0u; j < g_pendingBorderRejection.count; j++)
                if (g_pendingBorderRejection.trackIds[j] ==
                    event->rejectedTrackIds[i]) break;
            if (j == g_pendingBorderRejection.count) uniqueAdded++;
        }
        if ((uint32_t) g_pendingBorderRejection.count + uniqueAdded >
            CORE3_CORE_REJECTION_BACKLOG_MAX) return 0u;
        for (i = 0u; i < event->rejectedCount; i++)
        {
            uint16_t j;
            for (j = 0u; j < g_pendingBorderRejection.count; j++)
                if (g_pendingBorderRejection.trackIds[j] ==
                    event->rejectedTrackIds[i]) break;
            if (j == g_pendingBorderRejection.count)
                g_pendingBorderRejection.trackIds[
                    g_pendingBorderRejection.count++] =
                    event->rejectedTrackIds[i];
        }
        if (observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(event->trackerFrameSeq,
                g_pendingBorderRejection.trackerFrameSeq) != 0u)
            g_pendingBorderRejection.trackerFrameSeq = event->trackerFrameSeq;
        flushPendingBorderRejections();
    }
    g_vision.planningSnapshot = *snapshot;
    g_vision.planningSeq++;
    markVisionDirty();
    return 1u;
}
