core4_cyt4bb7/project/code/app/core0Loop.c
SHA-256：6e79b7257334190f146a14951fa121570066a7c0e268e081210b8796998d6aad
代码（c）
#include "core0Loop.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "core4CoreDataTransfer.h"
#include "core4LinkCore4.h"
#include "configCore4Runtime.h"
#include "zf_driver_pit.h"

static volatile uint32_t g_linkTickMs;
static core4CoreLinkSnapshot g_linkShared;
static uint32_t g_visionGeneration;
static uint32_t g_visionPublishSeq;
static uint32_t g_visionPublishTickMs;
static uint32_t g_lastVisionProbeTickMs;
static uint32_t g_lastLinkPublishTickMs;
static uint8_t g_visionSharedFresh;
static uint8_t g_wirePaused;
static uint8_t g_forceVisionReadyReplay;
static uint32_t g_visionReadySeq;
static uint32_t g_appliedSeq;
static uint32_t g_planningSeq;
static uint32_t g_healthSeq;
static uint32_t g_paramGlobalRequestSeq;
static uint32_t g_paramGlobalStatePublishSeq;
static uint32_t g_paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq;
static core4CoreIngressEvent g_pendingIngress;
static uint8_t g_pendingIngressValid;
static core4CoreEgressEvent g_pendingEgress;
static uint8_t g_pendingEgressValid;
static core4CoreBorderRejection g_pendingBorderRejection;
static uint8_t g_pendingBorderRejectionValid;

static uint8_t paramGlobalTerminalAwaitingConsume(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((g_linkShared.paramGlobalStateSeq != 0u) &&
        (g_paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq !=
            g_linkShared.paramGlobalStateSeq) &&
        (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(&g_linkShared.paramGlobalState) != 0u) &&
        ((g_linkShared.paramGlobalState.flags &
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) != 0u));
}

static void clearSharedParamGlobalState(void)
{
    memset(&g_linkShared.paramGlobalState, 0,
        sizeof(g_linkShared.paramGlobalState));
    g_linkShared.paramGlobalStateSeq = 0u;
}

static void clearSessionPending(void)
{
    memset(&g_pendingIngress, 0, sizeof(g_pendingIngress));
    memset(&g_pendingEgress, 0, sizeof(g_pendingEgress));
    memset(&g_pendingBorderRejection, 0,
        sizeof(g_pendingBorderRejection));
    g_pendingIngressValid = 0u;
    g_pendingEgressValid = 0u;
    g_pendingBorderRejectionValid = 0u;
}

static uint8_t mergePendingBorderRejections(
    observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *snapshot)
{
    if ((snapshot == NULL) || (g_pendingBorderRejectionValid == 0u)) return 0u;
    if ((snapshot->ownerSession != g_pendingBorderRejection.ownerSession) ||
        (snapshot->revision != g_pendingBorderRejection.revision) ||
        (snapshot->hash != g_pendingBorderRejection.hash))
        return 0u;
    return core4CoreBorderRejectionMerge(&g_pendingBorderRejection, snapshot);
}

static void commitPendingBorderRejections(uint8_t delivered)
{
    if ((delivered == 0u) ||
        (delivered > g_pendingBorderRejection.rejectedCount)) return;
    g_pendingBorderRejection.rejectedCount = (uint8_t)
        (g_pendingBorderRejection.rejectedCount - delivered);
    if (g_pendingBorderRejection.rejectedCount == 0u)
    {
        memset(&g_pendingBorderRejection, 0,
            sizeof(g_pendingBorderRejection));
        g_pendingBorderRejectionValid = 0u;
        return;
    }
    memmove(g_pendingBorderRejection.rejectedTrackIds,
        &g_pendingBorderRejection.rejectedTrackIds[delivered],
        (size_t) g_pendingBorderRejection.rejectedCount * sizeof(uint16_t));
}

static void publishLinkSnapshot(uint32_t tickMs, uint8_t force)
{
    observerLinkSharedConfig staged;
    core4LinkCore4Status status;

    if ((force == 0u) && (g_lastLinkPublishTickMs == tickMs)) return;
    g_lastLinkPublishTickMs = tickMs;
    core4LinkCore4GetStatus(&status);
    if ((status.ownerSession != g_linkShared.status.ownerSession) ||
        (status.bindingEpoch != g_linkShared.status.bindingEpoch))
    {
        clearSessionPending();
        core4CoreDataResetIngress(g_linkShared.bootGeneration);
        if (g_visionGeneration != 0u)
            core4CoreDataSyncEgressConsumer(g_visionGeneration);
    }
    g_linkShared.status = status;
    if (paramGlobalTerminalAwaitingConsume() == 0u)
    {
        paramSyncGlobalState state;
        if (core4LinkCore4TakeParamGlobalState(&state) != 0u)
        {
            g_linkShared.paramGlobalState = state;
            g_paramGlobalStatePublishSeq++;
            if (g_paramGlobalStatePublishSeq == 0u)
            {
                g_paramGlobalStatePublishSeq = 1u;
                g_paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq = 0u;
            }
            g_linkShared.paramGlobalStateSeq =
                g_paramGlobalStatePublishSeq;
        }
    }
    if (((g_wirePaused != 0u) ||
         (core4LinkCore4IsParamGlobalStateValid() == 0u)) &&
        (paramGlobalTerminalAwaitingConsume() == 0u))
        clearSharedParamGlobalState();
    if (g_wirePaused != 0u)
    {
        uint32_t localSession = g_linkShared.status.localSession;
        memset(&g_linkShared.status, 0, sizeof(g_linkShared.status));
        g_linkShared.status.localSession = localSession;
        g_linkShared.status.stagedMode = 0xFFu;
        g_linkShared.status.appliedMode = 0xFFu;
        memset(&g_linkShared.stagedConfig, 0, sizeof(g_linkShared.stagedConfig));
        g_linkShared.stagedConfigSeq = 0u;
        if (paramGlobalTerminalAwaitingConsume() == 0u)
            clearSharedParamGlobalState();
    }
    else if (core4LinkCore4GetStagedConfig(&staged) != 0u)
    {
        if ((g_linkShared.stagedConfigSeq == 0u) ||
            (memcmp(&staged, &g_linkShared.stagedConfig, sizeof(staged)) != 0))
        {
            g_linkShared.stagedConfig = staged;
            g_linkShared.stagedConfigSeq++;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        memset(&g_linkShared.stagedConfig, 0, sizeof(g_linkShared.stagedConfig));
        g_linkShared.stagedConfigSeq = 0u;
    }
    g_linkShared.publishSeq++;
    g_linkShared.beginGeneration += 2u;
    if (g_linkShared.beginGeneration == 0u) g_linkShared.beginGeneration = 2u;
    g_linkShared.endGeneration = g_linkShared.beginGeneration;
    core4CoreDataWriteLink(&g_linkShared);
}

static void consumeVisionSnapshot(void)
{
    core4CoreVisionSnapshot vision;
    uint32_t bootGeneration;
    uint32_t publishSeq;

    if (g_lastVisionProbeTickMs != g_linkTickMs)
    {
        g_lastVisionProbeTickMs = g_linkTickMs;
        if ((core4CoreDataProbeVision(&bootGeneration, &publishSeq) != 0u) &&
            ((bootGeneration != g_visionGeneration) ||
             (publishSeq != g_visionPublishSeq)) &&
            (core4CoreDataTryReadVision(&vision) != 0u))
        {
            if (vision.bootGeneration != g_visionGeneration)
            {
                uint32_t previousGeneration = g_visionGeneration;
                core4CoreDataSyncEgressConsumer(vision.bootGeneration);
                g_visionGeneration = vision.bootGeneration;
                g_visionPublishSeq = 0u;
                g_visionReadySeq = 0u;
                g_appliedSeq = 0u;
                g_planningSeq = 0u;
                g_healthSeq = 0u;
                g_paramGlobalRequestSeq = 0u;
                g_paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq = 0u;
                clearSessionPending();
                g_forceVisionReadyReplay = 1u;
                g_wirePaused = 0u;
                if (previousGeneration != 0u)
                {
                    core4CoreDataNoteSessionReset();
                    core4LinkCore4Init(g_linkTickMs);
                }
            }
            if (vision.publishSeq != g_visionPublishSeq)
            {
                if (g_visionSharedFresh == 0u)
                {
                    clearSessionPending();
                    g_forceVisionReadyReplay = 1u;
                    g_wirePaused = 0u;
                }
                g_visionPublishSeq = vision.publishSeq;
                g_visionPublishTickMs = g_linkTickMs;
                g_visionSharedFresh = 1u;
            }
            if (g_visionSharedFresh != 0u)
            {
                if ((g_forceVisionReadyReplay != 0u) ||
                    (vision.visionReadySeq != g_visionReadySeq))
                {
                    core4LinkCore4SetVisionReady(vision.visionReady);
                    g_visionReadySeq = vision.visionReadySeq;
                    g_forceVisionReadyReplay = 0u;
                }
                if ((vision.appliedSeq != 0u) &&
                    (vision.appliedSeq != g_appliedSeq) &&
                    (core4LinkCore4MarkConfigApplied(vision.appliedOwnerSession,
                        vision.appliedRevision, vision.appliedHash,
                        vision.appliedMode) != 0u))
                {
                    g_appliedSeq = vision.appliedSeq;
                    g_linkShared.appliedConsumedSeq = g_appliedSeq;
                }
                if ((vision.planningSeq != 0u) &&
                    (vision.planningSeq != g_planningSeq))
                {
                    uint8_t delivered;
                    /* wire时间戳在cm7_0域重锚；相机真实新鲜度由HEALTH seq/age独立证明。 */
                    vision.planningSnapshot.captureTickMs = g_linkTickMs;
                    delivered = mergePendingBorderRejections(
                        &vision.planningSnapshot);
                    if (core4LinkCore4QueuePlanningTrackSnapshot(
                            &vision.planningSnapshot) != 0u)
                    {
                        g_planningSeq = vision.planningSeq;
                        commitPendingBorderRejections(delivered);
                    }
                }
                if ((vision.healthSeq != 0u) &&
                    (vision.healthSeq != g_healthSeq) &&
                    (core4LinkCore4PublishHealth(&vision.health) != 0u))
                {
                    g_healthSeq = vision.healthSeq;
                }
                if ((vision.paramGlobalRequestSeq != 0u) &&
                    (vision.paramGlobalRequestSeq != g_paramGlobalRequestSeq) &&
                    (core4LinkCore4QueueParamGlobalRequest(
                         &vision.paramGlobalRequest) != 0u))
                {
                    g_paramGlobalRequestSeq = vision.paramGlobalRequestSeq;
                }
                if ((vision.paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq != 0u) &&
                    (vision.paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq ==
                        g_linkShared.paramGlobalStateSeq))
                {
                    g_paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq =
                        vision.paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if ((g_visionSharedFresh != 0u) &&
        ((uint32_t) (g_linkTickMs - g_visionPublishTickMs) >=
            CORE4_CORE_SHARED_STALE_MS))
    {
        g_visionSharedFresh = 0u;
        g_wirePaused = 1u;
        g_forceVisionReadyReplay = 1u;
        clearSessionPending();
        core4LinkCore4SetVisionReady(0u);
        core4CoreDataNoteSharedStale();
    }
}

static void forwardKvmIngress(void)
{
    if ((g_pendingIngressValid != 0u) &&
        (core4CoreDataPushIngress(&g_pendingIngress) != 0u))
    {
        g_pendingIngressValid = 0u;
    }
    if (g_pendingIngressValid != 0u) return;
    memset(&g_pendingIngress, 0, sizeof(g_pendingIngress));
    if (core4LinkCore4TakeKvmControl(
        &g_pendingIngress.payload.control) != 0u)
    {
        g_pendingIngress.kind = CORE4_CORE_INGRESS_KVM_CONTROL;
        g_pendingIngressValid = 1u;
    }
    else if (core4LinkCore4TakeKvmEvent(
        &g_pendingIngress.payload.event) != 0u)
    {
        g_pendingIngress.kind = CORE4_CORE_INGRESS_KVM_EVENT;
        g_pendingIngressValid = 1u;
    }
    if ((g_pendingIngressValid != 0u) &&
        (core4CoreDataPushIngress(&g_pendingIngress) != 0u))
    {
        g_pendingIngressValid = 0u;
    }
}

static uint8_t retainBorderRejection(
    const core4CoreBorderRejection *event)
{
    return core4CoreBorderRejectionAppend(&g_pendingBorderRejection,
        &g_pendingBorderRejectionValid, event);
}

static void consumeKvmEgress(void)
{
    uint8_t accepted = 0u;
    if (g_pendingEgressValid == 0u)
    {
        g_pendingEgressValid = core4CoreDataPopEgress(&g_pendingEgress,
            g_visionGeneration);
    }
    if (g_pendingEgressValid == 0u) return;
    if (g_pendingEgress.kind == CORE4_CORE_EGRESS_KVM_ACK)
    {
        accepted = core4LinkCore4QueueKvmAck(&g_pendingEgress.payload.ack);
    }
    else if (g_pendingEgress.kind == CORE4_CORE_EGRESS_KVM_MENU)
    {
        accepted = core4LinkCore4QueueKvmMenuStatus(
            &g_pendingEgress.payload.menuStatus);
    }
    else if (g_pendingEgress.kind == CORE4_CORE_EGRESS_BORDER_REJECTION)
    {
        accepted = retainBorderRejection(
            &g_pendingEgress.payload.borderRejection);
    }
    else
    {
        accepted = 1u;
    }
    if (accepted != 0u) g_pendingEgressValid = 0u;
}

void processInit(void)
{
    core4CoreDataTimingInit();
    memset(&g_linkShared, 0, sizeof(g_linkShared));
    g_linkShared.magic = CORE4_CORE_LINK_MAGIC;
    g_linkShared.abiVersion = CORE4_CORE_ABI_VERSION;
    g_linkShared.payloadBytes = sizeof(g_linkShared);
    g_linkShared.bootGeneration = core4CoreDataMakeBootGeneration(0xC4700001u);
    g_lastVisionProbeTickMs = UINT32_MAX;
    g_lastLinkPublishTickMs = UINT32_MAX;
    g_wirePaused = 1u;
    g_forceVisionReadyReplay = 1u;
    g_paramGlobalStatePublishSeq = 0u;
    g_paramGlobalStateConsumedSeq = 0u;
    core4CoreDataResetIngress(g_linkShared.bootGeneration);
    g_linkShared.beginGeneration = 2u;
    g_linkShared.endGeneration = 2u;
    core4LinkCore4Init(0u);
    publishLinkSnapshot(0u, 1u);
    pit_ms_init(PIT_CH0, CORE4_RUNTIME_PIT_MS);
}

void pitProcess0(void)
{
    g_linkTickMs += CORE4_RUNTIME_PIT_MS;
}

void whileProcess(void)
{
    uint32_t tickMs = g_linkTickMs;
    if (g_wirePaused == 0u) consumeKvmEgress();
    consumeVisionSnapshot();
    if (g_wirePaused == 0u)
    {
        consumeKvmEgress();
        core4LinkCore4Poll(tickMs);
        forwardKvmIngress();
        core4LinkCore4FlushControl(tickMs);
        core4LinkCore4FlushTx(tickMs);
    }
    publishLinkSnapshot(tickMs, 0u);
}

_Static_assert(MT9V03X_W == CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH, "Core4 camera width must remain 188");
_Static_assert(MT9V03X_H == CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT, "Core4 camera height must remain 120");
_Static_assert(MT9V03X_FPS_DEF == 50, "Core4 camera capture must remain 50fps");

#define CORE4_CAMERA_INT_VALID_MASK (1u << 31)
#define CORE4_CAMERA_CYT2_EQUIVALENT_EXPOSURE (500u)

static volatile uint32_t *cameraSystemIntControl(void)
{
    return &CPUSS->unCM7_1_SYSTEM_INT_CTL[
        tcpwm_0_interrupts_59_IRQn].u32Register;
}

static uint32_t cameraInterruptMask(void)
{
    volatile uint32_t *control = cameraSystemIntControl();
    uint32_t saved = *control;
    *control = saved & ~CORE4_CAMERA_INT_VALID_MASK;
    (void) *control;
    __DSB();
    return saved;
}

static void cameraInterruptRestore(uint32_t saved)
{
    volatile uint32_t *control = cameraSystemIntControl();
    *control = saved;
    (void) *control;
    __DSB();
}

static uint8_t g_appImage[CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT][CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH];
static uint32_t g_appFrameSeq;
static uint8_t g_initialized;

uint8_t core4CameraServiceInit(void)
{
    uint8_t result = mt9v03x_init();
    uint32_t savedIntControl;

    if ((result == 0u) &&
        (mt9v03x_set_exposure_time(
            CORE4_CAMERA_CYT2_EQUIVALENT_EXPOSURE) != 0u))
    {
        result = 1u;
    }

    savedIntControl = cameraInterruptMask();
    mt9v03x_finish_flag = 0u;
    cameraInterruptRestore(savedIntControl);
    g_initialized = (uint8_t) (result == 0u);

    return result;
}

uint8_t core4CameraServiceSetExposure(uint16_t exposure)
{
    if (g_initialized == 0u)
    {
        return 1u;
    }
    return mt9v03x_set_exposure_time(exposure);
}

uint8_t core4CameraServiceTryCapture(uint32_t tickMs,
    uint8_t timingValid,
    core4CameraSnapshot *snapshot,
    uint32_t *copyCycles)
{
    uint8_t captured = 0u;
    uint32_t startCycles = 0u;
    uint32_t endCycles = 0u;
    uint32_t savedIntControl;

    if ((snapshot == NULL) || (copyCycles == NULL) || (mt9v03x_finish_flag == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    savedIntControl = cameraInterruptMask();

    if (timingValid != 0u)
    {
        startCycles = DWT->CYCCNT;
    }

    if (mt9v03x_finish_flag != 0u)
    {
        uint16_t y;
        mt9v03x_finish_flag = 0u;
        for (y = 0u; y < CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT; y++)
        {
            uint16_t x;
            for (x = 0u; x < CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH; x++)
            {
                g_appImage[y][x] = mt9v03x_image
                    [CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT - 1u - y]
                    [CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH - 1u - x];
            }
        }
        captured = 1u;
    }

    if (timingValid != 0u)
    {
        endCycles = DWT->CYCCNT;
    }

    cameraInterruptRestore(savedIntControl);

    if (captured != 0u)
    {
        g_appFrameSeq++;
        if (g_appFrameSeq == 0u) g_appFrameSeq = 1u;
        snapshot->data = g_appImage[0];
        snapshot->width = CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH;
        snapshot->height = CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT;
        snapshot->appFrameSeq = g_appFrameSeq;
        snapshot->tickMs = tickMs;
        *copyCycles = (timingValid != 0u) ? (endCycles - startCycles) : 0u;
    }

    return captured;
}

static void fillSolidRect(uint16_t left, uint16_t top,
    uint16_t width, uint16_t height, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t rowsPerTransfer;
    uint16_t rows;
    uint16_t y = top;
    uint16_t i;

    if ((width == 0u) || (height == 0u) ||
        (width > CORE4_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS)) return;
    rowsPerTransfer = (uint16_t) (CORE4_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS / width);
    for (i = 0u; i < CORE4_SOLID_FILL_PIXELS; i++)
        g_solidFillBuffer[i] = color;
    while (height > 0u)
    {
        rows = (height < rowsPerTransfer) ? height : rowsPerTransfer;
        ips114_show_rgb565_image(left, y, g_solidFillBuffer,
            width, rows, width, rows, 0u);
        y = (uint16_t) (y + rows);
        height = (uint16_t) (height - rows);
    }
}

static void core4DiagnosticsFormatQ4(int16_t value, char output[12])
{
    int32_t signedValue = value;
    uint32_t magnitude = (signedValue < 0) ?
        (uint32_t) (-signedValue) : (uint32_t) signedValue;
    uint32_t tenths = (magnitude * 10u + 8u) / 16u;

    (void) snprintf(output, 12u, "%c%lu.%lu",
        (signedValue < 0) ? '-' : '+',
        (unsigned long) (tenths / 10u),
        (unsigned long) (tenths % 10u));
}

static void formatFixedLine(char *line,
    uint8_t width,
    const char *format,
    va_list args)
{
    char formatted[64u];
    size_t length;

    (void) vsnprintf(formatted, sizeof(formatted), format, args);
    memset(line, ' ', width);
    line[width] = '\0';
    length = strlen(formatted);
    if (length > width)
    {
        length = width;
    }
    memcpy(line, formatted, length);
}

static void core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(uint8_t slot,
    ips114_font_size_enum font,
    uint16_t x,
    uint16_t y,
    uint8_t width,
    uint16_t color,
    uint16_t background,
    const char *format,
    ...)
{
    char line[CORE4_HOME_SLOT_CHARS + 1u];
    va_list args;

    if ((slot >= CORE4_HOME_SLOT_COUNT) || (width > CORE4_HOME_SLOT_CHARS))
    {
        return;
    }
    memset(line, 0, sizeof(line));
    va_start(args, format);
    formatFixedLine(line, width, format, args);
    va_end(args);

    if ((g_homeSlotValid[slot] == 0u) ||
        (g_homeSlotColor[slot] != color) ||
        (g_homeSlotBackground[slot] != background) ||
        (memcmp(g_homeSlotCache[slot], line, sizeof(line)) != 0))
    {
        memcpy(g_homeSlotCache[slot], line, sizeof(line));
        g_homeSlotValid[slot] = 1u;
        g_homeSlotColor[slot] = color;
        g_homeSlotBackground[slot] = background;
        ips114_set_font(font);
        ips114_set_color(color, background);
        ips114_show_string(x, y, line);
    }
}

static void fillMenuRow(uint8_t row, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t y;

    if (row >= CORE4_MENU_LINE_COUNT)
    {
        return;
    }
    y = (uint16_t) (row * 16u);
    if (row == 0u)
    {
        fillSolidRect(1u, 1u, 238u, 15u, color);
        return;
    }
    fillSolidRect(1u, y, g_menuFillRightX, 16u, color);
    if (row == (CORE4_MENU_LINE_COUNT - 1u))
    {
        fillSolidRect(1u, 128u, g_menuFillRightX, 6u, color);
    }
}

static void drawMenuFrame(uint16_t color)
{
    fillSolidRect(0u, 0u, 240u, 1u, color);
    fillSolidRect(0u, 134u, 240u, 1u, color);
    fillSolidRect(0u, 1u, 1u, 133u, color);
    fillSolidRect(239u, 1u, 1u, 133u, color);
}

static void drawMenuScrollbar(uint8_t total, uint8_t top)
{
    uint16_t trackTop = 16u;
    uint16_t trackBottom = 133u;
    uint16_t trackHeight;
    uint16_t thumbHeight;
    uint16_t thumbY;

    g_menuFillRightX = (total > CORE4_MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS)
                           ? (CORE4_MENU_SCROLL_X - 1u)
                           : 238u;
    if (total <= CORE4_MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS)
    {
        if (g_scrollValid != 0u)
        {
            fillSolidRect(CORE4_MENU_SCROLL_X, trackTop,
                (uint16_t) (238u - CORE4_MENU_SCROLL_X + 1u),
                (uint16_t) (trackBottom - trackTop + 1u), RGB565_BLACK);
            memset(g_menuLineValid, 0, sizeof(g_menuLineValid));
        }
        g_scrollValid = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if ((g_scrollValid != 0u) &&
        (g_scrollTotal == total) &&
        (g_scrollTop == top))
    {
        return;
    }

    fillSolidRect(CORE4_MENU_SCROLL_X, trackTop,
        (uint16_t) (238u - CORE4_MENU_SCROLL_X + 1u),
        (uint16_t) (trackBottom - trackTop + 1u), RGB565_BLACK);
    fillSolidRect(CORE4_MENU_SCROLL_X, trackTop, 1u,
        (uint16_t) (trackBottom - trackTop + 1u), RGB565_GREEN);
    fillSolidRect(238u, trackTop, 1u,
        (uint16_t) (trackBottom - trackTop + 1u), RGB565_GREEN);
    trackHeight = (uint16_t) (trackBottom - trackTop + 1u);
    thumbHeight = (uint16_t) (((uint32_t) trackHeight *
                                  CORE4_MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS) /
                              total);
    if (thumbHeight < 6u)
    {
        thumbHeight = 6u;
    }
    thumbY = (uint16_t) (trackTop +
                         (((uint32_t) (trackHeight - thumbHeight) * top) /
                             (total - CORE4_MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS)));
    if ((uint16_t) (thumbY + thumbHeight - 1u) > trackBottom)
        thumbHeight = (uint16_t) (trackBottom - thumbY + 1u);
    fillSolidRect((uint16_t) (CORE4_MENU_SCROLL_X + 1u), thumbY,
        (uint16_t) (237u - (CORE4_MENU_SCROLL_X + 1u) + 1u),
        thumbHeight, RGB565_GREEN);
    g_scrollTotal = total;
    g_scrollTop = top;
    g_scrollValid = 1u;
}

static void core4DiagnosticsShowMenuTitle(const char *title)
{
    char bounded[40];
    size_t length;
    uint16_t x;

    if (title == NULL)
    {
        title = "";
    }
    length = strlen(title);
    if (length > 39u) length = 39u;
    memcpy(bounded, title, length);
    bounded[length] = '\0';
    if ((g_menuLineValid[0] != 0u) &&
        (strcmp(g_menuLineCache[0], bounded) == 0)) return;
    fillMenuRow(0u, RGB565_GREEN);
    x = (uint16_t) ((240u - (uint16_t) (length * 6u)) / 2u);
    if (x < 2u) x = 2u;
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_BLACK, RGB565_GREEN);
    ips114_show_string(x, 4u, bounded);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    memset(g_menuLineCache[0], 0, sizeof(g_menuLineCache[0]));
    (void) strncpy(g_menuLineCache[0], bounded, CORE4_MENU_LINE_CHARS);
    g_menuLineValid[0] = 1u;
}

static void core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow(uint8_t row,
    core4MenuRowStyle style,
    const char *name,
    const char *value)
{
    char signature[CORE4_MENU_LINE_CHARS + 1u];
    char fixedValue[CORE4_MENU_VALUE_CHARS + 1u];
    uint16_t background = RGB565_BLACK;
    uint16_t nameForeground = CORE4_MENU_NORM_NAME_FG;
    uint16_t valueForeground = CORE4_MENU_NORM_VAL_FG;
    char marker = ' ';
    uint8_t structureChanged;
    uint8_t valueChanged;
    size_t valueLength;

    if ((row == 0u) || (row >= CORE4_MENU_LINE_COUNT))
    {
        return;
    }
    if (name == NULL)
    {
        name = "";
    }
    if (value == NULL)
    {
        value = "";
    }
    if (style == CORE4_MENU_ROW_SELECTED)
    {
        background = CORE4_MENU_SEL_BG;
        nameForeground = CORE4_MENU_SEL_NAME_FG;
        valueForeground = CORE4_MENU_SEL_VAL_FG;
        marker = '>';
    }
    else if (style == CORE4_MENU_ROW_EDIT)
    {
        background = CORE4_MENU_EDIT_BG;
        nameForeground = CORE4_MENU_EDIT_NAME_FG;
        valueForeground = CORE4_MENU_EDIT_VAL_FG;
        marker = '*';
    }

    (void) snprintf(signature, sizeof(signature), "%c%.11s", marker, name);
    memset(fixedValue, ' ', CORE4_MENU_VALUE_CHARS);
    fixedValue[CORE4_MENU_VALUE_CHARS] = '\0';
    valueLength = strlen(value);
    if (valueLength > CORE4_MENU_VALUE_CHARS)
    {
        valueLength = CORE4_MENU_VALUE_CHARS;
    }
    memcpy(fixedValue, value, valueLength);
    structureChanged = (uint8_t) ((g_menuLineValid[row] == 0u) ||
                                  (g_menuLineStyle[row] != style) ||
                                  (strncmp(g_menuLineCache[row],
                                       signature,
                                       CORE4_MENU_LINE_CHARS) != 0));
    valueChanged = (uint8_t) ((g_menuLineValid[row] == 0u) ||
                              (strncmp(g_menuValueCache[row],
                                   fixedValue,
                                   CORE4_MENU_VALUE_CHARS) != 0));

    if (structureChanged != 0u)
    {
        fillMenuRow(row, background);
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
        ips114_set_color(nameForeground, background);
        ips114_show_char(8u, (uint16_t) (row * 16u), marker);
        ips114_show_string(CORE4_MENU_NAME_X, (uint16_t) (row * 16u), name);
        memset(g_menuLineCache[row], 0, sizeof(g_menuLineCache[row]));
        (void) strncpy(g_menuLineCache[row], signature, CORE4_MENU_LINE_CHARS);
        g_menuLineStyle[row] = style;
    }
    if ((structureChanged != 0u) || (valueChanged != 0u))
    {
        ips114_set_color(valueForeground, background);
        ips114_show_string(CORE4_MENU_VALUE_X,
            (uint16_t) (row * 16u),
            fixedValue);
        memcpy(g_menuValueCache[row], fixedValue, sizeof(fixedValue));
        g_menuLineValid[row] = 1u;
    }
}

static uint16_t core4DiagnosticsFrameColor(uint8_t linkReady,
    uint8_t inputOwner)
{
    if ((linkReady == 0u) || (inputOwner == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE))
    {
        return RGB565_YELLOW;
    }
    return (inputOwner == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED;
}

static uint16_t core4DiagnosticsOwnerFrameColor(const core4RuntimeStatus *status)
{
    if ((status == NULL) || (status->kvmLinkReady == 0u) ||
        (status->kvmInputOwner == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE)) return RGB565_YELLOW;
    return (status->kvmInputOwner == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4)
        ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED;
}

static void drawHomeFrame(uint16_t color)
{
    if (g_homeFrameColor != color)
    {
        drawMenuFrame(color);
        fillSolidRect(133u, 16u, 1u, 89u, color);
        fillSolidRect(1u, 104u, 238u, 1u, color);
        fillSolidRect(1u, 119u, 238u, 1u, color);
        g_homeFrameColor = color;
    }
}

static void enterHomeSurface(uint16_t frameColor)
{
    if (g_displaySurface != CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_HOME)
    {
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_clear();
        memset(g_homeSlotValid, 0, sizeof(g_homeSlotValid));
        memset(g_homeSlotColor, 0, sizeof(g_homeSlotColor));
        memset(g_homeSlotBackground, 0, sizeof(g_homeSlotBackground));
        fillMenuRow(0u, RGB565_GREEN);
        g_homeFrameColor = 0xFFFFu;
        g_homeTitleColor = 0xFFFFu;
        g_displaySurface = CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_HOME;
    }
    drawHomeFrame(frameColor);
}

static void enterMenuSurface(core4MenuState state)
{
    uint8_t oldThreshold = (uint8_t) (g_lastMenuState == CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT);
    uint8_t newThreshold = (uint8_t) (state == CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT);

    if ((g_displaySurface != CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_MENU) ||
        (oldThreshold != newThreshold))
    {
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
        ips114_clear();
        memset(g_menuLineValid, 0, sizeof(g_menuLineValid));
        g_scrollValid = 0u;
        g_menuFrameColor = 0xFFFFu;
        g_thresholdOriginalFrameSeq = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        g_thresholdPreviewFrameSeq = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        g_thresholdFrameColor = 0xFFFFu;
        g_thresholdMode = 0xFFu;
        g_thresholdOriginalValid = 0u;
        g_thresholdPreviewValid = 0u;
        memset(g_thresholdSlotValid, 0, sizeof(g_thresholdSlotValid));
        g_displaySurface = CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_MENU;
    }
    g_lastMenuState = state;
}

static uint32_t core4DiagnosticsHardwareDuty(uint8_t percent)
{
    uint32_t logicalDuty = ((uint32_t) CORE4_RGB_LOGICAL_BRIGHTNESS * percent) / 100u;

    if (logicalDuty > PWM_DUTY_MAX)
    {
        logicalDuty = PWM_DUTY_MAX;
    }
    return PWM_DUTY_MAX - logicalDuty;
}

static void core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(uint8_t red, uint8_t green, uint8_t blue)
{
    uint32_t redDuty;
    uint32_t greenDuty;
    uint32_t blueDuty;

    if (g_rgbReady == 0u)
    {
        return;
    }
    redDuty = core4DiagnosticsHardwareDuty(red ? 100u : 0u);
    greenDuty = core4DiagnosticsHardwareDuty(green ? 100u : 0u);
    blueDuty = core4DiagnosticsHardwareDuty(blue ? 100u : 0u);

    if (redDuty != g_lastRedDuty)
    {
        pwm_set_duty(CORE4_RGB_LED_R_PWM, redDuty);
        g_lastRedDuty = redDuty;
    }
    if (greenDuty != g_lastGreenDuty)
    {
        pwm_set_duty(CORE4_RGB_LED_G_PWM, greenDuty);
        g_lastGreenDuty = greenDuty;
    }
    if (blueDuty != g_lastBlueDuty)
    {
        pwm_set_duty(CORE4_RGB_LED_B_PWM, blueDuty);
        g_lastBlueDuty = blueDuty;
    }
}

static void core4DiagnosticsSetRgbLevel(uint8_t red, uint8_t green, uint8_t blue,
    uint8_t level)
{
    uint32_t redDuty;
    uint32_t greenDuty;
    uint32_t blueDuty;
    if (g_rgbReady == 0u) return;
    redDuty = core4DiagnosticsHardwareDuty(red ? level : 0u);
    greenDuty = core4DiagnosticsHardwareDuty(green ? level : 0u);
    blueDuty = core4DiagnosticsHardwareDuty(blue ? level : 0u);
    if (redDuty != g_lastRedDuty) { pwm_set_duty(CORE4_RGB_LED_R_PWM, redDuty); g_lastRedDuty = redDuty; }
    if (greenDuty != g_lastGreenDuty) { pwm_set_duty(CORE4_RGB_LED_G_PWM, greenDuty); g_lastGreenDuty = greenDuty; }
    if (blueDuty != g_lastBlueDuty) { pwm_set_duty(CORE4_RGB_LED_B_PWM, blueDuty); g_lastBlueDuty = blueDuty; }
}

static uint8_t core4DiagnosticsBreatheLevel(uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint32_t phase = tickMs % 1000u;
    uint32_t triangle = (phase < 500u) ? phase : (1000u - phase);
    return (uint8_t) (20u + (triangle * 80u) / 500u);
}

void core4DiagnosticsDisplayInitEarly(void)
{
    g_timingValid = 0u;
    g_rgbReady = 0u;
    g_lastRedDuty = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    g_lastGreenDuty = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    g_lastBlueDuty = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    memset(g_homeSlotValid, 0, sizeof(g_homeSlotValid));
    memset(g_menuLineValid, 0, sizeof(g_menuLineValid));
    memset(g_thresholdSlotValid, 0, sizeof(g_thresholdSlotValid));
    g_displaySurface = CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_UNKNOWN;
    g_lastMenuState = CORE4_MENU_WAIT_LINK;
    g_lastMenuRevision = 0u;
    g_homeFrameColor = 0xFFFFu;
    g_lastRgbMode = 0xFFu;
    g_modeFlashStartMs = 0u;

    ips114_set_dir(IPS114_PORTAIT);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_init();
}

void core4DiagnosticsRuntimeInit(void)
{
    uint32_t before;

    g_timingValid = 0u;
    if ((SystemCoreClock != 0u) && ((DWT->CTRL & DWT_CTRL_NOCYCCNT_Msk) == 0u))
    {
        CoreDebug->DEMCR |= CoreDebug_DEMCR_TRCENA_Msk;
        DWT->CYCCNT = 0u;
        DWT->CTRL |= DWT_CTRL_CYCCNTENA_Msk;
        __DSB();
        __ISB();

        before = DWT->CYCCNT;
        __NOP();
        __NOP();
        __NOP();
        __NOP();
        if (((DWT->CTRL & DWT_CTRL_CYCCNTENA_Msk) != 0u) && (DWT->CYCCNT != before))
        {
            g_timingValid = 1u;
        }
    }

    pwm_init(CORE4_RGB_LED_R_PWM, CORE4_RGB_PWM_FREQUENCY_HZ, PWM_DUTY_MAX);
    pwm_init(CORE4_RGB_LED_G_PWM, CORE4_RGB_PWM_FREQUENCY_HZ, PWM_DUTY_MAX);
    pwm_init(CORE4_RGB_LED_B_PWM, CORE4_RGB_PWM_FREQUENCY_HZ, PWM_DUTY_MAX);
    g_rgbReady = 1u;
}

uint8_t core4DiagnosticsTimingValid(void)
{
    return g_timingValid;
}

uint32_t core4DiagnosticsCycleNow(void)
{
    return (g_timingValid != 0u) ? DWT->CYCCNT : 0u;
}

uint32_t core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(uint32_t cycles)
{
    uint64_t scaled;

    if ((g_timingValid == 0u) || (SystemCoreClock == 0u))
    {
        return CORE4_TIMING_INVALID_US;
    }

    scaled = (uint64_t) cycles * 1000000u;
    return (uint32_t) (scaled / SystemCoreClock);
}

void core4DiagnosticsUpdateRgb(const core4RuntimeStatus *status, uint32_t tickMs)
{
    uint8_t blinkOn;

    if (status == NULL)
    {
        core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(0u, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }

    switch (status->state)
    {
        case CORE4_RUNTIME_BOOT:
            blinkOn = (uint8_t) (((tickMs / CORE4_RGB_SLOW_HALF_PERIOD_MS) & 1u) == 0u);
            core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(blinkOn, blinkOn, blinkOn);
            break;
        case CORE4_RUNTIME_CAMERA_STARTING:
            blinkOn = (uint8_t) (((tickMs / CORE4_RGB_SLOW_HALF_PERIOD_MS) & 1u) == 0u);
            core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(0u, 0u, blinkOn);
            break;
        case CORE4_RUNTIME_RUNNING:
            if (g_lastRgbMode != status->cameraControlState)
            {
                g_lastRgbMode = status->cameraControlState;
                g_modeFlashStartMs = tickMs;
            }
            if ((status->lastCameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN) &&
                (status->core1LinkReady == 0u))
            {
                blinkOn = (uint8_t) (((tickMs / CORE4_RGB_FAST_HALF_PERIOD_MS) & 1u) == 0u);
                core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(blinkOn, blinkOn, 0u);
            }
            else if (((status->controlFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_BARRIER_REQUIRED) != 0u) ||
                (status->primaryReason == OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_CAMERA))
            {
                blinkOn = (uint8_t) (((tickMs / CORE4_RGB_FAST_HALF_PERIOD_MS) & 1u) == 0u);
                core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(blinkOn, blinkOn, 0u);
            }
            else if ((status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN) ||
                (status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_LINK_WAIT) ||
                (status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE))
            {
                core4DiagnosticsSetRgbLevel(1u, 1u, 0u,
                    core4DiagnosticsBreatheLevel(tickMs));
            }
            else if (status->initFailedMask != 0u)
            {
                uint32_t phase = tickMs % 2000u;
                blinkOn = (uint8_t) ((phase < 100u) ||
                    ((phase >= 250u) && (phase < 350u)));
                core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(blinkOn, 0u, 0u);
            }
            else if ((uint32_t) (tickMs - g_modeFlashStartMs) < 500u)
            {
                uint32_t phase = tickMs - g_modeFlashStartMs;
                blinkOn = (uint8_t) ((phase < 100u) ||
                    ((phase >= 250u) && (phase < 350u)));
                if (status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN)
                    core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(0u, blinkOn, blinkOn);
                else core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(blinkOn, blinkOn, 0u);
            }
            else if (status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_SEARCH)
            {
                core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(1u, 0u, 1u);
            }
            else if (status->activeSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)
            {
                core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(0u, 0u, 1u);
            }
            else if (status->activeSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1)
            {
                core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(0u, 1u, 0u);
            }
            else
            {
                if (status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN)
                    core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(0u, 1u, 1u);
                else core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(1u, 1u, 0u);
            }
            break;
        case CORE4_RUNTIME_CAMERA_FAULT:
        default:
            blinkOn = (uint8_t) (((tickMs / CORE4_RGB_FAST_HALF_PERIOD_MS) & 1u) == 0u);
            core4DiagnosticsSetRgb(blinkOn, 0u, 0u);
            break;
    }
}

uint32_t core4DiagnosticsRenderInitFaultSummary(uint8_t failedMask,
    uint8_t unverifiedMask,
    uint8_t secondsLeft)
{
    static const char *const names[3] = {"FLASH", "CAMERA", "PIPELINE"};
    uint32_t startCycles = core4DiagnosticsCycleNow();
    uint8_t row = 0u;
    uint8_t i;
    if (g_displaySurface != CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_INIT_FAULT)
    {
        uint16_t titleColor = (failedMask != 0u) ? RGB565_RED : RGB565_YELLOW;
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
        ips114_clear();
        drawMenuFrame(titleColor);
        fillSolidRect(1u, 1u, 238u, 15u, titleColor);
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_6X8_FONT);
        ips114_set_color(RGB565_BLACK, titleColor);
        ips114_show_string(78u, 4u,
            (failedMask != 0u) ? "HW INIT FAIL" : "HW INIT CHECK");
        ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
        for (i = 0u; i < 3u; i++)
        {
            uint8_t bit = (uint8_t) (1u << i);
            if ((failedMask & bit) != 0u)
            {
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK);
                ips114_show_string(16u, (uint16_t) (34u + row * 16u), names[i]);
                ips114_show_string(136u, (uint16_t) (34u + row * 16u), "FAIL ");
                row++;
            }
        }
        if ((unverifiedMask & CORE4_INIT_CHECK_DWT) != 0u)
        {
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(16u, (uint16_t) (34u + row * 16u), "DWT TIMER");
            ips114_show_string(136u, (uint16_t) (34u + row * 16u), "CHECK");
        }
        g_displaySurface = CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_INIT_FAULT;
    }
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
    ips114_show_string(16u, 114u, "CONTINUE 0s");
    ips114_show_uint(88u, 114u, secondsLeft, 1u);
    return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
}

static uint16_t previewMapX(uint16_t imageX)
{
    return (uint16_t) (CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_X +
        ((uint32_t) imageX * (CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_WIDTH - 1u)) /
        (CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH - 1u));
}

static uint16_t previewMapY(uint16_t imageY)
{
    return (uint16_t) (CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_Y +
        ((uint32_t) imageY * (CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_HEIGHT - 1u)) /
        (CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT - 1u));
}

static void previewCross(uint16_t imageX, uint16_t imageY,
    uint16_t radius, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t x = previewMapX(imageX);
    uint16_t y = previewMapY(imageY);
    uint16_t minX = CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_X;
    uint16_t maxX = (uint16_t) (minX + CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_WIDTH - 1u);
    uint16_t minY = CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_Y;
    uint16_t maxY = (uint16_t) (minY + CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_HEIGHT - 1u);
    uint16_t x0 = (x > minX + radius) ? (uint16_t) (x - radius) : minX;
    uint16_t x1 = (x + radius < maxX) ? (uint16_t) (x + radius) : maxX;
    uint16_t y0 = (y > minY + radius) ? (uint16_t) (y - radius) : minY;
    uint16_t y1 = (y + radius < maxY) ? (uint16_t) (y + radius) : maxY;
    fillSolidRect(x0, y, (uint16_t) (x1 - x0 + 1u), 1u, color);
    fillSolidRect(x, y0, 1u, (uint16_t) (y1 - y0 + 1u), color);
}

static void previewCircle(uint16_t imageX, uint16_t imageY,
    uint16_t imageRadius, uint16_t color)
{
    int16_t cx = (int16_t) previewMapX(imageX);
    int16_t cy = (int16_t) previewMapY(imageY);
    int16_t radius = (int16_t) (((uint32_t) imageRadius *
        CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_WIDTH) / CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH);
    int16_t x = radius;
    int16_t y = 0;
    int16_t error = 1 - radius;
    int16_t minX = (int16_t) CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_X;
    int16_t maxX = (int16_t) (CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_X +
        CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_WIDTH - 1u);
    int16_t minY = (int16_t) CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_Y;
    int16_t maxY = (int16_t) (CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_Y +
        CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_HEIGHT - 1u);
    if (radius <= 0) return;
    while (x >= y)
    {
        int16_t px[8] = {cx + x, cx + y, cx - y, cx - x,
            cx - x, cx - y, cx + y, cx + x};
        int16_t py[8] = {cy + y, cy + x, cy + x, cy + y,
            cy - y, cy - x, cy - x, cy - y};
        uint8_t i;
        for (i = 0u; i < 8u; i++)
        {
            if ((px[i] >= minX) && (px[i] <= maxX) &&
                (py[i] >= minY) && (py[i] <= maxY))
                ips114_draw_point((uint16_t) px[i], (uint16_t) py[i], color);
        }
        y++;
        if (error < 0) error = (int16_t) (error + 2 * y + 1);
        else
        {
            x--;
            error = (int16_t) (error + 2 * (y - x) + 1);
        }
    }
}

static void previewHeading(uint16_t imageX, uint16_t imageY,
    int16_t headingQ8, uint16_t color)
{
    float heading = (float) headingQ8 / 256.0f;
    int16_t x0 = (int16_t) previewMapX(imageX);
    int16_t y0 = (int16_t) previewMapY(imageY);
    int16_t x1 = (int16_t) ((float) x0 + cosf(heading) * 9.0f);
    int16_t y1 = (int16_t) ((float) y0 + sinf(heading) * 9.0f);
    int16_t minX = (int16_t) CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_X;
    int16_t maxX = (int16_t) (CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_X +
        CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_WIDTH - 1u);
    int16_t minY = (int16_t) CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_Y;
    int16_t maxY = (int16_t) (CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_Y +
        CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_HEIGHT - 1u);
    if (x1 < minX) x1 = minX; else if (x1 > maxX) x1 = maxX;
    if (y1 < minY) y1 = minY; else if (y1 > maxY) y1 = maxY;
    ips114_draw_line((uint16_t) x0, (uint16_t) y0,
        (uint16_t) x1, (uint16_t) y1, color);
}

static char core4DiagnosticsControlClass(uint8_t controlClass)
{
    switch (controlClass)
    {
        case OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_CORE1_TRACK: return 'L';
        case OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_OBSERVER_TRACK: return 'R';
        case OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_SEARCH: return 'S';
        default: return 'N';
    }
}

static void previewTrackBorder(const beaconTrackBorderMarginsStruct *margin, uint16_t color)
{
    uint16_t left;
    uint16_t right;
    uint16_t top;
    uint16_t bottom;

    if (margin == NULL) return;
    left = previewMapX(margin->left);
    right = previewMapX((uint16_t) (CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH - 1u - margin->right));
    top = previewMapY(margin->top);
    bottom = previewMapY((uint16_t) (CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT - 1u - margin->bottom));
    if (margin->top != 0u) ips114_draw_line(left, top, right, top, color);
    if (margin->bottom != 0u) ips114_draw_line(left, bottom, right, bottom, color);
    if (margin->left != 0u) ips114_draw_line(left, top, left, bottom, color);
    if (margin->right != 0u) ips114_draw_line(right, top, right, bottom, color);
}

static void previewEdgePredictionBand(const beaconTrackEdgeBandsStruct *bands)
{
    uint16_t left = previewMapX(0u);
    uint16_t right = previewMapX(CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH - 1u);
    uint16_t top = previewMapY(0u);
    uint16_t bottom = previewMapY(CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT - 1u);
    if (bands == NULL) return;
    if (bands->left != 0u)
        ips114_draw_line(previewMapX(bands->left), top, previewMapX(bands->left), bottom,
            RGB565_MAGENTA);
    if (bands->right != 0u)
        ips114_draw_line(previewMapX(CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH - bands->right), top,
            previewMapX(CORE4_CAMERA_WIDTH - bands->right), bottom, RGB565_MAGENTA);
    if (bands->top != 0u)
        ips114_draw_line(left, previewMapY(bands->top), right, previewMapY(bands->top),
            RGB565_MAGENTA);
    if (bands->bottom != 0u)
        ips114_draw_line(left, previewMapY(CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT - bands->bottom), right,
            previewMapY(CORE4_CAMERA_HEIGHT - bands->bottom), RGB565_MAGENTA);
}

uint32_t core4DiagnosticsRenderPreview(const core4CameraSnapshot *snapshot,
    const core4RuntimeStatus *status,
    const core4VisionObservation *observation)
{
    uint32_t startCycles;
    uint16_t frameColor;

    if ((snapshot == NULL) || (snapshot->data == NULL) || (status == NULL))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    startCycles = core4DiagnosticsCycleNow();
    frameColor = core4DiagnosticsOwnerFrameColor(status);
    enterHomeSurface(frameColor);
    ips114_show_gray_image(CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_X,
        CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_Y,
        snapshot->data,
        snapshot->width,
        snapshot->height,
        CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_WIDTH,
        CORE4_DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_HEIGHT,
        0u);
    if ((observation != NULL) && (observation->valid != 0u))
    {
        previewTrackBorder(&observation->border.exit, RGB565_YELLOW);
        previewTrackBorder(&observation->border.enter, RGB565_CYAN);
        previewEdgePredictionBand(&observation->edgeBands);
    }
    if ((observation != NULL) && (observation->valid != 0u))
    {
        uint16_t i;
        for (i = 0u; i < observation->retainedCount; i++)
        {
            const core4VisionTrack *track = &observation->tracks[i];
            if ((track->flags & BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u)
                continue;
            uint8_t isSelected = (uint8_t) ((status->viewOverlayValid != 0u) &&
                (status->activeSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4) &&
                ((status->viewOverlay.flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_SELECTED) != 0u) &&
                (status->viewOverlay.sourceFrameSeq == observation->trackerFrameSeq) &&
                (status->viewOverlay.selectedTrackId == track->trackId));
            if (isSelected == 0u)
            {
                uint16_t x = (track->fresh != 0u) ? track->centerX : track->predX;
                uint16_t y = (track->fresh != 0u) ? track->centerY : track->predY;
                previewCross(x, y, 3u, RGB565_YELLOW);
            }
        }
    }
    if (status->viewOverlayValid != 0u)
    {
        const observerLinkViewOverlay *overlay = &status->viewOverlay;
        if ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_CENTER) != 0u)
            previewCross(overlay->activeCenterX, overlay->activeCenterY, 4u, RGB565_CYAN);
        if ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_DEADZONE) != 0u)
        {
            previewCircle(overlay->activeCenterX, overlay->activeCenterY,
                overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius, RGB565_YELLOW);
            previewCircle(overlay->activeCenterX, overlay->activeCenterY,
                overlay->deadzoneExitRadius, RGB565_MAGENTA);
        }
        if ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_SELECTED) != 0u)
            previewCross(overlay->selectedX, overlay->selectedY, 5u,
                (overlay->selectedFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_COAST) ?
                    RGB565_MAGENTA : RGB565_RED);
        if ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_POSE) != 0u)
        {
            uint16_t poseColor = (overlay->poseFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD) ?
                RGB565_BLUE : RGB565_GREEN;
            previewCross(overlay->poseX, overlay->poseY, 5u, poseColor);
            if ((overlay->poseFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HEADING_VALID) != 0u)
            {
                previewHeading(overlay->poseX, overlay->poseY,
                    overlay->poseHeadingQ8, poseColor);
            }
        }
    }
    return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
}

uint32_t core4DiagnosticsRenderHud(const core4RuntimeStatus *status)
{
    uint32_t startCycles;
    const char *controlName;
    const char *sourceName;
    char errX[12];
    char errY[12];
    uint16_t frameColor;
    uint16_t titleColor;
    uint16_t coastCount;

    if (status == NULL)
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    startCycles = core4DiagnosticsCycleNow();
    controlName = core4DiagnosticsControlName(status->cameraControlState);
    sourceName = core4DiagnosticsSourceName(status);
    core4DiagnosticsFormatQ4(status->errXQ4, errX);
    core4DiagnosticsFormatQ4(status->errYQ4, errY);
    frameColor = core4DiagnosticsOwnerFrameColor(status);
    enterHomeSurface(frameColor);
    titleColor = (status->state == CORE4_RUNTIME_CAMERA_FAULT) ? RGB565_RED :
        (((status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_HOME) ||
          (status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_RUNNING)) &&
         (status->primaryReason == OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_NONE)) ?
            RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_YELLOW;
    if (g_homeTitleColor != titleColor)
    {
        fillMenuRow(0u, titleColor);
        g_homeSlotValid[0] = 0u;
        g_homeTitleColor = titleColor;
        g_homeFrameColor = 0xFFFFu;
        drawHomeFrame(frameColor);
    }
    coastCount = (status->confirmedBeacons >= status->freshBeacons) ?
        (uint16_t) (status->confirmedBeacons - status->freshBeacons) : 0u;
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(0u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 30u, 4u, 30u,
        RGB565_BLACK, titleColor, "CORE4 %s", controlName);
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(1u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 17u, 17u,
        RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK, "CAM:%s FPS:%lu",
        core4DiagnosticsStateShortName(status->state), (unsigned long) status->appFps);
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(2u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 25u, 17u,
        (status->frameValid != 0u) ? RGB565_WHITE : RGB565_RED, RGB565_BLACK,
        "AGE:%lums", (unsigned long) status->frameAgeMs);
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(3u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 33u, 17u,
        RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK, "L:%u F:%u C:%u",
        status->confirmedBeacons, status->freshBeacons,
        coastCount);
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(4u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 41u, 17u,
        (status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_SAFE) ?
            RGB565_YELLOW : RGB565_CYAN, RGB565_BLACK,
        "VIS:%s", controlName);
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(5u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 49u, 17u,
        (status->activeSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4) ? RGB565_BLUE :
            ((status->activeSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1) ? RGB565_GREEN :
             RGB565_MAGENTA), RGB565_BLACK,
        "SRC:%s", sourceName);
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(6u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 57u, 17u,
        RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK, "NAV:%s CLS:%c",
        core4DiagnosticsNavName(status->navState),
        core4DiagnosticsControlClass(status->controlClass));
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(7u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 65u, 17u,
        (status->controlFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_BARRIER_REQUIRED) ?
            RGB565_YELLOW : RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK,
        "BAR:%c DSP:%c",
        (status->controlFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_BARRIER_REQUIRED) ? 'Y' : 'N',
        (status->controlFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_DISPATCH_ENABLED) ? 'Y' : 'N');
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(8u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 73u, 17u,
        RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK, "EX:%s", errX);
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(9u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 81u, 17u,
        RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK, "EY:%s", errY);
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(10u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 135u, 89u, 17u,
        (status->core1LinkReady != 0u) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_YELLOW,
        RGB565_BLACK, "1:%s 0:%s 2:%s",
        status->core1LinkOnline ? "ON" : "LOST",
        status->core0LinkUp ? "OK" : "LOST", status->core2LinkUp ? "OK" : "LOST");
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(12u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 2u, 106u, 39u,
        (status->kvmInputOwner == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE) ? RGB565_YELLOW :
            RGB565_WHITE, RGB565_BLACK,
        "KEY:%s  C1:%s  CFG:%s",
        (status->kvmInputOwner == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) ? "C4" :
            ((status->kvmInputOwner == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) ? "C1" :
             ((status->kvmInputOwner == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ? "C0" : "NONE")),
        status->core1LinkReady ? "OK" : "WAIT",
        status->cameraControlLocked ? "LOCK" : "OPEN");
    core4DiagnosticsShowHomeSlot(13u, IPS114_6X8_FONT, 2u, 121u, 39u,
        (status->primaryReason == OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_NONE) ? RGB565_GREEN :
            RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK,
        "STATE:%s  %s",
        (status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN) ? "REJOIN" :
            ((status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE) ?
             "STANDALONE" : "HOME"),
        core4DiagnosticsReasonName(status->primaryReason));

    return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
}

uint32_t core4DiagnosticsRenderMenu(const core4MenuView *view)
{
    uint32_t startCycles;
    uint8_t row;
    uint16_t frameColor;

    if (view == NULL)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    startCycles = core4DiagnosticsCycleNow();
    frameColor = core4DiagnosticsFrameColor(view->linkReady,
        view->kvmInputOwner);

    if (view->state == CORE4_MENU_WAIT_LINK)
    {
        if (g_displaySurface != CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_WAIT)
        {
            ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
            ips114_clear();
            drawMenuFrame(RGB565_YELLOW);
            g_displaySurface = CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_WAIT;
            g_lastMenuRevision = UINT32_MAX;
        }
        if (g_lastMenuRevision != view->screenRevision)
        {
            const char *lastMode = core4DiagnosticsControlName(
                view->lastCameraControlState);

            ips114_set_color(RGB565_YELLOW, RGB565_BLACK);
            ips114_show_string(56u, 18u, "WAIT CORE1 LINK        ");
            ips114_show_string(40u, 50u, "LINK: NOT READY        ");
            ips114_show_string(40u, 66u, "KVM : DISABLED         ");
            ips114_show_string(40u, 82u, "LAST CTRL:             ");
            ips114_show_string(136u, 82u, "        ");
            ips114_show_string(136u, 82u, lastMode);
            ips114_show_string(40u, 106u, "RECONNECT -> HOME      ");
            g_lastMenuRevision = view->screenRevision;
        }
        return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
    }

    if (view->lastAction != CORE4_MENU_ACTION_NONE)
    {
        if ((g_displaySurface != CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_FEEDBACK) ||
            (g_lastMenuRevision != view->screenRevision))
        {
            uint16_t color = (view->lastAction ==
                CORE4_MENU_ACTION_RUNTIME_LOAD) ? RGB565_RED :
                ((view->lastActionOk != 0u) ? RGB565_GREEN : RGB565_RED);
            char slotText[16];

            ips114_full(color);
            if (view->lastAction == CORE4_MENU_ACTION_LIBRARY_SAVE ||
                view->lastAction == CORE4_MENU_ACTION_RUNTIME_LOAD)
            {
                ips114_set_color((color == RGB565_GREEN) ? RGB565_BLACK :
                    RGB565_WHITE, color);
                ips114_show_string(80u, 42u,
                    (view->lastAction == CORE4_MENU_ACTION_LIBRARY_SAVE) ?
                        "SAVE OK" : "LOAD OK");
                (void) snprintf(slotText, sizeof(slotText), "SLOT %u",
                    (unsigned int) view->lastActionSlot);
                ips114_show_string(88u, 66u, slotText);
                ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
            }
            g_displaySurface = CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_FEEDBACK;
            g_lastMenuRevision = view->screenRevision;
        }
        return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
    }
    if (view->state == CORE4_MENU_HOME)
    {
        enterHomeSurface(frameColor);
        g_lastMenuRevision = view->screenRevision;
        return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
    }
    if ((g_displaySurface == CORE4_DISPLAY_SURFACE_MENU) &&
        (g_lastMenuState == view->state) &&
        (g_lastMenuRevision == view->screenRevision))
    {
        return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
    }

    enterMenuSurface(view->state);
    if (view->state == CORE4_MENU_PAGE_LIST)
    {
        uint8_t pageCount = core4MenuGetPageCount();

        drawMenuScrollbar(pageCount, view->pageScrollTop);
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuTitle("PAGES");
        for (row = 0u; row < CORE4_MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS; row++)
        {
            uint8_t page = (uint8_t) (view->pageScrollTop + row);

            if (page < pageCount)
            {
                core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow((uint8_t) (row + 1u),
                    (page == (uint8_t) view->pageIndex)
                        ? CORE4_MENU_ROW_SELECTED
                        : CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
                    core4MenuGetPageName(page),
                    "");
            }
            else
            {
                core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow((uint8_t) (row + 1u),
                    CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
                    "",
                    "");
            }
        }
    }
    else if ((view->state == CORE4_MENU_OPTION_LIST) &&
        (view->pageIndex == 0))
    {
        char value[CORE4_MENU_VALUE_CHARS + 1u];

        drawMenuScrollbar(1u, 0u);
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuTitle("PARAM SLOTS");
        (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "SLOT %u",
            (unsigned int) (view->selectedParamSlot + 1u));
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow(1u, CORE4_MENU_ROW_SELECTED,
            "SELECT", value);
        switch (view->paramSlotUiState)
        {
            case PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING: (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "CHECKING"); break;
            case PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL: (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "FULL"); break;
            case PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_EMPTY: (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "EMPTY"); break;
            case PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_PARTIAL: (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "PARTIAL"); break;
            case PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_INVALID: (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "INVALID"); break;
            case PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE: (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "UNAVAILABLE"); break;
            default: (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "UNKNOWN"); break;
        }
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow(2u, CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
            "SLOT", value);
        if (view->paramGlobalUiState == CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED)
        {
            (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "QUEUED");
        }
        else if (view->paramGlobalUiState == CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS)
        {
            if (view->paramGlobalTarget <= 4u)
                (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value),
                    (view->paramGlobalExternal != 0u) ?
                        "BUSY C%u PH%u" : "RUN C%u PH%u",
                    (unsigned int) view->paramGlobalTarget,
                    (unsigned int) view->paramGlobalPhase);
            else
                (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value),
                    (view->paramGlobalExternal != 0u) ?
                        "BUSY PH%u" : "RUN PH%u",
                    (unsigned int) view->paramGlobalPhase);
        }
        else if (view->paramGlobalUiState == CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS)
        {
            (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "SUCCESS");
        }
        else if (view->paramGlobalUiState == CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED)
        {
            (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "FAIL C%u E%u",
                (unsigned int) view->paramGlobalTarget,
                (unsigned int) view->paramGlobalError);
        }
        else
        {
            (void) snprintf(value, sizeof(value), "IDLE");
        }
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow(3u, CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
            "TASK", value);
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow(4u, CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
            "K2/K3", "SELECT");
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow(5u, CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
            "K1 LONG", "SAVE");
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow(6u, CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
            "K4", "LOAD");
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow(7u, CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
            "K5", "BACK");
    }
    else
    {
        uint8_t page = (uint8_t) view->pageIndex;
        uint8_t optionCount = core4MenuGetOptionCount(page);

        drawMenuScrollbar(optionCount, view->optionScrollTop);
        core4DiagnosticsShowMenuTitle(core4MenuGetPageName(page));
        for (row = 0u; row < CORE4_MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS; row++)
        {
            uint8_t option = (uint8_t) (view->optionScrollTop + row);

            if (option < optionCount)
            {
                char value[CORE4_MENU_VALUE_CHARS + 1u];
                core4MenuRowStyle style = CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL;

                core4MenuFormatValue(core4MenuGetOptionValue(page, option), value);
                if (option == (uint8_t) view->optionIndex)
                {
                    style = (view->state == CORE4_MENU_EDIT)
                                ? CORE4_MENU_ROW_EDIT
                                : CORE4_MENU_ROW_SELECTED;
                }
                core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow((uint8_t) (row + 1u),
                    style,
                    core4MenuGetOptionName(page, option),
                    value);
            }
            else
            {
                core4DiagnosticsShowMenuRow((uint8_t) (row + 1u),
                    CORE4_MENU_ROW_NORMAL,
                    "",
                    "");
            }
        }
    }
    if (frameColor != g_menuFrameColor)
    {
        drawMenuFrame(frameColor);
        g_menuFrameColor = frameColor;
    }
    ips114_set_color(RGB565_GREEN, RGB565_BLACK);
    g_lastMenuRevision = view->screenRevision;
    return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
}

static void core4DiagnosticsDrawThresholdSlot(core4MenuThresholdItem item,
    uint16_t value, uint8_t selected)
{
    uint16_t slotX;
    uint16_t slotWidth;
    uint16_t nameX;
    uint16_t valueX;
    uint8_t digits;
    const char *name;
    char valueText[5];
    uint16_t background;
    uint16_t nameForeground;
    uint16_t valueForeground;

    if ((uint8_t) item >= CORE4_THRESHOLD_SLOT_COUNT) return;
    if ((g_thresholdSlotValid[item] != 0u) &&
        (g_thresholdSlotValue[item] == value) &&
        (g_thresholdSlotSelected[item] == selected)) return;

    if (item == CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_LOW)
    {
        slotX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_SLOT_LOW_X;
        slotWidth = CORE4_THRESHOLD_SLOT_LOW_WIDTH;
        nameX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_NAME_LOW_X;
        valueX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_VALUE_LOW_X;
        digits = 3u;
        name = "Lo:";
    }
    else if (item == CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_HIGH)
    {
        slotX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_SLOT_HIGH_X;
        slotWidth = CORE4_THRESHOLD_SLOT_HIGH_WIDTH;
        nameX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_NAME_HIGH_X;
        valueX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_VALUE_HIGH_X;
        digits = 3u;
        name = "Hi:";
    }
    else
    {
        slotX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_SLOT_EXPOSURE_X;
        slotWidth = CORE4_THRESHOLD_SLOT_EXPOSURE_WIDTH;
        nameX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_NAME_EXPOSURE_X;
        valueX = CORE4_THRESHOLD_VALUE_EXPOSURE_X;
        digits = 4u;
        name = "Ex:";
    }

    background = selected ? CORE4_MENU_SEL_BG : RGB565_BLACK;
    nameForeground = selected ? CORE4_MENU_SEL_NAME_FG : CORE4_MENU_NORM_NAME_FG;
    valueForeground = selected ? CORE4_MENU_SEL_VAL_FG : CORE4_MENU_NORM_VAL_FG;
    if (digits == 3u)
        (void) snprintf(valueText, sizeof(valueText), "%3u", (unsigned int) value);
    else
        (void) snprintf(valueText, sizeof(valueText), "%4u", (unsigned int) value);

    fillSolidRect(slotX, CORE4_THRESHOLD_TEXT_Y, slotWidth, 16u, background);
    ips114_set_font(IPS114_8X16_FONT);
    ips114_set_color(nameForeground, background);
    ips114_show_string(nameX, CORE4_THRESHOLD_TEXT_Y, name);
    ips114_set_color(valueForeground, background);
    ips114_show_string(valueX, CORE4_THRESHOLD_TEXT_Y, valueText);
    g_thresholdSlotValue[item] = value;
    g_thresholdSlotSelected[item] = selected;
    g_thresholdSlotValid[item] = 1u;
}

uint32_t core4DiagnosticsRenderThresholdEditor(const core4MenuView *view,
    const core4CameraSnapshot *snapshot,
    const uint8_t *detectPreview,
    uint8_t updateImages)
{
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params;
    uint32_t startCycles;
    uint16_t low;
    uint16_t high;
    uint16_t frameColor;

    if ((view == NULL) || (view->state != CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    startCycles = core4DiagnosticsCycleNow();
    frameColor = core4DiagnosticsFrameColor(view->linkReady,
        view->kvmInputOwner);
    enterMenuSurface(CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_EDIT);
    params = core4VisionParamsGetActive();
    if (view->detectMode == 1u)
    {
        low = params->legacyCannyLow;
        high = params->legacyCannyHigh;
        if (g_thresholdMode != view->detectMode)
            core4DiagnosticsShowMenuTitle("CANNY EDIT");
    }
    else
    {
        low = params->binaryLow;
        high = params->binaryHigh;
        if (g_thresholdMode != view->detectMode)
            core4DiagnosticsShowMenuTitle("BINARY EDIT");
    }
    if ((updateImages != 0u) && (snapshot != NULL) && (snapshot->data != NULL))
    {
        if ((g_thresholdOriginalValid == 0u) ||
            (snapshot->appFrameSeq != g_thresholdOriginalFrameSeq))
        {
            ips114_show_gray_image(CORE4_THRESHOLD_LEFT_X,
                CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_Y,
                snapshot->data,
                snapshot->width,
                snapshot->height,
                CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_W,
                CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_H,
                0u);
            g_thresholdOriginalFrameSeq = snapshot->appFrameSeq;
            g_thresholdOriginalValid = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if ((updateImages != 0u) && (g_thresholdOriginalValid != 0u))
    {
        fillSolidRect(CORE4_THRESHOLD_LEFT_X, CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_Y,
            CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_W, CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_H, RGB565_BLACK);
        g_thresholdOriginalFrameSeq = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        g_thresholdOriginalValid = 0u;
    }
    if ((updateImages != 0u) && (detectPreview != NULL) && (snapshot != NULL))
    {
        if ((g_thresholdPreviewValid == 0u) ||
            (snapshot->appFrameSeq != g_thresholdPreviewFrameSeq))
        {
            ips114_show_gray_image(CORE4_THRESHOLD_RIGHT_X,
                CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_Y,
                detectPreview,
                188u,
                120u,
                CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_W,
                CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_H,
                0u);
            g_thresholdPreviewFrameSeq = snapshot->appFrameSeq;
            g_thresholdPreviewValid = 1u;
        }
    }
    else if ((updateImages != 0u) && (g_thresholdPreviewValid != 0u))
    {
        fillSolidRect(CORE4_THRESHOLD_RIGHT_X, CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_Y,
            CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_W, CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_H, RGB565_BLACK);
        g_thresholdPreviewFrameSeq = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
        g_thresholdPreviewValid = 0u;
    }
    if (frameColor != g_thresholdFrameColor)
    {
        fillSolidRect(120u, CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_Y, 1u,
            (uint16_t) (CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_H + 1u), frameColor);
        fillSolidRect(1u,
            (uint16_t) (CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_Y + CORE4_THRESHOLD_IMAGE_H + 2u),
            238u, 1u, frameColor);
        drawMenuFrame(frameColor);
        g_thresholdFrameColor = frameColor;
    }
    core4DiagnosticsDrawThresholdSlot(CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_LOW,
        low, (uint8_t) (view->thresholdItem == CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_LOW));
    core4DiagnosticsDrawThresholdSlot(CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_HIGH,
        high, (uint8_t) (view->thresholdItem == CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_HIGH));
    core4DiagnosticsDrawThresholdSlot(CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_EXPOSURE,
        params->exposure,
        (uint8_t) (view->thresholdItem == CORE4_MENU_THRESHOLD_EXPOSURE));
    g_thresholdMode = view->detectMode;
    g_lastMenuRevision = view->screenRevision;
    return core4DiagnosticsCyclesToUs(core4DiagnosticsCycleNow() - startCycles);
}

#include "core4Menu.h"

#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "configCore4Runtime.h"
#include "configCore4VisionParams.h"
#include "core4VisionParams.h"
#include "core4VisionParamsPersistence.h"

#include "observerLinkProtocol.h"
#include "paramSyncOwnerService.h"

#define CORE4_MENU_OPTION_COUNT (5u)
#define CORE4_MENU_FEEDBACK_MS  (300u)

typedef struct
{
    float *value;
} core4MenuOption;

static float g_workValues[CORE4_MENU_OPTION_COUNT];
static core4MenuOption g_options[CORE4_MENU_OPTION_COUNT] = {
    {&g_workValues[0]},
    {&g_workValues[1]},
    {&g_workValues[2]},
    {&g_workValues[3]},
    {&g_workValues[4]},

static core4MenuView g_view;

static void markDirty(void)
{
    if (g_view.screenRevision < UINT32_MAX)
    {
        g_view.screenRevision++;
    }
}

static uint32_t floatToU32(float value)
{
    if (value <= 0.0f)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    if (value >= (float) UINT32_MAX)
    {
        return UINT32_MAX;
    }
    return (uint32_t) (value + 0.5f);
}

static void syncFromActive(void)
{
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params = core4VisionParamsGetActive();

    g_workValues[0] = (float) params->exposure;
    g_workValues[1] = (float) params->binaryLow;
    g_workValues[2] = (float) params->binaryHigh;
    g_workValues[3] = (float) params->legacyCannyLow;
    g_workValues[4] = (float) params->legacyCannyHigh;
    g_workValuesRevision = core4VisionParamsGetRevision();
}

static uint32_t g_paramGlobalRequestSequence;
static paramSyncGlobalState g_paramGlobalState;
static uint8_t g_paramGlobalStateValid;
static paramSyncGlobalRequest g_paramGlobalPendingRequest;
static uint8_t g_paramGlobalRequestPending;
static uint8_t g_paramSlotInspectPending;
static uint8_t g_externalParamTransactionActive;
static uint32_t g_lastTerminalCoordinatorBoot;
static uint32_t g_lastTerminalRequestBoot;
static uint32_t g_lastTerminalRequestSequence;

static void scheduleParamSlotInspect(void)
{
    g_paramSlotInspectPending = 1u;
    if (g_view.paramSlotUiState != PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING)
    {
        g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
        markDirty();
    }
}

static void setParamGlobalUi(core4MenuParamGlobalUiState uiState,
    uint8_t phase, uint8_t target, uint8_t error)
{
    if ((g_view.paramGlobalUiState != uiState) ||
        (g_view.paramGlobalPhase != phase) ||
        (g_view.paramGlobalTarget != target) ||
        (g_view.paramGlobalError != error))
    {
        g_view.paramGlobalUiState = uiState;
        g_view.paramGlobalPhase = phase;
        g_view.paramGlobalTarget = target;
        g_view.paramGlobalError = error;
        markDirty();
    }
}

static void setParamGlobalContext(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    if ((g_view.paramGlobalAction != action) ||
        (g_view.paramGlobalSlot != slot))
    {
        g_view.paramGlobalAction = action;
        g_view.paramGlobalSlot = slot;
        markDirty();
    }
}

static void setParamGlobalExternal(uint8_t external)
{
    if (g_view.paramGlobalExternal != external)
    {
        g_view.paramGlobalExternal = external;
        markDirty();
    }
}

static uint8_t observeNewTerminal(const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    if (((state->flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) == 0u) ||
        (state->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY))
        return 0u;
    if ((g_lastTerminalCoordinatorBoot == state->coordinatorBootGeneration) &&
        (g_lastTerminalRequestBoot == state->requestBootGeneration) &&
        (g_lastTerminalRequestSequence == state->requestSequence))
        return 0u;
    g_lastTerminalCoordinatorBoot = state->coordinatorBootGeneration;
    g_lastTerminalRequestBoot = state->requestBootGeneration;
    g_lastTerminalRequestSequence = state->requestSequence;
    return 1u;
}

static void invalidateGlobalParamRoute(void)
{
    g_paramGlobalStateValid = 0u;
    memset(&g_paramGlobalState, 0, sizeof(g_paramGlobalState));
    if (g_externalParamTransactionActive != 0u)
    {
        g_externalParamTransactionActive = 0u;
        setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
        setParamGlobalContext(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE, 0u);
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED, 4u,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
    }
    if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u)
    {
        if (g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action ==
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED, 4u,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
        g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
    }
}

static void pollGlobalParamState(void)
{
    paramSyncGlobalState state;
    uint8_t matchesPending;

    if (core4LinkCore4TakeParamGlobalState(&state) == 0u)
    {
        invalidateGlobalParamRoute();
        return;
    }
    g_paramGlobalState = state;
    g_paramGlobalStateValid = 1u;
    matchesPending = (uint8_t) ((g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u) &&
        (paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(&state,
            &g_paramGlobalPendingRequest) != 0u));
    if (observeNewTerminal(&state) != 0u) scheduleParamSlotInspect();
    if (matchesPending == 0u)
    {
        if ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u)
        {
            g_externalParamTransactionActive = 1u;
            setParamGlobalExternal(1u);
            setParamGlobalContext(state.action, state.slot);
            setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS, state.phase,
                state.target, state.error);
        }
        else if ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL) != 0u)
        {
            g_externalParamTransactionActive = 0u;
            setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
            setParamGlobalContext(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE, 0u);
            setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_IDLE, state.phase,
                state.target, state.error);
        }
        else if ((g_externalParamTransactionActive != 0u) &&
                 (paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&state) != 0u))
        {
            g_externalParamTransactionActive = 0u;
            setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
            setParamGlobalContext(PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE, 0u);
            setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_IDLE, state.phase,
                state.target, state.error);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (state.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_SUCCEEDED)
    {
        setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
        g_view.paramGlobalAction = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action;
        g_view.paramGlobalSlot = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.slot;
        if (g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action ==
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        {
            g_view.paramSlotUiState =
                paramSyncGlobalClassifySlotSummary(state.transactionId);
        }
        else
        {
            g_view.lastAction = (g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action ==
                PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY) ?
                CORE4_MENU_ACTION_LIBRARY_SAVE : CORE4_MENU_ACTION_RUNTIME_LOAD;
            g_view.lastActionOk = 1u;
            g_view.lastActionSlot = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.slot;
            g_feedbackStartMs = g_tickMs;
            g_paramSlotInspectPending = 1u;
        }
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_SUCCESS, state.phase,
            0xFFu, PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE);
        g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if (state.phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED)
    {
        setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
        g_view.paramGlobalAction = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action;
        g_view.paramGlobalSlot = g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.slot;
        if (g_paramGlobalPendingRequest.action ==
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED, state.phase,
            state.target, state.error);
        g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if ((state.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY) != 0u)
    {
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_PROGRESS, state.phase,
            state.target, state.error);
    }
}

static uint8_t requestGlobalParamAction(uint8_t action, uint8_t slot)
{
    paramSyncGlobalRequest request;
    uint8_t error;
    if (g_paramGlobalRequestPending != 0u)
        error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY;
    else if (g_paramGlobalStateValid == 0u)
        error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE;
    else if (paramSyncGlobalStateReady(&g_paramGlobalState) == 0u)
    {
        if ((g_paramGlobalState.flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY) != 0u)
            error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY;
        else if (g_paramGlobalState.readyMask != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK)
            error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INCOMPLETE;
        else
            error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_BUSY;
    }
    else
        error = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE;
    if (error != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE)
    {
        if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED, 4u, error);
        return 0u;
    }
    g_paramGlobalRequestSequence++;
    if (g_paramGlobalRequestSequence == 0u) g_paramGlobalRequestSequence = 1u;
    request.producerBootGeneration = core4LinkCore4GetLocalBootGeneration();
    request.sequence = g_paramGlobalRequestSequence;
    request.origin = 4u;
    request.action = action;
    request.slot = slot;
    request.reserved = 0u;
    if (core4LinkCore4QueueParamGlobalRequest(&request) == 0u)
    {
        if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
            g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
        setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_FAILED,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED, 4u,
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE);
        return 0u;
    }
    g_paramGlobalPendingRequest = request;
    g_paramGlobalRequestPending = 1u;
    setParamGlobalExternal(0u);
    setParamGlobalUi(CORE4_MENU_PARAM_GLOBAL_QUEUED,
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_REQUESTED, 0xFFu,
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE);
    g_view.paramGlobalAction = action;
    g_view.paramGlobalSlot = slot;
    if (action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        g_view.paramSlotUiState = PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t isValidKvmTarget(uint8_t target)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((target == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) ||
        (target == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) ||
        (target == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) ||
        (target == OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4));
}

static void applyWorkValues(void)
{
    core4VisionParamsStruct candidate = *core4VisionParamsGetActive();

    candidate.exposure = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[0]);
    candidate.binaryLow = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[1]);
    candidate.binaryHigh = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[2]);
    candidate.legacyCannyLow = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[3]);
    candidate.legacyCannyHigh = (uint16_t) floatToU32(g_workValues[4]);
    core4VisionParamsCommit(&candidate);
    syncFromActive();
}
