static uint8_t controlStatusIsValid(const observerLinkControlStatus *status)
{
    uint8_t statusValid;
    uint8_t decisionValid;
    uint8_t barrier;
    uint8_t dispatch;
    uint8_t core0LinkUp;
    uint8_t core2LinkUp;
    uint8_t requiredVision;

    if ((status == NULL) || (status->detectMode > 1u) ||
        (status->protocolCompatible > 1u) || (status->algorithmsReady > 1u) ||
        (status->configCompatible > 1u) ||
        (status->cameraControlState > OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN) ||
        ((status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)) ||
        (status->controlClass > OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_SEARCH) ||
        ((status->navState != 0u) && (status->navState != 2u) &&
         (status->navState != 3u) && (status->navState != 4u)) ||
        (status->systemPhase > OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_RUNNING) ||
        ((status->systemFlags & 0x80u) != 0u) ||
        (status->primaryReason > OBSERVER_LINK_REASON_LANDING) ||
        ((status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) &&
         (status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) &&
         (status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) &&
         (status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) &&
         (status->desiredTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE)) ||
        ((status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE0) &&
         (status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE1) &&
         (status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE3) &&
         (status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_CORE4) &&
         (status->ownerTarget != OBSERVER_LINK_KVM_TARGET_NONE)) ||
        (status->targetX >= 188u) ||
        (status->targetY >= 120u) || (status->targetSize > 22560u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    statusValid = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_STATUS_VALID) != 0u);
    decisionValid = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_DECISION_VALID) != 0u);
    barrier = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_BARRIER_REQUIRED) != 0u);
    dispatch = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_DISPATCH_ENABLED) != 0u);
    core0LinkUp = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_CORE0_LINK_UP) != 0u);
    core2LinkUp = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_CORE2_LINK_UP) != 0u);
    requiredVision = (uint8_t) ((status->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_FLAG_REQUIRED_VISION) != 0u);

    if ((((status->systemFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_STANDALONE) != 0u) !=
          (status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_STANDALONE)) ||
        (((status->systemFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_REJOIN) != 0u) !=
          (status->systemPhase == OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_PHASE_REJOIN)) ||
        (((status->systemFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_LANDING) != 0u) &&
         ((status->systemFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_SYSTEM_FLAG_LAUNCH_ELIGIBLE) != 0u)))
    {
        return 0u;
    }

    if (statusValid == 0u)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_SAFE) &&
            (status->activeSource == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE) &&
            (status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE) &&
            (status->navState == 0u) && (status->beaconCount == 0u) &&
            (status->targetX == 0u) && (status->targetY == 0u) &&
            (status->targetSize == 0u) && (status->errXQ4 == 0) &&
            (status->errYQ4 == 0) && (status->flags == 0u));
    }
    if ((status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_SAFE) ||
        ((status->cameraControlState == OBSERVER_LINK_CAMERA_CONTROL_RUN) !=
         (requiredVision != 0u)) ||
        ((core2LinkUp != 0u) && (core0LinkUp == 0u)) ||
        ((decisionValid != 0u) &&
         (status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE)) ||
        ((status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE)) ||
        ((status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_CORE1_TRACK) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE1)) ||
        ((status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_OBSERVER_TRACK) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4)) ||
        ((status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_SEARCH) &&
         (status->activeSource != OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_NONE)) ||
        ((dispatch != 0u) && ((decisionValid == 0u) || (barrier != 0u) ||
          (status->controlClass == OBSERVER_LINK_CONTROL_CLASS_NONE))))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodeControlStatus(const observerLinkControlStatus *status,
    uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (length == NULL) ||
        (controlStatusIsValid(status) == 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    payload[0] = status->detectMode;
    payload[1] = status->protocolCompatible;
    payload[2] = status->algorithmsReady;
    payload[3] = status->configCompatible;
    payload[4] = status->cameraControlState;
    payload[5] = status->activeSource;
    payload[6] = status->controlClass;
    payload[7] = status->flags;
    payload[8] = status->navState;
    payload[9] = status->beaconCount;
    putU16(&payload[10], status->targetX);
    putU16(&payload[12], status->targetY);
    putU16(&payload[14], status->targetSize);
    putU16(&payload[16], (uint16_t) status->errXQ4);
    putU16(&payload[18], (uint16_t) status->errYQ4);
    payload[20] = status->systemPhase;
    payload[21] = status->systemFlags;
    payload[22] = status->primaryReason;
    payload[23] = status->desiredTarget;
    payload[24] = status->ownerTarget;
    *length = OBSERVER_LINK_CORE1_HEARTBEAT_BYTES;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodeControlStatus(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length,
    observerLinkControlStatus *status)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (status == NULL) ||
        (length != OBSERVER_LINK_CORE1_HEARTBEAT_BYTES))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(status, 0, sizeof(*status));
    status->detectMode = payload[0];
    status->protocolCompatible = payload[1];
    status->algorithmsReady = payload[2];
    status->configCompatible = payload[3];
    status->cameraControlState = payload[4];
    status->activeSource = payload[5];
    status->controlClass = payload[6];
    status->flags = payload[7];
    status->navState = payload[8];
    status->beaconCount = payload[9];
    status->targetX = getU16(&payload[10]);
    status->targetY = getU16(&payload[12]);
    status->targetSize = getU16(&payload[14]);
    status->errXQ4 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[16]);
    status->errYQ4 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[18]);
    status->systemPhase = payload[20];
    status->systemFlags = payload[21];
    status->primaryReason = payload[22];
    status->desiredTarget = payload[23];
    status->ownerTarget = payload[24];
    return controlStatusIsValid(status);
}

static uint8_t observerSourceIsValid(uint8_t sourceId)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE3) ||
        (sourceId == OBSERVER_LINK_SOURCE_CORE4));
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodeHealth(const observerLinkHealth *health,
    uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if ((health == NULL) || (payload == NULL) || (length == NULL) ||
        (observerSourceIsValid(health->sourceId) == 0u) ||
        (health->cameraState > 2u) ||
        (health->configState > OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    putU32(&payload[0], health->ownerSession);
    putU32(&payload[4], health->appFrameSeq);
    putU32(&payload[8], health->captureTickMs);
    putU32(&payload[12], health->bridgeSeq);
    putU16(&payload[16], health->frameAgeMs);
    putU16(&payload[18], health->bridgeAgeMs);
    payload[20] = health->sourceId;
    payload[21] = health->cameraState;
    payload[22] = health->configState;
    payload[23] = health->flags;
    *length = OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_BYTES;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodeHealth(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length,
    observerLinkHealth *health)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (health == NULL) ||
        (length != OBSERVER_LINK_HEALTH_BYTES))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    health->ownerSession = getU32(&payload[0]);
    health->appFrameSeq = getU32(&payload[4]);
    health->captureTickMs = getU32(&payload[8]);
    health->bridgeSeq = getU32(&payload[12]);
    health->frameAgeMs = getU16(&payload[16]);
    health->bridgeAgeMs = getU16(&payload[18]);
    health->sourceId = payload[20];
    health->cameraState = payload[21];
    health->configState = payload[22];
    health->flags = payload[23];
    return (uint8_t) ((observerSourceIsValid(health->sourceId) != 0u) &&
        (health->cameraState <= 2u) &&
        (health->configState <= OBSERVER_LINK_CONFIG_REJECTED));
}

static uint8_t viewOverlayIsValid(const observerLinkViewOverlay *overlay)
{
    uint16_t knownFlags = OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_VALID |
        OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_CENTER | OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_DEADZONE |
        OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_SELECTED | OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_POSE;
    uint8_t selectedPresent;
    uint8_t posePresent;

    if ((overlay == NULL) || (overlay->overlaySeq == 0u) ||
        (overlay->ownerSession == 0u) || (overlay->configRevision == 0u) ||
        (overlay->detectMode > 1u) || ((overlay->flags & ~knownFlags) != 0u) ||
        ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_VALID) == 0u)) return 0u;
    selectedPresent = (uint8_t) ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_SELECTED) != 0u);
    posePresent = (uint8_t) ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_POSE) != 0u);
    if ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_CENTER) != 0u)
    {
        if ((overlay->activeCenterX >= 188u) || (overlay->activeCenterY >= 120u)) return 0u;
    }
    else if ((overlay->activeCenterX != 0u) || (overlay->activeCenterY != 0u)) return 0u;
    if ((overlay->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_FLAG_DEADZONE) != 0u)
    {
        if ((overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius > 188u) ||
            (overlay->deadzoneExitRadius > 188u) ||
            (overlay->deadzoneExitRadius > overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius)) return 0u;
    }
    else if ((overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius != 0u) ||
        (overlay->deadzoneExitRadius != 0u)) return 0u;
    if (selectedPresent != 0u)
    {
        if ((overlay->sourceFrameSeq == 0u) ||
            (overlay->selectedTrackId == 0u) || (overlay->selectedX >= 188u) ||
            (overlay->selectedY >= 120u) || (overlay->selectedSize > 22560u) ||
            ((overlay->selectedFlags & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_FRESH |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_COAST)) != 0u) ||
            (overlay->selectedFlags == 0u) ||
            (overlay->selectedFlags == (OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_FRESH |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_SELECTED_COAST))) return 0u;
    }
    else if ((overlay->selectedTrackId != 0u) || (overlay->selectedX != 0u) ||
        (overlay->selectedY != 0u) || (overlay->selectedSize != 0u) ||
        (overlay->selectedFlags != 0u)) return 0u;
    if (posePresent != 0u)
    {
        uint8_t poseAgeFlags = (uint8_t) (overlay->poseFlags &
            (OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_FRESH | OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD));
        if ((overlay->poseX >= 188u) || (overlay->poseY >= 120u) ||
            ((overlay->poseFlags & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_FRESH |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HEADING_VALID)) != 0u) ||
            (poseAgeFlags == 0u) ||
            (poseAgeFlags == (OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_FRESH |
                OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HOLD))) return 0u;
        if ((overlay->poseFlags & OBSERVER_LINK_OVERLAY_POSE_HEADING_VALID) != 0u)
        {
            if ((overlay->poseHeadingQ8 < -805) || (overlay->poseHeadingQ8 > 805)) return 0u;
        }
        else if (overlay->poseHeadingQ8 != 0) return 0u;
    }
    else if ((overlay->poseX != 0u) || (overlay->poseY != 0u) ||
        (overlay->poseHeadingQ8 != 0) || (overlay->poseFlags != 0u)) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodeViewOverlay(const observerLinkViewOverlay *overlay,
    uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (length == NULL) ||
        (viewOverlayIsValid(overlay) == 0u)) return 0u;
    putU32(&payload[0], overlay->overlaySeq);
    putU32(&payload[4], overlay->sourceFrameSeq);
    putU32(&payload[8], overlay->ownerSession);
    putU32(&payload[12], overlay->configRevision);
    putU32(&payload[16], overlay->configHash);
    putU16(&payload[20], overlay->flags);
    putU16(&payload[22], overlay->selectedTrackId);
    putU16(&payload[24], overlay->activeCenterX);
    putU16(&payload[26], overlay->activeCenterY);
    putU16(&payload[28], overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius);
    putU16(&payload[30], overlay->deadzoneExitRadius);
    putU16(&payload[32], overlay->selectedX);
    putU16(&payload[34], overlay->selectedY);
    putU16(&payload[36], overlay->selectedSize);
    putU16(&payload[38], overlay->poseX);
    putU16(&payload[40], overlay->poseY);
    putU16(&payload[42], (uint16_t) overlay->poseHeadingQ8);
    payload[44] = overlay->selectedFlags;
    payload[45] = overlay->poseFlags;
    payload[46] = overlay->detectMode;
    *length = OBSERVER_LINK_VIEW_OVERLAY_BYTES;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodeViewOverlay(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length,
    observerLinkViewOverlay *overlay)
{
    if ((payload == NULL) || (overlay == NULL) ||
        (length != OBSERVER_LINK_VIEW_OVERLAY_BYTES)) return 0u;
    memset(overlay, 0, sizeof(*overlay));
    overlay->overlaySeq = getU32(&payload[0]);
    overlay->sourceFrameSeq = getU32(&payload[4]);
    overlay->ownerSession = getU32(&payload[8]);
    overlay->configRevision = getU32(&payload[12]);
    overlay->configHash = getU32(&payload[16]);
    overlay->flags = getU16(&payload[20]);
    overlay->selectedTrackId = getU16(&payload[22]);
    overlay->activeCenterX = getU16(&payload[24]);
    overlay->activeCenterY = getU16(&payload[26]);
    overlay->deadzoneEnterRadius = getU16(&payload[28]);
    overlay->deadzoneExitRadius = getU16(&payload[30]);
    overlay->selectedX = getU16(&payload[32]);
    overlay->selectedY = getU16(&payload[34]);
    overlay->selectedSize = getU16(&payload[36]);
    overlay->poseX = getU16(&payload[38]);
    overlay->poseY = getU16(&payload[40]);
    overlay->poseHeadingQ8 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[42]);
    overlay->selectedFlags = payload[44];
    overlay->poseFlags = payload[45];
    overlay->detectMode = payload[46];
    return viewOverlayIsValid(overlay);
}

uint8_t observerLinkPlanningTrackFragmentCount(uint8_t retainedCount)
{
    if (retainedCount > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    return (retainedCount == 0u) ? 1u :
        (uint8_t) ((retainedCount + OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT - 1u) /
                   OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT);
}

static uint8_t planningTrackIsValid(const observerLinkPlanningTrack *track)
{
    uint8_t fresh;
    uint8_t coast;
    uint8_t edgeGrace;
    uint8_t rejected;

    if ((track == NULL) || (track->centerX >= 188u) ||
        (track->centerY >= 120u) || (track->predX >= 188u) ||
        (track->predY >= 120u) || (track->size > 22560u) ||
        (track->predSize > 22560u) || (track->trackId == 0u) ||
        (track->misses > OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_MISSES_MAX) ||
        ((track->flags & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_FRESH |
                                     OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_COAST |
                                     OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_EDGE_GRACE |
                                     OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED)) != 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    fresh = (uint8_t) ((track->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_FRESH) != 0u);
    coast = (uint8_t) ((track->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_COAST) != 0u);
    edgeGrace = (uint8_t) ((track->flags & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_EDGE_GRACE) != 0u);
    rejected = (uint8_t) ((track->flags &
        OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) != 0u);
    if (rejected != 0u)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((track->flags ==
            OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) &&
            (track->centerX == 0u) && (track->centerY == 0u) &&
            (track->predX == 0u) && (track->predY == 0u) &&
            (track->size == 0u) && (track->predSize == 0u) &&
            (track->misses == 0u) && (track->velXQ7 == 0) &&
            (track->velYQ7 == 0) && (track->areaVelQ0 == 0));
    }
    if ((edgeGrace != 0u) && ((fresh != 0u) || (coast == 0u))) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (((fresh != 0u) && (track->misses == 0u) && (coast == 0u)) ||
                      ((fresh == 0u) && (track->misses != 0u) && (coast != 0u)));
}

uint8_t observerLinkEncodePlanningTrackFragment(
    const observerLinkPlanningTrackSnapshot *snapshot,
    uint8_t fragmentIndex, uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    uint8_t fragmentCount;
    uint8_t first;
    uint8_t count;
    uint8_t i;
    uint8_t ordinaryRetained = 0u;
    uint16_t offset;

    if ((snapshot == NULL) || (payload == NULL) || (length == NULL) ||
        (snapshot->valid == 0u) || (observerSourceIsValid(snapshot->sourceId) == 0u) ||
        (snapshot->detectMode > 1u) ||
        (snapshot->retainedCount > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS) ||
        (snapshot->freshTotal > snapshot->confirmedTotal) ||
        ((uint16_t) snapshot->freshLeft + snapshot->freshRight != snapshot->freshTotal))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    for (i = 0u; i < snapshot->retainedCount; i++)
    {
        uint8_t j;
        if (planningTrackIsValid(&snapshot->tracks[i]) == 0u) return 0u;
        if ((snapshot->tracks[i].flags &
                OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED) == 0u)
            ordinaryRetained++;
        for (j = 0u; j < i; j++)
        {
            if (snapshot->tracks[j].trackId == snapshot->tracks[i].trackId)
                return 0u;
        }
    }
    if (ordinaryRetained > snapshot->confirmedTotal) return 0u;
    fragmentCount = observerLinkPlanningTrackFragmentCount(snapshot->retainedCount);
    if (fragmentIndex >= fragmentCount)
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    first = (uint8_t) (fragmentIndex * OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT);
    count = (uint8_t) (snapshot->retainedCount - first);
    if (count > OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT)
    {
        count = OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT;
    }
    memset(payload, 0, OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_MAX_BYTES);
    payload[0] = snapshot->sourceId;
    payload[1] = snapshot->detectMode;
    payload[2] = (uint8_t) (OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_VALID |
        ((snapshot->truncated != 0u) ? OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_TRUNCATED : 0u));
    payload[3] = fragmentIndex;
    payload[4] = fragmentCount;
    payload[5] = first;
    payload[6] = count;
    payload[7] = snapshot->retainedCount;
    putU32(&payload[8], snapshot->ownerSession);
    putU32(&payload[12], snapshot->revision);
    putU32(&payload[16], snapshot->hash);
    putU32(&payload[20], snapshot->appFrameSeq);
    putU32(&payload[24], snapshot->captureTickMs);
    payload[28] = snapshot->confirmedTotal;
    payload[29] = snapshot->freshTotal;
    payload[30] = snapshot->freshLeft;
    payload[31] = snapshot->freshRight;
    putU32(&payload[32], snapshot->trackerFrameSeq);
    offset = OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BYTES;
    for (i = 0u; i < count; i++)
    {
        const observerLinkPlanningTrack *track = &snapshot->tracks[first + i];
        uint8_t j;
        if (planningTrackIsValid(track) == 0u)
        {
            return 0u;
        }
        for (j = 0u; j < (uint8_t) (first + i); j++)
        {
            if (snapshot->tracks[j].trackId == track->trackId)
            {
                return 0u;
            }
        }
        payload[offset + 0u] = track->centerX;
        payload[offset + 1u] = track->centerY;
        payload[offset + 2u] = track->predX;
        payload[offset + 3u] = track->predY;
        putU16(&payload[offset + 4u], track->size);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 6u], track->predSize);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 8u], track->trackId);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 10u], (uint16_t) (track->misses |
            ((uint16_t) track->flags << 9u)));
        putU16(&payload[offset + 12u], (uint16_t) track->velXQ7);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 14u], (uint16_t) track->velYQ7);
        putU16(&payload[offset + 16u], (uint16_t) track->areaVelQ0);
        offset = (uint16_t) (offset + OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_BYTES);
    }
    *length = offset;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t observerLinkDecodePlanningTrackFragment(const uint8_t *payload,
    uint16_t length, observerLinkPlanningTrackFragment *fragment)
{
    uint8_t expectedFragments;
    uint8_t expectedFirst;
    uint8_t expectedCount;
    uint8_t i;
    uint16_t offset;

    if ((payload == NULL) || (fragment == NULL) ||
        (length < OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BYTES) ||
        (observerSourceIsValid(payload[0]) == 0u) || (payload[1] > 1u) ||
        ((payload[2] & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_VALID) == 0u) ||
        ((payload[2] & (uint8_t) ~(OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_VALID |
                                   OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_TRUNCATED)) != 0u) ||
        (payload[7] > OBSERVER_LINK_MAX_TRACKS) ||
        (payload[29] > payload[28]) ||
        ((uint16_t) payload[30] + payload[31] != payload[29]))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    expectedFragments = observerLinkPlanningTrackFragmentCount(payload[7]);
    if ((payload[4] != expectedFragments) || (payload[3] >= expectedFragments))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    expectedFirst = (uint8_t) (payload[3] * OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT);
    expectedCount = (uint8_t) (payload[7] - expectedFirst);
    if (expectedCount > OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT)
    {
        expectedCount = OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACKS_PER_FRAGMENT;
    }
    if ((payload[5] != expectedFirst) || (payload[6] != expectedCount) ||
        (length != (uint16_t) (OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BYTES +
                               expectedCount * OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_BYTES)))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    memset(fragment, 0, sizeof(*fragment));
    fragment->sourceId = payload[0];
    fragment->detectMode = payload[1];
    fragment->truncated = (uint8_t) ((payload[2] & OBSERVER_LINK_TRACK_SNAPSHOT_TRUNCATED) != 0u);
    fragment->fragmentIndex = payload[3];
    fragment->fragmentCount = payload[4];
    fragment->firstTrack = payload[5];
    fragment->trackCount = payload[6];
    fragment->retainedCount = payload[7];
    fragment->ownerSession = getU32(&payload[8]);
    fragment->revision = getU32(&payload[12]);
    fragment->hash = getU32(&payload[16]);
    fragment->appFrameSeq = getU32(&payload[20]);
    fragment->captureTickMs = getU32(&payload[24]);
    fragment->confirmedTotal = payload[28];
    fragment->freshTotal = payload[29];
    fragment->freshLeft = payload[30];
    fragment->freshRight = payload[31];
    fragment->trackerFrameSeq = getU32(&payload[32]);
    offset = OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_FRAGMENT_HEADER_BYTES;
    for (i = 0u; i < expectedCount; i++)
    {
        observerLinkPlanningTrack *track = &fragment->tracks[i];
        uint8_t j;
        track->centerX = payload[offset + 0u];
        track->centerY = payload[offset + 1u];
        track->predX = payload[offset + 2u];
        track->predY = payload[offset + 3u];
        track->size = getU16(&payload[offset + 4u]);
        track->predSize = getU16(&payload[offset + 6u]);
        track->trackId = getU16(&payload[offset + 8u]);
        {
            uint16_t state = getU16(&payload[offset + 10u]);
            if ((state & 0xe000u) != 0u)
            {
                return 0u;
            }
            track->misses = (uint16_t) (state & 0x01ffu);
            track->flags = (uint8_t) ((state >> 9u) & 0x0fu);
        }
        track->velXQ7 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[offset + 12u]);
        track->velYQ7 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[offset + 14u]);
        track->areaVelQ0 = (int16_t) getU16(&payload[offset + 16u]);
        if (planningTrackIsValid(track) == 0u)
        {
            return 0u;
        }
        for (j = 0u; j < i; j++)
        {
            if (fragment->tracks[j].trackId == track->trackId)
            {
                return 0u;
            }
        }
        offset = (uint16_t) (offset + OBSERVER_LINK_PLANNING_TRACK_BYTES);
    }
    return 1u;
}

/* RFC1982式32位序号比较：0保留给未初始化态，跨UINT32_MAX时仍保持半窗单调。 */
static inline uint8_t observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(
    uint32_t value, uint32_t reference)
{
    uint32_t delta = value - reference;
    return (uint8_t) ((value != 0u) && (delta != 0u) &&
                      (delta < 0x80000000u));
}

#define OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT (0u)
#define OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_ACCEPT (1u)

/* 在线时身份不可被其它session抢占；只有接收端已进入离线栅栏后，合格HELLO
 * 才能用任意非零session（含冷启动回退/同值）重建packet序号基线。 */
static inline uint8_t observerLinkRxSessionClassify(uint8_t online,
    uint32_t currentSession, uint32_t currentPacketSeq,
    uint8_t packetSeqPrimed, uint32_t incomingSession,
    uint32_t incomingPacketSeq, uint8_t qualifiedHello)
{
    if ((incomingSession == 0u) || (incomingPacketSeq == 0u))
        return OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    if (online == 0u)
        return (qualifiedHello != 0u) ? OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REBIND : OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    if (incomingSession != currentSession)
        return OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    if ((packetSeqPrimed != 0u) &&
        (observerLinkSequenceIsNewer(incomingPacketSeq,
             currentPacketSeq) == 0u))
        return OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_REJECT;
    return OBSERVER_LINK_RX_SESSION_ACCEPT;
}

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint32_t payloadCrc32;
    uint16_t offset;
    uint16_t totalLength;
    uint8_t op;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t target;
    uint8_t status;
    uint8_t length;
    uint8_t data[OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES];
} observerParamFrame;

static inline uint8_t observerParamEncode(const observerParamFrame *frame,
    uint8_t *payload, uint16_t *length)
{
    if (frame == NULL || payload == NULL || length == NULL ||
        frame->length > OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES) return 0u;
    payload[0] = frame->op;
    payload[1] = frame->slot;
    payload[2] = frame->target;
    payload[3] = frame->status;
    payload[4] = (uint8_t) frame->transactionId;
    payload[5] = (uint8_t) (frame->transactionId >> 8);
    payload[6] = (uint8_t) (frame->transactionId >> 16);
    payload[7] = (uint8_t) (frame->transactionId >> 24);
    payload[8] = (uint8_t) frame->offset;
    payload[9] = (uint8_t) (frame->offset >> 8);
    payload[10] = (uint8_t) frame->totalLength;
    payload[11] = (uint8_t) (frame->totalLength >> 8);
    payload[12] = (uint8_t) frame->payloadCrc32;
    payload[13] = (uint8_t) (frame->payloadCrc32 >> 8);
    payload[14] = (uint8_t) (frame->payloadCrc32 >> 16);
    payload[15] = (uint8_t) (frame->payloadCrc32 >> 24);
    payload[16] = frame->length;
    if (frame->length != 0u) memcpy(&payload[17], frame->data, frame->length);
    *length = (uint16_t) (OBSERVER_PARAM_HEADER_BYTES + frame->length);
    return 1u;
}

static inline uint8_t observerParamDecode(const uint8_t *payload,
    uint16_t length, observerParamFrame *frame)
{
    observerParamFrame candidate;
    if (payload == NULL || frame == NULL || length < OBSERVER_PARAM_HEADER_BYTES ||
        payload[16] > OBSERVER_PARAM_DATA_BYTES ||
        length != (uint16_t) (OBSERVER_PARAM_HEADER_BYTES + payload[16])) return 0u;
    memset(&candidate, 0, sizeof(candidate));
    candidate.op = payload[0];
    candidate.slot = payload[1];
    candidate.target = payload[2];
    candidate.status = payload[3];
    candidate.transactionId = (uint32_t) payload[4] | ((uint32_t) payload[5] << 8) |
                              ((uint32_t) payload[6] << 16) | ((uint32_t) payload[7] << 24);
    candidate.offset = (uint16_t) (payload[8] | ((uint16_t) payload[9] << 8));
    candidate.totalLength = (uint16_t) (payload[10] | ((uint16_t) payload[11] << 8));

    candidate.length = payload[16];
    if (candidate.length != 0u) memcpy(candidate.data, &payload[17], candidate.length);
    *frame = candidate;
    return 1u;
}

    candidate.target = payload[24]; candidate.error = payload[25];
    candidate.readyMask = payload[26]; candidate.flags = payload[27];
    if (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(&candidate) == 0u) return 0u;
    *value = candidate;
    return 1u;
}

#ifndef PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_H
#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_H

#include <stdint.h>

#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK (0x1Fu)

typedef enum
{
    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE = 0u,
    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY = 1u,
    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_LOAD_RUNTIME = 2u,
    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY = 3u
} paramSyncGlobalAction;

#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_VALID   (0u)
#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_EMPTY   (5u)
#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_INVALID (10u)

static inline uint32_t paramSyncGlobalPackSlotSummary(uint8_t validMask,
    uint8_t emptyMask, uint8_t invalidMask)
{
    return ((uint32_t) (validMask & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK) <<
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_VALID) |
        ((uint32_t) (emptyMask & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK) <<
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_EMPTY) |
        ((uint32_t) (invalidMask & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK) <<
            PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_INVALID);
}

static inline uint8_t paramSyncGlobalSlotSummaryMask(uint32_t summary,
    uint8_t shift)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((summary >> shift) & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK);
}

typedef enum
{
    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNKNOWN = 0u,
    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_CHECKING,
    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL,
    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_EMPTY,
    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_PARTIAL,
    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_INVALID,
    PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE
} paramSyncSlotUiState;

static inline uint8_t paramSyncGlobalClassifySlotSummary(uint32_t summary)
{
    uint8_t validMask = paramSyncGlobalSlotSummaryMask(summary,
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_VALID);
    uint8_t emptyMask = paramSyncGlobalSlotSummaryMask(summary,
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_EMPTY);
    uint8_t invalidMask = paramSyncGlobalSlotSummaryMask(summary,
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_SLOT_MASK_SHIFT_INVALID);
    if (invalidMask != 0u) return PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_INVALID;
    if (validMask == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK && emptyMask == 0u)
        return PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_FULL;
    if (emptyMask == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK && validMask == 0u)
        return PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_EMPTY;
    if ((uint8_t) (validMask | emptyMask) == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK)
        return PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_PARTIAL;
    return PARAM_SYNC_SLOT_UI_UNAVAILABLE;
}

typedef enum
{
    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_UNINITIALIZED = 0u,
    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_READY = 1u,

    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_SUCCEEDED = 11u,
    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED = 12u
} paramSyncGlobalPhase;

typedef enum
{
    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE = 0u,

    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_REJECTED = 2u,

    PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_ROUTE = 4u,

#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_READY    (1u << 0)
#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY     (1u << 1)
#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY (1u << 2)
#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL (1u << 3)
#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_OK       (1u << 4)
#define PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY (1u << 5)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration;
    uint32_t sequence;
    uint8_t origin;
    uint8_t action;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t reserved;
} paramSyncGlobalRequest;

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t coordinatorBootGeneration;
    uint32_t sequence;
    uint32_t requestBootGeneration;
    uint32_t requestSequence;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint8_t origin;
    uint8_t action;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t phase;
    uint8_t target;
    uint8_t error;
    uint8_t readyMask;
    uint8_t flags;
} paramSyncGlobalState;

static inline uint8_t paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(
    const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    const uint8_t allowedFlags = PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_READY |
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY | PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY |
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL | PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_OK |
        PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY;
    uint8_t identityPresent;
    if (state == 0 || state->coordinatorBootGeneration == 0u ||
        state->sequence == 0u || state->phase > PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED ||
        (state->target != 0xFFu && state->target > 4u) ||
        state->error > PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_INVALID ||
        (state->readyMask & (uint8_t) ~PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK) != 0u ||
        (state->flags & (uint8_t) ~allowedFlags) != 0u) return 0u;
    identityPresent = (uint8_t) (state->requestBootGeneration != 0u);
    if (identityPresent != (uint8_t) (state->requestSequence != 0u)) return 0u;
    if (state->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE)
    {
        if (state->slot != 0u || state->origin != 0xFFu) return 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        if (state->action > PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY ||
            (state->origin > 4u && state->origin != 0xFFu)) return 0u;
        if (state->slot < 1u || state->slot > 5u) return 0u;
    }
    if (state->phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_UNINITIALIZED)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((state->flags == 0u ||
                           state->flags == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY) &&
            state->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE &&
            identityPresent == 0u && state->transactionId == 0u &&
            state->target == 0xFFu && state->error == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE);
    }
    if (state->phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_READY)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (state->flags ==
                (PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_READY |
                 PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY) &&
            state->readyMask == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK &&
            state->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE &&
            identityPresent == 0u && state->transactionId == 0u &&
            state->target == 0xFFu && state->error == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE);
    }
    if (state->phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_RECOVERING)
    {
        return (uint8_t) (state->flags == (PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY |
                                          PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RECOVERY) &&
            state->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE &&
            identityPresent == 0u && state->target == 0xFFu &&
            (state->error == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE ||
             state->error == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_RECOVERY));
    }
    if (state->phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_SUCCEEDED)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((state->flags == (PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL |
                                           PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_OK) ||
                           state->flags == (PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL |
                                           PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_OK |
                                           PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY)) &&
            state->action != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE &&
            identityPresent != 0u && state->transactionId != 0u &&
            state->target == 0xFFu && state->error == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE);
    }
    if (state->phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_FAILED)
    {
        return (uint8_t) ((state->flags == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL ||
                           state->flags == (PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_TERMINAL |
                                           PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY)) &&
            state->action != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE &&
            identityPresent != 0u &&
            state->error != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE);
    }
    return (uint8_t) (state->phase >= PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_REQUESTED &&
        state->phase <= PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_ABORTING &&
        state->flags == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_BUSY &&
        state->action != PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE &&
        identityPresent != 0u && state->transactionId != 0u);
}

static inline uint8_t paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(
    const paramSyncGlobalRequest *request)
{
    if (request == 0 || request->producerBootGeneration == 0u ||
        request->sequence == 0u || request->origin > 4u ||
        request->reserved != 0u ||
        request->action < PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_SAVE_LIBRARY ||
        request->action > PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_INSPECT_LIBRARY)
        return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (request->slot >= 1u && request->slot <= 5u);
}

static inline uint8_t paramSyncGlobalStateReady(
    const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    return (uint8_t) (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(state) != 0u &&
        state->phase == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_PHASE_READY &&
        state->action == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ACTION_NONE &&
        state->target == 0xFFu && state->error == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_ERROR_NONE &&
        state->readyMask == PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_TARGET_MASK &&
        state->flags == (PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_READY |
                         PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY));
}

static inline uint8_t paramSyncGlobalStateRuntimeReady(
    const paramSyncGlobalState *state)
{
    return (uint8_t) (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(state) != 0u &&
        (state->flags & PARAM_SYNC_GLOBAL_FLAG_RUNTIME_READY) != 0u);
}

static inline uint8_t paramSyncGlobalStateMatchesRequest(
    const paramSyncGlobalState *state, const paramSyncGlobalRequest *request)
{
    return (uint8_t) (paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(state) != 0u &&
        paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(request) != 0u &&
        state->requestBootGeneration == request->producerBootGeneration &&
        state->requestSequence == request->sequence &&
        state->origin == request->origin && state->action == request->action &&
        state->slot == request->slot);
}

static inline void paramSyncGlobalPutU32(uint8_t *p, uint32_t value)
{
    p[0] = (uint8_t) value; p[1] = (uint8_t) (value >> 8);
    p[2] = (uint8_t) (value >> 16); p[3] = (uint8_t) (value >> 24);
}
static inline uint32_t paramSyncGlobalGetU32(const uint8_t *p)
{
    return (uint32_t) p[0] | ((uint32_t) p[1] << 8) |
        ((uint32_t) p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t) p[3] << 24);
}
static inline void paramSyncGlobalEncodeRequest(
    const paramSyncGlobalRequest *value, uint8_t out[12])
{
    paramSyncGlobalPutU32(&out[0], value->producerBootGeneration);
    paramSyncGlobalPutU32(&out[4], value->sequence);
    out[8] = value->origin; out[9] = value->action;
    out[10] = value->slot; out[11] = value->reserved;
}

    value->sequence = paramSyncGlobalGetU32(&in[4]);
    value->origin = in[8]; value->action = in[9];
    value->slot = in[10]; value->reserved = in[11];
    return paramSyncGlobalRequestIsValid(value);
}
static inline void paramSyncGlobalEncodeState(
    const paramSyncGlobalState *value, uint8_t out[28])
{
    paramSyncGlobalPutU32(&out[0], value->coordinatorBootGeneration);
    paramSyncGlobalPutU32(&out[4], value->sequence);
    paramSyncGlobalPutU32(&out[8], value->requestBootGeneration);
    paramSyncGlobalPutU32(&out[12], value->requestSequence);
    paramSyncGlobalPutU32(&out[16], value->transactionId);
    out[20] = value->origin; out[21] = value->action; out[22] = value->slot;
    out[23] = value->phase; out[24] = value->target; out[25] = value->error;
    out[26] = value->readyMask; out[27] = value->flags;
}

    value->sequence = paramSyncGlobalGetU32(&in[4]);
    value->requestBootGeneration = paramSyncGlobalGetU32(&in[8]);
    value->requestSequence = paramSyncGlobalGetU32(&in[12]);
    value->transactionId = paramSyncGlobalGetU32(&in[16]);
    value->origin = in[20]; value->action = in[21]; value->slot = in[22];
    value->phase = in[23]; value->target = in[24]; value->error = in[25];
    value->readyMask = in[26]; value->flags = in[27];
    return paramSyncGlobalStateIsValid(value);
}

#define PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC  (0x50535251u) /* PSRQ */
#define PARAM_SYNC_RESPONSE_MAGIC (0x50535253u) /* PSRS */
#define PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI    (1u)

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t beginSequence;
    uint32_t magic;
    uint32_t abiVersion;
    uint32_t payloadBytes;
    uint32_t producerBootGeneration;
    uint32_t sequence;

typedef char paramSyncMailbox_frame_size_assert[
    (sizeof(paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame) == PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_FRAME_BYTES) ? 1 : -1];

#pragma location = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_REQUEST_ADDR

#pragma location = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_RESPONSE_ADDR
__no_init static volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame paramSyncResponseRegion;

static uint8_t frameInputValid(uint32_t bootGeneration, uint32_t sequence,
    uint16_t dataLength)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((bootGeneration != 0u) && (sequence != 0u) &&
        (dataLength <= PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX));
}
static void cleanRegion(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region)
{
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*region));
    __DSB();
}

static void invalidateRegion(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region)
{
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) region, sizeof(*region));
    __DSB();
}

static uint8_t publishFrame(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region,
    const paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame staged;

    staged = *frame;
    staged.endSequence = 0u;

    region->beginSequence = 0u;
    region->endSequence = 0u;
    cleanRegion(region);

    memcpy((void *) region, &staged, sizeof(staged));
    cleanRegion(region);

    region->endSequence = staged.sequence;
    SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *)
        (((uintptr_t) &region->endSequence) & ~((uintptr_t) 31u)), 32u);
    __DSB();
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t sharedFrameValid(const paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame,
    uint32_t magic)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((frame->beginSequence != 0u) &&
        (frame->beginSequence == frame->sequence) &&
        (frame->endSequence == frame->sequence) &&
        (frame->magic == magic) &&
        (frame->abiVersion == PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI) &&
        (frame->payloadBytes == frame->dataLength) &&
        frameInputValid(frame->producerBootGeneration, frame->sequence,
            frame->dataLength));
}

static uint8_t tryReadFrame(volatile paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *region,
    uint32_t magic, paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame *frame)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame first;
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame second;
    uint8_t attempt;

    for (attempt = 0u; attempt < 3u; attempt++)
    {
        invalidateRegion(region);
        memcpy(&first, (const void *) region, sizeof(first));
        invalidateRegion(region);
        memcpy(&second, (const void *) region, sizeof(second));
        if (sharedFrameValid(&first, magic) &&
            sharedFrameValid(&second, magic) &&
            (memcmp(&first, &second, sizeof(first)) == 0))
        {
            *frame = second;
            return 1u;
        }
    }
    return 0u;
}

uint8_t paramSyncMailboxPublishRequest(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    paramSyncMailboxSharedFrame frame;
    if ((request == 0) || !frameInputValid(request->producerBootGeneration,
        request->sequence, request->dataLength)) return 0u;
    memset(&frame, 0, sizeof(frame));
    frame.beginSequence = request->sequence;
    frame.magic = PARAM_SYNC_REQUEST_MAGIC;
    frame.abiVersion = PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_ABI;
    frame.payloadBytes = request->dataLength;
    frame.producerBootGeneration = request->producerBootGeneration;
    frame.sequence = request->sequence;
    frame.transactionId = request->transactionId;
    frame.offset = request->offset;
    frame.payloadCrc32 = request->payloadCrc32;
    frame.dataLength = request->dataLength;
    frame.op = request->op;
    frame.slot = request->slot;
    frame.target = request->target;
    frame.state = request->flags;
    memcpy(frame.data, request->data, request->dataLength);
    return publishFrame(&paramSyncRequestRegion, &frame);
}

    candidate.payloadCrc32 = frame.payloadCrc32;
    candidate.dataLength = frame.dataLength;
    candidate.op = frame.op;
    candidate.slot = frame.slot;
    candidate.target = frame.target;
    candidate.flags = frame.state;
    memcpy(candidate.data, frame.data, frame.dataLength);
    *request = candidate;
    return 1u;
}

                      *oldSlotExternal <= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT &&

    transactionPending = (uint8_t) (g_syncMutationLocked || g_stagedValid ||
        g_flashPrepared || g_flashCommitted || runtimeMeta.pending);
    if ((activationPending == 0u) && (transactionPending == 0u)) return 1u;
    if ((request->op != PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH &&
         request->op != PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT) ||
        (request->dataLength != 4u)) return 0u;

    transactionId = getU32(request->data);
    if (activationPending != 0u)
    {
        if ((transactionId != 0u) || g_stagedValid || g_flashPrepared ||
            g_flashCommitted) return 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    if ((g_syncMutationLocked != 0u) &&
        (transactionId != g_syncLockedTransaction)) return 0u;
    if ((g_stagedValid || g_flashPrepared || g_flashCommitted) &&
        (transactionId != g_stagedTransactionId)) return 0u;
    if ((runtimeMeta.pending != 0u) &&
        (transactionId != runtimeMeta.transactionId)) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

uint8_t core4ParamSyncOwnerServiceMutationLocked(void)
{
    return (uint8_t) (g_syncMutationLocked || g_stagedValid ||
        g_flashPrepared || g_flashCommitted ||
        core4VisionParamsFlashMutationPending());
}

static void clearStaging(void)
{
    memset(&g_stagedBlob, 0, sizeof(g_stagedBlob));
    g_stagedTransactionId = 0u;
    g_stagedExpectedCrc = 0u;
    g_stagedBytes = 0u;
    g_stagedReceived = 0u;
    g_stagedSlot = 0u;
    g_stagedValid = 0u;
    g_flashPrepared = 0u;
    g_flashCommitted = 0u;
    g_stageKind = PARAM_STAGE_NONE;
    g_runtimeApplied = 0u;
}

static uint8_t rollbackTransaction(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    if (core4VisionParamsFlashAbortTransaction(transactionId) !=
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED) return 0u;
    if (core4VisionParamsFlashReadRuntime(&params) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID) return 0u;
    core4VisionParamsCommit(&params);
    return 1u;
}

static void publish(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request, uint8_t status,
    const uint8_t *data, uint16_t length, uint32_t crc)
{
    paramSyncMailboxResponse response;
    memset(&response, 0, sizeof(response));
    g_responseSequence++;
    if (g_responseSequence == 0u) g_responseSequence = 1u;
    response.producerBootGeneration = g_ownerBootGeneration;
    response.sequence = g_responseSequence;
    response.transactionId = request->transactionId;
    response.offset = request->offset;
    response.payloadCrc32 = crc;
    response.dataLength = length;
    response.op = request->op;
    response.slot = request->slot;
    response.target = request->target;
    response.status = status;
    if ((data != NULL) && (length != 0u)) memcpy(response.data, data, length);
    (void) paramSyncMailboxPublishResponse(&response);
}

static void handleReadMeta(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t output[26];
    uint8_t externalSlot;
    uint8_t internalSlot;
    core4VisionParamsLibraryMeta meta;
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;
    uint32_t blobCrc = 0u;

    if ((request->dataLength != 1u) ||
        (externalSlotValid(request->data[0]) == 0u))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    externalSlot = request->data[0];
    internalSlot = (uint8_t) (externalSlot - 1u);
    memset(&meta, 0, sizeof(meta));
    if (core4VisionParamsFlashInspectSlot(internalSlot, &meta) !=
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (meta.state == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LIBRARY_VALID)
    {
        if (core4VisionParamsFlashReadSlot(internalSlot, &params, NULL) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
        {
            publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(&params, &blob);
        blobCrc = getU32(&blob.bytes[CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_CRC_BYTES]);
    }
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(output));
    output[0] = CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET;
    output[1] = externalSlot;
    output[2] = meta.state;
    output[3] = 0u;
    putU32(&output[4], CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_FLASH_VERSION);
    putU32(&output[8], meta.generation);
    putU32(&output[12], blobCrc);
    putU32(&output[16], meta.transactionId);
    putU32(&output[20], CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_SCHEMA_HASH);
    putU16(&output[24], CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES);
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, output, sizeof(output), 0u);
}

static void handleReadRuntimeMeta(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t output[32];
    core4VisionParamsStruct runtime;
    core4VisionParamsRuntimeMeta meta;
    core4VisionParamsPersistenceStatus persistence;
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;
    uint32_t blobCrc;

    if (request->dataLength != 0u ||
        core4VisionParamsFlashReadRuntime(&runtime) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID ||
        core4VisionParamsFlashGetRuntimeMeta(&meta) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(&runtime, &blob);
    core4VisionParamsPersistenceGetStatus(&persistence);
    blobCrc = getU32(&blob.bytes[CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_CRC_BYTES]);
    memset(output, 0, sizeof(output));
    output[0] = CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET;
    output[1] = meta.valid;
    output[2] = meta.bank;
    output[3] = meta.pending;
    output[4] = (uint8_t) (memcmp(&runtime, core4VisionParamsGetActive(),
        sizeof(runtime)) != 0);
    output[5] = meta.sourceSlot;
    output[6] = persistence.runtimeDefaultsRewritten != 0u ? 1u : 0u;
    putU32(&output[8], CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_FLASH_VERSION);
    putU32(&output[12], meta.generation);
    putU32(&output[16], blobCrc);
    putU32(&output[20], meta.transactionId);
    putU32(&output[24], CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_SCHEMA_HASH);
    putU16(&output[28], CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES);
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, output, sizeof(output), 0u);
}

static void handleReadRuntimeChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t output[PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX];
    uint16_t offset;
    uint16_t length;
    uint32_t blobCrc;
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;

    if (request->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    offset = getU16(&request->data[0]);
    length = getU16(&request->data[2]);
    if (length == 0u || length > (PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX - 4u) ||
        (uint32_t) offset + length > CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES ||
        core4VisionParamsFlashReadRuntime(&params) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(&params, &blob);
    blobCrc = getU32(&blob.bytes[CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_CRC_BYTES]);
    putU16(&output[0], offset);
    putU16(&output[2], CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES);
    memcpy(&output[4], &blob.bytes[offset], length);
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, output,
        (uint16_t) (4u + length), blobCrc);
}

static void handleReadChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t output[PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX];
    uint8_t externalSlot;
    uint8_t internalSlot;
    uint16_t offset;
    uint16_t length;
    uint32_t blobCrc;
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    core4VisionParamsSlotMeta meta;
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;

    if (request->dataLength != 5u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    externalSlot = request->data[0];
    offset = getU16(&request->data[1]);
    length = getU16(&request->data[3]);
    if ((externalSlotValid(externalSlot) == 0u) || (length == 0u) ||
        (length > (PARAM_SYNC_MAILBOX_DATA_MAX - 5u)) ||
        (offset >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES) ||
        ((uint32_t) offset + length > CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    internalSlot = (uint8_t) (externalSlot - 1u);
    if (core4VisionParamsFlashReadSlot(internalSlot, &params, &meta) !=
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(&params, &blob);
    blobCrc = getU32(&blob.bytes[CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_CRC_BYTES]);
    output[0] = externalSlot;
    putU16(&output[1], offset);
    putU16(&output[3], CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES);
    memcpy(&output[5], &blob.bytes[offset], length);
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, output,
        (uint16_t) (5u + length), blobCrc);
}

static void handlePrepareLibraryFromLive(
    const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *active;
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    uint32_t blobCrc;

    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_flashPrepared != 0u || g_flashCommitted != 0u)
    {
        publish(request, (g_stageKind == PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY &&
            g_stagedSlot == slot &&
            g_stagedTransactionId == transactionId) ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK :
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, g_stagedExpectedCrc);
        return;
    }
    active = core4VisionParamsGetActive();
    core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(active, &blob);
    blobCrc = getU32(&blob.bytes[CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_CRC_BYTES]);
    if (core4VisionParamsFlashPrepareSlot((uint8_t) (slot - 1u), active,
            transactionId) != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    clearStaging();
    g_stagedBlob = blob;
    g_stagedSlot = slot;
    g_stagedTransactionId = transactionId;
    g_stagedExpectedCrc = blobCrc;
    g_stagedBytes = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES;
    g_stagedReceived = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES;
    g_stagedValid = 1u;
    g_flashPrepared = 1u;
    g_stageKind = PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, blobCrc);
}

static void handlePrepareRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    core4VisionParamsSaveStatus status;

    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 0u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u || slot == 0u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_flashPrepared != 0u || g_flashCommitted != 0u)
    {
        publish(request, (g_stageKind == PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME &&
            g_stagedSlot == slot &&
            g_stagedTransactionId == transactionId) ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK :
            PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    status = core4VisionParamsFlashPrepareRuntimeFromSlot(
        (uint8_t) (slot - 1u), transactionId);
    if (status != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    clearStaging();
    g_stagedSlot = slot;
    g_stagedTransactionId = transactionId;
    g_stagedValid = 1u;
    g_flashPrepared = 1u;
    g_stageKind = PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleCommitRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 1u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u ||
        g_stageKind != PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME || g_flashPrepared == 0u ||
        g_stagedSlot != slot || g_stagedTransactionId != transactionId)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_flashCommitted == 0u &&
        core4VisionParamsFlashCommitRuntime(transactionId) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_flashCommitted = 1u;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleApplyRuntime(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (decodeGlobalTransaction(request, 1u, &slot, &transactionId) == 0u ||
        transactionLocked(slot, transactionId) == 0u ||
        g_stageKind != PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME || g_flashCommitted == 0u ||
        g_stagedSlot != slot || g_stagedTransactionId != transactionId)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_runtimeApplied == 0u &&
        core4VisionParamsFlashApplyPreparedRuntime(transactionId) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_runtimeApplied = 1u;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handlePrepareBegin(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if ((request->dataLength != 19u) ||
        (externalSlotValid(request->data[0]) == 0u) ||
        (getU32(&request->data[5]) != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_FLASH_VERSION) ||
        (getU32(&request->data[9]) != CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_SCHEMA_HASH) ||
        (getU16(&request->data[17]) != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    transactionId = getU32(&request->data[1]);
    if (transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_flashPrepared != 0u && rollbackTransaction(g_stagedTransactionId) == 0u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    clearStaging();
    g_stagedSlot = request->data[0];
    g_stagedTransactionId = transactionId;
    g_stagedExpectedCrc = getU32(&request->data[13]);
    g_stagedBytes = getU16(&request->data[17]);
    g_stagedValid = 1u;
    g_stageKind = PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handlePrepareChunk(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint16_t offset;
    uint16_t length;
    if ((g_stagedValid == 0u) || (request->dataLength < 5u))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    offset = getU16(&request->data[1]);
    length = getU16(&request->data[3]);
    if ((request->data[0] != g_stagedSlot) ||
        (offset != g_stagedReceived) ||
        (length != (uint16_t) (request->dataLength - 5u)) ||
        ((uint32_t) offset + length > g_stagedBytes))
    {
        clearStaging();
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    memcpy(&g_stagedBlob.bytes[offset], &request->data[5], length);
    g_stagedReceived = (uint16_t) (g_stagedReceived + length);
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handlePrepareFinish(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint32_t internalCrc;
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    core4VisionParamsStruct sanitized;
    if ((g_stagedValid == 0u) || (request->dataLength != 1u) ||
        (request->data[0] != g_stagedSlot) ||
        (g_stagedReceived != g_stagedBytes))
    {
        clearStaging();
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    internalCrc = getU32(
        &g_stagedBlob.bytes[CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_CRC_BYTES]);
    if (g_flashPrepared != 0u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, internalCrc);
        return;
    }
    if (core4VisionParamsBlobDecode(&g_stagedBlob, &params) ==
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_VALID)
    {
        sanitized = params;
        core4VisionParamsSanitize(&sanitized);
    }
    else
    {
        clearStaging();
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((internalCrc != g_stagedExpectedCrc) ||
        (crc32IeeeCalc(g_stagedBlob.bytes,
             CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_CRC_BYTES) != internalCrc) ||
        (memcmp(&sanitized, &params, sizeof(params)) != 0) ||
        (core4VisionParamsFlashPrepareSlot((uint8_t) (g_stagedSlot - 1u),
             &params, g_stagedTransactionId) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED))
    {
        clearStaging();
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_flashPrepared = 1u;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, internalCrc);
}

static void handleCommit(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if ((request->dataLength != 5u) ||
        (externalSlotValid(request->data[0]) == 0u))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    slot = request->data[0];
    transactionId = getU32(&request->data[1]);
    if ((g_stageKind != PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY) ||
        (g_stagedValid == 0u) || (g_flashPrepared == 0u) ||
        (slot != g_stagedSlot) || (transactionId != g_stagedTransactionId))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (g_flashCommitted != 0u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (core4VisionParamsFlashCommitPrepared((uint8_t) (slot - 1u),
            transactionId) != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_flashCommitted = 1u;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleActivate(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t slot;
    uint8_t oldSlotExternal, pendingSlot;
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if ((request->dataLength != 5u) ||
        (externalSlotValid(request->data[0]) == 0u))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    slot = request->data[0];
    transactionId = getU32(&request->data[1]);
    if (((transactionId != 0u) && ((g_stagedValid == 0u) ||
                                      (g_flashCommitted == 0u) ||
                                      (transactionId != g_stagedTransactionId) ||
                                      (slot != g_stagedSlot))))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        if (!g_syncMutationLocked || g_syncLockedSlot != slot ||
            g_stagedValid || g_flashPrepared ||
            g_flashCommitted)
        {
            publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        if (activationContext(&oldSlotExternal, &pendingSlot))
        {
            publish(request, pendingSlot == slot ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        oldSlotExternal = (uint8_t) (core4VisionParamsFlashGetActiveSlot() + 1u);
        if (!externalSlotValid(oldSlotExternal))
        {
            publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        setActivationContext(oldSlotExternal, slot);
    }
    if (!(transactionId == 0u ? activateRuntimeSlotPending(slot) :
            activatePreparedRuntimeSlot(slot, transactionId)))
    {
        if (transactionId == 0u) (void) rollbackActivation();
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleAbort(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (request->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    transactionId = getU32(request->data);
    if (transactionId == UINT32_MAX)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        uint8_t ok = rollbackActivation();
        if (ok) clearMutationLock();
        publish(request, ok ? PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK : PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (!g_stagedValid && !g_flashPrepared && !g_flashCommitted &&
        transactionId == g_lastAbortedTransaction)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (((g_stagedValid != 0u) &&
         (transactionId != g_stagedTransactionId)) ||
        (rollbackTransaction(transactionId) == 0u))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_lastAbortedTransaction = transactionId;
    clearStaging();
    clearMutationLock();
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleFinish(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint32_t transactionId;
    if (request->dataLength != 4u)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_INVALID, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    transactionId = getU32(request->data);
    if (transactionId == 0u)
    {
        if (core4VisionParamsFlashFinishPendingActivation() !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        {
            publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            return;
        }
        clearActivationContext();
        clearMutationLock();
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (!g_stagedValid && !g_flashPrepared && !g_flashCommitted &&
        transactionId == g_lastFinishedTransaction)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if ((g_stagedValid != 0u) &&
        (((g_stageKind == PARAM_STAGE_LIBRARY) &&
          (g_flashCommitted == 0u)) ||
         ((g_stageKind == PARAM_STAGE_RUNTIME) &&
          ((g_flashCommitted == 0u) || (g_runtimeApplied == 0u))) ||
         (transactionId != g_stagedTransactionId)))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    if (core4VisionParamsFlashFinishTransaction(transactionId) !=
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_lastFinishedTransaction = transactionId;
    clearStaging();
    clearMutationLock();
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static void handleLock(const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    uint8_t oldSlot, newSlot;
    uint32_t transactionId = (request->dataLength == 5u) ?
        getU32(&request->data[1]) : 0u;
    if (request->dataLength != 5u || request->data[0] > 5u ||
        transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX ||
        (g_syncMutationLocked && (g_syncLockedSlot != request->data[0] ||
         g_syncLockedTransaction != transactionId)) ||
        g_stagedValid || g_flashPrepared || g_flashCommitted ||
        core4VisionParamsFlashMutationPending() ||
        activationContext(&oldSlot, &newSlot))
    {
        publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_syncMutationLocked = 1u;
    g_syncLockedSlot = request->data[0];
    g_syncLockedTransaction = transactionId;
    publish(request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_OK, NULL, 0u, 0u);
}

static uint8_t retainedRequestMayResume(
    const paramSyncMailboxRequest *request)
{
    if (request->target != CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_QUERY ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_CHUNK ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_META ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_RECOVERY ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT ||
        request->op == PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH);
}

void core4ParamSyncOwnerServiceInit(void)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest retainedRequest;
    g_lastBootGeneration = 0u;
    g_lastRequestSequence = 0u;
    g_responseSequence = 0u;
    core4CoreDataTimingInit();
    if (g_ownerBootGeneration == 0u)
        g_ownerBootGeneration = core4CoreDataMakeBootGeneration(0xC4745053u);
    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&retainedRequest) != 0u &&
        retainedRequestMayResume(&retainedRequest) == 0u)
    {
        g_lastBootGeneration = retainedRequest.producerBootGeneration;
        g_lastRequestSequence = retainedRequest.sequence;
        if (retainedRequest.target == CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET)
            publish(&retainedRequest, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
    }
}

void core4ParamSyncOwnerServicePoll(void)
{
    paramSyncMailboxRequest request;
    if (g_ownerBootGeneration == 0u)
        g_ownerBootGeneration = core4CoreDataMakeBootGeneration(0xC4745053u);
    if (paramSyncMailboxTryReadRequest(&request) == 0u) return;
    if ((request.producerBootGeneration == g_lastBootGeneration) &&
        (request.sequence == g_lastRequestSequence)) return;
    if (request.producerBootGeneration == g_lastBootGeneration &&
        (int32_t) (request.sequence - g_lastRequestSequence) <= 0) return;
    if ((g_lastBootGeneration != 0u) &&
        (request.producerBootGeneration != g_lastBootGeneration) &&
        (producerBootChangeAllowed(&request) == 0u))
    {
        if (request.target == CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET)
            publish(&request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_BUSY, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    g_lastBootGeneration = request.producerBootGeneration;
    g_lastRequestSequence = request.sequence;
    if (request.target != CORE4_PARAM_SYNC_TARGET) return;
    if (recoverActivationAfterOwnerBoot() == 0u)
    {
        publish(&request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_FAILED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
        return;
    }
    switch (request.op)
    {
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_META: handleReadMeta(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_CHUNK: handleReadChunk(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_META:
            handleReadRuntimeMeta(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_READ_RUNTIME_CHUNK:
            handleReadRuntimeChunk(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_LIBRARY_FROM_LIVE:
            handlePrepareLibraryFromLive(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_RUNTIME_FROM_SLOT:
            handlePrepareRuntime(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT_RUNTIME:
            handleCommitRuntime(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_APPLY_RUNTIME:
            handleApplyRuntime(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_BEGIN: handlePrepareBegin(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_CHUNK: handlePrepareChunk(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_PREPARE_VERIFY: handlePrepareFinish(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_COMMIT: handleCommit(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_ACTIVATE: handleActivate(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_ABORT: handleAbort(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_FINISH: handleFinish(&request); break;
        case PARAM_SYNC_OP_LOCK: handleLock(&request); break;
        default:
            publish(&request, PARAM_SYNC_STATUS_REJECTED, NULL, 0u, 0u);
            break;
    }
}

#endif

#define HALF_PI                         (1.57079632679489661923f)

#define WHITE                           (255)
#define cReverse(x)                     ((x) ? BLACK : WHITE)

static inline float clampf(float value, float minValue, float maxValue)
{
    return (value < minValue) ? minValue : ((value > maxValue) ? maxValue : value);
}

static inline float wrapToPi(float angle)
{
    while (angle > PI)
    {
        angle -= TWO_PI;
    }
    while (angle < -PI)
    {
        angle += TWO_PI;
    }
    return angle;
}

#include "core4VisionParams.h"

#include <string.h>

static core4VisionParamsStruct g_activeParams;
static uint32_t g_revision;

static uint32_t clampU32(uint32_t value, uint32_t minimum, uint32_t maximum)
{
    if (value < minimum)
    {
        return minimum;
    }
    if (value > maximum)
    {
        return maximum;
    }
    return value;
}

static uint16_t clampU16(uint16_t value, uint16_t minimum, uint16_t maximum)
{
    if (value < minimum)
    {
        return minimum;
    }
    if (value > maximum)
    {
        return maximum;
    }
    return value;
}

void core4VisionParamsLoadDefaults(core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    if (params == NULL)
    {
        return;
    }

    memset(params, 0, sizeof(*params));
    params->exposure = CORE4_VISION_EXPOSURE_DEFAULT;
    params->hudPeriodMs = CORE4_VISION_HUD_PERIOD_DEFAULT_MS;
    params->previewPeriodMs = CORE4_VISION_PREVIEW_PERIOD_DEFAULT_MS;
    params->statsPeriodMs = CORE4_VISION_STATS_PERIOD_DEFAULT_MS;
    params->binaryLow = CORE4_VISION_BINARY_LOW_DEFAULT;
    params->binaryHigh = CORE4_VISION_BINARY_HIGH_DEFAULT;
    params->legacyCannyLow = CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_LOW_DEFAULT;
    params->legacyCannyHigh = CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_HIGH_DEFAULT;
}

void core4VisionParamsSanitize(core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    if (params == NULL)
    {
        return;
    }

    if (params->exposure < CORE4_VISION_EXPOSURE_MIN)
    {
        params->exposure = CORE4_VISION_EXPOSURE_MIN;
    }
    if (params->exposure > CORE4_VISION_EXPOSURE_MAX)
    {
        params->exposure = CORE4_VISION_EXPOSURE_MAX;
    }
    params->hudPeriodMs = clampU32(params->hudPeriodMs,
        CORE4_VISION_HUD_PERIOD_MIN_MS,
        CORE4_VISION_HUD_PERIOD_MAX_MS);
    params->previewPeriodMs = clampU32(params->previewPeriodMs,
        CORE4_VISION_PREVIEW_PERIOD_MIN_MS,
        CORE4_VISION_PREVIEW_PERIOD_MAX_MS);
    params->statsPeriodMs = clampU32(params->statsPeriodMs,
        CORE4_VISION_STATS_PERIOD_MIN_MS,
        CORE4_VISION_STATS_PERIOD_MAX_MS);
    params->binaryLow = clampU16(params->binaryLow,
        CORE4_VISION_BINARY_MIN,
        CORE4_VISION_BINARY_MAX);
    params->binaryHigh = clampU16(params->binaryHigh,
        CORE4_VISION_BINARY_MIN,
        CORE4_VISION_BINARY_MAX);
    if (params->binaryLow > params->binaryHigh)
    {
        params->binaryLow = params->binaryHigh;
    }
    params->legacyCannyLow = clampU16(params->legacyCannyLow,
        CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_MIN,
        CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_MAX);
    params->legacyCannyHigh = clampU16(params->legacyCannyHigh,
        CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_MIN,
        CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_MAX);
    if ((uint32_t) params->legacyCannyLow + CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_GAP >
        params->legacyCannyHigh)
    {
        if (params->legacyCannyHigh >=
            (CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_MIN + CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_GAP))
        {
            params->legacyCannyLow = (uint16_t) (params->legacyCannyHigh -
                                                 CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_GAP);
        }
        else
        {
            params->legacyCannyLow = CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_MIN;
            params->legacyCannyHigh = (uint16_t) (CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_MIN +
                                                  CORE4_VISION_LEGACY_CANNY_GAP);
        }
    }
}

void core4VisionParamsSetInitial(const core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    if (params == NULL)
    {
        return;
    }

    g_activeParams = *params;
    core4VisionParamsSanitize(&g_activeParams);
    g_revision = 1u;
}

void core4VisionParamsCommit(const core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    if (params == NULL)
    {
        return;
    }

    g_activeParams = *params;
    core4VisionParamsSanitize(&g_activeParams);
    g_revision++;
    if (g_revision == 0u) g_revision = 1u;
}

const core4VisionParamsStruct *core4VisionParamsGetActive(void)
{
    return &g_activeParams;
}

uint32_t core4VisionParamsGetRevision(void)
{
    return g_revision;
}
