static void saturatingIncrement(uint32_t *value)
{
    if (*value < UINT32_MAX) (*value)++;
}

static void ensureFlashReady(void)
{
    if (g_flashReady == 0u)
    {
        flash_init();
        g_flashReady = 1u;
    }
}

static uintptr_t flashPageAddress(uint32_t page)
{
    return (uintptr_t) FLASH_BASE_ADDR + (uintptr_t) page * FLASH_PAGE_SIZE;
}

static const uint32_t *flashWordAddress(uint32_t page, uint32_t wordIndex)
{
    return (const uint32_t *) (uintptr_t)
        (flashPageAddress(page) + wordIndex * sizeof(uint32_t));
}

static core4FlashRangeState blankCheckRange(uint32_t page,
    uint32_t firstWord,
    uint32_t wordCount)
{
    cy_stc_flash_blankcheck_config_t config = {0};
    cy_en_flashdrv_status_t status;

    if ((page >= FLASH_PAGE_NUM) || (wordCount == 0u) ||
        (firstWord >= CORE4_FLASH_PAGE_WORDS) ||
        (wordCount > (CORE4_FLASH_PAGE_WORDS - firstWord)))
    {
        return CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_IO_FAILED;
    }
    config.addrToBeChecked = flashWordAddress(page, firstWord);
    config.numOfWordsToBeChecked = wordCount;
    status = Cy_Flash_BlankCheck(NULL, &config, CY_FLASH_DRIVER_BLOCKING);
    if (status == CY_FLASH_DRV_SUCCESS) return CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK;
    if (status == CY_FLASH_DRV_FLASH_NOT_ERASED) return CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_PROGRAMMED;
    return CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_IO_FAILED;
}

static void invalidateFlashWordCache(const uint32_t *wordAddress)
{
#if CY_CORE_CM7_0 || CY_CORE_CM7_1
    uintptr_t cacheLine = ((uintptr_t) wordAddress) & ~(uintptr_t) 31u;
    SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((uint32_t *) cacheLine, 32);
#else
    (void) wordAddress;
#endif
}

static uint8_t readFlashWordSafely(uint32_t page,
    uint32_t wordIndex,
    uint32_t *value)
{
    const uint32_t *address;
    core4FlashRangeState state;

    if ((value == NULL) || (wordIndex >= CORE4_FLASH_PAGE_WORDS)) return 1u;
    state = blankCheckRange(page, wordIndex, 1u);
    if (state == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK)
    {
        *value = UINT32_MAX;
        return 0u;
    }
    if (state != CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_PROGRAMMED) return 1u;
    address = flashWordAddress(page, wordIndex);
    invalidateFlashWordCache(address);
    *value = *((const volatile uint32_t *) address);
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t readPageBytes(uint32_t page, void *data, uint32_t length)
{
    uint32_t words;
    uint32_t i;

    if ((data == NULL) || (length == 0u)) return 1u;
    words = (length + 3u) / 4u;
    if (words > CORE4_SLOT_MAX_WORDS) return 1u;
    memset(g_flashWords, 0xFF, sizeof(g_flashWords));
    for (i = 0u; i < words; i++)
    {
        if (readFlashWordSafely(page, i, &g_flashWords[i]) != 0u) return 1u;
    }
    if (data != g_flashWords)
    {
        memcpy(data, g_flashWords, length);
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t erasePage(uint32_t page)
{
    cy_stc_flash_erasesector_config_t config = {0};
    cy_en_flashdrv_status_t status;

    config.blocking = CY_FLASH_ERASESECTOR_BLOCKING;
    config.intrMask = CY_FLASH_ERASESECTOR_NOT_SET_INTR_MASK;
    config.Addr = flashWordAddress(page, 0u);
    status = Cy_Flash_EraseSector(NULL, &config, CY_FLASH_DRIVER_BLOCKING);
    if (status != CY_FLASH_DRV_SUCCESS) return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) (blankCheckRange(page, 0u, CORE4_FLASH_PAGE_WORDS) ==
        CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK ? 0u : 1u);
}

static uint8_t programFlashWord(uint32_t page,
    uint32_t wordIndex,
    const uint32_t *value)
{
    cy_stc_flash_programrow_config_t config = {0};
    cy_en_flashdrv_status_t status;

    if ((value == NULL) || (wordIndex >= CORE4_FLASH_PAGE_WORDS)) return 1u;
    config.blocking = CY_FLASH_PROGRAMROW_BLOCKING;
    config.skipBC = CY_FLASH_PROGRAMROW_BLANK_CHECK;
    config.dataSize = CY_FLASH_PROGRAMROW_DATA_SIZE_32BIT;
    config.dataLoc = CY_FLASH_PROGRAMROW_DATA_LOCATION_SRAM;
    config.intrMask = CY_FLASH_PROGRAMROW_NOT_SET_INTR_MASK;
    config.destAddr = flashWordAddress(page, wordIndex);
    config.dataAddr = value;
#if CY_CORE_CM7_0 || CY_CORE_CM7_1
    {
        uintptr_t start = ((uintptr_t) value) & ~(uintptr_t) 31u;
        uintptr_t end = (((uintptr_t) value + sizeof(*value) + 31u) &
            ~(uintptr_t) 31u);
        SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((volatile void *) start,
            (int32_t) (end - start));
    }
#endif
    status = Cy_Flash_ProgramRow(NULL, &config, CY_FLASH_DRIVER_BLOCKING);
    return (uint8_t) (status == CY_FLASH_DRV_SUCCESS ? 0u : 1u);
}

static uint8_t writePageAtomic(uint32_t page, const void *data, uint32_t length)
{
    uint32_t words;
    uint32_t readback;
    uint32_t i;

    if ((data == NULL) || (length == 0u)) return 1u;
    words = (length + 3u) / 4u;
    if (words > CORE4_SLOT_MAX_WORDS) return 1u;
    if (erasePage(page) != 0u) return 1u;
    memset(g_flashWords, 0xFF, sizeof(g_flashWords));
    memcpy(g_flashWords, data, length);
    for (i = 1u; i < words; i++)
    {
        if ((programFlashWord(page, i, &g_flashWords[i]) != 0u) ||
            (readFlashWordSafely(page, i, &readback) != 0u) ||
            (readback != g_flashWords[i])) return 1u;
    }
    if (programFlashWord(page, 0u, &g_flashWords[0]) != 0u) return 1u;
    memset(g_flashWords, 0xFF, sizeof(g_flashWords));
    if (readPageBytes(page, g_flashWords, length) != 0u) return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) (memcmp(data, g_flashWords, length) == 0 ? 0u : 1u);
}

static uint8_t selectorSlotStateValid(uint32_t slot, uint32_t bank,
    uint32_t valid, uint32_t generation, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    if ((slot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) || (bank > 1u) ||
        (valid > CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY)) return 0u;
    if (valid == 0u)
        return (uint8_t) ((bank == 0u) && (generation == 0u) &&
            (transactionId == 0u));
    if (generation == 0u) return 0u;
    if (valid == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY)
        return (uint8_t) ((slot == 0u) && (bank == 0u) &&
            (generation == 1u) &&
            (transactionId == 0u));
    return (uint8_t) (transactionId != UINT32_MAX);
}

static uint8_t selectorValid(const core4SlotSelector *selector)
{
    uint32_t i;
    uint32_t crc;
    uint8_t anyValid = 0u;

    if ((selector->magic != CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_MAGIC) ||
        (selector->version != CORE4_SLOT_STORE_VERSION) ||
        (selector->generation == 0u) ||
        (selector->activeSlot > CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT)) return 0u;
    for (i = 0u; i < CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
    {
        if (selectorSlotStateValid(i, selector->bank[i],
            selector->valid[i], selector->slotGeneration[i],
            selector->transactionId[i]) == 0u) return 0u;
        if (selector->valid[i] != 0u) anyValid = 1u;
    }
    if ((anyValid == 0u &&
         selector->activeSlot != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
        (anyValid != 0u &&
         (selector->activeSlot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT ||
          selector->valid[selector->activeSlot] == 0u))) return 0u;
    if (selector->pendingTransactionId != 0u)
    {
        uint32_t slot = selector->rollbackSlot;
        if ((slot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
            (selector->rollbackActiveSlot >
                CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
            (selector->valid[slot] == 0u) ||
            (selector->slotGeneration[slot] == 0u) ||
            (selectorSlotStateValid(slot, selector->rollbackBank,
                selector->rollbackValid, selector->rollbackGeneration,
                selector->rollbackTransactionId) == 0u)) return 0u;
        if (selector->rollbackActiveSlot == slot)
        {
            if (selector->rollbackValid == 0u) return 0u;
        }
        else if ((selector->rollbackActiveSlot <
                    CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) &&
                 (selector->valid[selector->rollbackActiveSlot] == 0u))
            return 0u;
        if (selector->pendingTransactionId == UINT32_MAX)
        {
            if ((selector->activeSlot != slot) ||
                (selector->rollbackBank != selector->bank[slot]) ||
                (selector->rollbackValid != selector->valid[slot]) ||
                (selector->rollbackGeneration !=
                    selector->slotGeneration[slot]) ||
                (selector->rollbackTransactionId !=
                    selector->transactionId[slot])) return 0u;
        }
        else if (((selector->activeSlot !=
                    selector->rollbackActiveSlot) &&
                  (selector->activeSlot != slot)) ||
                 (selector->valid[slot] != CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD) ||
                 (selector->transactionId[slot] !=
                    selector->pendingTransactionId)) return 0u;
        else
        {
            uint32_t expectedGeneration =
                selector->rollbackGeneration + 1u;
            uint32_t expectedBank = 0u;
            if (expectedGeneration == 0u) expectedGeneration = 1u;
            if (selector->rollbackValid == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD)
                expectedBank = selector->rollbackBank ^ 1u;
            else if (selector->rollbackValid == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY)
                expectedBank = 1u;
            if ((selector->bank[slot] != expectedBank) ||
                (selector->slotGeneration[slot] != expectedGeneration))
                return 0u;
        }
    }
    else if ((selector->rollbackActiveSlot != 0u) ||
             (selector->rollbackSlot != 0u) ||
             (selector->rollbackBank != 0u) ||
             (selector->rollbackValid != 0u) ||
             (selector->rollbackGeneration != 0u) ||
             (selector->rollbackTransactionId != 0u))
    {
        return 0u;
    }
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) selector,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4SlotSelector, crc));
    return (uint8_t) (crc == selector->crc ? 1u : 0u);
}

static uint8_t selectorNewer(uint32_t candidate, uint32_t current)
{
    return (uint8_t) ((int32_t) (candidate - current) > 0 ? 1u : 0u);
}

static core4SelectorLoadState loadSelector(void)
{
    const uint32_t pages[2u] = {CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A, CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B};
    uint8_t found = 0u;
    uint8_t blankFound = 0u;
    uint8_t programmedInvalid = 0u;
    uint8_t committedInvalid = 0u;
    uint32_t p, record, word;
    for (p = 0u; p < 2u; p++)
    {
        for (record = 0u; record < CORE4_SELECTOR_RECORDS; record++)
        {
            core4SlotSelector candidate;
            uint32_t *words = (uint32_t *) (void *) &candidate;
            core4FlashRangeState state = blankCheckRange(pages[p],
                record * CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS, CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS);
            if (state == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_IO_FAILED) return CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
            if (state == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK)
            {
                blankFound = 1u;
                continue;
            }
            memset(&candidate, 0xFF, sizeof(candidate));
            for (word = 0u; word < CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS; word++)
                if (readFlashWordSafely(pages[p], record * CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS + word,
                    &words[word]) != 0u) return CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
            if (selectorValid(&candidate) == 0u)
            {
                programmedInvalid = 1u;
                if (candidate.magic == CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_MAGIC)
                    committedInvalid = 1u;
            }
            else if (!found ||
                selectorNewer(candidate.generation, g_selector.generation))
            {
                g_selector = candidate;
                g_selectorPage = (uint8_t) pages[p];
                g_selectorRecord = (uint8_t) record;
                found = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    if (committedInvalid != 0u && found != 0u)
    {
        g_selectorReady = 1u;
        return CORE4_SELECTOR_REPAIR_LAST_GOOD;
    }
    g_selectorReady = found;
    if (found) return CORE4_SELECTOR_VALID;
    if (programmedInvalid) return CORE4_SELECTOR_REBUILD_FROM_DATA;
    return blankFound ? CORE4_SELECTOR_NONE : CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
}

static uint8_t resolveSelectorUncertainty(void)
{
    core4SelectorLoadState state;
    if (g_selectorUncertain == 0u) return 0u;
    state = loadSelector();
    if ((state != CORE4_SELECTOR_VALID) &&
        (state != CORE4_SELECTOR_NONE)) return 1u;
    if (state == CORE4_SELECTOR_NONE)
    {
        if (g_selectorUncertainHadDurable != 0u) return 1u;
        memset(&g_selector, 0, sizeof(g_selector));
        g_selectorReady = 0u;
        g_selectorPage = 0u;
        g_selectorRecord = 0u;
    }
    g_selectorUncertain = 0u;
    g_selectorUncertainHadDurable = 0u;
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t reconcileSelectorWrite(const core4SlotSelector *expected)
{
    g_selectorUncertain = 1u;
    if (resolveSelectorUncertainty() != 0u) return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) ((g_selectorReady != 0u) &&
        (memcmp(&g_selector, expected, sizeof(*expected)) == 0) ? 0u : 1u);
}

static uint8_t writeSelector(const core4SlotSelector *candidate)
{
    core4SlotSelector stored = *candidate;
    core4SlotSelector verified;
    const uint32_t *words;
    uint32_t page = CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
    uint32_t record = 0u;
    uint32_t word;

    if (g_selectorUncertain != 0u)
    {
        if (resolveSelectorUncertainty() != 0u) return 1u;
        return 1u;
    }

    stored.magic = CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_MAGIC;
    stored.version = CORE4_SLOT_STORE_VERSION;
    stored.crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &stored,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4SlotSelector, crc));
    g_selectorUncertainHadDurable = g_selectorReady;
    if (g_selectorReady)
    {
        page = g_selectorPage;
        for (record = (uint32_t) g_selectorRecord + 1u;
             record < CORE4_SELECTOR_RECORDS; record++)
            if (blankCheckRange(page, record * CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS,
                CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS) == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK) break;
        if (record >= CORE4_SELECTOR_RECORDS)
        {
            page = (page == CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A) ?
                CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B : CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
            if (erasePage(page) != 0u) return 1u;
            record = 0u;
        }
    }
    else if (blankCheckRange(page, 0u, CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS) != CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK &&
             erasePage(page) != 0u) return 1u;
    words = (const uint32_t *) (const void *) &stored;
    for (word = 1u; word < CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS; word++)
        if (programFlashWord(page, record * CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS + word,
            &words[word]) != 0u) return 1u;
    if (programFlashWord(page, record * CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS, &words[0]) != 0u)
        return reconcileSelectorWrite(&stored);
    {
        uint32_t *verifyWords = (uint32_t *) (void *) &verified;
        for (word = 0u; word < CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS; word++)
            if (readFlashWordSafely(page, record * CORE4_SELECTOR_WORDS + word,
                &verifyWords[word]) != 0u) return reconcileSelectorWrite(&stored);
    }
    if (!selectorValid(&verified) || memcmp(&verified, &stored, sizeof(stored)) != 0)
        return reconcileSelectorWrite(&stored);
    g_selector = stored;
    g_selectorPage = (uint8_t) page;
    g_selectorRecord = (uint8_t) record;
    g_selectorReady = 1u;
    g_selectorUncertain = 0u;
    g_selectorUncertainHadDurable = 0u;
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t runtimeSelectorValid(const core4RuntimeSelector *selector)
{
    uint32_t crc;
    uint32_t expectedGeneration;
    if ((selector->magic != CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_MAGIC) ||
        (selector->version != CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_VERSION) ||
        (selector->recordBytes != CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES) ||
        (selector->sequence == 0u) ||
        (selector->bank > 1u) || (selector->valid != 1u) ||
        (selector->pending > 1u) ||
        (selector->sourceSlot > CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
        (selector->rollbackBank > 1u) ||
        (selector->rollbackValid > 1u) ||
        (selector->rollbackSourceSlot > CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
        (selector->generation == 0u) ||
        (selector->reserved0 != 0u) || (selector->reserved[0u] != 0u) ||
        (selector->reserved[1u] != 0u) || (selector->reserved[2u] != 0u))
        return 0u;
    if (selector->pending == 0u)
    {
        if ((selector->rollbackBank != 0u) ||
            (selector->rollbackValid != 0u) ||
            (selector->rollbackSourceSlot != 0u) ||
            (selector->rollbackGeneration != 0u) ||
            (selector->rollbackBlobCrc != 0u) ||
            (selector->rollbackTransactionId != 0u)) return 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        expectedGeneration = selector->rollbackGeneration + 1u;
        if (expectedGeneration == 0u) expectedGeneration = 1u;
        if ((selector->transactionId == 0u) ||
            (selector->rollbackValid != 1u) ||
            (selector->rollbackGeneration == 0u) ||
            (selector->bank == selector->rollbackBank) ||
            (selector->generation != expectedGeneration)) return 0u;
    }
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) selector,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4RuntimeSelector, crc));
    return (uint8_t) (crc == selector->crc ? 1u : 0u);
}

static core4SelectorLoadState loadRuntimeSelector(void)
{
    const uint32_t pages[2u] = {CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A,
        CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_B};
    uint8_t found = 0u;
    uint8_t blankFound = 0u;
    uint8_t programmedInvalid = 0u;
    uint8_t committedInvalid = 0u;
    uint32_t p, record, word;
    for (p = 0u; p < 2u; p++)
    {
        for (record = 0u; record < CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS; record++)
        {
            core4RuntimeSelector candidate;
            uint32_t *words = (uint32_t *) (void *) &candidate;
            core4FlashRangeState state = blankCheckRange(pages[p],
                record * CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS,
                CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS);
            if (state == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_IO_FAILED) return CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
            if (state == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK)
            {
                blankFound = 1u;
                continue;
            }
            memset(&candidate, 0xFF, sizeof(candidate));
            for (word = 0u; word < CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS; word++)
                if (readFlashWordSafely(pages[p],
                    record * CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS + word,
                    &words[word]) != 0u) return CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
            if (runtimeSelectorValid(&candidate) == 0u)
            {
                programmedInvalid = 1u;
                if (candidate.magic == CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_MAGIC)
                    committedInvalid = 1u;
            }
            else if (!found || selectorNewer(candidate.sequence,
                g_runtimeSelector.sequence))
            {
                g_runtimeSelector = candidate;
                g_runtimeSelectorPage = (uint8_t) pages[p];
                g_runtimeSelectorRecord = (uint8_t) record;
                found = 1u;
            }
        }
    }
    if (committedInvalid != 0u)
    {
        g_runtimeSelectorReady = 0u;
        return CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
    }
    g_runtimeSelectorReady = found;
    if (found) return CORE4_SELECTOR_VALID;
    if (programmedInvalid) return CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
    return blankFound ? CORE4_SELECTOR_NONE : CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
}

static uint8_t resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty(void)
{
    core4SelectorLoadState state;
    if (g_runtimeSelectorUncertain == 0u) return 0u;
    state = loadRuntimeSelector();
    if (state == CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT) return 1u;
    if (state == CORE4_SELECTOR_NONE)
    {
        if (g_runtimeSelectorUncertainHadDurable != 0u) return 1u;
        memset(&g_runtimeSelector, 0, sizeof(g_runtimeSelector));
        g_runtimeSelectorReady = 0u;
        g_runtimeSelectorPage = 0u;
        g_runtimeSelectorRecord = 0u;
    }
    g_runtimeSelectorUncertain = 0u;
    g_runtimeSelectorUncertainHadDurable = 0u;
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t reconcileRuntimeSelectorWrite(
    const core4RuntimeSelector *expected)
{
    g_runtimeSelectorUncertain = 1u;
    if (resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty() != 0u) return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) ((g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) &&
        (memcmp(&g_runtimeSelector, expected, sizeof(*expected)) == 0) ? 0u : 1u);
}

static uint8_t writeRuntimeSelector(const core4RuntimeSelector *candidate)
{
    core4RuntimeSelector stored = *candidate;
    core4RuntimeSelector verified;
    const uint32_t *words;
    uint32_t page = CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
    uint32_t record = 0u;
    uint32_t word;

    if (g_runtimeSelectorUncertain != 0u)
    {
        if (resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty() != 0u) return 1u;
        return 1u;
    }
    stored.magic = CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_MAGIC;
    stored.version = CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_VERSION;
    stored.recordBytes = CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_BYTES;
    stored.sequence = g_runtimeSelectorReady ?
        g_runtimeSelector.sequence + 1u : 1u;
    if (stored.sequence == 0u) stored.sequence = 1u;
    stored.crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &stored,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4RuntimeSelector, crc));
    g_runtimeSelectorUncertainHadDurable = g_runtimeSelectorReady;
    if (g_runtimeSelectorReady)
    {
        page = g_runtimeSelectorPage;
        for (record = (uint32_t) g_runtimeSelectorRecord + 1u;
             record < CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS; record++)
            if (blankCheckRange(page,
                record * CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS,
                CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS) == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK) break;
        if (record >= CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_RECORDS)
        {
            page = (page == CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A) ?
                CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_B : CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_PAGE_A;
            if (erasePage(page) != 0u) return 1u;
            record = 0u;
        }
    }
    else if (blankCheckRange(page, 0u, CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS) !=
        CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK && erasePage(page) != 0u) return 1u;
    words = (const uint32_t *) (const void *) &stored;
    for (word = 1u; word < CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS; word++)
        if (programFlashWord(page,
            record * CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS + word,
            &words[word]) != 0u) return 1u;
    if (programFlashWord(page, record * CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS,
        &words[0]) != 0u) return reconcileRuntimeSelectorWrite(&stored);
    {
        uint32_t *verifyWords = (uint32_t *) (void *) &verified;
        for (word = 0u; word < CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS; word++)
            if (readFlashWordSafely(page,
                record * CORE4_RUNTIME_SELECTOR_WORDS + word,
                &verifyWords[word]) != 0u)
                return reconcileRuntimeSelectorWrite(&stored);
    }
    if (!runtimeSelectorValid(&verified) ||
        memcmp(&verified, &stored, sizeof(stored)) != 0)
        return reconcileRuntimeSelectorWrite(&stored);
    g_runtimeSelector = stored;
    g_runtimeSelectorPage = (uint8_t) page;
    g_runtimeSelectorRecord = (uint8_t) record;
    g_runtimeSelectorReady = 1u;
    g_runtimeSelectorUncertain = 0u;
    g_runtimeSelectorUncertainHadDurable = 0u;
    return 0u;
}

static uint32_t runtimeDataPage(uint8_t bank)
{
    return bank != 0u ? CORE4_RUNTIME_DATA_PAGE_B :
        CORE4_RUNTIME_DATA_PAGE_A;
}

static uint8_t readRuntimeBank(uint8_t bank, uint32_t blobCrc,
    core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;
    if ((bank > 1u) || (params == NULL) ||
        (readPageBytes(runtimeDataPage(bank), &blob, sizeof(blob)) != 0u) ||
        (crc32IeeeCalc(blob.bytes, CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES) != blobCrc) ||
        (core4VisionParamsBlobDecode(&blob, params) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_VALID)) return 1u;
    core4VisionParamsSanitize(params);
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t writeRuntimeBank(uint8_t bank,
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params, uint32_t *blobCrc)
{
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;
    core4VisionParamsStruct sanitized;
    core4VisionParamsStruct verified;
    if ((bank > 1u) || (params == NULL) || (blobCrc == NULL)) return 1u;
    sanitized = *params;
    core4VisionParamsSanitize(&sanitized);
    core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(&sanitized, &blob);
    *blobCrc = crc32IeeeCalc(blob.bytes, CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES);
    if ((writePageAtomic(runtimeDataPage(bank), &blob, sizeof(blob)) != 0u) ||
        (readRuntimeBank(bank, *blobCrc, &verified) != 0u) ||
        (memcmp(&sanitized, &verified, sizeof(sanitized)) != 0)) return 1u;
    return 0u;
}

static void clearRuntimePrepared(void)
{
    memset(&g_runtimePrepared, 0, sizeof(g_runtimePrepared));
}

static uint8_t committedRuntimeSelector(core4RuntimeSelector *committed)
{
    if ((committed == NULL) || (g_runtimeSelectorReady == 0u)) return 1u;
    *committed = g_runtimeSelector;
    if (committed->pending != 0u)
    {
        if (committed->rollbackValid == 0u) return 1u;
        committed->bank = committed->rollbackBank;
        committed->valid = committed->rollbackValid;
        committed->pending = 0u;
        committed->sourceSlot = committed->rollbackSourceSlot;
        committed->generation = committed->rollbackGeneration;
        committed->blobCrc = committed->rollbackBlobCrc;
        committed->transactionId = committed->rollbackTransactionId;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static core4VisionParamsLoadStatus readRuntimeCommitted(
    core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    core4RuntimeSelector committed;
    if ((params == NULL) || (resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty() != 0u) ||
        (committedRuntimeSelector(&committed) != 0u) ||
        (readRuntimeBank(committed.bank, committed.blobCrc, params) != 0u))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
}

static core4VisionParamsSaveStatus prepareRuntimeInternal(
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params, uint32_t transactionId,
    uint8_t sourceSlot)
{
    uint8_t bank;
    if ((params == NULL) ||
        (sourceSlot > CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
        (resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty() != 0u) ||
        (g_runtimePrepared.valid != 0u) ||
        ((g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) &&
         (g_runtimeSelector.pending != 0u)))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    bank = (g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) ?
        (uint8_t) (g_runtimeSelector.bank ^ 1u) : 0u;
    memset(&g_runtimePrepared, 0, sizeof(g_runtimePrepared));
    if (writeRuntimeBank(bank, params, &g_runtimePrepared.blobCrc) != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFY_FAILED;
    g_runtimePrepared.transactionId = transactionId;
    g_runtimePrepared.generation = (g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) ?
        g_runtimeSelector.generation + 1u : 1u;
    if (g_runtimePrepared.generation == 0u)
        g_runtimePrepared.generation = 1u;
    g_runtimePrepared.sourceSlot = sourceSlot;
    g_runtimePrepared.bank = bank;
    g_runtimePrepared.valid = 1u;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

static core4VisionParamsSaveStatus commitRuntimeInternal(
    uint32_t transactionId, uint8_t pending)
{
    core4RuntimeSelector next;
    if ((g_runtimePrepared.valid == 0u) ||
        (g_runtimePrepared.committed != 0u) ||
        (g_runtimePrepared.transactionId != transactionId) ||
        ((pending != 0u) && ((transactionId == 0u) ||
         (g_runtimeSelectorReady == 0u))))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    memset(&next, 0, sizeof(next));
    if (g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) next = g_runtimeSelector;
    if (pending != 0u)
    {
        next.rollbackBank = g_runtimeSelector.bank;
        next.rollbackValid = g_runtimeSelector.valid;
        next.rollbackSourceSlot = g_runtimeSelector.sourceSlot;
        next.rollbackGeneration = g_runtimeSelector.generation;
        next.rollbackBlobCrc = g_runtimeSelector.blobCrc;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = g_runtimeSelector.transactionId;
    }
    else
    {
        next.rollbackBank = 0u;
        next.rollbackValid = 0u;
        next.rollbackSourceSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
        next.rollbackBlobCrc = 0u;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
    }
    next.bank = g_runtimePrepared.bank;
    next.valid = 1u;
    next.pending = (uint8_t) (pending != 0u);
    next.sourceSlot = g_runtimePrepared.sourceSlot;
    next.generation = g_runtimePrepared.generation;
    next.blobCrc = g_runtimePrepared.blobCrc;
    next.transactionId = transactionId;
    memset(next.reserved, 0, sizeof(next.reserved));
    if (writeRuntimeSelector(&next) != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    g_runtimePrepared.committed = 1u;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

static core4VisionParamsSaveStatus saveRuntimeFinal(
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params, uint8_t sourceSlot)
{
    core4VisionParamsSaveStatus status = prepareRuntimeInternal(params, 0u,
        sourceSlot);
    if (status == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        status = commitRuntimeInternal(0u, 0u);
    if ((status == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED) ||
        (g_runtimePrepared.committed == 0u)) clearRuntimePrepared();
    return status;
}

static core4VisionParamsSaveStatus abortRuntimeTransaction(
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4RuntimeSelector next;
    if (resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty() != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    if ((g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) &&
        (g_runtimeSelector.pending != 0u))
    {
        if ((g_runtimeSelector.transactionId != transactionId) ||
            (g_runtimeSelector.rollbackValid == 0u))
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
        next = g_runtimeSelector;
        next.bank = next.rollbackBank;
        next.valid = next.rollbackValid;
        next.pending = 0u;
        next.sourceSlot = next.rollbackSourceSlot;
        next.generation = next.rollbackGeneration;
        next.blobCrc = next.rollbackBlobCrc;
        next.transactionId = next.rollbackTransactionId;
        next.rollbackBank = 0u;
        next.rollbackValid = 0u;
        next.rollbackSourceSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
        next.rollbackBlobCrc = 0u;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
        memset(next.reserved, 0, sizeof(next.reserved));
        if (writeRuntimeSelector(&next) != 0u)
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    }
    else if ((g_runtimePrepared.valid != 0u) &&
        (g_runtimePrepared.transactionId != transactionId))
    {
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    }
    clearRuntimePrepared();
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

static core4VisionParamsSaveStatus finishRuntimeTransaction(
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4RuntimeSelector next;
    core4VisionParamsStruct verified;
    if (resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty() != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    if ((g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) &&
        (g_runtimeSelector.pending != 0u))
    {
        if ((g_runtimeSelector.transactionId != transactionId) ||
            (readRuntimeBank(g_runtimeSelector.bank,
                g_runtimeSelector.blobCrc, &verified) != 0u))
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFY_FAILED;
        next = g_runtimeSelector;
        next.pending = 0u;
        next.rollbackBank = 0u;
        next.rollbackValid = 0u;
        next.rollbackSourceSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
        next.rollbackBlobCrc = 0u;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
        memset(next.reserved, 0, sizeof(next.reserved));
        if (writeRuntimeSelector(&next) != 0u)
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    }
    else if ((g_runtimePrepared.valid != 0u) &&
        (g_runtimePrepared.transactionId != transactionId))
    {
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    }
    clearRuntimePrepared();
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

static core4VisionParamsSaveStatus applyCommittedRuntime(void)
{
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    if (readRuntimeCommitted(&params) != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    core4VisionParamsCommit(&params);
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

static uint8_t recoverPendingSelector(void)
{
    core4SlotSelector rollback;
    uint32_t slot;
    if (g_selector.pendingTransactionId == 0u) return 0u;
    slot = g_selector.rollbackSlot;
    if (slot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT ||
        g_selector.rollbackActiveSlot > CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT ||
        g_selector.rollbackBank > 1u ||
        g_selector.rollbackValid > CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY) return 1u;
    rollback = g_selector;
    rollback.generation++;
    if (rollback.generation == 0u) rollback.generation = 1u;
    rollback.activeSlot = g_selector.rollbackActiveSlot;
    rollback.bank[slot] = g_selector.rollbackBank;
    rollback.valid[slot] = g_selector.rollbackValid;
    rollback.slotGeneration[slot] = g_selector.rollbackGeneration;
    rollback.transactionId[slot] = g_selector.rollbackTransactionId;
    rollback.pendingTransactionId = 0u;
    rollback.rollbackActiveSlot = 0u;
    rollback.rollbackSlot = 0u;
    rollback.rollbackBank = 0u;
    rollback.rollbackValid = 0u;
    rollback.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
    rollback.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
    return writeSelector(&rollback);
}

static uint32_t slotPage(uint8_t slot, uint8_t bank)
{
    return (uint32_t) slot * 2u + (uint32_t) bank;
}

static uint8_t decodeLegacyPage(core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;

    if (readPageBytes(0u, &blob, sizeof(blob)) != 0u) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (core4VisionParamsBlobDecode(&blob, params) ==
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_VALID ? 1u : 0u);
}

static uint8_t decodeSlotRecord(uint8_t slot,
    uint8_t bank,
    core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    core4SlotRecord record;
    uint32_t crc;

    if (readPageBytes(slotPage(slot, bank), &record, sizeof(record)) != 0u) return 0u;
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &record,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4SlotRecord, crc));
    if ((record.magic != CORE4_SLOT_RECORD_MAGIC) ||
        (record.version != CORE4_SLOT_STORE_VERSION) ||
        (record.slot != slot) ||
        (record.payloadBytes != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES) ||
        (record.crc != crc) ||
        (core4VisionParamsBlobDecode(&record.payload, params) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_VALID)) return 0u;
    return 1u;
}

static uint8_t readRecoverableSlotRecord(uint8_t slot, uint8_t bank,
    uint8_t *valid, uint32_t *generation)
{
    core4SlotRecord record;
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    uint32_t crc;

    *valid = 0u;
    *generation = 0u;
    if (readPageBytes(slotPage(slot, bank), &record, sizeof(record)) != 0u)
        return 1u;
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &record,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4SlotRecord, crc));
    if ((record.magic == CORE4_SLOT_RECORD_MAGIC) &&
        (record.version == CORE4_SLOT_STORE_VERSION) &&
        (record.slot == slot) && (record.generation != 0u) &&
        (record.transactionId != UINT32_MAX) &&
        (record.payloadBytes == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES) &&
        (record.crc == crc) &&
        (core4VisionParamsBlobDecode(&record.payload, &params) ==
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_VALID))
    {
        *valid = 1u;
        *generation = record.generation;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t readRecoverableLegacy(uint8_t *valid)
{
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;

    *valid = 0u;
    if (readPageBytes(0u, &blob, sizeof(blob)) != 0u) return 1u;
    if (core4VisionParamsBlobDecode(&blob, &params) ==
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_VALID) *valid = 1u;
    return 0u;
}

static uint8_t rebuildLibrarySelector(core4SelectorLoadState state)
{
    core4SlotSelector recovered;
    uint8_t slot;

    if (state == CORE4_SELECTOR_REPAIR_LAST_GOOD)
    {
        recovered = g_selector;
    }
    else if (state == CORE4_SELECTOR_REBUILD_FROM_DATA)
    {
        memset(&recovered, 0, sizeof(recovered));
        recovered.generation = 1u;
        recovered.activeSlot = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT;
        for (slot = 0u; slot < CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT; slot++)
        {
            uint8_t bank;
            uint8_t selectedValid = 0u;
            uint8_t selectedBank = 0u;
            uint32_t selectedGeneration = 0u;
            for (bank = 0u; bank < 2u; bank++)
            {
                uint8_t valid;
                uint32_t generation;
                if (readRecoverableSlotRecord(slot, bank, &valid,
                    &generation) != 0u)
                    return 1u;
                if ((valid != 0u) && ((selectedValid == 0u) ||
                    (selectorNewer(generation, selectedGeneration) != 0u)))
                {
                    selectedValid = 1u;
                    selectedBank = bank;
                    selectedGeneration = generation;
                }
            }
            if (selectedValid != 0u)
            {
                recovered.bank[slot] = selectedBank;
                recovered.valid[slot] = CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD;
                recovered.slotGeneration[slot] = selectedGeneration;
                recovered.transactionId[slot] = 0u;
                if (recovered.activeSlot == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT)
                    recovered.activeSlot = slot;
            }
        }
        if (recovered.valid[0u] == 0u)
        {
            uint8_t valid;
            if (readRecoverableLegacy(&valid) != 0u) return 1u;
            if (valid != 0u)
            {
                recovered.valid[0u] = CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY;
                recovered.slotGeneration[0u] = 1u;
                recovered.activeSlot = 0u;
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        return 1u;
    }

    if ((erasePage(CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_A) != 0u) ||
        (erasePage(CORE4_SLOT_SELECTOR_PAGE_B) != 0u)) return 1u;
    memset(&g_selector, 0, sizeof(g_selector));
    g_selectorReady = 0u;
    g_selectorPage = 0u;
    g_selectorRecord = 0u;
    g_selectorUncertain = 0u;
    g_selectorUncertainHadDurable = 0u;
    return writeSelector(&recovered);
}

static uint8_t preparedRecordStillValid(uint8_t slot, uint8_t bank,
    uint32_t generation, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4SlotRecord record;
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    uint32_t crc;
    if (readPageBytes(slotPage(slot, bank), &record, sizeof(record)) != 0u)
        return 0u;
    crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &record,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4SlotRecord, crc));
    return (uint8_t) ((record.magic == CORE4_SLOT_RECORD_MAGIC) &&
        (record.version == CORE4_SLOT_STORE_VERSION) &&
        (record.slot == slot) && (record.generation == generation) &&
        (record.transactionId == transactionId) && (record.crc == crc) &&
        (record.payloadBytes == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES) &&
        (core4VisionParamsBlobDecode(&record.payload, &params) ==
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_VALID));
}

static core4VisionParamsSaveStatus saveSlotInternal(uint8_t slot,
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4SlotRecord record;
    core4SlotSelector next;
    core4VisionParamsStruct sanitized;
    uint8_t bank;

    if ((slot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) || (params == NULL))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    if (g_prepared.valid != 0u || g_selector.pendingTransactionId != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    sanitized = *params;
    core4VisionParamsSanitize(&sanitized);
    if (g_selector.valid[slot] == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD)
        bank = (uint8_t) (g_selector.bank[slot] ^ 1u);
    else if (g_selector.valid[slot] == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY)
        bank = 1u;
    else
        bank = 0u;
    memset(&record, 0, sizeof(record));
    record.magic = CORE4_SLOT_RECORD_MAGIC;
    record.version = CORE4_SLOT_STORE_VERSION;
    record.slot = slot;
    record.generation = g_selector.slotGeneration[slot] + 1u;
    if (record.generation == 0u) record.generation = 1u;
    record.transactionId = transactionId;
    record.payloadBytes = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES;
    core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(&sanitized, &record.payload);
    record.crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &record,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4SlotRecord, crc));
    if (writePageAtomic(slotPage(slot, bank), &record, sizeof(record)) != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    if (decodeSlotRecord(slot, bank, &sanitized) == 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFY_FAILED;
    next = g_selector;
    next.generation++;
    if (next.generation == 0u) next.generation = 1u;
    next.bank[slot] = bank;
    next.valid[slot] = CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD;
    next.slotGeneration[slot] = record.generation;
    next.transactionId[slot] = transactionId;
    next.activeSlot = slot;
    if (writeSelector(&next) != 0u) return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

static core4VisionParamsLoadStatus initializeRuntime(
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *defaults,
    core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    core4SelectorLoadState runtimeState = loadRuntimeSelector();
    core4VisionParamsStruct source;
    uint8_t sourceSlot = 0u;

    if (runtimeState == CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    if (runtimeState == CORE4_SELECTOR_VALID)
    {
        if (readRuntimeCommitted(params) == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
        /* A pending candidate is deliberately not repaired here: its rollback
         * must stay available for the coordinator's explicit ABORT. */
        if (g_runtimeSelector.pending != 0u)
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
        if ((defaults == NULL) ||
            (saveRuntimeFinal(defaults, 0u) !=
                CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED))
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_REWRITE_FAILED;
        *params = *defaults;
        core4VisionParamsSanitize(params);
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_DEFAULTS_REWRITTEN;
    }

    /* Upgrade from the former active-slot selector.  If it had already
     * switched to a pending candidate, first materialize the rollback source
     * and then recreate the runtime candidate as pending. */
    if ((g_selector.pendingTransactionId != 0u) &&
        (g_selector.activeSlot == g_selector.rollbackSlot) &&
        (g_selector.rollbackSlot < CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT))
    {
        uint8_t target = (uint8_t) g_selector.rollbackSlot;
        uint8_t oldActive = (uint8_t) g_selector.rollbackActiveSlot;
        uint32_t transactionId = g_selector.pendingTransactionId;
        uint8_t oldOk = 0u;
        if (oldActive < CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT)
        {
            if (oldActive == target)
            {
                if (g_selector.rollbackValid == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY)
                    oldOk = decodeLegacyPage(&source);
                else if (g_selector.rollbackValid == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD)
                    oldOk = decodeSlotRecord(target,
                        (uint8_t) g_selector.rollbackBank, &source);
            }
            else if (core4VisionParamsFlashReadSlot(oldActive, &source,
                NULL) == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
            {
                oldOk = 1u;
            }
        }
        if ((oldOk == 0u) && (defaults != NULL))
        {
            source = *defaults;
            core4VisionParamsSanitize(&source);
            oldActive = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT;
            oldOk = 1u;
        }
        if ((oldOk == 0u) ||
            (saveRuntimeFinal(&source,
                oldActive < CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT ?
                    (uint8_t) (oldActive + 1u) : 0u) !=
                CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED))
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_REWRITE_FAILED;
        *params = source;
        if (core4VisionParamsFlashReadSlot(target, &source, NULL) ==
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
        {
            if ((prepareRuntimeInternal(&source, transactionId,
                (uint8_t) (target + 1u)) !=
                    CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED) ||
                (commitRuntimeInternal(transactionId, 1u) !=
                    CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED))
                return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_REWRITE_FAILED;
        }
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
    }

    if ((g_selectorReady != 0u) &&
        (g_selector.activeSlot < CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) &&
        (core4VisionParamsFlashReadSlot((uint8_t) g_selector.activeSlot,
            &source, NULL) == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID))
    {
        sourceSlot = (uint8_t) (g_selector.activeSlot + 1u);
    }
    else if (defaults != NULL)
    {
        source = *defaults;
        core4VisionParamsSanitize(&source);
    }
    else
    {
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    }
    if (saveRuntimeFinal(&source, sourceSlot) !=
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_REWRITE_FAILED;
    *params = source;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
}

core4VisionParamsLoadStatus core4VisionParamsFlashLoad(core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    core4SelectorLoadState selectorState;
    core4FlashRangeState legacyState;
    core4VisionParamsLoadStatus libraryStatus = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
    core4VisionParamsLoadStatus runtimeStatus;
    core4VisionParamsStruct defaults;
    core4VisionParamsStruct loaded;

    if (params == NULL) return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    defaults = *params;
    core4VisionParamsSanitize(&defaults);
    ensureFlashReady();
    selectorState = loadSelector();
    if ((selectorState == CORE4_SELECTOR_REPAIR_LAST_GOOD) ||
        (selectorState == CORE4_SELECTOR_REBUILD_FROM_DATA))
    {
        if (rebuildLibrarySelector(selectorState) == 0u)
            selectorState = CORE4_SELECTOR_VALID;
        else
            selectorState = CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT;
    }
    if (selectorState == CORE4_SELECTOR_CORRUPT)
    {
        /* Runtime is the sole startup source.  Keep the damaged library
         * unavailable for diagnostics and writes, but still boot a verified
         * committed runtime (or rebuild runtime from defaults). */
        memset(&g_selector, 0, sizeof(g_selector));
        memset(&g_prepared, 0, sizeof(g_prepared));
        g_selectorReady = 0u;
        libraryStatus = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    }
    else if (selectorState == CORE4_SELECTOR_VALID)
    {
        if (g_selector.pendingTransactionId != 0u &&
            g_selector.pendingTransactionId != UINT32_MAX)
        {
            uint8_t slot = (uint8_t) g_selector.rollbackSlot;
            memset(&g_prepared, 0, sizeof(g_prepared));
            g_prepared.before = g_selector;
            g_prepared.before.activeSlot = g_selector.rollbackActiveSlot;
            g_prepared.before.bank[slot] = g_selector.rollbackBank;
            g_prepared.before.valid[slot] = g_selector.rollbackValid;
            g_prepared.before.slotGeneration[slot] =
                g_selector.rollbackGeneration;
            g_prepared.before.transactionId[slot] =
                g_selector.rollbackTransactionId;
            g_prepared.before.pendingTransactionId = 0u;
            g_prepared.transactionId = g_selector.pendingTransactionId;
            g_prepared.generation = g_selector.slotGeneration[slot];
            g_prepared.slot = slot;
            g_prepared.bank = (uint8_t) g_selector.bank[slot];
            g_prepared.valid = 1u;
            g_prepared.committed = 1u;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        memset(&g_selector, 0, sizeof(g_selector));
        g_selector.activeSlot = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT;
        legacyState = blankCheckRange(0u, 0u, CORE4_FLASH_PAGE_WORDS);
        if (legacyState == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_IO_FAILED)
        {
            libraryStatus = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
        }
        else if ((legacyState == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_PROGRAMMED) &&
            (decodeLegacyPage(&loaded) != 0u))
        {
            g_selector.activeSlot = 0u;
            g_selector.valid[0] = CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY;
            g_selector.slotGeneration[0] = 1u;
            g_selector.generation = 1u;
            if (writeSelector(&g_selector) != 0u)
            {
                saturatingIncrement(&g_status.writeVerifyFailures);
                libraryStatus = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_REWRITE_FAILED;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            g_selector.generation = 1u;
            if (legacyState == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_PROGRAMMED)
            {
                g_selector.activeSlot = 0u;
                g_selector.valid[0u] = CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY;
                g_selector.slotGeneration[0u] = 1u;
            }
            if (writeSelector(&g_selector) != 0u)
            {
                saturatingIncrement(&g_status.writeVerifyFailures);
                libraryStatus = (legacyState == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK)
                    ? CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_BLANK_INIT_FAILED
                    : CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_REWRITE_FAILED;
            }
            else
            {
                libraryStatus = (legacyState == CORE4_FLASH_RANGE_BLANK)
                    ? CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_BLANK_INITIALIZED
                    : CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
            }
        }
    }
    runtimeStatus = initializeRuntime(&defaults, params);
    g_status.libraryLoad = libraryStatus;
    g_status.runtimeLoad = runtimeStatus;
    if (runtimeStatus == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_DEFAULTS_REWRITTEN)
        g_status.runtimeDefaultsRewritten = 1u;
    if ((runtimeStatus != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID) &&
        (runtimeStatus != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_DEFAULTS_REWRITTEN))
        g_status.lastLoad = runtimeStatus;
    else if (runtimeStatus == CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_DEFAULTS_REWRITTEN)
        g_status.lastLoad = runtimeStatus;
    else if ((libraryStatus != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID) &&
        (libraryStatus != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_BLANK_INITIALIZED) &&
        (libraryStatus != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_DEFAULTS_REWRITTEN))
        g_status.lastLoad = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
    else
        g_status.lastLoad = libraryStatus;
    return g_status.lastLoad;
}

core4VisionParamsLoadStatus core4VisionParamsFlashReadSlot(uint8_t slot,
    core4VisionParamsStruct *params,
    core4VisionParamsSlotMeta *meta)
{
    uint8_t ok;

    if ((g_selectorReady == 0u) || (slot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
        (params == NULL) || (g_selector.valid[slot] == 0u))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    ok = (g_selector.valid[slot] == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY)
        ? decodeLegacyPage(params)
        : decodeSlotRecord(slot, (uint8_t) g_selector.bank[slot], params);
    if (ok == 0u) return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    core4VisionParamsSanitize(params);
    if (meta != NULL)
    {
        meta->generation = g_selector.slotGeneration[slot];
        meta->transactionId = g_selector.transactionId[slot];
        meta->valid = 1u;
        meta->active = 0u;
        meta->legacy = (uint8_t) (g_selector.valid[slot] == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY ? 1u : 0u);
    }
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
}

core4VisionParamsLoadStatus core4VisionParamsFlashInspectSlot(uint8_t slot,
    core4VisionParamsLibraryMeta *meta)
{
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    core4VisionParamsFlashBlob blob;
    if ((meta == NULL) || (g_selectorReady == 0u) ||
        (slot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
    meta->bank = (uint8_t) g_selector.bank[slot];
    meta->generation = g_selector.slotGeneration[slot];
    meta->transactionId = g_selector.transactionId[slot];
    if (g_selector.valid[slot] == 0u)
    {
        meta->state = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LIBRARY_EMPTY;
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
    }
    if (core4VisionParamsFlashReadSlot(slot, &params, NULL) !=
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
    {
        meta->state = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LIBRARY_INVALID;
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
    }
    core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(&params, &blob);
    meta->blobCrc = crc32IeeeCalc(blob.bytes,
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES);
    meta->state = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LIBRARY_VALID;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
}

core4VisionParamsLoadStatus core4VisionParamsFlashReadRuntime(
    core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    ensureFlashReady();
    return readRuntimeCommitted(params);
}

core4VisionParamsLoadStatus core4VisionParamsFlashGetRuntimeMeta(
    core4VisionParamsRuntimeMeta *meta)
{
    core4RuntimeSelector committed;
    if ((meta == NULL) || (resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty() != 0u) ||
        (committedRuntimeSelector(&committed) != 0u))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    memset(meta, 0, sizeof(*meta));
    meta->generation = committed.generation;
    meta->blobCrc = committed.blobCrc;
    meta->transactionId = committed.transactionId;
    meta->sourceSlot = committed.sourceSlot;
    meta->valid = committed.valid;
    meta->pending = g_runtimeSelector.pending;
    meta->bank = committed.bank;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashSaveRuntime(
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    ensureFlashReady();
    g_status.lastSave = saveRuntimeFinal(params, 0u);
    if (g_status.lastSave != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        saturatingIncrement(&g_status.writeVerifyFailures);
    return g_status.lastSave;
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashPrepareRuntime(
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params, uint32_t transactionId,
    uint8_t sourceSlot)
{
    ensureFlashReady();
    if ((transactionId == 0u) || (transactionId == UINT32_MAX))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    return prepareRuntimeInternal(params, transactionId, sourceSlot);
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashPrepareRuntimeFromSlot(
    uint8_t slot, uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    if ((transactionId == 0u) || (transactionId == UINT32_MAX) ||
        (core4VisionParamsFlashReadSlot(slot, &params, NULL) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    return prepareRuntimeInternal(&params, transactionId,
        (uint8_t) (slot + 1u));
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashApplyPreparedRuntime(
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4VisionParamsStruct params;
    if ((transactionId == 0u) ||
        (resolveRuntimeSelectorUncertainty() != 0u) ||
        (g_runtimeSelectorReady == 0u) ||
        (g_runtimeSelector.pending == 0u) ||
        (g_runtimeSelector.transactionId != transactionId) ||
        (readRuntimeBank(g_runtimeSelector.bank, g_runtimeSelector.blobCrc,
            &params) != 0u))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    core4VisionParamsCommit(&params);
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashCommitRuntime(
    uint32_t transactionId)

    if ((transactionId == 0u) || (transactionId == UINT32_MAX))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    return commitRuntimeInternal(transactionId, 1u);

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashSaveSlot(uint8_t slot,
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    ensureFlashReady();
    g_status.lastSave = (transactionId == UINT32_MAX) ?
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED :
        saveSlotInternal(slot, params, transactionId);
    if (g_status.lastSave != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        saturatingIncrement(&g_status.writeVerifyFailures);
    return g_status.lastSave;
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashPrepareSlot(uint8_t slot,
    const core4VisionParamsStruct *params,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4SlotRecord record;
    core4VisionParamsStruct sanitized;
    uint8_t bank;

    ensureFlashReady();
    if ((g_selectorReady == 0u) || (slot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
        (params == NULL) || (transactionId == 0u) ||
        (transactionId == UINT32_MAX) || (g_prepared.valid != 0u))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    sanitized = *params;
    core4VisionParamsSanitize(&sanitized);
    if (g_selector.valid[slot] == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD)
        bank = (uint8_t) (g_selector.bank[slot] ^ 1u);
    else if (g_selector.valid[slot] == CORE4_SLOT_VALID_LEGACY)
        bank = 1u;
    else
        bank = 0u;
    memset(&record, 0, sizeof(record));
    record.magic = CORE4_SLOT_RECORD_MAGIC;
    record.version = CORE4_SLOT_STORE_VERSION;
    record.slot = slot;
    record.generation = g_selector.slotGeneration[slot] + 1u;
    if (record.generation == 0u) record.generation = 1u;
    record.transactionId = transactionId;
    record.payloadBytes = CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_BLOB_BYTES;
    core4VisionParamsBlobEncode(&sanitized, &record.payload);
    record.crc = crc32IeeeCalc((const uint8_t *) &record,
        (uint32_t) offsetof(core4SlotRecord, crc));
    if ((writePageAtomic(slotPage(slot, bank), &record, sizeof(record)) != 0u) ||
        (decodeSlotRecord(slot, bank, &sanitized) == 0u))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFY_FAILED;
    memset(&g_prepared, 0, sizeof(g_prepared));
    g_prepared.before = g_selector;
    g_prepared.transactionId = transactionId;
    g_prepared.generation = record.generation;
    g_prepared.slot = slot;
    g_prepared.bank = bank;
    g_prepared.valid = 1u;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashCommitPrepared(uint8_t slot,
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4SlotSelector next;
    if ((transactionId == 0u) || (transactionId == UINT32_MAX) ||
        (g_prepared.valid == 0u) || (g_prepared.committed != 0u) ||
        (g_prepared.slot != slot) || (g_prepared.transactionId != transactionId) ||
        !preparedRecordStillValid(slot, g_prepared.bank, g_prepared.generation,
            transactionId))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    next = g_selector;
    next.generation++;
    if (next.generation == 0u) next.generation = 1u;
    next.bank[slot] = g_prepared.bank;
    next.valid[slot] = CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD;
    next.slotGeneration[slot] = g_prepared.generation;
    next.transactionId[slot] = transactionId;
    next.activeSlot = slot;
    next.pendingTransactionId = transactionId;
    next.rollbackActiveSlot = g_prepared.before.activeSlot;
    next.rollbackSlot = slot;
    next.rollbackBank = g_prepared.before.bank[slot];
    next.rollbackValid = g_prepared.before.valid[slot];
    next.rollbackGeneration = g_prepared.before.slotGeneration[slot];
    next.rollbackTransactionId = g_prepared.before.transactionId[slot];
    if (writeSelector(&next) != 0u) return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    g_prepared.committed = 1u;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashAbortTransaction(
    uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4SlotSelector rollback;
    core4VisionParamsSaveStatus runtimeStatus;
    uint8_t runtimePending;
    if (transactionId == UINT32_MAX)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    runtimePending = (uint8_t) (g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u &&
        g_runtimeSelector.pending != 0u &&
        g_runtimeSelector.transactionId == transactionId);
    if (runtimePending != 0u &&
        applyCommittedRuntime() != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    runtimeStatus = abortRuntimeTransaction(transactionId);
    if (runtimeStatus != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        return runtimeStatus;
    if (resolveSelectorUncertainty() != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    if (g_selector.pendingTransactionId != 0u)
    {
        if (g_selector.pendingTransactionId != transactionId ||
            recoverPendingSelector() != 0u)
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
        memset(&g_prepared, 0, sizeof(g_prepared));
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
    }
    if ((g_prepared.valid == 0u) || (g_prepared.transactionId != transactionId))
    {
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
    }
    if (g_prepared.committed != 0u)
    {
        rollback = g_prepared.before;
        rollback.generation = g_selector.generation + 1u;
        if (rollback.generation == 0u) rollback.generation = 1u;
        if (writeSelector(&rollback) != 0u) return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    }
    memset(&g_prepared, 0, sizeof(g_prepared));
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashFinishTransaction(uint32_t transactionId)
{
    core4VisionParamsSaveStatus runtimeStatus;
    uint8_t runtimePending;
    if (transactionId == UINT32_MAX)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    runtimePending = (uint8_t) (g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u &&
        g_runtimeSelector.pending != 0u &&
        g_runtimeSelector.transactionId == transactionId);
    if (runtimePending != 0u &&
        core4VisionParamsFlashApplyPreparedRuntime(transactionId) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFY_FAILED;
    if (resolveSelectorUncertainty() != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    if (g_selector.pendingTransactionId == transactionId)
    {
        uint8_t slot = (uint8_t) g_selector.rollbackSlot;
        core4SlotSelector next = g_selector;
        if ((slot >= CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SLOT_COUNT) ||
            (g_selector.valid[slot] != CORE4_SLOT_VALID_RECORD) ||
            (preparedRecordStillValid(slot, (uint8_t) g_selector.bank[slot],
                g_selector.slotGeneration[slot], transactionId) == 0u))
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFY_FAILED;
        next.generation++;
        if (next.generation == 0u) next.generation = 1u;
        next.pendingTransactionId = 0u;
        next.rollbackActiveSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackBank = 0u;
        next.rollbackValid = 0u;
        next.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
        if (writeSelector(&next) != 0u) return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    }
    if ((g_prepared.valid != 0u) && (g_prepared.transactionId == transactionId))
        memset(&g_prepared, 0, sizeof(g_prepared));
    else if (g_selector.pendingTransactionId != 0u)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    runtimeStatus = finishRuntimeTransaction(transactionId);
    if (runtimeStatus != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        return runtimeStatus;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED;
}

    uint32_t transactionId, core4VisionParamsStruct *params)

    core4VisionParamsLoadStatus status;
    if (params == NULL || transactionId == 0u || transactionId == UINT32_MAX ||
        g_prepared.valid == 0u || g_prepared.committed == 0u ||
        g_prepared.slot != slot || g_prepared.transactionId != transactionId ||

    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;

core4VisionParamsLoadStatus core4VisionParamsFlashAbortPendingActivation(
    core4VisionParamsStruct *params)
{
    if (params == NULL) return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    if ((g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) &&
        (g_runtimeSelector.pending != 0u) &&
        (g_runtimeSelector.transactionId == UINT32_MAX))
    {
        if (readRuntimeCommitted(params) != CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID)
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
        core4VisionParamsCommit(params);
    }
    if (abortRuntimeTransaction(UINT32_MAX) !=
        CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED)
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    if ((g_selector.pendingTransactionId == UINT32_MAX) &&
        (recoverPendingSelector() != 0u))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_READ_FAILED;
    return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_LOAD_VALID;
}

core4VisionParamsSaveStatus core4VisionParamsFlashFinishPendingActivation(void)
{
    core4VisionParamsSaveStatus status;
    if ((g_selector.pendingTransactionId == UINT32_MAX) &&
        ((g_runtimeSelectorReady == 0u) ||
         (g_runtimeSelector.pending == 0u) ||
         (g_runtimeSelector.transactionId != UINT32_MAX)))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    if ((g_runtimeSelectorReady != 0u) &&
        (g_runtimeSelector.pending != 0u) &&
        (g_runtimeSelector.transactionId == UINT32_MAX) &&
        (core4VisionParamsFlashApplyPreparedRuntime(UINT32_MAX) !=
            CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFIED))
        return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_VERIFY_FAILED;
    if (g_selector.pendingTransactionId == UINT32_MAX)
    {
        core4SlotSelector next = g_selector;
        next.generation++;
        if (next.generation == 0u) next.generation = 1u;
        next.pendingTransactionId = 0u;
        next.rollbackActiveSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackSlot = 0u;
        next.rollbackBank = 0u;
        next.rollbackValid = 0u;
        next.rollbackGeneration = 0u;
        next.rollbackTransactionId = 0u;
        if (writeSelector(&next) != 0u)
            return CORE4_VISION_PARAMS_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED;
    }
    status = finishRuntimeTransaction(UINT32_MAX);
    return status;
}

代码（c）
#include "crc32Ieee.h"

uint32_t crc32IeeeCalc(const uint8_t* data, uint32_t len)
{
    uint32_t crc = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    uint32_t i;

    for (i = 0u; i < len; i++)
    {
        uint8_t b;
        crc ^= (uint32_t) data[i];
        for (b = 0u; b < 8u; b++)
        {
            uint32_t mask = (uint32_t) (-(int32_t) (crc & 1u));
            crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320u & mask);
        }
    }
    return ~crc;
}
