core4_cyt4bb7/project/code/vision/beaconTrack.c
SHA-256：65ae1cb42782586e2583a21a7320b5ec9be268a374c2f318997e90ed6fdf9346
代码（c）
#include "beaconTrack.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "commonDef.h"
#include "configBeaconTrack.h"

/*
 * 时间一致性跟踪实现。逐帧:
 *   1) 全局选取综合 score 最小且满足连续性(距离+面积趋势+面积比)的轨迹-检测对，
 *      关联则平滑更新+hits++，否则 misses++、hits 归零。坐标速度单位 px/frame，
 *      面积速度单位 area pixels/frame。
 *   2) 删除丢失超限的轨迹(已确认容忍 DROP_MISSES，未确认容忍 1 帧)。
 *   3) 未关联的检测生成新轨迹。
 *   4) 输出: 已确认且 misses<=COAST_MISSES 的轨迹(滑行容忍偶发漏检)。
 * 定长数组 + 无动态内存; 纯前台调用(非 ISR)。
 */

static float beaconTrackDist2(float ax, float ay, float bx, float by)
{
    float dx = ax - bx;
    float dy = ay - by;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy;
}

static float beaconTrackAbs(float v)
{
    return (v < 0.0f) ? -v : v;
}

static float beaconTrackMax(float a, float b)
{
    return (a > b) ? a : b;
}

static uint16_t beaconTrackClampCoord(float v, uint16_t maxExclusive)
{
    float maxV = (maxExclusive > 0u) ? (float) (maxExclusive - 1u) : 0.0f;
    v = clampf(v, 0.0f, maxV);
    return (uint16_t) (v + 0.5f);
}

static uint16_t beaconTrackClampSize(float v)
{
    v = clampf(v, 0.0f, (float) OM_BUFFER_SIZE);
    return (uint16_t) (v + 0.5f);
}

static uint8_t beaconTrackIdActive(const beaconTrackerStruct* tracker, uint16_t id)
{
    if (id == 0u) return 1u;
    for (uint16_t t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
    {
        if (tracker->tracks[t].active && tracker->tracks[t].trackId == id) return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static uint16_t beaconTrackAllocId(beaconTrackerStruct* tracker)
{
    uint16_t id;
    for (uint16_t tries = 0u; tries < 0xFFFFu; tries++)
    {
        id = tracker->nextTrackId;
        tracker->nextTrackId++;
        if (tracker->nextTrackId == 0u) tracker->nextTrackId = 1u;
        if (!beaconTrackIdActive(tracker, id)) return id;
    }
    return 0u;
}

static float beaconTrackPredictFramesForOutput(const beaconTrackStruct* tr)
{
    return (tr->misses > 0u) ? (float) tr->misses : VISION_TRACK_PREDICT_FRAMES_DEFAULT;
}

static float beaconTrackPredX(const beaconTrackStruct* tr, float frames)
{
    return tr->lastRawX + tr->velX * frames;
}

static float beaconTrackPredY(const beaconTrackStruct* tr, float frames)
{
    return tr->lastRawY + tr->velY * frames;
}

static float beaconTrackPredSize(const beaconTrackStruct* tr, float frames)
{
    return clampf(tr->lastRawSize + tr->areaVel * frames, 0.0f, (float) OM_BUFFER_SIZE);
}

static float beaconTrackAreaVelDenom(float size)
{
    float areaBase = beaconTrackMax(size, VISION_TRACK_AREA_NORM_MIN);
    return beaconTrackMax(areaBase * VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_VEL_NORM,
                          VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_VEL_MIN_ABS);
}

static float beaconTrackAssociationScore(float d2, float maxDist2, float detSize,
                                         float predSize, float rawAreaVel, float areaVelBaseSize,
                                         float expectedAreaVel, uint8_t areaVelPrimed,
                                         float areaWeight, float areaVelWeight)
{
    float predDenom = beaconTrackMax(predSize, VISION_TRACK_AREA_NORM_MIN);
    float areaErr = beaconTrackAbs(detSize - predSize) / predDenom;
    float areaScore;
    float velScore = 0.0f;

    areaErr = clampf(areaErr, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_ERR_CAP);
    areaScore = areaErr * areaErr;

    if (areaVelPrimed)
    {
        float velErr = beaconTrackAbs(rawAreaVel - expectedAreaVel) / beaconTrackAreaVelDenom(areaVelBaseSize);
        velErr = clampf(velErr, 0.0f, VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_VEL_ERR_CAP);
        velScore = velErr * velErr;
    }

    return (d2 / maxDist2)
        + areaWeight * areaScore
        + areaVelWeight * velScore;
}

static uint8_t beaconTrackPairBetter(float score, float d2, uint16_t trackId, uint16_t detIdx,
                                     float bestScore, float bestD2,
                                     uint16_t bestTrackId, uint16_t bestDetIdx)
{
    const float eps = 0.0001f;
    if (score < (bestScore - eps)) return 1u;
    if (score > (bestScore + eps)) return 0u;
    if (d2 < (bestD2 - eps)) return 1u;
    if (d2 > (bestD2 + eps)) return 0u;
    if (trackId < bestTrackId) return 1u;
    if (trackId > bestTrackId) return 0u;
    return (detIdx < bestDetIdx) ? 1u : 0u;
}

/* 运行时跟踪参数(默认取 configBeaconTrack.h 的 #define, 菜单可热重载)。
 * 仅 Core4 前台读写, 无 ISR 竞争, 无需 volatile。 */
typedef struct
{
    float maxAssocDist;
    float sizeRatioMax;
    uint16_t confirmHits;
    uint16_t dropMisses;
    uint16_t coastMisses;
    float positionAlpha;  /* 关联更新位置低通系数(0<alpha<=1) */
    float sizeAlpha;      /* 关联更新面积低通系数(0<alpha<=1) */
    float areaVelAlpha;   /* 面积速度低通系数(0<alpha<=1) */
    float assocScoreMax;
    float assocAreaWeight;
    float assocAreaVelWeight;
    beaconTrackBorderConfigStruct border;
    uint16_t edgePredictionHoldFrames;
    beaconTrackEdgeBandsStruct edgeBands;
} beaconTrackConfigStruct;

#define BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_LEFT   (0x01u)
#define BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_RIGHT  (0x02u)
#define BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_TOP    (0x04u)
#define BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_BOTTOM (0x08u)

static beaconTrackConfigStruct beaconTrackConfig = {
    VISION_TRACK_MAX_ASSOC_DIST_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_SIZE_RATIO_MAX_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_CONFIRM_HITS_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_DROP_MISSES_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_COAST_MISSES_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_POSITION_ALPHA_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_SIZE_ALPHA_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_AREA_VEL_ALPHA_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_SCORE_MAX_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_WEIGHT_DEFAULT,
    VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_VEL_WEIGHT_DEFAULT,
    {
        {VISION_TRACK_BORDER_ENTER_LEFT_DEFAULT,
         VISION_TRACK_BORDER_ENTER_RIGHT_DEFAULT,
         VISION_TRACK_BORDER_ENTER_TOP_DEFAULT,
         VISION_TRACK_BORDER_ENTER_BOTTOM_DEFAULT},
        {VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_LEFT_DEFAULT,
         VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_RIGHT_DEFAULT,
         VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_TOP_DEFAULT,
         VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_BOTTOM_DEFAULT}
    },
    0u,
    {VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_OBSERVER_LEFT_DEFAULT,
     VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_OBSERVER_RIGHT_DEFAULT,
     VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_OBSERVER_TOP_DEFAULT,
     VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_OBSERVER_BOTTOM_DEFAULT}
};

static float beaconTrackPredictFramesForAssoc(const beaconTrackStruct* tr)
{
    float frames = (float) tr->misses + VISION_TRACK_PREDICT_FRAMES_DEFAULT;
    if ((tr->edgePredictionSideMask != 0u) &&
        (beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames != 0u))
    {
        frames = clampf(frames, VISION_TRACK_PREDICT_FRAMES_DEFAULT,
            VISION_TRACK_EDGE_ASSOC_PREDICT_FRAMES_MAX);
    }
    return frames;
}

static uint8_t beaconTrackEdgeSideMask(float x, float y)
{
    uint8_t mask = 0u;
    if (beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames == 0u) return 0u;
    if ((beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.left != 0u) &&
        (x < (float) beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.left)) mask |= BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_LEFT;
    if ((beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.right != 0u) &&
        (x >= (float) OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH - (float) beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.right))
        mask |= BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_RIGHT;
    if ((beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.top != 0u) &&
        (y < (float) beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.top)) mask |= BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_TOP;
    if ((beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.bottom != 0u) &&
        (y >= (float) OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT - (float) beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.bottom))
        mask |= BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_BOTTOM;
    return mask;
}

static uint8_t beaconTrackSideValid(uint8_t enter, uint8_t exit, uint8_t maximum)
{
    if ((enter == 0u) && (exit == 0u)) return 1u;
    return (uint8_t) ((enter >= 1u) && (enter <= maximum) && (exit < enter));
}

static uint8_t beaconTrackBorderValid(const beaconTrackBorderConfigStruct* margins)
{
    if (margins == 0) return 0u;
    return (uint8_t) (
        beaconTrackSideValid(margins->enter.left, margins->exit.left, VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX) &&
        beaconTrackSideValid(margins->enter.right, margins->exit.right, VISION_TRACK_BORDER_X_MAX) &&
        beaconTrackSideValid(margins->enter.top, margins->exit.top, VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX) &&
        beaconTrackSideValid(margins->enter.bottom, margins->exit.bottom, VISION_TRACK_BORDER_Y_MAX));
}

static uint8_t beaconTrackPointInside(float x, float y,
    const beaconTrackBorderMarginsStruct* margin)
{
    return (uint8_t) (((margin->left == 0u) || (x >= (float) margin->left)) &&
        ((margin->right == 0u) || (x <= (float) (OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH - 1u - margin->right))) &&
        ((margin->top == 0u) || (y >= (float) margin->top)) &&
        ((margin->bottom == 0u) || (y <= (float) (OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT - 1u - margin->bottom))));
}

static uint8_t beaconTrackUpdateBorderExit(beaconTrackStruct* tr, float x, float y)
{
    if (beaconTrackPointInside(x, y, &beaconTrackConfig.border.exit) != 0u)
    {
        tr->borderOutsideFrames = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }

    if (tr->borderOutsideFrames < 0xFFu) tr->borderOutsideFrames++;
    if (tr->borderOutsideFrames >= VISION_TRACK_BORDER_EXIT_HOLD_FRAMES_DEFAULT)
    {
        tr->borderEligible = 0u;
        return 1u;
    }
    return 0u;
}

void beaconTrackSetBorderMargins(const beaconTrackBorderConfigStruct* margins)
{
    if (beaconTrackBorderValid(margins) != 0u)
    {
        beaconTrackConfig.border = *margins;
    }
}

void beaconTrackSetEdgePredictionConfig(
    const beaconTrackEdgePredictionConfigStruct* config)
{
    uint16_t holdMs;
    if (config == 0) return;
    holdMs = config->holdMs;
    if (holdMs > VISION_TRACK_EDGE_PREDICTION_HOLD_MS_MAX)
        holdMs = VISION_TRACK_EDGE_PREDICTION_HOLD_MS_MAX;
    beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames = (uint16_t)
        ((holdMs + VISION_TRACK_CAMERA_FRAME_PERIOD_MS - 1u) /
         VISION_TRACK_CAMERA_FRAME_PERIOD_MS);
    beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands = config->bands;
    if (beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.left > (uint8_t) VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX)
        beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.left = (uint8_t) VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX;
    if (beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.right > (uint8_t) VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX)
        beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.right = (uint8_t) VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_X_MAX;
    if (beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.top > (uint8_t) VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX)
        beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.top = (uint8_t) VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX;
    if (beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.bottom > (uint8_t) VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX)
        beaconTrackConfig.edgeBands.bottom = (uint8_t) VISION_TRACK_EDGE_BAND_Y_MAX;
}

void beaconTrackSetParams(float maxAssocDist, float sizeRatioMax,
                          uint16_t confirmHits, uint16_t dropMisses, uint16_t coastMisses,
                          float positionAlpha, float sizeAlpha,
                          float areaVelAlpha, float assocScoreMax,
                          float assocAreaWeight, float assocAreaVelWeight)
{
    if (maxAssocDist > 0.0f) beaconTrackConfig.maxAssocDist = maxAssocDist;
    if (sizeRatioMax > 1.0f) beaconTrackConfig.sizeRatioMax = sizeRatioMax;
    if (confirmHits > 0u) beaconTrackConfig.confirmHits = confirmHits;
    if (dropMisses > 0u) beaconTrackConfig.dropMisses = dropMisses;
    if (coastMisses > 0u) beaconTrackConfig.coastMisses = coastMisses;
    if (positionAlpha > 0.0f && positionAlpha <= 1.0f) beaconTrackConfig.positionAlpha = positionAlpha;
    if (sizeAlpha > 0.0f && sizeAlpha <= 1.0f) beaconTrackConfig.sizeAlpha = sizeAlpha;
    if (areaVelAlpha > 0.0f && areaVelAlpha <= 1.0f) beaconTrackConfig.areaVelAlpha = areaVelAlpha;
    if (assocScoreMax > 0.0f) beaconTrackConfig.assocScoreMax = assocScoreMax;
    if (assocAreaWeight >= 0.0f) beaconTrackConfig.assocAreaWeight = assocAreaWeight;
    if (assocAreaVelWeight >= 0.0f) beaconTrackConfig.assocAreaVelWeight = assocAreaVelWeight;
}

void beaconTrackInit(beaconTrackerStruct* tracker)
{
    if (0 == tracker) return;
    for (uint16_t i = 0u; i < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; i++)
    {
        tracker->tracks[i].active = 0u;
    }
    tracker->confirmedCount = 0u;
    tracker->nextTrackId = 1u;
    tracker->frameSeq = 0u;
}

void beaconTrackMarkPublished(beaconTrackerStruct* tracker, uint16_t trackId)
{
    uint16_t t;
    if ((tracker == 0) || (trackId == 0u)) return;
    for (t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
    {
        beaconTrackStruct *track = &tracker->tracks[t];
        if ((track->active != 0u) && (track->trackId == trackId))
        {
            track->published = 1u;
            return;
        }
    }
}

void beaconTrackUpdate(beaconTrackerStruct* tracker, const BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT* det)
{
    if (0 == tracker || 0 == det) return;

    uint16_t nDet = det->beaconCount;
    uint16_t outCount = 0u;
    if (nDet > OM_MAX_OBJECTS) nDet = OM_MAX_OBJECTS;

    uint8_t detUsed[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];
    uint8_t trackUsed[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];
    for (uint16_t i = 0u; i < nDet; i++) detUsed[i] = 0u;
    for (uint16_t i = 0u; i < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; i++) trackUsed[i] = 0u;
    tracker->frameSeq++;

    const float maxDist2 = beaconTrackConfig.maxAssocDist * beaconTrackConfig.maxAssocDist;
    const float ratioMax = beaconTrackConfig.sizeRatioMax;
    const float ratioMin = 1.0f / beaconTrackConfig.sizeRatioMax;
    const float velMax = beaconTrackConfig.maxAssocDist * VISION_TRACK_VELOCITY_MAX_FACTOR_DEFAULT;

    /* EdgeBand热重载必须先于本帧关联生效，禁止缩小/关闭后再借旧资格
     * 多使用一次纵向放宽门。扩大参数只影响仍存活轨迹。 */
    for (uint16_t t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
    {
        beaconTrackStruct* tr = &tracker->tracks[t];
        if (!tr->active) continue;
        tr->edgePredictionSideMask = beaconTrackEdgeSideMask(
            tr->lastRawX, tr->lastRawY);
    }

    /* 1) 全局选择预测残差最小的兼容轨迹-检测对，避免槽位顺序先抢检测。 */
    for (;;)
    {
        int32_t bestTrack = -1;
        int32_t bestDet = -1;
        uint16_t bestTrackId = 0xFFFFu;
        uint16_t bestDetIdx = 0xFFFFu;
        float bestScore = beaconTrackConfig.assocScoreMax;
        float bestD2 = 1.0f;

        for (uint16_t t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
        {
            beaconTrackStruct* tr = &tracker->tracks[t];
            if (!tr->active || trackUsed[t]) continue;

            float frames = beaconTrackPredictFramesForAssoc(tr);
            float predX = beaconTrackPredX(tr, frames);
            float predY = beaconTrackPredY(tr, frames);
            float predSize = beaconTrackPredSize(tr, frames);
            float measurementFrames = (float) tr->misses + 1.0f;
            float predSizeDenom = beaconTrackMax(predSize, VISION_TRACK_AREA_NORM_MIN);
            for (uint16_t d = 0u; d < nDet; d++)
            {
                if (detUsed[d]) continue;
                float dcx = (float) det->beaconData[d].centerX;
                float dcy = (float) det->beaconData[d].centerY;
                float detSize = (float) det->beaconData[d].contourSize;
                float rawAreaVel = (detSize - tr->lastRawSize) / measurementFrames;
                float d2 = beaconTrackDist2(dcx, dcy, predX, predY);
                float positionScore;
                float ratio;
                float score;
                if ((tr->edgePredictionSideMask != 0u) &&
                    (beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames != 0u))
                {
                    float dx = dcx - predX;
                    float dy = dcy - predY;
                    float rx = beaconTrackConfig.maxAssocDist;
                    float ry = beaconTrackConfig.maxAssocDist;
                    if ((tr->edgePredictionSideMask &
                        (BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_LEFT | BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_RIGHT)) != 0u)
                        rx *= VISION_TRACK_EDGE_VERTICAL_ASSOC_SCALE;
                    if ((tr->edgePredictionSideMask &
                        (BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_TOP | BEACON_EDGE_SIDE_BOTTOM)) != 0u)
                        ry *= VISION_TRACK_EDGE_VERTICAL_ASSOC_SCALE;
                    positionScore = (dx * dx) / (rx * rx) + (dy * dy) / (ry * ry);
                    if (positionScore > 1.0f) continue;
                }
                else
                {
                    if (d2 > maxDist2) continue;
                    positionScore = d2 / maxDist2;
                }
                ratio = detSize / predSizeDenom;
                if (ratio > ratioMax || ratio < ratioMin) continue;
                score = beaconTrackAssociationScore(positionScore, 1.0f, detSize, predSize, rawAreaVel,
                                                     tr->lastRawSize,
                                                     tr->areaVel, tr->areaVelocityPrimed,
                                                     beaconTrackConfig.assocAreaWeight,
                                                     beaconTrackConfig.assocAreaVelWeight);
                if (score > beaconTrackConfig.assocScoreMax) continue;
                if (bestTrack < 0
                    || beaconTrackPairBetter(score, positionScore, tr->trackId, d,
                                             bestScore, bestD2, bestTrackId, bestDetIdx))
                {
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestD2 = positionScore;
                    bestTrack = (int32_t) t;
                    bestDet = (int32_t) d;
                    bestTrackId = tr->trackId;
                    bestDetIdx = d;
                }
            }
        }

        if (bestTrack < 0 || bestDet < 0) break;

        {
            uint16_t t = (uint16_t) bestTrack;
            uint16_t d = (uint16_t) bestDet;
            beaconTrackStruct* tr = &tracker->tracks[t];
            float aP = beaconTrackConfig.positionAlpha;
            float aS = beaconTrackConfig.sizeAlpha;
            float dcx = (float) det->beaconData[d].centerX;
            float dcy = (float) det->beaconData[d].centerY;
            float detSize = (float) det->beaconData[d].contourSize;
            float measurementFrames = (float) tr->misses + 1.0f;
            float rawVx = (dcx - tr->lastRawX) / measurementFrames;
            float rawVy = (dcy - tr->lastRawY) / measurementFrames;
            float rawAreaVel = (detSize - tr->lastRawSize) / measurementFrames;
            float areaVelMax = beaconTrackMax(tr->lastRawSize * VISION_TRACK_AREA_VEL_MAX_RATE,
                                              VISION_TRACK_ASSOC_AREA_VEL_MIN_ABS);
            rawVx = clampf(rawVx, -velMax, velMax);
            rawVy = clampf(rawVy, -velMax, velMax);
            rawAreaVel = clampf(rawAreaVel, -areaVelMax, areaVelMax);
            if (tr->velocityPrimed)
            {
                float aV = VISION_TRACK_VELOCITY_ALPHA_DEFAULT;
                tr->velX = aV * rawVx + (1.0f - aV) * tr->velX;
                tr->velY = aV * rawVy + (1.0f - aV) * tr->velY;
            }
            else
            {
                tr->velX = rawVx;
                tr->velY = rawVy;
                tr->velocityPrimed = 1u;
            }
            if (tr->areaVelocityPrimed)
            {
                float aA = beaconTrackConfig.areaVelAlpha;
                tr->areaVel = aA * rawAreaVel + (1.0f - aA) * tr->areaVel;
            }
            else
            {
                tr->areaVel = rawAreaVel;
                tr->areaVelocityPrimed = 1u;
            }
            tr->areaVel = clampf(tr->areaVel, -areaVelMax, areaVelMax);
            tr->velX = clampf(tr->velX, -velMax, velMax);
            tr->velY = clampf(tr->velY, -velMax, velMax);
            tr->lastRawX = dcx;
            tr->lastRawY = dcy;
            tr->lastRawSize = detSize;
            trackUsed[t] = 1u;
            detUsed[d] = 1u;
            /* 关联更新一阶低通(alpha*measured + (1-alpha)*old; 越小越平滑, 替代原硬编码 0.5)。 */
            tr->cx = aP * dcx + (1.0f - aP) * tr->cx;
            tr->cy = aP * dcy + (1.0f - aP) * tr->cy;
            tr->size = aS * detSize + (1.0f - aS) * tr->size;
            if (tr->hits < 0xFFFFu) tr->hits++;
            tr->misses = 0u;
            tr->fresh = 1u;
            tr->edgePredictionSideMask = beaconTrackEdgeSideMask(dcx, dcy);
            if (tr->borderEligible == 0u)
            {
                tr->borderEligible = beaconTrackPointInside(dcx, dcy,
                    &beaconTrackConfig.border.enter);
                if (tr->borderEligible != 0u) tr->borderOutsideFrames = 0u;
            }
            tr->frameSeq = tracker->frameSeq;
            if (tr->hits >= beaconTrackConfig.confirmHits) tr->confirmed = 1u;
        }
    }

    for (uint16_t t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
    {
        beaconTrackStruct* tr = &tracker->tracks[t];
        if (!tr->active || trackUsed[t]) continue;
        if (tr->misses < 0xFFFFu) tr->misses++;
        tr->hits = 0u;
        tr->fresh = 0u;
        tr->frameSeq = tracker->frameSeq;
    }

    /* 2) 边界拒绝优先于丢失删除和边缘预测。所有从Enter区取得资格的
     * 活动轨迹都参与Exit确认；只有已经确认发布过的轨迹产生一次拒绝事实。 */
    for (uint16_t t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
    {
        beaconTrackStruct* tr = &tracker->tracks[t];
        float predFrames;
        float predX;
        float predY;
        float qualificationX;
        float qualificationY;
        if (!tr->active || (tr->borderEligible == 0u)) continue;
        predFrames = beaconTrackPredictFramesForOutput(tr);
        predX = beaconTrackPredX(tr, predFrames);
        predY = beaconTrackPredY(tr, predFrames);
        qualificationX = (tr->fresh != 0u) ? tr->lastRawX : predX;
        qualificationY = (tr->fresh != 0u) ? tr->lastRawY : predY;
        if (beaconTrackUpdateBorderExit(tr, qualificationX,
                qualificationY) == 0u) continue;
        if (tr->published != 0u)
        {
            memset(&tracker->confirmed[outCount], 0,
                sizeof(tracker->confirmed[outCount]));
            tracker->confirmed[outCount].trackId = tr->trackId;
            tracker->confirmed[outCount].flags =
                BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED;
            outCount++;
        }
        tr->edgePredictionSideMask = 0u;
        tr->active = 0u;
        tr->confirmed = 0u;
        tr->fresh = 0u;
    }

    /* 3) 删除丢失超限轨迹 */
    for (uint16_t t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
    {
        beaconTrackStruct* tr = &tracker->tracks[t];
        if (!tr->active) continue;
        uint16_t limit = tr->confirmed ? beaconTrackConfig.dropMisses : 1u;
        if (tr->confirmed && (tr->edgePredictionSideMask != 0u) &&
            (beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames != 0u))
        {
            limit = beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames;
        }
        if (tr->misses > limit)
        {
            tr->active = 0u;
            tr->fresh = 0u;
        }
    }

    /* 4) 未关联检测生成新轨迹(填首个空槽) */
    for (uint16_t d = 0u; d < nDet; d++)
    {
        if (detUsed[d]) continue;
        if (beaconTrackPointInside((float) det->beaconData[d].centerX,
                (float) det->beaconData[d].centerY,
                &beaconTrackConfig.border.enter) == 0u) continue;
        for (uint16_t t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
        {
            beaconTrackStruct* tr = &tracker->tracks[t];
            uint16_t newTrackId;
            if (tr->active) continue;
            newTrackId = beaconTrackAllocId(tracker);
            if (newTrackId == 0u) break;
            tr->cx = (float) det->beaconData[d].centerX;
            tr->cy = (float) det->beaconData[d].centerY;
            tr->size = (float) det->beaconData[d].contourSize;
            tr->lastRawX = tr->cx;
            tr->lastRawY = tr->cy;
            tr->lastRawSize = tr->size;
            tr->velX = 0.0f;
            tr->velY = 0.0f;
            tr->areaVel = 0.0f;
            tr->frameSeq = tracker->frameSeq;
            tr->trackId = newTrackId;
            tr->hits = 1u;
            tr->misses = 0u;
            tr->confirmed = 0u;
            tr->fresh = 1u;
            tr->velocityPrimed = 0u;
            tr->areaVelocityPrimed = 0u;
            tr->borderEligible = beaconTrackPointInside(tr->cx, tr->cy,
                &beaconTrackConfig.border.enter);
            tr->borderOutsideFrames = 0u;
            tr->edgePredictionSideMask = beaconTrackEdgeSideMask(tr->cx, tr->cy);
            tr->published = 0u;
            tr->active = 1u;
            break;
        }
    }

    /* 5) 输出已确认且仍新鲜(滑行容忍)的轨迹。拒绝记录已在前面。 */
    for (uint16_t t = 0u; t < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; t++)
    {
        beaconTrackStruct* tr = &tracker->tracks[t];
        if (!tr->active || !tr->confirmed) continue;
        {
            uint16_t outputLimit = beaconTrackConfig.coastMisses;
            if ((tr->edgePredictionSideMask != 0u) &&
                (beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames != 0u))
            {
                outputLimit = beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames;
            }
            if (tr->misses > outputLimit) continue;
        }
        float predFrames = beaconTrackPredictFramesForOutput(tr);
        float predX = beaconTrackPredX(tr, predFrames);
        float predY = beaconTrackPredY(tr, predFrames);
        float predSize = beaconTrackPredSize(tr, predFrames);
        if (tr->borderEligible == 0u) continue;
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].centerX = (uint16_t) (tr->cx + 0.5f);
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].centerY = (uint16_t) (tr->cy + 0.5f);
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].size = beaconTrackClampSize(tr->size);
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].trackId = tr->trackId;
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].predX = beaconTrackClampCoord(predX, OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH);
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].predY = beaconTrackClampCoord(predY, OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT);
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].predSize = beaconTrackClampSize(predSize);
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].misses = tr->misses;
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].fresh = tr->fresh;
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].flags =
            (tr->fresh ? BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_FRESH : 0u) |
            (tr->misses > 0u ? BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_COAST : 0u) |
            ((!tr->fresh && (tr->edgePredictionSideMask != 0u) &&
              (beaconTrackConfig.edgePredictionHoldFrames != 0u))
                ? BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_EDGE_GRACE : 0u);
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].frameSeq = tr->frameSeq;
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].velX = tr->velX;
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].velY = tr->velY;
        tracker->confirmed[outCount].areaVel = tr->areaVel;
        outCount++;
    }
    tracker->confirmedCount = outCount;
}

#ifndef BEACON_TRACK_H
#define BEACON_TRACK_H

#include <stdint.h>

#include "openMorph.h"  /* BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT / BEACON_DATA_STRUCT / OM_MAX_OBJECTS */

#define BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_FRESH       (0x01u)
#define BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_COAST       (0x02u)
#define BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_EDGE_GRACE  (0x04u)
#define BEACON_CONFIRMED_FLAG_BORDER_REJECTED (0x08u)

/*
 * beaconTrack - 信标时间一致性跟踪（抗光关键层）
 *
 * 单帧检测器（运行时 BinaryCC / Legacy Canny 二选一）可能出现瞬时反光误检(FP)与小目标漏检(FN)。本模块在其上叠加
 * 跨帧关联 + 位置/面积连续性门控 + 稳定性计数：连续 confirmHits 帧关联上才
 * 确认输出、连续 dropMisses 帧丢失才删除。瞬时反光跨帧不连续，过不了确认
 * 门控被滤掉。历史 Legacy Canny 仿真(run_beacon_tracking_test.py): 单帧 4 FP → 跟踪 0 FP。
 *
 * 信标恒亮不闪、可多帧延迟，故时间一致性是合理且有效的抗光手段。
 */

/* 跟踪参数默认值已移至 config/configBeaconTrack.h(VISION_TRACK_*_DEFAULT)。 */

/* 单条轨迹 */
typedef struct
{
    float cx;             /* 平滑后质心 X */
    float cy;             /* 平滑后质心 Y */
    float size;           /* 平滑后像素数 */
    float lastRawX;       /* 上次关联的原始检测 X */
    float lastRawY;       /* 上次关联的原始检测 Y */
    float lastRawSize;    /* 上次关联的原始检测面积 */
    float velX;           /* 原始检测速度(px/frame) */
    float velY;           /* 原始检测速度(px/frame) */
    float areaVel;        /* 原始检测面积速度(area pixels/frame) */
    uint32_t frameSeq;    /* 最近一次输出所属图像帧序号 */
    uint16_t trackId;     /* 轨迹 ID；0 保留为无效 */
    uint16_t hits;        /* 连续命中帧数 */
    uint16_t misses;      /* 连续丢失帧数 */
    uint8_t confirmed;    /* 1=已确认(连续命中达阈值) */
    uint8_t fresh;        /* 1=本帧关联到真实检测 */
    uint8_t velocityPrimed; /* 1=velX/velY 已由连续两次检测建立 */
    uint8_t areaVelocityPrimed; /* 1=areaVel 已由连续两次检测建立 */
    uint8_t borderEligible; /* 1=已通过发布边界施密特门 */
    uint8_t borderOutsideFrames; /* 连续越过 Exit 边界的输出判定帧数 */
    uint8_t edgePredictionSideMask; /* 上次 fresh 命中的 EdgeBand 边位掩码 */
    uint8_t published; /* 至少产生过一帧普通发布记录 */
    uint8_t active;       /* 1=槽位占用 */
} beaconTrackStruct;

/* 确认输出的信标质心(供决策/规划消费) */
typedef struct
{
    uint16_t centerX;
    uint16_t centerY;
    uint16_t size;
    uint16_t trackId;
    uint16_t predX;
    uint16_t predY;
    uint16_t predSize;
    uint16_t misses;
    uint8_t fresh;
    uint8_t flags;
    uint32_t frameSeq;
    float velX;           /* px/frame */
    float velY;           /* px/frame */
    float areaVel;        /* area pixels/frame */
} beaconConfirmedStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t left;
    uint8_t right;
    uint8_t top;
    uint8_t bottom;
} beaconTrackBorderMarginsStruct;

typedef struct
{
    beaconTrackBorderMarginsStruct enter;
    beaconTrackBorderMarginsStruct exit;
} beaconTrackBorderConfigStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t left;
    uint8_t right;
    uint8_t top;
    uint8_t bottom;
} beaconTrackEdgeBandsStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint16_t holdMs;
    beaconTrackEdgeBandsStruct bands;
} beaconTrackEdgePredictionConfigStruct;

/* 跟踪器 */
typedef struct
{
    beaconTrackStruct tracks[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];
    beaconConfirmedStruct confirmed[OM_MAX_OBJECTS]; /* update 后的确认输出 */
    uint16_t confirmedCount;
    uint16_t nextTrackId;
    uint32_t frameSeq;
} beaconTrackerStruct;

/* 初始化(清空所有轨迹) */
void beaconTrackInit(beaconTrackerStruct* tracker);

/* 运行时设置跟踪参数(默认取 configBeaconTrack.h #define, 菜单可热重载)。
 * positionAlpha/sizeAlpha: 关联更新一阶低通系数(0<alpha<=1, 越小越平滑; 替代原硬编码 0.5)。
 * 仅 Core4 前台 beaconTrackUpdate 读写, 无 ISR 竞争。 */
void beaconTrackSetParams(float maxAssocDist, float sizeRatioMax,
                          uint16_t confirmHits, uint16_t dropMisses, uint16_t coastMisses,
                          float positionAlpha, float sizeAlpha,
                          float areaVelAlpha, float assocScoreMax,
                          float assocAreaWeight, float assocAreaVelWeight);

void beaconTrackSetBorderMargins(const beaconTrackBorderConfigStruct* margins);
void beaconTrackSetEdgePredictionConfig(
    const beaconTrackEdgePredictionConfigStruct* config);

/* 用本帧 om_beacon 检测结果更新跟踪器；更新后确认信标在 tracker->confirmed[0..confirmedCount-1] */
void beaconTrackUpdate(beaconTrackerStruct* tracker, const BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT* det);
void beaconTrackMarkPublished(beaconTrackerStruct* tracker, uint16_t trackId);

#endif  /* BEACON_TRACK_H */

/*
 * om_beacon.c - [6] 信标检测 (Beacon Detection)
 *
 * 基于Canny边缘 + 简化BFS, 检测多个红外信标 (闭合椭圆/圆形轮廓)
 * 判据: 闭合性 + 尺寸 + 偏心率上限 + 内部亮度
 * 复用 Core4 vision workspace 的 inContourMap / contourQueue / contourGeneration 基础设施
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint16_t sizeMax;
    uint16_t sizeMin;
    float eccMaxRatioK;     // 预计算: ((eccMax-1)/(eccMax+1))^2, 用于无sqrt偏心率比较
    uint8_t brightnessMin;  // 内部亮度下限
    uint16_t maxEndpoints;  // 允许的最大端点数 (信标边缘常有断裂)
} BEACON_DATA_CONFIG;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static BEACON_DATA_CONFIG beaconDataConfig;

// ---- 内部函数声明 ----

static inline uint16_t beaconBFS(const u8Image* edgeSrc, uint16_t startX, uint16_t startY, uint32_t genTag, BEACON_DATA_STRUCT* beacon, float* outMxx, float* outMyy, float* outMxy);

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void beaconDetectInit(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax, float eccMax, uint8_t brightnessMin, uint16_t maxEndpoints)
{
    beaconDataConfig.sizeMin = sizeMin;
    beaconDataConfig.sizeMax = sizeMax;
    // 预计算偏心率阈值的平方比值, 运行时只需一次乘法+比较
    float k = (eccMax - 1.0f) / (eccMax + 1.0f);
    beaconDataConfig.eccMaxRatioK = k * k;
    beaconDataConfig.brightnessMin = brightnessMin;
    beaconDataConfig.maxEndpoints = maxEndpoints;
}

uint16_t beaconDetect(const u8Image* edgeSrc, const u8Image* graySrc, BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj)
{
    if (edgeSrc->size > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) return 0;

    // generation 替代 memset (与 contourDetect 共享基础设施)
    contourGeneration++;
    if (contourGeneration == 0)
    {
        memset(inContourMap, 0, sizeof(inContourMap));
        contourGeneration = 1;
    }
    uint32_t genBase = (uint32_t) contourGeneration << 16;

    uint16_t beaconCount = 0;
    uint32_t tagCounter = 0;

    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < edgeSrc->yLen && beaconCount < (OM_MAX_OBJECTS - 1u); y++)
    {
        uint32_t rowOff = y * edgeSrc->xLen;
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < edgeSrc->xLen && beaconCount < 100; x++)
        {
            uint32_t i = rowOff + x;
            if (edgeSrc->ptr[i] != WHITE || (inContourMap[i] >> 16) == contourGeneration) continue;

            tagCounter++;
            if (tagCounter > 0xFFFFu) goto beaconDone;

            uint32_t genTag = genBase | (uint32_t) tagCounter;

            float curMxx, curMyy, curMxy;
            uint16_t ep = beaconBFS(edgeSrc, (uint16_t) x, (uint16_t) y, genTag,
                                    &obj->beaconData[beaconCount], &curMxx, &curMyy, &curMxy);

            // 闭合轮廓过滤 (信标边缘断裂容忍)
            if (ep > beaconDataConfig.maxEndpoints) continue;

            // 尺寸过滤
            uint16_t sz = obj->beaconData[beaconCount].contourSize;
            if (sz < beaconDataConfig.sizeMin || sz > beaconDataConfig.sizeMax) continue;

            // 偏心率上限过滤: 拒绝过度拉伸的非信标轮廓
            // eigMax/eigMin > eccMax  <=>  diff^2 > sum^2 * ((eccMax-1)/(eccMax+1))^2
            float eigSum = curMxx + curMyy;
            float eigDiff2 = (curMxx - curMyy) * (curMxx - curMyy) + 4.0f * curMxy * curMxy;
            if (eigSum > 0.0f)
            {
                float bound = eigSum * eigSum * beaconDataConfig.eccMaxRatioK;
                if (eigDiff2 > bound) continue;
            }

            // 质心亮度检查: 填充椭圆的质心必在填充区域内, 单像素即可判定
            uint16_t cx = obj->beaconData[beaconCount].centerX;
            uint16_t cy = obj->beaconData[beaconCount].centerY;
            uint8_t centroidBrightness = graySrc->ptr[(uint32_t) cy * graySrc->xLen + (uint32_t) cx];
            obj->beaconData[beaconCount].brightness = centroidBrightness;
            if (centroidBrightness < beaconDataConfig.brightnessMin) continue;

            beaconCount++;
        }
    }

beaconDone:
    obj->beaconCount = beaconCount;
    for (uint16_t i = beaconCount; i < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; i++) obj->beaconData[i].contourSize = 0;
    return beaconCount;
}

// ---- 内部函数实现 ----

// 简化BFS: 仅计算二阶矩 (无三阶矩/朝向), 返回端点数
static inline uint16_t beaconBFS(const u8Image* obj, uint16_t startX, uint16_t startY, uint32_t genTag, BEACON_DATA_STRUCT* beacon, float* outMxx, float* outMyy, float* outMxy)
{
    uint32_t width = obj->xLen;
    uint32_t height = obj->yLen;

    beacon->contourSize = 0;
    beacon->centerX = 0;
    beacon->centerY = 0;
    beacon->brightness = 0;

    uint16_t head = 0;
    uint16_t tail = 0;

    inContourMap[startY * width + startX] = genTag;
    contourQueue[tail++] = ((uint32_t) startY << 16) | (uint32_t) startX;

    uint32_t sumX = 0;
    uint32_t sumY = 0;
    uint32_t sumXX = 0;
    uint32_t sumYY = 0;
    uint32_t sumXY = 0;
    uint16_t totalCount = 0;
    uint16_t endpointCount = 0;
    uint8_t abandon = 0;

    while (head < tail)
    {
        uint16_t cx = (uint16_t) (contourQueue[head] & 0xFFFFu);
        uint16_t cy = (uint16_t) (contourQueue[head] >> 16);
        head++;

        totalCount++;

        if (!abandon)
        {
            sumX += cx;
            sumY += cy;
            sumXX += (uint32_t) cx * cx;
            sumYY += (uint32_t) cy * cy;
            sumXY += (uint32_t) cx * cy;
        }

        uint8_t whiteNeighborCount = 0;

        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            int32_t nx = (int32_t) cx + contourDx[i];
            int32_t ny = (int32_t) cy + contourDy[i];

            if (nx < 0 || (uint32_t) nx >= width || ny < 0 || (uint32_t) ny >= height) continue;

            uint16_t nIdx = (uint16_t) ((uint32_t) ny * width + (uint32_t) nx);

            if (obj->ptr[nIdx] == WHITE)
            {
                whiteNeighborCount++;

                if ((inContourMap[nIdx] >> 16) != contourGeneration)
                {
                    inContourMap[nIdx] = genTag;
                    if (tail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                        contourQueue[tail++] = ((uint32_t) ny << 16) | (uint32_t) nx;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!abandon && whiteNeighborCount < 2) endpointCount++;

        if (!abandon && (totalCount > beaconDataConfig.sizeMax || endpointCount > beaconDataConfig.maxEndpoints)) abandon = 1;
    }

    /* abandon 时置 0：让调用方尺寸过滤 (sz < sizeMin) 直接拒绝本应丢弃的轮廓 */
    beacon->contourSize = abandon ? 0u : totalCount;

    if (totalCount > 0 && !abandon)
    {
        float fN = (float) totalCount;
        float meanX = (float) sumX / fN;
        float meanY = (float) sumY / fN;
        beacon->centerX = (uint16_t) (sumX / totalCount);
        beacon->centerY = (uint16_t) (sumY / totalCount);

        *outMxx = (float) sumXX / fN - meanX * meanX;
        *outMyy = (float) sumYY / fN - meanY * meanY;
        *outMxy = (float) sumXY / fN - meanX * meanY;
    }
    else
    {
        *outMxx = 0.0f;
        *outMyy = 0.0f;
        *outMxy = 0.0f;
    }

    return endpointCount;
}

/*
 * om_beaconcc.c - core1 信标 BinaryCC 检测
 *
 * 双阈值二值化 + 八连通连通域 + 矩/Hu 筛选，输出兼容 BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT。
 */

#include "om_beaconcc.h"

#include "om_internal.h"

typedef struct
{
    uint16_t area;
    uint16_t bboxMinX;
    uint16_t bboxMinY;
    uint16_t bboxMaxX;
    uint16_t bboxMaxY;
    float centroidX;
    float centroidY;
    float meanBrightness;
    uint8_t peakBrightness;
    float m20;
    float m02;
    float m11;
    float m30;
    float m03;
    float m21;
    float m12;
    float hu[7];
    float huDistance;
    float ecc;
    float fillRatio;
    uint8_t shapeEligible;
    uint8_t huEligible;
} BEACONCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT;

static BEACONCC_CONFIG_STRUCT beaconCcConfig;
static uint8_t beaconCcTemplateReady = 0u;
static float beaconCcHuTemplate[7];
static uint8_t beaconCcCandidateCount = 0u;

static void beaconCcThreshold(const u8Image* graySrc, u8Image* maskDst);
static uint8_t beaconCcVisited(uint32_t index);
static void beaconCcMarkVisited(uint32_t index);
static uint8_t beaconCcScanComponent(const u8Image* graySrc, const u8Image* maskDst, uint32_t startIndex,
                                     BEACONCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* out);
static void beaconCcFinishCandidate(BEACONCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* c, float sumX, float sumY,
                                    float sumX2, float sumY2, float sumXY,
                                    float sumX3, float sumY3, float sumX2Y, float sumXY2,
                                    float sumGray, uint8_t peakBrightness);
static void beaconCcComputeHu(float area, float mu20, float mu02, float mu11, float mu30, float mu03,
                              float mu21, float mu12, float hu[7]);
static float beaconCcHuDistance(const float hu[7], const float templ[7]);

void beaconCcInit(const BEACONCC_CONFIG_STRUCT* config)
{
    memset(&beaconCcConfig, 0, sizeof(beaconCcConfig));
    memset(beaconCcHuTemplate, 0, sizeof(beaconCcHuTemplate));
    beaconCcTemplateReady = 0u;
    beaconCcCandidateCount = 0u;
    if (config != 0) beaconCcConfig = *config;
}

void beaconCcSetConfig(const BEACONCC_CONFIG_STRUCT* config)
{
    if (config == 0) return;
    beaconCcConfig = *config;
}

void beaconCcSetTemplate(const float hu[7], float huMax)
{
    if (hu == 0 || huMax <= 0.0f)
    {
        beaconCcTemplateReady = 0u;
        beaconCcConfig.huMax = 0.0f;
        return;
    }
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++) beaconCcHuTemplate[i] = hu[i];
    beaconCcConfig.huMax = huMax;
    beaconCcTemplateReady = 1u;
}

uint16_t beaconCcDetect(const u8Image* graySrc, u8Image* maskDst, BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj)
{
    if (obj == 0 || graySrc == 0 || maskDst == 0 || graySrc->ptr == 0 || maskDst->ptr == 0 ||
        graySrc->size > OM_BUFFER_SIZE || maskDst->size < graySrc->size)
    {
        if (obj != 0) obj->beaconCount = 0u;
        return 0u;
    }

    beaconCcThreshold(graySrc, maskDst);
    beaconCcCandidateCount = 0u;

    contourGeneration++;
    if (contourGeneration == 0u)
    {
        memset(inContourMap, 0, graySrc->size * sizeof(inContourMap[0]));
        contourGeneration = 1u;
    }

    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < graySrc->size; i++)
    {
        BEACONCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT c;
        if (maskDst->ptr[i] != WHITE || beaconCcVisited(i)) continue;

        memset(&c, 0, sizeof(c));
        if (!beaconCcScanComponent(graySrc, maskDst, i, &c))
        {
            continue;
        }

        if (c.area < beaconCcConfig.areaMin)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (beaconCcConfig.areaMax > 0u && c.area > beaconCcConfig.areaMax)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (beaconCcConfig.brightnessMin > 0u && c.meanBrightness < (float) beaconCcConfig.brightnessMin)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (c.shapeEligible && beaconCcConfig.eccMax > 0.0f && c.ecc > beaconCcConfig.eccMax)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (c.shapeEligible && beaconCcConfig.fillMin > 0.0f && c.fillRatio < beaconCcConfig.fillMin)
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (beaconCcTemplateReady && c.huEligible && beaconCcConfig.huMax > 0.0f &&
            c.huDistance > beaconCcConfig.huMax)
        {
            continue;
        }

        if (beaconCcCandidateCount < OM_MAX_OBJECTS)
        {
            uint8_t dst = beaconCcCandidateCount;
            obj->beaconData[dst].centerX = (uint16_t) (c.centroidX + 0.5f);
            obj->beaconData[dst].centerY = (uint16_t) (c.centroidY + 0.5f);
            obj->beaconData[dst].contourSize = c.area;
            obj->beaconData[dst].brightness = (uint8_t) (c.meanBrightness + 0.5f);
            beaconCcCandidateCount++;
        }
    }

    obj->beaconCount = beaconCcCandidateCount;
    for (uint8_t i = beaconCcCandidateCount; i < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; i++) obj->beaconData[i].contourSize = 0u;
    return beaconCcCandidateCount;
}

static void beaconCcThreshold(const u8Image* graySrc, u8Image* maskDst)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < graySrc->size; i++)
    {
        uint8_t v = graySrc->ptr[i];
        maskDst->ptr[i] = (v >= beaconCcConfig.thresholdLow && v <= beaconCcConfig.thresholdHigh) ? WHITE : BLACK;
    }
}

static uint8_t beaconCcVisited(uint32_t index)
{
    return ((inContourMap[index] >> 16) == contourGeneration) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static void beaconCcMarkVisited(uint32_t index)
{
    inContourMap[index] = ((uint32_t) contourGeneration << 16) | 1u;
}

static uint8_t beaconCcScanComponent(const u8Image* graySrc, const u8Image* maskDst, uint32_t startIndex,
                                     BEACONCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* out)
{
    uint32_t head = 0u;
    uint32_t tail = 0u;
    float sumX = 0.0f, sumY = 0.0f, sumX2 = 0.0f, sumY2 = 0.0f, sumXY = 0.0f;
    float sumX3 = 0.0f, sumY3 = 0.0f, sumX2Y = 0.0f, sumXY2 = 0.0f, sumGray = 0.0f;
    uint8_t peakBrightness = 0u;

    out->bboxMinX = graySrc->xLen;
    out->bboxMinY = graySrc->yLen;
    if (tail >= OM_BUFFER_SIZE) return 0u;
    contourQueue[tail++] = startIndex;
    beaconCcMarkVisited(startIndex);

    while (head < tail)
    {
        uint32_t cur = contourQueue[head++];
        uint32_t x = cur % graySrc->xLen;
        uint32_t y = cur / graySrc->xLen;
        float xf = (float) x;
        float yf = (float) y;
        uint8_t gray8 = graySrc->ptr[cur];
        float gray = (float) gray8;

        out->area++;
        if (x < out->bboxMinX) out->bboxMinX = (uint16_t) x;
        if (y < out->bboxMinY) out->bboxMinY = (uint16_t) y;
        if (x > out->bboxMaxX) out->bboxMaxX = (uint16_t) x;
        if (y > out->bboxMaxY) out->bboxMaxY = (uint16_t) y;
        if (gray8 > peakBrightness) peakBrightness = gray8;

        sumX += xf;
        sumY += yf;
        sumX2 += xf * xf;
        sumY2 += yf * yf;
        sumXY += xf * yf;
        sumX3 += xf * xf * xf;
        sumY3 += yf * yf * yf;
        sumX2Y += xf * xf * yf;
        sumXY2 += xf * yf * yf;
        sumGray += gray;

        for (uint8_t ni = 0u; ni < 8u; ni++)
        {
            int32_t nx = (int32_t) x + contourDx[ni];
            int32_t ny = (int32_t) y + contourDy[ni];
            uint32_t next;
            if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || (uint32_t) nx >= graySrc->xLen || (uint32_t) ny >= graySrc->yLen) continue;
            next = (uint32_t) ny * graySrc->xLen + (uint32_t) nx;
            if (maskDst->ptr[next] == WHITE && !beaconCcVisited(next))
            {
                if (tail >= OM_BUFFER_SIZE) return 0u;
                beaconCcMarkVisited(next);
                contourQueue[tail++] = next;
            }
        }
    }

    if (out->area == 0u) return 0u;
    beaconCcFinishCandidate(out, sumX, sumY, sumX2, sumY2, sumXY, sumX3, sumY3,
                            sumX2Y, sumXY2, sumGray, peakBrightness);
    return 1u;
}

static void beaconCcFinishCandidate(BEACONCC_CANDIDATE_STRUCT* c, float sumX, float sumY,
                                    float sumX2, float sumY2, float sumXY,
                                    float sumX3, float sumY3, float sumX2Y, float sumXY2,
                                    float sumGray, uint8_t peakBrightness)
{
    float area = (float) c->area;
    float cx = sumX / area;
    float cy = sumY / area;
    float mu20 = sumX2 - cx * sumX;
    float mu02 = sumY2 - cy * sumY;
    float mu11 = sumXY - cx * sumY;
    float mu30 = sumX3 - 3.0f * cx * sumX2 + 3.0f * cx * cx * sumX - cx * cx * cx * area;
    float mu03 = sumY3 - 3.0f * cy * sumY2 + 3.0f * cy * cy * sumY - cy * cy * cy * area;
    float mu21 = sumX2Y - cy * sumX2 - 2.0f * cx * sumXY + 2.0f * cx * cy * sumX + cx * cx * sumY - cx * cx * cy * area;
    float mu12 = sumXY2 - cx * sumY2 - 2.0f * cy * sumXY + 2.0f * cx * cy * sumY + cy * cy * sumX - cx * cy * cy * area;
    float covXX = mu20 / area;
    float covYY = mu02 / area;
    float covXY = mu11 / area;
    float trace = covXX + covYY;
    float delta = sqrtf((covXX - covYY) * (covXX - covYY) + 4.0f * covXY * covXY);
    float lambdaA = (trace + delta) * 0.5f;
    float lambdaB = (trace - delta) * 0.5f;
    float bboxArea = (float) ((c->bboxMaxX - c->bboxMinX + 1u) * (c->bboxMaxY - c->bboxMinY + 1u));

    if (lambdaA < lambdaB)
    {
        float t = lambdaA;
        lambdaA = lambdaB;
        lambdaB = t;
    }

    c->centroidX = cx;
    c->centroidY = cy;
    c->meanBrightness = sumGray / area;
    c->peakBrightness = peakBrightness;
    c->m20 = mu20;
    c->m02 = mu02;
    c->m11 = mu11;
    c->m30 = mu30;
    c->m03 = mu03;
    c->m21 = mu21;
    c->m12 = mu12;
    c->ecc = (lambdaB > 1.0e-6f) ? (lambdaA / lambdaB) : 9999.0f;
    c->fillRatio = (bboxArea > 0.0f) ? (area / bboxArea) : 0.0f;
    beaconCcComputeHu(area, mu20, mu02, mu11, mu30, mu03, mu21, mu12, c->hu);
    c->huDistance = beaconCcTemplateReady ? beaconCcHuDistance(c->hu, beaconCcHuTemplate) : -1.0f;
    c->shapeEligible = (c->area >= beaconCcConfig.huAreaMin) ? 1u : 0u;
    c->huEligible = (beaconCcTemplateReady && c->shapeEligible) ? 1u : 0u;
}

static void beaconCcComputeHu(float area, float mu20, float mu02, float mu11, float mu30, float mu03,
                              float mu21, float mu12, float hu[7])
{
    float invArea2 = 1.0f / (area * area);
    float invArea25 = invArea2 / sqrtf(area);
    float eta20 = mu20 * invArea2;
    float eta02 = mu02 * invArea2;
    float eta11 = mu11 * invArea2;
    float eta30 = mu30 * invArea25;
    float eta03 = mu03 * invArea25;
    float eta21 = mu21 * invArea25;
    float eta12 = mu12 * invArea25;
    float a = eta30 + eta12;
    float b = eta21 + eta03;
    float c = eta30 - 3.0f * eta12;
    float d = 3.0f * eta21 - eta03;

    hu[0] = eta20 + eta02;
    hu[1] = (eta20 - eta02) * (eta20 - eta02) + 4.0f * eta11 * eta11;
    hu[2] = c * c + d * d;
    hu[3] = a * a + b * b;
    hu[4] = c * a * (a * a - 3.0f * b * b) + d * b * (3.0f * a * a - b * b);
    hu[5] = (eta20 - eta02) * (a * a - b * b) + 4.0f * eta11 * a * b;
    hu[6] = d * a * (a * a - 3.0f * b * b) - c * b * (3.0f * a * a - b * b);
}

static float beaconCcHuDistance(const float hu[7], const float templ[7])
{
    static const float weights[7] = {2.0f, 2.0f, 1.5f, 1.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.02f};
    float distance = 0.0f;
    for (uint8_t i = 0u; i < 7u; i++)
    {
        float a = fabsf(hu[i]);
        float b = fabsf(templ[i]);
        if (a < 1.0e-12f) a = 1.0e-12f;
        if (b < 1.0e-12f) b = 1.0e-12f;
        distance += weights[i] * fabsf(logf(a) - logf(b));
    }
    return distance;
}

/*
 * om_canny.c - [4] 高斯模糊及Canny边缘检测
 *
 * 3x3定点高斯核 / 逐行流水线 Sobel+NMS+滞后门限 边缘检测
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- define ----

#define CANNY_RING_WIDTH (OM_CANNY_RING_WIDTH)

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t width;
    uint32_t height;
    uint32_t pixelCount;
    uint32_t cropStartX;
    uint32_t cropStartY;
    uint32_t cropEndX;
    uint32_t cropEndY;
    uint32_t blurStartX;
    uint32_t blurStartY;
    uint32_t blurEndX;
    uint32_t blurEndY;
} gaussConfigStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t width;
    uint32_t height;
    uint32_t pixelCount;
    uint32_t sobelStartX;
    uint32_t sobelStartY;
    uint32_t sobelEndX;
    uint32_t sobelEndY;
    uint32_t nmsStartX;
    uint32_t nmsStartY;
    uint32_t nmsEndX;
    uint32_t nmsEndY;
    uint16_t thresholdLow;
    uint16_t thresholdHigh;
    uint32_t thresholdLowSq;
    uint32_t thresholdHighSq;
    int32_t trackOffsets[8];
} cannyConfigStruct;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt0[256];
static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt1[256];
static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt2[256];
static gaussConfigStruct gaussConfig = {0u};
static cannyConfigStruct cannyConfig = {0u};
static uint32_t sobelMapRing[3][CANNY_RING_WIDTH] = {0};
static uint8_t sobelDirMapRing[3][CANNY_RING_WIDTH] = {0};

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void gaussianInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY)
{
    // gaussianKernelTemp[0] : 四个角点对应的核值
    // gaussianKernelTemp[1] : 四个边点对应的核值
    // gaussianKernelTemp[2] : 中心点对应的核值
    float gaussianKernelTemp[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};

    memset(&gaussConfig, 0, sizeof(gaussConfig));

    if ((NULL == src) || (NULL == src->ptr) || (0u == src->xLen) || (0u == src->yLen) ||
        (src->xLen > CANNY_RING_WIDTH) || ((src->xLen * src->yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE))
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    gaussConfig.width = src->xLen;
    gaussConfig.height = src->yLen;
    gaussConfig.pixelCount = src->xLen * src->yLen;

    if (startX > endX)
    {
        uint32_t temp = startX;
        startX = endX;
        endX = temp;
    }
    if (startY > endY)
    {
        uint32_t temp = startY;
        startY = endY;
        endY = temp;
    }

    gaussConfig.cropStartX = unsignRange(startX, gaussConfig.width - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropStartY = unsignRange(startY, gaussConfig.height - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropEndX = range(endX, gaussConfig.cropStartX, gaussConfig.width - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropEndY = range(endY, gaussConfig.cropStartY, gaussConfig.height - 1u);

    gaussConfig.blurStartX = 1u;
    gaussConfig.blurStartY = 1u;
    gaussConfig.blurEndX = 0u;
    gaussConfig.blurEndY = 0u;

    if ((gaussConfig.width >= 3u) && (gaussConfig.height >= 3u) &&
        ((gaussConfig.cropEndX - gaussConfig.cropStartX) >= 2u) &&
        ((gaussConfig.cropEndY - gaussConfig.cropStartY) >= 2u))
    {
        gaussConfig.blurStartX = (0u == gaussConfig.cropStartX) ? 1u : (gaussConfig.cropStartX + 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurStartY = (0u == gaussConfig.cropStartY) ? 1u : (gaussConfig.cropStartY + 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurEndX = (gaussConfig.cropEndX >= (gaussConfig.width - 1u)) ? (gaussConfig.width - 2u) : (gaussConfig.cropEndX - 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurEndY = (gaussConfig.cropEndY >= (gaussConfig.height - 1u)) ? (gaussConfig.height - 2u) : (gaussConfig.cropEndY - 1u);
    }

    if (sigma <= 0.0f)
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    float sigma2 = sigma * sigma;
    float coeff = 1.0f / (TWO_PI * sigma2);
    float sum = 0.0f;

    // 生成 3x3 高斯核，并提取 3 个唯一值（角点/边点/中心）
    for (uint8_t y = 0u; y < 3; y++)
    {
        for (uint8_t x = 0u; x < 3; x++)
        {
            int16_t dx = (int16_t) x - 1;
            int16_t dy = (int16_t) y - 1;
            float exponent = -((float) (dx * dx + dy * dy)) / (2.0f * sigma2);
            float value = (float) exp((double) exponent) * coeff;

            if (0 == dx && 0 == dy) gaussianKernelTemp[2] = value;
            else if (0 == dx || 0 == dy) gaussianKernelTemp[1] = value;
            else gaussianKernelTemp[0] = value;

            sum += value;
        }
    }

    if (sum <= 0.0f)
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    // 归一化 3 个唯一核值
    gaussianKernelTemp[0] /= sum;
    gaussianKernelTemp[1] /= sum;
    gaussianKernelTemp[2] /= sum;

    // 预计算核值与 8bit 灰度值相乘的 定点数 (放缩256倍)，消除内层浮点开销
    for (uint16_t gray = 0u; gray < 256; gray++)
    {
        gaussKernelPreValueInt0[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[0] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
        gaussKernelPreValueInt1[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[1] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
        gaussKernelPreValueInt2[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[2] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
    }
}
void cannyInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY, uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    gaussianInit(src, sigma, startX, startY, endX, endY);

    memset(&cannyConfig, 0, sizeof(cannyConfig));

    if ((NULL == src) || (NULL == src->ptr) || (0u == src->xLen) || (0u == src->yLen) ||
        (src->xLen > CANNY_RING_WIDTH) || ((src->xLen * src->yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)) return;

    cannyConfig.width = src->xLen;
    cannyConfig.height = src->yLen;
    cannyConfig.pixelCount = src->xLen * src->yLen;

    if (thresholdLow > thresholdHigh)
    {
        uint16_t temp = thresholdLow;
        thresholdLow = thresholdHigh;
        thresholdHigh = temp;
    }

    cannyConfig.thresholdLow = thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHigh = thresholdHigh;

    // 提前计算平方
    cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq = (uint32_t) thresholdLow * thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq = (uint32_t) thresholdHigh * thresholdHigh;

    cannyConfig.sobelStartX = 1u;
    cannyConfig.sobelStartY = 1u;
    cannyConfig.sobelEndX = 0u;
    cannyConfig.sobelEndY = 0u;
    cannyConfig.nmsStartX = 1u;
    cannyConfig.nmsStartY = 1u;
    cannyConfig.nmsEndX = 0u;
    cannyConfig.nmsEndY = 0u;

    if ((gaussConfig.blurEndX > (gaussConfig.blurStartX + 1u)) &&
        (gaussConfig.blurEndY > (gaussConfig.blurStartY + 1u)))
    {
        cannyConfig.sobelStartX = gaussConfig.blurStartX + 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelStartY = gaussConfig.blurStartY + 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelEndX = gaussConfig.blurEndX - 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelEndY = gaussConfig.blurEndY - 1u;
    }

    if ((cannyConfig.sobelEndX > (cannyConfig.sobelStartX + 1u)) &&
        (cannyConfig.sobelEndY > (cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u)))
    {
        cannyConfig.nmsStartX = cannyConfig.sobelStartX + 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsStartY = cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsEndX = cannyConfig.sobelEndX - 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsEndY = cannyConfig.sobelEndY - 1u;
    }

    // 预先计算滞后门限追踪(连边)阶段需要的直接邻信偏移
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[0] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width - 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[1] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[2] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width + 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[3] = -1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[4] = 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[5] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width - 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[6] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[7] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width + 1;
}

/* 运行时仅更新 Canny 双阈值，不重算高斯核与 ROI，便于按键调参 */
void cannySetThreshold(uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    if (thresholdLow > thresholdHigh)
    {
        uint16_t temp = thresholdLow;
        thresholdLow = thresholdHigh;
        thresholdHigh = temp;
    }

    cannyConfig.thresholdLow = thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHigh = thresholdHigh;
    cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq = (uint32_t) thresholdLow * thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq = (uint32_t) thresholdHigh * thresholdHigh;
}

void cannyEdgeDetection(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dstGaussBlur, u8Image* dst)
{
    if (NULL == src || NULL == src->ptr || NULL == dstGaussBlur || NULL == dstGaussBlur->ptr ||
        NULL == dst || NULL == dst->ptr) return;
    if (0u == cannyConfig.pixelCount || 0u == gaussConfig.width) return;

    uint32_t queueHead = 0u;
    uint32_t queueTail = 0u;

    // 清零目标画布、ring buffer 残留、高斯模糊边界脏值
    memset(dst->ptr, BLACK, gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height);
    memset(dstGaussBlur->ptr, 0, gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height);
    memset(sobelMapRing, 0, sizeof(sobelMapRing));
    memset(sobelDirMapRing, 0, sizeof(sobelDirMapRing));

    for (uint32_t y = gaussConfig.blurStartY; y <= gaussConfig.blurEndY; y++)
    {
        // ================== 第1阶段: 高斯模糊 ==================
        const uint8_t* row0 = src->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row1 = src->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row2 = src->ptr + (y + 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        uint8_t* dstRow = dstGaussBlur->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

        for (uint32_t x = gaussConfig.blurStartX; x <= gaussConfig.blurEndX; x++)
        {
            uint32_t result = gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row0[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt2[row1[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row2[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x + 1u]];

            result = (result + 128) >> 8;
            dstRow[x] = (uint8_t) ((result > 255) ? 255 : result);
        }

        // ================== 第2阶段: Sobel计算 ==================
        if ((cannyConfig.sobelStartX <= cannyConfig.sobelEndX) &&
            (cannyConfig.sobelStartY <= cannyConfig.sobelEndY) &&
            (y >= (cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u)) &&
            ((y - 1u) <= cannyConfig.sobelEndY))
        {
            const uint8_t* s_row0 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + (y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width;
            const uint8_t* s_row1 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
            const uint8_t* s_row2 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

            uint32_t* sobelRow = sobelMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];
            uint8_t* dirRow = sobelDirMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];

            for (uint32_t x = cannyConfig.sobelStartX; x <= cannyConfig.sobelEndX; x++)
            {
                int32_t gx = (int32_t) s_row0[x + 1u] + ((int32_t) s_row1[x + 1u] << 1) + (int32_t) s_row2[x + 1u] - (int32_t) s_row0[x - 1u] - ((int32_t) s_row1[x - 1u] << 1) - (int32_t) s_row2[x - 1u];
                int32_t gy = (int32_t) s_row0[x - 1u] + ((int32_t) s_row0[x] << 1) + (int32_t) s_row0[x + 1u] - (int32_t) s_row2[x - 1u] - ((int32_t) s_row2[x] << 1) - (int32_t) s_row2[x + 1u];

                // 去除掉极其耗时的 sqrtf 运算
                uint32_t mag_sq = (uint32_t) (gx * gx) + (uint32_t) (gy * gy);
                sobelRow[x] = mag_sq;

                // 完全消除浮点除法，只用整数比较判定4大区面方向
                int32_t ax = (gx >= 0) ? gx : -gx;
                int32_t ay = (gy >= 0) ? gy : -gy;
                int32_t ay256 = ay << 8;

                if (ay256 <= ax * 106)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 0;  // 水平梯度主导（纵向边缘），沿水平方向抑制
                }
                else if (ay256 >= ax * 618)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 2;  // 垂直梯度主导（横向边缘），沿垂直方向抑制
                }
                else if ((gx ^ gy) >= 0)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 1;  // 45度梯度
                }
                else
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 3;  // 135度梯度
                }
            }
        }

        // ================== 第3阶段: 非极大值抑制 ==================
        if ((cannyConfig.nmsStartX <= cannyConfig.nmsEndX) &&
            (cannyConfig.nmsStartY <= cannyConfig.nmsEndY) &&
            (y >= (cannyConfig.nmsStartY + 2u)) &&
            ((y - 2u) <= cannyConfig.nmsEndY))
        {
            const uint32_t* n_row0 = sobelMapRing[(y - 3u) % 3];
            const uint32_t* n_row1 = sobelMapRing[(y - 2u) % 3];
            const uint32_t* n_row2 = sobelMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];
            const uint8_t* dirRow = sobelDirMapRing[(y - 2u) % 3];

            uint8_t* final_dstRow = dst->ptr + (y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width + cannyConfig.nmsStartX;

            for (uint32_t x = cannyConfig.nmsStartX; x <= cannyConfig.nmsEndX; x++)
            {
                uint32_t edge0, edge1;
                uint32_t magnitude = n_row1[x];
                uint8_t dir = dirRow[x];

                if (dir == 0)
                {
                    edge0 = n_row1[x - 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row1[x + 1u];
                }
                else if (dir == 2)
                {
                    edge0 = n_row0[x];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x];
                }
                else if (dir == 1)
                {
                    // gx, gy 同号 → 梯度方向 ↗ (亮度梯度指向右上) → NMS 比较 ↗ 与 ↙
                    edge0 = n_row0[x + 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x - 1u];
                }
                else
                {
                    // gx, gy 异号 → 梯度方向 ↘ (亮度梯度指向右下) → NMS 比较 ↘ 与 ↖
                    edge0 = n_row0[x - 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x + 1u];
                }

                if ((magnitude > edge0) && (magnitude >= edge1))
                {
                    if (magnitude >= cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq)
                    {
                        *final_dstRow = WHITE;  // 确信强边缘
                        if (queueTail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                        {
                            cannyEdgeQueue[queueTail++] = (uint16_t) ((y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width + x);
                        }
                    }
                    else if (magnitude >= cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq)
                    {
                        *final_dstRow = 127;  // 先标记为弱边缘，用于第四阶段追踪，避免大数组分配
                    }
                }

                final_dstRow++;
            }
        }
    }

    // ================== 第4阶段: 滞后门限追踪(连边) ==================
    while (queueHead < queueTail)
    {
        uint32_t index = cannyEdgeQueue[queueHead++];

        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            int32_t trackIndex = (int32_t) index + cannyConfig.trackOffsets[i];

            if (trackIndex >= 0 && trackIndex < (int32_t) cannyConfig.pixelCount)
            {
                if (dst->ptr[trackIndex] == 127)
                {
                    dst->ptr[trackIndex] = WHITE;  // 连通升级为强边缘

                    // 防溢出保护
                    if (queueTail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                    {
                        cannyEdgeQueue[queueTail++] = (uint16_t) trackIndex;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ================== 收尾: 清理死路 ==================
    uint32_t totalPixels = gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < totalPixels; i++)
    {
        if (dst->ptr[i] == 127) dst->ptr[i] = BLACK;  // 无法与强边缘连通被消除
    }
}

/*
 * openMorph_config.h - openMorph 库可移植配置头
 *
 * 移植到新工程时只需修改本文件即可适配不同图像分辨率与对象数量上限。
 * openMorph 内部其他源文件不应再出现关于尺寸的字面量。
 */
#ifndef OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H
#define OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H

// ============================================================================
//  图像最大尺寸 (静态缓冲区按此分配)
// ============================================================================
//  Core4 实际相机 MT9V03X 为 188 x 120 = 22560 像素。
//  必须与相机分辨率匹配: 若小于真实分辨率, om_canny/cannyInit 入口保护
//  ((xLen*yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) 会拒绝处理 → canny 图纯黑、信标失效。
//  本副本只服务 Core4 前视相机，不引入或接管相机驱动。
//  像素索引以 uint16 存储 (om_beacon/om_canny), 故 W*H 须 <= 65535; 22560 在范围内。
//  本配置与具体相机驱动解耦，不引入 SDK 头依赖。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH  (188u)
#define OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT (120u)
#define OM_BUFFER_SIZE      (OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH * OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT)

// ============================================================================
//  对象检测数量上限 (轮廓 / 信标 / 连通域共用)
// ============================================================================
//  contourData[] / beaconData[] / sbea[] 等数组的成员数量。
//  超过此上限的候选对象会被忽略 (只保留前 N 个有效结果)。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_MAX_OBJECTS (101u)

// ============================================================================
//  Canny 流水线环形缓冲宽度
// ============================================================================
//  Canny 边缘检测内部 sobel 环形缓冲的列宽，必须 >= OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_CANNY_RING_WIDTH (256u)

// ============================================================================
//  轮廓跟踪状态机参数
// ============================================================================
#define OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD       (2u)      // 连续检测到帧数: SEARCHING → ACQUIRING
#define OM_LOCK_CONFIRM         (1u)      // 继续确认帧数: ACQUIRING → LOCKED
#define OM_LOST_THRESHOLD       (5u)      // 连续丢失帧数: LOCKED → LOST_HOLDING
#define OM_LOST_TIMEOUT         (30u)     // 超时帧数: LOST_HOLDING → SEARCHING
#define OM_RAY_BALANCE_CONFIDENCE_MIN (0.50f) // ^尖端几何定向最低置信度: 低于此值拒绝更新朝向, 目标位置仍有效
#define OM_ORIENTATION_MIN_SIZE (8u)      // 朝向可靠的最小像素数 (与 core0 openMorph 算法同源)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA    (0.4f)    // 朝向低通滤波系数 (喂给 lowPassFilter, 越大越跟随/越小越平滑)
#define OM_POSITION_ALPHA       (1.0f)    // 质心位置不过滤
#define OM_VELOCITY_ALPHA       (0.1f)    // 原始质心差分速度低通滤波系数
#define OM_VELOCITY_DT_MIN_S    (0.001f)  // 有效图像样本间隔下限
#define OM_VELOCITY_DT_MAX_S    (0.200f)  // 超过此间隔只重建速度基线
#define OM_BORDER_MARGIN        (1u)      // 画幅边缘安全边距

// ============================================================================
//  朝向跳变保护默认值 (运行时可由菜单热重载, 逻辑同 ToF 定高跳变保护)
//   NORMAL  态: |Δθ| > JUMP_MAX 视为异常突跳, 拒绝该样本进 SUSPENDED
//   SUSPEND 态: |Δθ| < RECOVER_RAD 即时恢复; 介于二者间累计 CONFIRM_FRAMES 帧后
//               接受新朝向为基线; 持续 > JUMP_MAX 则计数清零继续沿用旧朝向
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_ORIENTATION_JUMP_MAX       (0.785398f)  // PI/4, 朝向跳变阈值 (rad)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_RECOVER_RAD    (0.196349f)  // PI/16, 恢复窄带 (rad)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_CONFIRM_FRAMES (3u)         // 异常持续这么多帧后接受新朝向

#endif  // OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H

#ifndef COMMON_DEF_H
#define COMMON_DEF_H

#include <stdint.h>

/* coreT3 工作模式: cm_7_0 采集 MT9V03X 原始灰度帧并经 WiFi SPI 上行。 */
#define CORET3_MODE_RAW_IMAGE_STREAM (0)
#define CORET3_MODE                  (CORET3_MODE_RAW_IMAGE_STREAM)

#define range(x, min, max)  (((x) < (min)) ? (min) : (((x) > (max)) ? (max) : (x)))
#define unsignRange(x, max) (((x) > (max)) ? (max) : (x))

#define toRad(x) ((x) * 3.14159265358979323846f / 180.0f)
#define toDeg(x) ((x) * 180.0f / 3.14159265358979323846f)

#define BLACK 0
#define WHITE 255
#define cReverse(x) ((x) ? BLACK : WHITE)

#ifndef PI
#define PI      (3.14159265358979323846f)
#endif
#define TWO_PI  (2.0f * PI)
#define HALF_PI (0.5f * PI)

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t* ptr;
    uint32_t xLen;
    uint32_t yLen;
    uint32_t size;
} u8Image;

typedef struct
{
    uint16_t* ptr;
    uint32_t xLen;
    uint32_t yLen;
    uint32_t size;
} u16Image;

typedef struct
{
    float* ptr;
    uint32_t xLen;
    uint32_t yLen;
    uint32_t size;
} floatKernel;

typedef union
{
    uint8_t data[4];
    float value;
} floatByteUnion;

#endif /* COMMON_DEF_H */
coreT3_cyt4bb7/project/code/config/configImageStream.h

代码（c）
#ifndef CORET3_CONFIG_IMAGE_STREAM_H
#define CORET3_CONFIG_IMAGE_STREAM_H

#include <stdint.h>

/* 默认匹配 active core0/core1 的 MT9V03X 几何。相机按 core0 已验证 50fps 采集。 */
#define CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_WIDTH        (188u)
#define CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_HEIGHT       (120u)
#define CORET3_IMAGE_CAMERA_FPS          (50u)
#define CORET3_IMAGE_NO_FRAME_PERIOD_MS  (100u)
#define CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_AUTO_EXP     (0u)
#define CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_EXP_TIME     (101u)
#define CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_GAIN         (32u)

#if (CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_WIDTH < 1u) || (CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_WIDTH > 188u)
#error "CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_WIDTH must be in 1..188"
#endif
#if (CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_HEIGHT < 1u) || (CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_HEIGHT > 120u)
#error "CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_HEIGHT must be in 1..120"
#endif
#if ((CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_WIDTH * CORET3_IMAGE_STREAM_HEIGHT) > 65535u)
#error "CORET3 image size must fit MT9V03X driver limit"
#endif
#if (CORET3_IMAGE_CAMERA_FPS < 1u)
#error "CORET3_IMAGE_CAMERA_FPS must be > 0"
#endif
#if (CORET3_IMAGE_NO_FRAME_PERIOD_MS < 1u)
#error "CORET3_IMAGE_NO_FRAME_PERIOD_MS must be > 0"
#endif

#endif /* CORET3_CONFIG_IMAGE_STREAM_H */

/* coreT3 极简固件：只做两件事——
 *   1. MT9V03X 采集的整帧经 WiFi SPI 逐飞助手协议发到 PC 上位机；
 *   2. 同一帧在本板 IPS114 显示。
 * 前台单循环、无 PIT/按键/状态计数（参考 SeekFree E6_12 已验证结构；
 * 之前加 10ms PIT 会抢占阻塞式 WiFi SPI 发送，发 1 帧即卡死）。 */

/* 发送前先拷贝到本地缓冲，发送与显示读同一快照，避免与相机 DMA 撕裂。 */
static uint8_t imageCopy[MT9V03X_H][MT9V03X_W];

static void wifiSpiInitBlock(void)
{
    while (wifi_spi_init(CORET3_WIFI_SSID, CORET3_WIFI_PASSWORD))
    {
        ips114_show_string(0u, 0u, "WiFi connecting...");
        system_delay_ms(100u);
    }

    if (1 != WIFI_SPI_AUTO_CONNECT)
    {
        while (wifi_spi_socket_connect("TCP",
                                       CORET3_WIFI_TARGET_IP,
                                       CORET3_WIFI_TARGET_PORT,
                                       CORET3_WIFI_LOCAL_PORT))
        {
            ips114_show_string(0u, 0u, "TCP  connecting...");
            system_delay_ms(100u);
        }
    }
}

void processInit(void)
{
    /* 本驱动方向命名反直觉：PORTAIT=240x135(宽x高)、CROSSWISE=135x240。
     * 188 宽需要 240 宽的绘制区，故用 PORTAIT_180 才容得下 188x120，
     * 用 CROSSWISE(宽 135) 会因 x+188-1>135 触发 set_region 超边界断言。 */
    ips114_set_dir(IPS114_PORTAIT_180);
    ips114_init();
    ips114_clear();
    ips114_show_string(0u, 0u, "coreT3 WiFi SPI");

    wifiSpiInitBlock();

    mt9v03x_init();
    seekfree_assistant_interface_init(SEEKFREE_ASSISTANT_WIFI_SPI);
    seekfree_assistant_camera_information_config(SEEKFREE_ASSISTANT_MT9V03X,
                                                 imageCopy[0],
                                                 MT9V03X_W,
                                                 MT9V03X_H);

    ips114_clear();
}

/*
 * lowPassFilter.c
 *
 *  Created: 20250319
 *  Author: Hecate
 */
#include "lowPassFilter.h"

void lowPassFilterInit(LowPassFilterData *obj, float alpha)
{
    obj->alpha = alpha;

    obj->filteredValue = 0;
    obj->firstFlag = 1;
    obj->lastOutput = 0;
}

void lowPassFilterReset(LowPassFilterData *obj, float value)
{
    obj->firstFlag = 0u;
    obj->lastOutput = value;
    obj->filteredValue = value;
}

void lowPassFilter(LowPassFilterData *obj, const float value)
{
    if ((obj)->firstFlag == 1u)
    {
        (obj)->firstFlag = 0u;
        (obj)->lastOutput = value;
    }
    (obj)->filteredValue = (obj)->alpha * value + (1.0f - (obj)->alpha) * (obj)->lastOutput;
    (obj)->lastOutput = (obj)->filteredValue;
}
