SHA-256：0b347f9b7acd7150d28431bcb9f97b57bbd2bb8fda5ddd052e129de152db153f
代码（c）
/*
 * om_beacon.c - [6] 信标检测 (Beacon Detection)
 *
 * 基于Canny边缘 + 简化BFS, 检测多个红外信标 (闭合椭圆/圆形轮廓)
 * 判据: 闭合性 + 尺寸 + 偏心率上限 + 内部亮度
 * 复用 om_contour.c 的 inContourMap / contourQueue / contourGeneration 基础设施
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint16_t sizeMax;
    uint16_t sizeMin;
    float eccMaxRatioK;     // 预计算: ((eccMax-1)/(eccMax+1))^2, 用于无sqrt偏心率比较
    uint8_t brightnessMin;  // 内部亮度下限
    uint16_t maxEndpoints;  // 允许的最大端点数 (信标边缘常有断裂)
} BEACON_DATA_CONFIG;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static BEACON_DATA_CONFIG beaconDataConfig;

// ---- 内部函数声明 ----

static inline uint16_t beaconBFS(const u8Image* edgeSrc, uint16_t startX, uint16_t startY, uint32_t genTag, BEACON_DATA_STRUCT* beacon, float* outMxx, float* outMyy, float* outMxy);

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void beaconDetectInit(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax, float eccMax, uint8_t brightnessMin, uint16_t maxEndpoints)
{
    beaconDataConfig.sizeMin = sizeMin;
    beaconDataConfig.sizeMax = sizeMax;
    // 预计算偏心率阈值的平方比值, 运行时只需一次乘法+比较
    float k = (eccMax - 1.0f) / (eccMax + 1.0f);
    beaconDataConfig.eccMaxRatioK = k * k;
    beaconDataConfig.brightnessMin = brightnessMin;
    beaconDataConfig.maxEndpoints = maxEndpoints;
}

uint16_t beaconDetect(const u8Image* edgeSrc, const u8Image* graySrc, BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj)
{
    if (edgeSrc->size > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) return 0;

    // generation 替代 memset (与 contourDetect 共享基础设施)
    contourGeneration++;
    if (contourGeneration == 0)
    {
        memset(inContourMap, 0, sizeof(inContourMap));
        contourGeneration = 1;
    }
    uint32_t genBase = (uint32_t) contourGeneration << 16;

    uint16_t beaconCount = 0;
    uint32_t tagCounter = 0;

    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < edgeSrc->yLen && beaconCount < 100; y++)
    {
        uint32_t rowOff = y * edgeSrc->xLen;
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < edgeSrc->xLen && beaconCount < 100; x++)
        {
            uint32_t i = rowOff + x;
            if (edgeSrc->ptr[i] != WHITE || (inContourMap[i] >> 16) == contourGeneration) continue;

            tagCounter++;
            if (tagCounter > 0xFFFFu) goto beaconDone;

            uint32_t genTag = genBase | (uint32_t) tagCounter;

            float curMxx, curMyy, curMxy;
            uint16_t ep = beaconBFS(edgeSrc, (uint16_t) x, (uint16_t) y, genTag,
                                    &obj->beaconData[beaconCount], &curMxx, &curMyy, &curMxy);

            // 闭合轮廓过滤 (信标边缘断裂容忍)
            if (ep > beaconDataConfig.maxEndpoints) continue;

            // 尺寸过滤
            uint16_t sz = obj->beaconData[beaconCount].contourSize;
            if (sz < beaconDataConfig.sizeMin || sz > beaconDataConfig.sizeMax) continue;

            // 偏心率上限过滤: 拒绝过度拉伸的非信标轮廓
            // eigMax/eigMin > eccMax  <=>  diff^2 > sum^2 * ((eccMax-1)/(eccMax+1))^2
            float eigSum = curMxx + curMyy;
            float eigDiff2 = (curMxx - curMyy) * (curMxx - curMyy) + 4.0f * curMxy * curMxy;
            if (eigSum > 0.0f)
            {
                float bound = eigSum * eigSum * beaconDataConfig.eccMaxRatioK;
                if (eigDiff2 > bound) continue;
            }

            // 质心亮度检查: 填充椭圆的质心必在填充区域内, 单像素即可判定
            uint16_t cx = obj->beaconData[beaconCount].centerX;
            uint16_t cy = obj->beaconData[beaconCount].centerY;
            uint8_t centroidBrightness = graySrc->ptr[(uint32_t) cy * graySrc->xLen + (uint32_t) cx];
            obj->beaconData[beaconCount].brightness = centroidBrightness;
            if (centroidBrightness < beaconDataConfig.brightnessMin) continue;

            beaconCount++;
        }
    }

beaconDone:
    obj->beaconCount = beaconCount;
    for (uint16_t i = beaconCount; i < 101; i++) obj->beaconData[i].contourSize = 0;
    return beaconCount;
}

// ---- 内部函数实现 ----

// 简化BFS: 仅计算二阶矩 (无三阶矩/朝向), 返回端点数
static inline uint16_t beaconBFS(const u8Image* obj, uint16_t startX, uint16_t startY, uint32_t genTag, BEACON_DATA_STRUCT* beacon, float* outMxx, float* outMyy, float* outMxy)
{
    uint32_t width = obj->xLen;
    uint32_t height = obj->yLen;

    beacon->contourSize = 0;
    beacon->centerX = 0;
    beacon->centerY = 0;
    beacon->brightness = 0;

    uint16_t head = 0;
    uint16_t tail = 0;

    inContourMap[startY * width + startX] = genTag;
    contourQueue[tail++] = ((uint32_t) startY << 16) | (uint32_t) startX;

    uint32_t sumX = 0;
    uint32_t sumY = 0;
    uint32_t sumXX = 0;
    uint32_t sumYY = 0;
    uint32_t sumXY = 0;
    uint16_t totalCount = 0;
    uint16_t endpointCount = 0;
    uint8_t abandon = 0;

    while (head < tail)
    {
        uint16_t cx = (uint16_t) (contourQueue[head] & 0xFFFFu);
        uint16_t cy = (uint16_t) (contourQueue[head] >> 16);
        head++;

        totalCount++;

        if (!abandon)
        {
            sumX += cx;
            sumY += cy;
            sumXX += (uint32_t) cx * cx;
            sumYY += (uint32_t) cy * cy;
            sumXY += (uint32_t) cx * cy;
        }

        uint8_t whiteNeighborCount = 0;

        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            int32_t nx = (int32_t) cx + contourDx[i];
            int32_t ny = (int32_t) cy + contourDy[i];

            if (nx < 0 || (uint32_t) nx >= width || ny < 0 || (uint32_t) ny >= height) continue;

            uint16_t nIdx = (uint16_t) ((uint32_t) ny * width + (uint32_t) nx);

            if (obj->ptr[nIdx] == WHITE)
            {
                whiteNeighborCount++;

                if ((inContourMap[nIdx] >> 16) != contourGeneration)
                {
                    inContourMap[nIdx] = genTag;
                    if (tail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                        contourQueue[tail++] = ((uint32_t) ny << 16) | (uint32_t) nx;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!abandon && whiteNeighborCount < 2) endpointCount++;

        if (!abandon && (totalCount > beaconDataConfig.sizeMax || endpointCount > beaconDataConfig.maxEndpoints)) abandon = 1;
    }

    beacon->contourSize = totalCount;

    if (totalCount > 0 && !abandon)
    {
        float fN = (float) totalCount;
        float meanX = (float) sumX / fN;
        float meanY = (float) sumY / fN;
        beacon->centerX = (uint16_t) (sumX / totalCount);
        beacon->centerY = (uint16_t) (sumY / totalCount);

        *outMxx = (float) sumXX / fN - meanX * meanX;
        *outMyy = (float) sumYY / fN - meanY * meanY;
        *outMxy = (float) sumXY / fN - meanX * meanY;
    }
    else
    {
        *outMxx = 0.0f;
        *outMyy = 0.0f;
        *outMxy = 0.0f;
    }

    return endpointCount;
}
coreT3_cyt4bb7/project/code/om_binary.c
SHA-256：1db51de7e87df6f34d5052594bff59289da1cfe494054af95691d78cc7ff8763
代码（c）
/*
 * om_binary.c - [2] 二值化
 *
 * 单阈值 / 双阈值 / RGB565 二值化
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t threshold;
    uint8_t thresholdUp;
    uint8_t thresholdDown;
    uint8_t background;
    uint8_t r_min, r_max;
    uint8_t g_min, g_max;
    uint8_t b_min, b_max;
} binaryConfigStruct;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static binaryConfigStruct binaryConfig;

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void toBinaryInit(uint8_t threshold)
{
    binaryConfig.threshold = threshold;
}

void toBinaryDoubleThresholdInit(uint8_t thresholdUp, uint8_t thresholdDown)
{
    binaryConfig.thresholdUp = thresholdUp;
    binaryConfig.thresholdDown = thresholdDown;
}

void rgb565toBinaryInit(uint8_t background, uint8_t r_min, uint8_t r_max, uint8_t g_min, uint8_t g_max, uint8_t b_min, uint8_t b_max)
{
    binaryConfig.background = background;
    binaryConfig.r_min = r_min;
    binaryConfig.r_max = r_max;
    binaryConfig.g_min = g_min;
    binaryConfig.g_max = g_max;
    binaryConfig.b_min = b_min;
    binaryConfig.b_max = b_max;
}

inline void toBinary(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dst)
{
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < src->xLen * src->yLen; i++) dst->ptr[i] = (src->ptr[i] > binaryConfig.threshold) ? WHITE : BLACK;
}

inline void toBinaryDoubleThreshold(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dst)
{
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < src->xLen * src->yLen; i++) dst->ptr[i] = ((src->ptr[i] < binaryConfig.thresholdDown) ? BLACK : ((src->ptr[i] <= binaryConfig.thresholdUp) ? WHITE : BLACK));
}

inline void rgb565toBinary(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dst)
{
    // 注意: src->ptr 按小端存储 RGB565, 每像素2字节
    // src->xLen/yLen 为像素维度, 迭代像素总数
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < src->xLen * src->yLen; i++)
    {
        uint16_t pixel = (uint16_t) src->ptr[i * 2u] | ((uint16_t) src->ptr[i * 2u + 1u] << 8);

        // 从RGB565格式中提取RGB分量
        uint8_t r = (pixel >> 11) << 3;          // 红色分量 (5位 -> 8位)
        uint8_t g = ((pixel >> 5) & 0x3F) << 2;  // 绿色分量 (6位 -> 8位)
        uint8_t b = (pixel & 0x1F) << 3;         // 蓝色分量 (5位 -> 8位)

        // 根据范围判断是否为前景
        dst->ptr[i] = (r >= binaryConfig.r_min && r <= binaryConfig.r_max && g >= binaryConfig.g_min && g <= binaryConfig.g_max && b >= binaryConfig.b_min && b <= binaryConfig.b_max) ? cReverse(binaryConfig.background) : binaryConfig.background;
    }
}

/*
 * om_canny.c - [4] 高斯模糊及Canny边缘检测
 *
 * 3x3定点高斯核 / 逐行流水线 Sobel+NMS+滞后门限 边缘检测
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- define ----

#define CANNY_RING_WIDTH (OM_CANNY_RING_WIDTH)

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t width;
    uint32_t height;
    uint32_t pixelCount;
    uint32_t cropStartX;
    uint32_t cropStartY;
    uint32_t cropEndX;
    uint32_t cropEndY;
    uint32_t blurStartX;
    uint32_t blurStartY;
    uint32_t blurEndX;
    uint32_t blurEndY;
} gaussConfigStruct;

typedef struct
{
    uint32_t width;
    uint32_t height;
    uint32_t pixelCount;
    uint32_t sobelStartX;
    uint32_t sobelStartY;
    uint32_t sobelEndX;
    uint32_t sobelEndY;
    uint32_t nmsStartX;
    uint32_t nmsStartY;
    uint32_t nmsEndX;
    uint32_t nmsEndY;
    uint16_t thresholdLow;
    uint16_t thresholdHigh;
    uint32_t thresholdLowSq;
    uint32_t thresholdHighSq;
    int32_t trackOffsets[8];
} cannyConfigStruct;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt0[256];
static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt1[256];
static uint16_t gaussKernelPreValueInt2[256];
static gaussConfigStruct gaussConfig = {0u};
static cannyConfigStruct cannyConfig = {0u};
static uint32_t sobelMapRing[3][CANNY_RING_WIDTH] = {0};
static uint8_t sobelDirMapRing[3][CANNY_RING_WIDTH] = {0};
static uint16_t cannyEdgeQueue[UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE] = {0};

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

// kernelSize = 3u;
void gaussianInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY)
{
    // gaussianKernelTemp[0] : 四个角点对应的核值
    // gaussianKernelTemp[1] : 四个边点对应的核值
    // gaussianKernelTemp[2] : 中心点对应的核值
    float gaussianKernelTemp[3] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};

    memset(&gaussConfig, 0, sizeof(gaussConfig));

    if ((NULL == src) || (NULL == src->ptr) || (0u == src->xLen) || (0u == src->yLen) ||
        (src->xLen > CANNY_RING_WIDTH) || ((src->xLen * src->yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE))
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    gaussConfig.width = src->xLen;
    gaussConfig.height = src->yLen;
    gaussConfig.pixelCount = src->xLen * src->yLen;

    if (startX > endX)
    {
        uint32_t temp = startX;
        startX = endX;
        endX = temp;
    }
    if (startY > endY)
    {
        uint32_t temp = startY;
        startY = endY;
        endY = temp;
    }

    gaussConfig.cropStartX = unsignRange(startX, gaussConfig.width - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropStartY = unsignRange(startY, gaussConfig.height - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropEndX = range(endX, gaussConfig.cropStartX, gaussConfig.width - 1u);
    gaussConfig.cropEndY = range(endY, gaussConfig.cropStartY, gaussConfig.height - 1u);

    gaussConfig.blurStartX = 1u;
    gaussConfig.blurStartY = 1u;
    gaussConfig.blurEndX = 0u;
    gaussConfig.blurEndY = 0u;

    if ((gaussConfig.width >= 3u) && (gaussConfig.height >= 3u) &&
        ((gaussConfig.cropEndX - gaussConfig.cropStartX) >= 2u) &&
        ((gaussConfig.cropEndY - gaussConfig.cropStartY) >= 2u))
    {
        gaussConfig.blurStartX = (0u == gaussConfig.cropStartX) ? 1u : (gaussConfig.cropStartX + 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurStartY = (0u == gaussConfig.cropStartY) ? 1u : (gaussConfig.cropStartY + 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurEndX = (gaussConfig.cropEndX >= (gaussConfig.width - 1u)) ? (gaussConfig.width - 2u) : (gaussConfig.cropEndX - 1u);
        gaussConfig.blurEndY = (gaussConfig.cropEndY >= (gaussConfig.height - 1u)) ? (gaussConfig.height - 2u) : (gaussConfig.cropEndY - 1u);
    }

    if (sigma <= 0.0f)
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    float sigma2 = sigma * sigma;
    float coeff = 1.0f / (TWO_PI * sigma2);
    float sum = 0.0f;

    // 生成 3x3 高斯核，并提取 3 个唯一值（角点/边点/中心）
    for (uint8_t y = 0u; y < 3; y++)
    {
        for (uint8_t x = 0u; x < 3; x++)
        {
            int16_t dx = (int16_t) x - 1;
            int16_t dy = (int16_t) y - 1;
            float exponent = -((float) (dx * dx + dy * dy)) / (2.0f * sigma2);
            float value = (float) exp((double) exponent) * coeff;

            if (0 == dx && 0 == dy) gaussianKernelTemp[2] = value;
            else if (0 == dx || 0 == dy) gaussianKernelTemp[1] = value;
            else gaussianKernelTemp[0] = value;

            sum += value;
        }
    }

    if (sum <= 0.0f)
    {
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt0, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt0));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt1, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt1));
        memset(gaussKernelPreValueInt2, 0, sizeof(gaussKernelPreValueInt2));
        return;
    }

    // 归一化 3 个唯一核值
    gaussianKernelTemp[0] /= sum;
    gaussianKernelTemp[1] /= sum;
    gaussianKernelTemp[2] /= sum;

    // 预计算核值与 8bit 灰度值相乘的 定点数 (放缩256倍)，消除内层浮点开销
    for (uint16_t gray = 0u; gray < 256; gray++)
    {
        gaussKernelPreValueInt0[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[0] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
        gaussKernelPreValueInt1[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[1] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
        gaussKernelPreValueInt2[gray] = (uint16_t) (gaussianKernelTemp[2] * (float) gray * 256.0f);
    }
}

void gaussianBlur(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dst)
{
    if (NULL == src || NULL == src->ptr || NULL == dst || NULL == dst->ptr) return;
    if (0u == gaussConfig.width || gaussConfig.blurStartX > gaussConfig.blurEndX) return;

    for (uint32_t y = gaussConfig.blurStartY; y <= gaussConfig.blurEndY; y++)
    {
        const uint8_t* row0 = src->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row1 = src->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row2 = src->ptr + (y + 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        uint8_t* dstRow = dst->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

        for (uint32_t x = gaussConfig.blurStartX; x <= gaussConfig.blurEndX; x++)
        {
            uint32_t result = gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row0[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt2[row1[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row2[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x + 1u]];

            result = (result + 128) >> 8;
            dstRow[x] = (uint8_t) ((result > 255) ? 255 : result);
        }
    }
}

void cannyInit(const u8Image* src, float sigma, uint32_t startX, uint32_t startY, uint32_t endX, uint32_t endY, uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    gaussianInit(src, sigma, startX, startY, endX, endY);

    memset(&cannyConfig, 0, sizeof(cannyConfig));

    if ((NULL == src) || (NULL == src->ptr) || (0u == src->xLen) || (0u == src->yLen) ||
        (src->xLen > CANNY_RING_WIDTH) || ((src->xLen * src->yLen) > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)) return;

    cannyConfig.width = src->xLen;
    cannyConfig.height = src->yLen;
    cannyConfig.pixelCount = src->xLen * src->yLen;

    if (thresholdLow > thresholdHigh)
    {
        uint16_t temp = thresholdLow;
        thresholdLow = thresholdHigh;
        thresholdHigh = temp;
    }

    cannyConfig.thresholdLow = thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHigh = thresholdHigh;

    // 提前计算平方
    cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq = (uint32_t) thresholdLow * thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq = (uint32_t) thresholdHigh * thresholdHigh;

    cannyConfig.sobelStartX = 1u;
    cannyConfig.sobelStartY = 1u;
    cannyConfig.sobelEndX = 0u;
    cannyConfig.sobelEndY = 0u;
    cannyConfig.nmsStartX = 1u;
    cannyConfig.nmsStartY = 1u;
    cannyConfig.nmsEndX = 0u;
    cannyConfig.nmsEndY = 0u;

    if ((gaussConfig.blurEndX > (gaussConfig.blurStartX + 1u)) &&
        (gaussConfig.blurEndY > (gaussConfig.blurStartY + 1u)))
    {
        cannyConfig.sobelStartX = gaussConfig.blurStartX + 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelStartY = gaussConfig.blurStartY + 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelEndX = gaussConfig.blurEndX - 1u;
        cannyConfig.sobelEndY = gaussConfig.blurEndY - 1u;
    }

    if ((cannyConfig.sobelEndX > (cannyConfig.sobelStartX + 1u)) &&
        (cannyConfig.sobelEndY > (cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u)))
    {
        cannyConfig.nmsStartX = cannyConfig.sobelStartX + 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsStartY = cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsEndX = cannyConfig.sobelEndX - 1u;
        cannyConfig.nmsEndY = cannyConfig.sobelEndY - 1u;
    }

    // 预先计算滞后门限追踪(连边)阶段需要的直接邻信偏移
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[0] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width - 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[1] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[2] = -(int32_t) gaussConfig.width + 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[3] = -1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[4] = 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[5] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width - 1;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[6] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width;
    cannyConfig.trackOffsets[7] = (int32_t) gaussConfig.width + 1;
}

/* 运行时仅更新 Canny 双阈值，不重算高斯核与 ROI，便于按键调参 */
void cannySetThreshold(uint16_t thresholdLow, uint16_t thresholdHigh)
{
    if (thresholdLow > thresholdHigh)
    {
        uint16_t temp = thresholdLow;
        thresholdLow = thresholdHigh;
        thresholdHigh = temp;
    }

    cannyConfig.thresholdLow = thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHigh = thresholdHigh;
    cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq = (uint32_t) thresholdLow * thresholdLow;
    cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq = (uint32_t) thresholdHigh * thresholdHigh;
}

void cannyEdgeDetection(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dstGaussBlur, u8Image* dst)
{
    if (NULL == src || NULL == src->ptr || NULL == dstGaussBlur || NULL == dstGaussBlur->ptr ||
        NULL == dst || NULL == dst->ptr) return;
    if (0u == cannyConfig.pixelCount || 0u == gaussConfig.width) return;

    uint32_t queueHead = 0u;
    uint32_t queueTail = 0u;

    // 清零目标画布、ring buffer 残留、高斯模糊边界脏值
    memset(dst->ptr, BLACK, gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height);
    memset(dstGaussBlur->ptr, 0, gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height);
    memset(sobelMapRing, 0, sizeof(sobelMapRing));
    memset(sobelDirMapRing, 0, sizeof(sobelDirMapRing));

    for (uint32_t y = gaussConfig.blurStartY; y <= gaussConfig.blurEndY; y++)
    {
        // ================== 第1阶段: 高斯模糊 ==================
        const uint8_t* row0 = src->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row1 = src->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;
        const uint8_t* row2 = src->ptr + (y + 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
        uint8_t* dstRow = dstGaussBlur->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

        for (uint32_t x = gaussConfig.blurStartX; x <= gaussConfig.blurEndX; x++)
        {
            uint32_t result = gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row0[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row0[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt2[row1[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row1[x + 1u]] +
                              gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x - 1u]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt1[row2[x]] + gaussKernelPreValueInt0[row2[x + 1u]];

            result = (result + 128) >> 8;
            dstRow[x] = (uint8_t) ((result > 255) ? 255 : result);
        }

        // ================== 第2阶段: Sobel计算 ==================
        if ((cannyConfig.sobelStartX <= cannyConfig.sobelEndX) &&
            (cannyConfig.sobelStartY <= cannyConfig.sobelEndY) &&
            (y >= (cannyConfig.sobelStartY + 1u)) &&
            ((y - 1u) <= cannyConfig.sobelEndY))
        {
            const uint8_t* s_row0 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + (y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width;
            const uint8_t* s_row1 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + (y - 1u) * gaussConfig.width;
            const uint8_t* s_row2 = dstGaussBlur->ptr + y * gaussConfig.width;

            uint32_t* sobelRow = sobelMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];
            uint8_t* dirRow = sobelDirMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];

            for (uint32_t x = cannyConfig.sobelStartX; x <= cannyConfig.sobelEndX; x++)
            {
                int32_t gx = (int32_t) s_row0[x + 1u] + ((int32_t) s_row1[x + 1u] << 1) + (int32_t) s_row2[x + 1u] - (int32_t) s_row0[x - 1u] - ((int32_t) s_row1[x - 1u] << 1) - (int32_t) s_row2[x - 1u];
                int32_t gy = (int32_t) s_row0[x - 1u] + ((int32_t) s_row0[x] << 1) + (int32_t) s_row0[x + 1u] - (int32_t) s_row2[x - 1u] - ((int32_t) s_row2[x] << 1) - (int32_t) s_row2[x + 1u];

                // 去除掉极其耗时的 sqrtf 运算
                uint32_t mag_sq = (uint32_t) (gx * gx) + (uint32_t) (gy * gy);
                sobelRow[x] = mag_sq;

                // 完全消除浮点除法，只用整数比较判定4大区面方向
                int32_t ax = (gx >= 0) ? gx : -gx;
                int32_t ay = (gy >= 0) ? gy : -gy;
                int32_t ay256 = ay << 8;

                if (ay256 <= ax * 106)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 0;  // 水平梯度主导（纵向边缘），沿水平方向抑制
                }
                else if (ay256 >= ax * 618)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 2;  // 垂直梯度主导（横向边缘），沿垂直方向抑制
                }
                else if ((gx ^ gy) >= 0)
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 1;  // 45度梯度
                }
                else
                {
                    dirRow[x] = 3;  // 135度梯度
                }
            }
        }

        // ================== 第3阶段: 非极大值抑制 ==================
        if ((cannyConfig.nmsStartX <= cannyConfig.nmsEndX) &&
            (cannyConfig.nmsStartY <= cannyConfig.nmsEndY) &&
            (y >= (cannyConfig.nmsStartY + 2u)) &&
            ((y - 2u) <= cannyConfig.nmsEndY))
        {
            const uint32_t* n_row0 = sobelMapRing[(y - 3u) % 3];
            const uint32_t* n_row1 = sobelMapRing[(y - 2u) % 3];
            const uint32_t* n_row2 = sobelMapRing[(y - 1u) % 3];
            const uint8_t* dirRow = sobelDirMapRing[(y - 2u) % 3];

            uint8_t* final_dstRow = dst->ptr + (y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width + cannyConfig.nmsStartX;

            for (uint32_t x = cannyConfig.nmsStartX; x <= cannyConfig.nmsEndX; x++)
            {
                uint32_t edge0, edge1;
                uint32_t magnitude = n_row1[x];
                uint8_t dir = dirRow[x];

                if (dir == 0)
                {
                    edge0 = n_row1[x - 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row1[x + 1u];
                }
                else if (dir == 2)
                {
                    edge0 = n_row0[x];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x];
                }
                else if (dir == 1)
                {
                    // gx, gy 同号 → 梯度方向 ↗ (亮度梯度指向右上) → NMS 比较 ↗ 与 ↙
                    edge0 = n_row0[x + 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x - 1u];
                }
                else
                {
                    // gx, gy 异号 → 梯度方向 ↘ (亮度梯度指向右下) → NMS 比较 ↘ 与 ↖
                    edge0 = n_row0[x - 1u];
                    edge1 = n_row2[x + 1u];
                }

                if ((magnitude > edge0) && (magnitude >= edge1))
                {
                    if (magnitude >= cannyConfig.thresholdHighSq)
                    {
                        *final_dstRow = WHITE;  // 确信强边缘
                        if (queueTail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                        {
                            cannyEdgeQueue[queueTail++] = (uint16_t) ((y - 2u) * gaussConfig.width + x);
                        }
                    }
                    else if (magnitude >= cannyConfig.thresholdLowSq)
                    {
                        *final_dstRow = 127;  // 先标记为弱边缘，用于第四阶段追踪，避免大数组分配
                    }
                }

                final_dstRow++;
            }
        }
    }

    // ================== 第4阶段: 滞后门限追踪(连边) ==================
    while (queueHead < queueTail)
    {
        uint32_t index = cannyEdgeQueue[queueHead++];

        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            int32_t trackIndex = (int32_t) index + cannyConfig.trackOffsets[i];

            if (trackIndex >= 0 && trackIndex < (int32_t) cannyConfig.pixelCount)
            {
                if (dst->ptr[trackIndex] == 127)
                {
                    dst->ptr[trackIndex] = WHITE;  // 连通升级为强边缘

                    // 防溢出保护
                    if (queueTail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                    {
                        cannyEdgeQueue[queueTail++] = (uint16_t) trackIndex;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ================== 收尾: 清理死路 ==================
    uint32_t totalPixels = gaussConfig.width * gaussConfig.height;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < totalPixels; i++)
    {
        if (dst->ptr[i] == 127) dst->ptr[i] = BLACK;  // 无法与强边缘连通被消除
    }
}

/*
 * om_connected.c - [3] 连通域检测
 *
 * 四邻域 / 八邻域 Two-Pass 连通域标记
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t background;
    u8Image* data;
    u8Image* show;
    float areaTopMin;
    float areaTopMax;
    float kMin;
    float kMax;
    uint16_t xRange[2];
    uint16_t yRange[2];
} connectedAreaConfigStruct;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static connectedAreaConfigStruct connectedAreaConfig;
static uint16_t g_labMap[UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE];
static uint16_t g_labelEquivalence[UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE];
static SBEA g_tempBea[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void twoPassConnectedAreaInit(uint8_t background, u8Image* src, u8Image* sho, float areaMinLow, float areaMaxLow, float areaMinHigh, float areaMaxHigh, float leftDeadZone, float rightDeadZone, float topDeadZone, float bottomDeadZone)
{
    connectedAreaConfig.background = background;
    connectedAreaConfig.data = src;
    connectedAreaConfig.show = sho;
    connectedAreaConfig.areaTopMax = areaMaxHigh;
    connectedAreaConfig.areaTopMin = areaMinHigh;
    connectedAreaConfig.xRange[0] = (uint16_t) (leftDeadZone * src->xLen);
    connectedAreaConfig.xRange[1] = (uint16_t) ((1.0f - rightDeadZone) * src->xLen);
    connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0] = (uint16_t) (topDeadZone * src->yLen);
    connectedAreaConfig.yRange[1] = (uint16_t) ((1.0f - bottomDeadZone) * src->yLen);
    connectedAreaConfig.kMin = (areaMinLow - areaMinHigh) / ((float) connectedAreaConfig.yRange[1] - (float) connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0]);
    connectedAreaConfig.kMax = (areaMaxLow - areaMaxHigh) / ((float) connectedAreaConfig.yRange[1] - (float) connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0]);
}

inline void twoPassFourConnectedAreaProcess(BEAINF* obj)
{
    // first pass
    if (connectedAreaConfig.data->size > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) return;
    uint16_t lab = 0;

    // 清零全局数组
    memset(g_labMap, 0, connectedAreaConfig.data->size * sizeof(uint16_t));
    memset(g_labelEquivalence, 0, UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE * sizeof(uint16_t));

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < connectedAreaConfig.data->size; i++)
    {
        if (lab >= UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) continue;

        if (connectedAreaConfig.data->ptr[i] == connectedAreaConfig.background)
        {
            g_labMap[i] = 0;  // 背景像素标记为0
            continue;
        }

        uint16_t left = (i % connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen == 0) ? 0 : g_labMap[i - 1];
        uint16_t up = (i < connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen) ? 0 : g_labMap[i - connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen];

        if (!left && !up)
        {
            g_labMap[i] = ++lab;  // 新标签
            g_labelEquivalence[lab] = lab;
        }
        else if (left && !up) g_labMap[i] = left;  // 使用左边标签
        else if (!left && up) g_labMap[i] = up;    // 使用上边标签
        else
        {
            // 两个标签合并
            uint16_t minLabel = (left < up) ? left : up;
            uint16_t maxLabel = (left < up) ? up : left;
            g_labMap[i] = minLabel;
            if (minLabel < g_labelEquivalence[maxLabel]) g_labelEquivalence[maxLabel] = minLabel;
        }
    }

    // second pass
    // 清零全局临时BEA数组
    memset(g_tempBea, 0, 101 * sizeof(SBEA));
    uint16_t tempBeaCount = 0;

    // 路径压缩优化标签等价表
    for (uint16_t i = 1; i <= lab; i++)
    {
        uint16_t root = i;
        while (root != g_labelEquivalence[root]) root = g_labelEquivalence[root];
        g_labelEquivalence[i] = root;
    }

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < connectedAreaConfig.data->size; i++)
    {
        uint16_t curr_label = g_labMap[i];

        if (!curr_label) continue;

        // 使用优化后的等价表直接查找
        curr_label = g_labelEquivalence[curr_label];

        if (curr_label > 100) continue;  // 防止数组越界

        tempBeaCount = (curr_label > tempBeaCount) ? curr_label : tempBeaCount;

        g_tempBea[curr_label - 1].beaX += (i % connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen);
        g_tempBea[curr_label - 1].beaY += (i / connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen);
        g_tempBea[curr_label - 1].beaArea++;
    }

    // filter pass
    memcpy(connectedAreaConfig.show->ptr, connectedAreaConfig.data->ptr, connectedAreaConfig.data->size * sizeof(uint8_t));
    obj->beaCount = 0;          // 重置计数器
    obj->selectedIndex = 100;   // 100表示未选中任何区域
    float minDistance = -1.0f;  // 使用-1表示未初始化

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < tempBeaCount; i++)
    {
        // 跳过空区域
        if (g_tempBea[i].beaArea == 0 || obj->beaCount >= 100) continue;

        // 计算质心
        g_tempBea[i].beaX = (uint32_t) ((float) g_tempBea[i].beaX / (float) g_tempBea[i].beaArea);
        g_tempBea[i].beaY = (uint32_t) ((float) g_tempBea[i].beaY / (float) g_tempBea[i].beaArea);

        // 检查面积和位置约束
        if (g_tempBea[i].beaX < connectedAreaConfig.xRange[0] || g_tempBea[i].beaX >= connectedAreaConfig.xRange[1] ||
            g_tempBea[i].beaY < connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0] || g_tempBea[i].beaY >= connectedAreaConfig.yRange[1] ||
            g_tempBea[i].beaArea > (uint16_t) (connectedAreaConfig.areaTopMax + connectedAreaConfig.kMax * (float) (g_tempBea[i].beaY - connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0])) || g_tempBea[i].beaArea < (uint16_t) (connectedAreaConfig.areaTopMin + connectedAreaConfig.kMin * (float) (g_tempBea[i].beaY - connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0])))
            continue;

        // 将有效信标添加到结果数组
        obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaX = g_tempBea[i].beaX;
        obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaY = g_tempBea[i].beaY;
        obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaArea = g_tempBea[i].beaArea;

        // 选择逻辑：分两种情况处理
        if (obj->lastFrameBeaExist)
        {
            // 上帧有灯：选择距离上帧选中的灯距离最近的信标
            float distance = sqrtf(powf((float) obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaX - (float) obj->lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[0], 2) +
                                   powf((float) obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaY - (float) obj->lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[1], 2));

            if (minDistance < 0.0f || distance < minDistance)
            {
                obj->selectedIndex = obj->beaCount;
                minDistance = distance;
            }
        }
        // 上帧无灯：选择面积最大的信标
        else if (obj->selectedIndex == 100 || obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaArea > obj->sbea[obj->selectedIndex].beaArea) obj->selectedIndex = obj->beaCount;

        // 标记水平线
        for (uint16_t x = 0; x < connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen; x++) connectedAreaConfig.show->ptr[obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaY * connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen + x] = cReverse(connectedAreaConfig.background);

        // 标记垂直线
        for (uint16_t y = 0; y < connectedAreaConfig.data->yLen; y++) connectedAreaConfig.show->ptr[y * connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen + obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaX] = cReverse(connectedAreaConfig.background);

        obj->beaCount++;
    }

    if (obj->beaCount)
    {
        obj->lastFrameBeaExist = 1;  // 标记当前帧有有效区域
        obj->lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[0] = obj->sbea[obj->selectedIndex].beaX;
        obj->lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[1] = obj->sbea[obj->selectedIndex].beaY;
    }
    else obj->lastFrameBeaExist = 0;
}

inline void twoPassEightConnectedAreaProcess(BEAINF* obj)
{
    // first pass
    if (connectedAreaConfig.data->size > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) return;
    uint16_t lab = 0;

    // 清零全局数组
    memset(g_labMap, 0, connectedAreaConfig.data->size * sizeof(uint16_t));
    memset(g_labelEquivalence, 0, UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE * sizeof(uint16_t));
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < connectedAreaConfig.data->size; i++)
    {
        if (lab >= UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) continue;

        if (connectedAreaConfig.data->ptr[i] == connectedAreaConfig.background)
        {
            g_labMap[i] = 0;  // 背景像素标记为0
            continue;
        }

        // 收集所有标签
        uint16_t labels[4];
        labels[0] = (i % connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen == 0) ? 0 : g_labMap[i - 1];
        labels[1] = (i % connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen == 0 || i < connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen) ? 0 : g_labMap[i - connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen - 1];
        labels[2] = (i < connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen) ? 0 : g_labMap[i - connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen];
        labels[3] = (i % connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen == connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen - 1 || i < connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen) ? 0 : g_labMap[i - connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen + 1];
        uint16_t validLabels[4] = {0};
        uint8_t validCount = 0;

        for (uint16_t k = 0; k < 4; k++)
            if (labels[k] != 0) validLabels[validCount++] = labels[k];

        if (!validCount)
        {
            g_labMap[i] = ++lab;  // 新标签
            g_labelEquivalence[lab] = lab;
        }
        else if (validCount == 1) g_labMap[i] = validLabels[0];
        else
        {
            // 找到最小标签
            uint16_t minLabel = validLabels[0];
            for (uint16_t k = 1; k < validCount; k++) minLabel = (validLabels[k] < minLabel) ? validLabels[k] : minLabel;

            // 使用最小标签
            g_labMap[i] = minLabel;

            // 将所有其他标签指向最小标签
            for (uint16_t k = 0; k < validCount; k++)
                if (minLabel < g_labelEquivalence[validLabels[k]]) g_labelEquivalence[validLabels[k]] = minLabel;
        }
    }

    // second pass
    // 清零全局临时BEA数组（复用同一个全局数组）
    memset(g_tempBea, 0, 101 * sizeof(SBEA));
    uint16_t tempBeaCount = 0;

    // 路径压缩优化标签等价表
    for (uint16_t i = 1; i <= lab; i++)
    {
        uint16_t root = i;
        while (root != g_labelEquivalence[root]) root = g_labelEquivalence[root];
        g_labelEquivalence[i] = root;
    }

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < connectedAreaConfig.data->size; i++)
    {
        uint16_t curr_label = g_labMap[i];

        if (!curr_label) continue;

        // 使用优化后的等价表直接查找
        curr_label = g_labelEquivalence[curr_label];

        if (curr_label > 100) continue;  // 防止数组越界

        tempBeaCount = (curr_label > tempBeaCount) ? curr_label : tempBeaCount;

        g_tempBea[curr_label - 1].beaX += (i % connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen);
        g_tempBea[curr_label - 1].beaY += (i / connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen);
        g_tempBea[curr_label - 1].beaArea++;
    }

    //  filter pass
    memcpy(connectedAreaConfig.show->ptr, connectedAreaConfig.data->ptr, connectedAreaConfig.data->size * sizeof(uint8_t));
    obj->beaCount = 0;          // 重置计数器
    obj->selectedIndex = 100;   // 100表示未选中任何区域
    float minDistance = -1.0f;  // 使用-1表示未初始化

    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < tempBeaCount; i++)
    {
        // 跳过空区域
        if (g_tempBea[i].beaArea == 0 || obj->beaCount >= 100) continue;

        // 计算质心
        g_tempBea[i].beaX = (uint32_t) ((float) g_tempBea[i].beaX / (float) g_tempBea[i].beaArea);
        g_tempBea[i].beaY = (uint32_t) ((float) g_tempBea[i].beaY / (float) g_tempBea[i].beaArea);

        // 检查面积和位置约束
        if (g_tempBea[i].beaX < connectedAreaConfig.xRange[0] || g_tempBea[i].beaX >= connectedAreaConfig.xRange[1] ||
            g_tempBea[i].beaY < connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0] || g_tempBea[i].beaY >= connectedAreaConfig.yRange[1] ||
            g_tempBea[i].beaArea > (uint16_t) (connectedAreaConfig.areaTopMax + connectedAreaConfig.kMax * (float) (g_tempBea[i].beaY - connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0])) || g_tempBea[i].beaArea < (uint16_t) (connectedAreaConfig.areaTopMin + connectedAreaConfig.kMin * (float) (g_tempBea[i].beaY - connectedAreaConfig.yRange[0])))
            continue;

        // 将有效信标添加到结果数组
        obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaX = g_tempBea[i].beaX;
        obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaY = g_tempBea[i].beaY;
        obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaArea = g_tempBea[i].beaArea;

        // 选择逻辑：分两种情况处理
        if (obj->lastFrameBeaExist)
        {
            // 上帧有灯：选择距离上帧选中的灯距离最近的信标
            float distance = sqrtf(powf((float) obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaX - (float) obj->lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[0], 2) +
                                   powf((float) obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaY - (float) obj->lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[1], 2));

            if (minDistance < 0.0f || distance < minDistance)
            {
                obj->selectedIndex = obj->beaCount;
                minDistance = distance;
            }
        }
        // 上帧无灯：选择面积最大的信标
        else if (obj->selectedIndex == 100 || obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaArea > obj->sbea[obj->selectedIndex].beaArea) obj->selectedIndex = obj->beaCount;

        // 标记水平线
        for (uint16_t x = 0; x < connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen; x++) connectedAreaConfig.show->ptr[obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaY * connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen + x] = cReverse(connectedAreaConfig.background);

        // 标记垂直线
        for (uint16_t y = 0; y < connectedAreaConfig.data->yLen; y++) connectedAreaConfig.show->ptr[y * connectedAreaConfig.data->xLen + obj->sbea[obj->beaCount].beaX] = cReverse(connectedAreaConfig.background);

        obj->beaCount++;
    }

    if (obj->beaCount)
    {
        obj->lastFrameBeaExist = 1;  // 标记当前帧有有效区域
        obj->lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[0] = obj->sbea[obj->selectedIndex].beaX;
        obj->lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[1] = obj->sbea[obj->selectedIndex].beaY;
    }
    else obj->lastFrameBeaExist = 0;
}

/*
 * om_contour.c - [5] 轮廓提取
 *
 * 8邻域BFS闭合轮廓检测、Hu矩特征匹配与几何特征
 * 本文件同时对外暴露 om_beacon.c 共用的BFS基础设施 (inContourMap 等)
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- define ----

#define CONTOUR_ECC_MIN      (1.5f)
#define CONTOUR_ECC_MAX      (6.0f) /* 偏心率上限: ^ 笔画粗 ecc<=4, 细长开放曲线 ecc>=20 */
/* CONTOUR_HU_TOPK 已废弃: 现对所有候选全量计算 Hu, 不做 Top-K 预筛 */
#define CONTOUR_USE_FAST_LOG (1u)

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint16_t sizeMax;
    uint16_t sizeMin;

    uint16_t visionCenterX;  // 视觉中心 X
    uint16_t visionCenterY;  // 视觉中心 Y

    uint16_t roiRadius;        // ROI 检测半径 (0=全图)
    uint16_t earlyStopRadius;  // 质心距视觉中心 <= 此值时立即停止
    uint32_t earlyStopRadiusSq;

    uint8_t centroidFeature;  // 0: 质心在内 1: 质心在外

    uint8_t huTemplateReady;  // Hu模板是否有效: 1=已设置, 0=未设置

    float huTemplate[7];    // 目标形状Hu矩模板
    float shapeWeight;      // 形状匹配权重 (0=纯距离, >0启用Hu矩匹配)
    float huLostThreshold;  // 目标丢失Hu距离阈值 (选中轮廓Hu距离>阈值 → targetLost)
    uint8_t brightnessMax;  // 质心亮度允许上限 (255=禁用, ^笔画位于暗背景上)
} CONTOUR_DATA_CONFIG;

// ============================================================================
//  共用 BFS 基础设施 (om_beacon.c 通过 extern 复用)
// ============================================================================

uint32_t inContourMap[UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE];
uint16_t contourGeneration = 0;
const int8_t contourDx[8] = {0, 1, 1, 1, 0, -1, -1, -1};
const int8_t contourDy[8] = {-1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, -1};
uint32_t contourQueue[UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE];

// ---- 内部数据 ----

static CONTOUR_DATA_CONFIG contourDataConfig;

// ---- 轮廓选择缓冲区 (内存换性能: 全帧候选对应Hu特征) ----
static float contourHuBuf[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];         // 每条轮廓的Hu加权匹配距离
static uint32_t contourDistSqBuf[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];  // 每条轮廓质心距视觉中心的距离平方
static float contourMomBuf[OM_MAX_OBJECTS * 7];    // 每条轮廓的中心矩 [mxx,myy,mxy,m30,m03,m21,m12]
static float contourOrientBuf[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];     /* 朝向: 主轴方向 + 三阶矩符号定向 (-PI ~ PI) */
static float contourM3ConfBuf[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];     /* 三阶矩定向置信度 */

/* Hu 选择策略: candidate 与最佳 Hu 距离差 < CONTOUR_HU_TIE_THRESHOLD 时
 * 使用位置距离 tiebreak; 收紧则更依赖 Hu */
#define CONTOUR_HU_TIE_THRESHOLD 1.0f

// ---- 内部函数声明 ----

static inline uint16_t eightNeighborhoodIterativeCall(const u8Image* obj, uint16_t startX, uint16_t startY, uint32_t genTag, CONTOUR_DATA_STRUCT* contour, float* outMxx, float* outMyy, float* outMxy, float* outM30, float* outM03, float* outM21, float* outM12, float* outOrientation, float* outM3Confidence);
static void computeHuMoments(float mxx, float myy, float mxy, float m30, float m03, float m21, float m12, uint16_t n, float hu[7]);
static float contourHuDistanceByIndex(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint16_t contourIdx);
static float huMatchDistance(const float huA[7], const float huB[7]);
static inline float fastLogPositive(float x);

/* ---- 跟踪滤波: 复用通用 lowPassFilter 模块, 系数由 OM_*_ALPHA 宏调节 ---- */

// 标量一阶低通 (位置): 每拍刷新 alpha 后喂给通用 IIR
static void contourLowPass(LowPassFilterData* f, float sample, float alpha)
{
    f->alpha = alpha;
    lowPassFilter(f, sample);
}

// 角度域一阶低通 (朝向): 解卷绕喂给通用 IIR, 再卷绕回 [-PI, PI]
static void contourAngleLowPass(LowPassFilterData* f, float sample, float alpha)
{
    f->alpha = alpha;
    if (f->firstFlag == 1u)
    {
        lowPassFilterReset(f, sample);
        return;
    }
    float diff = sample - f->lastOutput;
    while (diff > PI) diff -= TWO_PI;
    while (diff < -PI) diff += TWO_PI;
    lowPassFilter(f, f->lastOutput + diff);
    float out = f->filteredValue;
    while (out > PI) out -= TWO_PI;
    while (out < -PI) out += TWO_PI;
    f->filteredValue = out;
    f->lastOutput = out;
}

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void contourDetectInit(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax, uint8_t centroidFeature, uint16_t visionCenterX, uint16_t visionCenterY, uint16_t roiRadius, uint16_t earlyStopRadius, uint8_t brightnessMax)
{
    contourDataConfig.sizeMin = sizeMin;
    contourDataConfig.sizeMax = sizeMax;
    contourDataConfig.centroidFeature = centroidFeature;
    contourDataConfig.visionCenterX = visionCenterX;
    contourDataConfig.visionCenterY = visionCenterY;
    contourDataConfig.roiRadius = roiRadius;
    contourDataConfig.earlyStopRadius = earlyStopRadius;
    contourDataConfig.brightnessMax = brightnessMax;
    contourDataConfig.earlyStopRadiusSq = (uint32_t) earlyStopRadius * earlyStopRadius;
    contourDataConfig.huTemplateReady = 0u;
    contourDataConfig.shapeWeight = 0.0f;
    contourDataConfig.huLostThreshold = 0.0f;
}

void contourDetectSetSizeRange(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax)
{
    contourDataConfig.sizeMin = sizeMin;
    contourDataConfig.sizeMax = sizeMax;
}

void contourDetectSetTemplate(const float* huMoments, float shapeWeight, float huLostThreshold)
{
    if (NULL == huMoments)
    {
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 7; i++) contourDataConfig.huTemplate[i] = 0.0f;
        contourDataConfig.huTemplateReady = 0u;
    }
    else
    {
        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 7; i++) contourDataConfig.huTemplate[i] = huMoments[i];
        contourDataConfig.huTemplateReady = 1u;
    }
    contourDataConfig.shapeWeight = shapeWeight;
    contourDataConfig.huLostThreshold = huLostThreshold;
}

uint16_t contourDetect(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* graySrc, CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj)
{
    if (src->size > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
    {
        obj->contourCount = 0;
        obj->selectedIndex = 0;
        obj->targetLost = 1;
        obj->orientation = 0.0f;
        return 0;
    }

    // generation 替代 memset: 每帧自增, 匹配当前 generation 才视为已访问
    contourGeneration++;
    if (contourGeneration == 0)
    {
        memset(inContourMap, 0, sizeof(inContourMap));
        contourGeneration = 1;
    }
    uint32_t genBase = (uint32_t) contourGeneration << 16;

    uint16_t contourCount = 0;
    uint32_t tagCounter = 0;
    obj->selectedIndex = 0;
    obj->orientation = 0.0f;
    obj->targetLost = 1;

    /* huEnabled 仅以模板是否就绪为准 (shapeWeight 保留作为变量, 但不再参与打分) */
    uint8_t huEnabled = (contourDataConfig.huTemplateReady) ? 1u : 0u;

    // ROI 边界
    uint32_t roiStartX = 0, roiStartY = 0;
    uint32_t roiEndX = src->xLen - 1, roiEndY = src->yLen - 1;
    if (contourDataConfig.roiRadius > 0)
    {
        int32_t rs = (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterX - (int32_t) contourDataConfig.roiRadius;
        int32_t re = (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterX + (int32_t) contourDataConfig.roiRadius;
        int32_t ts = (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterY - (int32_t) contourDataConfig.roiRadius;
        int32_t te = (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterY + (int32_t) contourDataConfig.roiRadius;
        roiStartX = (rs < 0) ? 0 : (uint32_t) rs;
        roiStartY = (ts < 0) ? 0 : (uint32_t) ts;
        roiEndX = ((uint32_t) re >= src->xLen) ? src->xLen - 1 : (uint32_t) re;
        roiEndY = ((uint32_t) te >= src->yLen) ? src->yLen - 1 : (uint32_t) te;
    }

    // ========== 第一阶段: 扫描全部轮廓并收集特征 ==========
    for (uint32_t y = roiStartY; y <= roiEndY && contourCount < OM_MAX_OBJECTS - 1; y++)
    {
        uint32_t rowOff = y * src->xLen;
        for (uint32_t x = roiStartX; x <= roiEndX && contourCount < OM_MAX_OBJECTS - 1; x++)
        {
            uint32_t i = rowOff + x;
            if (src->ptr[i] != WHITE || (inContourMap[i] >> 16) == contourGeneration) continue;

            tagCounter++;
            if (tagCounter > 0xFFFFu) goto phaseTwoSelect;

            uint32_t genTag = genBase | (uint32_t) tagCounter;

            float curMxx = 0.0f, curMyy = 0.0f, curMxy = 0.0f;
            float curM30 = 0.0f, curM03 = 0.0f, curM21 = 0.0f, curM12 = 0.0f;
            uint16_t endpointCount = eightNeighborhoodIterativeCall(src, (uint16_t) x, (uint16_t) y, genTag, &obj->contourData[contourCount], &curMxx, &curMyy, &curMxy, &curM30, &curM03, &curM21, &curM12, &contourOrientBuf[contourCount], &contourM3ConfBuf[contourCount]);

            /* 闭合判定收紧: 真闭环=0 端点, ^=2 端点; 其余开放噪声曲线一律弃 */
            if (endpointCount != 0u && endpointCount != 2u) continue;

            /* BFS 内 abandon (触边/超尺寸/超端点) 时 contourSize 已被置 0, 下方 sizeMin 检查会拒绝 */

            // 尺寸过滤
            uint16_t sz = obj->contourData[contourCount].contourSize;
            if (sz < contourDataConfig.sizeMin || sz > contourDataConfig.sizeMax) continue;

            // ^形状几何预筛: 偏心率检查 (^主轴比/次轴比 在[1.5, 6])
            float eigSum = curMxx + curMyy;
            float eigDiff2 = (curMxx - curMyy) * (curMxx - curMyy) + 4.0f * curMxy * curMxy;
            if (eigSum > 0.0f && eigDiff2 > 0.0f)
            {
                // 免sqrt偏心率判定:
                // eigMax/eigMin < r  <=>  diff^2 < sum^2 * ((r-1)/(r+1))^2
                // eigMax/eigMin > r  <=>  diff^2 > sum^2 * ((r-1)/(r+1))^2
                const float ratioKMin = (CONTOUR_ECC_MIN - 1.0f) / (CONTOUR_ECC_MIN + 1.0f);
                const float ratioKMax = (CONTOUR_ECC_MAX - 1.0f) / (CONTOUR_ECC_MAX + 1.0f);
                float boundMin = eigSum * ratioKMin;
                float boundMax = eigSum * ratioKMax;
                if (eigDiff2 < boundMin * boundMin) continue;
                if (eigDiff2 > boundMax * boundMax) continue;
            }

            // 质心亮度上限过滤: ^笔画必处于暗背景上, 中心过亮必非^
            if (contourDataConfig.brightnessMax < 255)
            {
                uint16_t ccx = obj->contourData[contourCount].centerX;
                uint16_t ccy = obj->contourData[contourCount].centerY;
                uint8_t centroidBright = graySrc->ptr[(uint32_t) ccy * graySrc->xLen + (uint32_t) ccx];
                if (centroidBright > contourDataConfig.brightnessMax) continue;
            }

            // 质心内外特征 (射线法: 由质心向右发射水平射线, 统计与本轮廓边缘的交点奇偶)
            if (contourDataConfig.centroidFeature <= 1)
            {
                uint16_t crossings = 0;
                uint8_t prevEdge = 0;
                for (uint16_t cx = obj->contourData[contourCount].centerX + 1; cx < src->xLen; cx++)
                {
                    uint16_t idx = (uint16_t) (obj->contourData[contourCount].centerY * src->xLen + cx);
                    uint8_t isEdge = ((inContourMap[idx] & 0xFFFFu) == tagCounter && (inContourMap[idx] >> 16) == contourGeneration) ? 1u : 0u;
                    if (isEdge && !prevEdge) crossings++;
                    prevEdge = isEdge;
                }
                uint8_t centroidInside = crossings & 1u;
                if (contourDataConfig.centroidFeature == 0 && !centroidInside) continue;
                if (contourDataConfig.centroidFeature == 1 && centroidInside) continue;
            }

            // 存储距离平方
            int32_t dx = (int32_t) obj->contourData[contourCount].centerX - (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterX;
            int32_t dy = (int32_t) obj->contourData[contourCount].centerY - (int32_t) contourDataConfig.visionCenterY;
            contourDistSqBuf[contourCount] = (uint32_t) (dx * dx + dy * dy);

            // 存储中心矩 (第二阶段成败选择需要)
            uint32_t mBase = (uint32_t) contourCount * 7u;
            contourMomBuf[mBase] = curMxx;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 1] = curMyy;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 2] = curMxy;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 3] = curM30;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 4] = curM03;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 5] = curM21;
            contourMomBuf[mBase + 6] = curM12;

            // Hu距离在第二阶段进入Top-K候选后才算, 第一阶段仅收集几何特征
            obj->contourData[contourCount].huDistance = 0.0f;

            contourCount++;

            // 非Hu模式下 earlyStop (Hu模式需收集全部轮廓, 不能早停)
            if (!huEnabled && contourDataConfig.earlyStopRadius > 0 && contourDistSqBuf[contourCount - 1] <= contourDataConfig.earlyStopRadiusSq)
                goto phaseTwoSelect;
        }
    }

phaseTwoSelect:
    obj->contourCount = contourCount;

    // ========== 第二阶段: 在已收集轮廓中选出最佳轮廓 ==========
    if (contourCount > 0)
    {
        if (huEnabled && contourCount > 1)
        {
            // Hu-first: 对所有候选计算 Hu 距离, 不做 Top-K 预筛
            float huMin = 3.402823466e+38f;
            for (uint16_t k = 0; k < contourCount; k++)
            {
                float dHu = contourHuDistanceByIndex(obj, k);
                contourHuBuf[k] = dHu;
                obj->contourData[k].huDistance = dHu;
                if (dHu < huMin) huMin = dHu;
            }

            /* Hu 优先选择: 最小 Hu; 同 Hu 带内 (差 < TIE_THRESHOLD) 按位置 tiebreak */
            uint32_t bestTieDist = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
            for (uint16_t k = 0; k < contourCount; k++)
            {
                if ((contourHuBuf[k] - huMin) < CONTOUR_HU_TIE_THRESHOLD)
                {
                    if (contourDistSqBuf[k] < bestTieDist)
                    {
                        bestTieDist = contourDistSqBuf[k];
                        obj->selectedIndex = (uint8_t) k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else if (!huEnabled)
        {
            // 纯距离选择
            uint32_t bestDist = contourDistSqBuf[0];
            obj->selectedIndex = 0;
            for (uint16_t k = 1; k < contourCount; k++)
            {
                if (contourDistSqBuf[k] < bestDist)
                {
                    bestDist = contourDistSqBuf[k];
                    obj->selectedIndex = (uint8_t) k;
                }
            }
        }
        // contourCount==1 时 selectedIndex 已为 0

        // 目标丢失判定: Hu距离超阈值 → 形状不匹配模板
        if (huEnabled && contourDataConfig.huLostThreshold > 0.0f)
        {
            float selHu = contourHuDistanceByIndex(obj, obj->selectedIndex);
            contourHuBuf[obj->selectedIndex] = selHu;
            obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].huDistance = selHu;
            obj->targetLost = (selHu > contourDataConfig.huLostThreshold) ? 1u : 0u;
        }
        else
        {
            obj->targetLost = 0;
        }

        /* 选中轮廓朝向: BFS 末尾用三阶矩符号定向, 无跨帧状态 */
        obj->orientation = contourOrientBuf[obj->selectedIndex];
    }

    // 清空后段未使用位置
    for (uint16_t i = contourCount; i < OM_MAX_OBJECTS; i++) obj->contourData[i].contourSize = 0;

    // ========== 跟踪状态机 ==========
    {
        uint8_t detected = (obj->targetLost == 0u && contourCount > 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
        uint16_t selCx = obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].centerX;
        uint16_t selCy = obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].centerY;
        float selOrient = contourOrientBuf[obj->selectedIndex];
        float selM3Conf = contourM3ConfBuf[obj->selectedIndex];
        uint16_t selSize = obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].contourSize;

        // 画幅边缘接触检测: 质心过于靠近边缘视为丢失
        if (detected)
        {
            if (selCx <= OM_BORDER_MARGIN || selCx >= (src->xLen - 1u - OM_BORDER_MARGIN) ||
                selCy <= OM_BORDER_MARGIN || selCy >= (src->yLen - 1u - OM_BORDER_MARGIN))
            {
                detected = 0u;
                obj->targetLost = 1u;
            }
        }

        // 写入当前帧 m3Confidence
        obj->m3Confidence = detected ? selM3Conf : 0.0f;

        if (detected)
        {
            obj->lostFrameCount = 0u;
            obj->lockFrameCount = (obj->lockFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->lockFrameCount + 1u : 255u;

            switch (obj->trackingState)
            {
                case OM_TRACK_SEARCHING:
                    if (obj->lockFrameCount >= OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD)
                        obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING;
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING:
                    if (obj->lockFrameCount >= (OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD + OM_LOCK_CONFIRM))
                        obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOCKED;
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_LOCKED:
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING:
                    obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOCKED;
                    break;
                default:
                    obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
                    break;
            }

            // 朝向鲁棒性: 主轴方向(PCA, 二阶矩决定)始终实时跟随; 三阶矩符号弱(尖端
            // 不可信)时仅把尖端对齐上一帧消除 180 度乱跳, 不冻结主轴角。
            // 旧实现低置信度时整体沿用 lastValidOrientation, 而实测 m3Conf<=0.001 恒
            // 低于阈值 -> 每帧冻结 + 回写自锁, 导致旋转时朝向锁死在首帧。
            float finalOrient = selOrient;
            if (obj->trackingState >= OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING && obj->lastValidSize > 0u)
            {
                if (selSize < OM_ORIENTATION_MIN_SIZE || selM3Conf < OM_M3_CONFIDENCE_MIN)
                {
                    float diff = selOrient - obj->lastValidOrientation;
                    while (diff > PI) diff -= TWO_PI;
                    while (diff < -PI) diff += TWO_PI;
                    // selOrient 与上一帧反向(尖端选反) -> 翻转 180 度对齐, 主轴角仍随实时
                    if (diff > HALF_PI)
                        finalOrient = selOrient - PI;
                    else if (diff < -HALF_PI)
                        finalOrient = selOrient + PI;
                    while (finalOrient > PI) finalOrient -= TWO_PI;
                    while (finalOrient < -PI) finalOrient += TWO_PI;
                }
                // selM3Conf 足够: 信任 selOrient (含实时尖端定向), 不干预
            }

            // 更新 lastValid
            obj->lastValidCenterX = selCx;
            obj->lastValidCenterY = selCy;
            obj->lastValidOrientation = finalOrient;
            obj->lastValidHuDistance = obj->contourData[obj->selectedIndex].huDistance;
            obj->lastValidSize = selSize;

            // 低通滤波 (仅 LOCKED 态), 系数由 OM_*_ALPHA 宏调节
            if (obj->trackingState == OM_TRACK_LOCKED)
            {
                contourLowPass(&obj->centerXFilter, (float)selCx, OM_POSITION_ALPHA);
                contourLowPass(&obj->centerYFilter, (float)selCy, OM_POSITION_ALPHA);
                contourAngleLowPass(&obj->orientFilter, finalOrient, OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA);
            }
            else
            {
                // 非 LOCKED 态直接跟随, 锚定滤波器状态防止入锁瞬间突跳
                lowPassFilterReset(&obj->centerXFilter, (float)selCx);
                lowPassFilterReset(&obj->centerYFilter, (float)selCy);
                lowPassFilterReset(&obj->orientFilter, finalOrient);
            }

            obj->orientation = obj->orientFilter.filteredValue;
        }
        else
        {
            // 目标丢失
            obj->lockFrameCount = 0u;
            obj->lostFrameCount = (obj->lostFrameCount < 255u) ? obj->lostFrameCount + 1u : 255u;

            switch (obj->trackingState)
            {
                case OM_TRACK_SEARCHING:
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING:
                    obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_LOCKED:
                    if (obj->lostFrameCount >= OM_LOST_THRESHOLD)
                        obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING;
                    break;
                case OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING:
                    if (obj->lostFrameCount >= OM_LOST_TIMEOUT)
                        obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
                    break;
                default:
                    obj->trackingState = OM_TRACK_SEARCHING;
                    break;
            }

            // 保持 lastValid 不覆盖, 输出滤波值不变
            if (obj->lastValidSize > 0u)
                obj->orientation = obj->orientFilter.filteredValue;
            else
                obj->orientation = 0.0f;
        }
    }

    return contourCount;
}

// ---- 提取 Hu 实现 ----

uint8_t contourExtractHuMoments(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t contourIndex, float huOut[7])
{
    if (obj == NULL || huOut == NULL) return 0u;
    if (contourIndex >= obj->contourCount || obj->contourData[contourIndex].contourSize == 0) return 0u;
    uint32_t mBase = (uint32_t) contourIndex * 7u;
    computeHuMoments(contourMomBuf[mBase], contourMomBuf[mBase + 1], contourMomBuf[mBase + 2],
        contourMomBuf[mBase + 3], contourMomBuf[mBase + 4], contourMomBuf[mBase + 5], contourMomBuf[mBase + 6],
        obj->contourData[contourIndex].contourSize, huOut);
    return 1u;
}

// ---- 内部函数实现 ----

// 8邻域BFS: 统计连通区域大小、质心、二阶矩、三阶矩及端点数; 返回端点数
static inline uint16_t eightNeighborhoodIterativeCall(const u8Image* obj, uint16_t startX, uint16_t startY, uint32_t genTag, CONTOUR_DATA_STRUCT* contour, float* outMxx, float* outMyy, float* outMxy, float* outM30, float* outM03, float* outM21, float* outM12, float* outOrientation, float* outM3Confidence)
{
    uint32_t width = obj->xLen;
    uint32_t height = obj->yLen;

    contour->contourSize = 0;
    contour->centerX = 0;
    contour->centerY = 0;

    uint16_t head = 0;
    uint16_t tail = 0;

    // 起点入队并标记 (packed: high16=y, low16=x)
    inContourMap[startY * width + startX] = genTag;
    contourQueue[tail++] = ((uint32_t) startY << 16) | (uint32_t) startX;

    uint32_t sumX = 0;
    uint32_t sumY = 0;
    uint32_t sumXX = 0;
    uint32_t sumYY = 0;
    uint32_t sumXY = 0;
    uint64_t sumXXX = 0;
    uint64_t sumYYY = 0;
    uint64_t sumXXY = 0;
    uint64_t sumXYY = 0;
    uint16_t totalCount = 0;
    uint16_t endpointCount = 0;
    uint8_t abandon = 0;

    while (head < tail)
    {
        uint16_t cx = (uint16_t) (contourQueue[head] & 0xFFFFu);
        uint16_t cy = (uint16_t) (contourQueue[head] >> 16);
        head++;

        totalCount++;

        if (!abandon)
        {
            sumX += cx;
            sumY += cy;
            uint32_t cxx = (uint32_t) cx * cx;
            uint32_t cyy = (uint32_t) cy * cy;
            sumXX += cxx;
            sumYY += cyy;
            sumXY += (uint32_t) cx * cy;
            sumXXX += (uint64_t) cxx * cx;
            sumYYY += (uint64_t) cyy * cy;
            sumXXY += (uint64_t) cxx * cy;
            sumXYY += (uint64_t) cx * cyy;
        }

        // 统计原图中当前像素的白色8邻域数量 (用于端点检测)
        uint8_t whiteNeighborCount = 0;

        for (uint8_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        {
            int32_t nx = (int32_t) cx + contourDx[i];
            int32_t ny = (int32_t) cy + contourDy[i];

            if (nx < 0 || (uint32_t) nx >= width || ny < 0 || (uint32_t) ny >= height) continue;

            uint16_t nIdx = (uint16_t) ((uint32_t) ny * width + (uint32_t) nx);

            if (obj->ptr[nIdx] == WHITE)
            {
                whiteNeighborCount++;

                // 未访问的白色像素入队
                if ((inContourMap[nIdx] >> 16) != contourGeneration)
                {
                    inContourMap[nIdx] = genTag;
                    if (tail < UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE)
                        contourQueue[tail++] = ((uint32_t) ny << 16) | (uint32_t) nx;
                }
            }
        }

        // Canny后边缘上端点像素白色邻居数 < 2
        if (!abandon && whiteNeighborCount < 2) endpointCount++;

        /* 触图像边界即 abandon: 边缘截断的开放曲线刚好有 2 个端点会冒充闭合 ^ */
        if (!abandon && (cx == 0u || cy == 0u || (uint32_t) cx == width - 1u || (uint32_t) cy == height - 1u)) abandon = 1;

        if (!abandon && (totalCount > contourDataConfig.sizeMax || endpointCount > 2)) abandon = 1;
    }

    /* abandon 时 contourSize 置 0, 让 caller 的 sizeMin 检查直接拒绝该轮廓 */
    contour->contourSize = abandon ? 0u : totalCount;

    if (totalCount > 0 && !abandon)
    {
        float fN = (float) totalCount;
        float meanX = (float) sumX / fN;
        float meanY = (float) sumY / fN;
        contour->centerX = (uint16_t) (sumX / totalCount);
        contour->centerY = (uint16_t) (sumY / totalCount);

        *outMxx = (float) sumXX / fN - meanX * meanX;
        *outMyy = (float) sumYY / fN - meanY * meanY;
        *outMxy = (float) sumXY / fN - meanX * meanY;

        // 计算中心矩
        *outM30 = (float) sumXXX / fN - 3.0f * meanX * (float) sumXX / fN + 2.0f * meanX * meanX * meanX;
        *outM03 = (float) sumYYY / fN - 3.0f * meanY * (float) sumYY / fN + 2.0f * meanY * meanY * meanY;
        *outM21 = (float) sumXXY / fN - 2.0f * meanX * (float) sumXY / fN - meanY * (float) sumXX / fN + 2.0f * meanX * meanX * meanY;
        *outM12 = (float) sumXYY / fN - 2.0f * meanY * (float) sumXY / fN - meanX * (float) sumYY / fN + 2.0f * meanX * meanY * meanY;

        /* ^ 尖端朝向: 主轴方向 + 三阶矩符号定向
         * theta = 0.5*atan2(2*mxy, mxx-myy) 是次轴; 主轴 axis = theta + PI/2
         * 沿主轴投影的三阶矩 m3Axis 符号指向长尾 (^ 尖端)
         * m3Axis = c^3*m30 + 3*c^2*s*m21 + 3*c*s^2*m12 + s^3*m03
         */
        float orientTheta = 0.5f * atan2f(2.0f * (*outMxy), (*outMxx) - (*outMyy));
        float orientAxis = orientTheta + HALF_PI;
        float c = cosf(orientAxis);
        float s = sinf(orientAxis);
        float c2 = c * c;
        float s2 = s * s;
        float m3Axis = c2 * c * (*outM30) + 3.0f * c2 * s * (*outM21) + 3.0f * c * s2 * (*outM12) + s2 * s * (*outM03);
        float eigSumLocal = (*outMxx) + (*outMyy);
        *outM3Confidence = (eigSumLocal > 1e-6f) ? (m3Axis * m3Axis) / (eigSumLocal * eigSumLocal * eigSumLocal + 1e-6f) : 0.0f;
        if (*outM3Confidence < 0.0f) *outM3Confidence = -(*outM3Confidence);
        float result = (m3Axis > 0.0f) ? orientAxis : (orientAxis + PI);
        while (result > PI) result -= TWO_PI;
        while (result < -PI) result += TWO_PI;
        *outOrientation = result;
    }
    else
    {
        *outMxx = 0.0f;
        *outMyy = 0.0f;
        *outMxy = 0.0f;
        *outM30 = 0.0f;
        *outM03 = 0.0f;
        *outM21 = 0.0f;
        *outM12 = 0.0f;
        *outOrientation = 0.0f;
        *outM3Confidence = 0.0f;
    }

    return endpointCount;
}

// 计算7个Hu不变矩 (输入为中心矩, n为像素数)
static void computeHuMoments(float mxx, float myy, float mxy, float m30, float m03, float m21, float m12, uint16_t n, float hu[7])
{
    float fN = (float) n;
    float sqrtN = sqrtf(fN);
    float invN = 1.0f / fN;
    float invN15 = invN / sqrtN;

    // 归一化中心矩
    float eta20 = mxx * invN;
    float eta02 = myy * invN;
    float eta11 = mxy * invN;
    float eta30 = m30 * invN15;
    float eta03 = m03 * invN15;
    float eta21 = m21 * invN15;
    float eta12 = m12 * invN15;

    // 7个Hu不变矩
    hu[0] = eta20 + eta02;
    hu[1] = (eta20 - eta02) * (eta20 - eta02) + 4.0f * eta11 * eta11;

    float t1 = eta30 - 3.0f * eta12;
    float t2 = 3.0f * eta21 - eta03;
    hu[2] = t1 * t1 + t2 * t2;

    float t3 = eta30 + eta12;
    float t4 = eta21 + eta03;
    hu[3] = t3 * t3 + t4 * t4;

    float t3sq = t3 * t3;
    float t4sq = t4 * t4;
    hu[4] = t1 * t3 * (t3sq - 3.0f * t4sq) + t2 * t4 * (3.0f * t3sq - t4sq);
    hu[5] = (eta20 - eta02) * (t3sq - t4sq) + 4.0f * eta11 * t3 * t4;
    hu[6] = t2 * t3 * (t3sq - 3.0f * t4sq) - t1 * t4 * (3.0f * t3sq - t4sq);
}

static float contourHuDistanceByIndex(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint16_t contourIdx)
{
    float hu[7];
    uint32_t mBase = (uint32_t) contourIdx * 7u;
    computeHuMoments(contourMomBuf[mBase], contourMomBuf[mBase + 1], contourMomBuf[mBase + 2],
        contourMomBuf[mBase + 3], contourMomBuf[mBase + 4], contourMomBuf[mBase + 5], contourMomBuf[mBase + 6],
        obj->contourData[contourIdx].contourSize, hu);
    return huMatchDistance(hu, contourDataConfig.huTemplate);
}

static inline float fastLogPositive(float x)
{
#if (CONTOUR_USE_FAST_LOG)
    union
    {
        float f;
        uint32_t u;
    } v;
    v.f = x;

    int32_t exp2 = (int32_t) ((v.u >> 23) & 0xFFu) - 127;
    uint32_t mant = (v.u & 0x7FFFFFu) | 0x3F800000u;  // 1.m
    union
    {
        float f;
        uint32_t u;
    } vm;
    vm.u = mant;
    float m = vm.f;

    float y = m - 1.0f;  // y in [0,1)
    // ln(1+y) 三阶截断
    float ln_m = y - 0.5f * y * y + (1.0f / 3.0f) * y * y * y;
    return ln_m + (float) exp2 * 0.69314718056f;
#else
    return logf(x);
#endif
}

// Hu矩加权匹配距离 (log空间加权L1, 低阶高权重, h6符号无意义)
static float huMatchDistance(const float huA[7], const float huB[7])
{
    float a0 = fabsf(huA[0]);
    if (a0 < 1e-12f) a0 = 1e-12f;
    float b0 = fabsf(huB[0]);
    if (b0 < 1e-12f) b0 = 1e-12f;
    float a1 = fabsf(huA[1]);
    if (a1 < 1e-12f) a1 = 1e-12f;
    float b1 = fabsf(huB[1]);
    if (b1 < 1e-12f) b1 = 1e-12f;
    float a2 = fabsf(huA[2]);
    if (a2 < 1e-12f) a2 = 1e-12f;
    float b2 = fabsf(huB[2]);
    if (b2 < 1e-12f) b2 = 1e-12f;
    float a3 = fabsf(huA[3]);
    if (a3 < 1e-12f) a3 = 1e-12f;
    float b3 = fabsf(huB[3]);
    if (b3 < 1e-12f) b3 = 1e-12f;
    float a4 = fabsf(huA[4]);
    if (a4 < 1e-12f) a4 = 1e-12f;
    float b4 = fabsf(huB[4]);
    if (b4 < 1e-12f) b4 = 1e-12f;
    float a5 = fabsf(huA[5]);
    if (a5 < 1e-12f) a5 = 1e-12f;
    float b5 = fabsf(huB[5]);
    if (b5 < 1e-12f) b5 = 1e-12f;

    float d0 = fastLogPositive(a0) - fastLogPositive(b0);
    float d1 = fastLogPositive(a1) - fastLogPositive(b1);
    float d2 = fastLogPositive(a2) - fastLogPositive(b2);
    float d3 = fastLogPositive(a3) - fastLogPositive(b3);
    float d4 = fastLogPositive(a4) - fastLogPositive(b4);
    float d5 = fastLogPositive(a5) - fastLogPositive(b5);

    float dist = 2.0f * fabsf(d0) + 2.0f * fabsf(d1) + 1.5f * fabsf(d2) + 1.5f * fabsf(d3) + 0.5f * fabsf(d4) + 0.5f * fabsf(d5);
    return dist;
}

/*
 * om_morph.c - [1] 形态学运算
 *
 * 腐蚀 / 膨胀 / 开运算 / 闭运算
 */

#include "om_internal.h"

// ---- typedef ----

typedef struct
{
    uint8_t background;
} morphConfigStruct;

// ---- 内部变量 ----

static morphConfigStruct morphConfig;
static uint8_t g_morphBuffer[UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE];

// ---- 外部函数实现 ----

void morphInit(uint8_t background)
{
    morphConfig.background = background;
}

inline void morphErode(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* kernel, u8Image* dst)
{
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < src->size; i++)
    {
        uint16_t y = i / src->xLen;
        uint16_t x = i % src->xLen;

        uint8_t result = cReverse(morphConfig.background);

        // 遍历内核，但减少不必要的计算
        for (uint16_t j = 0; j < kernel->size && result == cReverse(morphConfig.background); j++)
        {
            if (kernel->ptr[j] == cReverse(morphConfig.background))
            {
                uint16_t kx = j % kernel->xLen;
                uint16_t ky = j / kernel->xLen;

                int32_t px = (int32_t) x + (int32_t) kx - (int32_t) (kernel->xLen >> 1);
                int32_t py = (int32_t) y + (int32_t) ky - (int32_t) (kernel->yLen >> 1);

                result = (px < 0 || px >= src->xLen || py < 0 || py >= src->yLen) ? morphConfig.background : (src->ptr[py * src->xLen + px] == morphConfig.background ? morphConfig.background : result);
            }
        }

        dst->ptr[i] = result;
    }
}

inline void morphDilate(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* kernel, u8Image* dst)
{
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < src->size; i++)
    {
        uint16_t y = i / src->xLen;
        uint16_t x = i % src->xLen;

        uint8_t result = morphConfig.background;

        // 遍历内核，但减少不必要的计算
        for (uint16_t j = 0; j < kernel->size && result == morphConfig.background; j++)
        {
            if (kernel->ptr[j] == cReverse(morphConfig.background))
            {
                uint16_t kx = j % kernel->xLen;
                uint16_t ky = j / kernel->xLen;

                int32_t px = (int32_t) x + (int32_t) kx - (int32_t) (kernel->xLen >> 1);
                int32_t py = (int32_t) y + (int32_t) ky - (int32_t) (kernel->yLen >> 1);

                result = (px < 0 || px >= src->xLen || py < 0 || py >= src->yLen) ? morphConfig.background : (src->ptr[py * src->xLen + px] == morphConfig.background ? result : cReverse(morphConfig.background));
            }
        }

        dst->ptr[i] = result;
    }
}

inline void morphOpen(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* kernel, u8Image* dst)
{
    if (src->xLen * src->yLen > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) return;

    // 使用全局缓冲区，避免栈分配
    memset(g_morphBuffer, 0, src->xLen * src->yLen * sizeof(uint8_t));
    u8Image tempImg = {g_morphBuffer, src->xLen, src->yLen, src->xLen * src->yLen};

    morphErode(src, kernel, &tempImg);
    morphDilate(&tempImg, kernel, dst);
}

inline void morphClose(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* kernel, u8Image* dst)
{
    if (src->xLen * src->yLen > UNIFORMLY_PRE_ALLOCATED_BUFFER_SIZE) return;

    // 使用全局缓冲区，避免栈分配
    memset(g_morphBuffer, 0, src->xLen * src->yLen * sizeof(uint8_t));
    u8Image tempImg = {g_morphBuffer, src->xLen, src->yLen, src->xLen * src->yLen};

    morphDilate(src, kernel, &tempImg);
    morphErode(&tempImg, kernel, dst);
}

/*
 * openMorph.h - 图像处理 头文件
 *
 *  Created: 20250804
 *  Author: Hecate
 *
 *  模块组成:
 *    [1] 形态学运算        —— 腐蚀 / 膨胀 / 开运算 / 闭运算
 *    [2] 二值化            —— 单阈值 / 双阈值 / RGB565
 *    [3] 连通域处理        —— 四连通 / 八连通 Two-Pass
 *    [4] 高斯模糊与Canny   —— 3x3定点高斯核 / 逐行流水线边缘检测
 *    [5] 轮廓提取          —— 8邻域BFS闭合轮廓检测与几何特征
 *    [6] 信标检测          —— Canny+BFS的目标点亮信标检测
 */
#ifndef OPENMORPH_H
#define OPENMORPH_H

// ============================================================================
//  包含文件
// ============================================================================

#include <stdint.h>

#include "commonDef.h"
#include "openMorph_config.h"

void morphInit(uint8_t background);

void morphErode(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* kernel, u8Image* dst);
void morphDilate(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* kernel, u8Image* dst);
void morphOpen(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* kernel, u8Image* dst);
void morphClose(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* kernel, u8Image* dst);

// ============================================================================
//  [2] 二值化

// ---- 函数声明 ----

void toBinaryInit(uint8_t threshold);
void toBinaryDoubleThresholdInit(uint8_t thresholdUp, uint8_t thresholdDown);
void rgb565toBinaryInit(uint8_t background, uint8_t r_min, uint8_t r_max, uint8_t g_min, uint8_t g_max, uint8_t b_min, uint8_t b_max);

void toBinary(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dst);
void toBinaryDoubleThreshold(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dst);
void rgb565toBinary(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dst);

// ============================================================================

// ---- typedef ----

// 单个信标区域数据
typedef struct
{
    uint32_t beaX;     // 质心 X (累加和平均)
    uint32_t beaY;     // 质心 Y (累加和平均)
    uint16_t beaArea;  // 区域像素数
} SBEA;

// 连通域检测器数据
typedef struct
{
    uint16_t beaCount;                   // 有效区域数量
    uint8_t lastFrameBeaExist;           // 上帧是否存在
    uint32_t lastFrameSelectedBeaXY[2];  // 上帧选中区域质心
    uint16_t selectedIndex;              // 当前选中区域索引
    SBEA sbea[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];           // 区域缓存
} BEAINF;

// ---- 函数声明 ----

void twoPassConnectedAreaInit(uint8_t background, u8Image* src, u8Image* sho, float areaMinLow, float areaMaxLow, float areaMinHigh, float areaMaxHigh, float leftDeadZone, float rightDeadZone, float topDeadZone, float bottomDeadZone);

// 处理四连通区域
void twoPassFourConnectedAreaProcess(BEAINF* obj);

// 处理八连通区域
void twoPassEightConnectedAreaProcess(BEAINF* obj);

void gaussianBlur(const u8Image* src, u8Image* dst);

// ---- typedef ----

// 单个轮廓数据
typedef struct
{
    uint16_t centerX;      // 质心 X
    uint16_t centerY;      // 质心 Y
    uint16_t contourSize;  // 全部像素数
    float huDistance;      /* Hu 距离: 0 = 未参与 Hu (未进 Top-K); >0 = 实际匹配距离 */
} CONTOUR_DATA_STRUCT;

// 跟踪状态枚举
#define OM_TRACK_SEARCHING    (0u)
#define OM_TRACK_ACQUIRING    (1u)
#define OM_TRACK_LOCKED       (2u)
#define OM_TRACK_LOST_HOLDING (3u)

// 轮廓检测器数据
typedef struct
{
    CONTOUR_DATA_STRUCT contourData[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];  // 轮廓数据缓存

    uint8_t selectedIndex;  // 当前选中轮廓索引
    uint8_t contourCount;   // 有效闭合轮廓数量
    uint8_t targetLost;     // 1=目标丢失(无候选或Hu距离超阈值), 0=锁定中
    float orientation;      // 选中轮廓的几何朝向 (弧度, -PI ~ PI)

    /* 跨帧状态保持 */
    uint16_t lastValidCenterX;
    uint16_t lastValidCenterY;
    float lastValidOrientation;
    float lastValidHuDistance;
    uint16_t lastValidSize;
    uint8_t lostFrameCount;
    uint8_t lockFrameCount;
    uint8_t trackingState;
    float m3Confidence;              // 三阶矩定向置信度 (用于朝向鲁棒性)
    LowPassFilterData orientFilter;  // 朝向低通 (角度域, 系数 OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA)
    LowPassFilterData centerXFilter; // 位置 X 低通 (系数 OM_POSITION_ALPHA)
    LowPassFilterData centerYFilter; // 位置 Y 低通 (系数 OM_POSITION_ALPHA)
} CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT;

// ---- 函数声明 ----

void contourDetectInit(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax, uint8_t centroidFeature, uint16_t visionCenterX, uint16_t visionCenterY, uint16_t roiRadius, uint16_t earlyStopRadius, uint8_t brightnessMax);

// 运行时更新尺寸过滤范围 (标定后收紧)
void contourDetectSetSizeRange(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax);

// 设置目标形状Hu矩模板
// shapeWeight: 0=纯距离选择, >0=Hu距离+距离微调权重, 建议0.15
// huLostThreshold: 选中轮廓Hu距离超阈值则置targetLost=1, 建议20.0
// huMoments: 可传NULL以禁用Hu模板(此时退化为纯距离逻辑)
void contourDetectSetTemplate(const float* huMoments, float shapeWeight, float huLostThreshold);

// 检测: src=Canny边缘图, graySrc=灰度原图 (用于亮度筛除), 返回检测到的闭合轮廓数量
// brightnessMax=255时跳过亮度筛除
uint16_t contourDetect(const u8Image* src, const u8Image* graySrc, CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj);

// 从最近一次 contourDetect() 结果中提取指定轮廓的 7 维 Hu 矩
// 返回 1=成功, 0=索引越界或无数据（必须在同一帧 contourDetect 之后调用）
uint8_t contourExtractHuMoments(const CONTOUR_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj, uint8_t contourIndex, float huOut[7]);

// ============================================================================
//  [6] 信标检测 (Beacon Detection)
// ============================================================================

// ---- typedef ----

// 单个信标数据
typedef struct
{
    uint16_t centerX;      // 质心 X
    uint16_t centerY;      // 质心 Y
    uint16_t contourSize;  // 轮廓像素数
    uint8_t brightness;    // 质心区域亮度 (用于排查)
} BEACON_DATA_STRUCT;

// 信标检测器数据
typedef struct
{
    BEACON_DATA_STRUCT beaconData[OM_MAX_OBJECTS];  // 信标数据缓存
    uint8_t beaconCount;                            // 有效信标数量
} BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT;

// ---- 函数声明 ----

// eccMax: 偏心率上限 (>=1.0, 1.0=理想圆, 3.0=允许中等椭圆)
// brightnessMin: 信标内部亮度下限 (0~255, 建议大于120才视为发光体)
// maxEndpoints: 允许最大端点数 (信标边缘可有断口, 建议6~10)
void beaconDetectInit(uint16_t sizeMin, uint16_t sizeMax, float eccMax, uint8_t brightnessMin, uint16_t maxEndpoints);

// 检测: edgeSrc=Canny边缘图, graySrc=灰度原图 (亮度采样)
// 返回检测到的信标数量 (结果存入 obj->beaconData)
uint16_t beaconDetect(const u8Image* edgeSrc, const u8Image* graySrc, BEACON_DETECTOR_STRUCT* obj);

#endif  // OPENMORPH_H

/*
 * openMorph_config.h - openMorph 库可移植配置头
 *
 * 移植到新工程时只需修改本文件即可适配不同图像分辨率与对象数量上限。
 * openMorph 内部其他源文件不应再出现关于尺寸的字面量。
 */
#ifndef OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H
#define OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H

// ============================================================================
//  图像最大尺寸 (静态缓冲区按此分配)
// ============================================================================
//  当前默认 94 x 60 = 5640 像素 (与本工程实际相机分辨率匹配)
//  如需适配 188x120 / 320x240 等更高分辨率，按比例上调即可。
//  本配置与具体相机驱动解耦，不引入 SDK 头依赖。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH   (94u)
#define OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT  (60u)
#define OM_BUFFER_SIZE       (OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH * OM_IMAGE_MAX_HEIGHT)

// ============================================================================
//  对象检测数量上限 (轮廓 / 信标 / 连通域共用)
// ============================================================================
//  contourData[] / beaconData[] / sbea[] 等数组的成员数量。
//  超过此上限的候选对象会被忽略 (只保留前 N 个有效结果)。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_MAX_OBJECTS       (101u)

// ============================================================================
//  Canny 流水线环形缓冲宽度
// ============================================================================
//  Canny 边缘检测内部 sobel 环形缓冲的列宽，必须 >= OM_IMAGE_MAX_WIDTH。
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#define OM_CANNY_RING_WIDTH  (256u)

// ============================================================================
//  轮廓跟踪状态机参数
// ============================================================================
#define OM_LOCK_THRESHOLD         (3u)   // 连续检测到帧数: SEARCHING → ACQUIRING
#define OM_LOCK_CONFIRM           (2u)   // 继续确认帧数: ACQUIRING → LOCKED
#define OM_LOST_THRESHOLD         (5u)   // 连续丢失帧数: LOCKED → LOST_HOLDING
#define OM_LOST_TIMEOUT           (30u)  // 超时帧数: LOST_HOLDING → SEARCHING
#define OM_ORIENTATION_JUMP_MAX   (0.785398f)  // PI/4, 帧间朝向跳变上限 (预留, 当前未启用硬跳变保护)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_CONFIRM_FRAMES (3u)     // 新朝向确认帧数
#define OM_M3_CONFIDENCE_MIN      (0.02f)      // 三阶矩尖端定向最低置信度: 低于此值仅按上帧对齐尖端180度, 不冻结主轴
#define OM_ORIENTATION_MIN_SIZE   (8u)         // 朝向可靠的最小像素数 (94×60 下按面积比例从 188×120 的 30 下调)
#define OM_ORIENTATION_ALPHA      (0.4f)       // 朝向低通滤波系数 (喂给 lowPassFilter, 越大越跟随/越小越平滑)
#define OM_POSITION_ALPHA         (0.5f)       // 位置低通滤波系数 (喂给 lowPassFilter, 越大越跟随/越小越平滑)
#define OM_BORDER_MARGIN          (1u)         // 画幅边缘安全边距

#endif  // OPENMORPH_CONFIG_H

===== TABLE 1 =====
秦华骏 | 窦林禹吉 | 魏志豪 | 潘雅琴

===== TABLE 2 =====
符号或缩写 | 含义 | 单位或取值
Core0～Core4 | 生产控制系统的五个 CYT4BB7 双核逻辑节点；Core0/Core1 共载于主飞控PCB | —
CoreT3 | 独立原始图像录制与调试板 | —
vx、vy | 统一规划中的车体系前向、横向速度意图 | m/s
wz | 统一规划中的偏航角速度意图 | rad/s
errFwd、errRight | 目标相对动态中心的车体系前向、横向误差 | 规划内部量
u、v | 图像平面横向、纵向坐标 | pixel
ToF | Time of Flight，飞行高度测距传感器 | mm
IMU | Inertial Measurement Unit，惯性测量单元 | —
KF | Kalman Filter，水平速度估计中的卡尔曼滤波 | —
TD | Tracking Differentiator，规划输出整形环节 | —
KVM | Core0 实体按键到多板菜单的租约式路由机制 | —
DTO | 跨核传输的数据对象 | —
CRC | 循环冗余校验 | —
Live RAM | 当前编辑并被运行消费者使用的参数工作副本 | —
Runtime | 独立于参数库、可在上电时恢复的运行参数 | —
Library Slot | 整机参数库槽，编号 1～5 | —
CODE-CONFIRMED | 当前源码和调用链已核实 | 证据等级
BUILD-CONFIRMED | 指定提交和 IAR 配置构建通过 | 证据等级
HW-CONFIRMED | 指定固件、板卡、接线和场景实测通过 | 证据等级
NEEDS-EVIDENCE | 当前证据不足或不适用于当前基线 | 证据等级
Host/回放 | 指定主机回归或记录回放；作为验证方法绑定到提交和输入范围，不单独构成正式证据等级 | 支撑证据

===== TABLE 3 =====
系统问题 | 常规实现 | 本工程机制 | 直接价值 | 适用边界
目标跨出单相机视野 | 丢失后在新画面重新确认，或每拍选择最近候选 | 三源本地跟踪、统一车体系、精确身份保持与全来源重新评分 | 减少重复确认和计划硬复位的机会 | 不具备跨相机全局ID，多灯交叉仍可能误接管
飞机与车辆协同 | 两端分别规划，用启停量粗同步 | Core1产生唯一 vx/vy/wz，两端分别执行动力学闭环 | 统一任务意图，减少互相冲突的局部决策 | 不保证瞬时速度相同或轨迹误差为零
多节点故障恢复 | 仅依据在线位或收到任意新帧恢复 | 分类故障、首因锁存、session/sequence/freshness与零帧fence | 防止旧身份和陈旧命令跨重连复活 | 只覆盖已经建模的故障类别
多板参数保存 | 操作员逐板保存和加载 | 五板PREPARE、COMMIT、ACTIVATE、FINISH/ABORT事务 | 避免部分板卡加载造成混合配置 | 不等于Flash瞬时原子写入或任意断电均已验证

===== TABLE 16 =====
消息或事实 | 关键字段 | 接收与失效规则
Observer轨迹 | source、session、trackId、observation sequence、confirmed、位置与预测 | 来源与会话必须匹配，序号必须前进，数值有限且在新鲜窗内；边界拒绝只撤销完全匹配的当前身份
Observer配置 | revision、hash、DetectMode、source profile、APPLIED | peer报告的实际应用tuple与Core1期望完全一致后才允许进入规划候选池
Core1→Core0 MOTION | producer generation、sequence、valid、vx/vy/wz、age | 静默或producer变化后先建立零帧基线；Core0仅接受基线之后的新序号，超过300 ms撤销资格

参数事务消息 | transaction、slot、operation、phase、participant result | 非零事务身份和目标槽必须一致；任一参与者拒绝、超时或应用失败均不能宣布全局完成

===== TABLE 17 =====

===== TABLE 19 =====
术语 | 含义
owner | 对硬件、状态或协议事实拥有唯一写入与生命周期职责的模块
facade | 向调用方提供有限生命周期、命令或快照接口的边界
snapshot | 带身份、序号、新鲜度的一次性一致性数据副本
session | 协议peer的一次启动或绑定身份
bindingEpoch | 物理绑定边沿代次，用于隔离重启前后的旧租约和事件
fresh | 数据身份合法且年龄未越过业务超时
last-good | 最近一次一致读取成功的快照；不能据此刷新新鲜度
EdgeHold | 普通短时遮挡时对预测目标进行有限时间衰减保持
BORDER_REJECTED | 轨迹跨越可信边界后的身份化拒绝事实
fence | 重连后先建立安全零基线，再接受新非零命令的屏障
